verses.skt: rāgādirogān satatānuṣaktān aśeṣakāyaprasṛtān aśeṣān | autsukyamohāratidāñ jaghāna yo ’pūrvavaidyāya namo ’stu tasmai
verses.tib: 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa / rgyun du 'brel pas lus kun ma lus khyab / 'dod dang gti mug khro ba sel ba yi / sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo

verses.skt: āyuḥkāmayamānena dharmārthasukhasādhanam | āyurvedopadeśeṣu vidheyaḥ param ādaraḥ
verses.tib: tshe ni ring par 'dod pa yis / chos dang nor dang bde ba bsgrub / tshe yi rig byed lung bshad pa / rab tu gus par bya bar gyis

verses.skt: brahmā smṛtvāyuṣo vedaṃ prajāpatim ajigrahat | so ’śvinau tau sahasrākṣaṃ so ’triputrādikān munīn
verses.tib: tshangs pas tshe yi rig byed dran / skye dgu'i bdag la bshad pa yin / de yis tha skar des brgya byin / des rgyun shes drang srong la'o

verses.skt: te ’gniveśādikāṃs te tu pṛthak tantrāṇi tenire | tebhyo ’tiviprakīrṇebhyaḥ prāyaḥ sārataroccayaḥ
verses.tib: de yis me bzhin 'jug la / de rnams kyis rgyud so sor byas / shin tu 'thob pa de rnams las / rab ces phal cher btus pa ni

verses.skt: kriyate ’ṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṃ nātisaṃkṣepavistaram | kāyabālagrahordhvāṅgaśalyadaṃṣṭrājarāvṛṣān
verses.tib: shin tu bsdus min rgyas min par / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po byas / lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod / mtshon dang mche ba rgas ro tsa

verses.skt: aṣṭāv aṅgāni tasyāhuś cikitsā yeṣu saṃśritā | vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaś ceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ
verses.tib: gso dpyad gang la gnas pa yi / yan lag brgyad du de bshad do / rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan yang / nyes pa rnam gsum mdor bsdus yin

verses.skt: vikṛtāvikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vartayanti ca | te vyāpino ’pi hṛnnābhyor adhomadhyordhvasaṃśrayāḥ
verses.tib: de ni rnam gyur ma gyur pas / lus ni 'joms dang gnas pa yin / des khyab gyur kyang snying ga dang / lte ba'i 'og bar steng na gnas

verses.skt: vayo'horātribhuktānāṃ te ’ntamadhyādigāḥ kramāt | tair bhaved viṣamas tīkṣṇo mandaś cāgniḥ samaiḥ samaḥ
verses.tib: na tshod nyin zhag zas zos la / de ni mtha' dbus rtogs rim / des ni 'ju ba mi snyoms rno / chung dang mnyam pas mnyam par 'gyur

verses.skt: koṣṭhaḥ krūro mṛdur madhyo madhyaḥ syāt taiḥ samair api | śukrārtavasthair janmādau viṣeṇeva viṣakrimeḥ
verses.tib: de ni lto ba sra snyi ran / mnyam pas kyang ni bar mar 'gyur / skye ba'i dang por khu khrag gnas / dug can srin bu'i dug dang mtshungs

verses.skt: taiś ca tisraḥ prakṛtayo hīnamadhyottamāḥ pṛthak | samadhātuḥ samastāsu śreṣṭhā nindyā dvidoṣajāḥ
verses.tib: de ni rang bzhin rnam gsum ste / chung 'bring chen po so sor lta / ma lus pa la khams mnyam pa / mchog yin nyes pa gnyis 'byung smad

verses.skt: tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaś calo ’nilaḥ | pittaṃ sasnehatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam
verses.tib: de la rlung ni rtsub cing yang / grang zhing sra la phra zhing g.yo / mkhris pa smum bcas rno zhing dro / yang zhing dri mnam 'khru zhing gsher

verses.skt: snigdhaḥ śīto gurur mandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ | saṃsargaḥ saṃnipātaś ca taddvitrikṣayakopataḥ
verses.tib: bad kan snum bsil lci ba dang / rtul zhing 'jam brtan 'byar ba gcan / de gnyis gsum zad 'khrugs pa las / ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa yin

verses.skt: rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjaśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ | sapta dūṣyā malā mūtraśakṛtsvedādayo ’pi ca
verses.tib: lus zungs dngas ma khrag dang sha / tshil dang rus rkang khu chu ste / gnod bya bdun yin dri ma gcin / bshang brdul la pa yin

verses.skt: vṛddhiḥ samānaiḥ sarveṣāṃ viparītair viparyayaḥ | rasāḥ svādvamlalavaṇatiktoṣaṇakaṣāyakāḥ
verses.tib: thams cad mnyam pas 'phel 'gyur zhing / de las bzlog pas gnod par 'gyur / ro ni mngar skyur lan tshwa dang / tsha dang kha dang bska ba ste

verses.skt: ṣaḍ dravyam āśritās te ca yathāpūrvaṃ balāvahāḥ | tatrādyā mārutaṃ ghnanti trayas tiktādayaḥ kapham
verses.tib: rdzas drug la gnas de dag kyang / bzhin du stobs chen yin / de las dang po'i gsum po ni / rlung 'joms tshwa bad kan sel

verses.skt: kaṣāyatiktamadhurāḥ pittam anye tu kurvate | śamanaṃ kopanaṃ svasthahitaṃ dravyam iti tridhā
verses.tib: bska dang kha dang mngar ba ni / mkhris sel gzhan dag skyed pa yin / de ltar rdzas ni rnam pa gsum / zhi 'khrugs tha mal gnas la phan

verses.skt: uṣṇaśītaguṇotkarṣāt tatra vīryaṃ dvidhā smṛtam | tridhā vipāko dravyasya svādvamlakaṭukātmakaḥ
verses.tib: de la tsha bsil phul byung bas / nus pa rnam pa gnyis su bshad / rdzas ni khu ba rnam gsum ste / mngar skyur tsha ba'i bdag nyid can

verses.skt: gurumandahimasnigdhaślakṣṇasāndramṛdusthirāḥ | guṇāḥ sasūkṣmaviśadā viṃśatiḥ saviparyayāḥ
verses.tib: yon tan lci rtul bsil dang snum / 'jam dang bska ba mnyen dang brtan / phra dang bcas shing bska bag can / de bzlog pa dang nyi shu yin

verses.skt: kālārthakarmaṇāṃ yogo hīnamithyātimātrakaḥ | samyagyogaś ca vijñeyo rogārogyaikakāraṇam
verses.tib: dus don las kyi sbyor ba rnams / dman dang log par lhag pa dang / yang dag sbyor bas nad dang ni / nad med rgyu gcig yin zhes bya

verses.skt: rogas tu doṣavaiṣamyaṃ doṣasāmyam arogatā | nijāgantuvibhāgena tatra rogā dvidhā smṛtāḥ
verses.tib: nad ni nyes pa ma snyoms yin / nyes pa snyoms pa nad med nyid / de la nad ni rang bzhin gnas / glo bur cha yis gnyis su bshad

verses.skt: teṣāṃ kāyamanobhedād adhiṣṭhānam api dvidhā | rajas tamaś ca manaso dvau ca doṣāv udāhṛtau
verses.tib: de rnams lus sems dbye ba yis / gnas kyang rnam pa gnyis yin no / 'dod chags gti mug kyang yid kyi / nyes pa gnyis su bstan pa yin

verses.skt: darśanasparśanapraśnaiḥ parīkṣeta ca rogiṇam | rogaṃ nidānaprāgrūpalakṣaṇopaśayāptibhiḥ
verses.tib: nad pa blta dang reg pa dang / dris pa yas ni yongs su brtag / nad kyi gzhi yi dang po'i tshul / mtshan nyid nyer bsten 'thob pa yin

verses.skt: bhūmidehaprabhedena deśam āhur iha dvidhā | jāṅgalaṃ vātabhūyiṣṭham anūpaṃ tu kapholbaṇam
verses.tib: sa dang lus kyi bye brag gis / 'di la yul sa rnam gnyis bshad / skams phal cher rlung skyed cing / rlan can bad kan 'phel ba yin

verses.skt: sādhāraṇaṃ samamalaṃ tridhā bhūdeśam ādiśet | kṣaṇādir vyādhyavasthā ca kālo bheṣajayogakṛt
verses.tib: cha mnyam nyes pa mnyam pa ste / sa yi phyogs ni gsum du bshad / skad cig la sogs nad kyi skabs / dus su sman ni sbyor bar byed

verses.skt: śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ ceti samāsād auṣadhaṃ dvidhā | śarīrajānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramauṣadham
verses.tib: mdor na sman ni rnam gnyis te / sbyang ba dang ni zhi ba'o / lus las byung ba'i nad rnams kyi / rim gyis sman gyi dam pa ni

verses.skt: vastir vireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu | dhīdhairyātmādivijñānaṃ manodoṣauṣadhaṃ param
verses.tib: mas gtong bkru sman slon sman dang / de bzhin til mar mar sbrang rtsi / blo dang brtan bdag shes pa / sems kyi nyes pa'i sman mchog yin

verses.skt: bhiṣag dravyāṇy upasthātā rogī pādacatuṣṭayam | cikitsitasya nirdiṣṭaṃ pratyekaṃ tac caturguṇam
verses.tib: gso ba dag tu bstan pa ni / sman pa sman dang nad g.yog dang / nad pa yan lag rnam bzhi ste / re re'ang rnam pa bzhi bzhi yin

verses.skt: dakṣas tīrthāttaśāstrārtho dṛṣṭakarmā śucir bhiṣak | bahukalpaṃ bahuguṇaṃ saṃpannaṃ yogyam auṣadham
verses.tib: sman pa mkhas stegs gzhung don shes / las rnams mthong bzhin gtsang ba yin / sman ni cho ga mang po dang / yon tan mang ldan phun tshogs 'phrod

verses.skt: anuraktaḥ śucir dakṣo buddhimān paricārakaḥ | āḍhyo rogī bhiṣagvaśyo jñāpakaḥ sattvavān api
verses.tib: nad g.yog rjes brtse gtsang sbra can / sgrim zhing blo dang ldan pa yin / nad pa phyug cing bsgo ba nyan / shes par nus shing snying stobs ldan

verses.skt: sādhyo ’sādhya iti vyādhir dvidhā tau tu punar dvidhā | susādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaś ca yāpyo yaś cānupakramaḥ
sarvauṣadhakṣame dehe yūnaḥ puṃso jitātmanaḥ | amarmago ’lpahetvagrarūparūpo ’nupadravaḥ
verses.tib: sman kun bzod par nus pa'i lus / skyes bu gzhon zhing bdag nyid thul / gnad du ma song rgyu sngar tshul / mtshan nyid chung dang gnod pa med

verses.skt: atulyadūṣyadeśartuprakṛtiḥ pādasaṃpadi | graheṣv anuguṇeṣv ekadoṣamārgo navaḥ sukhaḥ
verses.tib: gnod bya yul dus rang bzhin rnams / mtshungs min yan lag phun sum tshogs / bza' ni rjes su mthun pa la / nyes pa lam gcig gsar gso sla

verses.skt: śastrādisādhanaḥ kṛcchraḥ saṃkare ca tato gadaḥ | śeṣatvād āyuṣo yāpyaḥ pathyābhyāsād viparyaye
verses.tib: gso ba dka' zhing de las 'dres / tshe yi lhag ma lus phyir 'tsho / go bzlog pa la goms phan nyid

verses.skt: anupakrama eva syāt sthito ’tyantaviparyaye | autsukyamohāratikṛd dṛṣṭariṣṭo ’kṣanāśanaḥ
verses.tib: bcos pa'i thabs med nyid du 'gyur / shin tu phyin ci log par gnas / 'dod dang rmongs dang khro bar byed / 'chi ltas snang zhing dbang po nyams

verses.skt: tyajed ārtaṃ bhiṣagbhūpair dviṣṭaṃ teṣāṃ dviṣaṃ dviṣam | hīnopakaraṇaṃ vyagram avidheyaṃ gatāyuṣam
verses.tib: sman pa rgyal po la sdang dang / de dang mi mdza' sdang ba dang / yo byad mi 'byor brel ba dang / nyan du mi btub tshe zad dang

verses.skt: caṇḍaṃ śokāturaṃ bhīruṃ kṛtaghnaṃ vaidyamāninam | tantrasyāsya paraṃ cāto vakṣyate ’dhyāyasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.tib: gtum zhing mya ngan la mnan 'jigs / byas pa mi gzo sman brnyas spangs / de nas gzhan yang rgyud 'di yi / le'u bsdus pa bshad bya ste

verses.skt: āyuṣkāmadinartvīhārogānutpādanadravāḥ | annajñānānnasaṃrakṣāmātrādravyarasāśrayāḥ
verses.tib: tshe ring nyin re / dus spyod dang / nad med bya dang btung ba dang / zas shes bya dang zas bsdam dang / zas tshod sman dang ro la gnas

verses.skt: doṣādijñānatadbhedataccikitsādvyupakramāḥ | śuddhyādisnehanasvedarekāsthāpananāvanam
verses.tib: nad shes bya dang de'i dbye ba / de gso ba dang gso thabs gnyis / sbyang snum chos khrus brta bya

verses.skt: dhūmagaṇḍūṣadṛksekatṛptiyantrakaśastrakam | sirāvidhiḥ śalyavidhiḥ śastrakṣārāgnikarmikau
verses.tib: sman dung khar dor mig bkru dang / gso dang dbyung thabs zug rngu mtshon / gtar dpyad zug rngu dbyung ba'i dpyad / mtshon dang thal sman me btsa'i las

verses.skt: sūtrasthānam ime ’dhyāyās triṃśac chārīram ucyate | garbhāvakrāntitadvyāpadaṅgamarmavibhāgikam
verses.tib: mdog nas le'u sum cu ni / 'di yin lus kyi brjod bya ste / mngal du 'jug dang de'i nad dang / yan lag gnad kyi bye brag dang

verses.skt: vikṛtir dūtajaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ nidānaṃ sārvarogikam | jvarāsṛkśvāsayakṣmādimadādyarśo'tisāriṇām
verses.tib: rnam 'gyur bang chen las byung drug / nad kun 'byung ba'i nad gzhi dang / rims khrag dbugs mi bde gcong

verses.skt: mūtrāghātapramehāṇāṃ vidradhyādyudarasya ca | pāṇḍukuṣṭhānilārtānāṃ vātāsrasya ca ṣoḍaśa
verses.tib: chang dang gzhang 'brum tshad pa'i nad / chu 'gags gcin ni snyi ba dang / khong 'bras dmu rdzing dag dang ni / skya rbab mdze nad rlung gis gzir / dreg nag dag dang bcu drug yin

verses.skt: cikitsitaṃ jvare rakte kāse śvāse ca yakṣmaṇi | vamau madātyaye ’rśaḥsu viṣi dvau dvau ca mūtrite
verses.tib: rims nad gso dang khrag dang ni / lud pa dbugs mi bde dang gcong / slon dang chang nad gzhang 'brum dang / tshad nad pho ba gcin nad gnyis

verses.skt: vidradhau gulmajaṭharapāṇḍuśophavisarpiṣu | kuṣṭhaśvitrānilavyādhivātāsreṣu cikitsitam
verses.tib: khong 'bras skran dang dmu rdzing dang / sbya rbab 'or nad me dbal dang / mdze dang sha bkra rlung nad dang / drag nad gso ba'i dpyad rnams te

verses.skt: dvāviṃśatir ime ’dhyāyāḥ kalpasiddhir ataḥ param | kalpo vamer virekasya tatsiddhir vastikalpanā
verses.tib: le'u nyi shu gnyis 'di yin / de las gzhan pa cho ga grub / skyug sman bkru sman cho ga dang

verses.skt: siddhir vastyāpadāṃ ṣaṣṭho dravyakalpo ’ta uttaram | bālopacāre tadvyādhau tadgrahe dvau ca bhūtage
verses.tib: de grub mas gtong cho ga dang / mas gtong nyes grub drug pa ni / sman yin de nas phyi ma ni / byis pa nyer spyod de'i nad dang / de gdon 'byung por gtogs pa gnyis

verses.skt: unmāde ’tha smṛtibhraṃśe dvau dvau vartmasu saṃdhiṣu | dṛktamoliṅganāśeṣu trayo dvau dvau ca sarvage
verses.tib: smyo dang brjed byed gnyis gnyis / mig chu rdzi ma'i grwa mtshams dang / mig 'bras rab rib mthong nyams gsum / gnyis gnyis kun la 'gro ba yin

verses.skt: karṇanāsāmukhaśirovraṇe bhaṅge bhagandare | granthyādau kṣudrarogeṣu guhyaroge pṛthag dvayam
verses.tib: rna nad sna dang kha nad mgo'i / rma dang chag grugs mtshan bar rdol / 'bras phra mo'i nad rnams dang / gsang ba'i nad ni tha dad gnyis

verses.skt: viṣe bhujaṅge kīṭeṣu mūṣakeṣu rasāyane | catvāriṃśo ’napatyānām adhyāyo bījapoṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: dug dang sbrul dang srin bu'i dug / byi ba dang ni bcud kyis len / bu med sa bon gso ba ste / le'u bzhi bcu nyid yin no

verses.skt: ity adhyāyaśataṃ viṃśaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ sthānair udīritam
verses.tib: de ltar le'u ni brgya nyi shu / gnas ni drug tu bshad pa yin

verses.skt: brāhme muhūrta uttiṣṭhet svastho rakṣārtham āyuṣaḥ | śarīracintāṃ nirvartya kṛtaśaucavidhis tataḥ
verses.tib: bde gnas tshe ni bsrung ba'i phyir / yud tsam tshangs phyir gnas te langs / lus kyi bya ba rdzogs byas nas / de nas gtsang sbra'i cho ga bya

verses.skt: arkanyagrodhakhadirakarañjakakubhādijam | prātar bhuktvā ca mṛdvagraṃ kaṣāyakaṭutiktakam
verses.tib: arka n+ya gro d+ha seng ldeng / ka rany+dza ka ku la / bska dang tsha dang kha ba dag / rtse 'jam nang par zas spyad nas

verses.skt: kanīnyagrasamasthaulyaṃ praguṇaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam | bhakṣayed dantapavanaṃ dantamāṃsāny abādhayan
verses.tib: so dang rnyil la ma gnod par / so yi dag byed bca' bar bya / ma zhu slon bro dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: nādyād ajīrṇavamathuśvāsakāsajvarārditī | tṛṣṇāsyapākahṛnnetraśiraḥkarṇāmayī ca tat
verses.tib: lud pa lu rims kha yon can / skom zhing kha skams snying mig rna / mgo bo na bas 'di mi bca'

verses.skt: sauvīram añjanaṃ nityaṃ hitam akṣṇos tato bhajet | cakṣus tejomayaṃ tasya viśeṣāc chleṣmato bhayam
verses.tib: rtag tu mig sman skyer khaN+Da / mig la phan pas de phyir bsten / de ni me yi rang bzhin te / lhag par bad kan la 'jigs pas

verses.skt: bhuktavāṃś ca śiraḥsnātaḥ śrāntaḥ chardananāvanaiḥ | rātrau jāgaritaś cāpi nāñjyāj jvarita eva ca
yojayet saptarātre ’smāt srāvaṇārthaṃ rasāñjanam | tato nāvanagaṇḍūṣadhūmatāmbūlabhāg bhavet
verses.tib: mchi ma 'dzag phyir skyer khaN+Da / zhag bdun zhing ni blugs par bya / de nas sna sman mkhur bkang dor / dud pa so rtsi bsten par bya

verses.skt: tāmbūlaṃ kṣatapittāsrarūkṣotkupitacakṣuṣām | viṣamūrchāmadārtānām apathyaṃ śoṣiṇām api
verses.tib: so rtsi glo 'grams mkhris pa khrag / rtsub pas mig ni na ba dang / dug gis brgyal zhing chang nad gzir / lus skem gyur la gnod pa yin

verses.skt: abhyaṅgam ācaren nityaṃ sa jarāśramavātahā | dṛṣṭiprasādapuṣṭyāyuḥsvapnasutvaktvadārḍhyakṛt
verses.tib: rtag tu bsku byug spyod byed na / de ni rgas ngal rlung 'joms yin / mig gsal lus rgyas tshe 'phel zhing / gnyid 'od pags 'jam rtas byed yin

verses.skt: śiraḥśravaṇapādeṣu taṃ viśeṣeṇa śīlayet | varjyo ’bhyaṅgaḥ kaphagrastakṛtasaṃśuddhyajīrṇibhiḥ
verses.tib: des ni mgo dang rna ba dang / rkang pa khyad par rtag tu brtan / bad kan skyes dang ma zhu dang / bkru sman btang bsku byug spang

verses.skt: lāghavaṃ karmasāmarthyaṃ dīpto ’gnir medasaḥ kṣayaḥ | vibhaktaghanagātratvaṃ vyāyāmād upajāyate
verses.tib: yang zhing las ni nus pa dang / me yi drod skyed tshul 'bri la / lus kyi skabs phyed mkhregs pa nyid / rtsol ba las ni 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vātapittāmayī bālo vṛddho ’jīrṇo ca taṃ tyajet | ardhaśaktyā niṣevyas tu balibhiḥ snigdhabhojibhiḥ
verses.tib: rlung mkhris nad can byis pa dang / rgas shing 'khogs pas de spang bya / stobs ldan snum bag za ba dang

verses.skt: śītakāle vasante ca mandam eva tato ’nyadā | taṃ kṛtvānusukhaṃ dehaṃ mardayec ca samantataḥ
verses.tib: grang ba'i dus dang dpyid dus dang / nus ldan dag gis de bsten bya / de las gzhan tshe dal ba nyid / de byas ci bder lus dag ni / kun / nas yongs su mnye bar bya

verses.skt: tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ pratamako raktapittaṃ śramaḥ klamaḥ | ativyāyāmataḥ kāso jvaraś chardiś ca jāyate
verses.tib: shin tu rtsol bas lud pa dang / skom dang gcong can mi dran mun / khrag dang mkhris rgyas ngal dang dub / rims dang slon pa 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vyāyāmajāgarādhvastrīhāsyabhāṣyādisāhasam | gajaṃ siṃha ivākarṣan bhajann ati vinaśyati
verses.tib: rtsol ba mi nyal lam bud med / dgod dang smra sogs shugs 'byin dang / seng ges glang po drangs pa bzhin / shin tu drags pas ma rung 'gyur

verses.skt: udvartanaṃ kaphaharaṃ medasaḥ pravilāyanam | sthirīkaraṇam aṅgānāṃ tvakprasādakaraṃ param
verses.tib: dril phyis bad kan sel ba dang / tshil ni rab tu zhu byed cing / yan lag brtan par byed pa dang / pags pa gsal bar byed pa'i mchog

verses.skt: dīpanaṃ vṛṣyam āyuṣyaṃ snānam ūrjābalapradam | kaṇḍūmalaśramasvedatandrātṛḍdāhapāpmajit
verses.tib: khrus ni drod skyed ro tsa dang / tshe dang mdangs dang stobs rab skyed / g.ya' dang dri ma ngal dang rdul / snyom skom lus tsha mi shis sel

verses.skt: uṣṇāmbunādhaḥkāyasya pariṣeko balāvahaḥ | tenaiva tūttamāṅgasya balahṛtkeśacakṣuṣām
verses.tib: chu dron gyis ni lus kyi smad / blugs shing bkrus pa stobs skyed yin / de nyid mgor blugs khrus byas na / skra dang mig gi stobs 'phrog yin

verses.skt: snānam arditanetrāsyakarṇarogātisāriṣu | ādhmānapīnasājīrṇabhuktavatsu ca garhitam
verses.tib: khrus ni 'gram chags mig nad dang / rna ba'i nad dang tshad pas 'khru / lto sbos cham pa ma zhu dang / zos ma thag pa rnams la smad

verses.skt: jīrṇe hitaṃ mitaṃ cādyān na vegān īrayed balāt | na vegito ’nyakāryaḥ syān nājitvā sādhyam āmayam
verses.tib: zhu nas phan zhing ran par za / bshang nan gyis brnag mi bya / shugs ma phyung bar gzhan mi bya / gnod las mi bde bar ma yin

verses.skt: sukhārthāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ matāḥ sarvāḥ pravṛttayaḥ | sukhaṃ ca na vinā dharmāt tasmād dharmaparo bhavet
verses.tib: sems can thams cad bde 'dod phyir / rtsom pa kun la 'jug par 'dod / bde bar chos med par ma yin / de bas chos la brtson par bya

verses.skt: bhaktyā kalyāṇamitrāṇi sevetetaradūragaḥ | hiṃsāsteyān yathākāmaṃ paiśunyaṃ paruṣānṛte
verses.tib: mos pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten / cig shos ring du spang bar bya / 'tshe dang brku dang 'dod log spyod / phra ma ngag rtsub tshig dang

verses.skt: saṃbhinnālāpaṃ vyāpādam abhidhyāṃ dṛgviparyayam | pāpaṃ karmeti daśadhā kāyavāṅmānasais tyajet
verses.tib: mi 'brel smra dang gnod sems dang / brnab sems lta ba phyin ci log / de ltar sdig pa'i las rnams bcu / lus ngag yid kyis spang bar bya

verses.skt: avṛttivyādhiśokārtān anuvarteta śaktitaḥ | ātmavat satataṃ paśyed api kīṭapipīlikam
verses.tib: phongs pa nad pa mya ngan gzir / ci nus par ni phan gdags bya / 'bu srin grog sbur dag la yang / rang dang 'dra bar rtag tu blta

verses.skt: arcayed devagovipravṛddhavaidyanṛpātithīn | vimukhān nārthinaḥ kuryān nāvamanyeta nākṣipet
verses.tib: lha dang dge slong bram ze dang / sman pa rgan rgyal mgron pos mchod / slong la rgyab kyis phyogs mi bya / brnyas par mi bya tshar mi gcad

verses.skt: upakārapradhānaḥ syād apakārapare ’py arau | saṃpadvipatsv ekamanā hetāv īrṣyet phale na tu
verses.tib: gnod par byed brtson dgra gzhan la'ang / phan gdags pa ni gtso cher bya / 'byor dang rgud la'ang yid gcig bya / rgyu la phrag dog 'bras bu min

verses.skt: kāle hitaṃ mitaṃ brūyād avisaṃvādi peśalam | pūrvābhibhāṣī sumukhaḥ suśīlaḥ karuṇāmṛduḥ
verses.tib: dus su phan dang ran par smra / slu ba med cing nges par bya / bzhin 'dzum gsong por smra ba dang / spyod pa bzang zhing snying rje 'jam

verses.skt: naikaḥ sukhī na sarvatra viśrabdho na ca śaṅkitaḥ | na kañcid ātmanaḥ śatruṃ nātmānaṃ kasyacid ripum
verses.tib: gcig pu bde min thams cad la / yid mi brtan zhing dogs mi bya / su yang bdag gi dgra yin dang / bdag ni su yi dgrar gyur dang

verses.skt: prakāśayen nāpamānaṃ na ca niḥsnehatāṃ prabhoḥ | janasyāśayam ālakṣya yo yathā parituṣyati
verses.tib: brnyas dang bdag la gtso bo ni / mi byams zhes ni smra mi bya / 'gro ba'i bsam pa shes nas ni / gang zhig ji ltar yongs mgu ba

verses.skt: taṃ tathaivānuvarteta parārādhanapaṇḍitaḥ | na pīḍayed indriyāṇi na caitāny ati lālayet
verses.tib: de la de bzhin rjes 'jug cing / gzhan dag dga' byed mdzangs pa yin / dbang po gzir bar mi bya zhing / 'di rab nyams bder bya ba'ang min

verses.skt: trivargaśūnyaṃ nārambhaṃ bhajet taṃ cāvirodhayan | anuyāyāt pratipadaṃ sarvadharmeṣu madhyamām
verses.tib: tshoms gsum med pa'i rtsom pa la / mi bsten de dang 'gal mi bya / chos rnams kun gyi lam la ni / dbu ma'i lam gyi rjes 'jug bya

verses.skt: nīcaromanakhaśmaśrur nirmalāṅghrimalāyanaḥ | snānaśīlaḥ susurabhiḥ suveṣo ’nulbaṇojjvalaḥ
verses.tib: skra sen kha spu ring mi gzhag / sgo dgu rkang pa dri med bya / khrus la dga' zhing dri zhim bsgo / cha lugs bzang zhing mi 'phyar spa

verses.skt: dhārayet satataṃ ratnasiddhamantramahauṣadhīḥ | sātapatrapadatrāṇo vicared yugamātradṛk
verses.tib: rin chen grub pa'i gsang sngags dang / sman chen rtag tu bcang bar bya / gdugs dkar lham dang ldan pa ni / gnya' shing gang tsam blta zhing 'gro

verses.skt: niśi cātyayike kārye daṇḍī maulī sahāyavān | caityapūjyadhvajāśastacchāyābhasmatuṣāśucīn
verses.tib: mtshan mo don chen dag la ni / dbyig thogs mgo dkri grogs ldan bya / mchod rten mchod bya rgyal mtshan dang / mi shis grib ma thal phub dang

verses.skt: nākrāmec charkarāloṣṭabalisnānabhuvo na ca | nadīṃ taren na bāhubhyāṃ nāgniskandham abhivrajet
verses.tib: mi gtsang gseg bod gtor ma dang / khrus byas sa ni 'gom mi bya / chu bor rgyal te 'gro mi bya / me chen phung por 'gro mi bya

verses.skt: saṃdigdhanāvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ ca nārohed duṣṭayānavat | nāsaṃvṛtamukhaḥ kuryāt kṣutihāsyavijṛmbhaṇam
verses.tib: the tshom bcas pa'i gru shing la / bzhon pa mi bsrun bzhin mi 'dzeg / sbrid pa gad mo glal ba la / kha ni gdangs par mi bya'o

verses.skt: nāsikāṃ na vikuṣṇīyān nākasmād vilikhed bhuvam | nāṅgaiś ceṣṭeta viguṇaṃ nāsītotkaṭakaś ciram
verses.tib: sna ni brud par mi bya zhing / don med sa ris mi bya'o / lus kyi yan lag mi gcu zhing / tsog tsog por yang 'dug mi bya

verses.skt: dehavākcetasāṃ ceṣṭāḥ prāk śramād vinivartayet | nordhvajānuś ciraṃ tiṣṭhen naktaṃ seveta na drumam
verses.tib: lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa ni / snga nas ngal las bzlog par bya / bus 'greng yun gnas mi bya / mtshan mo shing drung bsten mi bya

verses.skt: tathā catvaracaityāntaścatuṣpathasurālayān | sūnāṭavīśūnyagṛhaśmaśānāni divāpi na
verses.tib: sum mdo mchod rten drung bzhi mdo / lha'i khang pa yang de bzhin no / gsod sa 'brog stong khang stong dang / dur khrod du ni nyin mo'ang min

verses.skt: asaṃmārjitam ādarśam anupaskṛtakāminīm | rajasvalāṃ ca nekṣeta sadā prātar amaṅgalam
sarvathekṣeta nādityaṃ na bhāraṃ śirasā vahet | nekṣeta pratataṃ sūkṣmaṃ dīptāmedhyāpriyāṇi ca
verses.tib: rnam kun nyi ma la mi blta / mgo yis khur ni bskur mi bya / shin tu phra dang 'tsher ba dang / mi gtsang mi sdug rgyun mi blta

verses.skt: madyavikrayasaṃdhānadānādānāni nācaret | purovātātaparajastuṣāraparuṣānilān
verses.tib: chang 'tshong ba dang sbyor ba dag / sbyin dang len la spyad mi bya / mdun gyi ser bu nyi tshan rdul / ba mo dang ni rlung rtsub dang

verses.skt: anṛjuḥ kṣavathūdgārakāsasvapnānnamaithunam | kūlacchāyāṃ nṛpadviṣṭaṃ vyāladaṃṣṭriviṣāṇinaḥ
verses.tib: sbrid bsgregs pa lud pa zas / gnyid log nyal po gcu mi bya / gad kha'i grib ma rgyal po sdang / sbrul gdug gcan gzan rwa can dang

verses.skt: hīnānāryātinipuṇasevāṃ vigraham uttamaiḥ | saṃdhyāsv abhyavahārastrīsvapnādhyayanacintanam
verses.tib: dus mtshams dag tu zas bza' dang / bud med nyal klog sems las dang

verses.skt: śatrusattragaṇākīrṇagaṇikāpaṇikāśanam | gātravaktranakhair vādyaṃ hastakeśāvadhūnanam
verses.tib: dgra bo'i nar mar zan tshogs 'dus / smad 'tshong tshong pa'i zas dag dang / lus dang mchu dang sen sgra 'byin / lag pa skra ni sprugs pa dang

verses.skt: toyāgnipūjyamadhyena yānaṃ dhūmaṃ śavāśrayam | madyātisaktiṃ viśrambhasvātantrye strīṣu ca tyajet
verses.tib: chu me mchod bya'i bar du 'gro / ro bsregs la brten dud pa dang / chang chags dang bud med la / yid rton rang dbang gyur pa spang

verses.skt: ācāryaḥ sarvaceṣṭāsu loka eva hi dhīmataḥ | anukuryāt tam evāto laukike ’rthe parīkṣakaḥ
verses.tib: blo ldan spyod pa thams cad la / 'jig rten nyid ni slob dpon yin / de bas 'jig rten pa yi don / rtogs par byed pas de nyid bya

verses.skt: ārdrasaṃtānatā tyāgaḥ kāyavākcetasāṃ damaḥ | svārthabuddhiḥ parārtheṣu paryāptam iti sadvratam
verses.tib: snying rjes brlan zhing gtong dang ldan / lus dang ngag yid dul ba dang / gzhan gyi don la rang don sems / de dag dam pa'i spyod mthar thug

verses.skt: naktandināni me yānti kathambhūtasya saṃprati | duḥkhabhāṅ na bhavaty evaṃ nityaṃ saṃnihitasmṛtiḥ
verses.tib: da ltar bdag ni nyin mtshan du / ji lta bur ni gnas 'gro zhes / rtag tu dran pa nyer 'jog pa / sdug bsngal snod du mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: evaṃ kṛtsnadinaṃ nītvā rātrau yāme gṛhe gate | devān ṛṣīn gurūn smṛtvā tataḥ śayanam ācaret
ity ācāraḥ samāsena yaṃ prāpnoti samācaran | āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ yaśo lokāṃś ca śāśvatān
verses.tib: de ltar spyod pa mdor bsdus pas / gang zhig kun tu spyod byed pa / tshe dang nad med dbang phyug dang / grags pa 'jig rten rtag 'thob 'gyur

verses.skt: māsair dvisaṃkhyair māghādyaiḥ kramāt ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ | śiśiro ’tha vasantaś ca grīṣmo varṣāśaraddhimāḥ
verses.tib: dgun zla ra ba gnyis gnyis / rim bzhin dus ni drug tu bshad

verses.skt: śiśirādyās tribhis tais tu vidyād ayanam uttaram | ādānaṃ ca tad ādatte nṛṇāṃ pratidinaṃ balam
verses.tib: de las dgun zla tha / gsum ni byang du 'gro zhes bya / de tshe mi rnams nyin re bzhin / mthu 'phrogs pa zhes bya ba yin

verses.skt: tasmin hy atyarthatīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣā mārgasvabhāvataḥ | ādityapavanāḥ saumyān kṣapayanti guṇān bhuvaḥ
verses.tib: de tshe shin tu rno / zhing tsha / rtsub pa'i las kyi ngo bo nyid / nyi ma rlung gi zla ba yi / sa yi yon tan zad par byed

verses.skt: tiktaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaṭuko balino ’tra rasāḥ kramāt | tasmād ādānam āgneyam ṛtavo dakṣiṇāyanam
verses.tib: 'dir ni tshab ska kha ba yi / ro rnams stobs ni che ba yin / de bas me ni mthu stobs 'phrog / lho phyogs su ni 'gro ba'i dus

verses.skt: varṣādayo visargaś ca yad balaṃ visṛjaty ayam | saumyatvād atra somo hi balavān hīyate raviḥ
verses.tib: dbyar la sogs pa'i slar stobs skyed / 'di stobs slar ni skyed pas na / 'dir ni bsil bas zla ba ni / stobs dang ldan pas nyi ma 'bri

verses.skt: meghavṛṣṭyanilaiḥ śītaiḥ śāntatāpe mahītale | snigdhāś cehāmlalavaṇamadhurā balino rasāḥ
verses.tib: char 'bab pa dang rlung bsil bas / sa stengs tsha ba zhi ba na / 'dir ni snum dang skyur lan tshwa / mngar ba'i ro rnams mthu skyed do

verses.skt: śīte ’gryaṃ vṛṣṭigharme ’lpaṃ balaṃ madhyaṃ tu śeṣayoḥ | balinaḥ śītasaṃrodhād dhemante prabalo ’nalaḥ
verses.tib: dgun tshe char dang tsha dus su / stobs chung lhag ma dag la 'bring / stobs ldan grang bas bkag pas na / dgun gyi dus su me stobs ldan

verses.skt: bhavaty alpendhano dhātūn sa paced vāyuneritaḥ | ato hime ’smin seveta svādvamlalavaṇān rasān
verses.tib: de ni rlung gis sbar bas na / zas nyung gyur na lus zungs skems / de bas dgun ni mngar skyur dang / lan tshwa'i ro ni bsten par bya

verses.skt: dairghyān niśānām etarhi prātar eva bubhukṣitaḥ | avaśyakāryaṃ saṃbhāvya yathoktaṃ śīlayed anu
verses.tib: de tshe mtshan mo ring bas na / nang par nyid ni bkres par 'gyur / nges par bya ba byas nas ni / ji skad bshad rdzogs de rjes la

verses.skt: vātaghnatailair abhyaṅgaṃ mūrdhni tailaṃ vimardanam | niyuddhaṃ kuśalaiḥ sārdhaṃ pādāghātaṃ ca yuktitaḥ
verses.tib: rlung 'joms til mar gyis byug cing / spyi bo'ang til mar gyis byug mnye / bag yod pa dang stobs 'gyed cing / rkang pas ran par mnye bar bya

verses.skt: kaṣāyāpahṛtasnehas tataḥ snāto yathāvidhi | kuṅkumena sadarpeṇa pradigdho ’gurudhūpitaḥ
verses.tib: de nas bska bas snum bsal la / cho ga bzhin du khrus dag bya / gur gum gla rtsi dang bcas pas / lus bsku a ka ru yis bdug

verses.skt: rasān snigdhān palaṃ puṣṭaṃ gauḍam acchasurāṃ surām | godhūmapiṣṭamāṣekṣukṣīrotthavikṛtīḥ śubhāḥ
verses.tib: sha tshon khu ba snum pa dang / bu ram chang dang chang dang sa chang / gro dang 'bras khur ma sha dang / 'o ma bu ram shing byas bza'

verses.skt: navam annaṃ vasāṃ tailaṃ śaucakārye sukhodakam | prāvārājinakauśeyapraveṇīkaucavāstṛtam
verses.tib: kha zas gsar dang zhag til mar / dro 'jam chu yis gtsang sbra bya / be'u ras slag pa dar go / dre'u rngog re'u bal chen gding

verses.skt: uṣṇasvabhāvair laghubhiḥ prāvṛtaḥ śayanaṃ bhajet | yuktyārkakiraṇān svedaṃ pādatrāṇaṃ ca sarvadā
verses.tib: rang bzhin dro zhing yang ba yi / gos bgo mal la brten par bya / nyi ma'i 'od la ran par 'de / dugs bya lham ni rtag tu bgo

verses.skt: pīvarorustanaśroṇyaḥ samadāḥ pramadāḥ priyāḥ | haranti śītam uṣṇāṅgyo dhūpakuṅkumayauvanaiḥ
verses.tib: chung ma gzhon zhing yid 'ong rgyags / nu ma brla dang ro smad rgyas / gur gum gyis byugs spos kyis bdug / lus kyi drod kyis grang sel ba'o

verses.skt: aṅgāratāpasaṃtaptagarbhabhūveśmacāriṇaḥ | śītapāruṣyajanito na doṣo jātu jāyate
verses.tib: sa khang khang pa nyis rim byas / mdag me'i drod kyis bsros pa ni / grang dang rtsub pa las byung ba'i / nyes pa nam yang mi

verses.skt: ayam eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ śiśire ’pi viśeṣataḥ | tadā hi śītam adhikaṃ raukṣyaṃ cādānakālajam
verses.tib: 'byung ngo / dgun smad dus su lhag par yang / cho ga 'di nyid bya ba yin / de tshe lhag par grang ba dang

verses.skt: kaphaś cito hi śiśire vasante ’rkāṃśutāpitaḥ | hatvāgniṃ kurute rogān atas taṃ tvarayā tyajet
verses.tib: stobs 'phrogs las byung rtsub pa yin / dgun ni bad kan khong na / dpyid dus nyi ma'i 'od dros pa / me yi drod nyams nas skyed de / de bas de ni myur du bsal

verses.skt: tīkṣṇair vamananasyādyair laghurūkṣaiś ca bhojanaiḥ | vyāyāmodvartanāghātair jitvā śleṣmāṇam ulbaṇam
verses.tib: rno dang skyug sman sna sman sogs / yang dang rtsub pa'i kha zas dang / bcag dang lus phyi mnyes pa yis / bad kan bdo ba'i nad bsal bya

verses.skt: snāto ’nuliptaḥ karpūracandanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ | purāṇayavagodhūmakṣaudrajāṅgalaśūlyabhuk
verses.tib: khrus byas ga pur tsan+dan dang / gur gum pas bsku bar bya / nas dang gro ni rnying pa dang / sbrang rtsi skam sa'i bsregs sha bza'

verses.skt: sahakārarasonmiśrān āsvādya priyayārpitān | priyāsyasaṅgasurabhīn priyānetrotpalāṅkitān
verses.tib: a mra'i khu ba dang sbyar ba'i / khu ba skom du sbyar ba btung / chung ma dri zhim ut+pal gyi / mig dang ldan dang lhan cig cing

verses.skt: saumanasyakṛto hṛdyān vayasyaiḥ sahitaḥ pibet | nirgadān āsavāriṣṭasīdhumārdvīkamādhavān
verses.tib: yid ni dga' zhing bder byas pas / grogs dang lhan cig btung bar bya / skyon med chang rgan dro 'jam dang / bu ram rgun chang sbrang chang dang

verses.skt: śṛṅgaverāmbu sārāmbu madhvambu jaladāmbu ca | dakṣiṇānilaśīteṣu parito jalavāhiṣu
verses.tib: sga chu bskol dang se'u'i chu / sbrang chu'am gla sgang chu btung bya / lho phyogs ser bus bsil ba dang / mtha' ma kun tu chu 'bab la

verses.skt: adṛṣṭanaṣṭasūryeṣu maṇikuṭṭimakāntiṣu | parapuṣṭavighuṣṭeṣu kāmakarmāntabhūmiṣu
verses.tib: nyi ma'i 'od ni mi snang dang / nor bu bcag 'dra'i mdangs ldan pa / khu byug snyan pa sgra sgrogs shing / 'dod pa'i longs spyod ldan pa'i sa

verses.skt: vicitrapuṣpavṛkṣeṣu kānaneṣu sugandhiṣu | goṣṭhīkathābhiś citrābhir madhyāhnaṃ gamayet sukhī
verses.tib: sna tshogs me tog ldan pa'i shing / dri zhim skyed mos tshal du ni / dga' 'dun gtam ni sna tshogs pas / phyed du bde bas bde bar bya

verses.skt: guruśītadivāsvapnasnigdhāmlamadhurāṃs tyajet | tīkṣṇāṃśur atitīkṣṇāṃśur grīṣme saṃkṣipatīva yat
verses.tib: lci bsil nyin mo nyal ba dang / snum bag mngar skyur spang bar bya / nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha bas

verses.skt: pratyahaṃ kṣīyate śleṣmā tena vāyuś ca vardhate | ato ’smin paṭukaṭvamlavyāyāmārkakarāṃs tyajet
verses.tib: so ga 'phrog pa 'dra ba yin / de bas de tshe lan tshwa tsha / skyur rtsol nyi ma'i 'od zer spang

verses.skt: bhajen madhuram evānnaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ himaṃ dravam | suśītatoyasiktāṅgo lihyāt saktūn saśarkarān
verses.tib: zas ni mngar dang yang ba dang / snum bsil sla ba nyid bsten bya / rab bsil chu yis lus bkru zhing / phye zan kha rar bcas pa bza'

verses.skt: madyaṃ na peyaṃ peyaṃ vā svalpaṃ subahuvāri vā | anyathā śoṣaśaithilyadāhamohān karoti tat
verses.tib: chang mi btung ste 'thung na yang / nyung ba'am chu mang bsres la btung / gzhan du de ni kha skom lhod / tsha dang rmongs par byed pa yin

verses.skt: kundendudhavalaṃ śālim aśnīyāj jāṅgalaiḥ palaiḥ | pibed rasaṃ nātighanaṃ rasālāṃ rāgakhāṇḍavau
verses.tib: 'bras chan kun+da ltar dkar dang / skam sa'i srog chags sha dag bza' / khu ba mi ska zho dang ni / bu ram sbyar g.yos byas btung / phal cher skyur ba btung bar bya'o

verses.skt: pānakaṃ pañcasāraṃ vā navamṛdbhājane sthitam | mocacocadalair yuktaṃ sāmlaṃ mṛnmayaśuktibhiḥ
verses.tib: snying po lnga yi btung ba ni / kham phor sar pa la gnas pa / chu shing rgya star dum bu bsres / skyur bcas kham phor snod kyis btung

verses.skt: pāṭalāvāsitaṃ cāmbhaḥ sakarpūraṃ suśītalam | śaśāṅkakiraṇān bhakṣyān rajanyāṃ bhakṣayan pibet
verses.tib: chu ni pa ta las bsgos shing / ga bur bcas shing shin tu bsil / zla zer lta bu'i bza' ba ni / mtshan mo'i dus su bza' ba dang

verses.skt: sasitaṃ māhiṣaṃ kṣīraṃ candranakṣatraśītalam | abhraṅkaṣamahāśālatālaruddhoṣṇaraśmiṣu
verses.tib: zla ba skar ma ltar dkar ba'i / ma he'i 'o ma bsil mo btung / sA la ta la chen mo ni / sprin reg tsha ba'i 'od zer sgrib

verses.skt: vaneṣu mādhavīśliṣṭadrākṣāstabakaśāliṣu | sugandhihimapānīyasicyamānapaṭālike
verses.tib: rgun 'bru'i snye ma g.yur za zhing / 'khri shing ldan dang nags tshal bzang / dri bzang khang pa chu yis ni

verses.skt: kāyamāne cite cūtapravālaphalalumbibhiḥ | kadalīdalakalhāramṛṇālakamalotpalaiḥ
verses.tib: bsil khang lus dang 'tsham byas la / chag chag btab dang a mra yi / ldum bu 'bras bu 'phyang ba dang / chu shing 'dab dang kal ltar / pad rtsa pad+ma ut+pal

verses.skt: komalaiḥ kalpite talpe hasatkusumapallave | madhyandine ’rkatāpārtaḥ svapyād dhārāgṛhe ’thavā
verses.tib: me tog rgyas pa dang ldan par / 'jam pa'i gnas mal bcas nas ni / phyed dus nyi mas gdungs pa na / nyal ba'am chu yi khang pa ni

verses.skt: pustastrīstanahastāsyapravṛttośīravāriṇi | niśākarakarākīrṇe saudhapṛṣṭhe niśāsu ca
verses.tib: bud med bcos gzugs nu ma lag / kha las u shir chu 'bab bya / mtshan mo yang thog rdo thal byugs / zla ba'i 'od kyis bsil bar nyal

verses.skt: āsanā svasthacittasya candanārdrasya mālinaḥ | nivṛttakāmatantrasya susūkṣmatanuvāsasaḥ
verses.tib: mal stan bde bar sems bde zhing / tsan+dan lde gu phreng ba thogs / rab tu phra ba'i gos bgos te / 'dod pa'i rgyun las bzlog par bya

verses.skt: jalārdrās tālavṛntāni vistṛtāḥ padminīpuṭāḥ | utkṣepāś ca mṛdūtkṣepā jalavarṣihimānilāḥ
verses.tib: ta la'i bsil yab spos chus btab / pad+ma'i 'dab rgyas rlung yab dang / dal gyis legs par g.yob pa dang / rdzi char ser bu dang ldan bya

verses.skt: karpūramallikāmālā hārāḥ saharicandanāḥ | manoharakalālāpāḥ śiśavaḥ sārikāḥ śukāḥ
verses.tib: ga bur ma li ka'i phreng ba / mu tig do shal tsan+dan dkar / ne tso sha ri ka la / sgra snyan yid 'ong sgrogs pa dang

verses.skt: mṛṇālavalayāḥ kāntāḥ protphullakamalojjvalāḥ | jaṅgamā iva padminyo haranti dayitāḥ klamam
verses.tib: chung ma gdu bu pad rtsa 'dra / pad+ma rgyas pa lta bur mdzes / pad+ma can ni 'gro 'dral / snyom pa sel bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: ādānaglānavapuṣām agniḥ sanno ’pi sīdati | varṣāsu doṣair duṣyanti te ’mbulambāmbude ’mbare
verses.tib: mthu 'phrogs pa ni na ba'i lus / dman pa las kyang dman gyur te / dbyar ni gnod pas gnod gyur te / mkha' la sprin 'dus chu yis brlan

verses.skt: satuṣāreṇa marutā sahasā śītalena ca | bhūbāṣpeṇāmlapākena malinena ca vāriṇā
verses.tib: chu thigs bcas pa'i rlung dang ni / grang ba drag por ldang ba dang / sa yi rlangs pa skyur min dang / chu ni rnyog ma

verses.skt: vahninaiva ca mandena teṣv ity anyo'nyadūṣiṣu | bhajet sādhāraṇaṃ sarvam ūṣmaṇas tejanaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: can dag gis / me drod chung bas gnod par byed / phan tshun gnod pa de la ni / dro zhing me yi stobs skyed pa / thun mong gang yin bsten par bya

verses.skt: āsthāpanaṃ śuddhatanur jīrṇaṃ dhānyaṃ rasān kṛtān | jāṅgalaṃ piśitaṃ yūṣān madhvariṣṭaṃ cirantanam
verses.tib: sbyang bas lus ni dag byas la / zas ni yang bag khu ba bza' / skam sa'i srog chags sha khu dang / sbrang rtsi can ni rnying pa btung

verses.skt: mastu sauvarcalāḍhyaṃ vā pañcakolāvacūrṇitam | divyaṃ kaupaṃ śṛtaṃ cāmbho bhojanaṃ tv atidurdine
verses.tib: dar ba kha ru tshar sbyar ba'am / tsha ba lnga ni phye ma can / khron pa'i chu ni bskol ba'ang rung / char che'i dus su kha zas ni

verses.skt: vyaktāmlalavaṇasnehaṃ saṃśuṣkaṃ kṣaudraval laghu | apādacārī surabhiḥ satataṃ dhūpitāmbaraḥ
verses.tib: rab skyur lan tshwa snum dang bcas / skam zhing sbrang rtsir ldan la yang / rkang gis mi 'gro dri zhim byugs / rtag tu gos ni spos kyis bdug

verses.skt: harmyapṛṣṭhe vased bāṣpaśītasīkaravarjite | nadījalodamanthāhaḥsvapnāyāsātapāṃś tyajet
verses.tib: khang steng du ba mo bsil / char gyi zer spangs gnas par byas / rlung chu dang sbyar skyom dang / nyin gnyid rtsol dang nyi tshan spang

verses.skt: varṣāśītocitāṅgānāṃ sahasaivārkaraśmibhiḥ | taptānāṃ saṃcitaṃ vṛṣṭau pittaṃ śaradi kupyati
verses.tib: dbyar lus bsil bar gyur pa la / 'phral du nyi zer gyis gdungs pas / char 'bab tshe na'ang bsags pa yi / mkhris pa ston ni ldang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tajjayāya ghṛtaṃ tiktaṃ vireko raktamokṣaṇam | tiktaṃ svādu kaṣāyaṃ ca kṣudhito ’nnaṃ bhajel laghu
verses.tib: de bsal phyir ni sman mar kha / bkru sman gtang dang gtar ga bya / kha dang mngar dang bska ba dang / bkres tshe zas ni yang ba bza'

verses.skt: śālimudgasitādhātrīpaṭolamadhujāṅgalam | taptaṃ taptāṃśukiraṇaiḥ śītaṃ śītāṃśuraśmibhiḥ
verses.tib: 'bras chan mung+ga skyu rur / sbrang rtsi skam sa'i pa to la / nyi ma'i zer gyis gdungs pa dang / zla ba'i 'od kyis bsil byas la

verses.skt: samantād apy ahorātram agastyodayanirviṣam | śuci haṃsodakaṃ nāma nirmalaṃ malajij jalam
verses.tib: r-i Shi shar bas dug med pa / nyin mtshan gnyis kar sbyangs chu btung / dngas pa'i dri mad chu zhes pa

verses.skt: nābhiṣyandi na vā rūkṣaṃ pānādiṣv amṛtopamam | candanośīrakarpūramuktāsragvasanojjvalaḥ
verses.tib: dri med dri ma sel 'gyur ba / mi 'brug rtsub pa ma yin pa / btung ba la sogs bdud rtsir mtshungs / tsan+dan ur shing ga pur dang

verses.skt: saudheṣu saudhadhavalāṃ candrikāṃ rajanīmukhe | tuṣārakṣārasauhityadadhitailavasātapān
verses.tib: khang rdo thal gyis dkar zhing / zla zer can du mtshan gnas bya / zil pa thal sman ha cang 'grangs / zho dang til mar zhag nyi tshan

verses.skt: tīkṣṇamadyadivāsvapnapurovātān parityajet | śīte varṣāsu cādyāṃs trīn vasante ’ntyān rasān bhajet
verses.tib: mi bzad chang dang nyin par nyal / mdun gyi ser bu yongs su spang / dgun dang dbyar ni dang po'i gsum / dpyid ni tha ma'i ro gsum bsten

verses.skt: svāduṃ nidāghe śaradi svādutiktakaṣāyakān | śaradvasantayo rūkṣaṃ śītaṃ gharmaghanāntayoḥ
verses.tib: sos ka mngar te ston ka ni / mngar dang kha dang bska ba bsten / mdor na zas dang skom dag ni / ston dang dpyid ni rtsub pa ste

verses.skt: annapānaṃ samāsena viparītam ato ’nyadā | nityaṃ sarvarasābhyāsaḥ svasvādhikyam ṛtāv ṛtau
verses.tib: so ga dbyar mtha' bsil / bar bya / gzhan dag tu ni de las bzlog / rtag tu ro kun bsten pa las / rang rang dus su lhag par bsten

verses.skt: ṛtvor antyādisaptāhāv ṛtusaṃdhir iti smṛtaḥ | tatra pūrvo vidhis tyājyaḥ sevanīyo ’paraḥ kramāt
verses.tib: dus gnyis thog ma'i zhag bdun ni / dus mtshams yin par shes par bya / de ni snga ma'i cho ga spang / 'og ma rim bzhin bsten par bya

verses.skt: asātmyajā hi rogāḥ syuḥ sahasā tyāgaśīlanāt
verses.tib: ma spangs na ni nad 'gyur te / 'phral du nad ni 'ong bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vegān na dhārayed vātaviṇmūtrakṣavatṛṭkṣudhām | nidrākāsaśramaśvāsajṛmbhāśrucchardiretasām
verses.tib: phyi dbugs bshang gci sbrid pa dang / bkres skom gnyid dang lud pa dbugs / glal dang mchil ma skyugs pa dang / khu ba'i shugs ni dgag mi bya

verses.skt: adhovātasya rodhena gulmodāvartarukklamāḥ | vātamūtraśakṛtsaṅgadṛṣṭyagnivadhahṛdgadāḥ
verses.tib: 'phyen ni bkag par gyur pa yis / skran dang rtug skam gzer snyom lci / 'phyen dang bshang gci khong du 'gags / mig rtul drod chung snying nad 'gyur

verses.skt: snehasvedavidhis tatra vartayo bhojanāni ca | pānāni vastayaś caiva śastaṃ vātānulomanam
śakṛtaḥ piṇḍikodveṣṭapratiśyāyaśirorujaḥ | ūrdhvavāyuḥ parīkarto hṛdayasyoparodhanam
verses.tib: bshang 'gags byin pa'i nya 'gyur zhing / cham pas 'debs shing klad pa na / khar ni mi gtsang 'byung ba dang

verses.skt: mukhena viṭpravṛttiś ca pūrvoktāś cāmayāḥ smṛtāḥ | aṅgabhaṅgāśmarīvastimeḍhravaṅkṣaṇavedanāḥ
verses.tib: sngar bshad nad du'ang 'gyur ba yin / gcin 'gags pa yis yan lag na / rde'u chu so pho mtshan dang

verses.skt: mūtrasya rodhāt pūrve ca prāyo rogās tadauṣadham | vartyabhyaṅgāvagāhāś ca svedanaṃ vastikarma ca
verses.tib: dku yi nang na sngar gyi nad / phal cher 'byung ngo de yi sman / reng bu bsku byug lus bcing dang

verses.skt: annapānaṃ ca viḍbhedi viḍrodhottheṣu yakṣmasu | mūtrajeṣu tu pāne ca prāgbhaktaṃ śasyate ghṛtam
verses.tib: dugs dang sman mar mas gtong ba'o / zas skom bshang ba 'gags pa dang

verses.skt: jīrṇāntikaṃ cottamayā mātrayā yojanādvayam | avapīḍakam etac ca saṃjñitaṃ dhāraṇāt punaḥ
verses.tib: bshang 'gags las byung glo gcong mtshungs / chu bkag pa las mar gsar ni / che tshad tsam ni rab tu sbyar

verses.skt: udgārasyāruciḥ kampo vibandho hṛdayorasoḥ | ādhmānakāsahidhmāś ca hidhmāvat tatra bheṣajam
verses.tib: sgregs pa bgag na yi ga 'chus / lus 'dar snying dang brang 'gags na / sbo zhing lud pa skyigs bus 'debs / de'i sman skyigs bu dag dang 'dra

verses.skt: śiro'rtīndriyadaurbalyamanyāstambhārditaṃ kṣuteḥ | tīkṣṇadhūmāñjanāghrāṇanāvanārkavilokanaiḥ
verses.tib: sbrid bkag mgo na dbang mi rno / gnya' rengs kha yo 'gram chags 'gyur / dud rnon gyis bdug mig sman dang / sna sman nyi ma lta ba yis

verses.skt: pravartayet kṣutiṃ saktāṃ snehasvedau ca śīlayet | śoṣāṅgasādabādhiryasaṃmohabhramahṛdgadāḥ
verses.tib: snum dang dugs kyang bsten par bya / skom pa 'gags pas kha skams shing / yan lag mi bde rna mi gsang / mgo 'khor myos shing snying nad 'byung / der bsil cho ga thams cad phan / bkres pas lus / zhig yi ga 'chus / lus snyom nyam chung gzer mgo 'khor

verses.skt: tṛṣṇāyā nigrahāt tatra śītaḥ sarvo vidhir hitaḥ | aṅgabhaṅgāruciglānikārśyaśūlabhramāḥ kṣudhaḥ
verses.tib: snum dang dugs kyang bsten par bya / skom pa 'gags pas kha skams shing / yan lag mi bde rna mi gsang / mgo 'khor myos shing snying nad 'byung / der bsil cho ga thams cad phan / bkres pas lus / zhig yi ga 'chus / lus snyom nyam chung gzer mgo 'khor

verses.skt: tatra yojyaṃ laghu snigdham uṣṇam alpaṃ ca bhojanam | nidrāyā mohamūrdhākṣigauravālasyajṛmbhikāḥ
verses.tib: de la zas yang snum dro dang / chung ba dag ni sbyar bar bya / gnyid bkag khong myos spyi bo mig / lci zhing snyom la glal 'ong zhing

verses.skt: aṅgamardaś ca tatreṣṭaḥ svapnaḥ saṃvāhanāni ca | kāsasya rodhāt tadvṛddhiḥ śvāsārucihṛdāmayāḥ
verses.tib: lus zhig snyam sems de la ni / gnyid log lus mnye phan pa yin / lud pa bkag pas de 'phel zhing / dbugs mi bde zhing yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: śoṣo hidhmā ca kāryo ’tra kāsahā sutarāṃ vidhiḥ | gulmahṛdrogasaṃmohāḥ śramaśvāsād vidhāritāt
verses.tib: snying nad skems byed skyigs bus 'debs / der ni lud pas la cho ga bya / ngal dub dbugs ni bkag pa las / skran dang snying nad myos par 'gyur

verses.skt: hitaṃ viśramaṇaṃ tatra vātaghnaś ca kriyākramaḥ | jṛmbhāyāḥ kṣavavad rogāḥ sarvaś cānilajid vidhiḥ
verses.tib: de la ngal gso bya ba dang / rlung sel bya ba'i cho ga phan / glal bkag na ni sbrid bkag mtshungs / cho ga thams cad rlung 'joms bya

verses.skt: pīnasākṣiśirohṛdruṅmanyāstambhārucibhramāḥ | sagulmā bāṣpatas tatra svapno madyaṃ priyāḥ kathāḥ
verses.tib: mchil ma bkag pas mgo snying na / gnya' rengs yi ga 'chus mgo 'khor / skran bcas sna chu 'dzag 'gyur der / gnyid ngoms chang btung gtam snyan phan

verses.skt: visarpakoṭhakuṣṭhākṣikaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmayajvarāḥ | sakāsaśvāsahṛllāsavyaṅgaśvayathavo vameḥ
verses.tib: skyug bro brnags pas mi dbal mdze / 'bras dang mig nad g.yan pa rims / skya rbab lud pa dbugs mi bde / dang ga ro stod mi bde skrang

verses.skt: gaṇḍūṣadhūmānāhārā rūkṣaṃ bhuktvā tadudvamaḥ | vyāyāmaḥ srutir asrasya śastaṃ cātra virecanam
verses.tib: der kha bkang dbo dud smyung gnas / rtsub bros de nyid skyugs pa dang / rtsol dang myur bar gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: sakṣāralavaṇaṃ tailam abhyaṅgārthaṃ ca śasyate | śukrāt tatsravaṇaṃ guhyavedanāśvayathujvarāḥ
verses.tib: bkru sman gtang ba'ang bsngags pa yin / khu ba bkag pas de 'dzag dang / pho mtshan na dang 'or nad rims

verses.skt: hṛdvyathāmūtrasaṅgāṅgabhaṅgavṛddhyaśmaṣaṇḍhatāḥ | tāmracūḍasurāśālivastyabhyaṅgāvagāhanam
verses.tib: snying nad chu 'gags lus zhig dang / rde'u 'phel dang ma ning 'gyur / de la khyim bya'i sha dang chang / 'bras chan mas gtong lus bcing dang

verses.skt: vastiśuddhikaraiḥ siddhaṃ bhajet kṣīraṃ priyāḥ striyaḥ | tṛṭśūlārtaṃ tyajet kṣīṇaṃ viḍvamaṃ vegarodhinam
verses.tib: chu so'i nad bsal til mar btsos / 'o ma bud med gzhon bsten phan / shugs ni bkag dang btsir ba yis

verses.skt: rogāḥ sarve ’pi jāyante vegodīraṇadhāraṇaiḥ | nirdiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ tatra bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ye tu tān prati
verses.tib: nad ni kun kyang 'byung bar 'gyur / shin tu mang po de yi phyir / gso dpyad mang po 'dir bshad do

verses.skt: tataś cānekadhā prāyaḥ pavano yat prakupyati | annapānauṣadhaṃ tasya yuñjītāto ’nulomanam
verses.tib: de las phal cher rlung du ma / gang phyir 'khrugs par 'gyur bas na / de phyir de'i zas skom dang sman / mnyam par 'gyur bar sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: dhārayet tu sadā vegān hitaiṣī pretya ceha ca | lobherṣyādveṣamātsaryarāgādīnāṃ jitendriyaḥ
verses.tib: 'di dang gzhan du phan 'dod pas / 'dod chen phrag dog zhe sdang dang / ser sna 'dod chags la sogs shugs / rtag bkag dbang po thul bar bya

verses.skt: yateta ca yathākālaṃ malānāṃ śodhanaṃ prati | atyarthasaṃcitās te hi kruddhāḥ syur jīvitacchidaḥ
verses.tib: dri ma rnams ni sbyang ba'i phyir / ji bzhin dus su nan tan bya / de ni shin tu sogs 'gyur na / shas cher 'khrugs pas srog rgyun gcod

verses.skt: doṣāḥ kadācit kupyanti jitā laṅghanapācanaiḥ | ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ
verses.tib: gnod pa smyung dang gzhu byas pas / bsal kyang slar ni ldang srid kyi / gang zhig legs par sbyangs pa dag / de ni slar yang 'byung mi 'gyur

verses.skt: yathākramaṃ yathāyogam ata ūrdhvaṃ prayojayet | rasāyanāni siddhāni vṛṣyayogāṃś ca kālavit
verses.tib: dus shes pa yis de phan chad / rim pa bzhin du ci rigs par / bcud kyis len rnams grub pa dang / ro tsa'i sbyor ba sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: bheṣajakṣapite pathyam āhārair bṛṃhaṇaṃ kramāt | śāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmamudgamāṃsaghṛtādibhiḥ
verses.tib: sman rnams kyis ni lus sbyangs phan / sA lu drug cu pa dang dro / mung+ga sha dang mar la sogs / phan pa'i zas kyis rim lus brtas

verses.skt: hṛdyadīpanabhaiṣajyasaṃyogād rucipaktidaiḥ | sābhyaṅgodvartanasnānanirūhasnehavastibhiḥ
verses.tib: yid 'ong drod skyed sman sbyar ba / yi ga 'byed cing 'ju byed dang / bsku zhang dril phyis khrus byas dang / drag po 'jam rtsi mas gtong brtas

verses.skt: tathā sa labhate śarma sarvapāvakapāṭavam | dhīvarṇendriyavaimalyaṃ vṛṣatāṃ dairghyam āyuṣaḥ
verses.tib: des ni me kun stobs ldan zhing / blo mdog dbang po dri ma med / de bzhin tshe ring ro tsa dang / dpal dang gzi mdangs thob par 'gyur

verses.skt: ye bhūtaviṣavāyvagnikṣatabhaṅgādisaṃbhavāḥ | rāgadveṣabhayādyāś ca te syur āgantavo gadāḥ
verses.tib: 'byung po dugs dang rlung dang me / mtshon smas chag grugs 'byung dang / 'dod chags zhe sdang 'jig tshogs gang / de ni glo bur nad ces bya

verses.skt: tyāgaḥ prajñāparādhānām indriyopaśamaḥ smṛtiḥ | deśakālātmavijñānaṃ sadvṛttasyānuvartanam
verses.tib: shes rab nyes pa spang ba dang / dbang po nyer zhi dran pa dang / yul dus bdag nyid shes pa dang / dam pa'i spyod pa'i rjes 'jug pa

verses.skt: atharvavihitā śāntiḥ pratikūlagrahārcanam | bhūtādyasparśanopāyo nirdiṣṭaś ca pṛthak pṛthak
anutpattyai samāsena vidhir eṣa pradarśitaḥ | nijāgantuvikārāṇām utpannānāṃ ca śāntaye
verses.tib: mdor na ma skyes mi 'byung dang / skyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir / cho ga 'di ni bsten pa yin

verses.skt: śītodbhavaṃ doṣacayaṃ vasante viśodhayan grīṣmajam abhrakāle | ghanātyaye vārṣikam āśu samyak prāpnoti rogān ṛtujān na jātu
verses.tib: grang ba las byung nyes tshogs dpyid kyi tshe / rnam bsal sog las byung dbyar dus na / dbyar bsags sprin bral dus su legs sbyangs na / dus byung nad ni nam yang 'byung mi 'gyur

verses.skt: nityaṃ hitāhāravihārasevī samīkṣyakārī viṣayeṣv asaktaḥ | dātā samaḥ satyaparaḥ kṣamāvān āptopasevī ca bhavaty arogaḥ
verses.tib: rtag tu phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam bsten / brtags te byed cing yul rnams la mi chags / gtong ldan sems snyoms bden brtson bzod dang ldan / nyams ldan sten par byed na nad med 'gyur

verses.skt: jīvanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ hlādi buddhiprabodhanam | tanv avyaktarasaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ śītaṃ laghv amṛtopamam
verses.tib: pa'i gang gA'i chu / 'tsho byed ngoms byed yi gar 'ong / tshim byed sems ni gsal byed la / sla zhing ro mi gsal la zhim / bsil zhing yang ba bdud rtsir mtshungs

verses.skt: gaṅgāmbu nabhaso bhraṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tv arkendumārutaiḥ | hitāhitatve tad bhūyo deśakālāv apekṣate
verses.tib: nyi zla rlung gis reg gyur pa / de ni yul dus la ltos nas / phal / cher phan dang gnod pa yin

verses.skt: yenābhivṛṣṭam amalaṃ śālyannaṃ rājate sthitam | aklinnam avivarṇaṃ ca tat peyaṃ gāṅgam anyathā
verses.tib: gang zhing char 'bab dri ma med / 'bras chan dngul phor nang gnas pa / ma rul mdog kyang ma gyur pa / gang gA'i chu de btung bar bya

verses.skt: sāmudraṃ tan na pātavyaṃ māsād āśvayujād vinā | aindram ambu supātrastham avipannaṃ sadā pibet
verses.tib: gzhan du mtsho chu ston zla ni / 'bring po min par btung mi bya / char pa'i chu ni snod bzang bzhag / 'gyur ba med par rtag tu btung

verses.skt: tadabhāve ca bhūmiṣṭham āntarikṣānukāri yat | śucipṛthvasitaśvete deśe ’rkapavanāhatam
verses.tib: de med na ni thang la gnas / bar snang ba dang rjes mthun yin / sa phyogs dkar nag gtsang zhing yangs / nyi 'od rlung gis phog pa bsngags

verses.skt: na pibet paṅkaśaivālatṛṇaparṇāvilāstṛtam | sūryendupavanādṛṣṭam abhivṛṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ guru
verses.tib: lteng ka 'dam rdzab nya lcibs dang / rtsa dang lo ma rnyog ma can / nyi zla rlung gis ma phog pa / mngon du 'bab dang chu gar lci

verses.skt: phenilaṃ jantumat taptaṃ dantagrāhy atiśaityataḥ | anārtavaṃ ca yad divyam ārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: dbu ba srog chags can dang dro / grang ches so yis mi bzod pa / char gang dus su ma bab dang / dus kyi dang por bab pa gang / srog chags gdug dang ba 'dres

verses.skt: lūtāditantuviṇmūtraviṣasaṃśleṣadūṣitam | paścimodadhigāḥ śīghravahā yāś cāmalodakāḥ
verses.tib: bshang gci dug 'dres gnod mi btung / nub phyogs nas ni rgya mtshor bab / gang yang myur 'bab rdul med chu

verses.skt: pathyāḥ samāsāt tā nadyo viparītās tv ato ’nyathā | upalāsphālanākṣepavicchedaiḥ kheditodakāḥ
verses.tib: de dag mdor na dge ba yin / de las zlog na bzang ma yin / rdo la shugs drag rdebs pa yis / rgyun chad g.yengs pa'i chu dag dang

verses.skt: himavanmalayodbhūtāḥ pathyās tā eva ca sthirāḥ | kṛmiślīpadahṛtkaṇṭhaśirorogān prakurvate
verses.tib: gangs can ma la ya las byung / dge'o de ni brtan g.yung na / srin bu rkang bam snying dang ni / lkog ma klad pa'i nad skyed 'gyur

verses.skt: prācyāvantyaparāntotthā durnāmāni mahendrajāḥ | udaraślīpadātaṅkān sahyavindhyodbhavāḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: shar dang nub kyi mtha' las byung / gzhang 'brum skyed do dbang chen 'bab / dmu rdzing rkang bam nad skyed 'gyur / sa h+ya bin da'i ri las 'bab

verses.skt: kuṣṭhapāṇḍuśirorogān doṣaghnyaḥ pāriyātrajāḥ | balapauruṣakāriṇyaḥ sāgarāmbhas tridoṣakṛt
verses.tib: mdze dang skya rbab klad nad 'gyur / pa ri ya tra'i nad kun sel / khron pa rdzing la pa'i chu

verses.skt: āvilaṃ samalaṃ nīlaṃ ghanaṃ pītam athāpi ca | sakṣāraṃ picchilaṃ caiva sāmudraṃ tan nigadyate
vidyāt kūpataḍāgādīn jāṅgalānūpaśailataḥ | nāmbu peyam aśaktyā vā svalpam alpāgnigulmibhiḥ
verses.tib: skam sa rlan can brag las shes / drod chung skran yod skya rbab dang / dmu rdzing tshad 'khru gzhang 'brum mam

verses.skt: pāṇḍūdarātisārārśograhaṇīśoṣaśothibhiḥ | ṛte śarannidāghābhyāṃ pibet svastho ’pi cālpaśaḥ
verses.tib: pho ba'i drod chung 'or nad can / mi btung brnag dka' nyung zad btung / ston ka so ga ma gtogs par / nad med mis kyang cung zad btung

verses.skt: samasthūlakṛśā bhuktamadhyāntaprathamāmbupāḥ | śītaṃ madātyayaglānimūrchāchardiśramabhramān
verses.tib: zan zos bar mtha' thog mar ni / chu 'thungs ran dang sbom skems 'gyur / chu bsil chang nad brgyal ba dang / skyugs dang ngal dang mgo 'khor dang

verses.skt: tṛṣṇoṣṇadāhapittāsraviṣāṇy ambu niyacchati | dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ laghūṣṇaṃ vastiśodhanam
verses.tib: skom dang lus tsha mkhris pa dang / khrag rgyas dug naM sel byed yin / chu tshan drod skyed zas 'ju zhing / mgul bde lus yang gcin nad sel

verses.skt: hidhmādhmānānilaśleṣmasadyaḥśuddhinavajvare | kāsāmapīnasaśvāsapārśvarukṣu ca śasyate
verses.tib: skyigs bu lto sbos rlung bad kan / rims sar 'phral du zlog byed cing / lud pa cham sar dbugs mi bde / rtsib logs zug la bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: anabhiṣyandi laghu ca toyaṃ kvathitaśītalam | pittayukte hitaṃ doṣe vyuṣitaṃ tat tridoṣakṛt
verses.tib: chu ni bskol ba grang ba dag / bad kan mi skyed lus yang zhing / mkhris pa can la'ang phan pa yin / de ni zhag lon nyes gsum skyed

verses.skt: nārikelodakaṃ snigdhaṃ svādu vṛṣyaṃ himaṃ laghu | tṛṣṇāpittānilaharaṃ dīpanaṃ vastiśodhanam
verses.tib: rgya star chu ni snum pa dang / ro mngar ro tsa bsil zhing yang / skom dang mkhris pa rlung nad sel / drod skyed lgang pa'i nad sbyong byed

verses.skt: varṣāsu divyanādeye paraṃ toye varāvare | svādupākarasaṃ snigdham ojasyaṃ dhātuvardhanam
verses.tib: dbyar gyi char chu chu bo'i chu / mchog tu bzang dang ngan par bshad / chu'i sde tshan no / 'o ma phal cher ro zhu mngar / snum zhing mdangs skyed lus zungs 'phel

verses.skt: vātapittaharaṃ vṛṣyaṃ śleṣmalaṃ guru śītalam | prāyaḥ payo ’tra gavyaṃ tu jīvanīyaṃ rasāyanam
verses.tib: rlung dang mkhris sel ro tsa byed / bad kan skyed lci bsil ba yin / ba yi 'o ma 'tsho byed cing

verses.skt: kṣatakṣīṇahitaṃ medhyaṃ balyaṃ stanyakaraṃ saram | śramabhramamadālakṣmīśvāsakāsātitṛṭkṣudhaḥ
verses.tib: bcud kyis len yin glo rdol dang / glo gcong la phan yid gzhungs byed / stobs skyed nu zho skyed dang 'khru / ngal dang mgo 'khor myos dpal nyams / lud pa dbugs mi bde bkres skom

verses.skt: jīrṇajvaraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ raktapittaṃ ca nāśayet | hitam atyagnyanidrebhyo garīyo māhiṣaṃ himam
verses.tib: rims rnying gcin ni srib dang / khrag dang mkhris pa sel ba yin / ma he'i 'o ma 'ju drags dang / gnyid med la phan rab lci bsil

verses.skt: alpāmbupānavyāyāmakaṭutiktāśanair laghu | ājaṃ śoṣajvaraśvāsaraktapittātisārajit
verses.tib: ra ni chu nyung 'thung zas rgod / kha zhing tsha ba za bas yang / skems dang rims dang dbugs mi bde / khrag dang mkhris pa tshad nad sel

verses.skt: īṣadrūkṣoṣṇalavaṇam auṣṭrākam dīpanaṃ laghu | śastaṃ vātakaphānāhakṛmiśophodarārśasām
verses.tib: rnga mo'i 'o ma cung rtsub dro / lan tshwa bro zhing drod che yang / rlung dang bad kan lto sbos srin / 'or nad dmu rdzing gzhang nad sel

verses.skt: mānuṣaṃ vātapittāsṛgabhighātākṣirogajit | tarpaṇāścyotanair nasyair ahṛdyaṃ tūṣṇam āvikam
verses.tib: bud med nu zho rlung mkhris khrag / snad pa'i mig nad sel byed de / tshim byed mig dang snar blugs phan / lug gi 'o ma snying gnod tsha

verses.skt: vātavyādhiharaṃ hidhmāśvāsapittakaphapradam | hastinyāḥ sthairyakṛd bāḍham uṣṇaṃ tv aikaśaphaṃ laghu
verses.tib: rlung 'joms skyigs bu dbugs mi bde / mkhris / pa bad kan skyed pa yin / ban glang mo yis rab brtan byed / rmig pa gcig pa'i 'o ma tsha

verses.skt: śākhāvātaharaṃ sāmlalavaṇaṃ jaḍatākaram | payo ’bhiṣyandi gurv āmaṃ yuktyā śṛtam ato ’nyathā
verses.tib: yan lag rlung sal skyur bcas shing / lan tshwa bo zhing rmongs par byed / 'o rlon bad kan skyed cing lci / rigs par bskol bas de las gzhan

verses.skt: vinā tu vanitāstanyam āmam eva hitaṃ hi tat
verses.tib: shin tu bskol na 'ju dka' lci

verses.skt: bhaved garīyo ’tiśṛtaṃ dhāroṣṇam amṛtopamam | amlapākarasaṃ grāhi gurūṣṇaṃ dadhi vātajit
verses.tib: bzhos ma thog dro bdud rtsir mtshungs / zho ni ro dang zhu rjes skyur / rtug skam lci la rlung nad sel

verses.skt: medaḥśukrabalaśleṣmapittaraktāgniśophakṛt | rociṣṇu śastam arucau śītake viṣamajvare
verses.tib: tshil dang khu chu stobs bad kan / khrag mkhris drod skyed 'or nad skyed / yi ga 'bye zhing kha zas len / grang ba'i rims dang mi snyoms rims

verses.skt: pīnase mūtrakṛcchre ca rūkṣaṃ tu grahaṇīgade | naivādyān niśi naivoṣṇaṃ vasantoṣṇaśaratsu na
verses.tib: cham pa gcin 'gags gyur pa dang / 'khru ba'i nad la rtsub mo phan / zho dron dpyid dang sog dang / ston dus mtshan mo btung mi bya

verses.skt: nāmudgasūpaṃ nākṣaudraṃ tan nāghṛtasitopalam | na cānāmalakaṃ nāpi nityaṃ no mandam anyathā
verses.tib: de ni mung+ga'i sran tshod dang / sbrang rtsi mar dang sha khar / skyu ru ra ni med mi btung / rtag tu ma yin ma langs min

verses.skt: jvarāsṛkpittavīsarpakuṣṭhapāṇḍubhramapradam | takraṃ laghu kaṣāyāmlaṃ dīpanaṃ kaphavātajit
verses.tib: gzhan du me dbal rims khrag dang / mdze dang skya rbab mgo 'khor skyed / dar sar yang la bska zhing skyur / drod skyed bad kan rlung dag sel

verses.skt: śophodarārśograhaṇīdoṣamūtragrahārucīḥ | plīhagulmaghṛtavyāpadgarapāṇḍvāmayāñ jayet
verses.tib: skran nad dmu rdzing gzhang 'brum dang / pho nad chu sri yi ga 'chus / mcher pa skran dang mar ma zhu / sbyar dug skya rbab nad / rnams sel

verses.skt: tadvan mastu saraṃ srotaḥśodhi viṣṭambhajil laghu | navanītaṃ navaṃ vṛṣyaṃ śītaṃ varṇabalāgnikṛt
verses.tib: de 'dra zhog chu 'khru yang / rtsa sbubs sbyong la rtug skam sel / 'phral gyi mar sar ro ci zhing / bsil zhing mdog stobs drod skyed byed

verses.skt: saṃgrāhi vātapittāsṛkkṣayārśo'rditakāsajit | kṣīrodbhavaṃ tu saṃgrāhi raktapittākṣirogajit
verses.tib: 'khru gcod rlung mkhris khrag gzhang 'brum / glo gcong kha yon lung pa sel

verses.skt: śastaṃ dhīsmṛtimedhāgnibalāyuḥśukracakṣuṣām | bālavṛddhaprajākāntisaukumāryasvarārthinām
verses.tib: zhun mar blo rno dran gsal zhing / yid gzhungs drod skyed stobs tshe 'phel / mig dang byis rgan bu 'dod dang / mdangs bzang rab gzhon skad snyan phan

verses.skt: kṣatakṣīṇaparīsarpaśastrāgniglapitātmanām | vātapittaviṣonmādaśoṣālakṣmījvarāpaham
verses.tib: glo rdol skem dang gcod dang 'bras / mtshon smas mes tshig rma la'ang bsngags / rlung dang mkhris pa dug dang smyo / lus skems mdangs nyams rims nad sel

verses.skt: snehānām uttamaṃ śītaṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ param | sahasravīryaṃ vidhibhir ghṛtaṃ karmasahasrakṛt
verses.tib: snum gyi nang na snum mchog ste / bsil zhing na tshod 'jog pa'i mchog / zhun mar stobs ni stong dang ldan / sbyor bas las ni stong byed 'gyur

verses.skt: madāpasmāramūrchāyaśiraḥkarṇākṣiyonijān | purāṇaṃ jayati vyādhīn vraṇaśodhanaropaṇam
verses.tib: mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal / glad nad rna mig mngal nad dang / rma rnams sbyang zhing 'tsho byed pas / nad las rgyal byed dam pa yin

verses.skt: balyāḥ kilāṭapīyūṣakūrcikāmoraṇādayaḥ | śukranidrākaphakarā viṣṭambhigurudoṣalāḥ
verses.tib: phrum sar sbri dang rgya phrum dang / chur ba la sogs stobs skyed cing / khu ba gnyid dang bad kan 'phel / rtug skam byed lci nyes ba dang

verses.skt: gavye kṣīraghṛte śreṣṭhe nindite cāvisaṃbhave | ikṣoḥ saro guruḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇaḥ kaphamūtrakṛt
verses.tib: ba mar 'o ma mchog yin te / lug las byung ba smad pa yin / 'o ma'i sde tshan no / bu ram shing khu 'khru lci snum / sha skye ro tsa bad gcin 'phel

verses.skt: vṛṣyaḥ śīto ’srapittaghnaḥ svādupākaraso rasaḥ | so ’gre salavaṇo dantapīḍitaḥ śarkarāsamaḥ
verses.tib: bsil zhing khrag mkhris sel ba dang / ro dang zhu rjes mngar ba yin / de tshe lan tshwa bro zhing sos / bcas na khar dag dang 'dra

verses.skt: mūlāgrajantujagdhādipīḍanān malasaṃkarāt | kiñcitkālaṃ vidhṛtyā ca vikṛtiṃ yāti yāntrikaḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba rtse mo dbus zos / btsir dang dri mas sbags pa dang / dus ni cung zad lon pa las / 'khrul 'khor can ni rnam 'gyur te

verses.skt: vidāhī guruviṣṭambhī tenāsau tatra pauṇḍrakaḥ | śaityaprasādamādhuryair varas tam anu vāṃśikaḥ
verses.tib: tsha zhing lci la ma khrigs par 'gyur / de la khar dkar po'i shing / bsil dang mngar bas mchog yin la / de yi 'og ma sbubs can yin

verses.skt: śataparvakakāntāranaipālādyās tataḥ kramāt | sakṣārāḥ sakaṣāyāś ca soṣṇāḥ kiñcidvidāhinaḥ
verses.tib: tshigs brgya pa dang kan+ta ra / bal yul skyes de las rim / cung zad tsha bro bska ba dang / drod bcas cung zad tsha ba skyed

verses.skt: phāṇitaṃ gurv abhiṣyandi cayakṛn mūtraśodhanam | nātiśleṣmakaro dhautaḥ sṛṣṭamūtraśakṛd guḍaḥ
verses.tib: dbu ba can lci bad kan skyed / sogs byed gcin ni sbyong byed yin / dkar por dkan cher mi skyed / bshang dang gci ba bde bar 'byin

verses.skt: prabhūtakṛmimajjāsṛṅmedomāṃsakapho ’paraḥ | hṛdyaḥ purāṇaḥ pathyaś ca navaḥ śleṣmāgnisādakṛt
verses.tib: dmar nag phal cher srin bu khrag / rkang tshil sha dang bad kan skyed / rnying pa yid 'ong phan pa yin / sar pa drod 'bri bad kan skyed

verses.skt: vṛṣyāḥ kṣīṇakṣatahitā raktapittānilāpahāḥ | matsyaṇḍikākhaṇḍasitāḥ krameṇa guṇavattamāḥ
verses.tib: hwags dang khaN+Da kar dkar / rim gyis yon tan che ba ste / ro tsa glo gcong glo rdol dang / khrag dang mkhris pa rlung sel yin

verses.skt: tadguṇā tiktamadhurā kaṣāyā yāsaśarkarā | dāhatṛṭchardimūrchāsṛkpittaghnyaḥ sarvaśarkarāḥ
verses.tib: ya ba kha ra tsha zhing mngar / bska ste yon tan de dang 'dra / kha ra kar kun tsha dang skom / skyug bro brgyal dang khrag mkhris sel

verses.skt: śarkarekṣuvikārāṇāṃ phāṇitaṃ ca varāvare | cakṣuṣyaṃ chedi tṛṭśleṣmaviṣahidhmāsrapittanut
verses.tib: bu ram shing gdus khang dang / dbu ba can mchog tha ma yin / sbrang rtsi mig phan gcod skom dang / bad kan skyigs bu khrag mkhris 'joms

verses.skt: mehakuṣṭhakṛmicchardiśvāsakāsātisārajit | vraṇaśodhanasaṃdhānaropaṇaṃ vātalaṃ madhu
verses.tib: tshil chen mdze nad gcin nad skyug / lud pa dbugs mi bde tshad sel / rma sbyong rma 'tsho chag grugs sbyor / rlung ni skyed par byed pa yin

verses.skt: rūkṣaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ tattulyā madhuśarkarā | uṣṇam uṣṇārtam uṣṇe ca yuktaṃ coṣṇair nihanti tat
verses.tib: rtsub cing bska la mngar ba ste / sbrang rtsi'i khaN+Da de dang 'dra'o / tsha zhing tshas gdungs tsha bar ldan

verses.skt: yakṣmārśo'rditapittāsṛṅnāśanaṃ grāhi dīpanam
verses.tib: tsha ba des ni gsod par 'gyur / skyug sman sman mar mas gtong la / sbrang rtsi

verses.skt: pracchardane nirūhe ca madhūṣṇaṃ na nivāryate | alabdhapākam āśv eva tayor yasmān nivartate
verses.tib: dro ba'am bkag pa med / bu ram shing gi sde tshan no / 'bru mar rang gnas lta bu yin

verses.skt: tailaṃ svayonivat tatra mukhyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca | tvagdoṣakṛd acakṣuṣyaṃ sūkṣmoṣṇaṃ kaphakṛn na ca
verses.tib: de la til mar til dang mtshungs / gtso bo rno zhing khyab pa yin / pags pa'i nyes sel mig la gnod / tsha zhing rno la bad kan sel

verses.skt: kṛśānāṃ bṛṃhaṇāyālaṃ sthūlānāṃ karśanāya ca | baddhaviṭkaṃ kṛmighnaṃ ca saṃskārāt sarvarogajit
verses.tib: skem po dag ni sha skyed cing / sbom po'i sha 'bri mkhregs par 'ong / rtug skam srin bu 'joms pa dang / sbyar bas nad rnams thams cad sel

verses.skt: satiktoṣaṇam airaṇḍaṃ tailaṃ svādu saraṃ guru | vardhmagulmānilakaphān udaraṃ viṣamajvaram
verses.tib: e raN+Da mar tsha zhing kha / zhu rjes mngar lci 'khru ba yin / rlig rlugs skrang rlung bad kan dang / lto nad ldang dub rims nad sel

verses.skt: rukśophau ca kaṭīguhyakoṣṭhapṛṣṭhāśrayau jayet | tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ picchilaṃ visraṃ raktairaṇḍodbhavaṃ tv ati
verses.tib: 'or nad rked pa gsang ba'i nad / lto ba ro rgyab nad la phan / e raN+Da ni dmar po'i mar / rno tsha dri nga rab 'byil 'dred

verses.skt: kaṭūṣṇaṃ sārṣapaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kaphaśukrānilāpaham | laghu pittāsrakṛt koṭhakuṣṭhārśovraṇajantujit
verses.tib: yungs mar tsha dro rno ba dang / bad kan rlung sel khu ba 'bri / yang zhing khrag mkhris skyed byed la / sha bkra mdze 'brum rmen bu sel

verses.skt: ākṣaṃ svādu himaṃ keśyaṃ guru pittānilāpaham | nātyuṣṇaṃ nimbajaṃ tiktaṃ kṛmikuṣṭhakaphapraṇut
verses.tib: ba ru ra'i mar mngar bsil lci / skran skye rlung dang mkhris pa sel / nim dmar rab tu tsha min kha

verses.skt: umākusumbhajaṃ coṣṇaṃ tvagdoṣakaphapittakṛt | vasā majjā ca vātaghnau balapittakaphapradau
verses.tib: lto srin mkhris pa bad kan sel / zar ma le brgan rtsi yi mar / dro zhing pags nad bad mkhris skyed / zhag dang rkang ni rlung 'joms shing / stobs dang khu chu bad kan skyed

verses.skt: kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaṃ kārañjaṃ vraṇaśodhanam
verses.tib: lto srin mkhris pa bad kan sel / zar ma le brgan rtsi yi mar / dro zhing pags nad bad mkhris skyed / zhag dang rkang ni rlung 'joms shing / stobs dang khu chu bad kan skyed

verses.skt: māṃsānugasvarūpau ca vidyān medo ’pi tāv iva | dīpanaṃ rocanaṃ madhyaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ tuṣṭipuṣṭidam
verses.tib: sha ni rang dngos rjes mthun la / tshil yang de dang 'drar shes bya / til mar la pa'i sde tshan no / chang ni drod 'bar yi ga 'byed / rno zhing drod skyed khor brta dga'

verses.skt: sasvādutiktakaṭukam amlapākarasaṃ saram | sakaṣāyaṃ svarārogyapratibhāvarṇakṛl laghu
verses.tib: mngar bcas kha zhing tshab dang / zhu rjes skyur zhing cung zad 'khru / bska bcas gdangs snyan nad med dang / spobs bskyed mdog 'gyur khong yangs shing

verses.skt: naṣṭanidrātinidrebhyo hitaṃ pittāsradūṣaṇam | kṛśasthūlahitaṃ rūkṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ srotoviśodhanam
verses.tib: gnyid med pa dang gnyid che la / phan zhing khrag dang mkhris pa skyed / rigs 'thungs skem dang sbom phan zhing / rtsub rno las sgo khyab cing sbyong

verses.skt: vātaśleṣmaharaṃ yuktyā pītaṃ viṣavad anyathā | guru taddoṣajananaṃ navaṃ jīrṇam ato ’nyathā
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan sel ba yin / gzhan du bsten na dug dang mtshungs / chang sar lci zhing nyes skyed yin / chang rnying de las gzhan du byed

verses.skt: drākṣekṣavaḥ sakharjūrāḥ śālipiṣṭam yavasya ca | pañca madyākārāḥ śreṣṭhā drākṣā teṣāṃ viśiṣyate
peyaṃ noṣṇopacāreṇa na viriktakṣudhāturaiḥ | nātyarthatīkṣṇamṛdvalpasaṃbhāraṃ kaluṣaṃ na ca
verses.tib: tsha ba'i spyod par ldan mi btung / sun cing bkres nyen nad bas min / shin tu rno min sar pa dang / legs par ma bslangs rnyog can yin

verses.skt: gulmodarārśograhaṇīśoṣahṛt snehanī guruḥ | surānilaghnī medo'sṛkstanyamūtrakaphāvahā
verses.tib: 'bru chang skran dang dmu / rdzing dang / rtug skem glo gcong sel ba dang / rlung 'joms tshil dang khrag skyed cing / gcin bder 'byin zhing bad kan skyed

verses.skt: tadguṇā vāruṇī hṛdyā laghus tīkṣṇā nihanti ca | śūlakāsavamiśvāsavibandhādhmānapīnasān
verses.tib: chang dngas yon tan de 'dra las / yid 'ong yang zhing rno ba dang / gzer dang lud pa dbugs mi bde / skyug bro bshang 'gags sbos cham 'joms

verses.skt: nātitīvramadā laghvī pathyā vaibhītakī surā | vraṇe pāṇḍvāmaye kuṣṭhe na cātyarthaṃ virudhyate
verses.tib: ba rur chang yang zhing phan / shin tu ra ror mi 'gyur zhing / rma dang skya rbab mdze nad la / ha cang gnod par mi 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: viṣṭambhinī yavasurā gurvī rūkṣā tridoṣalā | yathādravyaguṇo ’riṣṭaḥ sarvamadyaguṇādhikaḥ
verses.tib: rdzas bzhin yon tan rjes mthun chang / chang gi yon tan kun las lhag / pho nad skya rbab mdze gzhang 'brum

verses.skt: grahaṇīpāṇḍukuṣṭhārśaḥśophaśoṣodarajvarān | hanti gulmakṛmiplīhnaḥ kaṣāyakaṭuvātalaḥ
verses.tib: lus skem skrang 'or dmu rdzing rims / skran dang srin bu mcher nad sel / ro ni bska zhing tsha rlung skyed / rgun chang nad sbyong snying la phan

verses.skt: mārdvīkaṃ lekhanaṃ hṛdyaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ saram | alpapittānilaṃ pāṇḍumehārśaḥkṛmināśanam
verses.tib: shin tu dro min mngar zhing 'khru / mkhris rlung cung zad skyed skya rbab / gcin nad gzhang 'brum srin nad sel

verses.skt: asmād alpāntaraguṇaṃ khārjūraṃ vātalaṃ guru | śārkaraḥ surabhiḥ svāduhṛdyo nātimado laghuḥ
sṛṣṭamūtraśakṛdvāto gauḍas tarpaṇadīpanaḥ | vātapittakaraḥ sīdhuḥ snehaśleṣmavikārahā
verses.tib: bu ram chang ni gcin rtug 'gags / 'byin zhing ngoms la drod skyed yin / bu ram shing chang rlung mkhris skyed / snum dang bad kan las byung 'joms

verses.skt: medaḥśophodarārśoghnas tatra pakvaraso varaḥ | chedī madhvāsavas tīkṣṇo mehapīnasakāsajit
verses.tib: tshil 'or dmu rdzing gzhang 'brum sel / de bas khu ba bskol mchog yin / sbrang chang 'grib byed rno ba ste / gcin nad cham pa lud pa sel

verses.skt: raktapittakaphotkledi śuktaṃ vātānulomanam | bhṛśoṣṇatīkṣṇarūkṣāmlaṃ hṛdyaṃ rucikaraṃ saram
verses.tib: tsha ni khrag mkhris bad kan dag / 'ju zhing rlung ni snyoms byed la / rab tu tsha zhing rno rtsub skyur / yid 'ong yig 'bye zhing 'khru

verses.skt: dīpanaṃ śiśirasparśaṃ pāṇḍudṛkkṛmināśanam | guḍekṣumadyamārdvīkaśuktaṃ laghu yathottaram
verses.tib: drod skyed reg na bsil ba dang / skya rbab srin sel mig la gnod / bu ram bur shing rgun chang dang / tsha ni phyi ma phyi ma yang

verses.skt: kandamūlaphalādyaṃ ca tadvad vidyāt tadāsutam | śāṇḍākī cāsutaṃ cānyat kālāmlaṃ rocanaṃ laghu
verses.tib: sdong bu rtsa ba 'bras las / mnan byas de dang 'drar shes bya / rdo gu la sogs bzhur ba gzhan / dus kyi skyur po yang zas len

verses.skt: dhānyāmlaṃ bhedi tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ pittakṛt sparśaśītalam | śramaklamaharaṃ rucyaṃ dīpanaṃ vastiśūlanut
verses.tib: 'bras khu'i rang skyur 'khru rno tsha / mkhris pa skyed byed bskus na bsil / ngal dang rmya sel yig 'byed

verses.skt: śastam āsthāpane hṛdyaṃ laghu vātakaphāpaham | ebhir eva guṇair yukte sauvīrakatuṣodake
verses.tib: drod skyed chu se'i nad sel yin / mas gtong la phan yid du 'ong

verses.skt: gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇād vaktramaladaurgandhyaśoṣajit
verses.tib: yang zhing rlung dang bad kan 'joms

verses.skt: kṛmihṛdrogagulmārśaḥpāṇḍuroganibarhaṇe | te kramād vituṣair vidyāt satuṣaiś ca yavaiḥ kṛte
mūtraṃ go'jāvimahiṣīgajāśvoṣṭrakharodbhavam | pittalaṃ rūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ lavaṇānurasaṃ kaṭu
verses.tib: ba gcin ra lug ma he dang / glang po rta bong rnga mo'i gcin / mkhris skyed rtsub cing rno la tsha / 'thungs rjes tsha bro ro tsha ste

verses.skt: kṛmiśophodarānāhaśūlapāṇḍukaphānilān | gulmāruciviṣaśvitrakuṣṭhārśāṃsi jayel laghu
verses.tib: srin nad 'or nad dmu rdzing sbos / gzer dang skya rbab bad kan rlung / dug skran sha bkra / yi ga 'chus / mdze dang gzhang 'brum myur du 'joms

verses.skt: toyakṣīrekṣutailānāṃ vargair madyasya ca kramāt | iti dravaikadeśo ’yaṃ yathāsthūlam udāhṛtaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar chu bo bu ram shing / til mar chang gi sde tshogs rim / gsher ba'i rdzas phyogs gcig pa 'di / rags rim ji bzhin bstan pa yin

verses.skt: rakto mahān sakalamas tūrṇakaḥ śakunāhṛtaḥ | sārāmukho dīrghaśūko lodhraśūkaḥ sugandhikaḥ
verses.tib: rtsa snar 'bras chan ka ma la / drug cu pa dang bya yis blangs / sgron bu'i mchu dang rtse rnon dang / ro 'dra'i 'bras 'dra dri bzang dang

verses.skt: puṇḍraḥ pāṇḍuḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ pramodo gauraśārivau | kāñcano mahiṣaḥ śūkaḥ dūṣakaḥ kusumāṇḍakaḥ
lāṅgalā lohavālākhyāḥ kardamāḥ śītabhīrukāḥ | pataṅgās tapanīyāś ca ye cānye śālayaḥ śubhāḥ
verses.tib: pa tang ka dang gser mdog can / gang gzhan 'bras ni bzang po rnams / ro mngar zhu rjes mngar zhing snum

verses.skt: svādupākarasāḥ snigdhā vṛṣyā baddhālpavarcasaḥ | kaṣāyānurasāḥ pathyā laghavo mūtralā himāḥ
verses.tib: ro tsa bshang gci ska zhing chung / ro rjes bska zhing phan pa dang / yang zhing gcin mang bsil ba yin

verses.skt: śūkajeṣu varas tatra raktas tṛṣṇātridoṣahā | mahāṃs tam anu kalamas taṃ cāpy anu tataḥ pare
verses.tib: de la rtse rno nang rtsa snar / mchog yin skom dang nyes gsum sel / de yi 'og tu 'bras chan smad / de'i 'og ka ma la de'i 'og

verses.skt: yavakā hāyanāḥ pāṃsubāṣpanaiṣadhakādayaḥ | svādūṣṇā guravaḥ snigdhāḥ pāke ’mlāḥ śleṣmapittalāḥ
verses.tib: nas 'dra ha yan char ma / ne sha da ka la sogs ni / ro mngar dri zhim lci la snum / zhu ba'i rjes skyur bad mkhris skyed

verses.skt: sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣāś ca pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca ninditāḥ | snigdho grāhī laghuḥ svādus tridoṣaghnaḥ sthiro himaḥ
verses.tib: bshang dang gci ba thur du 'byin / snga ma snga ma smad pa yin / 'bras nang drug cu ba mchog ste / rtsa ser shun pa nag pa dag / snum zhing 'ju sla brten zhing mngar / nyes pa gsum sel bsil rtug 'dril / de las rim bzhin thug chen dang

verses.skt: ṣaṣṭiko vrīhiṣu śreṣṭho gauraś cāsitagaurataḥ | tataḥ kramān mahāvrīhikṛṣṇavrīhijatūmukhāḥ
verses.tib: bshang dang gci ba thur du 'byin / snga ma snga ma smad pa yin / 'bras nang drug cu ba mchog ste / rtsa ser shun pa nag pa dag / snum zhing 'ju sla brten zhing mngar / nyes pa gsum sel bsil rtug 'dril / de las rim bzhin thug chen dang

verses.skt: kukkuṭāṇḍakalāvākhyapārāvatakaśūkarāḥ | varakoddālakojjvālacīnaśāradadardurāḥ
verses.tib: shun nag rgya skyegs tshigs ma 'dra / khyim bya'i sgang 'dra 'ur ba'i mig / phug ron 'bras dang su khar / 'ba' ra kha dang ut+pal dmar / tsi ta ston skyes da dur

verses.skt: gandhanāḥ kuruvindāś ca guṇair alpāntarāḥ smṛtāḥ | svādur amlavipāko ’nyo vrīhiḥ pittakaro guruḥ
verses.tib: gan d+han dang ku ru bin / yon tan rim bzhin chung shes bya / 'bras gzhan mngar zhing zhu rjes skyur

verses.skt: bahumūtrapurīṣoṣmā tridoṣas tv eva pāṭalaḥ | kaṅgukodravanīvāraśyāmākādi himaṃ laghu
verses.tib: mkhris pa skyed cing lci ba dang / gcin rtug mang zhing tshab yin / pa ta la nyid nyes gsum skyed / ci tshe khre dang ni ba ra / khre rgod sne 'bras bsil yang

verses.skt: tṛṇadhānyaṃ pavanakṛl lekhanaṃ kaphapittahṛt | bhagnasaṃdhānakṛt tatra priyaṅgur bṛṃhaṇī guruḥ
verses.tib: rtsa'i 'bru de dag rlung skyed cing / khong rtsub bad kan mkhris pa sel / de la khre ni rtas byed lci / lus kyi chag grugs 'byor bar byed

verses.skt: koradūṣaḥ paraṃ grāhī sparśo śīto viṣāpahaḥ | rūkṣaḥ śīto guruḥ svāduḥ saro viḍvātakṛd yavaḥ
verses.tib: khre rgod mchog tu 'khru gcod cing / reg na bsil la dug sel yin / nas / ni rtsub bsil lci la mngar

verses.skt: vṛṣyaḥ sthairyakaro mūtramedaḥpittakaphāñ jayet | pīnasaśvāsakāsorustambhakaṇṭhatvagāmayān
verses.tib: ro tsa brtan byed gcin dang ni / tshil dang mkhris pa bad kan sel / cham pa lud pa dbugs mi bde / da rgan lkog nad pags nad sel

verses.skt: nyūno yavād anuyavo rūkṣoṣṇo vaṃśajo yavaḥ | vṛṣyaḥ śīto guruḥ snigdho jīvano vātapittahā
verses.tib: nas rgod cung zad dman pa yin / smyig skyes 'bras nas rtsub cing tsha / gro ni ro tsa snum bsil lci / 'tsho byed rlung dang mkhris pa sel

verses.skt: saṃdhānakārī madhuro godhūmaḥ sthairyakṛt saraḥ | pathyā nandīmukhī śītā kaṣāyamadhurā laghuḥ
verses.tib: chag grugs 'byor byed mngar ba dang / sha mkhregs byed cing cung zad 'khru / nan+ti mu ka ro bska zhing / bsil zhing mngar yang phan pa yin

verses.skt: niḥsārā vātalā rūkṣā jūrṇādhmānakarā sarā
verses.tib: gra ma can gyi 'bru sna tshogs kyi sde tshan no / mon sran sde'u dkar sran chung / gang bu can 'bru rtsa sgo bkag / ro bska mngar zhing 'khru ba gcod / zhu rjes tsha la bsil zhing yang

verses.skt: mudgāḍhakīmasūrādi śimbīdhānyaṃ vibandhakṛt | kaṣāyaṃ svādu saṃgrāhi kaṭupākaṃ himaṃ laghu
verses.tib: gra ma can gyi 'bru sna tshogs kyi sde tshan no / mon sran sde'u dkar sran chung / gang bu can 'bru rtsa sgo bkag / ro bska mngar zhing 'khru ba gcod / zhu rjes tsha la bsil zhing yang

verses.skt: medaḥśleṣmāsrapitteṣu hitaṃ lepopasekayoḥ | varo ’tra mudgo ’lpacalaḥ kalāyas tv ativātalaḥ
verses.tib: tshil dang khrag dang mkhris pa la / bskus shing blugs na phan pa yin / 'di las mung+ga mchog rlung chung / sran ma shin tu rlung skyed yin

verses.skt: asṛkpittaharo rūkṣo vātalaś caṇakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: mon sran dkar po rlung skyed cing / rtsub cing lci la bshang ba 'phel

verses.skt: rājamāṣo ’nilakaro rūkṣo bahuśakṛd guruḥ | uṣṇāḥ kulatthāḥ pāke ’mlāḥ śukrāśmaśvāsapīnasān
verses.tib: rgya sran nag tsha zhu rjes skyur / khu chu'i rde'u cham lud pa / dbugs mi bde rlung bad gzhang 'brum

verses.skt: kāsārśaḥkaphavātāṃś ca ghnanti pittāsradāḥ param | niṣpāvo vātapittāsrastanyamūtrakaro guruḥ
verses.tib: 'joms shing khrag mkhris mchog tu skyed / nis pa ba ni rlung khrag mkhris / nu zho gcin 'phel lci zhing 'khru

verses.skt: saro vidāhī dṛkśukrakaphaśophaviṣāpahaḥ | māṣaḥ snigdho balaśleṣmamalapittakaraḥ saraḥ
verses.tib: tsha byed mig gnod khu ba 'bri / bad kan 'or nang dug rnams sel / ma sha snum stobs bad kan skyed

verses.skt: gurūṣṇo ’nilahā svāduḥ śukravṛddhivirekakṛt | phalāni māṣavad vidyāt kākāṇḍolātmaguptayoḥ
verses.tib: bshang gci mkhris pa 'phel byed 'khru / lci zhing tsha la rlung 'joms dang / khu ba 'phel zhing 'byin par byed / ka kan du la kha sral phre'u / yon tan mon sran gre'u dang 'dra

verses.skt: uṣṇas tvacyo himaḥ sparśe keśyo balyas tilo guruḥ | alpamūtraḥ kaṭuḥ pāke medhāgnikaphapittakṛt
verses.tib: til 'bru dro zhing pags pa 'jam / bsil zhing skra dang stobs skyed pa / lci zhing gcin nyung zhu rjes tsha / yid gzhungs drod skyed bad mkhris skyed

verses.skt: snigdhomā svādutiktoṣṇā kaphapittakarī guruḥ | dṛkśukrahṛt kaṭuḥ pāke tadvad bījaṃ kusumbhajam
verses.tib: zar ma snun mngar kha zhing dro / lci zhing bad kan mkhris pa skyed / mig gnod khu skems zhu rjes tsha / le brgan rtsi 'bras de dang 'dra

verses.skt: māṣo ’tra sarveṣv avaro yavakaḥ śūkajeṣu ca | navaṃ dhānyam abhiṣyandi laghu saṃvatsaroṣitam
verses.tib: gra ma can las nas rgod dang / ma sha gang bu can tha chad / 'bru yi gsar thog bad kan skyed / lor lon 'bru ni yang ba yin

verses.skt: śīghrajanma tathā sūpyaṃ nistuṣaṃ yuktibharjitam | maṇḍapeyāvilepīnām odanasya ca lāghavam
verses.tib: myur skye de bzhin sran ma ni / spun med legs brngos tshod ma yang / gang bu chags pa'i 'bru sna tshogs kyi sde tshan no / 'bras thug sla ska gar ba dang

verses.skt: yavagodhūmamāṣāś ca tilāś cābhinavā hitāḥ | purāṇā virasāḥ sūkṣmā na tathārthakarā matāḥ
verses.tib: 'bras chan rnams ni snga ma bzhin / yang ngo de las sla ba ni / dge 'o rlung ni lugs mthun byed / skom rmya nyes pa lhag ma 'joms / 'ju zhing lus zungs mnyam par byed

verses.skt: yathāpūrvaṃ śivas tatra maṇḍo vātānulomanaḥ | tṛḍglānidoṣaśeṣaghnaḥ pācano dhātusāmyakṛt
verses.tib: 'bras chan rnams ni snga ma bzhin / yang ngo de las sla ba ni / dge 'o rlung ni lugs mthun byed / skom rmya nyes pa lhag ma 'joms / 'ju zhing lus zungs mnyam par byed

verses.skt: srotomārdavakṛt svedī saṃdhukṣayati cānalam | kṣuttṛṣṇāglānidaurbalyakukṣirogajvarāpahā
verses.tib: rtsa sbubs mnyen byed rngul ba dang / me yi drod ni skyed par byed / thug ska bkres skom nyam chung rmya / lto nad rims nad sel ba yin

verses.skt: malānulomanī pathyā peyā dīpanapācanī | vilepī grāhiṇī hṛdyā tṛṣṇāghnī dīpanī hitā
verses.tib: dri ma 'gags la phan pa dang / drod skyed nad ni 'ju bar byed / thug gar 'khru gcod yi gar 'ong / skom sel drod skyed rma dang mig

verses.skt: vraṇākṣirogasaṃśuddhadurbalasnehapāyinām | sudhautaḥ prasrutaḥ svinno ’tyaktoṣmā caudano laghuḥ
verses.tib: bkru sman rjes dang nyam chung dang / snum 'thungs rjes la phan pa yin / 'bras chan legs bkrus khu btsags tshos / rlangs pa dang ni bral ba dang

verses.skt: yaś cāgneyauṣadhakvāthasādhito bhṛṣṭataṇḍulaḥ | viparīto guruḥ kṣīramāṃsādyair yaś ca sādhitaḥ
verses.tib: gang yang tsha ba'i sman rnams kyis / bskol ba'i 'bras tshos yang ba yin / de las bzlog pa gang zhig ni / sha khu 'o ma bskol lci

verses.skt: iti dravyakriyāyogamānādyaiḥ sarvam ādiśet | bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano vṛṣyaś cakṣuṣyo vraṇahā rasaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar rdzas dang bya sbyor dang / tshad la sogs pas kun shes bya / khu ba nyams rtas tshim byed cing / ro tsa mig phan rma la gnod

verses.skt: maudgas tu pathyaḥ saṃśuddhavraṇakaṇṭhākṣirogiṇām | vātānulomī kaulattho gulmatūṇīpratūṇijit
verses.tib: mon san sde'u sbyong dang rma / lkog ma mig nad dag la phan / ku lang+ga tha khu rlung dang skran

verses.skt: akṛtaṃ kṛtayūṣaṃ ca tanu saṃskāritaṃ rasam | sūpam amlam anamlaṃ ca guru vidyād yathottaram
tilapiṇyākavikṛtiḥ śuṣkaśākaṃ virūḍhakam | śāṇḍākīvaṭakaṃ dṛṅghnaṃ doṣalaṃ glapanaṃ guru
verses.tib: ro smad slar gzer gnod pa sel / til tshigs g.yos su sbyar byas nas / tshod ma skam dang myu gu dang / skyur por chang bu bcug pa ni

verses.skt: rasālā bṛṃhaṇī vṛṣyā snigdhā balyā rucipradā | śramakṣuttṛṭklamaharaṃ pānakaṃ prīṇanaṃ guru
verses.tib: dri 'dzin lus brta ro tsa zhing / snum zhing stobs skyed yi ga 'bye / rgun chu'i btung ba ngal dub dang / bkres sel tshim par byed cing lci

verses.skt: viṣṭambhi mūtralaṃ hṛdyaṃ yathādravyaguṇaṃ ca tat | lājās tṛṭchardyatīsāramehamedaḥkaphacchidaḥ
verses.tib: rtug skam gcin mang yi gar 'ong / de yi yon tan sman bzhin blta / 'bras yos skom dang skyug tshad 'khru / gcin mang tshil dang bad kan sel

verses.skt: kāsapittopaśamanā dīpanā laghavo himāḥ | pṛthukā guravo balyāḥ kaphaviṣṭambhakāriṇaḥ
verses.tib: lud pa mkhris pa nyer zhi byed / drod skyed yang zhing bsil ba yin / srus leb lci zhing stobs skyed la / bad kan bshang ba sra byed cing

verses.skt: dhānā viṣṭambhinī rūkṣā tarpaṇī lekhanī guruḥ | saktavo laghavaḥ kṣuttṛṭśramanetrāmayavraṇān
verses.tib: nas yos rtug mkhregs rtsub pa dang / skom zhing khong 'khrugs lci ba yin / nas phye khong yang bkres skom dang / ngal dub mig / nad rma la phan

verses.skt: ghnanti saṃtarpaṇāḥ pānāt sadya eva balapradāḥ | nodakāntaritān na dvir na niśāyāṃ na kevalān
verses.tib: skyo mar byas pa 'thungs pa yis / 'phral du stobs ni skyed byed yin / chu dang phye spel mi bza' zhing / dus gnyis mtshan mo 'phrad med min

verses.skt: na bhuktvā na dvijaiś chittvā saktūn adyān na vā bahūn | piṇyāko glapano rūkṣo viṣṭambhī dṛṣṭidūṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: 'grangs rjes mi bza' sos bcad min / ha cang 'grangs ches bza' mi bya / 'ba' cha nyam 'bri rtsub pa dang
