verses.skt: raukṣyād viṣṭambhate koṣṭhe viṣṭambhitvād vidahyate | vidāhāt kurute glāniṃ piṇyāko niśi sevitaḥ
verses.tib: bshang mkhregs mig la gnod pa yin / sha g.yos spod sbyar snum zhing lci

verses.skt: vesavāro guruḥ snigdho balopacayavardhanaḥ | mudgādijās tu guravo yathādravyaguṇānugāḥ
verses.tib: stobs skyed sha 'phel rtas byed yin / mung+ga g.yos sbyar lci ba dang / sman gyi cha dang yon tan 'dra

verses.skt: kukūlakarparabhrāṣṭrakandvaṅgāravipācitān | ekayonī¿ laghūn vidyād apūpān uttarottaram
verses.tib: khur ba mdag btsos dog le dang / sa slang da nur rgya sol bsregs / khur ba 'di rnams rigs gcig kyang / phyi ma phyi ma yang ba yin / g.yos su byas pa'i zas kyi sde tshan no

verses.skt: hariṇaiṇakuraṅgarkṣagokarṇamṛgamātṛkāḥ | śaśaśambaracāruṣkaśarabhādyā mṛgāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.tib: sha ba dgo ba ku rang ga / rkyang dang ri sha ri dwags ma / ri bong dang sgo tsa ru ka / ldang sgo la sogs ri dwags yin

verses.skt: lāvavārtīkavartīraraktavartmakakukkubhāḥ | kapiñjalopacakrākhyacakorakurubāhavaḥ
verses.tib: la ba bar ti bar ti ka / go tsa dmar dang gong mo dang / sreg pa u pa tsakra dang / ka pin tsa ra ku ru ba

verses.skt: vartako vartikā caiva tittiriḥ krakaraḥ śikhī | tāmracūḍākhyabakaragonardagirivartikāḥ
verses.tib: bar da ka dang bar ti ka / gong ma sreg dang rma bya dang / khyim bya dang ni tsa kor / gon nad dang ri la gnas

verses.skt: tathā śārapadendrābhavaraṭādyāś ca viṣkirāḥ | jīvañjīvakadātyūhabhṛṅgāhvaśukasārikāḥ
verses.tib: sha ra ba dang in+d+ra ba / ri bya 'di dag zas khron rko / shang shang te'u da du ha / bung 'dra ne+e tso sha ri ka

verses.skt: laṭvākokilahārītakapotacaṭakādayaḥ | pratudā bhekagodhāhiśvāvidādyā bileśayāḥ
verses.tib: ta la khu byug ha ri ta / bye'u la sogs mchus rko yin / sbal pa sbrul dang skyin gor dang / bi dur la sogs khung na gnas

verses.skt: gokharāśvataroṣṭrāśvadvīpisiṃharkṣavānarāḥ | mārjāramūṣakavyāghravṛkababhrutarakṣavaḥ
verses.tib: ba lang rta bong dre'u dang / stag gzig seng ge dom spre'u / byi la byi ba spyang ki dang / sre mo dang ni dred dag dang

verses.skt: lopākajambukaśyenacāṣavāntādavāyasāḥ | śaśaghnībhāsakuraragṛdhrolūkakuliṅgakāḥ
verses.tib: wa dang 'phar ba khra dang ni / chun lag khra spyang bya rog gi / bya rigs khra sngon bya ku ru / bya rgod 'ug pa ka ling ka

verses.skt: dhūmikā madhuhā ceti prasahā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | varāhamahiṣanyaṅkurururohitavāraṇāḥ
verses.tib: dung can ma du ha la sogs / bya dang gcan gzan rtsal mthus za / phag rgod ru ru ma he skyin / ro hi ta dang glang po che

verses.skt: sṛmaraś camaraḥ khaḍgo gavayaś ca mahāmṛgāḥ | haṃsasārasakādambabakakāraṇḍavaplavāḥ
verses.tib: mdzo rgod g.yag rgod bse dang ni / smyig glang zhes grags ri dwags che / chur gnas ngang pa sa ra sa / chu skyar ka ran da bya bla

verses.skt: balākotkrośacakrāhvamadgukrauñcādayo ’pcarāḥ | matsyā rohitapāṭhīnakūrmakumbhīrakarkaṭāḥ
verses.tib: rgya dang khrung khrung ngur pa dang / so bya ka tam+ba sogs yin / nya ro ha ti ba ti na

verses.skt: śuktiśaṅkhodraśambūkaśapharīvarmicandrikāḥ | culūkīnakramakaraśiśumāratimiṅgilāḥ
verses.tib: nya phyis rus sbal kum bir / kar ta / dung sram sham+bu ka / nye ldang bar mi tsan ti ka / bu lu chu srin nag khra dang

verses.skt: rājīcilicimādyāś ca māṃsam ity āhur aṣṭadhā | yoniṣv ajāvī vyāmiśragocaratvād aniścite
verses.tib: ja ri ci li tsi ma / de ltar sha ni brgyad du bshad / ra lug gzas kyi spyod yul ni / 'dres pas rigs gcig nges ma yin

verses.skt: mṛgyaṃ vaiṣkirikaṃ kiṃ ca prātudaṃ ca bileśayam | prāsahaṃ ca mahāmṛgyam apcaraṃ mātsyam aṣṭadhā
ādyāntyā jāṅgalānūpā madhyau sādhāraṇau smṛtau | tatra baddhamalāḥ śītā laghavo jāṅgalā hitāḥ
verses.tib: thog ma tha ma skam gsher gnas / bar ma gnyis po thun mong bshad / de las skam sa'i sha rtug 'gags / bsil ba dang ni yang pa yin

verses.skt: pittottare vātamadhye saṃnipāte kaphānuge | dīpanaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke grāhī rūkṣo himaḥ śaśaḥ
verses.tib: 'dus pa mkhris pa shas che zhing / rlung 'bring bad kan chung la phan / ri bong sha ni drod skyed rtsub / zhu rjes tsha zhing 'khru gcod bsil

verses.skt: īṣaduṣṇagurusnigdhā bṛṃhaṇā vartakādayaḥ | tittiris teṣv api varo medhāgnibalaśukrakṛt
verses.tib: bar ta ki la sogs pa'i sha / cung zad snum dro lci rtas byed / de rnams las kyang rgya bya'i sha / yid gzhungs drod stobs khu ba 'phel

verses.skt: grāhī varṇyo ’nilodriktasaṃnipātaharaḥ param | nātipathyaḥ śikhī pathyaḥ śrotrasvaravayodṛśām
verses.tib: bshang skems mdog bzang rlung shas che / 'dus pa sel ba'i dam pa yin / rma bya'i sha ni bzang min yang / rna mig skad 'gags rgas srar phan

verses.skt: tadvac ca kukkuṭo vṛṣyo grāmyas tu śleṣmalo guruḥ | medhānalakarā hṛdyāḥ krakarāḥ sopacakrakāḥ
verses.tib: khyim byed 'dra'i ro tsa la / grang gnas lci zhing bad kan skyed / gong mo u pa tsa krar bcas / yid gzhungs drod skyed yi gar 'ong

verses.skt: guruḥ salavaṇaḥ kāṇakapotaḥ sarvadoṣakṛt | caṭakāḥ śleṣmalāḥ snigdhā vātaghnāḥ śukralāḥ param
verses.tib: thi ba zhar ba'i sha lci zhing / tsha bro nyes pa thams cad skyed / bye'u sha bad kan skyed cing snum / rlung 'joms khu ba rab tu 'phel

verses.skt: gurūṣṇasnigdhamadhurā vargāś cāto yathottaram | mūtraśukrakṛto balyā vātaghnāḥ kaphapittalāḥ
verses.tib: sde tshan de las phyi ma rnams / rim bzhin lci dro snum zhing mngar / gcin mang ro tsa stobs skyed cing / rlung 'joms bad kan mkhris pa skyed

verses.skt: śītā mahāmṛgās teṣu kravyādaprasahāḥ punaḥ | lavaṇānurasāḥ pāke kaṭukā māṃsavardhanāḥ
verses.tib: de las ri dwags chen po bsil / rtsal mthus sha rlon za ba'i yang / ro rjes lan tshwa bro zhu rjes / tsha zhing sha ni 'phel bar byed

verses.skt: jīrṇārśograhaṇīdoṣaśoṣārtānāṃ paraṃ hitāḥ | nātiśītagurusnigdhaṃ māṃsam ājam adoṣalam
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum rnying pa pho ba grang / skem nad nyen la mchog tu phan / ra sha shin tu bsil min zhing / lci snum ma yin nyes med yin

verses.skt: śarīradhātusāmānyād anabhiṣyandi bṛṃhaṇam | viparītam ato jñeyam āvikaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ tu tat
verses.tib: lus dang khams ni mnyam pas na / bad kan mi skyed lus rtas byed / lug sha de las bzlog pa ste / lus rtas yin par shes par bya

verses.skt: śuṣkakāsaśramātyagniviṣamajvarapīnasān | kārśyaṃ kevalavātāṃś ca gomāṃsaṃ saṃniyacchati
verses.tib: ba lang sha ni lud skam dang / ngal dang tsho ches ma snyoms rims / cham pa dang ni skem pa dang / rlung nad gcig pu na ba sel

verses.skt: uṣṇo garīyān mahiṣaḥ svapnadārḍhyabṛhattvakṛt | tadvad varāhaḥ śramahā ruciśukrabalapradaḥ
verses.tib: ma he'i sha ni lci zhing tsha / gnyid che brtan byed shas cher skyed / phag rgod sha ni de 'dra zhing / ngal sel zas len khu stobs skyed

verses.skt: matsyāḥ paraṃ kaphakarāś cilicīmas tridoṣakṛt | lāvarohitagodhaiṇāḥ sve sve varge varāḥ param
verses.tib: nya ni mchog tu bad kan skyed / tsi li tsi ma nyes gsum skyed / la ba ro ha ti skyin gor / sha ba rang rang sde tshan mchog

verses.skt: matsyādipakṣiṇāṃ caiva gurūṇy aṇḍāni cādiśet | tāni snigdhāni vṛṣyāṇi svādupākarasāni ca
māṃsaṃ sadyohataṃ śuddhaṃ vayaḥsthaṃ ca bhajet tyajet | mṛtaṃ kṛśaṃ bhṛśaṃ medyaṃ vyādhivāriviṣair hatam
verses.tib: sha ni 'phral bsad pa dag dang / dar la bab pa bsten par bya / rang shi rid dang shin tu tsho / nad chu dug gis shi ba spang

verses.skt: puṃstriyoḥ pūrvapaścārdhe guruṇī garbhiṇī guruḥ | laghur yoṣic catuṣpātsu vihaṅgeṣu punaḥ pumān
verses.tib: pho dang mo yi stod smad phyed / lci ste sbrum ma thams cad lci / rkang bzhi mo yi yang ba yin / bya rnams kyi ni pho yi yang

verses.skt: śiraḥskandhorupṛṣṭhasya kaṭyāḥ sakthnoś ca gauravam | tathāmapakvāśayayor yathāpūrvaṃ vinirdiśet
verses.tib: mgo bo ro stod brang dang rgyab / rked pa dpyi yi lci ba yin / de bzhin pho ba rgyu ma sogs / bzhin du lci ba yin

verses.skt: śoṇitaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca dhātūnām uttarottaram | māṃsād garīyo vṛṣaṇameḍhravṛkkayakṛdgudam
verses.tib: khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams / phyi ma phyi ma lci ba yin / sha las rlig pa pho mtshan dang / mkhal ma mcher pa gzhang dag lci

verses.skt: śākaṃ pāṭhāśaṭhīsūṣāsuniṣaṇṇasatīnajam | tridoṣaghnaṃ laghu grāhi sarājakṣavavāstukam
verses.tib: sha'i sde tshan no / tshod ma pa tha sha ti dang / su sha su ni sha na dang / sa tin dza rgya sne'u / nyes pa gsum 'joms rtug sri yang

verses.skt: suniṣaṇṇo ’gnikṛd vṛṣyas teṣu rājakṣavaḥ param | grahaṇyarśovikāraghno varcobhedi tu vāstukam
verses.tib: de las su ni shan dro / ro tsa ra dzak+Sha pa ti / pho ba gzhang 'brum nad sel mchog / rgya sne'u rtug skam 'joms pa yin

verses.skt: hanti doṣatrayaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vṛṣyā soṣṇā rasāyanī | kākamācī sarā svaryā cāṅgery amlāgnidīpanī
verses.tib: mon sne'u dme ru nyes gsum 'joms / mdze sel ro tsa bcud len dro / 'khru zhing mgul pa snyan par byed / tsang gi ri skyur me drod skyed

verses.skt: grahaṇyarśo'nilaśleṣmanhitoṣṇā grāhiṇī laghuḥ | paṭolasaptalāriṣṭaśārṅgaṣṭāvalgujāmṛtāḥ
verses.tib: pho ba gzhang 'brum bad kan rlung / drod che 'khru gcod yang ba yin / pa to la dang sab ta la / nim pa shang gas+tha sle tres

verses.skt: vetrāgrabṛhatīvāsākutilītilaparṇikāḥ | maṇḍūkaparṇīkarkoṭakāravellakaparpaṭāḥ
verses.tib: a pal gu za rtsa'i myu gu / bri ha ti dang bA sha dang / ti la par Ni ku ta la / man du ka 'dab kar ko ta / ka ra be la par ba ta

verses.skt: nāḍīkalāyagojihvāvārtākaṃ vanatiktakam | karīraṃ kulakaṃ nandī kucailā śakulādanī
verses.tib: Na ti dang ni ka ta ya / go dzi ha dang bar da ka / ba na tig ta ka ri ram / ku li ka dang nan ti dang / ku tsel shag kun da ni

verses.skt: kaṭhillaṃ kembukaṃ śītaṃ sakośātakakarkaśam | tiktaṃ pāke kaṭu grāhi vātalaṃ kaphapittajit
verses.tib: ka til dang ke'u kam / sho tam ko sha ta ka dang / kar sha 'jam bsil kha zhing tsha / bshang sri rlung skyed bad mkhris sel

verses.skt: hṛdyaṃ paṭolaṃ kṛminut svādupākaṃ rucipradam | pittalaṃ dīpanaṃ bhedi vātaghnaṃ bṛhatīdvayam
verses.tib: pa to la zhim srin nad sel / zhu rjes mngar zhing yi ga 'byed / bri ha ti gnyis mkhris skyed 'khru / drod skyed rlung ni 'joms pa yin

verses.skt: vṛṣaṃ tu vamikāsaghnaṃ raktapittaharaṃ param | kāravellaṃ sakaṭukaṃ dīpanaṃ kaphajit param
verses.tib: bri shan rlung dang lud pa 'joms / khrag mkhris sel ba'i dam pa / yin / kar bel la kha ba dang / drod skyed bad kan sel mchog yin

verses.skt: vārtākaṃ kaṭutiktoṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ kaphavātajit | sakṣāram agnijananaṃ hṛdyaṃ rucyam apittalam
verses.tib: bar ta ka ro kha zhing tsha / mngar dro bad kan rlung dag sel / lan tshwar bcas pa me drod skyed / yid 'ong zas len mkhris mi skyed

verses.skt: karīram ādhmānakaraṃ kaṣāyaṃ svādu tiktakam | kośātakāvalgujakau bhedināv agnidīpanau
verses.tib: ka ri ra ni sbos byed cing / ro bska mngar zhing kha ba yin / ko sha ta ka bal gu za / 'khru zhing drod ni skyed byed yin

verses.skt: taṇḍulīyo himo rūkṣaḥ svādupākaraso laghuḥ | madapittaviṣāsraghno muñjātaṃ vātapittajit
verses.tib: tan du li bsil rtsub pa dang / ro mngar zhu rjes mngar zhing yang / chang nad mkhris nad dug khrag sal / mun dza las byung rlung mkhris sel

verses.skt: snigdhaṃ śītaṃ guru svādu bṛṃhaṇaṃ śukrakṛt param | gurvī sarā tu pālaṅkyā madaghnī cāpy upodakā
verses.tib: snum bsil lci zhing mngar ba dang / lus rtas khu ba 'phel ba'i mchog / pa lag kya lci 'khru bar byed / u po da ka chang nad 'joms

verses.skt: pālaṅkyāvat smṛtaś cañcuḥ sa tu saṃgrahaṇātmakaḥ | vidārī vātapittaghnī mūtralā svāduśītalā
verses.tib: tsu tsu pa lag kya 'dra las / de ni 'khru gcod bdag nyid can / bi da ri ni rlung mkhris sel / gcin mang mngar zhing bsil ba yin

verses.skt: jīvanī bṛṃhaṇī kaṇṭhyā gurvī vṛṣyā rasāyanam | cakṣuṣyā sarvadoṣaghnī jīvantī madhurā himā
verses.tib: 'tsho bar byed cing lkog nad sel / lus brta ro tsa lci bcud len / dzi ban ti mngar bsil ba dang / mig la phan zhing nyes gsum sel

verses.skt: kūṣmāṇḍatumbakāliṅgakarkārvervārutiṇḍiśam | tathā trapusacīnākacirbhaṭaṃ kaphavātakṛt
verses.tib: ku sman da bum sha ka ling / kar ka dang ni er ba ru / da na dis zhes bya ba dang / da na dis dang ga gon dang / tsin ta ka dang tsir bi ta / bad rlung skyed cing 'khrug cin mang

verses.skt: bhedi viṣṭambhy abhiṣyandi svādupākarasaṃ guru | vallīphalānāṃ pravaraṃ kūṣmāṇḍaṃ vātapittajit
verses.tib: bshang sri lci zhing zhu rjes mngar / 'khri shing 'bras bu'i nang na mchog / ku sman da ste rlung mkhris sel

verses.skt: vastiśuddhikaraṃ vṛṣyaṃ trapusaṃ tv atimūtralam | tumbaṃ rūkṣataraṃ grāhi kāliṅgairvārucirbhaṭam
verses.tib: gcin nad sel zhing ro tsar byed / ga gon shin tu gcin mang zhing / ku ba shin tu rtsub pa yin / ka ling ka dang er ba ru

verses.skt: bālaṃ pittaharaṃ śītaṃ vidyāt pakvam ato ’nyathā | śīrṇavṛntaṃ tu sakṣāraṃ pittalaṃ kaphavātajit
verses.tib: tsir bi mkhregs gzhon mkhris sel bsil / smin pa de las gzhan du byed / 'bras bu rnying lung lan tshwar bcas / mkhris skyed bad kan rlung nad sel

verses.skt: rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ hṛdyam aṣṭhīlānāhanul laghu | mṛṇālabisaśālūkakumudotpalakandakam
verses.tib: yi ga 'bye zhing dro yid 'ong / hen langs lto lbos sel zhing yang / pad rtsa rtsa ba ut+pal rtsa / ku mu ut+pal chu ba dang

verses.skt: nandīmāṣakakelūṭaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukam | krauñcādanaṃ kaloḍyaṃ ca rūkṣaṃ grāhi himaṃ guru
verses.tib: chus pa sha lu ka ta dang / sring gdang ga sha ru ka / kron dza da na ka lod / rtsub cing bshang sri bsil zhing lci

verses.skt: kadambanālikāmārṣakuṭiñjarakutumbakam | cillīlaṭvākaloṇīkākurūṭakagavedhukam
verses.tib: ka lam pa dang na li ka / mar she zhes ni bya ba dang / ku ti na dza ra ku kha / seng phrom yungs ma lo ni ka / ka ru da ka ga pe du

verses.skt: jīvantajhuñjhveḍagajayavaśākasuvarcalāḥ | ālukāni ca sarvāṇi tathā sūpyāni lakṣmaṇam
verses.tib: 'tsho byed dang ni dzun dzu dang / e dag dza dag dang ni / ya ba sha ka lcam pa dang / a lu ka thams cad dang / sran lo shing mngar lo ma dang

verses.skt: svādu rūkṣaṃ salavaṇaṃ vātaśleṣmakaraṃ guru | śītalaṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtraṃ prāyo viṣṭabhya jīryati
verses.tib: mngar zhing rtsub la lan tshwa bro / bad kan rlung skyed lci ba dang / bsil zhing bshang lci 'byung sla byed / phal cher zhu nas bshang gci mkhregs

verses.skt: svinnaṃ niṣpīḍitarasaṃ snehāḍhyaṃ nātidoṣalam | laghupattrā tu yā cillī sā vāstukasamā matā
verses.tib: tshos shing khu ba legs btsir la / mar cher btab pa nyes mi skyed / seng phrom 'dab ma zhes bya gang / de ni rgya sne'u dang 'drar 'dod

verses.skt: tarkārīvaruṇaṃ svādu satiktaṃ kaphavātajit | varṣābhvau kālaśākaṃ ca sakṣāraṃ kaṭutiktakam
verses.tib: tar ka ri bar na mngar / kha bcas rlung dang bad kan sel / pur+Na rnam gnyis ka la sha / cung zad tsha bro kha zhing tsha

verses.skt: dīpanaṃ bhedanaṃ hanti garaśophakaphānilān | dīpanāḥ kaphavātaghnāś ciribilvāṅkurāḥ sarāḥ
verses.tib: drod skyed khong 'khru sbyar dug dang / 'or nad bad kan rlung nad 'joms / tsi bi ra yi myu gu ni / drod skyed rlung dang bad sel 'khru

verses.skt: saṃgrāhi śālmalīpuṣpaṃ pittāsraghnaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: nye'u shing myu gu kha ba ste

verses.skt: śatāvaryaṅkurās tiktā vṛṣyā doṣatrayāpahāḥ | rūkṣo vaṃśakarīras tu vidāhī vātapittalaḥ
verses.tib: ro tsa nyes gsum sel ba yin / smyig ma'i myu gu rtsub pa dang / khong tsha rlung dang mkhris pa skyed / ba ru ra ni drod skyed kha

verses.skt: pattūro dīpanas tiktaḥ plīhārśaḥkaphavātajit | kṛmikāsakaphotkledān kāsamardo jayet saraḥ
verses.tib: mcher pa gzhang 'brum bad rlung sel / ka sa mar da srin lung pa / bad kan sel zhing zhu byed 'khru

verses.skt: rūkṣoṣṇam amlaṃ kausumbhaṃ guru pittakaraṃ saram | gurūṣṇaṃ sārṣapaṃ baddhaviṇmūtraṃ sarvadoṣakṛt
verses.tib: le brgan rtsi tshod rtsub skyur tsha / lci zhing mkhris pa skyed la 'khru / yungs kar tshod ma lci zhing tsha / bshang dang lci 'gags nyes kun skyed

verses.skt: yad bālam avyaktarasaṃ kiñcitkṣāraṃ satiktakam | tan mūlakaṃ doṣaharaṃ laghu soṣṇaṃ niyacchati
verses.tib: la phug gzhon nu ro mi gsal / cung zad tsha bro kha dang bcas / gang yin de ni nyes kun sel / yang zhing cung zad tsha ba dang

verses.skt: gulmakāsakṣayaśvāsavraṇanetragalāmayān | svarāgnisādodāvartapīnasāṃś ca mahat punaḥ
verses.tib: skran dang lud gcong dbugs mi bde / rma dang mig nad lkog nad sel / skad 'gags drod chung rtug skam dang / cham pa'i nad ni 'joms pa yin

verses.skt: rase pāke ca kaṭukam uṣṇavīryaṃ tridoṣakṛt | gurv abhiṣyandi ca snigdhasiddhaṃ tad api vātajit
verses.tib: nar son ro dang zhu rjes tsha / drod skyed byed cing nyes gsum skyed / bad kan skyed lci btsos pa ni / snum zhing de yang rlung sel yin

verses.skt: vātaśleṣmaharaṃ śuṣkaṃ sarvam āmaṃ tu doṣalam | kaṭūṣṇo vātakaphahā piṇḍāluḥ pittavardhanaḥ
verses.tib: skam po rlung dang bad kan sel / rjen pa thams cad nyes skyed yin / yungs ma tsha zhing dro ba dang / bad kan rlung sel mkhris pa skyed / shan ta mU la mkhris sel zhing / bsil zhing zhu rjes mngar ba dang / ro mngar kha zhing bska ba ste / bad kan dug kyang sel bar bshad

verses.skt: kuṭheraśigrusurasasumukhāsuribhūstṛṇam | phaṇijjārjakajambīraprabhṛti grāhi śālanam
verses.tib: ku ther bye'u rug shi kru / su mu kha dang ske / tshe dang / bu srin dang pha ni dza / zin thig le dang dzam bi ra / de la pa'i ldum rnams ni

verses.skt: vidāhi kaṭu rūkṣoṣṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ dīpanarocanam | dṛkśukrakṛmihṛt tīkṣṇaṃ doṣotkleśakaraṃ laghu
verses.tib: bshang gci sra zhing me drod skyed / khong pa tsha byed kha rtsub tsha / yid 'ong lus dro yi ga 'bye / mig gnod khu ba srin 'joms rno

verses.skt: hidhmākāsaviṣaśvāsapārśvarukpūtigandhahā | surasaḥ sumukho nātividāhī garaśophahā
verses.tib: skrang par byed dang yang ba yin / bye rug skyigs lud dbugs mi bde / rtsib logs zug dug kha mnam sel / su mu kha ni rab tsha min / sbyar dug 'or nad sel ba yin

verses.skt: ārdrikā tiktamadhurā mūtralā na ca pittakṛt | laśuno bhṛśatīkṣṇoṣṇaḥ kaṭupākarasaḥ saraḥ
verses.tib: 'u su'i lo ma kha zhing mngar / gcin mang mkhris pa skyed ma yin / sgog skya rab tu tsha zhing rno / zhu rjes tsha zhing 'khru ba dang

verses.skt: hṛdyaḥ keśyo gurur vṛṣyaḥ snigdho rocanadīpanaḥ | bhagnasaṃdhānakṛd balyo raktapittapradūṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: zhim zhing skra skyed lci ro tsha / snam zhing drod skyed yi ga 'bye / sha bkra mdze skran gzhang 'brum dang

verses.skt: kilāsakuṣṭhagulmārśomehakṛmikaphānilān | sahidhmāpīnasaśvāsakāsān hanti rasāyanam
verses.tib: gcin nad srin dang bad kan rlung / skyigs bu cham pa dbugs mi bde / lud pa sel te khrag mkhris skyed

verses.skt: palāṇḍus tadguṇanyūnaḥ śleṣmalo nātipittalaḥ | kaphavātārśasāṃ pathyaḥ svede ’bhyavahṛtau tathā
verses.tib: kun dong de las yon tan dman / bad kan skyed mkhris rab mi skyed / ke'u btsos dug sbyar zos pa yis / bad kan rlung dang gzhang 'brum sel

verses.skt: tīkṣṇo gṛñjanako grāhī pittināṃ hitakṛn na saḥ | dīpanaḥ sūraṇo rucyaḥ kaphaghno viśado laghuḥ
verses.tib: rno zhing rtug pa sri ba dang / de ni mkhris can la phan min / su ra drod skyed kha zas len / bad sel dri ma sbyong zhing yang

verses.skt: viśeṣād arśasāṃ pathyo bhūkandas tv atidoṣalaḥ | pattre puṣpe phale nāle kande ca gurutā kramāt
verses.tib: mchog tu gzhang 'brum dag la phan / sbang phrum shin tu nyes skyed yin / me tog 'dab ma 'bras yal ga / sdong bu rim bzhin lci ba yin

verses.skt: varā śākeṣu jīvantī sārṣapaṃ tv avaraṃ param | drākṣā phalottamā vṛṣyā cakṣuṣyā sṛṣṭamūtraviṭ
verses.tib: tshod ma'i rab mchog 'tsho byed yin / yungs kar tshod ma tha chad yin / tshod rngad rnams kyi sde tshan no / rgun 'brum 'bras bu'i mchog yin te / ro tsa mig sman bshang gci sla

verses.skt: svādupākarasā snigdhā sakaṣāyā himā guruḥ | nihanty anilapittāsratiktāsyatvamadātyayān
verses.tib: mngar zhing zhu rjes snum pa dang / cung zad bska zhing bsil la lci / rlung dang khrag mkhris sel byed cing / kha nang kha bro chang nad dang

verses.skt: tṛṣṇākāsaśramaśvāsasvarabhedakṣatakṣayān | udriktapittāñ jayati trīn doṣān svādu dāḍimam
verses.tib: skom lud tshad rims dbugs mi bde / skad 'dzer glo rdol glo gcong sel / bal po se'u mngar mkhris rgyas dang / nyes pa gsum po sel ba yin

verses.skt: pittāvirodhi nātyuṣṇam amlaṃ vātakaphāpaham | sarvaṃ hṛdyaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ grāhi rocanadīpanam
verses.tib: skyur ba mkhris skyed min cung dro / rlung dang bad kan 'joms par byed / se'u kun kyang yid 'ong snum / yang zhing bshang sra drod zas len

verses.skt: mocakharjūrapanasanārikelaparūṣakam | āmrātatālakāśmaryarājādanamadhūkajam
verses.tib: mo tsha 'bra go pa nas / rgya / star pa ru sha ka dang / a mra ta la kasma 'bras / ra ja da na ma du'i 'bras

verses.skt: sauvīrabadarāṅkollaphalguśleṣmātakodbhavam | vātāmābhiṣukākṣoṭamukūlakanikocakam
verses.tib: rgya shug so bi ra ang kol / phal ku sles ma ta'i 'bras bu / ta mal bi shu star ga'i 'bras / myu gu la dang rgya kham dang

verses.skt: urumāṇaṃ priyālaṃ ca bṛṃhaṇaṃ guru śītalam | dāhakṣatakṣayaharaṃ raktapittaprasādanam
verses.tib: a ru ma na pi yal 'bras / rtas byed lci zhing bsil ba yin / lus tsha glo rdol glo gcong sel / khrag dang mkhris pa snyoms par byed

verses.skt: svādupākarasaṃ snigdhaṃ viṣṭambhi kaphaśukrakṛt | phalaṃ tu pittalaṃ tālaṃ saraṃ kāśmaryajaṃ himam
verses.tib: zhu rjes mngar zhing snum pa dang / bshang lci bad kan khu ba 'phel / ta la'i 'bras bu mkhris skyed 'khru / kasma rgya 'bras bsil ba dang

verses.skt: śakṛnmūtravibandhaghnaṃ keśyaṃ medhyaṃ rasāyanam | vātāmādy uṣṇavīryaṃ tu kaphapittakaraṃ saram
verses.tib: bshang lci 'gags pa sel byed cing / skra byed yid gzhungs bcud len 'gyur / pa ta ma dro ba dang / bad kan mkhris pa skyed byed 'khru

verses.skt: paraṃ vātaharaṃ snigdham anuṣṇaṃ tu priyālajam | priyālamajjā madhuro vṛṣyaḥ pittānilāpahaḥ
verses.tib: snum zhing mchog tu rlung skyed byed / pi la ya'i 'bras tshab min / pi la ya yi tshi gu mngar / ro tsa mkhris pa rlung nad sel

verses.skt: kolamajjā guṇais tadvat tṛṭchardiḥkāsajic ca saḥ | pakvaṃ sudurjaraṃ bilvaṃ doṣalaṃ pūtimārutam
verses.tib: rgya shug tshi gu'i yon tan ni / de 'dra skam slon lud pa sel / bil 'bras smin pa 'ju dka' zhing / nyes skyed 'phyen ni dri ba byed / ma smin drod skyed bad rlung sel

verses.skt: dīpanaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ bālaṃ grāhy ubhayaṃ ca tat | kapittham āmaṃ kaṇṭhaghnaṃ doṣalaṃ doṣaghāti tu
verses.tib: de dag gnyis ka 'khru ba gcod / ma smin ka pid mgul nad dab / nyes pa kun skyed smin pa ni / nyes 'joms skyigs bu slon bro sel

verses.skt: pakvaṃ hidhmāvamathujit sarvaṃ grāhi viṣāpaham | jāmbavaṃ guru viṣṭambhi śītalaṃ bhṛśavātalam
verses.tib: kun kyang 'khru gcod dug 'joms yin / 'dzam bu'i shang tog bshang gci sri / bsil zhing shin tu rlung skyed yin

verses.skt: saṃgrāhi mūtraśakṛtor akaṇṭhyaṃ kaphapittajit | vātapittāsrakṛd bālaṃ baddhāsthi kaphapittakṛt
verses.tib: bshang dang lci ba gcod byed cing / lkog ma la gnod bad mkhris sel / a mra'i 'bras bu ma smin rlung / khrag mkhris skyed byed rus chags pa / bad kan mkhris skyed min rlung skyed / lci mngar bad kan khu ba 'phel / br-ik+Sha am+la rtsub bshang sri / lci tsha bad kan rlung dag 'joms

verses.skt: gurv āmraṃ vātajit pakvaṃ svādv amlaṃ kaphaśukrakṛt | vṛkṣāmlaṃ grāhi rūkṣoṣṇaṃ vātaśleṣmaharaṃ laghu
verses.tib: bshang dang lci ba gcod byed cing / lkog ma la gnod bad mkhris sel / a mra'i 'bras bu ma smin rlung / khrag mkhris skyed byed rus chags pa / bad kan mkhris skyed min rlung skyed / lci mngar bad kan khu ba 'phel / br-ik+Sha am+la rtsub bshang sri / lci tsha bad kan rlung dag 'joms

verses.skt: tṛṣṇāghnam uṣṇam amlāyāḥ phalaṃ pittakaraṃ saram
verses.tib: sha mya tsha lci skra gnod rtsub / pi lu'i 'bras bu mkhris pa skyed

verses.skt: śamyā gurūṣṇaṃ keśaghnaṃ rūkṣaṃ pīlu tu pittalam | kaphavātaharaṃ bhedi plīhārśaḥkṛmigulmanut
verses.tib: bad kan rlung nad sel zhing 'khru / mcher pa gzhang 'brum skran srin sel

verses.skt: satiktaṃ svādu yat pīlu nātyuṣṇaṃ tat tridoṣajit | tvak tiktakaṭukā snigdhā mātuluṅgasya vātajit
verses.tib: pi lu mngar zhing kha ba gang / shin tu tsha min nyes gsum 'joms / ba lu shun kha tsha zhing snum / rlung nad sel bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: bṛṃhaṇaṃ madhuraṃ māṃsaṃ vātapittaharaṃ guru | laghu tatkesaraṃ kāsaśvāsahidhmāmadātyayān
verses.tib: ba lung 'bras shas rtas byed mngar / rlung dang mkhris pa sel zhing lci / de yis rkang yang / skyigs lud pa / dbugs mi bde dang chang nad sel

verses.skt: āsyaśoṣānilaśleṣmavibandhacchardyarocakān | gulmodarārśaḥśūlāni mandāgnitvaṃ ca nāśayet
verses.tib: kha skam rlung dang bad kan dang / rtug sra skyugs bro yi ga 'chus / skran dang gzhang 'brum gzer nad dang / me drod chung ba nyid sel to

verses.skt: madhuraṃ kiñcid amlaṃ ca hṛdyaṃ bhaktaprarocakam | guru vātapraśamanaṃ vidyān nāraṅgajaṃ phalam
verses.tib: na rang ga 'bras mngar cung skyur / yi gar 'ong zhing kha zas len / lci zhing rlung ni rab skyed pa'i / yon tan ldan par shes par bya

verses.skt: bhallātakasya tvaṅmāṃsaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ svādu śītalam | tadasthyagnisamaṃ medhyaṃ kaphavātaharaṃ param
verses.tib: bse shing 'bras bu'i shun pa sha / khong rtas byed cing mngar la bsil / de'i rus me mnyam yid gzhungs byed / bad kan rlung ni sel ba'i mchog

verses.skt: svādv amlaṃ śītam uṣṇaṃ ca dvidhā pālevataṃ guru | rucyam atyagniśamanaṃ rucyaṃ madhuram ārukam
verses.tib: ku shu rnam gnyis lci ba ste / mngar skyur bsil dang tsha ba yin / yi ga 'bye zhing me rab 'bri / kham sha yi ga 'byed cing mngar

verses.skt: pakvam āśu jarāṃ yāti nātyuṣṇagurudoṣalam | drākṣāparūṣakaṃ cārdram amlaṃ pittakaphapradam
verses.tib: smin pa myur du 'ju bar 'gyur / shin tu tsha min lci nyes skyed / rgun 'brum pa ru sha ka dang / ka ra mar dang btsos rlon skyur / mkhris pa bad kan skyed cing 'khru

verses.skt: gurūṣṇavīryaṃ vātaghnaṃ saraṃ sakaramardakam | tathāmlaṃ kolakarkandhulikucāmrātakārukam
verses.tib: lci zhing nus tsha rlung 'joms so / rgya shug skyur thung li gu tshe / a mra ka ta de bzhin no

verses.skt: airāvataṃ dantaśaṭhaṃ satūdaṃ mṛgaliṇḍikam | nātipittakaraṃ pakvaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca karamardakam
verses.tib: e ra ba ti tu da dang / mri ka lin da dzam bir bcas / smin dang ka ra yar ta skam / mkhris pa shin tu skyed byed min

verses.skt: dīpanaṃ bhedanaṃ śuṣkam amlīkākolayoḥ phalam | tṛṣṇāśramaklamacchedi laghv iṣṭaṃ kaphavātayoḥ
verses.tib: am+li ka dang rgya shug skyur / skam po drod skyed 'khru ba dang / skom dang ngal dang rmya ba sel / yang zhing rlung dang bad kan 'joms

verses.skt: svādv amlaṃ laghu kolaṃ tu śuṣkaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca dīpanam
phalānām avaraṃ tatra likucaṃ sarvadoṣakṛt | himānaloṣṇadurvātavyālalālādidūṣitam
verses.tib: de las 'bras bu kun tha chad / li gu tsi ste nad kun slong / kha ba me dang rlung gnod nyen / sbrul gyi kha chu pas phog

verses.skt: vātaghnaṃ durjaraṃ proktaṃ nāraṅgaṃ kaphakṛd guru | tṛṣṇāśūlakaphotkledacchardiśvāsanivāraṇam
nārikelaṃ guru snigdhaṃ pittaghnaṃ svādu śītalam | balamāṃsakaraṃ hṛdyaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vastiśodhanam
jantujuṣṭaṃ jale magnam abhūmijam anārtavam | anyadhānyayutaṃ hīnavīryaṃ jīrṇatayāti ca
verses.tib: srin bus zos dang chu nang ltung / sa ngan dus min skyes pa dang / 'bru gzhan 'dres zhing mthu nyams dang

verses.skt: dhānyaṃ tyajet tathā śākaṃ rūkṣasiddham akomalam | asaṃjātarasaṃ tadvac chuṣkaṃ cānyatra mūlakāt
verses.tib: shin tu rnying 'gyur 'bru spang bya / tshod ma'ang de bzhin rtsub par ni / g.yos pa dag dang mi snyi dang / ro ni smin par ma gyur dang / la phug ma gtogs skam po dang

verses.skt: prāyeṇa phalam apy evaṃ tathāmaṃ bilvavarjitam | viṣyandi lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sṛṣṭamalaṃ viduḥ
verses.tib: 'bras bu'ang phal cher de bzhin te / bil ba ma gtogs rlon pa spang / 'bras bu'i sde tshan no / lan tshwa kun kyang bad kan skyed / phra zhing bshang gci 'byin la 'jam

verses.skt: vātaghnaṃ pāki tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ rocanaṃ kaphapittakṛt | saindhavaṃ tatra sasvādu vṛṣyaṃ hṛdyaṃ tridoṣanut
verses.tib: rlung 'joms 'ju byed tsha zhing rno / yi ga 'bye zhing bad mkhris skyed / de la lce myang tsha mngar bcas / ro tsa yid 'ong nyes gsum sel

verses.skt: laghv anuṣṇaṃ dṛśaḥ pathyam avidāhy agnidīpanam | laghu sauvarcalaṃ hṛdyaṃ sugandhy udgāraśodhanam
verses.tib: yang zhing tsha la mig la phan / tsha ba mi skyed me drod skyed / rtsal ru tsha yang yid 'ong zhing / sgregs pa sbyong zhing dri zhim la

verses.skt: kaṭupākaṃ vibandhaghnaṃ dīpanīyaṃ rucipradam | ūrdhvādhaḥkaphavātānulomanaṃ dīpanaṃ viḍam
verses.tib: zhu rjes tsha zhing bshang sri sel / drod skyed yi ga 'byed byed yin / kha ru tsha ni stod bad kan / smad kyi rlung 'byin drod skyed la / bshang 'gags lto sbos rtug skam dang

verses.skt: vibandhānāhaviṣṭambhaśūlagauravanāśanam | vipāke svādu sāmudraṃ guru śleṣmavivardhanam
verses.tib: gzer zug lus lci sel ba yin / rgya mtsho'i lan tshwa zhu rjes mngar / lci zhing bad kan rnam 'phel byed / bkod ma'i tsha ni cung zad kha

verses.skt: satiktakaṭukakṣāraṃ tīkṣṇam utkledi caudbhidam | kṛṣṇe sauvarcalaguṇā lavaṇe gandhavarjitāḥ
verses.tib: tsha dang ba tsha rno byed gsher / kha ru tsha nag yon tan dri / ma gtogs yon tan bi dar mtshungs / mtsho tsha yang ste sa skam tsha

verses.skt: romakaṃ laghu pāṃsūtthaṃ sakṣāraṃ śleṣmalaṃ guru | lavaṇānāṃ prayoge tu saindhavādi prayojayet
verses.tib: bad kan skyed cing 'ju dka' lci / lan tshwa rnams kyi sbyor ba la / rgya mtsho la sogs rab tu sbyar / nas tshig 'khus pa'i lan tshwa ni

verses.skt: gulmahṛdgrahaṇīpāṇḍuplīhānāhagalāmayān | śvāsārśaḥkaphakāsāṃś ca śamayed yavaśūkajaḥ
verses.tib: skran dang snying nad skya rbab dang / pho ba mcher pa lkog nad dang / lud pa gzhang 'brum dbugs mi bde / lto sbos bad kan sel ba yin

verses.skt: kṣāraḥ sarvaś ca paramaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇaḥ kṛmijil laghuḥ | pittāsṛgdūṣaṇaḥ pākī chedy ahṛdyo vidāraṇaḥ
verses.tib: swa rdzi ka sogs thal tsha kun / rab rno tsha zhing srin sel yang / khrag mkhris skyed byed smin byed la / gcod cing mi zhim rnam par 'byed

verses.skt: apathyaḥ kaṭulāvaṇyāc chukraujaḥkeśacakṣuṣām | hiṅgu vātakaphānāhaśūlaghnaṃ pittakopanam
verses.tib: nas tshig 'khus tsha kha bas na / mdog mdangs khu ba skra mig gnod / shing kun rlung dang bad kan sel / gzer 'joms mkhris pa skyed byed de

verses.skt: kaṭupākarasaṃ rucyaṃ dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ laghu | kaṣāyā madhurā pāke rūkṣā vilavaṇā laghuḥ
verses.tib: zhu rjes ro tsha yi ga 'byed / drod skyed zas 'ju yang ba yin / a ru ra bska zhu rjes mngar / rtsub cing lan tshwa'i ro med yang

verses.skt: dīpanī pācanī medhyā vayasaḥ sthāpanī param | uṣṇavīryā sarāyuṣyā buddhīndriyabalapradā
verses.tib: drod che zas 'ju yid gzhungs byed / na tshod la 'jog dam pa yin / dro zhing 'khrul tshe la phan / blo dang dbang gsal stobs rab skyed

verses.skt: kuṣṭhavaivarṇyavaisvaryapurāṇaviṣamajvarān | śiro'kṣipāṇḍuhṛdrogakāmalāgrahaṇīgadān
verses.tib: mdze dang bzhin lus mdog mi sdug / skad 'gags rims rnying mi bzad rims / mig nad skya rbab dang / mig ser pho ba'i nad rnams dang / skem bcas 'or dang gcin nad sel

verses.skt: saśoṣaśophātīsāramedamohavamikṛmīn | śvāsakāsaprasekārśaḥplīhānāhagarodaram
verses.tib: tshad 'khru rmongs bag myos slon srin / mchil mang lud pa dbugs mi bde / gzhang 'brum mcher pa lto sbos dug

verses.skt: vibandhaṃ srotasāṃ gulmam ūrustambham arocakam | harītakī jayed vyādhīṃs tāṃs tāṃś ca kaphavātajān
verses.tib: gsum 'phel rgyun 'gags skran dang ni / da rgan na dang yi ga 'chus / rlung dang bad kan las gyur nad / de dang de ni sel byed yin

verses.skt: tadvad āmalakaṃ śītam amlaṃ pittakaphāpaham | kaṭu pāke himaṃ keśyam akṣam īṣac ca tadguṇam
verses.tib: skyu ru ra yang de 'dra bsil / ro skyur bad mkhris sel de las / yon tan cung dman ba ru ra / zhu rjes tsha mngar skra mig phan

verses.skt: iyaṃ rasāyanavarā triphalākṣyāmayāpahā | ropaṇī tvag gadakledamedomehakaphāsrajit
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum po 'di dag ni / bcud kyis len mchog mig nad sel / rma 'tsho pags nad rma red dang / tshil ches gcin snyi bad khrag sel

verses.skt: sakesaraṃ caturjātaṃ tvakpattrailaṃ trijātakam | pittaprakopi tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ rocanadīpanam
verses.tib: shing tsha sug smel b+ha dra gsum / ge sar bcas pa dri bzang bzhi / na le sham ni mkhris skyed rno / rtsub cing drod skyed yi ga 'byed

verses.skt: sugandhi sarvapeyānāṃ vyañjanānāṃ ca vāsanam | lehānāṃ khādyapākānāṃ cūrṇānāṃ ca prayojayet
rase pāke ca kaṭukaṃ kaphaghnaṃ maricaṃ laghu | śleṣmalā svāduśītārdrā gurvī snigdhā ca pippalī
verses.tib: ro dang zhu rjes dag kyang tsha / bad kan 'joms shing yang ba yin / pi pi ling rlon bang skyed mngar / bsil zhing lci la snum pa yin

verses.skt: sā śuṣkā viparītātaḥ snigdhā vṛṣyā rase kaṭuḥ | svādupākānilaśleṣmaśvāsakāsāpahā sarā
verses.tib: skam po de las bzlog pa yin / snum zhing ro tsa ro tsha la / zhu rjes mngar zhing bad rlung dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde sel 'khru

verses.skt: na tām aty upayuñjīta rasāyanavidhiṃ vinā | nāgaraṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ grāhi hṛdyaṃ vibandhanut
verses.tib: gzhan las shas cher sbyar mi bya / dong gra drod skyed ro tsa dang / 'khru gcod yid 'ong mkhregs pa sel

verses.skt: rucyaṃ laghu svādupākaṃ snigdhoṣṇaṃ kaphavātajit | tadvad ārdrakam etac ca trayaṃ trikaṭukaṃ jayet
verses.tib: yi ga 'bye yang zhu rjes mngar / khong snum drod che bad rlung sel / sge'u gsher de 'dra de dag ni / tsha ba gsum ste sha spom dang

verses.skt: sthaulyāgnisadanaśvāsakāsaślīpadapīnasān | cavikāpippalīmūlaṃ maricālpāntaraṃ guṇaiḥ
verses.tib: me drod nyams dang dbugs mi bde / lud pa rkang bam cham pa 'joms / dbyi mo pi pi ling rtsa ba / nal sham yon tan cung zad chung

verses.skt: citrako ’gnisamaḥ pāke śophārśaḥkṛmikuṣṭhahā | pañcakolakam etac ca maricena vinā smṛtam
verses.tib: tsi tra ka stobs me dang mnyam / 'or nad gzhang 'brum srin mdze sel / 'di rnams las ni na le sham / ma gtogs tsha ba lnga zhes bshad

verses.skt: gulmaplīhodarānāhaśūlaghnaṃ dīpanaṃ param | bilvakāśmaryatarkārīpāṭalāṭuṇṭukair mahat
verses.tib: skran chen dmu rdzing lto sbos dang / gzer 'joms drod ni skyed pa'i mchog / bil ba kash+ma tar ka ri / ba ta la dang dun du ka

verses.skt: jayet kaṣāyatiktoṣṇaṃ pañcamūlaṃ kaphānilau | hrasvaṃ bṛhatyaṃśumatīdvayagokṣurakaiḥ smṛtam
verses.tib: rtsa chen lnga po bska kha dro / rlung dang bad kan sel byed yin / ang shu ma ti pri ha ti / gnyis gnyis gze rtsa chung lngar bshad

verses.skt: svādupākarasaṃ nātiśītoṣṇaṃ sarvadoṣajit | balāpunarnavairaṇḍaśūrpaparṇīdvayena tu
verses.tib: zhu rjes ro mngar ha cang ni / bsil dang tsha min nyes kun sel / ba la pur+Na e raN+Da / su pya par+Ni rnam gnyis rtsa

verses.skt: madhyamaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ nātipittakaraṃ saram | abhīruvīrājīvantījīvakarṣabhakaiḥ smṛtam
verses.tib: 'bring yin bad / kan rlung 'joms yin / shin tu mkhris pa mi skyed 'khru / nye'u shing ka ko la 'tsho byed / dzi ba ka dang ri shar bshad

verses.skt: jīvanākhyaṃ tu cakṣuṣyaṃ vṛṣyaṃ pittānilāpaham | tṛṇākhyaṃ pittajid darbhakāśekṣuśaraśālibhiḥ
verses.tib: 'tsho byed ces bya mig la phan / ro tsa rlung dang mkhris pa sel / 'jag ma ku sha 'bras bur shing / 'dam rtsa rtsar bshad lnga mkhris sel

verses.skt: śūkaśimbījapakvānnamāṃsaśākaphalauṣadhaiḥ | vargitair annaleśo ’yam ukto nityopayogikaḥ
verses.tib: gra ma gang bu g.yos sbyar zas / sha dang tshod ma shing tog sman / zas cha cung zad tshan gdus 'di / rtag tu dgos pa yod pa smra

verses.skt: rājā rājagṛhāsanne prāṇācāryaṃ niveśayet | sarvadā sa bhavaty evaṃ sarvatra pratijāgṛviḥ
verses.tib: rgyal po'i pho brang nye 'khor du / srog 'tsho'i slob dpon gzhag par bya / de ltar byas pas thams cad du / thams cad las ni bsrung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: annapānaṃ viṣād rakṣed viśeṣeṇa mahīpateḥ | yogakṣemau tadāyattau dharmādyā yannibandhanāḥ
verses.tib: khyad par du ni sa bdag gi / zas skom dug las bsrung bar bya / chos la dang gang 'brel pa'i / 'byor ba de de la rag las so

verses.skt: odano viṣavān sāndro yāty avisrāvyatām iva | cireṇa pacyate pakvo bhavet paryuṣitopamaḥ
verses.tib: 'bras chan dug bcas gsher bag kyang / skam bag can ni 'dra bar 'gyur / yun ring tshos par gyur pa dang

verses.skt: mayūrakaṇṭhatulyoṣmā mohamūrchāprasekakṛt | hīyate varṇagandhādyaiḥ klidyate candrikācitaḥ
verses.tib: tshos pa'ang zhag lon lta bur 'gyur / rlangs pa rma bya'i mgrin 'dra zhing / khong myos brgyal dang lus rngul skyed / dri dang mdog nyams par 'gyur

verses.skt: 7.4dv klidyate candrakānvitaḥ vyañjanāny āśu śuṣyanti dhyāmakvāthāni tatra ca | hīnātiriktā vikṛtā chāyā dṛśyeta naiva vā
verses.tib: rul zhing rma bya'i sgro ltar 'tsher / tshod ma myur du skams pa dang / bskol ba'i mdog ni gnag 'gyur zhing / der gzugs chung ba'am che ba'am / mi sdug pa'am mi snang 'gyur

verses.skt: phenordhvarājisīmantatantubudbudasaṃbhavaḥ | vicchinnavirasāḥ rāgāḥ khāṇḍavāḥ śākam āmiṣam
verses.tib: dbu ba steng 'byung ri mo mtshams / kha chu 'dra dang chu bur 'byung / btung ba mngar skyur tshod ma dang / sha dag mtshams bye ro dang bral

verses.skt: nīlā rājī rase tāmrā kṣīre dadhani dṛśyate | śyāvāpītāsitā takre ghṛte pānīyasaṃnibhā
verses.tib: sha khu'i ri mo sngor snang zhing / 'o ma zangs mdog zho dri ma / dar ba la ni ser dang gnag / mar khu chu dang 'dra bar snang

verses.skt: mastuni syāt kapotābhā rājī kṛṣṇā tuṣodake | kālī madyāmbhasoḥ kṣaudre harit taile ’ruṇopamā
verses.tib: chang dang chu rnag sbrang rtsi la / ljang snang til mar dag la dmar

verses.skt: pākaḥ phalānām āmānāṃ pakvānāṃ parikothanam | dravyāṇām ārdraśuṣkāṇāṃ syātāṃ mlānivivarṇate
verses.tib: shing tog ma smin smin par snang / smin pa dag ni yongs su 'drul / kha zas rlon dang skam pa dag / rnyings shing mdog / ni nyams par 'gyur

verses.skt: mṛdūnāṃ kaṭhinānāṃ ca bhavet sparśaviparyayaḥ | mālyasya sphuṭitāgratvaṃ mlānir gandhāntarodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: snyi ba dang ni sra ba dag / reg pa go ni bzlog par 'gyur / me tog phreng rtse lo ma gas / rnying cing dri ni mi zhim 'gyur

verses.skt: dhyāmamaṇḍalatā vastre śadanaṃ tantupakṣmaṇām | dhātumauktikakāṣṭhāśmaratnādiṣu malāktatā
verses.tib: gos la nag po tal til dang / spu rnams 'thul zhing kha tshar 'chad / gser dngul mu tig shing dang rdo / rin chen la dri ma chags

verses.skt: snehasparśaprabhāhāniḥ saprabhatvaṃ tu mṛnmaye | viṣadaḥ śyāvaśuṣkāsyo vilakṣo vīkṣate diśaḥ
verses.tib: gzi mdangs reg pa 'od nyams 'gyur / sa yi snod ni mdog bcas byed / dug ster kha ni sngo bskams la / gnong bag gis ni phyogs su blta

verses.skt: svedavepathumāṃs trasto bhītaḥ skhalati jṛmbhate | prāpyānnaṃ saviṣaṃ tv agnir ekāvartaḥ sphuṭaty ati
verses.tib: rngul zhing 'dar la skrag pa dang / 'jigs shing 'gros 'khyor glal bar 'gyur / dug ldan zas ni mes bsregs na / me lce gcig 'khyil me stag rgal

verses.skt: śikhikaṇṭhābhadhūmārcir anarcir vogragandhavān | mriyante makṣikāḥ prāśya kākaḥ kṣāmasvaro bhavet
verses.tib: du ba rma bya'i mgrin 'drar 'gyur / me lce mi 'bar 'bar yang mnan / sbrang mas zos na 'chi bar 'gyur / bya rog gis zos skad zhan 'gyur

verses.skt: utkrośanti ca dṛṣṭvaitac chukadātyūhasārikāḥ | haṃsaḥ praskhalati glānir jīvañjīvasya jāyate
verses.tib: 'di ni ne tso da ru ha / ri skegs kyis mthong ca co 'byin / ngang pas zos na rdeg 'chos la / shang shang te'u na bar 'gyur

verses.skt: cakorasyākṣivairāgyaṃ krauñcasya syān madodayaḥ | kapotaparabhṛddakṣacakravākā jahaty asūn
verses.tib: sreg pa mig ni mi chags byed / khrung khrung dag ni 'dzur bar 'gyur / phug ron khu byug bya gag dang / ngur bas zos na 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: udvegaṃ yāti mārjāraḥ śakṛn muñcati vānaraḥ | hṛṣyen mayūras taddṛṣṭyā mandatejo bhaved viṣam
verses.tib: byi la skyo zhing 'dor bar 'gyur / spre'u mi gtsang 'dor bar byed / rma byas de mthong dga' bar byed / dug gi dbal ni nyams par 'gyur

verses.skt: ity annaṃ viṣavaj jñātvā tyajed evaṃ prayatnataḥ | yathā tena vipadyerann api na kṣudrajantavaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar zas ni dug ldan par / shes shing ci nas de yi ni / srog chags phra mo yan chad la / gnod par 'gyur bas 'bad de dor

verses.skt: spṛṣṭe tu kaṇḍūdāhoṣājvarārtisphoṭasuptayaḥ | nakharomacyutiḥ śophaḥ sekādyā viṣanāśanāḥ
verses.tib: reg na tsha zhing g.ya' lan / rims 'debs 'brum 'byung tshor ba chung / sen mo spu 'byung lus skrangs te / de la dug ni rnam 'jig pa'i

verses.skt: śastās tatra pralepāś ca sevyacandanapadmakaiḥ | sasomavalkatālīśapattrakuṣṭhāmṛtānataiḥ
verses.tib: tsan+dan shug pa pu shel tsi / so ma'i shun bcas bal bu'i 'dab / ru rta sle tres a ka ru'i / chus bkrus blugs shing bsku bar bya

verses.skt: lālā jihvauṣṭhayor jāḍyam ūṣā cimicimāyanam | dantaharṣo rasājñatvaṃ hanustambhaś ca vaktrage
verses.tib: khar chud na ni mchil snabs mang / lce mchu sbrid cing bem por byed / lus tshan zhing so brtse la / ro mi tshor zhing 'gram so 'thams

verses.skt: sevyādyais tatra gaṇḍūṣāḥ sarvaṃ ca viṣajid dhitam | āmāśayagate svedamūrchādhmānamadabhramāḥ
verses.tib: de la dug kun 'joms sman dang / ur shi khus mkhur bkang / dbo / ma zhu'i gnas 'bab rdul ba dang / brgyal zhing lto sbos myos mgo 'khor

verses.skt: romaharṣo vamir dāhaś cakṣurhṛdayarodhanam | bindubhiś cācayo ’ṅgānāṃ pakvāśayagate punaḥ
verses.tib: ba spu ldang zhing skyug lus tsha / mig mi gsal zhing snying mi dran / yan lag thig les khyab par 'gyur / zhu ba'i gnas su phyin na yang

verses.skt: anekavarṇaṃ vamati mūtrayaty atisāryate | tandrā kṛśatvaṃ pāṇḍutvam udaraṃ balasaṃkṣayaḥ
verses.tib: kha dog sna tshogs skyug pa dang / gcin mngar rab tu 'khru bar 'gyur / rmya snyom skem zhing mdog skya la / gsus pa che zhing nyams stobs zad

verses.skt: tayor vāntaviriktasya haridre kaṭabhīṃ guḍam | sindhuvāritaniṣpāvabāṣpikāśataparvikāḥ
verses.tib: de gnyis slon dang khrus byas nas / ser gnyis bu ram gir kar ni / san+du ba ri nis pa ba / ba shi ka dang tshigs brgya pa

verses.skt: taṇḍulīyakamūlāni kukkuṭāṇḍam avalgujam | nāvanāñjanapāneṣu yojayed viṣaśāntaye
verses.tib: tan du li ya'i rtsa ba dang / bya gag sgo nga bal ku za / snar gtang mig sman blud bya ba / dug zhi'i phyir ni sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: viṣabhuktāya dadyāc ca śuddhāyordhvam adhas tathā | sūkṣmaṃ tāmrarajaḥ kāle sakṣaudraṃ hṛdviśodhanam
verses.tib: dug 'thungs pa dag steng dang ni / de bzhin 'og ni sbyangs gyur nas / dus su zangs bzang bdar phye ma / sbrang rtsir bcas pa snying sbyong sbyin

verses.skt: śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet | na sajjate hemapāṅge padmapattre ’mbuvad viṣam
verses.tib: snying nad sbyangs nas gser phye ni / zhib mo zho phyed sbyin byas na / pad+ma'i 'dab mar chu bzhin du / gser gyis yan lag la mi chags

verses.skt: jāyate vipulaṃ cāyur gare ’py eṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | viruddham api cāhāraṃ vidyād viṣagaropamam
verses.tib: tshe yang ring du 'phel bar 'gyur / sbyar dug la yang cho ga 'di'o / kha zas dag kyang mi mthun zos / sbyar dug 'dra bar shes par bya

verses.skt: ānūpam āmiṣaṃ māṣakṣaudrakṣīravirūḍhakaiḥ | virudhyate saha bisair mūlakena guḍena vā
verses.tib: rlan can sha dang mon sran gre'u / sbrang rtsi 'o ma myu gu can / pad+ma'i rtsa ba la phug gam / bu ram dang bcas mi 'phrod yin

verses.skt: viśeṣāt payasā matsyā matsyeṣv api cilīcimaḥ | viruddham amlaṃ payasā saha sarvaṃ phalaṃ tathā
verses.tib: khyad par du ni 'o ma nya / nya rnams las kyang tsi li tsim / 'o ma lhan cig skyur kun ni / mi 'phrod shing tog de bzhin no

verses.skt: tadvat kulatthacaṇakakaṅguvallamakuṣṭakāḥ | bhakṣayitvā haritakaṃ mūlakādi payas tyajet
verses.tib: de bzhin rgya sran khre dag dang / ba la ku mu ta mi 'phrod / la phug la sngo rngad ni / zos nas 'o ma spang bar bya

verses.skt: vārāhaṃ śvāvidhā nādyād dadhnā pṛṣatakukkuṭau | āmamāṃsāni pittena māṣasūpena mūlakam
verses.tib: phag rgod byi dur sha mi bza' / khyim bya bri sha ta zhor min / sha rlon mkhris pa dag dang ni / la phug ma sha'i tshod mar min

verses.skt: aviṃ kusumbhaśākena bisaiḥ saha virūḍhakam | māṣasūpaguḍakṣīradadhyājyair lākucaṃ phalam
verses.tib: le brgan tsi tshod lug shar min / myu gu'i tshod ma pad rtsar min / ma sha'i sran tshod bu ram zho

verses.skt: phalaṃ kadalyās takreṇa dadhnā tālaphalena vā | kaṇoṣaṇābhyāṃ madhunā kākamācīṃ guḍena vā
verses.tib: mar 'o li gu rtse'i 'bras min / chu shing 'bras bu dar bar min / ta la'i 'bras bu zhor mi 'phrod / tshab gnyis / po bu ram dang / sbrang rtsi ka kam tsir min

verses.skt: siddhāṃ vā matsyapacane pacane nāgarasya vā | siddhām anyatra vā pātre kāmāt tām uṣitāṃ niśām
verses.tib: de ni nya btsos pa'i snod dang / dong gra btsos bar g.yos pa min / ka ma ta ni snod gzhan du / btsos nas nyin mtshan lon mi bza'

verses.skt: matsyanistalanasnehe sādhitāḥ pippalīs tyajet | kāṃsye daśāham uṣitaṃ sarpir uṣṇaṃ tv aruṣkare
verses.tib: nya brngos pa yi snum la ni / pi pi ling brngos spang bar bya / mar sar khar snod zhag bcu lon / go bye'i 'bras bu dror mi bza'

verses.skt: bhāso virudhyate śūlyaḥ kampillas takrasādhitaḥ | aikadhyaṃ pāyasasurākṛśarāḥ parivarjayet
verses.tib: ba sa bsregs shar mi 'phrod cing / dar bar kam pi la btsos min / 'o thug dang ni kri sar / chang dang lhan cig mi 'phrod spang

verses.skt: madhusarpirvasātailapānīyāni dviśaś triśaḥ | ekatra vā samāṃśāni virudhyante parasparam
verses.tib: sbrang rtsir mar sar zhag til mar / chu rnams gnyis gnyis gsum gsum mam / cha mnyam lhan cig zos pa dag / phan tshun dag ni mi mthun no

verses.skt: bhinnāṃśe api madhvājye divyavāry anupānataḥ | madhupuṣkarabījaṃ ca madhumaireyaśārkaram
verses.tib: mar sbrang cha ni mi mnyam yang / char pa'i chu ni 'thungs na gnod / sbrang rtsi pad+ma'i sa bon dang / sbrang rtsi 'bru chang kha rar min

verses.skt: manthānupānaḥ kṣaireyo hāridraḥ kaṭutailavān | upodakātisārāya tilakalkena sādhitā
verses.tib: 'o thug rjes la skyo mar min / sha mo yungs mar brngos mi 'phrod / u po ta ka til tshigs la / btsos pa 'khru bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: balākā vāruṇīyuktā kulmāṣaiś ca virudhyate | bhṛṣṭā varāhavasayā saiva sadyo nihanty asūn
verses.tib: bya gag sha ni chang dngas dang / kul ma sha yi thug mi 'phrod / de nyid phag rgod tshil la brngos / srog ni 'phral du 'joms par byed

verses.skt: tadvat tittiripattrāḍhyagodhālāvakapiñjalāḥ | airaṇḍenāgninā siddhās tattailena vimūrchitāḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin sreg pa rma bya dang / la ba ka pin dza la sram / e raN+Da yi me la ni / e raN+Da mar brdos mi 'phrod

verses.skt: hārītamāṃsaṃ hāridraśūlakaprotapācitam | haridrāvahninā sadyo vyāpādayati jīvitam
verses.tib: ha rid tra sha skyer pa yi / thur ma dag la bskyon nas ni / skyer pa'i me la bsregs gyur pa / 'phral du srog ni 'joms par byed

verses.skt: bhasmapāṃsuparidhvastaṃ tad eva ca samākṣikam | yat kiñcid doṣam utkleśya na haret tat samāsataḥ
verses.tib: de nyid thal brdul gyis gos / sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'phrod ma yin / gang yang nyes pa ma sbyangs pa / mdor na de ni mi 'phrod yin / nyes 'di sbyang bar 'dod pa'am / yang na de dang mi mthun pa'i / rdzas de nyid kyis dang po ni / lus ni mngon par sbyang bar bya

verses.skt: viruddhaṃ śuddhir atreṣṭā śamo vā tadvirodhibhiḥ | dravyais tair eva vā pūrvaṃ śarīrasyābhisaṃskṛtiḥ
verses.tib: de nyid thal brdul gyis gos / sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'phrod ma yin / gang yang nyes pa ma sbyangs pa / mdor na de ni mi 'phrod yin / nyes 'di sbyang bar 'dod pa'am / yang na de dang mi mthun pa'i / rdzas de nyid kyis dang po ni / lus ni mngon par sbyang bar bya

verses.skt: vyāyāmasnigdhadīptāgnivayaḥsthabalaśālinām | virodhy api na pīḍāyai sātmyam alpaṃ ca bhojanam
verses.tib: rtsol can snum bsten drod che dang / dar la bab cing nyams stobs ldan / goms par zos dang cung zad zos / mi 'phrod gyur kyang gnod mi 'gyur

verses.skt: pādenāpathyam abhyastaṃ pādapādena vā tyajet | niṣeveta hitaṃ tadvad ekadvitryantarīkṛtam
verses.tib: mi 'phrod cha yis goms bya'am / cha yis cha yis yongs su spang / phan pa'ang de bzhin bsten bya ste / 'di dag gnyis gsum gyis / chod bya

verses.skt: apathyam api hi tyaktaṃ śīlitaṃ pathyam eva vā | sātmyāsātmyavikārāya jāyate sahasānyathā
verses.tib: skyon ni rim gyis 'grib pa dang / yon tan rim gyis 'phel 'gyur na / slar skye bar ni mi 'gyur zhing / g.yo ba med pa dag tu 'gyur / mi 'phrod pa yang spangs gyur zhing / 'phrod pa goms par gyur pa nyid / 'phral du spangs dang ma bsten las

verses.skt: krameṇāpacitā doṣāḥ krameṇopacitā guṇāḥ | santo yānty apunarbhāvam aprakampyā bhavanti ca
verses.tib: skyon ni rim gyis 'grib pa dang / yon tan rim gyis 'phel 'gyur na / slar skye bar ni mi 'gyur zhing / g.yo ba med pa dag tu 'gyur / mi 'phrod pa yang spangs gyur zhing / 'phrod pa goms par gyur pa nyid / 'phral du spangs dang ma bsten las

verses.skt: atyantasaṃnidhānānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ dūṣaṇātmanām | ahitair dūṣaṇaṃ bhūyo na vidvān kartum arhati
verses.tib: nyes pa rnams ni 'byung bar 'gyur / gnod pa gnod bya'i bdag nyid can / shin tu nyes par gyur pa la / phan med gnod par byed pa ni / mkhas pas phyir zhing bya mi rigs

verses.skt: āhāraśayanābrahmacaryair yuktyā prayojitaiḥ | śarīraṃ dhāryate nityam āgāram iva dhāraṇaiḥ
verses.tib: zas dang mal stan 'dod la spyod / ran zhing rigs par sbyar ba yis / khang khyim 'chos pa lta bur ni / rtag tu lus ni gzung bar bya

verses.skt: āhāro varṇitas tatra tatra tatra ca vakṣyate | nidrāyattaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ puṣṭiḥ kārśyaṃ balābalam
verses.tib: de la zas ni bshad zin zhing / de dang der ni bshad par bya / bde sdug sbom skem stobs che chung

verses.skt: vṛṣatā klībatā jñānam ajñānaṃ jīvitaṃ na ca | akāle ’tiprasaṅgāc ca na ca nidrā niṣevitā
verses.tib: bud med la phod mi phod dang / shes dang mi shes 'tsho dang 'chi / gnyid la rag ni lus pa yin / dus min ha cang thal ches dang / gnyid ni kun tu 'gegs pa dag

verses.skt: sukhāyuṣī parākuryāt kālarātrir ivāparā | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ snigdhaṃ prasvapanaṃ divā
verses.tib: bde dang tshe ni nyams byed de / dus mtshan gnyis pa lta bu yin / mtshan mo gnyid ni ma log rtsub / nyin mo gnyid log snum lcir 'gyur

verses.skt: arūkṣam anabhiṣyandi tv āsīnapracalāyitam | grīṣme vāyucayādānaraukṣyarātryalpabhāvataḥ
verses.tib: mig rtsub bad kan med par 'gyur / so ga rlung 'phel stobs 'phrog dus / rtsub cing mtshan mo thung bas na

verses.skt: divāsvapno hito ’nyasmin kaphapittakaro hi saḥ | muktvā tu bhāṣyayānādhvamadyastrībhārakarmabhiḥ
verses.tib: nyin par gnyid phan gzhan dag tu / de ni bad kan mkhris pa skyed / smra mang bzhon dang lam gyis dub / ra ro bud med bsten khur las

verses.skt: krodhaśokabhayaiḥ klāntān śvāsahidhmātisāriṇaḥ | vṛddhabālābalakṣīṇakṣatatṛṭśūlapīḍitān
verses.tib: khros dang mya ngan 'jigs pas dub / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde tshad 'khru / rgan dang byis pa nyams stobs zad / glo rdol skem dang gzer gyis gnod

verses.skt: ajīrṇyabhihatonmattān divāsvapnocitān api | dhātusāmyaṃ tathā hy eṣāṃ śleṣmā cāṅgāni puṣyati
verses.tib: zas ma zhu dang bcom dang smyo / nyin par gnyid log rigs ma gtogs / 'di dag de bzhin lus zungs snyoms / bad kan skyes shing lus brtas gyur

verses.skt: bahumedaḥkaphāḥ svapyuḥ snehanityāś ca nāhani | viṣārtaḥ kaṇṭharogī ca naiva jātu niśāsv api
verses.tib: tshil che bad kan mang dang snum / rtag za nyin par gnyid ma log / dug gis phog dang lkog nad can / mtshan mo nam yang gnyid ma log

verses.skt: akālaśayanān mohajvarastaimityapīnasāḥ | śirorukśophahṛllāsasrotorodhāgnimandatāḥ
verses.tib: dus min gnyid log rmongs bag dang / rims / skyed rmugs shing cham pas 'debs / mgo na skrang zhing slon sgyid skyur / rtsa yi rgyun 'gags me drod nyams

verses.skt: tatropavāsavamanasvedanāvanam auṣadham | yojayed atinidrāyāṃ tīkṣṇaṃ pracchardanāñjanam
verses.tib: de la bsnyung dang slon sman dang / rngul 'byung sna sman btang ba dang / gnyid ches gyur la skyug sman rno

verses.skt: nāvanaṃ laṅghanaṃ cintāṃ vyavāyaṃ śokabhīkrudhaḥ | ebhir eva ca nidrāyā nāśaḥ śleṣmātisaṃkṣayāt
verses.tib: mig sman rno dang sna sman dang / smyung ba sel las bud med bsten / mya ngan 'jigs dang khros ba sbyar / 'di dag nyid kyis gnyid drags pa

verses.skt: nidrānāśād aṅgamardaśirogauravajṛmbhikāḥ | jāḍyaglānibhramāpaktitandrā rogāś ca vātajāḥ
verses.tib: 'jig cing bad kan rab zad byed / gnyid yar ba yis yan lag snyoms / klad pa lci zhing glal 'ong la / mi gsal na zhing mgo 'khor la / zas mi 'ju rmya rlung skyed nad

verses.skt: kapho ’lpo vāyunoddhūto dhamanīḥ saṃnirudhya tu | kuryāt saṃjñāpahāṃ tandrāṃ dāruṇāṃ mohakāriṇīm
verses.tib: 'jig cing bad kan rab zad byed / gnyid yar ba yis yan lag snyoms / klad pa lci zhing glal 'ong la / mi gsal na zhing mgo 'khor la / zas mi 'ju rmya rlung skyed nad

verses.skt: unmīlitavinirbhugne parivartitatārake | bhavatas tatra nayane srute lulitapakṣmaṇī
ardhatrirātrāt sā sādhyā na sā sādhyā tataḥ param
verses.tib: de bas mtshan mo dus bzhin du

verses.skt: yathākālam ato nidrāṃ rātrau seveta sātmyataḥ | asātmyāj jāgarād ardhaṃ prātaḥ svapyād abhuktavān
verses.tib: ci bder gnyid ni log par bya / ma goms gnyid kyis ma log na / nang par ma zos phyed gnyid log

verses.skt: śīlayen mandanidras tu kṣīramadyarasān dadhi | abhyaṅgodvartanasnānamūrdhakarṇākṣitarpaṇam
verses.tib: gnyid yar gyur na 'o ma dang / chang dang sha khu zho rnams btung / lus bsku dril dang khrus bya zhing / mgo bsku rna ba mig dag bya

verses.skt: kāntābāhulatāśleṣo nirvṛtiḥ kṛtakṛtyatā | mano'nukūlā viṣayāḥ kāmaṃ nidrāsukhapradāḥ
verses.tib: na chung lag ngar gyis 'khyud dang / sems bde bya ba zin pa dang / yid dang rjes mthun yul ldan pa / ci 'dod gnyid 'ong bde bar skyed

verses.skt: brahmacaryarater grāmyasukhaniḥspṛhacetasaḥ | nidrā saṃtoṣatṛptasya svaṃ kālaṃ nātivartate
verses.tib: nyal po'i bde la sems ma chags / tshangs par spyod pa la dga' ba / chog shes pa yis mgu ba'i gnyid / rang gi dus las 'da' mi byed

verses.skt: grāmyadharme tyajen nārīm anuttānāṃ rajasvalām | apriyām apriyācārāṃ duṣṭasaṃkīrṇamehanām
verses.tib: nyal po'i chos ni spang bya ba / bkan min zla mtshan ldan pa dang / yid du mi 'ong mi sdug spyod / mngal ni skyon gyis khyab pa dang

verses.skt: atisthūlakṛśām sūtāṃ garbhiṇīm anyayoṣitam | varṇinīm anyayoniṃ ca gurudevanṛpālayam
verses.tib: rab sbom skem dang btsas pa dang / sbrum ma gzhan gyi bud med dang / rigs gzhan skye gnas mi mthun dang / bla ma lha dang rgyal po'i gnas

verses.skt: caityaśmaśānāyatanacatvarāmbucatuṣpatham | parvāṇy anaṅgaṃ divasaṃ śirohṛdayatāḍanam
verses.tib: mchod rten dur khrod gsod gnas dang / bsti sa lam gyi bzhi mdo chu / dus tshigs nyin mo yan lag min / snying ga mgo bor brdeg spang bya

verses.skt: atyāśito ’dhṛtiḥ kṣudvān duḥsthitāṅgaḥ pipāsitaḥ | bālo vṛddho ’nyavegārtas tyajed rogī ca maithunam
verses.tib: 'grangs ches ltogs dang stan bral dang / yan lag mi bder gnas dang skom / byis pa rgan dang shugs gzhan nyen / nad pa yis kyang 'khrig pa spang

verses.skt: seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ tṛpto vājīkṛtām hime | tryahād vasantaśaradoḥ pakṣād varṣānidāghayoḥ
verses.tib: dgun dus ro tsa byas drags tshe / 'dod pas 'dod pa bsten bar bya / dpyid ston zhag ni gnyis / gnyis nas / so ga dbyar tshe zla phyed cing

verses.skt: bhramaklamorudaurbalyabaladhātvindriyakṣayāḥ | aparvamaraṇaṃ ca syād anyathā gacchataḥ striyam
verses.tib: gzhan du bud med la zhugs na / mgo 'khor ngal dang bla mthu nyams / stobs dang lus zungs dbang po nyams / dus min 'chi bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: smṛtimedhāyurārogyapuṣṭīndriyayaśobalaiḥ | adhikā mandajaraso bhavanti strīṣu saṃyatāḥ
verses.tib: bud med dag la legs gdams na / dran dang yid gzhungs nad med tshe / dbang po rtas shing grags stobs rnams / lhag par 'phel zhing rgas srar 'gyur

verses.skt: snānānulepanahimānilakhaṇḍakhādyaśītāmbudugdharasayūṣasurāprasannāḥ | seveta cānu śayanaṃ viratau ratasya tasyaivam āśu vapuṣaḥ punar eti dhāma
verses.tib: khrus dang byug pa rlung bsil khar la sogs bza' / chu bsil 'o ma sha khu sran tshod chang dngas 'thungs / nyal po dga' byas 'od da dang bral gyur rjes la bsten / de 'dras de yi lus mdangs stobs slar skye bar 'gyur

verses.skt: śrutacaritasamṛddhe karmadakṣe dayālau bhiṣaji niranubandhaṃ deharakṣāṃ niveśya | bhavati vipulatejaḥsvāsthyakīrtiprabhāvaḥ svakuśalaphalabhogī bhūmipālaś cirāyuḥ
verses.tib: sman pa thos spyod phun tshogs ldan zhing las mkhas snying rje can / gags dang gnod med lus srung byed pa nye bar bzhag byas nas / rgyal po rang gi dge ba'i 'bras bu'i longs spyod bder spyod cing / nad med mthu dang gzi brjid grags pa yun ring 'phel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: mātrāśī sarvakālaṃ syān mātrā hy agneḥ pravartikā | mātrāṃ dravyāṇy apekṣante gurūṇy api laghūny api
verses.tib: dus kun du ni tshod zin bza' / de ni me drod skyed byed yin / rdzas ni lci ba'am yang ba'ang rung / chad la ltos par bya ba yin

verses.skt: gurūṇām ardhasauhityaṃ laghūnāṃ nātitṛptatā | mātrāpramāṇaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ sukhaṃ yāvad vijīryati
verses.tib: lci ba las ni phyed 'grangs bya / yang ba las ni rab 'grangs min / bde blag 'ju ba de tsam la / tshod zin zhes ni bshad pa yin

verses.skt: bhojanaṃ hīnamātraṃ tu na balopacayaujase | sarveṣāṃ vātarogāṇāṃ hetutāṃ ca prapadyate
verses.tib: zas tshod ma zin chung gyur na / stobs dang gzi mdangs 'phel mi 'gyur / rlung gi nad ni thams cad kyi / rgyu nyid du ni 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: atimātraṃ punaḥ sarvān āśu doṣān prakopayet | pīḍyamānā hi vātādyā yugapat tena kopitāḥ
verses.tib: tshad las shin tu ches ba yang / nyes pa thams cad myur du skyed / ma zhu'i zas ni mi bzad pa / de yis rlung gzir gyur pas / cig car rnam par 'khrugs 'gyur zhing / de nyid du ni zhugs gyur nas / rtsa sgo 'gags shing be snabs skyed

verses.skt: āmenānnena duṣṭena tad evāviśya kurvate | viṣṭambhayanto ’lasakaṃ cyāvayanto viṣūcikām
verses.tib: tshad las shin tu ches ba yang / nyes pa thams cad myur du skyed / ma zhu'i zas ni mi bzad pa / de yis rlung gzir gyur pas / cig car rnam par 'khrugs 'gyur zhing / de nyid du ni zhugs gyur nas / rtsa sgo 'gags shing be snabs skyed

verses.skt: adharottaramārgābhyāṃ sahasaivājitātmanaḥ | prayāti nordhvaṃ nādhastād āhāro na ca pacyate
verses.tib: steng dang 'og gi lam dag tu

verses.skt: āmāśaye ’lasībhūtas tena so ’lasakaḥ smṛtaḥ | vividhair vedanodbhedair vāyvādibhṛśakopataḥ
sūcībhir iva gātrāṇi vidhyatīti viṣūcikā | tatra śūlabhramānāhakampastambhādayo ’nilāt
verses.tib: bskyod pas gsud cing zug byed pa / brkam chags can la 'phral skyed byed / de las rlung las gzer mgo / 'khor / khong sbos 'dar zhing rengs 'gyur

verses.skt: pittāj jvarātisārāntardāhatṛṭpralayādayaḥ | kaphāc chardyaṅgagurutāvāksaṅgaṣṭhīvanādayaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa las ni 'khru rims 'debs / khong tsha skom zhing kha 'gyur / bad kan slon zhing yan lag lci / tshigs thog mchil ma mang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: viśeṣād durbalasyālpavahner vegavidhāriṇaḥ | pīḍitaṃ mārutenānnaṃ śleṣmaṇā ruddham antarā
verses.tib: khyad par du ni nyam chung zhing / me drod zhan dang shugs bkag pa'i / zas ni rlung gis bkag pa dang / bad kan gyis ni bar bkag pa'i

verses.skt: alasaṃ kṣobhitaṃ doṣaiḥ śalyatvenaiva saṃsthitam | śūlādīn kurute tīvrāṃś chardyatīsāravarjitān
verses.tib: nyes pa be'u snabs dkrugs pas na / zug rngu zug pa lta bur gnas / 'khru dang slon par mi byed par / gzer la sogs pa mi bzad pa

verses.skt: so ’laso ’tyarthaduṣṭās tu doṣā duṣṭāmabaddhakhāḥ | yāntas tiryak tanuṃ sarvāṃ daṇḍavat stambhayanti cet
verses.tib: be'u snabs de yin nyes rab gdug / be snabs mi bzad kyis sbubs bkag / rtsib logs kun tu drang por 'gro / shing bzhin rengs par 'gyur na ni

verses.skt: daṇḍakālasakaṃ nāma taṃ tyajed āśukāriṇam | viruddhādhyaśanājīrṇaśīlino viṣalakṣaṇam
verses.tib: myur du gsod byed de spang bya / mi 'phrod lhag za ma zhu bar / zad byed ma zhu dug gi ni / mtshan nyid can de mi bzad pa

verses.skt: āmadoṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ varjayed viṣasaṃjñakam | viṣarūpāśukāritvād viruddhopakramatvataḥ
verses.tib: dug gi ming can gang yin te / dug gi tshul can myur gsod byed / gso dpyad bya bar dka' bas spang / de nas ma zhu'i be'u snabs 'gyur / gsor rung shu dag rgyam tsha dang / po son cha bcug chu dron ni / 'thung bas skyugs bcug de nas na

verses.skt: athāmam alasībhūtaṃ sādhyaṃ tvaritam ullikhet | pītvā sogrāpaṭuphalaṃ vāry uṣṇaṃ yojayet tataḥ
verses.tib: dug gi ming can gang yin te / dug gi tshul can myur gsod byed / gso dpyad bya bar dka' bas spang / de nas ma zhu'i be'u snabs 'gyur / gsor rung shu dag rgyam tsha dang / po son cha bcug chu dron ni / 'thung bas skyugs bcug de nas na

verses.skt: svedanaṃ phalavartiṃ ca malavātānulomanīm | nāmyamānāni cāṅgāni bhṛśaṃ svinnāni veṣṭayet
verses.tib: dug dang mas gtong ring bu dag / dri ma rlung dag legs rgyu sbyar / yan lag 'khums par gyur pa la / shin tu dugs bya dkri bar bya

verses.skt: madanaṃ pippalī kuṣṭhaṃ vacā gaurāś ca sarṣapāḥ | guḍakṣārasamāyuktā phalavartiḥ praśasyate
viṣūcyām ativṛddhāyāṃ pārṣṇyor dāhaḥ praśasyate | tadahaś copavāsyainaṃ viriktavad upācaret
verses.tib: gsud nad shin tu 'phel ba dang / rting par me btsa' gdab pa bsngags / de ni de'i nyin ni smyung par gzhag

verses.skt: tīvrārtir api nājīrṇī pibec chūlaghnam auṣadham | āmasanno ’nalo nālaṃ paktuṃ doṣauṣadhāśanam
verses.tib: ma zhu mi bzad nyen gyur kyang / gzer 'joms sman ni btung mi bya / be'u snabs ma zhu me drod nyams / nad kyi sman ni 'ju mi nus

verses.skt: nihanyād api caiteṣāṃ vibhramaḥ sahasāturam | jīrṇāśane tu bhaiṣajyaṃ yuñjyāt stabdhagurūdare
verses.tib: de yis nad pa 'phral du ni / thung zhing 'chi ba dag tu 'ang 'gyur / kha zas zhu nas lto ba ni / rtsub srar gyur la sman dag kyang

verses.skt: doṣaśeṣasya pākārtham agneḥ saṃdhukṣaṇāya ca | śāntir āmavikārāṇāṃ bhavati tv apatarpaṇāt
verses.tib: nyes pa'i lhag ma sbyang phyir dang / pho ba'i me ni bskyed phyir gtang / ma zhu'i 'gyur ba zhi ba dag / nyams smad par ni byas las gyur

verses.skt: trividhaṃ trividhe doṣe tat samīkṣya prayojayet | tatrālpe laṅghanaṃ pathyaṃ madhye laṅghanapācanam
verses.tib: de gsum nyes pa / rnam gsum ni / brtags nas rab tu sbyar bar bya / de la chung la smyung ba phan / 'bring la smyung dang bzhu bya ba

verses.skt: prabhūte śodhanaṃ tad dhi mūlād unmūlayen malān | evam anyān api vyādhīn svanidānaviparyayāt
verses.tib: chen po la ni sbyang ba ste / de yis dri ma rtsa nas 'byin / de bzhin nad gzhan dag la yang / rang nad gzhi las go bzlog pas

verses.skt: cikitsed anubandhe tu sati hetuviparyayam | tyaktvā yathāyathaṃ vaidyo yuñjyād vyādhiviparyayam
verses.tib: gso ba de las rjes 'brel yod / rgyu las go bzlog rnam spang ba / sman pas ji lta ji lta bar / nad las go bzlog sbyar ba'am

verses.skt: tadarthakāri vā pakve doṣe tv iddhe ca pāvake | hitam abhyañjanasnehapānavastyādi yuktitaḥ
verses.tib: de'i don byed pa sbyor bar bya / nyes smin me drod skyed 'gyur nas / nyams rtas snum gyis byug pa dang / btung dang 'jam rtsi rigs sbyar

verses.skt: ajīrṇaṃ ca kaphād āmaṃ tatra śopho ’kṣigaṇḍayoḥ | sadyobhukta ivodgāraḥ prasekotkleśagauravam
verses.tib: bad kan ma zhu'i be snabs te / de ni mig dang mkhur ba skrang / sgregs pa zos ma thag 'dra 'byung / mchil ma mang zhing nyes g.yo lci

verses.skt: viṣṭabdham anilāc chūlavibandhādhmānasādakṛt | pittād vidagdhaṃ tṛṇmohabhramāmlodgāradāhavat
verses.tib: rlung las rengs bag gzer ba dang / bshang gci 'gags shing sbos drod nyams / mkhris las khong tsha skom mgo 'khor / rmongs bag sgregs pa skyur zhing tsha

verses.skt: laṅghanaṃ kāryam āme tu viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ bhṛśam | vidagdhe vamanaṃ yad vā yathāvasthaṃ hitaṃ bhavet
verses.tib: ma zhu be+e snabs smyung bar bya / rengs bag las ni dugs rab bya / tsha ba'i ma zhu skyug sman dag / btang ba'am gnas skabs gang phan bya

verses.skt: garīyaso bhavel līnād āmād eva vilambikā | kaphavātānubaddhāmaliṅgā tatsamasādhanā
verses.tib: ma zhu'i be snabs lci ba na / rtsa sbubs thim las yun can / bad kan rlung ni 'dres mtshan ma / de dang mnyam par bsgrub par bya

verses.skt: aśraddhā hṛdvyathā śuddhe ’py udgāre rasaśeṣataḥ | śayīta kiñcid evātra sarvaś cānāśito divā
verses.tib: dngas ma lus las zas dad chung / snying na sgregs pa mnam par 'gyur / 'di la cung zad gnyid log bya / ma zhu kun gyis nyin par ni

verses.skt: svapyād ajīrṇī saṃjātabubhukṣo ’dyān mitaṃ laghu | vibandho ’tipravṛttir vā glānir mārutamūḍhatā
verses.tib: zas ma zos par gnyid log la / bkres gyur yang las ran par bza' / ma zhu spyi yi mtshan ma ni / rnam par 'gags sam shas cher 'byung / na zhing rlung ni mi gsal rgyu

verses.skt: ajīrṇaliṅgaṃ sāmānyaṃ viṣṭambho gauravaṃ bhramaḥ | na cātimātram evānnam āmadoṣāya kevalam
verses.tib: mkhregs shing lus lci mgo bo 'khor / zas tshod lhag par gyur pa nyid / gcig bu ma zhum zad kyi

verses.skt: dviṣṭaviṣṭambhidagdhāmagururūkṣahimāśuci | vidāhi śuṣkam atyambuplutaṃ cānnaṃ na jīryati
verses.tib: mi 'dod gags byed tshig ma tshos / lci dang rtsub dang mi gtsang drang / khong tsha skom dad chu mang dang / bsres pa'i zas ni 'ju mi 'gyur

verses.skt: upataptena bhuktaṃ ca śokakrodhakṣudādibhiḥ | miśraṃ pathyam apathyaṃ ca bhuktaṃ samaśanaṃ matam
verses.tib: mya ngan khro dang bkres pa yis / nye bar gdungs shing zas mi 'ju / phan dang mi phan bsres pa dag / zos pa mnyam za / yin par 'dod

verses.skt: vidyād adhyaśanaṃ bhūyo bhuktasyopari bhojanam | akāle bahu cālpaṃ vā bhuktaṃ tu viṣamāśanam
verses.tib: 'grangs rjes slar yang za gyur pa / lhag par za ba yin zhes bya / dus min che ba'am chung zos pa / mi mnyam par ni zab yin

verses.skt: trīṇy apy etāni mṛtyuṃ vā ghorān vyādhīn sṛjanti vā | kāle sātmyaṃ śuci hitaṃ snigdhoṣṇaṃ laghu tanmanāḥ
verses.tib: gsum po 'dis kyang gsod pa'am / mi bzad nad kyis 'debs par byed / dus su goms shing gtsang la phan / snum dro yang dang ma yengs dang

verses.skt: ṣaḍrasaṃ madhuraprāyaṃ nātidrutavilambitam | snātaḥ kṣudvān viviktastho dhautapādakarānanaḥ
verses.tib: ro drug ldan zhing mngar bag che / shin tu myur min dal bar min / khrus byas bkres shing dben par gnas / kha gdong lag pa rkang pa bkrus

verses.skt: tarpayitvā pitÃn devān atithīn bālakān gurūn | pratyavekṣya tiraśco ’pi pratipannaparigrahān
verses.tib: lha dang rjed cing sbyin / bla ma byis pa mgron mchod byas / dud 'gro rnams kyang rab brtags shing

verses.skt: samīkṣya samyag ātmānam anindann abruvan dravam | iṣṭam iṣṭaiḥ sahāśnīyāc chucibhaktajanāhṛtam
verses.tib: bdag nyid legs par brtags nas ni / ma smad smra'am yid 'ong smra / skye bo gtsang zhing gus pas stobs / yid 'ong gnyen dang lhan cig bza'

verses.skt: bhojanaṃ tṛṇakeśādijuṣṭam uṣṇīkṛtaṃ punaḥ | śākāvarānnabhūyiṣṭham atyuṣṇalavaṇaṃ tyajet
verses.tib: zas ni rtswa dang skra sbu / 'dres shing khong du slar sros dang / tshod ma zas ngan mang ba dang / tsha ches lan tshwa mang ba spang

verses.skt: kilāṭadadhikūcīkākṣāraśuktāmamūlakam | kṛśaśuṣkavarāhāvigomatsyamahiṣāmiṣam
verses.tib: phrum dang zho dang phrum skam dang / ba tsha tsha dang la phug rjen / phag rgod lug dang ba glang nya / ma he'i sha dang rid dang skam

verses.skt: māṣaniṣpāvaśālūkabisapiṣṭavirūḍhakam | śuṣkaśākāni yavakān phāṇitaṃ ca na śīlayet
verses.tib: ma sha chu ldum nis sha ba / pad rtsa 'bras 'khur myu gur gyur / tshod ma skam dang nas 'dra dang / bu ram phra mo bza' mi bya

verses.skt: śīlayec chāligodhūmayavaṣaṣṭikajāṅgalam | suniṣaṇṇakajīvantībālamūlakavāstukam
verses.tib: sA lu'i 'bras dang gro dang nas / drug cu pa dang skam sa'i sha / a ru skyu ru rgun 'brum dang

verses.skt: pathyāmalakamṛdvīkāpaṭolīmudgaśarkarāḥ | ghṛtadivyodakakṣīrakṣaudradāḍimasaindhavam
verses.tib: mung+ga kha ra pa to la / zhun mar char chu 'o ma dang / sbrang rtsi se'u 'brum rgyam tsha bza'

verses.skt: triphalāṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ niśi netrabalāya ca | svāsthyānuvṛttikṛd yac ca rogocchedakaraṃ ca yat
verses.tib: mig dang stobs phyir mtshan mo ni / 'bras gsum sbrang rtsi mar sar bza' / mi nar 'jog par byed gang dang / nad sel byed pa gang yin bsten

verses.skt: bisekṣumocacocāmramodakotkārikādikam | adyād dravyaṃ guru snigdhaṃ svādu mandaṃ sthiraṃ puraḥ
verses.tib: pad rtsa bur shing tso tsa dang / mo tsa a mra'i 'bras bu dang / la du 'khur ba bu ram can / zas ni lci zhing snum pa dang / mngar zhing 'ju dka' bsten pa rnams / dang po nyid du bza' bar bya

verses.skt: viparītam ataś cānte madhye ’mlalavaṇotkaṭam | annena kukṣer dvāv aṃśau pānenaikaṃ prapūrayet
verses.tib: de las bzlog pa tha mar bza' / bar du skyur tsha lan tshwa can / lto yi cha gnyis zas kyis te / cha gcig skom gyis dgang bar bya

verses.skt: āśrayaṃ pavanādīnāṃ caturtham avaśeṣayet | anupānaṃ himaṃ vāri yavagodhūmayor hitam
verses.tib: rlung la sogs pa'i gnas su ni / cha bzhi pa ni lhag mar gzhag / zos rjes skom ni bsil ba'i chu / nas dang bag phye'i g.yos byas zos

verses.skt: dadhni madye viṣe kṣaudre koṣṇaṃ piṣṭamayeṣu tu | śākamudgādivikṛtau mastutakrāmlakāñjikam
verses.tib: zho chang dug 'bags sbrang rtsi la / chu bsil rjes su 'thungs na phan / mi 'ju 'gags la chu dron gtang / chad ma mung+ga'i gnod pa la / zhog chu dang dar ba dang / rang sgyur rtsab mo btung bar bya

verses.skt: surā kṛśānāṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ sthūlānāṃ tu madhūdakam | śoṣe māṃsaraso madyaṃ māṃse svalpe ca pāvake
verses.tib: skem po rgyas phyir chang btung ste / sbom pos sbrang rtsi'i chu btung ngo / gcong chen nad la sha khu btung / drod chung sha zos chang btung bya

verses.skt: vyādhyauṣadhādhvabhāṣyastrīlaṅghanātapakarmabhiḥ | kṣīṇe vṛddhe ca bāle ca payaḥ pathyaṃ yathāmṛtam
verses.tib: nad dang sman sbrum bud med / zan bcad dka' thub las rnams kyis / skem dang byis pa rgan po la / 'o ma bdud rtsi lta bur phan

verses.skt: viparītaṃ yad annasya guṇaiḥ syād avirodhi ca | anupānaṃ samāsena sarvadā tat praśasyate
verses.tib: mdor na zos rjes btung ba ni / gang zhig zas dang yon tan gyis / mi mthun mi 'phrod med gyur pa / de ni rnam pa kun tu bsngags

verses.skt: anupānaṃ karoty ūrjāṃ tṛptiṃ vyāptiṃ dṛḍhāṅgatām | annasaṃghātaśaithilyaviklittijaraṇāni ca
verses.tib: zas rjes skom 'thungs ngoms dang khyab / stobs 'phel lus ni brtan byed la / zas sdud snyi bar 'gyur ba dang / 'drul zhing rnam par 'ju bar 'gyur

verses.skt: nordhvajatrugadaśvāsakāsoraḥkṣatapīnase | gītabhāṣyaprasaṅge ca svarabhede ca tad dhitam
verses.tib: de ni nam tshang yan chad nad / dbugs lud glo rdol cham pa dang / glu len smra mang la chags dang / skad 'gags pa la gnod pa yin

verses.skt: praklinnadehamehākṣigalarogavraṇāturāḥ | pānaṃ tyajeyuḥ sarvaś ca bhāṣyādhvaśayanaṃ tyajet
verses.tib: lus las rnag 'dzag gcin nad mig / lkog nad rma yi nad kyis nyen / skom spang kun gyis skom 'thungs nas / mang smra lam zhugs nyal ba spang

verses.skt: pītvā bhuktvātapaṃ vahniṃ yānaṃ plavanavāhanam | prasṛṣṭe viṇmūtre hṛdi suvimale doṣe svapathage | viśuddhe codgāre kṣudupagamane vāte ’nusarati | tathāgnāv udrikte viśadakaraṇe dehe ca sulaghau | prayuñjītāhāraṃ vidhiniyamitaṃ kālaḥ sa hi mataḥ
verses.tib: zas zos nas ni nyi tshan me / rta zhon rkyal dang 'degs pa spang / bshang dang gci gsal snying la dri med nyes pa lam min par mi 'gro / sgregs pa dag cing bru ba tsha gyur thur gyi rlung ni tha mal rgyu / de bzhin me yi drod bdo dbang po gsal zhing lus kyang rab tu yang / zas kyi tshod ran cho gar sbyar bzhin za ba de ni dus su 'dod

verses.skt: dravyam eva rasādīnāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ te hi tadāśrayāḥ | pañcabhūtātmakaṃ tat tu kṣmām adhiṣṭhāya jāyate
verses.tib: sman rnams nyid kyi ro la / de ni de la bsten pas mchog / de yang 'byung / lnga'i bdag nyid can / sa la brten te skye ba yin

verses.skt: ambuyonyagnipavananabhasām samavāyataḥ | tannirvṛttir viśeṣaś ca vyapadeśas tu bhūyasā
verses.tib: chu ni skye gnas me dang rlung / nam mkha' rnams ni tshogs pa las / de skyes gyur dang khyad par phyung / ming ni shas che las gyur yin

verses.skt: tasmān naikarasaṃ dravyaṃ bhūtasaṃghātasaṃbhavāt | naikadoṣās tato rogās tatra vyakto rasaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: de bas 'byung ba 'dus pa las / byung bas sman ni ro gcig min / de phyir nad kyang nyes gcig min / de la gsal ba ro zhes bshad

verses.skt: avyakto ’nurasaḥ kiñcid ante vyakto ’pi ceṣyate | gurvādayo guṇā dravye pṛthivyādau rasāśraye
verses.tib: mi gsal ro rjes mtha' mar ni / cung zad gsal bdag tu'ang 'dod / sman gyi yon tan lci sogs dang / ro ni sa la bsten pas

verses.skt: raseṣu vyapadiśyante sāhacaryopacārataḥ | tatra dravyaṃ gurusthūlasthiragandhaguṇolbaṇam
verses.tib: mtshungs par spyod pa nyer gdags pas / ro las ming du btags pa yin / de la sa'i sman lci dang sbom / sra zhing dri yi shes rab che

verses.skt: pārthivaṃ gauravasthairyasaṃghātopacayāvaham | dravaśītagurusnigdhamandasāndrarasolbaṇam
verses.tib: lci zhing brtan dang 'dus pa dang / nye bar 'phel bar byed pa yin / chu yi gsher dang lci bsil snum / rtul zhing bskal ro shas che

verses.skt: āpyaṃ snehanaviṣyandakledaprahlādabandhakṛt | rūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇaviśadasūkṣmarūpaguṇolbaṇam
verses.tib: 'jam zhing bad kan 'dra ba la / 'drul zhing tshim byed sdud par byed / me yi rtsub rno tsha zhing skam / phra zhing gzugs kyi yon tan che

verses.skt: āgneyaṃ dāhabhāvarṇaprakāśapavanātmakam | vāyavyaṃ rūkṣaviśadalaghusparśaguṇolbaṇam
verses.tib: tsha zhing 'bar la mdog skyed cing / gsal zhing smin pa'i bdag nyid can / rlung gi rtsub cing khyab la yang / reg pa'i yon tan shas che yin

verses.skt: raukṣyalāghavavaiśadyavicāraglānikārakam | nābhasaṃ sūkṣmaviśadalaghuśabdaguṇolbaṇam
verses.tib: rtsub cing yang la dri ma sel / rnam dpyod na bar byed pa yin / nam mkha'i phra zhing dngas la yang / sgra yi yon tan shas che ste

verses.skt: sauṣiryalāghavakaraṃ jagaty evam anauṣadham | na kiñcid vidyate dravyaṃ vaśān nānārthayogayoḥ
verses.tib: khong stong yang bar byed pa yin / de ltar 'gro na don dang ni / sbyor ba sna tshogs dbang gis ni / sman min ci yang yod ma yin

verses.skt: dravyam ūrdhvagamaṃ tatra prāyo ’gnipavanotkaṭam | adhogāmi ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhūmitoyaguṇādhikam
verses.tib: de la sman ni gyen du 'gro / phal cher me dang rlung shas che / thur du 'gro ba phal cher ni / sa chu'i yon tan shas cher yin

verses.skt: iti dravyaṃ rasān bhedair uttaratropadekṣyate | vīryaṃ punar vadanty eke guru snigdhaṃ himaṃ mṛdu
verses.tib: de ltar sman no ro'i bye brag / 'di yi 'og nas ston pa yin / sman mthu la las bshad pa ni / lci snum bsil dang 'jam pa dang

verses.skt: laghu rūkṣoṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ ca tad evaṃ matam aṣṭadhā | carakas tv āha vīryaṃ tat kriyate yena yā kriyā
verses.tib: yang rtsub tsha dang rno ba ste / de ltar rnam pa brgyad du 'dod / sman mthu tsar kas bshad pa / gang gis bya ba gang byed pa

verses.skt: nāvīryaṃ kurute kiñcit sarvā vīryakṛtā hi sā | gurvādiṣv eva vīryākhyā tenānvartheti varṇyate
verses.tib: mthu min cir yang mi byed kyi / de dag thams cad mthu yis byed / des na lci la pa nyid / nus pa'i khyad par ldan pa dang

verses.skt: samagraguṇasāreṣu śaktyutkarṣavivartiṣu | vyavahārāya mukhyatvād bahvagragrahaṇād api
verses.tib: yon tan ma / lus snying por ni / gyur pas mthu zhes bshad pa dag / don dang mthun par btags pa yin / gcis pa mang du yod na yang / tha snyad gtso bo nyid kyis yin

verses.skt: ataś ca viparītatvāt saṃbhavaty api naiva sā | vivakṣyate rasādyeṣu vīryaṃ gurvādayo hy ataḥ
verses.tib: de bas go ni bzlog pa'i phyir / de ni ro la pa la / srid du zin kyang ma bshad de / de bas lci ba la sogs yin

verses.skt: uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ dvidhaivānye vīryam ācakṣate ’pi ca | nānātmakam api dravyam agnīṣomau mahābalau
verses.tib: gzhan dag tsha dang bsil nyid gnyis / stobs yin zhes kyang ston par byed / sman ni sna tshogs bdag nyid can / nyi ma zla ba'i stobs can yin

verses.skt: vyaktāvyaktaṃ jagad iva nātikrāmati jātu cit | tatroṣṇaṃ bhramatṛḍglānisvedadāhāśupākitāḥ
verses.tib: 'gro 'di gsal dang mi gsal las / nam yang 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro / de la tsha ba mgo 'khor skom / rmya rdul tsha zhing myur 'ju byed

verses.skt: śamaṃ ca vātakaphayoḥ karoti śiśiraṃ punaḥ | hlādanaṃ jīvanaṃ stambhaṃ prasādaṃ raktapittayoḥ
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan zhi bar byed / bsil ba dag ni tshim byed cing / 'tsho dang rengs par byed pa dang / khrag dang mkhris pa rab dang byed

verses.skt: jāṭhareṇāgninā yogād yad udeti rasāntaram | rasānāṃ pariṇāmānte sa vipāka iti smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: pho ba'i me dang phrad pa las / gang zhig ro gzhan byung gyur pa'i / ro rnams kyi ni mthar zhu ba / de ni zhu ba zhes bshad do

verses.skt: svāduḥ paṭuś ca madhuram amlo ’mlaṃ pacyate rasaḥ | tiktoṣaṇakaṣāyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ
verses.tib: mngar dang lan tshwa zhu rjes mngar / skyur ba'i zhu rjes skyur ba yin / kha dang bska dang tshab rnams / zhu rjes phal cher kha ba yin

verses.skt: rasair asau tulyaphalas tatra dravyaṃ śubhāśubham | kiñcid rasena kurute karma pākena cāparam
verses.tib: ro dang zhu rjes 'bras bu mnyam / de la sman ni bzang dang ngan / la la ro yis las byed la / gzhan dag 'ju bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: guṇāntareṇa vīryeṇa prabhāveṇaiva kiñcana | yad yad dravye rasādīnāṃ balavattvena vartate
verses.tib: yon tan gzhan dang nus pa dang / mthu yis la la byed pa yin / sman gyi ro gang dang gang / stobs ldan nyid kyis gnas byed de

verses.skt: abhibhūyetarāṃs tat tat kāraṇatvaṃ prapadyate | viruddhaguṇasaṃyoge bhūyasālpaṃ hi jīyate
verses.tib: shin tu zil mnan de dang de / sgrub byed rgyu ni nyid du gnas / yon tan mi 'phrod sbyar ba ni / mang pos nyung ngu zil gyis gnon

verses.skt: rasaṃ vipākas tau vīryaṃ prabhāvas tāny apohati | balasāmye rasādīnām iti naisargikaṃ balam
verses.tib: ro dang 'ju ba'i mthu dag ni / de yi stobs kyi zil gyis gnon / ro de ltar stobs ni mnyam / ma bcos pa yi stobs dang ldan

verses.skt: rasādisāmye yat karma viśiṣṭaṃ tat prabhāvajam | dantī rasādyais tulyāpi citrakasya virecanī
verses.tib: ro mnyam pa'i las gang ni / khyad 'phags de ni mthu las skyes / dan ti dang ni tsi tra ka / ro mtshungs kyang dan ti 'khru

verses.skt: madhukasya ca mṛdvīkā ghṛtaṃ kṣīrasya dīpanam | iti sāmānyataḥ karma dravyādīnāṃ punaś ca tat
verses.tib: shing mngar rgun 'brum 'dra yang 'khru / 'o ma mar 'dra mar drod skyed / de ltar sman la sogs pa yi / spyi yi las te de yang ni

verses.skt: vicitrapratyayārabdhadravyabhedena bhidyate | svādur guruś ca godhūmo vātajid vātakṛd yavaḥ
verses.tib: sna tshogs rkyen gyi dbye ba yis / sman dbye tha dad gyur pa yin / gro dang nas ni mngar ba dang / lci las rlung 'joms skyed pa yin

verses.skt: uṣṇā matsyāḥ payaḥ śītaṃ kaṭuḥ siṃho na śūkaraḥ
verses.tib: nya gro 'o ma bsil ba dang / seng ge kha yis phag ma yin

verses.skt: kṣmāmbho'gnikṣmāmbutejaḥkhavāyvagnyanilago'nilaiḥ | dvayolbaṇaiḥ kramād bhūtair madhurādirasodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: mngar ba la sogs ro skye ba / sa chu me sa chu dang me / mkha' rlung me rlung sa dang rlung / gnyis gnyis shas che las rim 'byung

verses.skt: teṣāṃ vidyād rasaṃ svāduṃ yo vaktram anulimpati | āsvādyamāno dehasya hlādano ’kṣaprasādanaḥ
verses.tib: de las ro ni mngar ba dag / gang zhig myangs pa'i tshe na ni / kha la chags shing lus kyang ni / tshim byed dbang po rab dang byed

verses.skt: priyaḥ pipīlikādīnām amlaḥ kṣālayate mukham | harṣaṇo romadantānām akṣibhruvanikocanaḥ
verses.tib: grog ma la sogs dga' ba yin / skyur ba kha nas chu 'dzag cing / so brtse sbu ni ldang ba dang / mig dang smin ma 'dzum par byed

verses.skt: lavaṇaḥ syandayaty āsyaṃ kapolagaladāhakṛt | tikto viśadayaty āsyaṃ rasanaṃ pratihanti ca
verses.tib: lan tshwa khar ni mchil ma 'du / mkhur ba gre ba tsha bar byed / kha ba kha yi dri ma sbyang / lce ni 'joms par byed pa yin

verses.skt: udvejayati jihvāgraṃ kurvaṃś cimicimāṃ kaṭuḥ | srāvayaty akṣināsāsyaṃ kapolaṃ dahatīva ca
verses.tib: tsha ba lce rtse skyo byed cing / tsag tsag byed par 'gyur ba dang / kha mig sna las 'dzag byed cing / mkhur bsreg par byed pa yin

verses.skt: kaṣāyo jaḍayej jihvāṃ kaṇṭhasrotovibandhakṛt | rasānām iti rūpāṇi karmāṇi madhuro rasaḥ
verses.tib: bska bas lce ni bem por byed / gre ba rtsa sbubs 'gags par byed / ro yi tshul ni de dag ste / las ni ro mngar ba dag gis

verses.skt: ājanmasātmyāt kurute dhātūnāṃ prabalaṃ balam | bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇavarṇakeśendriyaujasām
verses.tib: skyes nas 'phrod par byed pa dang / lus zungs mthu stobs rab skyed cing / byis pa rgan po glo rdol skem / mdog mdangs skra dang dbang po bzang

verses.skt: praśasto bṛṃhaṇaḥ kaṇṭhyaḥ stanyasaṃdhānakṛd guruḥ | āyuṣyo jīvanaḥ snigdhaḥ pittānilaviṣāpahaḥ
verses.tib: lus rtas skad 'gags phan zhing lci / nu zho skyed cing rma 'byor byed / tshe ring 'tsho byed snum pa dang / rlung dang mkhris pa dug rnams sel

verses.skt: kurute ’tyupayogena sa medaḥśleṣmajān gadān | sthaulyāgnisādasaṃnyāsamehagaṇḍārbudādikān
verses.tib: ha cang drags na tshil bcas dang / bad kan las byung nad skyed cing / lus sbom drod bri chang nad dang / gcin nad lba ba rmen skyed

verses.skt: amlo ’gnidīptikṛt snigdho hṛdyaḥ pācanarocanaḥ | uṣṇavīryo himasparśaḥ prīṇanaḥ kledano laghuḥ
verses.tib: skyur ba me drod skyed byed snum / zhim zhing 'ju byed yi ga 'bye / dro ba'i nus skyed reg pa bsil / tshim byed 'drul byed yang ba ste

verses.skt: karoti kaphapittāsraṃ mūḍhavātānulomanaḥ | so ’tyabhyastas tanoḥ kuryāc chaithilyaṃ timiraṃ bhramam
verses.tib: bad kan khrag mkhris rgyas par byed / rlung 'gags rgyu bar byed pa yin / de ni shin tu bsten drags na / lus lhod rab rib mgo 'khor dang

verses.skt: kaṇḍūpāṇḍutvavīsarpaśophavisphoṭatṛḍjvarān | lavaṇaḥ stambhasaṃghātabandhavidhmāpano ’gnikṛt
verses.tib: g.yan pa skya rbab me dbal dang / 'or nad thor bu skom rims skyed / lan tshwa sra dang 'khyil pa dang / 'gags pa 'byin zhing drod skyed byed

verses.skt: snehanaḥ svedanas tīkṣṇo rocanaś chedabhedakṛt | so ’tiyukto ’srapavanaṃ khalatiṃ palitaṃ valīm
verses.tib: snum dang dugs kyis rdul zhing rno / yi ga 'byed cing gcod 'byed byed / de ni drags pas rlung khrag dang / skra 'byi skra dkar gnyer ma dang

verses.skt: tṛṭkuṣṭhaviṣavīsarpān janayet kṣapayed balam | tiktaḥ svayam arociṣṇur aruciṃ kṛmitṛḍviṣam
verses.tib: skom mdze dug dang me dbal rnams / skyed cing stobs ni bri bar byed / kha ba rang nyid zhim min zhing / yi ga 'chus dang srin skom dug

verses.skt: kuṣṭhamūrchājvarotkleśadāhapittakaphāñ jayet | kledamedovasāmajjaśakṛnmūtropaśoṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: mdze dang rgyal dang rims slon bro / tsha dang mkhris pa bad kan 'joms / 'drul dang tshil dang zhag dang rkang / bshang dang gci ba skems pa dang

verses.skt: laghur medhyo himo rūkṣaḥ stanyakaṇṭhaviśodhanaḥ | dhātukṣayānilavyādhīn atiyogāt karoti saḥ
verses.tib: yang zhing yid gzhungs bsil zhing rtsub / nu ma'i nad dang skad 'gags sel / de ni shin tu drags gyur na / lus zungs zad cing rlung nad skyed

verses.skt: kaṭur galāmayodardakuṣṭhālasakaśophajit | vraṇāvasādanaḥ snehamedaḥkledopaśoṣaṇaḥ
