verses.tib: tsha bas lkog nad 'gags pa dang / mdze dang ma zhu 'or nad sel / rma 'jig byed cing snum pa dang / tshil dang 'drul bag skems par byed

verses.skt: dīpanaḥ pācano rucyaḥ śodhano ’nnasya śoṣaṇaḥ | chinatti bandhān srotāṃsi vivṛṇoti kaphāpahaḥ
verses.tib: drod skyed 'ju byed yi ga 'byed / sbyong zhing zas ni 'jig par byed / 'ching ba gcod cing rtsa sbubs dag / rnam par 'byed cing bad kan sel

verses.skt: kurute so ’tiyogena tṛṣṇāṃ śukrabalakṣayam | mūrchām ākuñcanaṃ kampaṃ kaṭīpṛṣṭhādiṣu vyathām
verses.tib: de ni shin tu drag 'gyur bas / skom skyed khu ba stobs zad cing / brgyal zhing lus 'khums 'dar ba dang / rked pa rgyab na bar byed

verses.skt: kaṣāyaḥ pittakaphahā gurur asraviśodhanaḥ | pīḍano ropaṇaḥ śītaḥ kledamedoviśoṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: bska bas mkhris pa bad kan sel / lci zhing khrag nad rnam par sbyong / skem zhing rma 'tsho bsil ba dang / 'drul dang tshil ni rnam par skems

verses.skt: āmasaṃstambhano grāhī rūkṣo ’ti tvakprasādanaḥ | karoti śīlitaḥ so ’ti viṣṭambhādhmānahṛdrujaḥ
verses.tib: be'u snabs 'khyil zhing sri bar byed / rtsub cing lpags mdog rab dang byed / de ni shin tu bsten drags na / bshang 'gags lto sbo snying nad dang

verses.skt: tṛṭkārśyapauruṣabhraṃśasrotorodhamalagrahān | ghṛtahemaguḍākṣoṭamocacocaparūṣakam
verses.tib: skom dang skem zhing skyes mthu nyams / rtsa sgo 'gags shing dri ma sri / zhun mar bu ram star ga gser / mo tsa tso tsa pa ru sha

verses.skt: abhīruvīrāpanasarājādanabalātrayam | mede catasraḥ parṇinyo jīvantī jīvakarṣabhau
verses.tib: nye'u shing ram nye pa nas / ra dza dan pa la gsum / med gnyis dang par+Ni bzhi / 'tsho byed dzi ba ri sho ba

verses.skt: madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ bimbī vidārī śrāvaṇīyugam | kṣīraśuklā tukākṣīrī kṣīriṇyau kāśmarī sahe
verses.tib: shing mngar ma du ka bim+bi / shra ba ni gnyis bi da ri / cu gang k+Shi ra shu ku la / sa ha'o can kash+ma ri

verses.skt: kṣīrekṣugokṣurakṣaudradrākṣādir madhuro gaṇaḥ | amlo dhātrīphalāmlīkāmātuluṅgāmlavetasam
verses.tib: 'o ma bu ram shing gze ma / rgun 'brum sbrang mngar ba'i sde

verses.skt: dāḍimaṃ rajataṃ takraṃ cukraṃ pālevataṃ dadhi | āmram āmrātakaṃ bhavyaṃ kapitthaṃ karamardakam
verses.tib: skyur ba skyu ru am+li ka / ba lung dang ni / star bu dang / se'u 'bru rdul dang dar ba dang

verses.skt: vṛkṣāmlakolalikucakośāmlātakadhanvanam | mastudhānyāmlamadyāni jambīraṃ tilakaṇṭakam
verses.tib: tshwa dang ku shu a mra dang / am+la ta ka b+ha bya dang / ka ram rda ka pid ta'o / tsha mchog rtsal ru kha ru tsha

verses.skt: varaṃ sauvarcalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ viḍaṃ sāmudram audbhidam | romakaṃ pāṃsujaṃ sīsaṃ kṣāraś ca lavaṇo gaṇaḥ
verses.tib: bi da rgya mtsho bkod ma'i tsha / mtsho tsha skam tsha ro nye dang / k+Sha ra lan tshwa'i sde tshan yin

verses.skt: tiktaḥ paṭolī trāyantī vālakośīracandanam | bhūnimbanimbakaṭukātagarāguruvatsakam
verses.tib: kha ba kyi lce pa to la / tsan+dan ur shi ba le ka / ci skrigs nim pa pu tse shel / rgya spos a kar ba tsha ka

verses.skt: naktamāladvirajanīmustamūrvāṭarūṣakam | pāṭhāpāmārgakāṃsyāyoguḍūcīdhanvayāsakam
verses.tib: nag ta ma la ser po gnyis / gla sgang mur ba ba sha ka / a pa marga po son cha / 'khar lcags sle tres byi tsher ba

verses.skt: pañcamūlaṃ mahad vyāghryau viśālātiviṣā vacā | kaṭuko hiṅgumaricakṛmijitpañcakolakam
verses.tib: rtsa ba che lnga bya gri gnyis / bong nga shu dag bi sha la / tsha ba shing kun na le sham / byi dang ga dang tsha ba lnga

verses.skt: kuṭherādyā haritakāḥ pittaṃ mūtram aruṣkaram | vargaḥ kaṣāyaḥ pathyākṣaṃ śirīṣaḥ khadiro madhu
verses.tib: ku the ra ldum rngad sngo / mkhris pa gcin dang go bye yin / bska tshan a ru ba ru ra / sbrang rtsi seng ldeng shi ri sha

verses.skt: kadambodumbaraṃ muktāpravālāñjanagairikam | bālaṃ kapitthaṃ kharjūraṃ bisapadmotpalādi ca
verses.tib: ka dam u dum+b+hAr dang / mu tig byu ru an tsan bcag / ka pid tha gzhon kha rdzur / pad rtsa pad+ma ut+pa la'o

verses.skt: madhuraṃ śleṣmalaṃ prāyo jīrṇāc chāliyavād ṛte | mudgād godhūmataḥ kṣaudrāt sitāyā jāṅgalāmiṣāt
verses.tib: 'bras rnying nas rnying gro rnying dang / mung+ga sbrang rtsi sha ka ra / skam sa'i sha rnams ma gtogs pa'i / mngar ba phal cher bad kan skyed / skyu ru se 'bru ma gtogs pa'i

verses.skt: prāyo ’mlaṃ pittajananaṃ dāḍimāmalakād ṛte | apathyaṃ lavaṇaṃ prāyaś cakṣuṣo ’nyatra saindhavāt
verses.tib: skyur ba phal cher mkhris pa skyed / rgyam tsha lce myang tsha ma gtogs / lan tshwa phal cher mig la gnod

verses.skt: tiktaṃ kaṭu ca bhūyiṣṭham avṛṣyaṃ vātakopanam | ṛte ’mṛtāpaṭolībhyāṃ śuṇṭhīkṛṣṇārasonataḥ
verses.tib: sle tres pa to la bca' sga / sgog skya pi pi ling ma gtogs / kha dang tsha ba phal cher ni / ro tsa 'bri zhing rlung skyed yin

verses.skt: kaṣāyaṃ prāyaśaḥ śītaṃ stambhanaṃ cābhayāṃ vinā | rasāḥ kaṭvamlalavaṇā vīryeṇoṣṇā yathottaram
verses.tib: bska las a ru ra ma gtogs / phal cher bsil zhing sri bar byed / ro tsha skyur dang lan tshwa rnams / bzhin du dro nus ldan

verses.skt: tiktaḥ kaṣāyo madhuras tadvad eva ca śītalāḥ | tiktaḥ kaṭuḥ kaṣāyaś ca rūkṣā baddhamalās tathā
verses.tib: kha dang bska dang mngar ba rnams / de bzhin du ni bsil ba nyid / kha dang tsha dang bska ba rnams / de bzhin rtsub cing dri ma sri

verses.skt: paṭvamlamadhurāḥ snigdhāḥ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtramārutāḥ | paṭoḥ kaṣāyas tasmāc ca madhuraḥ paramaṃ guruḥ
verses.tib: lan tshwa skyur mngar snum pa dang / bshang gci thur gyi dbugs 'byin byed / lan tshwa las bska de bas kyang / mngar ba mchog tu lci ba yin

verses.skt: laghur amlaḥ kaṭus tasmāt tasmād api ca tiktakaḥ | saṃyogāḥ saptapañcāśat kalpanā tu triṣaṣṭidhā
verses.tib: skyur las tsha dang de bas kyang / kha bdag ni yang ba yin / ro rnams kyis ni dbye ba las / sbyor ba lnga bcu rtsa bdun dang / brtags pa drug cu rtsa gsum du

verses.skt: lavaṇād amlamadhurau kāryau syātāṃ yathākramam | vāyor niranubandhasya pākaśāntipravṛttaye
prāk tikto madhuraḥ paścāt kaṣāyo ’nte vidhīyate | taiḥ pittaṃ śamam abhyeti pakvācchīkṛtapiṇḍitam
kaṭuḥ prāk tiktakaḥ paścāt kaṣāyo ’nte vidhīyate | taiḥ śleṣmā śamam abhyeti pakvācchīkṛtapiṇḍitaḥ
rasānāṃ yaugikatvena yathāsthūlaṃ vibhajyate | ekaikahīnās tān pañcadaśa yānti rasā dvike
verses.tib: rags rim / ji bzhin phye ba yin / de lnga re re phri ba las

verses.skt: svādur dvikeṣu pañcāmlaś caturo lavaṇas trayam | dvau tiktaḥ kaṭukaś caikaṃ yāti pañcadaśeti tu
verses.tib: lngar gyur pa ni ro gnyis pa / gsum pa mngar bcu skyur drug ste

verses.skt: trike svādur daśāmlaḥ ṣaṭ trīn paṭus tikta ekakam | catuṣkeṣu daśa svāduś caturo ’mlaḥ paṭuḥ sakṛt
verses.tib: lan tshwa gsum ste kha ba gcig / bzhi pa la ni mngar po bcu / skyur ba bzhi po lan tshwa gcig / lnga pa la ni skyur gcig pu

verses.skt: pañcakeṣv ekam evāmlo madhuraḥ pañca sevate | dravyam ekaṃ ṣaḍāsvādam asaṃyuktāś ca ṣaḍ rasāḥ
verses.tib: mngar ba lnga la brten pa yin / sman ni ro drug gcig pu yin / ma 'dres pa ni ro drug 'gyur

verses.skt: ṣaṭ pañcakā ṣaṭ ca pṛthag rasāḥ syuś caturdvikau pañcadaśaprakārau | bhedās trikā viṃśatir ekam eva dravyaṃ ṣaḍāsvādam iti triṣaṣṭiḥ
verses.tib: lnga pa drug dang ro ni tha dad drug / bzhi pa gnyis pa rnam pa lnga yin / dbye ba gsum pa nyi shu gcig nyid de / sman ni ro drug de ltar drug cu gsum

verses.skt: te rasānurasato rasabhedās tāratamyaparikalpanayā ca | saṃbhavanti gaṇanāṃ samatītā doṣabheṣajavaśād upayojyāḥ
verses.tib: de rnams ro dang rdo rjes ro'i dbye ba / rab dang rab mchog dag tu brtags pa las / rtsis las 'das par byung bar gyur pa ni / nad dang sman gyi dbang las nye bar sbyar

verses.skt: doṣadhātumalā mūlaṃ sadā dehasya taṃ calaḥ | utsāhocchvāsaniśvāsaceṣṭāvegapravartanaiḥ
verses.tib: nad dang lus zungs dri ma rnams / rtag tu lus kyi rtsa ba yin / de rlung dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub dang / bskyod dang las spyod shugs 'byin dang

verses.skt: samyaggatyā ca dhātūnām akṣāṇāṃ pāṭavena ca | anugṛhṇāty avikṛtaḥ pittaṃ paktyūṣmadarśanaiḥ
verses.tib: lus zungs legs par rgyu ba dang / dbang po rnams ni gsal ba dag / mi gnod pa ni rjes 'dzin yin / mkhris pa 'ju drod mthong byed dang

verses.skt: kṣuttṛḍruciprabhāmedhādhīśauryatanumārdavaiḥ | śleṣmā sthiratvasnigdhatvasaṃdhibandhakṣamādibhiḥ
verses.tib: bkres skom zas len mdangs yid gzhungs / blo ldan dpa' snying lus 'jam pas / bad kan brtan zhing snum nyid dang / tshigs 'brel bzod la pas so

verses.skt: prīṇanaṃ jīvanaṃ lepaḥ sneho dhāraṇapūraṇe | garbhotpādaś ca dhātūnāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ karma kramāt smṛtam
verses.tib: lus zungs las gtso bzhin / tshim byed 'tsho byed g.yogs pa dang / snum dang brtan dang 'gengs pa dang / mngal ni skyed byed yin par bshad

verses.skt: avaṣṭambhaḥ purīṣasya mūtrasya kledavāhanam | svedasya kledavidhṛtir vṛddhas tu kurute ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: brtan par byed pa bshang ba yin / 'drul dang 'byin pa gcin gyi yin / ba spu brtan pa rdul gyi yin / rlung ni 'phel bar gyur pa yis

verses.skt: kārśyakārṣṇyoṣṇakāmatvakampānāhaśakṛdgrahān | balanidrendriyabhraṃśapralāpabhramadīnatāḥ
verses.tib: skem dang mdog gnag drod bag dga' / 'dar dang lto sbos bshang ba sre / stobs dang gnyid dang dbang po nyams / smra mang mgo 'khor zhum par byed

verses.skt: pītaviṇmūtranetratvakkṣuttṛḍdāhālpanidratāḥ | pittaṃ śleṣmāgnisadanaprasekālasyagauravam
verses.tib: mkhris pa bshang gci pags mig ser / bkres skom lus tsha gnyid chung byed / bad kan drod nyams mchil ma mang / khong snyom lci / dang sha mdog dkar

verses.skt: śvaityaśaityaślathāṅgatvaṃ śvāsakāsātinidratāḥ | raso ’pi śleṣmavad raktaṃ visarpaplīhavidradhīn
verses.tib: lus grang yan lag lhod pa dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde gnyid che / dngas ma'ang bad kan dang 'dra la / khrag 'phel me dbal khong 'bras mcher

verses.skt: kuṣṭhavātāsrapittāsragulmopakuśakāmalāḥ | vyaṅgāgnināśasaṃmoharaktatvaṅnetramūtratāḥ
verses.tib: mdze dang rlung khrag mkhris pa khrag / skran dang rnyil nad mig ser dang / bskyod dka' drod nyams rmongs bag can / mig dang gcin pags dmar bar 'gyur

verses.skt: māṃsaṃ gaṇḍārbudagranthigaṇḍorūdaravṛddhitāḥ | kaṇṭhādiṣv adhimāṃsaṃ ca tadvan medas tathā śramam
verses.tib: sha 'phel wa ba rmen bu mdud / mkhur tshos brang lto brla sbom zhing / mgul lhag par sha yang che / tshil 'phel de 'dra de bzhin ngal

verses.skt: alpe ’pi ceṣṭite śvāsaṃ sphikstanodaralambanam | asthy adhyasthy adhidantāṃś ca majjā netrāṅgagauravam
verses.tib: cung zad bskyod kyang dbugs rgod cing / rkub tshos nu ma gsus 'phyang 'gyur / rus 'phel rus lhag so lhag 'gyur / rkang 'phel lus lci mig rtsa g.yung

verses.skt: parvasu sthūlamūlāni kuryāt kṛcchrāṇy arūṃṣi ca | atistrīkāmatāṃ vṛddhaṃ śuktaṃ śukrāśmarīm api
verses.tib: tshigs kyi mgo bo sbom pa dang / tshigs la thor bu gso dka' 'byung / khu 'phel bud med la rab gdung / khu ba'i rde'u dag tu 'ang 'gyur

verses.skt: kukṣāv ādhmānam āṭopaṃ gauravaṃ vedanāṃ śakṛt | mūtraṃ tu vastinistodaṃ kṛte ’py akṛtasaṃjñatām
verses.tib: bshang 'phel lto sbos rgyu 'khrug cing / lus lci lto ba na bar byed / gcin 'phel chu sor zug cing na / gcis kyang ma gcis snyam sems 'gyur

verses.skt: svedo ’tisvedadaurgandhyakaṇḍūr evaṃ ca lakṣayet | dūṣikādīn api malān bāhulyagurutādibhiḥ
verses.tib: rngul 'phel rdul che dri mi zhim / g.yan pa nyid kyang skyed ces bya / mig rdul la dri ma rnams / mang bas lci la par byed

verses.skt: liṅgaṃ kṣīṇe ’nile ’ṅgasya sādo ’lpaṃ bhāṣitehitam | saṃjñāmohas tathā śleṣmavṛddhyuktāmayasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.tib: rlung zad mtshan ma lus mi bde / smra nyung rtsol ba chung bar 'gyur / dran pa mi gsal bad kan 'phel / sngar bshad pa yi nad rnams 'byung

verses.skt: pitte mando ’nalaḥ śītaṃ prabhāhāniḥ kaphe bhramaḥ | śleṣmāśayānāṃ śūnyatvaṃ hṛddravaḥ ślathasaṃdhitā
verses.tib: mkhris zad drod nyams grang ba dang / mdog nyams byed de bad kan zad / mgo 'khor bad kan gnas stongs shing / snying 'dar tshigs ni lhod par 'gyur

verses.skt: rase raukṣyaṃ śramaḥ śoṣo glāniḥ śabdāsahiṣṇutā | rakte ’mlaśiśiraprītisirāśaithilyarūkṣatāḥ
verses.tib: cung zad rtsub ngal skam pa dang / na zhing sgra cher mi bzod 'gyur / khrag zad skyur dang bsil la dga' / rtsa lhod pags pa rtsub par 'gyur

verses.skt: māṃse ’kṣaglānigaṇḍasphikśuṣkatāsaṃdhivedanāḥ | medasi svapanaṃ kaṭyāḥ plīhno vṛddhiḥ kṛśāṅgatā
verses.tib: sha zad dbang nyams mig mkhur ba'i / rus skam lhu tshigs na bar 'gyur / tshil zad gnyid che dpyi rked mngon / mcher pa che dang lus skem 'gyur

verses.skt: asthny asthitodaḥ śadanaṃ dantakeśanakhādiṣu | asthnāṃ majjani sauṣiryaṃ bhramas timiradarśanam
verses.tib: rus zad rus zug so dang ni / sen mo skra la sogs pa 'byung / rkang zad rkang sbubs stong pa dang / mgo 'khor rab rib can du 'gyur

verses.skt: śukre cirāt prasicyeta śukraṃ śoṇitam eva vā | todo ’tyarthaṃ vṛṣaṇayor meḍhraṃ dhūmāyatīva ca
verses.tib: khu ba / zad pas ring nas 'byung / yang na khu ba khrag nyid 'byung / rlig pa shin tu na ba dang / pho mtshan tshig pa snyam du sems

verses.skt: purīṣe vāyur antrāṇi saśabdo veṣṭayann iva | kukṣau bhramati yāty ūrdhvaṃ hṛtpārśve pīḍayan bhṛśam
verses.tib: bshang zad rlung ni rgyu ma'i nang / sgra bcas 'khyil pa lta bur byed / lto bar rgyu zhing gyen du 'gro / snying ga rtsib logs mi bzad na

verses.skt: mūtre ’lpaṃ mūtrayet kṛcchrād vivarṇaṃ sāsram eva vā | svede romacyutiḥ stabdharomatā sphuṭanaṃ tvacaḥ
verses.tib: gcin zad gcin ni nyung sri dang / mdog 'gyur ba 'am khrag bcas nyid / rdul zad sbu 'byi spu 'grengs la / pags pa rnams ni 'gas par 'gyur

verses.skt: malānām atisūkṣmāṇāṃ durlakṣyaṃ lakṣayet kṣayam | svamalāyanasaṃśoṣatodaśūnyatvalāghavaiḥ
verses.tib: dri ma shin tu phra ba rnams / zad pas brtag dka' dri ma yi / rang gnas bskams dang na ba dang / stong dang yang ba las shes bya

verses.skt: doṣādīnāṃ yathāsvaṃ ca vidyād vṛddhikṣayau bhiṣak | kṣayeṇa viparītānāṃ guṇānāṃ vardhanena ca
verses.tib: nad rang nyid ji lta ba'i / yon tan 'di ni bzlog pa dang / zad pa dang ni 'phel gyur las / 'phel 'bri sman pas shes par bya

verses.skt: vṛddhiṃ malānāṃ saṅgāc ca kṣayaṃ cātivisargataḥ | malocitatvād dehasya kṣayo vṛddhes tu pīḍanaḥ
verses.tib: dri ma thogs las 'phel ba ste / shin tu 'byung las zad shes bya / lus ni dri mas brten pas na / 'phel bas zad pa gnod pa yin

verses.skt: tatrāsthani sthito vāyuḥ pittaṃ tu svedaraktayoḥ | śleṣmā śeṣeṣu tenaiṣām āśrayāśrayiṇāṃ mithaḥ
verses.tib: de la rlung ni rus par gnas / mkhris pa rngul dang khrag la gnas / bad kan lhag ma gnas des 'di / phan tshun rten dang brten pa yin

verses.skt: yad ekasya tad anyasya vardhanakṣapaṇauṣadham | asthimārutayor naivaṃ prāyo vṛddhir hi tarpaṇāt
verses.tib: 'phel dang zad par byed pa'i sman / gcig gi gang yin gzhan gyi'ang de / rus pa rlung gnyis la 'di min / phal cher rtas pas 'phel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: śleṣmaṇānugatā tasmāt saṃkṣayas tadviparyayāt | vāyunānugato ’smāc ca vṛddhikṣayasamudbhavān
verses.tib: bad kan rjes mthun de yi phyir / de las bzlog pas zad pa yin / rlung dang rjes mthun de ltar na / 'phel dang zad pa 'byung 'gyur ba'i

verses.skt: vikārān sādhayec chīghraṃ kramāl laṅghanabṛṃhaṇaiḥ | vāyor anyatra tajjāṃs tu tair evotkramayojitaiḥ
verses.tib: smyung dang brta bar bya ba yis / nad ni rim gyis gso bar bya / rlung ma gtogs te de skyes la / de nyid bzlog thabs sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: viśeṣād raktavṛddhyutthān raktasrutivirecanaiḥ | māṃsavṛddhibhavān rogān śastrakṣārāgnikarmabhiḥ
verses.tib: khyad par du ni khrag skyes nad / gtar ga bkru sman dag gis gso / sha cher skyes las byung ba'i nad / gtar ga me btsa' thal sman sbyar

verses.skt: sthaulyakārśyopacāreṇa medojān asthisaṃkṣayāt | jātān kṣīraghṛtais tiktasaṃyutair vastibhis tathā
verses.tib: tshil ches sbom skem gso bar bya / rus pa zad pa las byung la / mar dang 'o ma kha rang sbyar / de bzhin 'jam rtsi gtang bas gso

verses.skt: majjaśukrodbhavān rogān bhojanaiḥ svādutiktakaiḥ | vṛddhaṃ śukraṃ vyavāyādyair yac cānyac chukraśoṣikam
verses.tib: bshang ba 'phel la 'khru bas gso / bshang bzas las byung ba'i nad / ra lug nang grol zan dron dang

verses.skt: viḍvṛddhijān atīsārakriyayā viṭkṣayodbhavān | meṣājamadhyakulmāṣayavamāṣadvayādibhiḥ
verses.tib: sbyar thug ma sha gnyis sogs sbyin / gcin 'phel gyur la gcin 'bri ba

verses.skt: mūtravṛddhikṣayotthāṃś ca mehakṛcchracikitsayā | vyāyāmābhyañjanasvedamadyaiḥ svedakṣayodbhavān
verses.tib: gcin zad las byung / gcin snyi gso / rdul mi 'byung la rtsol dang bsku / rdul 'byung cho gas gso bar bya

verses.skt: svasthānasthasya kāyāgner aṃśā dhātuṣu saṃśritāḥ | teṣāṃ sādātidīptibhyāṃ dhātuvṛddhikṣayodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: lus kyi me drod rang gnas 'dug / cha shas lus zungs rnams la brten / de rnams 'bri zhing rab 'bar ba / lus zungs 'phel dang zad par 'gyur

verses.skt: pūrvo dhātuḥ paraṃ kuryād vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇaś ca tadvidham | doṣā duṣṭā rasair dhātūn dūṣayanty ubhaye malān
verses.tib: lus zungs dang po phyi ma ni / rgyas byed zad pa'ang de bzhin no / nyes 'khrugs pas ni lus zungs nyen / gnyi gas dri ma la gnod byed

verses.skt: adho dve sapta śirasi khāni svedavahāni ca | malā malāyanāni syur yathāsvaṃ teṣv ato gadāḥ
verses.tib: 'og na gnyis te mgo bor bdun / bu ga dang ni rdul 'byung ba'i / dri ma'i gnas ni dri ma ste / rang rang gnas su nad skyed 'gyur

verses.skt: ojas tu tejo dhātūnāṃ śukrāntānāṃ paraṃ smṛtam | hṛdayastham api vyāpi dehasthitinibandhanam
verses.tib: lus zungs khu ba'i mthar thug pa'i / nang nas gzi can mdangs mchog yin / snying la gnas kyang khyab pa dang / lus ni brtan par gnas pa yin / gang zhig 'jig na nges 'jig la / gang zhig gnas na gnas gyur pa

verses.skt: snigdhaṃ somātmakaṃ śuddham īṣallohitapītakam | yannāśe niyataṃ nāśo yasmiṃs tiṣṭhati tiṣṭhati
verses.tib: lus zungs khu ba'i mthar thug pa'i / nang nas gzi can mdangs mchog yin / snying la gnas kyang khyab pa dang / lus ni brtan par gnas pa yin / gang zhig 'jig na nges 'jig la / gang zhig gnas na gnas gyur pa

verses.skt: niṣpadyante yato bhāvā vividhā dehasaṃśrayāḥ | ojaḥ kṣīyeta kopakṣuddhyānaśokaśramādibhiḥ
verses.tib: gang la dngos rnams sna tshogs pa / lus la brten pa 'byung ba yin / mdangs ni sems 'khrugs bkres sems las / mya ngan ngal la pas zad

verses.skt: bibheti durbalo ’bhīkṣṇaṃ dhyāyati vyathitendriyaḥ | duśchāyo durmanā rūkṣo bhavet kṣāmaś ca tatkṣaye
verses.tib: de zad sdang zhing lus rid la / yang yang sems shing dbang po nyams / gzi nyams rtsub dang yid mi dga' / nyam chung bar ni 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: jīvanīyauṣadhakṣīrarasādyās tatra bheṣajam | ojovṛddhau hi dehasya tuṣṭipuṣṭibalodayaḥ
verses.tib: 'tsho byed sman dang 'o ma dang / sha khu la sogs de'i sman yin / zas gang mi 'dod gang zhig slong / de la mi 'phrod 'phrod pa ni / spang dang sbyin par bya ba dag / de dang des 'phel zad par 'gyur

verses.skt: yad annaṃ dveṣṭi yad api prārthayetāvirodhi tu | tat tat tyajan samaśnaṃś ca tau tau vṛddhikṣayau jayet
verses.tib: 'tsho byed sman dang 'o ma dang / sha khu la sogs de'i sman yin / zas gang mi 'dod gang zhig slong / de la mi 'phrod 'phrod pa ni / spang dang sbyin par bya ba dag / de dang des 'phel zad par 'gyur

verses.skt: kurvate hi ruciṃ doṣā viparītasamānayoḥ | vṛddhāḥ kṣīṇāś ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ lakṣayanty abudhās tu na
verses.tib: nyes pa phyin ci log pa dang / mthun pas sred pa skyed byed de / phal cher 'phel dang zad pa dag / mi mkhas pa yis mi shes so

verses.skt: yathābalaṃ yathāsvaṃ ca doṣā vṛddhā vitanvate | rūpāṇi jahati kṣīṇāḥ samāḥ svaṃ karma kurvate
verses.tib: ji bzhin stobs dang rang ji bzhin / 'phel na nyes pa rgyas par 'gyur / zad pas rang bzhin 'dor bar 'gyur / mnyam na rang gi las rnams byed

verses.skt: ya eva dehasya samā vivṛddhyai ta eva doṣā viṣamā vadhāya | yasmād atas te hitacaryayaiva kṣayād vivṛddher iva rakṣaṇīyāḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig mnyam pas lus ni 'phel bar byed / nyes pa de nyid mi mnyam gsod par byed / de bas zad ba'ang 'phel ba lta bu ni / phan pa'i spyod pa nyid kyis bsrung bar bya

verses.skt: pakvāśayakaṭīsakthiśrotrāsthisparśanendriyam | sthānaṃ vātasya tatrāpi pakvādhānaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: zhu ba'i gnas dang rked pa dpyi / rna ba rus pa reg dbang po / rlung gnas yin te de las kyang / zhu ba'i gnas su khyad par gnas

verses.skt: nābhir āmāśayaḥ svedo lasīkā rudhiraṃ rasaḥ | dṛk sparśanaṃ ca pittasya nābhir atra viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: mkhris gnas lte ba pho ba rdul / chu ser dngas ma khrag dang ni / mig dang pags pa dag yin te / de las lte ba khyad par gnas

verses.skt: uraḥkaṇṭhaśiraḥklomaparvāṇy āmāśayo rasaḥ | medo ghrāṇaṃ ca jihvā ca kaphasya sutarām uraḥ
verses.tib: bad kan brang dang mgul pa mgo / glo ba rus tshigs ma zhu'i gnas / dngas ma tshil dang sna lcer gnas / brang ni khyad par dag gi gnas

verses.skt: prāṇādibhedāt pañcātmā vāyuḥ prāṇo ’tra mūrdhagaḥ | uraḥkaṇṭhacaro buddhihṛdayendriyacittadhṛk
verses.tib: rlung ni srog dbye ba yin / lnga yi bdag nyid 'dir srog ni / spyir gnas brang dang gre bar rgyu / blo dang dbang po sems 'dzin byed

verses.skt: ṣṭhīvanakṣavathūdgāraniḥśvāsānnapraveśakṛt | uraḥ sthānam udānasya nāsānābhigalāṃś caret
verses.tib: mchil 'dor sbrid 'byung sgregs pa 'don / dbugs rngub zas ni mid par byed / gyen rgyu'i gnas ni brang yin te / sna dang lce dang lkog mar rgyu

verses.skt: vākpravṛttiprayatnorjābalavarṇasmṛtikriyaḥ | vyāno hṛdi sthitaḥ kṛtsnadehacārī mahājavaḥ
verses.tib: tshigs 'byin 'bad rtsol mdangs dang ni / stobs dang kha dog dran las byed / khyab byed snying gnas lus kun la / ma lus khyab cing rab tu mgyogs

verses.skt: gatyapakṣepaṇotkṣepanimeṣonmeṣaṇādikāḥ | prāyaḥ sarvāḥ kriyās tasmin pratibaddhāḥ śarīriṇām
verses.tib: 'gro dang 'degs dang 'jog pa dang / mig 'byed 'dzums pa la sogs pa / lus can bya ba phal cher ni / de la rag ni lus pa yin

verses.skt: samāno ’gnisamīpasthaḥ koṣṭhe carati sarvataḥ | annaṃ gṛhṇāti pacati vivecayati muñcati
verses.tib: mnyam gnas me drod nye bar gnas / nang grol kun tu rgyu ba yin / bya ba zas len 'ju ba dang / dngas snyigs 'byed cing 'dor bar byed

verses.skt: apāno ’pānagaḥ śroṇivastimeḍhrorugocaraḥ | śukrārtavaśakṛnmūtragarbhaniṣkramaṇakriyaḥ
verses.tib: thur sel gzhang gnas 'dong mo dang / lgang pa pho mtshan brla nang rgyu / bya ba khu ba zla mtshan dang / bshang gci mngal gnas 'byin par byed

verses.skt: pittaṃ pañcātmakaṃ tatra pakvāmāśayamadhyagam | pañcabhūtātmakatve ’pi yat taijasaguṇodayāt
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i rang bzhin lnga de la / zhu dang ma zhu'i gnas par gnas / 'byung lnga'i bdag nyid can gyis ni / gang me'i yon tan shas che bas

verses.skt: tyaktadravyatvaṃ pākādikarmaṇānalaśabditam | pacaty annaṃ vibhajate sārakiṭṭau pṛthak tathā
verses.tib: gsher nyid skems byed 'ju la / las kyi me yi sgrar bshad do / zas ni 'ju dang de bzhin du / dngas ma tshigs ma 'byed par byed

verses.skt: tatrastham eva pittānāṃ śeṣāṇām apy anugraham | karoti baladānena pācakaṃ nāma tat smṛtam
verses.tib: der gnas bzhin du mkhris pa ni / lhag ma rnams kyi grogs byed pas / stobs bskyed pa yis byed 'gyur bas / de ni 'ju byed ces bshad do

verses.skt: āmāśayāśrayaṃ pittaṃ rañjakaṃ rasarañjanāt | buddhimedhābhimānādyair abhipretārthasādhanāt
verses.tib: mkhris pa ma zhu'i gnas la brten / dngas mdog bsgyur bas dmar sgyur yin / mkhris pa sgrub byed snying la gnas / blo dang / yid gzhungs nga rgyal / mngon 'dod don ni sgrub byed pas

verses.skt: sādhakaṃ hṛdgataṃ pittaṃ rūpālocanataḥ smṛtam | dṛkstham ālocakaṃ tvaksthaṃ bhrājakaṃ bhrājanāt tvacaḥ
verses.tib: mig la gnas te gzugs mthong byed / mthong byed ces bshad mdog gsal ni / pags mdog gsal byed pags par gnas

verses.skt: śleṣmā tu pañcadhoraḥsthaḥ sa trikasya svavīryataḥ | hṛdayasyānnavīryāc ca tatstha evāmbukarmaṇā
verses.tib: bad kan rnam lnga brang gnas pa / rang gi stobs kyis sum mdo dang / snying dang zas kyi mthu dang ni / de nyid la gnas chu las byed

verses.skt: kaphadhāmnāṃ ca śeṣāṇāṃ yat karoty avalambanam | ato ’valambakaḥ śleṣmā yas tv āmāśayasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan lhag ma'i gnas gyur pa'i / rten ni gang phyir byed gyur pas / de phyir rten byed ces bshad do / gang zhig ma zhu'i gnas la gnas

verses.skt: kledakaḥ so ’nnasaṃghātakledanād rasabodhanāt | bodhako rasanāsthāyī śiraḥsaṃstho ’kṣatarpaṇāt
verses.tib: de ni zas 'drul byed pas / myags byed ces ni bya ba yin / myong byed lcer gnas ro tshor byed / rtas byed mgor gnas dbang po ni / tshim par byed de 'byor byed ni

verses.skt: tarpakaḥ saṃdhisaṃśleṣāc chleṣakaḥ saṃdhiṣu sthitaḥ | iti prāyeṇa doṣāṇāṃ sthānāny avikṛtātmanām
verses.tib: tshigs la gnas nas 'byor par byed / de ltar nad ni phal mo che / mi 'gyur bdag nyid can khyab kyang

verses.skt: vyāpinām api jānīyāt karmāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak | uṣṇena yuktā rūkṣādyā vāyoḥ kurvanti saṃcayam
verses.tib: gnas yin par ni shes bya ste / las rnams kyang ni tha dad yin / rtsub sogs dro bar ldan pas ni / rlung ni par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: śītena kopam uṣṇena śamaṃ snigdhādayo guṇāḥ | śītena yuktās tīkṣṇādyāś cayaṃ pittasya kurvate
verses.tib: grang bas ldang byed snum la sogs / yon tan dro ldan zhi byed 'gyur / rno bsil ba dang ldan pas / mkhris pa par byed 'gyur la

verses.skt: uṣṇena kopaṃ mandādyāḥ śamaṃ śītopasaṃhitāḥ | śītena yuktāḥ snigdhādyāḥ kurvate śleṣmaṇaś cayam
verses.tib: dro bas ldang zhing ro rtul / bsil bar ldan pas zhi bar 'gyur / snum grang dang ldan pa yis / bad kan par byed 'gyur la

verses.skt: uṣṇena kopaṃ tenaiva guṇā rūkṣādayaḥ śamam | cayo vṛddhiḥ svadhāmny eva pradveṣo vṛddhihetuṣu
verses.tib: gro bas ldang 'gyur de nyid ni / rtsub sogs yon tan gyis zhir 'gyur / rang gnas nyid du 'phel yin / dkyil 'gyur rgyu las 'khrugs pa dang

verses.skt: viparītaguṇecchā ca kopas tūnmārgagamitā | liṅgānāṃ darśanaṃ sveṣām asvāsthyaṃ rogasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.tib: mi mthun pa yi yon tan 'dod / ldang ba log pa'i lam zhugs nyid / rang gi rtags ni ston pa dang / bde med nad ni 'byung 'gyur ba'o

verses.skt: svasthānasthasya samatā vikārāsaṃbhavaḥ śamaḥ | cayaprakopapraśamā vāyor grīṣmādiṣu triṣu
verses.tib: rang gnas gnas pa mnyam nyid dang / nad rnams ma byung zhi ba yin / sogs dang ldang dang rab zhi ba / rlung ni so ga gsum tshe

verses.skt: varṣādiṣu tu pittasya śleṣmaṇaḥ śiśirādiṣu | cīyate laghurūkṣābhir oṣadhibhiḥ samīraṇaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa dbyar la sogs par te / bad kan dgun smad par ro / yang dang rtsub pa la sogs pa'i / sman dang lus kyang de mtshungs pas / so ga rlung ni sogs 'gyur gyi / dro ba'i dus kyis ldang mi 'gyur / chu rnams 'ju ba skyur ba dang / sman yang de dag 'dra ba yis

verses.skt: tadvidhas tadvidhe dehe kālasyauṣṇyān na kupyati | adbhir amlavipākābhir oṣadhibhiś ca tādṛśam
verses.tib: mkhris pa dbyar la sogs par te / bad kan dgun smad par ro / yang dang rtsub pa la sogs pa'i / sman dang lus kyang de mtshungs pas / so ga rlung ni sogs 'gyur gyi / dro ba'i dus kyis ldang mi 'gyur / chu rnams 'ju ba skyur ba dang / sman yang de dag 'dra ba yis

verses.skt: pittaṃ yāti cayaṃ kopaṃ na tu kālasya śaityataḥ | cīyate snigdhaśītābhir udakauṣadhibhiḥ kaphaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa kyi dus kyis ni / grang ba nyid kyis ldang mi 'gyur / chu dang sman ni bsil ba dang / snum pas dus ni mtshungs 'gyur yang / dgun smad bad kan 'gyur gyi

verses.skt: tulye ’pi kāle dehe ca skannatvān na prakupyati | iti kālasvabhāvo ’yam āhārādivaśāt punaḥ
verses.tib: bsgongs pas ldang bar mi 'gyur ro / de ltar dus kyi rang bzhin 'di / zas la pa'i dbang gis ni

verses.skt: cayādīn yānti sadyo ’pi doṣāḥ kāle ’pi vā na tu | vyāpnoti sahasā deham āpādatalamastakam
verses.tib: dus la bab par ma gyur kyang / 'phral du pa la sogs 'gyur / nad ni ldang gyur 'phral du lus / mgo nas rkang gi bar du khyab

verses.skt: nivartate tu kupito malo ’lpālpaṃ jalaughavat | nānārūpair asaṃkhyeyair vikāraiḥ kupitā malāḥ
verses.tib: ldog 'gyur chu yi rgyun bzhin du / cung zhig cung zhig dag gis zhi / nad 'khrugs sna tshogs tshul can ni / grangs med par ni gyur pa'i lus

verses.skt: tāpayanti tanuṃ tasmāt taddhetvākṛtisādhanam | śakyaṃ naikaikaśo vaktum ataḥ sāmānyam ucyate
verses.tib: thams cad nye bar gzir gyur pa / de rgyu tshul dang sgrub pa dag / re re nas ni bstan mi nus / de bas spyi yi brjod pa yin

verses.skt: doṣā eva hi sarveṣāṃ rogāṇām ekakāraṇam | yathā pakṣī paripatan sarvataḥ sarvam apy ahaḥ
verses.tib: nad rnams dag ni thams cad kyi / nyes pa'i rgyu ni gcig pu nyid / dper na bya ni lding 'gyur pa / nyin rangs kun tu seng gyur kyang

verses.skt: chāyām atyeti nātmīyāṃ yathā vā kṛtsnam apy adaḥ | vikārajātaṃ vividhaṃ trīn guṇān nātivartate
verses.tib: rang gi grib ma dang mi 'bral / 'gro kun de dang 'dra ba yin / yang na ji ltar ma lus pa'i / 'gro ba mi 'dra sna tshogs 'di / yon tan gsum dang mi 'bral lo

verses.skt: tathā svadhātuvaiṣamyanimittam api sarvadā | vikārajātaṃ trīn doṣān teṣāṃ kope tu kāraṇam
verses.tib: de bzhin rang khams ma snyoms pa'i / rgyu yang gnas skabs thams cad du / nad rigs nyes pa gsum mi 'bral / de rnams kyis ni ldang ba'i rgyu

verses.skt: arthair asātmyaiḥ saṃyogaḥ kālaḥ karma ca duṣkṛtam | hīnātimithyāyogena bhidyate tat punas tridhā
verses.tib: dbang don mi 'tsham phrad pa dang / dus dang nyes pa'i las rnams so / de yang dman ltag log sbyor bas / dbye ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur

verses.skt: hīno ’rthenendriyasyālpaḥ saṃyogaḥ svena naiva vā | atiyogo ’tisaṃsargaḥ sūkṣmabhāsurabhairavam
verses.tib: dbang don rang yul chung du'am / mi sbyor ba ni dman pa ste / shas cher gtad pa lhag sbyor ba / rab phra'i 'od dang 'jigs pa dang

verses.skt: atyāsannātidūrasthaṃ vipriyaṃ vikṛtādi ca | yad akṣṇā vīkṣyate rūpaṃ mithyāyogaḥ sa dāruṇaḥ
verses.tib: shin tu nye dang shin tu ring / yid du mi 'ong mi sdug pa'i / gzugs la mig ni lta byed pa / lag sbyor de ni mi zad yin / de bzhin rab drags rdul la sogs / dbang don ji bzhin shes par bya / dus kyang grang dang tsha ba dang / char dus dbye bas gsum du 'dod

verses.skt: evam atyuccapūtyādīn indriyārthān yathāyatham | vidyāt kālas tu śītoṣṇavarṣābhedāt tridhā mataḥ
verses.tib: shin tu nye dang shin tu ring / yid du mi 'ong mi sdug pa'i / gzugs la mig ni lta byed pa / lag sbyor de ni mi zad yin / de bzhin rab drags rdul la sogs / dbang don ji bzhin shes par bya / dus kyang grang dang tsha ba dang / char dus dbye bas gsum du 'dod

verses.skt: sa hīno hīnaśītādir atiyogo ’tilakṣaṇaḥ | mithyāyogas tu nirdiṣṭo viparītasvalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: de dman grang chung ba dang / lhag sbyor shin tu che / mtshan nyid / rang gi mtshan nyid phyin ci log / log pa'i sbyor ba yin par bshad

verses.skt: kāyavākcittabhedena karmāpi vibhajet tridhā | kāyādikarmaṇo hīnā pravṛttir hīnasaṃjñakaḥ
verses.tib: lus ngag yid kyi dbye ba yis / las kyang rnam pa gsum du bshad / lus la sogs pa'i las dman la / 'jug pa dman pa'i ming can yin

verses.skt: atiyogo ’tivṛttis tu vegodīraṇadhāraṇam | viṣamāṅgakriyārambhapatanaskhalanādikam
verses.tib: brtun ngas 'jug pa lhag sbyor ba'o / shugs bkag pa dang btsir ba dang / mi bzad lus kyi las rnams dang / gcus dang rdeg 'chos gom 'khyor

verses.skt: bhāṣaṇaṃ sāmibhuktasya rāgadveṣabhayādi ca | karma prāṇātipātādi daśadhā yac ca ninditam
verses.tib: ldang bzhin smra bar byed pa dang / 'dod chags zhe sdang 'jig dang / srog gcod la sogs las rnams dang / rnam bcu de yang smad pa yin

verses.skt: mithyāyogaḥ samasto ’sāv iha vāmutra vā kṛtam | nidānam etad doṣāṇāṃ kupitās tena naikadhā
verses.tib: 'di dang gzhan du byas pa rnams / de dag ma lus log sbyor yin / 'di dag nad kyi rgyu yin no / ldang 'gyur de ni mtha' yas te

verses.skt: kurvanti vividhān vyādhīn śākhākoṣṭhāsthisaṃdhiṣu | śākhā raktādayas tvak ca bāhyarogāyanaṃ hi tat
verses.tib: sna tshogs nad ni byed par 'gyur / yan lag nang khrol lhu tshigs brten / yan lag khrag pags pa yin / de ni phyi rol nad gnas te

verses.skt: tadāśrayā maṣavyaṅgagaṇḍālajyarbudādayaḥ | bahirbhāgāś ca durnāmagulmaśophādayo gadāḥ
verses.tib: de brten ma zhu yan lag na / lba ba be'u snabs 'brum pa / gzhang 'brum skran dang 'or nad sogs / de dag phyi rol nad ces bya

verses.skt: antaḥ koṣṭho mahāsrota āmapakvāśayāśrayaḥ | tatsthānāḥ chardyatīsārakāsaśvāsodarajvarāḥ
verses.tib: nang nad rtsa sbubs chen po dang / ma zhu zhu ba'i gnas la brten / gnas de las ni skyugs tshad 'khru / dmu rdzing lud pa dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: antarbhāgaṃ ca śophārśogulmavisarpavidradhi | śirohṛdayavastyādimarmāṇy asthnāṃ ca saṃdhayaḥ
verses.tib: nang gi cha yi gzhang 'brum skrang / skran dang me dbal khong 'brum pa / mgo bo snying dang chu so / rus pa'i tshigs nad gnad yin no

verses.skt: tannibaddhāḥ sirāsnāyukaṇḍarādyāś ca madhyamaḥ | rogamārgaḥ sthitās tatra yakṣmapakṣavadhārditāḥ
verses.tib: de 'brel rtsa dang chu ba dang / chu ba chen bar ma yin / de la nad lam der gnas pa / gcong chen gzhogs phyed mjing kha yo / glad nad dang tshigs rus dang

verses.skt: mūrdhādirogāḥ saṃdhyasthitrikaśūlagrahādayaḥ | sraṃsavyāsavyadhasvāp asādaruktodabhedanam
verses.tib: dpyi yi gzer dang gnod nad / 'byin khyab zug dang snyom pa dang / lus tsha nad gzer bye ba dang / 'ja' zhing chag snyam rkang lag 'khums

verses.skt: saṅgāṅgabhaṅgasaṃkocavartaharṣaṇatarpaṇam | kampapāruṣyasauṣiryaśoṣaspandanaveṣṭanam
verses.tib: bsgongs dang rtse dang skom byed dang / 'dar dang rtsub dang khong stong dang / skem dang mgul dang dkris snyam dang

verses.skt: stambhaḥ kaṣāyarasatā varṇaḥ śyāvo ’ruṇo ’pi vā | karmāṇi vāyoḥ pittasya dāharāgoṣmapākitāḥ
verses.tib: rengs dang ro bska bro ba'o / mdog ni gnag gam dmar ba dag / rlung gi las yin mkhris pa'i las / lus tsha mdog dmar dro / smin byed

verses.skt: svedaḥ kledaḥ srutiḥ kothaḥ sadanaṃ mūrchanaṃ madaḥ | kaṭukāmlau rasau varṇaḥ pāṇḍurāruṇavarjitaḥ
verses.tib: rngul dang gnag dang 'dzag rma red / 'drul dang brgyal zhing myos pa dang / kha'i ro kha dang sgyur ba dang / mdog skya dmar rtsa ma yin pa'o

verses.skt: śleṣmaṇaḥ snehakāṭhinyakaṇḍūśītatvagauravam | bandhopalepastaimityaśophāpaktyatinidratāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las ni mkhrang zhing snum / g.ya' zhing khong grang lci ba dang / tshigs dam sha rgyas rmongs bag dang / skrang zhing gnyid che zas mi 'ju

verses.skt: varṇaḥ śveto rasau svādulavaṇau cirakāritā | ity aśeṣāmayavyāpi yad uktaṃ doṣalakṣaṇam
verses.tib: mdog dkar kha ro lan tshwa mngar / las kyi mtha' las 'dam ring ngo / de ltar ji skad bshad pa yi / mtshan nyid kyis ni nad kun khyab

verses.skt: darśanādyair avahitas tat samyag upalakṣayet | vyādhyavasthāvibhāgajñaḥ paśyann ārtān pratikṣaṇam
verses.tib: de ni ma yengs lta pas / yang dag par ni shes par bya / nad kyi gnas skabs dbye shes pas / nad pa skad cig re rer blta

verses.skt: abhyāsāt prāpyate dṛṣṭiḥ karmasiddhiprakāśinī | ratnādisadasajjñānaṃ na śāstrād eva jāyate
verses.tib: goms pas nges par thob 'gyur te / las rnams grub pa gsal byed yin / rin chen la sogs bzang ngan shes / bstan bcos 'ba' zhig las mi 'byung

verses.skt: dṛṣṭāpacārajaḥ kaścit kaścit pūrvāparādhajaḥ | tatsaṃkarād bhavaty anyo vyādhir evaṃ tridhā smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: nad ni 'di ltar rnam gsum ste / la la tshe 'di'i nyes las byung / la la sngon gyi nyes las byung / gzhan dag de gnyis 'dres las byung

verses.skt: yathānidānaṃ doṣotthaḥ karmajo hetubhir vinā | mahārambho ’lpake hetāv ātaṅko doṣakarmajaḥ
verses.tib: nyes 'byung nad gzhi ji bzhin par / las skyes rgyu ni med pa yin / rgyu chung ba la dkyel che'i nang / nyes dang las las byung ba yin

verses.skt: vipakṣaśīlanāt pūrvaḥ karmajaḥ karmasaṃkṣayāt | gacchaty ubhayajanmā tu doṣakarmakṣayāt kṣayam
verses.tib: dang po mi mthun bza' ba yin / las skyes las ni zad pa ste / gnyi ga las byung nyes dang las / zad pas zad par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: dvidhā svaparatantratvād vyādhayo ’ntyāḥ punar dvidhā | pūrvajāḥ pūrvarūpākhyā jātāḥ paścād upadravāḥ
verses.tib: nad ni rang rgyud gzhan rgyud las / gnyis 'gyur mtha' 'ang gnyis yin te / sngar skyes snga ma'i tshul du bshad / phyi skyes pa ni bla brnan yin

verses.skt: yathāsvajanmopaśayāḥ svatantrāḥ spaṣṭalakṣaṇāḥ | viparītās tato ’nye tu vidyād evaṃ malān api
verses.tib: rang gnas ji bzhin gnas pa ni / rang rgyud can de mtshan nyid gsal / gzhan dag de las go bzlog pa / dri ma'ang de bzhin shes par gyis

verses.skt: tā¿ lakṣayed avahito vikurvāṇān pratijvaram | teṣāṃ pradhānapraśame praśamo ’śāmyatas tathā
verses.tib: de ni nad re ldang ba na / ma yengs pas ni shes bya ste / de rnams gtso bo zhi byas pas / zhi 'gyur zhi bar ma gyur na

verses.skt: paścāc cikitset tūrṇaṃ vā balavantam upadravam | vyādhikliṣṭaśarīrasya pīḍākarataro hi saḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin phyi nas gso bar bya / 'on te bla brnan stobs che na / myur gso de nad kyis gzir ba / lus la shas cher gnod byed yin

verses.skt: vikāranāmākuśalo na jihrīyāt kadācana | na hi sarvavikārāṇāṃ nāmato ’sti dhruvā sthitiḥ
verses.tib: nad la rnam par mi mkhas shes / ngo tsha nam yang ma byed cig / nad kyi 'gyur ba thams cad kyi / ming gi nges bstan yod pa min

verses.skt: sa eva kupito doṣaḥ samutthānaviśeṣataḥ | sthānāntarāṇi ca prāpya vikārān kurute bahūn
verses.tib: nyes pa de nyid 'khrugs nas ni / khyad / par du ni ldang gyur nas / gnas gzhan dag tu song nas ni / nad ni mang por byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: tasmād vikāraprakṛtīr adhiṣṭhānāntarāṇi ca | buddhvā hetuviśeṣāṃś ca śīghraṃ kuryād upakramam
verses.tib: de bas nad kyi rang bzhin ni / rang gnas gzhan du 'phos pa dang / rgyu yi khyad par shes byas la / sman dpyad kyis gso myur du bya

verses.skt: dūṣyaṃ deśaṃ balaṃ kālam analaṃ prakṛtiṃ vayaḥ | sattvaṃ sātmyaṃ tathāhāram avasthāś ca pṛthagvidhāḥ
verses.tib: gnod bya yul dang nyams stobs dus / me drod rang bzhin na tshod dang / snying stobs goms dang zas rnams kyis / gnas skabs rnam pa tha dad pa

verses.skt: sūkṣmasūkṣmāḥ samīkṣyaiṣāṃ doṣauṣadhanirūpaṇe | yo vartate cikitsāyāṃ na sa skhalati jātu cit
verses.tib: 'di dag phra mo yan chad brtag / nad dang sman gyi tshul brtags pas / gang zhig gso ba la 'jug pa / de ni nam yang 'khrul mi 'gyur

verses.skt: gurvalpavyādhisaṃsthānaṃ sattvadehabalābalāt | dṛśyate ’py anyathākāraṃ tasminn avahito bhavet
verses.tib: nad dkyel che ba'am chung ba dag / phog snya lus nyams che chung las / gnod par byed pa snang 'gyur bas / de la'ang ma yengs nyid du bya

verses.skt: guruṃ laghum iti vyādhiṃ kalpayaṃs tu bhiṣagbruvaḥ | alpadoṣākalanayā pathye vipratipadyate
verses.tib: sman pa ngan pas nad rnams ni / lci ba yang bar yongs rtog cing / nad nyung dag tu brtags pa yis / gso ba log pa dag tu 'gyur

verses.skt: tato ’lpam alpavīryaṃ vā guruvyādhau prayojitam | udīrayettarāṃ rogān saṃśodhanam ayogataḥ
verses.tib: de bas chung ba'ang stobs chung ba / dkyel chen nad la rab tu sbyor / sbyor ba chung ngur sbyar ba yis / nad ni shin tu slong ba yin

verses.skt: śodhanaṃ tv atiyogena viparītaṃ viparyaye | kṣiṇuyān na malān eva kevalaṃ vapur asyati
verses.tib: sbyor ba'ang lhag par sbyor ba dang / log par sbyor bas phyin ci log / dri ma 'byung bar mi zad kyi / lus kyang shin tu ma rung 'gyur

verses.skt: ato ’bhiyuktaḥ satataṃ sarvam ālocya sarvathā | tathā yuñjīta bhaiṣajyam ārogyāya yathā dhruvam
verses.tib: de bas rtag tu brtson pa dang / thams cad kun tu legs brtags nas / ci nas nad med brtan gyur pa / de ltar sman dpyad sbyar bar gyis

verses.skt: vakṣyante ’taḥ paraṃ doṣā vṛddhikṣayavibhedataḥ | pṛthak trīn viddhi saṃsargas tridhā tatra tu tān nava
verses.tib: de nas gzhan yang nad rnams ni / 'phel zad dbye bas bshad bya ste / tha dad pa las gsum shes bya / ldan gsum de yang de dgu yin

verses.skt: trīn eva samayā vṛddhyā ṣaḍ ekasyātiśāyane | trayodaśa samasteṣu ṣaḍ dvyekātiśayena tu
verses.tib: mnyam par 'phel bas gsum nyid de / gcig rab lhag pas drug tu 'gyur / ma lus pa las bcu gsum yin / gnyis gcig lhag pa las drug ste

verses.skt: ekaṃ tulyādhikaiḥ ṣaṭ ca tāratamyavikalpanāt | pañcaviṃśatim ity evaṃ vṛddhaiḥ kṣīṇaiś ca tāvataḥ
verses.tib: mtshungs las gcig yin rab dang ni / rab mchog brtags pa las drug yin / de ltar nyi shu rtsa lnga ni / 'phel ba'o zad pa'ang de snyed yin

verses.skt: ekaikavṛddhisamatākṣayaiḥ ṣaṭ te punaś ca ṣaṭ | ekakṣayadvandvavṛddhyā saviparyayayāpi te
verses.tib: de dag re re 'phel mnyam zad / drug ste slar yang de dag ni / gcig zad gnyis gnyis 'phel ba ni / go bzlog bcas las drug tu 'gyur

verses.skt: bhedā dviṣaṣṭir nirdiṣṭās triṣaṣṭiḥ svāsthyakāraṇam | saṃsargād rasarudhirādibhis tathaiṣāṃ | doṣāṃs tu kṣayasamatāvivṛddhibhedaiḥ | ānantyaṃ taratamayogataś ca yātān | jānīyād avahitamānaso yathāsvam
verses.tib: dbye ba drug cu gnyis su / bstan / drug cu gsum pa bder gnas rgyu / de bzhin 'di dag dngas ma khrag 'dres pa las / nad ni zad dang mnyam dang 'phel ba'i dbye ba yis / rab dang rab mchog dag las mtha' yas nyid 'gyur bar / rang bzhin ci 'dra ma yengs yid kyis shes par gyis

verses.skt: vātasyopakramaḥ snehaḥ svedaḥ saṃśodhanaṃ mṛdu | svādvamlalavaṇoṣṇāni bhojyāny abhyaṅgamardanam
verses.tib: rlung nad gso ba snum dang ni / dugs dang sbyang ba 'jam rtsi dang / mngar skyur lan tshwa bro ba yi / zas dang bsku zhing mnye ba dang

verses.skt: veṣṭanaṃ trāsanaṃ seko madyaṃ paiṣṭikagauḍikam | snigdhoṣṇā vastayo vastiniyamaḥ sukhaśīlatā
verses.tib: dkri snun sman chu blugs pa dang / gro chang 'bras chang bu ram chang / snum dro 'jam rtsi gtang ba ni / 'jam rtsi nges pa bde dga' dang

verses.skt: dīpanaiḥ pācanaiḥ snigdhāḥ snehāś cānekayonayaḥ | viśeṣān medyapiśitarasatailānuvāsanam
verses.tib: skye gnas du ma'i snum dag ni / drod che 'ju bar byed g.yos sbyar / khyad par du ni sha tshon dang / til mar dang sbyar 'jam rtsi bya

verses.skt: pittasya sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ svāduśītair virecanam | svādutiktakaṣāyāṇi bhojanāny auṣadhāni ca
verses.tib: mkhris pa mar sar blud pa dang / mngar zhing bsil ba'i bkru sman dang / mngar dang kha dang bska ba yi / zas dang sman ni sbyin pa dang

verses.skt: sugandhiśītahṛdyānāṃ gandhānām upasevanam | kaṇṭheguṇānāṃ hārāṇāṃ maṇīnām urasā dhṛtiḥ
verses.tib: dri bzang bsil zhing yid 'ong ba'i / dri ni nye bar bsten pa dang / mgul du do shal se mo do / nor bu brang du gdags par bya

verses.skt: karpūracandanośīrair anulepaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | pradoṣaś candramāḥ saudhaṃ hāri gītaṃ himo ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: ga bur tsan+dan ur shi ra'i / byug pas skad cig re re bsku / srod la rdo thal can zla zer / yid 'ong glu dang ser bsil bsten

verses.skt: ayantraṇasukhaṃ mitraṃ putraḥ saṃdigdhamugdhavāk | chandānuvartino dārāḥ priyāḥ śīlavibhūṣitāḥ
verses.tib: bag phebs mdza' bo bde ba dang / bu la gzhon skad nyams rangs smra / chung ma yid mthun las byed cing / sdug cig yon tan rnams kyis brgyan

verses.skt: śītāmbudhārāgarbhāṇi gṛhāṇy udyānadīrghikāḥ | sutīrthavipulasvacchasalilāśayasaikate
verses.tib: khang pa nyi rim chu bsil blugs / skyed mos tshal rdzing bzang po ni / rgya tsha dang ni stegs bcas pa / chus brlan bye ma bsil ba dang

verses.skt: sāmbhojajalatīrānte kāyamāne drumākule | saumyā bhāvāḥ payaḥ sarpir virekaś ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: spyil bu lus tshad shing khebs dang / chu 'gram pad+mar bcas par ni / bde gnas khyad par 'o ma dang / mar sar bza' dang bkru sman bya

verses.skt: śleṣmaṇo vidhinā yuktaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vamanarecanam | annaṃ rūkṣālpatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ kaṭutiktakaṣāyakam
verses.tib: bad kan cho gar ldan par ni / skyug sman bkru sman rnon po btang / zas ni rtsub chung rno zhing dro / tsha zhing kha dang bska ba bza'

verses.skt: dīrghakālasthitaṃ madyaṃ ratiprītiḥ prajāgaraḥ | anekarūpo vyāyāmaś cintā rūkṣaṃ vimardanam
verses.tib: chang ni yun lon pa btung / rtse dga' dang ni gnyid mi log / rtsol / ba'i tshul ni sna tshogs dang / sems las rtsub pas mnye ba dang

verses.skt: viśeṣād vamanaṃ yūṣaḥ kṣaudraṃ medoghnam auṣadham | dhūmopavāsagaṇḍūṣā niḥsukhatvaṃ sukhāya ca
verses.tib: khyad par sman khu skyug sman btang / sbrang rtsi tshil 'joms sman bsten bya / smyung bdud bdug mkhur bkang dbo / bde ba med nyid bde phyir bya / nad rnams so sor gso ba dang / nad las dpags te bshad pa yin / ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa dag / de ni so so'i tshul bzhin brtag

verses.skt: upakramaḥ pṛthag doṣān yo ’yam uddiśya kīrtitaḥ | saṃsargasaṃnipāteṣu taṃ yathāsvaṃ vikalpayet
verses.tib: khyad par sman khu skyug sman btang / sbrang rtsi tshil 'joms sman bsten bya / smyung bdud bdug mkhur bkang dbo / bde ba med nyid bde phyir bya / nad rnams so sor gso ba dang / nad las dpags te bshad pa yin / ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa dag / de ni so so'i tshul bzhin brtag

verses.skt: graiṣmaḥ prāyo marutpitte vāsantaḥ kaphamārute | maruto yogavāhitvāt kaphapitte tu śāradaḥ
verses.tib: rlung ni zung du 'jug pas na / rlung mkhris phal cher so ga'i bya / bad kan rlung la dpyid kyi bya / bad kan mkhris pa ston gyi bya

verses.skt: caya eva jayed doṣaṃ kupitaṃ tv avirodhayan | sarvakope balīyāṃsaṃ śeṣadoṣāvirodhataḥ
verses.tib: zung du 'jug pa rlung gi mchog / yang dag 'dres pas gnyis bdag can / me dang ldan pas sreg par byed / zla ba ldan pas bsil bar byed / nad ni dkyel sogs dus su bsal / ldang na gzhan don med par gso / thams cad ldan na tshabs che ba / nad gzhan gnod pa med par gso

verses.skt: prayogaḥ śamayed vyādhim ekaṃ yo ’nyam udīrayet | nāsau viśuddhaḥ śuddhas tu śamayed yo na kopayet
verses.tib: nad ni sbyor bas zhi bya ba / gang gzhan ldang bar byed pa dag / de ni dag min gzhan dag ni / ldang bar mi 'gyur rnam dag yin

verses.skt: vyāyāmād ūṣmaṇas taikṣṇyād ahitācaraṇād api | koṣṭhāc chākhāsthimarmāṇi drutatvān mārutasya ca
verses.tib: rtsol drag tsha ba rno ba dang / gnod par 'gyur ba spyad pas kyang / khong pa yan lag rus pa dang / gnad du rlung ni 'jug par 'gyur

verses.skt: doṣā yānti tathā tebhyaḥ srotomukhaviśodhanāt | vṛddhyābhiṣyandanāt pākāt koṣṭhaṃ vāyoś ca nigrahāt
verses.tib: de bzhin de la rtsa sgo ni / rnam par sbyangs pas 'byung bar 'gyur / smin byas rlung ni tshar bcad pas / khong pa'i nang du 'du bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tatrasthāś ca vilamberan bhūyo hetupratīkṣiṇaḥ | te kālādibalaṃ labdhvā kupyanty anyāśrayeṣv api
verses.tib: der gnas nas kyang rgyu dag la / sdod cing ring du thogs pa yin / de ni dus sogs stobs thob nas / gzhan la brten yang ldang bar byed

verses.skt: tatrānyasthānasaṃstheṣu tadīyām abaleṣu tu | kuryāc cikitsāṃ svām eva balenānyābhibhāviṣu
verses.tib: de la gnas gzhan gnas pa ni / de nyid stobs ni med nyid la / gso bar bya ba rang gi ni / stobs kyis gzhan zil gnon byed na'o

verses.skt: āgantuṃ śamayed doṣaṃ sthāninaṃ pratikṛtya vā | prāyas tiryaggatā doṣāḥ kleśayanty āturāṃś ciram
verses.tib: bla brnan nad ni zhi byas na / rang gnas gnas pa gso mi dgos / phal cher rtsib logs 'gro ba'i nad / nad pa yun nyon mongs byed

verses.skt: sādhāraṇaṃ vā kurvīta kriyām ubhayayoginīm
kuryān na teṣu tvarayā dehāgnibalavit kriyām | śamayet tān prayogeṇa sukhaṃ vā koṣṭham ānayet
verses.tib: lus me'i stobs ni shes pa yis / de la thabs dag mi bya / de ni sbyor bas zhi bya'am / khong du bde bar bsdu bar bya

verses.skt: jñātvā koṣṭhaprapannāṃś ca yathāsannaṃ vinirharet | srotorodhabalabhraṃśagauravānilamūḍhatāḥ
verses.tib: khong du 'dus par shes nas ni / ji ltar nye ba bzhin du bsal / bu ga 'byung 'gags stobs nyams shing / lci zhing rlung ni khung du 'khrul

verses.skt: ālasyāpaktiniṣṭhīvamalasaṅgāruciklamāḥ | liṅgaṃ malānāṃ sāmānāṃ nirāmāṇāṃ viparyayaḥ
verses.tib: khong snyom mi 'ju mchil ma mang / bshang gci sri dub zas mi len / nad rtse ma zhil spyi yi rtags / rtse / zhil de las bzlog pa yin

verses.skt: viṇmūtranakhadantatvakcakṣuṣāṃ pītatā bhavet | raktatvam atha kṛṣṇatvaṃ pṛṣṭhāsthikaṭisaṃdhiruk
śiroruk jāyate tīvrā nidrā virasatā mukhe | kvacic ca śvayathur gātre jvarātīsāraharṣaṇam
ūṣmaṇo ’lpabalatvena dhātum ādyam apācitam | duṣṭam āmāśayagataṃ rasam āmaṃ pracakṣate
verses.tib: khong ba'i drod stobs chung nyid kyis / lus zungs dang po mi 'ju ba / nad ni pho bar zhugs pa dag / dngas ma ma zhu yin par bshad

verses.skt: anye doṣebhya evātiduṣṭebhyo ’nyo'nyamūrchanāt | kodravebhyo viṣasyeva vadanty āmasya saṃbhavam
verses.tib: gzhan dag nad nyid rab 'khrugs pa / rab sdug phan tshun 'doms las byung / ko dra ba yi dug bzhin du / nad tshabs chen po 'byung bar bshad

verses.skt: āmena tena saṃpṛktā doṣā dūṣyāś ca dūṣitāḥ | sāmā ity upadiśyante ye ca rogās tadudbhavāḥ
verses.tib: nad tshabs de dang 'dres pa dang / gnod pa gnod bya gnod 'gyur dang / nad gzhan gang dag de las byung / ma zhu ba dang bcas par bshad

verses.skt: vāyuḥ sāmo vibandhāgnisādastambhāntrakūjanaiḥ | vedanāśophanistodaiḥ kramaśo ’ṅgāni pīḍayan
vicared yugapac cāpi gṛhṇāti kupito bhṛśam | snehādyair vṛddhim āyāti sūryameghodaye niśi
nirāmo viśado rūkṣo nirvibandho ’lpavedanaḥ | viparītaguṇaiḥ śāntiṃ snigdhair yāti viśeṣataḥ
durgandhi haritaṃ śyāvaṃ pittam amlaṃ ghanaṃ guru | amlīkākaṇṭhahṛddāhakaraṃ sāmaṃ vinirdiśet
ātāmrapītam atyuṣṇaṃ rase kaṭukam asthiram | pakvaṃ vigandhi vijñeyaṃ rucipaktibalapradam
āvilas tantulaḥ styānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe ’vatiṣṭhate | sāmo balāso durgandhiḥ kṣududgāravighātakṛt
phenavān piṇḍitaḥ pāṇdur niḥsāro ’gandha eva ca | pakvaḥ sa eva vijñeyaś chedavān vaktraśuddhidaḥ
sarvadehapravisṛtān sāmān doṣān na nirharet | līnān dhātuṣv anutkliṣṭān phalād āmād rasān iva
verses.tib: de ni lus kun zhugs gyur pa / nad nang zhugs te rtse ma bcil / ma smin dbyung bar mi bya ste / ma smin shing thog khu bar mtshungs

verses.skt: āśrayasya hi nāśāya te syur durnirharatvataḥ | pācanair dīpanaiḥ snehais tān svedaiś ca pariṣkṛtān
verses.tib: de ni dbyung bar dka' bas na / rten ni 'jig par byed par 'gyur / de ni smin dang drod skyed snum / dugs bya rtse bcil de bsil ba

verses.skt: śodhayec chodhanaiḥ kāle yathāsannaṃ yathābalam | hanty āśu yuktaṃ vaktreṇa dravyam āmāśayān malān
verses.tib: ji ltar nye dang stobs ji bzhin / sbyangs pa'i dus su bsal bar bya / kha nas rigs par sman btang bas / ma zhu'i gnas las nad myur bsal

verses.skt: ghrāṇena cordhvajatrūtthān pakvādhānād gudena ca | utkliṣṭān adha ūrdhvaṃ vā na cāmān vahataḥ svayam
verses.tib: nam tshod yan chad sna sman gyis / zhu ba'i gnas yong mas gtong bsal / steng ngam 'og tu 'byung bar rtsom

verses.skt: dhārayed auṣadhair doṣān vidhṛtās te hi rogadāḥ | pravṛttān prāg ato doṣān upekṣeta hitāśinaḥ
verses.tib: sman gyis nad ni mi dgag ste / bkag na de nyid nad skyed 'gyur / de bas dang por nad 'byung la / bsdad de phan par bza' bar bya

verses.skt: vibaddhān pācanais tais taiḥ pācayen nirhareta vā | śrāvaṇe kārttike caitre māsi sādhāraṇe kramāt
verses.tib: 'khyil la smin pa de dang des / smin byas de bzhin bsal bar bya / dbyar ston tha dpyid zla 'bring

verses.skt: prāvṛṭśaradvasanteṣu māseṣv eteṣu śodhayet | sādhāraṇeṣu vidhinā trimāsāntaritān malān
verses.tib: thun mong dus su rim bzhin du / so ga dbyar dang dgun bsags pa'i

verses.skt: grīṣmavarṣāhimacitān vāyvādīn āśu nirharet | atyuṣṇavarṣaśītā hi grīṣmavarṣāhimāgamāḥ
verses.tib: rlung sogs nad ni myur du bsal / so ga dbyar dang dgun gyi tshe / rab tsha char dang grang ba'i dus

verses.skt: saṃdhau sādhāraṇe teṣāṃ duṣṭān doṣān viśodhayet | svasthavṛttam abhipretya vyādhau vyādhivaśena tu
verses.tib: de rnams dus mtshams thun mong ste / de tshe nad ni mi bzang bsal / tha mal bde gnas dbang byas kyi / nad pa nad kyi dbang du ni

verses.skt: trayaḥ sādhāraṇās teṣām antare prāvṛṣādayaḥ | prāvṛṭ śucinabhau teṣu śarad ūrjasahau smṛtau
tapasyo madhumāsaś ca vasantaḥ śodhanaṃ prati | etān ṛtūn vikalpyaivaṃ dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ bhiṣak
kṛtvā śītoṣṇavṛṣṭīnāṃ pratīkāraṃ yathāyatham | prayojayet kriyāṃ prāptāṃ kriyākālaṃ na hāpayet
verses.tib: grang tsha char gyi dus dag gi / gnyen po ji bzhin byas nas ni / sbyor ba'i dus su bab pa na / bya ba dus la mi sdod do

verses.skt: yuñjyād anannam annādau madhye ’nte kavaḍāntare | grāse grāse muhuḥ sānnaṃ sāmudgaṃ niśi cauṣadham
verses.tib: sman ni zas ma zos sngon dang / dbus dang mtha' dang kham gyi bar / zas bar tseg bu zas bcas dang / zas mnan mtshan mo btung ba'o

verses.skt: kaphodreke gade ’nannaṃ balino rogarogiṇoḥ | annādau viguṇe ’pāne samāne madhya iṣyate
verses.tib: bad kan bdo 'das nad pa ni / nyams stobs ldan la ma zos btang / thur sel rlung la zas sngar btang / mnyam gnas ldang la bar du yin

verses.skt: vyāne ’nte prātarāśasya sāyamāśasya tūttare | grāsagrāsāntayoḥ prāṇe praduṣṭe mātariśvani
verses.tib: khyab byed nang par zas za'i mthar / gyen rgyu'i rlung la dgongs ka'o / srog ces bya ba'i rlung ldang la / kham gyi bar dang zas bar bza'

verses.skt: muhur muhur viṣacchardihidhmātṛṭśvāsakāsiṣu | yojyaṃ sabhojyaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ bhojyaiś citrair arocake
verses.tib: dugs dang skyugs lud dbugs mi bde / skom dad skye la tseg bu'o / yi ga 'chus la sna tshogs zas / sman dang zas bcas sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: kampākṣepakahidhmāsu sāmudgaṃ laghubhojinām | ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu svapnakāle praśasyate
verses.tib: skyigs bu lus 'dar lag 'dar dang / zas nyung za la mnan pa gtang / nam tshong yan chad nad la ni / mtshan mo'i dus su btang ba bsngags

verses.skt: upakramyasya hi dvitvād dvidhaivopakramo mataḥ | ekaḥ saṃtarpaṇas tatra dvitīyaś cāpatarpaṇaḥ
verses.tib: gso ba rnam pa gnyis yin phyir / gso thabs rnam pa gnyis su 'dod / de gcig brta bar bya ba yin / gnyis pa nyams ni smad pa'o

verses.skt: bṛṃhaṇo laṅghanaś ceti tatparyāyāv udāhṛtau | bṛṃhaṇaṃ yad bṛhattvāya laṅghanaṃ lāghavāya yat
verses.tib: de dag rgyas bya smyung ba zhes / rnam grangs dag tu bshad pa yin / lus sha rgyas phyir rgyas bya ste / yang ba nyid phyir smyung bar bya

verses.skt: dehasya bhavataḥ prāyo bhaumāpam itarac ca te | snehanaṃ rūkṣaṇaṃ karma svedanaṃ stambhanaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: de ni phal cher sa chu dang / cig shos las ni gyur pa yin / las gang snum dang dgag pa dang / dugs dang khong rtsub bya ba ste

verses.skt: bhūtānāṃ tad api dvaidhyād dvitayaṃ nātivartate | śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ ceti dvidhā tatrāpi laṅghanam
verses.tib: 'byung ba de yang gnyis yin phyir / gnyis las 'da' bar mi byed do / de la'ang sbyong dang zhi bya ba / rnam pa gnyis po smyung ba yin

verses.skt: yad īrayed bahir doṣān pañcadhā śodhanaṃ ca tat | nirūho vamanaṃ kāyaśiroreko ’sravisrutiḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig nad ni phyir 'byin pa / sbyong yin de ni rnam lnga ste / mas gtong skyugs sman lus nad bkru / mgo bo'i nad bkru gtar gas dbyung

verses.skt: na śodhayati yad doṣān samān nodīrayaty api | samīkaroti viṣamān śamanaṃ tac ca saptadhā
verses.tib: gang zhig nad ni mi sbyong dang / snyoms gnas glongs pa ma yon dang / ma snyoms snyoms par byed pa dag / zhi ba yin te de rnams bdun

verses.skt: pācanaṃ dīpanaṃ kṣuttṛḍvyāyāmātapamārutāḥ | bṛṃhaṇaṃ śamanaṃ tv eva vāyoḥ pittānilasya ca
verses.tib: smin dang drod skyed bkres skom dang / rtsol bcag nyi tshan ser bu bsil / brta ba dag ni rlung dang ni / rlung bcas mkhris pa zhi byed yin

verses.skt: bṛṃhayed vyādhibhaiṣajyamadyastrīśokakarśitān | bhārādhvoraḥkṣatakṣīṇarūkṣadurbalavātalān
verses.tib: brta bya nad dang sman dang chang / bud med mya ngan gyis nyam chung / khur dang lam gyis glo rdol dang / lus rtsub nyams dma' rlung shas che

verses.skt: garbhiṇīsūtikābālavṛddhān grīṣme ’parān api | māṃsakṣīrasitāsarpirmadhurasnigdhavastibhiḥ
verses.tib: sbrum ma bu btsas byis pa rgan / so ga'i dus dang gzhan yang brta / sha dang 'o ma ka ra dkar / mar sar mngar bag mas gtong dang

verses.skt: svapnaśayyāsukhābhyaṅgasnānanirvṛtiharṣaṇaiḥ | mehāmadoṣātisnigdhajvarorustambhakuṣṭhinaḥ
verses.tib: gnyid log nyal bde bsku byug dang / khrus dang bder gnas nyams dga' brta / gcin snyi ma zhu snum rab zos / rims btab brla rengs mdze nad can

verses.skt: visarpavidradhiplīhaśiraḥkaṇṭhākṣirogiṇaḥ | sthūlāṃś ca laṅghayen nityaṃ śiśire tv aparān api
verses.tib: shub khong 'bras mcher pa na / glad nad lkog nad mig nad dang / sbom po dgun dang gzhan dag kyang / rtag tu smyung bar bya ba yin

verses.skt: tatra saṃśodhanaiḥ sthaulyabalapittakaphādhikān | āmadoṣajvaracchardiratīsārahṛdāmayaiḥ
verses.tib: de la sbyang bya shas che sbom / stobs ldan mkhris pa bad kan rgyas / ma zhu'i nad dang rims dang skyug

verses.skt: vibandhagauravodgārahṛllāsādibhir āturān | madhyasthaulyādikān prāyaḥ pūrvaṃ pācanadīpanaiḥ
verses.tib: tshad pas 'khru dang snying nad can / lus lci sgregs mang bshang gci 'gags / yi ga 'chus sogs kyis na ba / 'bring tsam spom sogs phal cher ni / dang por smin dang drod bskyed bya

verses.skt: ebhir evāmayair ārtān hīnasthaulyabalādhikān | kṣuttṛṣṇānigrahair doṣais tv ārtān madhyabalair dṛḍhān
verses.tib: nad ni 'di dag gis nyam thag / sbom dang stobs sogs chung ba la / bkres dang skom pas tshar bcad do / nad kyis nyam thag stobs 'bring brtan

verses.skt: samīraṇātapāyāsaiḥ kim utālpabalair narān | na bṛṃhayel laṅghanīyān bṛṃhyāṃs tu mṛdu laṅghayet
verses.tib: ser bu tsha rtsol gyis smad na / nyam chung mi brta smos ci dgos / nyams smad bya ba brta mi bya / brta bya nyams smad 'jam pos bya

verses.skt: yuktyā vā deśakālādibalatas tān upācaret | bṛṃhite syād balaṃ puṣṭis tatsādhyāmayasaṃkṣayaḥ
verses.tib: yang na yul dang stobs sogs las / rigs pas de ni nye bar spyad / brta bas stobs ni 'phel ba dang / de yis bsgrub bya'i nad zad 'gyur

verses.skt: vimalendriyatā sargo malānāṃ lāghavaṃ ruciḥ | kṣuttṛṭsahodayaḥ śuddhahṛdayodgārakaṇṭhatā
verses.tib: smyung bas dbang gsal dri ma rnams / mi sri khong yang yi ga 'bye / bkres dang skom pa lhan cig 'byung / dang ga snying dang sgregs pa dag

verses.skt: vyādhimārdavam utsāhas tandrānāśaś ca laṅghite | anapekṣitamātrādisevite kurutas tu te
verses.tib: nad kyi rtse zhil spro ba che / snyom bag med pa dag tu 'gyur / de dag tshad la sogs pa dang / mi ldan sten par byed pa dag

verses.skt: atisthaulyātikārśyādīn vakṣyante te ca sauṣadhāḥ | rūpaṃ tair eva ca jñeyam atibṛṃhitalaṅghite
verses.tib: rab sbom rab tu skem sogs 'gyur / de yang sman bcas bshad pa yin / tshul ni shin tu brta ba dang / nyams smad de nyid las shes bya

verses.skt: atisthaulyāpacīmehajvarodarabhagandarān | kāsasaṃnyāsakṛcchrāmakuṣṭhādīn atidāruṇān
verses.tib: shin tu tsho ches 'brum gcin snyi / rims dang dmu rdzing mtshan bar rdol / lus rmongs gcin sri be'u snabs chags / mdze la sogs pa mi bzad 'byung

verses.skt: tatra medo'nilaśleṣmanāśanaṃ sarvam iṣyate | kulatthajūrṇaśyāmākayavamudgamadhūdakam
verses.tib: de la tshil dang rlung bad kan / sel bar byed pa thams cad phan / dzur na khre rgod ku lang+tha / nas dang sran chung mon sran sde'u

verses.skt: mastudaṇḍāhatāriṣṭacintāśodhanajāgaram | madhunā triphalāṃ lihyād guḍūcīm abhayāṃ ghanam
verses.tib: dar ba dar rnying zho ga chu / sems las bya dang mi nyal bya / sbrang rtsi 'bras bu gsum pa'am / sle tres gla sgang a ru ra

verses.skt: rasāñjanasya mahataḥ pañcamūlasya gugguloḥ | śilājatuprayogaś ca sāgnimantharaso hitaḥ
verses.tib: skyer khaN+Da dang rtsa ba ni / chen po lnga dang gu gul dang / brag zhun gyi ni sbyor ba dang / ag ni man tha'i khu bcas phan

verses.skt: viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kṣāraḥ kālaloharajo madhu | yavāmalakacūrṇaṃ ca yogo ’tisthaulyadoṣajit
verses.tib: nas tshig 'khus thal byi dang ga / bca' sga lcags phye sbrang rtsi dang / nas dang skyu ru'i phye ma yi / sbyor bas shin tu tsho nad sel

verses.skt: vyoṣakaṭvīvarāśigruviḍaṅgātiviṣāsthirāḥ | hiṅgusauvarcalājājīyavānīdhānyacitrakāḥ
verses.tib: tsha gsum 'bras gsum pu tse shel / shi kru byi dang po s+Thir / shing kun go snyod kha ru tsha / la la phud dang 'u su dang / kru trug tres dang ser po gnyis / bri ha gnyis dang chu rtsi mo

verses.skt: niśe bṛhatyau hapuṣā pāṭhā mūlaṃ ca kembukāt | eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca sadṛśāṃśakam
verses.tib: ha pu sha dang pa ta dang / ke pu ka yi rtsa ba ste / 'di rnams phye ma mar sbrang rtsi / til mar dag ni cha snyoms pa

verses.skt: saktubhiḥ ṣoḍaśaguṇair yuktaṃ pītaṃ nihanti tat | atisthaulyādikān sarvān rogān anyāṃś ca tadvidhān
verses.tib: nas phye'i cha ni bcu drug bskyed / sbyar ba 'thungs na de 'joms so / shin tu shas che'i bdag nyid kun / gzhan yang de 'dra'i nad rnams dang

verses.skt: hṛdrogakāmalāśvitraśvāsakāsagalagrahān | buddhimedhāsmṛtikaraṃ saṃnasyāgneś ca dīpanam
verses.tib: snying nad mig ser sha bkra dang / lus dbugs mi bde lkog nad sel / blo dang yid gzhungs sems dran byed / zas 'ju pho ba'i drod kyang skyed

verses.skt: atikārśyaṃ bhramaḥ kāsas tṛṣṇādhikyam arocakaḥ | snehāgninidrādṛkśrotraśukraujaḥkṣutsvarakṣayaḥ
verses.tib: smyung drags rab skam mgo 'khor lud / skom dad che zhing yi ga 'chus / snum drod gnyid mig rna ba nyams / khu ba gzi mdangs skad gsang zad

verses.skt: vastihṛnmūrdhajaṅghorutrikapārśvarujā jvaraḥ | pralāpordhvānilaglānicchardiparvāsthibhedanam
verses.tib: rgu so snying klad byin pa brla / dku do rtsib logs na rims 'debs / tshig mang stong du rlung nad 'jug / rmya zhing skyug bro rus tshigs na

verses.skt: varcomūtragrahādyāś ca jāyante ’tivilaṅghanāt | kārśyam eva varaṃ sthaulyān na hi sthūlasya bheṣajam
verses.tib: bshang gci sri ba la sogs pa / smyung ba drags pas 'byung bar 'gyur / rab tu tsho bas skem nyid mchog / shin tu tsho drags pa yi sman

verses.skt: bṛṃhaṇaṃ laṅghanaṃ vālam atimedo'gnivātajit | madhurasnigdhasauhityair yat saukhyena ca naśyati
verses.tib: shin tu tshil ches me rlung sel / brta dang nyams smad yod ma yin / gang zhig mngar dang snum bag bza' / bsod bde dag gis skem pa sel

verses.skt: kraśimā sthavimātyantaviparītaniṣevaṇaiḥ | yojayed bṛṃhaṇaṃ tatra sarvaṃ pānānnabheṣajam
verses.tib: de las shin tu bzlog pa dag / nges par bsten pas sbom nyid sel / de la bza' btung sman rnams ni / brta bar byed pa thams cad sbyar

verses.skt: acintayā harṣaṇena dhruvaṃ saṃtarpaṇena ca | svapnaprasaṅgāc ca kṛśo varāha iva puṣyati
verses.tib: sems las med dang dga' ba dang / nges par brta bar bya ba dang / gnyid cher log pas skam pa yang / phag dang 'dra bar lus rgyas gyur / lus ni brtas shing tsho byed pa

verses.skt: na hi māṃsasamaṃ kiñcid anyad dehabṛhattvakṛt | māṃsādamāṃsaṃ māṃsena saṃbhṛtatvād viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: sha dang 'dra ba gang yang med / sha mi za la sha za'i shas / lus ni shin tu brtas byed yin / sbom la nyams smad lci bas bya / de las bzlog pa skem la phan / nas dang gro ni gnyis ka la / de la 'os par byed pas brtag

verses.skt: guru cātarpaṇaṃ sthūle viparītaṃ hitaṃ kṛśe | yavagodhūmam ubhayos tadyogyāhitakalpanam
verses.tib: sha dang 'dra ba gang yang med / sha mi za la sha za'i shas / lus ni shin tu brtas byed yin / sbom la nyams smad lci bas bya / de las bzlog pa skem la phan / nas dang gro ni gnyis ka la / de la 'os par byed pas brtag

verses.skt: doṣagatyātiricyante grāhibhedyādibhedataḥ | upakramā na te dvitvād bhinnā api gadā iva
verses.tib: nad kyi dbye ba tha dad kyi / gcod 'khrul / sogs dbye ba yis / nad ltar tha dad gyur kyang ni / gso ba gnyis las yod ma yin

verses.skt: madanamadhukalambānimbabimbīviśālātrapusakuṭajamūrvādevadālīkṛmighnam | viduladahanacitrāḥ kośavatyau karañjaḥ kaṇalavaṇavacailāsarṣapāś chardanāni
verses.tib: po son cha dang shing mngar dang / ku ba kha bo nim pa dang / bim pa ga gon bi sha la / dug mo nyung dang mur ba dang / de ba da li byi dang ga / lcang ma tsi tra kru trug tres / ko sha pa ti ka rany+dza / pi pi ling dang rgyam tsha dang

verses.skt: nikumbhakumbhatriphalāgavākṣīsnukśaṅkhinīnīlinitilvakāni | śamyākakampillakahemadugdhā dugdhaṃ ca mūtraṃ ca virecanāni
verses.tib: shu dag sug smel yungs kar te / 'di dag skyugs ba'i sman gyi sde / dan ti dang ni tri bid ta / 'bras bu gsum dang bi sha la / shang ki ni dang snu ha dang / seng phrom dong ga ni li ni / khron bu dang ni kam pi l+ya / 'o ma ba gcin 'khru bar byed

verses.skt: madanakuṭajakuṣṭhadevadālīmadhukavacādaśamūladārurāsnāḥ | yavamiśikṛtavedhanaṃ kulatthā madhu lavaṇaṃ trivṛtā nirūhaṇāni
verses.tib: po son cha dang dug mo nyung / ru rta de ba da li dang / shing mngar shu dag rtsa ba bcu / thang shing ra snal la phud / sha ta pus pa pa ta la / rgya sran nag po sbrang rtsi dang / rgyam tsha lce tsha shing nye ro / 'di dag mas gtong bkru sman te

verses.skt: vellāpāmārgavyoṣadārvīsurālā bījaṃ śairīṣaṃ bārhataṃ śaigravaṃ ca | sāro mādhūkaḥ saindhavaṃ tārkṣyaśailaṃ truṭyau pṛthvīkā śodhayanty uttamāṅgam
verses.tib: a ba marga byi dang ga / tsha ba gsum dang skyer pa'i rtsa / su ra la dang shi ri Sha / bri had shi kru'i sa bon dang / seng ldeng ma du ka'i snying po / rgyam tsha dngul rdo pha bong dreg / sug smel gnyis dang go snyod spom / mgo bo'i nad sbyong byed pa yin

verses.skt: bhadradāru nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ daśamūlaṃ balādvayam | vāyuṃ vīratarādiś ca vidāryādiś ca nāśayet
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu dang bal gnyis / bi ra ta ri'i sman sder gtogs / bi da ri sogs rlung nad sel / dUr ba dang ni byi tsher ba / nim pa ba sha ka'i lo ma / kha sral phre'u 'ol ma se / nye'u shing pa zhes bya dang / shi ta ba ki pri yang ku

verses.skt: dūrvānantā nimbavāsātmaguptā gundrābhīruḥ śītapākī priyaṅguḥ | nyagrodhādiḥ padmakādiḥ sthire dve padmaṃ vanyaṃ śārivādiś ca pittam || 6 || āragvadhādir arkādir muṣkakādyo ’sanādikaḥ | surasādiḥ samustādir vatsakādir balāsajit
verses.tib: n+ya gro d+ha sogs shug pa sogs / s+thi ra rnam gnyis pad+ma'i ze / ban n+ya thal tres sogs mkhris sel / dong ga sogs dang arka sogs / mung+ga sogs dang po son sogs / bye'u rug pa sogs gla sgang sogs / dug mo nyung sogs bad kan sel

verses.skt: jīvantīkākolyau mede dve mudgamāṣaparṇyau ca | ṛṣabhakajīvakamadhukaṃ ceti gaṇo jīvanīyākhyaḥ
verses.tib: dzi ban+ti dang ram nye ba / me da ma hA me da dang / mung+ga ma sha par+Ni dang / ldum bu zangs rtsi ba dang ni / dzi ba ka dang shing mngar te / sde 'di 'tsho byed ces bya / yin

verses.skt: vidāripañcāṅgulavṛścikālīvṛścīvadevāhvayaśūrpaparṇyaḥ | kaṇḍūkarī jīvanahrasvasaṃjñe dve pañcake gopasutā tripādī
verses.tib: bid ri dang e raN+Da / priSh+tsi kha li pur+Na rna / de ba ha sa de ba dang / par+Ni gnyis dang kha sral dang / 'tsho byed lnga dang rtsa chung lnga / thal tres dang ni lcang ma dang / haM sa pa ti zhes bya rnams

verses.skt: vidāryādir ayaṃ hṛdyo bṛṃhaṇo vātapittahā | śoṣagulmāṅgamardordhvaśvāsakāsaharo gaṇaḥ
verses.tib: bi da ri sogs 'di snying phan / nyam chung rlung dang mkhris pa sel / lus skem skran tshigs yan lag na / dbugs mi bde dang lud pa lu / sel bar byed pa'i sde tshan yin

verses.skt: śārivośīrakāśmaryamadhūkaśiśiradvayam | yaṣṭī parūṣakaṃ hanti dāhapittāsratṛḍjvarān
verses.tib: thal tres dang ni pu shel tse / tang pa la dang ni ma du ka / tsan+dan dkar dang dmar ba dang / shing mngar pa ru sha ka rnams / tshad pa mkhris pa khrag rgyas dang / skom dang rims kyis btab pa sel

verses.skt: padmakapuṇḍrau vṛddhitugarddhyaḥ śṛṅgy amṛtā daśa jīvanasaṃjñāḥ | stanyakarā ghnantīraṇapittaṃ prīṇanajīvanabṛṃhaṇavṛṣyāḥ
verses.tib: shug pa puN+Da rI ka dang / br-it+ti r-it+ti cu gang dang / sring gi sle tres 'tsho byed bcu / nu zho skyed byed rlung mkhris sel / nyam chung tshim byed brtas byed la / 'tsho byed ro tsa nyid du byed

verses.skt: parūṣakaṃ varā drākṣā kaṭphalaṃ katakāt phalam | rājāhvaṃ dāḍimaṃ śākaṃ tṛṇmūtrāmayavātajit
verses.tib: pa ru sha dang 'bras bu gsum / rgun 'brum dang ni kad pa la / ka ta ka'i 'bras ra dza dan / se'u 'bru ba ra da du rnams / skom dang che dang gcin sri dang / rlung gi nad rnams sel byed yin

verses.skt: añjanaṃ phalinī māṃsī padmotpalarasāñjanam | sailāmadhukanāgāhvaṃ viṣāntardāhapittanut
verses.tib: any+dza na dang pha li ni / spang spos pad+ma ut+pa la / skyer khaN+Da dang sug smel dang / shing mngar nA ga ge sar bcas / dug dang nang gi tsha ba dang

verses.skt: paṭolakaṭurohiṇīcandanaṃ madhusravaguḍūcipāṭhānvitam | nihanti kaphapittakuṣṭhajvarān viṣaṃ vamim arocakaṃ kāmalām
verses.tib: mkhris pa rgyas pa sel bar byed / pa tol dang pu tse shel / tsan+dan dkar po mur ba dang / sle tres skra lor bcas pa dag / bad kan mkhris pa mdze dang rims / dug dang skyug bro yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: guḍūcīpadmakāriṣṭadhānakāraktacandanam | pittaśleṣmajvaracchardidāhatṛṣṇāghnam agnikṛt
verses.tib: sle tres dang ni shug pa dang / nim pa 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / tsan+dan dmar po zhes bya rnams / mkhris pa dang ni bad kan dang / rims dang skyug bro lus tsha dang / skom dad che sel me drod skyed / dong ga dang ni dug mo nyung / ka ka tig ta ba ta li

verses.skt: bhūnimbasairyakapaṭolakarañjayugmasaptacchadāgnisuṣavīphalabāṇaghoṇṭāḥ || 17 || āragvadhādir jayati cchardikuṣṭhaviṣajvarān | kaphaṃ kaṇḍūṃ pramehaṃ ca duṣṭavraṇaviśodhanaḥ
verses.tib: lo ma bdun pa kru trug tres / su Sha byi ta po son cha / sa ha ra tsa zhes bya dang / rgya shug gi ni 'bras bu rnams / de ni slon bro mdze nad dang / dug dang / rims dang bad kan dang / g.yan pa dang ni gcin snyi dang

verses.skt: asanatiniśabhūrjaśvetavāhaprakīryāḥ khadirakadarabhaṇḍīśiṃśipāmeṣaśṛṅgyaḥ | trihimatalapalāśā joṅgakaḥ śākaśālau kramukadhavakaliṅgacchāgakarṇāśvakarṇāḥ
verses.tib: a sa na dang ti ni sha / stag pa shwe ta ba ha dang / ka ta ra dang seng ldeng dang / ban da dang ni shing sha ba / a dza sring ga tsan+dan gsum / ta la a kar pa la sha / sa la kha ra pa tra dang / d+ha ba ka ling ka spro tog

verses.skt: asanādir vijayate śvitrakuṣṭhakaphakrimīn | pāṇḍurogaṃ pramehaṃ ca medodoṣanibarhaṇaḥ
verses.tib: tsha ga karna bad tsha ka / tha ram zhes ni bya ba ste / a san sogs de rnams kyis / sha bkra mdze nad bad kan dang / srin nad skya rbab gcin snyi dang / tsho ches nad ni sel bar byed

verses.skt: varuṇasairyakayugmaśatāvarīdahanamoraṭabilvaviṣāṇikāḥ | dvibṛhatīdvikarañjajayādvayaṃ bahalapallavadarbharujākarāḥ
verses.tib: bar na she rgya ka gnyis / nye shing tsi tra mo ra ta / bil ba any+dza sring gi dang / bri ha ti ni rnam gnyis dang / ka rany+dza gnyis dza ya gnyis / shi kru ku sha ru rta'o

verses.skt: varuṇādiḥ kaphaṃ medo mandāgnitvaṃ niyacchati | āḍhyavātaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ gulmaṃ cāntaḥ savidradhim
verses.tib: ba ra ni sogs bad kan tshil / me drod chung dang rlung nad 'khyims / klad pa la brten nad sel zhing / skran dang khong 'bras 'joms pa yin

verses.skt: ūṣakas tutthakaṃ hiṅgu kāsīsadvayasaindhavam | saśilājatu kṛcchrāśmagulmamedaḥkaphāpaham
verses.tib: rgyam tsha brag zhun nag tshur gnyis / gcin sri rde'us 'gags pa dang / skran dang tshil ches bad kan sel / be+e lan ta ra ar ni / sbra tog bri sha sru sru'i rtsa / i ka ta dang gzem dang / sa ha ra dza ba na dang / ka sha br-ik+Sha da ni dang

verses.skt: vellantarāraṇikabūkavṛṣāśmabhedagokaṇṭaketkaṭasahācarabāṇakāśāḥ | vṛkṣādanīnalakuśadvayaguṇṭhagundrābhallūkamoraṭakuraṇṭakarambhapārthāḥ || 24 || vargo vīratarādyo ’yaṃ hanti vātakṛtān gadān | aśmarīśarkarāmūtrakṛcchrāghātarujāharaḥ
verses.tib: kun+tha dang ni kha sral dang / ba lu ka dang mo ra ta / ku ru ta dang ka ram pa / lcam pa zhes bya'i sman sde 'di / be len ta ra la sogs pa / rlung las gyur pa'i nad 'joms shing / rde'u'i phre'u yod pa dang / gcin sri ba yi nad rnams sel

verses.skt: lodhraśābarakalodhrapalāśā jiṅginīsaralakaṭphalayuktāḥ | kutsitāmbakadalīgataśokāḥ sailavāluparipelavamocāḥ
verses.tib: seng phrom sha ba ra ro tra / pa la sha dang dz+hin dzi ni / thang shing kad pa la ra sna / ka tam pa dang chu shing dang / e la ba lu a shwa ka / pa ri pe la mo tsa ka

verses.skt: eṣa lodhrādiko nāma medaḥkaphaharo gaṇaḥ | yonidoṣaharaḥ stambhī varṇyo viṣavināśanaḥ
verses.tib: 'di ni seng phrom sogs zhes bya / tshil ches bad kan sel ba'i sde / mngal nad 'joms shing 'khru ba gcod / mdog bzang dug nad sel byed yin

verses.skt: arkālarkau nāgadantī viśalyā bhārgī rāsnā vṛścikālī prakīryā | pratyakpuṣpī pītatailodakīryā śvetāyugmaṃ tāpasānāṃ ca vṛkṣaḥ
verses.tib: arka dang ni a ral ka / nA ga dan+ti bi sha l+ye / ga bra ra sna bri shal / a ba marga ka rany+dza / ka kad ri ka rany+dza / gi ri kar gnyis iM gu dang

verses.skt: ayam arkādiko vargaḥ kaphamedoviṣāpahaḥ | kṛmikuṣṭhapraśamano viśeṣād vraṇaśodhanaḥ
verses.tib: arka la sogs sde tshan 'di / bad kan tshil ches dug / rnams sel / srin nad dang ni mdze nad 'joms / khyad par du ni rma la phan

verses.skt: surasayugaphaṇijjaṃ kālamālā viḍaṅgaṃ kharabusavṛṣakarṇīkaṭphalaṃ kāsamardaḥ | kṣavakasarasibhārgīkārmukāḥ kākamācī kulahalaviṣamuṣṭī bhūstṛṇo bhūtakeśī
verses.tib: bye'u rug rnams gnyis ku ther / ka la mal byi dang ga / kha ra pa tra kad pa la / bri sha kar+Ni sha kun ti / ske tshe ka bid tha'i lo ma / ga bra mon sne'u ka mu ka / rkang mar bi sha muSh+Thi dang / bu srin dang 'bam po'o

verses.skt: surasādir gaṇaḥ śleṣmamedaḥkṛminiṣūdanaḥ | pratiśyāyāruciśvāsakāsaghno vraṇaśodhanaḥ
verses.tib: bye'u rug pa la sogs pa'i sde / bad kan tshil ches srin nad sel / cham pa yi ga 'chus lud pa / dbugs mi bde 'joms rma red sbyong

verses.skt: muṣkakasnugvarādvīpipalāśadhavaśiṃśipāḥ | gulmamehāśmarīpāṇḍumedo'rśaḥkaphaśukrajit
verses.tib: muska ka dang snu ha dang / 'bras bu gsum dang tsi tra ka / pa la sha dang d+ha ba dang / shing sha pa zhes bya ba rnams / skran dang gcin nad rde'u chags / skya rbab dang ni tshil ches nad / bad kan rgyas dang khu ba yi / nad rnams sel bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: vatsakamūrvābhārgīkaṭukā marīcaṃ ghuṇapriyā ca gaṇḍīram | elā pāṭhājājī kaṭvaṅgaphalājamodasiddhārthavacāḥ
verses.tib: dug mo nyung dang mur ba dang / bar gi dang ni bu tse shel / na le sham dang bong nga dkar / chu sgog sug smel pa ta dang / nyungs kar zir ur lu / a za mo dang po son cha

verses.skt: jīrakahiṅguviḍaṅgaṃ paśugandhā pañcakolakaṃ hanti | calakaphamedaḥpīnasagulmajvaraśūladurnāmnaḥ
verses.tib: shu dag zi ra nag po dang / shing kun dang ni byi dang ga / pa shu gan+d+ha tsha ba lnga / rlung dang bad kan tshil ches dang / cham pa skran dang rims dang gzer / gzhang 'brum gyi ni nad rnams sel

verses.skt: vacājaladadevāhvanāgarātiviṣābhayāḥ | haridrādvayayaṣṭyāhvakalaśīkuṭajodbhavāḥ
verses.tib: shu dag gla sgang thang shing dang / dong gra bong nga a rur / ser po gnyis dang shing mngar dang / kr-iSh+Na par+Ni dug mo nyung

verses.skt: vacāharidrādigaṇāv āmātīsāranāśanau | medaḥkaphāḍhyapavanastanyadoṣanibarhaṇau
verses.tib: shu dag yung ba la sogs sde / be'u snabs tshad pas 'khru smin gcod / tshil ches bad kan rgyas rlung 'khyil / nu ma'i nad rnams sel bar byed

verses.skt: priyaṅgupuṣpāñjanayugmapadmāḥ padmād rajo yojanavally anantā | mānadrumo mocarasaḥ samaṅgā punnāgaśītaṃ madanīyahetuḥ
verses.tib: pri yang+ku dang ra gan dud / lig bu mig dang stang zil dang / lcim rtsa pad+ma ge sar dang / btsod dang ya ba sha ka dang / shal ma li dang de'i khu ba / sa mang ga dang bun ma / tsan+dan da ta ka'i me tog

verses.skt: ambaṣṭhā madhukaṃ namaskarī nandīvṛkṣapalāśakacchurāḥ | lodhraṃ dhātakibilvapeśike kaṭvaṅgaḥ kamalodbhavaṃ rajaḥ
verses.tib: aM pa sha dang shing mngar dang / na ma ka ra tu ni shing / rgya skyegs shing dang kad tshur / seng phrom bil rkang da ta ki / pad+ma'i ge sar ka tang ka

verses.skt: gaṇau priyaṅgvambaṣṭhādī pakvātīsāranāśanau | saṃdhānīyau hitau pitte vraṇānām api ropaṇau
verses.tib: pri yang aM pas+tha sde gnyis / zhu ba'i tshad pa'i 'khru ba sel / 'byor byed mkhris pa dag la phan / rma yang 'tshob par byed pa yin

verses.skt: mustāvacāgnidviniśādvitiktābhallātapāṭhātriphalāviṣākhyāḥ | kuṣṭhaṃ truṭī haimavatī ca yonistanyāmayaghnā malapācanāś ca
verses.tib: kla sgang shu dag kru trug tres / ser po gnyis dang kha ba / gnyis / go bye pa tha 'bras bu gsum / bong nga dkar nag ru rta dang / sug smel dang ni shu dag rnams / nu zho mngal nad dri ma sel / n+ya gro d+ha dang a shwad+tha

verses.skt: nyagrodhapippalasadāphalalodhrayugmaṃ jambūdvayārjunakapītanasomavalkāḥ | plakṣāmravañjulapiyālapalāśanandīkolīkadambaviralāmadhukaṃ madhūkam || 41 || nyagrodhādir gaṇo vraṇyaḥ saṃgrāhī bhagnasādhanaḥ | medaḥpittāsratṛḍdāhayoniroganibarhaṇaḥ
verses.tib: 'dzam bu gnyis dang ardzu na / ka pi ta dang kad pa la / blag sha a mra lcang ma dang / bi ya la dang pa la sha / nan+ti rgya shug ka dam pa / bir shing mngar ma du ka / n+ya gro d+ha sogs sde tshan 'di / rma 'tsho 'khru gcod chag grugs sbyor

verses.skt: elāyugmaturuṣkakuṣṭhaphalinīmāṃsījaladhyāmakaṃ | spṛkkācorakacocapattratagarasthauṇeyajātīrasāḥ | śuktir vyāghranakho ’marāhvam aguruḥ śrīvāsakaḥ kuṅkumaṃ | caṇḍāgugguludevadhūpakhapurāḥ punnāganāgāhvayam
verses.tib: mngal gyi nad rnams sel bar byed / e la gnyis dang du ru ka / ru rta gan+d+ha bri yang ku / spri ka tso ra tso tsa dang / shing tsha gan+d+ha b+ha dra dang / rgya spos bo la s+the ne ya / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba chu srin sen / thang shing dang ni a ka ru / gur gum shi ri bas ka / tsan+dan gu gul lce pog dkar / bur na ma dang kun du ru / nA ga ge sar zhes bya'o

verses.skt: elādiko vātakaphau viṣaṃ ca viniyacchati | varṇaprasādanaḥ kaṇḍūpiṭikākoṭhanāśanaḥ
verses.tib: e la sogs ste rlung bad kan / dug rnams sel zhing mdog gsal byed / g.yan pa thor bu'i nad rnams dang / sha bkra bas ldag sel bar byed

verses.skt: śyāmādantīdravantīkramukakuṭaraṇāśaṅkhinīcarmasāhvā | svarṇakṣīrīgavākṣīśikharirajanakacchinnarohākarañjāḥ | bastāntrī vyādhighāto bahalabahurasas tīkṣṇavṛkṣāt phalāni | śyāmādyo hanti gulmaṃ viṣamarucikaphau hṛdrujaṃ mūtrakṛcchram
verses.tib: sha ma dan+ti dra ban+ti / ku ta ra na kra mu ka / shaM gi ni dang sa ta la / khron bu dang ni ga bak+Shi / su d+ha k+Shi ra kam+bi l+ye / sle tres dong ga ka rany+dza / baSh+Ta an+t+ra shi kru dang / a mra shing ro tsha'i 'bras bu / dur byid la sogs sde tshan 'di / skran dang dug dang yi ga 'chus / bad kan dang ni snying nad dang / gcin sri ba yi nad rnams 'joms

verses.skt: trayastriṃśad iti proktā vargās teṣu tv alābhataḥ | yuñjyāt tadvidham anyac ca dravyaṃ jahyād ayaugikam
verses.tib: de ltar sum cu rtsa gsum bshad / sde tshan de las ma rnyed na / de dang mtshungs pa gzhan dang sbyar / mi 'dra'i sbyor ba spang bar bya

verses.skt: ete vargā doṣadūṣyādy apekṣya kalkakvāthasnehalehādiyuktāḥ | pāne nasye ’nvāsane ’ntar bahir vā lepābhyaṅgair ghnanti rogān sukṛcchrān
verses.tib: sde tshan de dag gnod dang gnod bya sogs ltos te / cho ga bskol dang snum dang bsdams pa la sogs ldan / btung dang snar gtang mas gtong dang ni phyi rol du / bsku zhing byugs pas shin tu gso dka'i nad kun 'joms

verses.skt: guruśītasarasnigdhamandasūkṣmamṛdudravam | auṣadhaṃ snehanaṃ prāyo viparītaṃ virūkṣaṇam
verses.tib: snum byed sman rnams phal cher ni / lci zhing bsil la khong 'khru snum / rdul dang bral la mnyen zhing brlan / de las bzlog pa rtsub byed yin

verses.skt: sarpir majjā vasā tailaṃ sneheṣu pravaraṃ matam | tatrāpi cottamaṃ sarpiḥ saṃskārasyānuvartanāt
verses.tib: zhun mar rkang dang tshil til mar / snum rnams kyi ni mchog rab 'dod / de dag las kyang zhun mar ni / sbyor rjes su 'jug pas mchog yin no / de dag sngon bzhin mkhris pa sel / phyi ma bzhin du cig shos sel

verses.skt: mādhuryād avidāhitvāj janmādy eva ca śīlanāt | pittaghnās te yathāpūrvam itaraghnā yathottaram
verses.tib: zhun mar rkang dang tshil til mar / snum rnams kyi ni mchog rab 'dod / de dag las kyang zhun mar ni / sbyor rjes su 'jug pas mchog yin no / de dag sngon bzhin mkhris pa sel / phyi ma bzhin du cig shos sel

verses.skt: ghṛtāt tailaṃ guru vasā tailān majjā tato ’pi ca | dvābhyāṃ tribhiś caturbhis tair yamakas trivṛto mahān
verses.tib: mar bas til mar lci de bas / tshil de tshil bas rkang lci'o / de las gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi / zung dang gsum pa che zhes bya

verses.skt: svedyasaṃśodhyamadyastrīvyāyāmāsaktacintakāḥ | vṛddhabālābalakṛśā rūkṣāḥ kṣīṇāsraretasaḥ
verses.tib: dugs bya sbyang bya chang bud med / rtsol chags sems las che ba dang / rgan po byis pa stobs chung spegs / rtsub dang khrag dang khu ba zad

verses.skt: vātārtasyandatimiradāruṇapratibodhinaḥ | snehyā na tv atimandāgnitīkṣṇāgnisthūladurbalāḥ
verses.tib: rlung nad kyis nyen rab rib dang / shin tu dbye dka' la snum bya / shin tu drod chung rab drod che / shin tu sbom dang rid pa dang

verses.skt: ūrustambhātisārāmagalarogagarodaraiḥ | mūrchāchardyaruciśleṣmatṛṣṇāmadyaiś ca pīḍitāḥ
verses.tib: brla rengs tshad 'khru ma zhu dang / lkog nad dbyig dug dmu rdzing dang / brgyal skyugs bad kan yi ga 'chus / skom dad chang nad kyis nyen dang

verses.skt: apaprasūtā yukte ca nasye vastau virecane | tatra dhīsmṛtimedhādikāṅkṣiṇāṃ śasyate ghṛtam
verses.tib: dus min bu skyes sna sman dang / mas gtong bkru sman byas la min / de la blo dran yid gzhungs sogs / 'dod pa rnams la zhun mar bsngags

verses.skt: granthināḍīkṛmiśleṣmamedomārutarogiṣu | tailaṃ lāghavadārḍhyārthikrūrakoṣṭheṣu dehiṣu
verses.tib: rmen bu bad kan srin bu dang / tshil ches rlung nad yod pa dang / lus yang mkhrang 'dod lto srab pa'i / lus can rnams la til mar phan

verses.skt: vātātapādhvabhārastrīvyāyāmakṣīṇadhātuṣu | rūkṣakleśakṣamātyagnivātāvṛtapatheṣu ca
verses.tib: rlung dang nyi tshan lam bud med / khur dang rtsol bas lus zungs zad / rtsub nyon mongs bzod me drod rno

verses.skt: śeṣau vasā tu saṃdhyasthimarmakoṣṭharujāsu ca | tathā dagdhāhatabhraṣṭayonikarṇaśiroruji
verses.tib: rtsa sgo rlung 'gags lhag ma phan / tshigs dang rus pa gnad rnams dang / lto na mes tshig rma byung ltung / mngal dang rna ba glad nad la

verses.skt: tailaṃ prāvṛṣi varṣānte sarpir anyau tu mādhave | ṛtau sādhāraṇe snehaḥ śasto ’hni vimale ravau
verses.tib: til mar dbyar phan zhun mar ni / dbyar mtha' de bzhin dpyid kyang bsngags / thun mong dus la snum rnams ni / nyin mor nyi ma gsal tshe bsngags

verses.skt: tailaṃ tvarāyāṃ śīte ’pi gharme ’pi ca ghṛtaṃ niśi | niśy eva pitte pavane saṃsarge pittavaty api
verses.tib: la dgun yang til mar gtang / tsha ba'i dus su'ang mar tshan gtang / mkhris pa rlung dang mkhris par bcas / ldan pa la yang mtshan mo nyid

verses.skt: niśy anyathā vātakaphād rogāḥ syuḥ pittato divā | yuktyāvacārayet snehaṃ bhakṣyādyannena vastibhiḥ
verses.tib: mtshan mo las gzhan rlung bad kan / nyin par sbyar bas mkhris nad 'gyur / bza' sogs zas

verses.skt: nasyābhyañjanagaṇḍūṣamūrdhakarṇākṣitarpaṇaiḥ | rasabhedaikakatvābhyāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭir vicāraṇāḥ
verses.tib: dang mas gtong dang / sna nas gtang bsku mkhur bkang dgo / mgo bsku rna mig dgang ba yi / snum ni rigs par dpyad par bya / ro yi dbye ba re re yis / drug cu rtsa bzhir rnam par brtags

verses.skt: snehasyānyābhibhūtatvād alpatvāc ca kramāt smṛtāḥ | yathoktahetvabhāvāc ca nācchapeyo vicāraṇā
verses.tib: snum ni gzhan gyis zil gnon zhing / chung ngu dgos pas rim par bshad / ji skad bshad pa'i rgyu med pas / dngas ma btung la dpyad mi dgos
