verses.skt: snehasya kalpaḥ sa śreṣṭhaḥ snehakarmāśusādhanāt | dvābhyāṃ caturbhir aṣṭābhir yāmair jīryanti yāḥ kramāt
verses.tib: snum gyi las ni myur bsgrubs pas / snum de'i cho ga mchog yin no / gang zhig thun ni gnyis dang bzhi / brgyad kyis rim bzhin 'ju 'gyur ba

verses.skt: hrasvamadhyottamā mātrās tās tābhyaś ca hrasīyasīm | kalpayed vīkṣya doṣādīn prāg eva tu hrasīyasīm
verses.tib: tshad chung 'bring dang che ba ste / de las chung ngu bza' ba mchog / nad la sogs pa brtags nas ni / thog mar shin tu chung ngu bza'

verses.skt: hyastane jīrṇa evānne sneho ’cchaḥ śuddhaye bahuḥ | śamanaḥ kṣudvato ’nanno madhyamātraś ca śasyate
verses.tib: snga de'i zas de zhu nyid na / sbyang phyir dngas ma mang du btung / zhi bya ltogs byas zas med par / 'bring tshad tsam ni bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: bṛṃhaṇo rasamadyādyaiḥ sabhakto ’lpo hitaḥ sa ca | bālavṛddhapipāsārtasnehadviṇmadyaśīliṣu
verses.tib: brta ba sha dang sha khu sogs / de yang 'bras chan nyung bcas pa / byis pa rgan po skom gyis gdungs / snum 'gras chang dad che ba dang

verses.skt: strīsnehanityamandāgnisukhitakleśabhīruṣu | mṛdukoṣṭhālpadoṣeṣu kāle coṣṇe kṛśeṣu ca
verses.tib: bud med snum ni rtag bsten dang / drod chung bde dang dka' mi bzod / lto snyi nad dkyel chung tsha dus / nyam chung pa la bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: prāṅmadhyottarabhakto ’sāv adhomadhyordhvadehajān | vyādhīñ jayed balaṃ kuryād aṅgānāṃ ca yathākramam
verses.tib: dang po bar dang zas rjes zos / lus kyi smad bar stod las byung / nad rnams sel zhing lus kyi stobs / bskyed pa'i rim bzhin byed pa yin

verses.skt: vāry uṣṇam acche ’nupibet snehe tat sukhapaktaye | āsyopalepaśuddhyai ca taubarāruṣkare na tu
verses.tib: de ni legs par smin phyir dang / khar chags pa ni phyi ba'i phyir / snum dag 'thungs rjes chu tshan btung / e raN pa la ta kar min

verses.skt: mūrchā dāho ’ratis tṛṣṇā jṛmbhā mohabhramaklamāḥ | bhavanti jīryati snehe jīrṇaḥ syāt taiḥ śamaṃ gataiḥ
jīrṇājīrṇaviśaṅkāyāṃ punar uṣṇodakaṃ pibet | tenodgāraviśuddhiḥ syāt tataś ca laghutā ruciḥ
verses.tib: zhu'am ma zhu'i dogs skyes na / slar yang chu tshan btung bar bya / des ni sgregs pa dag 'gyur zhing / de las khong yang yi gar 'ong

verses.skt: bhojyo ’nnaṃ mātrayā pāsyan śvaḥ piban pītavān api | dravoṣṇam anabhiṣyandi nātisnigdham asaṃkaram
verses.tib: nang par 'thung ngam 'thungs pa dang / 'thungs par gyur tshe kha zas ran / gsher dro bad kan mi skyed dang / shin tu snum min 'dres min bza'

verses.skt: uṣṇodakopacārī syād brahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ | na vegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān
verses.tib: kha lag chu dron gyis bkru zhing / bud med mi bsten mtshan mo nyal / shugs dgag drag shul las rnams dang / khro dang mya ngan nyi tshan grang

verses.skt: pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyātyāsanasaṃsthitīḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhaḥsvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca
verses.tib: ser bu'i khar 'dug rta zhon 'gro / mang smra rab mtho'i stan la 'dug / sngas ni rab mtho rab dma' dang / nyin nyal dud rdul gnas / pa spang

verses.skt: yāny ahāni pibet tāni tāvanty anyāny api tyajet | sarvakarmasv ayaṃ prāyo vyādhikṣīṇeṣu ca kramaḥ
verses.tib: gang gis nyin mo 'thungs gyur pa / de ltar gzhan la'ang spang bar bya / rim 'di las rnams thams cad dang / nad zad pa la spyad par bya

verses.skt: upacāras tu śamane kāryaḥ snehe viriktavat | tryaham acchaṃ mṛdau koṣṭhe krūre saptadinaṃ pibet
verses.tib: zhi ba'i snum gyi nyer spyad ni / bkru sman btang ba lta bur bya / lto snyi zhun mar zhag gsum btung / lto sra ba yis zhag bdun btung

verses.skt: samyaksnigdho ’thavā yāvad ataḥ sātmyībhavet param | vātānulomyaṃ dīpto ’gnir varcaḥ snigdham asaṃhatam
verses.tib: yang na ji srid snum par btung / de phan chad ni goms par 'gyur / rlung ni bder rgyu me drod 'bar / bshang ba snum zhing mi sri la

verses.skt: snehodvegaḥ klamaḥ samyaksnigdhe rūkṣe viparyayaḥ | atisnigdhe tu pāṇḍutvaṃ ghrāṇavaktragudasravāḥ
verses.tib: snum mi 'dod cing snyoms 'gyur pa / snum legs yin te rtsub go bzlog / snum drags pa yis skya ba dang / sna dang kha rkub las 'dzag 'gyur

verses.skt: amātrayāhito ’kāle mithyāhāravihārataḥ | snehaḥ karoti śophārśastandrāstambhavisaṃjñatāḥ
verses.tib: tshad dang mi ldan dus min gnod / zas dang spyod lam log pa yis / snum chos byed skrang gzhang 'brum dang / khong rmya rengs shing sems myos dang

verses.skt: kaṇḍūkuṣṭhajvarotkleśaśūlānāhabhramādikān | kṣuttṛṣṇollekhanasvedarūkṣapānānnabheṣajam
verses.tib: g.yan pa mdze dang rims skyug gzer / lto sbos mgo 'khor la sogs 'gyur / de la bkres skom skyug sman dugs

verses.skt: takrāriṣṭakhaloddālayavaśyāmākakodravāḥ | pippalītriphalākṣaudrapathyāgomūtraguggulu
verses.tib: zas skom sman ni rtsub pa dang / dar ba chang rnying tshod ma dang / 'bru rgod ci tse khre rgod dang / sbrang rtsi 'bras gsum pi pi ling / ba gcin gu gul a ru ra

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ pratirogaṃ ca snehavyāpadi sādhanam | virūkṣaṇe laṅghanavat kṛtātikṛtalakṣaṇam
verses.tib: nad dmigs so so ji bzhin du / snum las nad gyur bcos thabs yin / rtsub pa dag ni smyung byas dang / shin tu byas dang 'dra ba yin

verses.skt: snigdhadravoṣṇadhanvottharasabhuk svedam ācaret | snigdhas tryahaṃ sthitaḥ kuryād virekaṃ vamanaṃ punaḥ
verses.tib: slon dro skams sa las byung snum / sha khu btung zhing dugs dpyad bya / khrus byed pa'am skyug sman gtong / snum byas zhag gsum gnas par bya

verses.skt: ekāhaṃ dinam anyac ca kapham utkleśya tatkaraiḥ | māṃsalā medurā bhūriśleṣmāṇo viṣamāgnayaḥ
verses.tib: nyin zhag gzhan pa gcig cig ni / de bskyed pa yis bad kan skyod / sha che tshil che bad kan mang / me yi 'ju drod mi snyoms dang

verses.skt: snehocitāś ca ye snehyās tān pūrvaṃ rūkṣayet tataḥ | saṃsnehya śodhayed evaṃ snehavyāpan na jāyate
verses.tib: snum la goms pa'i snum bya rnams / de ni sngon du rtsub chos bya / de nas snum byas sbyangs gyur na / de la snum nad mi 'byung ngo

verses.skt: alaṃ malān īrayituṃ snehaś cāsātmyatāṃ gataḥ | bālavṛddhādiṣu snehaparihārāsahiṣṇuṣu
verses.tib: snum la goms par gyur pas na / dri ma 'thon par nus pa yin / byis pa rgan phol sogs pa / snum spang bar ni mi nus la

verses.skt: yogān imān anudvegān sadyaḥsnehān prayojayet | prājyamāṃsarasās teṣu peyā vā snehabharjitā
verses.tib: skye bar mi byed sbyor ba 'dis / 'phral du snum ni sbyar bar bya / de la mar brngos sha khu dang / mar dang brngos pa'i thug pa'am

verses.skt: tilacūrṇaś ca sasnehaphāṇitaḥ kṛśarā tathā | kṣīrapeyā ghṛtāḍhyoṣṇā dadhno vā saguḍaḥ saraḥ
verses.tib: til che snum / bcas bu ram chung / bcas dang kri sar dang ni / 'o thug mar mang dro ba'am / bu ram zho dang bcas pa'am

verses.skt: peyā ca pañcaprasṛtā snehais taṇḍulapañcamaiḥ | saptaite snehanāḥ sadyaḥ snehāś ca lavaṇolbaṇāḥ
verses.tib: thug pa snum ni bzhi pa la / lnga pa 'bras dang ldan par bya / bdun pa de dag 'phral snum bya / snum rnams lan tshwa cher btab pa

verses.skt: tad dhy abhiṣyandy arūkṣaṃ ca sūkṣmam uṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca | guḍānūpāmiṣakṣīratilamāṣasurādadhi
verses.tib: de ni bad kan skyed rtsub min / phra zhing dro la lus khyab byed / mdze dang skran nad gcin snyi la / bu ram bcas bza' 'o ma sha / til dang ma sha chang dang zho / snum bya'i don du mi bya'o / 'bras gsum pi pi ling gu gul / a ru ra la sogs bskol bas

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaśophaprameheṣu snehārthaṃ na prakalpayet | triphalāpippalīpathyāguggulvādivipācitān
verses.tib: de ni bad kan skyed rtsub min / phra zhing dro la lus khyab byed / mdze dang skran nad gcin snyi la / bu ram bcas bza' 'o ma sha / til dang ma sha chang dang zho / snum bya'i don du mi bya'o / 'bras gsum pi pi ling gu gul / a ru ra la sogs bskol bas

verses.skt: snehān yathāsvam eteṣāṃ yojayed avikāriṇaḥ | kṣīṇānāṃ tv āmayair agnidehasaṃdhukṣaṇakṣamān
verses.tib: de dag snum la ji bzhin du / gnod pa med par sbyar bar bya / nad kyis nyam chung gyur pa las / lus drod stobs bskyed nus pa btang

verses.skt: dīptāntarāgniḥ pariśuddhakoṣṭhaḥ pratyagradhātur balavarṇayuktaḥ | dṛḍhendriyo mandajaraḥ śatāyuḥ snehopasevī puruṣaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ
verses.tib: skyes bu snum la brten par byed pa rnams / nang gi drod 'bar khong pa dag pa dang / lus zungs 'phral brta stobs dang mdog bzang ldan / dbang brtan rgas sra lo brgya thub par bshad

verses.skt: svedas tāpopanāhoṣmadravabhedāc caturvidhaḥ | tāpo ’gnitaptavasanaphālahastatalādibhiḥ
verses.tib: dugs bsro bcing dang tha mal pa / chu dugs dbye bas rnam pa bzhi / bsro ba gos dang lcags dang ni / lag mthil la sogs mer bsros bsro

verses.skt: upanāho vacākiṇvaśatāhvādevadārubhiḥ | dhānyaiḥ samastair gandhaiś ca rāsnairaṇḍajaṭāmiṣaiḥ
verses.tib: bcing ba shu dag sbang ma dang / thang shing sha ta put+pa dang / 'bru kun dri rnams ra sna dang / e raN+Da'i rtsa shu dag dang

verses.skt: udriktalavaṇaiḥ snehacukratakrapayaḥplutaiḥ | kevale pavane śleṣmasaṃsṛṣṭe surasādibhiḥ
verses.tib: snum bag tsha dang dar ba dang / 'o mas sbrus shing tsha cher btab / rlung lus byung ba 'ba' zhig sel / bad kan 'dres la bye'u rug sogs

verses.skt: pittena padmakādyais tu śālvaṇākhyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | snigdhoṣṇavīryair mṛdubhiś carmapaṭṭair apūtibhiḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa 'dres la shug sogs kyis / glan pa zhes bya yang dang yang / dkri ba snum zhing nus pa dro / spu 'jam lpags rul min pas dkri

verses.skt: alābhe vātajit pattrakauśeyāvikaśāṭakaiḥ | baddhaṃ rātrau divā muñcen muñced rātrau divākṛtam
verses.tib: ma rnyed rlung 'joms lo ma dang / dar dang snam bu ras kyis dkri / mtshan mo dkris pa nyin par dgrol / nyin par dkris pa mtshan mo dgrol / tha mal pa ni khur ba dang / bong ba gyo mo rdo sa phye / gso ma'i lo ma 'bru rnams dang / lci ril phye ma phub ma rnams

verses.skt: ūṣmā tūtkārikāloṣṭakapālopalapāṃsubhiḥ | pattrabhaṅgena dhānyena karīṣasikatātuṣaiḥ
verses.tib: ma rnyed rlung 'joms lo ma dang / dar dang snam bu ras kyis dkri / mtshan mo dkris pa nyin par dgrol / nyin par dkris pa mtshan mo dgrol / tha mal pa ni khur ba dang / bong ba gyo mo rdo sa phye / gso ma'i lo ma 'bru rnams dang / lci ril phye ma phub ma rnams

verses.skt: anekopāyasaṃtaptaiḥ prayojyo deśakālataḥ | śigruvāraṇakairaṇḍakarañjasurasārjakāt
verses.tib: thabs rnams du mas legs bsros pa / yul dang dus las dpags / te sbyar / chu dugs shi kru ba ra na / e raN+Da dang ka rany+dza

verses.skt: śirīṣavāsāvaṃśārkamālatīdīrghavṛntataḥ | pattrabhaṅgair vacādyaiś ca māṃsaiś cānūpavārijaiḥ
verses.tib: byi'u rug pa dang ardza ka / shi ri sha dang ba sha ka / 'od ma arka ma la ti / ya ba sha ka'i lo ma bkru

verses.skt: daśamūlena ca pṛthak sahitair vā yathāmalam | snehavadbhiḥ surāśuktavārikṣīrādisādhitaiḥ
verses.tib: shu dag la sogs sman rnams dang / gsher sa chur gnas sha rnams dang / rtsa bcu nad dmigs ji bzhin du / so so'am lhan cig sbyar nas ni / snum ldan chang dang tsha dang ni / 'o ma chu sogs kyis btsos la

verses.skt: kumbhīr galantīr nāḍīr vā pūrayitvā rujārditam | vāsasācchāditaṃ gātraṃ snigdhaṃ siñced yathāsukham
verses.tib: bum pa'am sbu gu ring po ni / bkang la nad kyis nyam thag pa'i / lus ni gos kyis dkris nas su / ci bde bar ni snum chu blugs

verses.skt: tair eva vā dravaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ sarvāṅgage ’nile | avagāhyāturas tiṣṭhed arśaḥkṛcchrādirukṣu ca
verses.tib: lus la rlung nad zhugs gyur pa / de nyid kyis 'dir bkang snod du / nad pa zhugs te gnas na ni / gcin sri gzhang 'brum sogs nad sel

verses.skt: nivāte ’ntarbahiḥsnigdho jīrṇānnaḥ svedam ācaret | vyādhivyādhitadeśartuvaśān madhyavarāvaram
verses.tib: rlung med phyi nang snum bcas shing / zas 'ju'i dus su dugs dpyad bya / nad dang nad pa yul dus kyi / dbang las chung 'bring chen po bya

verses.skt: kaphārto rūkṣaṇaṃ rūkṣo rūkṣaḥ snigdhaṃ kaphānile | āmāśayagate vāyau kaphe pakvāśayāśrite
verses.tib: bad kan gyis nyin rtsub dugs bya / bad kan rlung la rtsub snum bya / rlung ni ma zhu'i gnas zhugs dang / bad kan zhu ba'i gnas brten la

verses.skt: rūkṣapūrvaṃ tathā snehapūrvaṃ sthānānurodhataḥ | alpaṃ vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ svalpaṃ dṛṅmuṣkahṛdaye na vā
verses.tib: gnas kyi dbang gis rtsub dugs dang / de bzhin snum sngar 'gro dugs bya / sta zur dag dang mig dang snying / rlig par nyung ngu'am bya ba min

verses.skt: śītaśūlakṣaye svinno jāte ’ṅgānāṃ ca mārdave | syāc chanair mṛditaḥ snātas tataḥ snehavidhiṃ bhajet
verses.tib: dugs kyis grang dang zug gzer bral / yan lag mnyen par gyur pa dang / dal gyis mnyes la khrus byas la / de nas snum gyi cho ga bsten

verses.skt: pittāsrakopatṛṇmūrchāsvarāṅgasadanabhramāḥ | saṃdhipīḍā jvaraḥ śyāvaraktamaṇḍaladarśanam
verses.tib: dugs drags pa yis khrag mkhris 'khrugs / skom brgyal skad 'gags yan lag 'jums / mgo 'khor tshigs na rims 'debs shing / tshi gu dmar po tal til snang

verses.skt: svedātiyogāc chardiś ca tatra stambhanam auṣadham | viṣakṣārāgnyatīsāracchardimohātureṣu ca
verses.tib: lums kyis skyugs bro bar 'gyur te / der ni zhi bya'i sman gyis gso / dugs dang thal sman me btsa' dang / tshad 'khru skyugs bro brgyal nad gso

verses.skt: svedanaṃ guru tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ prāyaḥ stambhanam anyathā | dravasthirasarasnigdharūkṣasūkṣmaṃ ca bheṣajam
verses.tib: dugs ni phal cher lci dro rno / de las gzhan pa zhi byed yin / gsher zhing brtan 'khru snum pa dang / rtsub cing sra ba dugs sman yin

verses.skt: svedanaṃ stambhanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ rūkṣasūkṣmasaradravam | prāyas tiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ ca madhuraṃ ca samāsataḥ
verses.tib: 'jam dang rtsub dang zhi 'byar bag / gsher bag de ni sel byed yin / mdor na phal cher kha ba dang / bska dang mngar ba de sman yin

verses.skt: stambhitaḥ syād bale labdhe yathoktāmayasaṃkṣayāt | stambhatvaksnāyusaṃkocakampahṛdvāgghanugrahaiḥ
verses.tib: zhi zhing rtse bcil stobs thob 'gyur / ji skad bshad pa'i nad rnams zad / bcil drags pags pa rtsa 'khums shing / 'dar snying kha 'gram nad du 'gyur

verses.skt: pādauṣṭhatvakkaraiḥ śyāvair atistambhitam ādiśet | na svedayed atisthūlarūkṣadurbalamūrchitān
verses.tib: rkang mchu lag pa pags nag 'gyur / bcil drags pa yi nad du bshad / shin tu spom dang rtsub pa dang

verses.skt: stambhanīyakṣatakṣīṇakṣāmamadyavikāriṇaḥ | timirodaravīsarpakuṣṭhaśoṣāḍhyarogiṇaḥ
verses.tib: nyam chung brgyal bar gyur pa dang / dugs drags bcos dgos glo rdol dang / skem dang chang nad kyis btab dang / rab rib dmu rdzing shu ba mched

verses.skt: pītadugdhadadhisnehamadhūn kṛtavirecanān | bhraṣṭadagdhagudaglānikrodhaśokabhayārditān
verses.tib: mdze nad 'or nad rlung mkhris dang / 'o ma zho dang mar sbrang rtsi / 'thungs dang bkru sman btang ba dang / lus nad tshigs dang gzhang nad yod / khro dang mya ngan 'jigs pas nyen

verses.skt: kṣuttṛṣṇākāmalāpāṇḍumehinaḥ pittapīḍitān | garbhiṇīṃ puṣpitāṃ sūtāṃ mṛdu cātyayike gade
verses.tib: bkres skom mig ser skya rbab dang / gcin nad mkhris nad zla mtshan 'dzag / sbrum dang bu skyes dugs mi bya / nad tshabs che na 'jam por bya

verses.skt: śvāsakāsapratiśyāyahidhmādhmānavibandhiṣu | svarabhedānilavyādhiśleṣmāmastambhagaurave
verses.tib: lud pa cham pa dbugs mi bde / skyigs bu lto spos bshang 'gags dang / skad 'gags rlung gi nad rnams dang / bad kan be snabs 'khyil zhing lci

verses.skt: aṅgamardakaṭīpārśvapṛṣṭhakukṣihanugrahe | mahattve muṣkayoḥ khalyām āyāme vātakaṇṭake
verses.tib: lus rengs rked pa rtsib logs dang / sgur dang lto nad 'gram nad dang / rlig nad skrangs dang da rgan dang / rtsol dang rlung nad kyis zug dang

verses.skt: mūtrakṛcchrārbudagranthiśukrāghātāḍhyamārute | svedaṃ yathāyathaṃ kuryāt tadauṣadhavibhāgataḥ
verses.tib: gcin 'gags thor bu rmen bu dang / khu ba bkag dang rlung 'khyims la / de yi sman gyi dbye ba yis / dugs ni so so ji bzhin bya

verses.skt: svedo hitas tv anāgneyo vāte medaḥkaphāvṛte | nivātaṃ gṛham āyāso guruprāvaraṇaṃ bhayam
verses.tib: dugs phan me yis bsro min pa / rlung nad tshil dang bad kan can / rlung med khang par rtsol ba dang / gos lci ba dang 'jigs pa dang

verses.skt: upanāhāhavakrodhā bhūripānaṃ kṣudhātapaḥ
verses.tib: dkri dang stobs 'gyed khro ba dang / chang mang bkres dang nyi tshan bzhag

verses.skt: svedayanti daśaitāni naram agniguṇād ṛte

verses.tib: nad gang nad khrol gnas pa'i lus zungs gnas / rtsar song rkang lag rus pa'i nang song ba'i / nad de dugs kyis bsrung bar byas nas ni / khong du bsdus la sbyang bas dpyis dbyung bya

verses.skt: kaphe vidadhyād vamanaṃ saṃyoge vā kapholbaṇe | tadvad virecanaṃ pitte viśeṣeṇa tu vāmayet
verses.tib: bad kan nad dam 'dres pa yi / bad kan rgyas la skyugs sman gtang / de bzhin mkhris pa bkru sman bya / rims / sar tshad 'khru thur du ni

verses.skt: navajvarātisārādhaḥpittāsṛgrājayakṣmiṇaḥ | kuṣṭhamehāpacīgranthiślīpadonmādakāsinaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa khrag 'khru glo gcong dang / mdze dang gcin nad 'brum thor bu / rkang bam mi dran lud pa can

verses.skt: śvāsahṛllāsavīsarpastanyadoṣordhvarogiṇaḥ | avāmyā garbhiṇī rūkṣaḥ kṣudhito nityaduḥkhitaḥ
verses.tib: dbugs mi bde snying 'phar 'bras mched / nu ma'i nad dang ro stod nad / khyad par du ni skyug sman bya / skyug sman mi gtong sbrum khong rtsub / bkres dang rtag tu sdug bsngal ba

verses.skt: bālavṛddhakṛśasthūlahṛdrogikṣatadurbalāḥ | prasaktavamathuplīhatimirakṛmikoṣṭhinaḥ
verses.tib: byis pa rgan skem sbom snying na / glo skam smras dang nyam chung dang / rtag tu slon dang mcher pa na / rab rib lto na srin bu yod

verses.tib: rlung khrag 'dren mar gyen du 'byung / so nams gtong skad 'dzer dang / gcin sri dmu rdzing skran can dang / slon dka' drod che gzhang 'brum can

verses.skt: udāvartabhramāṣṭhīlāpārśvarugvātarogiṇaḥ | ṛte viṣagarājīrṇaviruddhābhyavahārataḥ
verses.tib: rtug skam mgo 'khor rtsib logs sra / rtsib logs zug dang rlung can no / de dag dug 'thungs ma zhu dang / mi 'phrod zas zos ma gtogs so

verses.skt: prasaktavamathoḥ pūrve prāyeṇāmajvaro ’pi ca | dhūmāntaiḥ karmabhir varjyāḥ sarvair eva tv ajīrṇinaḥ
verses.tib: rtag tu slon pa yan chad dang / phal cher ma zhu'i rims dag dang / ma zhu ba ni thams cad la'ang / dud pas bdug pa'i las kun spangs

verses.skt: virekasādhyā gulmārśovisphoṭavyaṅgakāmalāḥ | jīrṇajvarodaragaracchardiplīhahalīmakāḥ
verses.tib: bkru sman gyis gso skran gzhang 'brum / 'brum bu mig ser gzhogs phyed lci / rims rnying dmu rdzing dbyig dug dang / skyugs dang mcher nad skya rbab dang

verses.skt: vidradhis timiraṃ kācaḥ syandaḥ pakvāśayavyathā | yoniśukrāśrayā rogāḥ koṣṭhagāḥ kṛmayo vraṇāḥ
verses.tib: long nad rab rib sngon por gyur / mchi 'dzag zhu ba'i gnas na zug / mngal dang khu ba'i gnas kyi nad / khong nad gtogs dang srin nad rma

verses.skt: vātāsram ūrdhvagaṃ raktaṃ mūtrāghātaḥ śakṛdgrahaḥ | vāmyaś ca kuṣṭhamehādyā na tu recyā navajvarī
verses.tib: dreg nad nam tshong yan chad nad / gcin sri bshang ba 'gags pa dang / slon bya mdze gcin nad sogs yin / khrus mi bya ba rims gsar dang

verses.skt: alpāgnyadhogapittāsrakṣatapāyvatisāriṇaḥ | saśalyāsthāpitakrūrakoṣṭhātisnigdhaśoṣiṇaḥ
verses.tib: drod chung khrag mkhris thur du 'byung / rmas dang gzhang nad tshad pas 'khru / khong du mtshon lus lto sra dang / snum ches pa dang skem ches pa'o

verses.skt: atha sādhāraṇe kāle snigdhasvinnaṃ yathāvidhi | śvovamyam utkliṣṭakaphaṃ matsyamāṣatilādibhiḥ
verses.tib: de nas thun mong dus su ni / cho ga bzhin du snum gyis nyen / nya dang ma sha til sogs kyis / nang par slon bya'i bad kan skyed

verses.skt: niśāṃ suptaṃ sujīrṇānnaṃ pūrvāhṇe kṛtamaṅgalam | nirannam īṣatsnigdhaṃ vā peyayā pītasarpiṣam
verses.tib: mtshan mo gnyid log zas legs zhu / snga dro'i dang por bkra shis byas / zas ma zos pa'am cung zad snum / thug pa zhun mar ldan par btung

verses.skt: vṛddhabālābalaklībabhīrūn rogānurodhataḥ | ākaṇṭhaṃ pāyitān madyaṃ kṣīram ikṣurasaṃ rasam
verses.tib: byis pa rgan po nyams stobs chung / sman stobs chung ba nad dbang las / chang 'o bu ram / shing sha khu / nad dmigs ji skad bshad pa bzhin

verses.skt: yathāvikāravihitāṃ madhusaindhavasaṃyutām | koṣṭhaṃ vibhajya bhaiṣajyamātrāṃ mantrābhimantritām
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha dang ldan pa / sman tshad lto ba las dpags te / sman la sngags ni mngon bzlas la

verses.skt: brahmadakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkānilānalāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ sauṣadhigrāmā bhūtasaṃghāś ca pāntu vaḥ
verses.tib: tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag dang tha skar bu / drag po dbang po nyi zla sa me rlung / drang srong rnams kyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang / 'byung po'i tshogs kyis khyed ni bsrung bar shog

verses.skt: rasāyanam ivarṣīṇām amarāṇām ivāmṛtam | sudhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyam idam astu te
verses.tib: drang srong rnams kyi bcud kyis len pa dang / lha rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi lta bu dang / klu mchog rnams kyi bdud rtsi lta bur ni / khyod la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig

verses.skt: namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyagurave vaiḍūryaprabharājāya
verses.tib: oM na mo b+ha ga ba te / b+hai Sha dz+ya gu ru bai DUr+ya pra b+ha rA dzA ya

verses.skt: tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya
verses.tib: ta thA ga tA ya

verses.skt: tad yathā
verses.tib: arta te

verses.skt: bhaiṣajye bhaiṣajye mahābhaiṣajye samudgate svāhā
verses.tib: saM myag saM bud+d+hA ya / tad+ya thA / oM b+haiSha dz+ye b+hai Sha dz+ye ma hA b+hai Sha dz+ye / rA dza sa mung+ga te swAhA

verses.skt: prāṅmukhaṃ pāyayet pīto muhūrtam anupālayet | tanmanā jātahṛllāsaprasekaś chardayet tataḥ
verses.tib: shar du kha bstan 'thung du bzhug / 'thungs nas de la sems dmigs te / yud tsam bsdad la dang gar 'khyil / mchil ma de nas slon du gzhug

verses.skt: aṅgulībhyām anāyasto nālena mṛdunāthavā | galatālv arujan vegān apravṛttān pravartayan
verses.tib: ma gnod par ni sor mos sam / yang na chu ba 'jam po yis / lkog ma lce'u chung ma snang bya / skyug mi bro bar mi drang ngo

verses.skt: pravartayan pravṛttāṃś ca jānutulyāsane sthitaḥ | ubhe pārśve lalāṭaṃ ca vamataś cāsya dhārayet
verses.tib: 'byung bar bzlog pa slon par bya / pus mo dang mnyam stan la gnas / de ni slon tshe glo gnyis dang / 'phral ba dag nas brten par bya

verses.skt: prapīḍayet tathā nābhiṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ ca pratilomataḥ | kaphe tīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭukaiḥ pitte svāduhimair iti
verses.tib: de bzhin lte ba btsir ba dang / rgyab nas gyen du mnye bar bya / de ltar bad kan rno drod kha / mkhris pa mngar dang bsil bas slon

verses.skt: vamet snigdhāmlalavaṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭe marutā kaphe | pittasya darśanaṃ yāvac chedo vā śleṣmaṇo bhavet
verses.tib: rlung 'dres bad kan snum pa dang / skyur dang lan tshwa dag gis slon / ji srid bad kan rgyun chad pa'am / mkhris pa snang gi bar du skyugs

verses.skt: hīnavegaḥ kaṇādhātrīsiddhārthalavaṇodakaiḥ | vamet punaḥ punas tatra vegānām apravartanam
verses.tib: shugs dal pi pi ling skyu ru / yungs kar rgyam tsha chu dag gis / yang dang yang ni slon du gzhug / de ni slon par ma gyur pa'am

verses.skt: pravṛttiḥ savibandhā vā kevalasyauṣadhasya vā | ayogas tena niṣṭhīvakaṇḍūkoṭhajvarādayaḥ
verses.tib: sdod pa dang bcas slon pa'am / sman ni 'ba' zhig byung gyur na / sbyor nyes de ni mchil ma mang / g.yan pa thor pu rims sogs 'byung

verses.skt: nirvibandhaṃ pravartante kaphapittānilāḥ kramāt | samyagyoge ’tiyoge tu phenacandrakaraktavat
verses.tib: bder skyugs bad kan mkhris pa dang / rlung ni rim gyis 'byung bar 'gyur / sbyor ba legs yin sbyor drags pas / dbu ba tshon can khrag 'drar snang

verses.skt: manaḥprasādaḥ svāsthyaṃ cāvasthānaṃ ca svayaṃ bhavet | vaiparītyam ayogānāṃ na cātimahatī vyathā
vamitaṃ kṣāmatā dāhaḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣas tamo bhramaḥ | ghorā vāyvāmayā mṛtyur jīvaśoṇitanirgamāt
verses.tib: slon nas khong rmya lus tsha dang / lkog / skam mgo 'khor mig mi mthong / rlung nad mi bzad ldan gyur zhing / srog gi khrag 'byung 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: samyagyogena vamitaṃ kṣaṇam āśvāsya pāyayet | dhūmatrayasyānyatamaṃ snehācāram athādiśet
verses.tib: sbyor ba legs pas slon na ni / yud tsam ngal gso dud pa gsum / gang yang rung bas bdugs pa dang / de'i 'og snum gyi spyod pa bstan

verses.skt: tataḥ sāyaṃ prabhāte vā kṣudvān snātaḥ sukhāmbunā | bhuñjāno raktaśālyannaṃ bhajet peyādikaṃ kramam
verses.tib: de nas dgongs ka'am nang par ni / bkres tshe chu dron gyis bkru la / sA lu rtsa snar 'bras kyi ni / thug pa la sogs rim bzhin bsten

verses.skt: peyāṃ vilepīm akṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīn ubhayaṃ tathaikam | krameṇa seveta naro ’nnakālān pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ
verses.tib: thug pa gar g.yos ma byas pa'i / khu ba sha khu gsum dang gnyis dang gcig / mchog dang bar ma tha ma'i sbyong bas sbyang / mi yis zas kyi dus su rim bzhin spyad

verses.skt: yathāṇur agnis tṛṇagomayādyaiḥ saṃdhukṣyamāṇo bhavati krameṇa | mahān sthiraḥ sarvapacas tathaiva śuddhasya peyādibhir antarāgniḥ
verses.tib: dper na me chu rtswa dang lci sogs kyis / rnam par sbar na rim gyis mched pa na / che zhing brtan la thams cad mched par nus / sbyangs pa'i nang me thug sogs kyis de bzhin

verses.skt: jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegāś catvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍ aṣṭau | daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthas tathā syād dvicaturguṇaś ca
verses.tib: slon tshad chung dang 'bring dang chen po ni / bzhi dang drug dang lan brgyad slon par 'dod / de nyid bcu dang nyis ldab sum ldab 'khru / bre gang de bzhin nyis ldab bzhi ldab 'gyur

verses.skt: pittāvasānaṃ vamanaṃ virekād ardhaṃ kaphāntaṃ ca virekam āhuḥ | dvitrān saviṭkān apanīya vegān meyaṃ vireke vamane tu pītam
verses.tib: skyug sman mthar mkhris bkru sman las byed dang / bad kan mthar dbyung 'khru ba mchog tu bshad / 'khru ba gnyis gsum bshang dang bcas ma gtogs / 'khru ba gzhal te slon la 'thungs ma gtogs

verses.skt: athainaṃ vāmitaṃ bhūyaḥ snehasvedopapāditam | śleṣmakāle gate jñātvā koṣṭhaṃ samyag virecayet
verses.tib: de nas slon pa de la ni / slar yang snum dang dugs byas te / bad kan dus 'das lto shes nas / legs par bkru sman gtang bar bya

verses.skt: bahupitto mṛduḥ koṣṭhaḥ kṣīreṇāpi viricyate | prabhūtamārutaḥ krūraḥ kṛcchrāc chyāmādikair api
verses.tib: mkhris pa mang zhing lto snyi la / 'o mas byang ni bkru bar byed / rlung shas che shing lto sra na / dur byid sogs kyis kyang bkru dka'

verses.skt: kaṣāyamadhuraiḥ pitte virekaḥ kaṭukaiḥ kaphe | snigdhoṣṇalavaṇair vāyāv apravṛttau tu pāyayet
verses.tib: bkru sman mkhris la mngar dang bska / bad kan la ni kha bas bya / rlung la snum bro lan tshwa can / mi 'khrun ni chu tshan blud

verses.skt: uṣṇāmbu svedayed asya pāṇitāpena codaram | utthāne ’lpe dine tasmin bhuktvānyedyuḥ punaḥ pibet
verses.tib: lag pa bsros pas de yi ni / lto ba legs par dugs bya'o / ma 'khrus de zhag ldang zas zos / nyi ma gnyis par slar yang btung

verses.skt: adṛḍhasnehakoṣṭhas tu pibed ūrdhvaṃ daśāhataḥ | bhūyo ’py upaskṛtatanuḥ snehasvedair virecanam
verses.tib: lto ba rab sra snum dag ni / zhag bcu'i bar du yang btung bas / slar yang snum dang dugs kyis ni / lus sbyangs nas ni bkru sman gyis

verses.skt: yaugikaṃ samyag ālocya smaran pūrvam atikramam | hṛtkukṣyaśuddhir arucir utkleśaḥ śleṣmapittayoḥ
verses.tib: sbyor ba legs par brtags pa dang / sngar / gyi nyes pa dran par bya / snying dang lto na yi ga 'chus / bad kan mkhris pa glongs pa dang

verses.skt: kaṇḍūvidāhaḥ piṭikāh pīnaso vātaviḍgrahaḥ | ayogalakṣaṇaṃ yogo vaiparītye yathoditāt
verses.tib: g.yan pa lus tsha thor bu dang / cham pas 'debs shing bshang rlung 'gags / sbyor ba nyes pa'i mtshan nyid yin / sbyor legs ji skad bshad go bzlog

verses.skt: viṭpittakaphavāteṣu niḥsṛteṣu kramāt sravet | niḥśleṣmapittam udakaṃ śvetaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ salohitam
verses.tib: bshang ba mkhris pa bad kan rlung / rim gyis 'khru zhing 'byung ba na / bad kan mkhris pa med chu 'khru / skya zhing rnag dang khrag dang bcas

verses.skt: māṃsadhāvanatulyaṃ vā medaḥkhaṇḍābham eva vā | gudaniḥsaraṇaṃ tṛṣṇā bhramo netrapraveśanam
verses.tib: yang na sha bkrus lta bu'am / tshil gyi dum bu 'dra nyid dam / gzhang 'byung skom dad che ba dang / mgo 'khor mig ni phugs su bros

verses.skt: bhavanty ativiriktasya tathātivamanāmayāḥ | samyagviriktam enaṃ ca vamanoktena yojayet
verses.tib: bkru sman drags pas 'byung ba yin / de bzhin skyug sman drags nad 'byung / legs par 'khrus pa de la ni

verses.skt: dhūmavarjyena vidhinā tato vamitavān iva | krameṇānnāni bhuñjāno bhajet prakṛtibhojanam
verses.tib: dud pas bdug pa ma gtogs pa'i / cho ga skyug sman dang mtshungs pas / de nas slon dang 'dra bar bya / zas la rim gyis spyad nas ni / de 'og nar ma'i kha zas bsten

verses.skt: mandavahnim asaṃśuddham akṣāmaṃ doṣadurbalam | adṛṣṭajīrṇaliṅgaṃ ca laṅghayet pītabheṣajam
verses.tib: sman 'thungs me drod chung ba dang / ma dag nad kyis rmya ba dang / zhu ba'i mtshan ma ma mthong na / de ni nyin par smyung byas la

verses.skt: snehasvedauṣadhotkleśasaṅgair iti na bādhyate | saṃśodhanāsravisrāvasnehayojanalaṅghanaiḥ
verses.tib: snum dang dugs dang sman rnams kyis / glongs pa'i nad kyis nyen mi 'gyur / sbyangs dang khrag ni 'byung ba dang / snum mchog la sbyar smyung ba yis

verses.skt: yāty agnir mandatāṃ tasmāt kramaṃ peyādim ācaret | srutālpapittaśleṣmāṇaṃ madyapaṃ vātapaittikam
verses.tib: me drod zhan pa nyid 'gyur te / de bas thug sogs rim gyis spyad / bad kan mkhris pa bri zhing chung / chang 'thungs rlung dang mkhris pa che

verses.skt: peyāṃ na pāyayet teṣāṃ tarpaṇādikramo hitaḥ | apakvaṃ vamanaṃ dośān pacyamānaṃ virecanam
verses.tib: de la thug pa mi blud kyi / brta ba la sogs rim pa phan / skyug sman ma zhu bar nad 'byin / bkru sman zhu nas 'byin pa yin

verses.skt: nirhared vamanasyātaḥ pākaṃ na pratipālayet | durbalo bahudoṣaś ca doṣapākena yaḥ svayam
verses.tib: zhu ba la ni bsdad mi dgos / steng dang 'og tu 'byung rigs pas / gang tshe phyin ci log gyur na / de tshe skyugs la rkang par ni / chu dron dag gis blugs par bya / lus kyi stod ni chu grang blugs / 'khru ba la ni de las bzlog / gang zhig nyam chung nad mang dang

verses.skt: viricyate bhedanīyair bhojyais tam upapādayet | durbalaḥ śodhitaḥ pūrvam alpadoṣaḥ kṛśo naraḥ
verses.tib: 'khru bar byed la 'khru ba ni / kha zas byin la der 'khrur gzhug / sngar sbyangs pas ni nyam chung dang / nad kyi dkyel chung lus zad mi

verses.skt: aparijñātakoṣṭhaś ca piben mṛdv alpam auṣadham | varaṃ tad asakṛtpītam anyathā saṃśayāvaham
verses.tib: snyi mi shes la / sman ni 'jam zhing chung ngu blud / de mang 'thungs pa mchog yin gyi / gzhan du dgos pa bcas mi rung / nyam chung pa yi nad mang po / g.yos gyur cung zad cung zad cig / sman ni 'jam pos lan mang zhig / de ni nyung 'gyur zhi bar bya

verses.skt: hared bahūṃś calān doṣān alpān alpān punaḥ punaḥ | durbalasya mṛdudravyair alpān saṃśamayet tu tān
verses.tib: snyi mi shes la / sman ni 'jam zhing chung ngu blud / de mang 'thungs pa mchog yin gyi / gzhan du dgos pa bcas mi rung / nyam chung pa yi nad mang po / g.yos gyur cung zad cung zad cig / sman ni 'jam pos lan mang zhig / de ni nyung 'gyur zhi bar bya

verses.skt: kleśayanti ciraṃ te hi hanyur vainam anirhṛtāḥ | mandāgniṃ krūrakoṣṭhaṃ ca sakṣāralavaṇair ghṛtaiḥ
verses.tib: ma btsal de ni yun ring du / nyon mongs pa'am gsod par 'gyur / me drod chung dang lto sra la / thal sman rgyam tsha mar bcas pas

verses.skt: saṃdhukṣitāgniṃ vijitakaphavātaṃ ca śodhayet | rūkṣabahvanilakrūrakoṣṭhavyāyāmaśīlinām
verses.tib: me yi drod ni bskyed nas su / rlung dang bad kan bsal bar bya / rtsub cing rlung mang lto sra dang / rtag tu rtsol ba'i tshul can dang

verses.skt: dīptāgnīnāṃ ca bhaiṣajyam avirecyaiva jīryati | tebhyo vastiṃ purā dadyāt tataḥ snigdhaṃ virecanam
verses.tib: me drod rab tu che la sman / mi 'khru bar ni zhu bar 'gyur / de la sngar ni 'jam rtsi btang / de nas snum pa'i bkru sman bya

verses.skt: śakṛn nirhṛtya vā kiñcit tīkṣṇābhiḥ phalavartibhiḥ | pravṛttaṃ hi malaṃ snigdho vireko nirharet sukham
verses.tib: sman ni rnon po'i reng bu yis / bshang ba cung zad dbyung bar bya / dri ma legs par 'khrus nas ni / snum 'khru bde bar 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: viṣābhighātapiṭikākuṣṭhaśophavisarpiṇaḥ | kāmalāpāṇḍumehārtān nātisnigdhān viśodhayet
verses.tib: dug gis phog na thor bu 'byung / mdze dang 'or nad me dpal dang / mig ser skya rbab za khus nyen / ha cang snum ches sbyang mi bya

verses.skt: sarvān snehavirekaiś ca rūkṣais tu snehabhāvitān | karmaṇāṃ vamanādīnāṃ punar apy antare ’ntare
verses.tib: kun la bkru sman snum bag gtang / snum gyis zhen la rtsub pa gtang / skyug sman la sogs las rnams la / slar yang bar skabs bar skabs su

verses.skt: snehasvedau prayuñjīta sneham ante balāya ca | malo hi dehād utkleśya hriyate vāsaso yathā
verses.tib: snum dang dugs kyi cho ga bya / snum rjes la ni stobs bskyed bya / lus las nad rnams bsal ba na / gos kyi dri ma 'khru dang mtshungs / snum dang dugs dag ma byas par / gang zhig sbyang ba'i las byed pa

verses.skt: snehasvedais tathotkliṣṭaḥ śodhyate śodhanair malaḥ | snehasvedāv anabhyasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tu yaḥ
verses.tib: snum dang dugs kyi cho ga bya / snum rjes la ni stobs bskyed bya / lus las nad rnams bsal ba na / gos kyi dri ma 'khru dang mtshungs / snum dang dugs dag ma byas par / gang zhig sbyang ba'i las byed pa

verses.skt: dāru śuṣkam ivānāme śarīraṃ tasya dīryate
verses.tib: shing skam 'gugs par byed pa ltar / de yi lus ni ma rungs 'gyur

verses.skt: buddhiprasādaṃ balam indriyāṇāṃ dhātusthiratvaṃ jvalanasya dīptim | cirāc ca pākaṃ vayasaḥ karoti saṃśodhanaṃ samyagupāsyamānam
verses.tib: sbyang ba legs par nye bar bstan pas ni / blo gros gsal zhing dbang po stobs dang ldan / lus zungs brtan zhing khong pa'i me drod 'bar / na tshod dag kyang ring du 'jog par byed

verses.skt: vātolbaṇeṣu doṣeṣu vāte vā vastir iṣyate | upakramāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ so ’graṇīs trividhas tu saḥ
verses.tib: rlung shas che ba'i nad rnams sam / rlung la mas gtong bsngags pa ste / de ni gso ba thams cad kyi / mchog ste de yang rnam pa gsum

verses.skt: nirūho ’nvāsanaṃ vastir uttaras tena sādhayet | gulmānāhakhuḍaplīhaśuddhātīsāraśūlinaḥ
verses.tib: bkru drags 'jam rtsi mas gtong gong / de yis / gso bya skran dang ni / lto sbos dreg nad mcher pa dang / 'khru ba 'ba' zhig gzer nad dang

verses.skt: jīrṇajvarapratiśyāyaśukrānilamalagrahān | vardhmāśmarīrajonāśān dāruṇāṃś cānilāmayān
verses.tib: rims rnying bying dang cham pa dang / khu ba rlung dang dri ma 'gags / rlig rlugs rde'u nad zla mtshan 'jig / rlung gi nad ni mi bzad gso

verses.skt: anāsthāpyās tv atisnigdhaḥ kṣatorasko bhṛśaṃ kṛśaḥ | āmātīsārī vamimān saṃśuddho dattanāvanaḥ
verses.tib: bkru drags mi bya snum drags dang / glo rdol shin tu skems pa dang / be+e snabs 'khru dang slon bro dang / sbyang byas sna sman btang ba dang

verses.skt: śvāsakāsaprasekārśohidhmādhmānālpavahnayaḥ | śūnapāyuḥ kṛtāhāro baddhacchidrodakodarī
verses.tib: dbugs mi bde lud cham gzhang 'brum / skyigs bu lto sbos me drod chung / gzhang skrangs kha zas zos zin dang / lto 'gags bu ga chu yod dang

verses.skt: kuṣṭhī ca madhumehī ca māsān sapta ca garbhiṇī | āsthāpyā eva cānvāsyā viśeṣād ativahnayaḥ
verses.tib: mdze can gcin nad sbrang mdog dang / sbrum ma zla bdun yan chad do / bkru drags bya nyid 'jam rtsi bya / khyad par du ni me drod che

verses.skt: rūkṣāḥ kevalavātārtā nānuvāsyās ta eva ca | ye ’nāsthāpyās tathā pāṇḍukāmalāmehapīnasāḥ
verses.tib: rtsub dang rlung nad gcig pus nyen / 'jam rtsi mi bya'ang de nyid do / de bzhin skya rbab mig ser dang / tshil che cham btab zas ma zos

verses.skt: nirannaplīhaviḍbhedigurukoṣṭhakaphodarāḥ | abhiṣyandibhṛśasthūlakṛmikoṣṭhāḍhyamārutāḥ
verses.tib: bshang bar 'khru bar byed pa dang / lto lci lto nad bad kan can / mchil ma mang dang shin tu sbom / lto na srin yod rlung 'khyims dang

verses.skt: pīte viṣe gare ’pacyāṃ ślīpadī galagaṇḍavān | tayos tu netraṃ hemādidhātudārvasthiveṇujam
verses.tib: dug dag 'thungs dang 'brum bus btab / rkang bam lkog ma'i wa ba can / de gnyis sbu gu gser sogs dang / shing rus 'od ma las byas pa

verses.skt: gopucchākāram acchidraṃ ślakṣṇarju guṭikāmukham | ūne ’bde pañca pūrṇe ’sminn āsaptabhyo ’ṅgulāni ṣaṭ
verses.tib: ba lang mjug 'dra bug rdol med / 'jam zhing drang la kha zlum pa'o / lo gcig ma lon sor lnga pa / lo tshad lo bdun pa yi bar / tshad ni sor drug yin par bshad

verses.skt: saptame sapta tāny aṣṭau dvādaśe ṣoḍaśe nava | dvādaśaiva paraṃ viṃśād vīkṣya varṣāntareṣu ca
verses.tib: lo bdun pa yi bdun nyid de / bcu gnyis pa la sor brgyad bya / bcu drug yan chad sor dgu ste / nyi shu yan chad sor bcu gnyis

verses.skt: vayobalaśarīrāṇi pramāṇam abhivardhayet | svāṅguṣṭhena samaṃ mūle sthaulyenāgre kaniṣṭhayā
verses.tib: lo gzhan dag la na tshod dang / stobs dang lus tshad brtags nas ni / tshad ni mngon pa bskyed par bya / rtsa ba rang gi mthe bong mnyam / rtse mo mthe'u chung tshad du bya

verses.skt: pūrṇe ’bde ’ṅgulam ādāya tadardhārdhapravardhitam | tryaṅgulaṃ paramaṃ chidraṃ mūle ’gre vahate tu yat
verses.tib: lo gcig lon sor nas bzung ste / de yis phyed phyed kyis bskyed bya / gang zhig rtsa ba'i bu ga'i tshad / sor mo gsum rtse shong ba mchog

verses.skt: mudgaṃ māṣaṃ kalāyaṃ ca klinnaṃ karkandhukaṃ kramāt | mūlacchidrapramāṇena prānte ghaṭitakarṇikam
verses.tib: mung+ga ma sha sran ma btsos / rgya shug 'bras shong rim bzhin bya / rtsa ba'i bu ga'i tshad kyis ni / mthar ni bug pa 'gegs par bya

verses.skt: vartyāgre pihitaṃ mūle yathāsvaṃ dvyaṅgulāntaram | karṇikādvitayaṃ netre kuryāt tatra ca yojayet
verses.tib: lce rtse rang gi sor gnyis kyis / chod par 'gag pa gnyis pa bya / der ni rkyal bu gdags bya ba

verses.skt: ajāvimahiṣādīnāṃ vastiṃ sumṛditaṃ dṛḍham | kaṣāyaraktaṃ niśchidragranthigandhasiraṃ tanum
verses.tib: ra lug ma he la sogs pa'i / lgang pa legs mnyes sra / ba dang / dmar btsos bu ga thag thug med / dri nga rtsa ris med srab par

verses.skt: grathitaṃ sādhu sūtreṇa sukhasaṃsthāpyabheṣajam | vastyabhāve ’ṅkapādaṃ vā nyased vāso ’thavā ghanam
verses.tib: sman ni legs par blugs byas la / srad bus dam par bcing bar bya / lgang med rkyal pa'i dpung pa'am / byin pa'i pags pa'am ras stug bzang

verses.skt: nirūhamātrā prathame prakuñco vatsare param | prakuñcavṛddhiḥ pratyabdaṃ yāvat ṣaṭ prasṛtās tataḥ
verses.tib: ni ru ha tshad dang po ni / lo gcig pa la srang gcig mchog / ji srid srang ni bcu gnyis par

verses.skt: prasṛtaṃ vardhayed ūrdhvaṃ dvādaśāṣṭādaśasya tu | āsaptater idaṃ mānaṃ daśaiva prasṛtāḥ param
verses.tib: lo re srang res bskyed par bya / bcu gnyis pa nas brgyad par / de yang bdun cu'i bar chad 'di / de phan tshad srang nyi shu nyid

verses.skt: yathāyathaṃ nirūhasya pādo mātrānuvāsane | āsthāpyaṃ snehitaṃ svinnaṃ śuddhaṃ labdhabalaṃ punaḥ
verses.tib: bkru sman drag tshad ji lta ba / de yi bzhi cha 'jam rtsi tshad / bkru sman drag bya snum dugs bya / sbyang byas nas kyang stobs thob pa

verses.skt: anvāsanārhaṃ vijñāya pūrvam evānuvāsayet | śīte vasante ca divā rātrau kecit tato ’nyadā
verses.tib: 'jam rtsi gtang 'os par shes nas / thog ma nyid du 'jam rtsi gtang / dgun dpyid nyin par gtang de las / gzhan du mtshan gtang la la 'dod

verses.skt: abhyaktasnātam ucitāt pādahīnaṃ hitaṃ laghu | asnigdharūkṣam aśitaṃ sānupānaṃ dravādi ca
verses.tib: bsku byug khrus bya sngon thang las / bzhi gsum phan zhing yang ba dang / snum dang rtsub ches ma yin bza' / khu ba la sogs zos rjes btung

verses.skt: kṛtacaṅkramaṇaṃ muktaviṇmūtraṃ śayane sukhe | nātyucchrite na cocchīrṣe saṃviṣṭaṃ vāmapārśvataḥ
verses.tib: bcags la bshang gci bsal nas ni / mal du bde bar gnas byas la / mtho dman med par mgo smad de / glo g.yon gyis ni phab nas su

verses.skt: saṃkocya dakṣiṇaṃ sakthi prasārya ca tato ’param | athāsya netraṃ praṇayet snigdhe snigdhamukhaṃ gude
verses.tib: rkang pa g.yas pa bkug nas ni / rkang pa g.yon pa brkyang bar bya / de nas de la gce'u kha dang / gzhang sgo snum gyis bskus nas ni

verses.skt: ucchvāsya vaster vadane baddhe hastam akampayan | pṛṣṭhavaṃśaṃ prati tato nātidrutavilambitam
verses.tib: gce'u lgang pa'i dbugs bton la / kha bcings lag pa mi 'dar bar / rgyab kyi logs su 'dug nas ni / shin tu myur dang bul min dang

verses.skt: nātivegaṃ na vā mandaṃ sakṛd eva prapīḍayet | sāvaśeṣaṃ ca kurvīta vāyuḥ śeṣe hi tiṣṭhati
verses.tib: ha cang shugs drag dal min par / ran par lan cig khong na btsir / rlung ni lhag par gnas pas na / lhag ma cung zad lus par bya

verses.skt: datte tūttānadehasya pāṇinā tāḍayet sphijau | tatpārṣṇibhyāṃ tathā śayyāṃ pādataś ca trir utkṣipet
verses.tib: btang nas lus ni gan rkyal bzhag / rkub tshos lag pas brdab par bya / rting pas mjug tsos brdung bya zhing / rting pa bteg la lan gsum gsig

verses.skt: tataḥ prasāritāṅgasya sopadhānasya pārṣṇike | āhanyān muṣṭināṅgaṃ ca snehenābhyajya mardayet
verses.tib: de nas lus ni brkyangs nas su / sngas dang bcas pa'i rting par ni / khu tshur gyis brdung lus kyang ni / snum gyis bskus la mnye bar bya

verses.skt: vedanārtam iti sneho na hi śīghraṃ nivartate | yojyaḥ śīghraṃ nivṛtte ’nyaḥ sneho ’tiṣṭhann akāryakṛt
verses.tib: tshor bas nyen pas snum dag ni / myur du phyir 'byung mi byed do / gal te myur du phyir byung na / phan mi byed pas gzhan dag gtang

verses.skt: dīptāgniṃ tv āgatasnehaṃ sāyāhne bhojayel laghu | nivṛttikālaḥ paramas trayo yāmas tataḥ param
verses.tib: me drod che zhing snum byung na / dgongs ka kha zas yang ba sbyin / dbyung ba'i dus kyi dam pa ni / thun gsum / yin te de phan chad

verses.skt: ahorātram upekṣeta parataḥ phalavartibhiḥ | tīkṣṇair vā vastibhiḥ kuryād yatnaṃ snehanivṛttaye
verses.tib: nyin mtshan gcig ni bsdad nas su / de yi 'og tu reng bu yis / snum dbyung phyir ni 'bad bya ba'am / mas gtong ba ni rnon po bya

verses.skt: atiraukṣyād anāgacchan na cej jāḍyādidoṣakṛt | upekṣetaiva hi tato ’dhyuṣitaś ca niśāṃ pibet
verses.tib: shin tu rtsub pas ma byung zhing / snyom bag la sogs nad med na / btang snyoms su ni gzhag par bya / de nas mtshan 'das nang par ni

verses.skt: prātar nāgaradhānyāmbhaḥ koṣṇaṃ kevalam eva vā | anvāsayet tṛtīye ’hni pañcame vā punaś ca tam
verses.tib: bca' sga 'u su bskol chu 'am / yang na chu tshan 'ba' zhig btung / 'jam rtsi btang nas nyin gsum mam / nyin lnga lon nas slar gtang ba'am

verses.skt: yathā vā snehapaktiḥ syād ato ’tyulbaṇamārutān | vyāyāmanityān dīptāgnīn rūkṣāṃś ca prativāsaram
verses.tib: ji srid snum ni 'jug gyur pa'am / yang na rlung ni shas che dang / rtag tu rtsol byed me drod che / khong rtsub pa la nyin re gtang

verses.skt: ādhmānasaṃkocapurīṣabandhakṣīṇendriyatvārucibhaṅgaśūlāḥ | pāṅgulyaśākhāśritavātabhagnabandhāś ca sādhyā hy anuvāsanena
iti snehais tricaturaiḥ snigdhe srotoviśuddhaye | nirūhaṃ śodhanaṃ yuñjyād asnigdhe snehanaṃ tanoḥ
verses.tib: de ltar snum ni gsum mam bzhi / snum gyur rtsa sgo sbyang ba'i phyir / mas gtong khrus kyis sbyang ba dang / snum med lus ni snum gyur gtang

verses.skt: pañcame ’tha tṛtīye vā divase sādhake śubhe | madhyāhne kiñcidāvṛtte prayukte balimaṅgale
verses.tib: nyi ma gsum mam nyin lnga na / tshes grangs bzang zhing dge ba la / nyin phyed cung zad yol ba'i tshe / gtor ma bkra shis cho ga bya

verses.skt: abhyaktasveditotsṛṣṭamalaṃ nātibubhukṣitam | avekṣya puruṣaṃ doṣabheṣajādīni cādarāt
verses.tib: snum bskus dugs bya bshang gci ni / bsal zhing shing tu bkres min la / skyes bu'i nad dmigs sman la sogs / 'bad de shes par byas nas ni

verses.skt: vastiṃ prakalpayed vaidyas tadvidyair bahubhiḥ saha | kvāthayed viṃśatipalaṃ dravyasyāṣṭau phalāni ca
verses.tib: sman pa de la mkhas pa ni / mar dang lhan cig mas gtong sbyar / sman gyi srang ni nyi shu dang / bo son cha brgyad lhan cig bskol

verses.skt: tataḥ kvāthāc caturthāṃśaṃ snehaṃ vāte prakalpayet | pitte svasthe ca ṣaṣṭhāṃśam aṣṭamāṃśaṃ kaphe ’dhike
verses.tib: bskol ba de yi bzhi cha yis / sman mar rlung la rjes su sbyar / mkhris pa bde bar gnas drug cha / bad kan shas che brgyad cha gcig

verses.skt: sarvatra cāṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ kalkād bhavati vā yathā | nātyacchasāndratā vasteḥ palamātraṃ guḍasya ca
verses.tib: yang na kun la sman gyi ni / brgyad cha gcig gam ci nas kyang / mas gtong ska slar mi 'gyur bya / bu ram dag ni srang gcig tsam

verses.skt: madhupaṭvādiśeṣaṃ ca yuktyā sarvaṃ tad ekataḥ | uṣṇāmbukumbhībāṣpeṇa taptaṃ khajasamāhatam
verses.tib: rigs pas sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha sogs / lhag ma de kun snod cig blugs / bum par chu bskol rlangs pa yis / bsro zhing gzar bus dkrugs nas ni

verses.skt: prakṣipya vastau praṇayet pāyau nātyuṣṇaśītalam | nātisnigdhaṃ na vā rūkṣaṃ nātitīkṣṇaṃ na vā mṛdu
verses.tib: rkyal pa'i nang blugs mjug mar ni / gtong tshe shin tu tsha grang min / shin tu snum min rtsub pa'ang min / shin tu rno min 'jam pa'ang min

verses.skt: nātyacchasāndraṃ nonātimātraṃ nāpaṭu nāti ca | lavaṇaṃ tadvad amlaṃ ca paṭhanty anye tu tadvidaḥ
verses.tib: shin tu ska min sla ba'ang min / shin tu mang nyung tshad med pa'ang / tsha che skyur ba'ang de dang 'dra / de la mkhas pa gzhan smra ba

verses.skt: mātrāṃ tripalikāṃ kuryāt snehamākṣikayoḥ pṛthak | karṣārdhaṃ māṇimanthasya svasthe kalkapaladvayam
verses.tib: snum dang sbrang rtsi gnyis so sor / srang ni gsum gsum byas nas su / rgyam tsha dag ni zho gnyis dang / nad med la btang sman srang gnyis

verses.skt: sarvadravāṇāṃ śeṣāṇāṃ palāni daśa kalpayet | mākṣikaṃ lavaṇaṃ snehaṃ kalkaṃ kvātham iti kramāt
verses.tib: khu ba'i / sman ni lhag ma kun / srang bcu yongs su sbyar bar bya / sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha snum rnams dang / sman phye khu ba'i rim pa ni

verses.skt: āvapeta nirūhāṇām eṣa saṃyojane vidhiḥ | uttāno dattamātre tu nirūhe tanmanā bhavet
verses.tib: mas gtong rkyal bar bcug byas te / 'di ni sbyor ba'i cho gar bshad / gan rkyal bzhag nas btang ma thag

verses.skt: kṛtopadhānaḥ sañjātavegaś cotkaṭakaḥ sṛjet | āgatau paramaḥ kālo muhūrto mṛtyave param
verses.tib: sngas kyis brten te mas gtong la / yid ni gzhan du ma yengs pas / 'khru ba tsog pus gtang bar bya / 'ong dus dam pa yud tsam ste / de las gzhan du 'chi byed yin

verses.skt: tatrānulomikaṃ snehakṣāramūtrāmlakalpitam | tvaritaṃ snigdhatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ vastim anyaṃ prapīḍayet
verses.tib: de la bcos pa'i thabs gyur snum / thal sman ba gcin khu skyur sbyar / myur bas snum la rno dro ba'i / mang gtong gzhan dag gtang bar bya

verses.skt: vidadyāt phalavartiṃ vā svedanottrāsanādi ca | svayam eva nivṛtte tu dvitīyo vastir iṣyate
verses.tib: yang na sman gyi reng bu dag / gtong zhing dugs la sogs pa bya / rang nyid 'ongs par gyur na ni / mas gtong gnyis pa gtang ba'am

verses.skt: tṛtīyo ’pi caturtho ’pi yāvad vā sunirūḍhatā | viriktavac ca yogādīn vidyād yoge tu bhojayet
verses.tib: lan gsum lan bzhi'i bar du ni / ji srid legs par gyur par gtang / de yis sbyor sogs bkru sman dang / 'dra bar shes bya sbyor legs na

verses.skt: koṣṇena vāriṇā snātaṃ tanudhanvarasaudanam | vikārā ye nirūḍhasya bhavanti pracalair malaiḥ
verses.tib: chu dron 'jam pos bkrus nas ni / sha khu 'bras chan nyung zad sbyin / mas gtong drag pos nad rnams kyi / dri ma bskyod pas byung gyur pa

verses.skt: te sukhoṣṇāmbusiktasya yānti bhuktavataḥ śamam | atha vātārditaṃ bhūyaḥ sadya evānuvāsayet
verses.tib: de ni chu dron gyis bkru dang / kha zas tshul bzhin thos bas 'byung / gal te rlung gis nyam thag na / slar yang 'phral du 'jam rtsi gtang

verses.skt: samyagdhīnātiyogāś ca tasya syuḥ snehapītavat | kiñcitkālaṃ sthito yaś ca sapurīṣo nivartate
verses.tib: de ni legs dang ma legs dang / grags pa snum 'thungs 'drar shes bya / gang zhig dus ni cung zad gnas / bshang dang bcas par 'byung 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: sānulomānilaḥ snehas tat siddham anuvāsanam | ekaṃ trīn vā balāse tu snehavastīn prakalpayet
verses.tib: thur du dbugs dang snum lhan cig / 'byung 'gyur 'jam rtsi legs pa yin / bad kan la ni mas gtong ba'i / 'jam rtsi gcig gam gsum gtang bya

verses.skt: pañca vā sapta vā pitte navaikādaśa vānile | punas tato ’py ayugmāṃs tu punar āsthāpanaṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa la ni lnga'am bdun / rlung la dgu'am bcu gcig gtang / slar yang de la zung min pa / mas gtong rjes la bya ba yin

verses.skt: kaphapittānileṣv annaṃ yūṣakṣīrarasaiḥ kramāt | vātaghnauṣadhaniḥkvāthatrivṛtāsaindhavair yutaḥ
verses.tib: bad mkhris rlung la rim bzhin zas / yu sha 'o ma sha khu gtang / rlung 'joms sman ni legs bskol ba / dur byid rgya mtshar bcas par bya

verses.skt: vastir eko ’nile snigdhaḥ svādvamloṣṇo rasānvitaḥ | nyagrodhādigaṇakvāthapadmakādisitāyutau
verses.tib: snum mngar skyur sha khu dron sbyar / mas gtong gcig ni rlung la phan / n+ya gro d+ha sogs sde tshan bskol / shug sogs kar dkar dang bcas

verses.skt: pitte svāduhimau sājyakṣīrekṣurasamākṣikau | āragvadhādiniḥkvāthavatsakādiyutās trayaḥ
verses.tib: mngar bsil bu ram shing khu mar / 'o ma sbrang rtsir bcas mkhris sel / dong ga la sogs bskol ba dang / dug mo nyung sogs bcas pa / gsum

verses.skt: rūkṣāḥ sakṣaudragomūtrās tīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭukāḥ kaphe | trayas te saṃnipāte ’pi doṣān ghnanti yataḥ kramāt
verses.tib: rtsub dang sbrang rtsi ba gcin bcas / rno zhing dro kha bad kan sel / gsum po 'dus pa'i nad la yang / gang phyir rim bzhin sel ba yin

verses.skt: tribhyaḥ paraṃ vastim ato necchanty anye cikitsakāḥ | na hi doṣaś caturtho ’sti punar dīyeta yaṃ prati
verses.tib: gsum po de las gzhan pa yin / mas gtong gso zhes gzhan mi 'dod / gang phyir slar yang sbyin bya ba'i / nyes pa bzhi po yod ma yin

verses.skt: utkleśanaṃ śuddhikaraṃ doṣāṇāṃ śamanaṃ kramāt | tridhaiva kalpayed vastim ity anye ’pi pracakṣate
verses.tib: nad bskyod dag par byed pa dang / zhi bar bya ba'i rim pa yis / mas gtong gsum po nyid brtag ces / de skad gzhan dag smra ba yin

verses.skt: doṣauṣadhādibalataḥ sarvam etat pramāṇayet | samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅgaṃ tu nāsaṃbhāvya nivartayet
verses.tib: nad dang sman sogs stobs las ni / 'di dag thams cad tshad mas gzhal / bskru sman drag btang legs mtshan ma / ma mthong bar du 'phro mi bcad

verses.skt: prāk sneha ekaḥ pañcānte dvādaśāsthāpanāni ca | sānvāsanāni karmaivaṃ vastayas triṃśad īritāḥ
verses.tib: dang por snum gcig tha mar lnga / bkru sman drag po bcu gnyis te / 'jam rtsir bcas ba mas gtong ba'i / las ni sum cur bshad pa yin

verses.skt: kālaḥ pañcadaśaiko ’tra prāk sneho ’nte trayas tathā | ṣaṭ pañcavastyantaritā yogo ’ṣṭau vastayo ’tra tu
verses.tib: dus ni bco lnga 'dir gcig ni / thog ma'i snum ste tha mar gsum / dugs dang mas gtong lnga par bshad / mas gtong sbyor 'dir brgyad yin te

verses.skt: trayo nirūhāḥ snehāś ca snehāv ādyantayor ubhau | snehavastiṃ nirūhaṃ vā naikam evātiśīlayet
verses.tib: ni ru ha dang snum gsum dang / thog ma tha ma gnyis ka'o / 'jam rtsi'am bkru sman mas gtong drag / gcig pu lhag par bsten mi bya

verses.skt: utkleśāgnivadhau snehān nirūhān maruto bhayam | tasmān nirūḍhaḥ snehyaḥ syān nirūhyaś cānuvāsitaḥ
verses.tib: 'jam rtsis nad slongs me drod 'joms / ni ru has rlung skyed 'jigs yod / de bas snum rjes bkrus drags gtang / khrus drag btang nas 'jam rtsi bya

verses.skt: snehaśodhanayuktyaivaṃ vastikarma tridoṣajit | hrasvayā snehapānasya mātrayā yojitaḥ samaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar rim pas snum sbyang bya / mas gtong las ni nyes gsum sel / snum gyi tshad ni chung ngu yi

verses.skt: mātrāvastiḥ smṛtaḥ snehaḥ śīlanīyaḥ sadā ca saḥ | bālavṛddhādhvabhārastrīvyāyāmāsaktacintakaiḥ
verses.tib: tshad dang de ni mnyam byas pa'i / snum tshad 'jam rtsi'i tshad du bshad / de ni byis rgan lam dang khur / bud med rtsol zhen pas du ba dang

verses.skt: vātabhagnābalālpāgninṛpeśvarasukhātmabhiḥ | doṣaghno niṣparīhāro balyaḥ sṛṣṭamalaḥ sukhaḥ
verses.tib: rlung nad kyis gzhom me drod chung / rgyal po phyug po la bde ba / yin pas rtag tu bsten par bya / nad 'joms yang ba med pa dang / stobs skyed bshang ba bde bar 'byung

verses.skt: vastau rogeṣu nārīṇāṃ yonigarbhāśayeṣu ca | dvitrāsthāpanaśuddhebhyo vidadhyād vastim uttaram
verses.tib: mas gtong bud med ro smad kyi / mngal dang mo mtshan nad rnams la / bkrus drags gnyis gsum gyis dag par / mas gtong gong mas gtang bar bya

verses.skt: āturāṅgulamānena tannetraṃ dvādaśāṅgulam | vṛttaṃ gopucchavan mūlamadyayoḥ kṛtakarṇikam
verses.tib: de yi gce'u nad pa yi / sor tshad bcu gnyis tshad du bya / zlum zhing ba lang mjug ma 'dra / rtsa ba dbus su gag pa gdags

verses.skt: siddhārthakapraveśāgraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ hemādisaṃbhavam | kundāśvamārasumanaḥpuṣpavṛntopamaṃ dṛḍham
verses.tib: rtse mo yungs kar shong ba tsam / 'jam pa gser la sogs las byas / kun+da sri zhing so man / me tog rtse mo ltar zlum phra

verses.skt: tasya vastir mṛdulaghur mātrā śuktir vikalpya vā | atha snātāśītasyāsya snehavastividhānataḥ
verses.tib: de yi rkyal bu 'jam / zhing yang / tshad srang phyed dam gang rigs bya / de nas khrus byas zas zos la / 'jam rtsi gtong ba'i cho ga bya

verses.skt: ṛjoḥ sukhopaviṣṭasya pīṭhe jānusame mṛdau | hṛṣṭe meḍhre sthite carjau śanaiḥ srotoviśuddhaye
verses.tib: khri stegs bus mnyam 'jam pa la / drang zhing bde bar 'dug nas ni / pho mtshan bteg cing drang bar bya / sbubs sbyang phyir ni thur ma ni

verses.skt: sūkṣmāṃ śalākāṃ praṇayet tayā śuddhe anusevani | āmehanāntaṃ netraṃ ca niṣkampaṃ gudavat tataḥ
verses.tib: 'jam pa rim gyis gzhug par bya / de dag pho mtshan dang 'tsham pa / 'bras bu'i mthar thug bar gtang ba / mi 'dar 'jam rtsi btang ltar bya

verses.skt: pīḍite ’ntargate snehe snehavastikramo hitaḥ | vastīn anena vidhinā dadyāt trīṃś caturo ’pi vā
verses.tib: btsir te btang la snum rjes bya / 'jam rtsi'i rim pa bzhin du bya / mas gtong cho ga 'di yis ni / gsum mam bzhi yi bar du gtang

verses.skt: anuvāsanavac cheṣaṃ sarvam evāsya cintayet | strīṇām ārtavakāle tu yonir gṛhṇāty apāvṛteḥ
verses.tib: lhag ma 'jam rtsi ji lta bar / 'di la thams cad sbyar bar bya / bud med zla mtshan dus su ni / mngal bye ba las chags par 'gyur

verses.skt: vidadhīta tadā tasmād anṛtāv api cātyaye | yonivibhraṃśaśūleṣu yonivyāpady asṛgdare
verses.tib: de phyir de tshe gtang bya la / rab na dus min par yang gtang / mo mtshan nyams dang gzer ba dang / mngal khrag rtag tu 'byung gtong ba

verses.skt: netraṃ daśāṅgulaṃ mudgapraveśaṃ caturaṅgulam | apatyamārge yojyaṃ syād dvyaṅgulaṃ mūtravartmani
verses.tib: gce bu sor bcu rtse mo yi / bu ga mung+ga shong sor bzhi / mngal gyi gnas su gtang bar bya / sor gnyis gcin 'bab lam du btang

verses.skt: mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu bālānāṃ tv ekam aṅgulam | prakuñco madhyamā mātrā bālānāṃ śuktir eva tu
verses.tib: gcin 'gags pa yi nad rnams la / bu mo rnams la sor gcig gtang / 'bring tshad srang ni gcig pa ste / bu mo rnams la srang phyed nyid

verses.skt: uttānāyāḥ śayānāyāḥ samyak saṃkocya sakthinī | ūrdhvajānvās tricaturān ahorātreṇa yojayet
verses.tib: mal du gan rkyal 'dug nas ni / brla ni legs par bskums nas su / pus mo bstod de nyin zhag ni / gcig la lan gsum lan bzhi gtang

verses.skt: vastīṃs trirātram evaṃ ca snehamātrāṃ vivardhayan | tryaham eva ca viśramya praṇidadhyāt punas tryaham
verses.tib: de ltar mas gtong zhag gsum la / snum gyi tshad ni bskyed par bya / de nas zhag gsum ngal bso nas / slar yang zhag gsum gtang bar bya

verses.skt: pakṣād vireko vamite tataḥ pakṣān nirūhaṇam | sadyo nirūḍhaś cānvāsyaḥ saptarātrād virecitaḥ
verses.tib: skyug sman byas zla phyed bkru sman / de nas zla phyed nas bkrus drags / bkrus drags 'phral la 'jam rtsi gtang / khrus btang zhag bdun nas 'jam rtsi

verses.skt: yathā kusumbhādiyutāt toyād rāgaṃ haret paṭaḥ | tathā dravīkṛtād dehād vastir nirharate malān
verses.tib: dper na leb rgan sogs btsos pa'i / gos ni chu las tshos len ltar / de bzhin bangs par byas lus la / mas gtong bas ni nang rnams 'byin

verses.skt: śākhāgatāḥ koṣṭhagatāś ca rogā marmordhvasarvāvayavāṅgajāś ca | ye santi teṣāṃ na tu kaścid anyo vāyoḥ paraṃ janmani hetur asti
verses.tib: lus kyi yan lag nang khrol dag tu song nad dang / gnad dang lus stod yan lag kun khyab nad / gang zhig yod pa de las skye ba'i rgyu / rlung ma gtogs pa gzhan dag yod ma yin

verses.skt: viṭśleṣmapittādimaloccayānāṃ vikṣepasaṃhārakaraḥ sa yasmāt | tasyātivṛddhasya śamāya nānyad vaster vinā bheṣajam asti kiñcit
verses.tib: bshang dang bad kan mkhris sogs nad sogs pa / gang phyir 'thor zhing sdud par byed pa yin / de ni rab 'phel gyur la zhi ba'i phyir / 'jam / rtsi ma gtogs sman gzhan gang yang med

verses.skt: tasmāc cikitsārdha iti pradiṣṭaḥ kṛtsnā cikitsāpi ca vastir ekaiḥ | tathā nijāgantuvikārakāriraktauṣadhatvena sirāvyadho ’pi
verses.tib: de bas gso ba ma lus las ma btang / gso ba'i phyed yin zhes ni la la 'dod / de bzhin nad rnying glo bur skyed byed la / gtar ga khrag dbyung sman nyid 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu viśeṣān nasyam iṣyate | nāsā hi śiraso dvāraṃ tena tad vyāpya hanti tān
verses.tib: nam tshong yan chad nad rnams la / ltag par sna nas btang ba phan / sna ni klad pa'i sgo yin te / des na de nas nad de 'joms

verses.skt: virecanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca śamanaṃ ca tridhāpi tat | virecanaṃ śiraḥśūlajāḍyasyandagalāmaye
marśadhmānāvapīḍākhyais tat punaḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ smṛtam
śophagaṇḍakṛmigranthikuṣṭhāpasmārapīnase | bṛṃhaṇaṃ vātaje śūle sūryāvarte svarakṣaye
verses.tib: bkru sman klad pa'i nad rnams dang / glong bag lkog nad mchi ma 'dzag / skrang dang thor bu srin rmen bu / mdze snyom cham pas btab la gtang / brta ba rlung las byung gzer dang

verses.skt: snehena tīkṣṇaiḥ siddhena kalkakvāthādibhiś ca tat
verses.tib: bkru sman klad pa'i nad rnams dang / glong bag lkog nad mchi ma 'dzag / skrang dang thor bu srin rmen bu / mdze snyom cham pas btab la gtang / brta ba rlung las byung gzer dang

verses.skt: nāsāsyaśoṣe vāksaṅge kṛcchrabodhe ’vabāhuke | śamanaṃ nīlikāvyaṅgakeśadoṣākṣirājiṣu
verses.tib: sna dang kha skom tshig mi thon / mig dbye dka' dpung bskyod dka' gtang / zhi ba mig sngon gdong pags nad / skra yi skyon mig dmar la gtang

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ yaugikaiḥ snehair yathāsvaṃ ca prasādhitaiḥ | kalkakvāthādibhiś cādyaṃ madhupaṭvāsavair api
verses.tib: dang po rang sbyor ji lta'i snum / sman gyi lde gu sogs bskol dang / shing mngar rgyam tsha chang rnying sogs / ci rigs pa ni bskol ba gtang

verses.skt: bṛṃhaṇaṃ dhanvamāṃsottharasāsṛkkhapurair api | śamanaṃ yojayet pūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena vā
verses.tib: brta ba 'u su'i khu ba dang / sha khu khrag dang thang chu'ang sbyar / zhi ba snga ma 'o ma dang / chu dang bcas par sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: marśaś ca pratimarśaś ca dvidhā sneho ’tra mātrayā | kalkādyair avapīḍas tu sa tīkṣṇair mūrdharecanaḥ
verses.tib: tshad chen dang ni tshang phran te / 'di yi snum tshad rnam pa gnyis / lde gu la sogs btsir ba yi / rno de spyi bo'i bkru sman yin

verses.skt: dhmānaṃ virecanaś cūrṇo yuñjyāt taṃ mukhavāyunā | ṣaḍaṅguladvimukhayā nāḍyā bheṣajagarbhayā
verses.tib: phye ma bud pa'i bkru sman te / sbu gu sor drug kha gnyis pa / nang na sman dang bcas pa dag / kha yi dbugs kyis bus te gtang

verses.skt: sa hi bhūritaraṃ doṣaṃ cūrṇatvād apakarṣati | pradeśinyaṅgulīparvadvayān magnasamuddhṛtāt
verses.tib: des ni mgo nad mang po yang / phye ma yin pas 'byen par byed / mdzub mo'i tshigs ni gnyis ba'i bar / smyugs pa'i phyir byung gyur pa las

verses.skt: yāvat pataty asau bindur daśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te | marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrās tā eva ca kramāt
verses.tib: thigs pa bcu'am brgyad dam drug / ji srid 'dzags par gyur pa dag / sna nas gtong tshad che 'bring chung / rim pa de nyid kyis shes bya

verses.skt: bindudvayonāḥ kalkāder yojayen na tu nāvanam | toyamadyagarasnehapītānāṃ pātum icchatām
verses.tib: lde gu la sogs thigs pa ni / gnyis kyis phri ste gtang bar bya / chu dang chang dang sbyar dug mar / 'thungs pa'am 'thung bar 'dod pa dag

verses.skt: bhuktabhaktaśiraḥsnātasnātukāmasrutāsṛjām | navapīnasavegārtasūtikāśvāsakāsinām
verses.tib: kha zas zos dang mgo bkrus dang / 'khru bar 'dod dang gtar ga byas / cham pa shugs 'ongs kyis gzir dang / bu btsas lud pa dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: śuddhānāṃ dattavastīnāṃ tathānārtavadurdine | anyatrātyayikād vyādher atha nasyaṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: sbyang byas mas gtong cho ga byas / de bzhin / dus min yul rmugs la / sna sman gtang bar mi bya ste / tshabs chen nad dang sogs ma gtogs so

verses.skt: prātaḥ śleṣmaṇi madhyāhne pitte sāyanniśoś cale | svasthavṛtte tu pūrvāhṇe śaratkālavasantayoḥ
verses.tib: bad kan nang par mkhris nyin phyed / rlung can phyi 'bred mtshan mo gtang / nad med pa la ston ka dang / dpyid kyi tshe na snga dro gtang

verses.skt: śīte madhyandine grīṣme sāyaṃ varṣāsu sātape | vātābhibhūte śirasi hidhmāyām apatānake
verses.tib: dgun ni phyed dus so ga'i tshe / phyi 'bred dbyar ni nyi dron bcas / rlung nad kyis thebs dang / skyigs bus btab dang mgo 'dar dang

verses.skt: manyāstambhe svarabhraṃśe sāyaṃ prātar dine dine | ekāhāntaram anyatra saptāhaṃ ca tad ācaret
verses.tib: gnye'u rengs skad ni 'gags pa la / nyin re nang par dgongs ka gtang / gzhan la nyin res bar bcad la / nyi ma bdun du de spyad bya

verses.skt: snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya prākkṛtāvaśyakasya ca | nivātaśayanasthasya jatrūrdhvaṃ svedayet punaḥ
verses.tib: rtag tu bya ba'i las byas nas / dang por mgo snum bsku dugs byas / rlung med mal du gnas nas ni / nam tshong yan chad dugs kyang bya

verses.skt: athottānarjudehasya pāṇipāde prasārite | kiñcidunnatapādasya kiñcin mūrdhani nāmite
verses.tib: de nas gan rkyal lus drang brkyang / rkang pa lag pa legs brkyangs la / rkang pa cung zad bstod nas su / mgo bo yid tsam smad par bya

verses.skt: nāsāpuṭaṃ pidhāyaikaṃ paryāyeṇa niṣecayet | uṣṇāmbutaptaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ praṇāḍyā picunāthavā
verses.tib: sna khung gcig ni rab bkag la / rim gyis yongs su blugs bya ba / sman ni chu dron gyis bsros la / sbu gu'am ras bal gyis blugs bya

verses.skt: datte pādatalaskandhahastakarṇādi mardayet | śanair ucchidya niṣṭhīvet pārśvayor ubhayos tataḥ
verses.tib: blugs nas rkang mthil phrag pa dang / lag pa rna ba la sogs mnye / rim gyis brngubs la glo gnyis su

verses.skt: ābheṣajakṣayād evaṃ dvis trir vā nasyam ācaret | mūrchāyāṃ śītatoyena siñcet pariharan śiraḥ
verses.tib: mchil ma dor ba de nas ni / sman ni zad par 'gyur gyi bar / lan gnyis lan gsum snar btang spyad / gal te brgyal gyur bsil ba'i chus / mgo ma gtogs par gtor bar bya

verses.skt: snehaṃ virecanasyānte dadyād doṣādyapekṣayā | nasyānte vākśataṃ tiṣṭhed uttāno dhārayet tataḥ
verses.tib: bkru sman 'og tu snum dag ni / nad sogs tshul las dpags te gtang / sna sman btang mthar gan rkyal du / grangs brgyar de las bsdad par bya

verses.skt: dhūmaṃ pītvā kavoṣṇāmbukavaḍān kaṇṭhaśuddhaye | samyaksnigdhe sukhocchvāsasvapnabodhākṣapāṭavam
verses.tib: dud pa brdubs la chu dron 'jam / gre ba mtshul pa dag phyir bya / snum btang legs gyur dbugs bder rgyu / gnyid log sad bde dbang po gsal

verses.skt: rūkṣe ’kṣistabdhatā śoṣo nāsāsye mūrdhaśūnyatā | snigdhe ’ti kaṇḍūgurutāprasekārucipīnasāḥ
verses.tib: nyes pas mgo rtsub mi 'gyur skam / sna dang kha skams klad stong snyam / snum drags g.yan dang lci ba nyid / mchil mang cham 'debs yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: suvirikte ’kṣilaghutāvaktrasvaraviśuddhayaḥ | durvirikte gadodrekaḥ kṣāmatātivirecite
verses.tib: legs bkrus mig gsal yang ba dang / kha dang skad ni dag par 'gyur / bkrus nyen nad ni 'phel bar 'gyur / bkrus drags khong ni rmya bar 'gyur

verses.skt: pratimarśaḥ kṣatakṣāmabālavṛddhasukhātmasu | prayojyo ’kālavarṣe ’pi na tv iṣṭo duṣṭapīnase
verses.tib: tshad phran glo rdol rid pa dang / byis pa rgan po skyid par gnas / dus min char 'bab par yang gtang / de ni cham pas drag btab dang

verses.skt: madyapīte ’balaśrotre kṛmidūṣitamūrdhani | utkṛṣṭotkliṣṭadoṣe ca hīnamātratayā hi saḥ
verses.tib: chang 'thungs rna ba 'on pa dang / klad rgyas srin bu zhugs pa dang / nad bsdus phyir ni ma phyung / la / tshad phra ba ni gtang mi bya

verses.skt: niśāharbhuktavāntāhaḥsvapnādhvaśramaretasām | śiro'bhyañjanagaṇḍūṣaprasrāvāñjanavarcasām
verses.tib: nyin mtshan zas zos slon gnyid nyal / mtha' dang bud med lam ngal dub / mgo bskus mkhur bkang dbo ba'i rjes / bshang gci mig sman btang rjes dang

verses.skt: dantakāṣṭhasya hāsasya yojyo ’nte ’sau dvibindukaḥ | pañcasu srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ klamanāśas triṣu kramāt
verses.tib: so shing gi rjes dgod pa yin / rjes la thigs pa gnyis pa gtang / lnga yis dbang po'i bu ga dag / gsum gyis rim bzhin ngal ba sel

verses.skt: dṛgbalaṃ pañcasu tato dantadārḍhyaṃ marucchamaḥ | na nasyam ūnasaptābde nātītāśītivatsare
verses.tib: lnga yis mig ni gsal bar byed / so brtan rlung nad zhi bar 'gyur / sna sman lo bdun ma lon dang / brgyad cu 'das la gtang mi bya

verses.skt: na conāṣṭādaśe dhūmaḥ kavaḍo nonapañcame | na śuddhir ūnadaśame na cātikrāntasaptatau
verses.tib: brgyad ma lon dud mi bdug / mkhur bkang lnga ma lon la min / lo bcu ma lon sbyang mi gtang / bdun cu 'das la'ang mi bya'o

verses.skt: ājanmamaraṇaṃ śastaḥ pratimarśas tu vastivat | marśavac ca guṇān kuryāt sa hi nityopasevanāt
verses.tib: skyes nas rgas pa'i bar du ni / tshad phran mas gtong lta bur bsngags / de ni rtag tu bsten gyur / tshad che ba ltar yon tan skyed

verses.skt: na cātra yantraṇā nāpi vyāpadbhyo marśavad bhayam | tailam eva ca nasyārthe nityābhyāsena śasyate
verses.tib: 'di la bdam pa gang yang med / gnod las tshad chen ltar 'jigs med / sna sman don du til mar nyid / rtag tu bsten pa bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: śirasaḥ śleṣmadhāmatvāt snehāḥ svasthasya netare | āśukṛccirakāritvaṃ guṇotkarṣāpakṛṣṭatā
verses.tib: mgo ni bad kan gnas yin phyir / snum gzhan bde gnas la mi bsngags / myur byed ring zhig byed pa dang / yon tan che dang chung byed pa'i

verses.skt: marśe ca pratimarśe ca viśeṣo na bhaved yadi | ko marśaṃ saparīhāraṃ sāpadaṃ ca bhajet tataḥ
verses.tib: khyad par tshad chen tshad phran la / gal te med par gyur na ni / gang zhig spang byas gnod byas pa'i / tshad chen ngag ni su zhig ston

verses.skt: acchapānavicārākhyau kuṭīvātātapasthitī | anvāsamātrāvastī ca tadvad eva vinirdiśet
verses.tib: spyil bu rlung dang tshad par gnas / 'jam rtsi tshad chen mas gtong tshad / de dang 'dra bar rnam par bstan

verses.skt: paṭolamudgavārtākahrasvamūlakajāṅgalaiḥ | rasaiḥ śāliyavān adyān nasyakarmaṇi ṣaḍvidhe
verses.tib: dza la sgron shing dzi ban+ti / gla sgang shing tsha pu shel tse / go bi tsan+dan skyer pa'i rtsa

verses.skt: uccairbhāṣaṇam āyāsam ajīrṇāsātmyabhojanam | dattanasyo naraḥ krodhaṃ yānādīṃś ca vivarjayet

jīvantījaladevadārujaladatvaksevyagopīhimaṃ | dārvītvaṅmadhukaplavāguruvarīpuṇḍrāhvabilvotpalam | dhāvanyau surabhiṃ sthire kṛmiharaṃ pattraṃ truṭīṃ reṇukāṃ | kiñjalkaṃ kamalād balāṃ śataguṇe divye ’mbhasi kvāthayet
verses.tib: shing mngar gla ba a ka ru / nye'u shing bil ba puN+Da rI / ut+pal mur ba par+Ni gnyis / bri ha ti gnyis byi dang ga / gan+d+ha b+ha dra sug smel dang / ha re Nu ka pad+ma yi / ge sar dang ni ba la ste / sman ni 'di rnams cha mnyam la / char pa'i chus ni bskol bar bya

verses.skt: tailād rasaṃ daśaguṇaṃ pariśeṣya tena tailaṃ paceta salilena daśaiva vārān | pāke kṣipec ca daśame samam ājadugdhaṃ nasyaṃ mahāguṇam uśanty aṇutailam etat
verses.tib: til mar las ni sman gyi khu / bcu 'gyur lhag byas de la ni / til mar chu dang bskol ba bya / lan bcu nyid ni bskol nas ni / tshos pa yi ni bcu cha la / de mnyam ra yi 'o ma blugs / snar btang til mar yon tan che / thigs phran zhes bya 'di bsten bya

verses.skt: ghanonnataprasannatvakskandhagrīvāsyavakṣasaḥ | dṛḍhendriyāstapalitā bhaveyur nasyaśīlinaḥ
verses.tib: phrag pa mgrin pa dpung mgo ni / mkhregs shing mthol pa gas mdog gsal / dbang brtan skra dkar med par 'gyur / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po

verses.skt: jatrūrdhvakaphavātotthavikārāṇām ajanmane | ucchedāya ca jātānāṃ pibed dhūmaṃ sadātmavān
verses.tib: nam tshong yan chad bang rlung las / byung ba'i nad rnams mi skye dang / skyes pa rnams ni bsal ba'i phyir / mkhas pas rtag tu dud pa brngub

verses.skt: snigdho madhyaḥ sa tīkṣṇaś ca vāte vātakaphe kaphe | yojyo na raktapittārtiviriktodaramehiṣu
verses.tib: de ni 'jam dang bar ma rno / rlung dang bad rlung bad kan la / gtang ngo mkhris khrag gis nyen dang

verses.skt: timirordhvānilādhmānarohiṇīdattavastiṣu | matsyamadyadadhikṣīrakṣaudrasnehaviṣāśiṣu
verses.tib: bkrus dang dmu rdzing za khu dang / rab rib sbos dang stod rlung nad / lkog nad mas gtong byas pa dang / nya dang chang dang 'o ma zho / sbrang rtsi mar dang dug 'thungs sogs

verses.skt: śirasy abhihate pāṇḍuroge jāgarite niśi | raktapittāndhyabādhiryatṛṇmūrchāmadamohakṛt
verses.tib: mgo nad skya rbab nad can ni / mtshan gnyid ma log la mi gtang / gal te dud pa cher brngubs na / khrag dang mkhris 'phel 'on dang long / skom dang brgyal dang rmongs par byed

verses.skt: dhūmo ’kāle ’tipīto vā tatra śīto vidhir hitaḥ | kṣutajṛmbhitaviṇmūtrastrīsevāśastrakarmaṇām
verses.tib: der ni bsil ba'i cho ga phan / bkres sbrid glal dang bshang gci bsal / bud med bsten dang gtar ga btab

verses.skt: hāsasya dantakāṣṭhasya dhūmam ante piben mṛdum | kāleṣv eṣu niśāhāranāvanānte ca madhyamam
verses.tib: dgod dang so shing bcas pa yi / mthar ni dud pa 'jam po gtang / dus 'di dag nas mtshan zas zos / sna sman rjes la bar ma brngub

verses.skt: nidrānasyāñjanasnānaccharditānte virecanam | vastinetrasamadravyaṃ trikośaṃ kārayed ṛju
verses.tib: gnyid log sna sman mig sman khrus / slon pa'i rjes la rnon pos bkru / mas gtong gce'u 'drar byas pa yi / dud gce'u sbubs gsum drang por bya

verses.skt: mūlāgre ’ṅguṣṭhakolāsthipraveśaṃ dhūmanetrakam | tīkṣṇasnehanamadhyeṣu trīṇi catvāri pañca ca
verses.tib: rtsa ba mtheb shong rtse mo ni / rgya shug shong ba'i tshad du bya / de yi tshad ni rngub byed pa'i / sor ni nyi shu sum cu gnyis / bzhi bcu rno dang bar ma dang

verses.skt: aṅgulānāṃ kramāt pātuḥ pramāṇenāṣṭakāni tat | ṛjūpaviṣṭas taccetā vivṛtāsyas triparyayam
verses.tib: 'jam po la ni rim bzhin bya / drang por 'dug cing de la sems / kha gdangs nas ni lan gsum brngub

verses.skt: pidhāya cchidram ekaikaṃ dhūmaṃ nāsikayā pibet | prāk piben nāsayotkliṣṭe doṣe ghrāṇaśirogate
verses.tib: sna khung re re bkag nas ni / snar ni dud pa brngub par bya / mgo dang snar gtogs nad bskyod pa / dang por sna nas brngub par bya

verses.skt: utkleśanārthaṃ vaktreṇa viparītaṃ tu kaṇṭhage | mukhenaivodvamed dhūmaṃ nāsayā dṛgvighātakṛt
verses.tib: bskyod pa'i don du kho nas brngub / gre bar gtogs pa de las bzlog / du ba kha gnyis nad slon gyi / snar slon mig la gnod par byed

verses.skt: ākṣepamokṣaiḥ pātavyo dhūmas tu tris tribhis tribhiḥ | ahnaḥ pibet sakṛt snigdhaṃ dvir madhyaṃ śodhanaṃ param
verses.tib: du ba rngub dang 'byin pa yis / lan ni gsum gsum brngub par bya / 'jam po nyin gcig lan gcig gtang / bar ma lan gnyis sbyor ba ni / lan gsum lan bzhi gtang bar bya

verses.skt: triś catur vā mṛdau tatra dravyāṇy aguru guggulu | mustasthauṇeyaśaileyanaladośīravālakam
verses.tib: der sman gu gul a ka ru / gla sgang rdo dreg s+tho ni ya / spang spos ur shi ba la ka

verses.skt: varāṅgakauntīmadhukabilvamajjailavālukam | śrīveṣṭakaṃ sarjaraso dhyāmakaṃ madanaṃ plavam
verses.tib: shing tsha kon ti shing mngar dang / bil rkang e la ba lu ka / pog dkar shri be ta ka dang / gla ba sbra tshil bya ma ka

verses.skt: śallakī kuṅkumaṃ māṣā yavāḥ kundurukas tilāḥ | snehaḥ phalānāṃ sārāṇāṃ medo majjā vasā ghṛtam
verses.tib: pog nag gur gum ma sha dang / kun tu ru dang nas dang til / snum bcas / 'bras bu snying po dang / tshil dang rkang dang zhag dang mar

verses.skt: śamane śallakī lākṣā pṛthvīkā kamalotpalam | nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣalodhratvacaḥ sitā
verses.tib: zhi ba pog nag rgya skyegs dang / rgun 'brum pad+ma ut+pal / n+ya gro d+ha dang a shwad tha / u dum+bA ra blag sha dang

verses.skt: yaṣṭīmadhu suvarṇatvak padmakaṃ raktayaṣṭikā | gandhāś cākuṣṭhatagarās tīkṣṇe jyotiṣmatī niśā
verses.tib: seng phrom shun pa kha ra dang / shing mngar klu shing shug pa btsod / dri las rgya spos ru rta bskol / rnon po dzo ti sma ti dang

verses.skt: daśamūlamanohvālaṃ lākṣā śvetā phalatrayam | gandhadravyāṇi tīkṣṇāni gaṇo mūrdhavirecanaḥ
verses.tib: skyer pa dang ni rtsa ba bcu / ldong ros ba bla rgya skyegs dang / gi ri gar kar 'bras bu gsum / dri yi sman la ro rno ba'i / mgo bo'i bkru sman sde tshan no

verses.skt: jale sthitām ahorātram iṣīkāṃ dvādaśāṅgulām | piṣṭair dhūmauṣadhair evaṃ pañcakṛtvaḥ pralepayet
verses.tib: de dag zhag gcig nur spangs la / dud pa'i sman rnams btags nas ni / thur ma sor ni bcu gnyis la / lan lnga'i bar du byug par bya

verses.skt: vartir aṅguṣṭhakasthūlā yavamadhyā yathā bhavet | chāyāśuṣkāṃ vigarbhāṃ tāṃ snehābhyaktāṃ yathāyatham
verses.tib: gdar bu mthe bong tsam sbom la / nas kyi dbyibs dang 'dra bar bya / grib mar skam zhing khong stong med / snum gyis ji bzhin bskus byas la

verses.skt: dhūmanetrārpitāṃ pātum agnipluṣṭāṃ prayojayet | śarāvasaṃpuṭacchidre nāḍīṃ nyasya daśāṅgulām
verses.tib: brngub phyir me yis bsregs nas ni / dud pa'i gce'u sbyar bar bya / kham phor kha sbyar bu gar ni

verses.skt: aṣṭāṅgulāṃ vā vaktreṇa kāsavān dhūmam āpibet
verses.tib: gce'u sor bcu'am sor brgyad pa / bcug pa kha nas dud pa ni

verses.skt: kāsaḥ śvāsaḥ pīnaso visvaratvaṃ pūtir gandhaḥ pāṇḍutā keśadoṣaḥ | karṇāsyākṣisrāvakaṇḍvartijāḍyaṃ tandrā hidhmā dhūmapaṃ na spṛśanti || 22™ || hṛtkaṇṭhendriyasaṃśuddhir lāghavaṃ śirasaḥ śamaḥ | yatheritānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ samyakpītasya lakṣaṇam
verses.tib: lud pa can gyis brngub par bya / dud pa brngubs la lud pa dbugs mi bde / skad 'gags rnag dang dri mi zhim gdong skya / skra skyon rna mig 'dzag g.ya' rmongs bag dang / snyom dang skyigs bu cham pa'i nad mi 'byung

verses.skt: catuḥprakāro gaṇḍūṣaḥ snigdhaḥ śamanaśodhanau | ropaṇaś ca trayas tatra triṣu yojyāś calādiṣu
verses.tib: mkhur bkang rnam pa bzhi yin te / snum dang zhi byed sbyong rma 'tshob / de las gsum ni rlung la sogs

verses.skt: antyo vraṇaghnaḥ snigdho ’tra svādvamlapaṭusādhitaiḥ | snehaiḥ saṃśamanas tiktakaṣāyamadhurauṣadhaiḥ
verses.tib: gsum gtang tha ma rma la phan / 'dir sman mngar skyur lan tshwa dang / tsha dang snum ni bskol ba yin / zhi byed kha bska mngar sman bskol

verses.skt: śodhanas tiktakaṭvamlapaṭūṣṇai ropaṇaḥ punaḥ | kaṣāyatiktakais tatra snehaḥ kṣīraṃ madhūdakam
verses.tib: sbyong ba kha dang tsha dang skyur / rma 'tshob byed pa kha ba dang / bska ba'i sman ni bskol bar bya / de la snum dang 'o ma dang

verses.skt: śuktaṃ madyaṃ raso mūtraṃ dhānyāmlaṃ ca yathāyatham | kalkair yuktaṃ vipakvaṃ vā yathāsparśaṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi chu dang tsha dang chang / ba gcin 'bru yi khu ba rnams / sman ni ji lta ji lta dang / lde gur bcas pa bskol ba ni / ji tsam bzod pa rnam par sbyar

verses.skt: dantaharṣe dantacāle mukharoge ca vātike | sukhoṣṇam athavā śītaṃ tilakalkodakaṃ hitam
verses.tib: so brtse so ni 'gul ba dang / rlung las gyur pa'i kha nad la / dro 'jam tsam mam bsil ba yi / til chus mkhur ba bkang ba phan

verses.skt: gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇe nityaṃ tailaṃ māṃsaraso ’thavā | ūṣādāhānvite pāke kṣate cāgantusaṃbhave
verses.tib: rtag tu mkhur ba bkang ste gzhag / til mar dag gam sha khu bsngags / kha drod che tsha tshos pa dang / 'phral du rma ni byung ba dang

verses.skt: viṣe kṣārāgnidagdhe ca sarpir dhāryaṃ payo ’thavā | vaiśadyaṃ janayaty āśu saṃdadhāti mukhe vraṇān
verses.tib: dug / dang thal sman mes tshig la / zhun mar dag gom 'o mas dgang / sbrang rtsi mkhur bkang byas pas ni / kha yi dri ma sbyong byed cing / kha yi rma ni 'tshob byed yin

verses.skt: dāhatṛṣṇāpraśamanaṃ madhugaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam | dhānyāmlam āsyavairasyamaladaurgandhyanāśanam
verses.tib: kha tsha skom dad rab zhi byed / ro mi tshor dang dri ma che / kha mnam 'bras rtsabs bkang bas sel

verses.skt: tad evālavaṇaṃ śītaṃ mukhaśoṣaharaṃ param | āśu kṣārāmbugaṇḍūṣo bhinatti śleṣmaṇaś cayam
verses.tib: de nyid cung zad tsha bcas bsil / kha skams sel ba'i dam pa yin / thal sman rnon khus mkhur bkang bas / bad kan sogs pa myur du sel

verses.skt: sukhoṣṇodakagaṇḍūṣair jāyate vaktralāghavam | nivāte sātape svinnamṛditaskandhakandharaḥ
verses.tib: chu tshan dro 'jam mkhur bkang bas / kha ni yang zhing bde bar byed / rlung med nyi tshan bcas par ni / phrag pa mjing bar dugs bya mnye

verses.skt: gaṇḍūṣam apiban kiñcidunnatāsyo vidhārayet | kaphapūrṇāsyatā yāvat sravadghrāṇākṣatāthavā
verses.tib: mkhur ba bkang nas gdong pa ni / cung zad bteg ste ji srid na / bad kan gyis ni kha gang ba'ang / sna mig 'dzag pa'i bar du gzhag

verses.skt: asaṃcāryo mukhe pūrṇe gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavaḍo ’nyathā
verses.tib: kha bkang mi spo bzhag mkhur bkang / gzhan du khar brngub par 'gyur ro

verses.skt: manyāśiraḥkarṇamukhākṣirogāḥ prasekakaṇṭhāmayavaktraśoṣāḥ | hṛllāsatandrārucipīnasāś ca sādhyā viśeṣāt kavaḍagraheṇa
verses.tib: gnye'u rengs mgo mig rna nad kha nag dang / mchil mang gre nad snying ga sra ba dang / snying 'phar snyam dang cham pa yi ga 'chus / mkhur bkang bshad pa'i sman rnams kyi

verses.skt: kalko rasakriyā cūrṇas trividhaṃ pratisāraṇam
verses.tib: lde gu sman khu phye ma ste / kha mur bya ba rnam gsum yin

verses.skt: yuñjyāt tat kapharogeṣu gaṇḍūṣavihitauṣadhaiḥ | mukhālepas tridhā doṣaviṣahā varṇakṛc ca saḥ
verses.tib: de ni bad kan nad la gtang / gdong bskus gsum ste nad sel dang / dug sel kha dog bzang byed pa'o

verses.skt: vyādher apacayaḥ puṣṭir vaiśadyaṃ vaktralāghavam | indriyāṇāṃ prasādaś ca kavaḍe śuddhilakṣaṇam
hīnāj jāḍyakaphotkleśāv arasajñānam eva ca | atiyogān mukhe pākaḥ śoṣatṛṣṇāruciklamaḥ
uṣṇo vātakaphe śastaḥ śeṣeṣv atyarthaśītalaḥ | tripramāṇaś caturbhāgatribhāgārdhāṅgulonnatiḥ
verses.tib: de drod bad kan rlung la bsngags / lhag ma la ni rab bsil ba / de yi tshad dpangs sor bzhi cha / sum cha phyed de rnam pa gsum

verses.skt: aśuṣkasya sthitis tasya śuṣko dūṣayati cchavim | tam ārdrayitvāpanayet tadante ’bhyaṅgam ācaret
verses.tib: ma bskams bar du de bzhag gi / bskams na pags pa la gnod 'gyur / de nas spangs nas bkru bar bya / de yi rjes la bsku byug bya

verses.skt: vivarjayed divāsvapnabhāṣyāgnyātapaśukkrudhaḥ | na yojyaḥ pīnase ’jīrṇe dattanasye hanugrahe
verses.tib: nyin par gnyid log mang smra khro / me tshan nyi tshan mya ngan spang / de ni cham pa sna sman gtang / ma zhu 'gram 'thams yi ga 'chus / mtshan gnyid ma log la mi gtang / de ni legs par spyod pa yis / dus min skra dkar ngo khabs dang

verses.skt: arocake jāgarite sa tu hanti suyojitaḥ | akālapalitavyaṅgavalītimiranīlikāḥ
verses.tib: nyin par gnyid log mang smra khro / me tshan nyi tshan mya ngan spang / de ni cham pa sna sman gtang / ma zhu 'gram 'thams yi ga 'chus / mtshan gnyid ma log la mi gtang / de ni legs par spyod pa yis / dus min skra dkar ngo khabs dang

verses.skt: kolamajjā vṛṣān mūlaṃ śābaraṃ gaurasarṣapāḥ | siṃhīmūlaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇā dārvītvaṅ nistuṣā yavāḥ
verses.tib: rgya shug snying po ba sha'i rtsa / seng phrom yungs kar dkar po rnams / sing hi'i rtsa ba til nag dang / skyer ba'i shun pa rme'u rnams

verses.skt: darbhamūlahimośīraśirīṣamiśitaṇḍulāḥ | kumudotpalakalhāradūrvāmadhukacandanam
verses.tib: 'jag rtsa tsan+dan ur shir / shiR+sha sha ta pus pa 'bras / ku mud ut+pal / ka la ha / dUr ba shing mngar tsan+dan rnams

verses.skt: kālīyakatilośīramāṃsītagarapadmakam | tālīśagundrāpuṇḍrāhvayaṣṭīkāśanatāguru
verses.tib: ka li ya ka ur shi ti / spang spos rgya spos shug pa rnams / da lis kun dra puN+Da rI / shing mngar rgya spos a ru ra

verses.skt: ity ardhārdhoditā lepā hemantādiṣu ṣaṭ smṛtāḥ | mukhālepanaśīlānāṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhavati darśanam
verses.tib: de ltar tshigs bcad phyed kyis bshad / bsku ba dgun stod sogs drug sbyar / gdong bsku ba la goms pa rnams / mthong ba brtan par 'gyur ba dang

verses.skt: vadanaṃ cāparimlānaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ tāmarasopamam | abhyaṅgasekapicavo vastiś ceti caturvidham
verses.tib: gdong ni yongs su mi rnying la / 'jam zhing pad+ma 'dra bar 'gyur / bsku dang blugs dang ras bal can / pags pas g.yogs dang rnam pa bzhi

verses.skt: mūrdhatailaṃ bahuguṇaṃ tad vidyād uttarottaram | tatrābhyaṅgaḥ prayoktavyo raukṣyakaṇḍūmalādiṣu
verses.tib: de ni spyi bo'i til mar te / phyi bzhin du ni yon tan che / de la byugs pa rtsub pa dang / g.ya' dang dri ma can la sbyar

verses.skt: arūṃṣikāśirastodadāhapākavraṇeṣu tu | pariṣekaḥ picuḥ keśaśātasphuṭanadhūpane
verses.tib: rlugs pa glog pa glad gzer dang / cha dang rma smin rnags la gtang / ras bal snum can skra 'byi dang

verses.skt: netrastambhe ca vastis tu prasuptyarditajāgare | nāsāsyaśoṣe timire śiroroge ca dāruṇe
verses.tib: gza' zhugs mig ni rengs la gtang / bags bcibs mgo bo tshor ba med / kha yo gnyid ni yar ba dang / kha dang sna skam rab rib dang / mi bzad mgo nad dag la sbyar

verses.skt: vidhis tasya niṣaṇṇasya pīṭhe jānusame mṛdau | śuddhāktasvinnadehasya dinānte gavyamāhiṣam
verses.tib: de yi cho ga 'dug pa la / khri'u pus mnyam 'jam pa la / lus bkrus bsku zhing dugs byas la / dgongs ka ba'am ma he yi

verses.skt: dvādaśāṅgulavistīrṇaṃ carmapaṭṭaṃ śiraḥsamam | ākarṇabandhanasthānaṃ lalāṭe vastraveṣṭite
verses.tib: pags pa mgo bo dang mnyam la / rgyar ni sor ni bcu gnyis pa / rna ba'i mthar thug bar bcings pa / 'phral ba gos kyis dkris pa ni

verses.skt: cailaveṇikayā baddhvā māṣakalkena lepayet | tato yathāvyādhi śṛtaṃ snehaṃ koṣṇaṃ niṣecayet
verses.tib: gos sam lan bus bcings byas la / ma sha'i lde gus bsku bar bya / de nas nad dmigs ci 'dra la / snum bskol ba ni dro 'jam tsam

verses.skt: ūrdhvaṃ keśabhuvo yāvad aṅgulaṃ dhārayec ca tam | āvaktranāsikotkledād daśāṣṭau ṣaṭ calādiṣu
verses.tib: de ni spyi bo man chad nas / skra drung sor gcig nub tsam blugs / kha dang snam tshul phyin par gzhag / de ni rlung sogs nad rnams la / stong phrag bcu dang brgyad drug gzhag

verses.skt: mātrāsahasrāṇy aruje tv ekaṃ skandhādi mardayet | muktasnehasya paramaṃ saptāhaṃ tasya sevanam
verses.tib: nad mad sa la stong phrag gcig / mar gsar phrag pa la sogs mnye / de ltar zhag bdun blugs par bya

verses.skt: dhārayet pūraṇaṃ karṇe karṇamūlaṃ vimardayan | rujaḥ syān mārdavaṃ yāvan mātrāśatam avedane
verses.tib: rna ba gang bar blugs te gzhag / rna ba'i rtsa la mnye bar bya / nad rtse zhil gyi bar bya zhing / rna ba se gol brgya par gzhag

verses.skt: yāvat paryeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalam | nimeṣonmeṣakālena samaṃ mātrā tu sā smṛtā
verses.tib: pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga ni / lag rtses bskor ba'i bar dang ni / mig 'byed 'jums dang mnyam pa yi / yun ni grangs kyi tshad du bshad

verses.skt: kacasadanasitatvapiñjaratvaṃ pariphuṭanaṃ śirasaḥ samīrarogān | jayati janayatīndriyaprasādaṃ svarahanumūrdhabalaṃ ca mūrdhatailam
