verses.tib: spyi bo'i til mar sbyar ba bskus pas ni / skra dkar dmar ser skra 'byi gza' zhugs dang / mgo bo'i rlung nad sel zhing dpang po gsal / skad gdangs 'gram pa mgo yi stobs skyed byed

verses.skt: sarveṣām akṣirogāṇām ādāv āścyotanaṃ hitam | ruktodakaṇḍugharṣāśrudāharāganibarhaṇam
verses.tib: mig nad dag ni thams cad la / dang por sman thigs blugs pas ni / zug na g.ya' drud mchi ma 'dzag / mig tsha mig dmar rnams la phan

verses.skt: uṣṇaṃ vāte kaphe koṣṇaṃ tac chītaṃ raktapittayoḥ | nivātasthasya vāmena pāṇinonmīlya locanam
verses.tib: rlung la dron po bad dro 'jam / khrag mkhris la ni de bsil bsngags / rlung med gnas su 'dug nas ni / lag pa g.yon pas mig phye la

verses.skt: śuktau pralambayānyena picuvartyā kanīnike | daśa dvādaśa vā bindūn dvyaṅgulād avasecayet
verses.tib: nya phyis nang sbyar ras bal ni / bsnyad pa'i thigs ba blugs bya ba / sor gnyis tsam spangs las mig grwa / thigs pa bcu'am bcu gnyis blugs

verses.skt: tataḥ pramṛjya mṛdunā cailena kaphavātayoḥ | anyena koṣṇapānīyaplutena svedayen mṛdu
verses.tib: de nas gos 'jam dag gis phyi / rlung dang bad kan can dag la / gos 'jam gzhan ni chu dron la / sbangs pas dugs ni 'jam po bya

verses.skt: atyuṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ rugrāgadṛṅnāśāyākṣisecanam | atiśītaṃ tu kurute nistodastambhavedanāḥ
verses.tib: mig sman blugs pa rab tsha rnos / na zhing mig dmar rtul bar 'gyur / shin tu grang bas zug pa dang / 'dzums mi shes dang na bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kaṣāyavartmatāṃ gharṣaṃ kṛcchrād unmeṣaṇaṃ bahu | vikāravṛddhim atyalpaṃ saṃrambham aparisrutam
verses.tib: rtsub cing mig ni 'byed dkar 'gyur / shin tu chung bas nad dkyel skyed / ma pho bas ni thu bar byed / bskus legs nad rtsa sna sul dang / kha yi sbubs su sman gyis khyab / spyi bor gtogs pa'i nad kyi ni / dri ma dpyis ni 'byin par byed

verses.skt: gatvā saṃdhiśiroghrāṇamukhasrotāṃsi bheṣajam | ūrdhvagān nayane nyastam apavartayate malān
verses.tib: rtsub cing mig ni 'byed dkar 'gyur / shin tu chung bas nad dkyel skyed / ma pho bas ni thu bar byed / bskus legs nad rtsa sna sul dang / kha yi sbubs su sman gyis khyab / spyi bor gtogs pa'i nad kyi ni / dri ma dpyis ni 'byin par byed

verses.skt: athāñjanaṃ śuddhatanor netramātrāśraye male | pakvaliṅge ’lpaśophātikaṇḍūpaicchilyalakṣite
verses.tib: de nas lus sbyangs mig sman bsku / mig tsam la ni gnas gyur pa / cung zad skrangs dang shin tu g.ya' / rdu ma chags pas smin shes shing

verses.skt: mandagharṣāśrurāge ’kṣṇi prayojyaṃ ghanadūṣike | ārte pittakaphāsṛgbhir mārutena viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: cung zad drud dmar mchi ma 'dzag / mig rdu stug la gtang bar bya / bad kan dang ni khrag mkhris dang / mchog tu rlung gis gzir la bsku

verses.skt: lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanam iti tridhā | añjanaṃ lekhanaṃ tatra kaṣāyāmlapaṭūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: mig sman phyi dang rmag so dang / gsal bar mthong ste rnam pa gsum

verses.skt: ropaṇaṃ tiktakair dravyaiḥ svāduśītaiḥ prasādanam | tīkṣṇāñjanābhisaṃtapte nayane tat prasādanam
verses.tib: de la phyi ba'i mig sman ni / bska dang skyur dang tsha dang kha / rma gso sman ni kha ba ste / gsal sman mngar dang bsil ba yin

verses.skt: prayujyamānaṃ labhate pratyañjanasamāhvayam | daśāṅgulā tanur madhye śalākā mukulānanā
verses.tib: thur ma sor bcu dbus phra la / rtse mo sri zhing kha 'bus 'dra

verses.skt: praśastā lekhane tāmrī ropaṇe kālalohajā | aṅgulī ca suvarṇotthā rūpyajā ca prasādane
verses.tib: phyi ba'i thur ma zangs kyi bsngags / rma gso lcags nag byas sor tsam / bzang po gsal bar byed pa ni / gser dang dngul las byas pa bsngags

verses.skt: piṇḍo rasakriyā cūrṇas tridhaivāñjanakalpanā | gurau madhye laghau doṣe tāṃ krameṇa prayojayet
verses.tib: gdar bu khu ba phye mas te / mig sman rnam gsum nyid du / brtag / de ni mig nad lci 'bring dang / yang ba la ni rim bzhin sbyar

verses.skt: piṇḍasya tīkṣṇadravyasya mṛdudravyakṛtasya ca | hareṇumātraṃ dviguṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ kathayanty api
rasakriyāyām apy evaṃ viḍaṅgaphalamātrakam | śalākāṃ dviguṇāṃ tīkṣṇe cūrṇe ca triguṇāṃ mṛdau
hareṇumātrā piṇḍasya vellamātrā rasakriyā | tīkṣṇasya dviguṇaṃ tasya mṛdunaś cūrṇitasya ca
dve śalāke tu tīkṣṇasya tisras taditarasya ca | niśi svapne na madhyāhne mlāne noṣṇagabhastibhiḥ
verses.tib: mtshan mo nyal dang nyi ma'i gung / zos 'thungs nyi ma tsha ba yis

verses.skt: akṣirogāya doṣāḥ syur vardhitotpīḍitadrutāḥ | prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca tacchāntyai vyabhre ’rke ’to ’ñjayet sadā
verses.tib: mig gi nad ni 'phel ba dang / dkyel ni skye dang 'khrugs par 'gyur / de bas de zhi phyir na dgongs / nyi ma sprin bral dus su bslu

verses.skt: vadanty anye tu na divā prayojyaṃ tīkṣṇam añjanam | virekadurbalaṃ cakṣur ādityaṃ prāpya sīdati
verses.tib: gzhan dag smra ba nyin par ni / mig sman rnon po gtang mi bya / bkrus pas nyam chung gyur pa'i mig / nyi ma bltas na gnod par 'gyur

verses.skt: svapnena rātrau kālasya saumyatvena ca tarpitā | śītasātmyā dṛg āgneyī sthiratāṃ labhate punaḥ
verses.tib: mtshan mo gnyid ni log pa dang / zla dus yin pas rtas 'gyur te / mig ni me yi rang bzhin pas / bsil bas gnad med bsten par 'gyur

verses.skt: atyudrikte balāse tu lekhanīye ’thavā gade | kāmam ahny api nātyuṣṇe tīkṣṇam akṣṇi prayojayet
verses.tib: mig nad bad kan shas che ba'am / phyi zhing gsal bar bya ba las / rab cha min pa'i nyin par yang / mig sman rnon po blugs par 'dod

verses.skt: aśmano janma lohasya tata eva ca tīkṣṇatā | upaghāto ’pi tenaiva tathā netrasya tejasaḥ
verses.tib: lcags ni rdo las 'byung ba yin / rno ba de nyid las byung yang / de nyid kyis ni gnod byed nus / mig gi rang bzhin de dang 'dra

verses.skt: na rātrāv api śīte ’ti netre tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ hitam | doṣam asrāvayet stabdhaṃ kaṇḍūjāḍyādikāri tat
verses.tib: dgun tshe mtshan mo mig sman ni / rnon po phan pa ma yin te / 'dzag mi 'gyur bas mig rengs dang / g.ya' dang mi gsal la sogs skyed / mig sman mi gtang 'jigs dang slon / khrus btang zan zos shugs kyis nyen / khros dang rims btab mig phyir byung / blang nad mya ngan gnyid ma log

verses.skt: nāñjayed bhītavamitaviriktāśitavegite | kruddhajvaritatāntākṣiśirorukśokajāgare
verses.tib: dgun tshe mtshan mo mig sman ni / rnon po phan pa ma yin te / 'dzag mi 'gyur bas mig rengs dang / g.ya' dang mi gsal la sogs skyed / mig sman mi gtang 'jigs dang slon / khrus btang zan zos shugs kyis nyen / khros dang rims btab mig phyir byung / blang nad mya ngan gnyid ma log

verses.skt: adṛṣṭe ’rke śiraḥsnāte pītayor dhūmamadyayoḥ | ajīrṇe ’gnyarkasaṃtapte divāsupte pipāsite
verses.tib: nyi ma ma mthong mgo bkrus dang / chang 'thungs dud pa brngubs pa dang / kha zas ma zhu nyi tshan gdungs / nyin nyal skom pa la mi gtang

verses.skt: atitīkṣṇamṛdustokabahvacchaghanakarkaśam | atyarthaśītalaṃ taptam añjanaṃ nāvacārayet
verses.tib: mig sman rab rno 'jam dang nyung / mang sla ska dang rtsub pa dang / shin tu bsil dang tsha ba yi / mig sman bsku bar mi bya'o

verses.skt: athānumīlayan dṛṣṭim antaḥ saṃcārayec chanaiḥ | añjite vartmanī kiñcic cālayec caivam añjanam
verses.tib: des na mig ni ma phye bar / dal gyis nang du khyab par bya / mig sman bskus nas mig mchu ni / cung zad bskyod la mig sman ni

verses.skt: tīkṣṇaṃ vyāpnoti sahasā na conmeṣanimeṣaṇam | niṣpīḍanaṃ ca vartmabhyāṃ kṣālanaṃ vā samācaret
verses.tib: rnon pos myur du khyab par 'gyur / dbye dang 'dzums par mi bya'o / mig mchu gnyis ni bsdam pa dang / bkru ba dag ni mi bya'o

verses.skt: apetauṣadhasaṃrambhaṃ nirvṛtaṃ nayanaṃ yadā | vyādhidoṣartuyogyābhir adbhiḥ prakṣālayet tadā
verses.tib: gang tshe mig sman gyis bskus pa'i / sman gyi rtsom pa zhi gyur na / nad kyi dmigs dang mthun pa yi / chu yis de tshe bkru bar bya

verses.skt: dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhakenākṣi tato vāmaṃ savāsasā | ūrdhvavartmani saṃgṛhya śodhyaṃ vāmena cetarat
verses.tib: de nas gos 'jam bcas pa yi / mthe bong dang ni mdzub mo gnyis / mig ni ci ran phye ste phyi / g.yon pas g.yas pa phyi bar bya

verses.skt: vartmaprāpto ’ñjanād doṣo rogān kuryād ato ’nyathā | kaṇḍūjāḍye ’ñjanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ vā yojayet punaḥ
verses.tib: gzhan du mig sman blugs pa yis / mig mchu khyab pas nad skyed 'gyur / sman gyis g.ya' ba'am rtul gyur na / rnon po'i dud brngub par bya

verses.skt: tīkṣṇāñjanābhitapte tu cūrṇaṃ pratyañjanaṃ himam
verses.tib: mig sman rnon pos tsha gyur na / slar 'chos mig sman bsil byed gzhug

verses.skt: nayane tāmyati stabdhe śuṣke rūkṣe ’bhighātite | vātapittāture jihme śīrṇapakṣmāvilekṣaṇe
verses.tib: mig 'dzums mi shes rengs bag dang / skam dang rtsub dang snad pa dang / rlung mkhris nad gyur zhum bag dang / rdzi ma byi zhing g.yogs par mthong

verses.skt: kṛcchronmīlasirāharṣasirotpātatamo'rjunaiḥ | syandamanthānyatovātavātaparyāyaśukrakaiḥ
verses.tib: dbye dka' rtsa ni brtse ba dang / mig ni rtsa 'gyur mi mthong dang / dmar zhing mchi 'dzag klad phyed na / rlung nad kun 'gro ling tog can

verses.skt: āture śāntarāgāśruśūlasaṃrambhadūṣike | nivāte tarpaṇaṃ yojyaṃ śuddhayor mūrdhakāyayoḥ
verses.tib: mig nad brtse zhing mchi ma 'dzag / na zhing dmar la mig rdu chags / thun mong dus su nang par ram / dgongs ka gan rkyal nyal nas ni / lus dang mgo sbyang rlung med pa'i / gnas su brta ba'i sman gtang ngo / nas sam ma sha'i rjen zan gyis / mig sbubs mtha' bskor mnyam pa ni

verses.skt: kāle sādhāraṇe prātaḥ sāyaṃ vottānaśāyinaḥ | yavamāṣamayīṃ pālīṃ netrakośād bahiḥ samām
verses.tib: mig nad brtse zhing mchi ma 'dzag / na zhing dmar la mig rdu chags / thun mong dus su nang par ram / dgongs ka gan rkyal nyal nas ni / lus dang mgo sbyang rlung med pa'i / gnas su brta ba'i sman gtang ngo / nas sam ma sha'i rjen zan gyis / mig sbubs mtha' bskor mnyam pa ni

verses.skt: dvyaṅguloccāṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā yathāsvaṃ siddham āvapet | sarpir nimīlite netre taptāmbupravilāyitam
verses.tib: dpangs su sor gnyis rten byas la / nad dmigs ji bzhin sman bskol la / zhun mar chu tshan la bsros te / mig ni btsums par blugs par bya

verses.skt: naktāndhyavātatimirakṛcchrabodhādike vasām | āpakṣmāgrād athonmeṣaṃ śanakais tasya kurvataḥ
verses.tib: mtshan mo mi mthong rlung rab rig / dbye dka' la tshil zhun blugs / rdzi ma'i rtse nub bar bkang la / de nas bskyod cing dbye ba ni / de ni dal gyis byed du gzhug

verses.skt: mātrā vigaṇayet tatra vartmasaṃdhisitāsite | dṛṣṭau ca kramaśo vyādhau śataṃ trīṇi ca pañca ca
verses.tib: tshad bgrang bya ba de la ni / mig mchu mig 'gram dkar nag nad / grangs brgya sum brgya lnga brgya dang

verses.skt: śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca daśa manthe daśānile | pitte ṣaṭ svasthavṛtte ca balāse pañca dhārayet
verses.tib: brgya phrag bdun dang brgyad rim bzhin / dkrugs dang rlung la grangs stong ste / mkhris pa nad med la drug brgya / bad kan la ni lnga brgya gzhag

verses.skt: kṛtvāpāṅge tato dvāraṃ snehaṃ pātre nigālayet | pibec ca dhūmaṃ nekṣeta vyoma rūpaṃ ca bhāsvaram
verses.tib: de nas mig 'gram 'dzag sgo bya / sman mar snod du gzags byas la / dud pa brngubs nas nam mkha' dang / gzugs 'tsher ba ni blta mi bya

verses.skt: itthaṃ pratidinaṃ vāyau pitte tv ekāntaraṃ kaphe | svasthe tu dvyantaraṃ dadyād ātṛpter iti yojayet
verses.tib: de ltar rlung la nyin re bya / mkhris pa nyin re'i bar du gcod / bad kan bder gnas gnyis par bcad / tshim / par 'gyur gyi bar du gtang

verses.skt: prakāśakṣamatā svāsthyaṃ viśadaṃ laghu locanam | tṛpte viparyayo ’tṛpte ’titṛpte śleṣmajā rujaḥ
verses.tib: tshim pas gsal bar mthong nus shing / bde zhing mig yang dri ma med / ma tshim pa las go bzlog yin / tshim drags bad kan nad skyed 'gyur

verses.skt: snehapītā tanur iva klāntā dṛṣṭir hi sīdati | tarpaṇānantaraṃ tasmād dṛgbalādhānakāriṇam
verses.tib: de ni lus kyis snum 'thungs ltar / mi gsal mthong ba nyam chung 'gyur / de bas lta ba'i rjes la ni / mthong ba'i stobs ni skyed byed la

verses.skt: puṭapākaṃ prayuñjīta pūrvokteṣv eva yakṣmasu | sa vāte snehanaḥ śleṣmasahite lekhano hitaḥ
verses.tib: sngar bshad pa yi mig nad la / phur ma btsos pa sbyar bar bya / de ni rlung las snum can te / bad kan bcas te phyi ba ban

verses.skt: dṛgdaurbalye ’nile pitte rakte svasthe prasādanaḥ | bhūśayaprasahānūpamedomajjavasāmiṣaiḥ
verses.tib: mthong nyams rlung dang mkhris bcas dang / khrag mkhris bde gnas la gsal byed / khung nas mthus tshol rlan can gyi / tshil dang rkang dang zhag sha rlon

verses.skt: snehanaṃ payasā piṣṭair jīvanīyaiś ca kalpayet | mṛgapakṣiyakṛnmāṃsamuktāyastāmrasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma dag dang btags pa dang / 'tsho byed dag dang sbyar ba'i snum / ri dwags bya yi mcher pa sha / mu tig lcags zangs rgyam tsha dung

verses.skt: srotojaśaṅkhaphenālair lekhanaṃ mastukalkitaiḥ | mṛgapakṣiyakṛnmajjavasāntrahṛdayāmiṣaiḥ
verses.tib: rgya mtsho'i lbu ba lig bu mig / ba bla zhog chur sbyar bya / ri dwags bya yi mcher pa rkang / lto tshil rgyu ma snying dang sha

verses.skt: madhuraiḥ saghṛtaiḥ stanyakṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ prasādanam | bilvamātraṃ pṛthak piṇḍaṃ māṃsabheṣajakalkayoḥ
verses.tib: mngar bag mar bcas nu zhor bcas / btags pa gsal bar byed pa yin / sha dang sman gyi lde gu ni / gong bu srang gcig so sor byas

verses.skt: urubūkavaṭāmbhojapattraiḥ snehādiṣu kramāt | veṣṭayitvā mṛdā liptaṃ dhavadhanvanagomayaiḥ
verses.tib: e raN n+ya gro pad+ma yi / lo ma snum pos rim bzhin du / dkris la 'byin pas byugs nas ni / da ba dgon pa'i lci ba'i me

verses.skt: pacet pradīptair agnyābhaṃ pakvaṃ niṣpīḍya tadrasam | netre tarpaṇavad yuñjyāt śataṃ dve trīṇi dhārayet
verses.tib: 'bar bar yongs su bsreg par bya / tshos nas de yi khu ba btsir / mig tu brta ba'i sman ltar blugs / phyi dang snum dang bsal ba la / brgya phrag gcig gnyis gsum car bzhag

verses.skt: lekhanasnehanāntyeṣu koṣṇau pūrvau himo ’paraḥ | dhūmapo ’nte tayor eva yogās tatra ca tṛptivat
verses.tib: dang por dro 'jam phyi bsil blugs / de nyid rjes la dud pa brngub / des ni sbyor ba brta dang mtshungs / brta dang phur btsos thigs pa blugs

verses.skt: tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyānarhe na yojayet | yāvanty ahāni yuñjīta dvis tato hitabhāg bhavet
verses.tib: sna sman mi bya la mi gtang / ji srid dus ni sman gtong ba / de yi nyis 'gyur 'phrod pa bza'

verses.skt: mālatīmallikāpuṣpair baddhākṣo nivasen niśām
verses.tib: me tog dzA ti ma li kas / mig bcings mtshan mo gnas par bya

verses.skt: sarvātmanā netrabalāya yatnaṃ kurvīta nasyāñjanatarpaṇādyaiḥ | dṛṣṭiś ca naṣṭā vividhaṃ jagac ca tamomayaṃ jāyata ekarūpam
verses.tib: sna sman mig sman brta ba la sogs pas / mig mthu bskyed phyir kun tu 'bad par bya / mthong ba nyams na 'gro ba sna tshogs pa'ang / mun pa'i rang bzhin tshul gcig nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: nānāvidhānāṃ śalyānāṃ nānādeśaprabodhinām | āhartum abhyupāyo yas tad yantraṃ yac ca darśane
verses.tib: bshad par bya'o / zug rngu rnam pa sna tshogs dang / lus ni sna tshogs gnod byed pa / 'byin ba'i thabs su gang gyur pa

verses.skt: arśobhagandarādīnāṃ śastrakṣārāgniyojane | śeṣāṅgaparirakṣāyāṃ tathā vastyādikarmaṇi
verses.tib: spyad yin de bzhin gzhang 'brum dang / mtshan par rdo la sogs brta ba dang / gtsags bu thal sman me btab pa'i / yan lag lhag ma bsrung phyir dang / mas gtong la sogs spyad ma gtogs

verses.skt: ghaṭikālābuśṛṅgaṃ ca jāmbavauṣṭhādikāni ca | anekarūpakāryāṇi yantrāṇi vividhāny ataḥ
verses.tib: bum pa ku ba rA dang ni / 'dzam bu'i mchu la sogs spyad yin / gang phyir cha spyad cho ga bzhin / sna tshogs tshul du brdung bya ba

verses.skt: vikalpya kalpayet buddhyā yathāsthūlaṃ tu vakṣyate | tulyāni kaṅkasiṃharkṣakākādimṛgapakṣiṇām
verses.tib: blo yis rnam dpyad bya ba ni / rags rim tsam zhig bstan pa yin / seng ge kang+ka dom bya rog / bya sogs kha 'dra ba'i

verses.skt: mukhair mukhāni yantrāṇāṃ kuryāt tatsaṃjñakāni ca | aṣṭādaśāṅgulāyāmāny āyasāni ca bhūriśaḥ
verses.tib: mchu can cha spyad byas nas ni / de yi ming yang gdags par bya / phal cher lcags kyi rgyu las ni / srid du sor ni bco brgyad pa

verses.skt: masūrākāraparyantaiḥ kaṇṭhe baddhāni kīlakaiḥ | vidyāt svastikayantrāṇi mūle ’ṅkuśanatāni ca
verses.tib: skam pa 'brel pa'i mtshams su ni / sran chung lta bu'i gzer gdab pa / rtsa ba lcags kyu ltar gug pa'i / cha spyad bde legs yin zhes bya / rtse mo g.yung drung lta bu'o

verses.skt: tair dṛḍhair asthisaṃlagnaśalyāharaṇam iṣyate | kīlabaddhavimuktāgrau saṃdaṃśau ṣoḍaśāṅgulau
verses.tib: de ni brtan par rus zug pa'i / zug rngu 'byin la sbyar bar bya / gzer btab rtse mo gyes pa dang / skam pa yin te sor bcu drug

verses.skt: tvaksirāsnāyupiśitalagnaśalyāpakarṣaṇau | ṣaḍaṅgulo ’nyo haraṇe sūkṣmaśalyopapakṣmaṇām
verses.tib: de ni pags pa rtsa rgyus shar / zhen pa'i zug rngu 'byin la sbyar / skam pa sor drug zug rngu phra / rdzi ma ma rungs 'byin la sbyar

verses.skt: mucuṇḍī sūkṣmadantarjur mūle rucakabhūṣaṇā | gambhīravraṇamāṃsānām armaṇaḥ śeṣitasya ca
verses.tib: so phra drang zhing rtsa ba ni / gdu bus brgyan pa mu tsa ti / des rma gting du zug pa dang / mig mdzer gting du lus la sbyar

verses.skt: dve dvādaśāṅgule matsyatālavat dvyekatālake | tālayantre smṛte karṇanāḍīśalyāpahāriṇī
verses.tib: nya mgo 'dra bar sor bcu gnyis / cha spyad gnyis pa gcig pa bya / nya mgo lta bu zhes bshad de / rna khung zug rngu 'byin la sbyar

verses.skt: nāḍīyantrāṇi suṣirāṇy ekānekamukhāni ca | srotogatānāṃ śalyānām āmayānāṃ ca darśane
verses.tib: cha spyad sbu gu can khong stong / rtse mo gcig gam mang po bya / des ni bu ga'i zug rngu dang / nad yod blta dang dbyung ba dang

verses.skt: kriyāṇāṃ sukaratvāya kuryād ācūṣaṇāya ca | tadvistāraparīṇāhadairghyaṃ sroto'nurodhataḥ
verses.tib: bya ba sla bar bya phyir dang / dgang bar bya ba'i don du bya / de yi zheng dang sbom srid tshad / bu ga'i tshad las dpag par bya

verses.skt: daśāṅgulārdhanāhāntaḥkaṇṭhaśalyāvalokinī | nāḍī pañcamukhacchidrā catuṣkarṇasya saṃgrahe
verses.tib: srid du sor bcu sbom sor lnga / gre ba'i zug rngu rtog byed yin / rtse mo lnga pa bu ga can / rtse mo bzhi la spyi mdud bya

verses.skt: vāraṅgasya dvikarṇasya tricchidrā tatpramāṇataḥ | vāraṅgakarṇasaṃsthānānāhadairghyānurodhataḥ
verses.tib: cha spyad thur ma gnyis pa ni / bu ga gsum pa de'i tshad bya / cha spyad bya ba rang gi dbyibs / sbom dang chu yi tshad / mnyam pa'i

verses.skt: nāḍīr evaṃvidhāś cānyā draṣṭuṃ śalyāni kārayet | padmakarṇikayā mūrdhni sadṛśī dvādaśāṅgulā
verses.tib: sbu gu de 'dra gzhan dag kyang / cha spyad shes par byed du gzhug / rtse mo pad+ma'i snying po 'dra / srid du sor ni bcu gnyis pa

verses.skt: caturthasuṣirā nāḍī śalyanirghātinī matā | arśasāṃ gostanākāraṃ yantrakaṃ caturaṅgulam
verses.tib: bzhi cha khong stong byas sbu gu / zug rngu 'byin pa yin par bshad / gzhang 'brum cha spyad pa yi ni / nu sor 'dra ba sor bzhi pa

verses.skt: nāhe pañcāṅgulaṃ puṃsāṃ pramadānāṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam | dvicchidraṃ darśane vyādher ekacchidraṃ tu karmaṇi
verses.tib: skyes pa'i sor lngas 'khyud pa ste / bud med sor drug gis 'khyud bya / nad lta ba la bu ga gnyis / las la bu ga gcig pa bya

verses.skt: madhye ’sya tryaṅgulaṃ chidram aṅguṣṭhodaravistṛtam | ardhāṅgulocchritodvṛttakarṇikaṃ ca tadūrdhvataḥ
verses.tib: dbus kyi bu ga sor gsum pa / mthe bong shong ba tsam du bya / de steng rtse mo zlum po ni / dpangs su sor ni phyed par bya

verses.skt: śamyākhyaṃ tādṛg acchidraṃ yantram arśaḥprapīḍanam | sarvathāpanayed oṣṭhaṃ chidrād ūrdhvaṃ bhagandare
verses.tib: khar dkrol de 'dra bug med / cha spyad gzhang 'brum btsir la sbyar / mtshan par rdol la rnam kun tu / bu ga yan chad bsal bar bya

verses.skt: ghrāṇārbudārśasām ekacchidrā nāḍyaṅguladvayā | pradeśinīparīṇāhā syād bhagandarayantravat
verses.tib: sna yi shu ba'i 'brum pa la / bu ga gcig pa sor gnyis bya / zheng du mdzub mo'i tshad tsam las / mtshan par rdol gyi spyad 'drar bya

verses.skt: aṅgulītrāṇakaṃ dāntaṃ vārkṣaṃ vā caturaṅgulam | dvicchidraṃ gostanākāraṃ tadvaktravivṛtau sukham
verses.tib: sor mo bsrung phyir ba so'am / shing gis shubs ni sor bzhi bya / ba yi nu 'dra bu ga gnyis / de yis kha ni dbye bar bya

verses.skt: yonivraṇekṣaṇaṃ madhye suṣiraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam | mudrābaddhaṃ caturbhittam ambhojamukulānanam
verses.tib: mo mtshan rma brtag dbus su ni / khong stong sor ni bcu drug pa / phyogs bzhir gdu bus bcing bar bya / rtse mo pad+ma kha zlum 'dra

verses.skt: catuḥśalākam ākrāntaṃ mūle tad vikasen mukhe | yantre nāḍīvraṇābhyaṅgakṣālanāya ṣaḍaṅgule
verses.tib: thur ma bzhi ni mnan pa yis / rtsa ba bsdams na kha dbye bya / cha spyad 'jam rtsi'i sbubs 'dra la / rtsa ba mtheb shong rtse sran shong

verses.skt: vastiyantrākṛtī mūle mukhe ’ṅguṣṭhakalāyakhe | agrato ’karṇike mūle nibaddhamṛducarmaṇī
verses.tib: rtse mo gag pa med pa la / rtsa bar lpags 'jam rkyal bu bcing / rma yi phug ni 'chas pa dang / rma bkru ba la sbyar bar bya / 'od ma'i sbu gu'am sgro rtsa ni

verses.skt: dvidvārā nalikā picchanalikā vodakodare | dhūmavastyādiyantrāṇi nirdiṣṭāni yathāyatham
verses.tib: 'dra ba kha gnyis dmu rdzing spyad / dud pa mas gtong la sogs spyad / rang rang gi ni skabs su smras

verses.skt: tryaṅgulāsyaṃ bhavec chṛṅgaṃ cūṣaṇe ’ṣṭādaśāṅgulam | agre siddhārthakacchidraṃ sunaddhaṃ cūcukākṛti
verses.tib: rdabs rwa kha zheng sor gsum pa / dpangs su sor brgyad pa'am bcu / rtse mo'i bu ga g.yungs kar shong / legs bkag nu sor dbyibs 'dra bya

verses.skt: syād dvādaśāṅgulo ’lābur nāhe tv aṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ | catustryaṅgulavṛttāsyo dīpto ’ntaḥ śleṣmaraktahṛt
verses.tib: ku ba srid du sor bcu gnyis / khyud skor sor ni bco brgyad pa / kha zlum sor ni gsum mam bzhi / nang 'bar bad kan khrag 'dren byed

verses.skt: tadvad ghaṭī hitā gulmavilayonnamane ca sā | śalākākhyāni yantrāṇi nānākarmākṛtīni ca
verses.tib: de bzhin bum pa de 'dra ba / glan pas skran yang 'ju bar byed / thur ma zhes bya'i cha spyad ni / las dang dbyibs ni sna tshogs pa

verses.skt: yathāyogapramāṇāni teṣām eṣaṇakarmaṇī | ubhe gaṇḍūpadamukhe srotobhyaḥ śalyahāriṇī
verses.tib: ci rigs pa yi tshad ldan bya / de la rma tshol las la gnyis / srin bu gan du pa ta'i dbyibs / bu ga'i nang gi zug rngu 'byin

verses.skt: masūradalavaktre dve syātām aṣṭanavāṅgule | śaṅkavaḥ ṣaḍ ubhau teṣāṃ ṣoḍaśadvādaśāṅgulau
verses.tib: kha ni sran chud phye 'dra gnyis / sor brgyad pa dang dgu pa'i tshad / thur ma drug ste de las gnyis / sor ni bcu drug bcu gnyis pa

verses.skt: vyūhane ’hiphaṇāvaktrau dvau daśadvādaśāṅgulau | cālane śarapuṅkhāsyāv āhārye baḍiśākṛtī
verses.tib: gnyis po bcu gnyis sor bcu pa / bskul spyad kha ni mda' ltong 'dra / 'byin pa'i cha spyad lcags kyu'i dbyibs

verses.skt: nato ’gre śaṅkunā tulyo garbhaśaṅkur iti smṛtaḥ | aṣṭāṅgulāyatas tena mūḍhagarbhaṃ haret striyāḥ
verses.tib: thur ma rtse mo gug pa ni / mngal gyi phur pa zhes bya ste / srid du sor brgyad byas pa des / bud med mngal du bu shi dbyung

verses.skt: aśmaryāharaṇaṃ sarpaphaṇāvad vakram agrataḥ | śarapuṅkhamukhaṃ dantapātanaṃ caturaṅgulam
verses.tib: rde'u 'byin cha spyad sprul mgo yi / gdengs ka 'dra la rtse gug pa'o / mda' ltong 'dra bar sor bzhi pa / so dbyung ba la sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: kārpāsavihitoṣṇīṣāḥ śalākāḥ ṣaṭ pramārjane | pāyāv āsannadūrārthe dve daśadvādaśāṅgule
verses.tib: rtse mo ras bal gyis dkris pa'i / phyi bsal thur ma drug bya'o / gzhang gi nye ring nang la gnyis / sor bcu ba dang bcu gnyis pa

verses.skt: dve ṣaṭsaptāṅgule ghrāṇe dve karṇe ’ṣṭanavāṅgule | karṇaśodhanam aśvatthapattraprāntaṃ sruvānanam
verses.tib: sna yi sor drug bdun pa gnyis / rna ba'i sor brgyad dgu pa gnyis / rna ba bsal la a shwad+tha'i / rtse'am blugs gzar kha 'dra bya / thur ma 'dzam bu'i thor to 'dra

verses.skt: śalākājāmbavauṣṭhānāṃ kṣāre ’gnau ca pṛthak trayam | yuñjyāt sthūlāṇudīrghāṇāṃ śalākām antravardhmani
verses.tib: thal sman me btsa' so sor gsum / phra sbom rim bzhin sbyar bar bya / rgyu ma'i las la thur ma ni

verses.skt: madhyordhvavṛttadaṇḍāṃ ca mūle cārdhendusaṃnibhām | kolāsthidalatulyāsyā nāsārśo'rbudadāhakṛt
verses.tib: khar ba 'dra zhing dbus zlum la / rtsa ba zla ba phyed 'dra bya / rgya shug tshi gu bkas 'dra ba / sna yi thor to 'brum sreg byed

verses.skt: aṣṭāṅgulā nimnamukhās tisraḥ kṣārauṣadhakrame | kanīnīmadhyamānāmīnakhamānasamair mukhaiḥ
verses.tib: sor brgyad pa la rtse mo ljon / gsum pa thal sman sman rim la / mthe'u chung gung mo srin lag gi / sen mo lta bu'i so byas pa'o

verses.skt: svaṃ svam uktāni yantrāṇi meḍhraśuddhyañjanādiṣu | anuyantrāṇy ayaskāntarajjūvastrāśmamudgarāḥ
verses.tib: pho mtshan spyad dang mig sman / cha spyad rang rang le'ur bshad / nye ba'i cha spyad khab long dang / thag pa ras dang tho ba dang

verses.skt: vadhrāntrajihvāvālāś ca śākhānakhamukhadvijāḥ | kālaḥ pākaḥ karaḥ pādo bhayaṃ harṣaś ca tatkriyāḥ
verses.tib: 'bring bu rgyu ma lce rta rda / yal ga sren mo kha so dang / dus dang smin dang lag rkang dang / 'jigs dang dga' ba de'i bya ba'i

verses.skt: upāyavit pravibhajed ālocya nipuṇaṃ dhiyā
verses.tib: bye brag thabs ni shes pa'o / mkhas pas blo yis dpyad par bya

verses.skt: nirghātanonmathanapūraṇamārgaśuddhisaṃvyūhanāharaṇabandhanapīḍanāni | ācūṣaṇonnamananāmanacālabhaṅgavyāvartanarjukaraṇāni ca yantrakarma || 41™ || vivartate sādhv avagāhate ca grāhyaṃ gṛhītvoddharate ca yasmāt | yantreṣv ataḥ kaṅkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthāneṣu sarveṣv adhikāri yac ca || 42™ ||
verses.tib: thal sman gdab dang mtshon dbyung bcing dang bcer ba dang / gzhib dang smad dang stod dang bskyod dang bcag pa dang / bzlog dang drang por bya ba tsha spyad las rnams yin / legs par zug cing 'byin par byed pa dang / gzung bya blangs nas 'byin par byed phyir dang / yan / lag kun la gnod pa med pas na / cha spyad kun gyi mchog ni kang+ka'i mchu

verses.skt: ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ sukarmārair ghaṭitāni yathāvidhi | śastrāṇi romavāhīni bāhulyenāṅgulāni ṣaṭ
verses.tib: mgar ba mkhas pas cho ga bzhin / brdungs pa'i gtar spyad nyi shu drug / spu ni chod par nus pa dag / phal cher sor ni drug par bya

verses.skt: surūpāṇi sudhārāṇi sugrahāṇi ca kārayet | akarālāni sudhmātasutīkṣṇāv artite ’yasi
verses.tib: gzugs legs so ni legs pa dang / gzung bar bde ba nyid du bya / ya yo med cing 'thar legs pa'i / shin tu rno ba'i lcags las bya

verses.skt: samāhitamukhāgrāṇi nīlāmbhojacchavīni ca | nāmānugatarūpāṇi sadā saṃnihitāni ca
verses.tib: rtse mo shin tu legs brdungs la / ut+pal sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba'i / rang ming rjes mthun gzugs can ni / rtag tu nye bar gzhag par bya

verses.skt: svonmānārdhacaturthāṃśaphalāny ekaikaśo ’pi ca | prāyo dvitrāṇi yuñjīta tāni sthānaviśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: rtse mo re re dag la yang / rang tshod sor phyed gnyis dang bzhi / phal cher gnyis dang gsum du bya / de gnas khyad par dag la sbyar

verses.skt: maṇḍalāgraṃ vṛddhipattram utpalādhyardhadhārake | sarpaiṣaṇyau vetasākhyaṃ śarāryāsyatrikūrcake
kuśāsyaṃ sāṭavadanam antarvaktrārdhacandrake | vrīhimukhaṃ kuṭhārī ca śalākāṅguliśastrake
baḍiśaṃ karapattrākhyaṃ kartarī nakhaśastrakam | dantalekhanakaṃ sūcyaḥ kūrco nāma khajāhvayam
ārā caturvidhākārā tathā syāt karṇavedhanī
verses.tib: de las dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'i rtse

verses.skt: maṇḍalāgraṃ phale teṣāṃ tarjanyantarnakhākṛti | lekhane chedane yojyaṃ pothakīśuṇḍikādiṣu
verses.tib: mdzub sen nang gi dbyibs 'drar bya / de ni rnyil skyes lkog ma yi / sha lhag la sogs gzhar bcad sbyar

verses.skt: vṛddhipattraṃ kṣurākāraṃ chedabhedanapāṭane | ṛjvagram unnate śophe gambhīre ca tad anyathā
verses.tib: 'phel gtsags spu gri'i dbyibs lta bu / gcod dang dral dang 'byin la sbyar / rtse drang skrangs nad mtho ba dang / zab pa la sbyar de las gzhan

verses.skt: natāgraṃ pṛṣṭhato dīrghahrasvavaktraṃ yathāśrayam | utpalādhyardhadhārākhye bhedane chedane tathā
verses.tib: ltag pa ring zhing rtse gug pa / so thung nad tshul ji bzhin sbyar / ut+pa la dang so phyed kyis / dral dang de bzhin gcad par bya

verses.skt: sarpāsyaṃ ghrāṇakarṇārśaśchedane ’rdhāṅgulaṃ phale | gater anveṣaṇe ślakṣṇā gaṇḍūpadamukhaiṣaṇī
verses.tib: sbrul kha rtse sor phyed rna ba / sna yi thor bu dpyad la sbyar / rma tshol 'jam po rta bla ba'i / mgo bo 'dra gzhal brtag par bya

verses.skt: bhedanārthe ’parā sūcīmukhā mūlaniviṣṭakhā | vetasaṃ vyadhane srāvye śarāryāsyatrikūrcake
verses.tib: de las gzhan pa khab rtse 'dra / rtse bug can ni dbug la sbyar / ljang pa'i lo 'dra 'bigs pa la / sha ri'i mchu 'dra mda' bug ni / kha 'dra rtse gsum khrag gzags la

verses.skt: kuśāṭāvadane srāvye dvyaṅgulaṃ syāt tayoḥ phalam | tadvad antarmukhaṃ tasya phalam adhyardham aṅgulam
verses.tib: 'jag rtse a ta'i mchu 'dra ba / 'bras bu sor gnyis khrag 'byin la / de 'dra'i so ni nang du lta

verses.skt: ardhacandrānanaṃ caitat tathādhyardhāṅgulaṃ phale | vrīhivaktraṃ prayojya ca tat sirodarayor vyadhe
verses.tib: gtsags 'bras zla ba kham pa 'dra / sor ni phyed dang gnyis yod bya / rtse mo 'bras dang 'dra pa la / sor ni phyed dang gnyis yod dag / de ni rtsa lto'i nad la sbyar

verses.skt: pṛthuḥ kuṭhārī godantasadṛśārdhāṅgulānanā | tayordhvadaṇḍayā vidhyed upary asthnāṃ sthitāṃ sirām
verses.tib: sta re'i spangs 'dra ba lang so / 'dra ba'i gtsags 'bras sor phyed pa / de yi yu ba gyen bstan la / rus pa'i steng gnas rtsa la gdab

verses.skt: tāmrī śalākā dvimukhī mukhe kurubakākṛtiḥ | liṅganāśaṃ tayā vidhyet kuryād aṅguliśastrakam
verses.tib: zangs ma'i thur ma rtse gnyis pa / rtse mo me / tog kha 'bus 'dra / de yis mthong nyams mig sbris dbug / rgya 'dra'i gcags bu bya ba ni

verses.skt: mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ phale tv ardhāṅgulāyatam | yogato vṛddhipattreṇa maṇḍalāgreṇa vā samam
verses.tib: sor gdub 'dra las kha 'byung ba / gtsags 'bras rgyar ni sor phyed pa / rig pas 'phel gtsags lta bu'am / dkyil 'khor lta bu'i rtse 'dra bya

verses.skt: tat pradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇamudrikam | sūtrabaddhaṃ galasrotorogacchedanabhedane
verses.tib: de ni mdzub mo'i thor tol / gdags su rung ba'i rgya 'dra bya / srad bus brtod la gre ba'i nang / nad rnams gcad dang dral la sbyar

verses.skt: grahaṇe śuṇḍikārmāder baḍiśaṃ sunatānanam | chede ’sthnāṃ karapattraṃ tu kharadhāraṃ daśāṅgulam
verses.tib: gre ba'i sha lhag thor gtsug 'dzin / lcags kyu'i rtse mo legs gug bya / rus pa gcod pa'i sog le ni

verses.skt: vistāre dvyaṅgulaṃ sūkṣmadantaṃ sutsarubandhanam | snāyusūtrakacacchede kartarī kartarīnibhā
verses.tib: srid du sor bcu zhing sor gnyis / so rnams phra zhing rab tu rno / yu ba chang gzung legs par bya / rma yi chu rgyus skra bcad pa'i / chan pa chan pa 'dra bar bya

verses.skt: vakrarjudhāraṃ dvimukhaṃ nakhaśastraṃ navāṅgulam | sūkṣmaśalyoddhṛticchedabhedapracchānalekhane
verses.tib: so yo so drang kha gnyis pa'i / sen mo 'dreg spyad sor dgu pa / zug rngu phra 'byung gcad pa dang / dral dang dbug dang phyi bar bya

verses.skt: ekadhāraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ prabaddhākṛti caikataḥ | dantalekhanakaṃ tena śodhayed dantaśarkarām
verses.tib: zur bzhi pa la sor gcig pa / dbyibs ni kun tu gcig 'dra ba / so phyi ba yi gcags spyad de / so yi dreg pa phyi bar bya

verses.skt: vṛttā gūḍhadṛḍhāḥ pāśe tisraḥ sūcyo ’tra sīvane | māṃsalānāṃ pradeśānāṃ tryaśrā tryaṅgulam āyatā
verses.tib: khab ni mgo zlum mig zab che / mkhrang pa gsum bya de las ni / sha che ba yi phyogs su ni / zur gsum srid du sor gsum pas

verses.skt: alpamāṃsāsthisaṃdhisthavraṇānāṃ dvyaṅgulāyatā | vrīhivaktrā dhanurvakrā pakvāmāśayamarmasu
verses.tib: sha chung pa dang rus tshigs na / rma yod pa la srid sor gnyis / zhu dang ma zhu'i gnas nad rma'i / khab rtse 'bras dbyibs gzhu ltar sgu

verses.skt: sā sārdhadvyaṅgulā sarvavṛttās tāś caturaṅgulāḥ | kūrco vṛttaikapīṭhasthāḥ saptāṣṭau vā subandhanāḥ
verses.tib: srid du sor ni phyed dang gsum / khab ni bdun dang brgyad kun yang / zlum po sor ni legs sbom pa / khri gcig la btsugs pir 'dra ba

verses.skt: sa yojyo nīlikāvyaṅgakeśaśāteṣu kuṭṭane | ardhāṅgulamukhair vṛttair aṣṭābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ khajaḥ
verses.tib: brtsan sngo gdong nad thig le gnag / skra 'byi ba la gtsags par bya / khab brgyad zlum po sor phyed pa

verses.skt: pāṇibhyāṃ mathyamānena ghrāṇāt tena hared asṛk | vyadhanaṃ karṇapālīnāṃ yūthikāmukulānanam
verses.tib: lag pa gnyis kyis btsugs nas ni / de yis sna yi khrag dbyung ngo / rna shal dbug pa'i snyung bu ni / yu ti ka ni kha 'bus 'dra

verses.skt: ārārdhāṅgulavṛttāsyā tatpraveśā tathordhvataḥ | caturaśrā tayā vidhyec chophaṃ pakvāmasaṃśaye
verses.tib: snyung bu sor ni phyed par bya / de yi tshad dbug de yan chad / zur bzhi par byas de yis ni / skrangs smin ma smin dogs la dbug

verses.skt: karṇapālīṃ ca bahalāṃ bahalāyāś ca śasyate | sūcī tribhāgasuṣirā tryaṅgulā karṇavedhanī
verses.tib: rna drung sha ni stug po dbug / snyung bu kha ni sbom po la / sum cha sbu gu yod byas la / sor gsum pa yis rna ba dbug

verses.skt: jalaukaḥkṣāradahanakācopalanakhādayaḥ | alauhāny anuśastrāṇi tāny evaṃ ca vikalpayet
verses.tib: pad+ma thal sman me btsa' dang / mching bu rdo dum sen mo / lcags min gtar spyad phra mo ste / de yang de bzhin sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: aparāṇy api yantrādīny upayogaṃ ca yaugikam | utpāṭyapāṭyasīvyaiṣyalekhyapracchānakuṭṭanam
verses.tib: cha spyad 'khrul 'khor pas kyang / mkho ba nad kyi dmigs dang sbyar / 'dren dang 'byin dang 'dral dang 'drub / dmigs tshol phya bsal zhal zhal gdab

verses.skt: chedyaṃ bhedyaṃ vyadho mantho graho dāhaś ca tatkriyāḥ | kuṇṭhakhaṇḍatanusthūlahrasvadīrghatvavakratāḥ
verses.tib: gtsags bcad gshegs dbug btsugs pa dang / gzung sreg de yis bya ba yin / gcad dang dral dang phyi ba'i phyir / spyad kyi gtsags 'bras rtsa ba'i bar

verses.skt: śastrāṇāṃ kharadhāratvam aṣṭau doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | chedabhedanalekhyārthaṃ śastraṃ vṛntaphalāntare
verses.tib: gtsags bcad gshegs dbug btsugs pa dang / gzung sreg de yis bya ba yin / gcad dang dral dang phyi ba'i phyir / spyad kyi gtsags 'bras rtsa ba'i bar

verses.skt: tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhair gṛhṇīyāt susamāhitaḥ | visrāvaṇāni vṛntāgre tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakena ca
verses.tib: mdzub mo gung mo mtheb mo yis / ma yengs pa dang legs par gzung / gtar ga gdab phyir rtse mo'i drung / mdzub mo dang ni mthe bos gzung

verses.skt: talapracchannavṛntāgraṃ grāhyaṃ vrīhimukhaṃ mukhe | mūleṣv āharaṇārthāni kriyāsaukaryato ’param
verses.tib: 'bras 'dra ba yi yu ba ni / chang par bcug ste rtse mas gdab / dbyung don yu ba nas gzung bya / gzhan dag bya ba gang bder bya / gtar spyad sna tshogs dag gi snod

verses.skt: syān navāṅgulavistāraḥ sughano dvādaśāṅgulaḥ | kṣaumapattrorṇakauśeyadukūlamṛducarmajaḥ
verses.tib: gso ras bal snam men dri'am / pags 'jam du gu la las byas / rab tu stug pa zheng sor dgu / srid du sar ni bcu gnyis pa

verses.skt: vinyastapāśaḥ susyūtaḥ sāntarorṇāsthaśastrakaḥ | śalākāpihitāsyaś ca śastrakośaḥ susaṃcayaḥ
verses.tib: bal gyis bar bcad spyad bcug la / legs par gzhag ste drub pa dang / thur mas kha ni brgyu bar bya

verses.skt: jalaukasas tu sukhināṃ raktasrāvāya yojayet | duṣṭāmbumatsyabhekāhiśavakothamalodbhavāḥ
verses.tib: srin bu pad pa bder gnas pa / khrag dbyung phyir ni sbyar bar bya / chu nang nya dang sbal dang / mi ro'i dri ma mnam las byung

verses.skt: raktāḥ śvetā bhṛśaṃ kṛṣṇāś capalāḥ sthūlapicchilāḥ | indrāyudhavicitrordhvarājayo romaśāś ca tāḥ
verses.tib: dmar dang dkar dang shin tu gnag / mi srun sbom dang 'byil ba dang / 'ja' tshon dang 'dra ro stod bkra / spu yod de rnams dug can yin

verses.skt: saviṣā varjayet tābhiḥ kaṇḍūpākajvarabhramāḥ | viṣapittāsranut kāryaṃ tatra śuddhāmbujāḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: spang bya des ni khrag gzhibs na / g.ya' rnags 'dzag rims mgo 'khor skyed / de la dugs khrag mkhris gso bya / chu mdog rnam par gsal ba dang

verses.skt: nirviṣāḥ śaivalaśyāvā vṛttā nīlordhvarājayaḥ | kaṣāyapṛṣṭhās tanvaṅgyaḥ kiñcitpītodarāś ca yāḥ
verses.tib: dug med nya lcibs med las byung / rtsa snar ro stong sngo khra zlum / rgyab ni ngur smrig 'dra lus phra / lto ni cung zad ser ba bzang

verses.skt: tā apy asamyagvamanāt pratataṃ ca nipātanāt | sīdantiḥ salilaṃ prāpya raktamattā iti tyajet
verses.tib: de yang legs par ma skyugs dang / rtag tu 'thung du bcug pa dag / chu nang zhugs te nub pa ni / khrag gis myos pa yin pas spangs

verses.skt: athetarā niśākalkayukte ’mbhasi pariplutāḥ | avantisome takre vā punaś cāśvāsitā jale
verses.tib: de nas cig shos skye rab brtags / chu sbyar ba yi nang du gzhug / kan dzi'am dar ba'i nang du gzhug / slar yang chur ni dbugs phyung nas

verses.skt: lāgayed ghṛtamṛtstanyaraktaśastranipātanaiḥ | pibantīr unnataskandhāś chādayen mṛduvāsasā
verses.tib: mar ram sa zhag nu zho 'am / khrag gi thigs pa bskus 'thung gzhug / 'thungs tshe ro stod mthor gyur na / ras ma srab mos g.yogs par bya

verses.skt: saṃpṛktād duṣṭaśuddhāsrāj jalaukā duṣṭaśoṇitam | ādatte prathamaṃ haṃsaḥ kṣīraṃ kṣīrodakād iva
verses.tib: khrag / ni bzang ngan 'dres pa las / pad pa dang por nad khrag ni / 'thungs te ngang pas 'o ma dang / 'dres chu'i 'o ma len dang mtshungs

verses.skt: gulmārśovidradhīn kuṣṭhavātaraktagalāmayān | netrarugviṣavīsarpān śamayanti jalaukasaḥ
daṃśasya tode kaṇḍvāṃ vā mokṣayed vāmayec ca tām | paṭutailāktavadanāṃ ślakṣṇakaṇḍanarūṣitām
verses.tib: so yis 'debs pa'am g.ya' gyur na / de ni slar dbyung skyug tu gzhug / rgyam tsha til mar gyis kha bsku / phye ma 'jam pos rgyab tu gtor

verses.skt: rakṣan raktamadād bhūyaḥ saptāhaṃ tā na pātayet | pūrvavat paṭutā dārḍhyaṃ samyagvānte jalaukasām
verses.tib: slar yang zhag bdun bar du ni / khrag myos bsrungs la 'thung mi gzhug / srin bu pad pa legs skyugs na / sngon bzhin khong grims brtan par 'gyur

verses.skt: klamo ’tiyogān mṛtyur vā durvānte stabdhatā madaḥ | anyatrānyatra tāḥ sthāpyā ghaṭe mṛtsnāmbugarbhiṇi
verses.tib: drags na dal zhing snyom 'chi 'gyur / skyugs ma legs na rengs myos 'gyur / bum pa chu dang sa blugs pa / gzhan dang gzhan du gzhag par bya

verses.skt: lālādikothanāśārthaṃ saviṣāḥ syus tadanvayāt | aśuddhau srāvayed daṃśān haridrāguḍamākṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: kha chu rul bag sbyang phyir bya / gzhan du dug dang bcas par 'gyur / ma dag pa'am khrag mang byung / skyer pa bu ram sbrang rtsis bsku

verses.skt: śatadhautājyapicavas tato lepāś ca śītalāḥ | duṣṭaraktāpagamanāt sadyo rāgarujāṃ śamaḥ
verses.tib: lan brgyar dkrugs mar ras bal gyi / ye'us byugs la sman bsil bsku / nad kyi khrag dang bral gyur na / 'phral du rtsa dmar nad med 'gyur

verses.skt: aśuddhaṃ calitaṃ sthānāt sthitaṃ raktaṃ vraṇāśaye | vyamlībhavet paryuṣitaṃ tasmāt tat srāvayet punaḥ
verses.tib: ma dag gnas nas bskyod gyur pa / rma yi gnas su 'dug pa'i khrag / zhag lon na ni gnag par 'gyur / de bas de ni slar dbyung ngo

verses.skt: yuñjyān nālābughaṭikā rakte pittena dūṣite | tāsām analasaṃyogād yuñjyāt tu kaphavāyunā
verses.tib: mkhris rgyas khrag gi nad la ni / ku ba bum pa sbyar mi bya / de gnyis me dang bcas pa yin / rlung dang bad kan la sbyar bya

verses.skt: kaphena duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ na śṛṅgeṇa vinirharet | skannatvād vātapittābhyāṃ duṣṭaṃ śṛṅgeṇa nirharet
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur nad khrag ni / ska bas rngabs rus gzhib mi bya / rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur khrag / rngabs rwas gzhibs te dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: gātraṃ baddhvopari dṛḍhaṃ rajjvā paṭṭena vā samam | snāyusaṃdhyasthimarmāṇi tyajan pracchānam ācaret
verses.tib: lus kyi gong du srad bu'am / ras kyis dam du bcings nas ni / chu ba tshigs rus gnad rnams ni / dor te zhal zhal gdab bar bya

verses.skt: adhodeśa pravisṛtaiḥ padair uparigāmibhiḥ | na gāḍhaghanatiryagbhir na pade padam ācaran
verses.tib: gyen du dbyung ba'i thabs kyis ni / thur du babs pa gdab bar bya / zab dang nye dang 'phred mi gdab / btab ba'i gnas su'ang gdab mi bya

verses.skt: pracchānenaikadeśasthaṃ grathitaṃ jalajanmabhiḥ | harec chṛṅgādibhiḥ suptam asṛg vyāpi sirāvyadhaiḥ
verses.tib: zhal zhal bya ba phyogs gcig 'dus / rtsa mdud srin bus khrag 'byung zhing / bem bem por gyur rwa gdab / nad khrag lus khyab gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: pracchānaṃ piṇḍite vā syād avagāḍhe jalaukasaḥ | tvaksthe ’lābughaṭīśṛṅgaṃ siraiva vyāpake ’sṛji
verses.tib: khrag nad 'dus pa zhal zhal bya / gting na yod pa pad pas dbyung / pags gnas ku bum rngabs ras dbyung / lus khyab khrag la gtar gnyid

verses.skt: vātādidhāma vā śṛṅgajalauko'lābubhiḥ kramāt | srutāsṛjaḥ pradehādyaiḥ śītaiḥ syād vāyukopataḥ
verses.tib: rlung gnas la rngabs rwa dang / pad pa ku bas rim bzhin dbyung / khrag phyung / bsil bskus la pas / rlung ni rnam par 'khrugs gyur te

verses.skt: satodakaṇḍuḥ śophas taṃ sarpiṣoṣṇena secayet
verses.tib: rma na g.ya' zhing skrangs gyur na'ang / de la zhun mar dron pos bsku

verses.skt: madhuraṃ lavaṇaṃ kiñcid aśītoṣṇam asaṃhatam | padmendragopahemāviśaśalohitalohitam
verses.tib: cung zad mngar zhing tsha bro la / grang dang tsha min ska ba min / pad+ma lam bu chu gsher dang / btsod dang ri bong khrag ltar dmar

verses.skt: lohitaṃ prabhavaḥ śuddhaṃ tanos tenaiva ca sthitaḥ | tat pittaśleṣmalaiḥ prāyo dūṣyate kurute tataḥ
verses.tib: dag cing dmar ba 'byung ba ni / de nyid kyis ni lus gnas byed / de ni phal cher bad mkhris kyi / nad kyis 'khrugs pas gnod bskyad pas

verses.skt: visarpavidradhiplīhagulmāgnisadanajvarān | mukhanetraśirorogamadatṛḍlavaṇāsyatāḥ
verses.tib: me dbal 'bras dang mcher nad dang / skran dang me drod bri dang rims / kha dang mig dang mgo nad dang / myos dang skom dang tsha bro dang

verses.skt: kuṣṭhavātāsrapittāsrakaṭvamlodgiraṇabhramān | śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyair upakrāntāś ca ye gadāḥ
verses.tib: mdze dang dreg nad mkhris khrag dang / sgregs pa skyur zhing mgo 'khor byed / bsil dro snum dang rtsub kyis / nad gang gsos par gyur pa dag / legs par 'chos par ma gyur pa / de ni khrag 'khrugs las gyur yin / khrag bdo gyur pa de las ni / gtar ga gdab pas dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: samyak sādhyā na sidhyanti te ca raktaprakopajāḥ | teṣu srāvayituṃ raktam udriktaṃ vyadhayet sirām
verses.tib: mdze dang dreg nad mkhris khrag dang / sgregs pa skyur zhing mgo 'khor byed / bsil dro snum dang rtsub kyis / nad gang gsos par gyur pa dag / legs par 'chos par ma gyur pa / de ni khrag 'khrugs las gyur yin / khrag bdo gyur pa de las ni / gtar ga gdab pas dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: na tūnaṣoḍaśātītasaptatyabdasrutāsṛjām | asnigdhāsveditātyarthasveditānilarogiṇām
verses.tib: de yang bcu drug ma lon dang / bdun cu 'das la khrag mi dbyung / nyam chung dugs drags dugs ma byas / rlung gi nad kyis nyen pa dang / sbrum ma bu btsas zas ma zhu / khrag mkhris lud pa dbugs mi bde / tshad 'khru rims dang skyugs pa dang / skya rbab yan lag kun skrangs dang

verses.skt: garbhiṇīsūtikājīrṇapittāsraśvāsakāsinām | atīsārodaracchardipāṇḍusarvāṅgaśophinām
verses.tib: de yang bcu drug ma lon dang / bdun cu 'das la khrag mi dbyung / nyam chung dugs drags dugs ma byas / rlung gi nad kyis nyen pa dang / sbrum ma bu btsas zas ma zhu / khrag mkhris lud pa dbugs mi bde / tshad 'khru rims dang skyugs pa dang / skya rbab yan lag kun skrangs dang

verses.skt: snehapīte prayukteṣu tathā pañcasu karmasu | nāyantritāṃ sirāṃ vidhyen na tiryaṅ nāpy anutthitām
verses.tib: snum 'thungs pa la sbyor ba dang / de bzhin las lnga byas la min / ma bsdams gtar ga mi gdab cing / yon po'am mi snang la mi gdab

verses.skt: nātiśītoṣṇavātābhreṣv anyatrātyayikād gadāt | śironetravikāreṣu lalāṭyāṃ mokṣayet sirām
verses.tib: tshabs chen nad ni ma gtogs pa / grang la tsha char rlung dus min / mgo dang mig gi nad rnams la / 'phral ba'i rtsa la gtar ba'am / mig 'gram sna drung rtsa la gdab

verses.skt: apāṅgyām upanāsyāṃ vā karṇarogeṣu karṇajām | nāsārogeṣu nāsāgre sthitāṃ nāsālalāṭayoḥ
verses.tib: rna ba'i nad la rna ba'i rtsa / sna yi nad la sna rtser ro / cham pa sna dang dpral rtsar gdab

verses.skt: pīnase mukharogeṣu jihvauṣṭhahanutālugāḥ | jatrūrdhvagranthiṣu grīvākarṇaśaṅkhaśiraḥśritāḥ
verses.tib: kha nad rnams la lce dang ni / mchu dang rkan gyi rtsar gdab bo / nam tshong yan chad rtsa mdud mgul / rna ba mur 'gram spyir gnas gdab

verses.skt: uro'pāṅgalalāṭasthā unmāde ’pasmṛtau punaḥ | hanusaṃdhau samaste vā sirāṃ bhrūmadhyagāminīm
verses.tib: smyo byed mig 'gram brang dpral rtsa / brjed byed 'gram pa'i / mtshams su gdab / yang na kun la smin mtshams gdab / 'bras dang rtsib logs zug pa la

verses.skt: vidradhau pārśvaśūle ca pārśvakakṣāstanāntare | tṛtīyake ’ṃsayor madhye skandhasyādhaś caturthake
verses.tib: rtsib logs nu ma'i bar rtsa gdab / nyin gsum pa la phrag mtshams gdab / nyin bzhi pa la ltag pa'i 'og / 'khru ba gzer dang ldan pa la

verses.skt: pravāhikāyāṃ śūlinyāṃ śroṇito dvyaṅgule sthitām | śukrameḍhrāmaye meḍhra ūrugāṃ galagaṇḍayoḥ
verses.tib: mjug to'i gong ma sor gnyis par / khu ba'i mtshan nad pho mtshan rtsa / lkog ma'i wa bar brla rtsa gdab / gzugs 'khums pus mthil 'og gam ni

verses.skt: gṛdhrasyāṃ jānuno ’dhastād ūrdhvaṃ vā caturaṅgule | indravaster adho ’pacyāṃ dvyaṅgule caturaṅgule
verses.tib: gong gi sor bzhi pa la gdab / 'bras kyi phreng bar byin pa'i nywa / 'og tu sor ba gnyis gdab bo / rkub tshos bus mo'i lha nga'i steng

verses.skt: ūrdhvaṃ gulphasya sakthyartau tathā kroṣṭukaśīrṣake | pādadāhe khuḍe harṣe vipādyāṃ vātakaṇṭake
verses.tib: nad la long mo'i ltag sor bzhir / rkang tsha 'theng dang sbrid pa dang / rting rdol rlung nad mdzer pa dang / rkang sor snags su chad pa la

verses.skt: cipye ca dvyaṅgule vidhyed upari kṣipramarmaṇaḥ | gṛdhrasyām iva viśvācyāṃ yathoktānām adarśane
verses.tib: rgya tshigs las gong sor gnyis gdab / 'khums la rkang 'khums lta bur gdab / ji skad bshad pa ma mngon na

verses.skt: marmahīne yathāsanne deśe ’nyāṃ vyadhayet sirām | atha snigdhatanuḥ sajjasarvopakaraṇo balī
verses.tib: gnad ma gtogs pa gar nye ba'i / phyogs gzhan dag tu gtar ga gdab / de nas lus snum gtar ga yi / yo byad kun bsags stobs dang ldan

verses.skt: kṛtasvastyayanaḥ snigdharasānnapratibhojitaḥ | agnitāpātapasvinno jānūccāsanasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.tib: bkra shis byas shing kha zas ni / snum zos khu ba 'thungs pa dang / me dang nyi tshan gyis dugs byas / pus mnyam mtho ba'i stan la 'dug

verses.skt: mṛdupaṭṭāttakeśānto jānusthāpitakūrparaḥ | muṣṭibhyāṃ vastragarbhābhyāṃ manye gāḍhaṃ nipīḍayet
verses.tib: skra rtsa ras ni 'jam pos bcings / pus mo'i lha ngar gru mo btsugs / khu tshur nang du glod bcug pas / mgul pa dam du btsir bar bya

verses.skt: dantaprapīḍanotkāsagaṇḍādhmānāni cācaret | pṛṣṭhato yantrayec cainaṃ vastram āveṣṭayan naraḥ
verses.tib: so bsdam lud pa lu ba dang / mkhur ba gnyis ni bud par bya / de la rgyab nas btsir ba dang / gos kyis dkri zhing mdzub mo ni

verses.skt: kandharāyāṃ parikṣipya nyasyāntar vāmatarjanīm | eṣo ’ntarmukhavarjyānāṃ sirāṇāṃ yantraṇe vidhiḥ
verses.tib: g.yon pa lkog mar bcug nas su / nang du legs par gzhug par bya / 'di ni nang du kha bltas rtsa / ma gtogs bsdam pa'i cho ga yin

verses.skt: tato madhyamayāṅgulyā vaidyo ’ṅguṣṭhavimuktayā | tāḍayed utthitāṃ jñātvā sparśād vāṅguṣṭhapīḍanaiḥ
verses.tib: de 'og sman pa'i mthe bo las / gung mo btang bar gyur ba yis / rtsa byung mngon la gdab byas nas / reg pa'am mthe bos mnan byas la

verses.skt: kuṭhāryā lakṣayen madhye vāmahastagṛhītayā | phaloddeśe suniṣkampaṃ sirāṃ tadvac ca mokṣayet
verses.tib: lag pa g.yon pas bzung ba yi / gtsags pu sta res dbus su gdab / gtsags bu'i kha phyogs mi g.yo gtad / de bzhin gdab pa'am btsir ba yis

verses.skt: tāḍayan pīḍayaṃś caināṃ vidhyed vrīhimukhena tu | aṅguṣṭhenonnamayyāgre nāsikām upanāsikām
verses.tib: bem rtol gdab las khrag dbyung ngo / sna drung gi ni rtsar / gdab pa / rtse mo mthe bos bteg nas ni

verses.skt: abhyunnatavidaṣṭāgrajihvasyādhas tadāśrayām | yantrayet stanayor ūrdhvaṃ grīvāśritasirāvyadhe
verses.tib: gtsags rtse 'bras 'dra gdab par bya / lce bteg bzlog ste sos mnan la / lce 'og rtsar ni gdab par bya

verses.skt: pāṣāṇagarbhahastasya jānusthe prasṛte bhuje | kukṣer ārabhya mṛdite vidhyed baddhordhvapaṭṭake
verses.tib: nu ma yan chad bsdams nas ni / mgul par gnas pa'i rtsar gdab bo / lag pa gnyis su rdo bcangs te

verses.skt: vidhyed dhastasirāṃ bāhāv anākuñcitakūrpare | baddhvā sukhopaviṣṭasya muṣṭim aṅguṣṭhagarbhiṇam
verses.tib: lag pa pus mor brten te brkyang / mchan khung man chad mnyes nas na / gong du bcings la mdo rtsar gdab / lag ngar rtsa ni bder 'dug ste

verses.skt: ūrdhvaṃ vedhyapradeśāc ca paṭṭikāṃ caturaṅgule | vidhyed ālambamānasya bāhubhyāṃ pārśvayoḥ sirām
verses.tib: gdab pa'i sor bzhi gong gi ni / phyogs su ras kyis dam bcings la / mthe bo chang par bcug nas ni / lag ngar brkyang la gdab par bya / rtsib logs rtsa ni dpung pa gnyis

verses.skt: prahṛṣṭe mehane jaṅghāsirāṃ jānuny akuñcite | pāde tu susthite ’dhastāj jānusaṃdher nipīḍite
verses.tib: thur du dpyangs te gdab bar bya / pho mtshan rtsa ni bteg gdab / byin rtsa pus mo ma bkug par / rkang pa legs gzhag pus mo la

verses.skt: gāḍhaṃ karābhyām āgulphaṃ caraṇe tasya copari | dvitīye kuñcite kiñcidārūḍhe hastavat tataḥ
verses.tib: 'og tu lag pa gnyis kyis ni / long mo'i bar du dam btsir la / rkang pa de steng gnyis pa ni / cung zad bkug ste bzhag pa yis / mnan la de nas lag pa ltar

verses.skt: baddhvā vidhyet sirām ittham anukteṣv api kalpayet | teṣu teṣu pradeśeṣu tat tad yantram upāyavit
verses.tib: rtsar gdab de ltar ma smos pa'i / gzhan dag la yang gdab byas la / thabs shes gtsags spyad de dang des / phyogs ni de dang de ru gdab

verses.skt: māṃsale nikṣiped deśe vrīhyāsyaṃ vrīhimātrakam | yavārdham asthnām upari sirāṃ vidhyan kuṭhārikām
verses.tib: sha che ba yi phyogs su 'debs / 'bras 'dra 'bras kyi srid tsam gdab / rus pa'i steng rtsa sta re 'dras / nas kyi phyed tsam gdab par bya

verses.skt: samyagviddhā sraved dhārāṃ yantre mukte tu na sravet | alpakālaṃ vahaty alpaṃ durviddhā tailacūrṇanaiḥ
verses.tib: legs par btab nas khrag gzags te / chings ma bkrol nas gzag mi bya / gdab ma legs pa dus cung zad / nyung zad 'byung ba til phye gdab

verses.skt: saśabdam atividdhā tu sraved duḥkhena dhāryate | bhīmūrchāyantraśaithilyakuṇṭhaśastrātitṛptayaḥ
verses.tib: gdab drags sgra dang bcas par ni / 'byung zhing bcad kyang dka' bar 'gyur / dbang dang 'bog par 'gyur ba dang / chings lhod mtshon rtul 'grangs drags dang

verses.skt: kṣāmatvavegitāsvedā raktasyāsrutihetavaḥ | asamyag asre sravati vellavyoṣaniśānataiḥ
verses.tib: nyam chung shugs nyen dugs ma byas / khrag mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin no / khrag ni legs par ma byung na / byi dang tsha gsum skyer pa dang

verses.skt: sāgāradhūmalavaṇatailair dihyāt sirāmukham | samyakpravṛtte koṣṇena tailena lavaṇena ca
verses.tib: rgya spos rgyam tsha khyim dud bcas / til mar btags la rma la bsku / khrag ni legs byung til mar dang / rgyam tshar bcas pa dro 'jam bsku

verses.skt: agre sravati duṣṭāsraṃ kusumbhād iva pītikā | samyak srutvā svayaṃ tiṣṭhec chuddhaṃ tad iti nāharet
verses.tib: le brgan rtsi las tshon ser ltar / dang po nad khrag 'byung par 'gyur / legs par byung na rang nyid 'chad / khrag bzang / byung na'ang dbyung mi bya

verses.skt: yantraṃ vimucya mūrchāyāṃ vījite vyajanaiḥ punaḥ | srāvayen mūrchati punas tv aparedyus tryahe ’pi vā
verses.tib: brgyal 'gyur na ni chings ma dgrol / rlung g.yab kyis g.yab slar khrag dbyung / slar 'bog gyur na nyi ma ni / gnyis pa'ang gsum pa dag la gdab

verses.skt: vātāc chyāvāruṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ vegasrāvy acchaphenilaṃ | pittāt pītāsitaṃ visram askandy auṣṇyāt sacandrikam
verses.tib: rlung khrag gnag cing dmar la rtsub / shugs drag gsal zhing lbu ba can / mkhris khrag ser la rtsa gnag mnam / sbyin bag dro zhing tshon can yin

verses.skt: vātikaṃ śoṇitaṃ śīghraṃ bhūmiḥ pibati cāvṛtam | makṣikāṇām akāntaṃ ca raktaṃ bhavati paittikam
ślaiṣmikaṃ makṣikākrāntaṃ śuṣyaty api na ceṇayat
kaphāt snigdham asṛk pāṇḍu tantumat picchilaṃ ghanam | saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ saṃsargāt tridoṣaṃ malināvilam
verses.tib: bad kan khrag ni 'jam la skya / rgyun can 'byar zhing ska ba yin / 'dres pa'i mtshan ma 'dres ma yin / nyes gsum dri ma rnyog ma can

verses.skt: aśuddhau balino ’py asraṃ na prasthāt srāvayet param | atisrutau hi mṛtyuḥ syād dāruṇā vā calāmayāḥ
verses.tib: khrag ngan pa ni nyams che la'ang / tshad las lhag par dbyung mi bya / khrag dbyung drags na'ang 'chi ba'am / rlung nad mi bzad 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tatrābhyaṅgarasakṣīraraktapānāni bheṣajam | srute rakte śanair yantram apanīya himāmbunā
verses.tib: de la bsku byug 'o ma khu / khrag bcud blud pa sman yin no / khrag phyung nas ni chings ma dag / dal gyis bkrol la chu bsil gyis

verses.skt: prakṣālya tailaplotāktaṃ bandhanīyaṃ sirāmukham | aśuddhaṃ srāvayed bhūyaḥ sāyam ahny apare ’pi vā
verses.tib: bkrus la til mar gyis byugs pa'i / gos 'jam gyis ni rma kha dkri / khrag nad yod na phyi 'bred dam / phyi de nyin par slar yang dbyung

verses.skt: snehopaskṛtadehasya pakṣād vā bhṛśadūṣitam | kiñcid dhi śeṣe duṣṭāsre naiva rogo ’tivartate
verses.tib: shin tu gnod pa'i khrag zla phyed / snum gyis brtas pa'i lus las dbyung / khrag ngan cung zad lus kyang ni / nad ni lhag par mi skyed pas

verses.skt: saśeṣam apy ato dhāryaṃ na cātisrutim ācaret | harec chṛṅgādibhiḥ śeṣaṃ prasādam athavā nayet
verses.tib: de phyir lhag ma yod gyur yang / gzhag gi shas cher mi dbyung ngo / lhag ma rngabs rwa gdab pa'ang / yang na spyod bsil khrag mkhris bsal

verses.skt: śītopacārapittāsrakriyāśuddhiviśoṣaṇaiḥ | duṣṭaṃ raktam anudriktam evam eva prasādayet
verses.tib: sbyang dang skam pa'i bye brag ni / gso bas de ni dang bar bya / nad khrag rab rgyas ma gyur ba'am / de 'dra'i thabs kyis gso bar bya / khrag gi rgyun ni mchod na

verses.skt: rakte tv atiṣṭhati kṣipraṃ stambhanīm ācaret kriyām | lodhrapriyaṅgupattaṅgamāṣayaṣṭyāhvagairikaiḥ
verses.tib: gcad pa'i sbyor ba myur du bya / seng phrom rma shing pri yang ku / ma sha shing mngar yug snam btsag

verses.skt: mṛtkapālāñjanakṣaumamaṣīkṣīritvagaṅkuraiḥ | vicūrṇayed vraṇamukhaṃ padmakādihimaṃ pibet
verses.tib: gyo dum zar ma snag tsha dang / 'o ma can shing shun lo ma / btags pa'i phye ma rma khar gdab / shug chu grang sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: tām eva vā sirāṃ vidhyed vyadhāt tasmād anantaram | sirāmukhaṃ vā tvaritaṃ dahet taptaśalākayā
verses.tib: yang na rtsa btab de gong gi / rtsa de nyid la gtar ga gdab / yang na thur ma bsregs pa yis / rma kha myur du bsreg par bya

verses.skt: unmārgagā yantranipīḍanena svasthānam āyānti punar na yāvat | doṣāḥ praduṣṭā rudhiraṃ prapannās tāvad dhitāhāravihārabhāk syāt
verses.tib: bcings pa nyes pas lam log la gnas te / nad ni rgyas pas khrag ni 'khrugs 'gyur ba / rang gi gnas su slar phyin ma gyur pa / de srid / zas dang spyod lam phan pa bsten

verses.skt: nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ laghu dīpanīyaṃ rakte ’panīte hitam annapānam | tadā śarīraṃ hy anavasthitāsṛg agnir viśeṣād iti rakṣitavyaḥ
verses.tib: shin tu tsha grang ma yin yang drod skyed / khrag sel byed pa'i bza' dang btung ba phan / de tshe lus dang khrag bder mi gnas pas / khyad par du ni me las bsrung bar bya

verses.skt: prasannavarṇendriyam indriyārthān icchantam avyāhatapaktṛvegam | sukhānvitaṃ puṣṭibalopapannaṃ viśuddharaktaṃ puruṣaṃ vadanti
verses.tib: mdog dang dbang po gsal zhing dbang po yul / 'dod cing zas 'ju shugs kyang bde bar 'ju / bde dang ldan zhing stobs rgyas phun sum tshogs / mi yi nad khrag dag pa yin par bshad

verses.skt: raktajā vyaṅgakuṣṭhādyāḥ kaṇṭhāsyākṣiśirogadāḥ | palitārūṃṣikābādhāḥ śāmyanty ete sirāvyadhāt
verses.tib: mdog dang dbang po gsal zhing dbang po yul / 'dod cing zas 'ju shugs kyang bde bar 'ju / bde dang ldan zhing stobs rgyas phun sum tshogs / mi yi nad khrag dag pa yin par bshad

verses.skt: nirvyādhinīlotpalapattranetraṃ suvyaktamūlāsitabaddhakeśam | candropamaṃ padmasugandhi vaktraṃ bhavel lalāṭe tu sirāvyadhena
vakrarjutiryagūrdhvādhaḥ śalyānāṃ pañcadhā gatiḥ | dhyāmaṃ śopharujāvantaṃ sravantaṃ śoṇitaṃ muhuḥ
verses.tib: zug rngu'i bgrod pa rnam lnga ste / yo drang thad ka steng dang 'og / kha gnag skrangs dang nad dang bcas / yang dang yang du khrag 'dzag la

verses.skt: abhyudgataṃ budbudavat piṭikopacitaṃ vraṇam | mṛdumāṃsaṃ ca jānīyād antaḥśalyaṃ samāsataḥ
verses.tib: rma yi nye 'khor mtho zhing glo / chu bur lta bu'i thor bu 'byung / sha ni 'jam 'gyur lus mdor na / khong du zug rngu yod shes bya

verses.skt: viśeṣāt tvaggate śalye vivarṇaḥ kaṭhināyataḥ | śopho bhavati māṃsasthe coṣaḥ śopho vivardhate
verses.tib: khyad par du ni pags pa na / mtshon lus mdog nyams sra ba dang / skrangs par 'gyur ro shar gnas pa / nad dang skrang pa lhag par 'phel

verses.skt: pīḍanākṣamatā pākaḥ śalyamārgo na rohati | peśyantaragate māṃsaprāptavac chvayathuṃ vinā
verses.tib: btsir bar mi bzod smin pa dang / rma yi sgo ni 'drub mi shes / nya yi nang zug shar zug dang / 'dra las skrang bag med pa yin

verses.skt: ākṣepaḥ snāyujālasya saṃrambhastambhavedanāḥ | snāyuge durharaṃ caitat sirādhmānaṃ sirāśrite
verses.tib: chu ba'i dra ba'i nang lus pa'i / chu ba las ni 'byung dka' zhing / bsgul dka' bskyod tshe rengs shing na / rtsa la brten pa rtsa skrang 'gyur / bu ga'i sbubs gnas sbubs kyis ni

verses.skt: svakarmaguṇahāniḥ syāt srotasāṃ srotasi sthite | dhamanīsthe ’nile raktaṃ phenayuktam udīrayet
verses.tib: rang gi las dang yon tan nyams / rtsa chen gnas pa'ang dbugs dang khrag / lbu ba can du 'byung 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: niryāti śabdavān syāc ca hṛllāsaḥ sāṅgavedanaḥ | saṃgharṣo balavān asthisaṃdhiprāpte ’sthipūrṇatā
verses.tib: sgra dang bcas par 'byung ba dang / snying dang yan lag na bcas 'gyur / rus tshigs bog rer mtshon lus pa / rus brtse tshabs cher na bar 'gyur / rus gnas nad mang skrang bar byed

verses.skt: naikarūpā rujo ’sthisthe śophas tadvac ca saṃdhige | ceṣṭānivṛttiś ca bhaved āṭopaḥ koṣṭhasaṃśrite
verses.tib: tshigs la gnas pa de dang 'dra / bskyod par dka' ba dag tu'ang 'gyur / nang grol nang yod 'khrugs pa dang

verses.skt: ānāho ’nnaśakṛnmūtradarśanaṃ ca vraṇānane | vidyān marmagataṃ śalyaṃ marmaviddhopalakṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: lbo zhing kha zas ngan skyugs gcin / rma yi khar ni 'byung bar 'gyur / gnad kyi nang du mtshon lus pa / gnad zug mtshan nyid las / shes bya

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ ca parisrāvais tvagādiṣu vibhāvayet | ruhyate śuddhadehānām anulomasthitaṃ tu tat
verses.tib: pags pa la sogs rang rang gi / ji ltar 'dzag las shes par bya / skyon med lus kyi rma 'tsho ba ste / de ni gnod pa med par gnas

verses.skt: doṣakopābhighātādikṣobhād bhūyo ’pi bādhate | tvaṅnaṣṭe yatra tatra syur abhyaṅgasvedamardanaiḥ
verses.tib: nad 'khrugs snad pa la sogs kyis / bslangs nas slar yang gnod pa skyed / gang yang rung bar pags pa nyams / bsku dang mnye dang dugs byas nas

verses.skt: rāgarugdāhasaṃrambhā yatra cājyaṃ vilīyate | āśu śuṣyati lepo vā tatsthānaṃ śalyavad vadet
verses.tib: mdog dmar na zhing tsha la 'khrugs / yang na gang du mar gzhag 'ju / lde gus byugs pa myur du bskams / gnas der zug rngu bcas shes bya

verses.skt: māṃsapraṇaṣṭaṃ saṃśuddhyā karśanāc chlathatāṃ gatam | kṣobhād rāgādibhiḥ śalyaṃ lakṣayet tadvad eva ca
verses.tib: shar lus sbyang bar byas pa yis / skem byas lhongs 'gyur bskul ba dang / btsan dmar sogs kyis shes par bya / nya dang rus tshigs nang grol gyi / zug rngu'ang de bzhin shes par bya / rus pa zug rngus ma rungs 'gyur

verses.skt: peśyasthisaṃdhikoṣṭheṣu naṣṭam asthiṣu lakṣayet | asthnām abhyañjanasvedabandhapīḍanamardanaiḥ
verses.tib: rus pa bsku dang dugs bya zhing / mnye dang btsir las shes par bya / rus tshigs gnas pa rus 'dra dang

verses.skt: prasāraṇākuñcanataḥ saṃdhinaṣṭaṃ tathāsthivat | naṣṭe snāyusirāsrotodhamanīṣv asame pathi
verses.tib: brkyang dang bskum las shes par bya / chu ba rtsa dang rtsa chen sbubs / zug rngu mi mnyam lam 'gro dang

verses.skt: aśvayuktaṃ rathaṃ khaṇḍacakram āropya rogiṇam | śīghraṃ nayet tatas tasya saṃrambhāc chalyam ādiśet
verses.tib: shing rta chag pa'i rta dang ni / ldan par nad pa bskyon nas su / myur du drangs nas de nas ni / bskyod pas zug rngu shes par bya

verses.skt: marmanaṣṭaṃ pṛthaṅ noktaṃ teṣāṃ māṃsādisaṃśrayāt | sāmānyena saśalyaṃ tu kṣobhiṇyā kriyayā saruk
verses.tib: gnad zug logs shig ma bshad de / de rnams sha la gnas yin / spyir ni zug rngu bcas bskyod pa'i / bya bas nad bcas las shes bya

verses.skt: vṛttaṃ pṛthu catuṣkoṇaṃ tripuṭaṃ ca samāsataḥ | adṛśyaśalyasaṃsthānaṃ vraṇākṛtyā vibhāvayet
verses.tib: mdor na zlum dang gyes pa dang / zur bzhi ba dang zur gsum pa'i / rma yi dbyibs las zug rngu ni / mi mngon rnam par shes par bya

verses.skt: teṣām āharaṇopāyau pratilomānulomakau | arvācīnaparācīne nirharet tadviparyayāt
verses.tib: de rnams dbyung ba'i thabs gyur gnyis / phyir drang ba dang mdun nas drang / rtse nas drang dang rtsa nas drang / de las bzlog pas dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: sukhāhāryaṃ yataś chittvā tatas tiryaggataṃ haret | śalyaṃ na nirghātyam uraḥkakṣāvaṅkṣaṇapārśvagam
verses.tib: dbyung sla gang na yod dral te / de nas thad kar drang bar bya / mtshon ni brang dang mtshan khung dang / brla drung rtsib logs zug pa dang

verses.skt: pratilomam anuttuṇḍaṃ chedyaṃ pṛthumukhaṃ ca yat | naivāhared viśalyaghnaṃ naṣṭaṃ vā nirupadravam
verses.tib: mdun drang rtse mo mngon gcad bya / kha zheng che drang mi bya dang / zug rngur ma gyur mde'u dang / mi mngon gnod med pa mi dbyung

verses.skt: athāharet karaprāpyaṃ kareṇaivetarat punaḥ | dṛśyaṃ siṃhāhimakaravarmikarkaṭakānanaiḥ
verses.tib: de nas lag pas zin gyur na / lag pa gnyis kyis drang bar bya / snang gzhan seng ge chu srin / dang / bar gyi karta ti mchus drang

verses.skt: adṛśyaṃ vraṇasaṃsthānād grahītuṃ śakyate yataḥ | kaṅkabhṛṅgāhvakuraraśarārivāyasānanaiḥ
verses.tib: mi mngon rma yi dbyibs las ni / gal te dbyung bar nus gyur pa / kang ka bring ka khrung khrung dang / bya rog sha ra bye'i mchus drang

verses.skt: saṃdaṃśābhyāṃ tvagādisthaṃ tālābhyāṃ suṣiraṃ haret | suṣirasthaṃ tu nalakaiḥ śeṣaṃ śeṣair yathāyatham
verses.tib: pags la gnas skam pas drang / khong stong nang nas nya mgos dbyung / sbu gur gnas pa 'dam bu 'dras / lhag ma gzhan gyis ci rigs drang

verses.skt: śastreṇa vā viśasyādau tato nirlohitaṃ vraṇam | kṛtvā ghṛtena saṃsvedya baddhācārikam ādiśet
verses.tib: yang na dang po mtshon gyis dral / de nas rma yi khrag bsal ba / byas la mar gyis dugs bya zhing / bcings te spyod pa bsten par bya

verses.skt: sirāsnāyuvilagnaṃ tu cālayitvā śalākayā | hṛdaye saṃsthitaṃ śalyaṃ trāsitasya himāmbunā
verses.tib: rtsa dang chu bar mtshon lus pa / thur mas bskyod de dbyung bar bya / snying gar gnas pa'i zug rngu ni / chu grang gtor bas sngangs byas la

verses.skt: tataḥ sthānāntaraṃ prāptaṃ āharet tad yathāyatham | yathāmārgaṃ durākarṣam anyato ’py evam āharet
verses.tib: gnas gzhan phyin cing 'phags gyur na / ci rigs par ni dbyung bar bya / rma yi sgo nas dbyung dka' ba / gzhan dag la yang de bzhin sbyar

verses.skt: asthidaṣṭe naraṃ padbhyāṃ pīḍayitvā vinirharet | ity aśakye subalibhiḥ sugṛhītasya kiṅkaraiḥ
verses.tib: rus par zug pa rkang pa ni / gnyis kyis mnan la drang bar bya / de ltar ma nus stobs che ba'i / g.yog gis dam du bzung ste dbyung

verses.skt: tathāpy aśakye vāraṅgaṃ vakrīkṛtya dhanurjyayā | subaddhaṃ vaktrakaṭake badhnīyāt susamāhitaḥ
verses.tib: 'on kyang ma nus mde'u'i rtsa / bkug la gzhu rgyud dam btags la / rta srab kyi ni kha lcags mthar / ma yengs pa yis dam btags te

verses.skt: susaṃyatasya pañcāṅgyā vājinaḥ kaśayātha tam | tāḍayed iti mūrdhānaṃ vegenonnamayan yathā
verses.tib: yan lag lnga pa legs bsdams nas / rta ni lcag gis gzhus nas su / brdeg cing mgo bo bteg nas ni / shugs kyis ji bzhin brtod nas ni

verses.skt: uddharec chalyam evaṃ vā śākhāyāṃ kalpayet taroḥ | baddhvā durbalavāraṅgaṃ kuśābhiḥ śalyam āharet
verses.tib: de ltar zug rngu dbyung ba'am / yang na shing gi yal gar gdags / mde'u rtsa phra bar srad bu dag

verses.skt: śvayathugrastavāraṅgaṃ śopham utpīḍya yuktitaḥ | mudgarāhatayā nāḍyā nirghātyottuṇḍitaṃ haret
verses.tib: btags te zug rngu dbyung bar bya / rma skrangs mde'u rtsa mi mngon na / skrangs pa lags par btsir nas dbyung / dong bu tho bas brdungs pa yis

verses.skt: tair eva cānayen mārgam amārgottuṇḍitaṃ tu yat | mṛditvā karṇināṃ karṇaṃ nāḍyāsyena nigṛhya vā
verses.tib: lam ma yin par 'byung ba gang / de nyid kyis ni rmar dbyung bya / mde'u zur bcum ste dbyung ba'am / dong bu kha yis dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: ayaskāntena niṣkarṇaṃ vivṛtāsyam ṛjusthitam | pakvāśayagataṃ śalyaṃ virekeṇa vinirharet
verses.tib: rna ba med cing rma kha dbye / drang 'dug khab long bstan pas dbyung / zhu ba'i gnas su zug rngu ni / bkru sman nyid kyis dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: duṣṭavātaviṣastanyaraktatoyādi cūṣaṇaiḥ | kaṇṭhasrotogate śalye sūtraṃ kaṇṭhe praveśayet
verses.tib: rlung gnod dugs dang nu zho dang / khrag dang chus gnod gzhibs pas bsal / gre ba'i nang zhugs / zug rngu la / skud pa gre bar gzhug bya ste

verses.skt: bisenātte tataḥ śalye bisaṃ sūtraṃ samaṃ haret | nāḍyāgnitāpitāṃ kṣiptvā śalākām apsthirīkṛtām
verses.tib: pad+ma'i rtsa bar skud pas gdags / pad rtsa zug rngu lhan cig drang / lcags sreg mig chur bcug pa yi / lcags thur brtan por byas nas ni

verses.skt: ānayej jātuṣaṃ kaṇṭhāj jatudigdhām ajātuṣam | keśondukena pītena dravaiḥ kaṇṭakam ākṣipet
verses.tib: rgya skyegs can nam rgya skyegs med / rgya skyegs kyis bsgos zug rngu dbyung / skra shad 'dzings pa 'thungs pa dang / gsher bas tsher ma zug pa gdon

verses.skt: sahasā sūtrabaddhena vamatas tena cetarat | aśakyaṃ mukhanāsābhyām āhartuṃ parato nudet
verses.tib: 'phral du srad bu thogs pa yis / slon par bya'o des cig shos / kha snar drang bar ma nus na / gzhan du thur du mid par bya

verses.skt: appānaskandhaghātābhyāṃ grāsaśalyaṃ praveśayet | sūkṣmākṣivraṇaśalyāni kṣaumavālajalair haret
verses.tib: zas kyis brnangs pa'i zug rngu ni / chu btung phrag par brdegs pas gzhug / mig gi rma yi zug rngu phra / dar ram bal lam chu yis bsal

verses.skt: apāṃ pūrṇaṃ vidhunuyād avākśirasam āyatam | vāmayec cāmukhaṃ bhasmarāśau vā nikhanen naram
verses.tib: mi ni chus gang kha sbubs te / sprugs pa'am brkyang la btsir slon pa'am / thal khung brkos te mi yi ni / ske yi bar du nub par gzhug

verses.skt: karṇe ’mbupūrṇe hastena mathitvā tailavāriṇī | kṣiped adhomukhaṃ karṇaṃ hanyād vācūṣayeta vā
verses.tib: rna ba chus gang lag pa yis / mnyes la til mar rgyun blugs la / rna ba thur du bstan nas ni / gdab pa'am yang na brngub bar bya

verses.skt: kīṭe srotogate karṇaṃ pūrayed lavaṇāmbunā | śuktena vā sukhoṣṇena mṛte kledaharo vidhiḥ
verses.tib: rna ba'i nang du 'bu zhugs na / rna ba tsha chus bkang ba'am / tsha chu dro 'jam nyid kyis dgang / shi nas 'bu ro dbyung thabs bya

verses.skt: jātuṣaṃ hemarūpyādidhātujaṃ ca cirasthitam | ūṣmaṇā prāyaśaḥ śalyaṃ dehajena vilīyate
verses.tib: rgya skyegs can dang gser dngul / 'byung khungs las byung yun gnas / mtshon ni phal cher lus kyi me / drod kyis 'ju bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: mṛdveṇudāruśṛṅgāsthidantavālopalāni na | viṣāṇaveṇvayastāladāruśalyaṃ cirād api
verses.tib: sa dang 'od ma shing rwa rus / so dang skra dang rdo ba'ang 'ju / rwa dang 'od tshal lcags ta la / shing tshal zug rngu ring pos kyang

verses.skt: prāyo nirbhujyate tad dhi pacaty āśu palāsṛjī | śalye māṃsāvagāḍhe cet sa deśo na vidahyate
verses.tib: phal cher de dag tshos 'gyur la / khrag dang sha yis tshos par byed / zug rngu sha yi gting du zug / phyogs de tsha ba'am med gyur na

verses.skt: tatas taṃ mardanasvedaśuddhikarṣaṇabṛṃhaṇaiḥ | tīkṣṇopanāhapānānnaghanaśastrapadāṅkanaiḥ
verses.tib: de nas de ni snang bya'i phyir / mnye dugs sbyangs dang sha dbri blta / sman rnon bcings dang zas skom sbyin / mtshon gyis btab cing gtsags pa yis

verses.skt: pācayitvā harec chalyaṃ pāṭanaiṣaṇabhedanaiḥ | śalyapradeśayantrāṇām avekṣya bahurūpatām
verses.tib: smin par byas nas rma dbral dang / btsal dang bye bas zug rngu dbyung / zug rngu'i gnas dang cha spyad kyi / tshul ni mang pos legs brtags te

verses.skt: tais tair upāyair matimān śalyaṃ vidyāt tathāharet
verses.tib: blo ldan thabs ni de dang des / shes par byas la zug rngu dbyung

verses.skt: vraṇaḥ saṃjāyate prāyaḥ pākāc chvayathupūrvakāt | tam evopacaret tasmād rakṣan pākaṃ prayatnataḥ
verses.tib: rma ni phal cher dang por ni / skrangs dang smin las 'byung bar 'gyur / de bas de nyid gso bya ste / de bsil byugs blugs khrag dbyung dang / legs par sbyangs pa la sogs pas / smin par gyur las 'bad de bsrung / thor bu ma smin skrangs drod chung / mdog 'dra sra zhing brtan par gnas

verses.skt: suśītalepasekāsramokṣasaṃśodhanādibhiḥ | śopho ’lpo ’lpoṣmaruk sāmaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṭhinaḥ sthiraḥ
verses.tib: rma ni phal cher dang por ni / skrangs dang smin las 'byung bar 'gyur / de bas de nyid gso bya ste / de bsil byugs blugs khrag dbyung dang / legs par sbyangs pa la sogs pas / smin par gyur las 'bad de bsrung / thor bu ma smin skrangs drod chung / mdog 'dra sra zhing brtan par gnas

verses.skt: pacyamāno vivarṇas tu rāgī vastir ivātataḥ | sphuṭatīva sanistodaḥ sāṅgamardavijṛmbhikaḥ
verses.tib: smin tshe mdog ni 'gyur ba dang / dmar zhing rkyal bu'i dbyibs ltar 'dug / gas pa lta bu'i nad bcas dang / yan lag snyom zhing glal bcas dang

verses.skt: saṃrambhārucidāhoṣātṛḍjvarānidratānvitaḥ | styānaṃ viṣyandayaty ājyaṃ vraṇavat sparśanāsahaḥ
verses.tib: lus grugs 'khrugs tsha yig 'chus / rims 'debs skom dad gnyid med dang / mar 'khyags bzhag na 'ju ba dang / rma gtar reg na mi bzod do

verses.skt: pakve ’lpavegatā mlāniḥ pāṇḍutā valisaṃbhavaḥ | nāmo ’nteṣūnnatir madhye kaṇḍūśophādimārdavam
verses.tib: smin gyur na ba'i shugs chung zhing / rnyid cing skya la gnyer ma 'du / mtha' ma 'jum zhing dbus su mtho / g.ya' dang skrang ba la sogs chung

verses.skt: spṛṣṭe pūyasya saṃcāro bhaved vastāv ivāmbhasaḥ | śūlaṃ narte ’nilād dāhaḥ pittāc chophaḥ kaphodayāt
verses.tib: rkyal pa yi ni chu lta bur / reg na rnag ni phan tshun rgyu / rlung min min mkhris min tsha / med de bad kan med mi skrang

verses.skt: rāgo raktāc ca pākaḥ syād ato doṣaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ | pāke ’tivṛtte suṣiras tanutvagdoṣabhakṣitaḥ
verses.tib: de bas nad khrag dang bcas smin / smin pa thal drags khong stong dang / nad kyis zos pas pags pa srab

verses.skt: valībhir ācitaḥ śyāvaḥ śīryamāṇatanūruhaḥ | kaphajeṣu tu śopheṣu gambhīraṃ pākam ety asṛk
verses.tib: gnyer ma 'jum zhing mdog gnag la / ba spu rnams ni 'byi bar 'gyur / bad kan shas che'i skrang pa ni / smin pa gting ring khrag gis gang

verses.skt: pakvaliṅgaṃ tato ’spaṣṭaṃ yatra syāc chītaśophatā | tvaksāvarṇyaṃ rujo ’lpatvaṃ ghanasparśatvam aśmavat
verses.tib: de bas smin rtags gsal ma yin / skrang pa gang du bsil 'gyur zhing / pags mdog mi 'gyur nad tshabs chung / rdo ltar reg na sra ba ni

verses.skt: raktapākam iti brūyāt taṃ prājño muktasaṃśayaḥ | alpasattve ’bale bāle pākād vātyartham uddhate
verses.tib: mkhas pas the tshom med par de / khrag gi smin pa zhes bshad bya / snying stobs nyam chung byis pa dang / thor bu smin pa'i tshabs che'am

verses.skt: dāraṇaṃ marmasaṃdhyādisthite cānyatra pāṭanam | āmacchede sirāsnāyuvyāpado ’sṛgatisrutiḥ
verses.tib: gnad dang rus tshigs la sogs par / 'byung ba ma gtogs gzhan dag 'dral / ma smin brtol na rtsa rgyus la / gnod cing khrag ni mang du 'byung

verses.skt: rujo ’tivṛddhir daraṇaṃ visarpo vā kṣatodbhavaḥ | tiṣṭhann antaḥ punaḥ pūyaḥ sirāsnāyvasṛgāmiṣam
verses.tib: nad tshabs rab 'phel rma gyes pa'am / rma 'byung thor bu 'byung bar 'gyur / rnag ni nang du gnas gyur pa / 'phel / bas rtsa rgyus sha dang ni

verses.skt: vivṛddho dahati kṣipraṃ tṛṇolapam ivānalaḥ | yaś chinatty āmam ajñānād yaś ca pakvam upekṣate
verses.tib: khrag rnams myur du sreg byed de / rtswa skam la ni me dang mtshungs / gang zhig ma smin brtol ba dang / gang zhig smin kyang btang snyoms 'jog

verses.skt: śvapacāv iva vijñeyau tāv aniścitakāriṇau | prāk śastrakarmaṇaś ceṣṭaṃ bhojayed annam āturam
verses.tib: khyad par mi shes de dag ni / sme sha can 'drar shes par bya / ma brtol ba yi dang po ni / kha zas phan pa sbyin par bya

verses.skt: pānapaṃ pāyayen madyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ yo vedanākṣamaḥ | na mūrchaty annasaṃyogān mattaḥ śastraṃ na budhyate
verses.tib: tshor ba mi bzad bzod 'gyur bas / chang 'thung ba la chang blud bya / zas zos pas ni mi brgyal zhing / nang du mtshon btab tshor mi 'gyur

verses.skt: anyatra mūḍhagarbhāśmamukharogodarāturāt | athāhṛtopakaraṇaṃ vaidyaḥ prāṅmukham āturam
verses.tib: rum du bu shi rde'u chags pa dang / kha nad dmu rdzing can ma gtogs / de nas yo byad kun bsags te / nad pa shar du kha bstan la

verses.skt: saṃmukho yantrayitvāśu nyasyen marmādi varjayan | anulomaṃ suniśitaṃ śastram āpūyadarśanāt
verses.tib: sman pa mngon phyogs bsdams nas ni / gnad ma gtogs gtsags bus gdab / sha shugs rjes mthun shin tu rno / gtsags bu rnag phyin bar du gdab

verses.skt: sakṛd evāharec tac ca pāke tu sumahaty api | pāṭayed dvyaṅgulaṃ samyag dvyaṅgulatryaṅgulāntaram
verses.tib: de ni cig car gdab bar bya / smin pa chen po yod kyang ni / rma zheng sor gnyis dral bya'am / sor gnyis pa yi zab sor gsum

verses.skt: eṣitvā samyag eṣiṇyā paritaḥ sunirūpitam | aṅgulīnālavālair vā yathādeśaṃ yathāśayam
verses.tib: mdzub mo chu ba spu dag gis / gnas phyogs ji bzhin brtag pa'am / rma 'tshol gyis ni legs btsal zhing / kun tu legs par brtag par bya

verses.skt: yato gatāṃ gatiṃ vidyād utsaṅgo yatra yatra ca | tatra tatra vraṇaṃ kuryāt suvibhaktaṃ nirāśayam
verses.tib: gang nas gang du 'gro bar 'gyur / gang du mtho ba shes byas la / de dang der ni rma btod de / legs phye phug ni med par bya

verses.skt: āyataṃ ca viśālaṃ ca yathā doṣo na tiṣṭhati | śauryam āśukriyā tīkṣṇaṃ śastram asvedavepathū
verses.tib: chu dang zheng du ci nas kyang / nad ni gnas par mi 'gyur bya / sman pa dpa' brtan las la myur / mtshon rno mi rtul mi 'dar la

verses.skt: asaṃmohaś ca vaidyasya śastrakarmaṇi śasyate | tiryak chindyāl lalāṭabhrūdantaveṣṭakajatruṇi
verses.tib: kun tu rmongs par ma gyur pa / gtsags bus 'debs pa'i las la bsngags / gyen du bcad rtsa 'phral smin rtsa / rnyil dang ske rtsa lto sbos dang

verses.skt: kukṣikakṣākṣikūṭauṣṭhakapolagalavaṅkṣaṇe | anyatra cchedanāt tiryak sirāsnāyuvipāṭanam
verses.tib: mchan khung dang ni mig sbubs mchu / mkhur tshos brla drung chu so rtsa'o / gzhan dag gyen du bcad na ni / rtsa dang chu ba'ang ma rungs 'gyur

verses.skt: śastre ’vacārite vāgbhiḥ śītāmbhobhiś ca rogiṇam | āśvāsya parito ’ṅgulyā paripīḍya vraṇaṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: gtsags bus btab nas nad pa ni / tshig snyan chu ni bsil ba yis / dbugs phyung nas ni de 'og rma / sor mos kun nas btsir ba dang

verses.skt: kṣālayitvā kaṣāyeṇa plotenāmbho ’panīya ca | guggulvagurusiddhārthahiṅgusarjarasānvitaiḥ
verses.tib: bska ba'i chu yis legs bkrus shing / sman chur bcug pa'i gos kyis phyi / gu gul yungs kar a / ru ra / shing kun ka ra rgyam tsha dang

verses.skt: dhūpayec paṭuṣaḍgranthānimbapattrair ghṛtaplutaiḥ | tilakalkājyamadhubhir yathāsvaṃ bheṣajena ca
verses.tib: shu dag nim pa'i lo ma ni / mar dang sbyar bas bdug par bya / til gyi lde gu mar sbrang rtsi / rang gi sman ni ji lta bas

verses.skt: digdhāṃ vartiṃ tato dadyāt tair evācchādayec ca tām | ghṛtāktaiḥ saktubhiś cordhvaṃ ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: byugs shing de nas rma tshangs gzhug / de nyid kyis ni de g.yogs la / mar dang phye sprus bskus pa dang / de'i 'og kog tse stug po ni

verses.skt: nidhāya yuktyā badhnīyāt paṭṭena susamāhitam | pārśve savye ’pasavye vā nādhastān naiva copari
verses.tib: gzhag ste shin tu ma yengs pas / gos kyis legs par bcing byas te / glo dang g.yas dang g.yon dag gam / steng dang 'og tu ma song bya

verses.skt: śucisūkṣmadṛḍhāḥ paṭṭāḥ kavalyaḥ savikeśikāḥ | dhūpitā mṛdavaḥ ślakṣṇā nirvalīkā vraṇe hitāḥ
verses.tib: rma tshangs kog tse dkris mar bcas / phra zhing sra la gtsang ba la / spos kyis bdugs shing 'jam la mnyen / kham khum med cing rma la phan

verses.skt: kurvītānantaraṃ tasya rakṣāṃ rakṣoniṣiddhaye | baliṃ copaharet tebhyaḥ sadā mūrdhnā ca dhārayet
verses.tib: bcings nas de'i 'og tu de / gnod pa bzlog phyir bsrung bar bya / de rnams la ni gtor ma sbyin / lak+Sh+mi gu ha a ti gu ha / spang spos pra ma tsa ri ni / tsha tra a ti tsha tra dang / dur ba shu dag nyungs kar dag / rtag tu de yi spyi bor btags

verses.skt: lakṣmīṃ guhām atiguhāṃ jaṭilāṃ brahmacāriṇīm | vacāṃ chattrām aticchattrāṃ dūrvāṃ siddhārthakān api
verses.tib: bcings nas de'i 'og tu de / gnod pa bzlog phyir bsrung bar bya / de rnams la ni gtor ma sbyin / lak+Sh+mi gu ha a ti gu ha / spang spos pra ma tsa ri ni / tsha tra a ti tsha tra dang / dur ba shu dag nyungs kar dag / rtag tu de yi spyi bor btags

verses.skt: tataḥ snehadinehoktaṃ tasyācāraṃ samādiśet | divāsvapno vraṇe kaṇḍūrāgarukśophapūyakṛt
verses.tib: de nas snum gyi cho gar bshad / nyin re'i kun spyod bshad pa bstan / nyin par gnyid log rma g.ya' zhing / kha dmar na skrangs rnag 'khyims 'gyur

verses.skt: strīṇāṃ tu smṛtisaṃsparśadarśanaiś calitasrute | śukre vyavāyajān doṣān asaṃsarge ’py avāpnuyāt
verses.tib: bud med dran nam reg pa'am / mthong bas khu ba byung 'gyur na / ma phrad na'ang 'khrig pa las / byung ba'i skyon ni thob par 'gyur

verses.skt: vraṇe śvayathur āyāsāt sa ca rāgaś ca jāgarāt | tau ca ruk ca divāsvāpāt tāś ca mṛtyuś ca maithunāt
bhojanaṃ ca yathāsātmyaṃ yavagodhūmaṣaṣṭikāḥ | masūramudgatubarījīvantīsuniṣaṇṇakāḥ
verses.tib: kha zas dag ni gang goms las / nas dang gro dang drug cu pa / sran chung mung+ga du ba ri / ni shan nA ga dzi ban+ti

verses.skt: bālamūlakavārtākataṇḍulīyakavāstukam | kāravellakakarkoṭapaṭolakaṭukāphalam
verses.tib: la phug gzhon nu brta ka / rgya sne'u dan+du li ya ka / ka ra be+e la karko ta / ka du ga pal pa to la

verses.skt: saindhavaṃ dāḍimaṃ dhātrī ghṛtaṃ taptahimaṃ jalam | jīrṇaśālyodanaṃ snigdham alpam uṣṇodakottaram
verses.tib: rgyam tsha se 'bru skyu ru ra / chu bskol ba ni bsgrangs pa dang / 'bras rnying chang dang snum nyung zad / zos rjes su chu tshan btung ba dang

verses.skt: bhuñjāno jāṅgalair māṃsaiḥ śīghraṃ vraṇam apohati | aśitaṃ mātrayā kāle pathyaṃ yāti jarāṃ sukham
verses.tib: skam sa'i sha ni zos gyur na / rma ni myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur / dus su ran par bza' ba dang / phan pa zos na bde 'ju 'gyur

verses.skt: ajīrṇāt tv anilādīnāṃ vibhramo balavān bhavet | tataḥ śopharujāpākadāhānāhān avāpnuyāt
verses.tib: ma zhu ba yi rlung la / ldang zhing nad ni stobs can 'gyur / de las skrangs dang rnags pa dang / tsha dang sbos par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: navaṃ dhānyaṃ tilān māṣān madyaṃ māṃsam ajāṅgalam | kṣīrekṣuvikṛtīr amlaṃ lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ tyajet
verses.tib: 'bru gsar til dang ma sha dang / chang dang rlan can las byung sha / 'o ma bu ram shing / las gyur / skyur dang lan tshwa tsha ba dang

verses.skt: yac cānyad api viṣṭambhi vidāhi guru śītalam | vargo ’yaṃ navadhānyādir vraṇinaḥ sarvadoṣakṛt
verses.tib: gzhan gang 'khru ba gcod byed dang / tsha dang bsil dang lci ba yang / 'bru sa ra la sogs sde tshan 'di / rma dang lan pa'i nad kun skyed

verses.skt: madyaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣāmlam āśu vyāpādayed vraṇam | vālośīraiś ca vījyeta na cainaṃ parighaṭṭayet
verses.tib: chang ni rno ba tsha rtsub 'gyur / rma la myur du gnod par byed / ba la uR+shi ras g.yab cing / 'di ni bskyod par mi bya la

verses.skt: na tuden na ca kaṇḍūyec ceṣṭamānaś ca pālayet | snigdhavṛddhadvijātīnāṃ kathāḥ śṛṇvan manaḥpriyāḥ
verses.tib: drag shul mi gzug 'phrug mi bya / bskyod pa'i tshe na bag bya'o / mdza' dang bram ze rgan kyi / gtam ni yid la dga' ba nyan

verses.skt: āśāvān vyādhimokṣāya kṣipraṃ vraṇam apohati | tṛtīye ’hni punaḥ kuryād vraṇakarma ca pūrvavat
verses.tib: nad las thar ba'i re bcas pas / rma ni myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur / nyin gsum lon tshe rma yi tshas

verses.skt: prakṣālanādi divase dvitīye nācaret tathā | tīvravyatho vigrathitaś cirāt saṃrohati vraṇaḥ
verses.tib: slar yang bkrus sogs las rnams ni / snga ma bzhin bya de bzhin du / nyin zhag gnyis par mi bya'o / tshabs cher na zhing mi 'byar la / rma ni yun ring zhig na 'tsho

verses.skt: snigdhāṃ rūkṣāṃ ślathāṃ gāḍhāṃ durnyastāṃ ca vikeśikām | vraṇe na dadyāt kalkaṃ vā snehāt kledo vivardhate
verses.tib: rma tshangs sam ni lde gus glan / snum ches rtsub ches dam pa dang / lhod drags gzhag nyes mi bya ste / snum ches rma ni rid par 'gyur

verses.skt: māṃsacchedo ’tirugraukṣyād daraṇaṃ śoṇitāgamaḥ | ślathātigāḍhadurnyāsair vraṇavartmāvagharṣaṇam
verses.tib: rtsub ches sha 'chad shin tu na / gas shing khrag ni 'byung bar 'gyur / dam dang klod drags gzhag nyes pas / rma yi kha ni 'drud par 'gyur

verses.skt: sapūtimāṃsaṃ sotsaṅgaṃ sagatiṃ pūyagarbhiṇam | vraṇaṃ viśodhayec chīghraṃ sthitā hy antar vikeśikā
verses.tib: rma ni rnag bcas skrangs shing mtho / rgyu bcas rnag phugs 'chas pa dag / rma tshangs 'jam po nang gnas pas / rma yi skyon ni dag par byed

verses.skt: vyamlaṃ tu pāṭitaṃ śophaṃ pācanaiḥ samupācaret | bhojanair upanāhaiś ca nātivraṇavirodhibhiḥ
verses.tib: skrangs pa ha cang ma smin brtol / smin zhing rnags par 'gyur ba spyad / phan pa'i sman dang zas sbyin dkri / shin tu rmar mi gnod pas gso

verses.skt: sadyaḥ sadyovraṇān sīvyed vivṛtān abhighātajān | medojā¿ likhitān granthīn hrasvāḥ pālīś ca karṇayoḥ
verses.tib: snad pa'i rma ni gsar du byung / ral zhing kha bye 'phral du btsem / rmen bu chen po bkas pa dang / rna shal bu ga chad pa'ang btsem

verses.skt: śiro'kṣikūṭanāsauṣṭhagaṇḍakarṇorubāhuṣu | grīvālalāṭamuṣkasphiṅmeḍhrapāyūdarādiṣu
verses.tib: mgo dang mig phugs sna dang mchu / mkhur tshos rna pa dpung pa brla / mgul pa phrag pa rlig pa dpyi / pho mtshan gzhang dang lto ba

verses.skt: gambhīreṣu pradeśeṣu māṃsaleṣv acaleṣu ca | na tu vaṅkṣaṇakakṣādāv alpamāṃse cale vraṇān
verses.tib: phugs ring ba yi gnas rnams dang / sha che mi 'gul ma yin dang / chu so mchan khung la dang / sha chung mgul pa'i rma dag dang

verses.skt: vāyunirvāhiṇaḥ śalyagarbhān kṣāraviṣāgnijān | sīvyec calāsthiśuṣkāsratṛṇaromāpanīya tu
verses.tib: dbugs dbyung zug rngu yod pa dang / thal sman dug mes tshig mi btsem / btsem pa rus dum khrag skam / dang / rtsa dang spu rnams bsal nas ni

verses.skt: pralambi māṃsaṃ vicchinnaṃ niveśya svaniveśane | saṃdhyasthi ca sthite rakte snāyvā sūtreṇa valkalaiḥ
verses.tib: sha chad dum bu 'phyang ba dang / rang gi gnas su glan pa dang / rus tshigs bcug cing khrag gzags la / skud pa shing shun rgyus pas btsem
