verses.skt: sīvyen na dūre nāsanne gṛhṇan nālpaṃ na vā bahu | sāntvayitvā tataś cārtaṃ vraṇe madhughṛtadrutaiḥ
verses.tib: srubs ni nye ba'am ring mi bya / blang ba che ba'am chung mi bya / de nas spro bsring byas nas mthar / rma ni sbrang rtsi mar sbyar dang

verses.skt: añjanakṣaumajamaṣīphalinīśallakīphalaiḥ | salodhramadhukair digdhe yuñjyād bandhādi pūrvavat
verses.tib: skyer pa zar ma'i dud pa dang / 'bras bu gsum dang sa la ki / seng phrom mngar dang snum bcas pas / bskus la bcing sngon bzhin bya

verses.skt: vraṇo niḥśoṇitauṣṭho yaḥ kiñcid evāvalikhya tam | saṃjātarudhiraṃ sīvyet saṃdhānaṃ hy asya śoṇitam
verses.tib: rma kha khrag ni med 'gyur gang / de ni cung zad 'brud bya ste / rma 'byor byed pa khrag yin pas / phyung ste legs par drub par bya

verses.skt: bandhanāni tu deśādīn vīkṣya yuñjīta teṣu ca | āvikājinakauśeyam uṣṇaṃ kṣaumaṃ tu śītalam
verses.tib: de la bcings pa yul la / brtags nas nges par sbyar bar bya / bal gos pags pa dar gsum dro / zar ma'i ras ni bsil ba yin

verses.skt: śītoṣṇaṃ tulāsaṃtānakārpāsasnāyuvalkajam | tāmrāyastrapusīsāni vraṇe medaḥkaphādhike
verses.tib: dro grang ran pa shing bal 'dab / ras bal rgyus pa shing shun yin / zangs lcags zha nye ro nye yis / bad kan tshil ches rma la glan

verses.skt: bhaṅge ca yuñjyāt phalakaṃ carmavalkakuśādi ca | svanāmānugatākārā bandhās tu daśa pañca ca
verses.tib: chag thur shing byang pags pa dang / shing shun smyig tshal pas bcings / dbyibs ni rang min rjes mthun pa'i / bcing ba bco lnga rnam bya ste

verses.skt: kośasvastikamuttolīcīnadāmānuvellitam | khaṭvāvibandhasthagikāvitānotsaṅgagoṣphaṇāḥ
verses.tib: shubs dang bkra shis lhod par bcing / mthar chags bcing dang zlum por bcing / mda' lcags khri dang dam bcing dang / sgye'u bla re lkog shal dang

verses.skt: yamakaṃ maṇḍalākhyaṃ ca pañcāṅgī ceti yojayet | yo yatra suniviṣṭaḥ syāt taṃ teṣāṃ tatra buddhimān
verses.tib: 'ur mthil zung glan zlum pa dang / yan lag lnga pa zhes bya sbyar / de las gang zhig gang legs sbyor

verses.skt: vidadhyāt teṣu teṣv eva kośam aṅguliparvasu | svastikaṃ karṇakakṣādistaneṣūktaṃ ca saṃdhiṣu
muttolīṃ meḍhragrīvādau yuñjyāc cīnam apāṅgayoḥ | saṃbādhe ’ṅge tathā dāma śākhāsv evānuvellitam
verses.tib: de ni de ru legs par sbyar / brla dang mjug tsos mchan khung dang / chu so spyi bor dam du bcing

verses.skt: khaṭvāṃ gaṇḍe hanau śaṅkhe vibandhaṃ pṛṣṭhakodare | aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimeḍhrāgre sthagikām antravṛddhiṣu
vitānaṃ pṛthulāṅgādau tathā śirasi cerayet | vilambini tathotsaṅgaṃ nāsauṣṭhacibukādiṣu
goṣphaṇaṃ saṃdhiṣu tathā yamakaṃ yamike vraṇe | vṛtte ’ṅge maṇḍalākhyaṃ ca pañcāṅgīṃ cordhvajatruṣu
badhnīyād gāḍham ūrusphikkakṣāvaṅkṣaṇamūrdhasu | śākhāvadanakarṇoraḥpṛṣṭhapārśvagalodare
verses.tib: lag ngar gdong dang rna ba dang / rgyab dang rtsib logs mgul pa lto / pho mtshan rlig pa ran par bcing

verses.skt: samaṃ mehanamuṣke ca netre saṃdhiṣu ca ślatham | badhnīyāc chithilasthāne vātaśleṣmodbhave samam
verses.tib: mig dang tshigs su lhod par bcing / lhod bcings rma ni bad kan dang / rlung shas che la ran par bcing

verses.skt: gāḍham eva samasthāne bhṛśaṃ gāḍhaṃ tadāśaye | śīte vasante ’pi ca tau mokṣaṇīyau tryahāt tryahāt
verses.tib: ran zhing gnas su dam du bcing / dam zhing shin tu dam du bcing / dgun dang de bzhin dpyid kyi tshe / zhag ni gsum gsum dag nas dgrol

verses.skt: pittaraktotthayor bandho gāḍhasthāne samo mataḥ | samasthāne ślatho naiva śithilasyāśaye tathā
verses.tib: khrag mkhris shas che'i rma dag ni / dam bcing gnas su ran par bcing / ran bcing / gnas su lhod par bcing / lhod bcing gnas su bcing mi bya

verses.skt: sāyaṃ prātas tayor mokṣo grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate | abaddho daṃśamaśakaśītavātādipīḍitaḥ
verses.tib: de gnyis so ga ston gyi tshe / snga dro phyi dro dgrol bar bya / ma bcings sha sbrang sbrang bu dang / lhags pa ser bu pas gnod

verses.skt: duṣṭībhavec ciraṃ cātra na tiṣṭhet snehabheṣajam | kṛcchreṇa śuddhiṃ rūḍhiṃ vā yāti rūḍho vivarṇatām
verses.tib: rma red 'gyur zhing der snum dang / sman ni yun ring gnas mi 'gyur / sbyang ba'am 'tsho bar dka' ba dang / 'tshob kyang mdog ni mi sdug 'gyur

verses.skt: baddhas tu cūrṇito bhagno viśliṣṭaḥ pāṭito ’pi vā | chinnasnāyusiro ’py āśu sukhaṃ saṃrohati vraṇaḥ
verses.tib: bcings na chag bcing phyi mar 'gyur / 'phres sam 'bur gyur dral gyur tam / rtsa dang rgyus pa chad gyur kyang / rma ni myur du bde bar 'tsho

verses.skt: utthānaśayanādyāsu sarvehāsu na pīḍyate | udvṛttauṣṭhaḥ samutsanno viṣamaḥ kaṭhino ’tiruk
verses.tib: ldang dang nyal ba la sogs pa'i / spyod lam kun la gnod pa med / rma kha skyes mtho mi mnyam dang / sra zhing rab na 'tsho ba dka'

verses.skt: samo mṛdur aruk śīghraṃ vraṇaḥ śudhyati rohati | sthirāṇām alpamāṃsānāṃ raukṣyād anuparohatām
verses.tib: 'jam zhing mnyam la na ba med / rma ni myur du dag cing 'tshob / rma ni yun ring sha chung dang / rtsub pas 'byor par ma gyur na

verses.skt: pracchādyam auṣadhaṃ pattrair yathādoṣaṃ yathartu ca | ajīrṇataruṇāc chidraiḥ samantāt suniveśitaiḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi dus tshigs ji bzhin du / sman dang lo mas dgab par bya / ma rnying gzhon zhing bu ga med / kun nas legs par khebs pa dang

verses.skt: dhautair akarkaśaiḥ kṣīribhūrjārjunakadambajaiḥ | kuṣṭhinām agnidagdhānāṃ piṭikā madhumehinām
verses.tib: phyis shing mi rtsub lo ma ni / 'o ma can shing stag pa dang / ardzu na dang ka dam+ba'i / lo ma yis ni g.yogs par bya / mdze dang me yis tshig pa dang / 'bus zos gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra

verses.skt: karṇikāś conduruviṣe kṣāradagdhā viṣānvitāḥ | bandhanīyā na māṃspāke gudapāke ca dāruṇe
verses.tib: byi ba sbrul gyi dug dang ni / thal sman rno dang dug gis pho / rma ni bcing bar mi bya zhing / sha 'drul gzhang khar mi bzad rnags

verses.skt: śīryamāṇāḥ sarugdāhāḥ śophāvasthāvisarpiṇaḥ | arakṣayā vraṇe yasmin makṣikā nikṣipet kṛmīn
verses.tib: 'drul zhing tsha dang na bcas par / skrangs skams med bal mi bcing ngo / rma gang legs par ma bsrungs par / sbrang ma srin bu 'jug byed de

verses.skt: te bhakṣayantaḥ kurvanti rujāśophāsrasaṃsravān | surasādiṃ prayuñjīta tatra dhāvanapūraṇe
verses.tib: de yis zos pas na ba dang / skrang dang rnag khrag 'dzag par byed / der ni bkru dang dag par ni / bye'u rug la sogs sde tshan sbyar

verses.skt: saptaparṇakarañjārkanimbarājādanatvacaḥ | gomūtrakalkito lepaḥ sekaḥ kṣārāmbunā hitaḥ
verses.tib: sap+ta par+Ni ka rany+dza / arka dang ni nim pa dang / ra tsha dang ni shing tsha rnams / ba gcin dang ni btags pa yi / lde gu de la bsku ba dang / thal sman chu ni blugs pas phan

verses.skt: pracchādya māṃsapeśyā vā vraṇaṃ tān āśu nirharet | na cainaṃ tvaramāṇo ’ntaḥ sadoṣam uparohayet
verses.tib: yang na sha rlon gyis g.yogs la / de ni myur du dbyung bar bya / 'di ni nang na skyon bcas pas / myur du / 'tshob bar mi bya ste

verses.skt: so ’lpenāpy apacāreṇa bhūyo vikurute yataḥ | rūḍhe ’py ajīrṇavyāyāmavyavāyādīn vivarjayet
verses.tib: de ni gnod pa'ang chung ngus kyang / slar zhing 'grams par 'gyur ba yin / 'tshob par gyur kyang ma zhu dang / drag shul bud med bsten spang / zla ba drug gam bdun gyi bar / cho ga 'bad pas bsrung bar bya

verses.skt: harṣaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ cāpi yāvad āsthairyasaṃbhavāt | ādareṇānuvartyo ’yaṃ māsān ṣaṭ sapta vā vidhiḥ
verses.tib: de ni gnod pa'ang chung ngus kyang / slar zhing 'grams par 'gyur ba yin / 'tshob par gyur kyang ma zhu dang / drag shul bud med bsten spang / zla ba drug gam bdun gyi bar / cho ga 'bad pas bsrung bar bya

verses.skt: utpadyamānāsu ca tāsu tāsu vārtāsu doṣādibalānusārī | tais tair upāyaiḥ prayataś cikitsed ālocayan vistaram uttaroktam
verses.tib: gnas skabs de dang der ni byung gyur tshe / nad gzhi la stobs kyis rjes 'brangs te / phyi ma nas bshad rgya cher legs brtags la / thabs ni de dang de yis 'bad de gso

verses.skt: sarvaśastrānuśastrāṇāṃ kṣāraḥ śreṣṭho bahūni yat | chedyabhedyādikarmāṇi kurute viṣameṣv api
verses.tib: gtsags spyad lcags spyad rjes 'dra ba / mang po kun las thal sman mchog / dka' ba rnams su'ang bcad pa'am / dbug pa la byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: duḥkhāvacāryaśāstreṣu tena siddhim ayātsu ca | atikṛcchreṣu rogeṣu yac ca pāne ’pi yujyate
verses.tib: gtsags bus gdab par dka' ba la'ang / de yis bsgrub par rung ba dang / shin tu gso dka'i nad rnams la / gang zhig btung du'ang rung ba yin

verses.skt: sa peyo ’rśo'gnisādāśmagulmodaragarādiṣu | yojyaḥ sākṣān maṣaśvitrabāhyārśaḥkuṣṭhasuptiṣu
verses.tib: de ni gzhang 'brum me drod nyams / rde'u 'gags sbyar dug skran btung / sme ba sha bkra sna 'thor dang / phyi rol gzhang 'brum tshor med mdze

verses.skt: bhagandarārbudagranthiduṣṭanāḍīvraṇādiṣu | na tūbhayo ’pi yoktavyaḥ pitte rakte cale ’bale
verses.tib: thor bu 'brum phran mtshan bar rdol / rma log la byug par bya / khrag mkhris rlung can nad stobs chung

verses.skt: jvare ’tīsāre hṛnmūrdharoge pāṇḍvāmaye ’rucau | timire kṛtasaṃśuddhau śvayathau sarvagātrage
verses.tib: rims dang tshad 'khru snying klad nad / skya rbab yi ga 'chus pa dang / rab rib can la slon khrus btang / lus kun khyab pa'i 'or nad dang

verses.skt: bhīrugarbhiṇyṛtumatīprodvṛttaphalayoniṣu | ajīrṇe ’nne śiśau vṛddhe dhamanīsaṃdhimarmasu
verses.tib: 'jigs dang sbrum ma zla mtshan 'dzag / pho mtshan mo mtshan skrangs pa dang / byis pa rgan po zas ma zhu / rtsa bo che dang rus tshigs gnad

verses.skt: taruṇāsthisirāsnāyusevanīgalanābhiṣu | deśe ’lpamāṃse vṛṣaṇameḍhrasrotonakhāntare
verses.tib: rus pa gzhon nu chu ba rtsa / lto bsrubs mgul pa lte ba dang / sha srab phyogs dang rlig pa dang / pho mtshan bu ga sen mo phrag

verses.skt: vartmarogād ṛte ’kṣṇoś ca śītavarṣoṣṇadurdine | kālamuṣkakaśamyākakadalīpāribhadrakān
verses.tib: mig mchu ma gtogs mig nad rnams / tsha grang char dang yul rmus tshe / gnyi ga'ang gtang bar mi bya'o / mu ka ka nag sha mya ka / chu shing pa ri ba tra ka

verses.skt: aśvakarṇamahāvṛkṣapalāśāsphotavṛkṣakān | indravṛkṣārkapūtīkanaktamālāśvamārakān
verses.tib: a shwa ka r+Na 'dzam bu'i shing / pa la sha dang a po ta / en+d+ra br-ik+Sha arga dang / nag+ha ma la

verses.skt: kākajaṅghām apāmārgam agnimanthāgnitilvakān | sārdrān samūlaśākhādīn khaṇḍaśaḥ parikalpitān
verses.tib: muk+ti ka / sring shing a pa marga dang / ka ka dza ka tsi tra ka / ag+ni man+ta til bca' sga / rlon shing rtsa ba la bcas / dum bur yongs su gtubs pa dang

verses.skt: kośātakīs catasraś ca śūkaṃ nālaṃ yavasya ca | nivāte nicayīkṛtya pṛthak tāni śilātale
verses.tib: ko sha ta ka rnam bzhi dang / nas kyi sog ma gram rnams / rlung med gnas su bsags nas de / rdo leb steng du so sor gzhag

verses.skt: prakṣipya muṣkakacaye sudhāśmāni ca dīpayet | tatas tilānāṃ kutalair dagdhvāgnau vigate pṛthak
verses.tib: mu ka ka yi phung po dang / rdo thal rdo ni bcug par bya / de nas til gyi sdong bus bsreg / tshig nas me ni shi ba dang

verses.skt: kṛtvā sudhāśmanāṃ bhasma droṇaṃ tv itarabhasmanaḥ | muṣkakottaram ādāya pratyekaṃ jalamūtrayoḥ
verses.tib: rdo thal thal ba logs shig dbye / thal ba gzhan dag bre gang ste / mu ka'i thal lhag blangs nas ni / so sor phye ste chu dang gcin / srang stong dag dang bsres nas bzhu / tshags ni bzang pos de btsags la / ji srid 'byar bag dmar zhing dngas / rno bar gyur pa'i bar du ni

verses.skt: gālayed ardhabhāreṇa mahatā vāsasā ca tat | yāvat picchilaraktācchas tīkṣṇo jātas tadā ca tam
verses.tib: rdo thal thal ba logs shig dbye / thal ba gzhan dag bre gang ste / mu ka'i thal lhag blangs nas ni / so sor phye ste chu dang gcin / srang stong dag dang bsres nas bzhu / tshags ni bzang pos de btsags la / ji srid 'byar bag dmar zhing dngas / rno bar gyur pa'i bar du ni

verses.skt: gṛhītvā kṣāraniṣyandaṃ pacel lauhyāṃ vighaṭṭayan | pacyamāne tatas tasmiṃs tāḥ sudhābhasmaśarkarāḥ
verses.tib: thal ba'i dngas ma de blangs la / lcags snod bzang por bskol zhing dkrugs / de nas 'tshod par byed pa der / rdo thal bsregs rdo'i dum bu dang

verses.skt: śuktīḥ kṣīrapakaṃ śaṅkhanābhīś cāyasabhājane | kṛtvāgnivarṇān bahuśaḥ kṣārotthe kuḍavonmite
verses.tib: nya phyis k+Shi ra pa ka dang / dung gi lte ba lcags snod gzhug / me mdog can du lan mang bya / thal sman cha ni phul gang dang

verses.skt: nirvāpya piṣṭvā tenaiva pratīvāpaṃ vinikṣipet | ślakṣṇaṃ śakṛd dakṣaśikhigṛdhrakaṅkakapotajam
verses.tib: me bsad de nyid dang btags la / lde gu der ni gzhug par bya / khyim bya rma bya bya rgod dang / kang+ka phug ron rtug pa dang

verses.skt: catuṣpātpakṣipittālamanohvālavaṇāni ca | paritaḥ sutarāṃ cāto darvyā tam avaghaṭtayet
verses.tib: bya dang rkang bzhi'i mkhris pa dang / ba bla ldong ros lan tshwa rnams / zhib btags bcug bya de nas ni / gzar bus de yang kun tu dkrugs

verses.skt: sabāṣpaiś ca yadottiṣṭhed budbudair lehavad ghanaḥ | avatārya tadā śīto yavarāśāv ayomaye
verses.tib: gang tshe lbu bar bcas par khol / chu bur sbom ska lde gu 'dra / de tshe phab la grangs pa dang / lcags snod bcug ste nas nang gzhug

verses.skt: sthāpyo ’yaṃ madhyamaḥ kṣāro na tu piṣṭvā kṣipen mṛdau | nirvāpyāpanayet tīkṣṇe pūrvavat prativāpanam
verses.tib: 'di ni thal sman 'bring po yin / 'jam po ma btags phar bcug la / gsur la slar ni gdon par bya / rnon por snga ma bzhin bcug la

verses.skt: tathā lāṅgalikādantīcitrakātiviṣāvacāḥ | svarjikākanakakṣīrīhiṅgupūtikapallavāḥ
verses.tib: lang+ka ling+ka dan+ti dang / shu dag pong nga tsi tra ka / swa rtsi ka dang khron bu dang / shing kun ka rany+dza'i lo ma

verses.skt: tālapattrī viḍaṃ ceti saptarātrāt paraṃ tu saḥ | yojyas tīkṣṇo ’nilaśleṣmamedojeṣv arbudādiṣu
verses.tib: ta la'i lo ma kha ru tsha'i / phye bcug zhag bdun de gzhag bya / rnon po de ni rlung bad kan / tshil skyes thor bu tshogs la btang

verses.skt: madhyeṣv eṣv eva madhyo ’nyaḥ pittāsragudajanmasu | balārthaṃ kṣīṇapānīye kṣārāmbu punar āvapet
verses.tib: 'di nyid nad tshabs 'bring la 'bring / 'jam po khrag / mkhris gzhang 'brum la'o / mthu bskyed phyir ni 'o ma chu / thal sman chu ni slar yang gzhug

verses.skt: nātitīkṣṇamṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ picchilaḥ śīghragaḥ sitaḥ | śikharī sukhanirvāpyo na viṣyandī na cātiruk
verses.tib: shin tu rno min 'jam dang mnyen / 'byar bag sna rno dkar ba dang / rtse can bde bar 'jil ba dang / mi 'dzag byugs na nad mi che

verses.skt: kṣāro daśaguṇaḥ śastratejasor api karmakṛt | ācūṣann iva saṃrambhād gātram āpīḍayann iva
verses.tib: thal sman yon tan bcu dang ldan / gtsags bu me btsa'i las kyang byed / dkrugs pas gzhibs pa lta bu dang / lus ni btsir ba lta bu dang

verses.skt: sarvato ’nusaran doṣān unmūlayati mūlataḥ | karma kṛtvā gatarujaḥ svayaṃ evopaśāmyati
verses.tib: nad kyi rjes 'gro snyegs pas na / rtsa ba nas ni 'byin par byed / las byas nad dang bral nas kyang / rang nyid bar zhi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kṣārasādhye gade chinne likhite srāvite ’thavā | kṣāraṃ śalākayā dattvā plotaprāvṛtadehayā
verses.tib: thal sman gyis ni gso ba'i nad / mtshon bcad brud pa'am gtar ga bya / thal sman thur ma gos kyis ni / dkris pa bsgos te glan nas su

verses.skt: mātrāśatam upekṣeta tatrārśaḥsv āvṛtānanam | hastena yantraṃ kurvīta vartmarogeṣu vartmanī
verses.tib: grangs brgya'i bar du bsdad nas phyi / de la gzhang 'brum bskus gos kyis / g.yogs te lag pas dgab par bya / mig mchu'i nad la mig mchu bzlog

verses.skt: nirbhujya picunācchādya kṛṣṇabhāgaṃ vinikṣipet | padmapattratanuḥ kṣāralepo ghrāṇārbudeṣu ca
verses.tib: mig 'bras nag po ras bal gyis / bkab ste legs par byug par bya / thal sman pad lo tsam srab bsku / sna yi bu ga'i thor bu ni

verses.skt: pratyādityaṃ niṣaṇṇasya samunnamyāgranāsikām | mātrā vidhāryaḥ pañcāśat tadvad arśasi karṇaje
verses.tib: nyi ma la bltas 'dug pa la / sna rtse legs par btag nas ni / grangs ni lnga bcu'i bar du gzhag / rna ba'i thor bu la de bzhin

verses.skt: kṣāraṃ pramārjanenānu parimṛjyāvagamya ca | sudagdhaṃ ghṛtamadhvaktaṃ tat payomastukāñjikaiḥ
verses.tib: thal sman bskus pa'i 'og tu ni / phyis la legs nyes rtogs bya ste / legs tshig mar dang sbrang rtsi bsku / 'o ma rang skyur zho ga chus

verses.skt: nirvāpayet tataḥ sājyaiḥ svāduśītaiḥ pradehayet | abhiṣyandīni bhojyāni bhojyāni kledanāya ca
verses.tib: dbal bsad de nas mar bcas pa'i / mngar dang bsil bas byug par bya / bza' btung bad kan bskyed pa dang / bsrul pa'i phyir ni sbyin par bya

verses.skt: yadi ca sthiramūlatvāt kṣāradagdhaṃ na śīryate | dhānyāmlabījayaṣṭyāhvatilair ālepayet tataḥ
verses.tib: gal te rtsa ba brtan gyur pas / thal sman gyis bsregs mi 'drul na / 'u su skyur snyigs shing mngar dang / til gyi lde gus de tshe bsku

verses.skt: tilakalkaḥ samadhuko ghṛtākto vraṇaropaṇaḥ | pakvajambvasitaṃ sannaṃ samyagdagdhaṃ viparyaye
verses.tib: til gyi lde gu shing mngar bcas / mar gyis bskus na rma 'tshob byed / smin pa 'dzam bu ltar kun gnag / legs tshos de las go bzlog pa / dmar zhing na la g.ya' byed / bsregs nyes yin te de slar bsreg / bsregs drags khrag ni 'dzag pa dang / brgyal zhing tsha dang rims 'gyur

verses.skt: tāmratātodakaṇḍvādyair durdagdhaṃ taṃ punar dahet | atidagdhe sraved raktaṃ mūrchādāhajvarādayaḥ
verses.tib: til gyi lde gu shing mngar bcas / mar gyis bskus na rma 'tshob byed / smin pa 'dzam bu ltar kun gnag / legs tshos de las go bzlog pa / dmar zhing na la g.ya' byed / bsregs nyes yin te de slar bsreg / bsregs drags khrag ni 'dzag pa dang / brgyal zhing tsha dang rims 'gyur

verses.skt: gude viśeṣād viṇmūtrasaṃrodho ’tipravartanam | puṃstvopaghāto mṛtyur vā gudasya śātanād dhruvam
verses.tib: gzhang khar bsregs drags khyad par du / 'gags pa'am shas cher 'byung bar 'gyur / khu ba zad par 'gyur ba'am / gzhang kha 'byung bas 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: nāsāyāṃ nāsikāvaṃśadaraṇākuñcanodbhavaḥ | bhavec ca viṣayājñānaṃ tadvac chrotrādikeṣv api
verses.tib: snar drags sna yi mtshul bar ni / nyams pa'am yang na yo ba'am / yul ni 'dzin mi nus par 'gyur / rna ba pa'ang de dang 'dra

verses.skt: viśeṣād atra seko ’mlair lepo madhu ghṛtaṃ tilāḥ | vātapittaharā ceṣṭā sarvaiva śiśirā kriyā
verses.tib: 'dir ni mchog tu skyur ba blugs / shing mngar mar dang til btags byug / rlung dang mkhris pa sel ba dang / bsil pa'i spyod pa thams cad phan

verses.skt: amlo hi śītaḥ sparśena kṣāras tenopasaṃhitaḥ | yāty āśu svādutāṃ tasmād amlair nirvāpayettarām
verses.tib: skyur ba'i reg pa bsil bas na / thal sman de dang 'dres gyur na / de yis myur du mngar 'gyur bas / skyur bas tsha ba shin tu 'jil

verses.skt: viṣāgniśastrāśanimṛtyutulyaḥ kṣāro bhaved alpam atiprayuktaḥ | rogān nihanyād acireṇa ghorān sa dhīmatā samyaganuprayukto
agniḥ kṣārād api śreṣṭhas taddagdhānām asaṃbhavāt | bheṣajakṣāraśastraiś ca na siddhānāṃ prasādhanāt
verses.tib: me btsa' thal sman las mchog ste / des bsregs pas ni slar mi 'byung / sman dang thal sman mtshon spyad kyis / ma grub par yang grub byed yin

verses.skt: tvaci māṃse sirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthiṣu sa yujyate | maṣāṅgaglānimūrdhārtimanthakīlatilādiṣu
verses.tib: pags pa sha dang rtsa rgyus dang / tshigs dang rus de la gdab / sme ba mdze nad glad nad dang

verses.skt: tvagdāho vartigodantasūryakāntaśarādibhiḥ | arśobhagandaragranthināḍīduṣṭavraṇādiṣu
verses.tib: pags bsregs ras bal ba lang so / me shel mda' smyug me gdab / gzhang 'brum rmen bu mtshan bar rdol / bu ga rma longs la la

verses.skt: māṃsadāho madhusnehajāmbavauṣṭhaguḍādibhiḥ | śliṣṭavartmany asṛksrāvanīlyasamyagvyadhādiṣu
verses.tib: sha bsreg spra tshil mar bsregs dang / bu ram 'dzam bu'i chu yis bsreg / pags pa 'jar dang khrag ma chod / thig le gnag pags nad na

verses.skt: sirādidāhas tair eva na dahet kṣāravāritān | antaḥśalyāsṛjo bhinnakoṣṭhān bhūrivraṇāturān
verses.tib: de dag nyid kyi rtsa bsreg go / bsreg min thal sman bkag pa dang / nang na mtshon lus rma chen 'byung / khrag zags pa dang lto dral ba'o

verses.skt: sudagdhaṃ ghṛtamadhvaktaṃ snigdhaśītaiḥ pradehayet | tasya liṅgaṃ sthite rakte śabdaval lasikānvitam
verses.tib: legs bsreg mar dang sbrang rtsis bsku / snum dang bsil bas byug par bya / legs pa'i mtshan ma khrag mi dbyung / sgra can chu bur phre'u 'byung

verses.skt: pakvatālakapotābhaṃ surohaṃ nātivedanam | pramādadagdhavat sarvaṃ durdagdhātyarthadagdhayoḥ
verses.tib: ta la'i 'bras smin thi ba 'dra / na ba chung zhing 'tshob pa sla / bag med pas bsregs thams cad dang / bsregs nyes bsregs ni drags pa dang

verses.skt: caturdhā tat tu tucchena saha tucchasya lakṣaṇam | tvag vivarṇoṣyate ’tyarthaṃ na ca sphoṭasamudbhavaḥ
verses.tib: ma tshos mtshan nyid dang bcas bzhi / ma tshos pags mdog mi sdug tsha / chu bur 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: sasphoṭadāhatīvroṣaṃ durdagdham atidāhataḥ | māṃsalambanasaṃkocadāhadhūpanavedanāḥ
verses.tib: bsregs nyes chu bur che rab tsha / bsregs drags pas ni sha / 'phyang dang / pags pa 'khums shing rab tu tsha / dud pa 'khyims pa lta bu dang

verses.skt: sirādināśas tṛṇmūrchāvraṇagāmbhīryamṛtyavaḥ | tucchasyāgnipratapanaṃ kāryam uṣṇaṃ ca bheṣajam
verses.tib: rtsa 'khums shing skom dang brgyal / rma yi gting zab 'chi bar 'gyur / mtshos pa ni me phrad cing / tsha ba'i sman ni gtang bar bya

verses.skt: styāne ’sre vedanātyarthaṃ vilīne mandatā rujaḥ | durdagdhe śītam uṣṇaṃ ca yuñjyād ādau tato himam
verses.tib: khrag ska shin tu na bar 'gyur / zags par gyur na nad tshabs chung / bsregs nyes bsil dang dro ba'i sman / dang por btang na de 'og bsil

verses.skt: samyagdagdhe tavakṣīrīplakṣacandanagairikaiḥ | limpet sājyāmṛtair ūrdhvaṃ pittavidradhivat kriyā
verses.tib: bsregs legs na ni cu gang dang / p+lag sha tsan+dan btsag yug snam / sle tres bcas pa mngar bcas bsku / de 'og mkhris me dbal ltar spyad

verses.skt: atidagdhe drutaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ pittavisarpavat | snehadagdhe bhṛśataraṃ rūkṣaṃ tatra tu yojayet
verses.tib: bsregs drags mkhris pa me dbal gyi / cho ga thams cad myur du spyad / snum gyis shin tu bsregs drags pa / der ni rtsub pa'i cho ga'ang bya

verses.skt: śastrakṣārāgnayo yasmān mṛtyoḥ paramam āyudham | apramatto bhiṣak tasmāt tān samyag avacārayet
samāpyate sthānam idaṃ hṛdayasya rahasyavat | atrārthāḥ sūtritāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratanyante hi sarvataḥ
verses.tib: snying po gsang ba lta bu ni / gnas 'dir rdzogs par byas pa yin / 'dir don phra ba mdor bshad kyi / rgya cher kun tu bstan pa yin

verses.skt: śuddhe śukrārtave sattvaḥ svakarmakleśacoditaḥ | garbhaḥ saṃpadyate yuktivaśād agnir ivāraṇau
verses.tib: khu khrag skyon med par sems can / rang las nyon mongs kyis bskul nas / tshogs pas mngal chags 'gyur te / gtsub shing las ni me 'byung mtshungs

verses.skt: bījātmakair mahābhūtaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ sattvānugaiś ca saḥ | mātuś cāhārarasajaiḥ kramāt kukṣau vivardhate
verses.tib: sa bon bdag nyid 'byung ba che / phra mo sems kyi rjes 'gro dang / ma yi kha zas dngas ma las / rim gyis mngal du rnam par 'phel

verses.skt: tejo yathārkaraśmīnāṃ sphaṭikena tiraskṛtam | nendhanaṃ dṛśyate gacchat sattvo garbhāśayaṃ tathā
verses.tib: ji ltar nyi ma'i zer gyi me / me shel dang ni phrad gyur pa'i / shing la 'gro bar mi snang ste / sems can mngal gnas de dang 'dra

verses.skt: kāraṇānuvidhāyitvāt kāryāṇāṃ tatsvabhāvatā | nānāyonyākṛtīḥ sattvo dhatte ’to drutalohavat
verses.tib: rgyu yi rjes su 'gro bas na / 'bras bu de dang skal mnyam nyid / sems can skye gnas sna tshogs 'dzin / zangs ma la bzhu dang mtshungs

verses.skt: ata eva ca śukrasya bāhulyāj jāyate pumān | raktasya strī tayoḥ sāmye klībaḥ śukrārtave punaḥ
verses.tib: de bas khu ba mang ba las / phal cher skyes par skye 'gyur la / zla mtshan mang bas / bud med de / de gnyis mnyam las ma ning 'gyur

verses.skt: vāyunā bahuśo bhinne yathāsvaṃ bahvapatyatā | viyonivikṛtākārā jāyante vikṛtair malaiḥ
verses.tib: khu khrag rlung gis mang du phye / ji lta ba las mtshe mar 'gyur / skye gnas mi mthun gzugs mi sdug / gnod pa'i dri mas skye bar 'gyur

verses.skt: māsi māsi rajaḥ strīṇāṃ rasajaṃ sravati tryaham | vatsarād dvādaśād ūrdhvaṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam
verses.tib: bud med zla ba re re'i khrag / dngas ma las byung zhag gsum 'dzag / lo ni bcu gnyis yan chad nas / lnga bcu'i bar 'dzag de nas zad

verses.skt: pūrṇaṣoḍaśavarṣā strī pūrṇaviṃśena saṃgatā | śuddhe garbhāśaye mārge rakte śukre ’nile hṛdi
verses.tib: bud med lo ni bcu drug lon / skyes pa nyi shu lon dang 'dus / mngal gnas lam dang khu ba khrag / rlung dang sems ni dag gyur pa'i

verses.skt: vīryavantaṃ sutaṃ sūte tato nyūnābdayoḥ punaḥ | rogy alpāyur adhanyo vā garbho bhavati naiva vā
verses.tib: pu ni stobs dang ldan pa skye / de las lo ni ma tshang ba'i / nad can tshe thung skal ngan pa'i / bu chags pa'am chags mi 'gyur

verses.skt: vātādikuṇapagranthipūyakṣīṇamalāhvayam | bījāsamarthaṃ reto'sraṃ svaliṅgair doṣajaṃ vadet
verses.tib: rlung rul dang mdud pa can / dri ma skyon dang ldan bshad pa'i / khu khrag sa bon byed mi nus / rang gi mtshan mas skyon byung bshad

verses.skt: raktena kuṇapaṃ śleṣmavātābhyāṃ granthisaṃnibham | pūyābhaṃ raktapittābhyāṃ kṣīṇaṃ mārutapittataḥ
verses.tib: khrag gis rul zhing bad kan dang / rlung gis mdud pa can 'drar 'gyur / khrag dang mkhris pas rnag 'dra la / rlung dang mkhris pas zad par 'gyur

verses.skt: kṛcchrāṇy etāny asādhyaṃ tu tridoṣaṃ mūtraviṭprabham | kuryād vātādibhir duṣṭe svauṣadhaṃ kuṇape punaḥ
verses.tib: 'di dag gso dka' nyes gsum ldan / bshang gci 'dra ba gsor mi rung / rlung la sogs pas gnod gyur pa / rang gi sman gyis gso bar bya

verses.skt: dhātakīpuṣpakhadiradāḍimārjunasādhitam | pāyayet sarpir athavā vipakvam asanādibhiḥ
verses.tib: rul la da ta ka'i me tog / seng ldeng se 'bru ardzu na / mar dang bskol ba blud pa'am / a sa na bskol ba blud

verses.skt: palāśabhasmāśmabhidā granthyābhe pūyaretasi | parūṣakavaṭādibhyāṃ kṣīṇe śukrakarī kriyā
verses.tib: khu khrag mdud 'dra pa la sha'i / thal ba sru sru'i rtsa bas phan / rnag 'dra pa ru sha ka dang

verses.skt: snigdhaṃ vāntaṃ viriktaṃ ca nirūḍham anuvāsitam | yojayec chukradoṣārtaṃ samyag uttaravastibhiḥ
verses.tib: n+ya gro d+ha bskol ba blud / khu ba zad la ro tsa'i dpyad / bshang 'dra slon khrus shing kun dang

verses.skt: saṃśuddho viṭprabhe sarpir hiṅgusevyādisādhitam | pibed granthyārtave pāṭhāvyoṣavṛkṣakajaṃ jalam
verses.tib: pu shel tsi tra ka bskol blud / zla mtshan mdud 'dra pa tha dang / tsha gsum dug mo nyung bskol blud / zla mtshan rul dang rnag 'dra la

verses.skt: peyaṃ kuṇapapūyāsre candanaṃ vakṣyate tu yat | guhyaroge ca tat sarvaṃ kāryaṃ sottaravastikam
verses.tib: tsan+dan blud bya phyis bshad pa'i / gsang ba'i nad gsor bshad kun dang / 'jam rtsir bcas pa gang yin bya

verses.skt: śukraṃ śuklaṃ guru snigdhaṃ madhuraṃ bahalaṃ bahu | ghṛtamākṣikatailābhaṃ sadgarbhāyārtavaṃ punaḥ
verses.tib: khu ba dkar zhing lci ba dang / dmar dang bska dang mang ba dang / mar dang sbrang rtsi til mar 'dra / mngal du legs chags zla mtshan yang

verses.skt: lākṣārasaśaśāsrābhaṃ dhautaṃ yac ca virajyate | śuddhaśukrārtavaṃ svasthaṃ saṃraktaṃ mithunaṃ mithaḥ
verses.tib: rgya skyegs khu ba ri bong khrag / 'dra zhing bkrus na dag 'gyur / bzang / khu khrag skyon med nad med cing / phan tshun du ni chags pa dang

verses.skt: snehaiḥ puṃsavanaiḥ snigdhaṃ śuddhaṃ śīlitavastikam | naraṃ viśeṣāt kṣīrājyair madhurauṣadhasaṃskṛtaiḥ
verses.tib: ro tsa'i snum gyis brtas pa dang / sbyang ba byas shing 'jam rtsi btang / mchog tu skyes pa 'o ma mar / mngar ba'i sman gyis brta bar bya

verses.skt: nārīṃ tailena māṣaiś ca pittalaiḥ samupācaret | kṣāmaprasannavadanāṃ sphuracchroṇipayodharām
verses.tib: bud med til mar sha dag ni / mkhris pa skyed pa nye bar spyad / bud med nyam chung bzhin ras dang / nu ma rked pa 'gul ba dang

verses.skt: srastākṣikukṣiṃ puṃskāmāṃ vidyād ṛtumatīṃ striyam | padmaṃ saṃkocam āyāti dine ’tīte yathā tathā
verses.tib: mig dang dku g.yo skyes pa 'dod / zla mtshan ldan par shes par bya / dper na nyi ma nub pa na / pad+ma'i kha ni zum par 'gyur

verses.skt: ṛtāv atīte yoniḥ sā śukraṃ nātaḥ pratīcchati | māsenopacitaṃ raktaṃ dhamanībhyām ṛtau punaḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin zla mtshan dus 'das pa'i / mngal ni khu ba len mi 'gyur / zla ba gcig tu bsags pa'i khrag / rtsa chen gnyis las dus su ni

verses.skt: īṣatkṛṣṇaṃ vigandhaṃ ca vāyur yonimukhān nudet | tataḥ puṣpekṣaṇād eva kalyāṇadhyāyinī tryaham
verses.tib: cung zad gnag cing dri bral ba / rlung gis mngal gyi sgo ru 'byin / de nas zla mtshan mthong nyid nas / zhag gsum bar du sems dge bsam

verses.skt: mṛjālaṅkārarahitā darbhasaṃstaraśāyinī | kṣaireyaṃ yāvakaṃ stokaṃ koṣṭhaśodhanakarṣaṇam
verses.tib: rgyan dang khrus ni spang ba dang / ku sha'i stan la nyal bar bya / nas thug 'o mar btsos nyung zad / blud cing lto sbyang nyams smad bya

verses.skt: parṇe śarāve haste vā bhuñjīta brahmacāriṇī | caturthe ’hni tataḥ snātā śuklamālyāmbarā śuciḥ
verses.tib: lo ma'am rdza skyogs legs par ni / bza' zhing 'khrig pa spang bar bya / de nas zhag ni bzhi pa la / khrus byas gos phreng dkar zhing gtsang

verses.skt: icchantī bhartṛsadṛśaṃ putraṃ paśyet puraḥ patim | ṛtus tu dvādaśa niśāḥ pūrvās tisro ’tra ninditāḥ
verses.tib: pha dang 'dra ba'i bu 'dod cing / mdun du khyo ni blta bar bya / zla mtshan zhag ni bcu gnyis dus / de las dang po'i zhag gsum dang

verses.skt: ekādaśī ca yugmāsu syāt putro ’nyāsu kanyakā | upādhyāyo ’tha putrīyaṃ kurvīta vidhivad vidhim
verses.tib: bcu gcig pa smad tshes zung la / bur 'gyur gzhan du bu mor 'gyur / de nas bu phyir slob dpon gyis / cho ga cho ga bzhin byas la

verses.skt: namaskāraparāyās tu śūdrāyā mantravarjitam | avandhya evaṃ saṃyogaḥ syād apatyaṃ ca kāmataḥ
verses.tib: dmangs rigs phyag 'tshal la brtson pas / sngags kyis bya ba med par bya / de ltar 'dod spyod don ldan zhing / yid la 'dod pa'i bu skyed 'gyur

verses.skt: santo hy āhur apatyārthaṃ dampatyoḥ saṃgatiṃ rahaḥ | durapatyaṃ kulāṅgāro gotre jātaṃ mahaty api
verses.tib: bu 'dod bza' bran dben par ni / 'dod spyad bya zhes dam pa smra / gzhan du rigs bzang las kyang ni / bu ngan rigs sreg me 'drar 'gyur

verses.skt: icchetāṃ yādṛśaṃ putraṃ tadrūpacaritāṃś ca tau | cintayetāṃ janapadāṃs tadācāraparicchadau
verses.tib: ji lta ba yi bu 'dod pa / de yi tshal du de yis spyad / yul de'i skye bo'i spyod pa dang / de yi yo byad la bsam bya

verses.skt: karmānte ca pumān sarpiḥkṣīraśālyodanāśitaḥ | prāg dakṣiṇena pādena śayyāṃ mauhūrtikājñayā
verses.tib: las mthar skyes pas zhun mar dang / 'o ma 'bras chan bcas pa bza' / skar / mkhan lung gis mal khrir ni / skyes pa dang po rkang g.yas kyis

verses.skt: ārohet strī tu vāmena tasya dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ | tailamāṣottarāhārā tatra mantr aṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: 'dzeg bya bud med g.yon gyis 'dzeg / de yi g.yas logs ngag tu nyal / til mar mon sran gre'u sbyar bza' / der ni sngags kyi tshig brjod bya

verses.skt: āhir asy āyur asi sarvataḥ pratiṣṭhāsi | dhātā tvāṃ dadhātu vidhātā tvāṃ dadhātu | brahmavarcasā bhaveti
verses.tib: a yu ra si / sarba taHpra tiSh+Tha si d+ha twa d+ha tu / bi d+ha ba twa / ba d+ha du / brah+ma brtsa sa b+ha ba zhes bya'o

verses.skt: brahmā bṛhaspatir viṣṇuḥ somaḥ sūryas tathāśvinau | bhago ’tha mitrāvaruṇau vīraṃ dadatu me sutam
verses.tib: tshangs pa phur bu khyab 'jug dang / nyi zla tha skar bu gnyis dang / legs ldan mdza' bo chu lha rnams / bdag la dpa' ba'i bu stsol cig

verses.skt: sāntvayitvā tato ’nyanyaṃ saṃviśetāṃ mudānvitau | uttānā tanmanā yoṣit tiṣṭhed aṅgaiḥ susaṃsthitaiḥ
verses.tib: de nas phan tshun spro bskyed de / dga' dang bcas pas gnas par bya / bud med der sems gan rkyal gnas / yan lag legs par gnas 'dug bya

verses.skt: tathā hi bījaṃ gṛhṇāti doṣaiḥ svasthānam āsthitaiḥ | liṅgaṃ tu sadyogarbhāyā yonyā bījasya saṃgrahaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar nyes pa rang gnas 'dug / sa bon legs par 'dzin par 'gyur / 'phral du mngal chags mtshan ma ni / mngal du sa bon 'dzin pa dang

verses.skt: tṛptir gurutvaṃ sphuraṇaṃ śukrāsrānanu bandhanam | hṛdayaspandanaṃ tandrā tṛḍ glānī romaharṣaṇam
verses.tib: 'dod ngoms lci dang g.yo ba dang / khrag dang khu ba rjes 'dres dang / snying 'phar ba dang snyom pa dang / skom dang rmya dang ba spu ldang

verses.skt: avyaktaḥ prathame māsi saptāhāt kalalībhavet | garbhaḥ puṃsavanāny atra pūrvaṃ vyakteḥ prayojayet
verses.tib: zla ba dang po mig gsal zhag / bdun nas nur nur po ru 'gyur / 'dir ni mngal gyi bu skyes pa / gsal bar ma gyur gong du bya

verses.skt: balī puruṣakāro hi daivam apy ativartate | puṣye puruṣakaṃ haimaṃ rājataṃ vāthavāyasam
verses.tib: skyes bu byed pa 'di stobs ldan / las kyang zil gyis gnon par nus / skar ma rgyal skyes bu yi gzugs / gser ram dngul lam lcags las byas

verses.skt: kṛtvāgnivarṇaṃ nirvāpya kṣīre tasyāñjaliṃ pibet | gauradaṇḍam apāmārgaṃ jīvakarṣabhasairyakān
verses.tib: me mdog 'gyur bsregs 'o mar bcug / de ni snyim gang blud par bya / yang na go ra dan+da dang / a pa marga dzi ba ka / zangs rtsi ba dang sher+ya ka

verses.skt: pibet puṣye jale piṣṭān ekadvitrisamastaśaḥ | kṣīreṇa śvetabṛhatīmūlaṃ nāsāpuṭe svayam
verses.tib: gcig gam gnyis sam gsum zhig gam / thams cad chu la btab pa ni / skar ma rgyal la bab tshe blud / bri ha ti ni dkar po'i rtsa / 'o mar btab pa rang nyid kyis

verses.skt: putrārthaṃ dakṣiṇe siñced vāme duhitṛvāñchayā | payasā lakṣmaṇāmūlaṃ putrotpādasthitipradam
verses.tib: bu 'dod sna khung g.yas par blugs / bu mo 'dod na g.yon par blugs / lag sma na'i rtsa 'o mar sbyar / bu skyed gnas pa rab ster byed

verses.skt: nāsayāsyena vā pītaṃ vaṭaśuṅgāṣṭakaṃ tathā | oṣadhīr jīvanīyāś ca bāhyāntar upayojayet
verses.tib: de bzhin n+ya gro'i myu gu brgyad / sbyar ba sna 'am kha nas btung / 'tsho byed kyi ni sman sde rnams / phyi dang nang nas nye bar / sbyar

verses.skt: upacāraḥ priyahitair bhartrā bhṛtyaiś ca garbhadhṛk | navanītaghṛtakṣīraiḥ sadā cainām upācaret
verses.tib: mngal 'dzin yid 'ong phan pa yi / khyo dang 'khor gyis bsnyen bkur bya / mar gsar zhun mar 'o ma rnams / rtag tu de la blud par bya

verses.skt: ativyavāyam āyāsaṃ bhāraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ guru | akālajāgarasvapnaṃ kaṭhinotkaṭakāsanam
verses.tib: nyal po drags dang rtsol drags dang / khur dang gos ni lci ba dang / nyin nyal nub mo gnyid mi log / stan srab tsog pur 'dug pa dang

verses.skt: śokakrodhabhayodvegavegaśraddhāvidhāraṇam | upavāsādhvatīkṣṇoṣṇaguruviṣṭambhibhojanam
verses.tib: mya ngan khro dang 'jigs dang skyo / shugs dang sred pa dgag pa dang / smyung ba lam 'gro rno dang tsha / lci dang bshang 'gags zan za dang

verses.skt: raktaṃ nivasanaṃ śvabhrakūpekṣāṃ madyam āmiṣam | uttānaśayanaṃ yac ca striyo necchanti tat tyajet
verses.tib: gos dmar gyon dang g.yang sa dang / khron lta sha za chang 'thungs dang / gan rkyal nyal dang bud med dang / mi 'dod gang yin de kun spang

verses.skt: tathā raktasrutiṃ śuddhiṃ vastim āmāsato ’ṣṭamāt | ebhir garbhaḥ sraved āmaḥ kukṣau śuṣyen mriyeta vā
verses.tib: de bzhin gtar ga gdab slon khrus / mas gtong zla brgyad bar mi bya / 'di dag gis ni mngal 'jig pa'am / dku skams pa'am 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vātalaiś ca bhaved garbhaḥ kubjāndhajaḍavāmanaḥ | pittalaiḥ khalatiḥ piṅgaḥ śvitrī pāṇḍuḥ kaphātmabhiḥ
verses.tib: rlung ni skyed par byed pas mngal / sgur po 'on long mi thung 'gyur / mkhris pa can gyis spyi ther ser / bad kan sha bkra skya rbab 'gyur

verses.skt: vyādhīṃś cāsyā mṛdusukhair atīkṣṇair auṣadhair jayet | dvitīye māsi kalalād ghanaḥ peśy athavārbudam
verses.tib: nad gzhan 'jam zhing bde ba dang / rnon po ma yin sman gyis gso / nur nur po las zla gnyis bar / gor gor mer mer nar nar po

verses.skt: puṃstrīklībāḥ kramāt tebhyas tatra vyaktasya lakṣaṇam | kṣāmatā garimā kukṣer mūrchā chardir arocakaḥ
verses.tib: de las pho mo ma ning rim / de nas gsal 'gyur mtshan ma ni / rid cing dku ni lci ba dang / brgyal skyugs yi ga 'chus pa dang

verses.skt: jṛmbhā prasekaḥ sadanaṃ romarājyāḥ prakāśanam | amleṣṭatā stanau pīnau sastanyau kṛṣṇacūcukau
verses.tib: glal dang mchil mang snyom bag dang / spu yi phreng ba gsal ba dang / skyur la dga' zhing nu ma rgyas / nu zhor bcas shing rtse mo gnag

verses.skt: pādaśopho vidāho ’nye śraddhāś ca vividhātmikāḥ | mātṛjaṃ hy asya hṛdayaṃ mātuś ca hṛdayena tat
verses.tib: rkang pa skrangs shing kha zas tsha / sred pa sna tshogs nyid du 'gyur / 'di yi snying ni ma las skyes / ma yi snying yang de dang ni

verses.skt: saṃbaddhaṃ tena garbhiṇyā neṣṭaṃ śraddhāvimānanam | deyam apy ahitaṃ tasyai hitopahitam alpakam
verses.tib: 'brel pas de phyir sbrum ma ni / sred pa dgag par mi bya'o / de la gnod par 'gyur ba'ang / phan dang bsres te cung zad sbyin

verses.skt: śraddhāvighātād garbhasya vikṛtiś cyutir eva vā | vyaktībhavati māse ’sya tṛtīye gātrapañcakam
verses.tib: sred pa bkag na mngal gyi bu / mi sdug pa'am 'jig par 'gyur / zla ba gsum par de yi lus / mgo bo dpyi gnyis dpung pa gnyis / yan lag lnga ni gsal dod 'gyur

verses.skt: mūrdhā dve sakthinī bāhū sarvasūkṣmāṅgajanma ca | samam eva hi mūrdhādyair jñānaṃ ca sukhaduḥkhayoḥ
verses.tib: yan lag phra mo rnams kyang 'byung / mgo bo sogs dang cha mnyam du / bde dang / sdug bsngal shes pa 'byung

verses.skt: garbhasya nābhau mātuś ca hṛdi nāḍī nibadhyate | yayā sa puṣṭim āpnoti kedāra iva kulyayā
verses.tib: mngal gnas lte ba ma yi ni / snying gi rtsa dang 'brel pa'i phyir / de yis de ni 'phel 'gyur te / zhing gi yur ba dag dang mtshungs

verses.skt: caturthe vyaktatāṅgānāṃ cetanāyāś ca pañcame | ṣaṣṭhe snāyusirāromabalavarṇanakhatvacām
verses.tib: bzhi par yan lag gsal dod 'gyur / lnga par sems ni gsal bar 'gyur / drug par chu ba rtsa dang spu / sen mo pags pa mdog stobs 'gyur

verses.skt: sarvaiḥ sarvāṅgasaṃpūrṇo bhāvaiḥ puṣyati saptame | garbheṇotpīḍitā doṣās tasmin hṛdayam āśritāḥ | kaṇḍūṃ vidāhaṃ kurvanti garbhiṇyāḥ kikkisāni ca
verses.tib: bdun par dngos po thams cad kyis / yan lag kun ni rdzogs par 'gyur / mngal gnas nad kyis nyer gzir na / de tshe snying dang 'brel pa'i phyir / g.ya' dang tsha bar byed pa dang / pags gas rma phran 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: navanītaṃ hitaṃ tatra kolāmbumadhurauṣadhaiḥ | siddham alpapaṭusnehaṃ laghu svādu ca bhojanam
verses.tib: der ni mar sar rgya shug chu / mngar ba'i sman sde bskol ba phan / lan tshwa nyung zhing snum bag can / yang zhing mngar ba'i kha zas bza'

verses.skt: candanośīrakalkena limped ūrustanodaram | śreṣṭhayā vaiṇahariṇaśaśaśoṇitayuktayā
verses.tib: tsan+dan pu shel rtsi'i lde gus / brang dang nu ma lto la bsku / 'bras bu gsum pa'am e ne ya / sha bkra ri bong khrag sbyar bsku

verses.skt: aśvaghnapattrasiddhena tailenābhyajya mardayet | paṭolanimbamañjiṣṭhāsurasaiḥ secayet punaḥ
verses.tib: ka ra bI ra'i lo ma dang / til mar bskol bas bskus te mnye / pa to la dang nim pa btsod / bye'u rug gis kyang bsku bar bya

verses.skt: dārvīmadhukatoyena mṛjāṃ ca pariśīlayet | ojo ’ṣṭame saṃcarati mātāputrau muhuḥ kramāt
verses.tib: skyer pa shing mngar chu yis ni / bkru dang bsku ba bsten par bya / zla ba brgyad par ma dang bu / thang re rim gyis gzi mdangs 'pho

verses.skt: tena tau mlānamuditau tatra jāto na jīvati | śiśur ojo'navasthānān nārī saṃśayitā bhavet
verses.tib: de yis de gnyis zhum dgar 'gyur / byis mdangs ma la mi gnas pas / de tshe btsas na mi 'tsho la / bud med the tshom bcas skabs 'gyur

verses.skt: kṣīrapeyā ca peyātra saghṛtānvāsanaṃ ghṛtam | madhuraiḥ sādhitaṃ śuddhyai purāṇaśakṛtas tathā
verses.tib: 'dir ni'o ma can blud cing / mngar ba'i sman dang bskol ba yi / mar gyi 'jam rtsi gtang bya zhing / phyis rnying pa dag bya ba'i phyir

verses.skt: śuṣkamūlakakolāmlakaṣāyeṇa praśasyate | śatāhvākalkito vastiḥ satailaghṛtasaindhavaḥ
verses.tib: la phug skam dang rgya shug skyur / bska ba dang ni bskol ba bsngags / sha ta put+pa'i lde gu ni / rgyam tsha til mar 'jam rtsi gtang

verses.skt: tasmiṃs tv ekāhayāte ’pi kālaḥ sūter ataḥ param | varṣād vikārakārī syāt kukṣau vātena dhāritaḥ
verses.tib: de tshe zhag gcig 'das pa na'ang / dus su btsas yin de phan chad / rlung gis dkur ni bkag gyur na / lo yi bar du gnod pa skyed

verses.skt: śastaś ca navame māsi snigdho māṃsarasaudanaḥ | bahusnehā yavāgūr vā pūrvoktaṃ cānuvāsanam
verses.tib: zla dgu lon na snum bcas pa'i / 'bras chan sha khu blud pa bsngags / snum mang nas thug sbyin pa'am / sngar bshad pa yi 'jam rtsi gtang

verses.skt: tata eva picuṃ cāsyā yonau nityaṃ nidhāpayet | vātaghnapattrabhaṅgāmbhaḥ śītaṃ snāne ’nvahaṃ hitam
verses.tib: de / nyid la bcug ras bal ni / mtshan mar rtag tu gzhug par bya / rlung 'joms lo ma bskol ba'i chu / bsgrangs pas nyin re bkrus pa phan

verses.skt: niḥsnehāṅgī na navamān māsāt prabhṛti vāsayet | prāg dakṣiṇastanastanyā pūrvaṃ tatpārśvaceṣṭinī
verses.tib: zla dgu phan chad lus la ni / snum med par ni mi gzhag go / nu zho g.yas pa sngar byung zhing / g.yas logs la ni brten pa dang

verses.skt: puṃnāmadaurhṛdapraśnaratā puṃsvapnadarśinī | unnate dakṣiṇe kukṣau garbhe ca parimaṇḍale
verses.tib: 'dri tshig skyes pa'i ming can smra / dga' zhing rmi lam skyes pa mthong / dku ni g.yas pa mtho ba dang / mngal yang kun nas zlum pa dag

verses.skt: putraṃ sūte ’nyathā kanyāṃ yā cecchati nṛsaṃgatim | nṛtyavāditragāndharvagandhamālyapriyā ca yā
verses.tib: bu skye gzhan du bu mor 'gyur / gang yang skyes pa phrad 'dod dang / glu gar rol mo la dga' dang / dri dang phreng chags bu mor skye

verses.skt: klībaṃ tatsaṃkare tatra madhyaṃ kukṣeḥ samunnatam | yamau pārśvadvayonnāmāt kukṣau droṇyām iva sthite
verses.tib: de 'dres pas ni ma ning 'gyur / dku yi dbus ni mtho ba yin / mtshe ma logs gnyis mtho bas na / lte ba dma' bar 'dug pa yin

verses.skt: prāk caiva navamān māsāt sā sūtigṛham āśrayet | deśe praśaste saṃbhāraiḥ saṃpannaṃ sādhake ’hani
verses.tib: dgu pa'i dang po nas brtsams te / sa phyogs shis shing yo byad ni / phun tshogs ldan par dge ba'i zhag / de ni btsas khyim zhugs par bya'o

verses.skt: tatrodīkṣeta sā sūtiṃ sūtikāparivāritā | adyaśvaḥprasave glāniḥ kukṣyakṣiślathatā klamaḥ
verses.tib: der ni bud med btsa' myong bas / bskor te btsa' ba'i dus bar bsdad / deng ngam sang ni bu btsas rtags / snyom zhing dku dang mig lhod dub

verses.skt: adhogurutvam aruciḥ praseko bahumūtratā | vedanorūdarakaṭīpṛṣṭhahṛdvastivaṅkṣaṇe
verses.tib: smad du lci zhing yi ga 'chus / mchil ma mang zhing gcin mang 'byung / brla dang rked pa lto dang rgyab / snying dang chu so brla rtsa na

verses.skt: yonibhedarujātodasphuraṇasravaṇāni ca | āvīnām anu janmātas tato garbhodakasrutiḥ
verses.tib: mtshan bye na zhing zug pa dang / 'gul zhing 'dzag par 'gyur ba yin / rang dbang med gyur rjes su ni / de 'og mngal gyi chu 'dzag 'gyur

verses.skt: athopasthitagarbhāṃ tāṃ kṛtakautukamagalām | hastasthapuṃnāmaphalāṃ svabhyaktoṣṇāmbusecitām
verses.tib: de nas mngal nas las byung rtsom / bkra shis bsrung ba'i cho ga byas / lag par 'bras bu skyes ming gzhag / legs bskus chu ni dron mo blugs

verses.skt: pāyayet saghṛtāṃ peyāṃ tanau bhūśayane sthitām | ābhugnasakthim uttānām abhyaktāṅgīṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: mar dang bcas pa'i thug pa blud / de 'og sa la mal bcas 'dug / brla gnyis bkug ste gan rkyal gnas / yan lag yang nas yang du bsku

verses.skt: adho nābher vimṛdnīyāt kārayej jṛmbhacaṅkramam | garbhaḥ prayāty avāg evaṃ talliṅgaṃ hṛdvimokṣataḥ
verses.tib: lte ba man chad mnye bya zhing / glal dang 'chag pa byed du gzhug / de ltas mngal gnas thur du 'byung / de rtags snying ga las 'phos nas

verses.skt: āviśya jaṭharaṃ garbho vaster upari tiṣṭhati | āvyo ’bhitvarayanty enāṃ khaṭvām āropayet tataḥ
verses.tib: mngal gnas lto bar zhugs nas ni / chu so'i steng na gnas par 'gyur / de nas dbang med nad ldang ste / myur du khri la / gzhag par bya

verses.skt: atha saṃpīḍite garbhe yonim asyāḥ prasārayet | mṛdu pūrvaṃ pravāheta bāḍham āprasavāc ca sā
verses.tib: de 'og mngal gnas legs btsir nas / de yi mtshan ni dbye bar bya / dang por dal gyis btsir bya zhing / btsa' khar drag tu btsir bar bya

verses.skt: harṣayet tāṃ muhuḥ putrajanmaśabdajalānilaiḥ | pratyāyānti tathā prāṇāḥ sūtikleśāvasāditāḥ
verses.tib: de nas bu skye'i sgra dang ni / chu dang rlung gis dga' ba skyed / btsa' ba'i nad kyis gzir ba yi / sreg bral 'dra ba slar gso bya

verses.skt: dhūpayed garbhasaṅge tu yoniṃ kṛṣṇāhikañcukaiḥ | hiraṇyapuṣpīmūlaṃ ca pāṇipādena dhārayet
verses.tib: mngal du thogs na sbrul nag po'i / pags pas mo mtshan bdug par bya / bya r+Nu'i me tog rtsa ba'am / lcam pa'am yang na byi sha l+ya / rkang pa'am lag par gdags par bya

verses.skt: suvarcalāṃ viśalyāṃ vā jarāyvapatane ’pi ca | kāryam etat tathotkṣipya bāhvor enāṃ vikampayet
verses.tib: sha ma dbyung ba'i phyir yang ni / de dag nyid bya de nas bteg / dpung pa gnyis nas bzung ste sbrug

verses.skt: kaṭīm ākoṭayet pārṣṇyā sphijau gāḍhaṃ nipīḍayet | tālukaṇṭhaṃ spṛśed veṇyā mūrdhni dadyāt snuhīpayaḥ
verses.tib: rting pas mjug to rdeg pa dang / rkub tshos dam du btsir par bya / skra yis lkog ma rkan reg bya / snu ha'i 'o ma spyi por blugs

verses.skt: bhūrjalāṅgalikītumbīsarpatvakkuṣṭhasarṣapaiḥ | pṛthag dvābhyāṃ samastair vā yonilepanadhūpanam
verses.tib: stag pa ku ba lang+ka li / sbrul lpags ru rta yungs kar rnams / re re 'am gnyis sam ma lus pas / mo mtshan byug pa'am bdag par bya

verses.skt: kuṣṭhatālīśakalkaṃ vā surāmaṇḍena pāyayet | yūṣeṇa vā kulatthānāṃ bālbajenāsavena vā
verses.tib: ru rta'am bal bu'i lde gu ni / chang dngas dang ni blug par bya / ku lang+tha 'am bal ba dza / chang rnyings dag la btab ste blud

verses.skt: śatāhvāsarṣapājājīśigrutīkṣṇakacitrakaiḥ | sahiṅgukuṣṭhamadanair mūtre kṣīre ca sārṣapam
verses.tib: shu ti nyungs kar zi ra dang / shi kru tig sna kru drug tres / shing kun ru rta po son cha / 'o ma ba gcin yungs mar dang

verses.skt: tailaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ pāyau yonyāṃ vāpy anuvāsanam | śatapuṣpāvacākuṣṭhakaṇāsarṣapakalkitaḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba bshang ba'i sgo'am ni / mo mtshan nas ni 'jam rtsi btang / shu ti shu dag ru rta dang / yungs kar pi pi ling lde gu

verses.skt: nirūhaḥ pātayaty āśu sasnehalavaṇo ’parām | tatsaṅge hy anilo hetuḥ sā niryāty āśu tajjayāt
verses.tib: snum dang lan tshwar bcas pa yi / mas gtong sha ma myur du 'byin / der thogs rgyu ni rlung yin te / de bcom sha ma myur du 'byung

verses.skt: kuśalā pāṇināktena haret k ptanakhena vā | muktagarbhāparāṃ yoniṃ tailenāṅgaṃ ca mardayet
verses.tib: yang na lag bkrus sor mo bregs / mkhas pa yis ni drangs te dbyung / sha ma byung na mo mtshan dang / yan lag til mar gyis byugs mnye

verses.skt: makkallākhye śirovastikoṣṭhaśūle tu pāyayet | sucūrṇitaṃ yavakṣāraṃ ghṛtenoṣṇajalena vā
verses.tib: mngal nad gzer ni chu so mgo / lto ba gzer la thal sman ni / rnon po zhib tu btags pa dag / mar ram chu tshan sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: dhānyāmbu vā guḍavyoṣatrijātakarajo'nvitam | atha bālopacāreṇa bālaṃ yoṣid upācared
verses.tib: 'u su bskol chu bu ram dang / tsha gsum dri gsum btab blud / de nas byes pa'i nyer spyod kyis / byis pa ma mas skyong du gzhug

verses.skt: sūtikā kṣudvatī tailād ghṛtād vā mahatīṃ pibet | pañcakolakinīṃ mātrām anu coṣṇaṃ guḍodakam
verses.tib: bu btsas bkres yod til mar dang / mar las tshad / chen blud bya ba / tsha ba lnga phye ran btab sbyin / de 'og bu ram chu dron nam

verses.skt: vātaghnauṣadhatoyaṃ vā tathā vāyur na kupyati | viśudhyati ca duṣṭāsraṃ dvitrirātram ayaṃ kramaḥ
verses.tib: rlung 'joms sman bskol chu blud de / des ni rlung nad ldang mi 'gyur / khrag ngan dag kyang dag par byed / rim 'di zhag ni gnyis gsum bya

verses.skt: snehāyogyā tu niḥsneham amum eva vidhiṃ bhajet | pītavatyāś ca jaṭharaṃ yamakāktaṃ viveṣṭayet
verses.tib: snum mi 'phrod la cho ga 'di / snum med par ni bsten par bya / 'thungs nas lto ba til mar dang / mar bskus nas ni gos kyis dkri

verses.skt: jīrṇe snātā pibet peyāṃ pūrvoktauṣadhasādhitām | tryahād ūrdhvaṃ vidāryādivargakvāthena sādhitā
verses.tib: zhu nas khrus byas thug pa ni / sngar bshad sman dang bskol ba blud / zhag gsum phan chad bi da ri / la sman sde'i khu bar bskol

verses.skt: hitā yavāgūḥ snehāḍhyā sātmyataḥ payasāthavā | saptarātrāt paraṃ cāsyai kramaśo bṛṃhaṇaṃ hitam
verses.tib: nas thug phan zhing snum mang ba'am / goms pa'i dbang las 'o thug blud / zhag bdun phan chad de la ni / rim gyis brta ba'i cho ga phan

verses.skt: dvādaśāhe ’natikrānte piśitaṃ nopayojayet | yatnenopacaret sūtāṃ duḥsādhyo hi tadāmayaḥ
verses.tib: zhag ni bcu gnyis ma lon par / sha ni sbyin par mi bya'o / mngal du 'phel dang btsas pa'i nad / gsher dang khrag 'dzag btsir ba yis / nad de gso dka' yin pa'i phyir / btsas tshe 'bad de rim gro bya / de ltar zla ba phyed dang gnyis / kha zas bsdams dang bral nas

verses.skt: garbhavṛddhiprasavarukkledāsrasrutipīḍanaiḥ | evaṃ ca māsād adhyardhān muktāhārādiyantraṇā
verses.tib: zhag ni bcu gnyis ma lon par / sha ni sbyin par mi bya'o / mngal du 'phel dang btsas pa'i nad / gsher dang khrag 'dzag btsir ba yis / nad de gso dka' yin pa'i phyir / btsas tshe 'bad de rim gro bya / de ltar zla ba phyed dang gnyis / kha zas bsdams dang bral nas

verses.skt: gatasūtābhidhānā syāt punar ārtavadarśanāt
verses.tib: btsas pa'i ming dang bral ba'am / zla mtshan byung bar gyur bar du'o

verses.skt: garbhiṇyāḥ parihāryāṇāṃ sevayā rogato ’thavā | puṣpe dṛṣṭe ’thavā śūle bāhyāntaḥ snigdhaśītalam
verses.tib: sbrum mas spang bar bya ba dag / bsten pa'am nad kyi dbang las ni / zla mtshan byung ba'am gzer zhing na / phyi nang snum dang bsil thabs bya

verses.skt: sevyāmbhojahimakṣīrivalkakalkājyalepitān | dhārayed yonivastibhyām ārdrārdrān picunaktakān
verses.tib: uR+shi pad+ma tsan+dan dang / 'o ma can shing shun pa yi / lde gur mar ni bsku ba dang / ras bal sbangs pa bshang sgo dang / mo mtshan gnyis su them bur gzhug

verses.skt: śatadhautaghṛtāktāṃ strīṃ tadambhasy avagāhayet | sasitākṣaudrakumudakamalotpalakesaram
verses.tib: lan brgyar bkrus pa'i mar gyis ni / bsku ba'am bud med de yi lus / uR+shi ra chu nang gzhug / kha ra sbrang rtsi ku mu ta / pad+ma ut+pal ge sar ni

verses.skt: lihyāt kṣīraghṛtaṃ khādec chṛṅgāṭakakaserukam | pibet kāntābjaśālūkabālodumbaravat payaḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma'i mar sbyar ka she ru / sh-ing+ga ta ka sbyin bar bya / gan+d+ha pri yang ku dang ni / chu skyes rnams kyi rtsa ba dang / u du m+ba' ra gzhon nu dang / ldan pa'i 'o ma skom du blud

verses.skt: śṛtena śālikākolīdvibalāmadhukekṣubhiḥ | payasā raktaśālyannam adyāt samadhuśarkaram
verses.tib: sA lu'i rtsa ba ka ko la / ba la gnyis / dang shing mngar dang / bu ram shing dang bskol ba yi / 'o ma sA lu rtsa snar chan / sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas pa ni

verses.skt: rasair vā jāṅgalaiḥ śuddhivarjaṃ cāsroktam ācaret | asaṃpūrṇatrimāsāyāḥ pratyākhyāya prasādhayet
verses.tib: skam sa'i sha khu ldan par bza' / bkru sman ma gtogs khrag mkhris kyi / gso dpyad bshad pa thams cad bya / zla gsum ma tshang bar du ni

verses.skt: āmānvaye ca tatreṣṭaṃ śītaṃ rūkṣopasaṃhitam | upavāso ghanośīraguḍūcyaraludhānyakāḥ
verses.tib: be'u snabs ldan pa'ang dgag par bya / der ni bsil pan rtsub pa dang / smyung dang gla sgang uR+shir / sle tres 'u su a ral

verses.skt: durālabhāparpaṭakacandanātiviṣābalāḥ | kvathitāḥ salile pānaṃ tṛṇadhānyāni bhojanam
verses.tib: byi tsher dang ni parba ta / tsan+dan ba la bong nga dkar / bskol ba'i chu ni blud par bya / rtsa 'bru las g.yos zas sbyin dang

verses.skt: mudgādiyūṣair āme tu jite snigdhādi pūrvavat | garbhe nipatite tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ sāmarthyataḥ pibet
verses.tib: mung+ga sogs khus be'u snabs ni / bsal la snum sngon bzhin gtang / mngal ni rnam par 'jig gyur na

verses.skt: garbhakoṣṭhaviśuddhyartham artivismaraṇāya ca | laghunā pañcamūlena rūkṣāṃ peyāṃ tataḥ pibet
verses.tib: mngal nang dag par bya phyir dang / nad kyis gzir ba mi dran phyir / chang rno ci nus btung bar bya / de nas rtsa ba lnga po ni / chung ngu'i thug pa rtsub de blud

verses.skt: peyām amadyapā kalke sādhitāṃ pāñcakaulike | bilvādipañcakakvāthe tiloddālakataṇḍulaiḥ
verses.tib: chang mi 'thungs la thug pa ni / tsha ba lnga dang bskol ba dang / bil ba la sogs lnga dang bskol / til dang rtsa 'bru chan sbyin bya

verses.skt: māsatulyadināny evaṃ peyādiḥ patite kramaḥ | laghur asnehalavaṇo dīpanīyayuto hitaḥ
verses.tib: zla ba dang mnyam nyin zhag rim / mngal 'jig pa la thug sbyin / yang zhing snum dang lan tshwa med / drod bskyed ldan la phan pa yin

verses.skt: doṣadhātuparikledaśoṣārthaṃ vidhir ity ayam | snehānnavastayaś cordhvaṃ balyadīpanajīvanāḥ
verses.tib: nad dang lus zungs ljan ljin ni / skam phyir cho ga 'di bya'o / de phan chad zas snum 'jam rtsi / stobs skyed drod skyed 'tsho byed sbyin

verses.skt: saṃjātasāre mahati garbhe yoniparisravāt | vṛddhim aprāpnuvan garbhaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhati sasphuraḥ
verses.tib: snying por ldan pas cher skyes la / mo mtshan nas ni khrag 'dzag pas / mngal du skye bar mi nus la / lto na 'gul dang bcas par gnas

verses.skt: upaviṣṭakam āhus taṃ vardhate tena nodaram | śokopavāsarūkṣādyair athavā yonyatisravāt
verses.tib: de ni so na gnas shes bya / des ni lto ba rgyas mi 'gyur / mya ngan smyung dang rtsub sogs sam / yang na mngal nas khrag 'dzag pas

verses.skt: vāte kruddhe kṛśaḥ śuṣyed garbho nāgodaraṃ tu tam | udaraṃ vṛddham apy atra hīyate sphuraṇaṃ cirāt
verses.tib: rlung 'khrug skam zhing bskams gyur pa'i / mngal de klu yi lto zhes bya / 'dir ni lto ba rgyas gyur yang / 'grib cing yun lon na 'phar

verses.skt: tayor bṛṃhaṇavātaghnamadhuradravyasaṃskṛtaiḥ | ghṛtakṣīrarasais tṛptir āmagarbhāṃś ca khādayet
verses.tib: de gnyis brta dang rlung 'joms sman / mngar ba dag dang bskol ba yi / mar / dang 'o ma tshim sbyin zhing / skyes ma thag pa'i sha sbyin bya / de gnyis kyis ni tshim bya'i phyir

verses.skt: tair eva ca subhikṣāyāḥ kṣobhaṇaṃ yānavāhanaiḥ | līnākhye nisphure śyenagomatsyotkrośabarhijāḥ
verses.tib: khyogs dang bzhon par bskyon te bskul / sngon po zhes bya mi 'gul la / khra dang ba lang nya sha dang / sgra sgrogs bya dang rma bya yi

verses.skt: rasā bahughṛtā deyā māṣamūlakajā api | bālabilvaṃ tilān māṣān saktūṃś ca payasā pibet
verses.tib: sha khu mar ni mang po dang / mon sran gre'u dag dang ni / la phug dag gi khu ba blud / bil ba gzhon nu ma sha til / phye dang 'o ma sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: samedyamāṃsaṃ madhu vā kaṭyabhyaṅgaṃ ca śīlayet | harṣayet satataṃ cainām evaṃ garbhaḥ pravardhate
verses.tib: tshil bcas sha dang sbrang chang sbyin / rked pa bsku ba bsten par bya / de ni rtag tu dga' ba skyed / de 'dras mngal ni 'phel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: puṣṭo ’nyathā varṣagaṇaiḥ kṛcchrāj jāyeta naiva vā | udāvartaṃ tu garbhiṇyāḥ snehair āśutarāṃ jayet
verses.tib: rgyas pa gzhan du lo tshang nas / dka' bas btsas pa'am skye mi 'gyur / sbrum ma rtug pa 'gags gyur na / snum mam mthun pa'i 'jam rtsi yis / myur ba kho nar gso bar bya / gzhan du sbrum ma bu btsas 'chi / mngal du nang rab bsags pas sam / mi mthun pa'am gnod gzhan gyis

verses.skt: yogyaiś ca vastibhir hanyāt sagarbhāṃ sa hi garbhiṇīm | garbhe ’tidoṣopacayād apathyair daivato ’pi vā
verses.tib: rgyas pa gzhan du lo tshang nas / dka' bas btsas pa'am skye mi 'gyur / sbrum ma rtug pa 'gags gyur na / snum mam mthun pa'i 'jam rtsi yis / myur ba kho nar gso bar bya / gzhan du sbrum ma bu btsas 'chi / mngal du nang rab bsags pas sam / mi mthun pa'am gnod gzhan gyis

verses.skt: mṛte ’ntar udaraṃ śītaṃ stabdhaṃ dhmātaṃ bhṛśavyatham | garbhāspando bhramatṛṣṇā kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ klamaḥ
verses.tib: nang du shi na lto grang zhing / rengs dang sbo dang nad tshabs che / mngal mi 'gul dang mgo 'khor skom / dbugs 'byin dka' zhing dub pa dang

verses.skt: aratiḥ srastanetratvam āvīnām asamudbhavaḥ | tasyāḥ koṣṇāmbusiktāyāḥ piṣṭvā yoniṃ pralepayet
verses.tib: dga' ba med cing mi 'gyur dang / dbang med nad ni mang po 'byung / de la chu dron blugs pa dang

verses.skt: guḍaṃ kiṇvaṃ salavaṇaṃ tathāntaḥ pūrayen muhuḥ | ghṛtena kalkīkṛtayā śālmalyatasipicchayā
verses.tib: bu ram spang ma lan tshwar bcas / btags pas mo mtshan bsku ba dang / shal ma li dang zar ma ya / khu ba mar dang lde gur byas / nang du yang dang yang du gzhug

verses.skt: mantrair yogair jarāyūktair mūḍhagarbho na cet patet | athāpṛcchyeśvaraṃ vaidyo yatnenāśu tam āharet
verses.tib: sngags dang sha ma 'byin sbyor bya / gal te bu shi ma byung na / de nas sman pas rgyal po la / zhu la de 'bad myur du dbyung

verses.skt: hastam abhyajya yoniṃ ca sājyaśālmalipicchayā | hastena śakyaṃ tenaiva gātraṃ ca viṣamaṃ sthitam
verses.tib: shal ma li yi thang chu mar / bcas pas lag pa mo mtshan bsku / lag pas dbyung nus de nyid kyi / lus ni legs par mi gnas na

verses.skt: āñchanotpīḍasaṃpīḍavikṣepotkṣepaṇādibhiḥ | ānulomya samākarṣed yoniṃ praty ārjavāgatam
verses.tib: gcus shing bsgyur dang bzlog pa dang / btsir dang 'degs gzhag la kyis / lugs dang mthun par drangs nas ni / mngal gyi sgor ni drang por drang

verses.skt: hastapādaśirobhir yo yoniṃ bhugnaḥ prapadyate | pādena yonim ekena bhugno ’nyena gudaṃ ca yaḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig rkang lag mgo bo ni / yon por mngal du gnas gyur dang / rkang pa gcig ni mtshan du 'byung / gnyis pa bshang sgor chud yon po / de ni 'gags pa

verses.skt: viṣkambhau nāma tau mūḍhau śastradāraṇam arhataḥ | maṇḍalāṅguliśastrābhyāṃ tatra karma praśasyate
verses.tib: zhes bya ste / mtshon gyis bcad par 'os pa yin / las der dkyil 'khor sor gdub can / gtsags bu gnyis ni bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: vṛddhipattraṃ hi tīkṣṇāgraṃ na yonāv avacārayet | pūrvaṃ śiraḥkapālāni dārayitvā viśodhayet
verses.tib: 'phel gtsags rtse mo rno bas ni / mngal du gtang bar mi bya'o / dang por mgo bo'i thod pa ni / phye la rnam par dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: kakṣorastālucibukapradeśe ’nyatame tataḥ | samālambya dṛḍhaṃ karṣet kuśalo garbhaśaṅkunā
verses.tib: de nas mchan khung brang kos ko / rkan gyi phyogs ni gang rung bar / gtang de mngal gyi lcags kyu ni / brtan po dag gis mkhas pas drang

verses.skt: abhinnaśirasaṃ tv akṣikūṭayor gaṇḍayor api | bāhuṃ chittvāṃsasaktasya vātādhmātodarasya tu
verses.tib: mgo bo ma phye mig sbubs dang / mkhur tshos nas kyang drang bya zhing / phrag pa thogs na dpung par bcad / lto ba rlung gis sbos gyur pa

verses.skt: vidārya koṣṭham antrāṇi bahir vā saṃnirasya ca | kaṭīsaktasya tadvac ca tatkapālāni dārayet
verses.tib: nang grol dbral tam rgyu ma ni / phyi rol du ni bton te dbyung / rked par thogs na de bzhin du / de yi rus tshigs dbye bar bya

verses.skt: yad yad vāyuvaśād aṅgaṃ sajjed garbhasya khaṇḍaśaḥ | tat tac chittvāharet samyag rakṣen nārīṃ ca yatnataḥ
verses.tib: rlung gi dbang gis yan lag gang / mngal du thogs pa de dang de / dum bur gtubs la legs phyung ste / 'bad de bud med bsrung bar bya

verses.skt: garbhasya hi gatiṃ citrāṃ karoti viguṇo ’nilaḥ | tatrānalpamatis tasmād avasthāpekṣam ācaret
verses.tib: rlung ni rnam par 'khrugs gyur pas / mngal gyi gnas skabs sna tshogs byed / de phyir de ni mkhas pa yis / gnas skabs dag ni bltas te spyad

verses.skt: chindyād garbhaṃ na jīvantaṃ mātaraṃ sa hi mārayet | sahātmanā na copekṣyaḥ kṣaṇam apy astajīvitaḥ
verses.tib: ma dang lhan cig 'chi 'gyur bas / gson po mngal du gcad mi bya / 'chi bar 'gyur ba dag la ni / yud tsam btang snyoms gzhag mi bya

verses.skt: yonisaṃvaraṇabhraṃśamakkallaśvāsapīḍitām | pūtyudgārāṃ himāṅgīṃ ca mūḍhagarbhāṃ parityajet
verses.tib: mo mtshan 'gags dang nyams pa dang / gzer nad dbugs kyis nyam thag dang / sgregs pa mnam dang lus grang ba'i / mngal du bu shi bud med spang

verses.skt: athāpatantīm aparāṃ pātayet pūrvavad bhiṣak | evaṃ nirhṛtaśalyāṃ tu siñced uṣṇena vāriṇā
verses.tib: de nas sha ma thon na / sman pas sngon bzhin dbyung bar bya / de ltar zug rngu phyung nas ni / chu dron gyis ni bkru bar bya

verses.skt: dadyād abhyaktadehāyai yonau snehapicuṃ tataḥ | yonir mṛdur bhavet tena śūlaṃ cāsyāḥ praśāmyati
verses.tib: lus la snum gyis byugs pa dang / mtshan du ras bal snum can gzhug / des ni mo mtshan 'jam 'gyur zhing / de yis gzer ba zhi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: dīpyakātiviṣārāsnāhiṅgvelāpañcakolakāt | cūrṇaṃ snehena kalkaṃ vā kvāthaṃ vā pāyayet tataḥ
verses.tib: la la phud dang bong ba dkar / ra sna shing kun sug smel dang / tsha ba lnga yi phye ma snum / sbyar ba'am lde gu chu bskol blud

verses.skt: kaṭukātiviṣāpāṭhāśākatvagghiṅgutejinīḥ | tadvac ca doṣasyandārthaṃ vedanopaśamāya ca
verses.tib: de bzhin nad rnams 'dzag pa dang / tshor ba zhi phyir zhag gsum ni / pu tse shel dang bong nga dkar / ba sha ka yi shun pa dang / shing kun te dzo ba ti rnams / btags pa'i phye ma'am bskol ba blud

verses.skt: trirātram evaṃ saptāhaṃ sneham eva tataḥ pibet | sāyaṃ pibed ariṣṭaṃ ca tathā sukṛtam āsavam
verses.tib: de nas zhag bdun bar du ni / snum nyid nye bar btung bar bya / dgongs ka chang ni rnying pa dang / de bzhin legs sbyar chang btung bya

verses.skt: śirīṣakakubhakvāthapicūn yonau vinikṣipet | upadravāś ca ye ’nye syus tān yathāsvam upācaret
verses.tib: shiR+sha ka ku bar bskol sbangs / ras bal mo mtshan nang du gzhug / bla brnan gzhan dag gang byung ba / de la rang gis gso bas gso

verses.skt: payo vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ daśāhaṃ bhojane hitam | raso daśāhaṃ ca paraṃ laghupathyālpabhojanā
verses.tib: rlung 'joms sman ni 'o mar bskol / zhag bcu'i bar du bza' ba phan / zhag bcu'i bar du sha khu btung / de phan chad ni yang zhing phan

verses.skt: svedābhyaṅgaparā snehān balātailādikān bhajet | ūrdhvaṃ caturbhyo māsebhyaḥ sā krameṇa sukhāni ca
verses.tib: nyung ngu bza' zhing snum bsku dugs / ba la'i til mar la sogs bsten / zla ba bzhi lon phan chad de / de ni rim gyis ci bder spyad

verses.skt: balāmūlakaṣāyasya bhāgāḥ ṣaṭ payasas tathā | yavakolakulatthānāṃ daśamūlasya caikataḥ
verses.tib: ba le'i rtsa ba'i khu ba ni / cha drug 'o ma de mnyam dang / nas dang rgya shug ku lang+tha / rtsa ba bcu pa'i cha gcig dang

verses.skt: niḥkvāthabhāgo bhāgaś ca tailasya tu caturdaśaḥ | dvimedādārumañjiṣṭhākākolīdvayacandanaiḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba'i cha ni char byas pa'i / til mar cha ni bcu bzhi dang / med gnyis dang thang shing bcod / ra mnye ba gnyis tsan+dan dang

verses.skt: śārivākuṣṭhatagarajīvakarṣabhasaindhavaiḥ | kālānusāryāśaileyavacāgurupunarnavaiḥ
verses.tib: rgya spos rgyam tsha zangs rtsi ba / gla sgang rdo dreg shu dag dang / pur+Na rna ba a ka ru / a shwa gan+d+ha nye shing dang

verses.skt: aśvagandhāvarīkṣīraśuklāyaṣṭīvarārasaiḥ | śatāhvāśūrpaparṇyelātvakpattraiḥ ślakṣṇakalkitaiḥ
verses.tib: k+Shi ra ku shu shing mngar dang / ba la ras shu ti dang / pa r+Ni gnyis dang sug smel dang / shing tsha gan+d+ha b+har dra rnams / zhib tu btags pa'i lde gu dang

verses.skt: pakvaṃ mṛdvagninā tailaṃ sarvavātavikārajit | sūtikābālamarmāsthihatakṣīṇeṣu pūjitam
verses.tib: til mar me chung la bskol ba / rlung nad thams cad sel ba'i mchog / bu btsas byis pa rus pa gnad / snad dang skem la bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: jvaragulmagrahonmādamūtrāghātāntravṛddhijit | dhanvantarer abhimataṃ yonirogakṣayāpaham
verses.tib: rims skran gdon dang smyo byed dang / gcin nad rgyu ma skyes pa sel / thang la 'bar gyis mngal gyi ni / nad rnams sel ba'i mchog tu bshad

verses.skt: vastidvāre vipannāyāḥ kukṣiḥ praspandate yadi | janmakāle tataḥ śīghraṃ pāṭayitvoddharec chiśum
verses.tib: ma ni shi tshe chu sor ni / mngal gnas gal te dkur 'phar na / de ni skye ba'i dus yin pas / dbral te byis pa myur du dbyung

verses.skt: madhukaṃ śākabījaṃ ca payasyā suradāru ca | aśmantakaḥ kṛṣṇatilās tāmravallī śatāvarī
verses.tib: shi ri ka yi sa bon dang / pa ya s+ya dang thang shing bzhi / til nag sru sru'i rtsa ba dang / btsod dang nye'u shing zhes bya bzhi

verses.skt: vṛkṣādanī payasyā ca latā sotpalaśārivā | anantā śārivā rāsnā padmā ca madhuyaṣṭikā
verses.tib: bri sha dang ni pa ya s+ya / ut+pal thal tres pri yang ku / byi tsher thal tres ra sna dang / pad+ma tsa ri shing mngar dang

verses.skt: bṛhatīdvayakāśmaryakṣīriśuṅgatvacā ghṛtam | pṛśniparṇī balā śigruḥ śvadaṃṣṭrā madhuparṇikā
verses.tib: bri ha te gnyis tang pal dang / 'o shing myu gu shun pa dmar / kr-iSh+Na pa r+Ni ba la dang / shi kru gze ma sle tres dang

verses.skt: śṛṅgāṭakaṃ bisaṃ drākṣā kaseru madhukaṃ sitā | saptaitān payasā yogān ardhaślokasamāpanān
verses.tib: shring ga sta rga rgun pad rtsa / shing mngar kha ra ka she ru / tshigs / bcad phyed kyis rdzogs bshad pa'i / bdun pa 'di dag 'o mar sbyar

verses.skt: kramāt saptasu māseṣu garbhe sravati yojayet | kapitthabilvabṛhatīpaṭolekṣunidigdhikāt
verses.tib: zla ba bdun la rim bzhin du / mngal 'dzag pa la gtang bar bya / ka bid ta dang bil ba dang / bri ha ti dang bu ram dang / kaN+Da ka ri pa to la'i

verses.skt: mūlaiḥ śṛtaṃ prayuñjīta kṣīraṃ māse tathāṣṭame | navame śārivānantāpayasyāmadhuyaṣṭibhiḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba bskol bar byas pa dang / de bzhin 'o ma sha rnams ni / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshe na'ang btang / dgu par thal tres er Na dang / pa ya s+ya mngar gtang

verses.skt: yojayed daśame māsi siddhaṃ kṣīraṃ payasyayā | athavā yaṣṭimadhukanāgarāmaradārubhiḥ
verses.tib: zla ba bcu par pa ya s+ya / 'o ma dang ni bskol ba blud / yang na shing mngar dong gra dang / thang shing 'o mar sbyar ba sbyin

verses.skt: avasthitaṃ lohitam aṅganāyā vātena garbhaṃ bruvate ’nabhijñāḥ | garbhākṛtitvāt kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇaiḥ srute punaḥ kevala eva rakte
verses.tib: bud med mngal du rlung gis khrag bsgongs te / gnas pa de ni mngal chags cha 'dra bas / bu chags yin zhes mi mkhas pa dag smra / sman kha rno dros khrag ni 'ba' zhig zags

verses.skt: garbhaṃ jaḍā bhūtahṛtaṃ vadanti mūrter na dṛṣṭaṃ haraṇaṃ yatas taiḥ | ojo'śanatvād athavāvyavasthair bhūtair upekṣyeta na garbhamātā
verses.tib: blun pos mngal gnas 'byung pos zos zhes zer / mdangs 'phrog yin phyir de lus mngon sum du / 'phrog par mi snang ba 'am 'byung po ni / gzhung 'dor ma ni btang snyoms 'jog mi byed

verses.skt: śiro ’ntarādhir dvau bāhū sakthinīti samāsataḥ | ṣaḍaṅgam aṅgaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ tasyākṣihṛdayādikam
verses.tib: mdor na yan lag rnam drug ste / mgo dang khog pa dpung pa gnyis / brla gnyis yin te de'i nying lag / mig snying lag pa rkang pa

verses.skt: śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaḥ kramād guṇāḥ | khānilāgnyabbhuvām ekaguṇavṛddhyanvayaḥ pare
verses.tib: sgra dang reg bya gzugs ro dri / bzhin du nam mkha' rlung / me chu sa yi yon tan yin / yon tan re res phyi ma skyed

verses.skt: tatra khāt khāni dehe ’smin śrotraṃ śabdo viviktatā | vātāt sparśatvagucchvāsā vahner dṛgrūpapaktayaḥ
verses.tib: de la mkha' las lus bu ga / rna ba sgra dang khong stong nyid / rlung las reg pa lpags dbugs 'byin / me las mig dang gzugs 'ju nyid

verses.skt: āpyā jihvārasakledā ghrāṇagandhāsthi pārthivam | mṛdv atra mātṛjaṃ raktamāṃsamajjagudādikam
verses.tib: chu las lce dang ro dang gsher / sa las sna dri rus pa yin / 'dir ni ma las skyes 'jam khrag / sha dang rkang dang gzhang kha

verses.skt: paitṛkaṃ tu sthiraṃ śukradhamanyasthikacādikam | caitanaṃ cittam akṣāṇi nānāyoniṣu janma ca
verses.tib: pha skyes brtan dang khu chu dang / rtsa bo che rus skra yin / sems las sems byung dbang po rnams / skye gnas sna tshogs rnams kyang 'byung

verses.skt: sātmyajaṃ tv āyur ārogyam anālasyaṃ prabhā balam | rasajaṃ vapuṣo janma vṛttir vṛddhir alolatā
verses.tib: goms pa las byung nad med tshe / le lo med stobs gzi mdangs yin / dngas ma las byung lus skyed dang / gnas dang 'phel dang mi brkam nyid

verses.skt: sāttvikaṃ śaucam āstikyaṃ śukladharmarucir matiḥ | rājasaṃ bahubhāṣitvaṃ mānakruddambhamatsaram
verses.tib: snying stobs can gtsang yod par lta / chos dkar la dga' blo gros ldan / rdul can mang du smra ba dang / nga rgyal tshul 'chos khro phrag dog

verses.skt: tāmasaṃ bhayam ajñānaṃ nidrālasyaṃ viṣāditā | iti bhūtamayo dehas tatra sapta tvaco ’sṛjaḥ
verses.tib: mun pa 'jigs dang mi shes dang / gnyid dang le lo skyo ba'o / de ltar 'byung ba'i rang bzhin lus / de la khrag skyes lpags rim bdun

verses.skt: pacyamānāt prajāyante kṣīrāt saṃtānikā iva | dhātvāśayāntarakledo vipakvaḥ svaṃ svam ūṣmaṇā
verses.tib: 'o ma las ni spris ma bzhin / smin pa'i tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur / lus zungs gnas ni nang gsher gyi / rang gi drod kyis smin pas na

verses.skt: śleṣmasnāyvaparācchannaḥ kalākhyaḥ kāṣṭhasāravat | tāḥ sapta sapta cādhārā raktasyādyaḥ kramāt pare
verses.tib: bad kan rgyus pa shams g.yogs / char bshad shing gi snying po 'dra / bdun po de dag gnas bdun te / dang por khrag yin gzhan rim bzhin

verses.skt: kaphāmapittapakvānāṃ vāyor mūtrasya ca smṛtāḥ | garbhāśayo ’ṣṭamaḥ strīṇāṃ pittapakvāśayāntare
verses.tib: bad kan ma zhu mkhris zhu ba / rlung dang gcin gyi gnas su bshad / bud med mngal gnas brgyad pa ste / mkhris pa zhu ba'i gnas par gnas

verses.skt: koṣṭhāṅgāni sthitāny eṣu hṛdayaṃ kloma phupphusam | yakṛtplīhoṇḍukaṃ vṛkkau nābhiḍimbāntravastayaḥ
verses.tib: 'di la nang grol yan lag gnas / snying glo mchin mkhris mcher mkhal ma / pho ba grod pa rgyu ma dang / gnye ma long ka lgang pa'o

verses.skt: daśa jīvitadhāmāni śirorasanabandhanam | kaṇṭho ’sraṃ hṛdayaṃ nābhir vastiḥ śukraujasī gudam
verses.tib: srog gi gnas ni rnam bcu ste / mgo dang lce yi rtsa ba dang / lkog ma khrag dang snying lte ba / chu so khu chu dngas dang gzhang

verses.skt: jālāni kaṇḍarāś cāṅge pṛthak ṣoḍaśa nirdiśet | ṣaṭ kūrcāḥ sapta sīvanyo meḍhrajihvāśirogatāḥ
verses.tib: lus la rtsa dra chu ba che / re re bcu drug yod par bshad / pir 'dra drug dang srubs 'dra bdun / pho mtshan lce dang mgo la brten

verses.skt: śastreṇa tāḥ pariharec catasro māṃsarajjavaḥ | caturdaśāsthisaṃghātāḥ sīmantā dviguṇā nava
verses.tib: de dag gtsags bus gdab mi rung / sha yi thag pa rnam pa bzhi / rus pa'i tshogs 'dus bcu bzhi yod / mtshams ni dgu phrag gnyis yod la

verses.skt: asthnāṃ śatāni ṣaṣṭiś ca trīṇi dantanakhaiḥ saha | dhanvantaris tu trīṇy āha saṃdhīnāṃ ca śatadvayam
verses.tib: so dang sen mor bcas pa yi / rus pa sum brgya drug cu yin / thang la 'bar ni sum brgyar 'dod / tshigs ni nyis brgya rtsa bcur 'dod

verses.skt: daśottaraṃ sahasre dve nijagādātrinandanaḥ | snāvnāṃ navaśatī pañca puṃsāṃ peśīśatāni tu
verses.tib: rgyun shes bus ni tshigs kyi grangs / nyis stong dag ni yod par 'dod / rgyus pa dgu brgya skyes pa la / sha ni spar tshad lnga brgya yod

verses.skt: adhikā viṃśatiḥ strīṇāṃ yonistanasamāśritāḥ | daśa mūlasirā hṛtsthās tāḥ sarvaṃ sarvato vapuḥ
verses.tib: bud med kyi ni nu ma dang / mo mtshan la gnas nyi shu lhag / rtsa chen rtsa ba snying la gnas / de dag kun gyis lus kun khyab

verses.skt: rasātmakaṃ vahanty ojas tannibaddhaṃ hi ceṣṭitam | sthūlamūlāḥ susūkṣmāgrāḥ pattrarekhāpratānavat
verses.tib: dngas ma'i bdag nyid mdangs su 'gyur / de ni phra ba kun dang 'brel / rtsa ba sbom zhing rtse rab phra / lo ma'i rtsa ltar gyes pa yin

verses.skt: bhidyante tās tataḥ saptaśatāny āsāṃ bhavanti tu | tatraikaikaṃ ca śākhāyāṃ śataṃ tasmin na vedhayet
verses.tib: gyes pa de las rtsa phran ni / bdun brgya dag tu gyur pa yin / de la yan lag re re zhing / brgyad brgyad der ni gnas / pa yin / de la dbug par mi bya ba

verses.skt: sirāṃ jālandharāṃ nāma tisraś cābhyantarāśritāḥ | ṣoḍaśadviguṇāḥ śroṇyāṃ tāsāṃ dve dve tu vaṅkṣaṇe
verses.tib: nang na gnas pa gsum po yin / rked par bcu drug phrag gnyis te / de las brla rtsar gnyis gnyis dang

verses.skt: dve dve kaṭīkataruṇe śastreṇāṣṭau spṛśen na tāḥ | pārśvayoḥ ṣoḍaśaikaikām ūrdhvagāṃ varjayet tayoḥ
verses.tib: rked pa'i gnad rnams gnyis gnyis te / de brgyad gtsags bus gdab mi bya / rtsib logs gnyis la rtsa bcu drug / de las gyen 'gro zhes bya spang

verses.skt: dvādaśadviguṇāḥ pṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhavaṃśasya pārśvayoḥ | dve dve tatrordhvagāminyau na śastreṇa parāmṛśet
verses.tib: rgyab tu rtsa ni nyi shu bzhi / sgal tshigs kyi ni ngos gnyis na / de las gnyis gnyis gyen 'gro ba / mtshon gyis gdab par mi bya'o

verses.skt: pṛṣṭhavaj jaṭhare tāsāṃ mehanasyopari sthite | romarājīm ubhayato dve dve śastreṇa na spṛśet
verses.tib: rgyab bzhin lto na gnas rtsa de / pho mtshan steng na gnas pa dang / sbu yi phreng ba'i ngos gnyis rtsa / gnyis gnyis mtshon gyis mi gdab bo

verses.skt: catvāriṃśad urasy āsāṃ caturdaśa na vedhayet | stanarohitatanmūlahṛdaye tu pṛthag dvayam
verses.tib: brang la gnas pa bzhi bcu las / bcu bzhi dbug par mi bya ste / nu ma jing de yi rtsa ba dang / snying ga dag ni so sor gnyis / gnod bral gnad ni gnyis po dang

verses.skt: apastambhākhyayor ekāṃ tathāpālāpayor api | grīvāyāṃ pṛṣṭhavat tāsāṃ nīle manye kṛkāṭike
verses.tib: mi gsal zhes bya gnyis kyi gnyis / mgrin pa ltag pa 'dra ba las / sngon po mjing pa ltag pa dang

verses.skt: vidhure mātṛkāś cāṣṭau ṣoḍaśeti parityajet | hanvoḥ ṣoḍaśa tāsāṃ dve saṃdhibandhanakarmaṇī
verses.tib: 'gal pa dang ni ma mo brgyad / bcu drug yongs su spang bar bya / 'gram pa bcu drug de las gnyis / mtshams ni 'brel par byed pa spang

verses.skt: jihvāyāṃ hanuvat tāsām adho dve rasabodhane | dve ca vācaḥpravartinyau nāsāyāṃ caturuttarā
verses.tib: lce yang 'gram pa dang 'dra ste / 'og gi ro tshor byed gnyis dang / tshig 'byin byed pa gnyis po spang / sna yi rtsa ni nyi shu bzhi

verses.skt: viṃśatir gandhavedinyau tāsām ekāṃ ca tālugām | ṣaṭpañcāśan nayanayor nimeṣonmeṣakarmaṇī
verses.tib: de las dri tshor byed gnyis dang / rkan du 'gro ba'i rtsa gnyis spang / mig gnyis kyi ni lnga bcu drug / 'byed dang 'dzums pa'i las byed pa

verses.skt: dve dve apāṅgayor dve ca tāsāṃ ṣaḍ iti varjayet | nāsānetrāśritāḥ ṣaṣṭir lalāṭe sthapanīśritām
verses.tib: gnyis gnyis dang ni mig 'gram gnyis / drug po de dag spang bar bya / mig dang snar gnas 'phral ba la / brten pa'i rtsa ni drug cu las

verses.skt: tatraikāṃ dve tathāvartau catasraś ca kacāntagāḥ | saptaivaṃ varjayet tāsāṃ karṇayoḥ ṣoḍaśātra tu
verses.tib: bzhag pa gcig dang gtsug gi gnyis / skra mtshams gnas pa'i rtsa bzhi ste / bdun po de dag mtshon gdab spang / rna bar bcu drug de las 'dir

verses.skt: dve śabdabodhane śaṅkhau sirās tā eva cāśritāḥ | dve śaṅkhasaṃdhige tāsāṃ mūrdhni dvādaśa tatra tu
verses.tib: sgra thos byed pa'i rtsa gnyis spang / de nyid las ni mur 'gram gyi / mtshams su 'gro ba gnyis po spang / spyi bor bcu gnyis de las ni

verses.skt: ekaikāṃ pṛthag utkṣepasīmantādhipatisthitām | ity avedhyavibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ
verses.tib: gyen 'gro skra mtshams bdag po las / so so'i re re spang bar bya / de ltar yan lag re re'i rtsa'i / dbye ba / dbug min shes phyir bshad

verses.skt: avedhyās tatra kārtsnyena dehe ’ṣṭānavatis tathā | saṃkīrṇā grathitāḥ kṣudrā vakrāḥ saṃdhiṣu cāśritāḥ
verses.tib: de las lus la dbug mi rung / ma lus dgu bcu rtsa brgyad yod / dog dang rtsa mdud shin tu phra / yo dang tshigs la gnas mi dbug

verses.skt: tāsāṃ śatānāṃ saptānāṃ pādo ’sraṃ vahate pṛthak | vātapittakaphair juṣṭaṃ śuddhaṃ caivaṃ sthitā malāḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ni bdun brgya de rnams las / bzhi char khrag ni so sor rgyu / rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan khrag / nad med khrag ni de ltar gnas

verses.skt: śarīram anugṛhṇanti pīḍayanty anyathā punaḥ | tatra śyāvāruṇāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pūrṇariktāḥ kṣaṇāt sirāḥ
verses.tib: de ni lus la phan 'dogs te / gzhan du gnod pa skyed par 'gyur / de la gnag dang dmar dang phra / skad cig re re gang zhing stongs

verses.skt: praspandinyaś ca vātāsraṃ vahante pittaśoṇitam | sparśoṣṇāḥ śīghravāhinyo nīlapītāḥ kaphaṃ punaḥ
verses.tib: mgul pa rlung gi khrag rtsa yin / reg na tsha zhing myur du rgyu / mdog sngo ser por 'dug pa ni / mkhris pa'i khrag rtsa'i mtshan nyid yin

verses.skt: gauryaḥ snigdhāḥ sthirāḥ śītāḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ liṅgasaṃkare | gūḍhāḥ samasthitāḥ snigdhā rohiṇyaḥ śuddhaśoṇitam
verses.tib: dkar snum brtan grang bad kan rtsa / 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid 'dren ma yin / mi mngon mnyam gnas snum pa dang / mdog dmar khrag rtsa nad med yin

verses.skt: dhamanyo nābhisaṃbaddhā viṃśatiś caturuttarā | tābhiḥ parivṛtā nābhiś cakranābhir ivārakaiḥ
verses.tib: rtsa bo che ni nyi shu bzhi / lte ba la ni brten pa yin / de rnams kyis bskor lte ba ni / 'khor lo'i lte ba rtsibs bskor mtshungs

verses.skt: tābhiś cordhvam adhas tiryag deho ’yam anugṛhyate | srotāṃsi nāsike karṇau netre pāyvāsyamehanam
verses.tib: des ni steng 'og thad ka ru / lus 'di rjes su 'dzin pa yin / bu ga sna dang rna ba gnyis / mig gnyis kha rkub pho mtshan gyi'o

verses.skt: stanau raktapathaś ceti nārīṇām adhikaṃ trayam | jīvitāyatanāny antaḥ srotāṃsy āhus trayodaśa
verses.tib: bud med nu ma gnyis khrag sgo / gsum gyis lhag par gyur pa yin / nang gi srog gi gnas gyur pa'i / bu ga bcu gsum yod par bshad

verses.skt: prāṇadhātumalāmbho'nnavāhīny ahitasevanāt | tāni duṣṭāni rogāya viśuddhāni sukhāya ca
verses.tib: srog dang lus zungs dri ma chu / zas rgyu mi mthun bsten pa yin / de la gnod pas nad skyed la / skyon med dag pas bde bar byed

verses.skt: svadhātusamavarṇāni vṛttasthūlāny aṇūni ca | srotāṃsi dīrghāṇy ākṛtyā pratānasadṛśāni ca
verses.tib: rang gi lus zungs mdog mnyam zhing / zlum dang sbom dang phra ba yin / bu ga'i dbyibs ni ring po ste / lo ma'i rtsa 'phros lta bu yin

verses.skt: āhāraś ca vihāraś ca yaḥ syād doṣaguṇaiḥ samaḥ | dhātubhir viguṇo yaś ca srotasāṃ sa pradūṣakaḥ
verses.tib: zas dang spyod lam dag gis gang / nad kyi mthu dang mnyam gyur dang / gang yang lus zungs mi mnyam ste / bu ga'i rgyun la gnod byed yin

verses.skt: atipravṛttiḥ saṅgo vā sirāṇāṃ granthayo ’pi vā | vimārgato vā gamanaṃ srotasāṃ duṣṭilakṣaṇam
verses.tib: mang du 'byung ngam 'gags pa'am / rtsa ni mdud pa chags pa'am / lam gzhan dag tu 'gro ba ni / bu ga'i rgyu 'khrugs mtshan nyid yin

verses.skt: bisānām iva sūkṣmāṇi dūraṃ pravisṛtāni ca | dvārāṇi srotasāṃ dehe raso yair upacīyate
verses.tib: ring du rgyu bar byed pa ltar / gang gis dngas ma nyer 'phel ba'i / lus kyi sgo ni / bu ga yin / bu ga rnams ni brtol 'gyur na

verses.skt: vyadhe tu srotasāṃ mohakampādhmānavamijvarāḥ | pralāpaśūlaviṇmūtrarodhā maraṇam eva vā
verses.tib: 'dar myos lto sbos lkugs dang rims / sla dang gzer dang bshang gci 'gags / yang na 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: srotoviddham ato vaidyaḥ pratyākhyāya prasādhayet | uddhṛtya śalyaṃ yatnena sadyaḥkṣatavidhānataḥ
verses.tib: de bas sman pas bu ga brtol / re thag bcad de gso bar bya / 'phral du rma byung cho ga yis / 'bad de zug rngu dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: annasya paktā pittaṃ tu pācakākhyaṃ pureritam | doṣadhātumalādīnām ūṣmety ātreyaśāsanam
verses.tib: zas 'ju byed pa mkhris pa ni / 'ju byed yin zhes sngar bshad do / nad dang lus zungs dri ma yi / drod yin zhes ni rgyun shes zer

verses.skt: vāmapārśvāśritaṃ nābheḥ kiñcit sūryasya maṇḍalam | tanmadhye maṇḍalaṃ saumyaṃ tanmadhye ’gnir vyavasthitaḥ
jarāyumātrapracchannaḥ kācakośasthadīpavat
tadadhiṣṭhānam annasya grahaṇād grahaṇī matā | saiva dhanvantarimate kalā pittadharāhvayā
verses.tib: de ni zas kyi gnas yin zhing / 'dzin cing 'dzin byed ces bshad do / de nyid thang la 'bar gzhung gis / mkhris pa 'dzin pa'i cha ru bshad

verses.skt: āyurārogyavīryaujobhūtadhātvagnipuṣṭaye | sthitā pakvāśayadvāri bhuktamārgārgaleva sā
verses.tib: tshe dang nad med brtson gzi mdangs / lus zungs me drod stobs 'phel byed / zhu ba'i gnas kyi sgor 'jug gang / zas kyi lam gyi sgo gtan yin

verses.skt: bhuktam āmāśaye ruddhvā sā vipācya nayaty adhaḥ | balavaty abalā tv annam āmam eva vimuñcati
verses.tib: de ni stobs ldan zos pa rnams / zhu nas zur du 'dren par byed / stobs zhan gyur na kha zas ni / ma smin nyid du 'byung bar byed

verses.skt: grahaṇyā balam agnir hi sa cāpi grahaṇībalaḥ | dūṣite ’gnāv ato duṣṭā grahaṇī rogakāriṇī
verses.tib: 'dzin byed stobs ni me drod de / de yang 'dzin byed stobs can yin / de bas me drod nyams gyur na / 'dzin byed nad ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: yad annaṃ dehadhātvojobalavarṇādipoṣaṇam | tatrāgnir hetur āhārān na hy apakvād rasādayaḥ
verses.tib: zas gang lus kyi lus zungs mdangs / stobs dang kha dog rgyas byed / de rgyu kha zas me drod ni / mi 'ju dngas ma mi 'gyur

verses.skt: annaṃ kāle ’bhyavahṛtaṃ koṣṭhaṃ prāṇānilāhṛtam | dravair vibhinnasaṃghātaṃ nītaṃ snehena mārdavam
verses.tib: zas ni dus su zos gyur pa / lto bar srog gi rlung gis drangs / skom gyis gong por rnam par phye / snum gyis mnyen par byas pa yin

verses.skt: saṃdhukṣitaḥ samānena pacaty āmāśayasthitam | audaryo ’gnir yathā bāhyaḥ sthālīsthaṃ toyataṇḍulam
verses.tib: me mnyam gnas kyis bus nas ni / ma zhu'i gnas na gnas smin byed / phyi yi snod gnas 'bras chu ltar / lto ba'i me yis 'ju bar byed

verses.skt: ādau ṣaḍrasam apy annaṃ madhurībhūtam īrayet | phenībhūtaṃ kaphaṃ yātaṃ vidāhād amlatāṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: dang por ro drug zas kyang ni / mngar ba nyid du gyur nas ni / sbu ba can gyur bad kan 'gyur / zhu ba'i gnas nas 'pho ba na / rnam par tsha bas skyur nyid 'gyur

verses.skt: pittam āmāśayāt kuryāc cyavamānaṃ cyutaṃ punaḥ | agninā śoṣitaṃ pakvaṃ piṇḍitaṃ kaṭu mārutam
verses.tib: mkhris gyur 'phos pa'i rjes la ni / me drod kyis skams zhu ba dang / kha zhing gong bur gyur rlung skyed

verses.skt: bhaumāpyāgneyavāyavyāḥ pañcoṣmāṇaḥ sanābhasāḥ | pañcāhāraguṇān svān svān pārthivādīn pacanty anu
verses.tib: sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / nam mkha' bcas pa'i drod lnga pos / rang rang yon tan zas lnga po / sa kyis smin de 'og tu

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ te ca puṣṇanti pakvā bhūtaguṇān pṛthak | pārthivāḥ pārthivān eva śeṣāḥ śeṣāṃś ca dehagān
verses.tib: de dag rang rang ji bzhin rgyas / smin 'byung yon tan tha dad yin / sa ru gtogs pas sa nyid dang / lhag mas lus gtogs lhag ma rgyas

verses.skt: kiṭṭaṃ sāraś ca tat pakvam annaṃ saṃbhavati dvidhā | tatrācchaṃ kiṭṭam annasya mūtraṃ vidyād ghanam śakṛt
verses.tib: zas de zhu ba'i tshigs ma dang / dngas ma zhes bya gnyis su 'gyur / de las zas kyi tshigs ma sla / gcin 'gyur ska ba bshad bar 'gyur

verses.skt: sāras tu saptabhir bhūyo yathāsvaṃ pacyate ’gnibhiḥ | rasād raktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsān medas tato ’sthi ca
verses.tib: dngas mas lus zungs rang rang gi / me drod kyis smin rnam bdun 'gyur / dngas ma las khrag de las sha / sha las tshil te de las rus

verses.skt: asthno majjā tataḥ śukraṃ śukrād garbhaḥ prajāyate | kaphaḥ pittaṃ malāḥ kheṣu prasvedo nakharoma ca
