verses.tib: rus rkang de las khu ba yin / khu ba las na ming la gnas 'gyur / lus zungs tshigs ma rim bzhin du / bad mkhris bu ga'i dri ma dang / rdul dang sen mo ba spu dang / mi lpags bshang snum dngas ma yin / de ltar lus zungs smin pa las / dngas ma tshigs ma gnyis su 'gyur

verses.skt: sneho ’kṣitvagviṣām ojo dhātūnāṃ kramaśo malāḥ | prasādakiṭṭau dhātūnāṃ pākād evaṃ dvidharcchataḥ
verses.tib: rus rkang de las khu ba yin / khu ba las na ming la gnas 'gyur / lus zungs tshigs ma rim bzhin du / bad mkhris bu ga'i dri ma dang / rdul dang sen mo ba spu dang / mi lpags bshang snum dngas ma yin / de ltar lus zungs smin pa las / dngas ma tshigs ma gnyis su 'gyur

verses.skt: parasparopasaṃstambhād dhātusnehaparamparā | kecid āhur ahorātrāt ṣaḍahād apare pare
verses.tib: phan tshun nye bar bsten pa yin / zas 'ju dngas ma rim gyis / khu chur gyur pa la la ni / nyin zhag gcig 'dod gzhan dag ni

verses.skt: māsena yāti śukratvam annaṃ pākakramādibhiḥ | saṃtatā bhojyadhātūnāṃ parivṛttis tu cakravat
verses.tib: zhag drug kha cig zla gcig 'dod / lus kyi zungs ni zas kyi rgyun / 'khor lo lta bur yongs su 'khor

verses.skt: vṛṣyādīni prabhāveṇa sadyaḥ śukrādi kurvate | prāyaḥ karoty ahorātrāt karmānyad api bheṣajam
verses.tib: ro tsa pa'i mthu yis ni / 'phral du khu ba la skyed / phal cher sman gzhan nyin zhag ni / gcig gis las rnams byed pa yin

verses.skt: vyānena rasadhātur hi vikṣepocitakarmaṇā | yugapat sarvato ’jasraṃ dehe vikṣipyate sadā
verses.tib: khyab byed kyis dngas lus zungs rnams / 'thor bar byed pa'i las kyis ni / cig car rgyun mi 'chad kun tu / lus la rtag tu rnam par 'thor

verses.skt: kṣipyamāṇaḥ khavaiguṇyād rasaḥ sajjati yatra saḥ | tasmin vikāraṃ kurute khe varṣam iva toyadaḥ
verses.tib: gtor tshe bu ga'i skyon gyis ni / dngas ma gang du chags 'gyur te / der ni gnod pa skyed byed de / mkha' la sprin chags char 'bab mtshungs

verses.skt: doṣāṇām api caivaṃ syād ekadeśaprakopaṇam | annabhautikadhātvagnikarmeti paribhāṣitam
verses.tib: phyogs gcig 'dus na ldang bar 'gyur / de ltar 'byung ba lus zungs me'i / las ni yongs su bshad pa yin / zas ni dus su zos gyur pa / sa dang chu dang me dang rlung

verses.skt: annasya paktā sarveṣāṃ paktÃṇām adhiko mataḥ | tanmūlās te hi tadvṛddhikṣayavṛddhikṣayātmakāḥ
verses.tib: smin byed kun la zas 'ju ba'i / me ni lhag pa yin par 'dod / de ni rtsa ba de 'phel 'phel / zad gyur zad pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur

verses.skt: tasmāt taṃ vidhivad yuktair annapānendhanair hitaiḥ | pālayet prayatas tasya sthitau hy āyurbalasthitiḥ
verses.tib: de bas rigs pas cho ga bzhin / zas skom rigs / shing phan pa yin / de 'bad pas bsrungs gnas gyur na / tshe dang stobs ni gnas par 'gyur

verses.skt: samaḥ samāne sthānasthe viṣamo ’gnir vimārgage | pittābhimūrchite tīkṣṇo mando ’smin kaphapīḍite
verses.tib: mnyam gnas rang gnas 'dug na mnyam / mnyam lam gzhan 'gro drod mi snyoms / mkhris pa shas che rno bar 'gyur / bad kan gyis gnod me drod chung

verses.skt: samo ’gnir viṣamas tīkṣṇo mandaś caivaṃ caturvidhaḥ | yaḥ pacet samyag evānnaṃ bhuktaṃ samyak samas tv asau
verses.tib: me drod mnyam dang mi mnyam rno / chung dang de ltar rnam bzhi yin / gang zhig zas ni legs zos pa / legs par 'ju 'di mnyam pa yin

verses.skt: viṣamo ’samyag apy āśu samyag vāpi cirāt pacet | tīkṣṇo vahniḥ pacec chīghram asamyag api bhojanam
verses.tib: legs par ma zos myur 'ju ba'am / legs zos ring zhing 'ju mi mnyam / zas ni legs par ma zos kyang / myur 'ju me drod rnon po yin

verses.skt: mandas tu samyag apy annam upayuktaṃ cirāt pacet | kṛtvāsyaśoṣāṭopāntrakūjanādhmānagauravam
verses.tib: zas ni legs par zos gyur kyang / ring nas 'ju zhing kha skam dang / sbo dang rgyu ma 'khrugs pa dang / lci ba me drod chung ba yin

verses.skt: śānte ’gnau mriyate yukte ciraṃ jīvaty anāmayaḥ | rogī syād vikṛte mūlam agnistambhān nirucyate
verses.tib: me drod nyams na 'chi 'gyur zhing / skyon med na ni yun ring 'tsho / ma snyoms nad ni skye 'gyur bas / de phyir me drod gtso bo yin

verses.skt: sahajaṃ kālajaṃ yuktikṛtaṃ dehabalaṃ tridhā | tatra sattvaśarīrotthaṃ prākṛtaṃ sahajaṃ balam
verses.tib: lus stobs lhan cig skyes pa dang / dus skyes rigs pa las byung gsum / de la lus sems las byung ba / rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i stobs

verses.skt: vayaḥkṛtam ṛtūtthaṃ ca kālajaṃ yuktijaṃ punaḥ | vihārāhārajanitaṃ tathorjaskarayogajam
verses.tib: na tshong dus tshigs las byung ba / dus skyes yin te rigs pa las / byung ba spyod lam zas kyis bskyed / de bzhin gzi bskyed sbyor las 'byung

verses.skt: deśo ’lpavāridrunago jāṅgalaḥ svalparogadaḥ | ānūpo viparīto ’smāt samaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: yul phyogs shing ring chu nyung la / skams nad nyung skyed byed yin / rlan can de las bzlog pa yin / cha snyoms thun mong yin par bshad

verses.skt: majjamedovasāmūtrapittaśleṣmaśakṛnty asṛk | raso jalaṃ ca dehe ’sminn ekaikāñjalivardhitam
verses.tib: rkang dang tshil dang zhag dang gcin / mkhris pa bad kan phyis khrag / dngas ma chu rnams lus gnas pa'i / snyim pa re res skyed par byed

verses.skt: pṛthak svaprasṛtaṃ proktam ojomastiṣkaretasām | dvāv añjalī tu stanyasya catvāro rajasaḥ striyāḥ
verses.tib: mdangs dang klad rgyas khu chu ni / re re'ang rang gi khyor gang yin / bud med nu zho snyim do dang / zla mtshan snyim pa bzhi yod do

verses.skt: samadhātor idaṃ mānaṃ vidyād vṛddhikṣayāv ataḥ
verses.tib: de las 'phel dang zad shes bya

verses.skt: śukrāsṛggarbhiṇībhojyaceṣṭāgarbhāśayartuṣu | yaḥ syād doṣo ’dhikas tena prakṛtiḥ saptadhoditā
verses.tib: khu chu khrag dang sbrum ma'i zas / spyod lam mngal gnas dus tshigs las / gang zhig nyes pa lhag gyur des / rang bzhin rnam pa bdun du bshad

verses.skt: vibhutvād āśukāritvād balitvād anyakopanāt | svātantryād bahurogatvād doṣāṇāṃ prabalo ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: khyab dang myur bar byed phyir dang / stobs ldan ba dang gzhan ldang byad / rang dbang / can dang nad mang phyir / nad las phal cher rlung stobs can

verses.skt: prāyo ’ta eva pavanādhyuṣitā manuṣyā doṣātmakāḥ sphuṭitadhūsarakeśagātrāḥ | śītadviṣaś caladhṛtismṛtibuddhiceṣṭāsauhārdadṛṣṭigatayo ’tibahupralāpāḥ || 85 || alpavittabalajīvitanidrāḥ sannasaktacalajarjaravācaḥ | nāstikā bahubhujaḥ savilāsā gītahāsamṛgayākalilolāḥ
verses.tib: de nyid kyis na rlung gis bskyod pa'i mi rnams ni / nad kyi bdag nyid rdul can skra bshor pags pags / grang lhags mi bzod brtan dran blo gros spyod mdza' sred / blta dang 'gro ba g.yo zhing smra ba shin tu mang / bad kan nor nyung tshe thung gnyid srab dang / gcom chung tshig thogs g.yo zhing skad 'dzer dang / chad lta mang du za zhing sgeg dang bcas / glu dang dgod dang rngon las 'thab la dga'

verses.skt: madhurāmlapaṭūṣṇasātmyakāṅkṣāḥ kṛśadīrghākṛtayaḥ saśabdayātāḥ | na dṛḍhā na jitendriyā na cāryā na ca kāntādayitā bahuprajā vā
verses.tib: mngar skyur kha dang tsha ba'i ro goms sred / lus skem dbyibs ring 'gro tshe sbra dang bcas / mi brtan dbang po mi thul dam pa min / bud med mi chags bu mang skye mi 'gyur

verses.skt: netrāṇi caiṣāṃ kharadhūsarāṇi vṛttāny acārūṇi mṛtopamāni | unmīlitānīva bhavanti supte śailadrumāṃs te gaganaṃ ca yānti
verses.tib: de yi mig ni rtsub cing rdul gyis gang / zlum zhing mi mdzes 'chi ba lta bu dang / phye gdangs gnyid log lta bur snang ba yin / de ni shing dang ri 'dzeg mkha' 'phur rmi

verses.skt: adhanyā matsarādhmātāḥ stenāḥ prodbaddhapiṇḍikāḥ | śvaśṛgāloṣṭragṛdhrākhukākānūkāś ca vātikāḥ
verses.tib: skal ngan ser sna che zhing khengs pa dang / rku zhing byin snying rtsa bcas pa dang / khyi dang wa dang rnga mo bya rgod khra / byi ba'i mtshan nyid ldan mi rlung can yin

verses.skt: pittaṃ vahnir vahnijaṃ vā yad asmāt pittodriktas tīkṣṇatṛṣṇābubhukṣaḥ | gauroṣṇāṅgas tāmrahastāṅghrivaktraḥ śūro mānī piṅgakeśo ’lparomā
verses.tib: mkhris pa me 'dra me las byung yin phyir / mkhris pa rgyas pa skom dang bkres shas che / mdog ser lus tsha rkang lag gdong yang dmar / skra ser spu nyung dpa' zhing nga rgyal che

verses.skt: dayitamālyavilepanamaṇḍanaḥ sucaritaḥ śucir āśritavatsalaḥ | vibhavasāhasabuddhibalānvito bhavati bhīṣu gatir dviṣatām api
verses.tib: phreng ba byug pa rgyan la lhag par dga' / spyod bzang gtsang sbra che zhing mnyes gshin la / 'byor dang rtul phod blo gros stobs dang ldan / 'jig rten dgra bo'ang skyabs 'ongs skyob par byed

verses.skt: medhāvī praśithilasaṃdhibandhamāṃso nārīṇām anabhimato ’lpaśukrakāmaḥ | āvāsaḥ palitataraṅganīlikānāṃ bhuṅkte ’nnaṃ madhurakaṣāyatiktaśītam || 92 || gharmadveṣī svedanaḥ pūtigandhir bhūryuccārakrodhapānāśanerṣyaḥ | suptaḥ paśyet karṇikārān palāśān digdāholkāvidyudarkānalāṃś ca
verses.tib: yid gzhungs tshigs kyi mtshams dang sha ni rab tu lhod / bud med mi dga' khu ba dang ni 'dod pa chung / gnyer ma'i tshogs dang skra dkar mig sngo'i gnas gyur la / zas ni mngar dang bska dang kha bsil za bar dga' / than pa mi bzod rngul zhing dring la / bshang gci bza' btung khro dang phrag dog mang / rmi lam dong ka pa la sha'i me tog / glog 'gyu phyogs tshig skar mda' nyi me mthong

verses.skt: tanūni piṅgāni calāni caiṣāṃ tanvalpapakṣmāṇi himapriyāṇi | krodhena madyena raveś ca bhāsā rāgaṃ vrajanty āśu vilocanāni
verses.tib: 'di yi lus phra mig ser g.yo ba dang / rdzi ma srab cing nyung zhing grang la dga' / khro dang chang dang nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis / mig ni myur bar dmar por / 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: madhyāyuṣo madhyabalāḥ piṇḍitāḥ kleśabhīravaḥ | vyāghrarkṣakapimārjārayakṣānūkāś ca paittikāḥ
verses.tib: tshe ni ran cing stobs ni 'bring ba dang / mkhas shing sdug bsngal dag la sran chung 'gyur / stag dang dred dang spre'u byi la dang / gnod sbyin rang bzhin ldan pa mkhris can yin

verses.skt: śleṣmā somaḥ śleṣmalas tena saumyo gūḍhasnigdhaśliṣṭasaṃdhyasthimāṃsaḥ | kṣuttṛḍduḥkhakleśagharmair atapto buddhyā yuktaḥ sāttvikaḥ satyasaṃdhaḥ || 96 || priyaṅgudūrvāśarakāṇḍaśastra gorocanāpadmasuvarṇavarṇaḥ | pralambabāhuḥ pṛthupīnavakṣā mahālalāṭo ghananīlakeśaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan bsil bas bad kan can bsil zhing / rus tshigs mi mngon snum zhing sha rus 'brel / bkres skom nyon mongs sdug bsngal than pa bzod / blo ldan snying stobs che zhing dam bca' brtan / pri yang ku dang dUr ba 'dam bu'i mdog / tshon dang gi'u wang pad+ma gser mdog can / lag ngar ring zhing drang ni yangs la rgyas / 'phral ba'i dbyes che skra ni mthug cing gnag

verses.skt: mṛdvaṅgaḥ samasuvibhaktacārudeho bahvojoratirasaśukraputrabhṛtyaḥ | dharmātmā vadati na niṣṭhuraṃ ca jātu pracchannaṃ vahati dṛḍhaṃ ciraṃ ca vairam
verses.tib: lus 'jam snyoms shing yan lag mdzes pa dang / mdangs che khu bcud bu tsha g.yog 'khor mang / chos ldan tshig rtsub nam yang smra mi byed / dgra la zhe sdang 'dam khon 'dzin byed

verses.skt: samadadviradendratulyayāto jaladāmbhodhimṛdaṅgasiṃhaghoṣaḥ | smṛtimān abhiyogavān vinīto na ca bālye ’py atirodano na lolaḥ
verses.tib: glang po'i mchog dregs bcas pa lta bur 'gro / rgya mtsho 'brug dang rdza rnga seng ge yi / sgra ldan dran dang brtson 'grus dul bar ldan / byis pa'i tshe na'ang ngu dang skom shas chung

verses.skt: tiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ kaṭukoṣṇarūkṣam alpaṃ sa bhuṅkte balavāṃs tathāpi | raktāntasusnigdhaviśāladīrgha suvyaktaśuklāsitapakṣmalākṣaḥ
verses.tib: zas ni kha bska cha dang dro zhing rtsub / nyung ngu zos kyang de ni stobs dang ldan / mig gi mtha' dmar snum zhing dkyus ring yangs / dkar nag rab gsal rdzi ma snyoms dang ldan

verses.skt: alpavyāhārakrodhapānāśanehaḥ prājyāyurvitto dīrghadarśī vadānyaḥ | śrāddho gambhīraḥ sthūlalakṣaḥ kṣamāvān āryo nidrālur dīrghasūtraḥ kṛtajñaḥ
verses.tib: smra dang khro dang bza' btung spyod pa nyung / tshe ring nor mang ring lta tshig 'jam smra / dad cing blo zab lta che bzod dang ldan / rang bzhin bzang zhing gnyid che las mtha' ring

verses.skt: ṛjur vipaścit subhagaḥ sulajjo bhakto gurūṇāṃ sthirasauhṛdaś ca | svapne sapadmān savihaṅgamālāṃs toyāśayān paśyati toyadāṃś ca
verses.tib: byas gzo drang mkhas skal bzang ngo tshar ldan / bla ma la gus mdza' bshes dag la brten / rmi lam pad+ma bya yi phreng bar bcas / chu yi gnas dang sprin yang mthong ba yin

verses.skt: brahmarudrendravaruṇatārkṣyahaṃsagajādhipaiḥ | śleṣmaprakṛtayas tulyās tathā siṃhāśvagovṛṣaiḥ
verses.tib: tshangs pa drag po dbang po chu lha dang / nam mkha' lding dang ngang pa glang po mchog / de bzhin seng ge dang ni khyu mchog dang / bad kan can ni rang bzhin 'drar shes bya

verses.skt: prakṛtīr dvayasarvotthā dvandvasarvaguṇodaye | śaucāstikyādibhiś caivaṃ guṇair guṇamayīr vadet
verses.tib: rang bzhin gnyis dang kun las byung / gnyis gnyis kun gyi yon tan bskyed / gtsang sbra yod par smra kyi / yon tan gyis ni de ldan bshad

verses.skt: vayas tv āṣoḍaśād bālaṃ tatra dhātvindriyaujasām | vṛddhir āsaptater madhyaṃ tatrāvṛddhiḥ paraṃ kṣayaḥ
verses.tib: na tshod bcu drug par byis pa / de las lus zungs dbang po gzi / 'phel / 'gyur bdun cu'i bar bar ma / zad pa phan chad rgan po yin

verses.skt: svaṃ svaṃ hastatrayaṃ sārdhaṃ vapuḥ pātraṃ sukhāyuṣoḥ | na ca yad yuktam udriktair aṣṭābhir ninditair nijaiḥ
verses.tib: rang rang khru ni phyed dang bzhi / lus ni tshe ring bde ba'i snod / spu med gnag dang shin tu sbom / ring po nyid ni mi mthun bcas / smad pa brgyad dang rang nyid ldan / gang yin de ni de snod min / skra ni rab tu 'jam pa dang / phra zhing rtsa ba ma 'dres brtan

verses.skt: aromaśāsitasthūladīrghatvaiḥ saviparyayaiḥ | susnigdhā mṛdavaḥ sūkṣmā naikamūlāḥ sthirāḥ kacāḥ
verses.tib: rang rang khru ni phyed dang bzhi / lus ni tshe ring bde ba'i snod / spu med gnag dang shin tu sbom / ring po nyid ni mi mthun bcas / smad pa brgyad dang rang nyid ldan / gang yin de ni de snod min / skra ni rab tu 'jam pa dang / phra zhing rtsa ba ma 'dres brtan

verses.skt: lalāṭam unnataṃ śliṣṭaśaṅkham ardhendusaṃnibham | karṇau nīconnatau paścān mahāntau śliṣṭamāṃsalau
verses.tib: dpral ba mtho zhing mur 'gram 'phyar / zla ba kham pa 'ang ba bzang / rna brgyab phyogs rgya che mdzes / rna shal che zhing sha yis rgyas

verses.skt: netre vyaktāsitasite subaddhaghanapakṣmaṇī | unnatāgrā mahocchvāsā pīnarjur nāsikā samā
verses.tib: mig ni dkar nag 'byes pa dang / rdzi ma stug cing snyoms pa bzang / sna yi rtse mo dbugs cher 'byung / sha rgyas drang zhing snyoms pa bzang

verses.skt: oṣṭhau raktāv anudvṛttau mahatyau nolbaṇe hanū | mahad āsyaṃ ghanā dantāḥ snigdhāḥ ślakṣṇāḥ sitāḥ samāḥ
verses.tib: mchu ni dmar zhing ma 'phyangs ba / 'gram pa yangs shing mi 'bur bzang / kha che so yi tshigs dam la / snum zhing dkar la 'jam zhing snyoms

verses.skt: jihvā raktāyatā tanvī māṃsalaṃ cibukaṃ mahat | grīvā hrasvā ghanā vṛttā skandhāv unnatapīvarau
verses.tib: lce ni dmar zhing yangs la srab / ko sko che zhing sha yis rgyas / mgrin pa thung zhing sha rgyas zlum / phrag pa mthong zhing sha yis rgyas

verses.skt: udaraṃ dakṣiṇāvartagūḍhanābhi samunnatam | tanuraktonnatanakhaṃ snigdhaṃ ātāmramāṃsalam
verses.tib: lto ba zlum zhing lte ba ni / zab cing mtho la g.yas su 'khyil / rkang pa lag pa legs gnas shing / sen mo 'jam zhing mtho la dmar / snum zhing kun dmar sha rgyas pa / sor mo ring zlum bu ga med / rgyab zhing che zhing sgal tshigs nub / tshigs mtshams mi mngon dam pa dang

verses.skt: dīrghācchidrāṅguli mahat pāṇipādaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | gūḍhavaṃśaṃ bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ nigūḍhāḥ saṃdhayo dṛḍhāḥ
verses.tib: lto ba zlum zhing lte ba ni / zab cing mtho la g.yas su 'khyil / rkang pa lag pa legs gnas shing / sen mo 'jam zhing mtho la dmar / snum zhing kun dmar sha rgyas pa / sor mo ring zlum bu ga med / rgyab zhing che zhing sgal tshigs nub / tshigs mtshams mi mngon dam pa dang

verses.skt: dhīraḥ svaro ’nunādī ca varṇaḥ snigdhaḥ sthiraprabhaḥ | svabhāvajaṃ sthiraṃ sattvam avikāri vipatsv api
verses.tib: tshigs gsang mtho zhing brtan pa dang / mdog snum kha dog brtan par gnas / rang bzhin gyis 'byung snying stobs brtan / phongs pa'i tshe na'ang zhum pa med

verses.skt: uttarottarasukṣetraṃ vapur garbhādinīrujam | āyāmajñānavijñānair vardhamānaṃ śanaiḥ śubham
verses.tib: mngal nas brtsams te nad med pa / gong nas gong du zhing bzang la / shes dang ye shes rgya cher ni / 'phel zhing rim gyis dge bar 'gyur

verses.skt: iti sarvaguṇopete śarīre śaradāṃ śatam | āyur aiśvaryam iṣṭāś ca sarve bhāvāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.tib: de ltar yon tan kun ldan pa'i / lus ni ston brgya'i bar dag tu / tshe dang dbang phyug 'dod pa yi / dngos po thams cad rab tu gnas

verses.skt: tvagraktādīni sattvāntāny agryāṇy aṣṭau yathottaram | balapramāṇajñānārthaṃ sārāṇy uktāni dehinām
verses.tib: bags pa khrag snying stobs par / brgyad po phyi ma bzhin du mchog / stobs dang tshad dang shes pa'i phyir / lus can rnams kyi snying por bshad

verses.skt: sārair upetaḥ sarvaiḥ syāt paraṃ gauravasaṃyutaḥ | sarvārambheṣu cāśāvān sahiṣṇuḥ sanmatiḥ sthiraḥ
verses.tib: snying po kun dang ldan pa yi / mchog tu bkur bar / bya bar 'gyur / rtsom pa kun la'ang re bcas dang / bzod ldan blo bzang brtan par 'gyur

verses.skt: anutsekaṃ adainyaṃ ca sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca sevate | sattvavāṃs tapyamānas tu rājaso naiva tāmasaḥ
verses.tib: dregs dang zhum pa med par ni / bde dang sdug bsngal bsten gyur ba / snying stobs can yin rdul can khengs / mun pa can ni de ltar min

verses.skt: dānaśīladayāsatyabrahmacaryakṛtajñatāḥ | rasāyanāni maitrī ca puṇyāyurvṛddhikṛd gaṇaḥ
verses.tib: sbyin dang tshul khrims snying brtse bden / tshangs par spyod dang byas pa gzo / byams ldan bcud kyis len bsten pa / tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i sde'o

verses.skt: saptottaraṃ marmaśataṃ teṣām ekādaśādiśet | pṛthak sakthnos tathā bāhvos trīṇi koṣṭhe navorasi
verses.tib: gnad ni brgya las bdun lhag pa / de las bcu gcig brla dang ni / de bzhin lag ngar gnyis so sor / lto ba la gsum brang la dgu

verses.skt: pṛṣṭhe caturdaśordhvaṃ tu jatros triṃśac ca sapta ca | madhye pādatalasyāhur abhito madhyamāṅgulīm
verses.tib: rgyab la bcu bzhi nam tshong ni / yan chad sum cu rtsa bdun yod / rkang pa'i mthil nas gung mo yi / thad ka na ni mthil 'phrog pa'i

verses.skt: talahṛn nāma rujayā tatra viddhasya pañcatā | aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimadhyasthaṃ kṣipraṃ ākṣepamāraṇam
verses.tib: de phug gnad kyis 'chi bar 'gyur / mtheb sor dbus na rgya tshigs te / de phug bskyod pa'i gnad kyis 'chi

verses.skt: tasyordhvaṃ dvyaṅgule kūrcaḥ pādabhramaṇakampakṛt | gulphasaṃdher adhaḥ kūrcaśiraḥ śopharujākaram
verses.tib: de gong sor gnyis shes par bya / rkang pa 'khar zhing 'dar bar byed / long mo'i tshigs 'og pir mgo ste / de bcad skrang dang nad skyed byed

verses.skt: jaṅghācaraṇayoḥ saṃdhau gulpho rukstambhamāndyakṛt | jaṅghāntare tv indravastir mārayaty asṛjaḥ kṣayāt
verses.tib: byin pa rkang pa gnyis kyi bar / long mo gnad rengs bem por byed / byin pa'i nang na nya zhes pa / khrag zad pa yis 'chi bar byed

verses.skt: jaṅghorvoḥ saṃgame jānu khañjatā tatra jīvataḥ | jānunas tryaṅgulād ūrdhvam āṇyūrustambhaśophakṛt
verses.tib: byin pa brla mtshams pus mo ste / de phug gson yang 'theng por 'gyur / pus gong sor gsum par gnyan gong / de phug brla rengs skrang bar byed

verses.skt: urvy ūrumadhye tadvedhāt sakthiśoṣo ’srasaṃkṣayāt | ūrumūle lohitākṣaṃ hanti pakṣam asṛkkṣayāt
verses.tib: brla nang brla dbang zhes bya ba / de phug khrag zags brla bskam 'gyur / brla rtsa mig dmar zhes bya ba / khrag zad pas ni gzhogs phyed 'joms

verses.skt: muṣkavaṅkṣaṇayor madhye viṭapaṃ ṣaṇḍhatākaram | iti sakthnos tathā bāhvor maṇibandho ’tra gulphavat
verses.tib: brla rtsa rlig pa'i bar gyi gnad / ljon shing zhes bya ma ning byed / de dag brla'i'o dpung de bzhin / mkhrig ma 'di ni long mor mtshungs / gru mo byin 'dra de gnyis phug

verses.skt: kūrparaṃ jānuvat kauṇyaṃ tayor viṭapavat punaḥ | kakṣākṣamadhye kakṣādhṛk kuṇitvaṃ tatra jāyate
verses.tib: zha bo ljon shing 'dra ba ni / mchan khung nang na mchan khung 'dzin / de phug zha bo nyid du 'gyur / long ka'i gnad ni gzhang zhes bya

verses.skt: sthūlāntrabaddhaḥ sadyoghno viḍvātavamano gudaḥ | mūtrāśayo dhanurvakro vastir alpāsramāṃsagaḥ
verses.tib: de phug gzhang rlung gis 'phral gsod / lgang ba gzhu ltar yo ba yi / chu so'i gnad ni sha khrag nyung

verses.skt: ekādhovadano madhye kaṭyāḥ sadyo nihanty asūn | ṛte ’śmarīvraṇād viddhas tatrāpy ubhayataś ca saḥ
verses.tib: dbus na kha cig thur du lta / rked pa'i dbus gnas srog 'phral 'joms / rde'u 'byin rma bug gnas ma gtogs / de yang ngos gnyis phug ste 'dra

verses.skt: mūtrasrāvy ekato bhinne vraṇo rohec ca yatnataḥ | dehāmapakvasthānānāṃ madhye sarvasirāśrayaḥ
verses.tib: gcin 'dzag gnas dang gcig tu phug / rma ni 'tsho bar shin tu dka' / lus kyi zhu dang ma zhu'i gnas / dbus na lte ba rtsa kun gyi

verses.skt: nābhiḥ so ’pi hi sadyoghno dvāram āmāśayasya ca | sattvādidhāma hṛdayaṃ stanoraḥkoṣṭhamadhyagam
verses.tib: rten yin de yang 'phral gsod byed / ma zhu ba yi gnas sgor gyur / 'dod chags gnas snying zhes bya / brang dang nu ma lto dbus gnas

verses.skt: stanarohitamūlākhye dvyaṅgule stanayor vadet | ūrdhvādho ’srakaphāpūrṇakoṣṭho naśyet tayoḥ kramāt
verses.tib: nu mjing nu ma'i rtsa zhes bya / steng 'og sor gnyis nu ma'i gnad / de phug bad kan khrag gis ni / rim bzhin lto 'gengs 'jig par byed

verses.skt: apastambhāv uraḥpārśve nāḍyāv anilavāhinī | raktena pūrṇakoṣṭho ’tra śvāsāt kāsāc ca naśyati
verses.tib: rengs bral brang gi ngos gnyis na / rtsa sbubs gnyis po rlung rgyu ba / de phug khong pa khrag gis gang / lud pa dbugs mi bde bas 'chi

verses.skt: pṛṣṭhavaṃśorasor madhye tayor eva ca pārśvayoḥ | adho ’ṃsakūṭayor vidyād apālāpākhyamarmaṇī
verses.tib: rgyab kyi sgal tshigs brang gi bar / de gnyis kyi ni ngos gnyis na / phrag pa gnyis kyi 'og na ni / mi gsal zhes bya'i gnad gnyis yod

verses.skt: tayoḥ koṣṭhe ’sṛjā pūrṇe naśyed yātena pūyatām | pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśasya śroṇikarṇau prati sthite
verses.tib: de gnyis phug pas khong pa ni / khrag khengs rnag ste 'chi bar 'gyur / sgal tshigs kyi ni ngos gnyis na / rked pa'i cha gnyis gnas pa dang

verses.skt: vaṃśāśrite sphijor ūrdhvaṃ kaṭīkataruṇe smṛte | tatra raktakṣayāt pāṇdur hīnarūpo vinaśyati
verses.tib: rkub tshos ltag gnas sgal tshigs brten / rked pa can dang gzhon nur bshad / de snad khrag zad skya rbab dang / gzugs nyams pas ni 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: pṛṣṭhavaṃśaṃ hy ubhayato yau saṃdhī kaṭipārśvayoḥ | jaghanasya bahirbhāge marmaṇī tau kukundarau
verses.tib: rgyab kyi sgal tshigs ngos gnyis kyi / rked pa'i mtshams ni gang yin pa / ro smad kyi ni rgyab phyogs na / khung bu zhes bya'i gnad gnyis yod

verses.skt: ceṣṭāhānir adhaḥkāye sparśājñānaṃ ca tadvyadhāt | pārśvāntaranibaddhau yāv upari śroṇikarṇayoḥ
verses.tib: de snad bskyod pa nyams pa dang / ro smad tshor ba med par 'gyur / gang zhig rtsib logs gnyis dang 'brel

verses.skt: āśayacchādanau tau tu nitambau taruṇāsthigau | adhaḥśarīre śopho ’tra daurbalyaṃ maraṇaṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: sta zur rtse mo gnyis steng gi / gnas ni g.yogs par gyur pa dang / ro smad gzhon nu'i rus par gnas / de snad ro smad skrangs pa dang / nyam chung 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: pārśvāntaranibaddhau ca madhye jaghanapārśvayoḥ | tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca nirdiṣṭau pārśvasaṃdhī tayor vyadhāt
verses.tib: rtsib logs gnyis kyi nang dang 'brel / rked pa'i ngos gnyis dbus na gnas / thad ka dang ni gyen gnas pa / rtsib logs mtshams te de phug na

verses.skt: raktapūritakoṣṭhasya śarīrāntarasaṃbhavaḥ | stanamūlārjave bhāge pṛṣṭhavaṃśāśraye sire
verses.tib: khong pa khrag gis gang ba dang / lus dang bral ba nyid du 'gyur / nu ma gnyis kyi thad ka'i cha / rgyab kyi sgal tshigs la brten pa

verses.skt: bṛhatyau tatra viddhasya maraṇaṃ raktasaṃkṣayāt | bāhumūlābhisaṃbaddhe pṛṣṭhavaṃśasya pārśvayoḥ
verses.tib: rtsa chen zhes bya de phug na / khrag zad nas ni 'chi bar 'gyur / dpung mgo gnyis dang 'brel pa yi / sgal tshigs kyi ni ngos gnyis

verses.skt: aṃsayoḥ phalake bāhusvāpaśoṣau tayor vyadhāt | grīvām ubhayataḥ snāvnī grīvābāhuśiro'ntare
verses.tib: phrag pa gnyis kyi sog pa ste / de snad bskams shing tshor bral 'gyur / mgrin pa gnyis kyi ngos gnyis rtsa / dpung mgo dang ni mgrin pa'i bar

verses.skt: skandhāṃsapīṭhasaṃbandhāv aṃsau bāhukriyāharau | kaṇṭhanālīm ubhayataḥ sirā hanusamāśritāḥ
verses.tib: brag pa brag pa la brten gnad / de phug lag ngar bya ba nyams / srol gong gi ni ngos gnyis na / 'gram pa la ni brten pa'i rtsa

verses.skt: catasras tāsu nīle dve manye dve marmaṇī smṛte | svarapraṇāśavaikṛtyaṃ rasājñānaṃ ca tadvyadhe
verses.tib: bzhi ste de la sngon po gnyis / gnyis pa'ang mjing pa'i gnad du bshad / de phug skad 'gags mi sdug dang / lce yis ro ni mi tshor 'gyur

verses.skt: kaṇṭhanālīm ubhayato jihvānāsāgatāḥ sirāḥ | pṛthak catasras tāḥ sadyo ghnanty asūn mātṛkāhvayāḥ
verses.tib: lkog ma'i sbubs kyi ngos gnyis nas / lce dang snar ni 'gro ba'i rtsa / so sor bzhi bzhi yod ma mo / de bcad 'phral du srog 'joms so

verses.skt: kṛkāṭike śirogrīvāsaṃdhau tatra calaṃ śiraḥ | adhastāt karṇayor nimne vidhure śrutihāriṇī
verses.tib: mgo bo ske mtshams ltag pa ste / de phug mgo bo ldem por 'gyur / rna ba gnyis 'og lcong ba na / rna rtsa zhes bya'o na bar 'gyur

verses.skt: phaṇāv ubhayato ghrāṇamārgaṃ śrotrapathānugau | antargalasthitau vedhād gandhavijñānahāriṇau
verses.tib: sna yi bu ga gnyis dang ni / sna yi lam 'gro mgrin nang gnas / sbrul mgo zhes bya de bcad na / dri mi tshor bar byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: netrayor bāhyato ’pāṅgau bhruvoḥ pucchāntayor adhaḥ | tathopari bhruvor nimnāv āvartāv āndhyam eṣu tu
verses.tib: mig gnyis kyi ni phyi rol mtshams / smin ma skyes pa'i mtha' yi 'og / mig zur smin steng dma' bar gnas / 'khyil pa phug pas long bar 'gyur

verses.skt: anukarṇaṃ lalāṭānte śaṅkhau sadyovināśanau | keśānte śaṅkhayor ūrdhvam utkṣepau sthapani punaḥ
verses.tib: rna mchan 'phral ba'i mtha' na ni / mur 'gram zhes bya dbral 'chi byed / mur 'gram gnyis steng skra mtshams na / gdeg pa zhes bya bzhag bya yang

verses.skt: bhruvor madhye traye ’py atra śalye jīved anuddhṛte | svayaṃ vā patite pākāt sadyo naśyati tūddhṛte
verses.tib: smin mtshams bar gnas gsum char la'ang / zug rngu dag ni ma phyung zhing / smin nas rang nyid byung na 'tsho / phyung na 'phral du 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: jihvākṣināsikāśrotrakhacatuṣṭayasaṃgame | tālūny āsyāni catvāri srotasāṃ teṣu marmasu
verses.tib: lce mig sna dang rna ba yi / bu ga bzhi ni 'dus pa dag / rkan dang sgo ru kha bzhi ste / bu ga'i gnad ni de rnams kyi

verses.skt: viddhaḥ śṛṅgāṭakākhyeṣu sadyas tyajati jīvitam | kapāle saṃdhayaḥ pañca sīmantās tiryagūrdhvagāḥ
verses.tib: gnad ni sum / mdo ris zhes bya / de bcad srog ni 'phral du 'dor / thod pa yi ni mtshams lnga po / thad ka gyen 'gro mtshams kyi mtha'

verses.skt: bhramonmādamanonāśais teṣu viddheṣu naśyati | āntaro mastakasyordhvaṃ sirāsaṃdhisamāgamaḥ
verses.tib: de snad pas ni mgo 'khor dang / smyo zhing dran pa nyams te 'chi / spyi bo'i steng na gtsug 'khyil pa'i / rtsa dang ldan sbubs 'dus pa na

verses.skt: romāvarto ’dhipo nāma marma sadyo haraty asūn | viṣamaṃ spandanaṃ yatra pīḍite ruk ca marma tat
verses.tib: spu 'khyil bdag po zhes bya ba'i / gnad kyis srog ni 'jig par byed / gang du mnan na shin tu 'gul / rab na de gnad yin zhes bya

verses.skt: māṃsāsthisnāyudhamanīsirāsaṃdhisamāgamaḥ | syān marmeti ca tenātra sutarāṃ jīvitaṃ sthitam
verses.tib: sha rgyus rus pa rtsa chen dang / rtsa dang tshigs ni 'dus pa ru / gnad ces bya ste des na der / srog ni lhag par gnas pa yin

verses.skt: bāhulyena tu nirdeśaḥ ṣoḍhaivaṃ marmakalpanā | prāṇāyatanasāmānyād aikyaṃ vā marmaṇāṃ matam
verses.tib: mang du rnam par bstan mod kyi / gnad ni rnam pa drug tu bstan / srog gi gnas su thun mong bas / gnad ni gcig tu'ang gnas pa yin

verses.skt: māṃsajāni daśendrākhyatalahṛtstanarohitāḥ | śaṅkhau kaṭīkataruṇe nitambāv aṃsayoḥ phale
verses.tib: shar gtogs bcu ste byin lag nywa / mthil 'phrog nu mjing nu rtsa'o

verses.skt: asthny aṣṭau snāvamarmāṇi trayoviṃśatir āṇayaḥ | kūrcakūrcaśiro'pāṅgakṣiprotkṣepāṃsavastayaḥ
verses.tib: rus pa'i gnad brgyad mur 'gram dang / rked pa can dang gzhon nu dang / ro smad dang ni sog pa'o / rgyus pa'i gnad ni nyi shu gsum / gnyan gong zhes bya pir dang ni

verses.skt: gudāpastambhavidhuraśṛṅgāṭāni navādiśet | marmāṇi dhamanīsthāni saptatriṃśat sirāśrayāḥ
verses.tib: pir mgo mig zur rgya tshigs dang / phrag pa gzhag dang chu so yi / rtsa chen gnad ni rnam dgu ste / gzhang dang rengs bral rna rtsa dang / sum mdo ris zhes bshad pa'o / rtsa la gnas gnad sum cu bdun

verses.skt: bṛhatyau mātṛkā nīle manye kakṣādharau phaṇau | viṭape hṛdayaṃ nābhiḥ pārśvasaṃdhī stanādhare
verses.tib: rtsa chen gnyis dang ma mo sngo / 'gram pa mchan khung 'dzin sprul mgo / ljon shing snying dang lte ba dang / rtsib logs mtshams dang nu ma'i 'og

verses.skt: apālāpau sthapany urvyaś catasro lohitāni ca | saṃdhau viṃśatir āvartau maṇibandhau kukundarau
verses.tib: mi gsal gzhag dang brla dbang dang / dmar po zhes bya bzhi po'o / tshigs la nyi shu 'khyil pa dang

verses.skt: sīmantāḥ kūrparau gulphau kṛkāṭyau jānunī patiḥ | māṃsamarma gudo ’nyeṣāṃ snāvni kakṣādharau tathā
verses.tib: mkhrig ma gnyis dang khung bu dang / mtshams mtha' gru mo long mo dang / ltag pa pus mo bdag po'o / gzhan dag gzhang sha'i gnad ces zer

verses.skt: viṭapau vidhurākhye ca śṛṅgāṭāni sirāsu tu | apastambhāv apāṅgau ca dhamanīsthaṃ na taiḥ smṛtam
verses.tib: mchan khung 'dzin dang ljon shing ni / rgyus pa la brten rna rtsa dang / sum mdor si dang rengs bral dang / mig 'gram rtsa yi gnad yin gyi / rtsa chen gnas par de ma bshad

verses.skt: viddhe ’jasram asṛksrāvo māṃsadhāvanavat tanuḥ | pāṇḍutvam indriyājñānaṃ maraṇam cāśu māṃsaje
verses.tib: sha yi gnad bcad khrag rgyun 'dzag / sha bkrus 'drar 'gyur sla ba dang / skya zhing dbang po nyams pa dang / myur du 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: majjānvito ’ccho vicchinnaḥ srāvo ruk cāsthimarmaṇi | āyāmākṣepakastambhāḥ snāvaje ’bhyadhikaṃ rujā
verses.tib: rus / gnas gnad bcad rkang bcas na / sla dang bar bar chad cing 'dzag / rgyus pa'i gnad bcad na zhing 'khrug / brkyang bskum mi shes gnod par 'gyur

verses.skt: yānasthānāsanāśaktir vaikalyam atha vāntakaḥ | raktaṃ saśabdaphenoṣṇaṃ dhamanīsthe vicetasaḥ
verses.tib: 'gro dang stan gnas nus pa chung / dbang po nyams pa'am 'chi bar 'gyur / rtsa chen gnad bcad lbu ba dang / sgra bcas 'byung zhing dran nyams 'gyur

verses.skt: sirāmarmavyadhe sāndram ajasraṃ bahv asṛk sravet | tatkṣayāt tṛḍbhramaśvāsamohahidhmābhir antakaḥ
verses.tib: rtsa yi gnad bcad khrag ska zhing / rgyun mi 'chad par mang du 'byung / de zad mgo 'khor dbugs mi bde / skom rmongs skyigs bus 'debs bas 'chi

verses.skt: vastu śūkair ivākīrṇaṃ rūḍhe ca kuṇikhañjatā | balaceṣṭākṣayaḥ śoṣaḥ parvaśophaś ca saṃdhije
verses.tib: lus ni gra ma lta bus khyab / 'tshob kyang sgur po'am 'theng por 'gyur / tshigs gnad stobs dang spyod pa nyams / lus skem tshigs ni skrang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: nābhiśaṅkhādhipāpānahṛcchṛṅgāṭakavastayaḥ | aṣṭau ca mātṛkāḥ sadyo nighnanty ekānnaviṃśatiḥ
verses.tib: lte ba mur 'gram bdag po gzhang / snying dang chu so sum mdo ris / ma mo brgyad dang bcu dgu po / 'phral du srog ni gcod par byed

verses.skt: saptāhaḥ paramas teṣāṃ kālaḥ kālasya karṣaṇe | trayastriṃśadapastambhatalahṛtpārśvasaṃdhayaḥ
verses.tib: zhag bdun gyis ni nges par 'chi / rengs bral mthil 'phrog rtsib logs mtshams

verses.skt: kaṭītaruṇasīmantastanamūlendravastayaḥ | kṣiprāpālāpabṛhatīnitambastanarohitāḥ
verses.tib: rked pa can gzhon mtshams kyi mtha' / nu rtsa dbang po chu so'i gnad / rgyab tshigs mi gsal rtsa chen dang / ro smad nu mjing sum cu gsum

verses.skt: kālāntaraprāṇaharā māsamāsārdhajīvitāḥ | utkṣepau sthapanī trīṇi viśalyaghnāni tatra hi
verses.tib: zla ba'am zla phyed son nas ni / dus gzhan du ni 'chi bar byed / brdeg dang gzhag pa zhes bya gsum / der ni zug rngu byung gyur na

verses.skt: vāyur māṃsavasāmajjamastuluṅgāni śoṣayet | śalyāpāye vinirgacchan śvāsāt kāsāc ca hanty asūn
verses.tib: rlung gis sha dang tshil dang rkang / glad rgyas rnams ni skems par byed / mtshon phyung lud pa dbugs mi bde / 'byung zhing srog ni 'joms par 'gyur

verses.skt: phaṇāv apāṅgau vidhure nīle manye kṛkāṭike | aṃsāṃsaphalakāvartaviṭaporvīkukundarāḥ
verses.tib: sbrul mgo mig zur rna rtsa dang / sngon po 'gram gnas ltag pa'i gnad / phrag pa'am phrag 'khyil pa dang / ljon shing brla dbang khung bu dang

verses.skt: sajānulohitākṣāṇikakṣādhṛkkūrcakūrparāḥ | vaikalyam iti catvāri catvāriṃśac ca kurvate
verses.tib: mig dmar pus mo'i gnad dang bcas / mtshan 'dzin pir 'dra gru mo'i gnad / de ltar gnad ni bzhi bcu bzhis

verses.skt: haranti tāny api prāṇān kadācid abhighātataḥ | aṣṭau kūrcaśirogulphamaṇibandhā rujākarāḥ
verses.tib: rkang lag 'jas par byed 'gyur ba'am / gal te tshabs cher snad gyur na / des ni srog kyang 'joms par byed / pir mgo 'dra dang long mo dang / mkhrig ma'i gnad brgyad nad tshabs skyed

verses.skt: teṣāṃ viṭapakakṣādhṛgurvyaḥ kūrcaśirāṃsi ca | dvādaśāṅgulamānāni dvyaṅgule maṇibandhane
verses.tib: de las ljon shing mchan khung 'dzin / brla dang pir mgo lta bu ste / bcu gnyis sor gcig tshad yin no / mkhrig ma dang ni long mo dang / nu ma'i rtsa ba sor gnyis tshad

verses.skt: gulphau ca stanamūle ca tryaṅgulaṃ jānukūrparam | apānavastihṛnnābhinīlāḥ sīmantamātṛkāḥ
verses.tib: pus mo gru mo sor gsum tshad / gzhang dang chu so lte ba snying / sngon po mtshams mtha' ma mo dang

verses.skt: kūrcaśṛṅgāṭamanyāś ca triṃśad ekena varjitāḥ | ātmapāṇitalonmānāḥ śeṣāṇy ardhāṅgulaṃ vadet
verses.tib: pir 'dra sum mdo ris 'gram pa / gnad ni nyi shu dgu yi tshad / rang gi lag mthil tshad yin no

verses.skt: pañcāśat ṣaṭ ca marmāṇi tilavrīhisamāny api | iṣṭāni marmāṇy anyeṣāṃ caturdhoktāḥ sirās tu yāḥ
verses.tib: lhag ma gnad ni lnga bcu drug / sor phyed kyi ni tshad du 'dod / gzhan dag gnad de til 'bru ste / 'bras tsam gyi ni tshad du 'dod / rtsa bzhir bshad pa gang yin pa

verses.skt: tarpayanti vapuḥ kṛtsnaṃ tā marmāṇy āśritās tataḥ | tatkṣatāt kṣatajātyarthapravṛtter dhātusaṃkṣaye
verses.tib: lus kun brtas par byed pa rnams / de ni gnad la gnas pa yin / des na de phug khrag drag 'byung / lus zungs rnams ni zad pa'i phyir

verses.skt: vṛddhaś calo rujas tīvrāḥ pratanoti samīrayan | tejas tad uddhṛtaṃ dhatte tṛṣṇāśoṣamadabhramān
verses.tib: rlung 'phel nad ni mi bzang 'debs / rlung gis mkhris pa rgyas par byed / mkhris pa rgyas par gyur pas na / skom dang mgo 'khor skam dang myos

verses.skt: svinnasrastaślathatanuṃ haraty enaṃ tato ’ntakaḥ | vardhayet saṃdhito gātraṃ marmaṇy abhihate drutam
verses.tib: lus rngul tshigs dbye lus lhod dang / de ni gshin rje'i dbang du 'gro / gnad gcod na ni myur ba ru / lus kyi tshigs ni chod 'gyur te

verses.skt: chedanāt saṃdhideśasya saṃkucanti sirā hy ataḥ | jīvitaṃ prāṇināṃ tatra rakte tiṣṭhati tiṣṭhati
verses.tib: tshigs kyi phyogs su bcad pas na / rtsa ni 'khums par byed pa yin / de la srog chags rnams kyi srog / khrag gnas na ni gnas pa yin

verses.skt: suvikṣato ’py ato jīved amarmaṇi na marmaṇi | prāṇaghātini jīvet tu kaścid vaidyaguṇena cet
verses.tib: de bas gnad min legs phog na / nges par 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro / 'ga' zhig sman pa'i yon tan dang

verses.skt: asamagrābhighātāc ca so ’pi vaikalyam aśnute | tasmāt kṣāraviṣāgnyādīn yatnān marmasu varjayet
verses.tib: phyogs gcig tu ni phog pa yis / 'tsho bar gyur kyang de yi ni / dbang po mtshang nyid du 'gyur / de bas 'bad de gnad du ni / thal sman me btsa' la sogs spang

verses.skt: marmābhighātaḥ svalpo ’pi prāyaśo bādhatetarām | rogā marmāśrayās tadvat prakrāntā yatnato ’pi ca
verses.tib: gnad du phog na chung dus kyang / phal cher shin tu gnod pa yin / de bzhin gnad la brten pa'i nad / rab tu 'bad pas gso bar bya

verses.skt: puṣpaṃ phalasya dhūmo ’gner varṣasya jaladodayaḥ | yathā bhaviṣyato liṅgaṃ riṣṭaṃ mṛtyos tathā dhruvam
verses.tib: ji ltar 'bras bu me tog dang / me yi du ba char gyi sprin / phyis 'byung mtshan ma yin pa ltar / de bzhin 'chi ltas las nges 'chi

verses.skt: āyuṣmati kriyāḥ sarvāḥ saphalāḥ saṃprayojitāḥ | bhavanti bhiṣajāṃ bhūtyai kṛtajña iva bhūbhuji
kṣīṇāyuṣi kṛtaṃ karma vyarthaṃ kṛtam ivādhame | ayaśo dehasaṃdehaṃ svārthahāniṃ ca yacchati
tarhīdānīṃ gatāsūnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpracakṣate | vikṛtiḥ prakṛteḥ prājñaiḥ pradiṣṭā riṣṭasaṃjñayā
ariṣṭaṃ nāsti maraṇaṃ dṛṣṭariṣṭaṃ ca jīvitam | ariṣṭe riṣṭavijñānaṃ na ca riṣṭe ’py anaipuṇāt
verses.tib: 'chi ltas med na mi 'chil / 'chi ltas snang na / 'tsho mi 'gyur / 'chi ltas 'chi ltas mi shes pa / mi mkhas 'chi ltas med min shes

verses.skt: kecit tu tad dvidhety āhuḥ sthāyyasthāyivibhedataḥ | doṣāṇām api bāhulyād riṣṭābhāsaḥ samudbhavet
verses.tib: la la rten dang brten pa po'i / khyad par gyis de gnyis su 'dod / nad kyi tshul ni mang po las / 'chi ltas tshul du 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: sa doṣāṇāṃ śame śāmyet sthāyy avaśyaṃ tu mṛtyave | rūpendriyasvaracchāyāpraticchāyākriyādiṣu
verses.tib: nad zhin ni zhi 'gyur la / brtan par gnas na 'chi bar 'gyur / gzugs dang dbang po skad dang mdog / gzugs brnyan bya ba sogs pa dang

verses.skt: anyeṣv api ca bhāveṣu prākṛteṣv animittataḥ | vikṛtir yā samāsena riṣṭaṃ tad iti lakṣayet
verses.tib: dngos po dag ni gzhan la yang / tha mal pa las rgyu med par / gzhan du gyur gang mdor gang ni / 'chi ltas yin par de shes bya

verses.skt: keśaromanirabhyaṅgaṃ yasyābhyaktam ivekṣyate | yasyātyarthaṃ cale netre stabdhāntargatanirgate
verses.tib: skra dang ba spu ma bskus par / snum gyis bskus ltar gang snang dang / gang zhig mig ni rab g.yo dang / mi 'gyur phyir 'byung khung bur zhugs

verses.skt: jihme vistṛtasaṃkṣipte saṃkṣiptavinatabhruṇī | udbhrāntadarśane hīnadarśane nakulopame
verses.tib: yo dang bgrad dang 'jums pa dang / bcum zhing smin ma smad pa dang / 'khrul dang mthong ba nyams pa dang

verses.skt: kapotābhe alātābhe srute lulitapakṣmaṇī | nāsikātyarthavivṛtā saṃvṛtā piṭikācitā
verses.tib: sre mo'i mig ltar lta ba dang / thi ba 'dra dang mgal me 'dra / mchi ma 'dzag cing rdzi ma 'khrugs / sna ni shin tu gdangs pa dang

verses.skt: ucchūnā sphuṭitā mlānā yasyauṣṭho yāty adho ’dharaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ dvitīyaḥ syātāṃ vā pakvajambūnibhāv ubhau
verses.tib: zhom dang 'brum phran gyis khyab dang / skrang dang gos dang rnyid pa dang / gang gi ma mchu 'phyangs pa dang / yam chu gyen la brdzes pa dang / gnyi ga 'dzam bu smin 'drar snang

verses.skt: dantāḥ saśarkarāḥ śyāvās tāmrāḥ puṣpitapaṅkitāḥ | sahasaiva pateyur vā jihvā jihmā visarpiṇī
verses.tib: so gnag gseg mar bcas pa dang / dmar zhing so zho nag nog can / glo bur du ni 'byung ba dang / lce ni yo dang rtag tu 'byin

verses.skt: śūnā śuṣkā guruḥ śyāvā liptā suptā sakaṇṭakā | śiraḥ śirodharā voḍhuṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ vā bhāram ātmanaḥ
verses.tib: skrang dang skam dang lci dang gnag / gos dang rtsub dang tshor ba med / mjing pas mgo ni mi thig dang / rang gi ltag rgyab khur ltar lci

verses.skt: hanū vā piṇḍam āsyasthaṃ śaknuvanti na yasya ca | yasyānimittam aṅgāni gurūṇy atilaghūni vā
verses.tib: 'gram pas khan gnas pa yi / kha zas bldad par mi nus pa / gang zhig rgyu med par yan lag / shin tu lci ba'am shin tu yang

verses.skt: viṣadoṣād vinā yasya khebhyo raktaṃ pravartate | utsiktaṃ mehanaṃ yasya vṛṣaṇāv atiniḥsṛtau
verses.tib: dug dang snad pa med par ni / bu ga rnams las khrag 'byung dang / gang zhig pho mtshan nub pa dang

verses.skt: ato ’nyathā vā yasya syāt sarve te kālacoditāḥ | yasyāpūrvāḥ sirālekhā bālendvākṛtayo ’pi vā
verses.tib: rlig pa rab tu 'phyangs pa'am / de las go log gyur ba rnams / thams cad 'chi bdag dbang gyur yin / gang gi rtsa ris sngon med par

verses.skt: lalāṭe vastiśīrṣe vā ṣaṇ māsān na sa jīvati | padminīpattravat toyaṃ śarīre yasya dehinaḥ
verses.tib: zla ba tshes pa lta bu ni / 'phral ba'am chu so'i steng na gnas / de ni zla drug las mi 'tsho / lus can

verses.skt: plavate plavamānasya ṣaṇ māsās tasya jīvitam | haritābhāḥ sirā yasya romakūpāś ca saṃvṛtāḥ
verses.tib: gang gi lus la chu / pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bur ni / rgyal tshe chu ni mi chags pa / de ni zla ba drug na 'chi

verses.skt: so ’mlābhilāṣī puruṣaḥ pittān maraṇam aśnute | yasya gomayacūrṇābhaṃ cūrṇaṃ mūrdhni mukhe ’pi vā
sasnehaṃ mūrdhni dhūmo vā māsāntaṃ tasya jīvitam | mūrdhni bhruvor vā kurvanti sīmantāvartakā navāḥ
verses.tib: spyi bo du ba'am snum bcas snang / de ni zla ba gcig na 'chi / spyi bo'am smin mtshams gsar du ni / mtshams bye ba'am gtsug 'khyil snang

verses.skt: mṛtyuṃ svasthasya ṣaḍrātrāt trirātrād āturasya tu | jihvā śyāvā mukhaṃ pūti savyam akṣi nimajjati
verses.tib: nad med zhag ni drug gis 'chi / nad pa zhag gsum na 'chi 'gyur / lce gnag kha ni mnam pa dang / mig g.yas phugs su bros ba'am

verses.skt: khagā vā mūrdhni līyante yasya taṃ parivarjayet | yasya snātānuliptasya pūrvaṃ śuṣyaty uro bhṛśam
verses.tib: bya ni mgo la babs pa dag / gang yin de ni yongs su spang / gang zhig khrus byas byugs pa dang / lus kun gsher bar gnas bzhin du / snying ga shin tu myur bar bskams

verses.skt: ārdreṣu sarvagātreṣu so ’rdhamāsaṃ na jīvati | akasmād yugapad gātre varṇau prākṛtavaikṛtau
verses.tib: de ni zla phyed las mi 'tsho / glo bur du ni lus kun mdog / cig car tha mal pa las nyams

verses.skt: tathaivopacayaglāniraukṣyasnehādi mṛtyave | yasya sphuṭeyur aṅgulyo nākṛṣṭā na sa jīvati
verses.tib: de bzhin nad ni sogs pa dang / rtsub dang snum 'gyur 'chi ba yin / gong gi sor mo drangs pa dang / sgra mi 'byung ba de mi 'tsho

verses.skt: kṣavakāsādiṣu tathā yasyāpūrvo dhvanir bhavet | hrasvo dīrgho ’ti vocchvāsaḥ pūtiḥ surabhir eva vā
verses.tib: de bzhin lud pa sbrid la / gang zhig sngon med sgra byung ba'am / dbugs 'byin thung ba'am ring ba'am / dri mnam pa'am dri zhim 'gyur

verses.skt: āplutānāplute kāye yasya gandho ’timānuṣaḥ | malavastravraṇādau vā varṣāntaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.tib: lus ni khrus byas ma byas rung / mi ma yin pa'i dri 'byung ba'am / gos rma dri ma byung na yang / de ni lo gcig nas 'chi 'gyur

verses.skt: bhajante ’tyaṅgasaurasyād yaṃ yūkāmakṣikādayaḥ | tyajanti vātivairasyāt so ’pi varṣaṃ na jīvati
verses.tib: gang zhig shig dang sbrang ma / dri zhim pas ni 'du ba'am / dri nga bas ni spong 'gyur na / de ni lo gcig las mi 'tsho

verses.skt: satatoṣmasu gātreṣu śaityaṃ yasyopalakṣyate | śīteṣu bhṛśam auṣṇyaṃ vā svedaḥ stambho ’py ahetukaḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig rtag tu lus tshal / grang ba nyid du snang ba dang / bsil ba shin tu tsha bar snang / rgyu med par ni rngul dang rengs

verses.skt: yo jātaśītapiṭikaḥ śītāṅgo vā vidahyate | uṣṇadveṣī ca śitārtaḥ sa pretādhipagocaraḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig grang ba'i chu bur 'byung / lus grang ba las tsha ba skyes / grang gdungs than pa la mi dga' / de ni gshin rjes dbang 'gyur yin

verses.skt: urasy ūṣmā bhaved yasya jaṭhare cātiśītatā | bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ
verses.tib: gang gi snying ga dro gyur la / lto ba shin tu grang gyur cing / bshang ba 'khru zhing skom dad che / de ni ro dang 'dra ba yin

verses.skt: mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ niṣṭhyūtaṃ śukraṃ vāpsu nimajjati | niṣṭhyūtaṃ bahuvarṇaṃ vā yasya māsāt sa naśyati
verses.tib: bshang dang gci ba mchil snabs sam / kha chu chu nang nub gyur pa'am / mchil ma kha dog sna tshogs pa / gang yin pa de zla gcig 'chi

verses.skt: ghanībhūtam ivākāśam ākāśam iva yo ghanam | amūrtam iva mūrtaṃ ca mūrtaṃ cāmūrtavat sthitam
verses.tib: sa ni nam mkhar mthong ba dang / nam mkha' sar ni mthong gyur dang / gzugs med gzugs can lta bu dang / gzugs can gzugs med ltar gnas mthong

verses.skt: tejasvy atejas tadvac ca śuklaṃ kṛṣṇam asac ca sat | anetrarogaś candraṃ ca bahurūpam alāñchanam
verses.tib: de bzhin 'od can 'od med mthong / dkar po gnag dang pa med / mig nad med par zla ba ni / gzugs mngar ri med mthong dang

verses.skt: jāgrad rakṣāṃsi gandharvān pretān anyāṃś ca tadvidhān | rūpaṃ vyākṛti tat tac ca yaḥ paśyati sa naśyati
verses.tib: gnyid ma log par dri za srin / yi dwags gzhan yang de 'dra ba'i / gzugs mi sdug pa mthong 'gyur ba / gang yin de ni 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: saptarṣīṇāṃ samīpasthāṃ yo na paśyaty arundhatīm | dhruvam ākāśagaṅgāṃ vā sa na paśyati tāṃ samām
verses.tib: sme bdun dang ni nyer gnas pa'i / skar ma sgrib med ma mthong dang / dgu tshigs gung tshugs ma mthong ba / de ni lo gcig mi 'tsho'o

verses.skt: meghatoyaughanirghoṣavīṇāpaṇavaveṇujān | śṛṇoty anyāṃś ca yaḥ śabdān asato na sato ’pi vā
verses.tib: 'brug sgra chu bo'i sgra dang ni / gling bu pi wang rnga yi sgra / sgra gzhan med kyang thos pa'am / yod pa thos par ma gyur dang

verses.skt: niṣpīḍya karṇau śṛṇuyān na yo dhukadhukāsvanam | tadvad gandharasasparśān manyate yo viparyayāt
verses.tib: rna ba'i bu ga bkab pa yis / 'ur 'ur po yi sgra mi thos / de bzhin dri dang ro dang reg / gang zhig log par shes pa dang

verses.skt: sarvaśo vā na yo yaś ca dīpagandhaṃ na jighrati | vidhinā yasya doṣāya svāsthyāyāvidhinā rasāḥ
verses.tib: yang na yong ye mi tshor dang / me mar shi ba'i dri mi tshor / cho ga bzhin byas nad skyed la / cho ga log pas bde gnas dang

verses.skt: yaḥ pāṃsuneva kīrṇāṅgo yo ’ṅge ghātaṃ na vetti vā | antareṇa tapas tīvraṃ yogaṃ vā vidhipūrvakam
verses.tib: gang gi lus ni rdul g.yogs 'dra / lus la snad ba mi chor dang / dka' thub drag dang cho ga ni / sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor med pa ru

verses.skt: jānāty atīndriyaṃ yaś ca teṣāṃ maraṇam ādiśet | hīno dīnaḥ svaro ’vyakto yasya syād gadgado ’pi vā
verses.tib: dbang po las 'das shes pa skyed / de rnams 'chi bar shes par bya / skad 'gags dman zhing mi gsal dang / gang zhig skad ni 'dzer gyur dang

verses.skt: sahasā yo vimuhyed vā vivakṣur na sa jīvati | svarasya durbalībhāvaṃ hāniṃ ca balavarṇayoḥ
verses.tib: smra 'dod pa ni 'phral du ni / brjed 'gyur de ni mi 'tsho'o / skad gsang shin tu nyam chung 'gyur / mdog dang stobs ni nyams pa dang

verses.skt: rogavṛddhim ayuktyā ca dṛṣṭvā maraṇam ādiśet | apasvaraṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ prāptaṃ maraṇam ātmanaḥ
verses.tib: rgyu med par ni nad 'phel bar / snang ba dag kyang 'chi bar bshad / skad gdangs nyams par gyur pa dang / bdag nyid 'chi bar smra ba dang

verses.skt: śrotāraṃ cāsya śabdasya dūrataḥ parivarjayet | saṃsthānena pramāṇena varṇena prabhayāpi vā
verses.tib: de 'dra'i sgra ni thos pa dag / ring du yongs su spang bar bya / lus dbyibs dang ni tshad dang ni / mdog gam gzi mdangs gang dag gis

verses.skt: chāyā vivartate yasya svapne ’pi preta eva saḥ | ātapādarśatoyādau yā saṃsthānapramāṇataḥ
verses.tib: gzugs brnyan 'gyur ba rmi lam du / mthong na'ang de ni 'chi bar 'gyur / nyi ma me long chu la / gang zhig dbyibs dang tshad dang ni

verses.skt: chāyāṅgāt saṃbhavaty uktā praticchāyeti sā punaḥ | varṇaprabhāśrayā yā tu sā chāyaiva śarīragā
verses.tib: lus kyi rnam pa snang gyur pa / gzugs brnyan zhes ni de la bshad / mdog dang gzi mdangs la brten gang / lus gtogs gzugs brnyan lta bu yin

verses.skt: bhaved yasya praticchāyā chinnā bhinnādhikākulā | viśirā dviśirā jihmā vikṛtā yadi vānyathā
verses.tib: gang / gi gzugs brnyan bcad pa dang / gyes dang lhag dang 'khrugs pa dang / mgo med mgo gnyis yon po dang / mi sdug gzhan du gyur par snang

verses.skt: taṃ samāptāyuṣaṃ vidyān na cel lakṣyanimittajā | praticchāyāmayī yasya na cākṣṇīkṣyeta kanyakā
verses.tib: mtshan nyid las byung ma yin na / de ni tshe zad yin zhes bya / gang gi mig gi rgyal mor ni / gzugs brnyan snang bar ma gyur dang

verses.skt: khādīnāṃ pañca pañcānāṃ chāyā vividhalakṣaṇāḥ | nābhasī nirmalānīlā sasnehā saprabheva ca
verses.tib: nam mkha' la lnga po yi / gzugs brnyan rnam pa sna tshogs lnga / nam mkha' dngas shing sngo ba dang / snum bcas mdog dang bcas pa yin

verses.skt: vātād rajo'ruṇā śyāvā bhasmarūkṣā hataprabhā | viśuddharaktā tv āgneyī dīptābhā darśanapriyā
verses.tib: rlung las rdul can dmar dang gnag / thal mdog rtsub cing mdog nyams yin / me yi dmar zhing dang bar snang / mdangs ldan / blta na sdug pa yin

verses.skt: śuddhavaiḍūryavimalā susnigdhā toyajā sukhā | sthirā snigdhā ghanā śuddhā śyāmā śvetā ca pārthivī
verses.tib: chu skyes baiDUr+ya 'drar snang / dag cing rab snum bde ba yin / sa yi brtan snum dag pa dang / mthug cing dkar dang sngo bsangs yin

verses.skt: vāyavī rogamaraṇakleśāyānyāḥ sukhodayāḥ | prabhoktā taijasī sarvā sā tu saptavidhā smṛtā
verses.tib: rlung ni 'chi sdug bsngal skyed / gzhan dag bde ba skyed pa yin / me yis thams cad mdog can te / de ni rnam pa bdun du bshad

verses.skt: raktā pītā sitā śyāvā haritā pāṇḍurāsitā | tāsāṃ yāḥ syur vikāsinyaḥ snigdhāś ca vimalāś ca yāḥ
verses.tib: dmar dang ser dang dkar nag po / ljang dang skya dang nag po'o / de rnams la ni gang gsal 'gyur / snum dang dri ma med de dag

verses.skt: tāḥ śubhā malinā rūkṣāḥ saṃkṣiptāś cāśubhodayāḥ | varṇam ākrāmati cchāyā prabhā varṇaprakāśinī
verses.tib: dri ma can dang rtsub pa dang / zhum pa sdug bsngal skyed pa yin / mdangs kyis mdog ni zil gyis gnon / 'od ni kha dog gsal byed yin

verses.skt: āsanne lakṣyate chāyā vikṛṣṭe bhā prakāśate | nācchāyo nāprabhaḥ kaścid viśeṣāś cihnayanti tu
verses.tib: mdangs kyis nye bar snang ba yin / 'di ni ring nas snang ba yin / 'ga' zhig mdangs dang kha dog gi / mtshan ma'i khyad par med min te

verses.skt: nṛṇāṃ śubhāśubhotpattiṃ kāle chāyāsamāśrayāḥ | nikaṣann iva yaḥ pādau cyutāṃsaḥ parisarpati
verses.tib: mi rnams mtshan ma bzang ngan 'byung / dus su mdangs la brtan pa yin / gang zhig rkang pa 'drud pa dang / phrag pa yo bas 'gro ba dang

verses.skt: hīyate balataḥ śaśvad yo ’nnam aśnan hitaṃ bahu | yo ’lpāśī bahuviṇmūtro bahvāśī cālpamūtraviṭ
verses.tib: gang zhig phan zas mang zos kyang / rtag tu stobs ni nyams 'gyur na / gang zhig nyung zos bshang gci mang / mang zos bshang gci nyung ba dang

verses.skt: yo vālpāśī kaphenārto dīrghaṃ śvasiti ceṣṭate | dīrgham ucchvasya yo hrasvaṃ niḥśvasya paritāmyati
verses.tib: nyung zos bad kan gyis nyen zhing / dbugs 'byin zhing sa la 'gre / gang zhig dbugs phyung nas ni / thung du rngubs te shugs 'byin dang

verses.skt: hrasvaṃ ca yaḥ praśvasiti vyāviddhaṃ spandate bhṛśam | śiro vikṣipate kṛcchrād yo ’ñcayitvā prapāṇikau
verses.tib: thung du dbugs 'byin bsnun pa ltar / shin tu 'dar bar byed pa yang / gang zhig lag ngar bskums nas ni / mgo bo dka' bas 'debs pa dang

verses.skt: yo lalāṭāt srutasvedaḥ ślathasaṃdhānabandhanaḥ | utthāpyamānaḥ saṃmuhyed yo balī durbalo ’pi vā
verses.tib: gang zhig 'phral ba las rdul 'dzag / tshigs mtshams lhod par gyur pa dang / nyams che ba 'am nyam chung gyur pa gang / ldang ba'i tshe na mi dran 'gyur

verses.skt: uttāna eva svapiti yaḥ pādau vikaroti ca | śayanāsanakuḍyāder yo ’sad eva jighṛkṣati
verses.tib: gang zhig gan rkyal nyal nas ni / rkang pa rnam par bskyod pa dang / rtsig pa mal stan la sogs pa / gang zhig rtag tu snyes pa dang / rgyu med par dgod myongs tshul gyis

verses.skt: ahāsyahāsī saṃmuhyan yo leḍhi daśanacchadau | uttarauṣṭhaṃ parilihan phūtkārāṃś ca karoti yaḥ
verses.tib: mchu la ldags par byed pa dang / ya mchu ldags par byed pa dang / sgra bcas par yang gang byed dang

verses.skt: yam abhidravati cchāyā kṛṣṇā pītāruṇāpi vā | bhiṣagbheṣajapānānnagurumitradviṣaś ca ye
verses.tib: lus mdog nag po ser po dang / dmar po'i gzugs brnyan snang ba dang / sman pa sman dang kha zas dang / bla ma mdza' bshes la sdang gang

verses.skt: vaśagāḥ sarva evaite vijñeyāḥ samavartinaḥ | grīvālalāṭahṛdayaṃ yasya svidyati śītalam
verses.tib: 'di dag thams cad gshin rje yi / dbang gyur yin par shes par bya / gang zhig drod chung sems g.yengs dang

verses.skt: uṣṇo ’paraḥ pradeśaś ca śaraṇaṃ tasya devatāḥ | yo ’ṇujyotir anekāgro duśchāyo durmanāḥ sadā
verses.tib: rtag tu mdangs ngan yid mi bde / gang zhig gtor ma bya rog la

verses.skt: pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvarādiṣv atimātrayā | yaṃ viśanti viśaty enaṃ mṛtyur jvarapuraḥsaraḥ
baliṃ balibhṛto yasya praṇītaṃ nopabhuñjate | nirnimittaṃ ca yo medhāṃ śobhām upacayaṃ śriyam
verses.tib: byin yang za bar mi byed dang / gang zhig rgyu med yid gzhungs dang / mdzes shing lus rgyas dpal thob pa'am

verses.skt: prāpnoty ato vā vibhraṃśaṃ sa prāpnoti yamakṣayam | guṇadoṣamayī yasya svasthasya vyādhitasya vā
verses.tib: de las nyams par gyur pa dag / de ni gshin rje'i khyim du 'jug / tha mal par ram nad pa yis / gang zhig yon tan skyon rang bzhin

verses.skt: yāty anyathātvaṃ prakṛtiḥ ṣaṇ māsān na sa jīvati | bhaktiḥ śīlaṃ smṛtis tyāgo buddhir balam ahetukam
verses.tib: snga las gzhan du 'gyur par snang / de ni zla drug las mi 'tsho / dad dang tshul khrims dran dang sbyin / blo gros stobs ni rgyu med par

verses.skt: ṣaḍ etāni nivartante ṣaḍbhir māsair mariṣyataḥ | mattavadgativākkampamohā māsān mariṣyataḥ
verses.tib: 'di drug las ni ldog gyur pa / zla ba drug nas 'chi bar 'gyur / 'gro dang tshig ni smyo ba 'dra / 'dar rmongs zla ba gcig nas 'chi

verses.skt: naśyaty ajānan ṣaḍahāt keśaluñcanavedanām | na yāti yasya cāhāraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhāmayād ṛte
verses.tib: skra phyi ba na tshor ba med / zhag drug nas ni 'chi bar 'gyur / gang zhig lkog nad med pa ru / mid par kha zas mi chud dang

verses.skt: preṣyāḥ pratīpatāṃ yānti pretākṛtir udīryate | yasya nidrā bhaven nityā naiva vā na sa jīvati
verses.tib: bran g.yog log par byed gyur pa / de ni 'chi ba dang 'drar bshad / gang zhig rtag tu gnyid log pa'am / gnyid med de yang mi 'tsho'o

verses.skt: vaktram āpūryate ’śrūṇāṃ svidyataś caraṇau bhṛśam | cakṣuś cākulatāṃ yāti yamarājyaṃ gamiṣyataḥ
verses.tib: mchi mas gdong ni khebs pa dang / rkang pa shin tu rngul ba dang / mig ni mi sdug par snang ba / gshin rje'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur

verses.skt: yaiḥ purā ramate bhāvair aratis tair na jīvati | sahasā jāyate yasya vikāraḥ sarvalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: sngon chad dga' ba'i dngos la gang / dga' mi 'gyur ba de mi 'tsho / gang zhig 'phral du 'gyur ba yin / mtshan nyid thams cad snang ba dang

verses.skt: nivartate vā sahasā sahasā sa vinaśyati | jvaro nihanti balavān gambhīro dairgharātrikaḥ
verses.tib: 'phral du ldog par 'gyur ba dag / de ni mod la 'chi bar 'gyur / rims ni stobs dang ldan pa dang / gting du zhen zhing yun ring dang / bla bcas mgo 'khor dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: sapralāpabhramaśvāsaḥ kṣīṇaṃ śūnaṃ hatānalam | akṣāmaṃ saktavacanaṃ raktākṣaṃ hṛdi śūlinam
verses.tib: rid cing skrangs dang me drod nyams / tshig mi gsal zhing thogs pa dang / mig dmar snying ni gzer ba dang

verses.skt: saśuṣkakāsaḥ pūrvāhṇe yo ’parāhṇe ’pi vā bhavet | balamāṃsavihīnasya śleṣmakāsasamanvitaḥ
verses.tib: snga dro lud pa skam po 'byung / phyi dro de las gzhan du 'gyur / bad kan lud par bcas pa dang / stobs dang sha ni zad na 'chi

verses.skt: raktapittaṃ bhṛśaṃ raktaṃ kṛṣṇam indradhanuṣprabham | tāmrahāridraharitaṃ rūpaṃ raktaṃ pradarśayet
verses.tib: khrag dang mkhris pa shin tu dmar / yang na gnag pa'am tshon can nam / dmar dang ser dang ljang mdog tu / khrag gi gzugs ni rab tu snang

verses.skt: romakūpapravisṛtaṃ kaṇṭhāsyahṛdaye sajat | vāsaso ’rañjanaṃ pūti vegavac cāti bhūri ca
verses.tib: ba spu'i bu ga nas 'dzag dang / lkog ma snying gar gos pa dang / gos la ma chags dri ngal / shugs byung shin tu mang du 'byung

verses.skt: vṛddhaṃ pāṇḍujvaracchardikāsaśophātisāriṇam | kāsaśvāsau jvaraccharditṛṣṇātīsāraśophinam
verses.tib: rgad po skya rbab rims thabs skyugs / lud pa skrang dang tshad 'khru gsod / lud pa dbugs mi bde rims skyugs / skom dang tshad 'khru 'or nad dang

verses.skt: yakṣmā pārśvarujānāharaktacchardyaṃsatāpinam | chardir vegavatī mūtraśakṛdgandhiḥ sacandrikā
verses.tib: gcong can sbos dang rtsib logs gzer / khrag skyug phrag pa tshan 'chi / skyug pa shugs dang ldan pa dang / bshang gci dri yod tshon can dang

verses.skt: sāsraviṭpūyarukkāsaśvāsavaty anuṣaṅgiṇī | tṛṣṇānyarogakṣapitaṃ bahirjihvaṃ vicetanam
verses.tib: lud pa bshang nag khrag dang bcas / dbugs mi bde yun ring na 'chi / skom dad nad gzhan gyis nyam smad / lce 'byung dran pa stor na 'chi

verses.skt: madātyayo ’tiśītārtaṃ kṣīṇaṃ tailaprabhānanam | arśāṃsi pāṇipannābhigudamuṣkāsyaśophinam
verses.tib: chang nad shin tu grang bas nyen / sha zad til mar gdong bskus 'dra / gzhang 'brum rkang lag lte ba dang / bshang sgo rlig pa'i kha skrangs dang

verses.skt: hṛtpārśvāṅgarujāchardipāyupākajvarāturam | atīsāro yakṛtpiṇḍamāṃsadhāvanamecakaiḥ
verses.tib: snying ga rtsib logs yan lag na / slon bro gzhang rnams rims kyis nyen / chad 'khru mcher ba'i dum bu dang / sha bkrus pa'am snum nag dang

verses.skt: tulyas tailaghṛtakṣīradadhimajjavasāsavaiḥ | mastuluṅgamaṣīpūyavesavārāmbumākṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: til mar 'o ma mar 'dra yang / zho dang rkang zhag chang snying dang / gnag tsha 'dra ba dang / sha brdungs chu dang sbrang rtsi dang

verses.skt: atiraktāsitasnigdhapūtyacchaghanavedanaḥ | karburaḥ prasravan dhātūn niṣpurīṣo ’thavātiviṭ
verses.tib: rab dmar gnag dang snum pa dang / rnag 'dra sla ska rnag dang bcas / lus zungs sna tshogs 'byung ba dang / bshang ba / med pa'am che ba 'am

verses.skt: tantumān makṣikākrānto rājīmāṃś candrakair yutaḥ | śīrṇapāyuvaliṃ muktanālaṃ parvāsthiśūlinam
verses.tib: 'byar bag sbrang ma lta bu'am / ri mo can dang tshon can dang / gzhang gi gnyer ma phyir 'byung dang / sgra can rus tshigs gzer ba dang

verses.skt: srastapāyuṃ balakṣīṇam annam evopaveśayan | satṛṭśvāsajvaracchardidāhānāhapravāhikaḥ
verses.tib: bshang sgo bye zhing stobs zad dang / zas ni nyams 'byung ba dang / skom bcas rims dang skyug pa dang / lus tsha lto sbos rgyun 'khrus 'chi

verses.skt: aśmarī śūnavṛṣaṇaṃ baddhamūtraṃ rujārditam | mehas tṛḍdāhapiṭikāmāṃsakothātisāriṇam
verses.tib: rde'u 'gags rlig pa skrangs pa dang / gcin 'gags nad kyis nyam thag gsod / gcin snyi skom dang tsha 'brum bcas / sha rul tshad pas 'khru ba 'chi

verses.skt: piṭikā marmahṛtpṛṣṭhastanāṃsagudamūrdhagāḥ | parvapādakarasthā vā mandotsāhaṃ pramehiṇam
verses.tib: thor nad dang ni snying ga rgyab / nu ma phrag pa spyi bor byung / tshigs dang rkang pa lag par gnas / gcin sri nad can stobs chung dang

verses.skt: sarvaṃ ca māṃsasaṃkothadāhatṛṣṇāmadajvaraiḥ | visarpamarmasaṃrodhahidhmāśvāsabhramaklamaiḥ
verses.tib: sha rnams thams cad 'drul ba dang / skom dang tsha myos rims btab 'chi / me dbal gnad ni 'gags pa dang / skyigs bu mgo 'khor dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: gulmaḥ pṛthuparīṇāho ghanaḥ kūrma ivonnataḥ | sirānaddho jvaracchardihidhmādhmānarujānvitaḥ
verses.tib: skran ni rgya cher kun nas zlum / sra zhing rus sbal ltar mtho dang / rtsa mngon rims btab skyugs pa dang / skyigs bu sbos shing zug gzer bcas

verses.skt: kāsapīnasahṛllāsaśvāsātīsāraśophavān | viṇmūtrasaṃgrahaśvāsaśophahidhmājvarabhramaiḥ
verses.tib: tshang 'khru skrang dang dbugs mi bde / dmu rdzing bshang gci 'gags pa dang / dbugs mi bde skrang skyigs bu dang

verses.skt: mūrchāchardyatisāraiś ca jaṭharaṃ hanti durbalam | śūnākṣaṃ kuṭilopastham upaklinnatanutvacam
verses.tib: rims dang mgo 'khor brgyal slon 'khru / nyam chung mi ni gsod 'gyur zhing / mig skrang ba dang mchan khung dang / pags pa rul zhing srab pa dang

verses.skt: virecanahṛtānāham ānahyantaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | pāṇḍurogaḥ śvayathumān pītākṣinakhadarśanam
verses.tib: bkru sman gyis bkrus lto sbos zhing / yang dang yang du 'phel ba 'chi / skya rbab skrang dang bcas pa dang / mig dang sen mo ser por snang

verses.skt: tandrādāhārucicchardimūrchādhmānātisāravān | anekopadravayutaḥ pādābhyāṃ prasṛto naram
verses.tib: snyoms tsha yi ga 'chus dang slon / brgyal dang lto sbos tshad 'khru 'chi / skrangs nad bla brnan sna tshogs ldan / skyes pa rkang gnyis dang por skrangs / bud med mgo nas skrangs na 'chi / gnyi ga'ang mtshan dang mchan khung skrangs / ri mor bcas 'dzag skyugs pa dang / rims dang tshad 'khru dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: nārīṃ śopho mukhād dhanti kukṣiguhyād ubhāv api | rājīcitaḥ sravaṃś chardijvaraśvāsātisāriṇam
verses.tib: snyoms tsha yi ga 'chus dang slon / brgyal dang lto sbos tshad 'khru 'chi / skrangs nad bla brnan sna tshogs ldan / skyes pa rkang gnyis dang por skrangs / bud med mgo nas skrangs na 'chi / gnyi ga'ang mtshan dang mchan khung skrangs / ri mor bcas 'dzag skyugs pa dang / rims dang tshad 'khru dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: jvarātīsārau śophānte śvayathur vā tayoḥ kṣaye | durbalasya viśeṣeṇa jāyante ’ntāya dehinaḥ
verses.tib: skrangs pa'i tha mar rims tshad 'khru / de gnyis gnyis zad mthar skrangs dang / lus can nyam chung gyur pa dag / skrangs par gyur na 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: śvayathur yasya pādasthaḥ parisraste ca piṇḍike | sīdataḥ sakthinī caiva taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet
verses.tib: gang zhig skrangs pa rkang par / gnas / byin pa'i nywar ni phyin pa dang / dpyi yi bar du gnod gyur pa / de ni sman pas spang bar bya

verses.skt: ānanaṃ hastapādaṃ ca viśeṣād yasya śuṣyataḥ | śūyete vā vinā dehāt sa māsād yāti pañcatām
verses.tib: gang gi gdong lag rkang pa ni / lhag par skams par gyur pa'am / lus ma gtogs 'di shas cher skrangs / de ni zla ba gcig na 'chi

verses.skt: visarpaḥ kāsavaivarṇyajvaramūrchāṅgabhaṅgavān | bhramāsyaśophahṛllāsadehasādātisāravān
verses.tib: me dbal lud pa kha dog nyams / rims brgyal yan lag bcag snyam sems / mgo 'khor kha skams snying ga na / lus snyom tshad pas 'khru ldan spang

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaṃ viśīryamāṇāṅgaṃ raktanetraṃ hatasvaram | mandāgniṃ jantubhir juṣṭaṃ hanti tṛṣṇātisāriṇam
verses.tib: mdze ni yan lag 'drul ba dang / mig dmar skad ni 'gags pa dang / drod nyams srin bu rnams kyis gtses / skom dang tshad pas 'khru ldan 'chi

verses.skt: vāyuḥ suptatvacaṃ bhugnaṃ kampaśopharujāturam | vātāsraṃ mohamūrchāyamadāsvapnajvarānvitam
verses.tib: rlung nad pags pas tshor med byed / lus 'dar skrang dang nad kyis gzir / dreg nad rmongs shing brgyal ba dang / myos dang gnyid che rims mgo rengs

verses.skt: śirograhāruciśvāsasaṃkocasphoṭakothavat | śirorogāruciśvāsamohaviḍbhedatṛḍbhramaiḥ
verses.tib: yi ga 'chus dang dbugs mi bde / 'khums shing chu bur rul pa 'dra / mgo nad yid 'chus dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: ghnanti sarvāmayāḥ kṣīṇasvaradhātubalānalam | vātavyādhir apasmārī kuṣṭhī rakty udarī kṣayī
verses.tib: skad 'gags lus zungs me drod zad / lus nyam chung nad kun gsod byed / rlung gi nad dang brjed byed dang / mdze nad khrag dang dmu rdzing gcong

verses.skt: gulmī mehī ca tān kṣīṇān vikāre ’lpe ’pi varjayet | balamāṃsakṣayas tīvro rogavṛddhir arocakaḥ
verses.tib: skran can gcin nad ldan pa yis / sha zad nad tshabs chung yang sdang / sha dang stobs ni shin tu zad / nad 'phel yi ga 'chus pa dag

verses.skt: yasyāturasya lakṣyante trīn pakṣān na sa jīvati | vātāṣṭhīlātisaṃvṛddhā tiṣṭhanti dāruṇā hṛdi
verses.tib: nad pa gang la snang 'gyur te / zla ba phyed dang gnyis na 'chi / rlung nad gtun 'dra la 'phel 'gyur zhing / mi zad snying ga gnas pa dag

verses.skt: tṛṣṇayānuparītasya sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam | śaithilyaṃ piṇḍike vāyur nītvā nāsāṃ ca jihmatām
verses.tib: 'phral du srog ni 'phrog par byed / rlung nad nywa ni lhod byed cing / sna ni yon por 'chus byed pa / gang gi 'gram pa zad par snang

verses.skt: kṣīṇasyāyamya manye vā sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam | nābhigudāntaraṃ gatvā vaṅkṣaṇau vā samāśrayan
verses.tib: 'phral du srog ni 'phrog pa yin / rlung nad lte ba gzhang bar song / yang na brla dbrag gnyis na gnas

verses.skt: gṛhītvā pāyuhṛdaye kṣīṇadehasya vā balī | malān vastiśiro nābhiṃ vibadhya janayan rujam
verses.tib: stobs ldan rlung ni nyam chung ba'i / gzhang dang snying gar gnas byed pa'am / dri ma chu so'i ltag lte ba / bkag te nad ni skyed pa dang

verses.skt: kurvan vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ śūlaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ bhinnapurīṣatām | śvāsaṃ vā janayan vāyur gṛhītvā gudavaṅkṣaṇam
verses.tib: chu sor gzer bar byed 'gyur la / skom dad 'khru bar byed pa dang / chu so bshang sgor gnas nas ni / rlung ni / dbugs mi bde skyed dang

verses.skt: vitatya parśukāgrāṇi gṛhītvoraś ca mārutaḥ | stimitasyātatākṣasya sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam
verses.tib: rtsib ma'i rtse mo 'degs byed cing / snying gar rlung ni brten pa dang / mig bgrad 'gyur ba med byed pa / 'phral du srog ni 'phrog par byed

verses.skt: sahasā jvarasaṃtāpas tṛṣṇā mūrchā balakṣayaḥ | viśleṣaṇaṃ ca saṃdhīnāṃ mumūrṣor upajāyate
verses.tib: 'phral du rims dang tsha bas btab / skom dad brgyal dang stobs zad dang / tshigs mtshams bral bar gyur pa rnams / nye bar 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: gosarge vadanād yasya svedaḥ pracyavate bhṛśam | lepajvaropataptasya durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.tib: nang par gang gi gdong las ni / rngul nas shas cher 'dzag 'gyur zhing / khar chags rims kyis gdungs pa rnams / de yang 'tsho bar dka' ba yin

verses.skt: pravālaguṭikābhāsā yasya gātre masūrikāḥ | utpadyāśu vinaśyanti na cirāt sa vinaśyati
verses.tib: gang gi lus la 'brum phran ni / byi ru'i mdog 'dra snang gyur pa / byung nas myur du mi snang gyur / de ni ring por mi thogs 'chi

verses.skt: masūravidalaprakhyās tathā vidrumasaṃnibhāḥ | antarvaktrāḥ kiṇābhāś ca visphoṭā dehanāśanāḥ
verses.tib: 'brum pa sran chung bshus 'dra zhing / de bzhin byi ru'i mdog 'dra ba / nang du kha blta tshad 'brum 'dra / 'brum bus lus ni 'jig byed yin

verses.skt: kāmalākṣṇor mukhaṃ pūrṇaṃ śaṅkhayor muktamāṃsatā | saṃtrāsaś coṣṇatāṅge ca yasya taṃ parivarjayet
verses.tib: mig ser gdong ser rgyas pa dang / mur 'gram gnyis kyi sha zad pa / skrag cing lus ni tsha bdag / gang yin de ni spang bar bya

verses.skt: akasmād anudhāvac ca vighṛṣṭaṃ tvaksamāśrayam | yo vātajo na śūlāya syān na dāhāya pittajaḥ
verses.tib: rgyu med phrugs pa dag las rma / 'phel zhing mched par byed pa dang / rlung skyed gang yin na ba med

verses.skt: candanośīramadirākuṇapadhvāṅkṣagandhayaḥ | śaivālakukkuṭaśikhākuṅkumālamaṣīprabhāḥ
antardāhā nirūṣmaṇaḥ prāṇanāśakarā vraṇāḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa las gyur tsha ba med

verses.skt: kaphajo na ca pūyāya marmajaś ca ruje na yaḥ | acūrṇaś cūrṇakīrṇābho yatrākasmāc ca dṛśyate
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur rnag med dang / gang zhig nad skyed zug gzer med / phye mas khyab dang rnying par snang / gang du glo bur dag tu ni

verses.skt: rūpaṃ śaktidhvajādīnāṃ sarvāṃs tān varjayed vraṇān | viṇmūtramārutavahaṃ kṛmiṇaṃ ca bhagandaram
verses.tib: rgyal mtshan mdung la sogs gzugs snang / rma de thams cad spangs bar bya / mtshan par rdol na bshang gcig rlung / 'byung zhing srin bus gtses pa dang

verses.skt: ghaṭṭayañ jānunā jānu pādāv udyamya pātayan | yo ’pāsyati muhur vaktram āturo na sa jīvati
verses.tib: pus mo phan tshun 'byer ba dang / rkang pa bteg nas ltung gyur dang / yang dang yang du kha bsgyur ba'i / nad pa de ni 'tsho mi 'gyur

verses.skt: dantaiś chindan nakhāgrāṇi taiś ca keśāṃs tṛṇāni ca | bhūmiṃ kāṣṭhena vilikhan loṣṭaṃ loṣṭena tāḍayan
verses.tib: so yis sen mo'i rtse gcod cing / sen mos skra'am rtsa gcod dang / sa la shing bus 'dri ba dang / bong pas bong ba rdeg pa dang

verses.skt: hṛṣṭaromā sāndramūtraḥ śuṣkakāsī jvarī ca yaḥ | muhur hasan muhuḥ kṣveḍan śayyāṃ pādena hanti yaḥ
verses.tib: spu ldang gcin ni bska ba dang / lud pa bskams shing rims kyis 'debs / skad cig dgod cing spyugs glu len / ma la la rkang bas rdeg pa dang

verses.skt: muhuś chidrāṇi vimṛśann āturo na sa jīvati | mṛtyave sahasārtasya tilakavyaṅgaviplavaḥ
verses.tib: skad cig re res bu gsol / nad pa gang yin de mi 'tsho / gdong la sme ba ngo khabs dang

verses.skt: mukhe dantanakhe puṣpaṃ jaṭhare vividhāḥ sirāḥ | ūrdhvaśvāsaṃ gatoṣmāṇaṃ śūlopahatavaṅkṣaṇam
verses.tib: mdzer skyes so sen thig le chags / lto la sna tshogs rtsa snang ba / glo bur byung ba de mi 'tsho / gyen du dbugs rtseg drod yal zhing / brla dbrag gnyis su gzer gyis nyen

verses.skt: śarma cānadhigacchantaṃ buddhimān parivarjayet | vikārā yasya vardhante prakṛtiḥ parihīyate
verses.tib: dpal dang rnam par bral gyur pa / blo dang ldan pas yongs su spang / gang gi nad ni 'phel 'gyur dang / rang bzhin yongs su nyams pa ni

verses.skt: sahasā sahasā tasya mṛtyur harati jīvitam | yam uddiśyāturaṃ vaidyaḥ saṃpādayitum auṣadham
verses.tib: gang la 'phral du 'byung gyur pa / de ni mod la 'chi bar 'gyur / sman pas nad pa gang zhig la / sman gyi bya ba byas gyur pa

verses.skt: yatamāno na śaknoti durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam | vijñātaṃ bahuśaḥ siddhaṃ vidhivac cāvacāritam
verses.tib: 'bad kyang sos par ma gyur na / de yi srog ni rnyed par dka' / mkhas shing mang du grub pa dang / cho ga bzhin du byin gyur yang

verses.skt: na sidhyaty auṣadhaṃ yasya nāsti tasya cikitsitam | bhaved yasyauṣadhe ’nne vā kalpyamāne viparyayaḥ
verses.tib: sman gyi bya ba ma grub gang / de la gso ba'i thabs med do / gang gis sman ni sbyor ba'i tshe / rgyu med par ni phyin ci log

verses.skt: akasmād varṇagandhādeḥ svastho ’pi na sa jīvati | nivāte sendhanaṃ yasya jyotiś cāpy upaśāmyati
verses.tib: mdog dang ro logs gyur na / nad med yin yang de mi 'tsho / gang gi gnas su shing bcas med

verses.skt: āturasya gṛhe yasya bhidyante vā patanti vā | atimātram amatrāṇi durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.tib: rlung med kyang ni shi 'gyur dang / nad pa gang gi khyim du ni / snod ni shin tu mang po dag / chag gam lhung bar gyur pa na / de yi srog ni rnyed par dga'

verses.skt: yaṃ naraṃ sahasā rogo durbalaṃ parimuñcati | saṃśayaprāptam ātreyo jīvitaṃ tasya manyate
verses.tib: mi gang nyam chung gyur ba yang / glo bur sos par snang 'gyur ba / de yi srog kyang ma nges pa / yin par rgyun shes bus bshad do

verses.skt: kathayen na ca pṛṣṭo ’pi duḥśravaṃ maraṇaṃ bhiṣak | gatāsor bandhumitrāṇāṃ na cecchet taṃ cikitsitum
verses.tib: nye du mdza' bo rnams kyis ni / dris kyang mnyan par mi bya la / sman pas smra bar mi bya zhing / de yi gso ba'ang khas mi blang

verses.skt: yamadūtapiśācādyair yat parāsur upāsyate | ghnadbhir auṣadhavīryāṇi tasmāt taṃ parivarjayet
verses.tib: gshin rje'i pho nya sha za / gzhan gyis nye bar bsten pa gang / sman gyis stobs ni 'joms pas na / de phyir de ni yongs su spangs

verses.skt: āyurvedaphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yad āyurjñe pratiṣṭhitam | riṣṭajñānādṛtas tasmāt sarvadaiva bhaved bhiṣak
verses.tib: tshe yi rig byed 'bras bu kun / tshe shes pa la gnas pa yin / de bas 'chi ltas gnas pa kun / sman pas 'bad de shes par bya

verses.skt: maraṇaṃ prāṇināṃ dṛṣṭam āyuḥpuṇyobhayakṣayāt | tayor apy akṣayād dṛṣṭaṃ viṣamāparihāriṇām
verses.tib: tshe dang bsod nams gnyi ga zad / de gnyis zad par ma gyur yang / yang ba ni ma spangs pas / srog chags rnams ni 'chi bar bshad

verses.skt: pāṣaṇḍāśramavarṇānāṃ savarṇāḥ karmasiddhaye | ta eva viparītāḥ syur dūtāḥ karmavipattaye
verses.tib: ya mtshan can dang dge sbyong dang / rigs mthun / las ni 'grub par bshad / de las go bzlog pho nya ni / las ni 'grub min rtags su bshad

verses.skt: dīnaṃ bhītaṃ drutaṃ trastaṃ rūkṣāmaṅgalavādinam | śastriṇaṃ daṇḍinaṃ ṣaṇḍhaṃ muṇḍaśmaśrujaṭādharam
verses.tib: dman dang 'jigs rengs sngangs pa dang / rtsub dang bkra mi shis smra dang / mtshon cha dbyug thogs mgo reg dang / ma ning smar ral pa can

verses.skt: amaṅgalāhvayaṃ krūrakarmāṇaṃ malinaṃ striyam | anekaṃ vyādhitaṃ vyaṅgaṃ raktamālyānulepanam
verses.tib: bkra mi shis pa'i ming dang ldan / sdig las bud med dri ma can / mang po nad pa mi sdug dang / phreng ba byug pa dmar pos brgyan

verses.skt: tailapaṅkāṅkitaṃ jīrṇavivarṇārdraikavāsasam | kharoṣṭramahiṣārūḍhaṃ kāṣṭhaloṣṭādimardinam
verses.tib: til mar 'dam bskus gos rnying dang / mdog ngan rlan can gos gcig gon / bong bu rnga mo ma he zhon / shing dang bong ba nyed pa dang

verses.skt: nānugacched bhiṣag dūtam āhvayantaṃ ca dūrataḥ | aśastacintāvacane nagne chindati bhindati
verses.tib: ring nas 'bod pa'i pho nya 'ongs / sman pas yongs su spangs bar bya / bkra mi shis pa sems dang smra / gcer bu gcod dang 'jig pa dang

verses.skt: juhvāne pāvakaṃ piṇḍān pitṛbhyo nirvapaty api | supte muktakace ’bhyakte rudaty aprayate tathā
verses.tib: mtshun gtor me la bsreg pa dang / 'chi ba rnams la ster ba dang / sar nyal skra bshig skud pa dang / ngu dang ma bsdams gnas skabs su

verses.skt: vaidye dūtā manuṣyāṇām āgacchanti mumūrṣatām | vikārasāmānyaguṇe deśe kāle ’thavā bhiṣak
verses.tib: sman pa gnas tshe pho nya 'ongs / mi ni 'chi bar ston pa yin / nad dang mtshan nyid mtshungs ba yi / yul lam dus su sman pa gnas

verses.skt: dūtam abhyāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nāturaṃ tam upācaret | spṛśanto nābhināsāsyakeśaromanakhadvijān
verses.tib: bang chen 'bod du 'ongs mthong na / nad pa de ni gso mi bya / lte ba kha dang sna reg dang / skra dang spu dang sen mo so

verses.skt: guhyapṛṣṭhastanagrīvājaṭharānāmikāṅgulīḥ | kārpāsabusasīsāsthikapālamusalopalam
verses.tib: mtshan rgyab nu ma mgrin pa dang / lto dang srin lag dag dang ni / ras bal phub ma zha nye rtsa

verses.skt: mārjanīśūrpacailāntabhasmāṅgāradaśātuṣān | rajjūpānattulāpāśam anyad vā bhagnavicyutam
verses.tib: rus pa gtun brdung phyags ma rdo / zhabs ma gos kyis mtha' ma dang / thal ba sol ba kha tshar sogs / gzhan yang thog gi zhags pa thogs

verses.skt: tatpūrvadarśane dūtā vyāharanti mariṣyatām | tathārdharātre madhyāhne saṃdhyayoḥ parvavāsare
verses.tib: pho nya de 'dra sngon du mthong / 'chi ba dag tu ston pa yin / de bzhin mtshan phyed nyi ma'i gung / thun mtshams dang ni dus tshigs dang

verses.skt: ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīnavamīrāhuketūdayādiṣu | bharaṇīkṛttikāśleṣāpūrvārdrāpaitryanairṛte
verses.tib: tshes drug tshes bzhi tshes dgu dang / sgra gcan mjug 'char dus / bra nye smin drug skag chu stod

verses.skt: yasmiṃś ca dūte bruvati vākyam āturasaṃśrayam | paśyen nimittam aśubhaṃ taṃ ca nānuvrajed bhiṣak
verses.tib: gong du pho nya nad pa yi / mtshan nyid la ni brten pa'i tshig / mi dge smra dang mi shis mthong / der ni sman pa 'gro mi bya

verses.skt: tad yathā vikalaḥ pretaḥ pretālaṅkāra eva vā | chinnaṃ dagdhaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā tadvādīni vacāṃsi vā
verses.tib: dbang bo ma tshang mi ro'am / mi rus kyis ni brgyan pa'am / chad dang tshig dang nyams chag dang / de yi tshig tu / smra ba'am

verses.skt: raso vā kaṭukas tīvro gandho vā kauṇapo mahān | sparśo vā vipulaḥ krūro yad vānyad api tādṛśam
verses.tib: ro ni tsha dang drag pa'am / dri ni shas cher rul pa'am / reg bya rgya cher mi bzad dang / gang yang de 'dra gzhan dag ni

verses.skt: tat sarvam abhito vākyaṃ vākyakāle ’thavā punaḥ | dūtam abhyāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nāturaṃ tam upācaret
verses.tib: de kun mdun du smra ba'am / yang na de skad smra ba'i tshe / pho nya 'ongs par mthong na ni / nad pa de ni gso mi bya

verses.skt: hāhākranditam utkruṣṭam ākruṣṭaṃ skhalanaṃ kṣutam | vastrātapatrapādatravyasanaṃ vyasanīkṣaṇam
verses.tib: kyi hud kyi hud cho nges 'debs / 'od dod mod mo 'gyel sbrid sgra / gos dang gdugs dang lham 'jig dang / sdug bsngal ba dag mthong ba dang

verses.skt: caityadhvajānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ pūrṇānāṃ ca nimajjanam | hatāniṣṭapravādāś ca dūṣaṇaṃ bhasmapāṃsubhiḥ
verses.tib: shing chen rgyal mtshan gang ba'i snod / chu nang nub par mthong ba dag / gsod yid du mi 'ong smra / thal ba phyag dar gyis gtor dang / phyi la sram dang sbrul dang ni

verses.skt: pathaś chedo ’himārjāragodhāsaraṭavānaraiḥ | dīptāṃ prati diśaṃ vācaḥ krūrāṇāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām
verses.tib: spre'us lam ni bcad pa dang / 'bar ba'i phyogs su bya / gdug pa sgra ni sgrogs pa dang

verses.skt: kṛṣṇadhānyaguḍodaśvillavaṇāsavacarmaṇām | sarṣapāṇāṃ vasātailatṛṇapaṅkendhanasya ca
verses.tib: 'bru gnag bu ram dar ba dang / lan tshwa chang rnying pags pa dang / yungs kar zhag dang 'bru mar dang / rtswa dang 'dam bu bud shing dang

verses.skt: klībakrūraśvapākānāṃ jālavāgurayor api | charditasya purīṣasya pūtidurdarśanasya ca
verses.tib: ma ning mi srun sme sha can / rgya dag dang ni rnyi rnams dang / slon dang bshang ba gtong ba dang / rnag dang mtshan ma ngan pa mthong

verses.skt: niḥsārasya vyavāyasya kārpāsāder arer api | śayanāsanayānānām uttānānāṃ tu darśanam
verses.tib: snying po med dang 'khrig pa spyod / ras bal dang dgra bo mthong / mal stan dang ni khyogs la / kha sbub tu ni gnas par mthong

verses.skt: nyubjānām itareṣāṃ ca pātrādīnām aśobhanam | puṃsaṃjñāḥ pakṣiṇo vāmāḥ strīsaṃjñā dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.tib: nad pa dag dang gzhan dag dang / snod ngan mthong mi shes so / skyes pa'i ming can bya g.yon na / bud med ming can g.yas 'dug bzang

verses.skt: pradakṣiṇaṃ khagamṛgā yānto naivaṃ śvajambukāḥ | ayugmāś ca mṛgāḥ śastāḥ śastā nityaṃ ca darśane
verses.tib: bya dang ri dwags g.yas skor bzang / khyi dang wa ni de lta min / ri dwags rnams ni zung min shis / tsa sha bya rgod khany+dza ri / ne+e'u le dang rma bya rnams / mthong ba rtag tu shis pa yin / 'ug pa byi la sbrul mthong ba / rnam pa kun tu shis ma yin

verses.skt: cāṣabhāsabharadvājanakulacchāgabarhiṇaḥ | aśubhaṃ sarvatholūkabiḍālasaraṭekṣaṇam
verses.tib: bya dang ri dwags g.yas skor bzang / khyi dang wa ni de lta min / ri dwags rnams ni zung min shis / tsa sha bya rgod khany+dza ri / ne+e'u le dang rma bya rnams / mthong ba rtag tu shis pa yin / 'ug pa byi la sbrul mthong ba / rnam pa kun tu shis ma yin

verses.skt: praśastāḥ kīrtane kolagodhāhiśaśajāhakāḥ | na darśane na virute vānararkṣāv ato ’nyathā
verses.tib: go da dang ni ri bong sbrul / dza ba ka ni ming thos dge / mthong dang sgra sgrogs de lta min / dred dang spre'u de las bzlog

verses.skt: dhanur aindraṃ ca lālāṭam aśubhaṃ śubham anyataḥ | agnipūrṇāni pātrāṇi bhinnāni viśikhāni ca
verses.tib: 'phral ba'i phyogs su 'ja' tshon mthong / mi shis rgyab tu mthong na shis / me yis gang ba'i snod dag ni / chag dang khong stong gnas pa dang

verses.skt: dadhyakṣatādi nirgacchad vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca maṅgalam | vaidyo mariṣyatāṃ veśma praviśann eva paśyati
verses.tib: nad pa 'chi 'gyur khyim du ni / sman pa 'jug par byed pa'i tshe / zho bkra shis 'og nas bshad / gang ba'i snod phyir byung mthong dang

verses.skt: dūtādy asādhu dṛṣṭvaivaṃ tyajed ārtam ato ’nyathā | karuṇāśuddhasaṃtāno yatnatas tam upācaret
verses.tib: pho nya la / mi shis mthong / de lta'i nad pa spang bar bya / de las gzhan par snying rje'i rgyud / dag pas 'bad de gso bar bya

verses.skt: dadhyakṣatekṣuniṣpāvapriyaṅgumadhusarpiṣām | yāvakāñjanabhṛṅgāraghaṇṭādīpasaroruhām
verses.tib: zho 'bru bu ram shing dang khre / sbrang rtsi zhun mar pri yang ku / nas thug dngul rdo bum pa dang / dril bu mar me chu skyes dang

verses.skt: dūrvārdramatsyamāṃsānāṃ lājānāṃ phalabhakṣayoḥ | ratnebhapūrṇakumbhānāṃ kanyāyāḥ syandanasya ca
verses.tib: dUr pa nya dang sha rlon dang / 'bras yos 'bras bu kha zas dang / bum pa rin po che yis gang / bu mo gzhon dang shing rta dang

verses.skt: narasya vardhamānasya devatānāṃ nṛpasya ca | śuklānāṃ sumanovālacāmarāmbaravājinām
verses.tib: mi ni mgo 'phang mtho ba dang / lha rnams dang ni rgyal po dang / gos dkar gon dang me tog dkar / khyim dang rnga yab rta dkar mthong

verses.skt: śaṅkhasādhudvijoṣṇīṣatoraṇasvastikasya ca | bhūmeḥ samuddhatāyāś ca vahneḥ prajvalitasya ca
verses.tib: dam pa bram ze gtsug tor dung / rta babs dang ni g.yung drung dang / sa ni brkos par gyur pa dang / me ni rab tu 'bar ba dang

verses.skt: manojñasyānnapānasya pūrṇasya śakaṭasya ca | nṛbhir dhenvāḥ savatsāyā vaḍabāyāḥ striyā api
verses.tib: bza' btung yid du 'ong ba dang / mi yis shing rta legs gang dang / ba ni be'u dang bcas pa dang / rgod ma bud med btsas dang

verses.skt: jīvañjīvakasāraṅgasārasapriyavādinām | haṃsānāṃ śatapattrāṇāṃ baddhasyaikapaśos tathā
verses.tib: shang shang te'u sha bkra dang / ngang pa khu byug rma bya dang / sar sa ni sgra snyan sgrogs / de bzhin phyugs gcig btags pa dang

verses.skt: rucakādarśasiddhārtharocanānāṃ ca darśanam | gandhaḥ susurabhir varṇaḥ suśuklo madhuro rasaḥ
verses.tib: gdu bu me long yungs kar dang / gi wang rnams ni mthong ba dang / byug pa dri zhim gyis byugs dang / khu ba dkar zhing mngar ba dang

verses.skt: gopater anukūlasya svanas tadvad gavām api | mṛgapakṣinarāṇāṃ ca śobhināṃ śobhanā giraḥ
verses.tib: khyu mchog de bzhin ba lang rnams / rjes su mthun pa'i sgra sgrogs dang / ri dwags bya dang mi rnams ni / yid 'ong sgra snyan smra ba yi

verses.skt: chattradhvajapatākānām utkṣepaṇam abhiṣṭutiḥ | bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāṃ śabdāḥ puṇyāhaniḥsvanāḥ
verses.tib: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan pa dan bsgreng / mngon par stod par byed pa dang / rdza rnga dung dang rnga bo che / sgra dang bkra shis sgra sgrogs pa

verses.skt: vedādhyayanaśabdāś ca sukho vāyuḥ pradakṣiṇaḥ | pathi veśmapraveśe ca vidyād ārogyalakṣaṇam
verses.tib: bram ze rig byed 'don pa dang / bde ba'i rlung ni rjes mthun rgyu / lam dang khyim du 'jug tshe yod / nad sos mtshan nyid yin shes bya

verses.skt: ity uktaṃ dūtaśakunaṃ svapnān ūrdhvaṃ pracakṣate | svapne madyaṃ saha pretair yaḥ piban kṛṣyate śunā
verses.tib: de ltar pho nya dge bshad nas / de 'og rmi lam bshad bya ste / rmi lam shi ba'i mi rnams dang / lhan cig chang 'thungs khyis drangs gang

verses.skt: sa martyo mṛtyunā śīghraṃ jvararūpeṇa nīyate | raktamālyavapurvastro yo hasan hriyate striyā
verses.tib: mi de rim gyis gzugs can gyi / 'chi bdag gis ni myur khyer 'gyur / lus dang gos dang phreng ba dmar / bud med rgod pas drangs rmis gang

verses.skt: so ’srapittena mahiṣaśvavarāhoṣṭragardabhaiḥ | yaḥ prayāti diśaṃ yāmyāṃ maraṇaṃ tasya yakṣmaṇā
verses.tib: de ni khrag mkhris dag gis 'chi / ma he rta phag bong bu dang / rnga mo zhon te lho phyogs 'gro / de ni gcong chen nad kyis 'chi

verses.skt: latā kaṇṭakinī vaṃśas tālo vā hṛdi jāyate | yasya tasyāśu gulmena yasya vahnim anarciṣam
verses.tib: lcug ma tsher can 'od ma'am / ta la / snying gar skyes pa rmi / gang yin de ni skran gyis 'chi / gang zhig me ni mi 'bar la

verses.skt: juhvato ghṛtasiktasya nagnasyorasi jāyate | padmaṃ sa naśyet kuṣṭhena caṇḍālaiḥ saha yaḥ pibet
verses.tib: sbyin sreg byed cing mar gyis bskus / gcer bur 'dug dang pad+ma ni / snying gar byung rmis mdze yis 'chi / gang zhig sme sha can lhan cig

verses.skt: snehaṃ bahuvidhaṃ svapne sa prameheṇa naśyati | unmādena jale majjed yo nṛtyan rākṣasaiḥ saha
verses.tib: snum mang 'thungs par rmi bde / gcin nad kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur / srin po lhan cig gar byed cing / chu la bying rmi smyo byed 'dzin

verses.skt: apasmāreṇa yo martyo nṛtyan pretena nīyate | yānaṃ kharoṣṭramārjārakapiśārdūlaśūkaraiḥ
verses.tib: ra ro gar byed shi ba yi / mis khyer rmi ba brjed byed 'dzin / bong bu rnga mo byi la spre'u / seng+ge stag dang khwa dag dang
