verses.skt: yasya pretaiḥ śṛgālair vā sa mṛtyor vartate mukhe | apūpaśaṣkulīr jagdhvā vibuddhas tadvidhaṃ vaman
verses.tib: wa 'am mi ro la zhon rmis / de ni 'chi bdag khar song yin / snum khur sha khu li zos rmis / sad nas de 'dra slon 'gyur ba

verses.skt: na jīvaty akṣirogāya sūryendugrahaṇekṣaṇam | sūryācandramasoḥ pātadarśanaṃ dṛgvināśanam
verses.tib: gang yin de ni 'tsho mi 'gyur / nyi zla gzas zin rmis mig na / nyi ma zla ba lhung ba yi / rmi lam mthong na long bar 'gyur

verses.skt: mūrdhni vaṃśalatādīnāṃ saṃbhavo vayasāṃ tathā | nilayo muṇḍatā kākagṛdhrādyaiḥ parivāraṇam
verses.tib: spyi bor 'od ma'i lcug skyes / de bzhin bya rog tshang 'cha' dang / mgo bo chad par rmis pa dang / khwa dang bya rog sogs kyis bskor

verses.skt: tathā pretapiśācastrīdraviḍāndhragavāśanaiḥ | saṅgo vetralatāvaṃśatṛṇakaṇṭakasaṃkaṭe
verses.tib: de bzhin yi dwags sha za mo / byad ma sme sha can gyis bskor / 'od ma'i tshal dang tsher ma dang / rtswa yi tshang tshing nang du tshud

verses.skt: śvabhraśmaśānaśayanaṃ patanaṃ pāṃsubhasmanoḥ | majjanaṃ jalapaṅkādau śīghreṇa srotasā hṛtiḥ
verses.tib: g.yang sar lhung dang dur khrod nyal / phyag dar thal ba'i nang du lhung / chu dang 'dam la par nub / chu rgyun gyis ni myur du khyer

verses.skt: nṛtyavāditragītāni raktasragvastradhāraṇam | vayo'ṅgavṛddhir abhyaṅgo vivāhaḥ śmaśrukarma ca
verses.tib: glu gar dang ni rol mo dang / gos dang phreng ba dmar po 'chang / lus 'phel na tshod rgas pa dang / bag ma len zhing kha spu 'dreg

verses.skt: pakvānnasnehamadyāśaḥ pracchardanavirecane | hiraṇyalohayor lābhaḥ kalir bandhaparājayau
verses.tib: zas btsos snum za chang 'thung dang / skyugs dang 'khru ba rmi ba dang / lcags dang gser dag rnyed pa dang / btsong dang rtsod las pham pa dang

verses.skt: upānadyuganāśaś ca prapātaḥ pādacarmaṇoḥ | harṣo bhṛśaṃ prakupitaiḥ pitṛbhiś cāvabhartsanam
verses.tib: mchil lham gnyis ni stor ba dang / rkang pags lhung ba rmi ba dang / shin tu dga' dang rab khros ba'i / shi ba'i gnyen gyis spyos pa dang

verses.skt: pradīpagrahanakṣatradantadaivatacakṣuṣām | patanaṃ vā vināśo vā bhedanaṃ parvatasya ca
verses.tib: mar me gza' dang skar ma dang / so mig lha'i gzugs rnams ni / lhung ba'am 'jig pa rmis pa'am / ri bo ral par 'gyur pa dang

verses.skt: kānane raktakusume pāpakarmaniveśane | citāndhakārasaṃbādhe jananyāṃ ca praveśanam
verses.tib: nags tshal 'bar ba'i nang dang ni / sdig can khyim du 'jug pa dang / ro bsregs pa dang mun par zhugs / ma yi mngal du zhugs pa dang

verses.skt: pātaḥ prāsādaśailāder matsyena grasanaṃ tathā | kāṣāyiṇām asaumyānāṃ nagnānāṃ daṇḍadhāriṇām
verses.tib: brag dang khang pa sar lhung dang / de bzhin nya / yis mid pa dang / chos gos gon pa'i mi srun dang / gcer bu dbyug pa thogs pa dang

verses.skt: raktākṣāṇāṃ ca kṛṣṇānāṃ darśanaṃ jātu neṣyate | kṛṣṇā pāpānanācārā dīrghakeśanakhastanī
verses.tib: mig dmar kha dog gnag pa ni / mthong na nam yang shis yin / bud med sdig can gdong gnag dang / skra dang sen mo nu ma ring

verses.skt: virāgamālyavasanā svapne kālaniśā matā | manovahānāṃ pūrṇatvāt srotasāṃ prabalair malaiḥ
verses.tib: gos dang phreng ba dmar po thogs / rmis pa dus mtshan yin par 'dod / nad ni stobs dang ldan pa yis / yid 'jug bu ga bkag pa'i phyir

verses.skt: dṛśyante dāruṇāḥ svapnā rogī yair yāti pañcatām | arogaḥ saṃśayaṃ prāpya kaścid eva vimucyate
verses.tib: mi bzad rmi lam mthong 'gyur te / nad pa 'chi bar 'gyur pa yin / nad med the tshom bcas gyur zhing / 'ga' zhig thar bar 'gyur pa yin

verses.skt: dṛṣṭaḥ śruto ’nubhūtaś ca prārthitaḥ kalpitas tathā | bhāviko doṣajaś ceti svapnaḥ saptavidho mataḥ
verses.tib: mthong dang thos dang nyams myong dang / gsol ba btab dang brtags pa dang / 'byung bar 'gyur dang nad las byung / rmi lam rnam pa bdun du bshad

verses.skt: teṣv ādyā niṣphalāḥ pañca yathāsvaprakṛtir divā | vismṛto dīrghahrasvo ’ti pūrvarātre cirāt phalam
verses.tib: de las dang po'i lnga po dang / rang gi rang bzhin nyin mo brjed / shin tu ring thung 'bras bu med / cha 'dres pa yi rang bzhin can / mtshan stong rmi lam 'bras bu ring

verses.skt: dṛṣṭaḥ karoti tucchaṃ ca gosarge tadahar mahat | nidrayā vānupahataḥ pratīpair vacanais tathā
verses.tib: mthong ba chung ngu byed pa yin / nang par mthong dang gnyid ma log / mi mthun gtam gyis bar mchod / de yi nyin par 'bras chen 'gyur

verses.skt: yāti pāpo ’lpaphalatāṃ dānahomajapādibhiḥ | akalyāṇam api svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatraiva yaḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: sbyin dang sbyin sreg la kyis / rmi lam 'bras bu chung bar 'gyur / gang zhig rmi lam ngan mthong nas / slar yang gnas skabs de nyid du

verses.skt: paśyet saumyaṃ śubhaṃ tasya śubham eva phalaṃ bhavet | devān dvijān govṛṣabhān jīvataḥ suhṛdo nṛpān
verses.tib: rmi lam bzang po mthong gyur na / 'bras bu bzang po nyid thob 'gyur / lha dang bram ze khyu mchog dang / ba lang rgyal po mdza' bshes gson

verses.skt: sādhūn yaśasvino vahnim iddhaṃ svacchān jalāśayān | kanyāḥ kumārakān gaurān śuklavastrān sutejasaḥ
verses.tib: skyes bu dam pa grags ldan dang / me 'bar ba dang dngas pa'i mtsho / bu mo khye'u ser ba dang / gos dkar gon zhing mdangs dang ldan

verses.skt: narāśanaṃ dīptatanuṃ samantād rudhirokṣitam | yaḥ paśyel labhate yo vā chattrādarśaviṣāmiṣam
verses.tib: skyes bu za dang lus 'bar dang / khrag gis lus kun byugs pa dag / gang gis mthong bar gyur ba dang / gdugs dang sha rlon me long dug

verses.skt: śuklāḥ sumanaso vastram amedhyālepanaṃ phalam | śailaprāsādasaphalavṛkṣasiṃhanaradvipān
verses.tib: sna ma dkar pos gos pa dang / mi gtsang gis byugs 'bras bu rnyed / ri bo khang 'bras bcas shing / 'dzeg dang seng ge glang chen mi

verses.skt: ārohed go'śvayānaṃ ca taren nadahradodadhīn | pūrvottareṇa gamanam agamyāgamanaṃ mṛtam
verses.tib: rta dang ba lang dag la zhon / chu bo mtsho bran rgya mtsho rgal / shar dang byang du 'gro ba dang / bgrod min 'gro dang shi ba dang

verses.skt: saṃbādhān niḥsṛtir devaiḥ pitṛbhiś cābhinandanam | rodanaṃ patitotthānaṃ dviṣatāṃ cāvamardanam
verses.tib: nyam nga / las thar lha rnams dang / pha mas mngon par bstod pa dang / ngu dang ltung las ldang ba dang / dgra bo pham par byas pa dag

verses.skt: yasya syād āyur ārogyaṃ vittaṃ bahu ca so ’śnute | maṅgalācārasaṃpannaḥ parivāras tathāturaḥ
verses.tib: nor mang po ni rnyed par 'gyur / de bzhin nad pa'i g.yog 'khor ni / bkra shis cho ga phun sum tshogs

verses.skt: śraddadhāno ’nukūlaś ca prabhūtadravyasaṃgrahaḥ | sattvalakṣaṇasaṃyogo bhaktir vaidyadvijātiṣu
verses.tib: dad ldan rjes su mthun pa dang / nor mang bsdus par gyur pa dang / snying stobs mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing / sman pa bram ze la gus

verses.skt: cikitsāyām anirvedas tad ārogyasya lakṣaṇam | ity atra janmamaraṇaṃ yataḥ samyag udāhṛtam
verses.tib: gso dpyad rnams la skyo ba med / de ni nad med 'gyur mtshan nyid / rtag tu shis pa sdud pa dang / bkra mi shis pa rnam par spang / 'di dag de nyid mthong ba yi / drang srong rnams kyis shis par bshad / de ltar 'di ni skye dang 'chi / mtshan nyid gang phyir bshad pas na

verses.skt: śarīrasya tataḥ sthānaṃ śārīram idam ucyate
verses.tib: de phyir lus kyi gnas yin pas / 'di ni lus kyi gnas su bshad

verses.skt: rogaḥ pāpmā jvaro vyādhir vikāro duḥkham āmayaḥ | yakṣmātaṅkagadābādhāḥ śabdāḥ paryāyavācinaḥ
verses.tib: nad dang sdig pa rims gnod byed / 'gyur byed sdug bsngal ma zhu'i skyon / zad byed 'tsho dka' mkhun gnod skyed / ming gi rnam grangs sgras bshad do

verses.skt: nidānaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇy upaśayas tathā | saṃprāptiś ceti vijñānaṃ rogāṇāṃ pañcadhā smṛtam
verses.tib: nad gzhi sngar byung tshul dang ni / de bzhin tshul phyed goms byed dang / dkyel gyur shes par byed pa ste / nad ni rnam pa lngar shes bya

verses.skt: nimittahetvāyatanapratyayotthānakāraṇaiḥ | nidānam āhuḥ paryāyaiḥ prāgrūpaṃ yena lakṣyate
verses.tib: gzhi dang rgyu dang skye mched dang / rkyen dang slong bar byed pa'i rgyu / rnam grangs kyis ni nad gzhi bshad / gang gis sngar byung tshul shes pas

verses.skt: utpitsur āmayo doṣaviśeṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitaḥ | liṅgam avyaktam alpatvād vyādhīnāṃ tad yathāyatham
verses.tib: nad ni 'byung bar 'dod gyur la / bye brag phyed par ma gyur ba / nad kyi tshul ni ji bzhin par / chung phyir mtshan nyid mi gsal ba'o

verses.skt: tad eva vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpam ity abhidhīyate | saṃsthānaṃ vyañjanaṃ liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cihnam ākṛtiḥ
verses.tib: de nyid gsal ba nyid gyur pa / tshul phyed pa zhes bya bar bshad / dbyibs dang gsal mngon rtags dang ni / mtshan nyid mtshan ma rnams yin no

verses.skt: hetuvyādhiviparyastaviparyastārthakāriṇām | auṣadhānnavihārāṇām upayogaṃ sukhāvaham
verses.tib: rgyu dang nad dang mi mthun zhing / mi mthun pa yi don byed pa'i / sman dang zas / dang spyod lam rnams / nyer bar bsgyur pas bde 'gyur ba

verses.skt: vidyād upaśayaṃ vyādheḥ sa hi sātmyam iti smṛtaḥ | viparīto ’nupaśayo vyādhyasātmyābhisaṃjñitaḥ
verses.tib: nyams brtas byed par shes bya ste / de ni goms pa zhes byar bshad / de las bzlog pa'i ma goms nad / mi 'phrod nad ces bya ba'o

verses.skt: yathāduṣṭena doṣeṇa yathā cānuvisarpatā | nirvṛttir āmayasyāsau saṃprāptir jātir āgatiḥ
verses.tib: gang gis nad ni dkyil gyur pas / ji bzhin rjes su 'phel 'gyur zhing / nad rnams rdzogs shing mngon gyur pa / skyes shing 'ongs pa dkyel gyur yin

verses.skt: saṃkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālaviśeṣataḥ | sā bhidyate yathātraiva vakṣyante ’ṣṭau jvarā iti
verses.tib: de ni grangs brtag gtso bo dang / stobs dang dus kyis phye ba yin / grangs ni ji ltar 'di nyid las / rim ni brgyad du bshad pa yin / nad rnams spyir ni bsdus pa las / cha shas dbye ba brtag pa yin / rang dbang gzhan dbang gnyis las ni / nad rnams gtso bor bshad pa yin

verses.skt: doṣāṇāṃ samavetānāṃ vikalpo ’ṃśāṃśakalpanā | svātantryapāratantryābhyāṃ vyādheḥ prādhānyam ādiśet
verses.tib: de ni grangs brtag gtso bo dang / stobs dang dus kyis phye ba yin / grangs ni ji ltar 'di nyid las / rim ni brgyad du bshad pa yin / nad rnams spyir ni bsdus pa las / cha shas dbye ba brtag pa yin / rang dbang gzhan dbang gnyis las ni / nad rnams gtso bor bshad pa yin

verses.skt: hetvādikārtsnyāvayavair balābalaviśeṣaṇam | naktandinartubhuktāṃśair vyādhikālo yathāmalam
verses.tib: rgyu ma lus phyogs gcig las / stobs ni che chung shes par bya / nyin mtshan dus dang zas zos chas / nyes pa ji bzhin nad kyi dus

verses.skt: iti prokto nidānārthas taṃ vyāsenopadekṣyati | sarveṣām eva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ
verses.tib: de ltar nad gzhi'i don bshad nas / de ni rgyas par bshad par bya / nad rnams kun gyi nad gzhi ni / nad ni 'khrugs par gyur pa yin

verses.skt: tatprakopasya tu proktaṃ vividhāhitasevanam | ahitaṃ trividho yogas trayāṇāṃ prāg udāhṛtaḥ
verses.tib: de ni gnod 'gyur sna tshogs pa / bsten pas ldang bar 'gyur bar bshad / gsum po'i sbyor ba rnam pa gsum / gnod 'gyur sngar ni bshad pa yin

verses.skt: tiktoṣaṇakaṣāyālparūkṣapramitabhojanaiḥ | dhāraṇodīraṇaniśājāgarātyuccabhāṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: kha dang tsha dang bska / rtsub dang bcud med sra ba dang / bkag dang nan gyis btsir ba dang / mtshan mo mi nyal skad cher smra

verses.skt: kriyātiyogabhīśokacintāvyāyāmamaithunaiḥ | grīṣmāhorātribhuktānte prakupyati samīraṇaḥ
verses.tib: sbyangs pa'i sbyor drags mya ngan 'jigs / sems las drag shul bud med drags / so ga nyin mtshan zas zhu'i rjes / rlung gi nad ni ldang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: pittaṃ kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇapaṭukrodhavidāhibhiḥ | śaranmadhyāhnarātryardhavidāhasamayeṣu ca
verses.tib: mkhris pa tsha dang skyur dang rna / lan tshwa bro dang lus tsha dang / ston ka nyin phyed mtshan phyed dang / tsha ba'i dus su ldang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: svādvamlalavaṇasnigdhagurvabhiṣyandiśītalaiḥ | āsyāsvapnasukhājīrṇadivāsvapnātibṛṃhaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: mngar skyur lan tshwa snum pa dang / lci dang bad kan skyed bsil dang / 'dug dang bde dang gnyid ma zhu / nyin par gnyid log brtas drags dang

verses.skt: pracchardanādyayogena bhuktamātravasantayoḥ | pūrvāhṇe pūrvarātre ca śleṣmā dvandvaṃ tu saṃkarāt
verses.tib: slon sbyor ba nyes pa dang / zos ma thag dang dpyid kyi dus / snga dro mtshan stod bad kan ldang / 'dres pa las ni ldan pa yin

verses.skt: miśrībhāvāt samastānāṃ saṃnipātas tathā punaḥ | saṃkīrṇājīrṇaviṣamaviruddhādhyaśanādibhiḥ
verses.tib: thams cad bsten pas 'dus par 'gyur / de bzhin gzhan yang 'dren mar zos / ma zhu ma snyoms mi 'phrod dang / lhag par zos pa la / dang

verses.skt: vyāpannamadyapānīyaśuṣkaśākāmamūlakaiḥ | piṇyākamṛdyavasurāpūtiśuṣkakṛśāmiṣaiḥ
verses.tib: chang dang btung ba nyes pa dang / tshod ma skam dang la phug rjen / til tshigs sa zhag so ba'i chang / sha rul sha skam sha rid rnams

verses.skt: doṣatrayakarais tais tais tathānnaparivartanāt | ṛtor duṣṭāt purovātād grahāveśād viṣād garāt
verses.tib: de dang de yis nyes gsum skyed / de bzhin kha zas sbos pa dang / dus tshigs log pa bdun gyi rlung

verses.skt: duṣṭānnāt parvatāśleṣād grahair janmarkṣapīḍanāt | mithyāyogāc ca vividhāt pāpānāṃ ca niṣevaṇāt
verses.tib: gdon zhugs dug dang dbyig dug zos / be'u snabs nad 'khrugs ri rtsar gnas / btsas skar la ni gza' zhugs dang / log par sbyor ba sna tshogs dang / sdig pa'i las la brten pa dang

verses.skt: strīṇāṃ prasavavaiṣamyāt tathā mithyopacārataḥ | pratirogam iti kruddhā rogādhiṣṭhānagāminīḥ
verses.tib: bud med bu btsas log par byung / gso ba log par byas las ldang / de ltar so so'i nad ldang bas / nad kyi gnas su 'gro byed pa

verses.skt: rasāyanīḥ prapadyāśu doṣā dehe vikurvate
verses.tib: rtsa sbubs rnams su phyin pa dang / nad rnams lus la myur du skyed

verses.skt: jvaro rogapatiḥ pāpmā mṛtyur ojo'śano ’ntakaḥ | krodho dakṣādhvaradhvaṃsī rudrordhvanayanodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: rims ni nad bdag sdig can dang / 'chi bdag mdangs za 'chi byed yi / khros pas myur ba'i mchod sbyin brlag / drag po dpral ba'i mig las byung

verses.skt: janmāntayor mohamayaḥ saṃtāpātmāpacārajaḥ | vividhair nāmabhiḥ krūro nānāyoniṣu vartate
verses.tib: skye dang 'chi tshe rmongs byed pa / mi 'phrod sna tshogs bsten las byung / mi bzad ming ni sna tshogs pas / skye gnas du ma rnams la gnas

verses.skt: sa jāyate ’ṣṭadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthaṅ miśraiḥ samāgataiḥ | āgantuś ca malās tatra svaiḥ svair duṣṭāḥ pradūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: 'dus dang glo bur las brgyad 'gyur / de la nad rnams rang rang ni / rgyu las 'khrugs te ldang ba yis

verses.skt: āmāśayaṃ praviśyāmam anugamya pidhāya ca | srotāṃsi paktisthānāc ca nirasya jvalanaṃ bahiḥ
verses.tib: ma zhu'i gnas su zhugs gyur pa / lhan cig gnas nas rtsa sgo bkag / zhu ba'i gnas nas me drod ni / phyi rol du ni 'byin par byed

verses.skt: saha tenābhisarpantas tapantaḥ sakalaṃ vapuḥ | kurvanto gātram atyuṣṇaṃ jvaraṃ nirvartayanti te
verses.tib: de dang lhan cig mngon khyab nas / lus kun tsha bar byed pa yin / yan lag shin tu tsha byed pas / rims ni de yis skyed par byed

verses.skt: srotovibandhāt prāyeṇa tataḥ svedo na jāyate | tasya prāgrūpam ālasyam aratir gātragauravam
verses.tib: rtsa sgo bkag pas de 'og tu / rdul ni mang du mi 'byung ngo / de yi sngon tshul sgyid zhan dang / nyams mi dga' zhing lus lci la

verses.skt: āsyavairasyam arucijṛmbhā sāsrākulākṣitā | aṅgamardo ’vipāko ’lpaprāṇatā bahunidratā
verses.tib: ro mi tshor zhing yi ga 'chus / glal 'byung mig 'khrugs mchi mar bcas / yan lag na zhing 'ju stobs chung / nyam chung gnyid ni che ba dang

verses.skt: romaharṣo vinamanaṃ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ klamaḥ | hitopadeśeṣv akṣāntiḥ prītir amlapaṭūṣaṇe
verses.tib: sbu ldang bya rmyang byed 'dod dang / byin pa'i nywa na lus snyom dang / phan par bstan pa mi bzod khro / skyur dang tsha dang drod

verses.skt: dveṣaḥ svāduṣu bhakṣyeṣu tathā bāleṣu tṛḍ bhṛśam | śabdāgniśītavātāmbucchāyoṣṇeṣv animittataḥ
verses.tib: la sred / kha zas mngar ba la mi dga' / byis pa la sdang skom dad che / sgra me grang lhags rlung dang chu

verses.skt: icchā dveṣaś ca tad anu jvarasya vyaktatā bhavet | āgamāpagamakṣobhamṛdutāvedanoṣmaṇām
verses.tib: dga' dang mi dga' dag tu byed / de rjes rims ni gsal bar 'gyur / rims thebs 'byang nye'i tshe nad tshabs / chung zhing tshab mi snyoms la

verses.skt: vaiṣamyaṃ tatra tatrāṅge tās tāḥ syur vedanāś calāḥ | pādayoḥ suptatā stambhaḥ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ śamaḥ
verses.tib: yan lag de dang der 'pho zhing / na bde dang der g.yo 'gyur / rkang pa bems po rengs pa dang / byin snying na zhing ngal ba dang

verses.skt: viśleṣa iva saṃdhīnāṃ sāda ūrvoḥ kaṭīgrahaḥ | pṛṣṭhaṃ kṣodam ivāpnoti niṣpīḍyata ivodaram
verses.tib: tshigs rnams bye ba lta bur sems / brla dang rked pa na ba dang / rgyab ni brdungs pa ltar sems dang / lto ba btsir ba snyam sems dang

verses.skt: chidyanta iva cāsthīni pārśvagāni viśeṣataḥ | hṛdayasya grahas todaḥ prājaneneva vakṣasaḥ
verses.tib: rus pa bcad pa snyam pa dang / rtsib ma lhag par na ba dang / snying ni btsir snyam sems shing zug / brang du btsugs pa lta bur gzer

verses.skt: skandhayor mathanaṃ bāhvor bhedaḥ pīḍanam aṃsayoḥ | aśaktir bhakṣaṇe hanvor jṛmbhaṇaṃ karṇayoḥ svanaḥ
verses.tib: phrag pa brdungs snyam dpung pa ni / bcom snyam sems shing sgrog dus na / 'gram pas kha zas bldad mi nus / glal 'byung rna ba sgra dang bcas

verses.skt: nistodaḥ śaṅkhayor mūrdhni vedanā virasāsyatā | kaṣāyāsyatvam athavā malānām apravartanam
verses.tib: mur 'gram zug cing mgo bo na / lce yis ro ni mi tshor ram / yang na kha bska bro bar 'gyur / dri ma rnams ni sri ba dang

verses.skt: rūkṣāruṇatvagāsyākṣinakhamūtrapurīṣatā | prasekārocakāśraddhāvipākāsvedajāgarāḥ
verses.tib: lpags mig kha dang sen mo dang / bshang sogs rtsub cing dmar ba dang / mchil mang yi ga 'chus sred chung / zas mi 'ju zhing rdul mi 'byung / gnyid yar mchu dang gre bskam / skom dad che zhing lud pa skam

verses.skt: kaṇṭhauṣṭhaśoṣas tṛṭ śuṣkau chardikāsau viṣāditā | harṣo romāṅgadanteṣu vepathuḥ kṣavathor grahaḥ
verses.tib: lud pa lu zhing skyugs pa skam / sems zhum lus kyi ba spu ldang / pags pa so dag brtse ba dang / rkang lag 'dar zhing sbrid pa thogs

verses.skt: bhramaḥ pralāpo gharmecchā vināmaś cānilajvare | yugapad vyāptir aṅgānāṃ pralāpaḥ kaṭuvaktratā
verses.tib: mgo 'khor tshig ni bla ba dang / drod bag la dga' bya rmyang byed / rlung gi rims su shes par bya / lus kun cig car khyab pa dang / bla zhing kha'i ro kha ba dang

verses.skt: nāsāsyapākaḥ śītecchā bhramo mūrchā mado ’ratiḥ | viṭsraṃsaḥ pittavamanaṃ raktaṣṭhīvanam amlakaḥ
verses.tib: bsil 'dod kha snar thor bu 'byung / mgo 'khor brgyal myos snying mi dga' / bshang sla mkhris pa slon pa dang / mchil ma khrag bcas sgregs pa skyur

verses.skt: raktakoṭhodgamaḥ pītaharitatvaṃ tvagādiṣu | svedo niḥśvāsavaigandhyam atitṛṣṇā ca pittaje
verses.tib: thor bu dmar po 'byung ba dang / pags pa la ser rtsa sngo / rdul 'byung dbugs ni mnam pa dang / skom dad rab che mkhris pa'i rims

verses.skt: viśeṣād arucir jāḍyaṃ srotorodho ’lpavegatā | praseko mukhamādhuryaṃ hṛllepaśvāsapīnasāḥ
verses.tib: lhag par yi ga 'chus shing rmongs / bu ga 'gags shing rims shugs dal / mchil mang kha nang mngar ba bro / dang ga lci zhing / dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: hṛllāsaś chardanaṃ kāsaḥ stambhaḥ śvaityaṃ tvagādiṣu | aṅgeṣu śītapiṭikās tandrodardaḥ kaphodbhave
verses.tib: cham btab snying na skyug pa 'byung / lud pa lus rengs lpags skya / yan lag thor bu grang mo 'byung / snyom zhing lus 'dar bad kan rims

verses.skt: kāle yathāsvaṃ sarveṣāṃ pravṛttir vṛddhir eva vā | nidānoktānupaśayo viparītopaśāyitā | yathāsvaṃ liṅgasaṃsarge jvaraḥ saṃsargajo ’pi ca
verses.tib: rang gi dus su thams cad ni / 'byung zhing 'phel ba nyid 'gyur ba / nad gzhir bshad pa'i mi mthun bsten / bsgyur bas bde bar byed pa yin / rang rang mtshan ma 'dres pa ni / ldan pa'i rims yin gzhan yang ni

verses.skt: śiro'rtimūrchāvamidāhamohakaṇṭhāsyaśoṣāratiparvabhedāḥ | unnidratātṛḍbhramaromaharṣā jṛmbhātivāktvaṃ ca calāt sapittāt
verses.tib: mgon brgyal slon lus tsha rmongs bag 'gyur / gre ba kha skam mi dga' rus tshigs na / gnyid mid mgo 'khor spu ldang skom dad che / kha glal tshig mang rlung mkhris 'dres pa'i rims

verses.skt: tāpahānyaruciparvaśirorukpīnasaśvasanakāsavibandhāḥ | śītajāḍyatimirabhramatandrāḥ śleṣmavātajanitajvaraliṅgam
verses.tib: tsha med yi ga 'chus shing klad tshigs na / cham pa lud pa dbugs mi bde bshang sri / khong bsil rmongs bag rab rib mgo 'khor rmya / bad kan rlung 'dres rims kyi mtshan ma yin

verses.skt: śītastambhasvedadāhāvyavasthā tṛṣṇākāsaśleṣmapittapravṛttiḥ | mohas tandrā liptatiktāsyatā ca jñeyaṃ rūpaṃ śleṣmapittajvarasya
verses.tib: lus rdul rengs dang tsha bsil sor mi gnas / skom dad lud pa bad kan mkhris bag 'byung / rmongs bag rmya dang kha bro khar dri chags / bad kan mkhris pa 'dres pa'i rims kyi rtags

verses.skt: sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvair dāho ’tra ca muhur muhuḥ | tadvac chītaṃ mahānidrā divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi
verses.tib: kun nas 'byung ba rtags kun ldan / 'dir yang thang ri tsha ba ldang / de bzhin grang dang nyin mo ni / gnyid che mtshan mo gnyid med byung ba'am

verses.skt: sadā vā naiva vā nidrā mahāsvedo ’ti naiva vā | gītanartanahāsyādivikṛtehāpravartanam
verses.tib: rtag par gnyid 'ong pa'am yang na yar / rdul cher 'byung ba'am rdul mi 'byung / glu dang gar dang dgod pa / spyod pa ngan pa la 'jug cing

verses.skt: sāśruṇī kaluṣe rakte bhugne lulitapakṣmaṇī | akṣiṇī piṇḍikāpārśvamūrdhaparvāsthirugbhramaḥ
verses.tib: mig dmar mchi ma 'dzag dang bcas / zhum zhing rdzi ma 'khrugs par snang / byin snying rtsib logs na ba dang / mgo bo rus tshigs na mgo 'khor

verses.skt: sasvanau sarujau karṇau kaṇṭhaḥ śūkair ivācitaḥ | paridagdhā kharā jihvā gurusrastāṅgasaṃdhitā
verses.tib: rna ba sgra dang nad dang bcas / mgul pa gra mas gang snyam sems / lce rtsub kun nas bsregs ltar snang / lus lci tshigs ni 'bye snyam sems

verses.skt: raktapittakaphaṣṭhīvo lolanaṃ śiraso ’tiruk | koṭhānāṃ śyāvaraktānāṃ maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanam
verses.tib: mchil mar khrag mkhris bad kan 'byung / mgo bo g.yo zhing skom dad che / thor bu 'brum phran mtha' 'khor la / dmar zhing gnag pa 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: hṛdvyathā malasaṃsaṅgaḥ pravṛttir vālpaśo ’ti vā | snigdhāsyatā balabhraṃśaḥ svarasādaḥ pralāpitā
verses.tib: snying na bshang gci sri ba'am / yang na nyung ba'am rab mang 'byung / kha nang snum zhing nyams stobs chung

verses.skt: doṣapākaś cirāt tandrā pratataṃ kaṇṭhakūjanam | saṃnipātam abhinyāsaṃ taṃ brūyāc ca hṛtaujasam
verses.tib: gcom chung 'gyur zhing bla ba dang / nad smin dka' zhing rmugs pa dang / rgyun tu / gre ba 'dzer ba ni

verses.skt: vāyunā kapharuddhena pittam antaḥ prapīḍitam | vyavāyitvāc ca sūkṣmatvād bahirmārgaṃ pravartate
tena hāridranetratvaṃ saṃnipātodbhave jvare
verses.tib: 'dus pa'i rims te mngon rmugs byed / de ni mdangs 'phrog ces kyang bshad

verses.skt: doṣe vibaddhe naṣṭe ’gnau sarvasaṃpūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ | asādhyaḥ so ’nyathā kṛcchro bhaved vaikalyado ’pi vā
verses.tib: nad kyis bkag cing me drod nyams / mtshan ma thams cad rdzogs gyur pa / gsor mi rung te de las gzhan / gso dka' 'am dbang po ma tshang 'gyur

verses.skt: anyac ca saṃnipātottho yatra pittaṃ pṛthak sthitam | tvaci koṣṭhe ’thavā dāhaṃ vidadhāti puro ’nu vā
verses.tib: gzhan yang 'dus pa las byung ba / gang du mkhris pa logs shig gnas / pags pa'am nang grol tsha ba dag / 'debs pa'am tsha ba snga phyis 'byung

verses.skt: tadvad vātakaphau śītaṃ dāhādir dustaras tayoḥ | śītādau tatra pittena kaphe syanditaśoṣite
verses.tib: de bzhin bad kan rlung grang ba / de gnyid tsha snga gso dka' yin / grang snga der ni mkhris pa yis / bad kan gsher ba skam pa dang

verses.skt: śīte śānte ’mlako mūrchā madas tṛṣṇā ca jāyate | dāhādau punar ante syus tandrāṣṭhīvavamiklamāḥ
verses.tib: grang bzhi byes kha sgyur brgyal / myos dang skom dad skye bar 'gyur / tsha ba snga ma de rjes la / rmugs slon mchil mang khod snyom 'gyur

verses.skt: āgantur abhighātābhiṣaṅgaśāpābhicārataḥ | caturdhātra kṣatacchedadāhādyair abhighātajaḥ
verses.tib: glo bur drag shul las byung dang / mngon zin byad byas dmod byung bzhi / de la smas bcad mes tshig / ngal ba drag shul las byung yin

verses.skt: śramāc ca tasmin pavanaḥ prāyo raktaṃ pradūṣayan | savyathāśophavaivarṇyaṃ sarujaṃ kurute jvaram
verses.tib: de ni phal cher rlung nad kyis / khrag ni gnod cing 'khrugs byas pas / na bcas mdog nyams skrang dang bcas / zug gzer bcas pa'i rims skyed 'gyur

verses.skt: grahāveśauṣadhiviṣakrodhabhīśokakāmajaḥ | abhiṣaṅgād graheṇāsminn akasmād dhāsarodane
verses.tib: gdon zhugs sman gyi dri dang dug / khros 'jigs mya ngan gdon las 'byung / mngon par zin las byung rims yin / 'dir gdon rgyu med dgod cing ngu

verses.skt: oṣadhigandhaje mūrchā śirorug vamathuḥ kṣavaḥ | viṣān mūrchātisārāsyaśyāvatādāhahṛdgadāḥ
verses.tib: sman gyi dri bskyed brgyal ba dang / sbid pa glad nad skrangs par 'gyur / dug las brgyal dang tshad par 'khru / mdog nag lus tsha snying nad 'byung

verses.skt: krodhāt kampaḥ śiroruk ca pralāpo bhayaśokaje | kāmād bhramo ’rucir dāho hrīnidrādhīdhṛtikṣayaḥ
verses.tib: khros pas lus 'dar glad nad 'gyur / mya ngan 'jigs las bla bar 'gyur / 'dod las mgo 'khor yid 'chus tsha / ngo tsha gnyid blo brtan nyams 'gyur

verses.skt: grahādau saṃnipātasya bhayādau marutas traye | kopaḥ kope ’pi pittasya yau tu śāpābhicārajau
verses.tib: gdon la sogs pa 'dus pa'i rims / 'jig tshogs gsum ni rlung gi rims / khro las mkhris pa ldang bar 'gyur / dmod pa byad byas las byung gang

verses.skt: saṃnipātajvarau ghorau tāv asahyatamau matau | tatrābhicārikair mantrair hūyamānasya tapyate
verses.tib: 'dus pa'i rims ni mi bzad pa / de ni shin tu bzod dkar bshad / de la byad byas sngags kyis ni / sbyin sreg byas pa bzhin du byas

verses.skt: pūrvaṃ cetas tato dehas tato visphoṭatṛḍbhramaiḥ | sadāhamūrchair grastasya pratyahaṃ vardhate jvaraḥ
verses.tib: thog mar sems 'bab de 'og lus / de nas thor bu mgo 'khor skom / tsha bcas brgyal bas zin gyur ba'i / rims ni nyin re bzhin du 'phel

verses.skt: iti jvaro ’ṣṭadhā dṛṣṭaḥ samāsād vividhas tu saḥ | śārīro mānasaḥ saumyas tīkṣṇo ’ntarbahirāśrayaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar rims ni brgyad du bcas / de dag mdor na rnam gnyis te / lus dang sems kyi rims dang ni / grang dang tsha dang phyi nang gnas

verses.skt: prākṛto vaikṛtaḥ sādhyo ’sādhyaḥ sāmo nirāmakaḥ | pūrvaṃ śarīre śārīre tāpo manasi mānase
verses.tib: rang bzhin dang ni gyur ba dang / gsor rung gsor mi rung ba dang / smin dang ma smin zhes bya'o / lus rims thog mar lus tsha byed / sems kyi dang por snying tsha 'gyur

verses.skt: pavane yogavāhitvāc chītaṃ śleṣmayute bhavet | dāhaḥ pittayute miśraṃ miśre ’ntaḥsaṃśraye punaḥ
verses.tib: 'byung tshe grang ba'i rims su 'gyur / mkhris pa dang ldan tsha ba ste / 'dres pas 'dres pa'o nang gnas pa

verses.skt: jvare ’dhikaṃ vikārāḥ syur antaḥ kṣobho malagrahaḥ | bahir eva bahirvege tāpo ’pi ca susādhyatā
verses.tib: rims nad dkyel ni bskyed 'gyur nas / nang na na zhing bshang gci sri / phyi rol rims ni tsha ba dang / phyi rol gnas pa gso bar sla

verses.skt: varṣāśaradvasanteṣu vātādyaiḥ prākṛtaḥ kramāt | vaikṛto ’nyaḥ sa duḥsādhyaḥ prāyaś ca prākṛto ’nilāt
verses.tib: dbyar dang ston dang dpyid dus su / rlung rim 'byung rang bzhin rims / gzhan du gyur pa de gso dka' / phal cher rlung ni rang bzhin rims

verses.skt: varṣāsu māruto duṣṭaḥ pittaśleṣmānvito jvaram | kuryāt pittaṃ ca śaradi tasya cānubalaṃ kaphaḥ
verses.tib: dbyar dus rlung nad ldang 'gyur na / mkhris pa bad kan ldan rims 'gyur / ston ka mkhris bas nad slong ste / bad kan de yi grogs byed 'gyur

verses.skt: tatprakṛtyā visargāc ca tatra nānaśanād bhayam | kapho vasante tam api vātapittaṃ bhaved anu
verses.tib: der ni smyung ba byas gyur kyang / gnod par 'gyur ba ma yin no / bad kan dpyid ldang de yang ni / de rjes rlung dang mkhris pa 'byung

verses.skt: balavatsv alpadoṣeṣu jvaraḥ sādhyo ’nupadravaḥ | sarvathā vikṛtijñāne prāg asādhya udāhṛtaḥ
verses.tib: nyams stobs che zhing nad tshabs chung / bla brnan med rims gso bar sla / rnam kun 'gyur bzhes bya bar / gsor mi rung ba sngar bshad do

verses.skt: jvaropadravatīkṣṇatvam aglānir bahumūtratā | na pravṛttir na viḍ jīrṇā na kṣut sāmajvarākṛtiḥ
verses.tib: rims kyi nad tshabs che zhing tsha / khong rmya nyam chung gcin mang dang / bshang sri kha zas mi 'ju la / bkres chung ma smin rims mtshan nyid

verses.skt: jvaravego ’dhikaṃ tṛṣṇā pralāpaḥ śvasanaṃ bhramaḥ | malapravṛttir utkleśaḥ pacyamānasya lakṣaṇam
verses.tib: rims shugs stobs che skom dad che / bla zhing mgo 'khor dbugs mi bde / bshang gci bder 'byung nad bskyod pa / smin par 'gyur pa'i mtshan ma yin

verses.skt: jīrṇatāmaviparyāsāt saptarātraṃ ca laṅghanāt | jvaraḥ pañcavidhaḥ prokto malakālabalābalāt
verses.tib: ma smin go bzlog mtshan nyid dang / zhag bdun smyung byas las smin bshad / rims ni nad kyi dus dang ni / stobs chung che las rnam lngar bshad

verses.skt: prāyaśaḥ saṃnipātena bhūyasā tūpadiśyate | saṃtataḥ satato ’nyedyus tṛtīyakacaturthakau
verses.tib: phal cher 'dus par gyur ba yi / rims su mang du 'gyur bar bshad / rgyun dang rtag pa nyin gcig pa / nyin gsum pa dang nyin bzhi ba'o

verses.skt: dhātumūtraśakṛdvāhisrotasāṃ vyāpino malāḥ | tāpayantas tanuṃ sarvāṃ tulyadūṣyādivardhitāḥ
verses.tib: lus zungs bshang gci rgyu ba yi / bu gnad kyis khyab byas pas / lus kun tsha bar gyur nas ni / gnod bya dang mnyam par 'phel

verses.skt: balino guravaḥ stabdhā viśeṣeṇa rasāśritāḥ | saṃtataṃ niṣpratidvandvā jvaraṃ kuryuḥ suduḥsaham
verses.tib: stobs che lus lci rkang lag rengs / khyad par du ni / dngas mar gnas / gnyen pos bcos dka' bzod par dka' / rgyun gyi rims su 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: malaṃ jvaroṣmā dhātūn vā sa śīghraṃ kṣapayet tataḥ | sarvākāraṃ rasādīnāṃ śuddhyāśuddhyāpi vā kramāt
verses.tib: de yi drod kyis dri ma dang / lus zungs myur du zad par byed / de 'og rnam kun lus zungs / dag pa'am ma dag rims kyis ni

verses.skt: vātapittakaphaiḥ sapta daśa dvādaśa vāsarān | prāyo ’nuyāti maryādāṃ mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca
verses.tib: rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan zhag / bdun nam bcu'am bcu gnyis gnas / phal cher mtshams las mi 'da' bar / 'tsho ba'am 'chi ba dag tu byed

verses.skt: ity agniveśasya mataṃ hārītasya punaḥ smṛtiḥ | dviguṇā saptamī yāvan navamy ekādaśī tathā
verses.tib: de skad me bzhin 'jug gis bshad / ljang sngon gyis ni bshad pa'i gzhung / bdun pa nyis bldab gyur ba yin / de bzhin dgu dang bcu gcig bldab

verses.skt: eṣā tridoṣamaryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca | śuddhyaśuddhau jvaraḥ kālaṃ dīrgham apy anuvartate
verses.tib: 'di ni nad gzhi gsum gyis tshigs / 'tsho dang 'chi bar byed pa yin / rims dus dag dang ma dag las / yun dus su gnas pa yin

verses.skt: kṛśānāṃ vyādhimuktānāṃ mithyāhārādisevinām | alpo ’pi doṣo dūṣyāder labdhvānyatamato balam
verses.tib: nad rtse zhil ba nyam chung dang / kha zas mi 'phrod bsten pas / nad dkyel chung yang gnod bya / brten te stobs che nyid gyur las

verses.skt: savipakṣo jvaraṃ kuryād viṣamaṃ kṣayavṛddhibhāk | doṣaḥ pravartate teṣāṃ sve kāle jvarayan balī
verses.tib: gnyen por bcas shing 'phel 'bri gnas / mi bzad pa ni nyid du 'gyur / de rnams kyis ni nad kyi stobs / rang gi dus su rims stobs skyed

verses.skt: nivartate punaś caiṣa pratyanīkabalābalaḥ | kṣīṇe doṣe jvaraḥ sūkṣmo rasādiṣv eva līyate
verses.tib: slar yang de dag bcos thabs kyis / stobs che chung las ldog par byed / nad zad rims ni phrar gyur pa / bcud la sogs pa nyid la thim

verses.skt: līnatvāt kārśyavaivarṇyajāḍyādīn ādadhāti saḥ | āsannavivṛtāsyatvāt srotasāṃ rasavāhinām
verses.tib: thim pas lus rid sha mdog nyams / rmongs bag la sogs de yis skyed / nye zhing kha ni bye ba'i phyir / dngas ma rgyu ba'i rtsa sgo las

verses.skt: āśu sarvasya vapuṣo vyāptir doṣeṇa jāyate | saṃtataḥ satatas tena viparīto viparyayāt
verses.tib: lus kun myur du khyab pa ni / nad kyis skye bar byed pa yin / des na rgyun tu rtag rims 'gyur / de las bzlog pa tshul mi 'dra

verses.skt: viṣamo viṣamārambhakriyākālo ’nuṣaṅgavān | doṣo raktāśrayaḥ prāyaḥ karoti satataṃ jvaram
verses.tib: mi snyoms rtsol ba mi mnyam pa / bya ba'i dus min mnyam yun ring / de ni nyin mtshan lan gnyis ldang / gzhan dag nyin re lan re yin / phal cher nad ni khrag la brten / rtag pa'i rims ni byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: ahorātrasya sa dviḥ syāt sakṛd anyedyur āśritaḥ | tasmin māṃsavahā nāḍīr medonāḍīs tṛtīyake
verses.tib: de yang nyin mtshan lan gnyis ldang / nyin gcig nyin re lan re ldang / de ni sha yi rtsa la brten / gsum pa tshil gyi rtsa la gnas

verses.skt: grāhī pittānilān mūrdhnas trikasya kaphapittataḥ | sapṛṣṭhasyānilakaphāt sa caikāhāntaraḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa rlung gnyis spyi nas 'dzin / bad kan mkhris gyur sum mdo na / rlung dang bad kan rgyab nas 'dzin / de ni zhag gcig gis chod yin

verses.skt: caturthako male medomajjāsthyanyatamasthite | majjastha evety apare prabhāvaṃ sa tu darśayet
verses.tib: nyin bzhi pa'i rims / nad tshil dang / rkang dang rus pa'i nang na gnas / gzhan dag tshil nyid la gnas zer / de yi nus pa bstan pa ni

verses.skt: dvidhā kaphena jaṅghābhyāṃ sa pūrvaṃ śiraso ’nilāt | asthimajjobhayagate caturthakaviparyayaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan gyis ni byin gnyis na / rlung gis na bar byed / rus rkang gnyis kar zhugs pa yin / nyin bzhi pa ni go bzlog pa'o

verses.skt: tridhā dvyahaṃ jvarayati dinam ekaṃ tu muñcati | balābalena doṣāṇām annaceṣṭādijanmanā
verses.tib: nyin gsum pas ni nyin gnyis na / nyin cig na bar mi byed do / nad rnams kyi ni stobs che chung / zas dang spyod pa las 'byung zhing

verses.skt: jvaraḥ syān manasas tadvat karmaṇaś ca tadā tadā | doṣadūṣyartvahorātraprabhṛtīnāṃ balāj jvaraḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin rims rnams 'byung ba ni / yid dang las las skye bar 'gyur / nad kyis lus zungs dkrugs gyur pa / nad sos nyi tshe zhu bar 'gyur

verses.skt: manaso viṣayāṇāṃ ca kālaṃ taṃ taṃ prapadyate | dhātūn prakṣobhayan doṣo mokṣakāle vilīyate
tato naraḥ śvasan svidyan kūjan vamati ceṣṭate | vepate pralapaty uṣṇaiḥ śītaiś cāṅgair hataprabhaḥ
verses.tib: de tshe nad ba dbugs drag rdul / mkhun zhing slon byed 'gre ba dang / lus 'dar tshig mang tshab dang / lus grang bzhin mdog nyams pa dang

verses.skt: visaṃjño jvaravegārtaḥ sakrodha iva vīkṣate | sadoṣaśabdaṃ ca śakṛd dravaṃ sṛjati vegavat
verses.tib: dran stor rims kyi shugs kyis gzir / khros pa'i tshul gyis lta ba dang / bshang ba nad dang sgrar bcas pa / sla ba shugs drag 'byung ba yin

verses.skt: deho laghur vyapagataklamamohatāpaḥ pāko mukhe karaṇasauṣṭhavam avyathatvam | svedaḥ kṣavaḥ prakṛtiyogi mano ’nnalipsā kaṇḍūś ca mūrdhni vigatajvaralakṣaṇāni
verses.tib: lus ni yang zhing rmya dang rmongs bag tsha ba med / kha na thor bu 'byung dang dbang po brtas shing bde / yid ni sor gnas rdul sbrid bder 'byung yi ga 'byed / mgo bo g.ya' ba rims nad 'byang ba'i mtshan ma yin

verses.skt: bhṛśoṣṇatīkṣṇakaṭvamlalavaṇādividāhibhiḥ | kodravoddālakaiś cānnais tadyuktair atisevitaiḥ
verses.tib: rab dro rab rno tsha dang skyur / lan tshwa la sogs tsha ba dang / khre rgod ut+pa la yi zas / de bcas shin tu bsten drags dang

verses.skt: kupitaṃ pittalaiḥ pittaṃ dravaṃ raktaṃ ca mūrchite | te mithas tulyarūpatvam āgamya vyāpnutas tanum
verses.tib: mkhris pa can gyi mkhris nad ni / gsher dang khrag rgyas nad du 'gyur / de ni phan tshun 'dres gyur bas / lus kun khyab par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: pittaṃ raktasya vikṛteḥ saṃsargād dūṣaṇād api | gandhavarṇānuvṛtteś ca raktena vyapadiśyate
verses.tib: mkhris pa khrag las gyur pa dang / 'dres dang gnod bya las dang gcig / mdog dang dri ni rjes mthun pas / khrag gi ming du bstan pa yin

verses.skt: prabhavaty asṛjaḥ sthānāt plīhato yakṛtaś ca tat | śirogurutvam aruciḥ śītecchā dhūmako ’mlakaḥ
verses.tib: de ni khrag gnas mchin pa dang / mcher pa las ni 'byung bar 'gyur / mgo bo lci zhing yi ga 'chus / bsil 'dod sgregs pa dud can skyur

verses.skt: chardiś charditabaibhatsyaṃ kāsaḥ śvāso bhramaḥ klamaḥ | lohalohitamatsyāmagandhāsyatvaṃ svarakṣayaḥ
verses.tib: lud pa dbugs mi bde mgo 'khor / khong snyom khrag dmar nya dri bro / kha dri mi zhim skad 'gags la

verses.skt: raktahāridraharitavarṇatā nayanādiṣu | nīlalohitapītānāṃ varṇānām avivecanam
verses.tib: mig la pa'i kha dog ni / dmar dang ljang dang ser por snang

verses.skt: svapne tadvarṇadarśitvaṃ bhavaty asmin bhaviṣyati | ūrdhvaṃ nāsākṣikarṇāsyair meḍhrayonigudair adhaḥ
verses.tib: rmi lam du yang kha dog de / 'dir ni mthong bar 'gyur ba yin / stod du sna mig rna ba kha / smad du bshang sgo pho mo'i mtshan

verses.skt: kupitaṃ romakūpaiś ca samastais tat pravartate | ūrdhvaṃ sādhyaṃ kaphād yasmāt tad virecanasādhanam
verses.tib: ba spu'i bu ga kun las kyang / khrag rab rgyas pa 'byung bar 'gyur / stod kyi bad kan yin gso sla / de ni bkru sman btang bas gso

verses.skt: bahvauṣadhaṃ ca pittasya vireko hi varauṣadham | anubandhī kapho yaś ca tatra tasyāpi śuddhikṛt
verses.tib: sman mang yod cing / mkhris pa yi / sman gyi mchog ni bkru sman yin / zla la yod pa'i bad kan yang / der ni de yis sbyangs byas 'gyur

verses.skt: kaṣāyāḥ svādavo ’py asya viśuddhaśleṣmaṇo hitāḥ | kim u tiktāḥ kaṣāyā vā ye nisargāt kaphāpahāḥ
verses.tib: de la sman ni mngar dang bska / bad kan dag la phan pa la / gang gtogs ngang gis bad kan sel / kha dang bska ba smos ci dgos

verses.skt: adho yāpyaṃ calād yasmāt tat pracchardanasādhanam | alpauṣadhaṃ ca pittasya vamanaṃ na varauṣadham
verses.tib: thur du 'byung ba'i rlung yin phyir / de ni skyug sman btang bas gso / mkhris pa'i sman ni nyung ba yin / skyug sman mkhris pa'i sman mchog yin

verses.skt: anubandhī calo yaś ca śāntaye ’pi na tasya tat | kaṣāyāś ca hitās tasya madhurā eva kevalam
verses.tib: zla la yod pa'i rlung nad kyang / de ni de yis zhi mi 'gyur / de la ro ni mngar bskol ba / 'ba' zhig phan par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: kaphamārutasaṃsṛṣṭam asādhyam ubhayāyanam | aśakyaprātilomyatvād abhāvād auṣadhasya ca
verses.tib: bad kan rlung ni 'dres pa'i nad / gnyi gar 'byung ba gso dka' ste / bzlog pa'i thabs ni med phyir dang / sman yang yod pa ma yin no

verses.skt: na hi saṃśodhanaṃ kiñcid asty asya pratilomagam | śodhanaṃ pratilomaṃ ca raktapitte bhiṣagjitam
verses.tib: 'di las bzlog par bya ba'i thabs / sbyang ba'ang yod pa ma yin te / sbyangs pas bzlog par bya ba dang / sman pas khrag mkhris gso ba yin

verses.skt: evam evopaśamanaṃ sarvaśo nāsya vidyate | saṃsṛṣṭeṣu hi doṣeṣu sarvajic chamanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: mkhris pa nye bar zhi ba yang / 'di las yong ye yod ma yin / 'dres par gyur ba'i nad la ni / thams cad sel ba'i zhi bya phan

verses.skt: tatra doṣānugamanaṃ sirāsra iva lakṣayet | upadravāṃś ca vikṛtijñānatas teṣu cādhikam
verses.tib: de la nad dang rjes mthun pa'i / gtar ga btab ste brtag par bya / bla brnan byung bar gyur pa dag / 'gyur bar shes las rtogs par bya

verses.skt: āśukārī yataḥ kāsas tam evātaḥ pravakṣyati | pañca kāsāḥ smṛtā vātapittaśleṣmakṣatakṣayaiḥ
verses.tib: de la lud pa myur gnod byed / de phyir de nyid bshad par bya / lud pa rlung mkhris bad kan dang / glo rdol glo gcong la lngar bshad

verses.skt: kṣayāyopekṣitāḥ sarve balinaś cottarottaram | teṣāṃ bhaviṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ kaṇṭhe kaṇḍūr arocakaḥ
verses.tib: thams cad ma gsos zad byed 'gyur / phyi ma bzhin du stobs chen yin / de rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rtags / gre ba g.ya' zhing yi ga 'chus / gre nang gra mas gang snyam sems / de la thur rgyu'i rlung gnod 'gyur / stod du song ste brang du phyin / de tshe mgul ba'i nad du zhen

verses.skt: śūkapūrṇābhakaṇṭhatvaṃ tatrādho vihato ’nilaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ pravṛttaḥ prāpyoras tasmin kaṇṭhe ca saṃsajan
verses.tib: thams cad ma gsos zad byed 'gyur / phyi ma bzhin du stobs chen yin / de rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rtags / gre ba g.ya' zhing yi ga 'chus / gre nang gra mas gang snyam sems / de la thur rgyu'i rlung gnod 'gyur / stod du song ste brang du phyin / de tshe mgul ba'i nad du zhen

verses.skt: śiraḥsrotāṃsi saṃpūrya tato ’ṅgāny utkṣipann iva | kṣipann ivākṣiṇī pṛṣṭham uraḥ pārśve ca pīḍayan
verses.tib: mgo ba'i rtsa rnams bkang nas ni / de nas yan lag 'degs pa ltar / g.yengs byed mig rdol tsam du na / rgyab brang rtsib logs na zhing zug

verses.skt: pravartate sa vaktreṇa bhinnakāṃsyopamadhvaniḥ | hetubhedāt pratīghātabhedo vāyoḥ saraṃhasaḥ
verses.tib: kha ru 'byung zhing rgyu ba ni / lud pa snod chag 'dra'i sgra 'byung / nad gzhi'i dbye bas nad kyang ni / tha dang shugs dang bcas pa yin

verses.skt: yad rujāśabdavaiṣamyaṃ kāsānāṃ jāyate tataḥ | kupito vātalair vātaḥ śuṣkoraḥkaṇṭhavaktratām
verses.tib: nad gang sgra ni mi snyoms pa'i / de las lud pa 'byung ba yin / rlung nad skyes pa rlung 'khrugs pa / brang dang gre ba skam zhing

verses.skt: hṛtpārśvoraḥśiraḥśūlaṃ mohakṣobhasvarakṣayān | karoti śuṣkaṃ kāsaṃ ca mahāvegarujāsvanam
verses.tib: snying brang rtsib logs klad pa gzer / rmongs bag khong 'khrugs skad 'gags shing / lud pa skam po 'byung byed cing / na ba'i shugs drag sgra cher 'byung

verses.skt: so ’ṅgaharṣī kaphaṃ śuṣkaṃ kṛcchrān muktvālpatāṃ vrajet | pittāt pītākṣikaphatā tiktāsyatvaṃ jvaro bhramaḥ
verses.tib: lus kun brtse bcas bad kan skam / 'thon par dka' zhing nyung ngu 'byung / mkhris pas mig dang bad kan ser / kha nang kha zhing rims mgo 'khor

verses.skt: pittāsṛgvamanaṃ tṛṣṇā vaisvaryaṃ dhūmako ’mlakaḥ | pratataṃ kāsavegena jyotiṣām iva darśanam
verses.tib: khrag mkhris slon zhing skom / dad che / skad 'gags dud 'dra skyur ba dang / lud pa'i shugs kyi rgyun 'byung ba / skar mda' 'phro ba lta bur snang

verses.skt: kaphād uro ’lparuṅ mūrdhahṛdayaṃ stimitaṃ guru | kaṇṭhopalepaḥ sadanaṃ pīnasacchardyarocakāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las brang nad tshabs chung / mgo lci snying ga gang snyam sems / gre bar bskus 'dra snyom par byed / cham 'debs zas skyug yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: romaharṣo ghanasnigdhaśvetaśleṣmapravartanam | yuddhādyaiḥ sāhasais tais taiḥ sevitair ayathābalam
verses.tib: spu rtse lud pa skam pa dang / snum zhing dkar ba 'byung bar 'gyur / stobs 'gyed la sogs drag shul rnams / mi nus bzhin byas de dang des

verses.skt: urasy antaḥkṣate vāyuḥ pittenānugato balī | kupitaḥ kurute kāsaṃ kaphaṃ tena saśoṇitam
verses.tib: rlung gis brang nang glo dral la / mkhris pa rjes 'brangs dkyel gyur pa / 'khrugs te lud pa lu bar byed / de ni bad kan khrag bcas dang

verses.skt: pītaṃ śyāvaṃ ca śuṣkaṃ ca grathitaṃ kuthitaṃ bahu | ṣṭhīvet kaṇṭhena rujatā vibhinneneva corasā
verses.tib: ser zhing gnag la skam pa dang / ril ril por mnam mang du 'byung / 'byung tshe gre ba na ba dang / brang ni dral ba snyam du sems

verses.skt: sūcībhir iva tīkṣṇābhis tudyamānena śūlinā | parvabhedajvaraśvāsatṛṣṇāvaisvaryakampavān
verses.tib: khab ni rnon pos phug snyam sems / gzer gyis 'debs par byed pa dang / tshigs 'bye rims dang dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: pārāvata ivākūjan pārśvaśūlī tato ’sya ca | kramād vīryaṃ ruciḥ paktā balaṃ varṇaś ca hīyate
verses.tib: skad 'gags lus 'dar skom dad che / phug ron lta bur mkhun 'byin to / rtsib logs gzer 'gyur de nas ni / rim gyis stobs dang me drod dang / nus pa nyams ni 'bri bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kṣīṇasya sāsṛṅmūtratvaṃ syāc ca pṛṣṭhakaṭīgrahaḥ | vāyupradhānāḥ kupitā dhātavo rājayakṣmiṇaḥ
verses.tib: zad byed kyis gcin khrag dang bcas / rgyab dang rkang pa na bar 'gyur / gtso bo rlung ni 'khrugs pa yis / lus zungs zad byed nad rgyal bo

verses.skt: kurvanti yakṣmāyatanaiḥ kāsaṃ ṣṭhīvet kaphaṃ tataḥ | pūtipūyopamaṃ pītaṃ visraṃ haritalohitam
verses.tib: glo gcong gi ni gnas byed cing / lud pa lu zhing bad kan 'byung / rnag 'dra mnam zhing ser ba dang / rul zhing rtsa sngo dmar ba dang

verses.skt: lucyete iva pārśve ca hṛdayaṃ patatīva ca | akasmād uṣṇaśītecchā bahvāśitvaṃ balakṣayaḥ
verses.tib: rtsib logs bton pa ltar sems shing / snying ni ltung bsnyam du byed / rgyu med dro dang grang ba 'dod / zas mang za zhing nyams stobs zad

verses.skt: snigdhaprasannavaktratvaṃ śrīmaddarśananetratā | tato ’sya kṣayarūpāṇi sarvāṇy āvirbhavanti ca
verses.tib: bzhin ni snum zhing dang bar snang / mig ni mdang ldan pa lta sdug 'gyur / de nas de las zad byed 'gyur / thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: ity eṣa kṣayajaḥ kāsaḥ kṣīṇānāṃ dehanāśanaḥ | yāpyo vā balināṃ tadvat kṣatajo ’bhinavau tu tau
verses.tib: de ltar glo rdol las byung lud / nyam chung lus ni 'jig byed de / stobs ldan gso ba brtsam du rung / glo gcong las byung de dang 'dra

verses.skt: sidhyetām api sānāthyāt sādhyā doṣaiḥ pṛthak trayaḥ | miśrā yāpyā dvayāt sarve jarasā sthavirasya ca
verses.tib: de gnyis gsar byung mgon ldan 'grub / nad gzhi tha dad gsum gsor rung / gnyis 'dres kun kyang rgan po ni / na tshod zad btab 'tsho btsam

verses.skt: kāsāc chvāsakṣayacchardisvarasādādayo gadāḥ | bhavanty upekṣayā yasmāt tasmāt taṃ tvarayā jayet
verses.tib: lud pa yal bar bor ba las / dbugs mi bde dang zad byed slon / skad 'gags la sogs nad 'byung 'gyur / de phyir de ni myur du gso

verses.skt: kāsavṛddhyā bhavec chvāsaḥ pūrvair vā doṣakopanaiḥ | āmātīsāravamathuviṣapāṇḍujvarair api
verses.tib: lud pa 'phel ba'am sngar nad gzhi / 'khrugs las dbugs mi bde 'byung 'gyur / ma zhu tshad 'khru slon dug 'thungs

verses.skt: rajodhūmānilair marmaghātād atihimāmbunā | kṣudrakas tamakaś chinno mahān ūrdhvaś ca pañcamaḥ
verses.tib: skya rbab rims btab las kyang 'byung / phran tshegs mun can chad pa dang / chen po gyen 'byung rnam pa lnga

verses.skt: kaphoparuddhagamanaḥ pavano viṣvagāsthitaḥ | prāṇodakānnavāhīni duṣṭaḥ srotāṃsi dūṣayan
verses.tib: bad kan gyis ni rgyu lam bkag / rlung ni sna tshogs khyab par gnas / srog dang zas skom rgyu ba'i lam / sbu gu nad kyis bkag pas na

verses.skt: uraḥsthaḥ kurute śvāsam āmāśayasamudbhavam | prāgrūpaṃ tasya hṛtpārśvaśūlaṃ prāṇavilomatā
verses.tib: ma zhu'i gnas nas 'byung ba'i dbugs / brang gnas dbugs mi bde bar byed / de yi sngon tshul snying rtsib logs

verses.skt: ānāhaḥ śaṅkhabhedaś ca tatrāyāsātibhojanaiḥ | preritaḥ prerayet kṣudraṃ svayaṃ saṃśamanaṃ marut
verses.tib: gzer zhing srog rlung mi mthun rgyu / spos dang mur 'gram na ba yin / des ni drag shul 'grangs drags pas / bskyod pa'i rngam pa phran tshegs 'gyur / de ni rang nyid zhi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: pratilomaṃ sirā gacchann udīrya pavanaḥ kapham | parigṛhya śirogrīvam uraḥ pārśve ca pīḍayan
verses.tib: rlung gis rtsa sbubs logs rgyu byed / bad kan slongs par gyur nas ni / klad pa mgul ba'i nang song ste / brang dang rtsib logs na bar byed

verses.skt: kāsaṃ ghurghurakaṃ moham arucim pīnasaṃ tṛṣam | karoti tīvravegaṃ ca śvāsaṃ prāṇopatāpinam
verses.tib: lud pa ngar sgra 'dzer mi dran / cham pa mi bzad yi ga 'chus / mi bzad shugs ni skyed byed cing

verses.skt: pratāmyet tasya vegena niṣṭhyūtānte kṣaṇaṃ sukhī | kṛcchrāc chayānaḥ śvasiti niṣaṇṇaḥ svāsthyam ṛcchati
verses.tib: dbugs mi bde bde'i shugs kyis / srog la gnod 'gyur lud pa'i mthar / skad cig bde bar byed pa yin / nyal tshe shin tu mi bde la / 'dug na cung zad bde bar 'gyur

verses.skt: ucchritākṣo lalāṭena svidyatā bhṛśam artimān | viśuṣkāsyo muhuḥśvāsī kāṅkṣaty uṣṇaṃ savepathuḥ
verses.tib: mig gdangs 'phral ba'i phyogs nas ni / rngul 'dzag shin tu na bas nyen / kha skam dbugs ni bstud mar 'byung / dro ba 'dod cing 'dar dang bcas

verses.skt: meghāmbuśītaprāgvātaiḥ śleṣmalaiś ca vivardhate | sa yāpyas tamako sādhyo navo vā balino bhavet
verses.tib: char 'bab grang dang ser bus phog / bad kan bskyed pas rnam par 'phel / mun can de ni 'tsho bya tsam / nyams ldan gsar du btab gso sla

verses.skt: jvaramūrchāyutaḥ śītaiḥ śāmyet pratamakas tu saḥ | chinnāc chvasiti vicchinnaṃ marmacchedarujārditaḥ
verses.tib: rims dang brgyal las byung gang ba'i / sman gyis zhi ste rab mun can / dbugs 'chad dbugs 'byin rgyun chad pa'i / gnad gcod nad kyis gzir bar byed

verses.skt: sasvedamūrchaḥ sānāho vastidāhanirodhavān | adhodṛg viplutākṣaś ca muhyan raktaikalocanaḥ
verses.tib: rngul bcas brgyal dang spos dang bcas / lgang pa tsha zhing gcin 'gags byed / mig mi sdug cing thur du lta / mig gcig dmar zhing dran pa stor

verses.skt: śuṣkāsyaḥ pralapan dīno naṣṭacchāyo vicetanaḥ | mahatā mahatā dīno nādena śvasiti krathan
verses.tib: kha skam smre zhing skad gdangs dma' / gzim dngas nyams shing sems bral ba'o / chen por ro cher 'byung zhing / sgra che sdur pa drag pa dang

verses.skt: uddhūyamānaḥ saṃrabdho mattarṣabha ivāniśam | praṇaṣṭajñānavijñāno vibhrāntanayanānanaḥ
verses.tib: bskyod pa bzhin du 'byung 'gyur zhing / khyu mchog rgyags pa'i nga ro 'dra / shes dang rnam shes rab nyams shing / mig 'khrul bzhin ni 'gyur ba dang

verses.skt: vakṣaḥ samākṣipan baddhamūtravarcā viśīrṇavāk | śuṣkakaṇṭho muhur muhyan karṇaśaṅkhaśiro'tiruk
verses.tib: ro stod zhum par 'gyur ba dang / bshang gci 'gags shing skad gsang nyams / mgul skam yang dang yang mi dran / rna ba mur 'gram klad pa na

verses.skt: dīrgham ūrdhvaṃ śvasity ūrdhvān na ca pratyāharaty adhaḥ | śleṣmāvṛtamukhasrotāḥ kruddhagandhavahārditaḥ
verses.tib: gyen 'byung dbugs ni ring du 'byin / slar ni thur du rngub mi nus / bad kan gyis kha rtsa sgo 'gags / rlung ni 'khrugs pas gzir 'gyur ba

verses.skt: ūrdhvadṛg vīkṣate bhrāntam akṣiṇī paritaḥ kṣipan | marmasu cchidyamāneṣu paridevī niruddhavāk
verses.tib: gyen du blta zhing 'khrul byed pas / mig ni kun tu lta byed pa / gnad rnams / 'chad par byed bzhin du / skad 'gags smre sngags 'don par byed

verses.skt: ete sidhyeyur avyaktā vyaktāḥ prāṇaharā dhruvam | śvāsaikahetuprāgrūpasaṃkhyāprakṛtisaṃśrayāḥ
verses.tib: 'di dag ma tshang gsor rung la / tshang na nges par srog 'phrog byed / dbugs mi bde rgyu sngon tshul dang / grangs dang rang bzhin rten gcig yin

verses.skt: hidhmā bhaktodbhavā kṣudrā yamalā mahatīti ca | gambhīrā ca marut tatra tvarayāyuktisevitaiḥ
verses.tib: skyigs bu thas byung phran tshegs dang / zung dang chen por 'byung ba dang / za bdag dang rnam pa lnga / de la rlung gis ring zos dang

verses.skt: rūkṣatīkṣṇakharāsātmyair annapānaiḥ prapīḍitaḥ | karoti hidhmām arujāṃ mandaśabdāṃ kṣavānugām
verses.tib: rtsub tsha sra dang ma goms pa'i / zas dang skom gyis btsir gyur pa'i / rlung gis skyigs bu nad med dang / sgra mi grag cing sbrid 'byung ste

verses.skt: śamaṃ sātmyānnapānena yā prayāti ca sānnajā | āyāsāt pavanaḥ kṣudraḥ kṣudrāṃ hidhmāṃ pravartayet
verses.tib: gang zhig goms pa'i zas skom gyis / zhi 'gyur skyigs bu zas byung yin / drag shul gyis rlung cung zad be skyod

verses.skt: jatrumūlapravisṛtām alpavegāṃ mṛduṃ ca sā | vṛddhim āyāsyato yāti bhuktamātre ca mārdavam
verses.tib: skyigs bu phra mo 'byung bar 'gyur / nam tshong rtsa ba nas 'byung byed / de ni shul ngal 'jam pa yin / rtsol ba drag po 'phel 'gyur la / zas zos tsam gyis dal bar 'gyur

verses.skt: cireṇa yamalair vegair āhāre yā pravartate | pariṇāmonmukhe vṛddhiṃ pariṇāme ca gacchati
verses.tib: gang zhig zas las 'byung 'gyur ba / 'ju bar nye ba'i tshe na 'dabs / zas zhu zin nas 'phel 'gyur ba'o

verses.skt: kampayantī śirogrīvam ādhmātasyātitṛṣyataḥ | pralāpacchardyatīsāranetraviplutijṛmbhiṇaḥ
verses.tib: mgo dang mgul pa 'dar byed cing / sbo dang shin tu skom dad skyed / bla dang slon dang tshad par 'khru / mig gdangs glal ni 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: yamalā veginī hidhmā pariṇāmavatī ca sā | stabdhabhrūśaṅkhayugmasya sāsraviplutacakṣuṣaḥ
verses.tib: skyigs bu zung 'byung shugs drag la / zhu dang bcas par de shes bya / skyigs bu chen po 'byung ba'i tshul / smin ma mur 'gram gnyis rengs shing / mi gnas ma chi 'dzag har bar lta

verses.skt: stambhayantī tanuṃ vācaṃ smṛtiṃ saṃjñāṃ ca muṣṇatī | rundhatī mārgam annasya kurvatī marmaghaṭṭanam
verses.tib: lus rengs tshig ni thogs byed cing / dran dang 'du shes 'khrul par byed / mid pa'am sbubs ni 'gags byed cing / gnad kyi tshogs ni skyod par byed

verses.skt: pṛṣṭhato namanaṃ śoṣaṃ mahāhidhmā pravartate | mahāmūlā mahāśabdā mahāvegā mahābalā
verses.tib: rgyab sgu lus ni khong skem byed / rtsa ba che zhing sgra che la / nad tshabs che zhing stobs cher 'byung

verses.skt: pakvāśayād vā nābher vā pūrvavad yā pravartate | tadrūpā sā muhuḥ kuryāj jṛmbhām aṅgaprasāraṇam
verses.tib: zhu ba'i gnas sam lte 'og nas / snga ma 'dra bar gang zhig 'byung / de 'dra'i tshul ni bstud mar 'byung / glal dang rkang lag bya rmyang byed

verses.skt: gambhīreṇānunādena gambhīrā tāsu sādhayet | ādye dve varjayed antye sarvaliṅgāṃ ca veginīm
verses.tib: brag ca zab 'byung zab mo'o / de rnams las ni dang po yi / gnyis po gso bar bya ba yin / tha ma gnyis dang zung 'byung ba / mtshan nyid / kun rdzogs shugs drag spang

verses.skt: sarvāś ca saṃcitāmasya sthavirasya vyavāyinaḥ | vyādhibhiḥ kṣīṇadehasya bhaktacchedakṣatasya vā
verses.tib: 'di dag thams cad yun bsags / rgad po bud med kyis dub dang / nad kyis nyam chung zas bcad pa / glo rdol nad can spang bar bya

verses.skt: sarve ’pi rogā nāśāya na tv evaṃ śīghrakāriṇaḥ | hidhmāśvāsau yathā tau hi mṛtyukāle kṛtālayau
verses.tib: nad kun gyis 'chi byed mod kyi / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ltar / nad gzhan myur du gsod mi byed / 'di dag 'chi tshe nges 'byung 'gyur

verses.skt: anekarogānugato bahurogapurogamaḥ | rājayakṣmā kṣayaḥ śoṣo rogarāḍ iti ca smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: nad ni du ma rjes 'brang zhing / nad mang sngon du 'gro 'gyur la / rgyal po zad byed skem byed dang / nad kyi rgyal po zhes kyang bshad

verses.skt: nakṣatrāṇāṃ dvijānāṃ ca rājño ’bhūd yad ayaṃ purā | yac ca rājā ca yakṣmā ca rājayakṣmā tato mataḥ
verses.tib: rgyu skar rnams dang bram ze yi / rgyal po'i gcong du sngon gyur cing / gang yang nad kyi rgyal por 'gyur

verses.skt: dehauṣadhakṣayakṛteḥ kṣayas tatsaṃbhavāc ca saḥ | rasādiśoṣaṇāc choṣo rogarāṭ teṣu rājanāt
verses.tib: de phyir gnod pa'i rgyal por bshad / lus dang sman ni zad byed cing / zad las 'byung bas zad byed yin / drangs skems pas skem byed yin

verses.skt: sāhasaṃ vegasaṃrodhaḥ śukraujaḥsnehasaṃkṣayaḥ | annapānavidhityāgaś catvāras tasya hetavaḥ
verses.tib: drag shul bsten dang shugs bkag dang / khu chu drangs ma snum zad dang / zas skom cho ga dang bral bsten / bzhi po 'di dag de yi rgyu

verses.skt: tair udīrṇo ’nilaḥ pittaṃ kaphaṃ codīrya sarvataḥ | śarīrasaṃdhīn āviśya tān sirāś ca prapīḍayan
verses.tib: de yis rlung dang mkhris pa dang / bad kan bslangs nas thams cad du / lus kyi tshigs kun la zhugs te / de yis rtsa sgo la gnod cing

verses.skt: mukhāni srotasāṃ ruddhvā tathaivātivivṛtya vā | sarpann ūrdhvam adhas tiryag yathāsvaṃ janayed gadān
verses.tib: bu ga'i sgo ni bkag pa'am / yang na shin tu kha bye 'gyur / stod smad thad kar gnas nas ni / rang gi nad ni ji bzhin skyed

verses.skt: rūpaṃ bhaviṣyatas tasya pratiśyāyo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ | praseko mukhamādhuryaṃ sadanaṃ vahnidehayoḥ
verses.tib: de 'byung 'gyur ba'i sngon tshul ni / cham 'debs sbrid pa shin tu mang / mchil ma kha nas ro mngar bro / lus dang me drod nyam chung byed

verses.skt: sthālyamatrānnapānādau śucāv apy aśucīkṣaṇam | makṣikātṛṇakeśādipātaḥ prāyo ’nnapānayoḥ
verses.tib: gzhong snod zas skom la sogs ni / gtsang yang mi gtsang nyid du mthong / phal cher zas dang skom la / sbrang ma sku dang rtsa 'bab

verses.skt: hṛllāsaś chardir arucir aśnato ’pi balakṣayaḥ | pāṇyor avekṣā pādāsyaśopho ’kṣṇor atiśuklatā
verses.tib: snying 'phar slon bro yi ga 'chus / kha zas zos kyang nyams stobs zad / lag par lta zhing rkang gdong skrang / mig ni shin tu dkar por snang

verses.skt: bāhvoḥ pramāṇajijñāsā kāye baibhatsyadarśanam | strīmadyamāṃsapriyatā ghṛṇitvaṃ mūrdhaguṇṭhanam
verses.tib: lag ngar dag ni 'jal bar 'dod / lus la 'jigs su rung bar mthong / bud med / chang dang sha la dga' / smod dang klad pa 'gebs par byed

verses.skt: nakhakeśātivṛddhiś ca svapne cābhibhavo bhavet | pataṅgakṛkalāsāhikapiśvāpadapakṣibhiḥ
verses.tib: skra dang sen mo shin tu 'phel / rmi lam du ni phye ma leb / rtsangs pa sdig sbrul gcan gzan spre'u / bya rnams kyis ni gtses par mthong

verses.skt: keśāsthituṣabhasmādirāśau samadhirohaṇam | śūnyānāṃ grāmadeśānāṃ darśanaṃ śuṣyato ’mbhaso
verses.tib: skra rus phub ma thal kyi / phung po la ni 'dzegs pa dang / yul dang grong ni stong pa dang / chu klung skams par rmi lam mthong

verses.skt: jyotir girīṇāṃ patatāṃ jvalatāṃ ca mahīruhām | pīnasaśvāsakāsāṃsamūrdhasvararujo ’ruciḥ
verses.tib: skar mda' ri bo ltung ba dang / ljon shing rnams ni 'bar ba rmi / stod du gnas na cham pas 'debs / lud pa lu zhing dbugs mi bde / phrag pa spyi bo na ba dang / skad 'gags yi ga 'chus par 'gyur

verses.skt: ūrdhvaṃ viḍbhraṃśasaṃśoṣāv adhaś chardiś ca koṣṭhage | tiryaksthe pārśvarugdoṣe saṃdhige bhavati jvaraḥ
verses.tib: smad gnas bshang sla rtug skem byed / nang grol nang gnas slon par byed / thad kar gnas pas rtsib logs zug / tshigs la gnas na rims su 'gyur

verses.skt: rūpāṇy ekādaśaitāni jāyante rājayakṣmiṇaḥ | teṣām upadravān vidyāt kaṇṭhoddhvaṃsam urorujam
verses.tib: de ltar nad tshul bcu gcig ni / gcong chen ldan las 'byung bar 'gyur / de rnams kyi ni bla brnan dag / skad 'gags brang du na ba dang

verses.skt: jṛmbhāṅgamardaniṣṭhīvavahnisādāsyapūtitāḥ | tatra vātāc chiraḥpārśvaśūlam aṃsāṅgamardanam
verses.tib: kha glal lus grugs mchil snabs mang / drod nyams kha mnam yin shes bya / de la rlung gyur klad pa dang / rtsib logs zug sha yan lag na

verses.skt: kaṇṭhoddhvaṃsaḥ svarabhraṃśaḥ pittāt pādāṃsapāṇiṣu | dāho ’tīsāro ’sṛkchardir mukhagandho jvaro madaḥ
verses.tib: skad 'gags mgul pa subs par 'gyur / mkhris rgyas rkang lag phrag pa tsha / tshad 'khru khrag tu slon pa dang / kha mnam rims 'debs myos par 'gyur

verses.skt: kaphād arocakaś chardiḥ kāso mūrdhāṅgagauravam | prasekaḥ pīnasaḥ śvāsaḥ svarasādo ’lpavahnitā
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur yi ga 'chus / slon lud lus dang yan lag lci / mchil snabs mang zhing cham pas 'debs / dbugs mi bde skad 'gags drod nyams

verses.skt: doṣair mandānalatvena sopalepaiḥ kapholbaṇaiḥ | srotomukheṣu ruddheṣu dhātūṣmasv alpakeṣu ca
verses.tib: nad kyi me drod nyam chung bas / 'byar bcas bad kan rgyas gyur nas / rtsa sbubs sgo ni 'gags pa dang / lus zungs drod ni chung 'gyur bas

verses.skt: vidahyamānaḥ svasthāne rasas tāṃs tān upadravān | kuryād agacchan māṃsādīn asṛk cordhvaṃ pradhāvati
verses.tib: dngas ma rang gi gnas su ni / ma zhu bla brnan de dang de / skyed cing sha mi 'gyur la / khrag ni gyen du 'byung bar byed

verses.skt: pacyate koṣṭha evānnam annapaktraiva cāsya yat | prāyo ’smān malatāṃ yātaṃ naivālaṃ dhātupuṣṭaye
verses.tib: khong pa nyid du zas 'du bas / dngas mar 'gyur bar mi byed cing / phal cher dri ma nyid 'gyur gyi / lus zungs 'phel bar mi byed do

verses.skt: raso ’py asya na raktāya māṃsāya kuta eva tu | upastabdhaḥ sa śakṛtā kevalaṃ vartate kṣayī
verses.tib: dngas ma khrag tu mi 'gyur na / shar 'gyur ba lta smos ci dgos / zad byed can ni bshang 'phel ba / 'ba' zhig gis ni gnas par byed

verses.skt: liṅgeṣv alpeṣv api kṣīṇaṃ vyādhyauṣadhabalākṣamam | varjayet sādhayed eva sarveṣv api tato ’nyathā
verses.tib: mtshan / ma chung yang nyam chung zhing / nad kyis sman gyi stobs mi bzod / spang bya de las gzhan pa ni / thams cad ldan yang gso bar bya

verses.skt: kṣīṇamāṃsabalaṃ jahyāt pūrvaliṅgair upadrutam | pratyākhyāya naraṃ cāśu dravyavantam upācaret
doṣair vyastaiḥ samastaiś ca kṣayāt ṣaṣṭhaś ca medasā | svarabhedo bhavet tatra kṣāmo rūkṣaś calaḥ svaraḥ
verses.tib: nad ni sna re 'dus pa dang / zad byed tshil las gyur pa drug / skad 'gags kyi ni dbye ba yin

verses.skt: śūkapūrṇābhakaṇṭhatvaṃ snigdhoṣṇopaśayo ’nilāt | pittāt tālugale dāhaḥ śoṣa uktāvasūyanam
verses.tib: de las rlung g.yo nyam chung rtsub / gre ba gra mas gang snyam byed / de la snum dro 'o ma phan / mkhris pa las gyur rkan lkog tsha

verses.skt: limpann iva kaphāt kaṇṭhaṃ mandaḥ khurakhurāyate | svaro vibaddhaḥ sarvais tu sarvaliṅgaḥ kṣayāt kaṣet
verses.tib: skam zhing smra bar mi nus 'gyur / bad kan mgul ba byugs snyam byed / skad kyi gsang dma' ngar ngar 'dzer / thogs bcas 'gyur ro thams cad kyi / mtshan ma thams cad ldan pa yin / zad byed las ni drud snyam byed

verses.skt: dhūmāyatīva cātyarthaṃ medasā śleṣmalakṣaṇaḥ | kṛcchralakṣyākṣaraś cātra sarvair antyaṃ ca varjayet
verses.tib: du bas bdugs ltar shin tu na / tshil gyur bad kan bdag gnyid can / tshig gi brda sprod mi nus 'gyur / 'dir ni 'dus dang tha mar spang

verses.skt: arocako bhaved doṣair jihvāhṛdayasaṃśrayaiḥ | saṃnipātena manasaḥ saṃtāpena ca pañcamaḥ
verses.tib: yi ga 'chus pa'i nad rnams ni / lce snying gnas pa so so dang / 'dus pa dang ni yid kyi ni / gdung ba las gyur lnga pa yin

verses.skt: kaṣāyatiktamadhuraṃ vātādiṣu mukhaṃ kramāt | sarvotthe virasaṃ śokakrodhādiṣu yathāmalam
verses.tib: kha ni bska dang kha mngar bro / rlung gsum dang rim bzhin sbyar / kun las gyur pa ro bro med / mya ngan khro nad ji bzhin

verses.skt: chardir doṣaiḥ pṛthak sarvair dviṣṭair arthaiś ca pañcamī | udāno vikṛto doṣān sarvāsv apy ūrdhvam asyati
verses.tib: slon bro nad gzhi sna re kun / mi sdug yul las byung lnga pa / 'di dag stod du rgyu ba'i rlung / 'khrugs pas nad ni thams cad phul

verses.skt: tāsūtkleśāsyalāvaṇyaprasekārucayo ’gragāḥ | nābhipṛṣṭhaṃ rujan vāyuḥ pārśve cāhāram utkṣipet
verses.tib: de rnams bslangs na kha tsha bro / mchil mang yi ga 'chus sngon byung / rlung gyur lte ba rgyab tu zug / rtsib logs na zhing zas slon nas

verses.skt: tato vicchinnam alpālpaṃ kaṣāyaṃ phenilaṃ vamet | śabdodgārayutaṃ kṛṣṇam acchaṃ kṛcchreṇa vegavat
verses.tib: cung zad 'byung zhing chad pa dang / ro bska lbu ba can du skyugs / sgregs pa'i sgra bcas mdog gnag la / sla zhing 'byung dka' sgra dang bcas

verses.skt: kāsāsyaśoṣahṛnmūrdhasvarapīḍāklamānvitaḥ | pittāt kṣārodakanibhaṃ dhūmraṃ haritapītakam
verses.tib: lud pa kha skam glad snying na / skad 'gags pa dang khong snyom bcas / mkhris gyur thal chu 'dra ba la / dung kha ljang sngon mdog ser skyug

verses.skt: sāsṛg amlaṃ kaṭūṣṇaṃ ca tṛṇmūrchātāpadāhavat | kaphāt snigdhaṃ ghanaṃ śītaṃ śleṣmatantugavākṣitam
verses.tib: khrag bcas ro skyur tsha zhing bro / skom dad brgyal tsha brdungs bcas yin / bad kan las byung snum bska bsil / nal nal bor 'dug dra ba ris

verses.skt: madhuraṃ lavaṇaṃ bhūri prasaktaṃ romaharṣaṇam | mukhaśvayathumādhuryatandrāhṛllāsakāsavān
verses.tib: ro mngar lan tshwa bro tshabs che / chags shing ba spu brtse bar byed / gdong / skrang kha nang mngar ba bro / snyom zhing snying na lud pa can

verses.skt: sarvaliṅgā malaiḥ sarvai riṣṭoktā yā ca tāṃ tyajet | pūtyamedhyāśucidviṣṭadarśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ
verses.tib: gsum char las byung rtags kun ldan / 'chi ltas las bshad gang de spang / rul dang mi gtsang btsog pa dang / skyugs bro mthong dang thos kyis

verses.skt: tapte citte hṛdi kliṣṭe chardir dviṣṭārthayogajā | vātādīn eva vimṛśet kṛmitṛṇāmadaurhṛde
verses.tib: yid gdung snying la phog gyur slon / mi sdug yul las byung ba yin / yid mi bde skom srin be'u snabs / rlung nyid la gnas par brtag

verses.skt: śūlavepathuhṛllāsair viśeṣāt kṛmijāṃ vadet | kṛmihṛdrogaliṅgaiś ca smṛtāḥ pañca tu hṛdgadāḥ
verses.tib: gzer dang 'phar dang snying na ba / bye brag tu ni srin bu'i nad / srin bu'i snying nad mtshan ma las / de ni shes par bya ba yin / snying nad nad ni re re 'dus / srin bu las gyur rnam lngar bshad / rlung gis shin tu zug cing na / gas dang bshags pa snyam du sems

verses.skt: teṣāṃ gulmanidānoktaiḥ samutthānaiś ca saṃbhavaḥ | vātena śūlyate ’tyarthaṃ tudyate sphuṭatīva ca
verses.tib: gzer dang 'phar dang snying na ba / bye brag tu ni srin bu'i nad / srin bu'i snying nad mtshan ma las / de ni shes par bya ba yin / snying nad nad ni re re 'dus / srin bu las gyur rnam lngar bshad / rlung gis shin tu zug cing na / gas dang bshags pa snyam du sems

verses.skt: bhidyate śuṣyati stabdhaṃ hṛdayaṃ śūnyatā dravaḥ | akasmād dīnatā śoko bhayaṃ śabdāsahiṣṇutā
verses.tib: bcom snyam sems shing skam la rengs / snying ga stong snyam zag par byed / rgyu med zhum zhing mi dga' la / 'jigs shing dgra ni mi bzod cing

verses.skt: vepathur veṣṭanaṃ mohaḥ śvāsarodho ’lpanidratā | pittāt tṛṣṇā bhramo mūrchā dāhaḥ svedo ’mlakaḥ klamaḥ
verses.tib: 'phar zhing 'gre la gcus snyam byed / rmongs bag dbugs thung gnyid chung 'gyur / mkhris gyur snyom dang mgo 'khor brgyal / tsha rngul snying ga skyur lus snyom

verses.skt: chardanaṃ cāmlapittasya dhūmakaḥ pītatā jvaraḥ | śleṣmaṇā hṛdayaṃ stabdhaṃ bhārikaṃ sāśmagarbhavat
verses.tib: mkhris pa skyur ba slon par byed / dud pa khar song ser rims 'debs / bad kan las byung snying ga rengs / khong na rdo bcug lta bur lci

verses.skt: kāsāgnisādaniṣṭhīvanidrālasyārucijvarāḥ | sarvaliṅgas tribhir doṣaiḥ kṛmibhiḥ śyāvanetratā
verses.tib: drod nyams mchil mang lud pa lu / gnyid che snyom rims yi ga 'chus / nyes gsum mtshan nyid thams cad ldan / srin bus mig ni gnag pa dang

verses.skt: tamaḥpraveśo hṛllāsaḥ śoṣaḥ kaṇḍūḥ kaphasrutiḥ | hṛdayaṃ pratataṃ cātra krakaceneva dāryate
verses.tib: mun par zhugs snyom byed snying 'phar / lus skam g.ya' zhing bad kan 'dzag / 'di ni rtag tu sog le yis / snying la 'drud pa lta bur sems

verses.skt: cikitsed āmayaṃ ghoraṃ taṃ śīghraṃ śīghrakāriṇam | vātāt pittāt kaphāt tṛṣṇā saṃnipātād rasakṣayāt
verses.tib: mi bzad nad des myur gsod pas / de ni rings par gso bar bya / skom dang rlung mkhris bad kan dang / 'dus pa dngas ma zad pa dang

verses.skt: ṣaṣṭhī syād upasargāc ca vātapitte tu kāraṇam | sarvāsu tatprakopo hi saumyadhātupraśoṣaṇāt
verses.tib: nad 'dres pa las drug tu 'gyur / de ltar gyur pa thams cad la / rlung mkhris gnyis ni rgyu yin te / de 'khrugs lus zungs bsil ba ni / skams nas ldang bar 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: sarvadehabhramotkampatāpatṛḍdāhamohakṛt | jihvāmūlagalaklomatālutoyavahāḥ sirāḥ
verses.tib: lus kun 'dar zhing mgo 'khor tsha / skom dang khong tsha rmongs par byed / lce drung mgul pa glo ba dang / skom dad skom 'thungs rgyu ba'i rtsa

verses.skt: saṃśoṣya tṛṣṇā jāyante tāsāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam | mukhaśoṣo jalātṛptir annadveṣaḥ svarakṣayaḥ
verses.tib: skom pas skom dad skye bar 'gyur / de rnams kyi ni spyi'i mtshan nyid / kha skam skom gyis mi ngoms dang / zas la mi dga' skad 'gags dang

verses.skt: kaṇṭhauṣṭhajihvākārkaśyaṃ jihvāniṣkramaṇaṃ klamaḥ | pralāpaś cittavibhraṃśas tṛḍgrahoktās tathāmayāḥ
verses.tib: gre ba lce mchu rtsub mor 'gyur / lce 'byin byed cing khong snyom la / bla zhing sems ni myos pa dang / de bzhin skom gdung nad du 'gyur / lus skams rmya zhing 'on pa dang / rmongs bag mgo 'khor snying nad de / 'di lta bu yi nad rnams ni

verses.skt: mārutāt kṣāmatā dainyaṃ śaṅkhatodaḥ śirobhramaḥ | gandhājñānāsyavairasyaśrutinidrābalakṣayāḥ
verses.tib: rlung 'gyur khong rmya nyam chung la / mur 'gram zug cing klad pa 'khor / sna lces dri dang ro mi tshor / 'on zhing gnyid med nyams stobs zad

verses.skt: śītāmbupānād vṛddhiś ca pittān mūrchāsyatiktatā | raktekṣaṇatvaṃ pratataṃ śoṣo dāho ’tidhūmakaḥ
verses.tib: chu grang 'thungs na skom 'phel 'gyur / mkhris pa kha nang ro khyab rgyal / mngar por mthong zhing rtag par ni / kha skam khong tsha dbugs mnam pa'o

verses.skt: kapho ruṇaddhi kupitas toyavāhiṣu mārutam | srotaḥsu sa kaphas tena paṅkavac choṣyate tataḥ
verses.tib: bad kan ldang bas skom rgyu'i rtsa / bkag pas rlung ni 'khrugs gyur nas / de tshe de yis bad kan ni / 'dam bzhin de yis skem par byed

verses.skt: śūkair ivācitaḥ kaṇṭho nidrā madhuravaktratā | ādhmānaṃ śiraso jāḍyaṃ staimityacchardyarocakāḥ
verses.tib: mgul pa gra mas gang snyam sems / gnyid che kha nang mngar bar bro / lto ba mgo bo tshor ba chung / rmongs bag slon gyur yig 'chus

verses.skt: ālasyam avipākaś ca sarvaiḥ syāt sarvalakṣaṇā | āmodbhavā ca bhaktasya saṃrodhād vātapittajā
verses.tib: lus skam kha zas mi 'ju'o / kun las gyur pa rtags kun ldan / be'u snabs las gyur kha zas ni / mid dka' rlung mkhris las gyur yin

verses.skt: uṣṇaklāntasya sahasā śītāmbho bhajatas tṛṣam | ūṣmā ruddho gataḥ koṣṭhaṃ yāṃ kuryāt pittajaiva sā
verses.tib: tsha bas ngal bas 'phral du na / chu grang bsten gyur skom dad che / khong par tsha ba bsdus pa yis / skom dad de ni mkhris skyes yin

verses.skt: yā ca pānātipānotthā tīkṣṇāgneḥ snehajā ca yā | snigdhagurvamlalavaṇabhojanena kaphodbhavā
verses.tib: gang yang chang drags me drod rno / snum zos skyes pa'ang mkhris 'byung yin / snum zhing skyur dang lan tshwa'i bag / zos pas bad kan las skyes 'gyur

verses.skt: tṛṣṇā rasakṣayoktena lakṣaṇena kṣayātmikā | śoṣamehajvarādyanyadīrgharogopasargataḥ
verses.tib: zad byed las ni skom dad 'gyur / dngas ma zad dang mtshan nyid 'dra / khong skam gcin nad rims nad / yun nad ni rims skom nad

verses.skt: yā tṛṣṇā jāyate tīvrā sopasargātmikā smṛtā
verses.tib: gang zhig skom dang mi bzang skyes / de ni 'dres las 'byung bar bshad

verses.skt: tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣasūkṣmāmlaṃ vyavāyy āśukaraṃ laghu | vikāṣi viśadaṃ madyam ojaso ’smād viparyayaḥ
verses.tib: rno dang drod che rtsub phra skyur / nyal po 'dod myur byed dang yang / gsal dang dang bar byed par bshad / mdangs ni 'di las go bzlog yin / dug kyang rno yin mod kyis / sems la gnod par byed pa yin / nus pas 'chi bar byed pas na / dug

verses.skt: tīkṣṇādayo viṣe ’py uktāś cittopaplāvino guṇāḥ | jīvitāntāya jāyante viṣe tūtkarṣavṛttitaḥ
verses.tib: rno dang drod che rtsub phra skyur / nyal po 'dod myur byed dang yang / gsal dang dang bar byed par bshad / mdangs ni 'di las go bzlog yin / dug kyang rno yin mod kyis / sems la gnod par byed pa yin / nus pas 'chi bar byed pas na / dug

verses.skt: tīkṣṇādibhir guṇair madyaṃ mandādīn ojaso guṇān | daśabhir daśa saṃkṣobhya ceto nayati vikriyām
verses.tib: ni lhag par mthu che'o / chang ni rno yon tan gyi / mdangs kyi yon tan rtul la / bcu po bcu yis 'khrugs byas nas / sems ni sgyur bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: ādye made dvitīye tu pramādāyatane sthitaḥ | durvikalpahato mūḍhaḥ sukham ity adhimucyate
verses.tib: ra ro dang po gnyis pa yis / bag med pa yi gnas la gnas / rnam rtog ngan bcom rmongs pa rnams / bde ba yin snyam sems par 'gyur

verses.skt: madhyamottamayoḥ saṃdhiṃ prāpya rājasatāmasaḥ | niraṅkuśa iva vyālo na kiñcin nācarej jaḍaḥ
verses.tib: 'bring dang chen po bar gyi tshe / rngul dang mun pa'i rang bzhin can / glang chen lcags kyu med pa ltar / rmongs pas mi bya ci yang med

verses.skt: iyaṃ bhūmir avadyānāṃ dauḥśīlyasyedam āspadam | eko ’yaṃ bahumārgāya durgater deśikaḥ param
verses.tib: 'di ni kha nam tho'i gnas / 'di ni tshul khrims 'chal pa'i gzhi / 'di gcig ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i lam / mang po ston par byed pa yin

verses.skt: niśceṣṭaḥ śavavac chete tṛtīye tu made sthitaḥ | maraṇād api pāpātmā gataḥ pāpatarāṃ daśām
verses.tib: ra ro gsum pa'i tshe na ni / sems med par ni ro ltar nyal / nyes pa'i bdag nyid shi ba las / shin tu ma rungs gnas skabs 'thob

verses.skt: dharmādharmaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkham arthānarthaṃ hitāhitam | yad āsakto na jānāti kathaṃ tac chīlayed budhaḥ
verses.tib: chos dang chos min bde dang sdug / don dang don min phan dang gnod / gang la chags pa mi shes pa / de la mkhas pas ji ltar bsten

verses.skt: madye moho bhayaṃ śokaḥ krodho mṛtyuś ca saṃśritāḥ | sonmādamadamūrchāyāḥ sāpasmārāpatānakāḥ
verses.tib: chang las myos 'jigs mya ngan dang / khro dang srog dang bral ba nas / smyo byed myos dang brgyal bar bcas / brjed byed bcas pa kun song nad

verses.skt: yatraikaḥ smṛtivibhraṃśas tatra sarvam asādhu yat | ayuktiyuktam annaṃ hi vyādhaye maraṇāya vā
verses.tib: gang du dran pa nyams gcig yod / der ni mi dge thams cad 'byung / mi 'phrod zas ni zos pas kyang / nad dam yang na 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: madyaṃ trivargadhīdhairyalajjāder api nāśanam | nātimādyanti balinaḥ kṛtāhārā mahāśanāḥ
verses.tib: chang ni sde tshan gsum blo ldan / ngo tsha kyang 'jig par byed / nyams stobs ldan dang zas zos dang

verses.skt: snigdhāḥ sattvavayoyuktā madyanityās tadanvayāḥ | medaḥkaphādhikā mandavātapittā dṛḍhāgnayaḥ
verses.tib: zas cher za dang snum bag za / snying stobs lang tshor ldan pa dang / rtag tu chang 'thungs de'i rigs skyes / tshil dang bad kan shas che la / rlung dang mkhris pa shas chung dang / me drod che zhing brtan pa rnams

verses.skt: viparyaye ’timādyanti viśrabdhāḥ kupitāś ca ye | madyena cāmlarūkṣeṇa sājīrṇe bahunāti ca
verses.tib: de las bzlog pa chang dad can / khros dang chang rtsub skyur shas che / ma zhur bcas dang mnga' 'thung pa / gang yin shas cher ra ror 'gyur

verses.skt: vātāt pittāt kaphāt sarvaiś catvāraḥ syur madātyayāḥ | sarve ’pi sarvair jāyante vyapadeśas tu bhūyasā
verses.tib: rlung mkhris bad kan kun las byung / chang nad rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ro / kun kyang kun las skyes mod kyi / shas che ba las ming du btags

verses.skt: sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ pramoho hṛdayavyathā | viḍbhedaḥ pratataṃ tṛṣṇā saumyāgneyo jvaro ’ruciḥ
verses.tib: de rnams kyi ni spyi mtshan nyid / rmongs dang snying ni na ba dang / 'khru zhing rtag tu skom dad che / tsha grang rims 'debs yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: śiraḥpārśvāsthirukkampo marmabhedas trikagrahaḥ | urovibandhas timiraṃ kāsaḥ śvāsaḥ prajāgaraḥ
verses.tib: mgo bo rtsib rus na dang 'dar / gnad 'jig ltag pa na ba dang / brla rengs rab rib khyer ba dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde gnyid med

verses.skt: svedo ’timātraṃ viṣṭambhaḥ śvayathuś cittavibhramaḥ | pralāpaś chardir utkleśo bhramo duḥsvapnadarśanam
verses.tib: rngul cher 'byung zhing bshang ba 'gags / skang zhing sems ni 'khrul pa dang / bla zhing slon par byed pa dang / mgo 'khor rmi lam ngan mthong ba'o

verses.skt: viśeṣāj jāgaraśvāsakampamūrdharujo ’nilāt | svapne bhramaty utpatati pretaiś ca saha bhāṣate
verses.tib: rlung gyur khyad par gnyid mi 'ong / dbugs mi bde zhing klad na 'dar / rmi lam du ni 'phyan zhing 'phur / gshin po rnams dang gtam smra rmi

verses.skt: pittād dāhajvarasvedamohātīsāratṛḍbhramāḥ | deho haritahāridro raktanetrakapolatā
verses.tib: mkhris pas lus tsha skad 'gags dang / rmongs bag tshad 'khru skom mgo 'khor / lus mdog ljang dang ser ba dang / mig dang mkhur tshos dmar bar 'gyur

verses.skt: śleṣmaṇā chardihṛllāsanidrodardāṅgagauravam | sarvaje sarvaliṅgatvaṃ muktvā madyaṃ pibet tu yaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan gyis slon snying na dang / gnyid che grang 'dar yan lag lci / kun skyes mtshan nyid kun dang ldan / chang spangs pa las 'phral du ni / mang du 'thungs sam ma goms 'thungs

verses.skt: sahasānucitaṃ vānyat tasya dhvaṃsakavikṣayau | bhavetāṃ mārutāt kaṣṭau durbalasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: de las 'joms dang lus skam nad / rlung las sdug bsngal ldan pa 'byung / nyam chung ba la mchog tu 'byung

verses.skt: dhvaṃsake śleṣmaniṣṭhīvaḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣo ’tinidratā | śabdāsahatvaṃ tandrā ca vikṣaye ’ṅgaśiro'tiruk
verses.tib: 'joms pas bad kan mchil ma mang / lkog ma skams shing gnyid rab che / sgra drag mi bzod glong bag 'gyur / lud skam yan lag mgo rab na

verses.skt: hṛtkaṇṭharogaḥ saṃmohaḥ kāsas tṛṣṇā vamir jvaraḥ | nivṛtto yas tu madyebhyo jitātmā buddhipūrvakṛt
verses.tib: snying nad mgul nad rmongs bag dang / lud pa skom dad slon rims 'debs / gang zhig chang rnams spangs pas ni / dbang po thul zhing brtags te byed

verses.skt: vikāraiḥ spṛśyate jātu na sa śārīramānasaiḥ | rajomohāhitāhāraparasya syus trayo gadāḥ
verses.tib: nam yang de la lus sems kyi / skyon rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro / rdul dang mun pa mi 'phrod zas / mchog tu bsten las nad gsum 'byung

verses.skt: rasāsṛkcetanāvāhisrotorodhasamudbhavāḥ | madamūrchāyasaṃnyāsā yathottarabalottarāḥ
verses.tib: dngas ma khrag dang sems rgyu ba'i / rtsa sbubs bkag pa las byung ba / myos dang brgyal dang kun song nad / phyi ma bzhin du stobs rab che

verses.skt: mado ’tra doṣaiḥ sarvaiś ca raktamadyaviṣair api | saktānalpadrutābhāṣaś calaḥ skhalitaceṣṭitaḥ
verses.tib: 'dir myos nad sna re re kun / khrag chang dug rnams las kyang 'byung / rlung las gtam la chags pa dang / mang smra nyung smra spyod pa 'khrul

verses.skt: rūkṣaśyāvāruṇatanur made vātodbhave bhavet | pittena krodhano raktapītābhaḥ kalahapriyaḥ
verses.tib: lus ni rtsub gnag dmar ba yi / myos pa rlung las skyes pa yin / mkhris pa las khro dmar ba dang / ser por snang zhing rtsod la dga'

verses.skt: svalpasaṃbaddhavāk pāṇḍuḥ kaphād dhyānaparo ’lasaḥ | sarvātmā saṃnipātena raktāt stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭitā
verses.tib: bad kan tshig nyung 'brel smra skya / sems / las che zhing le lo che / 'dus pa mtshan nyid kun dang ldan / khrag las mig dang yan lag rengs

verses.skt: pittaliṅgaṃ ca madyena vikṛtehasvarāṅgatā | viṣe kampo ’tinidrā ca sarvebhyo ’bhyadhikas tu saḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa yin / chang gis yan lag skad bskyod 'gyur / dug gis 'dar zhing gnyid rab che / de ni kun las myos tshabs che

verses.skt: lakṣayel lakṣaṇotkarṣād vātādīn śoṇitādiṣu | aruṇaṃ kṛṣṇanīlaṃ vā khaṃ paśyan praviśet tamaḥ
verses.tib: khrag pa yis rlung pa'i / mtshan nyid lhag par shes par bya / brgyal ba rlung gi bdag nyid can / nam mkha' dmar sngo gnag par ni / mthong zhing mun par zhugs snyam sems

verses.skt: śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyeta hṛtpīḍā vepathur bhramaḥ | kārśyaṃ śyāvāruṇā chāyā mūrchāye mārutātmake
verses.tib: myur du sangs par byed pa dang / snying na 'dar zhing mgo 'khor la / skem zhing bzhin mdog dmar nag 'gyur

verses.skt: pittena raktaṃ pītaṃ vā nabhaḥ paśyan viśet tamaḥ | vibudhyeta ca sasvedo dāhatṛṭtāpapīḍitaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pas dmar ba'am ser por ni / nam mkha' mthong zhing mun 'thibs byed / sangs nas rdul dang bcas pa dang / tsha skom gdungs pas nyen pa dang

verses.skt: bhinnaviṇ nīlapītābho raktapītākulekṣaṇaḥ | kaphena meghasaṃkāśaṃ paśyann ākāśam āviśet
verses.tib: 'khru zhing kha dog ser dang dmar / mig dmar ser bar snang bar 'gyur / bad kan gyis ni sprin lta bur / nam mkha' mthong zhing mun 'thibs byed

verses.skt: tamaś cirāc ca budhyeta sahṛllāsaḥ prasekavān | gurubhiḥ stimitair aṅgair ārdracarmāvanaddhavat
verses.tib: nas sangs par 'gyur ba dang / snying na bcas pas mchil ma mang / pags pa rlon pas g.yogs pa bzhin / yan lag lci zhing tshor ba chung

verses.skt: sarvākṛtis tribhir doṣair apasmāra ivāparaḥ | pātayaty āśu niśceṣṭaṃ vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitaiḥ
verses.tib: nyes pa gsum gyi mtshan kun ldan / brjed byed gnyis pa lta bu ste / myur du 'gyel zhing brgyal 'gyur la / 'jigs rung spyod pa med pa yin

verses.skt: doṣeṣu madamūrchāyāḥ kṛtavegeṣu dehinām | svayam evopaśāmyanti saṃnyāso nauṣadhair vinā
verses.tib: lus can myos dang brgyal ba yis / nad la shugs yod gyur kyang ni / rang nyid zhi bar 'gyur ba yin / kun zhugs sman med par mi zhi

verses.skt: vāgdehamanasāṃ ceṣṭām ākṣipyātibalā malāḥ | saṃnyāsaṃ saṃnipatitāḥ prāṇāyatanasaṃśrayāḥ
verses.tib: 'dus pa las gyur kun zhugs pa / srog gi gnas la brten pa yis / lus dang ngag yid spyod pa 'phrog

verses.skt: kurvanti tena puruṣaḥ kāṣṭhībhūto mṛtopamaḥ | mriyeta śīghraṃ śīghraṃ cec cikitsā na prayujyate
verses.tib: de yis skyes bu ro dang ni / shing dang rtsig pa 'dra bar byed / rings par gso bar ma byas na / myur du 'chi bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: agādhe grāhabahule salilaugha ivāṭate | saṃnyāse vinimajjantaṃ naram āśu nivartayet
verses.tib: mtsho zab chu srin mang po can / chu 'jing 'jug ngogs med par ni / kun zhugs pa ni nub byed la / mi ni myur du gdon par bya

verses.skt: madamānaroṣatoṣaprabhṛtibhir aribhir nijaiḥ pariṣvaṅgaḥ | yuktāyuktaṃ ca samaṃ yuktiviyuktena madyena
verses.tib: rigs pas brten dang bral / ba'i chang 'thungs pas / myos dregs khro dang bral ba'i rang bzhin can / rang gi dgra bos yongs su 'khyud 'gyur zhing / rigs dang mi rigs mnyam par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: balakāladeśasātmyaprakṛtisahāyāmayavayāṃsi | pravibhajya tadanurūpaṃ yadi pibati tataḥ pibaty amṛtam
verses.tib: stobs dang dus dang yul dang goms pa dang / rang bzhin grogs dang na tshod nad rnams ni / legs brtags de dang rjes mthun gang zhig 'thung / de ni bdud rtsi 'thungs dang mtshungs pa yin

verses.skt: arivat prāṇino māṃsakīlakā viśasanti yat | arśāṃsi tasmād ucyante gudamārganirodhataḥ
verses.tib: dgra ltar srog chags rnams kyi tshe / gzhang 'brum 'byung bas gsod byed pas / de phyir bshang ba'i lam 'gegs pas / gzhang 'brum zhes ni bshad pa yin

verses.skt: doṣās tvaṅmāṃsamedāṃsi saṃdūṣya vividhākṛtīn | māṃsāṅkurān apānādau kurvanty arśāṃsi tān jaguḥ
verses.tib: nad kyis lpags tshil sha rnams ni / gnod byas dbyibs ni sna tshogs pa'i / sha yi myu gu gzhang su / skyes de gzhang 'brum yin par bshad

verses.skt: sahajanmottarotthānabhedād dvedhā samāsataḥ | śuṣkasrāvivibhedāc ca gudaḥ sthūlāntrasaṃśrayaḥ
verses.tib: lhan cig skyes dang phyis 'byung dang / skam dang khrag tu 'dzag pa yi / dbye bas mdor na rnam gnyis yin / gzhang ni rgyu ma sbom por brten

verses.skt: ardhapañcāṅgulas tasmiṃs tisro ’dhyardhāṅgulāḥ sthitāḥ | balyaḥ pravāhiṇī tāsām antar madhye visarjanī
verses.tib: sor ni phyed dang lnga yod do / gnyer gsum sor ni phyed dang gnyis / rim pa de yi nang ma ni / phyir 'phul bar ma sel ba yin

verses.skt: bāhyā saṃvaraṇī tasyā gudauṣṭho bahir aṅgule | yavādhyardhaḥ pramāṇena romāṇy atra tataḥ param
verses.tib: de yi phyi rol 'dzum pa yin / de yi phyi rol sor gcig kha / nas ni phyed dang gnyis kyi tshad / de phan chad ni spu skye 'gyur

verses.skt: tatra hetuḥ sahotthānāṃ valībījopataptatā | arśasāṃ bījataptis tu mātāpitrapacārataḥ
verses.tib: de la lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu / gnyer ma'i sa bon gnod 'gyur nyid / gzhang 'brum sa bon gnod pa yang / pha mas mi 'phrod zos pa dang

verses.skt: daivāc ca tābhyāṃ kopo hi saṃnipātasya tāny ataḥ | asādhyāny evam ākhyātāḥ sarve rogāḥ kulodbhavāḥ
verses.tib: sngon las de gnyis dang 'dus pa / 'khrugs pa las gyur de dag ni / gsor mi rung ba nyid du bshad / rigs 'byung nad kun de dang 'dra

verses.skt: sahajāni viśeṣeṇa rūkṣadurdarśanāni ca | antarmukhāni pāṇḍūni dāruṇopadravāṇi ca
verses.tib: lhan cig skyes pa khyad par du / rtsub cing brta bar dka' ba dang / nang du kha bltas dkar ba dang / bla brnan mi bzod can gso dka'

verses.skt: ṣoḍhānyāni pṛthag doṣasaṃsarganicayāsrataḥ | śuṣkāṇi vātaśleṣmabhyām ārdrāṇi tv asrapittataḥ
verses.tib: cig shos drug ste nad tha dad / 'dres dang 'dus pa khrag las 'byung / rlung dang bad kan gnyis las / skam / khrag dang mkhris pa las rlan can

verses.skt: doṣaprakopahetus tu prāg uktas tena sādite | agnau male ’tinicite punaś cātivyavāyataḥ
