verses.tib: nad rnams ldang rgyu sngar bshad pa / 'khrugs pa de yis khong pa yi / me drod nyams shing bshang ba 'phel / gzhan yang nyal bo rab drags dang / gzhon pas khong dkrugs stan dag ni

verses.skt: yānasaṃkṣobhaviṣamakaṭhinotkaṭakāsanāt | vastinetrāśmaloṣṭorvītalacailādighaṭṭanāt
verses.tib: ma snyoms sra dang tsog pur 'dug / 'jam rtsi'i gce'u sa dang ni / rdo dang gos kyis drud pa dang

verses.skt: bhṛśaṃ śītāmbusaṃsparśāt pratatātipravāhaṇāt | vātamūtraśakṛdvegadhāraṇāt tadudīraṇāt
verses.tib: shin tu grang ba'i chus bkrus dang / rtag tu 'khru bar byed pa dang / bshang dang gci dang 'phyen gyi shugs / bkag dang nan gyis btsir ba dang

verses.skt: jvaragulmātisārāmagrahaṇīśophapāṇḍubhiḥ | karśanād viṣamābhyaś ca ceṣṭābhyo yoṣitāṃ punaḥ
verses.tib: rims dang skran dang tshad par 'khru / 'or nad skya rbab be snabs kyis / skems byas gnod par 'gyur ba yi / spyod pa bsten las 'byung bar 'gyur / bud med zla grangs ma tshang 'phyil / zla ba rdzogs pas gzir las 'byung / de 'dra dag dang gzhan yang rlung / thur sel 'khrugs pas dri ma ni

verses.skt: āmagarbhaprapatanād garbhavṛddhiprapīḍanāt | īdṛśaiś cāparair vāyur apānaḥ kupito malam
verses.tib: rims dang skran dang tshad par 'khru / 'or nad skya rbab be snabs kyis / skems byas gnod par 'gyur ba yi / spyod pa bsten las 'byung bar 'gyur / bud med zla grangs ma tshang 'phyil / zla ba rdzogs pas gzir las 'byung / de 'dra dag dang gzhan yang rlung / thur sel 'khrugs pas dri ma ni

verses.skt: pāyor valīṣu taṃ dhatte tāsv abhiṣyaṇṇamūrtiṣu | jāyante ’rśāṃsi tatpūrvalakṣaṇaṃ mandavahnitā
verses.tib: gzhang gi gnyer mar de gzhag pas / de ni mi mngon gyur pas gnas / gzhang 'brum 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin / de yi sngon tshul me drod nyams

verses.skt: viṣṭambhaḥ sakthisadanaṃ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ bhramaḥ | sādo ’ṅge netrayoḥ śophaḥ śakṛdbhedo ’thavā grahaḥ
verses.tib: brla ni rengs shing na ba dang / byin pa'i nywa na mgo 'khor zhing / yan lag na zhing mig gnyis skrang / bshang ba 'khru ba'am yang ni sri

verses.skt: mārutaḥ pracuro mūḍhaḥ prāyo nābher adhaś caran | saruk saparikartaś ca kṛcchrān nirgacchati svanam
verses.tib: rlung chen nang nas 'khyil ba dang / phal cher lte ba'i 'og nas rgyu / nad bcas bcad pa lta bur sems / dka' bar 'byung zhing sgra can 'byung

verses.skt: antrakūjanam āṭopaḥ kṣāmatodgārabhūritā | prabhūtaṃ mūtram alpā viḍ aśraddhā dhūmako ’mlakaḥ
verses.tib: rgyu ma krul krul zer zhing spos / skem zhing sgregs pa mang du 'byung / gcin mang bshang nyung yi ga 'chus / sgregs pa dud 'drar skyur ba 'byung

verses.skt: śiraḥpṛṣṭhorasāṃ śūlam ālasyaṃ bhinnavarṇatā | tandrendriyāṇāṃ daurbalyaṃ krodho duḥkhopacāratā
verses.tib: mgo dang brang dang rgyab tu gzer / snyom zhing kha dog nyams pa dang / glong bag dbang po nyam chung la / khro zhing bsnyen bkur dka' ba dang

verses.skt: āśaṅkā grahaṇīdoṣapāṇḍugulmodareṣu ca | etāny eva vivardhante jāteṣu hatanāmasu
verses.tib: ma zhu skem nad skya rbab dang / dmu rdzing rnams la som nyi skyes / gzhang 'brum skye bar gyur ba la / 'di dag nyid ni 'phel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: nivartamāno ’pāno hi tair adhomārgarodhataḥ | kṣobhayann anilān anyān sarvendriyaśarīragān
verses.tib: de yis 'og gi lam bkag pas / thur du sel ba'i rlang log ste / lus dang dbang po kun gnas pa'i / rlung gzhan / thams cad 'khrug par byed

verses.skt: tathā mūtraśakṛtpittakaphān dhātūṃś ca sāśayān | mṛdnāty agniṃ tataḥ sarvo bhavati prāyaśo ’rśasaḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin bshang gci mkhris pa dang / bad kan lus zungs rten bcas pa / 'khrugs shing me drod nyams par byed / de nas gzhang 'brum nad can la / phal cher thams cad nyer 'byung ba

verses.skt: kṛśo bhṛśaṃ hatotsāho dīnaḥ kṣāmo ’tiniṣprabhaḥ | asāro vigatacchāyo jantujuṣṭa iva drumaḥ
verses.tib: skem zhing mchog tu bskyod mi nus / stobs zad khong rmya bzhin mdangs nyams / lus lhod snying po med 'gyur zhing / 'bus zos pa yi shing 'dra la

verses.skt: kṛtsnair upadravair grasto yathoktair marmapīḍanaiḥ | tathā kāsapipāsāsyavairasyaśvāsapīnasaiḥ
verses.tib: bla brnan ma lus dag gis 'debs / ji skad bshad pa'i gnad gzir zhing / lud pa skam dang skad 'gags dang / kha ro mi tshor cham 'debs sbo

verses.skt: klamāṅgabhaṅgavamathukṣavathuśvayathujvaraiḥ | klaibyabādhiryataimiryaśarkarāśmaripīḍitaḥ
verses.tib: sgyid sgyur rka lag na zhing slon / sbrid pa skrang dang rims nad dang / khu ba zad cing rab rib slon / rde'u chags nad kyis gzir ba dang

verses.skt: kṣāmabhinnasvaro dhyāyan muhuḥ ṣṭhīvan arocakī | sarvaparvāsthihṛnnābhipāyuvaṅkṣaṇaśūlavān
verses.tib: skad 'gags zhum la sems khong chud / mchil ma mang 'dor yi ga 'chus / rus tshigs kun dang snying lte ba / gzhang dang sna rtsa gzir dang bcas

verses.skt: gudena sravatā picchāṃ pulākodakasaṃnibhām | vibaddhamuktaṃ śuṣkārdraṃ pakvāmaṃ cāntarāntarā
verses.tib: khu ba lta bu'i sbyin bag 'dzag / rtug skam sbyin pa'am sla bar 'gyur / smin dang ma smin bar bar 'khru

verses.skt: pāṇḍu pītaṃ harid raktaṃ picchilaṃ copaveśyate | gudāṅkurā bahvanilāḥ śuṣkāś cimicimānvitāḥ
verses.tib: skya zhing ser dang sngon po yi / khrag ni sbyin bag 'khru bar 'gyur / gzhang 'brum rlung shas che las gyur / skam zhing tseg tseg tsha ba dang

verses.skt: mlānāḥ śyāvāruṇāḥ stabdhā viṣamāḥ paruṣāḥ kharāḥ | mitho visadṛśā vakrās tīkṣṇā visphuṭitānanāḥ
verses.tib: rnyid cing dmar nag rengs pa dang / mi snyoms rtsub cing sra ba dang / phan tshun mi 'dra yo ba dang / rtse mo rno zhing gas pa dang

verses.skt: bimbīkarkandhukharjūrakārpāsīphalasaṃnibhāḥ | kecit kadambapuṣpābhāḥ kecit siddhārthakopamāḥ
verses.tib: bim pa rgya shug kha rdzu ra / ras bal sa bon dang 'dra zhing / la la ka tam me tog 'dra / la la yungs kar lta bur skyes

verses.skt: śiraḥpārśvāṃsakaṭyūruvaṅkṣaṇābhyadhikavyathāḥ | kṣavathūdgāraviṣṭambhahṛdgrahārocakapradāḥ
verses.tib: mgo dang phrag pa rtsib logs brla / chu so dag tu lhag par na / sbrid pa sgregs pa bshang ba sri / snying 'phar yi ga 'chus pa skyed

verses.skt: kāsaśvāsāgnivaiṣamyakarṇanādabhramāvahāḥ | tair ārto grathitaṃ stokaṃ saśabdaṃ sapravāhikam
verses.tib: lud dbugs mi bde me drod nyams / rna ba sgra bcas mgo 'khor byed / des nyes rtug skam nyung ngu ni

verses.skt: rukphenapicchānugataṃ vibaddham upaveśyate | kṛṣṇatvaṅnakhaviṇmūtranetravaktraś ca jāyate
verses.tib: sgra bcas ska sla 'dren ma dang / na zhing lbu ba 'byar bag can / rtug skam tshul gyis 'byung bar 'gyur / pags pa sen mo bshang gci dang / mig dang / gdong ni gnag par 'gyur

verses.skt: gulmaplīhodarāṣṭhīlāsaṃbhavas tata eva ca | pittottarā nīlamukhā raktapītāsitaprabhāḥ
verses.tib: skran dang mcher pa dmu rdzing dang / gtun 'dra de nyid las 'byung 'gyur / mkhris shas che las rtse mo ni / sngo zhing dmar ser dkar bar snang

verses.skt: tanvasrasrāviṇo visrās tanavo mṛdavaḥ ślathāḥ | śukajihvāyakṛtkhaṇḍajalaukovaktrasaṃnibhāḥ
verses.tib: phra zhing dri mnam khrag sla 'dzag / srab cing 'jam la lhod pa yin / mcher pa'i dum bu ne tso'i lce / srin bu pad pa'i mchu 'drar snang

verses.skt: dāhapākajvarasvedatṛṇmūrchārucimohadāḥ | soṣmāṇo dravanīloṣṇapītaraktāmavarcasaḥ
verses.tib: tsha zhing gnag la rims dang rngul / skom dad yi ga 'chus rmongs skyed / bshang dro sla zhing sngo la tsha / ser zhing dmar bar 'khru bar 'gyur

verses.skt: yavamadhyā haritpītahāridratvaṅnakhādayaḥ | śleṣmolbaṇā mahāmūlā ghanā mandarujaḥ sitāḥ
verses.tib: nas rul nang 'dra pags pa dang / sen sngo ser ljang bar 'gyur / bad kan shas che rtsa ba sbom / mthug cing nad kyi shugs dal dkar

verses.skt: ucchūnopācitāḥ snigdhāḥ stabdhavṛttagurusthirāḥ | picchilāḥ stimitāḥ ślakṣṇāḥ kaṇḍvāḍhyāḥ sparśanapriyāḥ
verses.tib: skrang zhing rgyas la snum pa dang / 'greng zhing snum la lci zhing brtan / 'byar bag tshor ba chung zhing 'jam / g.ya' zhing reg na dga' bar byed

verses.skt: karīrapanasāsthyābhās tathā gostanasaṃnibhāḥ | vaṅkṣaṇānāhinaḥ pāyuvastinābhivikartinaḥ
verses.tib: ka ri ra ba na sa yi / rus pa ba yi nu sor 'dra / chu sor zug cing sbo gzhang na / lte ba lgang pa bcad snyam sems

verses.skt: sakāsaśvāsahṛllāsaprasekārucipīnasāḥ | mehakṛcchraśirojāḍyaśiśirajvarakāriṇaḥ
verses.tib: lud pa dbugs mi bde snying na / mchil mang cham 'debs yi ga 'chus / gcin sri mgo bo tshor ba med / grang ba'i rims ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: klaibyāgnimārdavacchardirāmaprāyavikāradāḥ | vasābhasakaphaprājyapurīṣāḥ sapravāhikāḥ
verses.tib: kha chu 'dzag cing me drod nyams / slon zhing ma zhu'i nad kun skyed / bshang ba tshil 'dra bad kan mang / 'khru dang bcas par 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: na sravanti na bhidyante pāṇḍusnigdhatvagādayaḥ | saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgāḥ saṃsargān nicayāt sarvalakṣaṇāḥ
verses.tib: 'dzag par mi byed rdol mi byed / pags pa la sogs snum zhing dkar / 'dres las mtshan nyid 'dres pa yin / 'dus pa mtshan nyid kun dang ldan

verses.skt: raktolbaṇā gudekīlāḥ pittākṛtisamanvitāḥ | vaṭaprarohasadṛśā guñjāvidrumasaṃnibhāḥ
verses.tib: khrag shas che las gzhang 'brum ni / mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid 'dra ba la / n+ya gro d+ha yi myu gu 'dra / byi ru 'ol ma se mdog 'dra

verses.skt: te ’tyarthaṃ duṣṭam uṣṇaṃ ca gāḍhaviṭpratipīḍitāḥ | sravanti sahasā raktaṃ tasya cātipravṛttitaḥ
verses.tib: shin tu tsha bro na ba dang / bshang ba shugs kyis rab btsir las / 'phral du khrag ni 'byung ba dang / de nyid shin tu 'dzag par 'gyur

verses.skt: bhekābhaḥ pīḍyate duḥkhaiḥ śoṇitakṣayasaṃbhavaiḥ | hīnavarṇabalotsāho hataujaḥ kaluṣendriyaḥ
verses.tib: sbal pa 'dra zhing khrag zad las / byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen 'gyur / mdog stobs spro ba nyams pa dang / mdangs 'phrog dbang po zhan par 'gyur

verses.skt: mudgakodravajūrṇāhvakarīracaṇakādibhiḥ | rūkṣaiḥ saṃgrāhibhir vāyuḥ sve sthāne kupito balī
verses.tib: mung+ga ko dra ba'i phye ma / tsa na ka ri ra pa / rtsub dang bshang ba sri bas rlung / rang gnas 'khrugs pa stobs / ldan pas

verses.skt: adhovahāni srotāṃsi saṃrudhyādhaḥ praśoṣayan | purīṣaṃ vātaviṇmūtrasaṅgaṃ kurvīta dāruṇam
verses.tib: thur du rgyu ba'i bu ga ni / bkag ste smad du rab skams nas / bshang ba gci ba 'phyen rnams ni / 'gags pas nad ni mi bzad skyed

verses.skt: tena tīvrā rujā koṣṭhapṛṣṭhahṛtpārśvagā bhavet | ādhmānam udarāveṣṭo hṛllāso parikartanam
verses.tib: de yis khong pa rgyab rtsib logs / snying gar nad ni shin tu skyed / lto spos gsus pa na ba dang / snying gcus rgyu ma bcad snyam sems

verses.skt: vastau ca sutarāṃ śūlaṃ gaṇḍaśvayathusaṃbhavaḥ | pavanasyordhvagāmitvaṃ tataś chardyarucijvarāḥ
verses.tib: chu sor shin tu zug pa dang / mkhur bar skrang pa 'byung bar 'gyur / rlung ni gyen du song gyur na / de las slon rims yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: hṛdrogagrahaṇīdoṣamūtrasaṅgapravāhikāḥ | bādhiryatimiraśvāsaśirorukkāsapīnasāḥ
verses.tib: snying nad be'u snabs ma zhu dang / gcin sri bshang ba 'khru ba dang / 'on dang rab rib dbugs mi bde / mgo na lud pa cham pas 'debs

verses.skt: manovikāras tṛṣṇāsrapittagulmodarādayaḥ | te te ca vātajā rogā jāyante bhṛśadāruṇāḥ
verses.tib: yid kyis 'gyur ba skom dang khrag / mkhris pa skran dang dmu rdzing / rlung gi nad gtogs de dang de / shin tu mi bzad 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: durnāmnām ity udāvartaḥ paramo ’yam upadravaḥ | vātābhibhūtakoṣṭhānāṃ tair vināpi sa jāyate
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum gyen du 'khyil 'gyur ba / 'di ni mchog tu gnod byed yin / rlung shas che ba'i khong par ni / de med par yang 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: sahajāni tridoṣāṇi yāni cābhyantare valau | sthitāni tāny asādhyāni yāpyante ’gnibalādibhiḥ
verses.tib: lhan cig skyes dang nad gsum ldan / phugs ma'i gnyer mar gang gnas pa / de dag gsor mi rung ba yin / me drod stobs che kyis 'tsho

verses.skt: dvandvajāni dvitīyāyāṃ valau yāny āśritāni ca | kṛcchrasādhyāni tāny āhuḥ parisaṃvatsarāṇi ca
verses.tib: 'dres las gyur dang gnyer ma ni / bar mar gnas pa gang yin pa / lo gcig yan chad lon gyur pa / de dag gso dka' yin par bshad

verses.skt: bāhyāyāṃ tu valau jātāny ekadoṣolbaṇāni ca | arśāṃsi sukhasādhyāni na cotpatitāni ca
verses.tib: phyi rol gnyer mar byung ba dang / nad gcig shas che las byung dang / skyes nas ring po ma lon gang / gzhang 'brum de ni gso ba sla

verses.skt: meḍhrādiṣv api vakṣyante yathāsvaṃ nābhijāni tu | gaṇḍūpadāsyarūpāṇi picchilāni mṛdūni ca
verses.tib: pho mtshan kyi 'og nas ni / rang rang skabs bshad lte bar skyes / rta bla ba yi kha 'dra zhing / 'byung bag can la 'jam pa yin

verses.skt: vyāno gṛhītvā śleṣmāṇaṃ karoty arśas tvaco bahiḥ | kīlopamaṃ sthirakharaṃ carmakīlaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ
verses.tib: khyab byed kyis ni bad kan bsdus / pags pa'i phyi rol thor bur byed / mdzer pa 'dra zhing rtsub par gnas / pags pa'i mdzer pa yin par shes

verses.skt: vātena todaḥ pāruṣyaṃ pittād asitaraktatā | śleṣmaṇā snigdhatā tasya grathitatvaṃ savarṇatā
verses.tib: rlung gis zug cing rtsub par 'gyur / mkhris pas gnag la dmar rtsar 'gyur / bad kan gyis de snum nyid dang / rmen bu'i mdog dang 'dra bar 'gyur

verses.skt: arśasāṃ praśame yatnam āśu kurvīta buddhimān | tāny āśu hi gudaṃ baddhvā kuryur baddhagudodaram
verses.tib: blo dang ldan pas myur bar ni / 'bad de gzhang 'brum gso bar byed / de yis gzhang ni myur 'gags nas / dmu rdzing nad ni skye bar 'gyur

verses.skt: doṣair vyastaiḥ samastaiś ca bhayāc chokāc ca ṣaḍvidhaḥ | atīsāraḥ sa sutarāṃ jāyate ’tyambupānataḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi sna re kun dang ni / 'jigs dang mya ngan las gyur pa'i / tshad pas 'khru ba rnam drug yin / de ni chu 'thungs drags pa dang

verses.skt: kṛśaśuṣkāmiṣāsātmyatilapiṣṭavirūḍhakaiḥ | madyarūkṣātimātrānnair arśobhiḥ snehavibhramāt
verses.tib: sha rid sha skam ma goms pa'i / til gyi khu ba ma smin 'bru / chang rtsub kha zas tshod ma zin / gzhang 'brum snum bag drags pa dang

verses.skt: kṛmibhyo vegarodhāc ca tadvidhaiḥ kupito ’nilaḥ | visraṃsayaty adho ’bdhātuṃ hatvā tenaiva cānalam
verses.tib: 'bu dang shugs ni bkag las 'byung / de 'dras rlung ni 'khrugs pa yis / chu khams thur du bskyod gyur la / de nyid kyis ni me drod nyams

verses.skt: vyāpadyānuśakṛt koṣṭhaṃ purīṣaṃ dravatāṃ nayan | prakalpate ’tisārāya lakṣaṇaṃ tasya bhāvinaḥ
verses.tib: de 'og khong pa khyab nas ni / bshang ba sla ba nyid du byed / de ltar tshad 'khru 'byung bar bshad / de yi 'byung 'gyur mtshan ma ni

verses.skt: todo hṛdgudakoṣṭheṣu gātrasādo malagrahaḥ | ādhmānam avipākaś ca tatra vātena viḍjalam
verses.tib: bshang lam snying ga lto bar zug / lus snyom bshang ba sri ba dang / sbo zhing kha zas mi 'ju ba'o / de las rlung gyur bshang chur bcas

verses.skt: alpālpaṃ śabdaśūlāḍhyaṃ vibaddham upaveśyate | rūkṣaṃ saphenam acchaṃ ca grathitaṃ vā muhur muhuḥ
verses.tib: nyung zhig 'byung zhing gzer sgra bcas / 'gag cing 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / rtsub sla dbu bar bcas pa 'am / gong bu yang dang yang du 'byung

verses.skt: tathā dagdhaguḍābhāsaṃ sapicchāparikartikam | śuṣkāsyo bhraṣṭapāyuś ca hṛṣṭaromā viniṣṭanan
verses.tib: de bzhin bu ram tshig pa 'dra / sbyin bag bcas shing bcad snyam sems / kha skam gzhang ni snad pa dang / spu langs pa dang 'khru ba yin

verses.skt: pittena pītam asitaṃ hāridraṃ śādvalaprabham | saraktam atidurgandhaṃ tṛṇmūrchāsvedadāhavān
verses.tib: mkhris pas ser zhing gnag pa dang / sngo zhing du ba'i mdog 'dra la / khrag bcas shin tu dri mnam pa / skom dad brgyal tsha rdul dang bcas

verses.skt: saśūlaṃ pāyusaṃtāpapākavāñ chleṣmaṇā ghanam | picchilaṃ tantumac chvetaṃ snigdham āmaṃ kaphānvitam
verses.tib: gzer bcas gzhang kha tsha dang bcas / gzhang khar thor bu 'byung ba yin / bad kan las gyur ska ba dang / 'byar bag dkar zhing nal nal po / snum zhing be'u snabs bad kan bcas

verses.skt: abhīkṣṇam guru durgandhaṃ vibaddham anubaddharuk | nidrālur alaso ’nnadviḍ alpālpaṃ sapravāhikam
verses.tib: rgyun du 'khru zhing lci la mnam / ska zhing nad rjes 'brang ba dang / gnyid che khong snyom yi ga 'chus / nyung zad nyung zad 'khru dang bcas

verses.skt: saromaharṣaṃ sotkleśo guruvastigudodaraḥ | kṛte ’py akṛtasaṃjñaś ca sarvātmā sarvalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: ba spu brtse zhing glong bcas dang / chu so lto ba gzhang kha lci / bshang yang bshang ba ma btang snyam / kun skyes mtshan nyid kun dang ldan

verses.skt: bhayena kṣobhite citte sapitto drāvayec chakṛt | vāyus tato ’tisāryeta kṣipram uṣṇaṃ dravaṃ plavam
verses.tib: 'jigs pas sems ni 'khrugs gyur pa / rlung gis mkhris bcas bshang ba ni / sla byed de nas 'khru ba ni / tsha zhing sla la 'phyo ba dang

verses.skt: vātapittasamaṃ liṅgair āhus tadvac ca śokataḥ | atīsāraḥ samāsena dvidhā sāmo nirāmakaḥ
verses.tib: mtshan ma rlung mkhris / las byung 'dra / mya ngan las byung de dang 'dra / mdor na tshad 'khru rnam gnyis te / ma zhur bcas dang ma zhu med

verses.skt: sāsṛṅ nirasras tatrādye gauravād apsu majjati | śakṛd durgandham āṭopaviṣṭambhārtiprasekinaḥ
verses.tib: khrag bcas khrag med de las ni / dang po bshang gci chur 'bying 'gyur / dri mnam lto ni sbo ba dang / mkhregs shing mchil snabs shin tu mang

verses.skt: viparīto nirāmas tu kaphāt pakvo ’pi majjati | atīsāreṣu yo nātiyatnavān grahaṇīgadaḥ
verses.tib: smin pa de las bzlog pa yin / bad kan smin pa'ang chu nang 'bying / gang zhig tshad 'khru 'bad pa ni / med des pho ba'i nad du 'gyur

verses.skt: tasya syād agnividhvaṃsakarair anyasya sevitaiḥ | sāmaṃ śakṛn nirāmaṃ vā jīrṇe yenātisāryate
verses.tib: me drod nyams par byed pa yi / zas bsten pa yis me drod nyams / gang zhig zhu nas bshang ba ni / be'u snabs bcas dang be'u snabs med

verses.skt: so ’tīsāro ’tisaraṇād āśukārī svabhāvataḥ | sāmaṃ sānnam ajīrṇe ’nne jīrṇe pakvaṃ tu naiva vā
verses.tib: 'khru ba de ni tshad 'khru ste / rang bzhin gyis ni myur gsod byed / ma zhu kha zas ma zhu dang / zhu ba smin pa'ang mi 'khru 'gyur

verses.skt: akasmād vā muhur baddham akasmāc chithilaṃ muhuḥ | cirakṛd grahaṇīdoṣaḥ saṃcayāc copaveśayet
verses.tib: rgyu med yang dang yang sri ba'am / rgyu med yang yang sla bar 'byung / pho bar ma zhu shing 'khru / yun ring na bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: sa caturdhā pṛthag doṣaiḥ saṃnipātāc ca jāyate | prāgrūpaṃ tasya sadanaṃ cirāt pacanam amlakaḥ
verses.tib: de ni nad sna re re 'dus / las byung rnam pa bzhi yin no / de yi sngon tshul snyom pa dang / ring nas 'ju zhing skyur bag 'byung

verses.skt: praseko vaktravairasyam arucis tṛṭ klamo bhramaḥ | ānaddhodaratā chardiḥ karṇakṣveḍo ’ntrakūjanam
verses.tib: rmya snyom skom zhing yi ga 'chus / lto sbo slon ni bro ba dang / rna ba rgyu ma sgra dang bcas

verses.skt: sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kārśyaṃ dhūmakas tamako jvaraḥ | mūrchā śirorug viṣṭambhaḥ śvayathuḥ karapādayoḥ
verses.tib: spyi yi mtshan nyid skem pa dang / du ba mun dang rims kyis 'debs / brgyal zhing mgo na bshang ba 'gags / rkang pa lag pa skrangs par 'gyur

verses.skt: tatrānilāt tāluśoṣas timiraṃ karṇayoḥ svanaḥ | pārśvoruvaṅkṣaṇagrīvārujābhīkṣṇaṃ viṣūcikā
verses.tib: de la rlung la rkan bskams zhing / rab rib rna bar sgra 'byung dang / rtsib logs brla dang chu sor na / bshang ba yang dang yang du 'byung / yang yang sbo zhing gsud pa dang

verses.skt: raseṣu gṛddhiḥ sarveṣu kṣut tṛṣṇā parikartikā | jīrṇe jīryati cādhmānaṃ bhukte svāsthyaṃ samaśnute
verses.tib: ro rnams kun la brkam pa dang / bkres skom rgyu ma bcad snyam sems / zas zhu nas ni sbo ba dang / zas zos nas ni bde bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vātahṛdrogagulmārśaḥplīhapāṇḍutvaśaṅkitaḥ | cirād duḥkhaṃ dravaṃ śuṣkaṃ tanv āmaṃ śabdaphenavat
verses.tib: rlung gi snying nad skran gzhang 'brum / mcher pa skya rbab 'byung bar dogs / bshang ba 'byung dka' ska slar 'byung / de yang be+e snabs sgra can 'byung / gzhang na lud pa dbugs mi bde / mkhris pa sngo zhing ser ba dang / ser po sla bag 'khru bar 'gyur

verses.skt: punaḥ punaḥ sṛjed varcaḥ pāyurukśvāsakāsavān | pittena nīlapītābhaṃ pītābhaḥ sṛjati dravam
verses.tib: rlung gi snying nad skran gzhang 'brum / mcher pa skya rbab 'byung bar dogs / bshang ba 'byung dka' ska slar 'byung / de yang be+e snabs sgra can 'byung / gzhang na lud pa dbugs mi bde / mkhris pa sngo zhing ser ba dang / ser po sla bag 'khru bar 'gyur

verses.skt: pūtyamlodgārahṛtkaṇṭhadāhārucitṛḍarditaḥ | śleṣmaṇā pacyate duḥkham annaṃ chardir arocakaḥ
verses.tib: mnam zhing sgregs sgyur snying lkog tsha / yi ga 'chus shing skom dad che / bad kan las gyur 'ju dka' zhing / zas slon yi ga 'chus pa dang

verses.skt: āsyopadehaniṣṭhīvakāsahṛllāsapīnasāḥ | hṛdayaṃ manyate styānam udaraṃ stimitaṃ guru
verses.tib: khar chags mchil ma mang ba dang / lud pa snying nad cham pas 'debs / snying ga mer mer por sems shing / lto ba tshor ba chung zhing lci

verses.skt: udgāro duṣṭamadhuraḥ sadanaṃ strīṣv aharṣaṇam | bhinnāmaśleṣmasaṃsṛṣṭaguruvarcaḥpravartanam
verses.tib: sgregs pa dri mnam mngar 'byung snyom / bud med mi dga' me drod chung / be'u snabs bad kan 'dres par 'khru / bshang ba lci bar 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: akṛśasyāpi daurbalyaṃ sarvaje sarvasaṃkaraḥ | vibhāge ’ṅgasya ye coktā viṣamādyās trayo ’gnayaḥ
verses.tib: rid pa min yang nyams stobs chung / kun skyes mtshan nyid 'dren mar ldan / ma snyoms la sogs me drod gsum / yan lag char phye gang bshad pa

verses.skt: te ’pi syur grahaṇīdoṣāḥ samas tu svāsthyakāraṇam | vātavyādhyaśmarīkuṣṭhamehodarabhagandarāḥ | arśāṃsi grahaṇīty aṣṭau mahārogāḥ sudustarāḥ
verses.tib: de yang pho ba'i nad du 'gyur / snyoms pa bde gnas rgyu yin no / rlung nad rde'u nad mdze nad dang / gcin snyi dmu rdzing mtshan bar rdol / gzhang 'brum pho nad ces bya brgyad / nad chen gso bar dka' ba yin

verses.skt: vastivastiśiromeḍhrakaṭīvṛṣaṇapāyavaḥ | ekasaṃbandhanāḥ proktā gudāsthivivarāśrayāḥ
verses.tib: lgang pa lgang pa'i mgo pho mtshan / rked pa rlig pa gzhang kha ni / gzhang kha'i rus par brten gyur zhing / gcig tu 'brel ba yin par bshad

verses.skt: adhomukho ’pi vastir hi mūtravāhisirāmukhaiḥ | pārśvebhyaḥ pūryate sūkṣmaiḥ syandamānair anāratam
verses.tib: lgang pa kha ni thur bltas kyang / gcin 'dzag pa yi rtsa sgo nas / rgyun mi 'chad par 'dzag pa yis / ngos gnyis nas ni phre'us 'gengs

verses.skt: yais tair eva praviśyainaṃ doṣāḥ kurvanti viṃśatim | mūtrāghātān pramehāṃś ca kṛcchrān marmasamāśrayān
verses.tib: zhugs pa gang yin de yis ni / gcin 'gags pa dang gcin snyi ba'i / gso dka' gnad la brten pa'i nad / nyi shu skyed par byed pa yin

verses.skt: vastivaṅkṣaṇameḍhrārtiyukto ’lpālpaṃ muhur muhuḥ | mūtrayed vātaje kṛcchre paitte pītaṃ sadāharuk
verses.tib: lgang pa chu so pho mtshan na / cung zad yang dang yang du 'byung / sri ba rlung las gyur ba yin / mkhris pa las gyur ser tsha na

verses.skt: raktaṃ vā kaphaje vastimeḍhragauravaśophavān | sapicchaṃ savibandhaṃ ca sarvaiḥ sarvātmakaṃ malaiḥ
verses.tib: mdog dmar bad kan las gyur pa / lgang pa pho mtshan lci zhing skrangs / 'byar bag ngal gyis 'byung zhing thogs / nad kun las byung mtshan kun ldan

verses.skt: yadā vāyur mukhaṃ vaster āvṛtya pariśoṣayet | mūtraṃ sapittaṃ sakaphaṃ saśukraṃ vā tadā kramāt
verses.tib: gang tshe rlung gis lgang pa'i kha / bkag pa de tshe gcin mkhris pa / bad kan khu chur bcas pa ni / rim gyis bskams par byas pa las

verses.skt: saṃjāyate ’śmarī ghorā pittād gor iva rocanā | śleṣmāśrayā ca sarvā syād athāsyāḥ pūrvalakṣaṇam
verses.tib: mi bzad rde'u chags 'gyur te / ba lang mkhris par gi / wang ltar / thams cad bad kan la brten 'gyur / 'di yi sngon tshul mtshan nyid ni

verses.skt: vastyādhmānaṃ tadāsannadeśeṣu parito ’tiruk | mūtre ca bastagandhatvaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ jvaro ’ruciḥ
verses.tib: lgang pa sbo zhing de yi ni / nye 'khor kun du rab tu na / gcin yang lhag par dbre bro zhing / gcin 'gags rims 'debs yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: sāmānyaliṅgaṃ ruṅ nābhisevanīvastimūrdhasu | viśīrṇadhāraṃ mūtraṃ syāt tayā mārganirodhane
verses.tib: spyi yi mtshan nyid lte ba dang / lgang mgo lgang pa'i srubs na zhing / de yis gcin 'byung sgo bkag pas / gcin gyi rgyun ni 'chad cing 'byung

verses.skt: tadvyapāyāt sukhaṃ mehed acchaṃ gomedakopamam | tatsaṃkṣobhāt kṣate sāsram āyāsāc cātirug bhavet
verses.tib: de byung zin nas bde bar byed / sla zhing ba lang tshil 'dra la / de bskyod pa yis khrag tu 'gyur / drag shul spyod pas rab tu na

verses.skt: tatra vātād bhṛśārtyārto dantān khādati vepate | mṛdnāti mehanaṃ nābhiṃ pīḍayaty aniśaṃ kvaṇan
verses.tib: de la rlung gyur shin tu na / so 'thams sdom zhing lus 'dar la / pho mtshan nyed cing lte ba 'tshir / rgyun du na zhing 'khun par byed

verses.skt: sānilaṃ muñcati śakṛn muhur mehati binduśaḥ | śyāvā rūkṣāśmarī cāsya syāc citā kaṇṭakair iva
verses.tib: bshang ba 'phyen dang bcas par 'byung / gcin gyi thigs pa yang yang 'ong / rde'u gnag cing rtsub pa dang / chu sor tsher mas gang snyam byed

verses.skt: pittena dahyate vastiḥ pacyamāna ivoṣmavān | bhallātakāsthisaṃsthānā raktā pītāsitāśmarī
verses.tib: mkhris pas lgang pa tsha ba dang / btsos pa snyam byed rab tu dro / go bye'i 'bras bu'i dbyibs 'dra la / rde'u mdog dmar zhing ser la gnag

verses.skt: vastir nistudyata iva śleṣmaṇā śītalo guruḥ | aśmarī mahatī ślakṣṇā madhuvarṇāthavā sitā
verses.tib: bad kan gyis bsil lci ba dang / lgang pa'i nang du zug cing na / rde'u che zhing 'jam pa la / sbrang rtsi'i mdog gam yang na dkar

verses.skt: etā bhavanti bālānāṃ teṣām eva ca bhūyasā | āśrayopacayālpatvād grahaṇāharaṇe sukhāḥ
verses.tib: 'di dag byis pa rnams la ni / phal cher 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin / gnas dang sha ni chung ba'i phyir / bzung dang dbyung ba bde ba yin

verses.skt: śukrāśmarī tu mahatāṃ jāyate śukradhāraṇāt | sthānāc cyutam amuktaṃ hi muṣkayor antare ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: mi chen khu ba las byung rde'u / khu ba bkag las 'byung bar 'gyur / gnas las 'phos pa phyir ma byung / rlig bar gnas pa rlung gis ni

verses.skt: śoṣayaty upasaṃgṛhya śukraṃ tac chuṣkam aśmarī | vastirukkṛcchramūtratvamuṣkaśvayathukāriṇī
verses.tib: bskams nas nye bar bsdus gyur pa / de ni khu ba rde'u chags yin / lgang par gcin ni sri byed cing / tsha zhing skrang bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: tasyām utpannamātrāyāṃ śukram eti vilīyate | pīḍite tv avakāśe ’sminn aśmary eva ca śarkarā
verses.tib: de ni skyes ma thag tu ni / khu ba zhu ste sla bar 'gyur / phyogs der mnan na zhu bar byed / rde'u gseg ma lta bur gnas

verses.skt: aṇuśo vāyunā bhinnā sā tv asminn anulomage | nireti saha mūtreṇa pratilome vibadhyate
verses.tib: rlung gis phye mar bshig gyur pa / de 'dir tshul bzhin 'byung zhes bya / gcin dang lhan cig phyir 'byung 'gyur / lugs bzhin mi 'byung rde'ur chags

verses.skt: mūtrasaṃdhāriṇaḥ kuryād ruddhvā vaster mukhaṃ marut | mūtrasaṅgaṃ rujaṃ kaṇḍūṃ kadācic ca svadhāmataḥ
verses.tib: gcin ni bkag par / byas gyur pas / rlung gis lgang ba'i kha bkag nas / gcin 'gags na zhing g.ya' bar 'gyur / lan 'ga' rang gnas las spangs nas

verses.skt: pracyāvya vastim udvṛttaṃ garbhābhaṃ sthūlaviplutam | karoti tatra rugdāhaspandanodveṣṭanāni ca
verses.tib: lgang pa rgyas te kha che zhing / mngal 'dra sbom zhing log par 'dug / der ni na zhing tsha bar byed / 'phar zhing gcus pa snyam du sems

verses.skt: binduśaś ca pravarteta mūtraṃ vastau tu pīḍite | dhārayā dvividho ’py eṣa vātavastir iti smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: thigs pa tsam du 'dzag pa dang / lgang btsir rgyun ni 'byung bar 'gyur / rnam pa gnyis po 'di dag ni / rlung gi lgang pa'i nad ces bya

verses.skt: dustaro dustarataro dvitīyaḥ prabalānilaḥ | śakṛnmārgasya vasteś ca vāyur antaram āśritaḥ
verses.tib: gso dka' gnyis pa rlung gi yin / mthu chen shin tu gso dka' yin / bshang lam de ni ldang pa yi / bar na rlung ni brten gyur pa

verses.skt: aṣṭhīlābhaṃ ghanaṃ granthiṃ karoty acalam unnatam | vātāṣṭhīleti sādhmānaviṇmūtrānilasaṅgakṛt
verses.tib: gtun 'dra sra zhing mtho ba dang / mi 'gyur gnas byed mdud pa can / rlung nad gtun 'dra de sbos bcas / bshang gci 'phyen ni 'gags byed yin

verses.skt: viguṇaḥ kuṇḍalībhūto vastau tīvravyatho ’nilaḥ | āvidhya mūtraṃ bhramati sastambhodveṣṭagauravaḥ
verses.tib: log rgyu 'khyil bar byed pa yi / rlung gis chu sor mi bzad gzer / gcin las zhugs te 'khyil byed cing / rengs byed lci zhing gcus snyam byed

verses.skt: mūtram alpālpam athavā vimuñcati śakṛt sṛjan | vātakuṇḍalikety eṣā mūtraṃ tu vidhṛtaṃ ciram
verses.tib: gcin ni nyung shas nyung shas 'byung / yang na bshang gci gtong tshe 'byung / 'di ni rlung nad 'khyil ba yin / gcin ni yun bkag gyur pa

verses.skt: na nireti vibaddhaṃ vā mūtrātītaṃ tad alparuk | vidhāraṇāt pratihataṃ vātodāvartitaṃ yadā
verses.tib: sri zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur la / gcin thon nas ni nad tshabs 'bri / gcin bkag pa yis gnod gyur pa / gang tshe rlung gis bzlog gyur pa

verses.skt: nābher adhastād udaraṃ mūtram āpūrayet tadā | kuryāt tīvrarug ādhmānam apaktiṃ malasaṃgraham
verses.tib: lte ba'i 'og nas lte ba'i bar / gcin gyis gang 'gyur de yi tshe / rab tu na zhing sbos pa dang / zas mi 'ju zhing dri ma 'gags

verses.skt: tan mūtrajaṭharaṃ chidravaiguṇyenānilena vā | ākṣiptam alpaṃ mūtraṃ tad vastau nāle ’thavā maṇau
verses.tib: gcin 'byung bu ga 'chus pa'am / rlung gis bkag nas gcin nyung 'byung / lgang pa mtshan sbubs nor bu ni

verses.skt: sthitvā sravec chanaiḥ paścāt sarujaṃ vātha nīrujam | mūtrotsaṅgaḥ sa vicchinnataccheṣaguruśephasaḥ
verses.tib: gnas nas de 'og rim gyis 'dzag / nad bcas pa'am nad med pa / gcin ni chad dang bcas par 'byung / lhag ma lus te mtshan lci yin

verses.skt: antar vastimukhe vṛttaḥ sthiro ’lpaḥ sahasā bhavet | aśmarītulyarug granthir mūtragranthiḥ sa ucyate
verses.tib: lgang pa'i kha nang zlum zhing sra / cung zhig 'phral du 'byung 'gyur na / gcin rde'u lta bu ni / gcin gyi mdud par de bshad do

verses.skt: mūtritasya striyaṃ yāto vāyunā śukram uddhatam | sthānāc cyutaṃ mūtrayataḥ prāk paścād vā pravartate
verses.tib: rlung gis khu ba bskyod gyur pa / gnas las bskyod cing gcin btang tshe / sngon nam phyi nas thal chu dang

verses.skt: bhasmodakapratīkāśaṃ mūtraśukraṃ tad ucyate | rūkṣadurbalayor vātād udāvartaṃ śakṛd yadā
verses.tib: mdog 'dra byung bar 'gyur ba yin / khu ba 'dres par de bshad do / rtsub cing skem la rlung gis ni / gang tshe rtug skam nad gyur pa

verses.skt: mūtrasroto ’nuparyeti saṃsṛṣṭaṃ śakṛtā tadā | mūtraṃ viṭtulyagandhaṃ syād viḍvighātaṃ tam ādiśet
verses.tib: gcin 'byung bu gar song nas ni / bshang ba dang 'dres de yi tshe / gcin ni bshang ba'i dri can 'byung / bshang ba 'gags par de bshad do

verses.skt: pittaṃ vyāyāmatīkṣṇoṣṇabhojanādhvātapādibhiḥ | pravṛddhaṃ vāyunā kṣiptaṃ vastyupasthārtidāhavat
verses.tib: mkhris pa drag shul kha zas ni / rno tsha nyi tshan la sogs kyis / 'phel zhing rlung ni zhugs gyur pa / lgang pa'i nye 'khor tsha zhing na

verses.skt: mūtraṃ pravartayet pītaṃ saraktaṃ raktam eva vā | uṣṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kṛcchrād uṣṇavātaṃ vadanti tam
verses.tib: gcin ni ser por 'gyur ba 'am / yang na khrag bcas khrag nyid 'byung / tsha zhing sril yang yang 'byung / de ni tsha rlung zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: rūkṣasya klāntadehasya vastisthau pittamārutau | mūtrakṣayaṃ sarugdāhaṃ janayetāṃ tadāhvayam
verses.tib: rtsub cing lus ni rmya ba yi / lgang par gnas pa'i mkhris pa rlung / gcin zad tsha dang na bar bcas / bskyed pa de yang de skad bshad

verses.skt: pittaṃ kapho dvāv api vā saṃhanyete ’nilena cet | kṛcchrān mūtraṃ tadā pītaṃ raktaṃ śvetaṃ ghanaṃ sṛjet
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pa gnyi ga la / rlung gis bskyod par gyur na ni / de tshe gcin sri ser ba dang / dmar zhing dkar la ska ba 'byung

verses.skt: sadāhaṃ rocanāśaṅkhacūrṇavarṇaṃ bhavec ca tat | śuṣkaṃ samastavarṇaṃ vā mūtrasādaṃ vadanti tam
verses.tib: de ni tsha bcas gi wang ngam / dung gi phye ma'i mdog 'dra 'am / yang na skam zhing mdog kun ldan / de ni gcin nyams nad du bshad

verses.skt: iti vistarataḥ proktā rogā mūtrāpravṛttijāḥ | nidānalakṣaṇair ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyante ’tipravṛttijāḥ
verses.tib: de ltar gcin 'gags las byung ba'i / mtshan nyid rgya cher bshad nas ni / de 'og gcin snyi las byung ba'i / nad gzhi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa yin

verses.skt: pramehā viṃśatis tatra śleṣmato daśa pittataḥ | ṣaṭ catvāro ’nilāt teṣāṃ medomūtrakaphāvaham
verses.tib: gcin snyi'i nad ni nyi shu ste / de las bad kan las gyur bcu / mkhris pa las drug rlung gyur bzhi / de rnams tshil gcin bad kan skyed

verses.skt: annapānakriyājātaṃ yat prāyas tat pravartakam | svādvamlalavaṇasnigdhagurupicchilaśītalam
verses.tib: zas dang skom gyi tshul las ni / phal cher de dag 'byung bar byed / mngar dang skyur dang lan tshwa dang / lci zhing 'byil la bsil ba dang

verses.skt: navadhānyasurānūpamāṃsekṣuguḍagorasam | ekasthānāsanaratiḥ śayanaṃ vidhivarjitam
verses.tib: 'bru mar chang dang gsher ba'i sha / dar ba bu ram bu ram shing / gnas gcig stan gcig la rtag gnas / mal stan cho gar mi ldan la

verses.skt: vastim āśritya kurute pramehān dūṣitaḥ kaphaḥ | dūṣayitvā vapuḥkledasvedamedorasāmiṣam
verses.tib: brten nas gcin snyi'i nad skyed byed / bad kan 'khrugs / las lgang pa'i gcin / snyi 'gyur lus gsher rdul tshil dang / sha glongs lgang par brten cing snyi

verses.skt: pittaṃ raktam api kṣīṇe kaphādau mūtrasaṃśrayam | dhātūn vastim upānīya tatkṣaye ’pi ca mārutaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pas khrag kyang zad byas nas / bad kan zad gcin gnas bskyed / rlung 'khrugs pa dang de zad las / lus zungs lgang par 'khus te bskyed / de byung gso bya 'tsho tsam dang / spang bya gcin nad rnam gsum 'gyur / mdor na mi mthun bya ba dang / nad dmigs chen po nyid kyis 'byung

verses.skt: sādhyayāpyaparityājyā mehās tenaiva tadbhavāḥ | samāsam akriyatayā mahātyayatayāpi ca
verses.tib: mkhris pas khrag kyang zad byas nas / bad kan zad gcin gnas bskyed / rlung 'khrugs pa dang de zad las / lus zungs lgang par 'khus te bskyed / de byung gso bya 'tsho tsam dang / spang bya gcin nad rnam gsum 'gyur / mdor na mi mthun bya ba dang / nad dmigs chen po nyid kyis 'byung

verses.skt: sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ prabhūtāvilamūtratā | doṣadūṣyāviśeṣe ’pi tatsaṃyogaviśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: de rnams kyi ni spyi'i mtshan nyid / gcin ni rnyog ma can du 'byung / gnod dang gnod bya khyad med kyang / de dus khyad par nyid dang ni

verses.skt: mūtravarṇādibhedena bhedo meheṣu kalpyate | acchaṃ bahu sitaṃ śītaṃ nirgandham udakopamam
verses.tib: gcin gyi mdog dbye ba yis / gcin snyi'i dbye ba brtag par bya / dang zhing mang la dkar zhing bsil / dri nga med cing chu 'dra ba

verses.skt: mehaty udakamehena kiñcic cāvilapicchilam | ikṣo rasam ivātyarthaṃ madhuraṃ cekṣumehataḥ
verses.tib: gcin snyi chu yi za khu yin / cung zad rnyog can sbyin bag can / bu ram shing khu lta bur mngar

verses.skt: sāndrībhavet paryuṣitaṃ sāndramehena mehati | surāmehī surātulyam upary accham adho ghanam
verses.tib: zhag lon na ni ska bar 'gyur / za khu gar po zhes bya'o / steng na dngas ma 'og na ska / chang 'dra chang gi za khu yin

verses.skt: saṃhṛṣṭaromā piṣṭena piṣṭavad bahalaṃ sitam | śukrābhaṃ śukramiśraṃ vā śukramehī pramehati
verses.tib: ba sbu ldang zhing 'bras btags 'dra / dkar zhing mang 'byung 'bras phye 'dra / khu chu 'dra ba'am khu ba 'dres / khu ba 'dra ba'i za khu yin

verses.skt: mūrtāṇūn sikatāmehī sikatārūpiṇo malān | śītamehī subahuśo madhuraṃ bhṛśaśītalam
verses.tib: gcin ni bye tshigs dri ma can / bye ma'i za khu zhes bya'o / gcin snyi mang du 'byung zhing bsil / mngar ba de bsil za khu yin

verses.skt: śanaiḥ śanaiḥ śanairmehī mandaṃ mandaṃ pramehati | lālātantuyutaṃ mūtraṃ lālāmehena picchilam
verses.tib: dal gyis nyung zad nyung zad 'byung / bags kyis 'byung ba'i za khu yin / kha chu 'dra ba'i nal nal po / 'byil bag kha chu'i za khu yin

verses.skt: gandhavarṇarasasparśaiḥ kṣāreṇa kṣāratoyavat | nīlamehena nīlābhaṃ kālamehī maṣīnibham
verses.tib: dri ro kha dog reg bya ni / nas tshig 'khus 'dra nas tshig can / za khu sngon po kha dog sngo / za khu nag po snag tsha 'dra

verses.skt: hāridramehī kaṭukaṃ haridrāsaṃnibhaṃ dahat | visraṃ māñjiṣṭhamehena mañjiṣṭhāsalilopamam
verses.tib: gcin snyi tsha zhing mdog ser ba / de ni skyer pa 'dra ba yin / mnam zhing btsod kyi khu ba 'dra / btsod kyi za khu zhes bya'o

verses.skt: visram uṣṇaṃ salavaṇaṃ raktābhaṃ raktamehataḥ | vasāmehī vasāmiśraṃ vasāṃ vā mūtrayen muhuḥ
verses.tib: dri nga tsha zhing lan tshwar bcas / khrag 'dra khrag gi za khu yin / zhag gi za khu zhag dang 'dres / zhag nyid gcin du 'byung ba yin

verses.skt: majjānaṃ majjamiśraṃ vā majjamehī muhur muhuḥ | hastī matta ivājasraṃ mūtraṃ vegavivarjitam
verses.tib: rkang 'dres pa'am rkang nyid ni / yang dang yang 'byung rkang za khu / glang chen myos ltar rgyun du ni / gcin shugs dal bar 'byung 'gyur la

verses.skt: salasīkaṃ vibaddhaṃ ca hastimehī pramehati | madhumehī madhusamaṃ jāyate sa kila dvidhā
verses.tib: chu ser bcas shing rnyog bcas 'byung / glang chen za khu zhes bya'o / sbrang rtsi'i za khu sbrang rtsi 'dra / de ni rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur

verses.skt: kruddhe dhātukṣayād vāyau doṣāvṛtapathe ’thavā | āvṛto doṣaliṅgāni so ’nimittaṃ pradarśayet
verses.tib: lus zungs zad pas rlung 'khrugs pa'am / nad kyis rtsa sbubs bkag ste 'byung / nad kyis bkag pa'i mtshan ma dag / de ni rgyu med par 'byung zhing

verses.skt: kṣīṇaḥ kṣaṇāt kṣaṇāt pūrṇo bhajate kṛcchrasādhyatām | kālenopekṣitāḥ sarve yad yānti madhumehatām
verses.tib: skad cig zad stong gang 'gyur ba / gso bar dka' ba nyid du 'gyur / thams cad dus su ma bcos na / sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i za khur 'gyur

verses.skt: madhuraṃ yac ca sarveṣu prāyo madhv iva mehati | sarve ’pi madhumehākhyā mādhuryāc ca tanor ataḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig thams cad mngar 'gyur bas / phal cher sbrang rtsi'i za khu yin / sbrang rtsi'i za khu zhes bya kun / mngar ba las ni bshad pa yin

verses.skt: avipāko ’ruciś chardir nidrā kāsaḥ sapīnasaḥ | upadravāḥ prajāyante mehānāṃ kaphajanmanām
verses.tib: zas mi 'ju zhing yi ga 'chus / slon lud gnyid che cham pas 'debs / bad kan las byung za khu la / bla brnan de dag 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vastimehanayos todo muṣkāvadaraṇaṃ jvaraḥ | dāhas tṛṣṇāmlako mūrchā viḍbhedaḥ pittajanmanām
verses.tib: pho mtshan lgang par zug pa dang / rlig 'bras bye zhing rims kyis 'debs / tsha skyur skom dad brgyal dang 'khru / mkhris pa las gyur bla brnan yin

verses.skt: vātikānām udāvartakampahṛdgrahalolatāḥ | śūlam unnidratā śoṣaḥ kāsaḥ śvāsaś ca jāyate
verses.tib: rlung las skyes pa'i snying 'phar zhing / lus 'dar snying na zas la brkam / gzer zhing gnyid med skem pa dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba 'byung

verses.skt: śarāvikā kacchapikā jālinī vinatālajī | masūrikā sarṣapikā putriṇī savidārikā
verses.tib: kham phor rus sbal 'dra ba can / sgu bo me dbal phra mo dang / sran chung 'dra dang nyungs kar 'dra / bu bcas 'byung dang pi da ri

verses.skt: vidradhiś ceti piṭikāḥ pramehopekṣayā daśa | saṃdhimarmasu jāyante māṃsaleṣu ca dhāmasu
verses.tib: khong 'bras zhes bya'i 'bras 'brum bcu / gcin nad ma bcos pa las 'byung / tshigs dang gnad dang sha che ba'i / srog gi gnas su 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: antonnatā madhyanimnā śyāvā kledarujānvitā | śarāvamānasaṃsthānā piṭikā syāc charāvikā
verses.tib: mtha' ma mtho zhing dbus ma dma' / gnag cing rnag dang nad btsas la / dbyibs dang tshad ni kham phor 'dra / thor bu kham phor zhes bya'o / nang du zug cing na byed la / nye 'khor dag tu cher mched cing / 'jam zhing rus sbal rgyab 'dra ba'i / 'bras nad rus sbal can zhes bya

verses.skt: avagāḍhārtinistodā mahāvastuparigrahā | ślakṣṇā kacchapapṛṣṭhābhā piṭikā kacchapī matā
verses.tib: mtha' ma mtho zhing dbus ma dma' / gnag cing rnag dang nad btsas la / dbyibs dang tshad ni kham phor 'dra / thor bu kham phor zhes bya'o / nang du zug cing na byed la / nye 'khor dag tu cher mched cing / 'jam zhing rus sbal rgyab 'dra ba'i / 'bras nad rus sbal can zhes bya

verses.skt: stabdhā sirājālavatī snigdhasrāvā mahāśayā | rujānistodabahulā sūkṣmacchidrā ca jālinī
verses.tib: sra zhing rtsa yi dra ba can / snum zhing 'dzag la khyon che ba / na zhing nang zug bu ga / ni / phra mor ldan pa dra ba can

verses.skt: avagāḍharujākledā pṛṣṭhe vā jaṭhare ’pi vā | mahatī piṭikā nīlā vinatā vinatā smṛtā
verses.tib: nang du zug cing na la rnags / rgyab bam lto ba dag tu ni / thor bu chen po kha dog gnag / sku bor 'dug pas sgu bor bshad

verses.skt: dahati tvacam utthāne bhṛśaṃ kaṣṭā visarpiṇī | raktakṛṣṇātitṛṭsphoṭadāhamohajvarālajī
verses.tib: skyes ma thag tu pags pa tsha / shin tu na byed me dbal te / dmar zhing gnag la gas pa dang / tsha zhing rmugs byed me dbal phra

verses.skt: mānasaṃsthānayos tulyā masūreṇa masūrikā | sarṣapāmānasaṃsthānā kṣiprapākā mahārujā
verses.tib: sran chung 'dra ba'i tshad dang dbyibs / mnyam pas sran chung can yin no / tshad dang dbyibs ni nyungs kar 'dra / myur du smin zhing nad tshabs che

verses.skt: sarṣapī sarṣapātulyapiṭikāparivāritā | putriṇī mahatī bhūrisusūkṣmapiṭikācitā
verses.tib: yungs kar 'dra ba'i 'brum phran gyis / yongs su bskor bas chu bur can / bu bcas che zhing mang ba la / rab phra'i 'brum bus khyab gyur pa'o

verses.skt: vidārīkandavad vṛttā kaṭhinā ca vidārikā | vidradhir vakṣyate ’nyatra tatrādyaṃ piṭikātrayam
verses.tib: ldum bu bi da ri ltar ldum / sra ba bi da ri zhes bya / khong 'bras gzhan du bshad pa yin / de la dang po'i 'bras nad gsum

verses.skt: putriṇī ca vidārī ca duḥsahā bahumedasaḥ | sahyāḥ pittolbaṇās tv anyāḥ saṃbhavanty alpamedasaḥ
verses.tib: bu bcas dang ni bi da ri / tshil chen las byung brnag dka' yin / gzhan dag mkhris pa shas che zhing / tshil chung las byung brnag nus 'gyur

verses.skt: tāsu mehavaśāc ca syād doṣodreko yathāyatham | prameheṇa vināpy etā jāyante duṣṭamedasaḥ | tāvac ca nopalakṣyante yāvad vastuparigrahaḥ
verses.tib: de rnams nad shas ji ltar che'i / gcin snyi ba yi dbang las 'byung / 'di dag za khu med par ni / gnod gyur tshil las 'byung 'gyur te / ji srid dngos po mi snang ba / de srid shes par mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: hāridravarṇaṃ raktaṃ vā mehaprāgrūpavarjitam | yo mūtrayen na taṃ mehaṃ raktapittaṃ tu tad viduḥ
verses.tib: kha dog ljang ba'am dmar ba'i gcin / za khu'i sngon tshul med pa yis / gcin 'byung gang de za khu min / de ni khrag mkhris yin zhes bya

verses.skt: svedo ’ṅgagandhaḥ śithilatvam aṅge śayyāsanasvapnasukhābhiṣaṅgaḥ | hṛnnetrajihvāśravaṇopadeho ghanāṅgatā keśanakhātivṛddhiḥ
verses.tib: lus rdul yan lag mnan zhing lhod pa dang / stan dang mal dang gnyid kyi bde la chags / snying mig rna ba kha lce byugs snyam byed / lus sbom skra dang sen mo ring ba dang

verses.skt: śītapriyatvaṃ galatāluśoṣo mādhuryam āsye karapādadāhaḥ | bhaviṣyato mehagaṇasya rūpaṃ mūtre ’bhidhāvanti pipīlikāś ca
verses.tib: bsil bag la dga' gre ba rkan bskams shing / kha nang ro mngar rkang mthil lag mthil tsha / gang du gcis par grog ma 'du 'gyur ba / gcin nad za khu'i tshogs ni phyis 'byung tshul

verses.skt: dṛṣṭvā pramehaṃ madhuraṃ sapicchaṃ madhūpamaṃ syād vividho vicāraḥ | saṃpūraṇād vā kaphasaṃbhavaḥ syāt kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣv anilātmako vā
verses.tib: za khu sbrang rtsi'i mdog 'dra 'byil ba dang / sbrang rtsi'i ro 'dra ba la gnyis su rtog / lus brtas bad kan can gyi za khu'am / nyes pa zad pas / rlung gi bdag can yin

verses.skt: sapūrvarūpāḥ kaphapittamehāḥ krameṇa ye vātakṛtāś ca mehāḥ | sādhyā na te pittakṛtās tu yāpyāḥ sādhyās tu medo yadi nātiduṣṭam
verses.tib: sngon tshul bcas pa'i bad mkhris za khu dang / gang yang rim gyis rlung nad za khur 'gyur / mkhris pa las gyur gang yin gso bar dka' / gal te tshil nad chung gyur gso sla

verses.skt: bhuktaiḥ paryuṣitātyuṣṇarūkṣaśuṣkavidāhibhiḥ | jihmaśayyāviceṣṭābhis tais taiś cāsṛkpradūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: kha zas khengs bu rab tsha dang / rtsub dang skam dang tsha 'gyur zos / nyal ba'i spyod pa mi bde bas / khrag nad skyed 'gyur de dang des

verses.skt: duṣṭatvaṅmāṃsamedo'sthisnāyvasṛkkaṇḍarāśrayaḥ | yaḥ śopho bahir antar vā mahāmūlo mahārujaḥ
verses.tib: pags pa sha tshil rus pa dang / khrag dang chu ba chu ba che / phyi dang nang du skrangs gyur pa / rtsa ba che zhing nad tshabs che

verses.skt: vṛttaḥ syād āyato yo vā smṛtaḥ ṣoḍhā sa vidradhiḥ | doṣaiḥ pṛthak samuditaiḥ śoṇitena kṣatena ca
verses.tib: zlum po'am 'jong bar gnas pa gang / khong 'bras de ni rnam pa drug / nad dmigs sna re 'dus pa dang / khrag dang smas pa las byung ba'o

verses.skt: bāhyo ’tra tatra tatrāṅge dāruṇo grathitonnataḥ | āntaro dāruṇataro gambhīro gulmavad ghanaḥ
verses.tib: 'dir phyi'i yan lag de dang der / rab na mdud pa 'dra la mtho / nang gi shin tu mi bzad cing / gting ring skran ltar sra ba yin

verses.skt: valmīkavat samucchrāyī śīghraghāty agniśastravat | nābhivastiyakṛtplīhaklomahṛtkukṣivaṅkṣaṇe
verses.tib: grog mkhar lta bur mtho ba dang / me dang mtshon ltar myur gsod byed / lte ba chu so mchin mcher pa / glo dang snying lto brla rtsa dang

verses.skt: syād vṛkkayor apāne ca vātāt tatrātitīvraruk | śyāvāruṇaś cirotthānapāko viṣamasaṃsthitiḥ
verses.tib: mkhal ma gnyis sam gzhang du'ang 'byung / de la rlung gyur nad tshabs drag / dmar nag ring zhig lon nas ni / 'byung zhing smin pa dbyibs mi snyoms

verses.skt: vyadhacchedabhramānāhaspandasarpaṇaśabdavān | raktatāmrāsitaḥ pittāt tṛṇmohajvaradāhavān
verses.tib: ran zhing mgo 'khor spos ba dang / g.yo zhing 'pho la sgra dang bcas / mkhris gyur zangs ltar dmar rtsa gnag / skom dad tsha rims rmongs bag skyed

verses.skt: kṣiprotthānaprapākaś ca pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūyutaḥ kaphāt | sotkleśaśītakastambhajṛmbhārocakagauravaḥ
verses.tib: ldang zhing smin pa myur ba yin / bad kan las skya g.ya' dang bcas / slon zhing bsil la sla ba dang / glal zhing lci la yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: cirotthānavipākaś ca saṃkīrṇaḥ saṃnipātataḥ | sāmarthyāc cātra vibhajed bāhyābhyantaralakṣaṇam
verses.tib: 'byung zhing smin pa yun ring thogs / 'dus pa las gyur 'dren ma yin / 'dir ni phyi nang gnyis mtshan nyid / don gyi dbang las shes par bya

verses.skt: kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ śyāvas tīvradāharujājvaraḥ | pittaliṅgo ’sṛjā bāhyaḥ strīṇām eva tathāntaraḥ
verses.tib: 'brum bu nag pos khebs shing gnag / rab tsha na zhing rims kyis 'debs / mkhris pa'i rtags ldan phyi 'am / nang / khrag gyur bud med nyid la 'byung

verses.skt: śastrādyair abhighātena kṣate vāpathyakāriṇaḥ | kṣatoṣmā vāyuvikṣiptaḥ saraktaṃ pittam īrayan
verses.tib: mtshon la pas smas pa yis / rma byung mi 'phrod bsten pa las / rma kha'i tsha ba rlung gis phul / khrag bcas mkhris pa 'byung bar byed

verses.skt: pittāsṛglakṣaṇaṃ kuryād vidradhiṃ bhūryupadravam | teṣūpadravabhedaś ca smṛto ’dhiṣṭhānabhedataḥ
verses.tib: khong 'bras bla brnan nad mang zhing / khrag mkhris mtshan nyid can dag byed / bla brnan de yi dbye ba yang / gnas kyi dbye ba las bshad do

verses.skt: nābhyāṃ hidhmā bhaved vastau mūtraṃ kṛcchreṇa pūti ca | śvāso yakṛti rodhas tu plīhny ucchvāsasya tṛṭ punaḥ
verses.tib: lte bar byung na skyigs bu ste / chu sor gcin 'gags rnag tu 'gyur / mcher pa dbugs mi bde mchin par / dbugs 'byung 'gag skom mgo 'khor 'gyur

verses.skt: galagrahaś ca klomni syāt sarvāṅgapragraho hṛdi | pramohas tamakaḥ kāso hṛdaye ghaṭṭanaṃ vyathā
verses.tib: glo bar byung na lkog nad 'gyur / snying byung yan lag kun gzir snyam / rab rmongs mun sros snyam du byed / snying 'phar na bar 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: kukṣipārśvāntarāṃsārtiḥ kukṣāv āṭopajanma ca | sakthnor graho vaṅkṣaṇayor vṛkkayoḥ kaṭipṛṣṭhayoḥ
verses.tib: lto ba rtsib logs phrag pa'i bar / na zhing lto sbos 'byung bar 'gyur / chu so mdoms bar byung brla na / mkhal mar byung na rked pa rgyab

verses.skt: pārśvayoś ca vyathā pāyau pavanasya nirodhanam | āmapakvavidagdhatvaṃ teṣāṃ śophavad ādiśet
verses.tib: rtsib logs su ni na bar 'gyur / gzhang du rlung ni thur 'byung 'gags / zhu dang ma zhu phyed nyid zhu / de dag 'or nad lta bur bshad

verses.skt: nābher ūrdhvaṃ mukhāt pakvāḥ prasravanty adhare gudāt | gudāsyān nābhijo vidyād doṣaṃ kledāc ca vidradhau
verses.tib: lte ba yan chad smin khar 'dzag / lte ba man chad gzhang du 'dzag / lte bar gnas pa gnyi gar 'dzag / khong 'bras kyi ni nad dmigs rnams

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ vraṇavat tatra vivarjyaḥ saṃnipātajaḥ | pakvo hṛnnābhivastistho bhinno ’ntar bahir eva vā
verses.tib: 'dzag las rma ltar shes par bya / de las 'dus pa las gyur dang / snying dang lte ba chu sor gnas / phyi 'am nang du bye ba 'am

verses.skt: pakvaś cāntaḥ sravan vaktrāt kṣīṇasyopadravānvitaḥ | evam eva stanasirā vivṛtāḥ prāpya yoṣitām
verses.tib: smin te kha nas 'dzag pa ni / nyam chung bla brnan ldan pa spang / de bzhin bud med bu btsas pa'am

verses.skt: sūtānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ vā saṃbhavec chvayathur ghanaḥ | stane sadugdhe ’dugdhe vā bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: sbrum ma'am nu zho yod pa dang / nu zho med pa'i nu ma yi / rtsa sgo kha byer phyin gyur nas / phyi yi khong 'bras mtshan nyid can

verses.skt: nāḍīnāṃ sūkṣmavaktratvāt kanyānāṃ na sa jāyate | kruddho ruddhagatir vāyuḥ śophaśūlakaraś caran
verses.tib: bu mo rnams kyi nu rtsa'i sgo / phra bas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro / rlung ni rgyu lam 'gags pas 'khrugs / skrang dang gzer ni skyed cing rgyu

verses.skt: muṣkau vaṅkṣaṇataḥ prāpya phalakośābhivāhinīḥ | prapīḍya dhamanīr vṛddhiṃ karoti phalakośayoḥ
verses.tib: chu so rlig par phyin pa dang / rlig par rgyu ba'i rtsa dag ni / btsir nas rlig pa pags pa dag / 'phel zhing rlig rlugs nyid du phyed

verses.skt: doṣāsramedomūtrāntraiḥ sa vṛddhiḥ saptadhā gadaḥ | mūtrāntrajāv apy anilād dhetubhedas tu kevalam
verses.tib: rang / khrag gcin tshil rgyu ma las / rlig rlugs de ni rnam bdun 'gyur / rgyu ma gcin skyes pa'am rlung / rgyu ma'i dbye ba 'ba' zhig gzhan

verses.skt: vātapūrṇadṛtisparśo rūkṣo vātād aheturuk | pakvodumbarasaṃkāśaḥ pittād dāhoṣmapākavān
verses.tib: rlung gyur rkyal pa gang 'dra zhing / reg na rtsub cing rgyu med na / mkhris gyur u dum+bA ra yi / 'bras bu smin 'dra tsha dro 'drul

verses.skt: kaphāc chīto guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino ’lparuk | kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaś ca raktataḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las bsil lci zhing snum / g.ya' zhing sra la nad tshabs chung / khrag gyur gnag cing 'brum bus khyab / mkhris pa'i rlig rlugs mtshan nyid ldan

verses.skt: kaphavan medasā vṛddhir mṛdus tālaphalopamaḥ | mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajaḥ sa tu gacchataḥ
verses.tib: tshil gyur rlig rlugs bad kan 'dra / 'jam zhing ta la'i 'bras bur mtshungs / gcin gnag pa la brten pa rnams / gcin las 'bang bar de 'gyur te

verses.skt: ambhobhiḥ pūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti saruṅ mṛduḥ | mūtrakṛcchram adhastāc ca valayaṃ phalakośayoḥ
verses.tib: rkyal pa chu yis gang bltar / g.yo 'gyur nad dang bcas shing 'jam / gcin 'gags pa dang rlig pa yi / 'og tu skrang par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: vātakopibhir āhāraiḥ śītatoyāvagāhanaiḥ | dhāraṇeraṇabhārādhvaviṣamāṅgapravartanaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung 'khrugs pa yi zas dang ni / chu grang la ni rkyal ba dang / shugs bkag bcir dang khur dang lam

verses.skt: kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣubhito ’nyaiś ca kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ yadā | pavano viguṇīkṛtya svaniveśād adho nayet
verses.tib: yan lag log par 'chus pa dang / rlung 'khrugs pa ni gzhan gyis kyang / gang tsho rgyu ma phra mo'i cha / rlung gis log par phul 'gyur te / rang gi gnas nas thur du bskyod

verses.skt: kuryād vaṅkṣaṇasaṃdhistho granthyābhaṃ śvayathuṃ tadā | upekṣyamāṇasya ca muṣkavṛddhim ādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ sa vāyuḥ
verses.tib: chu so'i tshigs su phyin pa dang / de cha mdud pa ltar glo 'gyur / yal bar bor na rlig pa cher skye zhing / spo shing na la rengs par rlung gis byed

verses.skt: prapīḍito ’ntaḥ svanavān prayāti pradhmāpayann eti punaś ca muktaḥ || 30ef || antravṛddhir asādhyo ’yaṃ vātavṛddhisamākṛtiḥ
verses.tib: rab tu gzir zhing nang na sgra dang bcas / gang bar byed cing bcug kyang slar 'byung byed / rgyu rlugs 'di ni gso dka' ste / rlung gi rlig rlugs 'dra ba yin

verses.skt: iti vṛddhinidānam atha gulmanidānam
rūkṣakṛṣṇāruṇasirātantujālagavākṣitaḥ | gulmo ’ṣṭadhā pṛthag doṣaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭair nicayaṃ gataiḥ
verses.tib: rtsub cing gnag la dmar pa'i rtsa / phra mo'i dra bas khebs pa yin / skran brgyad nad ni so so dang / 'dres dang 'dus pa las gyur dang

verses.skt: ārtavasya ca doṣeṇa nārīṇāṃ jāyate ’ṣṭamaḥ | jvaracchardyatisārādyair vamanādyaiś ca karmabhiḥ
verses.tib: zla mtshan gyi ni nyes pa yis / brgyad pa bud med rnams la 'byung / rims dang slon dang tshad 'khru / skyug sman dang las rnams kyis

verses.skt: karśito vātalāny atti śītaṃ vāmbu bubhukṣitaḥ | yaḥ pibaty anu cānnāni laṅghanaplavanādikam
verses.tib: skem gyur rlung skyes zas za dang / bkres te tu grang 'thungs gyur pa'am / skem 'thungs rjes la gang zhig ni / rkyal dang mchong ba la sogs pa

verses.skt: sevate dehasaṃkṣobhi cchardiṃ vā samudīrayet | anudīrṇām udīrṇān vā vātādīn na vimuñcati
verses.tib: bsten pas lus ni dkrugs byas dang / slon mi bro yang skyugs pa dang / rlung la sogs pa 'byung ba yi / shugs bkag pa 'am btsir pa'am

verses.skt: snehasvedāv anabhyasya śodhanaṃ vā niṣevate | śuddho vāśu vidāhīni bhajate syandanāni vā
verses.tib: snum ma dang dugs ni ma bsten par / sbyang ba'i las ni byas pa dang / sbyangs zin myur du tsha ba dang / bad kan skyed pa'i zas skom spyad

verses.skt: vātolbaṇās tasya malāḥ pṛthak kruddhā dviśo ’thavā | sarve vā raktayuktā vā mahāsroto'nuśāyinaḥ
verses.tib: rlung rgyas pa yi nad rnams ni / so so'am 'dres pa'am 'khrugs gyur pa'am / kun nas khrag dang bcas 'khrugs pas / sbubs can la ni brten gyur nas

verses.skt: ūrdhvādhomārgam āvṛtya kurvate śūlapūrvakam | sparśopalabhyaṃ gulmākhyam utplutaṃ granthirūpiṇam
verses.tib: steng 'og lam ni bkag nas su / gzer sngon 'gro zhing reg tu rung / shin tu mtho zhing mdud pa'i gzugs / skran ni skyed par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: karśanāt kaphaviṭpittair mārgasyāvaraṇena vā | vāyuḥ kṛtāśrayaḥ koṣṭhe raukṣyāt kāṭhinyam āgataḥ
verses.tib: skem pas bad kan mkhris bshang ba'i / rgyun srang 'gags par gyur pa yis / rlung ni khong par gnas bcas pa / rtsub pas sra bar gyur pa yin

verses.skt: svatantraḥ svāśraye duṣṭaḥ paratantraḥ parāśraye | piṇḍitatvād amūrto ’pi mūrtatvam iva saṃśritaḥ
verses.tib: rang gnas ldang 'gyur rang dbang can / gzhan gnas la brten gzhan dbang can / gong por gyur pas gzugs med kyang / gzugs can ltar gnas skran zhes bya

verses.skt: gulma ity ucyate vastinābhihṛtpārśvasaṃśrayaḥ | vātān manyāśiraḥśūlaṃ jvaraplīhāntrakūjanam
verses.tib: rtsib logs la ni gnas pa yin / rlung las mjing pa klad pa gzer / rims 'debs mcher na rgyu ma khrug

verses.skt: vyadhaḥ sūcyeva viṭsaṅgaḥ kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ muhuḥ | stambho gātre mukhe śoṣaḥ kārśyaṃ viṣamavahnitā
verses.tib: bshang sri khab kyis gtsags snyam na / dbugs 'byin yang dang yang mi phyin / lus rengs kha ni skam pa dang / skem zhing me drod mi snyoms la

verses.skt: rūkṣakṛṣṇatvagāditvaṃ calatvād anilasya ca | anirūpitasaṃsthānasthānavṛddhikṣayavyathaḥ
verses.tib: pags gnag cing rtsub pa dang / rlung skran g.yo ba yin pa'i phyir / dbyibs ni brtag par mi mngon zhing / gnas 'phel 'bri dang na ba dang

verses.skt: pipīlikāvyāpta iva gulmaḥ sphurati tudyate | pittād dāho ’mlako mūrchāviḍbhedasvedatṛḍjvarāḥ
verses.tib: grog mas khyab pa lta bur ni / skran ni 'gul zhing zug pa yin / mkhris las tsha zhing sgregs skyur brgyal / 'khru zhing lus rngul skom rims 'debs

verses.skt: hāridratvaṃ tvagādyeṣu gulmaś ca sparśanāsahaḥ | dūyate dīpyate soṣmā svasthānaṃ dahatīva ca
verses.tib: pags pa la sogs ser por snang / skran ni reg par mi bzod dang / tsha zhing 'bar la dro ba dang / rang gi gnas ni sreg snyam byed

verses.skt: kaphāt staimityam aruciḥ sadanaṃ śiśirajvaraḥ | pīnasālasyahṛllāsakāsaśuklatvagāditāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan slon bag yi ga 'chus / me drod nyams shing grang rims 'debs / chom pa khong snyom dang ga lci / lud pa lu zhing pags dkar

verses.skt: gulmo ’vagāḍhaḥ kaṭhino guruḥ suptaḥ sthiro ’lparuk | svadoṣasthānadhāmānaḥ sve sve kāle ca rukkarāḥ
verses.tib: skran phugs ring zhing sra ba dang / lci zhing rang gnas brten nad chung / phal cher rang gnas 'dug pa dang / rang gi dus su nad skyed byed

verses.skt: prāyas trayas tu dvandvotthā gulmāḥ saṃsṛṣṭalakṣaṇāḥ | sarvajas tīvrarugdāhaḥ śīghrapākī ghanonnataḥ
verses.tib: gnyis las byung ba'i skran gsum po / mtshan nyid 'dren mar ldan pa yin / kun skyes mi bzad na zhing tsha / myur smin sra mtho de gso dka'

verses.skt: so ’sādhyo raktagulmas tu striyā eva prajāyate | ṛtau vā navasūtā vā yadi vā yonirogiṇī
verses.tib: khrag gi skran ni gang yin pa / de ni bud med nyid la 'byung / zla mtshan dus sam bu gsar btsas / yang na mngal gyi nad can gyis

verses.skt: sevate vātalāni strī kruddhas tasyāḥ samīraṇaḥ | niruṇaddhy ārtavaṃ yonyāṃ pratimāsam avasthitam
verses.tib: bud med rlung skyed bsten gyur pas / rlung ni 'khrugs par gyur pa las / zla re 'byung bar byed pa yis

verses.skt: kukṣiṃ karoti tadgarbhaliṅgam āviṣkaroti ca | hṛllāsadaurhṛdastanyadarśanakṣāmatādikam
verses.tib: zla mtshan mngal du bkag pas ni / de ni mngal chags 'drar snang zhing / mtshan ma gsal bar ston byed de / snying 'phar nu 'dzag yid mi bde

verses.skt: krameṇa vāyusaṃsargāt pittayonitayā ca tat | śoṇitaṃ kurute tasyā vātapittotthagulmajān
verses.tib: de nas rim gyis rlung 'dres dang / mkhris pa yi ni rgyu yis na / rlung dang mkhris pa las byung ba'i / skran ni khrag de skyed byed yin

verses.skt: rukstambhadāhātīsāratṛḍjvarādīn upadravān | garbhāśaye ca sutarāṃ śūlaṃ duṣṭāsṛgāśraye
verses.tib: na zhing sra la tsha zhing 'khru / skom dad rims bla brnan 'byung / nad kyi khrag la brten pas na / mngal gnas dag tu lhag par gzer

verses.skt: yonyāś ca srāvadaurgandhyatodaspandanavedanāḥ | na cāṅgair garbhavad gulmaḥ sphuraty api tu śūlavān
verses.tib: mngal nas dri nga 'dzag pa dang / na zhing 'phar la zug par byed / mngal chags 'dra yang yan lag med / 'on kyang skran ni 'gul gzer ldan

verses.skt: piṇḍībhūtaḥ sa evāsyāḥ kadācit spandate cirāt | na cāsyā vardhate kukṣir gulma eva tu vardhate
verses.tib: de nyid der ni gong por gnas / lan 'ga' 'gul bar byed pa yin / 'di ni ltor 'phel mi byed kyi / skran nyid 'phel bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: svadoṣasaṃśrayo gulmaḥ sarvo bhavati tena saḥ | pākaṃ cireṇa bhajate naiva vā vidradhiḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: rang gi nad gzhi la brten pas / des der skran nad thams cad skyed / yun nas ni smin 'gyur ba'am / yang na ma smin khong 'bras kyang

verses.skt: pacyate śīghram atyarthaṃ duṣṭaraktāśrayatvataḥ | ataḥ śīghravidāhitvād vidradhiḥ so ’bhidhīyate
verses.tib: nad khrag la ni brten pa'i phyir / shin tu myur bar smin par 'gyur / de phyir myur du tsha 'gyur bas / khong 'bras zhes ni de la bshad

verses.skt: gulme ’ntarāśraye vastikukṣihṛtplīhavedanāḥ | agnivarṇabalabhraṃśo vegānāṃ cāpravartanam
verses.tib: nang gnas skran ni chu so dang / lto ba mchin pa snying na zhing / me drod mdog nyams nyams stobs 'bri / shugs ni 'gag par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: ato viparyayo bāhye koṣṭhāṅgeṣu tu nātiruk | vaivarṇyam avakāśasya bahir unnatatādhikam
verses.tib: phyi rol de las / bzlog pa ste / khong pa'i yan lag nad tshabs chung / phyogs de'i mdog ni nyams pa dang / phyi rol du ni mthong zhing 'phags

verses.skt: sāṭopam atyugrarujam ādhmānam udare bhṛśam | ūrdhvādhovātarodhena tam ānāhaṃ pracakṣate
verses.tib: lto sbo lhag par mi bzad na / rgyu ma'i sgra bcas mi bzad na / sbo bcas lto ba na ba dang / rlung gi nad kyis steng 'og bkag / de ni hen gyi zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: ghano ’ṣṭhīlopamo granthir aṣṭhīlordhvaṃ samunnataḥ | ānāhaliṅgas tiryak tu pratyaṣṭhīlā tadākṛtiḥ
verses.tib: sra zhing gtun 'dra mdud pa can / gtun 'dra gyen du mtho bar gnas / hen gyi mtshan ldan gtun bu ni / 'phred gnas de dang tshul 'dra yin

verses.skt: pakvāśayād gudopasthaṃ vāyus tīvrarujaḥ prayān | tūṇī pratūṇī tu bhavet sa evāto viparyaye
verses.tib: zhu ba'i gnas nas gzhang pho mtshan / rlung ni mi bzad na zhing rgyu / thur du zug pa yin par bshad / de las bzlog pa gyen du zug pa'o

verses.skt: udgārabāhulyapurīṣabandhatṛptyakṣamatvāntravikūjanāni | āṭopam ādhmānam apaktiśaktim āsannagulmasya vadanti cihnam
verses.tib: sgregs pa mang zhing bshang ba 'gags pa dang / 'grangs za mi nus rgyu ma sgra dang bcas / sbo zhing hen langs kha zas 'ju mi nus / skran ni nyer 'byung mtshan ma yin par bshad

verses.skt: rogāḥ sarve ’pi mande ’gnau sutarām udarāṇi tu | ajīrṇān malinaiś cānnair jāyante malasaṃcayāt
verses.tib: nad kun me drod nyams las skye / lhag par dmu rdzing nad skye zhing / ma zhu dri ma can gyi zas / dri ma las skye bar 'gyur

verses.skt: ūrdhvādho dhātavo ruddhvā vāhinīr ambuvāhinīḥ | prāṇāgnyapānān saṃdūṣya kuryus tvaṅmāṃsasaṃdhigāḥ
verses.tib: nad kyis chu ni rgyu ba'i rtsa / steng dang 'og tu bkag nas ni / srog dang thur sel la gnod de / pags pa sha yi bar gnas nad

verses.skt: ādhmāpya kukṣim udaram aṣṭadhā tac ca bhidyate | pṛthag doṣaiḥ samastaiś ca plīhabaddhakṣatodakaiḥ
verses.tib: lto ba bkang ste dmu rdzing skyed / de yang rnam pa brgyad 'gyur te / nad gzhi tha dad 'dus mcher pa / dri ma 'gags dang rgyu rdol dang

verses.skt: tenārtāḥ śuṣkatālvoṣṭhāḥ śūnapādakarodarāḥ | naṣṭaceṣṭābalāhārāḥ kṛśāḥ pradhmātakukṣayaḥ
verses.tib: des gzir rkan dang mchu bskams shing / rkang pa lag pa gsus pa skrang / spyod pa kha zas nyams stobs 'bri / skem zhing gsus pa cher skyes la

verses.skt: syuḥ pretarūpāḥ puruṣā bhāvinas tasya lakṣaṇam | kṣunnāśo ’nnaṃ cirāt sarvaṃ savidāhaṃ ca pacyate
verses.tib: mi ni gzugs can 'gyur / de ni 'byung 'gyur mtshan ma dag / bkres pa med cing zas kun ni / ring nas tsha zhing skyur bcas 'ju

verses.skt: jīrṇājīrṇaṃ na jānāti sauhityaṃ sahate na ca | kṣīyate balataḥ śaśvac chvasity alpe ’pi ceṣṭite
verses.tib: 'ju dang mi 'ju mi shes la / 'grangs par za yang mi nus shing / stobs ni rtag tu zad par 'gyur / cung zad bskyod kyang dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: vṛddhir viṣo ’pravṛttiś ca kiñcic chophaś ca pādayoḥ | rugvastisaṃdhau tatatā laghvalpābhojanair api
verses.tib: bshang ba 'phel zhing 'gags par byed / rkang pa gnyis su cung zad skrang / chu sor na zhing zas yang ba / cung zad zos kyang gsus pa rgyas

verses.skt: rājījanma valīnāśo jaṭhare jaṭhareṣu tu | sarveṣu tandrā sadanaṃ malasaṅgo ’lpavahnitā
verses.tib: rtsa rgyas lto ba'i gnyer ma 'jig / dmu rdzing nad ni thams cad la / snyom zhing nyam chung 'gyur ba dang / dri ma sri zhing me drod chung

verses.skt: dāhaḥ śvayathur ādhmānam ante salilasaṃbhavaḥ | sarvaṃ tv atoyam aruṇam aśophaṃ nātibhārikam
verses.tib: tsha zhing skrang la gsus pa sbo / mjug tu chu ni 'byung bar 'gyur / thams cad chu med par du smug / skrang med khur ltar lci ma yin

verses.skt: gavākṣitaṃ sirājālaiḥ sadā guḍaguḍāyate | nābhim antraṃ ca viṣṭabhya vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati
verses.tib: rtsa dra'i skar khung ris kyis khebs / rtag tu sgra ni 'ur 'ur zer / rlung gis lte ba rgyu mar zhugs / shugs skyed na ni 'jig par 'gyur

verses.skt: māruto hṛtkaṭīnābhipāyuvaṅkṣaṇavedanāḥ | saśabdo niścared vāyur viḍ baddhā mūtram alpakam
verses.tib: snying ga lte ba rked pa dang / gzhang dang chu son bar byed / rlung ni sgra dang bcas par rgyu / bshang ba 'gag cing gci ba nyung

verses.skt: nātimando ’nalo laulyaṃ na ca syād virasaṃ mukham | tatra vātodare śophaḥ pāṇipānmuṣkakukṣiṣu
verses.tib: me drod chung min skam pa min / khar ni ro bro med pa yin / de la rlung gi dmu rdzing ni / rkang lag rlig pa lto ba skrang

verses.skt: kukṣipārśvodarakaṭīpṛṣṭharuk parvabhedanam | śuṣkakāso ’ṅgamardo ’dhogurutā malasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.tib: lto ba rtsib logs rked rgyab na / tshigs rnams bye ba snyam du sems / lud pa skams shing yan lag snyom / ro smad lci zhing bshang gci 'gag

verses.skt: śyāvāruṇatvagāditvam akasmād vṛddhihrāsavat | satodabhedam udaraṃ tanukṛṣṇasirātatam
verses.tib: pags pa la gnag la smug / glo bur du ni 'phel zhing 'bri / gsus par zug cing na ba dang / rtsa bran nag pos khyab cing rgyas

verses.skt: ādhmātadṛtivac chabdam āhataṃ prakaroti ca | vāyuś cātra sarukśabdo vicaret sarvatogatiḥ
verses.tib: brdabs na rkyal pa dbugs kyis ni / gang ba lta bu'i sgra dang ldan / 'dir rlung nad dang sgrar bcas pas / thams cad du ni rgyu bar byed

verses.skt: pittodare jvaro mūrchā dāhas tṛṭ kaṭukāsyatā | bhramo ’tīsāraḥ pītatvaṃ tvagādāv udaraṃ harit
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i dmu rdzing rims 'debs rgyas / lus tsha skom dang kha ro kha / mgo 'khor tshad 'khru pags pa / ser zhing gsus pa'i mdog rtsa sngo

verses.skt: pītatāmrasirānaddhaṃ sasvedaṃ soṣma dahyate | dhūmāyati mṛdusparśaṃ kṣiprapākaṃ pradūyate
verses.tib: rtsa ni dmar ser dag gis khyab / rdul dang tsha bar bcas pas sreg / dad 'byung reg na 'jam pa dang / myur du smin zhing nyer gdung 'gyur

verses.skt: śleṣmodare ’ṅgasadanaṃ svāpaḥ śvayathugauravam | nidrotkleśāruciśvāsakāsaśuklatvagāditā
verses.tib: bad kan dmu rdzing lhu tshigs na / tshor ba med cing skrangs la lci / gnyid che slon zhing yi ga 'chus / lud pa dbugs mi bde pags

verses.skt: udaraṃ stimitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ śuklarājītataṃ mahat | cirābhivṛddhi kaṭhinaṃ śītasparśaṃ guru sthiram
verses.tib: sra zhing lto ba mkhrang la snum / rtsa yi ri mos khyab cing che / ring nas 'phel zhing sra ba dang / reg na grang zhing gsus pa lci

verses.skt: tridoṣakopanais tais taiḥ strīdattaiś ca rajomalaiḥ | garadūṣīviṣādyaiś ca saraktāḥ saṃcitā malāḥ
verses.tib: nad gsum 'khrugs pa de dang de / bud med kyis byin dri ma rdul / dbyig dug dug kyis gnod 'gyur / khrag bcas dri ma bsags pa ni

verses.skt: koṣṭhaṃ prāpya vikurvāṇāḥ śoṣamūrchābhramānvitam | kuryus triliṅgam udaraṃ śīghrapākaṃ sudāruṇam
verses.tib: ltor song gnod pa skyed byed de / kha skom mgo 'khor brgyal bcas pa'i / rtags gsum ldan pa'i dmu rdzing skyed / myur du smin zhing mi bzad na

verses.skt: bādhate tac ca sutarāṃ śītavātābhradarśane | atyāśitasya saṃkṣobhād yānayānādiceṣṭitaiḥ
verses.tib: de ni grang dang rlung dang char / phrad pas shin tu gnod par 'gyur / mang du zos pas bskyod pa dang / bzhon pa drag tu 'gro ba dang

verses.skt: ativyavāyakarmādhvavamanavyādhikarśanaiḥ | vāmapārśvāśritaḥ plīhā cyutaḥ sthānād vivardhate
verses.tib: las lam nyal po drags pas dub / skyug sman drags dang nad kyis skem / g.yon logs gnas pa'i mcher pa ni / gnas las 'phos te 'phel ba dang

verses.skt: śoṇitaṃ vā rasādibhyo vivṛddhaṃ taṃ vivardhayet | so ’ṣṭhīlevātikaṭhinaḥ prāk tataḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhavat
verses.tib: yang na dngas ma pas khrag / rgyas byas de ni 'phel gyur dang / de nas gtun bu bzhin rab sra / de nas rus sbal rgyab 'dra bar

verses.skt: krameṇa vardhamānaś ca kukṣāv udaram āvahet | śvāsakāsapipāsāsyavairasyādhmānarugjvaraiḥ
verses.tib: rim gyis 'phel bar 'gyur nas ni / lto bar dmu rdzing chags par byed / lud pa dbugs mi bde skom dad / kha yis ro ni mi tshor zhing / lci zhing na la rims kyis 'debs

verses.skt: pāṇḍutvamūrchāchardībhir dāhamohaiś ca saṃyutam | aruṇābhaṃ vivarṇaṃ vā nīlahāridrarājimat
verses.tib: sha mdog skya zhing mi sdug la / brgyal zhing slon par byed pa dang / tsha zhing myos dang ldan par 'gyur / rtsa mdog dmar ba'am mi sdug pa'am / sngo zhing ser la ri mor bcas

verses.skt: udāvartarujānāhair mohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ | gauravārucikāṭhinyair vidyāt tatra malān kramāt
verses.tib: de la rim gyis nad rnams ni / bshang 'gags nad dang lto sbos dang / rmongs bag skom tsha rims kyis 'debs / lus lci lto sra yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: plīhavad dakṣiṇāt pārśvāt kuryād yakṛd api cyutam | pakṣmavālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktair baddhāyane gude
verses.tib: mcher pa lta bur mchin g.yas logs / gnas 'phos dmu rdzing skyed ces bya / bya sgro spu dang bcas pa'i zas / zos pas bshang lam gnas 'gags te

verses.skt: durnāmabhir udāvartair anyair vāntropalepibhiḥ | varcaḥpittakaphān ruddhvā karoti kupito ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum dang ni rtug skam dang / rgyu mar chags pa'i zas kyis kyang / thur du sel ba'i rlung 'khrugs te / bshang bas bad mkhris bkag nas ni / lto bar dmu rdzing chags par byed

verses.skt: apāno jaṭharaṃ tena syur dāhajvaratṛṭkṣavāḥ | kāsaśvāsorusadanaṃ śirohṛnnābhipāyuruk
verses.tib: des ni tsha skom rims sbrid 'byung / lud pa dbugs mi bde brla na / klad snying lte ba gzhang kha na

verses.skt: malasaṅgo ’ruciś chardir udaraṃ mūḍhamārutam | sthiraṃ nīlāruṇasirārājīnaddham arāji vā
verses.tib: dri ma 'gags slon yi ga 'chus / lto bar rlung ni 'khyims par byed / brtan zhing rtsa ni sngo la smug

verses.skt: nābher upari ca prāyo gopucchākṛti jāyate | asthyādiśalyaiḥ sānnaiś ced bhuktair atyaśanena vā
verses.tib: phal cher lte ba'i 'og tu ni / ba lang mjug 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur / rus zug rngur bcas pa'i zas / zos sam shin tu drag zos pa

verses.skt: bhidyate pacyate vāntraṃ tacchidraiś ca sravan bahiḥ | āma eva gudād eti tato ’lpālpaṃ saviḍrasaḥ
verses.tib: rgyu ma rdol lam gas gyur nas / bu ga de nas ma zhu bar / phyir 'dzag bshang lam las 'byung zhing / bshang bcas nyung shas nyung shas ni

verses.skt: tulyaḥ kuṇapagandhena picchilaḥ pītalohitaḥ | śeṣaś cāpūrya jaṭharaṃ jaṭharaṃ ghoram āvahet
verses.tib: sha rul lta bur mnam pa ni / sbyin bag dmar ser 'byung bar 'gyur / lhag ma yis ni lto ba 'gengs / dmu rdzing mi bzad skye bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vardhayet tad adho nābher āśu caiti jalātmatām | udriktadoṣarūpaṃ ca vyāptaṃ ca śvāsatṛḍbhramaiḥ
verses.tib: de ni lte ba man chad rgyas / chus gang lta bur myur du 'gyur / nad kyi tshul ni shas cher ldan / dbugs mi bde skom mgo 'khor khyab

verses.skt: chidrodaram idaṃ prāhuḥ parisrāvīti cāpare | pravṛttasnehapānādeḥ sahasāmāmbupāyinaḥ
verses.tib: rgyu rdol dmu rdzing zhes bshad de / gzhan dag rgyu ma 'dzag ces zer / snum 'thungs la sogs byas nas ni / 'phral du chu grang 'thungs pa'am

verses.skt: atyambupānān mandāgneḥ kṣīṇasyātikṛśasya vā | ruddhvāmbumārgān anilaḥ kaphaś ca jalamūrchitaḥ
verses.tib: me drod bri ba'am ha cang ni / skom pas chu 'thung drags pa'am / rlung dang bad kan 'khrugs chur 'dres / chu yi lam ni bkag gyur pas

verses.skt: vardhayetāṃ tad evāmbu tatsthānād udarāśritau | tataḥ syād udaraṃ tṛṣṇāgudasrutirujānvitam
verses.tib: de nyid gnas der 'phel bar 'gyur / de 'og dmu rdzing gyur pa yin / de nas dmu rdzing de las ni / skom dad rkub tu chu 'dzag bcas

verses.skt: kāsaśvāsāruciyutaṃ nānāvarṇasirātatam | toyapūrṇadṛtisparśaśabdaprakṣobhavepathu
verses.tib: dbugs mi bde lud yi ga 'chus / sna tshogs mdog ldan rtsa yis khyab / rkyal pa chus gang reg pa 'dra / bskyod na sgra grag lus 'dar la

verses.skt: dakodaraṃ mahat snigdhaṃ sthiram āvṛttanābhi tat | upekṣayā ca sarveṣu doṣāḥ svasthānataś cyutāḥ
verses.tib: dmu rdzing chen pos cha zhing snum / brtan zhing de ni lte ba zlum / thams cad yal bar bor na ni / nad ni rang gnas las 'phos te

verses.skt: pākād dravā dravīkuryuḥ saṃdhisrotomukhāny api | svedaś ca bāhyasrotaḥsu vihatas tiryagāsthitaḥ
verses.tib: smin pas sla zhing zag 'gyur ba / tshigs dang rtsa sgo las kyang 'dzag / phyi yi rtsa sgo nas rngul 'byung / 'gags nas thad kar 'khyil zhing gnas

verses.skt: tad evodakam āpyāyya picchāṃ kuryāt tadā bhavet | gurūdaraṃ sthiraṃ vṛttam āhataṃ ca na śabdavat
verses.tib: chu de nyid ni 'phel 'gyur zhing / sbyin bag gyur na de tshe ni / lto ba lci zhing sra la zlum / brdabs na sgra ni mi 'byung zhing

verses.skt: mṛdu vyapetarājīkaṃ nābhyāṃ spṛṣṭaṃ ca sarpati | tad anūdakajanmāsmin kukṣivṛddhis tato ’dhikam
verses.tib: mdog 'jam rtsa ris mi snang la / lto ba dang ni rgyab tu 'gro / de rjes chu yi dmu rdzing skye / lto ba 'phel zhing / de las lhag

verses.skt: sirāntardhānam udakajaṭharoktaṃ ca lakṣaṇam | vātapittakaphaplīhasaṃnipātodakodaram
verses.tib: rtsa nub gyur pa'i dmu chu ni / dmu rdzing bshad pa'i mtshan nyid ldan / rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan mcher / 'dus pa'i chu yi dmu rdzing rnams

verses.skt: kṛcchraṃ yathottaraṃ pakṣāt paraṃ prāyo ’pare hataḥ | sarvaṃ ca jātasalilaṃ riṣṭoktopadravānvitam
verses.tib: phyi ma bzhin du gso ba dka' / gzhan dag phal cher zla phyed gsod / thams cad chur gyur 'chi ltas le'u / las bshad bla brnan ldan pa'ang gsod

verses.skt: janmanaivodaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kṛcchratamaṃ matam | balinas tad ajātāmbu yatnasādhyaṃ navotthitam
verses.tib: skyes nas dmu rdzing gyur pa dag / phal cher gso bar dka' bar bshad / stobs ldan chur ni ma gyur zhing / gsar du byung ba 'bad pas gso

verses.skt: pittapradhānāḥ kupitā yathoktaiḥ kopanair malāḥ | tatrānilena balinā kṣiptaṃ pittaṃ hṛdi sthitam
verses.tib: ji skad bshad pa'i nad 'khrugs pas / mkhris pa lhag par ldang 'gyur la / de la rlung ni stobs che bas / snying la gnas pa'i mkhris pa ni

verses.skt: dhamanīr daśa saṃprāpya vyāpnuvat sakalāṃ tanum | śleṣmatvagraktamāṃsāni pradūṣyāntaram āśritam
verses.tib: gtor te rtsa chen bcu'i nang bkram / lus kun la ni khyab gyur pas / bad kan pags pa sha khrag la / gnod byas bar du gnas nas ni

verses.skt: tvaṅmāṃsayos tat kurute tvaci varṇān pṛthagvidhān | pāṇḍuhāridraharitān pāṇḍutvaṃ teṣu cādhikam
verses.tib: sha dang pags pa de dag las / pags mdog tha dad dkar ba dang / ser zhing ljang sngon byed par 'gyur / de las skya ba'i shas che bas

verses.skt: yato ’taḥ pāṇḍur ity uktaḥ sa rogas tena gauravam | dhātūnāṃ syāc ca śaithilyam ojasaś ca guṇakṣayaḥ
verses.tib: de phyir skya rbab nad ces bshad / nad des lus ni lci ba dang / lus zungs rnams ni lhod pa dang / mdangs kyi yon tan zad gyur zhing

verses.skt: tato ’lparaktamedasko niḥsāraḥ syāc chlathendriyaḥ | mṛdyamānair ivāṅgair nā dravatā hṛdayena ca
verses.tib: de las khrag dang tshil chung ste / snying po med cing dbang po lhong / yan lag brdungs pa snyam byed cing / snying ni zag pa snyam du sems / mig phugs skrang zhing nyams la na / mchil mang skad gsang dma' ba dang / zas mi 'dod cing grang mi bzod / spu 'byi me drod nyams pa dang

verses.skt: śūnākṣikūṭaḥ sadanaḥ kopanaḥ ṣṭhīvano ’lpavāk | annadviṭ śiśiradveṣī śīrṇaromā hatānalaḥ
verses.tib: de las khrag dang tshil chung ste / snying po med cing dbang po lhong / yan lag brdungs pa snyam byed cing / snying ni zag pa snyam du sems / mig phugs skrang zhing nyams la na / mchil mang skad gsang dma' ba dang / zas mi 'dod cing grang mi bzod / spu 'byi me drod nyams pa dang

verses.skt: sannasaktho jvarī śvāsī karṇakṣveḍī bhramī śramī | sa pañcadhā pṛthag doṣaiḥ samastair mṛttikādanāt
verses.tib: ro smad 'bying zhing rims kyis 'debs / dbugs mi bde zhing rna sgra 'bod / mgo 'khor ngal bar byed pa yin / de ni nad gzhi tha dad 'dus / sa zhag zos las rnam lnga 'gyur

verses.skt: prāgrūpam asya hṛdayaspandanaṃ rūkṣatā tvaci | aruciḥ pītamūtratvaṃ svedābhāvo ’lpavahnitā
verses.tib: 'di yi sngon tshul snying 'phar zhing / pags pa rtsub par gyur pa dang / yi / ga 'chus shing gcin mdog ser / rngul med khong pa'i me drod chung

verses.skt: sādaḥ śramo ’nilāt tatra gātraruktodakampanam | kṛṣṇarūkṣāruṇasirānakhaviṇmūtranetratā
verses.tib: lus rmya ngal bar byed pa yin / de la rlung gyur lus na zug / rtsa sen mig dang bshang gci rnams / mdog nag rtsub la 'dar ba dang

verses.skt: śophānāhāsyavairasyaviṭśoṣāḥ pārśvamūrdharuk | pittād dharitapītābhasirāditvaṃ jvaras tamaḥ
verses.tib: skrang sbo kha yis ro mi tshor / rtug skam rtsib logs klad pa na / mkhris las rtsa dang sen mo / ljang sngon rims 'debs mun 'thibs byed

verses.skt: tṛṭsvedamūrchāśītecchā daurgandhyaṃ kaṭuvaktratā | varcobhedo ’mlako dāhaḥ kaphāc chuklasirāditā
verses.tib: skom dang rngul brgyal bsil ba 'dod / lus mnam kha nang kha ba dang / 'khru zhing sgregs pa skyur la tsha / bad kan rtsa dkar ba dang

verses.skt: tandrā lavaṇavaktratvaṃ romaharṣaḥ svarakṣayaḥ | kāsaś chardiś ca nicayān miśraliṅgo ’tiduḥsahaḥ
verses.tib: glongs shing kha nang lan tshwa bro / ba spu ldang zhing skad 'gags la / lud pa lu zhing slon par byed / 'dus gyur mtshan ma 'dres brnag dka'

verses.skt: mṛt kaṣāyānilaṃ pittam ūṣarā madhurā kapham | dūṣayitvā rasādīṃś ca raukṣyād bhuktaṃ virūkṣya ca
verses.tib: sa zhag bska bas rlung skyed la / tsha bro mkhris pa mngar bad kan / dngas ma la sogs gnod 'gyur zhing / rtsub pas zas zos rtsub gyur nas

verses.skt: srotāṃsy apakvaivāpūrya kuryād ruddhvā ca pūrvavat | pāṇḍurogaṃ tataḥ śūnanābhipādāsyamehanaḥ
verses.tib: zhu bas rtsa sbubs 'gags byas te / snga ma bzhin du skya rbab skyed / de nas lte ba rkang pa dang / kha dang pho mtshan skrang par byed

verses.skt: purīṣaṃ kṛmiman muñced bhinnaṃ sāsṛk kaphaṃ naraḥ | yaḥ pāṇḍurogī seveta pittalaṃ tasya kāmalām
verses.tib: bshang ba srin bu dang bcas 'khru / bad kan khrag dang bcas pa 'byung / gang zhig skya rbab nad kyis btab / de yis mkhris skyed zas zos pas

verses.skt: koṣṭhaśākhāśrayāṃ pittaṃ dagdhvāsṛṅmāṃsam āvahet | hāridranetramūtratvaṅnakhavaktraśakṛttayā
verses.tib: khong pa yan lag gnas mkhris gnas / bshang khrag bsregs te mig ser skyed / des ni mig dang pags pa gdong / bshang gci sen mo kha dog ser

verses.skt: dāhāvipākatṛṣṇāvān bhekābho durbalendriyaḥ | bhavet pittolbaṇasyāsau pāṇḍurogād ṛte ’pi ca
verses.tib: lus tsha skom dang zas mi 'ju / sbal 'dra dbang po nyam chung 'gyur / de ni mkhris pa'i shas chen / skya rbab nad med par de 'byung

verses.skt: upekṣayā ca śophāḍhyā sā kṛcchrā kumbhakāmalā | haritaśyāvapītatvaṃ pāṇḍuroge yadā bhavet
verses.tib: yal bar bor na cher skrangs te / gso dka' mig ser 'or thabs yin / ha li sa ni ljang nag ser

verses.skt: vātapittād bhramas tṛṣṇā strīṣv aharṣo mṛdur jvaraḥ | tandrā balānalabhraṃśo loḍharaṃ taṃ halīmakam
verses.tib: rlung mkhris mgo 'khor skom dad che / bud med la dga' rims chung 'debs / khong rmya me drod nyams stobs 'bri / ha li sa ka khrag ngan 'gyur

verses.skt: alasaṃ ceti śaṃsanti teṣāṃ pūrvam upadravāḥ | śophapradhānāḥ kathitāḥ sa evāto nigadyate
verses.tib: chu ser can zhes bya ba yin / de rnams kyi ni bla brnan sngar / 'or nad gtso bo yin par bshad / de phyir de nyid bshad par bya'o

verses.skt: pittaraktakaphān vāyur duṣṭo duṣṭān bahiḥsirāḥ | nītvā ruddhagatis tair hi kuryāt tvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayam
verses.tib: rlung 'khrugs gyur pas bad kan dang / khrag dang mkhris pa phyi rol rtsar / 'phros byas de yang rgyun srang 'gags / pags pa sha la gnas gyur te

verses.skt: utsedhaṃ saṃhataṃ śophaṃ tam āhur nicayād ataḥ | sarvaṃ hetuviśeṣais tu rūpabhedān navātmakam
verses.tib: 'or nad mthong zhing skrang par byed / de bas thams cad 'dus gyur bshad / rgyu rnams kyi ni bye brag las / gzugs dbye dgu yi bdag nyid can

verses.skt: doṣaiḥ pṛthag dvayaiḥ sarvair abhighātād viṣād api | dvidhā vā nijam āgantuṃ sarvāṅgaikāṅgajaṃ ca tam
verses.tib: nad gzhi tha dad gnyis dang kun / snad dang dug gis phog las 'byung / yang na rang dang glo bur gnyis / yan lag kun skrang phyogs gcig gnyis

verses.skt: pṛthūnnatagrathitatāviśeṣaiś ca tridhā viduḥ | sāmānyahetuḥ śophānāṃ doṣajānāṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: khyab dang mtho dang mdud pa yi / dbyibs kyi dbye bas gsum du 'dod / 'or nad kyi ni spyi yi rgyu / nad las skyes pa khyad par nyid

verses.skt: vyādhikarmopavāsādikṣīṇasya bhajato drutam | atimātram athānyasya gurvamlasnigdhaśītalam
verses.tib: nad las smyung kyis nyam chung / myur du lhag par zos las 'byung / de nas gzhan yang lci ba dang / skyur dang snum bsil lan tshwa dang

verses.skt: lavaṇakṣāratīkṣṇoṣṇaśākāmbu svapnajāgaram | mṛdgrāmyamāṃsavallūram ajīrṇaśramamaithunam
verses.tib: thal sman rnon po tsha ba dang / mya ngan chu gnyid drags dang yar / sa zos sha lci sha skam dang / ma zhu ngal dang bud med drags

verses.skt: padāter mārgagamanaṃ yānena kṣobhiṇāpi vā | śvāsakāsātisārārśojaṭharapradarajvarāḥ
verses.tib: rkang gis lam du 'gro ba 'am / bzhon pas drag tu bskyod 'gyur yin / lud pa dbugs mi bde tshad 'khru / gzhang 'brum lto ba'i nad dang ni

verses.skt: viṣūcyalasakacchardigarbhavisarpapāṇḍavaḥ | anye ca mithyopakrāntās tair doṣā vakṣasi sthitāḥ
verses.tib: gsud dang chu ser slon nyes dang / sbrum ma dang ni me dbal gyi / nad dang skya rbab dag gis btab / gzhan yang log par gsos gyur pa'i / nad de brang du gnas na ni

verses.skt: ūrdhvaṃ śopham adho vastau madhye kurvanti madhyagāḥ | sarvāṅgagāḥ sarvagataṃ pratyaṅgeṣu tadāśrayāḥ
verses.tib: stod skrang chu sor gnas smad skrang / dbus na gnas pa rab tu skrang / yan lag kun khyab thams cad skrang / nying lag la brten de skrang byed

verses.skt: tatpūrvarūpaṃ davathuḥ sirāyāmo ’ṅgagauravam | vātāc chophaś calo rūkṣaḥ khararomāruṇāsitaḥ
verses.tib: de yi sngon tshul rtsa rnams tsha / yan lag snyom par byed pa yin / rlung las skrang pa 'pho zhang rtsub / spu rtsub smug cing gnag pa dang

verses.skt: saṃkocaspandaharṣārtitodabhedaprasuptimān | kṣiprotthānaśamaḥ śīghram unnamet pīḍitas tanuḥ
verses.tib: pags 'khums 'dar brtse reg nan / na zhing zug pa bem bem po / myur bar ldang zhing myur du zhi / skrangs pa mnan na dma' bar 'gyur

verses.skt: snigdhoṣṇamardanaiḥ śāmyed rātrāv alpo divā mahān | tvak ca sarṣapalipteva tasmiṃś cimicimāyate
verses.tib: snum dang dro pas mnyes na zhi / mtshan mo chung zhing nyin mo che / pags pa yungs kar lde gu yis / bskus ltar tsha ba tsag tsag byed

verses.skt: pītaraktāsitābhāsaḥ pittād ātāmraromakṛt | śīghrānusārapraśamo madhye prāg jāyate tanuḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa rtsa ser dmar la gnag / spu ni dmar ser gyur pa dang / myur du ldang dang zhi mi 'gyur / dang por dbus su byung dang srab

verses.skt: satṛḍdāhajvarasvedadavakledamadabhramaḥ | śītābhilāṣī viḍbhedī gandhī sparśāsaho mṛduḥ
verses.tib: skom bcas tsha zhing rims 'debs rngul / mnam zhing 'drul la snum mgo 'khor / bsil bar 'dod cing thur du 'khru / dri mnam reg na mi bzod 'jam

verses.skt: kaṇḍūmān pāṇḍuromatvak kaṭhinaḥ śītalo guruḥ | snigdhaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ sthiraḥ styāno nidrāchardyagnisādakṛt
verses.tib: bad kan g.ya' spu pags pa dkar / mkhrang zhing bsil la lci ba dang / snum zhing 'jam la brten zhing 'thas / gnyid che slon zhing me drod nyams

verses.skt: ākrānto nonnamet kṛcchraśamajanmā niśābalaḥ | sraven nāsṛk cirāt picchāṃ kuśaśastrādivikṣataḥ
verses.tib: mnan na mi 'bying ldang dka' zhing / zhi dka' mtshan mo skrangs tshabs che / 'od ma gtsags bu dral yang / khrag mi 'byung bar spyin bag 'dzag

verses.skt: sparśoṣṇakāṅkṣī ca kaphād yathāsvaṃ dvandvajās trayaḥ | saṃkarād dhetuliṅgānāṃ nicayān nicayātmakaḥ
verses.tib: dro dang reg pa la mngon dga' / gnyis 'byung gsum po rang ji bzhin / rgyu dang mtshan ma 'dren ma yin / 'dus pa kun gyi bdag nyid can

verses.skt: abhighātena śastrādicchedabhedakṣatādibhiḥ | himānilodadhyanilair bhallātakapikacchujaiḥ
verses.tib: mtshon las pas nad gyur zhing / bcad dam dbral lam smas la / kha ba me dang rgya mtsho'i rlung / bse rtsi ka pi ka chu yi
