verses.skt: rasaiḥ śūkaiś ca saṃsparśāc chvayathuḥ syād visarpavān | bhṛśoṣmā lohitābhāsaḥ prāyaśaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: khu ba gra ma reg pas / skrang pa mched par 'gyur ba yin / shin tu tsha zhing dmar bar snang / phal cher mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid can

verses.skt: viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇiparisarpaṇamūtraṇāt | daṃṣṭrādantanakhāpātād aviṣaprāṇinām api
verses.tib: dug skyes srog chags dug can ni / lus la sod dang gcin gyis phog / srog chags dug med pa yi yang / so dang mche ba sen mos zug

verses.skt: viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṃkarāt | viṣavṛkṣānilasparśād garayogāvacūrṇanāt
verses.tib: gcin rtug khu bas smos pa dang / dri ma can gyi gos kyis reg / dug shing rlung la rag pa dang / dbyig dug phye mas reg las byung

verses.skt: mṛduś calo ’valambī ca śīghro dāharujākaraḥ | navo ’nupadravaḥ śophaḥ sādhyo ’sādhyaḥ pureritaḥ
verses.tib: mnyen zhing g.yo la 'phyang ba dang / myur gsod tsha zhing na bar byed / 'or nad gsar byung bla brnan med / gso sla gso dka' sngar bshad zin

verses.skt: syād visarpo ’bhighātāntair doṣair dūṣyaiś ca śophavat | tryadhiṣṭhānaṃ ca taṃ prāhur bāhyāntarubhayāśrayāt
verses.tib: me dpal nad dang snad pa'i bar / gnod pa 'or nad mtshungs pa yin / de ni phyi nang gnyi ga ste / gsum na gnas pa yin par bshad

verses.skt: yathottaraṃ ca duḥsādhyās tatra doṣā yathāyatham | prakopaṇaiḥ prakupitā viśeṣeṇa vidāhibhiḥ
verses.tib: phyi ma bzhin du gso bar dka' / de la nad ni ji bzhin du / 'khrugs pa'i rgyu yis ldang gyur la / khyad par du ni tsha ba yis

verses.skt: dehe śīghraṃ visarpanti te ’ntar antaḥsthitā bahiḥ | bahiḥsthā dvitaye dvisthā vidyāt tatrāntarāśrayam
verses.tib: lus la myur du mched par byed / de yang nang gnas nang du mched / phyir gnas phyir mched gnyi gar gnas / gnyi gar mched par byed pa yin / de la nang na gnas pa ni

verses.skt: marmopatāpāt saṃmohād ayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt | tṛṣṇātiyogād vegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt
verses.tib: gnad rnams tsha gdung myos par byed / bu ga rnams la gnod pa dang / skom dad rab che gcin nad / mi snyoms par ni 'byung ba dang

verses.skt: āśu cāgnibalabhraṃśād ato bāhyaṃ viparyayāt | tatra vātāt parīsarpo vātajvarasamavyathaḥ
verses.tib: me drod myur nyams las shes bya / phyi rol de las bzlog pa yin / de la rlung gyur me dbal ni / rlung gi rims dang nad thabs 'dra

verses.skt: śophasphuraṇanistodabhedāyāmārtiharṣavān | pittād drutagatiḥ pittajvaraliṅgo ’tilohitaḥ
verses.tib: skrang zhing 'gul la zug pa dang / yan lag snyom zhing ba spu brtse / mkhris gyur myur du mched cing 'gro / mkhris rims rtags ldan shin tu dmar

verses.skt: kaphāt kaṇḍūyutaḥ snigdhaḥ kaphajvarasamānaruk | svadoṣaliṅgaiś cīyante sarve sphoṭair upekṣitāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las g.ya' reg na 'jam / bad kan las byung rims 'dar na / me dbal kun yal bar bor / rang gi nad tshul bsags gyur na

verses.skt: te pakvabhinnāḥ svaṃ svaṃ ca bibhrati vraṇalakṣaṇam | vātapittāj jvaracchardimūrchātīsāratṛḍbhramaiḥ
verses.tib: de ni smin rdol rang rang gi / me dbal rma yi mtshan nyid 'dzin / rlung mkhris la ni rims 'debs slon / brgyal zhing tshad 'khru skom mgo 'khor / rus tshigs chag snyam me drod nyams / mun zhugs snyam sems yi ga 'chus / yan lag thams cad me mdag ni / 'bar pas khyab pa lta bur tsha

verses.skt: asthibhedāgnisadanatamakārocakair yutaḥ | karoti sarvam aṅgaṃ ca dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavat
verses.tib: de ni smin rdol rang rang gi / me dbal rma yi mtshan nyid 'dzin / rlung mkhris la ni rims 'debs slon / brgyal zhing tshad 'khru skom mgo 'khor / rus tshigs chag snyam me drod nyams / mun zhugs snyam sems yi ga 'chus / yan lag thams cad me mdag ni / 'bar pas khyab pa lta bur tsha

verses.skt: yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ visarpaś ca visarpati bhavet sa saḥ | śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vāśu ca cīyate
verses.tib: phyogs ni gang dang gang du mched / khyab pas yan lag de dang de / me mdag zhi ba ltar gnag pa'am / sngo ba'am dmar bas khyab byed la

verses.skt: agnidagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghragatvād drutaṃ ca saḥ | marmānusārī vīsarpaḥ syād vāto ’tibalas tataḥ
verses.tib: mes bsregs lta bur chu bur 'byung / myur du mched cing khyab par byed / gnad kyi rjes 'jug me dbal ni / de nas stobs rab skyes pa'i rlung

verses.skt: vyathetāṅgaṃ haret saṃjñāṃ nidrāṃ ca śvāsam īrayet | hidhmāṃ ca sa gato ’vasthām īdṛśīṃ labhate na nā
verses.tib: yan lag na zhing dran pa stor / gnyid yar dbugs kyi rngam pa drag / skyigs bus 'debs shing 'di lta bu'i / gnas skabs des ni thob par 'gyur

verses.skt: kvacic charmāratigrasto bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu | ceṣṭamānas tataḥ kliṣṭo manodehaśramodbhavām
verses.tib: sa dang mal khri stan la / gang du 'ang bde ba mi 'thob cing / 'gre zhing sdug bsngal myong ba dang / lus sems ngal las byung ba yis

verses.skt: duṣprabodho ’śnute nidrāṃ so ’gnivisarpa ucyate | kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham
verses.tib: gnyid kyi rmongs bag sad dga' ba / de ni me 'dra'i me dpal yin / bad kan gyis ni bkag pa'i rlung / bad kan de rdol mang du phye

verses.skt: raktaṃ vā vṛddharaktasya tvaksirāsnāvamāṃsagam | dūṣayitvā ca dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanām
verses.tib: khrag 'phel ba yis khrag brtol te / pags pa chu bshal gnas / gnod byas thor bu phra zhing rim / zlum zhing sbom la sra ba yi

verses.skt: granthīnāṃ kurute mālāṃ raktānāṃ tīvrarugjvarām | śvāsakāsātisārāsyaśoṣahidhmāvamibhramaiḥ
verses.tib: mdzer pa'i phreng ba chags byed cing / mdog dmar rab na rims kyis 'debs / lud pa dbugs mi bde tshad 'khru / kha skam skyigs bu slon mgo 'khor

verses.skt: mohavaivarṇyamūrchāṅgabhaṅgāgnisadanair yutām | ity ayaṃ granthivīsarpaḥ kaphamārutakopajaḥ
verses.tib: rmongs bag mdog nyams brgyal dang lus / yan lag na zhing me drod nyams / de ltar mdzer pa'i me dbal ni / bad kan rlung 'khrugs las gyur yin

verses.skt: kaphapittāj jvaraḥ stambho nidrātandrāśirorujaḥ | aṅgāvasādavikṣepapralāpārocakabhramāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris las rims 'debs rengs / gnyid che slon bag klad pa na / yan lag na zhing bya rmyang 'dod / bla zhing mgo 'khor yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: mūrchāgnihānir bhedo ’sthnāṃ pipāsendriyagauravam | āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati
verses.tib: rtsub cing drod nyams rus chag snyam / skom zhing dbang po mi gsal lci / be snabs 'khru zhing dang ga 'khyil / de ni rtsa sbubs rnams su 'gro

verses.skt: prāyeṇāmāśaye gṛhṇann ekadeśaṃ na cātiruk | piṭikair avakīrṇo ’tipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ
verses.tib: phal cher ma zhu gnas na zhugs / phyogs gcig tu ni rab min / thor bu ser po dmar po dang / dkar pos phyogs kun gang bar byed

verses.skt: mecakābho ’sitaḥ snigdho malinaḥ śophavān guruḥ | gambhīrapākaḥ prājyoṣmā spṛṣṭaḥ klinno ’vadīryate
verses.tib: nor bu ltar snang gnag cing snum / dri ma can la skrang zhing lci / rnag pa'i zabs che rab tu tsha

verses.skt: paṅkavacchīrṇamāṃsaś ca spaṣṭasnāyusirāgaṇaḥ | śavagandhiś ca vīsarpaṃ kardamākhyam uśanti tam
verses.tib: reg na 'jig cing rnag pa dang / 'dam ltar sha ni zhig gyur cing / rtsa rgyus gsal bar snang ba yin / mi yi ro ltar mnam me dpal / de ni 'dam 'dra zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvadhātvatisarpaṇaḥ | bāhyahetoḥ kṣatāt kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ pittam īrayan
verses.tib: kun skyes mtshan nyid kun dang ldan / lus zungs kun la rab khyab byed / phyi yi rgyu yi smas las 'khrugs / khrag bcas mkhris pa skyed byed de

verses.skt: visarpaṃ mārutaḥ kuryāt kulatthasadṛśaiś citam | sphoṭaiḥ śophajvararujādāhāḍhyaṃ śyāvalohitam
verses.tib: me dpal du ni rlung gis byed / rgya sran ku lang+tha 'dra ba'i / 'brum bus khyab skrang rims 'debs na / shin tu tsha la dmar zhing sngo

verses.skt: pṛthag doṣais trayaḥ sādhyā dvandvajāś cānupadravāḥ | asādhyau kṣatasarvotthau sarve cākrāntamarmakāḥ
verses.tib: nad dmigs tha dad las gyur gsum / gnyis gyur bla brnan med gso sla / rma dang 'dus pa las / 'byung dang / thams cad gnad ni khyab pa dang

verses.skt: śīrṇasnāyusirāmāṃsāḥ praklinnāḥ śavagandhayaḥ
verses.tib: rtsa dang chu ba sha 'drul dang / mi ro'i dri 'dra rul gso dka'

verses.skt: mithyāhāravihāreṇa viśeṣeṇa virodhinā | sādhunindāvadhānyasvaharaṇādyaiś ca sevitaiḥ
verses.tib: kha zas spyod lam log pa dang / khyad par du ni mi 'phrod bsten / dam pa smod dang srog gcod dang / gzhan gyi nor 'phrog bsten dang

verses.skt: pāpmabhiḥ karmabhiḥ sadyaḥ prāktanair veritā malāḥ | sirāḥ prapadya tiryaggās tvaglasīkāsṛgāmiṣam
verses.tib: sdig pa'i las ni 'phral byas dang / sngon chad byas pas nad bslangs nas / rtsa la thad kar gram nas ni / sha dang pags pa chu ser khrag

verses.skt: dūṣayanti ślathīkṛtya niścarantas tato bahiḥ | tvacaḥ kurvanti vaivarṇyaṃ duṣṭāḥ kuṣṭham uśanti tat
verses.tib: gnod byas sla bar gyur nas ni / de nas phyir ni 'byung 'gyur te / pags pa'i mdog ni mi sdug byed / mi bzad de ni mdze ru bshad

verses.skt: kālenopekṣitaṃ yasmāt sarvaṃ kuṣṇāti tad vapuḥ | prapadya dhātūn vyāpyāntaḥ sarvān saṃkledya cāvahet
verses.tib: gang phyir dus las yal bar bor / de ni lus kun ma rungs 'gyur / lus zungs la zhugs nang du khyab / thams cad 'drul bar byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: sasvedakledasaṃkothān kṛmīn sūkṣmān sudāruṇān | romatvaksnāyudhamanītaruṇāsthīni yaiḥ kramāt
verses.tib: rngul bcas rul zhing mnam pa dang / srin bu phra mo mi bzad skyed / spu lpags chu ba rtsa chen dang / rus pa snyi ba rim bzhin za

verses.skt: bhakṣayec chvitram asmāc ca kuṣṭhabāhyam udāhṛtam | kuṣṭhāni saptadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthaṅ miśraiḥ samāgataiḥ
verses.tib: de bas sha bkra phyi rol te / mdze las gzhan ni yin par bshad / nad gzhi tha dad 'dres pa dang / 'dus gyur mdze nad rnam pa bdun

verses.skt: sarveṣv api tridoṣeṣu vyapadeśo ’dhikatvataḥ | vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālaṃ pittād audumbaraṃ kaphāt
verses.tib: kun kyang nyes gsum las byung yang / de las lhag pa las ming 'dogs / rlung gi mdze ni thod pa 'dra / mkhris gyur u dum+bA ra ste

verses.skt: maṇḍalākhyaṃ vicarcī ca ṛkṣākhyaṃ vātapittajam | carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭibhasidhmālasavipādikāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur zlum glang shu / rlung mkhris las skyes ri sh+ya'i lce / bad rlung las byung pags pa gcig / 'brum phran dang ni sha bkra dang / 'bras byer chu ser zhig po'o

verses.skt: vātaśleṣmodbhavāḥ śleṣmapittād dadrūśatāruṣī | puṇḍarīkaṃ savisphoṭaṃ pāmā carmadalaṃ tathā
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pa las byung ba / shu ba rma kha brgya pa dang / pad+ma dkar po 'brum bur bcas / g.yan pa pags pa myags pa'o

verses.skt: sarvaiḥ syāt kākaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ trikaṃ dadru sakākaṇam | puṇḍarīkarkṣajihve ca mahākuṣṭhāni sapta tu
verses.tib: 'dus pa las gyur 'ol ma se / dang po'i gsum dang shu ba dang / 'ol ma se dang pad+ma dkar / ri sh+ya'i lce zhes bya ba ste / 'di bdun mdze nad chen po yin

verses.skt: atiślakṣṇakharasparśakhedāsvedavivarṇatāḥ | dāhaḥ kaṇḍūs tvaci svāpas todaḥ koṭhonnatiḥ śramaḥ
verses.tib: shin tu 'jam pa'am reg na / rtsub / rngul 'byung mi 'byung mdog mi sdug / lus tsha g.ya' zhing pags tshor med / thor bu phra'u mtho ba dang

verses.skt: vraṇānām adhikaṃ śūlaṃ śīghrotpattiś cirasthitiḥ | rūḍhānām api rūkṣatvaṃ nimitte ’lpe ’pi kopanam
verses.tib: rma ni lhag par gzer ba dang / myur du 'byung zhing ring du gnas / 'tshobs pa dag kyang rtsub par 'gyur / rgyu chung gis kyang nad cher ldang

verses.skt: romaharṣo ’sṛjaḥ kārṣṇyam kuṣṭhalakṣaṇam agrajam | kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ rūkṣaṃ suptaṃ kharaṃ tanu
verses.tib: ba sbu brtse zhing khrag mdog gnag / thod pa lta bu gnag cing smug / rtsub sra tshor ba chung la srab

verses.skt: vistṛtāsamaparyantaṃ hṛṣitair romabhiś citam | todāḍhyam alpakaṇḍūkaṃ kāpālaṃ śīghrasarpi ca
verses.tib: khyab cing mtha' ma mi mnyam la / ba spu langs pas khyab par byed / shin tu zug cing g.ya' ba chung / myur du khyab byed thod pa 'dra

verses.skt: pakvodumbaratāmratvagroma gaurasirācitam | bahalaṃ bahalakledaraktaṃ dāharujādhikam
verses.tib: u dum+bA ra smin pa ltar / pags spu smug rtsa dkar bas khyab / shas cher mthug dang shas cher 'drul / tsha ba'i nad dang khrag shas cher

verses.skt: āśūtthānāvadaraṇakṛmi vidyād udumbaram | sthiraṃ styānaṃ guru snigdhaṃ śvetaraktam anāśugam
verses.tib: myur du smin cing 'drul bar byed / 'bu can u dum+bA ra yin / brtan zhing 'thas la lci zhing 'jam / dkar dmar myur du mi mched la

verses.skt: anyo'nyasaktam utsannaṃ bahukaṇḍūsrutikrimi | ślakṣṇapītābhaparyantaṃ maṇḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalam
verses.tib: phan tshun 'dab 'brel shu ba slon / g.ya' zhing rnag che 'bus gang la / mtha' ma 'jam zhing ser por snang / gor gor por gnas zlum po yin

verses.skt: sakaṇḍūpiṭikā śyāvā lasīkāḍhyā vicarcikā | paruṣaṃ tanu raktāntam antaḥśyāvaṃ samunnatam
verses.tib: g.ya' zhing phra tsag gnag pa dang / chu ser mang ba glang shu yin / rtsub cing srab la mtha' ma dmar / nang na gnag cing mtho ba dang

verses.skt: satodadāharukkledaṃ karkaśaiḥ piṭikaiś citam | ṛkṣajihvākṛti proktam ṛkṣajihvaṃ bahukrimi
verses.tib: zug cing tsha la na zhing rnags / 'brum bu rtsub pos khyab pa dang / ri sh+ya'i lce ni dbyibs 'dra pa / 'bu mang ri sh+ya'i lce 'drar bshad

verses.skt: hasticarmakharasparśaṃ carmaikākhyaṃ mahāśrayam | asvedaṃ matsyaśakalasaṃnibhaṃ kiṭibhaṃ punaḥ
verses.tib: glang po'i lpags 'dra reg rtsub lpags / gcig pur bshad la gzhi che ba / rngul mi 'byung zhing nya lpags 'dra / 'brum bu phra mo thug thug po

verses.skt: rūkṣaṃ kiṇakharasparśaṃ kaṇḍūmat paruṣāsitam | sidhmaṃ rūkṣaṃ bahiḥ snigdham antar ghṛṣṭaṃ rajaḥ kiret
verses.tib: reg na rtsub dang ldan pa dang / g.ya' zhing sra la gnag pa yin / sha bkra nang rtsub phyi rol 'jam / phrugs na glog pa 'byung ba dang

verses.skt: ślakṣṇasparśaṃ tanu śvetatāmraṃ daugdhikapuṣpavat | prāyeṇa cordhvakāye syād gaṇḍaiḥ kaṇḍūyutaiś citam
verses.tib: reg na 'jam zhing srab pa la / ku ba'i me tog ltar dmar dkar / phal cher ro stod dag tu 'byung / rmen bu dmar po g.ya' dang ldan / khyab par byed pa'i 'bras zhes bya

verses.skt: raktair alasakaṃ pāṇipādadāryo vipādikāḥ | tīvrārtyo mandakaṇḍvaś ca sarāgapiṭikācitāḥ
verses.tib: rkang pa lag pa gas pa dang / mi bzad na zhing g.ya' tshabs chung / rkang lag zhig pa zhes bya'o / thor bu dmar pos khyab pa dang

verses.skt: dīrghapratānā dūrvāvad atasīkusumacchaviḥ | utsannamaṇḍalā dadrūḥ kaṇḍūmaty anuṣaṅgiṇī
verses.tib: ring du mched cing dUr ba 'dra / pags pa zar ma'i me tog 'dra / g.ya' zhing brtan par gnas pa dang / zlum por byung ba shu ba yin

verses.skt: sthūlamūlaṃ sadāhārti raktaśyāvaṃ bahuvraṇam | śatāruḥ kledajantvāḍhyaṃ prāyaśaḥ parvajanma ca
verses.tib: rtsa ba sbom zhing tsha bcas na / dmar zhing smug la rma kha mang / rnag cing 'bu mang kha brgya pa / phal cher kun tu skye ba yin

verses.skt: raktāntam antarā pāṇḍu kaṇḍūdāharujānvitam | sotsedham ācitaṃ raktaiḥ padmapattram ivāṃśubhiḥ
verses.tib: mtha' ma dmar zhing dbus na dkar / g.ya' tsha na dang bcas pa dang / mtho zhing ri mo brtan pas khyab / pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar rgyas shing

verses.skt: ghanabhūrilasīkāsṛkprāyam āśu vibhedi ca | puṇḍarīkaṃ tanutvagbhiś citaṃ sphoṭaiḥ sitāruṇaiḥ
verses.tib: stug cing chu ser khrag mang la / phal cher myur rdol pad dkar yin / pags pa srab pa'i 'brum bu dkar

verses.skt: visphoṭaṃ piṭikāḥ pāmā kaṇḍūkledarujādhikāḥ | sūkṣmāḥ śyāvāruṇā bahvyaḥ prāyaḥ sphikpāṇikūrpare
verses.tib: dmar bas gang ba 'brum bu yin / g.ya' ba'i nad ni g.ya' ba dang / 'drul zhing lhag par na ba dang / 'brum pa phra nag mang po ni / phal cher rkub lag gru mor 'byung

verses.skt: sasphoṭam asparśasahaṃ kaṇḍūṣātodadāhavat | raktaṃ dalac carmadalaṃ kākaṇaṃ tīvradāharuk
verses.tib: thor bu bcas shing reg mi bzod / g.ya' zhing dro tsha na dang bcas / dmar la pags pa myags pa yin / 'ol ma se ni rab tsha na

verses.skt: pūrvaṃ raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca kākaṇantīphalopamam | kuṣṭhaliṅgair yutaṃ sarvair naikavarṇaṃ tato bhavet
verses.tib: stod ni dmar zhing gnag pa ste / 'ol ma se yi 'bras bu 'dra / mdze yi mtshan ma kun dang ldan / de bas kha dog du mar 'gyur

verses.skt: doṣabhedīyavihitair ādiśel liṅgakarmabhiḥ | kuṣṭheṣu doṣolbaṇatāṃ sarvadoṣolbaṇaṃ tyajet
verses.tib: mdze nad nad gzhi shas che ba / nad dbye shes las bshad pa yi / mtshan ma las kyis bstan pa yi / nad kun rgyas pa las byung dang

verses.skt: riṣṭoktaṃ yac ca yac cāsthimajjaśukrasamāśrayam | yāpyaṃ medogataṃ kṛcchraṃ pittadvandvāsramāṃsagam
verses.tib: gang yang 'chi ltas las bshad dang / rus rkang khu chu la gnas spang / tshil la gnas pa 'tsho ba tsam / mkhris 'dres sha khrag gnas gso dka'

verses.skt: akṛcchraṃ kaphavātāḍhyaṃ tvakstham ekamalaṃ ca yat | tatra tvaci sthite kuṣṭhe todavaivarṇyarūkṣatāḥ
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan las gyur dang / pags gnas nad gcig gyur gso sla / de la pags par gnas pa'i mdze / zug cing rtsub la mdog mi sdug

verses.skt: svedasvāpaśvayathavaḥ śoṇite piśite punaḥ | pāṇipādāśritāḥ sphoṭāḥ kledaḥ saṃdhiṣu cādhikam
verses.tib: khrag gnas rngul 'byung gnyid che skrang / sha la gnas pa rkang pa dang / lag par 'brum bu 'byung ba dang / tshigs gnas lhag par tshigs 'drul skem

verses.skt: kauṇyaṃ gatikṣayo ’ṅgānāṃ dalanaṃ syāc ca medasi | nāsābhaṅgo ’sthimajjasthe netrarāgaḥ svarakṣayaḥ
verses.tib: rkang pa 'jas / 'gyur tshil gnas pa / yan lag zhig par byed par 'gyur / rus pa rkang gnas sna zhom zhing / mig dmar skad ni 'gags pa dang

verses.skt: kṣate ca kṛmayaḥ śukre svadārāpatyabādhanam | yathāpūrvaṃ ca sarvāṇi syur liṅgāny asṛgādiṣu
verses.tib: rma la 'bu zhugs khu bar gnas / bu dang chung mar bcas la 'byung / khrag la ni rim bzhin du / mtshan ma thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaikasaṃbhavaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ dāruṇaṃ ca tat | nirdiṣṭam aparisrāvi tridhātūdbhavasaṃśrayam
verses.tib: gzi gu mdze dang gcig las 'byung / de ni sha bkra chu dang ni / yongs su 'dzag pa zhes byar bshad / nad gzhi gsum la brten zhing 'byung

verses.skt: vātād rūkṣāruṇaṃ pittāt tāmraṃ kamalapattravat | sadāhaṃ romavidhvaṃsi kaphāc chvetaṃ ghanaṃ guru
verses.tib: rlung las rtsub cing smug pa yin / mkhris gyur pad+ma'i 'dab ltar dmar / tsha zhing ba spu 'byi bar byed / bad kan las skya stug cing lci

verses.skt: sakaṇḍu ca kramād raktamāṃsamedaḥsu cādiśet | varṇenaivedṛg ubhayaṃ kṛcchraṃ tac cottarottaram
verses.tib: g.ya' bcas rim bzhin khrag dang ni / sha dang tshil la brten par bshad / 'di dag mdog ni gnyi ga yin / de ni phyi ma bzhin gso dka'

verses.skt: aśuklaromābahalam asaṃsṛṣṭaṃ mitho navam | anagnidagdhajaṃ sādhyaṃ śvitraṃ varjyam ato ’nyathā
verses.tib: spu dkar ma yin srab pa dang / phan tshun ma 'dres gsar du byung / mes ma bsregs pa gso bar sla / de las gzhan pa gso dka' yin

verses.skt: guhyapāṇitalauṣṭheṣu jātam apy acirantanam | sparśaikāhāraśayyādisevanāt prāyaśo gadāḥ
verses.tib: mdoms dang lag mthil mchur byung ba / gsar du byung yang gso bar dka' / nad rnams phal cher zas dang ni / mal gcig reg la brten las

verses.skt: sarve saṃcāriṇo netratvagvikārā viśeṣataḥ | kṛmayas tu dvidhā proktā bāhyābhyantarabhedataḥ
verses.tib: thams cad 'go ste mig nad dang / mdze nad lhag par 'gos pa yin / sha bkra gzi gu'i nad bshad nas / da ni srin bu'i nad bshad bya / phyi dang nang gi dbye ba yis / srin bu rnam pa gnyis su bshad

verses.skt: bahirmalakaphāsṛgviḍjanmabhedāc caturvidhāḥ | nāmato viṃśatividhā bāhyās tatrāmṛjodbhavāḥ
verses.tib: phyi yi dri mas bad kan khrag / bshang skyes dbye bas rnam bzhi yin / ming las rnam pa nyi shur 'gyur / de la phyi yi khrag las byung

verses.skt: tilapramāṇasaṃsthānavarṇāḥ keśāmbarāśrayāḥ | bahupādāś ca sūkṣmāś ca yūkā likṣāś ca nāmataḥ
verses.tib: tshad dbyibs mdog ni til 'bru 'dra / skra dang gos la brten pa yin / phra zhing rkang pa mang la ming / shig dang sro ma zhes bya'o

verses.skt: dvidhā te koṭhapiṭikākaṇḍūgaṇḍān prakurvate | kuṣṭhaikahetavo ’ntarjāḥ śleṣmajās teṣu cādhikam
verses.tib: gnyi gas thor bu 'brum bu dang / g.yan pa dag ni skyed par 'gyur / nang gi mdze dang rgyu gcig ste / de las bad kan las mang skye

verses.skt: madhurānnaguḍakṣīradadhisaktunavaudanaiḥ | śakṛjjā bahuviḍdhānyaparṇaśākolakādibhiḥ
verses.tib: zas mngar bu ram 'o ma dang / tsha dang 'bras sar chan la dga' / mi gtsang byung bcas bshang / lam nas / lo ma 'dab ma la dga'

verses.skt: kaphād āmāśaye jātā vṛddhāḥ sarpanti sarvataḥ | pṛthubradhnanibhāḥ kecit kecid gaṇḍūpadopamāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan ma zhu'i gnas su 'byung / skyes nas kun du 'gro ba yin / la la 'breng ba 'dra ba yin / la la srin bu khol ma 'dra

verses.skt: rūḍhadhānyāṅkurākārās tanudīrghās tathāṇavaḥ | śvetās tāmrāvabhāsāś ca nāmataḥ saptadhā tu te
verses.tib: kha cig myu gu 'bus pa 'dra / phra zhing ring la chung ba dang / dkar zhing dmar bar snang ba yin / de yi ming ni rnam bdun te

verses.skt: antrādā udarāveṣṭā hṛdayādā mahākuhāḥ | kuravo darbhakusumāḥ sugandhās te ca kurvate
verses.tib: rgyu ma zad dang lto nang 'khyil / snying za ya mtshan chen po dang / mi mngon rgyu dang 'jag ma 'dra / dri zhim zhes bya de rnams ni

verses.skt: hṛllāsam āsyasravaṇam avipākam arocakam | mūrchāchardijvarānāhakārśyakṣavathupīnasān
verses.tib: snying 'phar kha chu 'dzag pa dang / zas mi 'ju zhing yi ga 'chas / brgyal zhing mi dran rims 'debs slon / skom zhing sbrid pa cham pas 'debs

verses.skt: raktavāhisirotthānā raktajā jantavo ’ṇavaḥ | apādā vṛttatāmrāś ca saukṣmyāt kecid adarśanāḥ
verses.tib: khrag rgyu ba yi rtsa nang nas / khrag las byung ba'i srin bu phra / zlum zhing rkang med zangs ltar dmar / phra zhing la lar bltar mi snang

verses.skt: keśādā romavidhvaṃsā romadvīpā udumbarāḥ | ṣaṭ te kuṣṭhaikakarmāṇaḥ sahasaurasamātaraḥ
verses.tib: skra rtsa za zhing sbu 'byi byed / sbu gling u dum+bA ra 'dra / zhags pa bcas dang thong ka ste / drug po de dag mdze las gcig

verses.skt: pakvāśaye purīṣotthā jāyante ’dhovisarpiṇaḥ | vṛddhāḥ santo bhaveyuś ca te yadāmāśayonmukhāḥ
verses.tib: zhu ba'i gnas su mi gtsang skyes / 'phel nas thur du rgyu bar byed / de ni cher 'phel gyur pa na / gang tshe ma zhu'i gnas su zhugs

verses.skt: tadāsyodgāraniḥśvāsā viḍgandhānuvidhāyinaḥ | pṛthuvṛttatanusthūlāḥ śyāvapītasitāsitāḥ
verses.tib: de tshe sgregs pa dbugs 'byung ba / phyi sa lta bur mnam par 'gyur / zlum zhing lus phra sbom po dang / smug dang ser dang dkar dang gnag

verses.skt: te pañca nāmnā kṛmayaḥ kakerukamakerukāḥ | sausurādāḥ sulūnākhyā lelihā janayanti ca
verses.tib: srin bu de ming rnam lnga ste / kham gyi zas dang dal gyis 'gro / myong bar byed dang brkam pa dang / lus la gnod byed ces bya'o

verses.skt: viḍbhedaśūlaviṣṭambhakārśyapāruṣyapāṇḍutāḥ | romaharṣāgnisadanagudakaṇḍūr vinirgamāt
verses.tib: des 'khru gzer dang rtug skam byed / skem zhing mdog ni skya ba dang / ba spu ldang zhing me drod nyams / lci g.ya' gzhang ni phyir 'byung byed

verses.skt: sarvārthānarthakaraṇe viśvasyāsyaikakāraṇam | aduṣṭaduṣṭaḥ pavanaḥ śarīrasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: rlung ni phan dang gnod byed la / 'di ni sna tshogs rgyu gcig pu / khyad par du ni lus kyi ni / nad dang nad med rgyu gcig pu

verses.skt: sa viśvakarmā viśvātmā viśvarūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ | sraṣṭā dhātā vibhur viṣṇuḥ saṃhartā mṛtyur antakaḥ
verses.tib: de ni kun byed kun bdag nyid / sna tshogs gzugs can skye dgu'i bdag / 'byin byed 'dzin byed khyab 'jug gtso / sdud byed 'chi bdag gshin rjer 'gyur

verses.skt: tadaduṣṭau prayatnena yatitavyam ataḥ sadā | tasyoktaṃ doṣavijñāne karma prākṛtavaikṛtam
verses.tib: de bas de ldang mi 'gyur bar / rtag tu 'bad pa nyid du gyis / de yis tha mal gzhan gyur las / nad kyi bye brag shes par bshad

verses.skt: samāsād vyāsato doṣabhedīye nāma dhāma ca | pratyekaṃ pañcadhā cāro vyāpāraś ceha vaikṛtam
verses.tib: bsdus dang rgyas pa de'i ming gnas / rgyu ba'i lam ni re re lnga / nad tshul shes par bshad pa yin / 'dir ni nad kyi rnam gyur ba

verses.skt: tasyocyate vibhāgena sanidānaṃ salakṣaṇam | dhātukṣayakarair vāyuḥ kupyaty atiniṣevitaiḥ
verses.tib: de yi dbye ba nad gzhi dang / mtshan nyid bcas pa nyid du bshad

verses.skt: asaṃkhyam api saṃkhyāya yad aśītyā pureritam 5.1+(1)ab || caran srotaḥsu rikteṣu bhṛśaṃ tāny eva pūrayan | tebhyo ’nyadoṣapūrṇebhyaḥ prāpya vāvaraṇaṃ balī
verses.tib: grangs med kyang ni brgyad cu yi / grangs su sngar ni bshad pa yin / lus zungs zad byed bsten drags pas / rlung ni 'khrugs par byed 'gyur te / sbu gu stong par rgyu gyur pa / de nyid shin tu 'gengs bar byed / nad gzhan gyis ni gang ba der / khebs pas mthu can nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: tatra pakvāśaye kruddhaḥ śūlānāhāntrakūjanam | malarodhāśmavardhmārśastrikapṛṣṭhakaṭīgraham
verses.tib: de la zhu ba'i gnas su zhugs / gzer dang rgyu ma sgra bcas sbo / bshang 'gags rde'u nad gzhang 'brum skye

verses.skt: karoty adharakāye ca tāṃs tān kṛcchrān upadravān | āmāśaye tṛḍvamathuśvāsakāsaviṣūcikāḥ
verses.tib: rgyab dang rked pa mjug mdor na / ro smad kyi ni phyogs de ru / mi bzad gnod pa de de skyed / ma zhu'i gnas zhugs skom dad slon / lud pa dbugs mi bde gsud nad

verses.skt: kaṇṭhoparodham udgārān vyādhīn ūrdhvaṃ ca nābhitaḥ | śrotrādiṣv indriyavadhaṃ tvaci sphuṭanarūkṣate
verses.tib: lkog ma 'gags shing sgregs mang na / lte ba yan chad skyed par byed / rna ba zhugs dbang por gnod / pags zhugs gas shing rtsub par byed

verses.skt: rakte tīvrā rujaḥ svāpaṃ tāpaṃ rāgaṃ vivarṇatām | arūṃṣy annasya viṣṭambham aruciṃ kṛśatāṃ bhramam
verses.tib: khrag zhugs gnyid stug mi bzad na / tsha zhing dmar la mdog mi sdug / thor 'byung kha zas sra bar gnas / yi ga 'chus skom mgo 'khor na

verses.skt: māṃsamedogato granthīṃs todāḍhyān karkaśāñ chramam | gurv aṅgaṃ cātiruk stabdhaṃ muṣṭidaṇḍahatopamam
verses.tib: sha tshil la gnas rmen bu dang / rab tu zug cing lus rtsub la / lus lci rab na rengs pa dang / khu tshur dbyig pas phog snyam byed

verses.skt: asthisthaḥ sakthisaṃdhyasthiśūlaṃ tīvraṃ balakṣayam | majjastho ’sthiṣu sauṣiryam asvapnaṃ saṃtatāṃ rujam
verses.tib: rus gnas brla dang rus tshigs na / mi bzad gzer zhing nyams stobs zad / rkang / gnas rus pa khong stong zhing / gnyid med rtag tu na ba yin

verses.skt: śukrasya śīghram utsargaṃ saṅgaṃ vikṛtim eva vā | tadvad garbhasya śukrasthaḥ sirāsv ādhmānariktate
verses.tib: khu bar gnas pa myur 'byung la / 'gags pa'am mdog 'gyur nyid du 'gyur / mngal gyi khu bar gnas de bzhin / rtsa rnams stong zhing sbo bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tatsthaḥ snāvasthitaḥ kuryād gṛdhrasyāyāmakubjatāḥ | vātapūrṇadṛtisparśaṃ śophaṃ saṃdhigato ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: chu bar gnas pa gzugs 'jas dang / sgur dang da rgan nad du 'gyur / tshigs la gnas pa'i rlung skrang pa / rkyal ba rlung gis gang reg 'dra

verses.skt: prasāraṇākuñcanayoḥ pravṛttiṃ ca savedanām | sarvāṅgasaṃśrayas todabhedasphuraṇabhañjanam
verses.tib: brkyang dang bskum par byed pa yis / bskyod pa na dang bcas par 'gyur / yan lag kun la brten pa ni / zug chag snyam sems 'gul ba dang

verses.skt: stambhanākṣepaṇasvāpasaṃdhyākuñcanakampanam | yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ kruddho ’bhyeti muhur muhuḥ
verses.tib: rengs dang tshor ba med pa dang / tshigs 'khums 'dar bar byed par 'gyur / gang tshe rtsa chen kun la gnas / yang dang yang du 'khrugs gyur pa

verses.skt: tadāṅgam ākṣipaty eṣa vyādhir ākṣepakaḥ smṛtaḥ | adhaḥ pratihato vāyur vrajann ūrdhvaṃ hṛdāśritāḥ
verses.tib: de tshe yan lag la 'jug pas / nad ni lus la 'jug ces bya / ro smad du ni 'gag pa'i rlung / gyen du song ste snying gar gnas

verses.skt: nāḍīḥ praviśya hṛdayaṃ śiraḥ śaṅkhau ca pīḍayan | ākṣipet parito gātraṃ dhanurvac cāsya nāmayet
verses.tib: snying ga'i sbu gur zhugs nas ni / mgo bo yan lag bcas par zug / lus ni kun du zhugs gyur na / de ni gzhu ltar sgu bor byed

verses.skt: kṛcchrād ucchvasiti stabdhasrastamīlitadṛk tataḥ | kapota iva kūjec ca niḥsaṃjñaḥ so ’patantrakaḥ
verses.tib: dbugs 'byin dka' zhing mig rengs har / lhod cing 'dzums par byed 'gyur la / de nas phug ron lta bur 'khun / dran pa med de gzhan dbang can

verses.skt: sa eva cāpatānākyho mukte tu marutā hṛdi | aśnuvīta muhuḥ svāsthyaṃ muhur asvāsthyam āvṛte
verses.tib: de nyid a ba ta nar bshad / rlung gis snying ni btang gyur na / skad cig tsam du bde la reg / slar zhugs na ni na bar byed

verses.skt: garbhapātasamutpannaḥ śoṇitātisravotthitaḥ | abhighātasamutthaś ca duścikitsyatamo hi saḥ
verses.tib: de ni mngal 'jig las byung dang / khrag ni lhag par 'dzag gyur dang / snad pa dag las byung gyur pa / shin tu gso bar dka' bar 'gyur

verses.skt: manye saṃstabhya vāto ’ntar āyacchan dhamanīr yadā | vyāpnoti sakalaṃ dehaṃ jatrur āyamyate tadā
verses.tib: mjing pa rengs pa'i rlung zhugs shing / gang tshe rtsa chen la gnas pa / lus kun khyab par gyur pa na / de tshe nam tshong 'gugs par byed

verses.skt: antar dhanur ivāṅgaṃ ca vegaiḥ stambhaṃ ca netrayoḥ | karoti jṛmbhāṃ daśanaṃ daśanānāṃ kaphodvamam
verses.tib: lus ni gzhu ltar nang du gug / mig rengs shugs ni 'byin par byed / glal 'byung so ni 'cha' ba dang / bad kan skyugs par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: pārśvayor vedanāṃ vākyahanupṛṣṭhaśirograham | antarāyāma ity eṣa bāhyāyāmaś ca tadvidhaḥ
verses.tib: rtsib logs zug cing tshig mi 'thon / 'gram pa rgyab dang mgo bo na / 'di ni nang du gug ces bya / phyi yi de dang 'dra ba la

verses.skt: dehasya bahirāyāmāt pṛṣṭhato nīyate śiraḥ | uraś cotkṣipyate tatra kandharā cāvamṛdyate
verses.tib: lus ni phyir dgyed byed pa dang / mgo bo rgyab tu 'dren byed cing / de la brang ni shin tu 'bur / gnya' ba bcom pa ltar na zhing

verses.skt: danteṣv āsye ca vaivarṇyaṃ prasvedaḥ srastagātratā | bāhyāyāmaṃ dhanuḥṣkambhaṃ bruvate veginaṃ ca tam
verses.tib: so dang kha ni mdog mi sdug / rngul zhing lus ni lhod par byed / phyir dgyed gzhu rengs zhes bya zhing / de la shugs drag ces kyang bshad

verses.skt: vraṇaṃ marmāśritaṃ prāpya samīraṇasamīraṇāt | vyāyacchanti tanuṃ doṣāḥ sarvām āpādamastakam
verses.tib: gnad la gnas pa'i rmar zhugs te / rlung gis bskyod par gyur pa dang / rkang pa nas ni mgo bo'i bar / lus la nad kyis khyab byed pa

verses.skt: tṛṣyataḥ pāṇḍugātrasya vraṇāyāmaḥ sa varjitaḥ | gate vege bhavet svāsthyaṃ sarveṣv ākṣepakeṣu ca
verses.tib: skam zhing lus ni skya gyur pa / rma yi da rgan de spang bya / lus la 'jug pa'i rlung kun ni / shugs dang bral nas bde bar 'gyur

verses.skt: jihvātilekhanāc chuṣkabhakṣaṇād abhighātataḥ | kupito hanumūlasthaḥ sraṃsayitvānilo hanū
verses.tib: lce ni brud drags skam zos gnod / 'gram pa'i rtsa bar gnas rlung 'khrugs / 'gram pa gnyis ni bskyod byas nas

verses.skt: karoti vivṛtāsyatvam athavā saṃvṛtāsyatām | hanusraṃsaḥ sa tena syāt kṛcchrāc carvaṇabhāṣaṇam
verses.tib: kha ni gdangs par byed pa'am / yang na 'dzums par byed par 'gyur / 'gram pa nyams par byed pa des / za dang smra ba dka' bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vāgvāhinīsirāsaṃstho jihvāṃ stambhayate ’nilaḥ | jihvāstambhaḥ sa tenānnapānavākyeṣv anīśatā
verses.tib: smra bar byed pa'i rtsa gnas rlung / lce ni ldibs par byed 'gyur zhing / lce ldibs des ni bza' btung dang / smra ba la sogs mi nus 'gyur

verses.skt: śirasā bhāraharaṇād atihāsyaprabhāṣaṇāt | uttrāsavaktrakṣavathoḥ kharakārmukakarṣaṇāt
verses.tib: mgo bos khur ni khyer pa dang / dgod drags mang du smra ba dang / sngangs dang gcus te sbrid pa gtong / gzhu sra 'dren par byed pa dang

verses.skt: viṣamād upadhānāc ca kaṭhinānāṃ ca carvaṇāt | vāyur vivṛddhas tais taiś ca vātalair ūrdhvam āsthitaḥ
verses.tib: sngas ni mi mnyam la nyal dang / sra ba 'cha' bar byed pa dang / rlung skyed pa ni de dang des / rlung 'phel ro stod la zhugs nas

verses.skt: vakrīkaroti vaktrārdham uktaṃ hasitam īkṣitam | tato ’sya kampate mūrdhā vāksaṅgaḥ stabdhanetratā
verses.tib: gdong gi gzhogs phyed yon por byed / smra ba dgod dang lta ba'ang yo / de nas de yi mgo 'gul zhing / tshig mi phyin la mig rengs shing

verses.skt: dantacālaḥ svarabhraṃśaḥ śrutihāniḥ kṣavagrahaḥ | gandhājñānaṃ smṛter mohas trāsaḥ suptasya jāyate
verses.tib: so 'gul skad ni 'gags pa dang / sgra mi thos shing sbrid pa thogs / dri mi tshor zhing dran nyams rmongs / gnyid log pa na dngang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: niṣṭhīvaḥ pārśvato yāyād ekasyākṣṇo nimīlanam | jatror ūrdhvaṃ rujā tīvrā śarīrārdhe ’dhare ’pi vā
verses.tib: mchil ma g.yon du 'dor ba dang / mig gcig 'dzums par 'gyur pa dang / nam tshong yan chad mi bzad na / gzhogs phyed dag gam ro smad na

verses.skt: tam āhur arditaṃ kecid ekāyāmam athāpare | raktam āśritya pavanaḥ kuryān mūrdhadharāḥ sirāḥ
verses.tib: la las de gzhogs phyed nad bshad / gzhan dag phyogs gcig gug ces zer / rlung ni khrag la / brten gyur te / spyi bo 'dzin pa'i rtsar zhugs pa

verses.skt: rūkṣāḥ savedanāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ so ’sādhyaḥ syāt sirāgrahaḥ | gṛhītvārdhaṃ tanor vāyuḥ sirāḥ snāyūr viśoṣya ca
verses.tib: rtsub cing nad bcas mdog gnag byed / rtsa 'dzin de ni gsor mi rung / rlung gis de la gzhogs phyed bzung / rtsa dang rgyus pa bskams byas nas

verses.skt: pakṣam anyataraṃ hanti saṃdhibandhān vimokṣayan | kṛtsno ’rdhakāyas tasya syād akarmaṇyo vicetanaḥ
verses.tib: gzhogs phyed gang yang rung la gnod / tshigs kyi sbrel mtshams lhod par byed / de yis lus phyed thams cad ni / las sbyor mi nus tshor ba med

verses.skt: ekāṅgarogaṃ taṃ kecid anye pakṣavadhaṃ viduḥ | sarvāṅgarogaṃ tadvac ca sarvakāyāśrite ’nile
verses.tib: de ni phyogs gcig nad ces zer / gzhan dag phyogs gcig bskams par 'chad / lus kun rlung nad de dang 'dra / yan lag kun la brten pa yin

verses.skt: śuddhavātahataḥ pakṣaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatamo mataḥ | kṛcchras tv anyena saṃsṛṣṭo vivarjyaḥ kṣayahetukaḥ
verses.tib: rlung nad nyi tshes gzhogs byed bskams / shin tu gse dka' yin par bshad / gzhan dang 'dres pa'ang gso dka' yin / zad byed rgyu can spang bar bya

verses.skt: āmabaddhāyanaḥ kuryāt saṃsthabhyāṅgaṃ kaphānvitaḥ | asādhyaṃ hatasarvehaṃ daṇḍavad daṇḍakaṃ marut
verses.tib: ma zhu bad kan ldan pa yis / rgyun srang bkag ste lus rengs pas / brkyang bskum kun las nyams 'gyur ba / shing 'dra shing ltar rengs pa yin

verses.skt: aṃsamūlasthito vāyuḥ sirāḥ saṃkocya tatragāḥ | bāhupraspanditaharaṃ janayaty avabāhukam
verses.tib: phrag pa'i rtsa bar zhugs pa'i rlung / der gnas rtsa ni 'khums byas te / dpung pa bskyod par mi nus byed / dpung pa 'jas pa'i rlung nad yin

verses.skt: talaṃ praty aṅgulīnāṃ yā kaṇḍarā bāhupṛṣṭhataḥ | bāhuceṣṭāpaharaṇī viśvācī nāma sā smṛtā
verses.tib: gang zhig lag mthil sor mor 'brel / chu ba rgyab tu 'khums byed cing / lag ngar bya ba nyams byed pa / rlung de bi sha tse ru bshad

verses.skt: vāyuḥ kaṭyāṃ sthitaḥ sakthnaḥ kaṇḍarām ākṣiped yadā | tadā khañjo bhavej jantuḥ paṅguḥ sakthnor dvayor api
verses.tib: gang tshe rlung ni rked par gnas / brla yi chu ba'i nang du zhugs / de tshe mi de 'theng por 'gyur / brla gnyis la zhugs 'phye bor 'gyur

verses.skt: kampate gamanārambhe khañjann iva ca yāti yaḥ | kalāyakhañjaṃ taṃ vidyān muktasaṃdhiprabandhanam
verses.tib: gang zhig 'gro bar rtsom pa na / lus 'dar 'theng po ltar 'gro ba / tshigs kyi sbrel mtshams lhod gyur pa / de ni sran ma'i 'theng por bshad

verses.skt: śītoṣṇadravasaṃśuṣkagurusnigdhair niṣevitaiḥ | jīrṇājīrṇe tathāyāsasaṃkṣobhasvapnajāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: kha zas dro grang skam rlon 'dres / lci dang snum ches bsten pa dang / zhu dang ma zhu mi bdes bskyod / nyin nyal mtshan gnyid ma log pas

verses.skt: saśleṣmamedaḥpavanam āmam atyarthasaṃcitam | abhibhūyetaraṃ doṣam ūrū cet pratipadyate
verses.tib: ma zhu shin tu 'gyur te / gal te brla nang zhugs 'gyur na / bad kan tshil dang rlung bcas pa / nad gzhan zil gyis mnan nas ni

verses.skt: sakthyasthīni prapūryāntaḥ śleṣmaṇā stimitena tat | tadā skabhnāti tenorū stabdhau śītāvacetanau
verses.tib: brla rus nang du gang byas te / bad kan gyis te rengs gyur la / de tshe de yis brla rengs byed / 'degs mi nus grang tshor ba med

verses.skt: parakīyāv iva gurū syātām atibhṛśavyathau | dhyānāṅgamardastaimityatandrāchardyarucijvaraiḥ
verses.tib: gzhan gyi yin snyam sems shing lci / mi bzad par ni 'gro ba nyams / sems khong chud cing yan lag na / snyom slon rims 'debs yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: saṃyutau pādasadanakṛcchroddharaṇasuptibhiḥ | tam ūrustambham ity āhur āḍhyavātam athāpare
verses.tib: rkang pa sgyid zhan 'degs pa dka' / bem bem por 'dug ldan pa / yin / de ni bla rengs nad ces bshad / gzhan dag phyug po'i rlung zhes zer

verses.skt: vātaśoṇitajaḥ śopho jānumadhye mahārujaḥ | jñeyaḥ kroṣṭukaśīrṣaś ca sthūlaḥ kroṣṭukaśīrṣavat
verses.tib: rlung dang khrag las skyes pa'i skrang / pus mo'i steng byung nad tshabs che / ce spyang mgo ltar sbom gyur pa / ce spyang mgo 'dra yin zhes bya

verses.skt: ruk pāde viṣamanyaste śramād vā jāyate yadā | vātena gulpham āśritya tam āhur vātakaṇṭakam
verses.tib: rkang pa na zhing mi mnyam 'dor / ngal ba las ni gang che rlung / long mor gnas te nad skyed pa / de ni rlung nad tsher mar bshad

verses.skt: pārṣṇiṃ praty aṅgulīnāṃ yā kaṇḍarā mārutārditā | sakthyutkṣepaṃ nigṛhṇāti gṛdhrasīṃ tāṃ pracakṣate
verses.tib: rting ba sor mor 'brel pa yi / chu bar rlung gis gnod gyur gang / brla nas 'jug par byed pa de / gzugs 'khums zhes ni bya bar bshad

verses.skt: viśvācī gṛdhrasī coktā khallis tīvrarujānvite | hṛṣyete caraṇau yasya bhavetāṃ ca prasuptavat
verses.tib: bi sha tsi dang gzugs 'khums bshad / mi bzad na ba kha lir bshad / gang gi rkang pa brtsi 'gyur zhing / bem bem por ni gyur pa dag

verses.skt: pādaharṣaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kaphamārutakopajaḥ | pādayoḥ kurute dāhaṃ pittāsṛksahito ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan rlung 'khrugs las gyur pa / rkang pa brtse bar de bshad do / mkhris pa khrag dang bcas pa'i rlung / rkang pa gnyis su tsha byed cing

verses.skt: viśeṣataś caṅkramite pādadāhaṃ tam ādiśet
verses.tib: khyad par du ni 'gro tshe tsha / de ni rkang tsha zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: vidāhy annaṃ viruddhaṃ ca tat tac cāsṛkpradūṣaṇam | bhajatāṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca svapnajāgaramaithunam
verses.tib: khrag ni 'khrugs par byed pa'i zas / tsha ba dang ni mi 'phrod pa / bsten dang sbyor ba log pa dang / nyin nyal mtshan gnyid ma log dang

verses.skt: prāyeṇa sukumārāṇām acaṅkramaṇaśīlinām | abhighātād aśuddheś ca nṛṇām asṛji dūṣite
verses.tib: nyal po drags dang skyid par gnas / 'chags pa'i spyod pa ma bsten dang / snad dang sbyang ba ma byas bas / mi yi khrag ni 'khrugs 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: vātalaiḥ śītalair vāyur vṛddhaḥ kruddho vimārgagaḥ | tādṛśaivāsṛjā ruddhaḥ prāk tad eva pradūṣayet
verses.tib: rlung skyed zos pas rlung nad ni / 'phel bas 'khrugs te lam gzhan zhugs / de bzhin khrag kyang lam 'gags la / dang por gnod par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: āḍhyarogaṃ khuḍaṃ vātabalāsaṃ vātaśoṇitam | tad āhur nāmabhis tac ca pūrvaṃ pādau pradhāvati
verses.tib: de ni phyug po'i rlung nad dang / 'theng nad stobs 'jig rlung khrag 'dres / ming du de ni rnam par bshad / de yang dang por rkang par rgyu

verses.skt: viśeṣād yānayānād yaiḥ pralambau tasya lakṣaṇam | bhaviṣyataḥ kuṣṭhasamaṃ tathā sādaḥ ślathāṅgatā
verses.tib: mchog tu bzhon sogs mchongs las byung / de yi 'byung 'gyur mtshan nyid ni / mdze ni 'byung 'gyur mtshan mar mtshungs / de bzhin lus nyams yan lag lhod

verses.skt: jānujaṅghorukaṭyaṃsahastapādāṅgasaṃdhiṣu | kaṇḍūsphuraṇanistodabhedagauravasuptatāḥ
verses.tib: pus mo byin pa brla rked pa / lag pa rkang pa'i tshigs rnams su / g.ya' zhing 'gul dang na ba dang / chag snyam / sems shing tshor med lci

verses.skt: bhūtvā bhūtvā praṇaśyanti muhur āvirbhavanti ca | pādayor mūlam āsthāya kadācid dhastayor api
verses.tib: yang dang yang du ldang ba dang / slar yang zhi bar 'gyur ba yin / rkang pa gnyis kyi rtsa bar gnas / lan 'ga' lag pa dag tu gnas

verses.skt: ākhor iva viṣaṃ kruddhaṃ kṛtsnaṃ dehaṃ vidhāvati | tvaṅmāṃsāśrayam uttānaṃ tat pūrvaṃ jāyate tataḥ
verses.tib: byi ba'i dug ni ldang ba ltar / lus kun la ni khyab par 'gyur / thog mar pags pa khrag la gnas / byung ba rtogs par bla zhes bya

verses.skt: kālāntareṇa gambhīraṃ sarvān dhātūn abhidravat | kaṇḍvādisaṃyutottāne tvak tāmrā śyāvalohitā
verses.tib: de nas rim gyis lus zungs kun / khyab ste rtogs par dka' zhes bya / rtogs sla pags g.ya' la sogs ldan / zangs ltar dmar dang sngo ba dang

verses.skt: sāyāmā bhṛśadāhoṣā gambhīre ’dhikapūrvaruk | śvayathur grathitaḥ pākī vāyuḥ saṃdhyasthimajjasu
verses.tib: bya rmyang bcas shing rab dro tsha / rtogs dka' sngar bas lhag par na / skrang zhing mkhrang la tshos par byed / gzhang dang tshigs dang rus pa rkang

verses.skt: chindann iva caraty antar vakrīkurvaṃś ca vegavān | karoti khañjaṃ paṅguṃ vā śarīre sarvataś caran
verses.tib: bcad snyam sems shing nang du rgyu / shugs dang ldan tshe sgur po dang / zha bo 'theng por byed 'gyur la / lus ni kun du rgyu ba yin

verses.skt: vāte ’dhike ’dhikaṃ tatra śūlasphuraṇatodanam | śophasya raukṣyakṛṣṇatvaśyāvatāvṛddhihānayaḥ
verses.tib: de la rlung shas che gyur na / gzer 'gul zug pa'i shas che zhing / skrang ba rtsub cing gnag pa dang / sngo zhing 'phel zhing 'bri bar 'gyur

verses.skt: dhamanyaṅgulisaṃdhīnāṃ saṃkoco ’ṅgagraho ’tiruk | śītadveṣānupaśayau stambhavepathusuptayaḥ
verses.tib: rtsa chen sor mo'i tshigs rnams ni / 'khums shing lus bcum bzhin du na / grang la mi dga' reg na bde / rengs shing 'dar la tshor ba med

verses.skt: rakte śopho ’tiruk todas tāmraś cimicimāyate | snigdharūkṣaiḥ śamaṃ naiti kaṇḍūkledasamanvitaḥ
verses.tib: khrag shas che skrang rab tu zug / dmar zhing tsha ba tseg tseg byed / snum dang rtsub bas zhi mi 'gyur / g.ya' dang 'drul bar ldan pa yin

verses.skt: pitte vidāhaḥ saṃmohaḥ svedo mūrchā madaḥ satṛṭ | sparśākṣamatvaṃ rug rāgaḥ śophaḥ pāko bhṛśoṣmatā
verses.tib: mkhris gyur tsha zhing rmongs bag dang / rngul zhing brgyal myos skom dad che / reg mi bzod cing na la dmar

verses.skt: kaphe staimityagurutāsuptisnigdhatvaśitatāḥ | kaṇḍūr mandā ca rug dvandvasarvaliṅgaṃ ca saṃkare
verses.tib: skrang zhing smin la shin tu bro / bad kan gyis 'gul mi shes lci / tshor med snum zhing grang ba dang / g.ya' zhing cung zad na ba yin / 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid 'dren ma yin

verses.skt: ekadoṣānugaṃ sādhyaṃ navaṃ yāpyaṃ dvidoṣajam | tridoṣajaṃ tyajet srāvi stabdham arbudakāri ca
verses.tib: nad gcig las byung gsar gso sla / nad gnyis las byung 'tsho ba tsam / 'dus pa las byung chu ser 'dzag / rengs dang thor bu 'byang ba spang

verses.skt: raktamārgaṃ nihatyāśu śākhāsaṃdhiṣu mārutaḥ | niviśyānyo'nyam āvārya vedanābhir haraty asūn
verses.tib: rlung ni yan lag tshigs gnas pa / khrag gi lam la myur gnod byed / de gnyis phan tshun 'dres gyur pa'i / nad kyis srog ni 'phrog par byed

verses.skt: vāyau pañcātmake prāṇo raukṣyavyāyāmalaṅghanaiḥ | atyāhārābhighātādhvavegodīraṇadhāraṇaiḥ
verses.tib: lnga yi bdag nyid can rlung las / srog rtsub drag shul smyung ba dang / 'grangs drags / snad dang lam gyis dub / shugs bkag nan gyis brtsir ba yis

verses.skt: kupitaś cakṣurādīnām upaghātaṃ pravartayet | pīnasārditatṛṭkāsaśvāsādīṃś cāmayān bahūn
verses.tib: 'khrugs nas mig la sogs pa la / nye bar gnod pa skyed byed cing / cham pa nyam thag skom lud pa / dbugs mi bde sogs nad ma bskyed

verses.skt: udānaḥ kṣavathūdgāracchardinidrāvidhāraṇaiḥ | gurubhārātiruditahāsyādyair vikṛto gadān
verses.tib: stod rgyu sbrid pa sgregs pa dang / skyugs pa gnyid ni bkag pa dang / khur lci 'degs dang drag tu ngu / dgod drags sogs kyis nad 'khrugs te

verses.skt: kaṇṭharodhamanobhraṃśacchardyarocakapīnasān | kuryāc ca galagaṇḍādīṃs tāṃs tāñ jatrūrdhvasaṃśrayān
verses.tib: mgul pa 'gags shing sems nyams la / cham 'debs slon zhing yi ga 'chus / mgul par lba ba sogs skyed cing

verses.skt: vyāno ’tigamanadhyānakrīḍāviṣamaceṣṭitaiḥ | virodhirūkṣabhīharṣaviṣādādyaiś ca dūṣitaḥ
verses.tib: khyab byed 'gro dang 'dug drags dang / rtsed mo drags dang mi bzod spyod / kha zas mi mthun rtsub 'jigs dga' / yi mug sogs kyis 'khrugs par 'gyur

verses.skt: puṃstvotsāhabalabhraṃśaśophacittotplavajvarān | sarvāṅgaroganistodaromaharṣāṅgasuptatāḥ
verses.tib: khu ba stobs dang spro ba nyams / skrang dang sems g.yengs rims kyis 'debs / yan lag kun la zug pa dang / spu brtse yan lag tshor ba med

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaṃ visarpam anyāṃś ca kuryāt sarvāṅgagān gadān | samāno viṣamājīrṇaśītasaṃkīrṇabhojanaiḥ
verses.tib: mdze dang med dbal gzhan yang ni / lus kun khyab pa'i nad skyed 'gyur / mnyam gnas 'du ba ma snyoms dang / grang dang 'dren ma'i zas zos dang

verses.skt: karoty akālaśayanajāgarādyaiś ca dūṣitaḥ | śūlagulmagrahaṇyādīn pakvāmāśayajān gadān
verses.tib: dus min gnyid log mtshan mo ni / gnyid ma log la sogs kyis 'khrugs / gzer dang skran dang pho nad sogs / zhu dang ma zhur gnas nad skyed

verses.skt: apāno rūkṣagurvannavegāghātātivāhanaiḥ | yānayānāsanasthānacaṅkramaiś cātisevitaiḥ
verses.tib: thur sel zas ni rtsub dang lci / shugs bkag pa dang mi srun bzhon / khyogs dang bzhon dang stan gnas dang / 'gro ba bsten ni drags pa yis

verses.skt: kupitaḥ kurute rogān kṛcchrān pakvāśayāśrayān | mūtraśukrapradoṣārśogudabhraṃśādikān bahūn
verses.tib: 'khrugs nas gso bar dka' ba'i nad / zhu ba'i gnas la brten pa skyed / gcin dang khu chu'i nad gzhang 'brum / gzhang 'byung la sogs mang po skyed

verses.skt: sarvaṃ ca mārutaṃ sāmaṃ tandrāstaimityagauravaiḥ | snigdhatvārocakālasyaśaityaśophāgnihānibhiḥ
verses.tib: rlung kun ma zhur ldan pa ni / snyom dang 'gul mi shes khong lci / snum dang sgyid zhan yi ga 'chus / grang skran me drod nyams byed cing

verses.skt: kaṭurūkṣābhilāṣeṇa tadvidhopaśayena ca | yuktaṃ vidyān nirāmaṃ tu tandrādīnāṃ viparyayāt
verses.tib: tsha dang rtsub pa mngon 'dod cing / de zos bde 'gyur las shes bya / ma zhu ba dang mi ldan pa / snyom sogs go ni bzlog pa yin

verses.skt: vāyor āvaraṇaṃ cāto bahubhedaṃ pravakṣyate | liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte dāhas tṛṣṇā śūlaṃ bhramas tamaḥ
verses.tib: de nas rlung gis 'dres pa yi / dbye ba mang por shes par bya / mkhris pas 'dres rtags tsha ba dang / skom gzer mgo 'khor mun 'thibs byed

verses.skt: kaṭukoṣṇāmlalavaṇair vidāhaḥ śītakāmatā | śaityagauravaśūlāni kaṭvādyupaśayo ’dhikam
verses.tib: tsha dro skyur dang / lan tshwa bro / tsha zhing grang ba 'dod pa yin / bsil zhing khong lci gzer ba dang / tsha ba sogs zos smyung ba dang

verses.skt: laṅghanāyāsarūkṣoṣṇakāmatā ca kaphāvṛte | raktāvṛte sadāhārtis tvaṅmāṃsāntarajā bhṛśam
verses.tib: rtsol dang rtsub pas lhag par bde / drod 'dod bad kan ldan pa yin / khrag bcas tsha zhing na dang bcas / pags pa'i sha nad shin tu zug

verses.skt: bhavec ca rāgī śvayathur jāyante maṇḍalāni ca | māṃsena kaṭhinaḥ śopho vivarṇaḥ piṭikās tathā
verses.tib: skrang pa mdog dmar 'gyur ba dang / thig le dmar po 'byung ba yin / sha dang 'dres pa mkhrang ba dang / mdog 'gyur 'brum bu phra mo 'byung

verses.skt: harṣaḥ pipīlikānāṃ ca saṃcāra iva jāyate | calaḥ snigdho mṛduḥ śītaḥ śopho gātreṣv arocakaḥ
verses.tib: spu brtse lus la grog ma ni / rgyu ba snyam du sems par 'gyur / tshil dang 'dres pa gso dka' dang / g.yo zhing snum la 'jam grang bar / lus la skrang zhing yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: āḍhyavāta iti jñeyaḥ sa kṛcchro medasāvṛte | sparśam asthyāvṛte ’tyuṣṇaṃ pīḍanaṃ cābhinandati
verses.tib: de ni phyug po'i rlung nad yin / rus pa dang ldan reg na tsha / btsir na mngon par dga' ba dang

verses.skt: sūcyeva tudyate ’tyartham aṅgaṃ sīdati śūlyate | majjāvṛte vinamanaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ pariveṣṭanam
verses.tib: khab kyis rab tu gtsags snyam byed / yan lag na zhing zug pa yin / rkang dang ldan la lus sgu zhing / glal mang dkris pa snyam du sems

verses.skt: śūlaṃ ca pīḍyamānena pāṇibhyāṃ labhate sukham | śukrāvṛte ’tivego vā na vā niṣphalatāpi vā
verses.tib: rab tu na la lag gnyis kyis / btsir na bde bar 'gyur ba yin / khu ba dang 'dris drag tu 'byung / yang na mi 'byung 'bras bu med

verses.skt: bhukte kukṣau rujā jīrṇe śāmyaty annāvṛte ’nile | mūtrāpravṛttir ādhmānaṃ vaster mūtrāvṛte bhavet
verses.tib: zas 'dres khong par ma zhu na / zhu nas nad de bde bar 'gyur / gcin dang rlung 'dres lgang pa sbo / gcin ni 'gags par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: viḍāvṛte vibandho ’dhaḥ svasthāne parikṛntati | vrajaty āśu jarāṃ sneho bhukte cānahyate naraḥ
verses.tib: bshang 'dres thur du 'byung ba 'gag / rang gi gnas su yongs su gcod / snum zos myur du 'ju bar 'gyur

verses.skt: 16.40bv sve sthāne parikṛntati śakṛt pīḍitam annena duḥkhaṃ śuṣkaṃ cirāt sṛjet | sarvadhātvāvṛte vāyau śroṇivaṅkṣaṇapṛṣṭharuk
verses.tib: zas zos lto ni sbos pa dang / zas kyis bshang ba phul nas ni / na zhing skom po rnyog can 'byung / rlung ni lus zungs kun dang 'dres / brla dang chu so rgyab tu na

verses.skt: vilomo māruto ’svasthaṃ hṛdayaṃ pīḍyate ’ti ca | bhramo mūrchā rujā dāhaḥ pittena prāṇa āvṛte
verses.tib: rlung ni log song mi bde zhing / snying ni rab tu na bar byed / srog dang mkhris pa 'dres gyur 'khrugs / mgo 'khor brgyal dang lus tsha 'gyur

verses.skt: vidagdhe ’nne ca vamanam udāne ’pi bhramādayaḥ | dāho ’ntar ūrjābhraṃśaś ca dāho vyāne ca sarvagaḥ
verses.tib: legs par ma zhu slon par byed / stod rgyu mgo 'khor sogs pa dang / nang du tsha zhing stobs zad 'gyur / khyab byed rmongs bag lus kun ni

verses.skt: klamo ’ṅgaceṣṭāsaṅgaś ca sasaṃtāpaḥ savedanaḥ | samāna ūṣmopahatir atisvedo ’ratiḥ satṛṭ
verses.tib: tsha zhing ngal la lus spyod 'gags / lus tsha nad dang bcas pa yin / mnyam gnas drod kyis gnod rdul che / mi dga' skom dang tsha bcas 'gyur

verses.skt: dāhaś ca syād apāne tu male hāridravarṇatā | rajo'tivṛttis tāpaś ca yonimehanapāyuṣu
verses.tib: thur du sel bas dri ma ni / kha / dog ser por 'byung ba dang / zla mtshan cher 'phel mo mtshan dang / pho mtshan rkub tu tsha bar 'gyur

verses.skt: śleṣmaṇā tv āvṛte prāṇe sādas tandrārucir vamiḥ | ṣṭhīvanaṃ kṣavathūdgāraniḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.tib: srog ni bad kan 'dres gyur pa / lus lhod skom dang yi ga 'chus / mchil mang sgregs pa sbrid mang slon / dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub thogs pa yin

verses.skt: udāne gurugātratvam arucir vāksvaragrahaḥ | balavarṇapraṇāśaś ca vyāne parvāsthivāggrahaḥ
verses.tib: stod rgyu lus ni lci ba dang / tshig thogs skad 'gags yi ga 'chus / stobs dang kha dog nyams par byed / khyab byed rus tshigs rengs pa dang

verses.skt: gurutāṅgeṣu sarveṣu skhalitaṃ ca gatau bhṛśam | samāne ’tihimāṅgatvam asvedo mandavahnitā
verses.tib: yan lag thams cad lci ba dang / 'gros ni shin tu 'khyor ba yin / mnyam gnas yan lag grang byed cing / rngul mi 'byung zhing drod chung 'gyur

verses.skt: apāne sakaphaṃ mūtraśakṛtaḥ syāt pravartanam | iti dvāviṃśatividhaṃ vāyor āvaraṇaṃ viduḥ
verses.tib: thur sel bshang dang gci ba ni / bad kan bcas par 'byung bar 'gyur / de ltar rlung ni gzhan 'brel ba / nyi shu rtsa gnyis yin zhes bya

verses.skt: prāṇādayas tathānyo'nyam āvṛṇvanti yathākramam | sarve ’pi viṃśatividhaṃ vidyād āvaraṇaṃ ca tat
verses.tib: de bzhin srog la sogs pa'i rlung / phan tshun rim bzhin 'dres gyur pa / kun kyang 'khrugs par gyur pa de / nyi shur 'gyur ba yin zhes bya / srog dang stod rgyu lhan cig 'khrugs

verses.skt: niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃrodhaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ śirograhaḥ | hṛdrogo mukhaśoṣaś ca prāṇenodāna āvṛte
verses.tib: dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub dka' ba dang / cham 'debs mgo bo na bar byed / snying na kha ni skam par 'gyur / stod rgyu'i rlung ni srog dang 'dres

verses.skt: udānenāvṛte prāṇe varṇaujobalasaṃkṣayaḥ | diśānayā ca vibhajet sarvam āvaraṇaṃ bhiṣak
verses.tib: mdog dang gzi mdangs stobs zad byed / phyogs 'dis 'gres pa lhag ma rnams / sman pas nye bar sbyar par bya

verses.skt: sthānāny avekṣya vātānāṃ vṛddhiṃ hāniṃ ca karmaṇām | prāṇādīnāṃ ca pañcānāṃ miśram āvaraṇaṃ mithaḥ
verses.tib: rlung ni gnas dang 'phel dang 'bri / las rnams legs par brtag par bya'o / srog la sogs pa lnga po ni / 'khrugs pas phan tshun 'dres pa yin

verses.skt: pittādibhir dvādaśabhir miśrāṇāṃ miśritaiś ca taiḥ | miśraiḥ pittādibhis tadvan miśraṇābhir anekadhā
verses.tib: mkhris pa la sogs bcu gnyis dang / 'dres par 'gyur te 'dren ma yin / mkhris pa sogs las 'dres de bzhin / 'dren ma rnam pa du ma yin

verses.skt: tāratamyavikalpāc ca yāty āvṛtir asaṃkhyatām | tāṃ lakṣayed avahito yathāsvaṃ lakṣaṇodayāt
verses.tib: rab dang rab mchog brtags pa yis / 'dres pa grangs med 'gyur ba yin / de ni rang gi mtshan nyid dang / rim gyis bde bar 'gyur ba las / rtogs dka' yin te yang yang brtag / ma yengs pas ni shes par bya / khyad par srog ni 'tsho ba yin / stod du rgyu ba stobs zhes brjod

verses.skt: śanaiḥ śanaiś copaśayād gūḍhām api muhur muhuḥ | viśeṣāj jīvitaṃ prāṇa udāno balam ucyate
verses.tib: rab dang rab mchog brtags pa yis / 'dres pa grangs med 'gyur ba yin / de ni rang gi mtshan nyid dang / rim gyis bde bar 'gyur ba las / rtogs dka' yin te yang yang brtag / ma yengs pas ni shes par bya / khyad par srog ni 'tsho ba yin / stod du rgyu ba stobs zhes brjod

verses.skt: syāt tayoḥ pīḍanād dhānir āyuṣaś ca balasya ca | āvṛtā vāyavo ’jñātā jñātā vā vatsaraṃ sthitāḥ
verses.tib: de gnyis gnod par gyur pa las / tshe dang stobs ni zad par 'gyur / rlung ni 'dres pa / ma shes pa'am / shes kyang lo gcig lon pa ni

verses.skt: prayatnenāpi duḥsādhyā bhaveyur vānupakramāḥ | vidradhiplīhahṛdrogagulmāgnisadanādayaḥ
verses.tib: 'bad kyang gso dka' yin pa'am / gso ba'i thabs ni med pa yin / 'dres nad yal bar bor na ni / khong 'bras mcher pa snying nad dang / skran dang me drod nyams la sogs

verses.skt: bhavanty upadravās teṣām āvṛtānām upekṣaṇāt
verses.tib: 'bad kyang gso dka' yin pa'am / gso ba'i thabs ni med pa yin / 'dres nad yal bar bor na ni / khong 'bras mcher pa snying nad dang / skran dang me drod nyams la sogs

verses.skt: vyādhīnāṃ saṃśayaṃ chettum anyato yo ’pramattavān | nidānaṃ satataṃ tena cintanīyaṃ vipaścitā
āmāśayastho hatvāgniṃ sāmo mārgān pidhāya yat | vidadhāti jvaraṃ doṣas tasmāt kurvīta laṅghanam
verses.tib: nad gzhi'i gnas te gnas gsum pa rdzogs so / de nas rims nad gso ba bshad par bya'o / rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis 'di skad ces bshad do / gang phyir ma zhu gnas ma zhu / rgyun srang bkag ste me drod nyams

verses.skt: prāgrūpeṣu jvarādau vā balaṃ yatnena pālayan | balādhiṣṭhānam ārogyam ārogyārthaḥ kriyākramaḥ
verses.tib: sngon tshul byung dang rims sogs la'ang / de phyir smyung ba bya dgos la / stobs ni 'bad pas bsrung bar bya / stobs ni nad med pa yi gnas / bya ba'i rims ni nad med don

verses.skt: laṅghanaiḥ kṣapite doṣe dīpte ’gnau lāghave sati | svāsthyaṃ kṣut tṛḍ ruciḥ paktir balam ojaś ca jāyate
verses.tib: smyung byas nad ni nyam smad cing / me drod skyed dang khong yang 'gyur / bde zhing bkres skom yi ga 'bye / zas 'ju stobs dang mdangs skyed 'gyur

verses.skt: tatrotkṛṣṭe samutkliṣṭe kaphaprāye cale male | sahṛllāsaprasekānnadveṣakāsaviṣūcike
verses.tib: de la phal cher bad kan nad / bslangs dang g.yos par gyur pa dang / dang gar 'khyil bcas mchil ma mang / zas la mi dga' lud pa gsung

verses.skt: sadyobhuktasya saṃjāte jvare sāme viśeṣataḥ | vamanaṃ vamanārhasya śastaṃ kuryāt tad anyathā
verses.tib: zos ma thag tu rims 'debs pa / khyad par du ni ma zhur 'gyur / skyug sman btang 'os skyug sman bsngags / de las gzhan du byas na ni

verses.skt: śvāsātīsārasaṃmohahṛdrogaviṣamajvarān | pippalībhir yutān gālān kaliṅgair madhukena vā
verses.tib: dbugs mi bde dang tshad 'khru rmongs / snying nad mi bzad rims kyis 'debs / po son pi pi ling bcas pa / dug mo nyung ngam shing mngar ni

verses.skt: uṣṇāmbhasā samadhunā pibet salavaṇena vā | paṭolanimbakarkoṭavetrapattrodakena vā
verses.tib: chu dron sbrang rtsir bcas pa'am / yang na rgyam tshar ldan pa blud / kar ka ta 'am pa to la / nim pa sba'i lo ma'i chu'am

verses.skt: tarpaṇena rasenekṣor madyaiḥ kalpoditāni vā | vamanāni prayuñjīta balakālavibhāgavit
verses.tib: 'bras yos kyi ni skyo ma'am / bu ram shing khu'am chang sbyar btung / nyams stobs dus kyi dbye shes pas / cho ga'i gnas las bshad pa yi / skyug sman dag ni rab tu btang

verses.skt: kṛte ’kṛte vā vamane jvarī kuryād viśoṣaṇam | doṣāṇāṃ samudīrṇānāṃ pācanāya śamāya ca
verses.tib: skyug sman gyi ni sbyor ba dag / byas par gyur tam ma byas kyang / rims / nad can la rnam sbyang bya / nad ni bskyod par gyur pa dang / smin dang zhi bar bya phyir bya

verses.skt: doṣeṇa bhasmanevāgnau channe ’nnaṃ na vipacyate | tasmād ādoṣapacanāj jvaritān upavāsayet
verses.tib: thal bas g.yogs pa'i me bzhin du / ma zhus khebs zas 'ju mi 'gyur / de bas nyes pa smin bya'i phyir / rims dang ldan la smyung ba bya

verses.skt: tṛṣṇag alpālpam uṣṇāmbu pibed vātakaphajvare | tat kaphaṃ vilayaṃ nītvā tṛṣṇām āśu nivartayet
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan rims skom dang / chu tshan nyung shas nyung shas btung / des ni bad kan zhu gyur nas / skom dad myur du sel bar byed

verses.skt: udīrya cāgniṃ srotāṃsi mṛdūkṛtya viśodhayet | līnapittānilasvedaśakṛnmūtrānulomanam
verses.tib: me drod skyed cing bu ga'i rgyun / 'jam par byas nas sbyong bar byed / zhen pa'i rlung mkhris rngul dang ni / bshang gci bde bar 'byin par byed

verses.skt: nidrājāḍyāruciharaṃ prāṇānām avalambanam | viparītam ataḥ śītaṃ doṣasaṃghātavardhanam
verses.tib: gnyid rmongs yi ga 'chus pa sel / srog ni 'dzin par byed pa yin / chu grang de las bzlog pa ste / nad kyi tshogs ni 'phelabyed yin

verses.skt: uṣṇam evaṅguṇatve ’pi yuñjyān naikāntapittale | udriktapitte davathudāhamohātisāriṇi
verses.tib: chu tshan yon tan de 'dra yang / gcig tu mkhris pas ldan rims dang / mkhris shas che dang phyogs gcig tsha / kun tsha rmongs bag tshad par 'khru

verses.skt: viṣamadyotthite grīṣme kṣatakṣīṇe ’srapittini | ghanacandanaśuṇṭhyambuparpaṭośīrasādhitam
verses.tib: chang dub las byung so ga dang / gcong skems khrag mkhris can mi blud / de la gla sgang tsan+dan dang / bca' sga par pa ta dang ni / pu shel tsi dang ba le ka

verses.skt: śītaṃ tebhyo hitaṃ toyaṃ pācanaṃ tṛḍjvarāpaham | ūṣmā pittād ṛte nāsti jvaro nāsty ūṣmaṇā vinā
verses.tib: bskol chu bsgrangs blud rims skom sel / mkhris pa med par tsha mi 'byung / tsha ba med par rims yod min

verses.skt: tasmāt pittaviruddhāni tyajet pittādhike ’dhikam | snānābhyaṅgapradehāṃś ca pariśeṣaṃ ca laṅghanam
verses.tib: de bas mkhris pa la gnod spang / mkhris shas che bas lhag par spang / khrus dang bsku dang byug pa dang / smyung ba lhag ma'ang spang bar bya

verses.skt: ajīrṇa iva śūlaghnaṃ sāme tīvraruji jvare | na pibed auṣadhaṃ tad dhi bhūya evāmam āvahet
verses.tib: ma zhu gzer 'joms sman lta bur / ma zhu rims ni mi bzad la / sman btung mi bya de yis ni / lhag par ma zhu 'phel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: āmābhibhūtakoṣṭhasya kṣīraṃ viṣam aher iva | sodardapīnasaśvāse jaṅghāparvāsthiśūlini
verses.tib: lto ba ma zhus khyab pa la / 'o ma sbrul la blud dang mtshungs / rlung dang bad kan bdag nyid der / lkog nad cham pa dbugs mi bde / byin pa tshigs rus gzer gyur la

verses.skt: vātaśleṣmātmake svedaḥ praśastaḥ sa pravartayet | svedamūtraśakṛdvātān kuryād agneś ca pāṭavam
verses.tib: rngul 'byung ba ni rab bsngags te / rngul dang bshang gci 'phyen bder 'byung / me drod skyed cing zas 'ju byed

verses.skt: snehoktam ācāravidhiṃ sarvaśaś cānupālayet | laṅghanaṃ svedanaṃ kālo yavāgvas tiktako rasaḥ
verses.tib: snum 'thung cho gar bshad pa ni / rnam pa kun du spyad par bya / smyang dang dugs bya dus dang ni / nas thug tig ta'i khu ba rnams

verses.skt: malānāṃ pācanāni syur yathāvasthaṃ krameṇa vā | śuddhavātakṣayāgantujīrṇajvariṣu laṅghanam
verses.tib: dri ma rnams ni smin byed pa / rim mam gnas skabs ji bzhin sbyin / rlung nad nyi tshe zad byed dang / glo bur ba dang rims rnying la / smyung ba mi bya de la ni

verses.skt: neṣyate teṣu hi hitaṃ śamanaṃ yan na karśanam | tatra sāmajvarākṛtyā jānīyād aviśoṣitam
verses.tib: nyams mi smad pa'i zhi bya phan / de la ma zhu'i rims ldan tshul / nyams smad mi byar shes par bya

verses.skt: dvividhopakramajñānam avekṣeta ca laṅghane | yuktaṃ laṅghitaliṅgais tu taṃ peyābhir upācaret
verses.tib: gso ba'i thabs ni gnyis shes las / brtags te smyung ba bya ba yin / smyung byas mtshan mar ldan pa ni / de la thug sla la sogs blud

verses.skt: yathāsvauṣadhasiddhābhir maṇḍapūrvābhir āditaḥ | ṣaḍahaṃ vā mṛdutvaṃ vā jvaro yāvad avāpnuyāt
verses.tib: rang gis sman dang ji bzhin bskol / dang por thug sla la sogs sbyin / zhag drug bar du'am gang tshe rims / rtse zhil gyur pa'i bar du sbyin

verses.skt: tasyāgnir dīpyate tābhiḥ samidbhir iva pāvakaḥ | prāg lājapeyāṃ sujarāṃ saśuṇṭhīdhānyapippalīm
verses.tib: de yis shing gis me bzhin du / de yi me drod 'phel bar byed / dang po 'bras yos thug 'ju sla / bca' sga pi pi ling dang bcas

verses.skt: sasaindhavāṃ tathāmlārthī tāṃ pibet sahadāḍimām | sṛṣṭaviḍ bahupitto vā saśuṇṭhīmākṣikāṃ himām
verses.tib: 'u su rgya mtshar bcas pa sbyin / skyur 'dod se'u 'bru bcas ba btung / 'khru ba'am mkhris pa mang ba la / sbrang rtsi bca' sga btab bsgrangs blud

verses.skt: vastipārśvaśiraḥśūlī vyāghrīgokṣurasādhitām | pṛśniparṇībalābilvanāgarotpaladhānyakaiḥ
verses.tib: chu so rtsib logs gzer / gze ma bya kri bskol ba blud / rims 'khrur kr-iSh+Na par+Ni dang / bal bil ba bca' sga dang

verses.skt: siddhāṃ jvarātisāry amlāṃ peyāṃ dīpanapācanīm | hrasvena pañcamūlena hikkārukśvāsakāsavān
verses.tib: ut+pal 'u su bskol rims 'khrur / thug skyur smin dang drod bskyed yin / skyigs bu lud pa dbugs mi bde / gzer can rtsa ba chung ngu lnga

verses.skt: pañcamūlena mahatā kaphārto yavasādhitām | vibaddhavarcāḥ sayavāṃ pippalyāmalakaiḥ kṛtāṃ
verses.tib: bad kan gyis nyen nas thug ni / rtsa ba chen po lnga pa sbyin / rtug pa 'gags la nad bcas pa / pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra

verses.skt: yavāgūṃ sarpiṣā bhṛṣṭāṃ maladoṣānulomanīm | cavikāpippalīmūladrākṣāmalakanāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: btab pa'i nas thug mar dang brngos / dri ma nad ni bde 'byung byed / lto bar rtug 'gags nad bcas la / dbyi mo pi pi ling rtsa ba

verses.skt: koṣṭhe vibaddhe saruji pibet tu parikartini | kolavṛkṣāmlakalaśīdhāvanīśrīphalaiḥ kṛtām
verses.tib: rgun 'brum dong ga skyu ru ra / khong pa bcad pa snyam byed la / rgya shugad trig sa la bar / kr-iSh+Na paNi bil ba blud

verses.skt: asvedanidras tṛṣṇārtaḥ sitāmalakanāgaraiḥ | sitābadaramṛdvīkāśārivāmustacandanaiḥ
verses.tib: rngul med gnyid med skom pas nyen / khar dong gra skyu ru ra'o / rgya shug khar rgun 'brum dang / thal tres gla sgang tsan+dan ni

verses.skt: tṛṣṇāchardiparīdāhajvaraghnīṃ kṣaudrasaṃyutām | kuryāt peyauṣadhair eva rasayūṣādikān api
verses.tib: skom dang slon dang bcas pa blud / sbrang rtsir bcas pa rims 'joms yin / de dag thug pa'i sman yin te / sha khu yu sha sogs pa'ang sbyar

verses.skt: madyodbhave madyanitye pittasthānagate kaphe | grīṣme tayor vādhikayos tṛṭchardirdāhapīḍite
verses.tib: chang las byung dang chang rgyun bsten / bad kan mkhris pa'i gnas zhugs nas / de gnyis shas che'am so ga'am / skom dang slon dang tshad pas nyen

verses.skt: ūrdhvaṃ pravṛtte rakte ca peyāṃ necchanti teṣu tu | jvarāpahaiḥ phalarasair adbhir vā lājatarpaṇāt
verses.tib: khrag ni stod du 'byung ba ste / de la thug pa mi blud kyi / 'bras phye'i skyo ma rims 'joms pa'i

verses.skt: pibet saśarkarākṣaudrān tato jīrṇe tu tarpaṇe | yavāgvāṃ vaudanaṃ kṣudvān aśnīyād bhṛṣṭataṇḍulam
verses.tib: 'bras bu'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang / khar dkar bcas blud par bya / de nas skyo ma zhu nas ni / bkres na nas thug 'bras brngos pa'i / 'bras chan dag ni bza' bya zhing

verses.skt: dakalāvaṇikair yūṣai rasair vā mudgalāvajaiḥ | ity ayaṃ ṣaḍaho neyo balaṃ doṣaṃ ca rakṣatā
verses.tib: sha khu sla ba'i khu ba 'am / mung+ga 'ur pa'i khu bcas bza' / de ltar zhag drug 'di bzlas te / nyams stobs nad ni bsrung bar bya

verses.skt: tataḥ pakveṣu doṣeṣu laṅghanādyaiḥ praśasyate | kaṣāyo doṣaśeṣasya pācanaḥ śamano ’thavā
verses.tib: de nas smyung ba la sogs pas / smin pa'i nad ni lhag ma rnams / smin pa'am yang na zhi bya'i phyir / sman khu'i sbyor ba'i bya ba bsngags

verses.skt: tiktaḥ pitte viśeṣeṇa prayojyaḥ kaṭukaḥ kaphe | pittaśleṣmaharatve ’pi kaṣāyaḥ sa na śasyate
verses.tib: mkhris la mchog tu kha ba ste / bad kan la ni tsha ba blud / bad kan mkhris pa sel byed kyang / bska ba bsngags pa ma yin te

verses.skt: navajvare malastambhāt kaṣāyo viṣamajvaram | kurute ’rucihṛllāsahidhmādhmānādikān api
verses.tib: rims gsar dri ma 'gags byed pas / bska bas mi bzad rims skyed cing / dang ga 'khyil dang yi ga 'chus / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde yang skyed

verses.skt: saptāhād auṣadhaṃ kecid āhur anye daśāhataḥ | kecil laghvannabhuktasya yojyam āmolbaṇe na tu
verses.tib: la la zhag bdun nas sman gtong / gzhan dag zhag ni bcu lon nas / kha cig zas yang zos nas gtong / ma zhu shas che la mi gtang

verses.skt: tīvrajvaraparītasya doṣavegodaye yataḥ | doṣe ’thavātinicite tandrāstaimityakāriṇi
verses.tib: gang phyir mi bzad rims nyen la / nad kyi shugs ni 'byung 'gyur ba / ma smin pa la sman gyis ni / rims ni slar 'phel byed pa 'am / nad ni shin tu sogs pa yis / snyom dang rmongs bag skyed par byed / gang tshe rims rtse zhil lus yang / dri ma la sogs g.yos gyur ba

verses.skt: apacyamānaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ bhūyo jvalayati jvaram | mṛdur jvaro laghur dehaś calitāś ca malā yadā
verses.tib: gang phyir mi bzad rims nyen la / nad kyi shugs ni 'byung 'gyur ba / ma smin pa la sman gyis ni / rims ni slar 'phel byed pa 'am / nad ni shin tu sogs pa yis / snyom dang rmongs bag skyed par byed / gang tshe rims rtse zhil lus yang / dri ma la sogs g.yos gyur ba

verses.skt: acirajvaritasyāpi bheṣajaṃ yojayet tadā | mustayā parpaṭaṃ yuktaṃ śuṇṭhyā duḥsparśayāpi vā
verses.tib: rims btab yun ring ma lon yang / de tshe sman ni sbyin par bya / gla sgang par pa tar bcas pa'am / bca' sga'am yang na byi tsher ba

verses.skt: pākyaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā pāṭhośīraṃ savālakam | pibet tadvac ca bhūnimbaguḍūcīmustanāgaram
verses.tib: bskol ba bsgrangs pa'i khu ba blud / pa ta pu shel pa la ka / blud pa'am de bzhin du nim pa / sle tres gla sgang do gra rnams

verses.skt: yathāyogam ime yojyāḥ kaṣāyā doṣapācanāḥ | jvarārocakatṛṣṇāsyavairasyāpaktināśanāḥ
verses.tib: 'di ni ci rigs par blud bya / nan smin byed pa'i sman khu ba / rims dang skom dad yi ga 'chus / khas ro mi tshor ma zhu 'joms

verses.skt: kaliṅgakāḥ paṭolasya pattraṃ kaṭukarohiṇī
verses.tib: dug mo nyung dang pa to la'i

verses.skt: paṭolaṃ śārivā mustā pāṭhā kaṭukarohiṇī | paṭolanimbatriphalāmṛdvīkāmustavatsakāḥ
verses.tib: lo ma dang ni pu tse shel / pa tol gla sgang thal tres dang / pa ta dang ni pu tse shel / pa tol nim pa 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: kirātatiktam amṛtā candanaṃ viśvabheṣajam | dhātrīmustāmṛtākṣaudram ardhaślokasamāpanāḥ
verses.tib: rgun 'brum gla sgang dug mo nyung / kir tig ta sle tres dang / bca' sga dang ni tsan+dan dkar / sle tres gla sgang skyu ru / sbrang / tshigs bcad phyed kyis rdzogs byas pa

verses.skt: pañcaite saṃtatādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ śamanā matāḥ | durālabhāmṛtāmustānāgaraṃ vātaje jvare
verses.tib: lnga po 'di dag rtag rims sogs / lnga po zhi bar byed par 'dod / rlung gi rims la byi tsher ba / bca' sga sle tres gla sgang phan

verses.skt: athavā pippalīmūlaguḍūcīviśvabheṣajam | kanīyaḥ pañcamūlaṃ ca pitte śakrayavā ghanam
verses.tib: yang na pi pi ling rtsa ba / sle tres dang ni bca' sga'am / rtsa ba lnga ba chung ngu phan / mkhris rims gla sgang dug mo nyung / pu tse shel ni sbrang rtsir bcas / de bzhin gla sgang par pa ta

verses.skt: kaṭukā ceti sakṣaudraṃ mustāparpaṭakaṃ tathā | sadhanvayāsabhūnimbaṃ vatsakādyo gaṇaḥ kaphe
verses.tib: byi tsher rtsa mkhris bcas pa phan / bad kan dug mo nyung sogs sde / yang na ba sha ka gla sgang / bca' sga byi tsher bskol ba phan

verses.skt: athavā vṛṣagāṅgeyīśṛṅgaveradurālabhāḥ | rugvibandhānilaśleṣmayukte dīpanapācanam
verses.tib: pi pi ling rtsa a ru ra / dong ga gla sgang pu tse shel / bad kan rlung 'dres bshang 'gags pas / na ba smin zhing drod skyed byed

verses.skt: abhayāpippalīmūlaśamyākakaṭukāghanam | drākṣāmadhūkamadhukalodhrakāśmaryaśārivāḥ
verses.tib: rgun 'brum shing mngar ma du ka / seng phrom tang pal thal tres dang / gla sgang skyu ru ba la ke

verses.skt: mustāmalakahrīverapadmakesarapadmakam | mṛṇālacandanośīranīlotpalaparūṣakam
verses.tib: pad+ma ge sar shug pa dang / pad rtsa tsan+dan uR+shir / ba ru sha ka ut+pal sngo

verses.skt: phāṇṭo himo vā drākṣādir jātīkusumavāsitaḥ | yukto madhusitālājair jayaty anilapittajam
verses.tib: rgun sogs skyo ma'am bskol bsgrangs pa / me tog dzA ti'i dris bsgos te / kha ra 'bras yos sbrang rtsir sbyar / rlung mkhris rims ni 'joms byed cing

verses.skt: jvaraṃ madātyayaṃ chardiṃ mūrchāṃ dāhaṃ śramaṃ bhramam | ūrdhvagaṃ raktapittaṃ ca pipāsāṃ kāmalām api
verses.tib: chang nad slon brgyal tsha mgo 'khor / ngal dang stod kyi khrag mkhris nad / skom dang mig ser dag kyang sel

verses.skt: pācayet kaṭukāṃ piṣṭvā karpare ’bhinave śucau | niṣpīḍito ghṛtayutas tadraso jvaradāhajit
verses.tib: pu tse shel btags snod sar pa / gtsang mdag tu bskol nas ni / btsir ba'i khu ba mar dang sbyar / khu ba des ni rims tshad sel

verses.skt: kaphavāte vacātiktāpāṭhāragvadhavatsakāḥ | pippalīcūrṇayukto vā kvāthaś chinnodbhavodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan rlung 'dres shu dag dang / pu tse shel dang pa ta dang / dong ga dug mo nyung bskol phan / yang na sle tres bskol ba yi / khu bar pi pi ling gi ni / phye ma btab ste 'thungs na phan

verses.skt: vyāghrīśuṇṭhyamṛtākvāthaḥ pippalīcūrṇasaṃyutaḥ | vātaśleṣmajvaraśvāsakāsapīnasaśūlajit
verses.tib: bya kri bca' sga sle tres bskol / pi pi ling gi phye mar bcas / bad kan rlung rims dbugs mi bde / lud pa cham pa gzer 'joms byed

verses.skt: pathyākustumburīmustāśuṇṭhīkaṭtṛṇaparpaṭam | sakaṭphalavacābhārgīdevāhvaṃ madhuhiṅgumat
verses.tib: gla sgang 'u su a ru ra / bca' sga skra lo pu ti ka / shu dgag bra kad phal / thang shing shing kun sbrang rtsir bcas

verses.skt: kaphavātajvaraṣṭhīvakukṣihṛtpārśvavedanāḥ | kaṇṭhāmayāsyaśvayathukāsaśvāsān niyacchati
verses.tib: rlung dang bad rims mchil ma mang / lto dang snying ga rtsib logs na / lkog nad kha ni skrangs pa dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde rnams sel

verses.skt: āragvadhādiḥ sakṣaudraḥ kaphapittajvaraṃ jayet | tathā tiktāvṛṣośīratrāyantītriphalāmṛtāḥ
verses.tib: dong ga sogs te sbrang rtsir bcas / bad kan mkhris / 'gyur rims 'joms so / de bzhin pu tse shel dang ni / ba sha ka dang pu shel tse / kyi lce ba dang 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: paṭolātiviṣānimbamūrvādhanvayavāsakāḥ | saṃnipātajvare vyāghrīdevadāruniśāghanam
verses.tib: sle tres dang ni pa to la / bong nga dkar po nim pa dang / mur ba byi tsher ba yang phan / 'dus pa'i rims la bya kri dang

verses.skt: paṭolapattranimbatvaktriphalākaṭukāyutam | nāgaraṃ pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ guḍūcī kaṇṭakārikā
verses.tib: thang shing skyer pa gla sgang dang / pa to lo ma nim pa'i shun / 'bras gsum pu tse shel yang phan

verses.skt: sakāsaśvāsapārśvārtau vātaśleṣmottare jvare | madhūkapuṣpamṛdvīkātrāyamāṇāparūṣakam
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan shas che'i rims / lud dbugs mi bde rtsib logs zug / dong gra puSh+kar mU la dang / sle tres kaN+Da ka ri phan / rgun 'brum ma du ka'i me tog

verses.skt: sośīratiktātriphalākāśmaryaṃ kalpayed dhimam | kaṣāyaṃ taṃ piban kāle jvarān sarvān apohati
verses.tib: ba ru sha ka kyi lce ba / pu shel tse dang pu tse shel / 'bras bu gsum dang tang pal bcas / bskol te bsgrangs par gyur pa yi / khu ba de ni des 'thungs na / rims ni thams cad sel bar byed

verses.skt: jātyāmalakamustāni tadvad dhanvayavāsakam | baddhaviṭ kaṭukādrākṣātrāyantītriphalāguḍam
verses.tib: dzA ti gla sgang skyu ru ra / byi tsher ba bskol de 'drar phan / bshang 'gags rgun 'brum pu tse shel / kyi lce bu ram 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: jīrṇauṣadho ’nnaṃ peyādyam ācarec chleṣmavān na tu | peyā kaphaṃ vardhayati paṅkaṃ pāṃsuṣu vṛṣṭivat
verses.tib: sman zhu nas ni thug pa sogs / spyad bya bad kan can gyis min / bad kan gyis brlan lus la ni / rngul la char bab 'phel ba ltar

verses.skt: śleṣmābhiṣyaṇṇadehānām ataḥ prāg api yojayet | yūṣān kulatthacaṇakakalāyādikṛtān laghūn
verses.tib: thug pa yis ni bad kan skyed / de phyir thog ma nyid du yang / yu sha rgya sran tsa na ka / sran ma sogs byas yang ba dang

verses.skt: rūkṣāṃs tiktarasopetān hṛdyān rucikarān paṭūn | raktādyāḥ śālayo jīrṇāḥ ṣaṣṭikāś ca jvare hitāḥ
verses.tib: rtsub cing ro kha ldan yid 'ong / yi ga 'byed byed g.yos legs sbyin / sA lu rtsa snar sogs 'bru rnying / drug cu pa yang rims la phan

verses.skt: śleṣmottare vītatuṣās tathā vāṭīkṛtā yavāḥ | odanas taiḥ sruto dvis triḥ prayoktavyo yathāyatham
verses.tib: bad kan shas cher de bzhin nas / phub ma med byas chag tshe'i chan / nad dang lus zungs sogs stobs las / rims sel sman khur btsos 'bras chan / lan gnyis lan gsum btsags nas ni / ci rigs par ni sbyin par bya / mung+ga sogs dang ku lang+tha'i / yu sha yang bas rims nad 'joms

verses.skt: doṣadūṣyādibalato jvaraghnakvāthasādhitaḥ | mudgādyair laghubhir yūṣāḥ kulatthaiś ca jvarāpahāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan shas cher de bzhin nas / phub ma med byas chag tshe'i chan / nad dang lus zungs sogs stobs las / rims sel sman khur btsos 'bras chan / lan gnyis lan gsum btsags nas ni / ci rigs par ni sbyin par bya / mung+ga sogs dang ku lang+tha'i / yu sha yang bas rims nad 'joms

verses.skt: kāravellakakarkoṭabālamūlakaparpaṭaiḥ | vārtākanimbakusumapaṭolaphalapallavaiḥ
verses.tib: tshod ma ka ra be la dang / kar ko ta dang la phug gzhon / par pa ta dang ba sha ka / nim pa'i me tog pa to la'i / 'bras bu dang ni lo ma las

verses.skt: atyantalaghubhir māṃsair jāṅgalaiś ca hitā rasāḥ | vyāghrīparūṣatarkārīdrākṣāmalakadāḍimaiḥ
verses.tib: shin tu yang ba'i sha dang ni / skam sa'i srog chags sha khu ni / kaN+Da ka ri pa ru sha / ag+ni man+tha rgun 'brum / dang

verses.skt: saṃskṛtāḥ pippalīśuṇṭhīdhānyajīrakasaindhavaiḥ | sitāmadhubhyāṃ prāyeṇa saṃyutā vā kṛtākṛtāḥ
verses.tib: skyu ru ra dang se 'bru dang / pi pi ling dang bca' sga dang / 'u su zir rgyam tshar bcas / phal cher khar sbrang rtsi cher / ldan pa'i g.yos byas ma byas pa

verses.skt: anamlatakrasiddhāni rucyāni vyañjanāni ca | acchāny analasaṃpannāny anupāne ’pi yojayet
verses.tib: mi skyur dar ba bskol ba dang / yi gar 'ong zhing sla ba dang / legs par bskol ba'i tshod ma phan / de ni btung ba'i phyir yang sbyin

verses.skt: tāni kvathitaśītaṃ ca vāri madyaṃ ca sātmyataḥ | sajvaraṃ jvaramuktaṃ vā dinānte bhojayel laghu
verses.tib: chu bskol bsgrangs par gyur pa dang / goms par gyur pa'i dbang las ni / chang yang blud par bya ba yin / rims dang bcas pa'am rims bral la / dgongs ka kha zas yang ba sbyin

verses.skt: śleṣmakṣayavivṛddhoṣmā balavān analas tadā | yathocite ’thavā kāle deśasātmyānurodhataḥ
verses.tib: de tshe bad kan me drod 'phel / khong pa'i me drod stobs dang ldan / yang na yul goms dbang las ni / ci rigs su yang sbyin par bya

verses.skt: prāg alpavahnir bhuñjāno na hy ajīrṇena pīḍyate | kaṣāyapānapathyānnair daśāha iti laṅghite
verses.tib: me drod chung la sngar zos na / zas ma zhu bar gzir bar 'gyur / sman bskol khu ba phan zas kyis / zhag bcu'i bar du smyung ba bya

verses.skt: sarpir dadyāt kaphe mande vātapittottare jvare | pakveṣu doṣeṣv amṛtaṃ tad viṣopamam anyathā
verses.tib: bad kan bri nas rlung mkhris ni / shas che'i rims la zhun mar sbyin / nad smin pa la bdud rtsi yin / gzhan du de ni dug dang mtshungs

verses.skt: daśāhe syād atīte ’pi jvaropadravavṛddhikṛt | laṅghanādikramaṃ tatra kuryād ākaphasaṃkṣayāt
verses.tib: zhag bcu 'das par gyur kyang ni / rims gyis bla brnan 'phel bar byed / de la smyung ba la sogs rims / bad kan zad kyi bar du bya

verses.skt: dehadhātvabalatvāc ca jvaro jīrṇo ’nuvartate | rūkṣaṃ hi tejo jvarakṛt tejasā rūkṣitasya ca
verses.tib: lus dang lus zungs stobs zhan pas / rims rnying du yang 'gyur ba yin / me drod rtsub pas rims skyed byed / me drod rtsub par gyur pa la

verses.skt: vamanasvedakālāmbukaṣāyalaghubhojanaiḥ | yaḥ syād atibalo dhātuḥ sahacārī sadāgatiḥ
verses.tib: skyugs sman dugs dang dus dang chu / bskol dang kha zas spangs pa yis / rlung gi khams ni grogs gyur pas / gang zhig stobs chen gyur pa la

verses.skt: tasya saṃśamanaṃ sarpir dīptasyevāmbu veśmanaḥ | vātapittajitām agryaṃ saṃskāraṃ cānurudhyate
verses.tib: de yi zhi byed zhun mar te / khang pa 'bar la chu blugs mtshungs / rlung mkhris sel ba'i mchog tu ni / sbyor ba'i dbang las gyur pas na

verses.skt: sutarāṃ tad dhy ato dadyād yathāsvauṣadhasādhitam | viparītaṃ jvaroṣmāṇaṃ jayet pittaṃ ca śaityataḥ
verses.tib: de phyir rang gi sman dang ni / ji bzhin bskol ba de la sbyin / rims dro mi mthun pas sel la / bsil bas mkhris pa'ang sel bar byed

verses.skt: snehād vātaṃ ghṛtaṃ tulyaṃ yogasaṃskārataḥ kapham | pūrve kaṣāyāḥ saghṛtāḥ sarve yojyā yathāmalam
verses.tib: snum pas rlung sel bad kan mar / mtshungs kyang sbyor dang g.yos pas sel / sngar gyi sman khu mar bcas pa / thams cad nad dmigs ji bzhin gtang

verses.skt: triphalāpicumandatvaṅmadhukaṃ bṛhatīdvayam | samasūradalaṃ kvāthaḥ saghṛto jvarakāsahā
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang nim pa'i shun / shing mngar bri ha ti / gnyis dang / sran chung 'o mar bcas bskol la / mar ldan rims dang lud pa 'joms

verses.skt: pippalīndrayavadhāvanitiktāśārivāmalakatāmalakībhiḥ | bilvamustahimapālanisevyair drākṣayātiviṣayā sthirayā ca
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang tig ta dug mo nyung / kaN+Da ka ri pu tse shel thal tres / ta ma la ka skyu ru ra bil ba / gla sgang tsan+dan kyi lce pu shel tse / rgun 'brum bong nga sa la par+Ni dang

verses.skt: ghṛtam āśu nihanti sādhitaṃ jvaram agniṃ viṣamaṃ halīmakam | aruciṃ bhṛśatāpam aṃsayor vamathuṃ pārśvaśirorujaṃ kṣayam
verses.tib: bskol ba'i mar gyis rims kyi nad dang ni / me drod mi snyoms ha li sa ka dang / yi ga 'chus dang mi bzad tsha ba dang / snyom pa'i nad dang rtsib logs na ba dang / mgo nad slon ni myur du 'joms par byed

verses.skt: tailvakaṃ pavanajanmani jvare yojayet trivṛtayā viyojitam | tiktakaṃ vṛṣaghṛtaṃ ca paittike yac ca pālanikayā śṛtaṃ haviḥ
verses.tib: dur byid ma gtogs seng phrom sogs bskol mar / rlung las gyur pa'i rims la bsngags pa yin / mkhris pa'i rims la pu tse shel dug mar / kyi lce bar bskol sman mar gang yin phan / bye dang ga dang dbyi mong kha ru tsha / pa ta tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka

verses.skt: viḍaṅgasauvarcalacavyapāṭhāvyoṣāgnisindhūdbhavayāvaśūkaiḥ | palāṃśakaiḥ kṣīrasamaṃ ghṛtasya prasthaṃ pacej jīrṇakaphajvaraghnam || 93 || guḍūcyā rasakalkābhyāṃ triphalāyā vṛṣasya vā | mṛdvīkāyā balāyāś ca snehāḥ siddhā jvaracchidaḥ
verses.tib: lce myang tsha dang nas tshig 'khus thal ba / 'di rnams cha ni srang rer byas pa dang / mar dang 'o ma cha ni mnyam byas pa / bre gang bskol bas bad kan rims rnying 'joms / sle tres khu ba lde gu dang / ba sha ka dang 'bras bu gsum / rgun 'brum dang ni ba la dang / bskol ba'i sman mar rims nad 'joms

verses.skt: jīrṇe ghṛte ca bhuñjīta mṛdumāṃsarasaudanam | balaṃ hy alaṃ doṣaharaṃ paraṃ tac ca balapradam
verses.tib: mar zhu nas ni sha 'jam khu / kha zas bcas pa bza' bar bya / des ni stobs rab skyed byed cing / nad ni shin tu zad byed yin

verses.skt: kaphapittaharā mudgakāravellādijā rasāḥ | prāyeṇa tasmān na hitā jīrṇe vātottare jvare
verses.tib: ka ra be+e la sogs khu dang / mung+ga bad kan mkhris 'joms pas / phal cher rlung shas che rims la

verses.skt: śūlodāvartaviṣṭambhajananā jvaravardhanāḥ | na śāmyaty evam api cej jvaraḥ kurvīta śodhanam
verses.tib: gzer dang bshang ba 'gags pa ni / skyed cing rims ni 'phel bar byed / de phyir de ni bsngags ma yin / gal te de ltar byas kyang ni / rims ni zhi bar ma gyur na

verses.skt: śodhanārhasya vamanaṃ prāg uktaṃ tasya yojayet | āmāśayagate doṣe balinaḥ pālayan balam
verses.tib: sbyang 'os la ni sbyang bar bya / de la skyugs sman sngar bshad pa / ma zhu bar ni gnas nad la / stobs can stobs ni bsrungs te btang

verses.skt: pakve tu śithile doṣe jvare vā viṣamadyaje | modakaṃ triphalāśyāmātrivṛtpippalikesaraiḥ
verses.tib: smin zhing nad ni lhod gyur pa'am / chang dang dug las byung rims la / sha ma dur byed 'bras bu gsum / pi pi ling dang ge sar dang

verses.skt: sasitāmadhubhir dadyād vyoṣādyaṃ vā virecanam | drākṣādhātrīrasaṃ tadvat sadrākṣāṃ vā harītakīm
verses.tib: yang na tsha ba gsum sogs sman / kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas pa sbyin / rgun 'brum skyu / ru ra'i khu ba / a ru ra ni rgun chur bcas

verses.skt: lihyād vā traivṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ saṃyuktaṃ madhusarpiṣā
verses.tib: dong ga'o mar bcas pa'am / rgun chu dang ni bcas pa blud

verses.skt: āragvadhaṃ vā payasā mṛdvīkānāṃ rasena vā | triphalāṃ trāyamāṇāṃ vā payasā jvaritaḥ pibet
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum mam kyi lce ba / 'o ma rims dang ldan pas btung / bkru sman btang ba'i skabs su yang / thug sla la sogs rim bzhin blud

verses.skt: viriktānāṃ ca saṃsargī maṇḍapūrvā yathākramam | cyavamānaṃ jvarotkliṣṭam upekṣeta malaṃ sadā
verses.tib: rim gyis di ma glongs g.yos tshe / de la rtag tu dgag mi bya / nad ni khong par gnas snyeg nas

verses.skt: pakvo ’pi hi vikurvīta doṣaḥ koṣṭhe kṛtāspadaḥ | atipravartamānaṃ vā pācayan saṃgrahaṃ nayet
verses.tib: smin kyang gnod pa skyed par byed / shin tu tshabs cher byung gyur na / smin nas gcad par bya ba yin

verses.skt: āmasaṃgrahaṇe doṣā doṣopakrama īritāḥ | pāyayed doṣaharaṇaṃ mohād āmajvare tu yaḥ
verses.tib: ma smin bkag pa'i nyes pa ni / nad bcos thabs su bshad pa yin / gang zhig rmongs pas ma smin pa'i / rims la nad 'byin sman gtong ba

verses.skt: prasuptaṃ kṛṣṇasarpaṃ sa karāgreṇa parāmṛśet | jvarakṣīṇasya na hitaṃ vamanaṃ na virecanam
verses.tib: de ni sbrul nag gnyid log la / lag pa'i rtse mos reg dang mtshungs / rims zad pa la slon sman dang / bkru sman phan pa ma yin te

verses.skt: kāmaṃ tu payasā tasya nirūhair vā haren malān | kṣīrocitasya prakṣīṇaśleṣmaṇo dāhatṛḍvataḥ
verses.tib: de la 'o ma dag gi ni / mas gtong bas ni nad bsal bya / 'o ma la goms bad kan zad / lus tsha skom dad gnyis yod na

verses.skt: kṣīraṃ pittānilārtasya pathyam apy atisāriṇaḥ | tad vapur laṅghanottaptaṃ pluṣṭaṃ vanam ivāgninā
verses.tib: rlung dang mkhris pas nyen pa ni / tshad par 'khru yang 'o ma pan / de lus smyung bas gdungs pa dag / mes tshig pa yi nags la ni

verses.skt: divyāmbu jīvayet tasya jvaraṃ cāśu niyacchati | saṃskṛtaṃ śītam uṣṇaṃ vā tasmād dhāroṣṇam eva vā
verses.tib: char chu 'bab pas skyed pa ltar / rims ni myur du sel bar byed / de bas 'o ma sbyar te bskol / dro ba'am bsgrangs pa bzhos ma thag

verses.skt: vibhajya kāle yuñjīta jvariṇaṃ hanty ato ’nyathā | payaḥ saśuṇṭhīkharjūramṛdvīkāśarkarāghṛtam
