verses.tib: dus kyi dbye ba shes te sbyin / de las gzhan du rims can gsod / 'o ma bca' sga 'bra gor bcas / rgun 'brum kha ra mar ldan par / bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi btab

verses.skt: śṛtaśītaṃ madhuyutaṃ tṛḍdāhajvaranāśanam | tadvad drākṣābalāyaṣṭīśārivākaṇacandanaiḥ
verses.tib: skom dad lus tsha rims 'joms byed / de bzhin pa la rgun shing mngar / tsan+dan thal tres pi pi ling

verses.skt: caturguṇenāmbhasā vā pippalyā vā śṛtaṃ pibet | kāsāc chvāsāc chiraḥśūlāt pārśvaśūlāc cirajvarāt
verses.tib: 'o ma'i bzhi 'gyur chu bskol ba'am / pi pi ling dang bskol ba ni / rims kyis btab pas 'thungs na ni / klad gzer lud pa dbugs mi bde

verses.skt: mucyate jvaritaḥ pītvā pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ payaḥ | śṛtam eraṇḍamūlena bālabilvena vā jvarāt
verses.tib: rtsib logs gzer rims rnying las thar / rtsa ba lnga bskol de dang 'dra / e raN+Da rtsa bskol ba'am / bil ba gzhon nu dang bskol ba'am / bzhos ma thag gi 'o ma 'thungs

verses.skt: dhāroṣṇaṃ vā payaḥ pītvā vibaddhānilavarcasaḥ | saraktapicchātisṛteḥ satṛṭśūlapravāhikāt
verses.tib: rlung gi rims kyis phyi sa / 'gags / khrag bcas sbyin bag tshad 'khru dang / skom dad gzer bcas 'khru las thar

verses.skt: siddhaṃ śuṇṭhībalāvyāghrīgokaṇṭakaguḍaiḥ payaḥ | śophamūtraśakṛdvātavibandhajvarakāsajit
verses.tib: bca' sga ba la bya kri dang / gze ma bu ram 'o mar btsos / bskol 'thungs skrangs bshang gcin dang 'phyen / 'gags dang rims dang lud pa 'joms

verses.skt: vṛścīvabilvavarṣābhūsādhitaṃ jvaraśophanut | śiṃśipāsārasiddhaṃ ca kṣīram āśu jvarāpaham
verses.tib: bri Sh+tsi bal bil ba dang / bar sha b+hu dang bskol ba yis / rims kyi skrangs nad sel ba yin / shing sha pa yi snying po dang / 'o ma dag tu bskol ba ni / rims ni myur du 'joms byed yin

verses.skt: nirūhas tu balaṃ vahniṃ vijvaratvaṃ mudaṃ rucim | doṣe yuktaḥ karoty āśu pakve pakvāśayaṃ gate
verses.tib: nad smin zhu ba'i gnad song la / mas gtong drag pos me stobs skyed / rims bral sems dga' yi ga 'byed / myur du skyed par byed pa yin

verses.skt: pittaṃ vā kaphapittaṃ vā pakvāśayagataṃ haret | sraṃsanaṃ trīn api malān vastiḥ pakvāśayāśrayān
verses.tib: bkru sman mkhris pa'am bad mkhris 'dres / mkhris pa'i gnas su zhugs pa sel / 'jam rtsis nad ni sum char dag / zhu ba'i nad la brten pa sel

verses.skt: prakṣīṇakaphapittasya trikapṛṣṭhakaṭīgrahe | dīptāgner baddhaśakṛtaḥ prayuñjītānuvāsanam
verses.tib: 'o mas bad kan mkhris pa dag / mjug to rgyab dang rked pa na / me drod che la rtug 'gags pa / 'jam rtsi mas gtong sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: paṭolanimbacchadanakaṭukācaturaṅgulaiḥ | sthirābalāgokṣurakamadanośīravālakaiḥ
verses.tib: nim pa pa to la'i lo ma / pu tse shel dang dong ga dang / s+thi ra ba la po son cha / gze ma pu shel ba la ka

verses.skt: payasy ardhodake kvāthaṃ kṣīraśeṣaṃ vimiśritam | kalkitair mustamadanakṛṣṇāmadhukavatsakaiḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma'am chur ni bskol ba dag / 'o ma lhag ma lus pa la / gla sgang shing mngar po son cha / pi pi ling dang dug mo nyung

verses.skt: vastiṃ madhughṛtābhyāṃ ca pīḍayej jvaranāśanam | catasraḥ parṇinīr yaṣṭīphalośīranṛpadrumān
verses.tib: mar dang sbrang rtsi bsres pa yi / 'jam rtsi btang na rims 'joms so / par+Ni bzhi dang shing mngar dang

verses.skt: kvāthayet kalkayed yaṣṭīśatāhvāphalinīphalam | mustaṃ ca vastiḥ saguḍakṣaudrasarpir jvarāpahaḥ
verses.tib: po son cha dang pu shel tse / dong ga rnams ni bskol ba ru / shing mngar sha ta puSh+pa dang / pri yang+ku dang po son cha / gla sgang lde gur byas pa la / bu ram mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas / 'jam rtsis rims ni sel byed yin

verses.skt: jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ pippalīṃ madhukaṃ vacām | ṛddhiṃ rāsnāṃ balāṃ bilvaṃ śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm
verses.tib: dzi ban+ti dang po son cha / me da shing mngar pi pi ling / shu dag d+d+hi ra sna dang / bal dang ni bil ba dang / shu ti dang ni nye shing rnams

verses.skt: piṣṭvā kṣīraṃ jalaṃ sarpis tailaṃ caikatra sādhitam | jvare ’nuvāsanaṃ dadyād yathāsnehaṃ yathāmalam
verses.tib: mar dang til mar 'o ma dang / chu dang btags te lhan cig bskol / snum ni nad dang rjes mthun pa'i / 'jam rtsi rims la gtang bar bya / gang yang cho ga grub pa las / rims sel bar ni bshad pa yi / 'jam

verses.skt: ye ca siddhiṣu vakṣyante vastayo jvaranāśanāḥ | śiroruggauravaśleṣmaharam indriyabodhanam
verses.tib: mar dang til mar 'o ma dang / chu dang btags te lhan cig bskol / snum ni nad dang rjes mthun pa'i / 'jam rtsi rims la gtang bar bya / gang yang cho ga grub pa las / rims sel bar ni bshad pa yi / 'jam

verses.skt: jīrṇajvare rucikaraṃ dadyān nasyaṃ virecanam | snaihikaṃ śūnyaśiraso dāhārte pittanāśanam
verses.tib: rtsi dag kyang gtang bar bya / sna yi bkru sman rims rnying la / btang na yi ga 'byed byed cing / mgo ni lci zhing bad kan che / sel zhing dbang po gsal byed la / snum gyi sna sman mgo stong snyam / lus tsha mkhris pa sel byed yin

verses.skt: dhūmagaṇḍūṣakavaḍān yathādoṣaṃ ca kalpayet | pratiśyāyāsyavairasyaśiraḥkaṇṭhāmayāpahān
verses.tib: dud brngub mkhur bkang mkhur ba sbo / nad dmigs ji bzhin sbyar bar bya / cham pa khas ro mi tshor dang / mgo nad lkog nad sel byed yin

verses.skt: arucau mātuluṅgasya kesaraṃ sājyasaindhavam | dhātrīdrākṣāsitānāṃ vā kalkam āsyena dhārayet
verses.tib: yi ga 'chus la kha lung gi / ge sar mar dang rgya ma tshar bcas / yang na rgun 'brum skyu ru ra / kha ra'i lde gu mkhur bar bcad

verses.skt: yathopaśayasaṃsparśān śītoṣṇadravyakalpitān | abhyaṅgālepasekādīñ jvare jīrṇe tvagāśrite
verses.tib: rims rnying pags pa la brten la / reg na ji ltar bde 'gyur ba'i / sman bsil dro ba la sbyar ba'i / bsku byug chu blugs la sogs bya

verses.skt: kuryād añjanadhūmāṃś ca tathaivāgantuje ’pi tān | dāhe sahasradhautena sarpiṣābhyaṅgam ācaret
verses.tib: mig sman dud pa'i sbyor ba'ang bya / glo bur byung la de de bzhin / tshal lan stong bkrus pa yi / mar gyis bsku ba spyad par bya

verses.skt: sūtroktaiś ca gaṇais tais tair madhurāmlakaṣāyakaiḥ | dūrvādibhir vā pittaghnaiḥ śodhanādigaṇoditaiḥ
verses.tib: mdo gnas las bshad sman gyi sde / mngar dang skyur dang bska ba dang / drur ba la sogs rlung mkhris 'joms / skyug sman la sogs sde tshan bshad

verses.skt: śītavīryair himasparśaiḥ kvāthakalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet | tailaṃ sakṣīram abhyaṅgāt sadyo dāhajvaropaham
verses.tib: nus pa bsil zhing reg na grang / bskol dang lde gur byas pa dang / til mar 'o mar bcas bskol ba / bskus na 'phral du tsha rims sel

verses.skt: śiro gātraṃ ca tair eva nātipiṣṭaiḥ pralepayet | tatkvāthena parīṣekam avagāhaṃ ca yojayet
verses.tib: mgo dang lus kyang de nyid ni / cung zad rtsing bar btags pas bsku / de bskol chu ni blugs pa dang / lus 'bying la yang sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: tathāranālasalilakṣīraśuktaghṛtādibhiḥ | kapitthamātuluṅgāmlavidārīlodhradāḍimaiḥ
verses.tib: skyur rtsabs chu dang 'o ma tsha / mar la sogs pa'ang de bzhin sbyar / bil rkang kha lung a mra dang / se'u 'bru seng phrom bid ri

verses.skt: badarīpallavotthena phenenāriṣṭakasya vā | lipte ’ṅge dāharuṅmohāś chardis tṛṣṇā ca śāmyati
verses.tib: rgya shug lo ma las byung ba'am / lung tang gi ni dbu ba yis / lus bskus tsha na rmongs bag dang / slon dang skom dad zhi bar byed

verses.skt: yo varṇitaḥ pittaharo doṣopakramaṇe kramaḥ | taṃ ca śīlayataḥ śīghraṃ sadāho naśyati jvaraḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig nad gso'i thabs su bshad / mkhris pa sel ba'i rim pa ste / bsten par byas na myur du ni / tsha dang bcas pa'i rims sel 'gyur

verses.skt: vīryoṣṇair uṣṇasaṃsparśais tagarāgurukuṅkumaiḥ | kuṣṭhasthauṇeyaśaileyasaralāmaradārubhiḥ
verses.tib: nus pa dro zhing reg na dro / rgya spos gur gum a ka ru / ru rta rdo dreg sto ne ya / sa ra la dang thang shing dang

verses.skt: nakharāsnāpuravacācaṇḍailādvayacorakaiḥ | pṛthvīkāśigrusurasāhiṃsrādhyāmakasarṣapaiḥ
verses.tib: chu srin sen mo ra sna dang / gu gul shu dag lca ba dang / sug smel gnyis dang tsa rong dang / tsan+dan sib dang byi'u rug pa

verses.skt: daśamūlāmṛtairaṇḍadvayapattūrarohiṣaiḥ | tamālapattrabhūtīkaśallakīdhānyadīpyakaiḥ
verses.tib: shi kru spang spos bya ma ka / yungs kar rtsa ba bcu pa dang / sle tres er N+Da gnyis dang / ba ru ra dang ro hi sha / ta ma la yi lo ma dang

verses.skt: miśimāṣakulatthāgniprakīryānākulīdvayaiḥ | anyaiś ca tadvidhair dravyaiḥ śīte tailaṃ jvare pacet
verses.tib: pu ti ka dang sa la ki / 'u su a za mo ta dang / shu ti ma sha ku lang+tha / tsi tra ka dang pra ki r+ya / na ku la ni rnam gnyis dang / gzhan yang de 'dra'i bsil ba'i sman / bskol dang lde gur byas nas ni

verses.skt: kvathitaiḥ kalkitair yuktaiḥ surāsauvīrakādibhiḥ | tenābhyañjyāt sukhoṣṇena taiḥ supiṣṭaiś ca lepayet
verses.tib: chang dang skyur rtsabs la sogs sbyar / til mar bskol ba grang rims sbyar / de dro 'jam gyis bsku ba dang / zhib tu btags pas byug par bya

verses.skt: kavoṣṇais taiḥ parīṣekam avagāhaṃ ca kalpayet | kevalair api tadvac ca śuktagomūtramastubhiḥ
verses.tib: cung zad dro bas blugs pa dang / lus 'bying bar yang bya ba yin / tshwa dang ba gcin zho ga chu / 'ba' zhig gis kyang de bzhin bya

verses.skt: āragvadhādivargaṃ ca pānābhyañjanalepane | dhūpān agurujān yāṃś ca vakṣyante viṣamajvare
verses.tib: dong ga la sogs sde yis kyang / btung dang bsku dang byug par bya / bdug pa a ka ru las byung / 'og nas bshad pa'i rims la sbyar

verses.skt: agnyanagnikṛtān svedān svedi bheṣajabhojanan | garbhabhūveśmaśayanaṃ kuthakambalarallakān
verses.tib: dugs ni mes byas mes ma byas / dugs kyi sman dang kha zas bsten / khang sbrum sa phug tu nyal zhing / la ba dre'u rngog re'u snam bgo

verses.skt: nirdhūmadīptair aṅgārair hasantīś ca hasantikāḥ | madyaṃ satryūṣaṇaṃ takraṃ kulatthavrīhikodravān
verses.tib: du ba med pa'i mdag mas gang / zhugs shing dag ni bsten pa dang / chang ni tsha ba gsum bcas / dang / dar ba rgya sran ku lang+tha / 'bru dang ko tra ba dag kyang

verses.skt: saṃśīlayed vepathumān yac cānyad api pittalam | dayitāḥ stanaśālinyaḥ pīnā vibhramabhūṣaṇāḥ
verses.tib: 'dar ba'i rims can de la sbyin / grang ba'i rims nad can de la / chung ma nu ma rgyas pa dang / rgyan gyis brgyan te bzhag pa dang

verses.skt: yauvanāsavamattāś ca tam āliṅgeyur aṅganāḥ | vītaśītaṃ ca vijñāya tās tato ’panayet punaḥ
verses.tib: lang tshos rgyags shing chang gis myos / bud med kyis de 'khyud par bya / grang dang bral bar shes nas ni / de nas de slar bsal bar bya

verses.skt: vardhanenaikadoṣasya kṣapaṇenocchritasya vā | kaphasthānānupūrvyā vā tulyakakṣāñ jayen malān
verses.tib: nad gcig 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / 'grib pa'am ldang bar gyur pa'am / mnyam gnas nad ni bad kan gyi / gnas kyi rim pas bsal bar bya

verses.skt: śamayet pittam evādau jvareṣu samavāyiṣu | durnivārataraṃ tad dhi jvarārtānāṃ viśeṣataḥ
chardimūrchāpipāsādīn avirodhāñ jvarasya tu
saṃnipātajvarasyānte karṇamūle sudāruṇaḥ | śophaḥ saṃjāyate yena kaścid eva vimucyate
verses.tib: 'dus pa'i rims kyi mtha' mar ni / gang gi rna pa'i rtsa ba ru / mi bzad skrang pa byung gyur na / 'ga' zhig thar par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: raktāvasecanaiḥ śīghraṃ sarpiḥpānaiś ca taṃ jayet | pradehaiḥ kaphapittaghnair nāvanaiḥ kavaḍagrahaiḥ
verses.tib: de ni gtar gas dbyung ba dang / zhun mar blud pas myur bsal te / bad mkhris sel ba'i sman bsku dang / sna sman mkhur ba bkang bas gso

verses.skt: śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyair jvaro yasya na śāmyati | śākhānusārī tasyāśu muñced bāhvoḥ kramāt sirām
verses.tib: gang gi rims ni bsil drod / dang / snum rtsub sogs kyis zhi mi 'gyur / yan lag zhen pa de rims bzhin / lag ngar las khrag myur du dbyung

verses.skt: ayam eva vidhiḥ kāryo viṣame ’pi yathāyatham | jvare vibhajya vātādīn yaś cānantaram ucyate
verses.tib: cho ga 'di ni mi bzad pa'i / rims la'ang nad dmigs ji bzhin bya / rlung sogs rim gyis cha phye la / phyis bshad gang yin dag kyang bya

verses.skt: paṭolakaṭukāmustāprāṇadāmadhukaiḥ kṛtāḥ | tricatuḥpañcaśaḥ kvāthā viṣamajvaranāśanāḥ
verses.tib: pa to la dang pu tse shel / gla sgang shing mngar a rur / gnyis sam gsum mam lnga bskol ba / mi bzad rims ni 'joms byed yin

verses.skt: yojayet triphalāṃ pathyāṃ guḍūcīṃ pippalīṃ pṛthak | tais tair vidhānaiḥ saguḍaṃ bhallātakam athāpi vā
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang a rur / sle tres pi pi ling so sor / cho ga de dang sbyar ba'am / go bye bu ram bcas pa sbyin

verses.skt: laṅghanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vādau jvarāgamanavāsare | prātaḥ satailaṃ laśunaṃ prāgbhaktaṃ vā tathā ghṛtam
verses.tib: rims kyis thebs pa'i nyin zhag la / nyams smad pa'am nyams brta bya / nang par til mar sgog skya bcas / bza' 'am yang na mar rnying ngam

verses.skt: jīrṇaṃ tadvad dadhi payas takraṃ sarpiś ca ṣaṭpalam | kalyāṇakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tiktākhyaṃ vṛṣasādhitam
verses.tib: de bzhin zho dang 'o ma sbyin / zhun mar srang drug pa dang ni / dge ba chen po'am ba'i rnam lnga / tig ta'ang dugs dang bskol te sbyin

verses.skt: triphalākolatarkārīkvāthe dadhnā śṛtaṃ ghṛtam | tilvakatvakkṛtāvāpaṃ viṣamajvarajit param
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang rgya shug dang / ag+ni man+tha bskol ba ru / zho dang bskol ba'i mar dag tu / seng phrom shun lpags lde gu btab / mi bzad rims ni 'joms pa'i mchog

verses.skt: surāṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca yan madyaṃ śikhitittiridakṣajam | māṃsaṃ medyoṣṇavīryaṃ ca sahānnena prakāmataḥ
verses.tib: 'bru chang dang ni chang rnying rno / rma bya gong mo sreg khyim bya / rlan can sha ni drod skyed pa / zas bcas dag ni ci 'dod par

verses.skt: sevitvā tadahaḥ svapyād athavā punar ullikhet | sarpiṣo mahatīṃ mātrāṃ pītvā vā chardayet punaḥ
verses.tib: bsten la de bzhin gnyid log pa'am / yang na slar ni skyug tu gzhug / yang na zhun mar tshad chen po / blud de slar yang skyug tu gzhug

verses.skt: nīlinīm ajagandhāṃ ca trivṛtāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm | pibej jvarasyāgamane snehasvedopapāditaḥ
verses.tib: a dza gan+d+ha ni li ni / dur byid dang ni pu tse shel / rims kyis 'debs tshe snum dang dugs / legs par byas te blud par bya

verses.skt: manohvā saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā tailena nayanāñjanam | yojyaṃ hiṅgusamā vyāghrīvasā nasyaṃ sasaindhavam
verses.tib: ldong ros rgyam tsha pi pi ling / til mar dang sbyar mig sman gzhug / shing kun stag tshil cha mnyam bya / rgyam tshar bcas pa'i sna sman bya

verses.skt: purāṇasarpiḥ siṃhasya vasā tadvat sasaindhavā | palaṅkaṣā nimbapattraṃ vacā kuṣṭhaṃ harītakī
verses.tib: de bzhin mar rnying seng ge'i tshil / rgyam tsha dag dang sbyar te gtang / pa la ka sa nim pa'i lo / shu dag ru rta a ru ra

verses.skt: sarṣapāḥ sayavāḥ sarpir dhūpo viḍ vā biḍālajā | puradhyāmavacāsarjanimbārkāgurudārubhiḥ
verses.tib: yungs kar nas bcas mar sbyar ba'i / bdug pa'am byi la'i rtug pas bdug / gu gul shu dag bya ma ka / sardza ra sa nim pa dang / arka dang ni a ru ra / thang / shing bcas pa'i spos sbyar ba

verses.skt: dhūpo jvareṣu sarveṣu kāryo ’yam aparājitaḥ | dhūpanasyāñjanottrāsā ye coktāś cittavaikṛte
verses.tib: 'di ni gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i / bdug pa yin te rims kun sel / spos bdug sna sman gtang bya ba / sems kyis bsgyur bar gang bshad dang

verses.skt: daivāśrayaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ jvarān sarvān vyapohati | viśeṣād viṣamān prāyas te hy āgantvanubandhajāḥ
verses.tib: 'phags pa la brten sman gyis ni / rims nad thams cad sel bar byed / mchog tu phal cher mi bzad rims / de ni glo bur 'ong rjes 'brel

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ ca sirāṃ vidhyed aśāntau viṣamajvare | kevalānilavīsarpavisphoṭābhihatajvare
verses.tib: rus par gnas la rlung zhi ba'i / bsku dang dugs dang mnye ba bya / rims der rlung nad zhi bya dang / khyad par du ni 'jam rtsi bya / ma 'dres rlung dang me dbal dang / 'brum bus gnod 'gyur rims la ni

verses.skt: sarpiḥpānahimālepasekamāṃsarasāśanam | kuryād yathāsvam uktaṃ ca raktamokṣādi sādhanam
verses.tib: zhun mar blud cing tsan+dan byug / sman chu blugs shing sha khu sbyin / rang gi dpyad ni ji skad bshad / gtar ga la sogs dag gis gso

verses.skt: grahotthe bhūtavidyoktaṃ balimantrādi sādhanam | oṣadhigandhaje pittaśamanaṃ viṣajid viṣe
verses.tib: gdon byung 'byung po'i rig par bshad / gtor ma sngags la sogs pas gso / sman dri las byung mkhris pa ni / zhi bya dug skyes dug gis gso

verses.skt: iṣṭair arthair manojñaiś ca yathādoṣaśamena ca | hitāhitavivekaiś ca jvaraṃ krodhādijaṃ jayet
verses.tib: 'dod don ji ltar yid 'thad dang / nad ni ji ltar zhi 'gyur ba / phan dang mi phan la mkhas pas / khros sogs las byung rims bsal bya

verses.skt: krodhajo yāti kāmena śāntiṃ krodhena kāmajaḥ | bhayaśokodbhavau tābhyāṃ bhīśokābhyāṃ tathetarau
verses.tib: khros byung 'dod pas zhi bar 'gyur / 'dod byung khros pas zhi bar 'gyur / mya ngan 'jigs byung de gnyis kyis / 'jigs dang mya ngan byung cig shos

verses.skt: śāpātharvaṇamantrotthe vidhir daivavyapāśrayaḥ | te jvarāḥ kevalāḥ pūrvaṃ vyāpyante ’nantaram malaiḥ
verses.tib: dmod pa mngon spyod sngags las byung / 'phags pa'i don la brten pas zhi / rims de thog mar ma 'dres la / de 'og dri mas khyab par byed

verses.skt: tasmād doṣānusāreṇa teṣv āhārādi kalpayet | na hi jvaro ’nubadhnāti mārutādyair vinā kṛtaḥ
verses.tib: de bas nad dang rjes mthun par / de la kha zas la sogs sbyar / rlung rgyu la ma brten par / rims ni rjes 'brel gnas mi byed

verses.skt: jvarakālasmṛtiṃ cāsya hāribhir viṣayair haret | karuṇārdraṃ manaḥ śuddhaṃ sarvajvaravināśanam
verses.tib: rims kyi dus dran byung de la / yid 'phrog yul gyis brjed par bya / snying rjes brlan zhing sems dag pa / rims kun 'joms par byed pa yin

verses.skt: tyajed ābalalābhāc ca vyāyāmasnānamaithunam | gurvasātmyavidāhy annaṃ yac cānyaj jvarakāraṇam
verses.tib: nyams stobs rdzogs par 'gyur gyi bar / rtsol dang khrus dang nyal po dang / zas lci ma goms tsha byed dang / gang gzhan rims skyed byed pa spangs

verses.skt: na vijvaro ’pi sahasā sarvānnīno bhavet tathā | nivṛtto ’pi jvaraḥ śīghraṃ vyāpādayati durbalam
verses.tib: rims bral gyur kyang 'phral du ni / zas kun bsten par mi bya ste / rims ni myur du ldog byed nas / nyam chung mi ni myur gsod byed

verses.skt: sadyaḥ prāṇaharo yasmāt tasmāt tasya viśeṣataḥ | tasyāṃ tasyām avasthāyāṃ tat tat kuryād bhiṣagjitam
verses.tib: gang phyir myur du gsod 'gyur bas / de phyir de ni khyad par du / gnas skabs de dang de dag tu / sman dpyad de dang de dag bya

verses.skt: oṣadhayo maṇayaś ca sumantrāḥ sādhugurudvijadaivatapūjāḥ | prītikarā manaso viṣayāś ca ghnanty api viṣṇukṛtaṃ jvaram ugram
verses.tib: sman dang nor bu sngags dang bcas pa dang / dam pa bla ma bram ze dkon mchog mchod / yid ni dga' bar byed pa'i yul bsten pas / khyab 'jug gis byas ma rungs rims kyang 'joms

verses.skt: ūrdhvagaṃ balino ’vegam ekadoṣānugaṃ navam | raktapittaṃ sukhe kāle sādhayen nirupadravam
verses.tib: khrag mkhris bde ba'i dus su 'byung / stobs ldan stod 'byung shugs dal la / nyes gcig las byung gsar du btab / bla brnan med pa gso bar bya

verses.skt: adhogaṃ yāpayed raktaṃ yac ca doṣadvayānugam | śāntaṃ śāntaṃ punaḥ kupyan mārgān mārgāntaraṃ ca yat
verses.tib: khrag gang nad gzhi gnyis la skyes / zhi zhing zhi zhing slar ldang dang / lam nas lam gzhan 'gro ba gang / thur du 'byung ba gso ba tsam

verses.skt: atipravṛttaṃ mandāgnes tridoṣaṃ dvipathaṃ tyajet | jñātvā nidānam ayanaṃ malāv anubalau balam
verses.tib: shas cher 'byung zhing me drod nyams / nyes gsum lam gnyis las byung spang / nad gzhi zas dang gnas dang ni / nad kyi grogs dang stobs dag dang

verses.skt: deśakālādyavasthāṃ ca raktapitte prayojayet | laṅghanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vādau śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ tathā
verses.tib: yul dang dus kyi gnas skabs sogs / shes bya dang por smyung ba'am brta / de bzhin sbyang dang zhi bya bas / khrag dang mkhris pa gso bar bya

verses.skt: saṃtarpaṇotthaṃ balino bahudoṣasya sādhayet | ūrdhvabhāgaṃ virekeṇa vamanena tv adhogatam
verses.tib: brta ba las byung stobs ldan pa / nad gzhi mang po las byung ba / gyen 'byung bkru sman gtong bas gso / thur 'byung skyug sman gyis gso rjo

verses.skt: śamanair bṛṃhaṇaiś cānyal laṅghyabṛṃhyān avekṣya ca | ūrdhvaṃ pravṛtte śamanau rasau tiktakaṣāyakau
verses.tib: smyung ba brta bya la ltos bya / stod du 'byung ba kha ba dang / bska ba'i sman khu smyung ba dang

verses.skt: upavāsaś ca niḥśuṇṭhīṣaḍaṅgodakapāyinaḥ | adhoge raktapitte tu bṛṃhaṇo madhuro rasaḥ
verses.tib: yan lag drug sman bca' sga med / 'thungs na zhi bar 'gyur ba yin / thur du 'byung ba'i khrag mkhris la / sman khu mngar bas brta bar bya

verses.skt: ūrdhvage tarpaṇaṃ yojyaṃ prāk ca peyā tv adhogate | aśnato balino ’śuddhaṃ na dhāryaṃ tad dhi rogakṛt
verses.tib: stong 'byung dang por skyo ma blud / smad 'byung dang / por thug pa blud / stobs ldan za nus ma dag khrag / byung yang mi dgag ga des nad skyed

verses.skt: dhārayed anyathā śīghram agnivac chīghrakāri tat | trivṛcchyāmākaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca saśarkaram
verses.tib: de ni gzhan du me lta bur / myur gsod byed pas gcad par bya / dur byid pri yang chu bskol dang / lde gu kha rar bcas pa dag

verses.skt: galagrahaṃ pūtinasyaṃ mūrchāyam aruciṃ jvaram | gulmaṃ plīhānam ānāhaṃ kilāsaṃ mūtrakṛcchratām
kuṣṭhāny arśāṃsi vīsarpaṃ varṇanāśaṃ bhagandaram | buddhīndriyoparodhaṃ ca kuryāt stambhitam āditaḥ
sādhayed vidhival lehaṃ lihyāt pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ | trivṛtā triphalā śyāmā pippalī śarkarā madhu
verses.tib: cho ga bzhin du de la ni / zho gnyis tsam du bldag par bya / dur byid pri yang 'bras bu gsum / kha ra sbrang rtsi pi pi ling

verses.skt: modakaḥ saṃnipātordhvaraktaśophajvarāpahaḥ | trivṛt samasitā tadvat pippalīpādasaṃyutā
verses.tib: sbrus pa 'dus byung stod du byung / khrag rims 'or nad sel byed yin / de bzhin dur byid kha rar mnyam / pi pi ling ni bzhi char bcas

verses.skt: vamanaṃ phalasaṃyuktaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sasitāmadhu | sasitaṃ vā jalaṃ kṣaudrayuktaṃ vā madhukodakam
verses.tib: skyug sman phyir ni po son cha / kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas skyo ma'am / kha ra sbrang rtsi po son cha / chur bcas pa'am shing mngar chu

verses.skt: kṣīraṃ vā rasam ikṣor vā śuddhasyānantaro vidhiḥ | yathāsvaṃ manthapeyādiḥ prayojyo rakṣatā balam
verses.tib: 'o ma'am bu ram shing khu blud / sbyangs pa'i rjes la cho ga ni / thug sla la sogs ji bzhin du / blud cing stobs ni bsrung bar bya

verses.skt: mantho jvarokto drākṣādiḥ pittaghnair vā phalaiḥ kṛtaḥ | madhukharjūramṛdvīkāparūṣakasitāmbhasā
verses.tib: skyo ma rims skabs bshad rgun sogs / yang na mkhris 'joms 'bras bur sbyar / sbrang rtsi 'bra go rgun 'brum dang / pa ru sha ka ka ra'i chu

verses.skt: mantho vā pañcasāreṇa saghṛtair lājasaktubhiḥ | dāḍimāmalakāmlo vā mandāgnyamlābhilāṣiṇām
verses.tib: snying po lnga yi skyom ni / 'bras yos phye ni mar bcas sbyin / me drod chung zhing skyur la dga' / se 'bru skyu ru ra skyur ba

verses.skt: kamalotpalakiñjalkapṛśniparṇīpriyaṅgukāḥ | uśīraṃ śabaraṃ lodhraṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ kucandanam
verses.tib: pad+ma ut+pal ge sar dang / kriSh+Na pa r+Ni pri yad+ku / pu shel tse dang seng phrom dkar / bca' sga dang ni tsan+dan dmar

verses.skt: hrīveraṃ dhātakīpuṣpaṃ bilvamadhyaṃ durālabhā | ardhārdhair vihitāḥ peyā vakṣyante pādayaugikāḥ
verses.tib: byi tsher da ta ka'i me tog / ba la ka dang bil ba'i rkang / tshigs bcad phyed bshad thug pa blud

verses.skt: bhūnimbasevyajaladā masūrāḥ pṛśniparṇy api | vidārigandhā mudgāś ca balā sarpir hareṇukāḥ
verses.tib: rtsa mkhris gla sgang pu shel tse / sran chung kr-iSh+Na pa r+Nir sbyar / mung+ga gan+d+ha bi da ri / ha re Nu ka bal mar

verses.skt: jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni śītavīryāṇi sādhayet | pṛthak pṛthag jale teṣāṃ yavāgūḥ kalpayed rase
verses.tib: nus pa bsil ba de rnams ni / skam sa'i srog chags sha dag dang / chur ni so sor bskol ba yi / khu bar nas thug sbyar ba bsgrangs

verses.skt: śītāḥ saśarkarākṣaudrās tadvan māṃsarasān api | īṣadamlān anamlān vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭān saśarkarān
verses.tib: khar sbrang rtsir sbyar ba blud / de bzhin du ni sha khu dang / cung zad skyur dang skyur min pa / mar brngos khar bcas pa sbyin

verses.skt: śūkaśimbībhavaṃ dhānyaṃ rakte śākaṃ ca śasyate | annasvarūpavijñāne yad uktaṃ laghuśītalam
verses.tib: zas kyi tshul ni shes pa ru / yang dang bsil bar gang bshad pa'i / gra ma gang bu can 'bru dang / tshod ma khrag la bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: pūrvoktam ambu pānīyaṃ pañcamūlena vā śṛtam | laghunā śṛtaśītaṃ vā madhvambho vā phalāmbu vā
verses.tib: sngar bshad / pa yi chu dag gam / rtsa ba chung ngu lnga bskol te / bsgrangs pa'am sbrang rtsi'i chu'am ni / 'bras bu mnyes pa'i chu blud bya

verses.skt: śaśaḥ savāstukaḥ śasto vibandhe tittiriḥ punaḥ | udumbarasya niryūhe sādhito mārute ’dhike
verses.tib: bshang 'gags rgya sne'u ri bong sha / rlung shas che la sreg pa'i sha / u dum bA ra'i khu ba ni / bskol ba blud na bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: plakṣasya barhiṇas tadvan nyagrodhasya ca kukkuṭaḥ | yat kiñcid raktapittasya nidānaṃ tac ca varjayet
verses.tib: de bzhin blag sha rma bya'i sha / n+ya gro d+ha dang khyim bya'i sha / khrag mkhris kyi ni nad gzhi ni / gang ci'ang rung ba de spang bya

verses.skt: vāsārasena phalinīmṛllodhrāñjanamākṣikam | pittāsṛk śamayet pītaṃ niryāso vāṭarūṣakāt
verses.tib: ba sha ka'i khu pri yang ku / sa nag dang ni skyer khaN+Da / seng phrom dang ni sbrang rtsir sbyar / 'thungs na khrag dang mkhris pa 'joms

verses.skt: śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktaḥ kevalo vā śṛto ’pi vā | vṛṣaḥ sadyo jayaty asraṃ sa hy asya param auṣadham
verses.tib: yang na ba sha ka yi ni / khu ba kha ra sbrang rtsi dang / bcas par 'thungs pa de bzhin te / ba sha ka ni 'ba' zhig dang / bskol bas khrag ni myur sel te / de ni 'di yi sman mchog yin

verses.skt: paṭolamālatīnimbacandanadvayapadmakam | lodhro vṛṣas taṇḍulīyaḥ kṛṣṇā mṛn madayantikā
verses.tib: pa to la dang ma la ti / nim pa shug pa tsan+dan gnyis / seng phrom ba sha tan tu li / sa nag ma da yan ti ka

verses.skt: śatāvarī gopakanyā kākolyau madhuyaṣṭikā | raktapittaharāḥ kvāthās trayaḥ samadhuśarkarāḥ
verses.tib: nye shing dang ni thal tres dang / ra mnye ba gnyis shing mngar rnams / bskol ba gsum po kha ra dang / sbrang rtsir bcas pas khrag mkhris 'joms

verses.skt: palāśavalkakvātho vā suśītaḥ śarkarānvitaḥ | lihyād vā madhusarpirbhyāṃ gavāśvaśakṛto rasam
verses.tib: rgya skyegs shing kun bskol ba ni / legs bsgrangs ka ra btab pa phan / yang na sbrang rtsi mar bcas pa'am / lci ba rta sbangs btsir khu 'thung

verses.skt: sakṣaudraṃ grathite rakte lihyāt pārāvatāc chakṛt | atiniḥsrutaraktaś ca kṣaudreṇa rudhiraṃ pibet
verses.tib: khrag nad mdud pa can 'drar 'byung / phug ron rtug pa sbrang rtsi phan / khrag ni shas cher byung gyur na / skom sa'i srog chags khrag dang ni / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'am ra yi ni

verses.skt: jāṅgalaṃ bhakṣayed vājam āmaṃ pittayutaṃ yakṛt | candanośīrajaladalājamudgakaṇāyavaiḥ
verses.tib: mchin pa mkhris bcas rlon pa bza' / tsan+dan gla sgang pu shel tse / 'bras yos mung+ga pi pi ling

verses.skt: balājale paryuṣitaiḥ kaṣāyo raktapittahā | prasādaś candanāmbhojasevyamṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭajaḥ
verses.tib: nas ni ba la'i chur sbangs pa / khu ba khrag mkhris sel byed yin / tsan+dan pad+ma pu shel tse / khu bar bong pa bsregs bcug la

verses.skt: suśītaḥ sasitākṣaudraḥ śoṇitātipravṛttijit | āpothya vā nave kumbhe plāvayed ikṣugaṇḍikāḥ
verses.tib: rab bsgrangs kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas / khrag ni shas cher 'byung ba sel / bu ram shing ni chu mang sbangs / rdza bum gsar par de bzhag nas

verses.skt: sthitaṃ tad guptam ākāśe rātriṃ prātaḥ srutaṃ jalam | madhumad vikacāmbhojakṛtottaṃsaṃ ca tadguṇam
verses.tib: mtshan mo phyi rol dben par gzhag / nang par chu ni btsags nas su / sbrang rtsi btab nas pad+ma ni / kha phye'i phreng rgyan chu de 'dra

verses.skt: ye ca pittajvare coktāḥ kaṣāyās tāṃś ca yojayet | kaṣāyair vividhair ebhir dīpte ’gnau vijite kaphe
verses.tib: gang yang / mkhris pa'i rims skabs bshad / sman khu de yang blud par bya / sman khu sna tshogs 'di yis ni / me drod skyed pas bad kan zad

verses.skt: raktapittaṃ na cec chāmyet tatra vātolbaṇe payaḥ | yuñjyāc chāgaṃ śṛtaṃ tadvad gavyaṃ pañcaguṇe ’mbhasi
verses.tib: gal te khrag mkhris ma zhi na / de la rlung shas cher phan pa'i / ra yi 'o ma bskol ba blud / de bzhin ba yi 'o ma ni / lnga 'gyur chu bskol gdus pa blud

verses.skt: pañcamūlena laghunā śṛtaṃ vā sasitāmadhu | jīvakarṣabhakadrākṣābalāgokṣuranāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu dang / sbrang rtsi kha ra bskol ba'ang rung / rgun 'brum bca' sga dzi ba ka / ba la gze ma zangs rtsi ba

verses.skt: pṛthak pṛthak śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ saghṛtaṃ sitayāthavā | gokaṇṭakābhīruśṛtaṃ parṇinībhis tathā payaḥ
verses.tib: re re 'o mar bskol ba'am / 'o ma khar mar bskol phan / gze ma nye'u shing bskol ba'am / de bzhin 'dab bzhi 'o mar bskol

verses.skt: hanty āśu raktaṃ sarujaṃ viśeṣān mūtramārgagam | viṇmārgage viśeṣeṇa hitaṃ mocarasena tu
verses.tib: khrag ni nad bcas myur du sel / mchog tu mtshan nas 'byung la phan / rkub las byung la khyad par du / mo tsa ra sa blud na phan

verses.skt: vaṭaprarohair śuṅgair vā śuṇṭhyudīcyotpalair api | raktātīsāradurnāmacikitsāṃ cātra kalpayet
verses.tib: n+ya gro d+ha yi myu gu'am / 'dab ma gzhon pa'am bca' sga dang / uR+shi ra dang ut+pal phan / khrag gi tshad 'khru gzhang 'brum gyi / gso ba dag kyang 'dir sbyar bya

verses.skt: pītvā kaṣāyān payasā bhuñjīta payasaiva ca | kaṣāyayogair ebhir vā vipakvaṃ pāyayed ghṛtam
verses.tib: sman khu 'o ma 'thungs nas ni / bza' ba'ang 'o ma nyid dang bza' / sman khu'i sbyor ba 'di dag nyid / bskol ba'i mar ni blud bar bya

verses.skt: samūlamastakaṃ kṣuṇṇaṃ vṛṣam aṣṭaguṇe ’mbhasi | paktvāṣṭāṃśāvaśeṣeṇa ghṛtaṃ tena vipācayet
verses.tib: ba sha ka rtsa rtser bcas brdungs / chu ni brgyad 'gyur nang du ni / bskol te brgyad cha lus gyur pa / de dang mar ni btso bar bya

verses.skt: tatpuṣpagarbhaṃ tac chītaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pittaśoṇitam | pittagulmajvaraśvāsakāsahṛdrogakāmalāḥ
verses.tib: de yi me tog nang bcug bsgrangs / sbrang rtsir bcas pas khrag mkhris dang / mkhris skran rims dang dbugs mi bde / lud pa snying nad mig ser dang

verses.skt: timirabhramavīsarpasvarasādāṃś ca nāśayet | palāśavṛntasvarase tadgarbhaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ pacet
verses.tib: rab rib mgo 'khor me dbal dang / skad 'gags pa ni 'joms par byed / pa la sha yi myu gu'i khur / de bcug mar ni bskol ba dag

verses.skt: sakṣaudraṃ tac ca raktaghnaṃ tathaiva trāyamāṇayā | rakte sapicche sakaphe grathite kaṇṭhamārgage
verses.tib: sbrang rtsir bcas pas khrag nad sel / kyi lce ba yang de bzhin no / khrag ni spyi bag bad kan bcas / mdud par chags nad mgul bar byung

verses.skt: lihyān mākṣikasarpirbhyāṃ kṣāram utpalanālajam | pṛthak pṛthak tathāmbhojareṇuśyāmāmadhūkajam
verses.tib: ut+pal sdong bu bsregs thal ba / zhun mar sbrang rtsir bcas pa bldag / pad+ma ut+pal ge sar dang / pri yang ku dang ma du ka / re re'i sbyor ba de bzhin bya

verses.skt: gudāgame viśeṣeṇa śoṇite vastir iṣyate | ghrāṇage rudhire śuddhe nāvanaṃ cānuṣecayet
verses.tib: khrag ni bshang / ba'i lam las ni / 'byung bar byed la khyad par du / 'jam rtsi btang ba bsngags pa yin / sna nas nad can khrag byung na / sna sman btang zhing blugs par bya

verses.skt: kaṣāyayogān pūrvoktān kṣīrekṣvādirasāplutān | kṣīrādīn sasitāṃs toyaṃ kevalaṃ vā jalaṃ hitaṃ
verses.tib: sngar bshad sman khu'i sbyor ba dang / 'o ma bu ram shing khu blugs / 'o ma sogs chu kha rar bcas / yang na chu ni 'ba' zhig phan

verses.skt: raso dāḍimapuṣpāṇām āmrāsthnaḥ śādvalasya vā | kalpayec chītavargaṃ ca pradehābhyañjanādiṣu
verses.tib: se 'bru'i me tog khu ba 'am / a mra'i rus pa dUr ba phan / bsil sman sde tshan gtogs pa dag / bsku dang byug la sogs las sbyar

verses.skt: susūkṣmā māṣapiṣṭī ca ghṛtabhṛṣṭā śivasya ca | ruṇaddhi mūrdhalepena nāsāraktaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
yac ca pittajvare proktaṃ bahir antaś ca bheṣajam | raktapitte hitaṃ tac ca kṣatakṣīṇe hitaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i rims sel bshad pa gang / phyi nang las btung sman de dang / glo rdol bar ni gang phan pa / de yang khrag dang mkhris par phan

verses.skt: kevalānilajaṃ kāsaṃ snehair ādāv upācaret | vātaghnasiddhaiḥ snigdhaiś ca peyāyūṣarasādibhiḥ
verses.tib: lud pa ma 'dres rlung las byung / dang por snum gyis gso bya zhing / sha khu thug pa yu sha sogs / rlung 'joms sman bskol snum pa dang

verses.skt: lehair dhūmais tathābhyaṅgasvedasekāvagāhanaiḥ | vastibhir baddhaviḍvātaṃ sapittaṃ tūrdhvabhaktikaiḥ
verses.tib: dud bdugs lde gu bsku dang dugs / chu blugs lus bcing dag gis gso / bshang rlung 'gags la 'jam rtsis gso

verses.skt: ghṛtaiḥ kṣīraiś ca sakaphaṃ jayet snehavirecanaiḥ | guḍūcīkaṇṭakārībhyāṃ pṛthak triṃśatpalād rase
verses.tib: mkhris bcas zhun mar 'o ma ni / zas kyi sngon btang bad kan bcas / snum bcas bkru sman btang bas gso / sle tres ka N+Ta ka ri gnyis / re re srang sum cu'i khu bar / mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis bskol

verses.skt: prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtād vātakāsanud vahnidīpanaḥ | kṣārarāsnāvacāhiṅgupāṭhāyaṣṭyāhvadhānyakaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung gi lud sel me drod skyed / k+Sha ra ra sna shu dag dang / shing kun pa ta shing mngar dang

verses.skt: dviśāṇaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ pañcakolayutaiḥ pacet | daśamūlasya niryūhe pīto maṇḍānupāyinā
verses.tib: 'u su zho gnyis mar bre gang / tsha ba lnga dang bcas pa dang / rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu bar bskol / 'thungs rjes thug pa blud gyur na

verses.skt: sa kāsaśvāsahṛtpārśvagrahaṇīrogagulmanut | droṇe ’pāṃ sādhayed rāsnādaśamūlaśatāvarīḥ
verses.tib: lud pa dbugs mi bde bcas snying / rtsib logs pho ba'i skran nad sel / ra sna nye'u shing rtsa ba bcu

verses.skt: palonmitā dvikuḍavaṃ kulatthaṃ badaraṃ yavaṃ | tulārdhaṃ cājamāṃsasya tena sādhyaṃ ghṛtāḍhakam
verses.tib: srang ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya / rgya sran rgya shug nas dag ni / ra sha srang ni lnga bcu dang / chu srang lnga brgya bcu gnyis bskol / de dang mar ni bre bzhi bskol

verses.skt: samakṣīraṃ palāṃśaiś ca jīvanīyaiḥ samīkṣya tat | prayuktaṃ vātarogeṣu pānanāvanavastibhiḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma mar mnyam dzi ban+ti / la sogs srang char byas te brtag / rlung gi nad la blud / pa dang / snar btang 'jam rtsi'i mas gtong sbyar

verses.skt: pañcakāsāñ chiraḥkampaṃ yonivaṅkṣaṇavedanām | sarvāṅgaikāṅgarogāṃś ca saplīhordhvānilāñ jayet
verses.tib: lud pa rnam lnga mgo 'dar dang / mo mtshan chu son ba dang / lud kun lus ni phyogs gcig nad / mchin bcas stod kyi rlung nad sel

verses.skt: vidāryādigaṇakvāthakalkasiddhaṃ ca kāsajit | aśokabījakṣavakajantughnāñjanapadmakaiḥ
verses.tib: bi da ri sogs sde tshan bskol / lde gu mar bskol lud pa 'joms / shing mngar a shwa ka'i sa bon / byi dang ga dang skyer khaN+Da

verses.skt: saviḍaiś ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ taccūrṇaṃ vā ghṛtaplutam | lihyāt payaś cānupibed ājaṃ kāsātipīḍitaḥ
verses.tib: shug pa kha ru tsha mar bskol / yang na de phye mar dang sbrus / lde gu byin la ra yi ni / 'o ma blud na lud pa sel

verses.skt: viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ rāsnā pippalī hiṅgu saindhavam | bhārgī kṣāraś ca tac cūrṇaṃ pibed vā ghṛtamātrayā
verses.tib: dong gar sna byi dang ga / shing kun rgyam tsha pi pi ling / bar gyi k+Sha ra de'i phye ma'am / mar dang ran tsam blud gyur na

verses.skt: sakaphe ’nilaje kāse śvāsahidhmāhatāgniṣu | durālabhāṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ śaṭhīṃ drākṣāṃ sitopalām
verses.tib: rlung gyur bad kan bcas lud pa / dbugs mi bde dang skyigs bu dang / me drod chung ba sel bar byed / byi tsher ba dang bca' sga dang / zur ba rgun 'brum kha ra dkar

verses.skt: lihyāt karkaṭaśṛṅgīṃ ca kāse tailena vātaje | duḥsparśāṃ pippalīṃ mustāṃ bhārgīṃ karkaṭakīṃ śaṭhīm
verses.tib: kar ka ta yi sring gi ni / til mar dang ni lde gur sbyar / rlung las gyur pa'i lud pa sel / byi tshar gla sgang pi pi ling

verses.skt: purāṇaguḍatailābhyāṃ cūrṇitāny avalehayet | tadvat sakṛṣṇāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ ca sabhārgīṃ tadvad eva ca
verses.tib: bar gyi zur pa kar ka ti / bu ram rnying dang til mar dang / lde gur byas pa bldag par bya / bca' sga pi pi ling de bzhin / kar ka ta sring de bzhin no

verses.skt: pibec ca kṛṣṇāṃ koṣṇena salilena sasaindhavām | mastunā sasitāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dadhnā vā kaṇareṇukām
verses.tib: chu dron dag dang pi pi ling / lce myang tsha dang bcas pa blud / bca' sga ka ra zho ga chu'am / pi pi ling phye zhor btab blud

verses.skt: pibed badaramajjño vā madirādadhimastubhiḥ | athavā pippalīkalkaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam
verses.tib: rgya shug tshi gu chang ngam zho / zho ga chu dang sbyar ba blud / yang na pi pi ling lde gu / mar brngos rgyam tshar bcas pa'ang phan

verses.skt: kāsī sapīnaso dhūmaṃ snaihikaṃ vidhinā pibet | hidhmāśvāsoktadhūmāṃś ca kṣīramāṃsarasāśanaḥ
verses.tib: lud pa cham bcas dud pa ni / snum bcas cho gas bdug pa dang / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde dud brngub / 'o ma sha khu bcas pa bza'

verses.skt: grāmyānūpaudakaiḥ śāliyavagodhūmaṣaṣṭikān | rasair māṣātmaguptānāṃ yūṣair vā bhojayed dhitān
verses.tib: grong chu rlan can srog chags sha / sA lu nas gro drug cu pa'am / ma sha ang ma kub ta yi

verses.skt: yavānīpippalībilvamadhyanāgaracitrakaiḥ | rāsnājājīpṛthakparṇīpalāśaśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ
verses.tib: yu sha dag dang zos na phan / la la phud dang pi pi ling / byil rkang dong gtsi tra ka / ra sna zir pa la sha / kr-iSh+Na par+Ni zur pa dang

verses.skt: siddhāṃ snigdhāmlalavaṇāṃ peyām anilaje pibet | kaṭīhṛtpārśvakoṣṭhārtiśvāsahidhmāpraṇāśanīm
verses.tib: ma nu bskol bar snum skyur dang / lan tshwar bcas thug rlung gyur blud / rked pa lto snying rtsib logs na / dbugs mi bde dang skyigs bu sel

verses.skt: daśamūlarase tadvat pañcakolaguḍānvitām | pibet peyāṃ samatilāṃ kṣaireyīṃ vā sasaindhavām
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu bar ni / tsha ba lnga dang bu ram bcas / til dang bcas pa'i thug pa blud / yang na 'o thug rgyam tshar bcas

verses.skt: mātsyakaukkuṭavārāhair māṃsair vā sājyasaindhavām | vāstuko vāyasīśākaṃ kāsaghnaḥ suniṣaṇṇakaḥ
verses.tib: nya dang khyim / bya phag rgod sha / mar dang rgyam tshar bcas pa'ang phan / tshod ma rgya sne'u pa ya si / ni shan na ga lud pa 'joms

verses.skt: kaṇṭakāryāḥ phalaṃ pattraṃ bālaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca mūlakam | snehās tailādayo bhakṣyāḥ kṣīrekṣurasagauḍikāḥ
verses.tib: ka N+Da ka ri'i lo 'bras dang / la phug gzhon nu skam po'ang phan / til mar sogs snum 'o ma dang / bu ram bu ram shing khu'i zas

verses.skt: dadhimastvāranālāmlaphalāmbumadirāḥ pibet | pittakāse tu sakaphe vamanaṃ sarpiṣā hitam
verses.tib: zho ga chu zho rang skyur chang / 'bras bu skyur chu blud pa phan / mkhris pa'i lud pa bad kan bcas / zhun mar gyis ni skyug sman phan

verses.skt: tathā madanakāśmaryamadhukakvathitair jalaiḥ | phalayaṣṭyāhvakalkair vā vidārīkṣurasāplutaiḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin po son cha tang pal / ma du ka ni bskol chus sam / shing mngar po son cha'i lde gu / bi da bu ram shing khur sbyar

verses.skt: pittakāse tanukaphe trivṛtāṃ madhurair yutām | yuñjyād virekāya yutāṃ ghanaśleṣmaṇi tiktakaiḥ
verses.tib: mkhris lud bad kan shas chung la / dur byid mngar ba'i sman sbyar gtang / bad kan shas cher kha ba'i sman / skyug sman phyir ni gtang bar bya

verses.skt: hṛtadoṣo himaṃ svādu snigdhaṃ saṃsarjanaṃ bhajet | ghane kaphe tu śiśiraṃ rūkṣaṃ tiktopasaṃhitam
verses.tib: nad sbyangs nas ni thug pa sogs / bsil dang mngar dang snum pa spyad / bad kan shas cher kha ba dang / rtsub pa dang sbyar grang thug blud

verses.skt: lehaḥ paitte sitādhātrīkṣaudradrākṣāhimotpalaiḥ | saghṛtaḥ sānile hitaḥ sakaphe sābdamaricaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris gyur kha ra skyu ru ra / rgun 'brum ut+pal tsan+dan dkar / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin / bad kan bcas lan le sham / gla sgang dang ni bcas pa sbyin

verses.skt: mṛdvīkārdhaśataṃ triṃśat pippalīḥ śarkarāpalam | lehayen madhunā gor vā kṣīrapasya śakṛdrasam
verses.tib: sum cu kha ra srang gcig sbyar / sbrang rtsi'am ba yi lci ba'am / be'u gzhon lci khur lde gur sbyar / shing tsha sug smel tsha ba gsum

verses.skt: tvagelāvyoṣamṛdvīkāpippalīmūlapauṣkaraiḥ | lājamustāśaṭhīrāsnādhātrīphalavibhītakaiḥ
verses.tib: rgun 'brum pi pi ling rtsa ba / ma nu 'bras yos gla sgang dang / zur pa dkar dang ra sna dang / skyu ru ra dang ba ru ra

verses.skt: śarkarākṣaudrasarpirbhir leho hṛdrogakāsahā | madhurair jāṅgalarasair yavaśyāmākakodravāḥ
verses.tib: kha ra sbrang rtsi zhun mar sbyar / lde gus snying nad lud pa sel / mngar ba'i sman dang srog chags ni / skam sa'i sha dang nas dang ni / khre dang khre rgod mung+ga sogs

verses.skt: mudgādiyūṣaiḥ śākaiś ca tiktakair mātrayā hitāḥ | ghanaśleṣmaṇi lehāś ca tiktakā madhusaṃyutāḥ
verses.tib: yu sha dang ni tshod ma dang / kha ba tshad ldan sbyar lde gu / kha ba dang ni sbrang rtsir bcas / bad kan shas che'i nad la phan / bad kan shas chung s+'a lu dang / drug cu pa'i chan sha khu phan / btung bar kha ra'am rgun chu'am / bu ram shing khu'am 'o ma blud

verses.skt: śālayaḥ syus tanukaphe ṣaṣṭikāś ca rasādibhiḥ | śarkarāmbho ’nupānārthaṃ drākṣekṣusvarasāḥ payaḥ
verses.tib: yu sha dang ni tshod ma dang / kha ba tshad ldan sbyar lde gu / kha ba dang ni sbrang rtsir bcas / bad kan shas che'i nad la phan / bad kan shas chung s+'a lu dang / drug cu pa'i chan sha khu phan / btung bar kha ra'am rgun chu'am / bu ram shing khu'am 'o ma blud

verses.skt: kākolībṛhatīmedādvayaiḥ savṛṣanāgaraiḥ | pittakāse rasakṣīrapeyāyūṣān prakalpayet
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i lud par ra mnye ba / bri ha ti gnyis med gnyis / ba tsa ka dang li dong gra / sha khu dang ni 'o ma'am

verses.skt: drākṣāṃ kaṇāṃ pañcamūlaṃ tṛṇākhyaṃ ca pacej jale | tena kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ pibet samadhuśarkaram
verses.tib: thug pa'am yu shar sbyar te blud / rgun 'brum dang ni pi pi ling / rtsa yi rtsa ba lngar bshad dang / chur / bskol ba yi khu ba dang / de dang 'o ma bskol te bsgrangs

verses.skt: sādhitāṃ tena peyāṃ vā suśītāṃ madhunānvitām | śaṭhīhrīverabṛhatīśarkarāviśvabheṣajam
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi khar ra bcas pa blud / yang na de yis thug pa bskol / legs bskol sbrang rtsir bcas pa sbyin

verses.skt: piṣṭvā rasaṃ pibet pūtaṃ vastreṇa ghṛtamūrchitam | medāṃ vidārīṃ kākolīṃ svayaṅguptāphalaṃ balām
verses.tib: zur pa dang ni ba le ka / kha ra bca' sga bri ha ti / btags pa'i khu ba ras kyis btsags / mar dang bsres te blud par bya

verses.skt: śarkarāṃ jīvakaṃ mudgamāṣaparṇyau durālabhām | kalkīkṛtya pacet sarpiḥ kṣīreṇāṣṭaguṇena tat
verses.tib: kha ra dang ni dzi ba ka / mung+ga ma sha par+Ni dang / byi tsher ba ni lde gur sbyar / mar dang 'o ma brgyad 'gyur bskol

verses.skt: pānabhojanaleheṣu prayuktaṃ pittakāsajit | lihyād vā cūrṇam eteṣāṃ kaṣāyam athavā pibet
verses.tib: de btung bza' dang bldag pa dang / sbyar bas mkhris pa'i lud pa sel / 'di dag phye ma'i lde gu 'am / bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya

verses.skt: kaphakāsī pibed ādau surakāṣṭhāt pradīpitāt | snehaṃ parisrutaṃ vyoṣayavakṣārāvacūrṇitam
verses.tib: bad kan lud can gyis dang por / thang shing bsregs nas gzags pa'i snum / ba sha ka dang nas tshig 'khus / thal ba'i phye ma btab pa btang

verses.skt: snigdhaṃ virecayed ūrdhvam adho mūrdhni ca yuktitaḥ | tīkṣṇair virekair balinaṃ saṃsargīṃ cāsya yojayet
verses.tib: snum bcas bkru sman gyis steng dang / 'og dang spyi bor ci rigs par / nyams stobs ldan bkru sman rno gtang / thug pa sogs kyang 'di la blud

verses.skt: yavamudgakulatthānnair uṣṇarūkṣaiḥ kaṭūtkaṭaiḥ | kāsamardakavārtākavyāghrīkṣārakaṇānvitaiḥ
verses.tib: nas dang mung+ga rgya sran zas / rtsub dron le sham gyis tsha / ka sa marda brda ka / bya kri ya bak+Sha ra dang / pi pi ling dang bcas pa sbyin / skam sa khung gnas sha khu snum

verses.skt: dhānvabailarasaiḥ snehais tilasarṣapanimbajaiḥ | daśamūlāmbu gharmāmbu madyaṃ madhvambu vā pibet
verses.tib: til dang yungs kar bil ba'i snum / sbyar ba'i thug pa sbyin par bya / skom na rtsa ba bcu bskol chu / chu tshan chang mang sbrang chu blud

verses.skt: mūlaiḥ pauṣkaraśamyākapaṭolaiḥ saṃsthitaṃ niśām | pibed vāri sahakṣaudraṃ kāleṣv annasya vā triṣu
verses.tib: dong ga ma nu'i rtsa ba dang / pa tol yi rtsa bar bcas / nub gcig chur sbangs sbrang rtsi btab / zas dus gsum mam nang par blud

verses.skt: pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ vibhītakam | śikhikukkuṭapicchānāṃ maṣī kṣāro yavodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang de rtsa ba / bca' sga dang ni ba ru ra / rma bya khyim bya'i mjug sgro ni / snag tshar byas dang nas tshig thal

verses.skt: viśālā pippalīmūlaṃ trivṛtā ca madhudravāḥ | kaphakāsaharā lehās trayaḥ ślokārdhayojitāḥ
verses.tib: bi sha gla sgang pi pi ling / dur byid sbrang rtsir sbyar ba ste / tshigs bcad phyed kyis rdzogs lde gu / gsum po bad kan lud pa sel

verses.skt: madhunā maricaṃ lihyān madhunaiva ca joṅgakam | pṛthag rasāṃś ca madhunā vyāghrīvārtākabhṛṅgajān
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi na le sham sbyar bldag / a ka ru sbrang rtsi nyid kyis / kaN+Da ka ri brta ka / bring ga ra dza'i khu ba dang

verses.skt: kāsaghnasyāśvaśakṛtaḥ surasasyāsitasya ca | devadāruśaṭhīrāsnākarkaṭākhyādurālabhāḥ
verses.tib: ka sa marda rta spangs btsir / khu ba bye ru gnas po'i khu / sbrang rtsi so sor sbyar ba ldag / thang shing zur par sna dang / byi tsher kar ka ta sring gi

verses.skt: pippalī nāgaraṃ mustaṃ pathyā dhātrī sitopalā | lājāḥ sitopalā sarpiḥ śṛṅgī dhātrīphalodbhavā
verses.tib: gla sgang bca' sga pi pi ling / kha ra a ru skyu ru ra / 'bras yos kha ra dkar po dang / skyu ru ra yi pags pa rnams

verses.skt: madhutailayutā lehās trayo vātānuge kaphe | dve pale dāḍimād aṣṭau guḍād vyoṣāt palatrayam
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi til mar sbyar lde gu / gsum po rlung 'dres bad kan sel / se'u 'bru srang gnyis / bu ram ni / srang brgyad tsha ba gsum srang res

verses.skt: rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ svaryaṃ pīnasaśvāsakāsajit | guḍakṣāroṣaṇakaṇādāḍimaṃ śvāsakāsajit
verses.tib: skad snyan drod skyed yi ga 'byed / lud pa dbugs mi bde cham sel / bu ram ya bak+Sha ra dang / na le sham dang pi pi ling

verses.skt: kramāt paladvayārdhākṣakarṣārdhākṣapalonmitam | pibej jvaroktaṃ pathyādi saśṛṅgīkaṃ ca pācanam
verses.tib: se'u 'bru rim gyis srang gnyis dang / zho re srang phyed du sbyar / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel / rims kyi skabs bshad a ru ra / sogs dang kar ka ta sring gi / bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya

verses.skt: athavā dīpyakatrivṛdviśālāghanapauṣkaram | sakaṇaṃ kvathitaṃ mūtre kaphakāsī jale ’pi vā
verses.tib: yang na dur byid la la phud / gla sgang ma nu bi shal / pi pi ling bcas pa gcin nam / chur bskol ba gcin lud pa sel

verses.skt: tailabhṛṣṭaṃ ca vaidehīkalkākṣaṃ sasitopalam | pāyayet kaphakāsaghnaṃ kulatthasalilāplutam
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni til mar brngos / lde gu zho gnyis kha rar bcas / rgya sran bskol ba'i khu bar sbyar / blud na bad kan lud pa 'joms

verses.skt: daśamūlāḍhake prasthaṃ ghṛtasyākṣasamaiḥ pacet | puṣkarāhvaśaṭhībilvasurasāvyoṣahiṅgubhiḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu khu bre bzhi dang / mar bre gang dang ma nu dang / zur pa bil ba bye'u rug pa / shing kun tsha gsum zho gnyis bskol

verses.skt: peyānupānaṃ tat sarvavātaśleṣmāmayāpaham | nirguṇḍīpattraniryāsasādhitaṃ kāsajid ghṛtam
verses.tib: blud pa'i rjes la thug pa btung / de kun bad kan rlung nad 'joms / nir gun thi lo bskol ba'i khu

verses.skt: ghṛtaṃ rase viḍaṅgānāṃ vyoṣagarbhaṃ ca sādhitam
verses.tib: mar bskol lud pa 'joms byed yin / byi dang ga yi khu ba'i nang

verses.skt: punarnavaśivātikāsaralakāsamardāmṛtā | paṭolabṛhatīphaṇijjakarasaiḥ payaḥsaṃyutaiḥ | ghṛtaṃ trikaṭunā ca siddham upayujya saṃjāyate | na kāsaviṣamajvarakṣayagudāṅkurebhyo bhayam
verses.tib: ka sa mar da sle tres dang / pa to la dang bri ha ti / pha nid dza ga'i khu ba ni / 'o ma mar dang bcas pa la / tsha ba gsum dang legs bskol 'thungs / lud pa'i rims drag zad byed dang / gzhang 'brum nad kyi 'jigs pa med

verses.skt: samūlaphalapattrāyāḥ kaṇṭakāryā rasāḍhake
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri'i rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu lo mar bcas pa yin

verses.skt: ghṛtaprasthaṃ balāvyoṣaviḍaṅgaśaṭhidāḍimaiḥ | sauvarcalayavakṣāramūlāmalakapauṣkaraiḥ
verses.tib: khu ba bre bzhi'i tshad la ni / mar bre gang dang ba la dang / tsha ba gsum dang byi dang ga / shu dag dang ni se'u 'bru dang / kha ru tsha dang nas tshig thal / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang

verses.skt: vṛścīvabṛhatīpathyāyavānīcitrakarddhibhiḥ | mṛdvīkācavyavarṣābhūdurālabhāmlavetasaiḥ
verses.tib: skyu ru ra dang ma nu dang / bri shi ba dang bri ha ti / a ru ra dang yab ti / kru trug tres dang rgun 'brum dang / dbyi mong byi tsher bar sha bu

verses.skt: śṛṅgītāmalakībhārgīrāsnāgokṣurakaiḥ pacet | kalkais tat sarvakāseṣu śvāsahidhmāsu ceṣyate
verses.tib: star bu karka ta sring gi / ta ma la gi ga bra'i rtsa / ra sna gze ma'i lde gu dang / bskol ba'i mar des lud kun dang / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde la'ang phan

verses.skt: kaṇṭakārīghṛtaṃ caitat kaphavyādhivināśanam | paced vyāghrītulāṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ vahe ’pām āḍhakasthite
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri'i sman mar 'di / bad kan nad ni sel byed yin / bya kri srang brgyad brdungs chu srang / nyis / stong bzhi bcu brgyad nang bskol

verses.skt: kṣipet pūte tu saṃcūrṇya vyoṣarāsnāmṛtāgnikān | śṛṅgībhārgīghanagranthidhanvayāsān palārdhakān
verses.tib: btsags par tsha ba gsum ra sna / sle tres kru trug phye ma dang / ka rka ta sring ga bra'i rtsa / gla sgang pi pi ling rtsa ba / byi tsher ba rnams srang phyed phyed

verses.skt: sarpiṣaḥ ṣoḍaśapalaṃ catvāriṃśat palāni ca | matsyaṇḍikāyāḥ śuddhāyāḥ punaś ca tad adhiśrayet
verses.tib: zhun mar srang ni bcu drug dang / kar dkar po srang bzhi bcu / slar yang de ni bskol bya ba

verses.skt: darvīlepini śīte ca pṛthag dvikuḍavaṃ kṣipet | pippalīnāṃ tavakṣīryā mākṣikasyānavasya ca
verses.tib: gzar bu la chags bsgrangs nas ni / pi pi ling dang smig rkang dang / sbrang rtsi rnying pa dag las ni / srang ni brgyad brgyad gzhug par bya

verses.skt: leho ’yaṃ gulmahṛdrogadurnāmaśvāsakāsajit | śamanaṃ ca pibed dhūmaṃ śodhanaṃ bahale kaphe
verses.tib: lde gu 'dis ni snying nad skran / gzhang 'brum lud dbugs mi bde sel / bad kan zhi bdud pa brngub / shas cher sbyangs pa'i dud pa brngub

verses.skt: manaḥśilālamadhukamāṃsīmusteṅgudītvacaḥ | dhūmaṃ kāsaghnavidhinā pītvā kṣīraṃ pibed anu
verses.tib: ldong ros ba bla shing mngar dang / spang spos gla sgang i gu da'i / shun lpags du ba lud 'joms pa'i / chogs dud pa brngubs nas ni

verses.skt: niṣṭhyūtānte guḍayutaṃ koṣṇaṃ dhūmo nihanti saḥ | vātaśleṣmottarān kāsān acireṇa cirantanān
verses.tib: mchil mang mthar ni bu ram bcas / 'o ma 'thungs pa'i dud rngubs des / rlung dang bad kan shas che ba'i / lud pa rnying pa'ang myur sel

verses.skt: tamakaḥ kaphakāse tu syāc cet pittānubandhajaḥ | pittakāsakriyāṃ tatra yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: bad kan lud pa mun zhugs snyam / gal te mkhris pa rjes 'brel la / der ni gnas skabs ji bzhin du / mkhris pa'i lud gso'i sbyor ba bya

verses.skt: kaphānubandhe pavane kuryāt kaphaharāṃ kriyām | pittānubandhayor vātakaphayoḥ pittanāśinīm
verses.tib: rlung ni bad kan 'brel pa la / bad kan bsal ba'i bya ba bya / mkhris pa dang 'brel rlung bad kan / lud par mkhris pa bsal bar bya

verses.skt: vātaśleṣmātmake śuṣke snigdham ārdre virūkṣaṇam | kāse karma sapitte tu kaphaje tiktasaṃyutam
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan bdag nyid skam / gsher la snum dang rtsub chos bya / lud pa bad kan las gyur ba / mkhris par bcas pa kha bas gso

verses.skt: urasy antaḥkṣate sadyo lākṣāṃ kṣaudrayutāṃ pibet | kṣīreṇa śālīn jīrṇe ’dyāt kṣīreṇaiva saśarkarān
verses.tib: glo nad 'grams la 'phral du ni / rgya skyegs sbrang rtsi'i 'o ma blud / zhu nas s+'a lu'i 'bras chan ni / 'o ma kha rar bcas pa bza'

verses.skt: pārśvavastisaruk cālpapittāgnis tāṃ surāyutām | bhinnaviṭkaḥ samustātiviṣāpāṭhāṃ savatsakām
verses.tib: rtsib logs chu son bcas te / mkhris drod shas chung chang sbyar btung / bshang 'khru gla sgang bong nga dkar / ba ta dug mo nyung bcas btung

verses.skt: lākṣāṃ sarpir madhūcchiṣṭaṃ jīvanīyaṃ gaṇaṃ sitām | tvakkṣīrīṃ samitaṃ kṣīre paktvā dīptānalaḥ pibet
verses.tib: rgya skyegs zhun mar sbrang rtsi dang / 'tsho byed sde tshan ka ra dkar / smig rkang kha ra mnyam 'o mar / bskol ba me drod che la blud

verses.skt: ikṣvārikābisagranthipadmakesaracandanaiḥ | śṛtaṃ payo madhuyutaṃ saṃdhānārthaṃ pibet kṣatī
verses.tib: bu ram shing dang pad+ma'i tshigs / pad+ma ge sar tsan+dan dmar / 'o mar bskol ba sbrang rtsir bcas / glo 'grams 'byor bar bya phyir blud

verses.skt: yavānāṃ cūrṇam āmānāṃ kṣīre siddhaṃ ghṛtānvitam | jvaradāhe sitākṣaudrasaktūn vā payasā pibet
verses.tib: nas rjen phye ni 'o ma ru / btsos te mar dang sbyar ba'am / kha ra sbrang rtsi 'o ma phye'i / skyom rims tshad ldan la blud

verses.skt: kāsavāṃs tu pibet sarpir madhurauṣadhasādhitam | guḍodakaṃ vā kvathitaṃ sakṣaudramaricaṃ hitam
verses.tib: lud pa can la sman mngar dang / bskol ba'i zhun mar blud par bya / yang na bu ram chu bskol bsgrangs / sbrang rtsi na le sham btab blud

verses.skt: cūrṇam āmalakānāṃ vā kṣīre pakvaṃ ghṛtānvitam | rasāyanavidhānena pippalīr vā prayojayet
verses.tib: yang na skyu ru ra'i phye ma / 'o mar bskol ba mar btab blud / yang na bcud kyis len cho gas / pi pi ling yang sbyin par bya

verses.skt: kāsī parvāsthiśūlī ca lihyāt saghṛtamākṣikāḥ | madhūkamadhukadrākṣātvakkṣīrīpippalībalāḥ
verses.tib: lud pa rus tshigs gzer ba la / rgun 'brum shing mngar ma du ka / smig rkang ba la pi pi ling / zhun mar sbrang rtsir bcas pa sbyin

verses.skt: trijātam ardhakarṣāṃśaṃ pippalyardhapalaṃ sitā | drākṣā madhūkaṃ kharjūraṃ palāśaṃ ślakṣṇacūrṇitam
verses.tib: dri sna gsum ni zho re dang / pi pi ling srang phyed kha ra / rgun 'brum 'bra go ma du ka / srang re zhib tu btags nas ni

verses.skt: madhunā guṭikā ghnanti tā vṛṣyāḥ pittaśoṇitam | kāsaśvāsārucicchardimūrchāhidhmāmadabhramān
verses.tib: sbrang rtsis ri lur byas pa yis / ro tsa byed cing khrag mkhris dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde slon bro / brgyal myos skyigs bu mgo 'khor dang

verses.skt: kṣatakṣayasvarabhraṃśaplīhaśoṣāḍhyamārutān | raktaniṣṭhīvahṛtpārśvarukpipāsājvarān api
verses.tib: glo rdol skad ni 'gags pa dang / mchil ma lus skem rlung 'khyil dang / mchil mar khrag 'byung rtsib logs na / snying nad skom dang rims nad 'joms

verses.skt: varṣābhūśarkarāraktaśālitaṇḍulajaṃ rajaḥ | raktaṣṭhīvī pibet siddhaṃ drākṣārasapayoghṛtaiḥ
verses.tib: bar sha bu dang kha ra dkar / s+'a lu rtsa snar btags pa'i phye / rgun chu 'o ma mar du bskol / mchil ma khrag tu 'byung la blud

verses.skt: madhūkamadhukakṣīrasiddhaṃ vā taṇḍulīyakam | yathāsvaṃ mārgavisṛte rakte kuryāc ca bheṣajam
verses.tib: shing mngar dang ni ma du ka / tan du li ya 'or btsos phan / khrag ni gang tshe drag tu 'byung / de bcos pa yi sman bsten bya

verses.skt: mūḍhavātas tv ajāmedaḥ surābhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam | kṣāmaḥ kṣīṇaḥ kṣatorasko mandanidro ’gnidīptimān
verses.tib: rlung 'khyil pa la ra tshil ni / chang brngos rgyam tshar bcas pa sbyin / skems shing nyam chung glo 'grams dang / gnyid chung me drod che ba la

verses.skt: śṛtakṣīrasareṇādyāt saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram | śarkarāyavagodhūmaṃ jīvakarṣabhakau madhu
verses.tib: 'o ma bskol ba'i spris mar chags / kha ra sbrang rtsi mar bcas sbyin / ka ra dkar dang nas dang gro / 'tsho byed zangs rtsi sbrang rtsir bcas

verses.skt: śṛtakṣīrānupānaṃ vā lihyāt kṣīṇaḥ kṣataḥ kṛśaḥ | kravyātpiśitaniryūhaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ pibec ca saḥ
verses.tib: yang na 'o mar bskol te blud / glo 'grams nyam chung rid la sbyin / sha za'i sha yi khu ba ni / mar dang brngos pa'i pi pi ling / sbrang rtsir bcas pa de la blud

verses.skt: pippalīkṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ māṃsaśoṇitavardhanam | nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣaśālapriyaṅgubhiḥ
verses.tib: sha dang khrag ni 'phel byed yin / u dum+bA ra n+ya gro d+ha / a shwat+tha dang blag sha dang / s+'a la'i shing dang pri yang ku / ta la'i rtse mo 'dzam bu'i shun

verses.skt: tālamastakajambūtvakpriyālaiś ca sapadmakaiḥ | sāśvakarṇaiḥ śṛtāt kṣīrād adyāj jātena sarpiṣā
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang shug par bcas / a shwa ka nar bcas pa ni / 'o mar bskol ba las byung ba'i / mar dang 'bras chan bza' ba ni / glo

verses.skt: śālyodanaṃ kṣatoraskaḥ kṣīṇaśukrabalendriyaḥ | vātapittārdite ’bhyaṅgo gātrabhede ghṛtair mataḥ
verses.tib: 'grams khu ba nyams stobs dang / dbang po'i nus pa zad la sbyin / rlung mkhris kyis nyon yan lag zhig / na la mar des bskus pa bsngags

verses.skt: tailaiś cānilarogaghnaiḥ pīḍite mātariśvanā | hṛtpārśvārtiṣu pānaṃ syāj jīvanīyasya sarpiṣaḥ
verses.tib: rlung nad kyis ni nyen pa la / rlung 'joms sman bskol til mar bsku / 'tsho byed sde tshan zhun mar ni / snying dang rtsib logs na la blud

verses.skt: kuryād vā vātarogaghnaṃ pittaraktāvirodhi yat | yaṣṭyāhvanāgabalayoḥ kvāthe kṣīrasame ghṛtam
verses.tib: yang na rlung nad 'joms pa dang / khrag mkhris sel ba gang yin bya / shing mngar nA ga pa la gnyis / 'o ma dang mnyam mar bskol bar

verses.skt: payasyāpippalīvāṃśīkalkaiḥ siddhaṃ kṣate hitam | jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ śuṇṭhī varī vīrā punarnavā
verses.tib: pa ya s+ye dang pi pi ling / smig rkang lde gu bskol bas ni / glo 'grams pa yi nad la phan / 'tsho byed sde tshan bca' sga dang

verses.skt: balābhārgīsvaguptarddhiśaṭhītāmalakīkaṇāḥ | śṛṅgāṭakaṃ payasyā ca pañcamūlaṃ ca yal laghu
verses.tib: nye'u shing ba dang ra mnye ba / ba spu ba gnyis pa la dang / ga bra'i rtsa ba kha sral phre'u / ri di zur pa ka ma la / shring ga da ka ka ya s+ya / rtsa ba lnga ni chung ngu dang

verses.skt: drākṣākṣoṭādi ca phalaṃ madhurasnigdhabṛṃhaṇam | taiḥ pacet sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ karṣāṃśaiḥ ślakṣṇakalkitaiḥ
verses.tib: rgun 'brum star ga'i 'bras bu sogs / mngar shing snum la stobs skyed pa / zho ni gnyis gnyis btags lde gu / de nang zhun mar bre gang bskol

verses.skt: kṣīradhātrīvidārīkṣucchāgamāṃsarasānvitam | prasthārdhaṃ madhunaḥ śīte śarkarārdhatulārajaḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma ra sha skyu ru ra / bi da ri dang bu ram shing / khu bar sha'i khu bar bcas / bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi ni / bre phyed khar srang lnga bcu / na le sham dang sug smel dang

verses.skt: palārdhakaṃ ca maricatvagelāpattrakesaram | vinīya prasṛtaṃ tasmāl lihyān mātrāṃ yathābalam
verses.tib: shing tsha gan+d+ha b+ha dra dang / na ga ge sar srang phyed phyed / phye mar btags te bcug nas ni / 'ju stobs rjes mthun tshad du blud

verses.skt: amṛtaprāśam ity etan narāṇām amṛtaṃ ghṛtam | sudhāmṛtarasaṃ prāśyaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasāśinā
verses.tib: 'di ni bdud rtsi'i sman mar te / mi rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi yin / bdud rtsi 'di ni zos nas su / 'o ma sha khu ldan zos na

verses.skt: naṣṭaśukrakṣatakṣīṇadurbalavyādhikarśitān | strīprasaktān kṛśān varṇasvarahīnāṃś ca bṛṃhayet
verses.tib: khu chu nyams dang glo 'grams dang / nyams stobs zad pa'i gso ba yin / bud med la gdu lus skem dang / mdog skad nyams la gtang bar bya

verses.skt: kāsahidhmājvaraśvāsadāhatṛṣṇāsrapittanut | putradaṃ chardimūrchāhṛdyonimūtrāmayāpaham
verses.tib: lud pa dang ni skyigs bu rims / dbugs mi bde dang lus cha dang / skom dad khrag mkhris sel byed cing / bu skyed byed cing slon dang brgyal / mngal nad gcin nad 'joms byed yin

verses.skt: śvadaṃṣṭrośīramañjiṣṭhābalākāśmaryakaṭtṛṇam | darbhamūlaṃ pṛthakparṇīṃ palāśarṣabhakau sthirām
verses.tib: gze ma btsod dang pu shel tse / ba la tang pal bu ti ka / kr-iSh+Na par+Ni dUr ba'i rtsa / thal tres stir pa la sha

verses.skt: pālikāni pacet teṣāṃ rase kṣīracaturguṇe | kalkaiḥ svaguptājīvantīmedarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ
verses.tib: de rnams srang re bskol ba yi / 'o ma sman khu'i bzhi 'gyur la / kha sral phre'u dzi baN+Ti / me da gnyis dang zangs rtsi ba / dzi ba ka dang nye'u shing dang

verses.skt: śatāvaryṛddhimṛdvīkāśarkarāśrāvaṇībisaiḥ | prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtād vātapittahṛdrogaśūlanut
verses.tib: ri di / rgun 'brum sha kha ra / sra ba dang ni pad+ma'i rtsa / mar ni bre gang bskol ba yis / rlung mkhris snying 'dzag gzer nad sel

verses.skt: mūtrakṛcchrapramehārśaḥkāsaśoṣakṣayāpahaḥ | dhanuḥstrīmadyabhārādhvakhinnānāṃ balamāṃsadaḥ
verses.tib: gcin sri ba dang gcin snyi ba / gzhang 'brum lud pa lus skem dang / zad byed rims ni sel byed cing / gzhu 'dren bud med chang dang lam / khur dub stobs dang sha zad skyed

verses.skt: madhukāṣṭapaladrākṣāprasthakvāthe paced ghṛtam | pippalyaṣṭapale kalke prasthaṃ siddhe ca śītale
verses.tib: shing mngar srang brgyad rgun 'brum ni / bre gang bskol bar mar btsos la / pi pi ling srang brgyad lde gu / bre gang bskol ba bsgrangs nas ni / kha ra sbrang rtsi re re zhing

verses.skt: pṛthag aṣṭapalaṃ kṣaudraśarkarābhyāṃ vimiśrayet | samasaktu kṣatakṣīṇaraktagulmeṣu tad dhitam
verses.tib: srang brgyad dang ni bsres pa la / nas phye mnyam sbyor zos pa yis / de ni glo 'grams zad byed dang / khrag gi skran la phan pa yin

verses.skt: dhātrīphalavidārīkṣujīvanīyarasād ghṛtāt | gavyājayoś ca payasoḥ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ vipācayet
verses.tib: skyu ru ra dang bi da ri / bu ram shing khu 'tsho byed kyi / sde tshan bskol ba'i khu ba mar / ba dang ra yi 'o ma las / bre ni re re btso bar bya

verses.skt: siddhaśīte sitākṣaudraṃ dviprasthaṃ vinayet tataḥ | yakṣmāpasmārapittāsṛkkāsamehakṣayāpaham
verses.tib: bskol btsags khar sbrang rtsi ni / bre re der ni gzhug par bya / de ni zad byed brjed byed dang / khrag dang mkhris pa lud pa dang / lus skem pa ni sel byed cing

verses.skt: vayaḥsthāpanam āyuṣyaṃ māṃsaśukrabalapradam | ghṛtaṃ tu pitte ’bhyadhike lihyād vāte ’dhike pibet
verses.tib: rgas sra tshe ni ring ba dang / sha dang khu chu stobs skyed byed / mkhris pa shas ches mar bldag bya / rlung shas che bas btung bar bya

verses.skt: līḍhaṃ nirvāpayet pittam alpatvād dhanti nānalam | ākrāmaty anilaṃ pītam ūṣmāṇaṃ niruṇaddhi ca
verses.tib: bldags pas mkhris pa zhi byed kyis / nyung bas rlung ni 'joms mi nus / 'thungs na rlung ni gnon byed cing / me drod nang du sdud par byed

verses.skt: kṣāmakṣīṇakṛśāṅgānām etāny eva ghṛtāni tu | tvakkṣīrīśarkarālājacūrṇaiḥ styānāni yojayet
verses.tib: skems shing lus kyi sha zad pas / sman mar bshad pa 'di dag nyid / smig rkang 'bras yos pi pi ling / phye ma lde gur byas la sbyin

verses.skt: sarpirguḍān samadhvaṃśān kṛtvā dadyāt payo ’nu ca | reto vīryaṃ balaṃ puṣṭiṃ tair āśutaram āpnuyāt
verses.tib: zhun mar bu ram sbrang rtsi'i cha / bcug ste byin la 'o ma blud / ro tsa brtson dang lus rgyas stobs / 'di yis myur du skyed par 'gyur

verses.skt: vītatvagasthikūṣmāṇḍatulāṃ svinnāṃ punaḥ pacet | ghaṭṭayan sarpiṣaḥ prasthe kṣaudravarṇe ’tra ca kṣipet
verses.tib: bum sha shun lpags sa bon bsal / srang brgyad rlangs par btsos nas ni / zhun mar bre gang nang gzhug dkrugs / sbrang rtsi'i mdog 'drar gyur pa dang / hwags ni srang brgyad pi pi ling

verses.skt: khaṇḍāc chataṃ kaṇāśuṇṭhyor dvipalaṃ jīrakād api | trijātadhānyamaricaṃ pṛthag ardhapalāṃśakam
verses.tib: bca' sga zir srang gnyis dang / dri sna gsum dang 'u su dang / na le sham ni re re zhing / srang ni phyed phyed tshad bcug la

verses.skt: avatāritaśīte ca dattvā kṣaudraṃ ghṛtārdhakam | khajenāmathya ca sthāpyaṃ tan nihanty upayojitam
verses.tib: phab ste bsgrangs par gyur pa dang / sbrang rtsi mar gyi phyed bcug la / gzar bus dkrugs te bzhag gyur pa / lud pa skyigs bu yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: kāsahidhmājvaraśvāsaraktapittakṣatakṣayān | uraḥsaṃdhānajananaṃ medhāsmṛtibalapradam
verses.tib: dbugs mi bde dang khrag mkhris dang / glo 'grams zad byed 'joms par byed / glo 'grams pa ni 'byor byed cing / blo dang dran pa stobs rab skyed

verses.skt: aśvibhyāṃ vihitaṃ hṛdyaṃ kūṣmāṇḍakarasāyanam | piben nāgabalāmūlasyārdhakarṣābhivardhitam
verses.tib: ku sman da yi bcud kyis len / yid du 'ong ba dam pa 'di / tha skar bu gnyis kyis bshad yin / nA ga pa la'i rtsa ba ni / zho gcig sogs kyis bskyed srang gcig

verses.skt: palaṃ kṣīrayutaṃ māsaṃ kṣīravṛttir anannabhuk | eṣa prayogaḥ puṣṭyāyurbalavarṇakaraḥ param
verses.tib: 'o mar bcas pa zla gcig btung / 'o ma spyad cing zas mi bza' / sbyor 'dis tshe ni 'phel byed cing / stobs skyed kha dog bzang byed mchog

verses.skt: maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ kalpo ’yaṃ yaṣṭyā viśvauṣadhasya ca | pādaśeṣaṃ jaladroṇe pacen nāgabalātulām
verses.tib: man du ka par+Ni shing mngar / bca' sga'i sbyor ba'ang 'di yin no / nA ga pa la srang brgya ni / chu srang lnga brgya rtsa bcu gnyis / nang du bskol te bzhi cha lus

verses.skt: tena kvāthena tulyāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ ca sādhayet | palārdhikaiś cātibalābalāyaṣṭīpunarnavaiḥ
verses.tib: sman khu de dang cha mnyam pa'i / 'o ma mar dang bskol bar bya / ba la a ti ba la dang

verses.skt: prapauṇḍarīkakāśmaryapriyālakapikacchubhiḥ | aśvagandhāsitābhīrumedāyugmatrikaṇṭakaiḥ
verses.tib: shing mngar pur+Na rna ba dang / stag tsher ba dang tang pal dang / pi la ya dang kha sral phre'u

verses.skt: kākolīkṣīrakākolīkṣīraśuklādvijīrakaiḥ | mṛṇālabisakharjūraśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaiḥ
verses.tib: a shwa gan+d+ha kha ra dkar / nye shing med rnam gnyis dang / gze ma ram nye ba gnyis dang / pa ya s+ya dang zi ra gnyis / pad+ma'i rtsa ba sdong bu dang / 'bra go sring ga ta ka dang

verses.skt: etan nāgabalāsarpiḥ pittaraktakṣatakṣayān | jayet tṛḍbhramadāhāṃś ca balapuṣṭikaraṃ param
verses.tib: nA ga pa la'i sman mar 'dis / khrag mkhris glo rdol zad byed dang / skom dad mgo 'khor sel byed cing / stobs ni skyed par byed pa'i mchog

verses.skt: varṇyam āyuṣyam ojasyaṃ valīpalitanāśanam | upayujya ca ṣaṇ māsān vṛddho ’pi taruṇāyate
verses.tib: mdog sdug mdangs bzang tshe 'phel zhing / skra dkar gnyer ma 'jig par byed / zla ba drug gi bar bsten na / rgan po'ang gzhon nu nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: dīpte ’gnau vidhir eṣa syān mande dīpanapācanaḥ | yakṣmoktaḥ kṣatināṃ śasto grāhī śakṛti tu drave
verses.tib: cho ga 'dis ni drod skyed cing / me drod bri ba skyed 'ju byed / gcong chen bshad pa'ang glo rdol bsngags / 'khru na gcod par byed par phan

verses.skt: daśamūlaṃ svayaṅguptāṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ śaṭhīṃ balām | hastipippalyapāmārgapippalīmūlacitrakān
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu pa kha sral phre'u / shang ka put+pa zur pa dang / pa la ha sti pi pi ling / a pa marga kru trug tres

verses.skt: bhārgīṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ ca dvipalāṃśaṃ yavāḍhakam | harītakīśataṃ caikaṃ jalapañcāḍhake pacet
verses.tib: ga bra pi pi ling rtsa ba / ma nu srang ni gnyis gnyis dang / nas srang drug cu rtsa bzhi dag / a ru ra ni srang brgya dag / chu srang drug brgya bzhi bcus bskol

verses.skt: yavasvede kaṣāyaṃ taṃ pūtaṃ tac cābhayāśatam | paced guḍatulāṃ dattvā kuḍavaṃ ca pṛthag ghṛtāt
verses.tib: btsags la a ru ra brgya der / bu ram srang brgya bcug la bskol / mar dang til

verses.skt: tailāt sapippalīcūrṇāt siddhaśīte ca mākṣikāt | lehaṃ dve cābhaye nityam ataḥ khāded rasāyanāt
verses.tib: mar pi pi ling / phye ma srang ni brgyad po dag / bskol te bsgrangs nas sbrang rtsir gzhug / rtag tu a ru ra gnyis bcas / lde gu bcud len 'di zos na

verses.skt: tad valīpalitaṃ hanyād varṇāyurbalavardhanam | pañcakāsān kṣayaṃ śvāsaṃ sahidhmaṃ viṣamajvaram
verses.tib: tshe ring mdog stobs 'phel bar byed / lud lnga zad byed dbugs mi bde / skyigs bur bcas pa'i mi bzad rims / gcin snyi ba yi nad dang ni

verses.skt: mehagulmagrahaṇyarśohṛdrogārucipīnasān | agastyavihitaṃ dhanyam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rasāyanam
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum skran dang snying nad dang / cham pa yi ga 'chus pa sel / bcud kyis len mchog dpal yon can / 'di ni drang srong r-i Shis bshad

verses.skt: daśamūlaṃ balāṃ mūrvāṃ haridre pippalīdvayam | pāṭhāśvagandhāpāmārgasvaguptātiviṣāmṛtāḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu pa ba la dang / mur ba ser po rnam gnyis dang / pi pi ling ni rnam gnyis dang / pa tha a shwa gan+d+ha dang / a pa marga kha sral phre'u / sle tres dan ti bong nga dkar

verses.skt: bālabilvaṃ trivṛddantīmūlaṃ pattraṃ ca citrakāt | payasyāṃ kuṭajaṃ hiṃsrāṃ puṣpaṃ sāraṃ ca bījakāt
verses.tib: bil ba gzhon nu dur byid dang / tsi tra ka rtsa lo mar bcas / pa ya s+ya dang dug mo nyung / spang spos bi za ka'i snying po / me tog bcas dang rkang mar dang

verses.skt: boṭasthavirabhallātavikaṅkataśatāvarīḥ | pūtikarañjaśamyākacandralekhāsahācaram
verses.tib: go bye byi dang ga ta dang / nye'u shing bu ti ka rany+dza / dong ga so ma ra dza dang / sa ha ra dza shi kru dang

verses.skt: śaubhāñjanakanimbatvagikṣuraṃ ca palāṃśakam | pathyāsahasraṃ saśataṃ yavānāṃ cāḍhakadvayam
verses.tib: nim pa'i shun lpags bu ram shing / phra mo'i khu ba srang re dang / a ru ra stong chig brgya dang / nas srang nyis brgya lnga bcu drug

verses.skt: paced aṣṭaguṇe toye yavasvede ’vatārayet | pūte kṣipet sapathye ca tatra jīrṇaguḍāt tulām
verses.tib: chu ni brgyad 'gyur nang du bskol / nas tshos pa dang phog nas ni / btsags nas a ru ra bcas der / bu ram rnying pa srang brgyad gzhug

verses.skt: tailājyadhātrīrasataḥ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ tataḥ punaḥ | adhiśrayen mṛdāv agnau darvīlepe ’vatārya ca
verses.tib: til mar zhun mar skyu ru'i khu / bre re bcug nas de rjes yang / me chung la ni btsos nas su / gzar bur chags nas thab las dbab

verses.skt: śīte prasthadvayaṃ kṣaudrāt pippalīkuḍavaṃ kṣipet | cūrṇīkṛtaṃ trijātāc ca tripalaṃ nikhanet tataḥ
verses.tib: bsgrangs nas sbrang rtsi bre do dang / pi pi ling ni phul gang gzhug / dri sna gsum ni phyer btags pa / srang gsum bcug nas de 'og tu

verses.skt: dhānye purāṇakumbhasthaṃ māsaṃ khādec ca pūrvavat | rasāyanaṃ vasiṣṭhoktam etat pūrvaguṇādhikam
verses.tib: rdza snod rnying bcug 'bru nang du / bcug ste zla ba gcig gzhag bya / de nas snga ma bzhin du bza' / gnas 'jog gis bshad bcud len 'di / sngon las yon tan lhag par che

verses.skt: svasthānāṃ niṣparīhāraṃ sarvartuṣu ca śasyate | pālikaṃ saindhavaṃ śuṇṭhī dve ca sauvarcalāt pale
verses.tib: nad med kyis bza' dgag pa med / dus kun du yang bsngags pa yin / rgyam tsha bca' sga srang re dang / kha ru tsha ni srang gnyis dang

verses.skt: kuḍavāṃśāni vṛkṣāmlaṃ dāḍimaṃ pattram ārjakāt | ekaikāṃ maricājājyor dhānyakād dve caturthike
verses.tib: da trig se'u 'bru ardza ka / de dag srang ni bzhi bzhi dang / na le sham gcig go snyod gnyis / 'u su'i 'bras bu srang bzhi dang

verses.skt: śarkarāyāḥ palāny atra daśa dve ca pradāpayet | kṛtvā cūrṇam ato mātrām annapāneṣu dāpayet
verses.tib: tshad 'di las ni / phye mar byas / zas dang skom la btab ste sbyin

verses.skt: rucyaṃ tad dīpanaṃ balyaṃ pārśvārtiśvāsakāsajit | ekāṃ ṣoḍaśikāṃ dhānyād dve dve cājājidīpyakāt
verses.tib: des ni yi ga 'byed pa dang / me drod skyed cing nyams stobs skyed / rtsib logs na dang dbugs mi bde / lud pa lu ba'i nad sel byed / 'u su zho gnyis go snyod dang / la la phud la zho bzhi bzhi

verses.skt: tābhyāṃ dāḍimavṛkṣāmle dvir dviḥ sauvarcalāt palam | śuṇṭhyāḥ karṣaṃ dadhitthasya madhyāt pañca palāni ca
verses.tib: se 'bru dang ni da trig dag / de yi nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur bya / kha ru tsha ni srang gcig dang / bca' sga zho gnyis bil ba'i rkang / srang lnga dang ni sbyar ba la

verses.skt: tac cūrṇaṃ ṣoḍaśapalaiḥ śarkarāyā vimiśrayet | ṣāḍavo ’yaṃ pradeyaḥ syād annapāneṣu pūrvavat
verses.tib: kha ra srang ni bcu drug gzhug / ro drug pa 'di bza' ba dang / btung ba snga ma bzhin du sbyin

verses.skt: vidhiś ca yakṣmavihito yathāvasthaṃ kṣate hitaḥ | nivṛtte kṣatadoṣe tu kaphe vṛddha uraḥ śiraḥ
verses.tib: gcong chen las bshad cho ga gang / gnas skabs ji bzhin glo rdol phan / glo rdol nad ni byang gyur nas / bad kan skyes nas mgo bo brang

verses.skt: dālyate kāsino yasya sa nā dhūmān pibed imān | dvimedādvibalāyaṣṭīkalkaiḥ kṣaume subhāvite
verses.tib: na ba'i lud pa can gang yin / de la dud pa 'di brngub bya / me da gnyis dang ba la gnyis / shing mngar gso ma'i shun lpags ni / lde gur byas la reng bur ni

verses.skt: vartiṃ kṛtvā pibed dhūmaṃ jīvanīyaghṛtānupaḥ | manaḥśilāpalāśājagandhātvakkṣīrināgaraiḥ
verses.tib: byas te dud pa brngub par bya / de rjes 'tsho byed sman mar btung / ldong ros dang ni ba la sha / a za gan+d+ha cu gang dang

verses.skt: tadvad evānupānaṃ tu śarkarekṣuguḍodakam | piṣṭvā manaḥśilāṃ tulyām ārdrayā vaṭaśuṅgayā
verses.tib: dong gra las kyang de bzhin bya / de rjes kha ra bu ram dang / bu ram shang khu btung bar blud / ldong ros dang ni n+ya gro d+ha'i / myu gu rlon pa cha snyoms btags

verses.skt: sasarpiṣkaṃ pibed dhūmaṃ tittiripratibhojanam | kṣayaje bṛṃhaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ kuryād agneś ca vardhanam
verses.tib: zhun mar dang sbyar dud pa brngub / de 'og sreg pa'i sha khu btung / glo rdol las byung blud pa la / thog mar stobs dang me drod skyed

verses.skt: bahudoṣāya sasnehaṃ mṛdu dadyād virecanam | śamyākena trivṛtayā mṛdvīkārasayuktayā
verses.tib: nad gzhi mngal snum bcas pa'i / bkru sman 'jam po gtang bar bya / dong ga dang ni dur byid gnyis / rgun 'bru'i chu dang sbyar ba dang

verses.skt: tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa vidārīsvarasena ca | sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibed yuktyā kṣīṇadeho viśodhanam
verses.tib: seng phrom bskol ba'i khu ba dang / bi da ri yi khu bar sbyar / zhun mar la btsos ci rigs sbyin / lus zad pa la sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: pitte kaphe dhātuṣu ca kṣīṇeṣu kṣayakāsavān | ghṛtaṃ karkaṭakīkṣīradvibalāsādhitaṃ pibet
verses.tib: mkhris pa bad kan lus zungs rnams / zad pa'i zad byad lung pa can / mar dang karka ta sring gi / 'o ma ba la gnyis bskol blud

verses.skt: vidārībhiḥ kadambair vā tālasasyaiś ca sādhitam | ghṛtaṃ payaś ca mūtrasya vaivarṇye kṛcchranirgame
verses.tib: bi da ri 'am ka tam pa / ta la'i 'bras bu bskol ba yi / mar dang 'o ma gcin nad ni / mdog 'gyur bre bar byed la blud

verses.skt: śūne savedane meḍhre pāyau saśroṇivaṅkṣaṇe | ghṛtamaṇḍena laghunānuvāsyo miśrakeṇa vā
verses.tib: pho mtshan rkub dang chu so dang / brla dbrag mjug to skrang zhing na / mar gyi nying khu yang ba 'am / til mar bsres pa'i 'jam rtsi gtang

verses.skt: jāṅgalair pratibhuktasya vartakādyā bileśayāḥ | kramaśaḥ prasahās tadvat prayojyāḥ piśitāśinaḥ
verses.tib: skam sa'i srog chags sha dang ni / byi'u sogs dang ni khung na gnas / de bzhin mthu rtsal gyis zas tshol / sha za'i sha yang rim bzhin sbyin

verses.skt: auṣṇyāt pramāthibhāvāc ca srotobhyaś cyāvayanti te | kaphaṃ śuddhaiś ca taiḥ puṣṭiṃ kuryāt samyag vahan rasaḥ
verses.tib: dro bas bad kan 'jig byed la / rtsa sbubs rnams ni dag byed cing / dngas ma legs par rgyu byed bas / lus ni rgyas par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: cavikātriphalābhārgīdaśamūlaiḥ sacitrakaiḥ | kulatthapippalīmūlapāṭhākolayavair jale
verses.tib: dbyi mo bar gyi 'bras bu gsum / rtsa ba bcu dang tsi tra ka / rgya sran pi pi ling rtsa ba / pa ta rgya shug nas chur bskol

verses.skt: śṛtair nāgaraduḥsparśāpippalīśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ | piṣṭaiḥ karkaṭaśṛṅgyā ca samaiḥ sarpir vipācayet
verses.tib: li dong gra dang byi tsher ba / zur pa ma nu pi pi ling / karka ta yi sring gi btags / mnyam pa'i zhun mar dag dang bskol

verses.skt: siddhe ’smiṃś cūrṇitau kṣārau dvau pañca lavaṇāni ca | dattvā yuktyā piben mātrāṃ kṣayakāsanipīḍitaḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba'i mar 'di k+Shar gnyis / lan tshwa lnga ni btags te gzhug / de las ran par 'thungs na ni / zad byed lud pas nyen pa sel

verses.skt: kāsamardābhayāmustāpāṭhākaṭphalanāgaraiḥ | pippalyā kaṭurohiṇyā kāśmaryā surasena ca
verses.tib: ka sa mar da a ru ra / gla sgang pa ta kad pa la / dong gra pi pi ling tang pal / pu tse shel tshad zho gnyis gnyis

verses.skt: akṣamātrair ghṛtaprasthaṃ kṣīradrākṣārasāḍhake | pacec choṣajvaraplīhasarvakāsaharaṃ śivam
verses.tib: mar ni bre gang 'o ma dang / rgun chu bre bzhi'i nang du bskol / zad byed rims dang mchin pa'i nad / lud pa kun sel dge ba yin / kaN+Da ka ri ba sha ka

verses.skt: vṛṣavyāghrīguḍūcīnāṃ pattramūlaphalāṅkurāt | rasakalkair ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ hanti kāsajvarārucīḥ
verses.tib: sle tres rtsa ba 'bras bu dang / myu gu lo mar bcas pa rnams / bskol ba'i khu ba mar du btsos / lud pa'i rims kyis btab pa dang / yi ga 'chus pa'i nad rnams sel

verses.skt: dviguṇe dāḍimarase siddhaṃ vā vyoṣasaṃyutam | pibed upari bhuktasya yavakṣārayutaṃ naraḥ
verses.tib: se 'bru'i khu ba nyis 'gyur ram / tsha gsum ldan par bskol ba'ang phan / ya bak+Sha ra mar dang sbyar / zas zos pa yi 'og tu blud

verses.skt: pippalīguḍasiddhaṃ vā chāgakṣīrayutaṃ ghṛtam | etāny agnivivṛddhyarthaṃ sarpīṃṣi kṣayakāsinām
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang bu ram bskol / ra yi 'o ma mar bcas phan / 'di ni me drod sbyar phyir te / zad byed lus can gyis mar btung

verses.skt: syur doṣabaddhakaṇṭhoraḥsrotasāṃ ca viśuddhaye | prasthonmite yavakvāthe viṃśatiṃ vijayāḥ pacet
verses.tib: nad kyis 'gags pa'i mid pa brang / rtsa sbubs rnams ni dag par byed / nas ni bre gang btsos pa ru / rnam par rgyal ba nyi shu btso

verses.skt: svinnā mṛditvā tās tasmin purāṇāt ṣaṭpalaṃ guḍāt | pippalyā dvipalaṃ karṣaṃ manohvāyā rasāñjanāt
verses.tib: tshos nas de phyung mnyes nas der / bu ram rnying pa srang drug dang / pi pi ling ni srang gnyis dang / ldong ros zho gnyis skyer khaN+Da

verses.skt: dattvārdhākṣaṃ paced bhūyaḥ sa lehaḥ śvāsakāsajit | śvāvidhāṃ sūcayo dagdhāḥ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkarāḥ
verses.tib: zho gcig tshad ni bcug nas ni / slar yang bskol ba'i lde gu des / lud pa dbugs mi bde sel byed / reg 'jam sgro rtsa bsregs nas ni / mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar

verses.skt: śvāsakāsaharā barhipādau vā madhusarpiṣā | eraṇḍapattrakṣāraṃ vā vyoṣatailaguḍānvitam
verses.tib: yang na rma bya'i rkang pa bsregs / mar dang sbrang rtsir sbyar ba yi / lde gu zos na lud pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba sel bar byed / e raN+Da yi thal ba ni / til mar tsha gsum bu ram bcas

verses.skt: lehayet kṣāram evaṃ vā surasairaṇḍapattrajam | lihyāt tryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ vā purāṇaguḍasarpiṣā
verses.tib: lde gu'am bye'u rug e raN+Da'i / lo ma'i thal ba de bzhin bya / tsha ba gsum gyi phye ma ni / bu ram rnying pa mar sbyar phan

verses.skt: padmakaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ devadāru ca | balā rāsnā ca taccūrṇaṃ samastaṃ samaśarkaram
verses.tib: shug pa tsha gsum 'bras bu gsum / byi dang ga dang thang shing dang / ba la ra sna'i phye ma kun / de dang mnyam pa'i kha rar sbyar

verses.skt: khāden madhughṛtābhyāṃ vā lihyāt kāsaharaṃ param | tadvan maricacūrṇaṃ vā saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram
verses.tib: yang na sbrang rtsi mar dang sbyar / lde gu lud pa sel byed mchog / de bzhin na le sham gyi phye / mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas

verses.skt: pathyāśuṇṭhīghanaguḍair guṭikāṃ dhārayen mukhe | sarveṣu śvāsakāseṣu kevalaṃ vā vibhītakam
verses.tib: bu ram dang ni bcas pa yi / ri lu khar ni bzhag gyur na / lud pa dbugs mi bde kun sel / yang na ba ru ra 'ba' zhig

verses.skt: pattrakalkaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ tilvakasya saśarkaram | peyā votkārikā charditṛṭkāsāmātisārajit
verses.tib: lud pa sel bar byed pa yin / seng phrom a mra kha ra dang / bcas pa'i lde gu mar dang brngos / thug pa zan dron nang du btab / slon bro skom dang lud pa dang / ma zhu tshad 'khru sel bar byed

verses.skt: kaṇṭakārīrase siddho kṣīraṃ yūṣān rasān api | sagaurāmalakaḥ sāmlaḥ sarvakāsabhiṣagjitam
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri'i khu bar bskol / mung+ga'i khu bar legs g.yos pa / skyu ru ra ser se'u 'brur bcas / lud pa kun gyi sman gyur yin

verses.skt: vātaghnauṣadhaniḥkvāthe kṣīraṃ yūṣān rasān api | vaiṣkirān prātudān bailān dāpayet kṣayakāsine
verses.tib: rlung 'joms sman bskol 'o ma'am / mchu yis zas tshol khron rko dang / khung na gnas pa'i sha khu ni / zad byed lud pa can la sbyin

verses.skt: kṣatakāse ca ye dhūmāḥ sānupānā nidarśitāḥ | kṣayakāse ’pi te yojyā vakṣyate yac ca yakṣmaṇi
verses.tib: glo rdol gyis dud brngubs la gang / btung bar bcas pa bsten pa yang / zad byed lud par de gtang bya / gang yang gcong chen skabs su bshad

verses.skt: bṛṃhaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ cāgneḥ srotasāṃ ca viśodhanam | vyatyāsāt kṣayakāsibhyo balyaṃ sarvaṃ praśasyate
verses.tib: stobs skyed me drod skyed pa dang / rtsa rgyun sbyong bar byed pa'i sman / rnam grangs zad byed lud can la / stobs skyed thams cad bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: saṃnipātodbhavo ghoraḥ kṣayakāso yatas tataḥ | yathādoṣabalaṃ tasya saṃnipātahitaṃ hitam
verses.tib: gang phyir 'dus pa las byung ba'i / zad byed lud pa mi bzad pas / de phyir nad stobs ji bzhin du / 'dus pa'i nad la phan pas gso

verses.skt: śvāsahidhmā yatas tulyahetvādyāḥ sādhanaṃ tataḥ | tulyam eva tadārtaṃ ca pūrvaṃ svedair upācaret
verses.tib: gang phyir skyigs bu dbugs mi bde / rgyu sogs mtshungs pas de yi phyir / gso ba'ang gcig ste des nyen la / thog mar dugs kyi nyer dpyad bya

verses.skt: snigdhair lavaṇatailāktaṃ taiḥ kheṣu grathitaḥ kaphaḥ | sulīno ’pi vilīno ’sya koṣṭhaṃ prāptaḥ sunirharaḥ
verses.tib: snum dang lan tshwa til mar byug / de yis bad kan bu gar 'gags / shin tu zhen pa zhu nas ni / khong par gnas pa legs par 'byin

verses.skt: srotasāṃ syān mṛdutvaṃ ca marutaś cānulomatā | svinnaṃ ca bhojayed annaṃ snigdham ānūpajai rasaiḥ
verses.tib: bu ga'i rgyun srang mnyen gyur cing / rlung ni lugs dang mthun par rgyu / 'jam zhing rlan gyur zas snum dang / rlan can shar bcas sbyin pa 'am

verses.skt: dadhyuttareṇa vā dadyāt tato ’smai vamanaṃ mṛdu | viśeṣāt kāsavamathuhṛdgrahasvarasādine
verses.tib: yang na zho yi spris ma sbyin / de nas de la rlon 'jam btang / mchog tu lud pa rnying nad dang / skad 'gags pa la skyug sman sbyin

verses.skt: pippalīsaindhavakṣaudrayuktaṃ vātāvirodhi yat | nirhṛte sukham āpnoti sa kaphe duṣṭavigrahe
verses.tib: rgyam tsha sbrang rtsi pi pi ling / sbyar ba'am rlung la phan pa gtang / bad kan gyis ni gnod byas pa / gsal na bde ba thob 'gyur la

verses.skt: srotaḥsu ca viśuddheṣu caraty avihato ’nilaḥ | dhmānodāvartatamake mātuluṅgāmlavetasaiḥ
verses.tib: bu ga rnam par dag gyur nas / rlung ni gnod pa med par rgyu / lto sbos rtug 'gags mun 'thibs byed / ma du lung ga star bu dang

verses.skt: hiṅgupīluviḍair yuktam annaṃ syād anulomanam | sasaindhavaṃ phalāmlaṃ vā koṣṇaṃ dadyād virecanam
verses.tib: shid+kun pi lu kha ru tsha / ldan zas byin na bde bar 'byung / rgyam tshar bcas pa'i 'bras bu skyur / cung zad dro ba'i bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: ete hi kaphasaṃruddhagatiprāṇaprakopajāḥ | tasmāt tanmārgaśuddhyartham ūrdhvādhaḥ śodhanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: 'di dag bad kan gyis lam bkag / srog gi rlung ni 'khrugs las byung / de bas de lam bsal bya'i phyir / steng dang 'og tu sbyang byas phan

verses.skt: udīryate bhṛśataraṃ mārgarodhād vahaj jalam | yathā tathānilas tasya mārgam asmād viśodhayet
verses.tib: ji ltar 'bag par gyur pa'i chu / shin tu 'khyil zhing 'phel ba ltar / de bzhin rlung ni 'khyil gyur pa'i / de lam legs par sbyang bar bya

verses.skt: aśāntau kṛtasaṃśuddher dhūmair līnaṃ malaṃ haret | haridrāpattram eraṇḍamūlaṃ lākṣāṃ manaḥśilām
verses.tib: sbyang ba byas kyang ma dag pa'i / zhen pa'i dri ma du bas bsal / yung ba'i lo ma e raN+Da'i / rtsa ba rgya skyegs ldong ros dang

verses.skt: sadevadārv alaṃ māṃsīṃ piṣṭvā vartiṃ prakalpayet | tāṃ ghṛtāktāṃ pibed dhūmaṃ yavān vā ghṛtasaṃyutān
