verses.tib: thang shing ba la spang spos bcas / btags te reng bu nyid du bya / de ni mar bskus dud pa rngub / yang na mar sbrus nas bsregs rngub

verses.skt: madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sarjarasaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā guru vāguru | candanaṃ vā tathā śṛṅgaṃ vālān vā snāva vā gavām
verses.tib: spra tshil sra rtsi pog dag gam / a ka ru bzang mar sbyar rngub / de bzhin tsan+dan glang rwa 'am / spu 'am rgyus pa'i dud pa rngub

verses.skt: ṛkṣagodhākuraṅgaiṇacarmaśṛṅgakhurāṇi vā | gugguluṃ vā manohvāṃ vā śālaniryāsam eva vā
verses.tib: btsod dang go dku rang ga / dge ba lpags mgar yi'am / yang na gu gul ldong ros sam / yang na sA la'i thang

verses.skt: śallakīṃ gugguluṃ lohaṃ padmakaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam | avaśyaṃ svedanīyānām asvedyānām api kṣaṇam
verses.tib: chu nyid / mo rtsa gu gul a ga ru / shug pa mar dang bcas dud rngub / dugs byar mi rung btang snyoms gzhag / brang dang mid pa zhom pa la / bshol du med na 'jam dugs bya

verses.skt: svedayet sasitākṣīrasukhoṣṇasnehasecanaiḥ | utkārikopanāhaiś ca svedādhyāyoktabheṣajaiḥ
verses.tib: kha ra dkar po'i 'o mas sam / dro 'jam tsam kyis dugs bya zhing / dkri dang ldan par bya ba'i dugs / dugs kyi le'ur bshad dugs bya / ma zhur de gso'i cho ga spyad / sbyor drags rlung shas cher gyur na / rlung nad bsal ba'i sbyor ba bya

verses.skt: uraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ ca mṛdubhiḥ sāme tv āmavidhiṃ caret | atiyogoddhataṃ vātaṃ dṛṣṭvā pavananāśanaiḥ
verses.tib: kha ra dkar po'i 'o mas sam / dro 'jam tsam kyis dugs bya zhing / dkri dang ldan par bya ba'i dugs / dugs kyi le'ur bshad dugs bya / ma zhur de gso'i cho ga spyad / sbyor drags rlung shas cher gyur na / rlung nad bsal ba'i sbyor ba bya

verses.skt: snigdhai rasādyair nātyuṣṇair abhyaṅgaiś ca śamaṃ nayet | anutkliṣṭakaphāsvinnadurbalānāṃ hi śodhanāt
verses.tib: sha khu snum sogs rab tsha sbyin / bsku ba dag gis zhi bar bya / bad kan ma slong dugs mi bya / nyam chung ba la sbyang byas pas

verses.skt: vāyur labdhāspado marma saṃśoṣyāśu hared asūn | kaṣāyalehasnehādyais teṣāṃ saṃśamayed ataḥ
verses.tib: rlung gi gnas rnyed gnas rnams ni / skam par byas nas srog 'phrog byed / de bas sman khu snum dang ni / lde gu kyis de zhir bya

verses.skt: kṣīṇakṣatātisārāsṛkpittadāhānubandhajān | madhurasnigdhaśītādyair hidhmāśvāsān upācaret
verses.tib: skem zhing glo rdol tshad 'khru dang / khrag mkhris tsha ba las byung ba'i / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba la / mngar snum bsil dag gis gso

verses.skt: kulatthadaśamūlānāṃ kvāthe syur jāṅgalā rasāḥ | yūṣāś ca śigruvārtākakāsaghnavṛṣamūlakaiḥ
verses.tib: ku lang+tha dang rtsa ba bcu / bskol ba'i skam sa'i sha khu phan / shi kru par ta ka dang ni / ka sa mar da ba sha ka / la phug lo ma'i khu ba dang / nim pa'i myu gu las byung dang

verses.skt: pallavair nimbakulakabṛhatīmātuluṅgajaiḥ | vyāghrīdurālabhāśṛṅgībilvamadhyatrikaṇṭakaiḥ
verses.tib: kha lung bri ha ti khu phan / kaN+Da ka ri byi tsher ba / bil ba'i rkang dang gze ma dang / sle tres kar ka ta sring gi / tsi tra ka dang ku lang+tha

verses.skt: sāmṛtāgnikulatthaiś ca yūṣaḥ syāt kvathitair jale | tadvad rāsnābṛhatyādibalāmudgaiḥ sacitrakaiḥ
verses.tib: chur bskol ba yi yu sha bya / yang na ra sna rtsa chung lnga / mung+ga tsi tra kar bcas blud / tsi tra go snyod kha ru tsha

verses.skt: peyā ca citrakājājīśṛṅgīsauvarcalaiḥ kṛtā | daśamūlena vā kāsaśvāsahidhmārujāpahā
verses.tib: kar kata sring thug pa phan / yang na rtsa ba bcu sbyar ba'i / thug pa blud na lud pa dang / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde nad sel

verses.skt: daśamūlaśaṭhīrāsnābhārgībilvarddhipauṣkaraiḥ | kulīraśṛṅgīcapalātāmalakyamṛtauṣadhaiḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu par sna dang / zur pa ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / bil ba gnyis dang ma nu dang / kar ka ta sring pi pi ling / lca ba sle tres bca' sga ni

verses.skt: pibet kaṣāyaṃ jīrṇe ’smin peyāṃ tair eva sādhitām | śāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmayavamudgakulatthabhuk
verses.tib: bskol ba'i khu ba blud zhu nas / de nyid dang btsos thug pa blud / sA lu drug cu pa dang gro / nas dang mung+ga rgya sran zos

verses.skt: kāsahṛdgrahapārśvārtihidhmāśvāsapraśāntaye | saktūn vārkāṅkurakṣīrabhāvitānāṃ samākṣikān
verses.tib: lud pa snying nad rtsib logs zug / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba sel / yang na arga'i myu gu yi / 'o ma dang sbrus nas kyi zan

verses.skt: yavānāṃ daśamūlādiniḥkvāthalulitān pibet | anne ca yojayet kṣārahiṅgvājyaviḍadāḍimān
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi dang bcas rtsa bcu sogs / bskol ba'i khu bar sbyar ba blud / zas ni k+Sha ra shing kun mar / kha ru tsha dang se'u sbyar za

verses.skt: sapauṣkaraśaṭhīvyoṣamātuluṅgāmlavetasān | daśamūlasya vā kvātham athavā devadāruṇaḥ
verses.tib: ma nu zur pa tsha ba gsum / star bu ba lung sbyar ba sbyin / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde skom dang / rtsa ba bcu bskol khu ba'am

verses.skt: pibed vā vāruṇīmaṇḍaṃ hidhmāśvāsī pipāsitaḥ | pippalīpippalīmūlapathyājantughnacitrakaiḥ
verses.tib: yang na thang shing bskol khu'am / chang gi dngas ma blud par bya / pi pi ling dang de'i rtsa ba / ma ru ra dang byi dang ga

verses.skt: kalkitair lepite rūḍhe niḥkṣiped ghṛtabhājane | takraṃ māsasthitaṃ tad dhi dīpanaṃ śvāsakāsajit
verses.tib: tsi tra ka rnams lde gur sbyar / mar snod bskus te bskams pa ru / snod du dar ba zla gcig gzhag / de 'bungs me yi drod skyed cing / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel

verses.skt: pāṭhāṃ madhurasāṃ dāru saralaṃ ca niśi sthitam | surāmaṇḍe ’lpalavaṇaṃ pibet prasṛtasaṃmitam
verses.tib: ba ta mur pa thang shing dang / sa ra la dang chang dngas ma / nub gcig bzhag ste lan tshwa btab / de las khyer gang blud par bya

verses.skt: bhārgīśuṇṭhyau sukhāmbhobhiḥ kṣāraṃ vā maricānvitam | svakvāthapiṣṭāṃ lulitāṃ bāṣpikāṃ pāyayeta vā
verses.tib: ga bra'i rtsa ba bca' sga'i phye'am / ya bak+Sha ra na le sham / bcas phye chu tshan blugs pa ban / ba spri ka ni bskol ba'i chu / btags pa lde gur byas bsres blud

verses.skt: svarasaḥ saptaparṇasya puṣpāṇāṃ vā śirīṣataḥ | hidhmāśvāse madhukaṇāyuktaḥ pittakaphānuge
verses.tib: sab ta par+Ni'i khu ba'am / shri sha yi ni me tog ni / pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir sbyar / bad kan mkhris pa 'dres gyur pa'i

verses.skt: utkārikā tugākṛṣṇāmadhūlīghṛtanāgaraiḥ | pittānubandhe yoktavyā pavane tv anubandhini
verses.tib: skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba sel / cu gang pi pi ling dang ni / 'bras dang bca' sga mar dag las / khu ba mkhris pa las gyur sal

verses.skt: śvāvicchaśāmiṣakaṇāghṛtaśalyakaśoṇitaiḥ | suvarcalārasavyoṣasarpirbhiḥ sahitaṃ payaḥ
verses.tib: ri bong sha dang pi pi ling / mar dang sha spya ka yi khrag / lcam pa'i khu ba tsha ba gsum / mar dang 'o mar sbyar ba dang

verses.skt: anu śālyodanaṃ peyam vātapittānubandhini | caturguṇāmbusiddhaṃ vā chāgaṃ saguḍanāgaram
verses.tib: 'bras chan zos la 'o ma blud / rlung mkhris 'dres pa las gyur sel / ra yi 'o ma bzhi 'gyur gyis

verses.skt: pippalīmūlamadhukaguḍago'śvaśakṛdrasān | hidhmābhiṣyandakāsaghnā¿ lihyān madhughṛtānvitān
verses.tib: chu bskol bu ram dong gra btab / pi pi ling rtsa shing mngar dang / bu ram lca brta sbangs khu / sbrang rtsi mar sbyar zos gyur na / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba sel

verses.skt: gogajāśvavarāhoṣṭrakharameṣājaviḍrasam | samadhv ekaikaśo lihyād bahuśleṣmāthavā pibet
verses.tib: rta dang glang po ba lang phag / rnga mong bong bu lug dang ra / gang yang rung ba'i rtug btsir khu / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba bldags na phan / bad kan shas cher btung ba blud

verses.skt: catuṣpāccarmaromāsthikhuraśṛṅgodbhavāṃ maṣīm | tathaiva vājigandhāyā lihyāc chvāsī kapholbaṇaḥ
verses.tib: rkang bzhi pa yi lpags rus spu / rmig pa bsregs la snag tshar byas / ya shwa gan+d+ha'i lde gu ni / sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bad kan shas

verses.skt: śaṭhīpauṣkaradhātrīr vā pauṣkaraṃ vā kaṇānvitam | gairikāñjanakṛṣṇā vā svarasaṃ vā kapitthajam
verses.tib: zur pa ma / nu skyu ru ra'am / ma nu pi pi ling bcas phan / yug snam pi pi ling bcas pa'am / ka pid ta yi khu ba'am

verses.skt: rasena vā kapitthasya dhātrīsaindhavapippalīḥ | ghṛtakṣaudreṇa vā pathyāviḍaṅgoṣaṇapippalīḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang rgyam tshar bcas / mar dang sbrang rtsi a ru ra'am / tsha ba gnyis dang kha ru tsha / rgya shug 'bras yos sbrang rtsi dang

verses.skt: kolalājāmaladrākṣāpippalīnāgarāṇi vā | guḍatailaniśādrākṣākaṇārāsnoṣaṇāni vā
verses.tib: rgun 'bru pi pi ling dong gra / bu ram rgun 'bru yung ra sna / pi pi ling dang na le sham / til mar dang ni sbyar ba phan / lde gu sman gyi phye ma yang

verses.skt: pibed rasāmbumadyāmlair lehauṣadharajāṃsi vā | jīvantīmustasurasatvagelādvayapauṣkaram
verses.tib: sha khu chu dron tsha btung / dzi ban ti dang gla sgang dang / bye'u rug pa dang shing tsha dang / sug smel gnyis dang ma nu dang

verses.skt: caṇḍātāmalakīlohabhārgīnāgaravālakam | karkaṭākhyāśaṭhīkṛṣṇānāgakesaracorakam
verses.tib: lca ba ta ma ma li ka / a ru ra dang ga bra'i rtsa / dong ga dang ni ba la ka / zur pa kar ka ta sring gi / nA ga ge sar pi pi ling

verses.skt: upayuktaṃ yathākāmaṃ cūrṇaṃ dviguṇaśarkaram | pārśvarugjvarakāsaghnaṃ hidhmāśvāsaharaṃ param
verses.tib: tsa rong ci rigs sbyar nas ni / phye ma nyis 'gyur kha rar bcas / rtsib logs nad rims lud pa sel / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde 'joms mchog

verses.skt: śaṭhītāmalakībhārgīcaṇḍāvālakapauṣkaram | śarkarāṣṭaguṇaṃ cūrṇaṃ hidhmāśvāsaharaṃ param
tulyaṃ guḍaṃ nāgaraṃ ca bhakṣayen nāvayeta vā | laśunasya palāṇḍor vā mūlaṃ gṛñjanakasya vā
verses.tib: dong ga bu ram cha mnyam pa / bza' ba'am sna nas btang sman bya / yang na sgag skya'am kun dong ngam / gri dza na yi rtsa bas bya

verses.skt: candanād vā rasaṃ dadyān nārīkṣīreṇa nāvanam | stanyena makṣikāviṣṭhām alaktakarasena vā
verses.tib: tsan+dan gyi ni khu ba dang / bud med nu zho snar blugs bya / sbrang ma'i rtug pa nu zhor sbyar / rgya skyegs khu ba dang sbyar blugs

verses.skt: sasaindhavaṃ ghṛtācchaṃ vā siddhaṃ stanyena vā ghṛtam | kalkitair madhuradravyais tat piben nāvayeta vā
verses.tib: rgyam tsha zhun mar dang bcas pa / nu zho mar dang bskol ba'am / mngar ba'i sman dang lde gur byas / de btung ba'am sna nas gtad

verses.skt: sakṛd uṣṇaṃ sakṛc chītaṃ vyatyāsāt sasitāmadhu | tadvat payas tathā siddham adhobhāgauṣadhair ghṛtam
verses.tib: kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas pa ni / grang dro res kyis blugs pa'am / de bzhin 'o ma bskol ba ni / sman gyi phye ma mar sbyar blugs

verses.skt: kaṇāsauvarcalakṣāravayaḥsthāhiṅgucorakaiḥ | sakāyasthair ghṛtaṃ mastudaśamūlarase pacet
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang kha ru tsha / ya bak+Sha ra sle tres dang / shing kun tso ra bye'u rug pa / mar dang zhog chur sbyar zhing / rtsa bcu'i khu bar bskol ba blud

verses.skt: tat pibej jīvanīyair vā lihyāt samadhu sādhitam | tejovaty abhayā kuṣṭhaṃ pippalī kaṭurohiṇī
verses.tib: yang na 'tsho byed bskol ba'i khu / sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud par bya / te dzo ba ti a ru ra / pi pi ling dang pu tse shel

verses.skt: bhūtikaṃ pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ palāśaś citrakaḥ śaṭhī | paṭudvayaṃ tāmalakī jīvantī bilvapeśikā
verses.tib: ru rta ma nu bu ti ka / tsitra ka dang pa la sha / zur pa lan tshwa rnam gnyis dang / dzi ban ti dang bil ba'i rkang

verses.skt: vacā pattraṃ ca tālīśaṃ karṣāṃśais tair vipācayet | hiṅgupādair ghṛtaprasthaṃ pītam āśu nihanti tat
verses.tib: shu dag bal bu'i lo ma rnams / de dag zho ni gnyis gnyis bskol / shing kun zho phyed mar bre gang / bskol ba de ni 'thungs gyur na

verses.skt: śākhānilārśograhaṇīhidhmāhṛtpārśvavedanāḥ | ardhāṃśena pibet sarpiḥ kṣāreṇa paṭunāthavā
verses.tib: rkang lag la ni zhen pa'i rlung / gzhang 'brum dang ni pho ba'i nad / skyigs bu snying nad rtsib logs zug / myur du sel bar byed pa yin / zhun mar cha phyed bcas pa yi / ya bak+Sha rgyam tsha sbyin

verses.skt: dhānvantaraṃ vṛṣaghṛtaṃ dādhikaṃ hapuṣādi vā | śītāmbusekaḥ sahasā trāsavikṣepabhīśucaḥ
verses.tib: thang la 'bar gyi'am dug gi mar / zho can ha pu sha'i mar blud / chu grang glo bur blugs pa dang / sngangs dang sprugs dang 'jigs pa dang

verses.skt: harṣerṣyocchvāsarodhāś ca hitaṃ kīṭaiś ca daṃśanam | yat kiñcit kaphavātaghnam uṣṇaṃ vātānulomanam
verses.tib: dga' dang phrag dog dbugs bsdams dang / gnod pa'i 'bu yi sos btab dang / gang yang bad kan rlung 'joms sman / dro zhing rlung ni bde rgyu bsten

verses.skt: tat sevyaṃ prāyaśo yac ca sutarāṃ mārutāpaham | sarveṣāṃ bṛṃhaṇe hy alpaḥ śakyaś ca prāyaśo bhavet
verses.tib: gang yang phal cher rlung gi nad / lhag par 'joms par byed pas spyad / thams cad la ni brta byas pas / tshabs chung gso bar sla ba yin

verses.skt: nātyarthaṃ śamane ’pāyo bhṛśo ’śakyaś ca karṣaṇe | śamanair bṛṃhaṇaiś cāto bhūyiṣṭhaṃ tān upācaret
verses.tib: lhag par nyams smad pa yis ni / zhi ba'i thabs su 'gyur ma yin / de bas zhi ba brta ba'i thabs / mang po de la spyad par bya

verses.skt: kāsaśvāsakṣayacchardihidhmāś cānyo'nyabheṣajaiḥ
verses.tib: lud pa dbugs mi bde gcong slon / skyigs bu'i sman ni phan tshun 'dre

verses.skt: balino bahudoṣasya snigdhasvinnasya śodhanam | ūrdhvādho yakṣmiṇaḥ kuryāt sasnehaṃ yan na karśanam
verses.tib: stobs ldan nad ni mang gyur la / snum chos dugs byas sbyang ba ni / snum med ma yin nyam smod min / steng 'og gi ni sbyang bar bya

verses.skt: payasā phalayuktena madhureṇa rasena vā | sarpiṣmatyā yavāgvā vā vamanadravyasiddhayā
verses.tib: 'o ma po son chang bcas pa'am / sha khu mngar dang ldan pa'am / zhun mar btab pa'i nas thug ni

verses.skt: vamed virecanaṃ dadyāt trivṛcchyāmānṛpadrumān | śarkarāmadhusarpirbhiḥ payasā tarpaṇena vā
verses.tib: skyug sman bskol bas slon du gzhug / sham dur byid dong grar bcas / kha ra sbrang rtsi mar dang ni / bcas pa'i 'o ma 'am skyo ma'am

verses.skt: drākṣāvidārīkāśmaryamāṃsānāṃ vā rasair yutān | śuddhakoṣṭhasya yuñjīta vidhiṃ bṛṃhaṇadīpanam
verses.tib: rgun 'bru tang pa la bi da ri / yang na sha khur ldan pa yi / bkru sman 'jam po gtang bar bya / lto sbyang pa la brta ba dang / drod skyed cho ga spyad par bya

verses.skt: hṛdyāni cānnapānāni vātaghnāni laghūni ca | śāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmayavamudgaṃ samoṣitam
verses.tib: zas skom yi gar 'ong ba dang / rlung 'joms byed cing yang ba sbyin / s+'a lu drug cu pa dang gro / nas dang mung+ga lo gcig lon

verses.skt: laghum acyutavīryaṃ ca sujaraṃ balakṛc ca yat
ājaṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ kravyānmāṃsaṃ ca śoṣajit | kākolūkavṛkadvīpigavāśvanakuloragam
verses.tib: ra yi 'o ma mar dang sha / sha za'i sha ni zad byed 'joms / bya rog 'ug pa spyang ki gzig / ba lang rta dang ne le sbrul

verses.skt: gṛdhrabhāsakharoṣṭraṃ ca hitaṃ chadmopasaṃhitam | jñātaṃ jugupsitaṃ tad dhi cchardiṣe na balaujase
verses.tib: bya rgod rnga mo bong bu khra'i / sha ni sgyu yis byin na phan / shes na de las smod pas na / slon zhing mdangs dang stobs mi 'gyur

verses.skt: mṛgādyāḥ pittakaphayoḥ pavane prasahādayaḥ | vesavārīkṛtāḥ pathyā rasādiṣu ca kalpitāḥ
verses.tib: bad mkhris ri dwags la sogs sha / rlung la mthu rtsal gzan tshol sha / tsho khur sbyar zhing phan pa dang / sha khu sogs la'ang sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: bhṛṣṭāḥ sarṣapatailena sarpiṣā vā yathāyatham | rasikā mṛdavaḥ snigdhāḥ paṭudravyābhisaṃskṛtāḥ
verses.tib: yungs mar dag dang brngos pa'am / yang na ci rigs mar dang brngos / khu bar ldan zhing mnyen la snum / spod la sogs dang legs g.yos sbyin / de bzhin la phug rgya sran las / g.yos pa'i yu shar sbyar bar bya / pi pi ling bcas nas dang bcas / rgya sran bcas shing dong grar bcas

verses.skt: hitā maulakakaulatthās tadvad yūṣāś ca sādhitāḥ | sapippalīkaṃ sayavaṃ sakulatthaṃ sanāgaram
verses.tib: yungs mar dag dang brngos pa'am / yang na ci rigs mar dang brngos / khu bar ldan zhing mnyen la snum / spod la sogs dang legs g.yos sbyin / de bzhin la phug rgya sran las / g.yos pa'i yu shar sbyar bar bya / pi pi ling bcas nas dang bcas / rgya sran bcas shing dong grar bcas

verses.skt: sadāḍimaṃ sāmalakaṃ snigdham ājaṃ rasaṃ pibet | tena ṣaḍ vinivartante vikārāḥ pīnasādayaḥ
verses.tib: se'u 'bru skyu ru ra dang bcas / ra sha'i khu ba snum bcas blud / des ni cham pa la sogs pa / gnod pa drug ni sel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: pibec ca sutarāṃ madyaṃ jīrṇaṃ srotoviśodhanam | pittādiṣu viśeṣeṇa madhvariṣṭācchavāruṇīḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa sogs las khyad par du / chang rnying rtsa sbubs sbyong byed pa / ngoms pa nyid du blud par bya / rgun chang chang rnying chang dngas blud

verses.skt: siddhaṃ vā pañcamūlena tāmalakyāthavā jalam | parṇinībhiś catasṛbhir dhānyanāgarakeṇa vā
verses.tib: rtsa ba chung ngu lngar bskol ba'am / tam la ka chur bskol ba'am / par+Ni bzhi dang bskol ba'am / 'u su bca' sga bskol ba blud

verses.skt: kalpayec cānukūlo ’sya tenānnaṃ śuci yatnavān | daśamūlena payasā siddhaṃ māṃsarasena vā
verses.tib: de dang kha zas gtsang ba dag / 'bad pas btsos pa rjes mthun yin / rtsa ba bcu dang 'o ma 'am / sha khu'i nang du btso bar bya

verses.skt: balāgarbhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yojyaṃ kravyānmāṃsarasena vā | sakṣaudraṃ payasā siddhaṃ sarpir daśaguṇena vā
verses.tib: ba la btab pa'i mar sbyar ba'am / sha za'i sha khur btsos pa sbyin / 'o ma bcu 'gyur dag dang ni / mar bskol sbrang rtsir bcas pa'ang phan

verses.skt: jīvantīṃ madhukaṃ drākṣāṃ phalāni kuṭajasya ca | puṣkarāhvaṃ śaṭhīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vyāghrīṃ gokṣurakaṃ balām
verses.tib: dzi ban ti dang shing mngar dang / rgun 'bru dug mo nyung 'bras bu / ma nu zur pa pi pi ling / bya kri gze ma ba la dang

verses.skt: nīlotpalaṃ tāmalakīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ durālabhām | kalkīkṛtya ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ rogarājaharaṃ param
verses.tib: ta ma la ki ut+pal sngo / kyi lce ba dang byi tsher ba / lde gur byas dang mar bskol ba / gcong chen sel ba'i dam pa yin

verses.skt: ghṛtaṃ kharjūramṛdvīkāmadhukaiḥ saparūṣakaiḥ | sapippalīkaṃ vaisvaryakāsaśvāsajvarāpaham
verses.tib: 'bra go rgun 'brum ma du ka / pa ru sha dang pi pi ling / mar dang bskol bas skad 'gags dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde rims 'joms

verses.skt: daśamūlaśṛtāt kṣīrāt sarpir yad udiyān navam | sapippalīkaṃ sakṣaudraṃ tat paraṃ svarabodhanam
verses.tib: rtsa bcu 'o mar bskol ba las / byung ba'i mar gsar gang yin de / pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir bcas / skad 'gags sel ba'i dam pa yin

verses.skt: śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūlaghnaṃ kāsaśvāsajvarāpaham | pañcabhiḥ pañcamūlair vā śṛtād yad udiyād ghṛtam
verses.tib: mgo brang rtsib logs gzer 'joms shing / lud pa dbugs mi bde rims sel / rtsa ba lnga ba lngar bskol ba'i / 'o ma las / byung mar gang yin

verses.skt: pañcānāṃ pañcamūlānāṃ rase kṣīracaturguṇe | siddhaṃ sarpir jayaty etad yakṣmaṇaḥ saptakaṃ balam
verses.tib: rtsa ba lnga pa lnga yi ni / khu ba 'o ma'i bzhi 'gyur la / bskol ba yi ni mar 'di yis / zang byed kyi ni stobs bdun 'joms

verses.skt: pañcakolayavakṣāraṣaṭpalena paced ghṛtam | prasthonmitaṃ tulyapayaḥ srotasāṃ tad viśodhanam
verses.tib: ya bak+Sha ra tsha ba lnga / srang drug dang ni btsos pa'i mar / bre gang 'o ma cha mnyam byas / de yis bu ga dag byed cing

verses.skt: gulmajvarodaraplīhagrahaṇīpāṇḍupīnasān | śvāsakāsāgnisadanaśvayathūrdhvānilāñ jayet
verses.tib: skran dang dmu rdzing mcher pa dang / pho nad skya rbab cham pa dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde drod nyams / skrang dang stod kyi rlung nad 'joms

verses.skt: rāsnābalāgokṣurakasthirāvarṣābhuvāriṇi | jīvantīpippalīgarbhaṃ sakṣīraṃ śoṣajid ghṛtam
verses.tib: ra sna ba la gze ma dang / ti ra ba ra sha khu'i chur / dzi ban ti dang pi pi ling / 'o bcas gcong chen 'joms pa'i mchog

verses.skt: aśvagandhāśṛtāt kṣīrād ghṛtaṃ ca sasitāpayaḥ | sādhāraṇāmiṣatulāṃ toyadroṇadvaye pacet
verses.tib: a shwa gan+d+ha 'o mar bskol / las byung mar 'o kha rar bcas / spyi yi sha ni srang brgya dag / chu bre sum cu gnyis na bskol

verses.skt: tenāṣṭabhāgaśeṣeṇa jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ | sādhayet sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ vātapittāmayāpaham
verses.tib: de yi brgyad cha lus pa ru / 'tsho byed bcu ni srang re gzhug / zhun mar bre gang bcas bskol ba / sha yi sman mar 'di blud pa'am / sha khu dang sbyar ci rigs sbyin / rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur nad / lud pa dbugs mi bde skad 'gags / skem zhing rtsib logs zug pa 'joms

verses.skt: māṃsasarpir idam pītaṃ yuktaṃ māṃsarasena vā | kāsaśvāsasvarabhraṃśaśoṣahṛtpārśvaśūlajit
verses.tib: de yi brgyad cha lus pa ru / 'tsho byed bcu ni srang re gzhug / zhun mar bre gang bcas bskol ba / sha yi sman mar 'di blud pa'am / sha khu dang sbyar ci rigs sbyin / rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur nad / lud pa dbugs mi bde skad 'gags / skem zhing rtsib logs zug pa 'joms

verses.skt: elājamodātriphalāsaurāṣṭrīvyoṣacitrakān | sārān ariṣṭagāyatrīśālabījakasaṃbhavān
verses.tib: sug smel ti mus 'bras gsum / sa nag tsha ba gsum tsi tra / sa ra nim pa seng ldeng dang / sA la'i 'bras bu las byung dang

verses.skt: bhallātakaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca pṛthag aṣṭapalonmitam | salile ṣoḍaśaguṇe ṣoḍaśāṃśasthitaṃ pacet
verses.tib: go bye dang ni byi dang ga / srang ni brgyad brgyad tshad du byas / chu ni bcu drug 'gyur byas par / bcu drug char gnas bar du bskol

verses.skt: punas tena ghṛtaprasthaṃ siddhe cāsmin palāni ṣaṭ | tavakṣīryāḥ kṣipet triṃśat sitāyā dviguṇaṃ madhu
verses.tib: slar yang de dang mar bre gang / bskol ba 'dir ni cu gang ni / srang drug khar srang sum cu bcug / sbrang rtsi srang ni drug cu gzhug

verses.skt: ghṛtāt trijātāt tripalaṃ tato līḍhaṃ khajāhatam | payo'nupānaṃ tat prāhṇe rasāyanam ayantraṇam
verses.tib: dri sna gsum ni srang re gzhug / gzar bus dkrugs te lde gur byas / snga dro zos la 'o ma btung / bcud len bsdams pa med pa yin

verses.skt: medhyaṃ cakṣuṣyam āyuṣyaṃ dīpanaṃ hanti cācirāt | mehagulmakṣayavyādhipāṇḍurogabhagandarān
verses.tib: yid gzhungs mig rno tshe ring la / drod skyed skran dang gcong chen nad / skya rbab dang ni mtshan bar rdol / myur du 'joms par byed pa yin

verses.skt: ye ca sarpirguḍāḥ proktāḥ kṣate yojyāḥ kṣaye ’pi te | tvagelāpippalīkṣīrīśarkarā dviguṇāḥ kramāt
verses.tib: gang yang zhun mar bu ram bcas / glo rdol la bshad zang byed sbyar / shing tsha sug smel pi pi ling / cu gang kha ra rim nyis 'gyur

verses.skt: cūrṇitā bhakṣitāḥ kṣaudrasarpiṣā vāvalehitāḥ | svaryāḥ kāsakṣayaśvāsapārśvarukkaphanāśanāḥ
verses.tib: phye mar byas bza' 'am sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang sbyar te lde gur zos / skad 'gags lud pa / dbugs mi bde / zad byed rtsib logs bad kan 'joms

verses.skt: viśeṣāt svarasāde ’sya nasyadhūmādi yojayet | tatrāpi vātaje koṣṇaṃ pibed auttarabhaktikam
verses.tib: 'di yi skad 'gags la khyad par / sna sman dud pa rngub bya / de la'ang rlung las gyur pa la

verses.skt: kāsamardakavārtākīmārkavasvarasair ghṛtam | sādhitaṃ kāsajit svaryaṃ siddham ārtagalena vā
verses.tib: kas mar da brda ka / bring+ga ra dza'i khu ba mar / bskol ba'am arda ga la bskol / dro 'jam zos rjes la blud na / yud pa lu dang skad 'gags sel

verses.skt: badarīpattrakalkaṃ vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam | tailaṃ vā madhukadrākṣāpippalīkṛminutphalaiḥ
verses.tib: rgya shug lo ma'i lde gu ni / mar brngos rgyam tshar bcas pa'am / shing mngar dang ni pi pi ling / byi dang ga dang rgun 'brum dang

verses.skt: haṃsapadyāś ca mūlena pakvaṃ nasto niṣecayet | sukhodakānupānaṃ ca sasarpiṣkaṃ guḍaudanam
verses.tib: ha nas par+Ni'i rtsa ba rnams / til mar bskol ba snar blugs bya / 'bras chan mar dang bu ram bcas / zos na de rjes chu tshan btung

verses.skt: aśnīyāt pāyasaṃ caivaṃ snigdhaṃ svedaṃ niyojayet | pittodbhave pibet sarpiḥ śṛtaśītapayo'nupaḥ
verses.tib: 'o thug snum can blud pa dang / snum gyi dugs kyi cho ga bya / mkhris pa las gyur 'o ma'i shing / lde gu bskol ba'i zhun mar ni / sbrang rtsir bcas te de rjes ni

verses.skt: kṣīrivṛkṣāṅkurakvāthakalkasiddhaṃ samākṣikam | aśnīyāc ca sasarpiṣkaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukapāyasam
verses.tib: 'o ma bskol te bsgrangs pa blud / shing mngar ma du ka 'o thug / zhun mar bcas pa blud pa'am

verses.skt: balāvidārigandhābhyāṃ vidāryā madhukena ca | siddhaṃ salavaṇaṃ sarpir nasyaṃ svaryam anuttamam
verses.tib: ba la dri bzang bi da ri / shing mngar k+Shi ta bi da ri / rgyam tshar bcas pa bskol ba'i mar / skad 'gags sna sman bla med yin

verses.skt: prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ pippalī bṛhatī balā | sādhitaṃ kṣīrasarpiś ca tat svaryaṃ nāvanaṃ param
verses.tib: pra puN+Da rI ka shing mngar / pi pi ling dang bri ha ti / ba la 'o ma mar bskol te / skad 'gags pa yi sna sman mchog

verses.skt: lihyān madhurakāṇāṃ ca cūrṇaṃ madhughṛtāplutam | pibet kaṭūni mūtreṇa kaphaje rūkṣabhojanaḥ
verses.tib: mngar ba'i sde tshan phye ma ni / sbrang rtsi mar sbyar lde gu sbyin / bad kan las gyur tsha ba dang / zas rtsub ba gcin blud par bya

verses.skt: kaṭphalāmalakavyoṣaṃ lihyāt tailamadhuplutam | vyoṣakṣārāgnicavikābhārgīpathyāmadhūni vā
verses.tib: kad pha la dang skyu ru ra / tsha gsum til mar sbrang rtsir sbyar / ya bak+Sha ra tsha ba gsum / kru trug tres dang dbyi mong dang

verses.skt: yavair yavāgūṃ yamake kaṇādhātrīkṛtāṃ pibet | bhuktvādyāt pippalīṃ śuṇṭhīṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vā vamanaṃ bhajet
verses.tib: a ru ra dang sbrang rtsir sbyar / nas thug til mar zhun mar dang / pi pi ling dang skyu rur sbyar / bca' sga dang ni pi pi ling / bza' ba'am skyug sman rnon po bsten

verses.skt: śarkarākṣaudramiśrāṇi śṛtāni madhuraiḥ saha | pibet payāṃsi yasyoccair vadato ’bhihataḥ svaraḥ
verses.tib: sha kha ra dang sbrang rtsir bsres / mngar ba'i sman dang lhan cig bskol / 'o ma 'thung bas skang gsang ni / chen por smras pa'i 'gags nad sel

verses.skt: vicitram annam arucau hitair upahitaṃ hitam | bahirantarmṛjā cittanirvāṇaṃ hṛdyam auṣadham
verses.tib: yi ga 'chus la sna tshogs zas / phan pa'i sman dang sbyar ba sbyin / phyi dang nang ni sbyang ba dang / sems dga' yid dang mthun sman sbyin

verses.skt: dvau kālau dantapavanaṃ bhakṣayen mukhadhāvanaiḥ | kaṣāyaiḥ kṣālayed āsyaṃ dhūmaṃ prāyogikaṃ pibet
verses.tib: dus gnyis su ni so shing dag / bca' zhing kha ni sbyang bya zhing / bska bas kha ni bkru ba dang / rjes su mthun pa'i dud pa rngub

verses.skt: tālīśacūrṇavaṭakāḥ sakarpūrasitopalāḥ | śaśāṅkakiraṇākhyāś ca bhakṣyā rucikarāḥ param
verses.tib: da lis kyi ni ri lu dang / kha ra ga bur bcas pa sbyin / 'bras khu zla ba'i zer ltar dkar / bza' ba yi ga 'byed pa'i mchog

verses.skt: vātād arocake tatra pibec cūrṇaṃ prasannayā | hareṇukṛṣṇākṛmijiddrākṣāsaindhavanāgarāt
verses.tib: de las rlung 'gyur yi ga 'chus / ha re Nu dang pi pi ling / byi dang ga dang ra sna dang / rgyam tsha dang ni dong gra dang / sug smel ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang

verses.skt: elābhārgīyavakṣārahiṅguyuktād ghṛtena vā | chardayed vā vacāmbhobhiḥ pittāc ca guḍavāribhiḥ
verses.tib: shing kun bcas pa mar ram ni / chang gi dngas mar sbyar te btung / shu ngag chus ni slon du gzhug / mkhris gyur bu ram chus slon gzhug

verses.skt: lihyād vā śarkarāsarpirlavaṇottamamākṣikam | kaphād vamen nimbajalair dīpyakāragvadhodakam
verses.tib: kha ra dang ni zhun mar ram / rgyam tsha sbrang rtsir bcas pa sbyin / bad kan nim pa'i chus slon gzhug / la la phud dang dong gra'i chu

verses.skt: pānaṃ samadhvariṣṭāś ca tīkṣṇāḥ samadhumādhavāḥ | pibec cūrṇaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ hareṇvādyuṣṇavāriṇā
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi'am chang rnying rno sbyar ba / bu ram sbrang rtsi chang bcas blud / ha re Nu sogs phye ma ni / sngar bshad chu tshan sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: elātvaṅnāgakusumatīkṣṇakṛṣṇāmahauṣadham | bhāgavṛddhaṃ kramāc cūrṇaṃ nihanti samaśarkaram
verses.tib: sug smel dang ni shing tsha dang / nA ga pus pa na le sham / pi pi ling dang bca' sga rnams / rim bzhin cha res bskyed phye ma / kha ra dag dang mnyam sbyar bas

verses.skt: prasekārucihṛtpārśvakāsaśvāsagalāmayān | yavānītintiḍīkāmlavetasauṣadhadāḍimam
verses.tib: snying dang rtsib logs na lud pa / dbugs mi bde dang mgul nad 'joms / la la phud dang da trig dang / star bu bca' sga se'u 'bru dang

verses.skt: kṛtvā kolaṃ ca karṣāṃśaṃ sitāyāś ca catuḥpalam | dhānyasauvarcalājājīvarāṅgaṃ cārdhakārṣikam
verses.tib: rgya shug zho ni gnyis gnyis byas / kha ra srang bzhi 'u su dang / go snyod shing tsha kha ru tsha

verses.skt: pippalīnāṃ śataṃ caikaṃ dve śate maricasya ca | cūrṇam etat paraṃ rucyaṃ hṛdyaṃ grāhi hinasti ca
verses.tib: zho re pi pi ling 'bru brgya / na le sham ni nyis brgya dag / phyer btags yi ga 'byed pa'i mchog / yid 'ong phyis 'gags pa dang

verses.skt: vibandhakāsahṛtpārśvaplīhārśograhaṇīgadān | tālīśapattraṃ maricaṃ nāgaraṃ pippalī śubhā
verses.tib: lud pa snying ga rtsib logs na / mcher pa gzhang 'brum pho nad sel / bal bu'i lo man le sham / dong gra dang ni pi pi ling

verses.skt: yathottaraṃ bhāgavṛddhyā tvagele cārdhabhāgike | tad rucyaṃ dīpanaṃ cūrṇaṃ kaṇāṣṭaguṇaśarkaram
verses.tib: bzhin du cha res bskyed / shing tsha sug smel dang po'i phyed / pi pi ling gi brgyad 'gyur gyi / kha rar sbyar ba'i phye ma de / drod skyed yi ga 'byed pa dang

verses.skt: kāsaśvāsārucicchardiplīhahṛtpārśvaśūlanut | pāṇḍujvarātisāraghnaṃ mūḍhavātānulomanam
verses.tib: lud pa lu dang dbugs mi bde / yi ga 'chus dang slon bro dang / mcher pa snying nad rtsib logs zug / skya rbab tshad 'khru rims nad 'joms / rlung 'khyil ba ni bde rgyu byed

verses.skt: arkāmṛtākṣārajale śarvarīm uṣitair yavaiḥ | praseke kalpitān saktūn bhakṣyāṃś cādyād balī vamet
verses.tib: phye btags bu ram rnying pa ni / srang ni nyi shu lnga ni bskol / sbrus te zho gnyis tshad ri lu / byas pa'i yon tan de dang mnyam / arga sle tres k+Sha ra'i chur / nas dang nub gcig spangs nas ni / chu dang zan ni sbrus nas su / byin te nyams stobs ldan slon gzhug

verses.skt: kaṭutiktais tathā śūlyaṃ bhakṣayej jāṅgalaṃ palam | śuṣkāṃś ca bhakṣyān sulaghūṃś caṇakādirasānupaḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin skam sa'i srog chags sha / bsregs pa kha dang tsha sbyar sbyin / zas ni skam zhing rab yang dang / tsa na ka sogs khu ba blud

verses.skt: śleṣmaṇo ’tiprasekena vāyuḥ śleṣmāṇam asyati | kaphaprasekaṃ taṃ vidvān snigdhoṣṇair eva nirjayet
verses.tib: bad kan gyis rab mchil ma mang / rlung gis mchil mang skyed par byed / de ni bad kan mchil mar bshad / snum dang dro bas de bsal bya

verses.skt: pīnase ’pi kramam imaṃ vamathau ca prayojayet | viśeṣāt pīnase ’bhyaṅgān snehān svedāṃś ca śīlayet
verses.tib: rims 'di cham pa dag dang ni / slon pa'i nad la'ang sbyar bar bya / mchog tu cham par bsku ba dang / snum dang dugs kyi cho ga bstan

verses.skt: snigdhān utkārikāpiṇḍaiḥ śiraḥpārśvagalādiṣu | lavaṇāmlakaṭūṣṇāṃś ca rasān snehopasaṃhitān
verses.tib: mgo dang lkog ma rtsib logs su / 'bras khur snum bcas dugs bya zhing / lan tshwa skyur dang kha dang tsha / sha khu snum dang bcas pa sbyin

verses.skt: śiro'ṃsapārśvaśūleṣu yathādoṣavidhiṃ caret | audakānūpapiśitair upanāhāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ
verses.tib: mgo bo snying ga rtsib logs gzer / nad gzhi ji bzhin gso bar bya / chu dang rlan can gnas pa'i sha / legs sbyar dkri ba'i dugs bya zhing

verses.skt: tatreṣṭāḥ sacatuḥsnehā doṣasaṃsarga iṣyate | pralepo natayaṣṭyāhvaśatāhvākuṣṭhacandanaiḥ
verses.tib: de nas snum bzhi'i sbyor ba bsngags / nad gzhi 'dres bar gyur pa la

verses.skt: balārāsnātilais tadvat sasarpirmadhukotpalaiḥ | punarnavākṛṣṇagandhābalāvīrāvidāribhiḥ
verses.tib: rgya spos shing mngar shu ti dang / tsan+dan mar gyi lde gus byug / pa la ra sna til mar dang / shing mngar ut+pal mar de bzhin

verses.skt: nāvanaṃ dhūmapānāni snehāś cauttarabhaktikāḥ | tailāny abhyaṅgayogīni vastikarma tathā param
verses.tib: ba spru ba dang shi kru dang / ba la ra mnye bid ri / sna sman dud pa rngub pa dang / zas zos 'og tu snum bsten zhing

verses.skt: śṛṅgādyair vā yathādoṣaṃ duṣṭam eṣāṃ hared asṛk | pradehaḥ saghṛtaiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ padmakośīracandanaiḥ
verses.tib: til mar gyis ni bsku ba dang / de bzhin 'jam rtsi'i las rab bsngags / yang na rngabs rwa la sogs pas / nad dmigs ji bzhin nad khrag dbyung

verses.skt: dūrvāmadhukamañjiṣṭhākesarair vā ghṛtāplutaiḥ | vaṭādisiddhatailena śatadhautena sarpiṣā
verses.tib: shug pa tsan+dan pu shel tse / mar bcas lde gus bsku ba'am / dUr ba shing mngar btsod dang ni / nA ga ge sar mar sbyar bsku / n+ya gro d+ha sogs bskol til mar / lan brgya bkrus pa'i mar gyis ni

verses.skt: abhyaṅgaḥ payasā sekaḥ śastaś ca madhukāmbunā | prāyeṇopahatāgnitvāt sapiccham atisāryate
verses.tib: bsku ba'am 'o ma shing mngar chus / blugs par gyur pa'ang bsngags pa yin / phal cher me drod nyams pa'i phyir / ma zhu be snabs bcas 'khru na

verses.skt: tasyātīsāragrahaṇīvihitaṃ hitam auṣadham | purīṣaṃ yatnato rakṣec chuṣyato rājayakṣmiṇaḥ
verses.tib: de la pho ba'i tshad 'khru ba'i / skabs su / bshad pa'i sman bsten phan / zad byed ldan pa'i bshang ba ni / rnam pa kun tu bsrung bya ste

verses.skt: sarvadhātukṣayārtasya balaṃ tasya hi viḍbalam | māṃsam evāśnato yuktyā mārdvīkaṃ pibato ’nu ca
verses.tib: de yi lus zungs kun zad pas / de stobs bshad pa'i stobs kyis gnas / rig pas sha rnams kho na sbyin / skom du rgun chang blud par bya

verses.skt: avidhāritavegasya yakṣmā na labhate ’ntaram | surāṃ samaṇḍāṃ mārdvīkam ariṣṭān sīdhumādhavān
verses.tib: shugs ni bkag par gyur pa yis / gcong chen gyis ni glags mi rnyed / chang dang chang dngas rgun chang dang / chang rnying bu ram sbrang chang dang

verses.skt: yathārham anupānārthaṃ piben māṃsāni bhakṣayan | srotovibandhamokṣārthaṃ balaujaḥpuṣṭaye ca tat
verses.tib: ci rigs par ni blud pa dang / sha ni sbyin pa nyid du bya / bu ga'i rgyun 'gags dag phyir dang / stobs dang mdangs ni rgyas bya'i phyir

verses.skt: snehakṣīrāmbukoṣṭheṣu svabhyaktam avagāhayet | uttīrṇaṃ miśrakaiḥ snehair bhūyo ’bhyaktaṃ sukhaiḥ karaiḥ
verses.tib: snum dang 'o ma chus gang ba'i / snod du lus ni 'bying bar bya / phyung nas bsres pa'i snum gyis ni / bsku zhing lag pas bde bar mnye

verses.skt: mṛdnīyāt sukham āsīnaṃ sukhaṃ codvartayet param | jīvantīṃ śatavīryāṃ ca vikasāṃ sapunarnavām
verses.tib: bde bar 'dug par gyur pa la / dal gyis lde gus dril bar bya / dzi ban ti dang dUr ba dang

verses.skt: aśvagandhām apāmārgaṃ tarkārīṃ madhukaṃ balām | vidārīṃ sarṣapān kuṣṭhaṃ taṇḍulān atasīphalam
verses.tib: btsod dang a shwa gan+d+ha dang / a pa marga ba spru ba / ag ni man ti shing mngar dang / ba la yungs kar bid ri / ru rta 'bras dang zar ma dang

verses.skt: māṣāṃs tilāṃś ca kiṇvaṃ ca sarvam ekatra cūrṇayet | yavacūrṇaṃ triguṇitaṃ dadhnā yuktaṃ samākṣikam
verses.tib: mon sran gre'u gnyis til dang phabs / thams cad gcig tu btags nas ni / nas kyi phye ni sum 'gyur dang / zho dang sbrang rtsi lhan cig sbyar

verses.skt: etad udvartanaṃ kāryaṃ puṣṭivarṇabalapradam | gaurasarṣapakalkena snānīyauṣadhibhiś ca saḥ
verses.tib: 'di dag gis ni dril phyis bya / sha rgyas mdog bzang stobs skyed byed / yungs kar ser po'i lde gu dang / 'tsho byed sde tshan dang sbyar ba

verses.skt: snāyād ṛtusukhais toyair jīvanīyopasādhitaiḥ | gandhamālyādikāṃ bhūṣām alakṣmīnāśanīṃ bhajet
verses.tib: khrus kyi sman gyis khrus bya zhing / dus tshigs bde ba'i chus khrus bya / dri dang phreng ba sogs pas brgyan / bkra mi shis pa 'jigs pa bstan

verses.skt: suhṛdāṃ darśanaṃ gītavāditrotsavasaṃśrutiḥ | vastayaḥ kṣīrasarpīṃṣi madyamāṃsasuśīlatā
verses.tib: mdza' bshes blta zhing glu dang ni / rol mo mnyan zhing dga' ston bya / 'jam rtsi 'o ma zhun mar dang / sha dang chang bsten tshul la gnas

verses.skt: daivavyapāśrayaṃ tat tad atharvoktaṃ ca pūjitam
verses.tib: lha la brten pa'i cho ga dang / mchod pa'i las la brtson par bya

verses.skt: āmāśayotkleśabhavāḥ prāyaś chardyo hitaṃ tataḥ | laṅghanaṃ prāg ṛte vāyor vamanaṃ tatra yojayet
verses.tib: slon nad phal cher ma zhu ba'i / gnas 'khrugs las byung de yi phyir / rlung ma gtogs la dang por ni / smyung byas skyug sman gtang ba phan

verses.skt: balino bahudoṣasya vamataḥ pratataṃ bahu | tato virekaṃ kramaśo hṛdyaṃ madyaiḥ phalāmbubhiḥ
verses.tib: stobs ldan rgyun tu slon gyur cing / nad mang 'gyur la gtang bar bya / de 'og rim gyis bkru sman ni / yid 'ong chang rgun chu sogs sam

verses.skt: kṣīrair vā saha sa hy ūrdhvaṃ gataṃ doṣaṃ nayaty adhaḥ | śamanaṃ cauṣadhaṃ rūkṣadurbalasya tad eva tu
verses.tib: 'o mas btang gyur de mod la / gyen 'byung nad ni thur du 'byung / zhi ba'i sman ni rtsub pa ste / nyam chung ba yang de nyid bya

verses.skt: pariśuṣkaṃ priyaṃ sātmyam annaṃ laghu ca śasyate | upavāsas tathā yūṣā rasāḥ kāmbalikāḥ khalāḥ
verses.tib: zas ni skam zhing yi gar 'ong / goms shing yang ba bsngags pa yin / de bzhin smyung ba yu sha dang / sha khu 'ba' cha skam pa la

verses.skt: śākāni lehā bhojyāni rāgaṣāḍavapānakāḥ | bhakṣyāḥ śuṣkā vicitrāś ca phalāni snānagharṣaṇam
verses.tib: tshod ma lde gu bza' ba dang / btung ba dri pa na ka / ro drug zas skom sna tshogs dang / 'bras bu 'khrus dang mnye ba dang

verses.skt: gandhāḥ sugandhayo gandhaphalapuṣpānnapānajāḥ | bhuktamātrasya sahasā mukhe śītāmbusecanam
verses.tib: dri zhim 'bras bu me tog skyes / zas dang skom la spyod pa dang / zos ma thag tu 'phral du ni / chu grang gis ni gdong bkru bya

verses.skt: hanti mārutajāṃ chardiṃ sarpiḥ pītaṃ sasaindhavam | kiñciduṣṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa sakāsahṛdayadravām
verses.tib: rlung las gyur pa'i slon pa'i nad / rgyam tsha mar bcas dro ba'am / tsha gsum lan tshwa gsum sbyar bas / lud pa dang ni snying 'dzag dang / bcas pa sel bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: vyoṣatrilavaṇāḍhyaṃ vā siddhaṃ vā dāḍimāmbunā | saśuṇṭhīdadhidhānyena śṛtaṃ tulyāmbu vā payaḥ
verses.tib: se 'bru'i khu ba bca' sga dang / 'u su zho dang mar bskol ba'am / chu dang 'o ma cha mnyam pa / khron gyi zas tshol sha khu ni

verses.skt: vyaktasaindhavasarpir vā phalāmlo vaiṣkiro rasaḥ | snigdhaṃ ca bhojanaṃ śuṇṭhīdadhidāḍimasādhitam
verses.tib: 'bras skyur rgyam tsha mar shas che / kha zas snum po bca' sga dang / zho dang se 'brur sbyar ba'am / rgyam tshar bcas pa dro 'jam phan

verses.skt: koṣṇaṃ salavaṇaṃ cātra hitaṃ snehavirecanam | pittajāyāṃ virekārthaṃ drākṣekṣusvarasais trivṛt
verses.tib: 'dir ni bkru sman lan tshwa dang / snum dang dro bar bcas pa phan / mkhris pa las byung bkru sman phyir / rgun 'brum bu ram shing khu dang / dur bying sbyar ba'i bkru sman btab

verses.skt: sarpir vā tailvakaṃ yojyaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca śleṣmadhāmagam | ūrdhvam eva haret pittaṃ svādutiktair viśuddhimān
verses.tib: zhun mar seng phrom sbyar ba gtang / 'phel te bad kan gnas khyab pa'i / mkhris par mngar dang khab yis / gyen du drangs la dag gyur nas

verses.skt: piben manthaṃ yavāgūṃ vā lājaiḥ samadhuśarkarām | mudgajāṅgalajair adyād vyañjanaiḥ śāliṣaṣṭikam
verses.tib: 'bras yos khar bcas pa las / skyo ma'am nas thug blud par bya / sA lu drug cug ba yi chan / skam sa'i sha khu mung+ga'i khu

verses.skt: mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭaprabhavaṃ suśītaṃ salilaṃ pibet | mudgośīrakaṇādhānyaiḥ saha vā saṃsthitaṃ niśām
verses.tib: so phag bsregs te chu nang gsur / shin tu bsgrangs pa'i chu blud pa'am / mung+ga 'u su pu shel tse / pi pi ling dang nub gcig sbangs

verses.skt: drākṣārasaṃ rasaṃ vekṣor guḍūcyambu payo ’pi vā | jambvāmrapallavośīravaṭaśuṅgāvarohajaḥ
verses.tib: yang na rgun chu bu ram shing / sle tres chu mang 'o ma blud / 'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma dang / u shir n+ya gro d+ha'i myu gu

verses.skt: kvāthaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ pītaḥ śīto vā viniyacchati | chardiṃ jvaram atīsāraṃ mūrchāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca durjayām
verses.tib: bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi ni / btab ste blugs na / slon pa dang / rims dang tshad 'khru brgyal ba dang / skom dad che ba mi bzad sel

verses.skt: dhātrīrasena vā śītaṃ piben mudgadalāmbu vā | kolamajjasitālājāmakṣikāviṭkaṇāñjanam
verses.tib: skyu ru ra'i khu tsan+dan bcas / mung+ga ba la'i chu blud phan / rgya shug tshi gu khar dkar / 'bras yos spra tshil pi pi ling

verses.skt: lihyāt kṣaudreṇa pathyāṃ vā drākṣāṃ vā badarāṇi vā | kaphajāyāṃ vamen nimbakṛṣṇāpiṇḍītasarṣapaiḥ
verses.tib: dngul rdo sbrang rtsi'am a ru ra / rgun 'bru'am rgya shug dang sbyar phan / bad kan las gyur nim pa dang / pi pi ling dang po son cha

verses.skt: yuktena koṣṇatoyena durbalaṃ copavāsayet | āragvadhādiniryūhaṃ śītaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibet
verses.tib: yungs kar chu dron gyis slon bya / nyam chung ba la smyung ba bya / dong gal khu ba bskol / bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud

verses.skt: manthān yavair vā bahuśaś chardighnauṣadhabhāvitaiḥ | kaphaghnam annaṃ hṛdyaṃ ca rāgāḥ sārjakabhūstṛṇāḥ
verses.tib: nas kyi skyo ma slon 'joms pa'i / sman mang dang ni sbyar ba blud / bad kan 'joms zas yi gar 'ong / btung ba zin thig bu srin

verses.skt: līḍhaṃ manaḥśilākṛṣṇāmaricaṃ bījapūrakāt | svarasena kapitthasya sakṣaudreṇa vamiṃ jayet
verses.tib: ldong ros dang ni pi pi ling / na le sham ni skyur rtsi che / ka pid ta yi khu ba dang / sbrang rtsir bcas pas slon nad sel

verses.skt: khādet kapitthaṃ savyoṣaṃ madhunā vā durālabhām | lihyān maricacocailāgośakṛdrasamākṣikam
verses.tib: ka pid ta dang tsha ba gsum / phyi tshor sbrang rtsir sbyar ba sbyin

verses.skt: anukūlopacāreṇa yāti dviṣṭārthajā śamam | kṛmijā kṛmihṛdrogagaditaiś ca bhiṣagjitaiḥ
verses.tib: mthun pa'i spyod pa byas pa yis / mi sdug yul mthong las byung sel / srin bu las byung srin bu yi / sman du bshad pa rnams kyis gso / lhag ma nad dmigs ji bzhin du / de zhi 'gyur ba'i dpyad kyis gso

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ pariśeṣāś ca tatkṛtāś ca tathāmayāḥ
verses.tib: mthun pa'i spyod pa byas pa yis / mi sdug yul mthong las byung sel / srin bu las byung srin bu yi / sman du bshad pa rnams kyis gso / lhag ma nad dmigs ji bzhin du / de zhi 'gyur ba'i dpyad kyis gso

verses.skt: chardiprasaṅgena hi mātariśvā dhātukṣayāt kopam upaity avaśyam | kuryād ato ’smin vamanātiyogaproktaṃ vidhiṃ stambhanabṛṃhaṇīyam
verses.tib: slon pa'i skabs su rlung gi nad rnams ni / lus zungs zad pas nges par ldang gyur te / de bas 'dir ni skyug sman sbyor drags pa'i / skabs bshad bcad dang brta ba'i cho ga bya

verses.skt: sarpirguḍā māṃsarasā ghṛtāni kalyāṇakatryūṣaṇajīvanāni | payāṃsi pathyopahitāni lehāś chardiṃ prasaktāṃ praśamaṃ nayanti
verses.tib: bu ram zhun mar sha khu dge ba che / tsha ba gsum dang 'tsho byed sman mar dang / 'o thug dang ni phan pa'i lde gu yis / rgyun du slon pa zhi ba nyid du bya

verses.skt: iti chardicikitsitam atha hṛdrogacikitsitam
hṛdroge vātaje tailaṃ mastusauvīratakravat
verses.tib: snying nad rlung gyur til mar ni

verses.skt: tailaṃ ca lavaṇaiḥ siddhaṃ samūtrāmlaṃ tathāguṇam | pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ saviḍaṃ gulmānāhārtijic ca tat | tailaṃ ca lavaṇaiḥ siddhaṃ samūtrāmlaṃ tathāguṇam
verses.tib: skyur rtsab dang ba zho ga chu / ldan pa tsha can dro 'jam blud / des ni lto sbos skran yang 'joms / til mar lan tshwar bcas dang skyur / ba gcin bskol ba'ang de dang mtshungs

verses.skt: bilvaṃ rāsnāṃ yavān kolaṃ devadāruṃ punarnavām | kulatthān pañcamūlaṃ ca paktvā tasmin pacej jale
verses.tib: bil ba ra sna rgya shug nas / thang shing dang ni ba spu ba / rgya sran rtsa ba lnga pa rnams / bskol ba'i chu der til mar ni

verses.skt: tailaṃ tan nāvane pāne vastau ca viniyojayet | śuṇṭhīvayaḥsthālavaṇakāyasthāhiṅgupauṣkaraiḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba de ni snar btang dang / btung dang 'jam rtsir gtang bar bya / bca' sga rgyam tsha byi'u rug pa / sle tres shing kun ma nu dang

verses.skt: pathyayā ca śṛtaṃ pārśvahṛdrujāgulmajid ghṛtam | sauvarcalasya dvipale pathyāpañcāśadanvite
verses.tib: a ru ra dang mar bskol ba / snying nad rtsib logs gzer skran 'joms / kha ru tsha ni srang / gnyis dang / a ru ra ni lnga bcu dang

verses.skt: ghṛtasya sādhitaḥ prastho hṛdrogaśvāsagulmajit | dāḍimaṃ kṛṣṇalavaṇaṃ śuṇṭhīhiṅgvamlavetasam
verses.tib: zhun mar bre gang bskol rtsib logs / snying nad skran dbugs mi bde sel / se 'bru bca' sga kha ru tsha / shing kun star bu phye mar sbyar

verses.skt: apatantrakahṛdrogaśvāsaghnaṃ cūrṇam uttamam | puṣkarāhvaśaṭhīśuṇṭhībījapūrajaṭābhayāḥ
verses.tib: rlung nad gzhan dbang can snying nad / dbugs mi bde ba sel mchog yin / ma nu zur pa bca' sga dang

verses.skt: pītāḥ kalkīkṛtāḥ kṣāraghṛtāmlalavaṇair yutāḥ | vikartikāśūlaharāḥ kvāthaḥ koṣṇaś ca tadguṇaḥ
verses.tib: skyur rtsi che rtsa a ru ra'i / lde gu ya bak+Sha ra dang / mngar skyur lan tshwa ldan pa 'thungs / bcad snyam sems pa'i gzer 'joms byed

verses.skt: yavānīlavaṇakṣāravacājājyauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ | sapūtidārubījāhvapalāśaśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ
verses.tib: rgyam tshal la phud k+Sha ra / shu dag go snyod bca' sga dang / thang shing sgyur rtsi chen po dang / zur pa ma nu pa la sha

verses.skt: yavakṣāro yavānī ca pibed uṣṇena vāriṇā | etena vātajaṃ śūlaṃ gulmaṃ caiva cirotthitam
verses.tib: bu ram ma nu skyur rtsi che / chang btags lde gu mar til mar / brngos te rgyam tshar ldan 'thungs na

verses.skt: bhidyate saptarātreṇa pavanena yathā ghanaḥ || 33+(1™)ab || pañcakolaśaṭhīpathyāguḍabījāhvapauṣkaram | vāruṇīkalkitaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ yamake lavaṇānvitam
hṛtpārśvayoniśūleṣu khāded gulmodareṣu ca | snigdhāś ceha hitāḥ svedāḥ saṃskṛtāni ghṛtāni ca
verses.tib: snying nad rtsib logs mo mtshan zug / skran dang dmu rdzing nad rnam sel / 'di la snum gyi dugs phan zhing / sman mar gyi ni sbyor ba phan

verses.skt: laghunā pañcamūlena śuṇṭhyā vā sādhitaṃ jalam | vāruṇīdadhimaṇḍaṃ vā dhānyāmlaṃ vā pibet tṛṣi
verses.tib: skom la rtsa ba chung ngu lnga'am / bca' sga dang ni bskol ba'i chu'am / chang gi dngas ma zho ga chu / 'bras bu'i rang skyur blud par bya

verses.skt: sāyāmastambhaśūlāme hṛdi mārutadūṣite | kriyaiṣā sadravāyāmapramohe tu hitā rasāḥ
verses.tib: bya rmyang rengs gzer ma zhur bcas / snying la rlung gis gnod gyur la / bya ba 'di bya snying 'dzag cing

verses.skt: snehāḍhyās tittirikrauñcaśikhivartakadakṣajāḥ | balātailaṃ sahṛdrogaḥ pibed vā sukumārakam
verses.tib: 'phar dang gcin snyi bcas pa la / sreg pa khrung khrung rma bya dang / dgo ba khyim bya snum mang phan / snying nad can la ba la'i mar / yang na skyid de ba'i mar blud

verses.skt: yaṣṭyāhvaśatapākaṃ vā mahāsnehaṃ tathottamam | rāsnājīvakajīvantībalāvyāghrīpunarnavaiḥ
verses.tib: shing mngar lan brgyar btsos pa'am / de bzhin snum chen mchog tu phan / ra sna 'tsho byed dzi ba ni ti / ba la bya kri ba spru ba

verses.skt: bhārgīsthirāvacāvyoṣair mahāsnehaṃ vipācayet | dadhipādaṃ tathāmlaiś ca lābhataḥ sa niṣevitaḥ
verses.tib: ga bra'i rtsa ba tir dang / shu dag tsha ba gsum dang ni / snum chen zhes bya bskol bar bya / zho ni bzhi cha de bzhin skyur / ji snyed pa las sbyar ba bsten

verses.skt: tarpaṇo bṛṃhaṇo balyo vātahṛdroganāśanaḥ | dīpte ’gnau sadravāyāme hṛdroge vātike hitam
verses.tib: tshim byed brtas byed stobs skyed cing / rlung gi snying nad 'joms pa yin / snying nad drod che 'phar ba dang / rlung las gyur ba'i snying nad la

verses.skt: kṣīraṃ dadhi guḍaḥ sarpir audakānūpam āmiṣam | etāny eva ca varjyāni hṛdrogeṣu caturṣv api
verses.tib: 'o ma zho dang bu ram mar / chu dang rlan can sha ngag phan / 'di ma gtogs pa'i snying gi nad / bzhi po dag la spang bar bya

verses.skt: śeṣeṣu stambhajāḍyāmasaṃyukte ’pi ca vātike | kaphānubandhe tasmiṃs tu rūkṣoṣṇām ācaret kriyām
verses.tib: rlung can / rengs dang be'u snabs can / tshor med lhag ma rnams la'ang spang / bad kan 'dres gyur de la ni / rtsub drod bshad pa'i bya ba bya

verses.skt: paitte drākṣekṣuniryāsasitākṣaudraparūṣakaiḥ | yukto vireko hṛdyaḥ syāt kramaḥ śuddhe ca pittahā
verses.tib: mkhris gyur rgun chu bu ram chu / kha ru sbrang rtsi pa ru shar / ldan pa'i bkru sman yid 'ong bas / sbyangs la mkhris sel rim pa bya

verses.skt: kṣatapittajvaroktaṃ ca bāhyāntaḥ parimārjanam | kaṭvīmadhukakalkaṃ ca pibet sasitam ambhasā
verses.tib: glo rdol rims kyi mkhris skabs bshad / phyi nang gi ni sbyang ba bya / pu shel tse dang shing mngar btags / kha rar bcas pa'i chu blud bya

verses.skt: śreyasīśarkarādrākṣājīvakarṣabhakotpalaiḥ | balākharjūrakākolīmedāyugmaiś ca sādhitam
verses.tib: ra sna khar rgun 'brum dang / 'tsho byed ut+pal zangs rtsi ba / ba la 'bra go ra mnye ba / me da gnyis dang ma he'u mar

verses.skt: sakṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ sarpiḥ pittahṛdroganāśanam | prapauṇḍarīkamadhukabisagranthikaserukāḥ
verses.tib: 'o mar bcas pa bskol ba ni / mkhris gyur snying nad sel byed yin / shing mngar ba spru puN+Da rI / pad+ma'i rtsa ba ka she ru

verses.skt: saśuṇṭhīśaivalās tābhiḥ sakṣīraṃ vipaced ghṛtam | śītaṃ samadhu tac ceṣṭaṃ svāduvargakṛtaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: bca' sga ba lar bcas de dang / 'o mar bcas dang bca' sgar bskol / bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi btab pa dang / mngar ba'i sde tshan bsdus pa'ang bsngags

verses.skt: vastiṃ ca dadyāt sakṣaudraṃ tailaṃ madhukasādhitam | kaphodbhave vamet svinnaḥ picumandavacāmbhasā
verses.tib: til mar shing mngar bcas bskol zhing / sbrang rtsi btab pa'i 'jam rtsi'ang phan / bad kan las gyur dugs byas la / nim pa shu dag chu yis slon

verses.skt: kulatthadhanvottharasatīkṣṇamadyayavāśanaḥ | pibec cūrṇaṃ vacāhiṅgulavaṇadvayanāgarāt
verses.tib: rgya sran khu ba rgyam tsho'i chu / chang rno blud cing nas zan sbyin / shu dag shing kun lan tshwa gnyis / dong gra sug smel la la phud

verses.skt: sailāyavānakakaṇāyavakṣārāt sukhāmbunā | phaladhānyāmlakaulatthayūṣamūtrāsavais tathā
verses.tib: nas tshig 'khus thal pi pi ling / phye ma dro 'jam chu blud pa'am / 'bras bu'i chu'am rang skyur ram / rgya sran ba gcin chang rnying blud

verses.skt: puṣkarāhvābhayāśuṇṭhīśaṭhīrāsnāvacākaṇāt | kvāthaṃ tathābhayāśuṇṭhīmādrīpītadrukaṭphalāt
verses.tib: ma nu bca' sga a ru ra / zur pa ra sna pi pi ling / shu dag bskol te blud pa'am / de bzhin bca' sga a ru ra / bong nga dkar po yung ba dang / kad pa la ni bskol ba'am

verses.skt: kvāthe rohītakāśvatthakhadirodumbarārjune | sapalāśavaṭe vyoṣatrivṛccūrṇānvite kṛtaḥ
verses.tib: ro hi ta ka a shwad tha / seng ldeng u dum bA ra dang / ardzu na dang pa la sha / n+ya gro d+ha bskol tsha ba gsum / dur byid phye mar bcas lde gu

verses.skt: sukhodakānupānaś ca lehaḥ kaphavikārahā | śleṣmagulmoditājyāni kṣārāṃś ca vividhān pibet
verses.tib: zos te chu tshan rjes 'thungs na / bad kan snying nad sel byed yin / bad kan skran skabs bshad mar dang / k+Sha ra sna tshogs blud par bya

verses.skt: prayojayec chilāhvaṃ vā brāhmaṃ vātra rasāyanam | tathāmalakalehaṃ vā prāśaṃ vāgastyanirmitam
verses.tib: yang na brag zhun bcud len dang / tshangs pa'i bcud len skyu ru ra'i / lde gu'am ri byis bshad pa'am / bdud rtsi'i mar ni 'di sbyar bya

verses.skt: syāc chūlaṃ yasya bhukte ’ti jīryaty alpaṃ jarāṃ gate | śāmyet sa kuṣṭhakṛmijillavaṇadvayatilvakaiḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig zan zos gzer gyis / 'debs / zas zhu gyur nas zhi gyur pa / de la ru rta byi dang ga / lan tshwa gnyis dang seng phrom dang

verses.skt: sadevadārvativiṣaiś cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā pibet | yasya jīrṇe ’dhikaṃ snehaiḥ sa virecyaḥ phalaiḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: thang shing bong dkar por bcas / phye ma chu bskol dro sbyar blud / gang zhig zhu nas cher gzer ba / de la snum gyi bkru sman ni

verses.skt: jīryaty anne tathā mūlais tīkṣṇaiḥ śūle sadādhike | prāyo ’nilo ruddhagatiḥ kupyaty āmāśaye gataḥ
verses.tib: 'bras bu dang ni de bzhin du / rtsa ba'i bkru sman sbyin par bya / phal cher rlung ni lam 'gags pa / ma zhu'i gnas su 'khru bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tasyānulomanaṃ kāryaṃ śuddhilaṅghanapācanaiḥ | kṛmighnam auṣadhaṃ sarvaṃ kṛmije hṛdayāmaye
verses.tib: de la smyung dang smin pa dang / sbyang bas bde bar rgyu bar bya / 'bu 'joms pa yi sman kun gyis / 'bu yi snying nad gso bar bya

verses.skt: tṛṣṇāsu vātapittaghno vidhiḥ prāyeṇa śasyate | sarvāsu śīto bāhyāntas tathā śamanaśodhanaḥ
verses.tib: skom dad rlung dang mkhris pa 'joms / cho ga phal cher bsngags pa yin / kun la phyi nang bsil ba dang / de bzhin zhi dang sbyang bar bya

verses.skt: divyāmbu śītaṃ sakṣaudraṃ tadvad bhaumaṃ ca tadguṇam | nirvāpitaṃ taptaloṣṭakapālasikatādibhiḥ
verses.tib: char chu grang mo sbrang rtsir bcas / sa chu'i yon tan de ldan bsngags / bong ba rdza skyogs bye ma'am / gshag ma bsreg bcug dngas mar bcas

verses.skt: saśarkaraṃ vā kvathitaṃ pañcamūlena vā jalam | darbhapūrveṇa manthaś ca praśasto lājasaktubhiḥ
verses.tib: bskol te kha rar bcas pa'am / dUr ba la rtsa ba lnga / bskol te kha ra btab pa'am / 'bras yos phyer sbyar skyo ma'ang bsngags

verses.skt: vāṭyaś cāmayavaiḥ śītaḥ śarkarāmākṣikānvitaḥ | yavāgūḥ śālibhis tadvat kodravaiś ca cirantanaiḥ
verses.tib: nas rjen chag tshe sbrang rtsi dang / kha ra btab pa grang mo'ang phan / de bzhin nas thug sA lu dang / ko tra pa ni rnying pa ni

verses.skt: śītena śītavīryaiś ca dravyaiḥ siddhena bhojanam | himāmbupariṣiktasya payasā sasitāmadhu
verses.tib: 'o ma bsil zhing nus bsil ba'i / sman dang bskol ba'i kha zas ni / nad pa chu grang gis bkrus nas / kha ra sbrang rtsi sbyin pa bsngags

verses.skt: rasaiś cānamlalavaṇair jāṅgalair ghṛtabharjitaiḥ | mudgādīnāṃ tathā yūṣair jīvanīyarasānvitaiḥ
verses.tib: skam sa'i sha khu lan tshwa skyur / med cing mar dang brngos pa yang / de bzhin mung+ga khu ba / 'tsho byed sde tshan khu bar bcas

verses.skt: nasyaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ śītair ikṣos tathā rasaḥ | nirvāpaṇāś ca gaṇḍūṣāḥ sūtrasthānoditā hitāḥ
verses.tib: sna sman 'o ma mar bsil sman / bskol ba'am bu ram shing khu phan / skom sel mkhur ba bkang nas ni / mdog nas las bshad byas pa'ang phan

verses.skt: dāhajvaroktā lepādyā nirīhatvaṃ manoratiḥ | mahāsariddhradādīnāṃ darśanasmaraṇāni ca
verses.tib: tsha rims bshad pa'i lde gu sogs / rtsol ba chung zhing sems dga' dang / chu bo mtsho ni chen po / dran pa dang ni mthong ba phan

verses.skt: tṛṣṇāyāṃ pavanotthāyāṃ saguḍaṃ dadhi śasyate | rasāś ca bṛṃhaṇāḥ śītā vidāryādigaṇāmbu ca
verses.tib: skom dad rlung las gyur pa las / zho ni bu ram bcas pa bsngags / sha khus nyams brtas bid ri / te bskol nas bsgrangs pa phan

verses.skt: pittajāyāṃ sitāyuktaḥ pakvodumbarajo rasaḥ | tatkvātho vā himas tadvac chārivādigaṇāmbu vā
verses.tib: mkhris gyur u dum bA ra smin / khu bar kha ra btab pa phan / yang na de bskol bsgrangs / pa'am / sha ri bsde tshan chu

verses.skt: tadvidhaiś ca gaṇaiḥ śītakaṣāyān sasitāmadhūn | madhurair auṣadhais tadvat kṣīrivṛkṣaiś ca kalpitān
verses.tib: sde tshan de 'dra bskol khu ba / bsgrangs ba kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas / mngar ba'i sman gyi sde tshan dang / 'o ma can shing bskol de bzhin

verses.skt: bījapūrakamṛdvīkāvaṭavetasapallavān | mūlāni kuśakāśānāṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ ca jale śṛtam
verses.tib: bi dza bur rgun 'brum dang / lcang ma n+ya gro d+ha'i lo ma / ku sha 'jag ma'i rtsa ba dang / shing mngar chu ni bskol ba'ang phan

verses.skt: jvaroditaṃ vā drākṣādi pañcasārāmbu vā pibet | kaphodbhavāyāṃ vamanaṃ nimbaprasavavāriṇā
verses.tib: rims la phan sman rgun 'brum / snying po lnga yi chu blud phan / bad kan las gyur nim pa ni / chu mchog bskol bas slon du gzhug

verses.skt: bilvāḍhakīpañcakoladarbhapañcakasādhitam | jalaṃ pibed rajanyā vā siddhaṃ sakṣaudraśarkaram
verses.tib: bil ba 'u su tsha ba lnga / 'jag ma kru trug tres bskol blud / yang na skyer ba chu bskol la / kha ra sbrang rtsi btab pa blud

verses.skt: mudgayūṣaṃ ca savyoṣapaṭolīnimbapallavam | yavānnaṃ tīkṣṇakavaḍanasyalehāṃś ca śīlayet
verses.tib: mung+ga'i khu ba pa to la / nim pa'i lo ma tsha gsum bcas / nas zan mkhur bkang rnon po dang

verses.skt: sarvair āmāc ca tad dhantrī kriyeṣṭā vamanaṃ tathā | tryūṣaṇāruṣkaravacāphalāmloṣṇāmbumastubhiḥ
verses.tib: sna sman lde gu rnon po'ang bsten / nyes kun ma zhu des 'joms pas / de bzhin slon gyi bya ba'ang bsngags / go bye shu dag cha ba gsum / 'bras bu skyur pa'am chu tshan nam / zho ga chu dang btung ba bsngags

verses.skt: annātyayān maṇḍam uṣṇaṃ himaṃ manthaṃ ca kālavit | tṛṣi śramān māṃsarasaṃ manthaṃ vā sasitaṃ pibet
verses.tib: zas kyi nyes 'byung dus shes pas / thug sla'am skyo ma bsil ba blud / ngal bas skom la sha khu'am / skyo ma kha rar bcas pa blud

verses.skt: ātapāt sasitaṃ manthaṃ yavakolajasaktubhiḥ | sarvāṇy aṅgāni limpec ca tilapiṇyākakāñjikaiḥ
verses.tib: tsha bas bskol la kha rar bcas / nas dang rgya shug phye skyo blud / lus kun til gyi lde gu dang / rang skyur bcas pas bsku bar bya

verses.skt: śītasnānāc ca madyāmbu pibet tṛṇmān guḍāmbu vā | madyād ardhajalaṃ madyaṃ snāto ’mlalavaṇair yutam
verses.tib: chu bsil khrus las skom gyur chang / chur bsres pa'am bur chu blud / chang ni chu phyed bcas pa blud / lan tshwa skyur dang bcas khrus bya

verses.skt: snehatīkṣṇatarāgnis tu svabhāvaśiśiraṃ jalam | snehād uṣṇāmbv ajīrṇāt tu jīrṇān maṇḍaṃ pipāsitaḥ
verses.tib: snum bcas me drod rab rno la / rang bzhin bsil ba'i chu blud bya / snum ma zhu la chu tshan blud / zhu las skom la thug pa blud

verses.skt: pibet snigdhānnatṛṣito himaspardhi guḍodakam | gurvādyannena tṛṣitaḥ pītvoṣṇāmbu tad ullikhet
verses.tib: zas snum zos pas skom dad 'gyur / kha ba dang mnyam bu ram chu / bu ram sogs zas zos la skom / chu dron blud la de slon bya

verses.skt: kṣayajāyāṃ kṣayahitaṃ sarvaṃ bṛṃhaṇam auṣadham | kṛśadurbalarūkṣāṇāṃ kṣīraṃ chāgo raso ’thavā
verses.tib: gcong chen las byung gcong la phan / thams cad nyams ni brta ba phan / skem zhing nyam chung khong rtsub la / sha khu'am ra yi 'o ma blud

verses.skt: kṣīraṃ ca sordhvavātāyāṃ kṣayakāsaharaiḥ śṛtam | rogopasargāj jātāyāṃ dhānyāmbu sasitāmadhu
verses.tib: stod rgyu'i rlung la 'o ma dang / zad byed lud pa'i sman bskol blud / nad rkyen las gyur 'u su ni / 'bras bskol kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas

verses.skt: pāne praśastaṃ sarvā ca kriyā rogādyapekṣayā | tṛṣyan pūrvāmayakṣīṇo na labheta jalaṃ yadi
verses.tib: nad dmigs la ni / bltas nas ni / btung ba'i bya ba kun kyang bsngags / skom zhing sngar gyi nad kyis gzir / chu dang 'phrad par ma gyur na

verses.skt: maraṇaṃ dīrgharogaṃ vā prāpnuyāt tvaritaṃ tataḥ | sātmyānnapānabhaiṣajyais tṛṣṇāṃ tasya jayet purā
verses.tib: 'chi ba'am yun ring ba yi nad / rnyed par 'gyur bas de yi phyir / goms pa'i zas skom sman gyis ni / de yi skom dad myur bsal bya

verses.skt: tasyāṃ jitāyām anyo ’pi vyādhiḥ śakyaś cikitsitum
verses.tib: de bsal nad ni gzhan dag kyang / gso ba nyid du nus pa yin

verses.skt: yaṃ doṣam adhikaṃ paśyet tasyādau pratikārayet | kaphasthānānupūrvyā ca tulyadoṣe madātyaye
verses.tib: nyes pa gang zhig shas cher mthong / de ni dang por gso bar bya / yang na chang nad nad gzhi mtshungs / bad kan gnas kyi rim pas gso

verses.skt: pittamārutaparyantaḥ prāyeṇa hi madātyayaḥ | hīnamithyātipītena yo vyādhir upajāyate
verses.tib: mkhris pa rlung gi mthar thug par / chang nad phal cher 'byung ba yin / dman dang log pa drag 'thungs las / nad ni gang zhig skyes gyur pa

verses.skt: samapītena tenaiva sa madyenopaśāmyati | madyasya viṣasādṛśyād viṣaṃ tūtkarṣavṛttibhiḥ
verses.tib: de nyid cha mnyam 'thungs pa yis / chang nyid kyis ni zhi bar 'gyur / chang dang dug ni mtshungs pa las / dug ni rno yon tan gyi

verses.skt: tīkṣṇādibhir guṇair yogād viṣāntaram apekṣate | tīkṣṇoṣṇenātimātreṇa pītenāmlavidāhinā
verses.tib: nus pa shin tu che bas na / dug gzhan la ni ltos pa yin / rno tshe lhag par 'thungs pa dang / tsha zhing skyur ba dag gis ni

verses.skt: madyenānnarasakledo vidagdhaḥ kṣāratāṃ gataḥ | yān kuryān madatṛṇmohajvarāntardāhavibhramān
verses.tib: chang gis zas kyi ro bsrul zhing / 'ju nyer ba tsha bro gang yin / myos dang skom rmongs nang du tsha / rims dang mgo 'khor skyed par byed

verses.skt: madyotkliṣṭena doṣeṇa ruddhaḥ srotaḥsu mārutaḥ | sutīvrā vedanā yāś ca śirasy asthiṣu saṃdhiṣu
verses.tib: chang gis bslangs pa'i nad kyis ni / rlung rgyu'i bu ga bkag gyur pas / mgo dang rus pa tshigs rnams su / mi bzad par ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: jīrṇāmamadyadoṣasya prakāṅkṣālāghave sati | yaugikaṃ vidhivad yuktaṃ madyam eva nihanti tān
verses.tib: sbyor ba rjes mthun gyur pa yi / chang nyid kyis ni de sel 'gyur / chang nad ma zhu zhu gyur na / zas 'dod lus ni yang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kṣāro hi yāti mādhuryaṃ śīghram amlopasaṃhitaḥ | madyam amleṣu ca śreṣṭhaṃ doṣaviṣyandanād alam
verses.tib: ba tsha ro ni skyur dang phrad / mngar ba nyid du myur du 'gyur / nad ni 'ju bar byed nus pas / skyur ba kun las chang mchog yin

verses.skt: tīkṣṇoṣṇādyaiḥ purā proktair dīpanādyais tathā guṇaiḥ | sātmyatvāc ca tad evāsya dhātusāmyakaraṃ param
verses.tib: sngar bshad rno dang dro dang / de bzhin drod skyed yon tan / de nyid goms pa'i dbang gis ni / 'di yis lus zungs mnyam byed mchog

verses.skt: saptāham aṣṭarātraṃ vā kuryāt pānātyayauṣadham | jīryaty etāvatā pānaṃ kālena vipathāśritam
verses.tib: zhag bdun nam zhig zhag brgyad par / chang nad sman gyi sbyor ba bya / dus 'di tsam gyis lam log par / gnas pa'i / chang nad zhi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: paraṃ tato ’nubadhnāti yo rogas tasya bheṣajam | yathāyathaṃ prayuñjīta kṛtapānātyayauṣadhaḥ
verses.tib: sman ni byas gyur nas chad nad / de phan chang ni rjes 'brel pa'i / nad gang yin pa de la sman / nad dmigs ji bzhin sbyin par bya

verses.skt: tatra vātolbaṇe madyaṃ dadyāt piṣṭakṛtaṃ yutam | bījapūrakavṛkṣāmlakoladāḍimadīpyakaiḥ
verses.tib: de la rlung shas che ba la / sgyur rtsi chen pod trig dang / rgya shug se 'bru go snyod dang

verses.skt: yavānīhapuṣājājīvyoṣatrilavaṇārdrakaiḥ | śūlyamāṃsair harītakaiḥ snehavadbhiś ca saktubhiḥ
verses.tib: la la phud dang ha pu sha / zi ra tsha gsum lan tshwa gsum / sge'u gsher phye chang sbyar ba blud / sreg sha ldum rngad bcas pa dang / snum dang ldan pa'i zas sbyin no

verses.skt: uṣṇasnigdhāmlalavaṇā medyamāṃsarasā hitāḥ | āmrāmrātakapeśībhiḥ saṃskṛtā rāgaṣāḍavāḥ
verses.tib: snum zhing dro skyur lan tshwar bcas / sha tshon khu ba blud pa'am / a mra a mra ta ka gtubs / g.yos sbyar ba yi drug pa'am

verses.skt: godhūmamāṣavikṛtir mṛduś citrā mukhapriyā | ārdrikārdrakakulmāṣaśuktamāṃsādigarbhiṇī
verses.tib: gro dang ma sha las byas pa / rnying zhing yi gar 'ong ba dang / sge gsher bcas ba'i khu ba ni / tsha dang sha sogs nang bcug pa'am

verses.skt: surabhir lavaṇā śītā nirgadā vācchavāruṇī | svaraso dāḍimāt kvāthaḥ pañcamūlāt kanīyasaḥ
verses.tib: chang ni dri zhim bsil ba dang / legs langs dngas shing tshar bcas phan / se 'bru'am rtsa ba chung lnga bskol

verses.skt: śuṇṭhīdhānyāt tathā mastu śuktāmbho'cchāmlakāñjikam | abhyaṅgodvartanasnānam uṣṇaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ ghanam
verses.tib: bca' sga 'u su bskol ba'am / zhog chu'am tsha chu'am / rang skyur dngas ma blud par bya / lus bsku dril dang bkru ba dang / gos ni dro zhing mthug pa dang

verses.skt: ghanaś cāgurujo dhūpaḥ paṅkaś cāgurukuṅkumaḥ | kucoruśroṇiśālinyo yauvanoṣṇāṅgayaṣṭayaḥ
verses.tib: a ka ru yi dud pas bdug / gur gum a ka ru yis byug / chung ma nu ma ro smad mdzes / lang tshor ldan zhing yan lag dro

verses.skt: harṣeṇāliṅgane yuktāḥ priyāḥ saṃvāhaneṣu ca | pittolbaṇe bahujalaṃ śārkaraṃ madhu vā yutam
verses.tib: dga' bas 'khyud par byed pa dang / bsnyen bkur byas par gyur pa'ang phan / mkhris pa shas cher chu mang ba'i / sbrang rtsi khar dang ldan pa'i

verses.skt: rasair dāḍimakharjūrabhavyadrākṣāparūṣajaiḥ | suśītaṃ sasitāsaktu yojyaṃ tādṛk ca pānakam
verses.tib: se 'bru 'bra go'i khu ba dang / b+ha bya rgun 'brum pa ru sha'i / khu bsgrangs phye dang khar rar bcas / btung ba'ang de 'dra blud par bya

verses.skt: svāduvargakaṣāyair vā yuktaṃ madyaṃ samākṣikam | śāliṣaṣṭikam aśnīyāc chaśājaiṇakapiñjalaiḥ
verses.tib: yang na mngar ba'i sde tshan bskol / khu ba chang bsres sbrang rtsi btab / sA lu drug cu pa'i tshan dang / ri bong gong sreg gtsod kyi sha

verses.skt: satīnamudgāmalakapaṭolīdāḍimai rasaiḥ | kaphapittaṃ samutkliṣṭam ullikhet tṛḍvidāhavān
verses.tib: tsa na mung+ga skyu ru ra / se 'bru pa to la g.yos sbyin / bad kan mkhris 'dres las gyur pa / tsha dang skom dang ldan pa yi

verses.skt: pītvāmbu śītaṃ madyaṃ vā bhūrīkṣurasasaṃyutam | drākṣārasaṃ vā saṃsargī tarpaṇādiḥ paraṃ hitaḥ
verses.tib: chang ngam chu grang bu ram shing / khu ba'am rgun chu mang blud la / slon gzhug 'dres pa'i nad la ni / skyo ma la sogs rim pas phan

verses.skt: tathāgnir dīpyate tasya doṣaśeṣānnapācanaḥ | kāse saraktaniṣṭhīve pārśvastanarujāsu ca
verses.tib: de yis me drod 'bar gyur pas / zas dang nyes lhag smin par byed / lud pa mchil ma khrag bcas 'byung / rtsib logs nu mar gzer ba dang

verses.skt: tṛṣṇāyāṃ savidāhāyāṃ sotkleśe hṛdayorasi | guḍūcībhadramustānāṃ paṭolasyāthavā rasam
verses.tib: tsha dang bcas pa'i skom dad dang / snying dang brang ni na ba la / sle tres ga dur bskol ba'am

verses.skt: saśṛṅgaveraṃ yuñjīta tittiripratibhojanam | tṛṣyate cāti balavad vātapitte samuddhate
verses.tib: yang na pa to la bskol khu / bca' sgar bcas pa blud bya zhing / gong ma sreg gi sha sbyin bya / mkhris pa rlung ni rgyas gyur pas

verses.skt: dadyād drākṣārasaṃ pānaṃ śītaṃ doṣānulomanam | jīrṇe ’dyān madhurāmlena cchāgamāṃsarasena ca
verses.tib: shin tu shas cher skom gyur na / rlung ni bde bar rgyu byed pa'i / rgun chu bsgrangs pa blud par bya / zhu nas ra sha'i khu ba ni / mngar dang skyur ba'i sman sbyar sbyin

verses.skt: tṛṣy alpaśaḥ piben madyaṃ madaṃ rakṣan bahūdakam | mustadāḍimalājāmbu jalaṃ vā parṇinīśṛtam
verses.tib: skom na chu mang bsres pa yi / chang blud ra ror mi 'gyur bsrung / gla sgang se 'bru 'bras yos chu'am / yang na 'dab ma bzhi bskol ba'am

verses.skt: pāṭalyutpalakandair vā svabhāvād eva vā himam | madyātipānād abdhātau kṣīṇe tejasi coddhate
verses.tib: ut+pal pa to la sogs sam / rang bzhin gyis ni bsil ba blud / chang mang 'thungs pas chu yi khams / 'bri zhing me shas rgyas par 'gyur

verses.skt: yaḥ śuṣkagalatālvoṣṭho jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣya ceṣṭate | pāyayet kāmato ’mbhas taṃ niśīthapavanāhatam
verses.tib: gre ba rkan mchu skam 'gyur zhing / lce ni 'byin cing gcong byed la / mtshan mo rlung gis bsil byas pa'i / chu ni yog tshad blud par bya

verses.skt: koladāḍimavṛkṣāmlacukrīkācukrikārasaḥ | pañcāmlako mukhālepaḥ sadyas tṛṣṇāṃ niyacchati
verses.tib: rgya shug se 'bru da trig dang / tsug tral chu ba'i khu ba / skyur ba lnga yis khar bskus na / 'phral du skom dad sel bar byed

verses.skt: tvacaṃ prāptaś ca pānoṣmā pittaraktābhimūrchitaḥ | dāhaṃ prakurute ghoraṃ tatrātiśiśiro vidhiḥ
verses.tib: chang 'thungs drod ni khrag mkhris dang / 'dres pas pags pa khyab gyur pas / mi bzad tsha ba skyed byed de / der ni rab bsil cho ga bya

verses.skt: aśāmyati rasais tṛpte rohiṇīṃ vyadhayet sirām | ullekhanopavāsābhyāṃ jayec chleṣmolbaṇaṃ pibet
verses.tib: ma zhu sha khus tshim byas la / ro hi ni las gtar ga gdab / slon dang smyung ba dag gis kyang / bad kan shas cher skug sman dang

verses.skt: śītaṃ śuṇṭhīsthirodīcyaduḥsparśānyatamodakam | nirāmaṃ kṣudhitaṃ kāle pāyayed bahumākṣikam
verses.tib: smyung ba bca' sga sti ra dang / kaN+Da ka ri ba la ka / gang yang rung ba'i chu blud bsal / ma zhu med cing bkres dus su / sbrang rtsi mang po blud par bya

verses.skt: śārkaraṃ madhu vā jīrṇam ariṣṭaṃ sīdhum eva vā | rūkṣatarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ yavānīnāgarānvitam
verses.tib: sha kha ra dang sbrang rtsi dang / chang rnying dag gam rgun chang ngam / rtsub pa'i skyo mar sbyar ba ni / dong gral la phud bcas blud

verses.skt: yūṣeṇa yavagodhūmaṃ tanunālpena bhojayet | uṣṇāmlakaṭutiktena kaulatthenālpasarpiṣā
verses.tib: nas dang gro zan nyung shas la / rgya sran yu sha nyung zad bcas / chu tshan kha dang tsha bar bcas / mar ni nyung zad bcas pa sbyin

verses.skt: śuṣkamūlakajaiś chāgai rasair vā dhanvacāriṇām | sāmlavetasavṛkṣāmlapaṭolīvyoṣadāḍimaiḥ
verses.tib: la phug skam por sha'i khu / skam sa'i srog chags sha khu ni / star bud trig pa to la / tsha ba gsum dang se 'brur sbyar

verses.skt: prabhūtaśuṇṭhīmaricaharitārdrakapeśikam | bījapūrarasādyamlabhṛṣṭanīrasavartitam
verses.tib: bca' sga na le sham mang btab / rjen rngad / gtubs pa dang ldan zhing / skyur rtsi chen po'i khu bas skyur / brngos shing khu ba med pa dang / ka ra mar dang ka ri ra

verses.skt: karīrakaramardādi rociṣṇu bahuśālanam | pravyaktāṣṭāṅgalavaṇaṃ vikalpitanimardakam
verses.tib: la sogs yi ga 'byed pa dang / lan tshwa brgyad po legs bro dang / gtubs shing be reg ltar btsos pa

verses.skt: yathāgni bhakṣayan māṃsaṃ mādhavaṃ nigadaṃ pibet | sitāsauvarcalājājītintiḍīkāmlavetasam
verses.tib: me drod tshod las sha sbyin zhing / sbrang chang nad med gyur pa blud / kha ra dang ni kha ru tsha / go snyod da trig star bu dang

verses.skt: tvagelāmaricārdhāṃśam aṣṭāṅgalavaṇaṃ hitam | srotoviśuddhyagnikaraṃ kaphaprāye madātyaye
verses.tib: shing tsha sug smel na le sham / cha phyed yan lag brgyad par bshad / phal cher bad kan chang nad sel / bu ga'i rgyun sbyong drod skyed byed

verses.skt: rūkṣoṣṇodvartanodgharṣasnānabhojanalaṅghanaiḥ | sakāmābhiḥ saha strībhir yuktyā jāgaraṇena ca
verses.tib: rtsub dang dro bas mnye zhing dril / khrus dang kha zas smyung byas dang / 'dod bcas bud med lhan cig gnas

verses.skt: madātyayaḥ kaphaprāyaḥ śīghraṃ samupaśāmyati | yad idaṃ karma nirdiṣṭaṃ pṛthag doṣabalaṃ prati
verses.tib: phal cher bad kan las byung ba'i / chang nad myur du zhi bar byed / nad gzhi so so'i shas che las / las rnams gang dag bstan pa 'di

verses.skt: saṃnipāte daśavidhe tac cheṣe ’pi vikalpayet | tvaṅnāgapuṣpamagadhāmaricājājidhānyakaiḥ
verses.tib: 'di ni 'dus pa las gyur pa / lhag ma bcu la'ang sbyar bar bya / shing tsha nA ga put+pa dang / pi pi ling dang na le sham / go snyod pa ru sha ka dang

verses.skt: parūṣakamadhūkailāsurāhvaiś ca sitānvitaiḥ | sakapittharasaṃ hṛdyaṃ pānakaṃ śaśibodhitam
verses.tib: 'u su sug smel ma du ka / thang shing kar dkar dang bcas / ka pid ta yi khu ba btab / ga pur dri yis bsgos gyur pa / btung ba shin tu yid 'ong ba

verses.skt: madātyayeṣu sarveṣu peyaṃ rucyagnidīpanam | nāvikṣobhya mano madyaṃ śarīram avihanya vā
verses.tib: chang nad kun la blud gyur na / yi ga 'byed cing me drod skyed / chang gis yid ni ma dkrugs shing / lus la gnod pa mi byed par

verses.skt: kuryān madātyayaṃ tasmād iṣyate harṣaṇī kriyā | saṃśuddhiśamanādyeṣu madadoṣaḥ kṛteṣv api
verses.tib: chang nad mi skyed de yi phyir / sems dgar 'gyur ba'i cho ga bya / chang nad la ni sbyang ba dang / zhi ba'i las ni byas gyur kyang

verses.skt: na cec chāmyet kaphe kṣīṇe jāte daurbalyalāghave | tasya madyavidagdhasya vātapittādhikasya ca
verses.tib: gal te ma zhi bad kan zad / nyam chung yang ba nyid gyur na / rlung dang mkhris pa shas che zhing / chang nad kyis zad 'o ma blud

verses.skt: grīṣmopataptasya taror yathā varṣaṃ tathā payaḥ | madyakṣīṇasya hi kṣīṇaṃ kṣīram āśv eva puṣyati
verses.tib: so ga'i tsha bas gdungs pa yi / shing las char pa bab dang mtshungs / chang gis zad par byas pa'i mdangs / 'o mas myur du brtas byed de

verses.skt: ojas tulyaṃ guṇaiḥ sarvair viparītaṃ ca madyataḥ | payasā vihate roge bale jāte nivartayet
verses.tib: mdangs dang yon tan kun mtshungs la / chang las go ni bzlog pa yin / 'o mas nad ni bcom gyur cing / stobs skyes nas ni 'o ma yi

verses.skt: kṣīraprayogaṃ madyaṃ ca krameṇālpālpam ācaret | na vikṣayadhvaṃsakotthaiḥ spṛśetopadravair yathā
verses.tib: cho ga chang yang bzlog byas te / rim gyis nyung zad nyung zad spyad / ci nas 'joms dang skams / gyur pa'i / bla brnan 'byung bar mi 'gyur bya

verses.skt: tayos tu syād ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ vastayo bṛṃhaṇāḥ śivāḥ | abhyaṅgodvartanasnānāny annapānaṃ ca vātajit
verses.tib: de gnyis la ni 'o ma mar / 'jam rtsi btang bas brta ba bsngags / bsku dang dril phyis khrus dang ni

verses.skt: yuktamadyasya madyottho na vyādhir upajāyate | ato ’sya vakṣyate yogo yaḥ sukhāyaiva kevalam
āśvinaṃ yā mahat tejo balaṃ sārasvataṃ ca yā | dadhāty aindraṃ ca yā vīryaṃ prabhāvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yā
astraṃ makaraketor yā puruṣārtho balasya yā | sautrāmaṇyāṃ dvijamukhe yā hutāśe ca hvayate
yā sarvauṣadhisaṃpūrṇān mathyamānāt surāsuraiḥ | mahodadheḥ samudbhūtā śrīśaśāṅkāmṛtaiḥ saha
madhumādhavamaireyasīdhugauḍāsavādibhiḥ | madaśaktim anujjhantī yā rūpair bahubhiḥ sthitā
yām āsvādya vilāsinyo yathārthaṃ nāma bibhrati | kulāṅganāpi yāṃ pītvā nayaty uddhatamānasā
anaṅgāliṅgitair aṅgaiḥ kvāpi ceto muner api | taraṅgabhaṅgabhrūkuṭītarjanair māninīmanaḥ
ekaṃ prasādya kurute yā dvayor api nirvṛtim | yathākāmaṃ bhaṭāvāptiparihṛṣṭāpsarogaṇe
tṛṇavat puruṣā yuddhe yām āsvādya tyajanty asūn | yāṃ śīlayitvāpi ciraṃ bahudhā bahuvigrahām
nityaṃ harṣātivegena tatpūrvam iva sevate | śokodvegāratibhayair yāṃ dṛṣṭvā nābhibhūyate
goṣṭhīmahotsavodyānaṃ na yasyāḥ śobhate vinā | smṛtvā smṛtvā ca bahuśo viyuktaḥ śocate yayā
aprasannāpi yā prītyai prasannā svarga eva yā | apīndraṃ manyate duḥsthaṃ hṛdayasthitayā yayā
anirdeśyasukhāsvādā svayaṃvedyaiva yā param | iti citrāsv avasthāsu priyām anukaroti yā
priyātipriyatāṃ yāti yat priyasya viśeṣataḥ | yā prītir yā ratir vā vāg yā puṣṭir iti ca stutā
devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasamānuṣaiḥ | pānapravṛttau satyāṃ tu tāṃ surāṃ vidhinā pibet
saṃbhavanti na te rogā medo'nilakaphodbhavāḥ | vidhiyuktād ṛte madyād ye na sidhyanti dāruṇāḥ
asti dehasya sāvasthā yasyāṃ pānaṃ nivāryate | anyatra madyān nigadād vividhauṣadhasaṃskṛtāt
ānūpaṃ jāṅgalaṃ ṃāṃsaṃ vidhināpy upakalpitam | madyaṃ sahāyam aprāpya samyak pariṇamet katham
sutīvramārutavyādhighātino laśunasya ca | madyamāṃsaviyuktasya prayoge syāt kiyān guṇaḥ
nigūḍhaśalyāharaṇe śastrakṣārāgnikarmaṇi | pītamadyaś viṣahate sukhaṃ vaidyavikatthanām
analottejanaṃ rucyaṃ śokaśramavinodakam | na cātaḥ param asty anyad ārogyabalapuṣṭikṛt
rakṣatā jīvitaṃ tasmāt peyam ātmavatā sadā | āśritopāśritahitaṃ paramaṃ dharmasādhanam

snātaḥ praṇamya suravipragurūn yathāsvaṃ vṛttiṃ vidhāya ca samastaparigrahasya | āpānabhūmim atha gandhajalābhiṣiktām āhāramaṇḍapasamīpagatāṃ śrayet || 75 || svāstṛte ’tha śayane kamanīye mitrabhṛtyaramaṇīsamavetaḥ | svaṃ yaśaḥ kathakacāraṇasaṃghair uddhataṃ niśamayann atilokam
vilāsinīnāṃ ca vilāsaśobhi gītaṃ sanṛtyaṃ kalatūryaghoṣaiḥ | kāñcīkalāpaiś calakiṅkiṇīkaiḥ krīḍāvihaṅgaiś ca kṛtānunādam
maṇikanakasamutthair āvaneyair vicitraiḥ | sajalavividhalekhakṣaumavastrāvṛtāṅgaiḥ | api munijanacittakṣobhasaṃpādinībhiś | cakitahariṇalolaprekṣaṇībhiḥ priyābhiḥ
stananitambakṛtād atigauravād alasam ākulam īśvarasaṃbhramāt | iti gataṃ dadhatībhir asaṃsthitaṃ taruṇacittavilobhanakārmaṇam
yauvanāsavamattābhir vilāsādhiṣṭhitātmabhiḥ | saṃcāryamāṇaṃ yugapat tanvaṅgībhir itastataḥ
tālavṛntanalinīdalānilaiḥ śītalīkṛtam atīva śītalaiḥ | darśane ’pi vidadhad vaśānugam svāditaṃ kim uta cittajanmanaḥ
cūtarasendumṛgaiḥ kṛtavāsaṃ mallikayojjvalayā ca sanātham | sphāṭikaśuktigataṃ sataraṅgaṃ kāntam anaṅgam ivodvahad aṅgam
tālīśādyaṃ cūrṇam elādikaṃ vā hṛdyaṃ prāśya prāg vayaḥsthāpanaṃ vā | tatprārthibhyo bhūmibhāge sumṛṣṭe toyonmiśraṃ dāpayitvā tataś ca
dhṛtimān smṛtimān nityam anūnādhikam ācaran | ucitenopacāreṇa sarvam evopapādayan
jitavikasitāsitasarojanayanasaṃkrāntivardhitaśrīkam | kāntāmukham iva saurabhahṛtamadhupagaṇaṃ piben madyam

pītvaivaṃ caṣakadvayaṃ parijanaṃ sanmānya sarvaṃ tato | gatvāhārabhuvaṃ puraḥ subhiṣajo bhuñjīta bhūyo ’tra ca | māṃsāpūpaghṛtārdrakādiharitair yuktaṃ sasauvarcalair | dvis trir vā niśi cālpam eva vanitāsaṃvalganārthaṃ pibet
rahasi dayitām aṅke kṛtvā bhujāntarapīḍanāt | pulakitatanuṃ jātasvedāṃ sakampapayodharām | yadi sarabhasaṃ sīdhor vāraṃ na pāyayate kṛtī | kim anubhavati kleśaprāyaṃ tato gṛhatantratām
varatanuvaktrasaṃgatisugandhitaraṃ sarakam | drutam iva padmarāgamaṇim āsavarūpadharam | bhavati ratiśrameṇa ca madaḥ pibato ’lpam api | kṣayam ata ojasaḥ pariharan sa śayīta param
verses.tib: bza' btung rlung ni sel ba phan / rig par chang 'thung gang gis ni / nad ni 'byung bar 'gyur ma yin

verses.skt: itthaṃ yuktyā piban madyaṃ na trivargād vihīyate | asārasaṃsārasukhaṃ paramaṃ cādhigacchati
aiśvaryasyopabhogo ’yaṃ spṛhaṇīyaḥ surair api | anyathā hi vipatsu syāt paścāt tāpendhanaṃ dhanam
upabhogena rahito bhogavān iti nindyate | nirmito ’tikadaryo ’yaṃ vidhinā nidhipālakaḥ
tasmād vyavasthayā pānaṃ pānasya satataṃ hitam | jitvā viṣayalubdhānām indriyāṇāṃ svatantratām
vidhir vasumatām eṣa bhaviṣyadvasavas tu ye | yathopapatti tair madyaṃ pātavyaṃ mātrayā hitam
yāvad dṛṣṭer na saṃbhrāntir yāvan na kṣobhate manaḥ | tāvad eva virantavyaṃ madyād ātmavatā sadā
abhyaṅgodvartanasnānavāsadhūpānulepanaiḥ | snigdhoṣṇair bhāvitaś cānnaiḥ pānaṃ vātottaraḥ pibet
śītopacārair vividhair madhurasnigdhaśītalaiḥ | paittiko bhāvitaś cānnaiḥ piban madyaṃ na sīdati
upacārair aśiśirair yavagodhūmabhuk pibet | ślaiṣmiko dhanvajair māṃsair madyaṃ māricikaiḥ saha
tatra vāte hitaṃ madyaṃ prāyaḥ paiṣṭikagauḍikam | pitte sāmbho madhu kaphe mārdvīkāriṣṭamādhavam
verses.tib: de la rlung nad la phan chang / phal cher zan chang bu ram chang / mkhris pa rgun chang chu dang bcas / bad kan chang rnying sbrang rgun chang

verses.skt: prāk pibec chlaiṣmiko madyaṃ bhuktasyopari paittikaḥ | vātikas tu piben madhye samadoṣo yathecchayā
verses.tib: bad kan can gyis dang por btung / mkhris pa can gyis zos rjes btung / rlung can gyis ni bar du btung / nad gzhi mnyam pas ci dgar btung

verses.skt: madeṣu vātapittaghnaṃ prāyo mūrchāsu ceṣyate | sarvatrāpi viśeṣeṇa pittam evopalakṣayet
verses.tib: myos dang brgyal la phal cher ni / rlung dang mkhris pa sel las bsngags / thams cad la yang khyad par du / mkhris pa shas cher shes par bya

verses.skt: śītāḥ pradehā maṇayaḥ sekā vyajanamārutāḥ | sitā drākṣekṣukharjūrakāśmaryasvarasāḥ payaḥ
verses.tib: bsku byug bsil dang nor bu dang / chus gtor rlung yab kyis g.yab byed / kha ra rgun 'brum bu ram shing / 'bra go tang pal khu ba dang

verses.skt: siddhaṃ madhuravargeṇa rasā yūṣāḥ sadāḍimāḥ | ṣaṣṭikāḥ śālayo raktā yavāḥ sarpiś ca jīvanam
verses.tib: mngar ba'i sde bskol 'o ma khu / yu sha se 'brur bcas pa blud / sA lu rtsa snar drug cu pa

verses.skt: kalyāṇakaṃ mahātiktaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ payasāgnikaḥ | pippalyo vā śilāhvaṃ vā rasāyanavidhānataḥ
verses.tib: nas dang 'tsho byed sman mar dang / dge ba chen po tig ta che / srang drug 'o ma tsi trar bcas / pi pi ling dang brag zhun ni / bcud kyis len gyi cho ga sbyin

verses.skt: triphalā vā prayoktavyā saghṛtakṣaudraśarkarā | prasaktavegeṣu hitaṃ mukhanāsāvarodhanam
verses.tib: yang na 'bras bu gsum mar dang / sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas pa sbyin / shugs drag pa la kha dang sna / bkag par gyur pa phan pa yin

verses.skt: pibed vā mānuṣīkṣīraṃ tena dadyāc ca nāvanam | mṛṇālabisakṛṣṇā vā lihyāt kṣaudreṇa sābhayāḥ
verses.tib: yang na bud med nu zho ni / blud pa'am sna nas gtang bar bya / pad+ma'i rtsa sdong pi pi ling / a ru ra 'am gla sgang ngam / byi tsher sbrang rtsir sbyar ba sbyin

verses.skt: durālabhāṃ vā mustaṃ vā śītena salilena vā | piben maricakolāsthimajjośīrāhikesaram
verses.tib: rgya shug tshi gu na le sham / nA ga ge sar pu shel tse / chu grang dang ni sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: dhātrīphalarase siddhaṃ pathyākvāthena vā ghṛtam | kuryāt kriyāṃ yathoktāṃ ca yathādoṣabalodayam
verses.tib: skyu ru ra yi khu ba'am / a ru ra mar bskol ba'ang phan / ji skad bshad pa'i bya ba dag / nad gzhi'i shas ni ji bzhin sbyar

verses.skt: pañca karmāṇi ceṣṭāni secanaṃ śoṇitasya ca | sattvasyālambanaṃ jñānam agṛddhir viṣayeṣu ca
verses.tib: las ni rnam lnga bya ba dang / gtar gas khrag ni dbyung ba dang / snying stobs che zhing shes dang ldan / yul la chags pa med pa phan

verses.skt: madeṣv atipravṛddheṣu mūrchāyeṣu ca yojayet | tīkṣṇaṃ saṃnyāsavihitaṃ viṣaghnaṃ viṣajeṣu ca
verses.tib: myos pa shin tu 'phel gyur dang / brgyal bar gyur pa dag la ni / kun tu zhugs pa'i sman rnon / dang / dug las byung ba dug sman gtang

verses.skt: āśu prayojyaṃ saṃnyāse sutīkṣṇaṃ nasyam añjanam | dhūmaḥ pradhamanaṃ todaḥ sūcībhiś ca nakhāntare
verses.tib: kun tu zhugs la rab rno ba'i / sna sman dang ni mig sman dang / dud pas bud dang khab kyis ni / sen mo'i bar du gzugs par bya

verses.skt: keśānāṃ luñcanaṃ dāho daṃśo daśanavṛścikaiḥ | kaṭvamlagālanaṃ vaktre kapikacchvavagharṣaṇam
verses.tib: skra 'bal bsregs dang sos btab dang / sdig pa sha sbrang gtses pa dang / mkhur bar tsha dang skyur ba gzhug / kha sral phre'u bdar bar bya

verses.skt: utthito labdhasaṃjñaś ca laśunasvarasaṃ pibet | khādet savyoṣalavaṇaṃ bījapūrakakesaram
verses.tib: 'du shes rnyed cing ldang gyur nas / sgog skya'i khu ba blud par bya / tsha ba gsum ni lan tshwar bcas / bi dza pu ra'i ge sar sbyin

verses.skt: laghvannaprati tīkṣṇoṣṇam adyāt srotoviśuddhaye | vismāpanaiḥ saṃsmaraṇaiḥ priyaśravaṇadarśanaiḥ
verses.tib: bu ga'i rgyun srang dag bya'i phyir / zas yang tsha dro rno ba sbyin / brjed pa dran phyir ngo mtshar dang / yid 'ong lta dang thos pa dang

verses.skt: paṭubhir gītavāditraśabdair vyāyāmaśīlanaiḥ | sraṃsanollekhanair dhūmaiḥ śoṇitasyāvasecanaiḥ
verses.tib: glu dang rol mo snyan pa yi / sgra snyan rtsol ba byed du gzhug / slon sman bkru sman btang dus rngub / khrag ni dbyung bar bya ba dag

verses.skt: upācaret taṃ pratatam anubandhabhayāt punaḥ | tasya saṃrakṣitavyaṃ ca manaḥ pralayahetutaḥ
verses.tib: rgyun mi chad pa spyad par bya / sems stor ba yi rgyu las ni / slar ldang 'brel pa'i 'jigs pa yis / de ni legs par bsrung bar bya

verses.skt: kāle sādhāraṇe vyabhre nātidurbalam arśasam | viśuddhakoṣṭhaṃ laghvalpam anulomanam āśitam
verses.tib: thun mong dus su sprin med par / gzhang 'brum can rab nyam chung min / lto sbyangs kha zas yang la nyung / rjes su mthun pa zos pa la

verses.skt: śuciṃ kṛtasvastyayanaṃ muktaviṇmūtram avyatham | śayane phalake vānyanarotsaṅge vyapāśritam
verses.tib: gtsang byas bde legs 'gyur bar byas / bshang dang gci bsal gnod pa med / khri'am spang leb mi gzhan gyi / pang par legs brten gnas nas ni

verses.skt: pūrveṇa kāyenottānaṃ pratyādityagudaṃ samam | samunnatakaṭīdeśam atha yantraṇavāsasā
verses.tib: gan rkyal 'dug cing ro stod smad / drang 'dug nyi mar rkub bstan la / rked pa'i phyogs ni bstod par bya

verses.skt: sakthnoḥ śirodharāyāṃ ca parikṣiptam ṛju sthitam | ālambitaṃ paricaraiḥ sarpiṣābhyaktapāyave
verses.tib: de nas brla dang gnya' bar ni / bcings pa'i gos kyis bsdams nas su / gzung ste drang por 'dug pa la / nad g.yog gis ni bzung nas su / rkub ni zhun mar dag gis bsku

verses.skt: tato ’smai sarpiṣābhyaktaṃ nidadhyād ṛju yantrakam | śanair anusukhaṃ pāyau tato dṛṣṭvā pravāhaṇāt
verses.tib: de nas mar gyis bskus pa yi / cha spyad drang por de gzhug bya / rkub nas phyogs par rim gyis gzhug / de nas 'byung 'gyur mthong ba dang

verses.skt: yantre praviṣṭaṃ durnāma plotaguṇṭhitayānu ca | śalākayotpīḍya bhiṣag yathoktavidhinā dahet
verses.tib: cha spyad chud par shes gyur nas / gzhang 'brum thur ma gos gsher bas / sman pas legs / par btsir nas ni / ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga yis

verses.skt: kṣāreṇaivārdram itarat kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā | mahad vā balinaś chittvā vītayantram athāturam
