verses.tib: rlan can thal sman bsreg cig shos / thal sman rnon po'i me yis bsreg / stobs ldan mche ba bcad de bsreg / de nas cha spyad phyung nas ni

verses.skt: svabhyaktapāyujaghanam avagāhe nidhāpayet | nirvātamandirasthasya tato ’syācāram ādiśet
verses.tib: nad pa'i rkub dang ro smad bsku / snum gyi nang du 'bying bar bya / de ltar zhag ni bdun bdun zhing / re re nye bar bcos par bya / de nas rlung med khang par ni / bzhag la spyod pa bsten par bya / gzhang 'brum mang la dang por g.yas / de nas g.yon bsal de 'og rgyab

verses.skt: ekaikam iti saptāhāt saptāhāt samupācaret | prāg dakṣiṇaṃ tato vāmam arśaḥ pṛṣṭhāgrajaṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: nad pa'i rkub dang ro smad bsku / snum gyi nang du 'bying bar bya / de ltar zhag ni bdun bdun zhing / re re nye bar bcos par bya / de nas rlung med khang par ni / bzhag la spyod pa bsten par bya / gzhang 'brum mang la dang por g.yas / de nas g.yon bsal de 'og rgyab

verses.skt: bahvarśasaḥ sudagdhasya syād vāyor anulomatā | rucir anne ’gnipaṭutā svāsthyaṃ varṇabalodayaḥ
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum mang po bsregs legs na / rlung ni bde bar rgyu byed cing / kha zas 'dod cing me drod skyed / bder gnas stobs dang kha dog skyed

verses.skt: vastiśūle tv adho nābher lepayec chlakṣṇakalkitaiḥ | varṣābhūkuṣṭhasurabhimiśilohāmarāhvayaiḥ
verses.tib: chu sog zer gyis btab pa la / ba spru ba dang ru rta dang / gan+d+ha mung+ga a ka ru / sha tapuSh+pa thang shing rnams / zhib tu btags la lde gu yis / lte ba man chad bsku bar bya

verses.skt: śakṛnmūtrapratīghāte pariṣekāvagāhayoḥ | varaṇālambuṣair aṇḍagokaṇṭakapunarnavaiḥ
verses.tib: bshang dang gci 'gags gyur pa la / a lam bu sa ba ru na / ba spru gzem e raN+Da / a za gan+d+ha mu ra rnams

verses.skt: suṣavīsurabhībhyāṃ ca kvātham uṣṇaṃ prayojayet | sasneham athavā kṣīraṃ tailaṃ vā vātanāśanam
verses.tib: bskol ba dro 'jam byas pa yis / blugs dang 'bying ba'i sbyor ba bya / yang na 'o ma snum bcas pa / rlung sel sman bskol til mar sbyar

verses.skt: yuñjītānnaṃ śakṛdbhedi snehān vātaghnadīpanān | athāprayojyadāhasya nirgatān kaphavātajān
verses.tib: zas ni bshang ba sla byed cing / snum dang rlung 'joms drod skyed sbyin / de nas bsreg pa mi bya zhing / bad kan rlung skyes phyir byung ba

verses.skt: sastambhakaṇḍūrukśophān abhyajya gudakīlakān | bilvamūlāgnikakṣārakuṣṭhaiḥ siddhena secayet
verses.tib: 'gags shing g.ya' la na zhing skrang / gzhang 'brum bsku ba byas nas ni / bil ba'i rtsa ba tsi tra ka / thal sman ru rta bskol ba yi

verses.skt: tailenāhibiḍāloṣṭravarāhavasayāthavā | svedayed anu piṇḍena dravasvedena vā punaḥ
verses.tib: til mar blugs pa'am sbrul byil / rnga mo phag rgod zhag gis byug / de rjes rlan dugs kyis dugs bya / yang na gsher dugs spyad par bya

verses.skt: kāsīsaṃ saindhavaṃ rāsnā śuṇṭhī kuṣṭhaṃ ca lāṅgalī | śilābhrakāśvamāraṃ ca jantuhṛd danticitrakau
haritālaṃ tathā svarṇakṣīrī taiś ca pacet samaiḥ | tailaṃ sudhārkapayasī gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe
etad abhyaṅgato ’rśāṃsi kṣāravat pātayed drutam | kṣārakarmakaraṃ hy etan na ca dūṣayate valīm
saktūnāṃ piṇḍikābhir vā snigdhānāṃ tailasarpiṣā | rāsnāyā hapuṣāyā vā piṇḍair vā kārṣṇyagandhikaiḥ
verses.tib: yang na zan ni til mar dang / zhun mar snum can gyis dugs bya / ra sna ha gu sha dag dang / shi kru'i lo ma'i gong pos bya

verses.skt: arkamūlaṃ śamīpattram nṛkeśaḥ sarpakañcukam | mārjāracarma sarpiś ca dhūpanaṃ hitam arśasām
verses.tib: arga'i rtsa ba shal ma li'i / lo ma mi skra sbrul lpags dang / byi la'i pags pa mar sbyar ba'i / dud bdugs gzhang 'brum dag la phan

verses.skt: tathāśvagandhā surasā bṛhatī pippalī ghṛtam | dhānyāmlapiṣṭair jīmūtabījais tajjālakaṃ mṛdu
verses.tib: a shwa gan+d+ha bri ha ti / byi'u rug pi pi ling mar sbyar / ku ba kha bo'i sa bon dang / yal ga 'jam por rang skyur dang

verses.skt: lepitaṃ chāyayā śuṣkaṃ vartir gudajaśātanī | sajālamūlajīmūtalehe vā kṣārasaṃyute
verses.tib: lde gu grib mar skams pa yi / reng bu rkub bcug gzhang 'brum 'jig / ku ba kha bo'i yal ga rtsa / thal sman bcas pa'i lde gu ni

verses.skt: guñjāsūraṇakūṣmāṇḍabījair vartis tathāguṇā | snukkṣīrārdraniśālepas tathā gomūtrakalkitaiḥ
verses.tib: 'ol ma se dang su ra na / bum sha yi ni sa bon las / reng bur byas pa de dang 'dra / su d+hA k+Shi ra yung lde gu

verses.skt: kṛkavākuśakṛtkṛṣṇāniśāguñjāphalais tathā | snukkṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ ṣaḍgranthāhalinīvāraṇāsthibhiḥ
verses.tib: khyim bya'i rtug pa pi pi ling / yung dang 'ol ma se dag ni / ba gcin btags pa de dang 'dra / snu ha'i 'o mar btags shu dag / ta ma la rus pri yang ku

verses.skt: kulīraśṛṅgīvijayākuṣṭhāruṣkaratutthakaiḥ | śigrumūlakajair bījaiḥ pattrair aśvaghnanimbajaiḥ
verses.tib: rnam rgyal kar ka ta sring gi / ru rta spangs ma go bye dang / shi kru la phug sa bon dang / nim pa ka ra bI ra'i lo / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang

verses.skt: pīlumūlena bilvena hiṅgunā ca samanvitaiḥ | kuṣṭhaṃ śirīṣabījāni pippalyaḥ saindhavaṃ guḍaḥ
verses.tib: bil rtsa shing kun bcas pa'am / ru rta shri sha'i sa bon dang / rgyam tsha bu ram pi pi ling

verses.skt: arkakṣīraṃ sudhākṣīraṃ triphalā ca pralepanam | ārkaṃ payaḥ sudhākāṇḍaṃ kaṭukālābupallavāḥ
verses.tib: arga snu ha'i 'o ma dang / 'bras bu gsum gyi lde gu bsku / arga'i 'o ma snu ha'i sdong / ku ba kha bo'i 'dab ma dang

verses.skt: karañjo bastamūtraṃ ca lepanaṃ śreṣṭham arśasām | ānuvāsanikair lepaḥ pippalyādyaiś ca pūjitaḥ
verses.tib: ka rany+dza dang ra thug gcin / lde gus gzhang 'brum sel mchog yin / 'jam rtsi'i sman ni pi pi ling / la sogs lde gu'ang bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: ebhir evauṣadhaiḥ kuryāt tailāny abhyañjanāya ca | dhūpanālepanābhyaṅgaiḥ prasravanti gudāṅkurāḥ
verses.tib: sman 'di nyid kyis til mar ni / bsku ba'i don du bskol bar bya / dud pas bdug dang lde gu ni / bskus pas gzhang 'brum dag gi khrag

verses.skt: saṃcitaṃ duṣṭarudhiraṃ tataḥ saṃpadyate sukhī | avartamānam ucchūnakaṭhinebhyo hared asṛk
verses.tib: sogs pa 'dzag par byed 'gyur te / de nas bde ba nyid du 'gyur / skrang zhing 'dzag par ma gyur dang / sra ba las ni khrag dbyung ste

verses.skt: arśobhyo jalajāśastrasūcīkūrcaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣair hi na vyādhir upaśāmyati
verses.tib: bad pa gtsags bu khab kyi ni / pir gyis yang dang yang khrag dbyung / bsil drod snum dang rtsub pa yis / nad ni zhi bar ma gyur na

verses.skt: rakte duṣṭe bhiṣak tasmād raktam evāvasecayet | yo jāto gorasaḥ kṣīrād vahnicūrṇāvacūrṇitāt
verses.tib: de phyir sman pas nad khrag nyid / dbyung ba la ni 'bad par bya / 'o ma tsi tra ka'i rtsa phye / btab pa las byung dar ba dang

verses.skt: pibaṃs tam eva tenaiva bhuñjāno gudajān jayet | kovidārasya mūlānāṃ mathitena rajaḥ piban
verses.tib: blud cing de nyid kyi zas ni / byin na gzhang 'brum sel bar 'gyur / ka pi da ri'i rtsa ba'i phye / dar ba gsar pa btab pa blud

verses.skt: aśnan jīrṇe ca pathyāni mucyate hatanāmabhiḥ | gudaśvayathuśūlārto mandāgnir gaulmikān pibet
verses.tib: zhu nas phan pa'i zas byin na / gzhang 'brum nad las thar bar 'gyur / gzhang skrang gzer bcas me drod 'bri / skran nad la ni phan pa'i sman

verses.skt: hiṅgvādīn anutakraṃ vā khāded guḍaharītakīm | takreṇa vā pibet pathyāvellāgnikuṭajatvacaḥ
verses.tib: shing kun la sogs blud pa'am / bu ram a rur sbyar ba / byin la de rjes dar ba blud / yang na a ru byi dang ga / dug mo nyung shun tsi tra ka

verses.skt: kaliṅgamagadhājyotiḥsūraṇān vāṃśavardhitān | koṣṇāmbunā vā tripaṭuvyoṣahiṅgvamlavetasam
verses.tib: dar ba dang sbyar blud pa'am / dug mo nyung dang pi pi ling / tsi tra ka dang su ra na / cha res bskyed pa chu dron blud / yang na tsha gsum lan tshwa gsum

verses.skt: yuktaṃ bilvakapitthābhyāṃ mahauṣadhaviḍena vā | aruṣkarair yavānyā vā pradadyāt takratarpaṇam
verses.tib: shing kun star bu bcas chu blud / bil ba ka pid thar bcas pa'am / bca' sga kha ru tsha ba bcas pa'am

verses.skt: dadyād vā hapuṣāhiṅgucitrakaṃ takrasaṃyutam | māsaṃ takrānupānāni khādet pīluphalāni vā
verses.tib: go bye la la phud bcas pa'i / skyo ma de la blud par bya / yang na shing kun spa ma'i 'bras / tsi tra ka dang dar ba sbyar / pi lu'i 'bras bu dar bar bcas / zla ba gcig gi bar du sbyin

verses.skt: pibed ahar ahas takraṃ niranno vā prakāmataḥ | atyarthaṃ mandakāyāgnes takram evāvacārayet
verses.tib: zas kyi sngon nyid re re zhing / ci 'dod par ni blud par bya / shin tu me drod chung ba la / dar ba kho na blud par bya

verses.skt: saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā māsārdhaṃ māsam eva ca | balakālavikārajño bhiṣak takraṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: nyams stobs dus dang gnas shes pa'i / sman pa yis ni dar ba dag / zhag bdun nam ni zhag bcu'am / zla ba zla gcig bar du blud

verses.skt: sāyaṃ vā lājasaktūnāṃ dadyāt takrāvalehikām | jīrṇe takre pradadyād vā takrapeyāṃ sasaindhavām
verses.tib: yang na phyi dro 'bras yos kyi / phye dang dar ba'i lde gu sbyin / dar ba zhu nas dar ba ni / thug pa rgyam tshar bcas pa blud

verses.skt: takrānupānaṃ sasnehaṃ takraudanam ataḥ param | yūṣai rasair vā takrāḍhyaiḥ śālīn bhuñjīta mātrayā
verses.tib: de rjes dar bar g.yos pa'i zan / snum can byin la dar ba blud / yu sha'am sha khu dar ba can / sA lu'i 'bras chen ran par bza'

verses.skt: rūkṣam ardhoddhṛtasnehaṃ yataś cānuddhṛtaṃ ghṛtam | takraṃ doṣāgnibalavit trividhaṃ tat prayojyet
verses.tib: rtsub dang mar phyed phyung ba dang / gang las mar ni ma phyung ba / dar ba nad dang me drod kyi / stobs las de ni rnam gsum sbyar

verses.skt: na virohanti gudajāḥ punas takrasamāhatāḥ | niṣiktaṃ tad dhi dahati bhūmāv api tṛṇolupam
verses.tib: dar bas legs bcom gyur pa yis / gzhang 'brum slar ni 'byung mi 'gyur / de blugs gyur na rtsa yi ni / tshogs kyang skye bar mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: srotaḥsu takraśuddheṣu raso dhātūn upaiti yaḥ | tena puṣṭir balaṃ varṇaḥ paraṃ tuṣṭiś ca jāyate
verses.tib: rtsa sbubs dar bas dag byas pas / lus zungs dngas mar gyur pa gang / de ni nyams dga' mdog dang stobs / mchog tu rgyas par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: vātaśleṣmavikārāṇāṃ śataṃ ca vinivartate | mathitaṃ bhājane kṣudrabṛhatīphalalepite
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan dag gi nad / brgya phrag dar ba rnying pas 'joms / gzhang 'brum gzhig par 'dod pa yis / kaN+Da ka ri'i lde gus bsku

verses.skt: niśāṃ paryuṣitaṃ peyam icchadbhir gudajakṣayam | dhānyopakuñcikājājīhapuṣāpippalīdvayaiḥ
verses.tib: snod du dar ba gsar pa ni / nub gcig gzhag ste blud par bya / 'u su zi ra go snyod dang / pi pi ling gnyis ha pu sha / shu ti pi pi ling rtsa ba

verses.skt: kāravīgranthikaśaṭhīyavānyagniyavānakaiḥ | cūrṇitair ghṛtapātrasthaṃ nātyamlaṃ takram āsutam
verses.tib: la la phud dang tsi tra ka / ya ba na gi'i phye ma dang / dar ba sbyar ba mar gyi snod / bzhag par gyur pa de las skyur / kha ba / dang ni rab skyur min

verses.skt: takrāriṣṭaṃ pibej jātaṃ vyaktāmlakaṭu kāmataḥ | dīpanaṃ rocanaṃ varṇyaṃ kaphavātānulomanam
verses.tib: skyur dang kha ba bro bar ni / ldang ba'i dar rnying ci 'dod blud / drod skyed mdog bzang yi ga 'byed / rlung dang bad kan sel byed cing

verses.skt: gudaśvayathukaṇḍvartināśanaṃ balavardhanam | tvacaṃ citrakamūlasya piṣṭvā kumbhaṃ pralepayet
verses.tib: gzhang skrang na bas nyam thag pa / 'joms shing stobs ni 'phel byed yin / kru trug tres kyi rtsa ba'i shu / btags pa'i lde gus bum pa bsku

verses.skt: takraṃ vā dadhi vā tatra jātam arśoharaṃ pibet | bhārgyāsphotāmṛtāpañcakoleṣv apy eṣa saṃvidhiḥ
verses.tib: der ni 'o ma dang ba gzhag / smin pa'i gzhang 'brum sel byed blud / ga bra'i rtsa ba a ru ra / sle tres tsha ba lnga dag la'ang / cho ga 'di nyid sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: piṣṭair gajakaṇāpāṭhākāravīpañcakolakaiḥ | tumburvajājīdhanikābilvamadhyaiś ca kalpayet
verses.tib: pa ta ha ti pi pi ling / shu ti tsha ba lnga g.yer ma / zi ra 'u su bil ba'i rkang / phye mar btags te sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: phalāmlān yamakasnehān peyāyūṣarasādikān | ebhir evauṣadhaiḥ sādhyaṃ vāri sarpiś ca dīpanam
verses.tib: 'bras bu skyur po mar til mar / yu sha sha khu thug bya / sman 'di nyid dang chu dang mar / bskol ba'ang drod skyed byed pa yin

verses.skt: kramo ’yaṃ bhinnaśakṛtāṃ vakṣyate gāḍhavarcasām | snehāḍhyaiḥ saktubhir yuktāṃ lavaṇāṃ vāruṇīṃ pibet
verses.tib: rim 'di bshang bslab yin / rtug pa 'gags pa bshang bya ste / snum zan dang ldan pa yi / chang dngas lan tshwa btab pa blud

verses.skt: lavaṇā eva vā takrasīdhudhānyāmlavāruṇīḥ | prāgbhaktān yamake bhṛṣṭān saktubhiś cāvacūrṇitān
verses.tib: yang na dar ba bu ram chang / chang skyur chang dngas lan tshwar sbyar / zas mngar mar dang til mar gyis

verses.skt: karañjapallavān khāded vātavarco'nulomanān | saguḍaṃ nāgaraṃ pāṭhāṃ guḍakṣāraghṛtāni vā
verses.tib: brngos pa'i ka rany+dza'i lo ma / steng du phye btab byin gyur na / rlung gis rtug pa 'gags pa sel / bca' sga bu ram bcas pa'am / ba ta bu ram mar lan tshwa

verses.skt: gomūtrādhyuṣitām adyāt saguḍāṃ vā harītakīm | pathyāśatadvayān mūtradroṇenāmūtrasaṃkṣayāt
verses.tib: ba gcin la spangs a ru ra / bu ram bcas pa sbyin pa'ang rung / a ru ra ni nyis brgya gcin / bre bcu drug tu gcin du'i bar

verses.skt: pakvāt khādet samadhunī dve dve hanti kaphodbhavān | durnāmakuṣṭhaśvayathugulmamehodarakṛmīn
verses.tib: bskol ba sbrang rtsir bcas pa dag / gnyis gnyis zos nas bad kan gyis / gzhang 'brum mdze dang 'or nad dang

verses.skt: granthyarbudāpacīsthaulyapāṇḍurogāḍhyamārutān | ajaśṛṅgījaṭākalkam ajāmūtreṇa yaḥ pibet
verses.tib: skran dang dmu rdzing gcin snyi 'bu / rmen bu shu bas khyab tsho ches / skya rbab rlung 'khyil 'joms par byed / a za sring gi rtsa ba yi / lde gu ra gcin sbyar 'thung zhing

verses.skt: guḍavārtākabhuk tasya naśyanty āśu gudāṅkurāḥ | śreṣṭhārasena trivṛtāṃ pathyāṃ takreṇa vā saha
verses.tib: bu ram bar ta ka zos na / gzhang 'brum myur du 'jig par 'gyur / dur byid 'bras bu gsum khur sbyar / yang na dar ba a ru ra'am

verses.skt: pathyāṃ vā pippalīyuktāṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭāṃ guḍānvitām | athavā satrivṛddantīṃ bhakṣayed anulomanīm
verses.tib: pi pi ling bcas a ru ra / mar dang brngos pa'i bu ram bcas / yang na dur byid dan dar bcas / zos na bde bar 'byung bar byed

verses.skt: hate gudāśraye doṣe gudajā yānti saṃkṣayam | dāḍimasvarasājājīyavānīguḍanāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: gzhang na gnas pa'i nad bsal na / gzhang 'brum zad par byed par 'gyur / se 'bru'i khu ba zir dang / bca' sga bu ram la la phud

verses.skt: pāṭhayā vā yutaṃ takraṃ vātavarco'nulomanam | sīdhuṃ vā gauḍam athavā sacitrakamahauṣadham
verses.tib: pa ta dang sbyar dar ba ni / rlung gis rtug 'gags sel byed yin / rgyun chang yang na bu ram chang / bca' sga kru trug tres dang bcas

verses.skt: pibet surāṃ vā hapuṣāpāṭhāsauvarcalānvitām | daśādidaśakair vṛddhāḥ pippalīr dvipicuṃ tilān
verses.tib: yang na chang ni pa ta dang / spa 'bras kha ru tsha bcas blud / pi pi ling ni bcu bcus bskyed / til ni srang phyed btab gyur na

verses.skt: pītvā kṣīreṇa labhate balaṃ dehahutāśayoḥ | duḥsparśakena bilvena yavānyā nāgareṇa vā
verses.tib: 'o ma bcas 'thungs lus stobs dang / me drod skyed par byed pa yin / byi tsher ba dang bil ba dang / la la phud dang dong gra rnams

verses.skt: ekaikenāpi saṃyuktā pāṭhā hanty arśasāṃ rujam | salilasya vahe paktvā prasthārdham abhayātvacām
verses.tib: re re dang sbyar pa tas kyang / gzhang 'brum nad ni sel bar byad / chu bre drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang / a ru ra shun bre phyed dang

verses.skt: prasthaṃ dhātryā daśapalaṃ kapitthānāṃ tato ’rdhataḥ | viśālāṃ lodhramaricakṛṣṇāvellailavālukam
verses.tib: skyu ru ra ni bre gang dang / ka pid ta ni srang bcu dang / pi sha la ni srang lnga dang / seng phrom shing tsha na le sham

verses.skt: dvipalāṃśaṃ pṛthak pādaśeṣe pūte guḍāt tule | dattvā prasthaṃ ca dhātakyāḥ sthāpayed ghṛtabhājane
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang byi dang ga / srang ni gnyis gnyis tshad byas bskol / bzhi cha lus btsags bu ram ni / srang ni nyis brgya bcug nas ni / da ta ki ni bre gang gzhug / mar gyi snod du bcug nas ni

verses.skt: pakṣāt sa śīlito ’riṣṭaḥ karoty agniṃ nihanti ca | gudajagrahaṇīpāṇḍukuṣṭhodaragarajvarān
verses.tib: me drod skyed cing gzhang 'brum dang / pho nad skya rbab mdze dmu rdzing / dbyig dug rims skran mchin nad dang

verses.skt: śvayathuplīhahṛdrogagulmayakṣmavamikṛmīn | jaladroṇe paced dantīdaśamūlavarāgnikān
verses.tib: snying nad skran dang gcong chen dang / slon dang srin bu'i nad rnams 'joms / chu bu bcu drug nang dan ti / rtsa bcu 'bras gsum tsi tra ka

verses.skt: pālikān pādaśeṣe tu kṣiped guḍatulāṃ param | pūrvavat sarvam asya syād ānulomitaras tv ayam
verses.tib: srang re bskol ba bzhi cha lus / bu ram srang brgyad gzhug par bya / thams cad snga ma dang 'dra las / rjes mthun cig shos sel bar byed

verses.skt: paced durālabhāprasthaṃ droṇe ’pāṃ prāsṛtaiḥ saha | dantīpāṭhāgnivijayāvāsāmalakanāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: chu bre bcu drug nang dag tu / byi tshor ba ni bre gang dang / dan ti pa ta tsi tra ka / rnam rgyal dong gra ba sha ka

verses.skt: tasmin sitāśataṃ dadyāt pādasthe ’nyac ca pūrvavat | limpet kumbhaṃ tu phalinīkṛṣṇācavyājyamākṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: bzhi cha lus pa de'i nang du / ka ra dkar po srang brgyad gzhug / gzhan dag snga ma bzhin du sbyar / rdza ma'i snod kyang pri yang ku / pi pi ling dang dbyi mo dang

verses.skt: prāgbhaktam ānulomyāya phalāmlaṃ vā pibed ghṛtam | cavyacitrakasiddhaṃ vā yavakṣāraguḍānvitam
verses.tib: bde bar 'byung phyir zas kyi sngar / 'bras bu skyur bcas mar blud pa'am / dbyi mo kru trug tras bskol mar / nas tshig / 'khus thal bu ram bcas

verses.skt: pippalīmūlasiddhaṃ vā saguḍakṣāranāgaram | pippalīpippalīmūladhānakādāḍimair ghṛtam
verses.tib: pi pi ling gi rtsa bar bskol / bu ram dong gra nas tshag 'khus / pi pi ling rtsa pi pi ling / se 'bru 'u su dag dang mar

verses.skt: dadhnā ca sādhitaṃ vātaśakṛnmūtravibandhanut | palāśakṣāratoyena triguṇena paced ghṛtam
verses.tib: 'phyen dang bshang gci 'gags pa sel / ba la sha yi thal ba'i chu / sum 'gyur dang ni mar du bskol

verses.skt: vatsakādipratīvāpam arśoghnaṃ dīpanaṃ param | pañcakolābhayākṣārayavānīviḍasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: dug mo nyung sogs phye ma btab / drod skyed gzhang 'brum 'joms pa'i mchog / tsha ba lnga dang ya ru ra

verses.skt: sapāṭhādhānyamaricaiḥ sabilvair dadhimat ghṛtam | sādhayet taj jayaty āśu gudavaṅkṣaṇavedanām
verses.tib: ya bak+Sha ra la la phud / lce myang tsha dang kha ru tsha / pa ta 'u su na le sham / bil bzho dang bcas pa'i mar / bskol ba des ni chu so gzhang

verses.skt: pravāhikāṃ gudabhraṃśaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ parisravam | pāṭhājamodadhanikāśvadaṃṣṭrāpañcakolakaiḥ
verses.tib: 'khru zhing gzhang ni nyams pa dang / gcin sri 'dzag pa sel bar byed / pa ta 'u su la la phud / tsha ba lnga dang gze ma dang

verses.skt: sabilvair dadhni cāṅgerīsvarase ca caturguṇe | hanty ājyaṃ siddham ānāhaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām
verses.tib: bil bzho dang tsang gi ri / khu ba mar gyi bzhi 'gyur bskol / lto sbos gcin ni sri ba dang / rtag tu 'khru dang gzhang 'brum dang

verses.skt: gudabhraṃśārtigudajagrahaṇīgadamārutān | śikhitittirilāvānāṃ rasān amlān susaṃskṛtān
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad rnams dang / bad kan rlung ni 'joms par byed / rma bya sreg pa 'ur bya yi / sha khu skyur po legs sbyar ba

verses.skt: dakṣāṇāṃ vartakānāṃ vā dadyād viḍvātasaṃgrahe | vāstukāgnitrivṛddantīpāṭhāmlīkādipallavān
verses.tib: 'phyen dang phyi sa 'gags la blud / rgya sne'u dur byid tsi tra ka / dan ti pa ti am+li ka / la sogs lo ma gzhan yang ni

verses.skt: anyac ca kaphavātaghnaṃ śākaṃ ca laghu bhedi ca | sahiṅgu yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ dadhisaraiḥ saha
verses.tib: bad kan rlung 'joms tshod ma ni / yang zhing bshang ba sla bar byed / shing kun mar dang til mar brngos / zho yi spris mar bskol ba dang

verses.skt: dhanikāpañcakolābhyāṃ piṣṭābhyāṃ dāḍimāmbunā | ārdrikāyāḥ kisalayaiḥ śakalair ārdrakasya ca
verses.tib: 'u su dang ni tsha ba lnga / btags pa'i phye dang se 'bru'i bcud / 'u su'i 'dab ma gzhon nu dang / sge'u gsher gshags par gyur pa dang

verses.skt: yuktam aṅgāradhūpena hṛdyena surabhīkṛtam | sajīrakaṃ samaricaṃ viḍasauvarcalotkaṭam
verses.tib: spos zhim legs bdug dri zhim byas / zir na le sham dang bcas / kha ru tsha ni shas cher bro

verses.skt: vātottarasya rūkṣasya mandāgner baddhavarcasaḥ | kalpayed raktaśālyannavyañjanaṃ śākavad rasān
verses.tib: rlung shas cher rtsub drod chung la / sA lu tsa snar 'bras chan ni / ba lang go ta rnga mo ra'i / sha khu tshod ltar g.yos pa dang / mchog tu sha za rnams kyi sha / rtug skam can la sbyin par bya / chang dang bur chang ka ra'i chu / rgun chang dar ba rtsab mo dang

verses.skt: gogodhāchagaloṣṭrāṇāṃ viśeṣāt kravyabhojinām | madirāṃ śārkaraṃ gauḍaṃ sīdhuṃ takraṃ tuṣodakam
verses.tib: rlung shas cher rtsub drod chung la / sA lu tsa snar 'bras chan ni / ba lang go ta rnga mo ra'i / sha khu tshod ltar g.yos pa dang / mchog tu sha za rnams kyi sha / rtug skam can la sbyin par bya / chang dang bur chang ka ra'i chu / rgun chang dar ba rtsab mo dang

verses.skt: ariṣṭaṃ mastu pānīyaṃ pānīyaṃ vālpakaṃ śṛtam | dhānyena dhānyaśuṇṭhībhyāṃ kaṇṭakārikayāthavā
verses.tib: chang rnying dang ni zho ga chu / yang na chu nyung bskol ba'am / 'u su bca' sga bskol ba'am / kaN+Da ka ri bskol ba blud

verses.skt: ante bhaktasya madhye vā vātavarco'nulomanam | viḍvātakaphapittānām ānulomye hi nirmale
verses.tib: zas kyi thog ma'am bar dag tu / rlung gi rtug skam sel ba sbyin / rlung mkhris bad kan rtug skam rnams / bde bar 'byung zhing dri ma sbyang

verses.skt: gude śāmyanti gudajāḥ pāvakaś cābhivardhate | udāvartaparītā ye ye cātyarthaṃ virūkṣitāḥ
verses.tib: gzhang khar gzhang 'brum zhi 'gyur zhing / me drod skyed par byed pa yin / rtug skam gyis ni gzir ba dang / gang yang shin tu khong rtsub dang

verses.skt: vilomavātāḥ śūlārtās teṣv iṣṭam anuvāsanam | pippalīṃ madanaṃ bilvaṃ śatāhvāṃ madhukaṃ vacām
verses.tib: rlung 'khyil gzer gyis nyen pa gang / de la 'jam rtsi bya ba bsngags / pi pi ling dang po son cha / bil ba shu ti shing mngar dang

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaṃ śaṭhīṃ puṣkarākhyaṃ citrakaṃ devadāru ca | piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipaktavyaṃ dviguṇakṣīrasaṃyutam
verses.tib: shu dag ru rta kru trug tres / zur pa ma nu thang shing rnams / btags te til mar la btso zhing / 'o ma til mar nyis 'gyur gzhug

verses.skt: arśasāṃ mūḍhavātānāṃ tac chreṣṭham anuvāsanam | gudaniḥsaraṇaṃ śūlaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum rlung gis 'khyil ba la / 'jam rtsi de ni mchog tu bsngags / gzhang 'byung ba dang gzer ba dang / gcin sri 'khrog cing 'khru ba dang

verses.skt: kaṭyūrupṛṣṭhadaurbalyam ānāhaṃ vaṅkṣaṇāśrayam | picchāsrāvaṃ gude śophaṃ vātavarcovinigraham
verses.tib: brla rked rgyab na nyam chung dang / lto sbos chu sor brten pa dang / be snabs 'khru dang gzhang skrang dang / rlung gis rtug ba 'gags pa dang

verses.skt: utthānaṃ bahuśo yac ca jayet tac cānuvāsanāt | nirūhaṃ vā prayuñjīta sakṣīraṃ pāñcamūlikam
verses.tib: gang zhig mang du 'byung 'dod pa / de dag 'jam rtsis sel bar byed / yang na mas gtong bkru sman drag / rtsa ba lnga pa 'o mar bcas

verses.skt: samūtrasnehalavaṇaṃ kalkair yuktaṃ phalādibhiḥ | atha raktārśasāṃ vīkṣya mārutasya kaphasya vā
verses.tib: ba gcin til mar lan tshwa dang / son cha la sogs lde gu gtang / de nas gzhang 'brum khrag 'dzag pa / rlung ngam bad kan dang 'brel ba

verses.skt: anubandhaṃ tataḥ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ vā yojayed dhimam | śakṛc chyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣam adho niryāti nānilaḥ
verses.tib: btags nas de la snum pa dang / rtsub dang bsil ba sbyar bar bya / de la rlung dang rjes 'brel ba / bshang ba gnag cing sra la rtsub / rlung ni thur du 'byung mi byed

verses.skt: kaṭyūrugudaśūlaṃ ca hetur yadi ca rūkṣaṇam | tatrānubandho vātasya śleṣmaṇo yadi viṭ ślathā
verses.tib: rked pa brla dang gzhang kha gzer / rtsub pa'i rgyur ni gyur pa yin / bad kan rjes 'brel bshang ba sla

verses.skt: śvetā pītā guruḥ snigdhā sapicchaḥ stimito gudaḥ | hetuḥ snigdhagurur vidyād yathāsvaṃ cāsralakṣaṇāt
verses.tib: skya zhing ser la lci zhing snum / spyi bag gzhang kha tshor ba chung / rgyu ni snum lci yin zhes bya / rang khrag mtshan nyid las kyang brtags

verses.skt: duṣṭe ’sre śodhanaṃ kāryaṃ laṅghanaṃ ca yathābalam | yāvac ca doṣaiḥ kāluṣyaṃ srutes tāvad upekṣaṇam
verses.tib: nad khrag bsal bar bya ba dang / nyams stobs ji bzhin smyung ba bya / ji srid nad khrag nag po byung / de srid khrag 'dzag gcad mi bya

verses.skt: doṣāṇāṃ pācanārthaṃ ca vahnisaṃdhukṣaṇāya ca | saṃgrahāya ca raktasya paraṃ tiktair upācaret
verses.tib: nad ni smin par bya phyir dang / me drod bskyed par bya phyir dang / khrag ni gcad par bya ba'i phyir / de phan chad ni kha ba blud

verses.skt: yat tu prakṣīṇadoṣasya raktaṃ vātolbaṇasya vā | snehais tat sādhayet yuktaiḥ pānābhyañjanavastiṣu
verses.tib: gang zhig nad / kyis stobs zad pa / khrag ni rlung gi shes che la / btung dang bsku dang 'jam rtsi ru / rig pas snum ni sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: yat tu pittolbaṇaṃ raktaṃ gharmakāle pravartate | stambhanīyaṃ tad ekāntān na ced vātakaphānugam
verses.tib: gang zhig mkhris pa rgyas pa'i khrag / tsha ba'i dus su 'byung gyur pa / de ni gcig tu gcad bya yi / rlung dang bad kan las gyur min / bad kan bcas khrag bca' sga dang

verses.skt: sakaphe ’sre pibet pākyaṃ śuṇṭhīkuṭajavalkalam | kirātatiktakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dhanvayāsaṃ kucandanam
verses.tib: dug mo nyung shun bskol ba blud / yang na rtsa mkhris bca' sga dang / byi tsher tsan+dan dmar po'am / skyer pa'i shun pa pu shel tse

verses.skt: dārvītvaṅnimbasevyāni tvacaṃ vā dāḍimodbhavām | kuṭajatvakphalaṃ tārkṣyaṃ mākṣikaṃ ghuṇavallabhām
verses.tib: nim pa'am se 'bru'i shun bskol blud / dug mo nyung shun 'bras bu dang / bong nga sbrang rtsi skyer khaN+Da 'am

verses.skt: pibet taṇḍulatoyena kalkitaṃ vā mayūrakam | tulāṃ divyāmbhasi paced ārdrāyāḥ kuṭajatvacaḥ
verses.tib: yang na a pa marga yi / lde gu 'bras kyi chu sbyar blud / dug mo nyung gi shun pa rlon / srang brgyad char chu nang du bskol

verses.skt: nīrasāyāṃ tvaci kvāthe dadyāt sūkṣmarajīkṛtān | samaṅgāphalinīmocarasān muṣṭyaṃśakān samān
verses.tib: shun lpags khu ba btsags pa ru / btsod dang mo tsa pri yang+ku'i / khu ba srang re dag dang ni / dug mo nyung gi phye ma bcug

verses.skt: taiś ca śakrayavān pūte tato darvīpralepanam | paktvāvalehaṃ līḍhvā ca taṃ yathāgnibalaṃ pibet
verses.tib: de nas gzar bur chags pa yi / lde gu bskol ba sbyin bya zhing / thug pa thug sla'i'o thug gam

verses.skt: peyāṃ maṇḍaṃ payaś chāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā chāgadugdhabhuk | leho ’yaṃ śamayaty āśu raktātīsārapāyujān
verses.tib: ra 'am ba yi'o ma'am / me stobs ji bzhin blud par bya / lde gu 'dis ni khrag gi ni / tshad 'khru gzhang 'brum sel byed cing

verses.skt: balavad raktapittaṃ ca sravad ūrdhvam adho ’pi vā | kuṭajatvaktulāṃ droṇe paced aṣṭāṃśaśeṣitam
verses.tib: khrag mkhris nad ni stobs ldan pa / steng ngam 'og nas 'byung ba sel / dug mo nyung shun srang brgyad cu / bre bcu drug bskol brgyad cha blud

verses.skt: kalkīkṛtya kṣipet tatra tārkṣyaśailaṃ kaṭutrayam | lodhradvayaṃ mocarasaṃ balāṃ dāḍimajaṃ tvacam
verses.tib: de ni cha gsum skyer khaN+Da / seng phrom gnyis dang mon cha ra / se 'bru gzhon nu'i shun lpags dang

verses.skt: bilvakarkaṭikāṃ mustaṃ samaṅgāṃ dhātakīphalam | palonmitaṃ daśapalaṃ kuṭajasyaiva ca tvacaḥ
verses.tib: bil ba gzhon nu gla sgang dang / btsod dang da ta ka'i 'bras bu / srang ni re re btags pa yi / lde gur byas pa gzhug par bya / dug mo nyung shun srang bcu dang

verses.skt: triṃśat palāni guḍato ghṛtāt pūte ca viṃśatiḥ | tat pakvaṃ lehatāṃ yātaṃ dhānye pakṣasthitaṃ lihan
verses.tib: zhun mar srang ni nyi shu dang / bu ram srang ni sum cu gzhug / bskol la gzar bur chags pa dang / 'bru nang zla phyed bcug ste bldag

verses.skt: sarvārśograhaṇīdoṣaśvāsakāsān niyacchati | lodhraṃ tilān mocarasaṃ samaṅgāṃ candanotpalam
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum kun dang pho ba'i nad / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel / seng phrom mo tsa ra sa til / btsod dang tsan+dan ut+pal

verses.skt: pāyayitvājadugdhena śālīṃs tenaiva bhojayet | yaṣṭyāhvapadmakānantāpayasyākṣīramoraṭam
verses.tib: ra yi 'o ma sbyar ba blud / de nyid dang ni 'bas chen sbyin / shing mngar shun pa byi tsher ba / 'o ma dUr ba pa ya s+ya

verses.skt: sasitāmadhu pātavyaṃ śītatoyena tena vā | lodhrakaṭvaṅgakuṭajasamaṅgāśālmalītvacam
verses.tib: khar sbrang rtsir / bcas chu'am / ra yi 'o ma sbyar ba btung / seng phrom btsod dang pu shel tse / sha ma li shun dug mo nyung / tsan+dan shing mngar pu shel tse

verses.skt: himakesarayaṣṭyāhvasevyaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā | yavānīndrayavāḥ pāṭḥā bilvaṃ śuṇṭhī rasāñjanam
verses.tib: nA ga ge sar 'bras chur blud / la la phud dang dug mo nyung / pa ta bca' sga skyer khaN+Da'i

verses.skt: cūrṇaś cale hitaḥ śūle pravṛtte cātiśoṇite | dugdhikākaṇṭakārībhyāṃ siddhaṃ sarpiḥ praśasyate
verses.tib: phye ma gzer dang bcas la phan / khrag ni drag tu 'byung ba la / kaN+Da ka ri pa ya s+ya / gnyis dang bskol ba'i zhun mar bsngags

verses.skt: athavā dhātakīlodhrakuṭajatvakphalotpalaiḥ | sakesarair yavakṣāradāḍimasvarasena vā
verses.tib: yang na seng phrom da ta ki / dug mo nyung shun 'bras bu dang / ut+pal pad+ma ge sar mar / ya bak+Sha ra se 'bru'i bcud

verses.skt: śarkarāmbhojakiñjalkasahitaṃ saha vā tilaiḥ | abhyastaṃ raktagudajān navanītaṃ niyacchati
verses.tib: kha ra pad+ma ge sar dang / mar sar bcas pa til sbyar ba'am / mar sar sbyar bas khrag las ni / gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum sel bar byed

verses.skt: chāgāni navanītājyakṣīramāṃsāni jāṅgalaḥ | anamlo vā kadamla vā savāstukaraso rasaḥ
verses.tib: ra yi mar sar 'o ma dang / skam sa'i srog chags sha khrag dang / rgya sne'i khu bar bcas sha khu / cung zad skyur dang skyur med pa

verses.skt: raktaśāliḥ saro dadhnaḥ ṣaṣṭikas taruṇī surā | taruṇaś ca surāmaṇḍaḥ śoṇitasyauṣadhaṃ param
verses.tib: sA lu tsa snar zho yi spri / drug cu pa dang chang sar dang / chang gi dngas ma sar pa ni / khrag las gyur pa'i sman mchog yin

verses.skt: peyāyūṣarasādyeṣu palāṇḍuḥ kevalo ’pi vā | sa jayaty ulbaṇaṃ raktaṃ mārutaṃ ca prayojitaḥ
verses.tib: thug pa yu sha sha khu sogs / yang na kun dong 'ba' zhig gis / khrag rgyas gyur pa sel byed de / rlung las gyur pa'ang sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: vātolbaṇāni prāyeṇa bhavanty asre ’tiniḥsṛte | arśāṃsi tasmād adhikaṃ tajjaye yatnam ācaret
verses.tib: phal cher rlung shas che gzhang 'brum / khrag 'dzag drags las 'byung 'gyur bas / de bas lhag par de la ni / de bsal ba la 'bad par bya

verses.skt: dṛṣṭvāsrapittaṃ prabalam abalau ca kaphānilau | śītopacāraḥ kartavyaḥ sarvathā tatpraśāntaye
verses.tib: khrag mkhris shas che bad kan dang / rlung shas che bar mthong gyur na / de zhi bya phyir rnam kun du / bsil ba'i cho ga spyad par bya

verses.skt: na ced evaṃ śamas tasya snigdhoṣṇais tarpayet tataḥ | rasaiḥ koṣṇaiś ca sarpirbhir avapīḍakayojitaiḥ
verses.tib: gal te des kyang ma zhi na / de tshe snum dang dro bas brta / sha khu dro 'jam zhun mar ni

verses.skt: secayet taṃ kavoṣṇaiś ca kāmaṃ tailapayoghṛtaiḥ | yavāsakuśakāśānāṃ mūlaṃ puṣpaṃ ca śālmaleḥ
verses.tib: de la til mar mar dang ni / 'o ma dro 'jam blud pa'ang bsngags / byi tsher ku sha 'jag ma'i rtswa / shal ma li yi me tog dang

verses.skt: nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaśuṅgāś ca dvipalonmitāḥ | triprasthe salilasyaitat kṣīraprasthe ca sādhayet
verses.tib: u dum bA ra n+ya gro d+ha / a shwad+tha yi myu gu srang / gnyis gnyis chu bre gsum dang ni / 'o ma bre gang nang du bskol

verses.skt: kṣīraśeṣe kaṣāye ca tasmin pūte vimiśrayet | kalkīkṛtaṃ mocarasaṃ samaṅgāṃ candanotpalam
verses.tib: 'o ma lus nas tshigs ma btsags / khu ba der ni mon cha ra / btsod dang tsan+dan ut+pal

verses.skt: priyaṅguṃ kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ kamalasya ca kesaram | picchāvastir ayaṃ siddhaḥ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaraḥ
verses.tib: ut+pal pad+ma'i ge sar dang / dug mo nyung gi sa bon / te / 'di rnams btags pa'i lde gu bsres / 'di ni spyi bag 'jam rtsir grags / mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas

verses.skt: pravāhikāgudabhraṃśaraktasrāvajvarāpahaḥ | yaṣṭyāhvapuṇḍarīkeṇa tathā mocarasādibhiḥ
verses.tib: mkhregs dang gzhang ni 'byung ba dang / khrag 'dzag rims ni 'joms par byed / shing mngar pra puN+Da rI ka / de bzhin mon char la sogs

verses.skt: kṣīradviguṇitaḥ pakvo deyaḥ sneho ’nuvāsanam | madhukotpalalodhrāmbu samaṅgā bilvacandanam
verses.tib: nyis 'gyur gyi ni 'o ma bskol / snum gyi 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya / shing mngar ut+pal seng phrom btsod / bil ba tsan+dan ba le ka

verses.skt: cavikātiviṣā mustaṃ pāṭhā kṣāro yavāgrajaḥ | dārvītvaṅ nāgaraṃ māṃsī citrako devadāru ca
verses.tib: dbyi mo gla sgang bong nga dkar / ba ta ya bak+Sha ra mchog / skyer pa shing tsha tsi tra ka / dong ga spang spos thang shing dang

verses.skt: cāṅgerīsvarase sarpiḥ sādhitaṃ tais tridoṣajit | arśo'tīsāragrahaṇīpāṇḍurogajvarārucau
verses.tib: tsang gi ri yi khu ba mar / bskol ba des ni nyes gsum 'joms / gzhang 'brum tshad 'khru pho ba'i nad / skya rbab rims dang yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: mūtrakṛcchre gudabhraṃśe vastyānāhe pravāhaṇe | picchāsrāve ’rśasāṃ śūle deyaṃ tat paramauṣadham
verses.tib: gcin sri gzhang ni nyams pa dang / chu so sbo dang mkhregs pa dang / be snabs 'khru dang gzhang 'brum sel / de blud sman gyi dam pa yin

verses.skt: vyatyāsān madhurāmlāni śītoṣṇāni ca yojayet | nityam agnibalāpekṣī jayaty arśaḥkṛtān gadān
verses.tib: rim gyis mngar zhing skyur ba dang / grang dro la sogs rtag tu ni / me drod stobs las ltos te gtang / gzhang 'brum nad las rgyal bar 'gyur

verses.skt: udāvartārtam abhyajya tailaiḥ śītajvarāpahaiḥ | susnigdhaiḥ svedayet piṇḍair vartim asmai gude tataḥ
verses.tib: rtug skam gyis nyen til mar ni / grang ba'i rims la phan pas bsku / rlan dugs snum can gyis dugs bya / de nas reng bu gzhug bya ste

verses.skt: abhyaktāṃ tatkarāṅguṣṭhasaṃnibhām anulomanīm | dadyāc chyāmātrivṛddantīpippalīnīlinīphalaiḥ
verses.tib: sha ma dur byid dan da dang / ni li ni 'bras pi pi ling / po son cha lan tshwa nyes 'gyur / phyer btags bu ram ba gcin sbyar / mar bskus ring bu mthe bong tsam

verses.skt: vicūrṇitair dvilavaṇair guḍagomūtrasaṃyutaiḥ | tadvan māgadhikārāṭhagṛhadhūmaiḥ sasarṣapaiḥ
verses.tib: bcug na rtug skam bde 'byung byed / pi pi ling dang po son cha / khyim gyi dung pa nyungs kar bcas

verses.skt: eteṣām eva vā cūrṇaṃ gude nāḍyā vinirdhamet | tadvighāte sutīkṣṇaṃ tu vastiṃ snigdhaṃ prapīḍayet
verses.tib: 'di dag nyid kyi phye ma ni / rkub nas gce 'us 'bud bar bya / de don med na rab rno snum / mas gtong bas ni btsir te gtang

verses.skt: ṛjūkuryād gudasirāviṇmūtramaruto ’sya saḥ | bhūyo ’nubandhe vātaghnair virecyaḥ sneharecanaiḥ
verses.tib: des ni gzhang rtsa drang por byed / bshang gci 'phyen ni bde bar 'byung / slar yang 'gags na rlung 'joms pa'i / bkru sman snum can gtang bya zhing / 'jam rtsi dag ni gtang bar bya

verses.skt: anuvāsyaś ca raukṣyād dhi saṅgo mārutavarcasoḥ | tripaṭutrikaṭuśreṣṭhādantyaruṣkaracitrakam
verses.tib: rtsub pas rlung ni rtug skam 'gyur / lan tshwa gsum dang tsha ba gsum / 'bras bu gsum dang dan ti dang / bse shing 'bras bu tsi / tra ka

verses.skt: jarjaraṃ snehamūtrāktam antardhūmaṃ vipācayet | śarāvasaṃdhau mṛllipte kṣāraḥ kalyāṇakāhvayaḥ
verses.tib: phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsis sbrus / rdza skyogs kha sbyar 'jim pas byugs / du ba nang 'khyims bsreg par bya / thal ba dge ba can zhes bya

verses.skt: sa pītaḥ sarpiṣā yukto bhakte vā snigdhabhojinā | udāvartavibandhārśogulmapāṇḍūdarakṛmīn
verses.tib: mar dang lhan cig blud pa'am / 'bras chan snum can dang sbyar zos / rtug skam 'gags dang gzhang 'brum skran / skya rbab dmu rdzing bde gcin sri

verses.skt: mūtrasaṅgāśmarīśophahṛdrogagrahaṇīgadān | mehaplīharujānāhaśvāsakāsāṃś ca nāśayet
verses.tib: snying nad 'or nad pho ba'i nad / gcin snyi mchin pa gzer dang smro / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba 'joms

verses.skt: sarvaṃ ca kuryād yat proktam arśasāṃ gāḍhavarcasām | droṇe ’pāṃ pūtivalkadvitulam atha pacet pādaśeṣe ca tasmin | deyāśītir guḍasya pratanukarajaso vyoṣato ’ṣṭau palāni | etan māsena jātaṃ janayati paramām ūṣmaṇaḥ paktiśaktiṃ | śuktaṃ kṛtvānulomyaṃ prajayati gudajaplīhagulmodarāṇi
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum la ni gang zhig bshad / de bzhin rtug skam dag la sbyar / ka rany+dza shun srang ni nyis brgya bcu / bre bcu drug bskol bzhi cha lus pa der / bu ram srang ni brgyad cu tsha ba gsum / srang brgyad zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma gzhug / 'di dag zla gcig bzhag ste langs gyur nas / tsha byas mchog tu drod skyed zas 'ju ba'i / nus skyed rlung bder rgyu byas gzhang 'brum dang / mcher nad skran dang dmu rdzing sel bar byed

verses.skt: pacet tulāṃ pūtikarañjavalkād dve mūlataś citrakakaṇṭakāryoḥ | droṇatraye ’pi caraṇāvaśeṣe pūte śataṃ tatra guḍasya dadyāt
verses.tib: pu ti ka rany+dza ni srang brgyad dang / tsi tra kaN+Da ka ri srang nyis brgya / chu bre bzhi bcu brgyad bskol bzhi cha lus / btsags te bsgrangs par bu ram srang brgyad gzhug

verses.skt: palikaṃ ca sucūrṇitaṃ trijātatrikaṭugranthikadāḍimāśmabhedam | purapuṣkaramūladhānyacavyaṃ hapuṣām ārdrakam amlavetasaṃ ca
verses.tib: dri sna gsum dang tsha gsum se 'bru dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba sru sru'i rtsa / gu gul ma nu 'u su dbyi mong dang / spa ma'i 'bras bu sge gsher star bu ni

verses.skt: śītībhūtaṃ kṣaudraviṃśatyupetam ārdradrākṣābījapūrārdrakaiś ca | yuktaṃ kāmaṃ gaṇḍikābhis tathekṣoḥ sarpiḥpātre māsamātreṇa jātam
verses.tib: srang re zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma bskol / bsgrangs nas sbrang rtsi srang ni nyi shu gzhug / sge gsher skyur rtsi chen po rgun 'brum rlon / bu ram shing gi khu ba btsir ba bcas / mar gyi snod bcug zla gcig bzhag ste langs

verses.skt: cukraṃ krakacam ivedaṃ durnāmnāṃ vahnidīpanaṃ paramam | pāṇḍugarodaragulmaplīhānāhāśmakṛcchraghnam
verses.tib: skyur gyur 'di ni gzhang 'brum sog le ste / me drod skyed par byed pa'i mchog yin la / skya rbab dbyig drug dmu rdzing skran mcher pa / lto sbos rde'u chags gcin sri 'joms par byed

verses.skt: droṇaṃ pīlurasasya vastragalitaṃ nyastaṃ havirbhājane | yuñjīta dvipalair madāmadhuphalākharjūradhātrīphalaiḥ | pāṭhāmādridurālabhāmlavidulavyoṣatvagelollakaiḥ | spṛkkākolalavaṅgavellacapalāmūlāgnikaiḥ pālikaiḥ
verses.tib: mar gyi snod kyi nang du bcug nas ni / da ta ki dang rgun 'bru 'bra go dang / skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu srang gnyis gnyis / pa ta bong nga dkar po byi tsher ba / star bu tsha ba gsum dang shing tsha dang / sug smel 'u su spra ki ka ko la / li shi pi pi ling rtsa byi

verses.skt: guḍapalaśatayojitaṃ nivāte nihitam idaṃ prapibaṃś ca pakṣamātrāt | niśamayati gudāṅkurān sagulmān analabalaṃ prabalaṃ karoti cāśu
verses.tib: dang ga / kru trug tres srang re re bu ram ni / srang brgyad rlung med gnas su zla phyed gzhag / des ni gzhang 'brum skran bcas zhi byed cing / me yi stobs ni myur du skyed par byed

verses.skt: ekaikaśo daśapale daśamūlakumbhapāṭhādvayārkaghuṇavallabhakaṭphalānām | dagdhe srute ’nu kalaśena jalena pakve pādasthite guḍatulāṃ palapañcakaṃ ca
verses.tib: yang na rtsa ba bcu pa dur byid dang / pa ta ar ka gnyis dang bong nga dkar / kad pa la rnams re re srang bcu bcu / snga ma bzhin du bsregs pa'i thal ba ni / chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol nas ni / bzhi cha lus par bu ram srang brgya dang / tsha ba gsum dang dbyi mong a ru ra / srang lnga tsi tra ka ni srang gnyis dang

verses.skt: dadyāt pratyekaṃ vyoṣacavyābhayānāṃ vahner muṣṭī dve yavakṣārataś ca | darvīm ālimpan hanti līḍho guḍo ’yaṃ gulmaplīhārśaḥkuṣṭhamehāgnisādān || 152 || toyadroṇe citrakamūlatulārdhaṃ sādhyaṃ yāvat pādadalastham athedam | aṣṭau dattvā jīrṇaguḍasya palāni kvāthyaṃ bhūyaḥ sāndratayā samam etat || 153 || trikaṭukamiśipathyākuṣṭhamustāvarāṅgakṛmiripudahanailācūrṇakīrṇo ’valehaḥ | jayati gudajakuṣṭhaplīhagulmodarāṇi prabalayati hutāśaṃ śaśvad abhyasyamānaḥ
verses.tib: ya bak+Sha ra srang gnyis bcug ste bskol / gzar bur chags pa'i bu ram lde gu yis / skran dang mcher nang gzhang 'brum mdze nad dang / gcin nad me drod nyams pa 'joms par byed / tsi tra ka yi rtsa ba srang lnga bcu / chu srang bcu drug bskol la brgyad cha lus / der ni bu ram rnying pa srang brgya gzhug / slar bskol ska bar gyur pa de nang du

verses.skt: guḍavyoṣavarāvellatilāruṣkaracitrakaiḥ | arśāṃsi hanti guṭikā tvagvikāraṃ ca śīlitā
verses.tib: ru rta gla sgang shing tsha byi dang ga / tsi tra ka dang sug smel phyer btags bsres / des ni gzhang 'brum mdze dang skran dang ni / mcher pa dmu rdzing nad ni 'joms byed cing

verses.skt: mṛlliptaṃ sauraṇaṃ kandaṃ paktvāgnau puṭapākavat | adyāt satailalavaṇaṃ durnāmavinivṛttaye
verses.tib: rtag tu bsten na me drod skyed par byed / tsha ba gsum dang til dang 'bras bu gsum / byi dang ga dang go bye tsi tra ka / bu ram ri lur byas bsten gzhang 'brum dang / pags pa'i nad ni sel bar byed pa yin / sor na yi rtsa ba kha sbyar bcug / 'jim pas bskus te cho ga bzhin bsregs pa

verses.skt: maricapippalināgaracitrakān kramavivardhitabhāgasamāhṛtān | śikhicaturguṇasūraṇayojitān kuru guḍena guḍān gudajacchidaḥ
verses.tib: na le sham dang pi pi ling dong gra / kru trug tres ni cha re bskyed pa dang / tsi tra bzhi 'gyur su ra na dang sbyar / bu ram ri lus gzhang 'brum gcod par byed

verses.skt: cūrṇīkṛtāḥ ṣoḍaśa sūraṇasya bhāgās tato ’rdhena ca citrakasya | mahauṣadhād dvau maricasya caiko guḍena durnāmajayāya piṇḍī
verses.tib: so ra na yi bcu drug phyer btags shing / tsi tra ka ni de yi cha phyed bya / bca' sga cha gnyis na le sham cha gcig / bu ram ri lur byas pas gzhang 'brum sel

verses.skt: pathyānāgarakṛṣṇākarañjavellāgnibhiḥ sitātulyaiḥ | vaḍabāmukha iva jarayati bahugurv api bhojanaṃ cūrṇaḥ
verses.tib: a ru ra dang dong gra pi pi ling / ka rany+dza dang tsi tra byi dang ga / ka ra mnyam phye rgod ma'i kha lta bu / zas lci mang du / zos kyang 'ju bar byed

verses.skt: kaliṅgalāṅgalīkṛṣṇāvahnyapāmārgataṇḍulaiḥ | bhūnimbasaindhavaguḍair guḍā gudajanāśanāḥ
verses.tib: dug mo nyung laM ga li pi pi ling / tsi tra ka dang a ba marga yi / sa bon rtsa mkhris rgyam tsha bu ram rnams

verses.skt: lavaṇottamavahnikaliṅgayavāṃś ciribilvamahāpicumandayutān | piba saptadinaṃ mathitāluḍitān yadi marditum icchasi pāyuruhān
verses.tib: ri lur byas pas gzhang 'brum sel bar byed / gal te gzhang 'brum gzhig par 'dod na ni / rgyam tsha tsi tra ka dang dug mo nyung / tsi li bil ba nim par bcas pa dag / btags pa'i phye ma dar bar bcas pa btung

verses.skt: śuṣkeṣu bhallātakam agryam uktaṃ bhaiṣajyam ārdreṣu tu vatsakatvak | sarveṣu sarvartuṣu kālaśeyam arśaḥsu balyaṃ ca malāpahaṃ ca
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum skam la ba la ta ka ste / gsher la dug mo nyung shun sman mchog yin / kun la dus kun du ni dar rnying mchog / stobs skyed byed cing nad rnams 'joms pa yin

verses.skt: bhittvā vibandhān anulomanāya yan mārutasyāgnibalāya yac ca | tad annapānauṣadham arśasena sevyaṃ vivarjyaṃ viparītam asmāt
verses.tib: rtug pa 'gags pa bsal bar bya ba'i phyir / rlung sel me drod skyed par byed pa yi / bza' dang btung ba gang yin de bsten bya / de las go zlog pa ni spang bar bya

verses.skt: arśo'tisāragrahaṇīvikārāḥ prāyeṇa cānyo'nyanidānabhūtāḥ | sanne ’nale santi na santi dīpte rakṣed atas teṣu viśeṣato ’gnim
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum tshad 'khru pho ba'i nad rnams ni / phal cher phan tshun rgyur gyur yin pas na / me drod chung na skye'i che na min / de bas de la mchog tu me drod bsrung

verses.skt: atīsāro hi bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhavaty āmāśayānvayaḥ | hatvāgniṃ vātaje ’py asmāt prāk tasmi¿ laṅghanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: 'khru ba phal cher ma zhu ba'i / gnas rten me drod nyams pa la / 'byung bas de'i phyir rlung gyur la'ang / dang po smyung ba byas pa phan

verses.skt: śūlānāhaprasekārtaṃ vāmayed atisāriṇam | doṣāḥ saṃnicitā ye ca vidagdhāhāramūrchitāḥ
verses.tib: gzer dbo bad kan gyis nyam thag / 'khru ba can ni slon du gzhug / nad ni gang zhig sogs pa dag / ma smin zas dang 'dres gyur na

verses.skt: atīsārāya kalpante teṣūpekṣaiva bheṣajam | bhṛśotkleśapravṛtteṣu svayam eva calātmasu
verses.tib: 'khru ba dag ni 'byung gyur te / shin tu slongs te 'byung gyur dang / rang nyid 'khru byed de la ni / btang snyoms gzhag pa de nyid sman

verses.skt: na tu saṃgrahaṇaṃ yojyaṃ pūrvam āmātisāriṇi | api cādhmānagurutāśūlastaimityakāriṇi
verses.tib: ma zhu 'khrul dang por ni / gcod pa'i sman ni gtang mi bya / gal te 'gags byed lto sbo lci

verses.skt: prāṇadā prāṇadā doṣe vibaddhe saṃpravartinī | pibet prakvathitās toye madhyadoṣo viśoṣayan
verses.tib: gzer dang tshor ba chung gyur la / a ru btang na nad 'khyil ba / 'byin pas srog ni ster byed yin / nad tshabs 'bring la khyad par du

verses.skt: bhūtikapippalīśuṇṭhīvacādhānyaharītakīḥ | athavā bilvadhanikāmustanāgaravālakam
verses.tib: bu ti ka dang pi pi ling / bca' sga shu dag a ru ra / 'u su legs par bskol ba blud / yang na bil ba 'u su dang / gla sgang dong gra ba le ka

verses.skt: viḍapāṭhāvacāpathyākṛmijinnāgarāṇi vā | śuṇṭhīghanavacāmādrībilvavatsakahiṅgu vā
verses.tib: pa tha shu dag kha ru tsha / dong ga byi dang a ru ra / bca' sga gla sgang bong nga dkar / bil ba shing kun dug mo nyung

verses.skt: śasyate tv alpadoṣāṇām upavāso ’tisāriṇām | vacāprativiṣābhyāṃ vā mustāparpaṭakena vā
verses.tib: nad gzhi chung ba'i tshad 'khrul / smyung ba byas pa bsngags pa yin / yang na shu dag bong nga dkar / gla sgang par pa ta bskol pa 'am

verses.skt: hrīveranāgarābhyāṃ vā vipakvaṃ pāyayej jalam | yukte ’nnakāle kṣutkṣāmaṃ laghvannaprati bhojayet
verses.tib: ba le ka dang dong gra ni / bskol ba'i chu dag blud par bya / bkres shing nyam chung zas dus su / kha zas yang ba rig pas sbyin

verses.skt: tathā sa śīghraṃ prāpnoti rucim agnibalaṃ balam | takreṇāvantisomena yavāgvā tarpaṇena vā
verses.tib: des de'i kha zas yi gar 'ong / me drod lus stobs skyed par byed / dar ba'am rang skyur dag gam ni

verses.skt: surayā madhunā vātha yathāsātmyam upācaret | bhojyāni kalpayed ūrdhvaṃ grāhidīpanapācanaiḥ
verses.tib: nas thug dag gi skyo ma'am / chang ngam rgun chang dag gi ni / btung ba gang 'os nyer spyad bya / kha zas byin pa'i 'og tu ni

verses.skt: bālabilvaśaṭhīdhānyahiṅguvṛkṣāmladāḍimaiḥ | palāśahapuṣājājīyavānīviḍasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: bil ba gzhon nu zur ba dkar / 'u su shing kun nga trig se'u / zi ra spa 'bras pa la sha / la la phud dang kha ru tsha

verses.skt: laghunā pañcamūlena pañcakolena pāṭhayā | śāliparṇībalābilvaiḥ pṛśniparṇyā ca sādhitā
verses.tib: rgyam tsha rtsa ba chung ngu lnga / tsha ba lnga dang pa tha ste / smin gcod drod ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: dāḍimāmlā hitā peyā kaphapitte samulbaṇe | abhayāpippalīmūlabilvair vātānulomanī
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pa'i shas che la / sa la par+Ni ba la dang / bil ba kr-iSh+Na par+Ni dang / se 'bru bskol ba'i thug pa phan / pi pi ling rtsa a ru ra / thug pas rlung ni bder rgyu byed

verses.skt: vibaddhaṃ doṣabahulo dīptāgnir yo ’tisāryate | kṛṣṇāviḍaṅgatriphalākaṣāyais taṃ virecayet
verses.tib: nad gzhi mang la 'gags pa dang / me drod che bar gang zhig 'khru / pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum / byi dang ga bskol bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: peyāṃ yuñjyād viriktasya vātaghnair dīpanaiḥ kṛtām | āme pariṇate yas tu dīpte ’gnāv upaveśyate
verses.tib: sbyangs byas nas ni thug pa dag / rlung 'joms me drod skyed pa blud / gang zhig ma zhu smin gyur dang / me drod skyes nas 'khru 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: saphenapicchaṃ sarujaṃ savibandhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | alpālpam alpaśamalaṃ nirviḍ vā sapravāhikam
verses.tib: 'byar bag lbum can nad bcas pa / sri shing yang dang yang du ni / yang yang 'khru zhing bshang chung ba'am / bshang ba ma 'dres mkhregs bcas la

verses.skt: dadhitailaghṛtakṣīraiḥ sa śuṇṭhīṃ saguḍāṃ pibet | svinnāni guḍatailena bhakṣayed badarāṇi vā
verses.tib: zho dang 'o ma mar til mar / bca' sga bu ram bcas pa blud / yang na rgya shug 'bras bu spangs / bu ram til mar ldan pa sbyin / bshang bsri la phan tshod ma

verses.skt: gāḍhaviḍvihitaiḥ śākair bahusnehais tathā rasaiḥ | kṣudhitaṃ bhojayed enaṃ dadhidāḍimasādhitaiḥ
verses.tib: sdum mang de bzhin sha khu dang / zho dang se 'bru g.yos pa dang / sA lu'i 'bras chen ma sha til / mung+ga legs par g.yos pa'i zas / de ni bkres par gyur tshe sbyin

verses.skt: śālyodanaṃ tilair māṣair mudgair vā sādhu sādhitam | śaṭhyā mūlakapotāyāḥ pāṭhāyāḥ svastikasya vā
verses.tib: zur ba'i rtsa ba ka pi ta / pa ta swa ti ka'i tshod ma / shu sha la la phud dang ni / kar ka ru dang sring gi ni / yang na

verses.skt: sūṣāyavānīkarkārukṣīriṇīcirbhaṭasya vā | upodakāyā jīvantyā vākucyā vāstukasya vā
verses.tib: tsir bi ta yang rung / u po ta ka dzi ban ti / ba gu rtse dang rgya sne'u dang / lcam pa'am yang na e raN dang / lo ni ka yi khu ba dang / rus sbal bye'u lo ba ka

verses.skt: suvarcalāyāś cuñcor vā loṇikāyā rasair api | kūrmavartakalopākaśikhitittirikaukkuṭaiḥ
verses.tib: rma bya sreg pa khyim bya yi / sha khu dang yang sbyin par bya / bil ba gla sgang ba ru ra

verses.skt: bilvamustākṣibhaiṣajyadhātakīpuṣpanāgaraiḥ | pakvātīsārajit takre yavāgūr dādhikī tathā
verses.tib: bca' sga da ta ka'i me tog / dar ba bskol ba'i nas thug gam / zho dang sbyar bas 'khru ba sel / ka pid ta dang ka tsu ra / ga bra'i rtsa ba yu ti dang

verses.skt: kapitthakacchurāphañjīyūthikāvaṭaśelujaiḥ | dāḍimīśaṇakārpāsīśālmalīnāṃ ca pallavaiḥ
verses.tib: n+ya gro d+ha dang rdo dreg dang / se 'bru so mar bal dang / shal ma li yi lo ma phan / bil ba gzhon nu'i lde gu dang

verses.skt: kalko bilvaśalāṭūnāṃ tilakalkaś ca tatsamaḥ | dadhnaḥ saro ’mlaḥ sasnehaḥ khalo hanti pravāhikām
verses.tib: til btags lde gu'ang de dang mnyam / zho yi spris skyur snum bcas dang / sbyar dug mkhregs pa 'joms par byed / 'u su zi ra na le sham

verses.skt: maricaṃ dhanikājājī tintiḍīkaṃ śaṭhī viḍam | dāḍimaṃ dhātakī pāṭhā triphalā pañcakolakam
verses.tib: da trig zur pa kha ru tsha / se 'bru pa ta da ta ki / 'bras gsum cha lnga ka pi / nas tshig 'khus thal la la phud / a mra 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu'i rkang

verses.skt: yāvaśūkaṃ kapitthāmrajambūmadhyaṃ sadīpyakam | piṣṭaiḥ ṣaḍguṇabilvais tair dadhni mudgarase guḍe
verses.tib: bil ba drug 'gyur lde gur btags / zho dang bu ram mung+ga'i khu / til mar mar dang g.yos pa dag

verses.skt: snehe ca yamake siddhaḥ khalo ’yam aparājitaḥ | dīpanaḥ pācano grāhī rucyo bimbiśināśanaḥ
verses.tib: gzhan gyis mi thub sbyar thug 'di / drod skyed smin byed 'khru ba gcod / yi ga 'byed cing mkhregs pa sel

verses.skt: kolānāṃ bālabilvānāṃ kalkaiḥ śāliyavasya ca | mudgamāṣatilānāṃ ca dhānyayūṣaṃ prakalpayet
verses.tib: rgya shug bil ba gzhon nu yi / lde gu 'bras dang nas dang ni / mud ga ma sha til rnams dang / 'bru yi yu shar rnam par btags

verses.skt: aikadhyaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ dadhidāḍimasārikam | varcaḥkṣaye śuṣkamukhaṃ śālyannaṃ tena bhojayet
verses.tib: bshang ba zad cing kha skam la / zho dang se 'bru'i khu ba dang / mar dang til mar lhan cig brngos / 'bras chan de dang sbyar ba ni / bshang zad kha ni skam la sbyin

verses.skt: dadhnaḥ saraṃ vā yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ saguḍanāgaram | surāṃ vā yamake bhṛṣṭāṃ vyañjanārthaṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: yang na zho spris snum gnyis brngos / bu ram bca' sgar bcas pa sbyin / yang na chang ni snum gnyis brngos / tshod ma'i don du sbyin pa'am

verses.skt: phalāmlaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ yūṣaṃ gṛñjanakasya vā | bhṛṣṭān vā yamake saktūn khāded vyoṣāvacūrṇitān
verses.tib: 'bras bu skyur po snum gnyis brngos / sgog pa las byas yu sha'am / snum gnyis dang brngos phye zan ni / tsha ba gsum gyi phye btab sbyin

verses.skt: māṣān susiddhāṃs tadvad vā ghṛtamaṇḍopasevanān | rasaṃ susiddhapūtaṃ vā chāgameṣāntarādhijam
verses.tib: de bzhin ma sha legs bcos pa / mar gyi snying po blud pa'am / ra thug lug thug dag gi sha / btsos te btsags pa'i khu ba dang

verses.skt: paced dāḍimasārāmlaṃ sadhānyasnehanāgaram | raktaśālyodanaṃ tena bhuñjānaḥ prapibaṃś ca tam
verses.tib: se 'bru'i khu ba'i chu dang ni / 'u su dong gra snum bcas bskol / sA lu rtsa snar bcas pa ni / za zhing de nyid 'thungs pa

verses.skt: varcaḥkṣayakṛtair āśu vikāraiḥ parimucyate | bālabilvaṃ guḍaṃ tailaṃ pippalīṃ viśvabheṣajam
verses.tib: yis / rtug pa zad pa las byung ba'i / nad las myur du thar bar 'gyur / bu ram til mar bil ba gzhon / pi pi ling dang bca' sga yi

verses.skt: lihyād vāte pratihate saśūlaḥ sapravāhikaḥ | valkalaṃ śābaraṃ puṣpaṃ dhātakyā badarīdalam
verses.tib: lde gus rlung gis gnod gyur pa'i / gzer thabs mkhregs dang bcas pa sel / seng phrom shun lpags da ta ka'i / me tog rgya shug 'dab ma rnams

verses.skt: eraṇḍabilvayavagokṣurakāmlasiddhāṃ pathyāṃ lihan madhuyutām atha vā guḍena | kṛcchrapravṛttam atiśūlam asṛgvimiśraṃ hanyād avaśyam atisāram udīrṇavegam
pibed dadhisarakṣaudrakapitthasvarasāplutam | vibaddhavātavarcās tu bahuśūlapravāhikaḥ
verses.tib: zho spris sbrang rtsi ka pi ta'i / khu bar sbyar ba blud na phan / rlung gis rtug 'gags shas cher ni / na zhing mkhregs par byed pa dang

verses.skt: saraktapicchas tṛṣṇārtaḥ kṣīrasauhityam arhati | yamakasyopari kṣīraṃ dhāroṣṇaṃ vā prayojayet
verses.tib: be snabs khrag bcas skom gdungs la / 'o ma tshim par blud na phan / til mar mar gyi steng du ni / bzhos ma thag pa'i 'o ma blud

verses.skt: śṛtam eraṇḍamūlena bālabilvena vā punaḥ | payasy utkvāthya mustānāṃ viṃśatiṃ triguṇe ’mbhasi
verses.tib: yang na a raN+Da yi rtsa'am / bil ba gzhon nu bskol ba blud / gla sgang nyi shu 'o ma yi / sum 'gyur gyi ni chu bskol ba

verses.skt: kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tat pītaṃ hanyād āmaṃ savedanam | pippalyāḥ pibataḥ sūkṣmaṃ rajo maricajanma vā
verses.tib: 'khru ba gzer bcas sel bar byed / pi pi ling dang na le sham / zhib du btags pa'i phye dang sbyin

verses.skt: cirakālānuṣaktāpi naśyaty āśu pravāhikā | nirāmarūpaṃ śūlārtaṃ laṅghanādyaiś ca karṣitam
verses.tib: des ni yun ring gnas pa yi / mkhregs pa sel bar byed par 'gyur / ma zhu med cing gzer gyis nyen / smyung ba la sogs pas nyams smad

verses.skt: rūkṣakoṣṭham apekṣyāgniṃ sakṣāraṃ pāyayed ghṛtam | siddhaṃ dadhisurāmaṇḍe daśamūlasya cāmbhasi
verses.tib: khong rtsub me drod brtags nas ni / mar ni thal sman rno bcas sbyin / yang na rtsa ba bcu bskol chu / zho dang chang gi dngas mar bskol

verses.skt: sindhūtthapañcakolābhyāṃ tailaṃ sadyo ’rtināśanam | ṣaḍbhiḥ śuṇṭhyāḥ palair dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ granthyagnisaindhavāt
verses.tib: lce myang tsha dang tsha ba lnga / til mar 'phral du nad 'joms byed / bca' sga srang drug pi pi ling / mU la kru trug tres rgyam tsha / srang gnyis til mar bre gang dang

verses.skt: tailaprasthaṃ paced dadhnā niḥsārakarujāpaham | ekato māṃsadugdhājyaṃ purīṣagrahaśūlajit
verses.tib: zho dang bskol ba'i til mar ni / 'khru ba'i nad ni sel byed yin / sha dang 'o ma mar phyogs gcig / btung dang 'jam rtsi bsku ba ru

verses.skt: pānānuvāsanābhyaṅgaprayuktaṃ tailam ekataḥ | tad dhi vātajitām agryaṃ śūlaṃ ca viguṇo ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: til mar 'ba' zhig phyogs gcig sbyar / bshang mkhregs gzer ni 'joms byed yin / de ni rlung sel mchog yin la / rlung 'khrugs ma gtogs gzer mi 'byung

verses.skt: dhātvantaropamardeddhaś calo vyāpī svadhāmagaḥ | tailaṃ mandānalasyāpi yuktyā śarmakaraṃ param
verses.tib: khams gzhan 'joms pas 'bar gyur pa / rlung ni rang gnas brten khyab byed / me drod chung la til mar ni / sbyar bas bde bar byed pa'i mchog

verses.skt: vāyvāśaye sataile hi bimbiśir nāvatiṣṭhate
verses.tib: til mar bcas pa rlung gnas su / mkhregs pa gnas par mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: kṣīṇe male svāyatanacyuteṣu doṣāntareṣv īraṇa ekavīre | ko niṣṭanan prāṇiti koṣṭhaśūlī nāntarbahistailaparo yadi syāt
verses.tib: dri ma zad cing nad gzhan rang gi ni / gnas las 'phos pas rlung ni stobs / che ba / khong pa gzer zhing mkhregs par byed pa la / phyi nang til mar ma btang su zhig 'tsho

verses.skt: gudarugbhraṃśayor yuñjyāt sakṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ haviḥ
verses.tib: gzhang na 'byung bar gyur pa la / 'o mar bskol ba'i mar rgya shug

verses.skt: rase kolāmlacāṅgeryor dadhni piṣṭe ca nāgare | tair eva cāmlaiḥ saṃyojya siddhaṃ suślakṣṇakalkitaiḥ
verses.tib: skyur po tsang gi ri'i khu ba / zho dang dong grar btags pa blud / sgyur ba de nyid bcug pa dang / 'u su na le sham zir

verses.skt: dhānyoṣaṇaviḍājājīpañcakolakadāḍimaiḥ | yojayet snehavastiṃ vā daśamūlena sādhitam
verses.tib: kha ru tsha dang tsha ba lnga / se 'bru dag dang sbyar ba ni / zhib tu btags pa'i lde gu phan / rtsa ba bcu pa bskol ba yi

verses.skt: śaṭhīśatāhvākuṣṭhair vā vacayā citrakeṇa vā | pravāhaṇe gudabhraṃśe mūtrāghāte kaṭīgrahe
verses.tib: zur ba shu ti ru rta'am / shu dag tsi tra ka bskol ba'i / snum gyi 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya / mkhregs dang gzhang ni 'byung ba dang / gcin sri rked pa na ba dang

verses.skt: madhurāmlaiḥ śṛtaṃ tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāpy anuvāsanam | praveśayed gudaṃ dhvastam abhyaktaṃ sveditaṃ mṛdu
verses.tib: mngar dang skyur bar bskol ba yi / mar ram til mar 'jam rtsi gtang / gzhang 'byung gzhug pa dka' ba la / bsku zhing dugs ni 'jam byas gzhug

verses.skt: kuryāc ca gophaṇābandhaṃ madhyacchidreṇa carmaṇā | pañcamūlasya mahataḥ kvāthaṃ kṣīre vipācayet
verses.tib: dbus su phug pa'i pags pa ni / 'ur mthil 'ching bdag kyang bya / rtsa ba lnga ni chen po yi / khu ba dang ni 'o mar bskol

verses.skt: unduruṃ cāntrarahitaṃ tena vātaghnakalkavat | tailaṃ paced gudabhraṃśaṃ pānābhyaṅgena taj jayet
verses.tib: byi ba rgyu ma bton pas kyang / rlung 'joms lde gu lta bur bya / til mar bskol gzhang 'byung ba la / btung dang bsku bas de gso bya

verses.skt: paitte tu sāme tīkṣṇoṣṇavarjyaṃ prāg iva laṅghanam | tṛḍvān pibet ṣaḍaṅgāmbu sabhūnimbaṃ saśārivam
verses.tib: mkhris pa ma zhu rno dang dro / spangs la sngon bzhin smyung ba bya / skom bcas yan lag drug pa'i chu / rtswa mkhris thal tres bcas pa blud

verses.skt: peyādi kṣudhitasyānnam agnisaṃdhukṣaṇaṃ hitam | bṛhatyādigaṇābhīrudvibalāśūrpaparṇibhiḥ
verses.tib: bkres na kha zas thug pa sogs / bri ha ti sogs nye'u shing pa / ba la rnam gnyis par+Ni gnyis / bskol ba drod skyed byed pa phan

verses.skt: pāyayed anubandhe tu sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbhasā | kuṭajasya phalaṃ piṣṭaṃ savalkaṃ saghuṇapriyam
verses.tib: blud kyang rjes su 'brel gyur na / dug mo nyung shun 'bras bu dang / bong nga dkar po bcas btags phye / sbrang rtsi bsres pa 'bras chu blud

verses.skt: pāṭhāvatsakabījatvagdārvīgranthikaśuṇṭhi vā | kvāthaṃ vātiviṣābilvavatsakodīcyamustajam
verses.tib: ba tha dug mo nyung shun 'bras / skyer pa pi pi ling rtsa'am / bong nga bil ba dug mo nyung / gla sgang ba le ka bskol ba'am

verses.skt: athavātiviṣāmūrvāniśendrayavatārkṣyajam | samadhvativiṣāśuṇṭhīmustendrayavakaṭphalam
verses.tib: yang na bong nga dkar mur ba / skyer pa dbul rdo dug mo nyung / bong nga bca' sga dug mo nyung / gla sgang kad pal sbrang rtsir bcas

verses.skt: palaṃ vatsakabījasya śrapayitvā rasaṃ pibet | yo rasāśī jayec chīghraṃ sa paittaṃ jaṭharāmayam
verses.tib: dug mo nyung gi sa bon ni / srang gcig bskol ba'i khu ba blud / gang zhig sha khu bcas sbyar za / mkhris bcas lto ba'i nad sel 'gyur

verses.skt: mustākaṣāyam evaṃ vā piben madhusamāyutam | sakṣaudraṃ śālmalīvṛntakaṣāyaṃ vā himāhvayam
verses.tib: de bzhin gla sgang bskol ba'i khu / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba blud pas phan / shal ma li yi 'dab ma'i rtsa / bskol ba'i / khu ba bsgrangs pa'am

verses.skt: kirātatiktakaṃ mustaṃ vatsakaṃ sarasāñjanam | kaṭaṅkaṭerī hrīveraṃ bilvamadhyaṃ durālabhā
verses.tib: rtsa mkhris gla sgang dug mo nyung / skyer khaN+Da dang bcas pa'am / yang na skyer pa ba le ka / bil ba'i rkang dang byi tsher ba

verses.skt: tilā mocarasaṃ lodhraṃ samaṅgā kamalotpalam | nāgaraṃ dhātakīpuṣpaṃ dāḍimasya tvag utpalam
verses.tib: til dang seng phrom mon cha ra / btsod dang pad+ma ut+pal / dong gra da ta ka'i me tog / se 'bru'i shun pa ut+pal bcas

verses.skt: ardhaślokaiḥ smṛtā yogāḥ sakṣaudrās taṇḍulāmbunā | niśendrayavalodhrailākvāthaḥ pakvātisārajit
verses.tib: tshigs bcad phyed kyis bshad sbyor ba / sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'bras chu blud / skyer pa seng phrom dug mo nyung

verses.skt: nāgarātiviṣāmustābhūnimbāmṛtavatsakaiḥ | sarvajvaraharaḥ kvāthaḥ sarvātīsāranāśanaḥ
guḍūcyativiṣādhānyaśuṇṭhībilvābdavālakaiḥ | pāṭhābhūnimbakuṭajacandanośīrapadmakaiḥ
verses.tib: sug smel bskol bas smin 'khru sel / seng phrom dang ni a brta / pri yang ku sogs sde tshan dang

verses.skt: kaṣāyaḥ śitalaḥ peyo jvarātīsāraśāntaye | hṛllāsārocakacchardipipāsādāhanāśanaḥ
lodhrāmbaṣṭhāpriyaṅgvādigaṇāṃs tadvat pṛthak pibet | kaṭvaṅgavalkayaṣṭyāhvaphalinīdāḍimāṅkuraiḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba so sor blud de bzhin / pu tse shel dang shing mngar dang / se 'bru'i myu gu pri yang ku / zho dang 'u su'i 'bras bur bcas

verses.skt: peyāvilepīkhalakān kuryāt sadadhidāḍimān | tadvad dadhitthabilvāmrajambūmadhyaiḥ prakalpayet
verses.tib: thug pa lde gus sbyar dugs bya / de bzhin bil ba ka pid tha / a mra 'dam bu'i rkang las sbyar

verses.skt: ajāpayaḥ prayoktavyaṃ nirāme tena cec chamaḥ | doṣādhikyān na jāyeta balinaṃ taṃ virecayet
verses.tib: smin pa'i khu bar ra'i 'o ma / mchog tu phan te des kyang ni / stobs ldan nad gzhi che ba'i phyir / ma zhin ni bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: vyatyāsena śakṛdraktam upaveśyeta yo ’pi vā | palāśaphalaniryūhaṃ yuktaṃ vā payasā pibet
verses.tib: rim gyis bshad pa khrag dag tu / gang zhig 'khru bar gyur pa la'ang / pa la sha yi 'bras bu yi / khu ba dang sbyar 'o ma blud

verses.skt: tato ’nu koṣṇaṃ pātavyaṃ kṣīram eva yathābalam | pravāhite tena male praśāmyaty udarāmayaḥ
verses.tib: de nas 'o ma dro 'jam tsam / nyams stobs ji bzhin blud par bya / des ni dri ma bsal bas na / lto yi nad ni zhi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: palāśavat prayojyā vā trāyamāṇā viśodhanī | saṃsargyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ śūlaṃ yady anuvartate
verses.tib: kyi lce ba yi sbyang ba yang / pa la sha ltar sbyor ba bya / thug sogs rim pa byas kyang ni / gal te gzer ni ma zhi na

verses.skt: srutadoṣasya taṃ śīghraṃ yathāvahny anuvāsayet | śatapuṣpāvarībhyāṃ ca bilvena madhukena ca
verses.tib: nyes bsal de la me drod stobs / las dpags 'jam rtsi myur du gtang / sha ta puSh+pa nye shing dang

verses.skt: tailapādaṃ payoyuktaṃ pakvam anvāsanaṃ ghṛtam | aśāntāv ity atīsāre picchāvastiḥ paraṃ hitaḥ
verses.tib: bil ba dang ni shing mngar dag / mar 'o til mar bzhi char bcas / bskol ba 'jam rtsi'i sman mar yin / des ni tsha 'khru ma zhi na / spyi bag 'jam rtsi mchog tu phan

verses.skt: pariveṣṭya kuśair ārdrair ārdravṛntāni śālmaleḥ | kṛṣṇamṛttikayālipya svedayed gomayāgninā
verses.tib: shal ma li yi lo ma rlon / ku sha rlon pas dkris nas ni / sa nag lde gu bskus nas su / lci ba skam po'i me nang bsregs

verses.skt: mṛcchoṣe tāni saṃkṣudya tatpiṇḍaṃ muṣṭisaṃmitam | mardayet payasaḥ prasthe pūtenāsthāpayet tataḥ
verses.tib: 'jim pa lus pa de bkog ste / gong po de las srang gcig tsam / 'o ma bre gang nang du mnye / btsags la dngas mar rgya spos dang

verses.skt: natayaṣṭyāhvakalkājyakṣaudratailavatānu ca | snāto bhuñjīta payasā jāṅgalena rasena vā
verses.tib: shing mngar sbrang rtsi lde gu mar / til mar ldan pas 'jam rtsi bya / khrus byas 'o ma 'bras chan sbyin / yang na skam sa'i sha khu sbyin

verses.skt: pittātisārajvaraśophagulmasamīraṇāsragrahaṇīvikārān | jayaty ayaṃ śīghram atipravṛttiṃ virecanāsthāpanayoś ca vastiḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i tshad 'khru rims dang 'or nad skran / rlung nad khrag dang pho ba'i nad sel zhing / 'di dag bkru sman mas gtong drag po yi / sbyor byas drag tu 'byung ba'ang myur zhi byed

verses.skt: kaṭvaṅgabilvajaṃ tv asthi kapitthaṃ surasāñjanam | lākṣāharidre hrīveraṃ kaṭphalaṃ śukanāsikā
lodhraṃ mocarasaṃ mustaṃ dhātakī vaṭaśuṅgakān | piṣṭvā taṇḍulatoyena vaṭakān akṣasaṃmitān
verses.tib: dug mo nyung ni bu ram phran / ltar bskol dug mo nyung sogs sde

verses.skt: pibet tenaiva toyena jvarātīsāranāśanaḥ | raktaprasādano hy eṣa śophātīsāranāśanaḥ
phāṇitaṃ kuṭajotthaṃ ca sarvātīsāranāśanam | vatsakādisamāyuktaṃ sāmbaṣṭhādi samākṣikam
verses.tib: a brta sogs sbrang rtsir bcas / lde gus 'khru ba thams cad sel

verses.skt: nīruṅnirāmaṃ dīptāgner api sāsraṃ cirotthitam | nānāvarṇam atīsāraṃ puṭapākair upācaret
verses.tib: smin cing nad med me drod che / khrag dang bcas pa ring nas 'khru / sna tshogs mdog tu 'khru 'gyur ba / sman thum btsos pa sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: tvakpiṇḍād dīrghavṛntasya śrīparṇīpattrasaṃvṛtāt | mṛlliptād agninā svinnād rasaṃ niṣpīḍitaṃ himam
verses.tib: kad pha la yi shun lde gu / bil ba'i lo mas dkris nas ni / 'jim pas bskus te me nang bsregs / khu ba btsir la bsgrangs pa ni

verses.skt: atīsārī pibed yuktaṃ madhunā sitayāthavā | evaṃ kṣīridrumatvagbhis tatprarohaiś ca kalpayet
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi'am kha rar bcas pa ru / 'khru ba can la ci rigs blud / de bzhin 'o ma can shing kun / de yi myu gu las kyang bya

verses.skt: kaṭvaṅgatvagghṛtayutā sveditā saliloṣmaṇā | sakṣaudrā hanty atīsāraṃ balavantam api drutam
verses.tib: 'khri shing shun pa mar dang bcas / bskol ba'i rlangs pas btsos pa ni / sbrang rtsi bcas pa tsha 'khru ba / stobs can drag tu 'byung ba'ang sel

verses.skt: pittātīsārī seveta pittalāny eva yaḥ punaḥ | raktātīsāraṃ kurute tasya pittaṃ satṛḍjvaram
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i 'khru ba can gyis ni / mkhris pa skyed byed gang bsten pa / de yis mkhris pa 'khrugs gyur nas / khrag gi tshad 'khru skom dad rims

verses.skt: dāruṇaṃ gudapākaṃ ca tatra cchāgaṃ payo hitam | padmotpalasamaṅgābhiḥ śṛtaṃ mocarasena ca
verses.tib: 'debs shing gzhang kha mi bzad 'drul / pad+ma ut+pal sa mang ga / mon cha ras bskol ba yi / ra yi 'o ma de la phan

verses.skt: śārivāyaṣṭilodhrair vā prasavair vā vaṭādijaiḥ | sakṣaudraśarkaraṃ pāne bhojane gudasecane
verses.tib: thal tres shing mngar seng phrom mam / n+ya gro d+ha sogs myu gu dang / sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas pa ni / btung ba'am gzhang khar blugs pas phan

verses.skt: tadvad rasādayo ’namlāḥ sājyāḥ pānānnayor hitāḥ | kāśmaryaphalayūṣaś ca kiñcidamlaḥ saśarkaraḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin sha khu sogs skyon med / mar bcas bsgrangs pa'i zas skom phan / tang pal 'bras bu'i khu ba ni / cung zad skyur zhing ka rar bcas

verses.skt: payasy ardhodake chāge hrīverotpalanāgaraiḥ | peyā raktātisāraghnī pṛśniparṇīrasānvitā
verses.tib: ra yi 'o ma chu phyed dang / ut+pal dong gra ba le ka / kr-iSh+Na par+Ni khu bar bcas / thug pas khrag gi tshad 'khru sel

verses.skt: prāgbhaktaṃ navanītaṃ vā lihyān madhusitāyutam | baliny asre ’sram evājaṃ mārgaṃ vā ghṛtabharjitam
verses.tib: zas kyi sngon du mar sar ni / sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar ba bldag / khrag 'khru tshabs che la ra'am / khrag gi mar brngos sbyin

verses.skt: kṣīrānupānaṃ kṣīrāśī tryahaṃ kṣīrodbhavaṃ ghṛtam | kapiñjalarasāśī vā lihann ārogyam aśnute
verses.tib: 'o ma dang bza' 'o ma btung / 'o ma bsrubs mar zhag gsum bsten / yang na gong ma sreg gi ni / sha khu dang zos nad med 'gyur

verses.skt: pītvā śatāvarīkalkaṃ kṣīreṇa kṣīrabhojanaḥ | raktātīsāraṃ hanty āśu tayā vā sādhitaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: nye shing btags pa / 'o ma dang / lhan cig blud cing 'o mar bza' / yang na de dang bskol ba yi / mar gyis tshad 'khru myur du sel

verses.skt: lākṣānāgaravaidehīkaṭukādārvivalkalaiḥ | sarpiḥ sendrayavaiḥ siddhaṃ peyāmaṇḍāvacāritam
verses.tib: rgya skyegs bca' sga pi pi ling / skyer pa'i shun pa pu tse shel / dug mo nyung dang bcas bskol mar / thug sla thug pa dang sbyar bas

verses.skt: atīsāraṃ jayec chīghraṃ tridoṣam api dāruṇam | kṛṣṇamṛcchaṅkhayaṣṭyāhvakṣaudrāsṛktaṇḍulodakam
verses.tib: nad gzhi gsum las byung ba yi / mi zad 'khru ba'ang myur du sel / sa nag dung dang shing mngar dang / sbrang rtsir khrag 'bras chu blud

verses.skt: jayaty asraṃ priyaṅguś ca taṇḍulāmbumadhuplutā | kalkas tilānāṃ kṛṣṇānāṃ śarkarāpāñcabhāgikaḥ
verses.tib: pri yang ku dang sbrang rtsi'ang phan / til nag btags pa'i lde gu dang / sha khar ni cha lnga ni

verses.skt: ājena payasā pītaḥ sadyo raktaṃ niyacchati | pītvā saśarkarākṣaudraṃ candanaṃ taṇḍulāmbunā
verses.tib: ra yi 'o ma sbyar ba blud / 'phral du khrag tu 'khru ba sel / kha ra sbrang rtsi tsan+dan bcas / 'bras kyi chu dang blud na ni

verses.skt: dāhatṛṣṇāpramohebhyo raktasrāvāc ca mucyate | gudasya dāhe pāke vā sekalepā hitā himāḥ
verses.tib: khong tsha skom dang gcin nad dang / khrag tu 'khru las thar bar 'gyur / gzhang kha tsha zhing 'drul ba la / bsil ba'i sman gyis blugs shing bsku

verses.skt: alpālpaṃ bahuśo raktaṃ saśūlam upaveśyate | yadā vibaddho vāyuś ca kṛcchrāc carati vā na vā
verses.tib: gang tshe yang dang yang du 'khru / khrag nyung gzer dang bcas par 'khru / rlung gis gags ni byas gyur pas / skabs 'byung ba'am mi 'byung byed

verses.skt: picchāvastiṃ tadā tasya pūrvoktam upakalpayet | pallavān jarjarīkṛtya śiṃśipākovidārayoḥ
verses.tib: de tshe de la spyi bag ni / 'jam rtsi sngar bshad gtang bar bya / kar bu dar shing sha pa / la sogs lo ma cham chom brdungs

verses.skt: paced yavāṃś ca sa kvāthe ghṛtakṣīrasamanvitaḥ | picchāsrutau gudabhraṃśe pravāhaṇarujāsu vā
verses.tib: nas dang bskol ba'i khu ba de / mar dang 'o ma bcas par bskol / spyi bag 'jam rtsi btang na ni / be+e snabs 'khru dang gzhang 'byung dang

verses.skt: picchāvastiḥ prayoktavyaḥ kṣatakṣīṇabalāvahaḥ | prapauṇḍarīkasiddhena sarpiṣā cānuvāsanam
verses.tib: mkhregs pa'i nad rnams sel byed cing / skem po stobs ni skyed par byed / stag tsher ba dang bskol ba yi / mar gyi 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya

verses.skt: raktaṃ viṭsahitaṃ pūrvaṃ paścād vā yo ’tisāryate | śatāvarīghṛtaṃ tasya lehārtham upakalpayet
verses.tib: dang por bshang ba khrag 'dres 'byung / yang na phyis ni 'khru gyur pa / de la nye shing bskol ba'i mar / lde gu'i don du sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: śarkarārdhāṃśakaṃ līḍhaṃ navanītaṃ navoddhṛtam | kṣaudrapādaṃ jayec chīghraṃ taṃ vikāraṃ hitāśinaḥ
verses.tib: kha ra cha phyed dang sbyar la / sbrang rtsi bzhi cha bcug pa yi / mar sar phan pa'i zas zos na / nad de myur du sel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaśuṅgān āpothya vāsayet | ahorātraṃ jale tapte ghṛtaṃ tenāmbhasā pacet
verses.tib: u dum wA ra n+ya gro d+ha / a shwad+tha yi myu gu ni / brdungs te zhag gcig chu nang sbangs / mnyes te btsags par mar bskol la

verses.skt: tad ardhaśarkarāyuktaṃ lehayet kṣaudrapādikam | adho vā yadi vāpy urdhvaṃ yasya raktaṃ pravartate
verses.tib: kha ra de yi phyed btab cing / sbrang rtsi bzhi cha btab ste blud / gang zhig khrag ni thur du'am / gyen du 'byung bar byed la sbyin

verses.skt: śleṣmātīsāre vātoktaṃ viśeṣād āmapācanam | kartavyam anubandhe ’sya pibet paktvāgnidīpanam
verses.tib: bad kan / 'khru ba rlung bshad pa'i / ma zhu smin bya mchog tu bya / rjes su 'brel pa de la ni

verses.skt: bilvakarkaṭikāmustaprāṇadāviśvabheṣajam | vacāviḍaṅgabhūtīkadhānakāmaradāru vā
verses.tib: bil ba gzhon nu gla sgang dang / a ru ra dang bca' sga bskol / smin cing me drod skyed pa blud / shu dag dong gra byi dang ga / bu ti ka dang thang shing dang

verses.skt: athavā pippalīmūlapippalīdvayacitrakam | pāṭhāgnivatsakagranthitiktāśuṇṭhīvacābhayāḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling gnyis kru trug tres / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba'am / pa ta tsi tra dug mo nyung / shu dag pi pi ling rtsa ba / pu tse shel dang a ru ra

verses.skt: kvathitā yadi vā piṣṭāḥ śleṣmātīsārabheṣajam | sauvarcalavacāvyoṣahiṅguprativiṣābhayāḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba'am yang na btags pa sbyin / bad kan tshad par 'khru sman blud / kha ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum / shu dag shing kun bong nga dkar

verses.skt: pibec chleṣmātisārārtaś cūrṇitāḥ koṣṇavāriṇā | madhyaṃ līḍhvā kapitthasya savyoṣakṣaudraśarkaram
verses.tib: a ru ra yi chu tshan bcas / bad kan 'khru bas nyen la blud / ka pid ta yi rkang dang ni / tsha gsum sbrang rtsi sha kha ra'am

verses.skt: kaṭphalaṃ madhuyuktaṃ vā mucyate jaṭharāmayāt | kaṇāṃ madhuyutāṃ līḍhvā takraṃ pītvā sacitrakam
verses.tib: kad pha la dang sbrang rtsir bcas / lto yi nad ni sel byed yin / pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir bcas / tsi tra ka dang dar bar bcas

verses.skt: bhuktvā vā bālabilvāni vyapohaty udarāmayam | pāṭhāmocarasāmbhodadhātakībilvanāgaram
verses.tib: bil ba gzhon nu byin na yang / 'khru ba'i nad ni sel bar byed / pa ta gla sgang mon cha ra / bil ba dong gra da ta ka'am

verses.skt: sukṛcchram apy atīsāraṃ guḍatakreṇa nāśayet | yavānīpippalīmūlacāturjātakanāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: bu ram dar bar bcas pa yis / 'khru ba shin tu gso dka' 'ang sel / pi pi ling rtsal la phud / dri bzang bzhi dang dong gra dang / na le sham dang kru trug tres

verses.skt: maricāgnijalājājīdhānyasauvarcalaiḥ samaiḥ | vṛṣāmladhātakīkṛṣṇābilvadāḍimadīpyakaiḥ
verses.tib: 'u su zi ra ba le ka / kha ru tsha rnams cha mnyam dang / da trig dang ni da ta ki / bil ba dang ni pi pi ling / se 'bru dang ni la la phud

verses.skt: triguṇaiḥ ṣaḍguṇasitaiḥ kapitthāṣṭaguṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ | cūrṇo ’tīsāragrahaṇīkṣayagulmagalāmayān
verses.tib: sum 'gyur ka ra drug 'gyur dang / ka pid ta ni brgyad 'gyur byas / phye mas tshad 'khru pho ba'i nad / zad byed skran dang lkog ma'i nad

verses.skt: kāsaśvāsāgnisādārśaḥpīnasārocakāñ jayet | karṣonmitā tavakṣīrī cāturjātaṃ dvikārṣikam
verses.tib: lud pa dbugs mi bde drod nyams / gzhang 'brum cham pa yi ga 'chus sel / smig rkang dang ni dri sna bzhi / zho ni gnyis gnyis la la phud

verses.skt: yavānīdhānyakājājīgranthivyoṣaṃ palāṃśakam | palāni dāḍimād aṣṭau sitāyāś caikataḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.tib: 'u su zi ra zho bzhi bzhi / pi pi ling rtsa tsha ba gsum / srang ni re re se 'bru dang / kha ra srang brgyad gcig sbyar 'di

verses.skt: guṇaiḥ kapitthāṣṭakavac cūrṇo ’yaṃ dāḍimāṣṭakaḥ | bhojyo vātātisāroktair yathāvasthaṃ khalādibhiḥ
verses.tib: phye ma se 'bru brgyad pa yin / yon tan gong ma dag dang 'dra / kha zas rlung gis 'khru bar bshad / sbyar thug la sogs ci rigs sbyin

verses.skt: saviḍaṅgaḥ samaricaḥ sakapitthaḥ sanāgaraḥ | cāṅgerītakrakolāmlaḥ khalaḥ śleṣmātisārajit
verses.tib: na le sham dang byi dang ga / ka pid ta dang dong grar bcas / tsang gi ri dang rgya shug skyur / sbyar thug bad kan 'khru

verses.skt: kṣīṇe śleṣmaṇi pūrvoktam amlaṃ lākṣādi ṣaṭpalam | purāṇaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ dadyād yavāgūmaṇḍamiśritam
verses.tib: ba sel / bad kan zad la sngar bshad pa'i / rgya skyegs la sogs srang drug pa

verses.skt: kaṭphalaṃ madhukaṃ lodhraṃ tvagdāḍimaphalasya ca | vātapittātisāraghnaṃ pibet taṇḍulavāriṇā
mustaṃ sātiviṣā dārvī vacā śuṇṭhī ca tatsamam | kaṣāyaṃ kṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ śleṣmavātātisāriṇe
verses.tib: nas thug dang ni bsres pa yi / mar ni rnying pa sbyin par bya / rlung dang bad kan gyis bkag pa

verses.skt: pītadāru vacā lodhraṃ kaliṅgaphalanāgaram | dāḍimāmbuyutaṃ dadyāt pittaśleṣmātisāriṇe
vātaśleṣmavibandhe vā sravaty ati kaphe ’pi vā | śūle pravāhikāyāṃ vā picchāvastiḥ praśasyate
verses.tib: bad kan shas cher 'khru ba'am / gzer zhing mkhregs par byed pa la / spyi bag 'jam rtsi bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: vacābilvakaṇākuṣṭhaśatāhvālavaṇānvitaḥ | bilvatailena tailena vacādyaiḥ sādhitena vā
verses.tib: shu dag bil ba pi pi ling / ru rta shu ti rgyam tshar bcas / bil ba'i mar ram til mar ni / shu dag sogs dang bskol ba gtang

verses.skt: bahuśaḥ kaphavātārte koṣṇenānvāsanaṃ hitam | kṣīṇe kaphe gude dīrghakālātīsāradurbale
verses.tib: bad kan rlung gis shas cher gzer / cung zad dro ba'i 'jam rtsi gtang / bad kan zad cing yun ring du / 'khru zhing nyam chung gyur pa na

verses.skt: anilaḥ prabalo ’vaśyaṃ svasthānasthaḥ prajāyate | sa balī sahasā hanyāt tasmāt taṃ tvarayā jayet
verses.tib: rlung ni nges par stobs che ba / rang gi gnas na brten de skye / de stobs che bas 'phral gsod byed / de phyir de ni myur du gso

verses.skt: vāyor anantaraṃ pittaṃ pittasyānantaraṃ kapham | jayet pūrvaṃ trayāṇāṃ vā bhaved yo balavattamaḥ
verses.tib: rlung gi rjes la mkhris pa ste / mkhris pa'i rjes la bad kan ni / gso ba'am gsum las dang po ni / gang zhig shas cher gyur pa gso

verses.skt: bhīśokābhyām api calaḥ śīghraṃ kupyaty atas tayoḥ | kāryā kriyā vātaharā harṣaṇāśvāsanāni ca
verses.tib: 'jigs dang mya ngan dag las kyang / myur du 'khrugs pas de phyir der / rlung bsal ba yi gso ba dang / dbugs dbyung ba dang dga' bar bya

verses.skt: yasyoccārād vinā mūtraṃ pavano vā pravartate | dīptāgner laghukoṣṭhasya śāntas tasyodarāmayaḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig gcin med phyi sa dang / 'phyen ni 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / me drod che zhing lto ba yang / de yi khong nad zhi ba yin

verses.skt: grahaṇīm āśritaṃ doṣam ajīrṇavad upācaret | atīsāroktavidhinā tasyāmaṃ ca vipācayet
verses.tib: pho ba la ni brten pa'i nad / ma zhu ba ltar gso bar bya / 'khru bar bshad pa'i cho ga yis / de yi ma zhu smin par bya

verses.skt: annakāle yavāgvādi pañcakolādibhir yutam | vitaret paṭulaghvannaṃ punar yogāṃś ca dīpanān
verses.tib: zas kyi dus su nad dug sogs / tsha ba lnga sogs ldan pa dang / tsha bro yang ba'i kha zas dang / gzhan yang drod skyed sbyor ba sbyin

verses.skt: dadyāt sātiviṣāṃ peyām āme sāmlāṃ sanāgarām | pāne ’tīsāravihitaṃ vāri takraṃ surādi ca
verses.tib: ma zhur thug pa bong nga dkar / bca' sga skyur dang bcas pa sbyin / btung bar 'khru ba las bshad pa'i / chu dang dar ba chang sogs blud

verses.skt: grahaṇīdoṣiṇāṃ takraṃ dīpanagrāhilāghavāt | pathyaṃ madhurapākitvān na ca pittapradūṣaṇam
verses.tib: pho ba'i nad la dar ba ni / drod skyed 'khru gcod yang bas na / phan te zhu rjes mngar ba'i phyir / mkhris pa skyed par mi byed do

verses.skt: kaṣāyoṣṇavikāśitvād rūkṣatvāc ca kaphe hitam | vāte svādvamlasāndratvāt sadyaskam avidāhi tat
verses.tib: bska zhing dro la sbyong byed dang / rtsub cing bad kan la yang phan / mngar skyur kha bas rlung la phan / bsrubs ma thag tu tsha mi skyed

verses.skt: caturṇāṃ prastham amlānāṃ tryūṣaṇāc ca palatrayam | lavaṇānāṃ ca catvāri śarkarāyāḥ palāṣṭakam
verses.tib: skyur ba bzhi po bre gang dang / tsha ba gsum ni srang gsum dang / rgya tsha srang bzhi kha ra ni / srang brgyad phye mar byas pa ni

verses.skt: tac cūrṇaṃ śākasūpānnarāgādiṣv avacārayet | kāsājīrṇāruciśvāsahṛtpāṇḍuplīhagulmanut
verses.tib: tshod ma sran tshod btung ba sogs / btung ngo drug sogs la yang gdab / ma zhu lud pa dbugs mi bde / yi ga 'chus dang skran mchin pa

verses.skt: nāgarātiviṣāmustaṃ pākyam āmaharaṃ pibet | uṣṇāmbunā vā tatkalkaṃ nāgaraṃ vāthavābhayām
verses.tib: dong gra gla sgang bong nga dkar / bskol ba ma zhu sel byed blud / de yi lde gu chu tshan nam

verses.skt: sasaindhavaṃ vacādiṃ vā tadvan madirayāthavā | varcasy āme sapravāhe pibed vā dāḍimāmbunā
verses.tib: bca' sga'am a ru ra bcas blud / shu dag la sogs rgyam tshar bcas / yang na chang dang sbyar ba blud / bshang ba ma smin 'khru bcas la

verses.skt: viḍena lavaṇaṃ piṣṭaṃ bilvacitrakanāgaram | sāme kaphānile koṣṭharukkare koṣṇavāriṇā
verses.tib: se 'bru'i chu dang bcas pa yi / bil ba dong gra tsi tra ka / kha ru tsha ni btab pa sbyin / bad kan rlung gyur be snabs can

verses.skt: kaliṅgahiṅgvativiṣāvacāsauvarcalābhayam | chardihṛdrogaśūleṣu peyam uṣṇena vāriṇā
verses.tib: khong pa gzer la dug mo nyung / shing kun bong nga kha ru tsha / shu dag a ru ra chu dron / skyugs pa'i rjes la gzer zhing bsgongs

verses.skt: pathyāsauvarcalājājīcūrṇaṃ maricasaṃyutam | pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ pāṭhāṃ śārivāṃ bṛhatīdvayam
verses.tib: a ru ra dang kha ru tsha / zi ra na le sham bcas phye / chu dron dang ni bcas pa blud / dong gra pa ta pi pi ling / thal tres bri ha ti gnyis dang

verses.skt: citrakaṃ kauṭajaṃ kṣāraṃ tathā lavaṇapañcakam | cūrṇīkṛtaṃ dadhisurātanmaṇḍoṣṇāmbukāñjikaiḥ
verses.tib: dug mo nyung dang tsi tra ka / tsha ba rnam lnga thal sman gnyis / phyer btags chang zho de'i dngas ma / chu dron rang skyur dag la blud

verses.skt: pibed agnivivṛddhyarthaṃ koṣṭhavātaharaṃ param | paṭūni pañca dvau kṣārau maricaṃ pañcakolakam
verses.tib: des ni me drod 'phel byed cing / khong pa'i rlung ni sel mchog yin / lan tshwa lnga dang thal sman gnyis / tsha ba lnga dang na le sham

verses.skt: dīpyakaṃ hiṅgu guṭikā bījapūrarase kṛtā | koladāḍimatoye vā paraṃ pācanadīpanī
verses.tib: la la phud dang shing kun las / skyur rtsi chen po'am se 'bru 'am / rgya shug khu bas ri lu byas / smin dang drod skyed byed mchog yin

verses.skt: tālīśapattracavikāmaricānāṃ palaṃ palam | kṛṣṇātanmūlayor dve dve pale śuṇṭhīpalatrayam
verses.tib: bal bu'i lo ma dbyi mo dang / pi pi ling ni srang re dang / pi pi ling dang de rtsa srang / gnyis gnyis bca' sga srang gsum dang

verses.skt: caturjātam uśīraṃ ca karṣāṃśaṃ ślakṣṇacūrṇitam | guḍena vaṭakān kṛtvā triguṇena sadā bhajet
verses.tib: dri sna gsum dang pu shel tse / zho ni gnyis gnyis phyir zhib btags / bu ram sum 'gyur dag gis ni / ri lu byas pa rtag tu bza'

verses.skt: madyayūṣarasāriṣṭamastupeyāpayo'nupaḥ | vātaśleṣmātmanāṃ chardigrahaṇīpārśvahṛdrujām
verses.tib: de rjes yu sha sha khu dang / chang rnying 'o ma zho ga chu / thug pa blud na rlung dang ni / bad kan las gyur slon bro dang / pho ba rtsib logs snying ga na

verses.skt: jvaraśvayathupāṇḍutvagulmapānātyayārśasām | prasekapīnasaśvāsakāsānāṃ ca nivṛttaye
verses.tib: rims dang 'or nad skya rbab dang / skran / dang chang nad gzhang 'brum dang / cham pa mchil ma dbugs mi bde / lud pa rnams ni 'joms par byed

verses.skt: abhayāṃ nāgarasthāne dadyāt tatraiva viḍgrahe | chardyādiṣu ca paitteṣu caturguṇasitānvitāḥ
verses.tib: bca' sga'i gong du a ru ra / bcug ste de la sbyin par bya / mkhris gyur slon bro la sogs la / kha ra bzhi 'gyur bcas pa ni

verses.skt: pakvena vaṭakāḥ kāryā guḍena sitayāpi vā | paraṃ hi vahnisaṃparkāl laghimānaṃ bhajanti te
verses.tib: bskol ba las ni ri lur byas / yang na bu ram kha rar bcas / me dang 'phrad par gyur pa las / de ni mchog tu yang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: athainaṃ paripakvāmaṃ mārutagrahaṇīgadam | dīpanīyayutaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayed alpaśo bhiṣak
verses.tib: de nas 'di ni ma zhu smin / rlung las gyur pa'i pho nad la / drod skyed sman dang bcas pa dang / mar ni nyung zad nyung zad blud

verses.skt: kiñcitsaṃdhukṣite tv agnau saktaviṇmūtramārutam | dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā saṃsnehya svinnābhyaktaṃ nirūhayet
verses.tib: me drod chung zhing skyes gyur nas / bshang gci rlung ni 'gags gyur na / zhag ni gnyis gsum snum btang dugs / bsku byas mas gtong drag po bya

verses.skt: tata eraṇḍatailena sarpiṣā tailvakena vā | sakṣāreṇānile śānte srastadoṣaṃ virecayet
verses.tib: de nas e raN+Da yi mar / seng phrom gyi ni mar dang ni / thal sman dag gis rlung zhi nas / g.yos pa'i nad la bkru sman gtang
