verses.skt: śuddharūkṣāśayaṃ baddhavarcaskaṃ cānuvāsayet | dīpanīyāmlavātaghnasiddhatailena taṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: sbyangs nas khong pa rtsub gyur te / bshang ba 'gags la 'jam rtsi ni / drod skyed skyur zhing rlung 'joms pa'i / sman btsos til mar de la gtang

verses.skt: nirūḍhaṃ ca viriktaṃ ca samyak cāpy anuvāsitam | laghvannapratisaṃyuktaṃ sarpir abhyāsayet punaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar bkru sman drag bkru sman / 'jam rtsi cho ga bzhin byas la / kha zas yang ba dang ldan pa'i / zhun mar slar yang bsten par bya

verses.skt: pañcamūlābhayāvyoṣapippalīmūlasaindhavaiḥ | rāsnākṣāradvayājājīviḍaṅgaśaṭhibhir ghṛtam
verses.tib: rtsa ba lnga dang tsha ba gsum / a ru ra dang lce myang tsha / ra sna pi pi ling rtsa ba / thal sman rnam gnyis zi ra dang / byi dang ga dang zur pa mar

verses.skt: śuktena mātuluṅgasya svarasenārdrakasya ca | śuṣkamūlakakolāmlacukrikādāḍimasya ca
verses.tib: tsha dang skyur rtsi chen po yi / khu ba dang ni sge'u gsher dang / la phug skam po rgya shug skyur / se 'bru tsug kri ka'i khu ba

verses.skt: takramastusurāmaṇḍasauvīrakatuṣodakaiḥ | kāñjikena ca tat pakvam agnidīptikaraṃ param
verses.tib: dar bzho dang chang dngas dang / rtsab mo dngas ma rtsab mo dang / skyur rtsabs dang ni de bskol ba / me drod skyed pa'i dam pa yin

verses.skt: śūlagulmodaraśvāsakāsānilakaphāpaham | sabījapūrakarasaṃ siddhaṃ vā pāyayed ghṛtam
verses.tib: gzer dang skran dang dmu rdzing dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba dang / rlung dang bad kan 'joms par byed / yang na skyur rtsi chen po yi / khu bar bskol ba'i mar blud bya

verses.skt: tailam abhyañjanārthaṃ ca siddham ebhiś calāpaham | eteṣām auṣadhānāṃ vā pibec cūrṇaṃ sukhāmbunā
verses.tib: 'di yi til mar bskol ba yis / bsku byug byas na rlung sel to / rlung dang bad kan ma 'dres zhu'am / bad kan rlung shas che ba la / sman ni 'di dag nyid kyi phye / chu dron sbyar ba blud par bya / mkhris pas me drod nyams gyur pa / bkru

verses.skt: vāte śleṣmāvṛte sāme kaphe vā vāyunoddhate | agner nirvāpakaṃ pittaṃ rekeṇa vamanena vā
verses.tib: 'di yi til mar bskol ba yis / bsku byug byas na rlung sel to / rlung dang bad kan ma 'dres zhu'am / bad kan rlung shas che ba la / sman ni 'di dag nyid kyi phye / chu dron sbyar ba blud par bya / mkhris pas me drod nyams gyur pa / bkru

verses.skt: hatvā tiktalaghugrāhidīpanair avidāhibhiḥ | annaiḥ saṃdhukṣayed agniṃ cūrṇaiḥ snehaiś ca tiktakaiḥ
verses.tib: sman dag gam slon sman gtang / kha dang yang dang 'khru gcod dang / tsha mi skyed pas drod bskyed bya / phye ma snum dang kha ba yis / me drod nye bar bskyed par bya

verses.skt: paṭolanimbatrāyantītiktātiktakaparpaṭam | kuṭajatvakphalaṃ mūrvā madhuśigruphalaṃ vacā
verses.tib: pa to la dang kyi lce ba / nim pa pu tse shel rtsa mkhris / par pa ta dang dug mo nyung / shun lpags 'bras bu mur ba dang / shi kru mngar po'i 'bras bu dang

verses.skt: dārvītvakpadmakośīrayavānīmustacandanam | saurāṣṭryativiṣāvyoṣatvagelāpattradāru ca
verses.tib: shu dag skyer pa'i shun lpags dang / shug pa dang ni pu shel tse / tsan+dan gla sgang la la phud / sa nag bong nga tsha ba gsum / shing tsha sug smel thang shing dang / gan+d+ha b+ha dra'i phye ma ni

verses.skt: cūrṇitaṃ madhunā lehyaṃ peyaṃ madyair jalena vā | hṛtpāṇḍugrahaṇīrogagulmaśūlārucijvarān
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi'i lde gur byas bza' ba'am / chang ngam chu dang sbyar 'thungs na / snying nad skya rbab pho ba'i nad / skran gzer rims nad yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: kāmalāṃ saṃnipātaṃ ca mukharogāṃś ca nāśayet | bhūnimbakaṭukāmustātryūṣaṇendrayavān samān
verses.tib: mig ser 'dus pa'i nad dang ni / kha yi nad rnams 'joms par byed / rtsa mkhris gla sgang pu tse shel / tsha ba gsum dang dug mo nyung

verses.skt: dvau citrakād vatsakatvagbhāgān ṣoḍaśa cūrṇayet | guḍaśītāmbunā pītaṃ grahaṇīdoṣagulmanut
verses.tib: tsi tra ka ni cha gnyis dang / dug mo nyung gi shun lpags ni / bcu drug cha sbyar zhib tu btags / de ni bu ram chu grang blud / pho ba'i nad dang skran sel zhing

verses.skt: kāmalājvarapāṇḍutvamehārucyatisārajit | nāgarātiviṣāmustāpāṭhābilvaṃ rasāñjanam
verses.tib: mig ser skya rbab rims kyi nad / yi ga 'chus dang 'khru ba 'joms / dong gra bong nga gla sgang dang / pa ta bil ba skyer khaN+Da / dug mo nyung gis po na dang

verses.skt: kuṭajatvakphalaṃ tiktā dhātakī ca kṛtaṃ rajaḥ | kṣaudrataṇḍulavāribhyāṃ paittike grahaṇīgade
verses.tib: tig ta da ta ka'i me tog / phye mar btags la sbrang rtsir sbyar / 'bras bkrus chu dang blud na ni / mkhris pa las gyur pho ba'i nad

verses.skt: pravāhikārśogudarugraktotthāneṣu ceṣyate | candanaṃ padmakośīraṃ pāṭhāṃ mūrvāṃ kuṭannaṭam
verses.tib: mkhregs 'khrugs gzhang 'brum gzhang kha na / khrag tu 'khru ba dag la'ang phan / tsan+dan shug pa pu shel tse / pa ta mur ba bla ba dang

verses.skt: ṣaḍgranthāśārivāsphotāsaptaparṇāṭarūṣakān | paṭolodumbarāśvatthavaṭaplakṣakapītanān
verses.tib: shu dag thal tres dbyi mo dang / lo ma bdun pa ba sha ka / pa to la dang n+ya gro d+ha / u dum wA ra a shwat+tha / be+eg sha ka pi ta na dang

verses.skt: kaṭukāṃ rohiṇīṃ mustāṃ nimbaṃ ca dvipalāṃśakān | droṇe ’pāṃ sādhayet tena pacet sarpiḥ picūnmitaiḥ
verses.tib: pu tse shel dang li ga dur / nim pa srang ni gnyis gnyis la / chu bra bcu drug bskol ba der / ki ra tig ta dug mo nyung

verses.skt: kirātatiktendrayavavīrāmāgadhikotpalaiḥ | pittagrahaṇyāṃ tat peyaṃ kuṣṭhoktaṃ tiktakaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: ram nye ut+pal pi pi ling / bskol ba de 'thungs mkhris pa yi / pho ba'i nad la blud par bya / mdzer bshad tig ta'i mar yang blud

verses.skt: grahaṇyāṃ śleṣmaduṣṭāyāṃ tīkṣṇaiḥ pracchardane kṛte | kaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāraiḥ kramād agniṃ vivardhayet
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur pho ba'i nad / slon sman rnon pos slon byas nas / tsha skyur lan tshwa thal sman gyis / rim / gyis me drod skyed par byed

verses.skt: pañcakolābhayādhānyapāṭhāgandhapalāśakaiḥ | bījapūrapragāḍhaiś ca siddhaiḥ peyādi kalpayet
verses.tib: tsha ba lnga dang a ru ra / 'u su pa ta pa la sha / skyur rtse chen po'i myu gu dang / bskol ba'i thug pa la sogs blud

verses.skt: droṇaṃ madhūkapuṣpāṇāṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca tato ’rdhataḥ | citrakasya tato ’rdhaṃ ca tathā bhallātakāḍhakam
verses.tib: ma du ka yi me tog bre / bcu drug bye dang ga de'i phyed / tsi tra ka ni de phyed dang / bse shing 'bras bu bre bzhi dang

verses.skt: mañjiṣṭhāṣṭapalaṃ caitaj jaladroṇatraye pacet | droṇaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ madhvardhāḍhakasaṃyutam
verses.tib: btsod srang brgyad de 'di dag ni / chu bre sum cu rtsa gnyis bskol / chu bye bcu drug lus bsgrangs par / sbrang rtsi bye do gzhug pa dang

verses.skt: elāmṛṇālāgurubhiś candanena ca rūṣite | kumbhe māsaṃ sthitaṃ jātam āsavaṃ taṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: sug smel pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / a kar tsan+dan lde gu byug / bum par zla ba gcig gzhag ste / langs nas mnan chang blud gyur na

verses.skt: grahaṇīṃ dīpayaty eṣa bṛṃhaṇaḥ pittaraktanut | śoṣakuṣṭhakilāsānāṃ pramehāṇāṃ ca nāśanaḥ
verses.tib: 'di yis pho ba'i drod skyed cing / nyams brtas khrag mkhris sel bar byed / skems dang mdze dang sha bkra dang / gci snyi ba yi nad rnams 'joms

verses.skt: madhūkapuṣpasvarasaṃ śṛtam ardhakṣayīkṛtam | kṣaudrapādayutaṃ śītaṃ pūrvavat saṃnidhāpayet
verses.tib: ma du ka yi me tog ni / khu ba bskol ba phyed du ba / bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi bzhi cha btab / snga ma bzhin du byas pa'i chang

verses.skt: tat piban grahaṇīdoṣān jayet sarvān hitāśanaḥ | tadvad drākṣekṣukharjūrasvarasān āsutān pibet
verses.tib: phan pa'i zas dang bcas bsten na / pho ba'i nad ni thams cad sel / de bzhin rgun 'bru bu ram shing / 'bra go'i khu ba mnan pa blud

verses.skt: hiṅgutiktāvacāmādrīpāṭhendrayavagokṣuram | pañcakolaṃ ca karṣāṃśaṃ palāṃśaṃ paṭupañcakam
verses.tib: shing kun shu dag pu tse shel / bong nga pa ta dug mo nyung / gze ma tsha ba lnga po zho / gnyis gnyis lan tshwa lnga srang re

verses.skt: ghṛtatailadvikuḍave dadhnaḥ prasthadvaye ca tat | āpothya kvāthayed agnau mṛdāv anugate rase
verses.tib: mar dang til mar phul do do / zho bre gnyis dang bsres nas ni / me ni chung ngu la btsos ste

verses.skt: antardhūmaṃ tato dagdhvā cūrṇīkṛtya ghṛtāplutam | pibet pāṇitalaṃ tasmiñ jīrṇe syān madhurāśanaḥ
verses.tib: rnying zhing khu ba thim pa dang / de nas du ba 'khyims par bsreg / btags te mar dang bsres pa dag / de las zho gnyis 'thungs nas ni / zhu nas kha zas mngar zos nas

verses.skt: vātaśleṣmāmayān sarvān hanyād viṣagarāṃś ca saḥ | bhūnimbaṃ rohiṇīṃ tiktāṃ paṭolaṃ nimbaparpaṭam
verses.tib: des ni bad kan rlung nad ni / kun dang dug dang dbyig dug 'joms / rtswa mkhris dang ni pu tse shel / pa to nim pa par pa ta

verses.skt: dagdhvā māhiṣamūtreṇa pibed agnivivardhanam | dve haridre vacā kuṣṭhaṃ citrakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī
verses.tib: bsregs la ma he'i gcin dang ni / 'thungs na me drod skyed byed yin / shu dag ru rta ser po gnyis / tsi tra ka dang pu tse shel

verses.skt: mustā ca cchāgamūtreṇa siddhaḥ kṣāro ’gnivardhanaḥ | catuḥpalaṃ sudhākāṇḍāt tripalaṃ lavaṇatrayāt
verses.tib: gla sgang ra yi gcin dang ni / bskol ba me drod skyed byed yin / su ta'i sdong bu srang bzhi dang / lan tshwa gsum las srang re dang

verses.skt: vārtākakuḍavaṃ cārkād aṣṭau dve citrakāt pale | dagdhvā rasena vārtākād guṭikā bhojanottarāḥ
verses.tib: par ta ka ni phul gang dang / arka srang brgyad tsi tra ka / srang gnyis bsregs la par ta ka'i / khu bas ri lu byas nas ni

verses.skt: bhuktam annaṃ pacanty āśu kāsaśvāsārśasāṃ hitāḥ | viṣūcikāpratiśyāyahṛdrogaśamanāś ca tāḥ
verses.tib: zas rjes zos na zos pa'i zas / myur du lud pa dbugs mi bde / gzhang 'brum gsung dang cham pa dang / snying nad des ni zhi bar byed

verses.skt: mātuluṅgaśaṭhīrāsnākaṭutrayaharītaki | svarjikāyāvaśūkākhyau kṣārau pañcapaṭūni ca
verses.tib: kha lud zur pa ra sna dang / tsha ba gsum dang a ru ra / nas tshig 'khus thal swardzi ka'i / thal sman lan tshwa lnga po rnams

verses.skt: sukhāmbupītaṃ taccūrṇaṃ balavarṇāgnivardhanam | ślaiṣmike grahaṇīdoṣe savāte tair ghṛtaṃ pacet
verses.tib: phyer btags dro 'jam chu dang blud / mdog stobs me drod 'phel byed yin / bad kan las gyur pho ba'i nad / rlung bcas de la mar dang bskol

verses.skt: dhānvantaraṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ ca bhallātakaghṛtābhayam | viḍakācoṣalavaṇasvarjikāyāvaśūkajān
verses.tib: thang la 'bar dang srang drug pa / de bzhin go bye'i sman mar blud / kha ru tsha dang tsha nag dang / bul tog dang ni swardzi ka / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang

verses.skt: saptalāṃ kaṇṭakārīṃ ca citrakaṃ caikato dahet | saptakṛtvaḥ srutasyāsya kṣārasyārdhāḍhake pacet
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri sab ta la / tsi tra ka ni gcig tu bsreg / lan bdun bar du gzags pa yi / thal khu bre do mar bre bzhi

verses.skt: āḍhakaṃ sarpiṣaḥ peyaṃ tad agnibalavṛddhaye | nicaye pañca karmāṇi yuñjyāc caitad yathābalam
verses.tib: bskol la me drod bskyed phyir blud / 'dus pa las ni lnga po dang / 'di dag nyams stobs ji bzhin bya

verses.skt: praseke ślaiṣmike ’lpāgner dīpanaṃ rūkṣatiktakam | yojyaṃ kṛśasya vyatyāsāt snigdharūkṣaṃ kaphodaye
verses.tib: bad kan mchil mang drod chung la / kha rtsub me drod skyed par sbyar / bad kan las byung skems pa la / snum dang rtsub pa res kyis bsten

verses.skt: kṣīṇakṣāmaśarīrasya dīpanaṃ snehasaṃyutam | dīpanaṃ bahupittasya tiktaṃ madhurakair yutam
verses.tib: nyam chung rid pa'i lus la ni / me drod skyed pa snum ldan sbyin / mkhris pa shas che'i drod nyams la / kha dang mngar ba ldan pa sbyin

verses.skt: sneho ’mlalavaṇair yukto bahuvātasya śasyate | sneham eva paraṃ vidyād durbalānaladīpanam
verses.tib: rlung shas che la snum skyur dang / lan tshwar ldan pa bsngags pa yin / rid pa me drod skyed pa la / snum nyid mchog tu shes par bya

verses.skt: nālaṃ snehasamiddhasya śamāyānnaṃ sugurv api | yo ’lpāgnitvāt kaphe kṣīṇe varcaḥ pakvam api ślatham
verses.tib: snum shas che bar gyur pa la / rab lci'i zas kyang sbyin mi bya / gang zhig drod chung bad kan zad / bshang ba smin kyang sla ba la

verses.skt: muñcet paṭvauṣadhayutaṃ sa pibed alpaśo ghṛtam | tena svamārgam ānītaḥ svakarmaṇi niyojitaḥ
verses.tib: de la sman rnor bcas pa yi / mar ni nyung zad blud par bya / de yis me dang mnyam gnas rlung / rang gnas bkug ste rang gi ni

verses.skt: samāno dīpayaty agnim agneḥ saṃdhukṣako hi saḥ | purīṣaṃ yaś ca kṛcchreṇa kaṭhinatvād vimuñcati
verses.tib: las la sbyor bas drod skyed byed / de ni me drod skyed byed yin / gang zhig bshang ba sra ba yis / dka' bas 'byin par byed pa dag

verses.skt: sa ghṛtaṃ lavaṇair yuktaṃ naro ’nnāvagrahaṃ pibet | raukṣyān mande ’nale sarpis tailaṃ vā dīpanaiḥ pibet
verses.tib: de la lan tshwa bcas pa'i mar / zas ni sla bar byed pa sbyin / rtsub pas me drod chung la mar / yang na til mar drod skyed blud

verses.skt: kṣāracūrṇāsavāriṣṭan mande snehātipānataḥ | udāvartāt tu yoktavyā nirūhasnehavastayaḥ
verses.tib: snum mang 'thungs pas drod nyams la / thal sman phye ma chang rnying sbyar / rtug 'gags pa la mas gtong ba'i / drag po dang ni 'jam rtsi bya

verses.skt: doṣātivṛddhyā mande ’gnau saṃśuddho ’nnavidhiṃ caret | vyādhimuktasya mande ’gnau sarpir eva tu dīpanam
verses.tib: nad tshab che bas me drod nyams / sbyang byas zas kyi cho ga spyad / nad byang me drod chung ba la / zhun mar 'ba' zhig drod skyed byed

verses.skt: adhvopavāsakṣāmatvair yavāgvā pāyayed ghṛtam | annāvapīḍitaṃ balyaṃ dīpanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca tat
verses.tib: lam dang smyung bas nyam chung la / nas thug mar dang sbyar ba'am / zas bcas blud na stobs skyed cing / drod skyed brta bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: dīrghakālaprasaṅgāt tu kṣāmakṣīṇakṛśān narān | prasahānāṃ rasaiḥ sāmlair bhojayet piśitāśinām
verses.tib: yun nyal po spyad pa dang / mi ni nyam chung skam gyur la / mthu rtsal can gyis zas tshol ba / sha za'i sha khu skyur sbyar sbyin

verses.skt: laghūṣṇakaṭuśodhitvād dīpayanty āśu te ’nalam | māṃsopacitamāṃsatvāt paraṃ ca balavardhanāḥ
verses.tib: yang zhing dri tsha sbyong byed pa / de yis me drod myur du skyed / sha yis skyed pa'i sha yin phyir / stobs ni mchog tu skyed par byed

verses.skt: snehāsavasurāriṣṭacūrṇakvāthahitāśanaiḥ | samyakprayuktair dehasya balam agneś ca vardhate
verses.tib: snum dang mnan chang chang rnying dang / sman khu phye ma 'phrod pa zos / lus la legs par sbyar ba yis / stobs dang me drod 'phel bar byed

verses.skt: dīpto yathaiva sthāṇuś ca bāhyo ’gniḥ sāradārubhiḥ | sasnehair jāyate tadvad āhāraiḥ koṣṭhago ’nalaḥ
verses.tib: dper na me ni shing sra bas / sbar ba yun ring gnas par byed / de bzhin khong par gnas pa'i me / snum dang bcas pas brtan par gnas

verses.skt: nābhojanena kāyāgnir dīpyate nātibhojanāt | yathā nirindhano vahnir alpo vātīndhanāvṛtaḥ
verses.tib: ji ltar me ni shing med pa'am / me chung shing ni drags pa ltar / lus me zas ni ma zos pa / zas drags gyur pas 'bar mi byed

verses.skt: yadā kṣīṇe kaphe pittaṃ svasthāne pavanānugam | pravṛddhaṃ vardhayaty agniṃ tadāsau sānilo ’nalaḥ
verses.tib: gang tshe bad kan zad mkhris pa / rang gi gnas su rlung zhugs na / me drod 'phel zhing rab rgyas 'gyur / de tshe me ni rlung bcas pas

verses.skt: paktvānnam āśu dhātūṃś ca sarvān ojaś ca saṃkṣipan | mārayet syāt sa nā svastho bhukte jīrṇe tu tāmyati
verses.tib: zas smin byas nas lus zungs kyang / zad cing mdangs 'thor byed pas gsod / zas zos nas ni bde 'gyur la / zhu nas mun zhugs snyam sems 'gyur

verses.skt: tṛṭkāsadāhamūrchādyā vyādhayo ’tyagnisaṃbhavāḥ | tam atyagniṃ gurusnigdhamandasāndrahimasthiraiḥ
verses.tib: skom dad tsha brgyal dbugs mi bde / la sogs me drod drags las 'byung / zas lci snum sla rtul ba dang / grang dang 'ju dka' me drod 'bri

verses.skt: annapānair nayec chāntiṃ dīptam agnim ivāmbubhiḥ | muhur muhur ajīrṇe ’pi bhojyāny asyopahārayet
verses.tib: 'bar ba'i me la chu blugs ltar / me drod shas cha de zhi bya / de nas kha zas ma zhu la'ang / yang dang yang du zas sbyin bya

verses.skt: nirindhano ’ntaraṃ labdhvā yathainaṃ na vipādayet | kṛśarāṃ pāyasaṃ snigdhaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ guḍavaikṛtam
verses.tib: bud shing med pa'i skabs rnyed ltar / ji gnas 'dir gnas mi 'gyur bya / kri sa ra dang 'o thug snum / snum khur bu ram g.yos pa dang

verses.skt: aśnīyād audakānūpapiśitāni bhṛtāni ca | matsyān viśeṣataḥ ślakṣṇān sthiratoyacarāś ca ye
verses.tib: rlan can chu yi srog chags ni / tsho ba yi ni sha sbyin no / mchog tu nya ni 'jam po dang / mi 'gul chu la gnas pa sbyin

verses.skt: āvikaṃ subhṛtaṃ māṃsam adyād atyagnivāraṇam | payaḥ sahamadhūcchiṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā tṛṣitaḥ pibet
verses.tib: lug sha tshon po dag kyang ni / zos na me drod drags pa sal / 'o ma sbrang rtsi bcas ba'am / mar dang sbyar ba skom tshe blud

verses.skt: godhūmacūrṇaṃ payasā bahusarpiḥpariplutam | ānūparasayuktān vā snehāṃs tailavivarjitān
verses.tib: gro yi phye ni 'o ma dang / mar ni mang por bcas pa blud / rlan can / srog chags sha khu dang / til mar ma gtogs snum can blud

verses.skt: śyāmātrivṛdvipakvaṃ vā payo dadyād virecanam | asakṛt pittaharaṇaṃ pāyasapratibhojanam
verses.tib: sha ma dur byid dang bskol ba'i / 'o ma'i bkru sman blud par bya / mkhris pa sel ba'i kha zas dang / 'o thug lan mang sbyin par bya

verses.skt: yat kiñcid guru medyaṃ ca śleṣmakāri ca bhojanam | sarvaṃ tad atyagnihitaṃ bhuktvā ca svapanaṃ divā
verses.tib: gang zhig lce zhing chil skyed dang / bad kan skyed pa'i kha zas rnams / thams cad me drod drags la phan / zos nas nyin par nyal bar bya

verses.skt: āhāram agniḥ pacati doṣān āhāravarjitaḥ | dhātūn kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣu jīvitaṃ dhātusaṃkṣaye
verses.tib: zas ni me drod kyis 'ju byed / zas med nas ni nad zad byed / lus zungs zad par byed par 'gyur / lus zungs zad nas 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: etat prakṛtyaiva viruddham annaṃ saṃyogasaṃskāravaśena cedam | ityādi avijñāya yatheṣṭaceṣṭāś caranti yat sāgnibalasya śaktiḥ
verses.tib: zas 'di dag ni rang bzhin gyis mi mthun / 'di ni sbyor dang g.yos kyis mi 'phrod pa / de la sogs pa me shes ci dga' bar / spyod de me drod stobs las gyur pa yin

verses.skt: tasmād agniṃ pālayet sarvayatnais tasmin naṣṭe yāti nā nāśam eva | doṣair graste grasyate rogasaṃghair yukte tu syān nīrujo dīrghajīvī || 93 ||
verses.tib: de bas 'bad pa kun gyis me drod bsrung / de nyams na ni mi yi srog nyes nyams / nyes pas khyab na nad kyi tshogs kyis 'debs / me drod mnyam na nad med tshe ring 'gyur

verses.skt: liṅgāgrasuṣire samyag yonyāṃ vā saṃpraveśayet | mūtraduḥkhaharaṃ mukhyaṃ karpūraṃ parisaṃkṣipet
verses.tib: de nas gcin 'gags pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o / rlung las gyur pa'i gcin sri la

verses.skt: kṛcchre vātaghnatailāktam adho nābheḥ samīraje | susnigdhaiḥ svedayed aṅgaṃ piṇḍasekāvagāhanaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung 'joms til mar gyis lus bsku / lte ba man chad dugs bya zhing / rlan dugs lus ni spying ba'ang bya

verses.skt: daśamūlabalairaṇḍayavābhīrupunarnavaiḥ | kulatthakolapattūravṛścīvopalabhedakaiḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu pa e raN+Da / ba la nas dang nye shing pa / ba spru ba dang ku lang+tha / rgya shug dang ni ba ru ra / sru sru'i rtsa ba bri shi ba

verses.skt: tailasarpirvarāharkṣavasāḥ kvathitakalkitaiḥ | sapañcalavaṇāḥ siddhāḥ pītāḥ śūlaharāḥ param
verses.tib: til mar zhun mar phag dang dred / zhag bskol lan tshwa bcas pa ni / 'thungs na gzer 'joms mchog yin no / sman 'di dag ni snum pa yi

verses.skt: dravyāṇy etāni pānānne tathā piṇḍopanāhane | saha tailaphalair yuñjyāt sāmlāni snehavanti ca
verses.tib: 'bras bur bcas shing skyur ba dang / snum dang ldan par zas skom dang / gong po dkri ba'i dugs dpyad bya

verses.skt: sauvarcalāḍhyāṃ madirāṃ piben mūtrarujāpahām | paitte yuñjīta śiśiraṃ sekalepāvagāhanam
verses.tib: kha ru tsha mang btab pa'i chang / 'thungs na gcin gyi nad sel byed / mkhris gyur bsku dang blugs pa dang / lus bcing bas ni bsil bar bya

verses.skt: pibed varīṃ gokṣurakaṃ vidārīṃ sakaserukām | tṛṇākhyaṃ pañcamūlaṃ ca pākyaṃ samadhuśarkaram
verses.tib: nye shing gze ma bi da ri / rgun 'bru rtsa yi rtsa ba lnga / bskol ba'i nang du sbrang rtsi dang / kha rab btab pa blud par bya / ba sha ka dang ga gon dang

verses.skt: vṛṣakaṃ trapusairvārulaṭvābījāni kuṅkumam | drākṣāmbhobhiḥ piban sarvān mūtrāghātān apohati
verses.tib: rgyal mo ga gon le brgan rtsi'i / sa bon gur gum rgun chu dang / 'thungs / na gcin 'gags nad sel byed

verses.skt: ervārubījayaṣṭyāhvadārvīr vā taṇḍulāmbunā | toyena kalkaṃ drākṣāyāḥ pibet paryuṣitena vā
verses.tib: shing mngar er ba ru'i sa bon / skyer pa 'bras kyi chu dang blud / rgun 'bru'i lde gu chur sbyar ba'am / rgun 'bru chur ni sbangs pa blud

verses.skt: kaphaje vamanaṃ svedaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭubhojanam | yavānāṃ vikṛtīḥ kṣāraṃ kālaśeyaṃ ca śīlayet
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur dugs byas la / skyug sman bza' ba rno dro sbyin / nas yos thal sman rno ba dang / dar ba bcas pa sbyin par bya

verses.skt: piben madyena sūkṣmailāṃ dhātrīphalarasena vā | sārasāsthiśvadaṃṣṭrailāvyoṣaṃ vā madhumūtravat
verses.tib: sug smel chang dang sbyar ba'am / skyu ru ra yi khu ba blud / bzhad rus gze ma sug smel dang / tsha gsum sbrang rtsi gcin bcas blud

verses.skt: svarasaṃ kaṇṭakāryā vā pāyayen mākṣikānvitam | śitivārakabījaṃ vā takreṇa ślakṣṇacūrṇitam
verses.tib: yang na kaN+Da ka ri'i khu / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba blud par bya / shi ti ba ra'i sa bon ni / zhib btags dar bar sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: dhavasaptāhvakuṭajaguḍūcīcaturaṅgulam | kembukailākarañjaṃ ca pākyaṃ samadhu sādhitām
verses.tib: ba da sap+ta par+Ni dang / sle tres dong gra dug mo nyung / ke'u ka dang sug smel dang / ka rany+dza bskol sbrang rtsir bcas

verses.skt: tair vā peyāṃ pravālaṃ vā cūrṇitaṃ taṇḍulāmbunā | satailaṃ pāṭalākṣāraṃ saptakṛtvo ’thavā srutam
verses.tib: des sbyar thug pa'am byi ru yi / phye ma 'bras kyi chu dang blud / pa ta li yi thal ba'i chu / lan bdun btsags pa til mar bcas

verses.skt: pāṭalīyāvaśūkābhyāṃ pāribhadrāt tilād api | kṣārodakena madirāṃ tvageloṣaṇasaṃyutām
verses.tib: nas tshig 'khus thal pa ta li / pa ri pa tra til thal chu / shing tsha sug smel na le sham / chang dang sbyar ba blud par bya

verses.skt: pibed guḍopadaṃśān vā lihyād etān pṛthak pṛthak | saṃnipātātmake sarvaṃ yathāvastham idaṃ hitam
verses.tib: 'di dag re re'i lde gur sbyar / bu ram so yis bcad cing bza' / 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can kun la / 'di dag gnas skabs ji bzhin phan

verses.skt: aśmany apy acirotthāne vātavastyādikeṣu ca | aśmarī dāruṇo vyādhir antakapratimo mataḥ
verses.tib: rde'u chags ring po ma lon dang / rlung gi lgang nad sogs la'ang sbyar / rde'u chags nad ni mi bzad de / 'chi bdag dang ni 'dra bar 'dod

verses.skt: taruṇo bheṣajaiḥ sādhyaḥ pravṛddhaś chedam arhati | tasya pūrveṣu rūpeṣu snehādikrama iṣyate
verses.tib: gzhon pa'i tshe na sman gyis gso / 'phel nas 'dral bar 'os pa yin / de yi sngon 'byung tshul la ni / snum 'chos la sogs rim pas bsngags

verses.skt: pāṣāṇabhedo vasuko vaśiro ’śmantako varī | kapotavaṅkātibalābhallūkośīrakacchakam
verses.tib: sru sru'i rtsa ba spra tog dang / a sman da ka ba si ra / nye shing lcam pa pu tse shel / a ti pa la ba lu ka

verses.skt: vṛkṣādanī śākaphalaṃ vyāghryau guṇṭhas trikaṇṭakaḥ | yavāḥ kulatthāḥ kolāni varuṇaḥ katakāt phalam
verses.tib: spangs ma br-ik+Sha da ni dang / sha ka'i 'bras bu bya kri gnyis / gud tha gze ma ku lang+tha / nas dang rgya shug pa ra Na / ka ta ka yi 'bras bu dang

verses.skt: ūṣakādipratīvāpam eṣāṃ kvāthe śṛtaṃ ghṛtam | bhinatti vātasaṃbhūtāṃ tat pītaṃ śīghram aśmarīm
verses.tib: u sha ka phye ma btab / 'di dag khu ba mar bskol blud / rlung gyur rde'u 'jig par byed

verses.skt: gandharvahastabṛhatīvyāghrīgokṣurakekṣurāt | mūlakalkaṃ pibed dadhnā madhureṇāśmabhedanam
verses.tib: e raN+Da dang bri ha ti / kaN+Da ka ri gze ma dang / bu ram shing phran rtsa ba yi / lde gu zho dang sbyar te blud / rde'u chags pa sel byed yin

verses.skt: kuśaḥ kāśaḥ śaro guṇṭha itkaṭo moraṭo ’śmabhit | darbho vidārī vārāhī śālimūlaṃ trikaṇṭakaḥ
verses.tib: ku / sha 'jag ma 'dam bu dang / ku ta nye'u shing ig ga tha / sru sru'i rtsa ba 'jag zlum dang / bi da ri dang ba ra hi / 'bras kyi rtsa ba gze ma dang

verses.skt: bhallūkaḥ pāṭalī pāṭhā pattūraḥ sakuraṇṭakaḥ | punarnave śirīṣaś ca teṣāṃ kvāthe paced ghṛtam
verses.tib: ba lu ka dang pa ta li / btul dang bla bar bcas / ba spru ba dang sri sha ka / de rnams bskol khu mar dang bskol

verses.skt: piṣṭena trapusādīnāṃ bījenendīvareṇa ca | madhukena śilājena tat pittāśmaribhedanam
verses.tib: ga gon sa bon la sogs dang / ut+pal yis bon dang / shing mngar dang ni brag zhun phye / de dag mkhris gyur rde chags sel

verses.skt: varuṇādiḥ samīraghnau gaṇāv elā hareṇukā | guggulur maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ citrakaḥ sasurāhvayaḥ
verses.tib: ba ra Na sogs rlung 'joms te / sug smel ha re Nu ka'i sde / gu gul ru rta na le sham / tsi tra ka dang bye'u rug pa

verses.skt: taiḥ kalkitaiḥ kṛtāv āpam ūṣakādigaṇena ca | bhinatti kaphajām āśu sādhitaṃ ghṛtam aśmarīm
verses.tib: de dag lde gur byas pa gzhug / u sha ka yi sde tshan bcug / mar bskol ba yis bad kan las / gyur pa'i rde'u myur du 'joms

verses.skt: kṣārakṣīrayavāgvādi dravyaiḥ svaiḥ svaiś ca kalpayet | picukāṅkollakatakaśākendīvarajaiḥ phalaiḥ
verses.tib: rang rang sman ni 'di nyid kyis / thal sman 'o ma thug sbyar / pi tsu ka dang ang go la / ka ta ka la sha ka dang / ut+pa la yi 'bras bu rnams

verses.skt: pītam uṣṇāmbu saguḍaṃ śarkarāpātanaṃ param | krauñcoṣṭrarāsabhāsthīni śvadaṃṣṭrā tālapattrikā
verses.tib: bu ram bcas pa'i chu dron blud / rde phran 'jig par byed pa'i mchog / khrung khrung rnga mo bong bu'i rus / gze ma ta la pa tri ka

verses.skt: ajamodā kadambasya mūlaṃ viśvasya cauṣadham | pītāni śarkarāṃ bhindyuḥ surayoṣṇodakena vā
verses.tib: a za mo dang ka dam pa'i / rtsa ba dang ni bca' sga ni / chang ngam chu dron bcas pa blud / rde phran chags pa 'jig par byed

verses.skt: nṛtyakuṇḍakabījānāṃ cūrṇaṃ mākṣikasaṃyutam | avikṣīreṇa saptāhaṃ pītam aśmaripātanaḥ
verses.tib: ma ri tsi ka'i sa bon gyi / phye ma sbrang rtsir sbyar ba dang / lug gi 'o ma zhag bdun ni / blud na rde'u ni 'jig par byed

verses.skt: kvāthaś ca śigrumūlotthaḥ kaduṣṇo ’śmarīpātanaḥ | tilāpāmārgakadalīpalāśayavasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.tib: shi kru'i rtsa ba bskol ba ni / dro 'jam 'thungs pas rde nad 'joms / til dang a pa marga dang / chu shing dang ni pa la sha

verses.skt: kṣāraḥ peyo ’vimūtreṇa śarkarāsv aśmarīṣu ca | kapotavaṅkāmūlaṃ vā pibed ekaṃ surādibhiḥ
verses.tib: nas tshig 'khus thal lug gcin blud / phye ma rde'u chags pa sel / yang na lcam pa'i rtsa ba ni / gcig tu chang la sogs pa blud

verses.skt: tatsiddhaṃ vā pibet kṣīraṃ vedanābhir upadrutaḥ | harītakyasthisiddhaṃ vā sādhitaṃ vā punarnavaiḥ
verses.tib: yang na de bskol 'o ma blud / nad kyis nyen pa sel ba byed / a ru ra yi rus pa btsos / yang na ba spru ba btsos blud

verses.skt: kṣīrānnabhug barhiśikhāmūlaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā | mūtrāghāteṣu vibhajed ataḥ śeṣeṣv api kriyām
verses.tib: yang na 'o ma can zas bza' / yang na bar hi shi ka yi / rtsa ba 'bras bur bcas pa blud / gcin 'gags lhag ma rnams la ni / 'di yi gso ba lhag ma'ang sbyar

verses.skt: bṛhatyādigaṇe siddhaṃ dviguṇīkṛtagokṣure | toyaṃ payo vā sarpir vā sarvamūtravikārajit
verses.tib: bri ha ti sogs sde tshan bskol / gze ma nyis 'gyur gzhug par bya / chu 'am 'o ma zhun mar dang / blud na gcin gyi nad kun sel

verses.skt: devadāruṃ ghanaṃ mūrvāṃ yaṣṭīmadhu harītakīm | mūtrāghāteṣu sarveṣu surākṣīrajalaiḥ pibet
verses.tib: thang shing gla sgang mur ba dang / shing mngar dang ni a ru ra / chang ngam / 'o ma chur sbyar ba / gcin gyi nad ni kun la blud

verses.skt: rasaṃ vā dhanvayāsasya kaṣāyaṃ kakubhasya vā | sukhāmbhasā vā triphalāṃ piṣṭāṃ saindhavasaṃyutām
verses.tib: byi tsher ba bskol khu ba'am / ardzu na bskol khu ba ni / rgyam tsha 'bras bu gsum btab la / chu tshan dro 'jam sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: vyāghrīgokṣurakakvāthe yavāgūṃ vā saphāṇitām | kvāthe vīratarāder vā tāmracūḍarase ’pi vā
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri gze ma bskol / yang na nas thug bur phran bcas / bi da ra sogs bskol ba'am / khyim bya'i sha yi khu ba blud

verses.skt: adyād vīratarādyena bhāvitaṃ vā śilājatu | madyaṃ vā nigadaṃ pītvā rathenāśvena vā vrajet
verses.tib: bi da ri la sogs pa dang / bskol ba'i brag zhun sbyin pa'am / yang na chang ni nad med blud / rta'am shing rtar bskyod nas ni

verses.skt: śīghravegena saṃkṣobhāt tathāsya cyavate ’śmarī | sarvathā copayoktavyo vargo vīratarādikaḥ
verses.tib: mgyogs par 'gro bas bskyod gyur na / rde'u de ni g.yo bar 'gyur / bi da ri la sogs pa yi / sde tshan rnam pa kun tu sbyar

verses.skt: rekārthaṃ tailvakaṃ sarpir vastikarma ca śīlayet | viśeṣād uttarān vastīñ chukrāśmaryāṃ tu śodhite
verses.tib: bkru sman don du seng phram mar / 'jam rtsi'i las kyang bsten par bya / mchog tu 'jam rtsi gong ma bya / khu chu'i rde'u chags de yi ni

verses.skt: tair mūtramārge balavān śukrāśayaviśuddhaye | pumān sutṛpto vṛṣyāṇāṃ māṃsānāṃ kukkuṭasya ca
verses.tib: gcin lam sbyangs la stobs che ba'i / khu chu'i gnas ni sbyang ba'i phyir / skyes pa khu ba 'phel byed pa'i / sha dang khyim bya'i sha yis 'grangs

verses.skt: kāmaṃ sakāmaḥ seveta pramadā madadāyinīḥ | siddhair upakramair ebhir na cec chāntis tadā bhiṣak
verses.tib: 'dod pa bdo bas bud med ni / dga' ba skyed la nyal po bya / gso ba 'di yis bcos kyang ni / ma zhi na ni sman pa yis

verses.skt: iti rājānam āpṛcchya śastraṃ sādhv avacārayet | akriyāyāṃ dhruvo mṛtyuḥ kriyāyāṃ saṃśayo bhavet
verses.tib: mtshon ni legs par brtag byas te / gso ba ma bgyi nges par 'chi / bgyis na 'ang dogs par bcas pa las / de ltar rgyal po la zhus nas

verses.skt: niścitasyāpi vaidyasya bahuśaḥ siddhakarmaṇaḥ | athāturam upasnigdhaśuddham īṣac ca karśitam
verses.tib: las la byang ba'i sman pa ni / mang po dang ni dpyad par bya / de nas nad par snum bskus shing / sbyangs shing cung zad nyams smad pa'i

verses.skt: abhyaktasvinnavapuṣam abhuktaṃ kṛtamaṅgalam | ājānuphalakasthasya narasyāṅke vyapāśritam
verses.tib: lus ni snum bsku dugs bya zhing / zan ma zos shing bkra shis byas / pus mor sleb pa'i spang leb la / 'dug pa mi yi pad par brten

verses.skt: pūrveṇa kāyenottānaṃ niṣaṇṇaṃ vastracumbhale | tato ’syākuñcite jānukūrpare vāsasā dṛḍham
verses.tib: ro stod gan rkyal bzhag nas ni / gos kyis dkris pa'i steng du gzhag / de nas de yi sgyid khung dag / bkug nas ras kyis dam pa ru

verses.skt: sahāśrayamanuṣyeṇa baddhasyāśvāsitasya ca | nābheḥ samantād abhyajyād adhas tasyāś ca vāmataḥ
verses.tib: rten gyi mi dang bcas par ni / bcings te dbugs ni phyung nas su / lte ba man chad bskus nas ni / de yi g.yon rol phyogs su ni

verses.skt: mṛditvā muṣṭinākrāmed yāvad aśmary adhogatā | tailākte vardhitanakhe tarjanīmadhyame tataḥ
verses.tib: mnyes la khu tshur gyis mnan cing / 'og tu 'byin pa'i bar du btsir / de nas g.yon pa'i mdzub mo dang / gung mo'i sen mo zegs nas ni / til mar bskus te rkub tu ni / srubs mtshams bar du gzhug / par bya

verses.skt: adakṣiṇe gude ’ṅgulyau praṇidhāyānusevani | āsādya balayatnābhyām aśmarīṃ gudameḍhrayoḥ
verses.tib: rde'u lte ba'i gnyer ma nas / pho mtshan gzhang bar phyin par bya / de nas chu so'i gnas su ni

verses.skt: kṛtvāntare tathā vastiṃ nirvalīkam anāyatam | utpīḍayed aṅgulībhyāṃ yāvad granthir ivonnatam
verses.tib: gnyer ma med cing dbyung sla ba / sor mo gnyis kyis btsir nas ni / mdud pa lta bur mtho bar bya

verses.skt: śalyaṃ syāt sevanīṃ muktvā yavamātreṇa pāṭayet | aśmamānena na yathā bhidyate sā tathāharet
verses.tib: srubs mtshams nas gang ma gtogs par / gtsags bus legs par dral nas ni / rde'u'i tshad du dbral byas la / ci nas chag grugs med par ni

verses.skt: samagraṃ sarpavaktreṇa strīṇāṃ vastis tu pārśvagaḥ | garbhāśayāśrayas tāsāṃ śastram utsaṅgavat tataḥ
verses.tib: cha spyad rtse mo gug pa yis / ma lus par ni dbyung bar bya / bud med chu so ngos su gnas / de ni mngal gnas pa la brten

verses.skt: nyased ato ’nyathā hy āsāṃ mūtrasrāvī vraṇo bhavet | mūtraprasekakṣaṇanān narasyāpy api caikadhā
verses.tib: gzhan du byas na de yis ni / rma nas gcin ni 'dzag par 'gyur / skyes pa'i rma ni dbral nyes na / gcin 'dzag pa dang gcig tu 'gyur

verses.skt: vastibhedo ’śmarīhetuḥ siddhiṃ yāti na tu dvidhā | viśalyam uṣṇapānīyadroṇyāṃ tam avagāhayet
verses.tib: chu so dbral ba'i rde'u rgyu / gcig las grub kyi gnyis las min / zug rngu chung las chu dron gyi / nang du de ni spying bar bya

verses.skt: tathā na pūryate ’sreṇa vastiḥ pūrṇe tu pīḍayet | meḍhrāntaḥ kṣīrivṛkṣāmbu mūtrasaṃśuddhaye tataḥ
verses.tib: de ltar khrag gis gang mi 'gyur / gang la mtshan las 'o ma can / shing gi khu ba btsir bar bya / de nas gcin ni dag bya'i phyir

verses.skt: kuryād guḍasya sauhityaṃ madhvājyāktavraṇaḥ pibet | dvau kālau saghṛtāṃ koṣṇāṃ yavāgūṃ mūtraśodhanaiḥ
verses.tib: bu ram grangs pa sbyin pa dang / rma la mar dang sbrang rtsi bsku / dus gnyis nas thug mar bcas pa'i / dro 'jam gcin skyed zhag gsum blud

verses.skt: tryahaṃ daśāhaṃ payasā guḍāḍhyenālpam odanam | bhuñjītordhvaṃ phalāmlaiś ca rasair jāṅgalacāriṇām
verses.tib: bu ram mang po 'o ma dang / 'bras chan nyung ba zhag bcu sbyin / de nas 'bras bu skyur ba dang / skam sa'i srog chags sha khu sbyin

verses.skt: kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa vraṇaṃ prakṣālya lepayet | prapauṇḍarīkamañjiṣṭhāyaṣṭyāhvanayanauṣadhaiḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma can shing khu ba yis / rma ni bkrus nas btsod dang ni / shing mngar pra puN+Da ra'i ka / seng phrom dkar pos bsku bar bya

verses.skt: vraṇābhyaṅge pacet tailam ebhir eva niśānvitaiḥ | daśāhaṃ svedayec cainaṃ svamārgaṃ saptarātrataḥ
verses.tib: rma bskus sman ni 'di dag nyid / skyer bcas til mar bskol te bskus / 'di yis rma zhag bcu dugs bya / gcin gyi lam ni zhag bdun na

verses.skt: mūtre tv agacchati dahed aśmarīvraṇam agninā | svamārgapratipattau tu svāduprāyair upācaret
verses.tib: rang gi lam nas ma byung na / rde'u'i rma ni me yis bsregs / rang gi lam nas byung gyur nas / phal cher mas gtong mngar bas gso

verses.skt: taṃ vastibhir na cārohed varṣaṃ rūḍhavraṇo ’pi saḥ | naganāgāśvavṛkṣastrīrathān nāpsu plaveta ca
verses.tib: rma de 'tshobs kyang lo gcig bar / ri bo glang po rta dang ni / shing la 'dzeg par mi bya ste / shing rtar mi zhon nyal po spang / chu la rkyal bar mi bya'o

verses.skt: mūtraśukravahau vastivṛṣaṇau sevanīṃ gudam | mūtraprasekaṃ yoniṃ ca śastreṇāṣṭau vivarjayet
verses.tib: khu chu gcin rgyu lgang pa dang / rlig sbubs mtshams / srubs gzhang rtsa dang / pho mtshan mo mtshan rtse mo ni / brgyad por mtshon ni gdab mi bya

verses.skt: mehino balinaḥ kuryād ādau vamanarecane | snigdhasya sarṣapāriṣṭanikumbhākṣakarañjajaiḥ
verses.tib: za khu can ni stobs ldan la / dang po skyug sman bkru sman ni / snum can nyungs kar a ri ha / ba ru ra dang ka rany+dza'i

verses.skt: tailas trikaṇṭakādyena yathāsvaṃ sādhitena vā | snehena mustadevāhvanāgaraprativāpavat
verses.tib: snum dang gze ma til mar bskol / rang sman ji bzhin bskol ba yi / snum bcas skyug sman bkru sman gtang / gla sgang thang shing dong gra bcug

verses.skt: surasādikaṣāyeṇa dadyād āsthāpanaṃ tataḥ | nyagrodhādes tu pittārtaṃ rasaiḥ śuddhaṃ ca tarpayet
verses.tib: bye'u rug pa sogs khu ba yi / 'jam rtsi de nas gtang bar bya / mkhris pa n+ya gro d+ha sogs pas / sbyangs nas sha khus brta bar bya

verses.skt: mūtragraharujāgulmakṣayādyās tv apatarpaṇāt | tato ’nubandharakṣārthaṃ śamanāni prayojayet
verses.tib: gcin nad dang ni skran dang ni / skem zhing nyams ni smad pa 'byung / de bas rjes 'brel bsrung ba'i phyir / zhi bar bya ba gtang bar bya

verses.skt: asaṃśodhyasya tāny eva sarvameheṣu pāyayet | dhātrīrasaplutāṃ prāhṇe haridrāṃ mākṣikānvitām
verses.tib: sbyang ba ma byas la de nyid / gcin nad can ni kun la blud / skyer pa skyu ru ra bskol khu / sbrang rtsir bcas pa nad par blud

verses.skt: dārvīsurāhvatriphalāmustā vā kvathitā jale | citrakatriphalādārvīkaliṅgān vā samākṣikān
verses.tib: skyer pa thang shing 'bras bu gsum / gla sgang chu bskol blud pa'ang phan / tsi tra skyer pa 'bras bu gsum / dug mo nyung ni sbrang rtsi bcas

verses.skt: madhuyuktaṃ guḍūcyā vā rasam āmalakasya vā | lodhrābhayātoyadakaṭphalānāṃ pāṭhāviḍaṅgārjunadhanvanānām | gāyatridārvīkṛmihṛddhavānāṃ kaphe trayaḥ kṣaudrayutāḥ kaṣāyāḥ
verses.tib: yang na sle tres skyu ru ra / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i khu ba'ang phan / seng phrom gla sgang kad pa la dang a ru ra / pa tha byi tsher byi dang ga dang ardzun / seng ldeng skyer pa byi dang ga dang dar ba bskol / khu ba gsum po sbrang rtsir bcas pas bad kan sel

verses.skt: uśīralodhrārjunacandanānāṃ paṭolanimbāmalakāmṛtānām | lodhrāmbukālīyakadhātakīnāṃ pitte trayaḥ kṣaudrayutāḥ kaṣāyāḥ
verses.tib: mkhris gyur pu shel seng phrom tsan+dan ardzu na / nim pa pa to la dang sle tre+es skyu ru ra / seng phrom ba le ka dang skyer pa da ta ka'i / gsum po de dag bskol ba sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud

verses.skt: yathāsvam ebhiḥ pānānnaṃ yavagodhūmabhāvanāḥ
verses.tib: 'di dag ji bzhin zas skom dang / nas dang gro dang sbyar ba dang

verses.skt: vātolbaṇeṣu snehāṃś ca prameheṣu prakalpayet | apūpasaktuvāṭyādir yavānāṃ vikṛtir hitā
verses.tib: rlung shas che ba'i gcin snyi la / snum dang sbyar te sbyin par bya / lci ba rta rtug las byung ba'am / 'od ma las ni skyes pa dag / khur ba zan dron chag tshe / nas las byas pa'i zan kyang phan / rtsa 'bru mung+ga la sogs dang / 'bras rnying drug cu pa rnying phan

verses.skt: gajāśvagudamuktānām athavā veṇujanmanām | tṛṇadhānyāni mudgādyāḥ śālir jīrṇaḥ saṣaṣṭikaḥ
verses.tib: rlung shas che ba'i gcin snyi la / snum dang sbyar te sbyin par bya / lci ba rta rtug las byung ba'am / 'od ma las ni skyes pa dag / khur ba zan dron chag tshe / nas las byas pa'i zan kyang phan / rtsa 'bru mung+ga la sogs dang / 'bras rnying drug cu pa rnying phan

verses.skt: śrīkukkuṭo ’mlaḥ khalakas tilasarṣapakiṭṭajaḥ | kapitthaṃ tindukaṃ jambūs tatkṛtā rāgaṣāḍavāḥ
verses.tib: nyungs kar til btsir las byung ba'am / sbyar thug / skyur dang bcas pa'am / ka pid ta dang tin tu ka / 'dzam bu de sbyar btung ba dang

verses.skt: tiktaṃ śākaṃ madhu śreṣṭhā bhakṣyāḥ śuṣkāḥ sasaktavaḥ | dhanvamāṃsāni śūlyāni pariśuṣkāṇy ayaskṛtiḥ
verses.tib: tshod ma kha bo sbrang rtsi dang / 'bras bu gsum zan bza' ba skam / skam sa'i sha ni bsregs pa dang / skam pa'am lcags dang g.yos pa dang

verses.skt: madhvariṣṭāsavā jīrṇāḥ sīdhuḥ pakvarasodbhavaḥ | tathāsanādisārāmbu darbhāmbho mākṣikodakam
verses.tib: rgun chang chang rnying mnan chang rnying / rgun chu bskol ba las byung blud / a sa na sogs bskol ba'i chu / 'jag ma bskol chu sbrang rtsi'i chu

verses.skt: vāsiteṣu varākvāthe śarvarīṃ śoṣiteṣv ahaḥ | yaveṣu sukṛtān saktūn sakṣaudrān sīdhunā pibet
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum la mtshan mo sbangs / nyin par skams la de nas ni / legs par btags pa'i phye dag dang / bu ram sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud

verses.skt: śālasaptāhvakampillavṛkṣakākṣakapitthajam | rohītakaṃ ca kusumaṃ madhunādyāt sucūrṇitam
verses.tib: sa la lo ma bdun pa dang / kam bi l+ya dang ba ru ra / bri sha ka dang ka pid ta / ro hi ni yi me tog ni / phyer btags sbrang rtsir bcas sbyin nam

verses.skt: kaphapittaprameheṣu pibed dhātrīrasena vā | trikaṇṭakaniśālodhrasomavalkavacārjunaiḥ
verses.tib: skyu ru ra yi khu ba blud / bad kan mkhris pa'i gcin nad sel / gzem skyer pa seng phrom dang / shu dag kad phal ardzu na

verses.skt: padmakāśmantakāriṣṭacandanāgurudīpyakaiḥ | paṭolamustamañjiṣṭhāmādrībhallātakaiḥ pacet
verses.tib: shug pa lung thang asman ta / tsan+dan dang ni a ka ru / la la phud dang pa to la / ga dur bong nga go bye btsod

verses.skt: tailaṃ vātakaphe pitte ghṛtaṃ miśreṣu miśrakam | daśamūlaśaṭhīdantīsurāhvaṃ dvipunarnavam
verses.tib: bad kan rlung la til mar bcas / mkhris par mar de 'dren mar btsos / rtsa ba bcu pa zi ra dkar / dan ti thang shing ba spru gnyis

verses.skt: mūlaṃ snugarkayoḥ pathyāṃ bhūkadambam aruṣkaram | karañjau varuṇān mūlaṃ pippalyāḥ pauṣkaraṃ ca yat
verses.tib: snu ha arga'i rtsa ba dang / bu ga dam pa a ru ra / go bye ka rany+dza'i rtsa ba / ba ra Na yi rtsa ba dang / pi pi ling rtsa ma nu'i rtsa

verses.skt: pṛthag daśapalaṃ prasthān yavakolakulatthataḥ | trīṃś cāṣṭaguṇite toye vipacet pādavartinā
verses.tib: re re srang ni bcu bcu dang / nas dang rgya shug rgya sran las / bre gsum chu ni brgyad 'gyur dang / bskol la bzhi cha lus pa dang

verses.skt: tena dvipippalīcavyavacānicularohiṣaiḥ | trivṛdviḍaṅgakampillabhārgīviśvaiś ca sādhayet
verses.tib: de dang pi pi ling gnyis dang / dbyi mo lcang ma ro hi sha / dur byid byi dang kam+bi l+ya / ga bra'i rtsa ba bca' sga dang

verses.skt: prasthaṃ ghṛtāj jayet sarvāṃs tan mehān piṭikā viṣam | pāṇḍuvidradhigulmārśaḥśoṣaśophagarodaram
verses.tib: mar bre gang dang bskol ba yis / gcin snyi'i nad ni de nyid dang / 'brum phran dug dang skya rbab dang / khong 'bras skran dang gzhang 'brum dang / 'or nad skem dang dbyig dug dang

verses.skt: śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ vamiṃ vṛddhiṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam | kuṣṭhonmādāv apasmāraṃ dhānvantaram idaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: dmu rdzing lud pa dbugs mi bde / slon dang tshil ches mcher pa'i nad / dreg mdze smyo byed brjed byed 'joms / mar 'di thang la 'bar gyi yin / seng phrom mur ba byi dang ga

verses.skt: lodhramūrvāśaṭhīvellabhārgīnatanakhaplavān | kaliṅgakuṣṭhakramukapriyaṅgvativiṣāgnikān
verses.tib: zur pa rgya spos ga bra'i rtsa / chu srin sen mo / dug mo nyung / gla ba ru rta pri yang ku / gla gor zho sha tsi tra ka

verses.skt: dve viśāle caturjātaṃ bhūnimbaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm | yavānīṃ pauṣkaraṃ pāṭhāṃ granthiṃ cavyaṃ phalatrayam
verses.tib: bong nga bil sha la gnyis dang / dri bzang bzhi dang rtsa mkhris dang / pu tse shel dang la la phud / pa ta puSh+kar mU la dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / dbyi mo dang ni 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: karṣāṃśam ambukalaśe pādaśeṣe srute hime | dvau prasthau mākṣikāt kṣiptvā rakṣet pakṣam upekṣayā
verses.tib: zho ni gnyis gnyis chu bre ni / bcu drug la bskol bzhi cha lus / btsags te bsgrangs pa'i nang du ni / sbrang rtsi bre do bcug nas ni / zla phyed legs par gzhag pa yi / seng phrom mnan chang gcin snyi dang

verses.skt: lodhrāsavo ’yaṃ mehārśaḥśvitrakuṣṭhārucikṛmīn | pāṇḍutvaṃ grahaṇīdoṣaṃ sthūlatāṃ ca niyacchati
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum mdze dang yi ga 'chus / srin bu skya rbab pho ba'i nad / tshil byed pa yi nad sel byed

verses.skt: sādhayed asanādīnāṃ palānāṃ viṃśatiṃ pṛthak | dvivahe ’pāṃ kṣipet tatra pādasthe dve śate guḍāt
verses.tib: a sa na la sogs pa'i sde / sna re srang ni nyi shu dag / chu bre nyis brgya lnga bcu drug / bskol la bzhi cha lus pa dang / bu ram srang ni nyis brgya dang

verses.skt: kṣaudrāḍhakārdhaṃ palikaṃ vatsakādiṃ ca kalkitam | tat kṣaudrapippalīcūrṇapradigdhe ghṛtabhājane
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi bre do gzhug pa dang / dug mo nyung sogs lde gu ni / srang re'i tshad ni bcug pa ste / sbrang rtsi pi pi ling gi phya / mar gyis bskus pa'i snod dag ni

verses.skt: sthitaṃ dṛḍhe jatusṛte yavarāśau nidhāpayet | khadirāṅgārataptāni bahuśo ’tra nimajjayet
verses.tib: rgya skyegs bskus par bcug nas ni / nas kyi nang du bcug nas su / lcags ni rno la srab pa dag / seng ldeng gi ni me mdag bsregs

verses.skt: tanūni tīkṣṇalohasya pattrāṇy ālohasaṃkṣayāt | ayaskṛtiḥ sthitā pītā pūrvasmād adhikā guṇaiḥ
verses.tib: ji srid lcags ni zad pa'i bar / mang du der ni gzhag par bya / lcags las byas pa'i chang mnan blud / sngon pas yon tan lhag pa yin

verses.skt: rūkṣam udvartanaṃ gāḍhaṃ vyāyāmo niśi jāgaraḥ | yac cānyac chleṣmamedoghnaṃ bahir antaś ca tad dhitam
verses.tib: rtsub pa dril phyis dam du bsdams / drag shul mtshan mo gnyid mi log / tshil dang bad kan 'joms byed gang / de ni phyi nang las btang phan

verses.skt: subhāvitāṃ sārajalais tulāṃ pītvā śilodbhavāt | sārāmbunaiva bhuñjānaḥ śālīñ jāṅgalajai rasaiḥ
verses.tib: brag zhun srang brgya snying po'i chu / sbangs pa'i snying po chu dang ni / legs par blud cing sA lu dang / skam sa'i sha khu bcas pa bza'

verses.skt: sarvān abhibhaven mehān subahūpadravān api | gaṇḍamālārbudagranthisthaulyakuṣṭhabhagandarān
verses.tib: bla brnan shin tu mang ba yi / gcin snyi'i nad ni kun kyang 'joms / 'bras phreng thor bu rmen bu dang / tshil ches mdze dang mtshan bar rdol

verses.skt: kṛmiślīpadaśophāṃś ca paraṃ caitad rasāyanam | adhanaś chattrapādatrarahito munivartanaḥ
verses.tib: srin nad rkang bam 'or nad sel / 'di ni bcud kyis len mchog yin / lam du dugs dang lham dag ni / med par drang srong tshul du ni

verses.skt: candanam utpalaṃ drākṣā uśīraṃ ca punarnavā | yaṣṭīmadhukaśrīkhaṇḍaṃ triphalotpalaśārivā
śamī vaṃśaphalaṃ lodhraṃ trijātaṃ nāgakesaram | padmakaṃ ca kaṇācūrṇaṃ tattulyā śarkarā śubhā
etac cūrṇaṃ pibet prātas taṇḍulodakavāriṇā | pramehe raktapitte ca kṛcchradoṣe ca dāruṇe
yojanānāṃ śataṃ yāyāt khaned vā salilāśayān | gośakṛnmūtravṛttir vā gobhir eva saha bhramet
verses.tib: dpag tshad brgya yi bar du 'gro / chu yi gnas ni brko ba'am / ba gcin lci ba bsten pa'am / ba lang dang ni lhan cig 'khyams

verses.skt: bṛṃhayed auṣadhāhārair amedomūtralaiḥ kṛśam | śarāvikādyāḥ piṭikāḥ śophavat samupācaret
verses.tib: skem pa'i gcin nad can dag / gi / zas dang sman tshil mi bskyed pas / kham phor la sogs 'bras nad ni / ma smin skrang pa'i nad ltar gso

verses.skt: apakvā vraṇavat pakvās tāsāṃ prāgrūpam eva ca | kṣīrivṛkṣāmbu pānāya bastamūtraṃ ca śasyate
verses.tib: sman pa la ni rma ltar gso / de yi sngon byung tshul nyid la / 'o ma can shing bskol chu dang / ra thug gcin ni blud pa bsngags / gcin snyi'i nad can lto sra bas

verses.skt: tīkṣṇaṃ ca śodhanaṃ prāyo durvirecyā hi mehinaḥ | tailam elādinā kuryād gaṇena vraṇaropaṇam
verses.tib: phal cher bkru sman rnon po gtang / sug smel sogs kyi til mar sbyar / rma 'tshob pa yi cho ga bya

verses.skt: udvartane kaṣāyaṃ tu vargeṇāragvadhādinā | pariṣeko ’sanādyena pānānne vatsakādinā
verses.tib: dong gra la sogs sde tshan ni / btags pa'i lde gus dril bar bya / a sa na sogs bskol chu blud / dug mo nyung sogs zas skom sbyar

verses.skt: pāṭhācitrakaśārṅgaṣṭāśārivākaṇṭakārikāḥ | saptāhvaṃ kauṭajaṃ mūlaṃ somavalkaṃ nṛpadrumam
verses.tib: pa ta thal tres tsi tra ka / sha rang ga pA kan ta ri / sap+ta par+Ni dug mo nyung / kad pha la dang dong ga'i phye

verses.skt: saṃcūrṇya madhunā lihyāt tadvac cūrṇaṃ navāyasam | madhumehitvam āpanno bhiṣagbhiḥ parivarjitaḥ
śilājatutulām adyāt pramehārtaḥ punarnavaḥ
verses.tib: sbrang rtsis lde gu byas pa'am / lcags dgu pa yang de bzhin sbyin

verses.skt: vidradhiṃ sarvam evāmaṃ śophavat samupācaret | pratataṃ ca hared raktaṃ pakve tu vraṇavat kriyā
verses.tib: khong 'bras ma smin thams cad la / 'or nang lta bur gso ba dang / rgyun tu khrag ni byung bar bya / smin pa la ni rma ltar gso

verses.skt: pañcamūlajalair dhautaṃ vātikaṃ lavaṇottaraiḥ | bhadrādivargayaṣṭyāhvatilair ālepayed vraṇam
verses.tib: rlung shas che la rtsa ba lnga / bskol bas rma ni bkru ba dang / thang shing sogs sde shing mngar dang / til sbyar rgyam tshas rma bsku bya

verses.skt: vairecanikayuktena traivṛtena viśodhya ca | vidārīvargasiddhena traivṛtenaiva ropayet
verses.tib: bkru sman dang ni ldan pa yi / dur byid kyis ni rnam sbyangs shing / bi da ri yi sde bskol ba'i / dur byid kyis ni rma 'byor bya

verses.skt: kṣālitaṃ kṣīritoyena limped yaṣṭyamṛtātilaiḥ | paittaṃ ghṛtena siddhena mañjiṣṭhośīrapadmakaiḥ
verses.tib: mkhris gyur 'o ma can chus bkru / sle tres shing mngar til gyis bsku / btsod dang rgya shug pu shel tse / pa ya s+ya dang ser po gnyis

verses.skt: payasyādviniśāśreṣṭhāyaṣṭīdugdhaiś ca ropayet | nyagrodhādipravālatvakphalair vā kaphajaṃ punaḥ
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang shing mngar dang / 'o mar bcas pas rma 'byor bya / yang na n+ya gro d+ha sogs pa'i / myu gu shun pa 'bras bu bsku / bad kan las gyur dong ga'i chus

verses.skt: āragvadhādinā dhautaṃ saktukumbhaniśātilaiḥ | limpet kulatthikādantī trivṛcchyāmāgnitilvakaiḥ
verses.tib: bkru zhing phye dang ser po gnyis / dur byid dang ni til gyis bsku / yang na rgya sran dan ti yi / sham dur byid tsi tra ka

verses.skt: sasaindhavaiḥ sagomūtrais tailaṃ kurvīta ropaṇam | raktāgantūdbhave kāryā pittavidradhivat kriyā
verses.tib: seng phrom rgyam tshab gcin bcas / til mar gyis ni rma 'tshob bya / khrag dang glo bur las gyur pa / mkhris pa'i khong 'bras lta bur gso

verses.skt: varuṇādigaṇakvātham apakve ’bhyantarotthite | ūṣakādipratīvāpaṃ pūrvāhṇe vidradhau pibet
verses.tib: ma smin nad du byung ba la / ba ra Na sogs sde bskol bar / u sha ka yi sde tshan btab / snga dro khong 'bras can / la blud

verses.skt: ghṛtaṃ virecanadravyaiḥ siddhaṃ tābhyāṃ ca pāyayet | nirūhaṃ snehavastiṃ ca tābhyām eva prakalpayet
verses.tib: bkru sman bcas par bskol ba'i mar / de gnyis dang ni ldan par blud / ni ru ha dang snum 'jam rtsi / de dag gnyis la sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: pānabhojanalepeṣu madhuśigruḥ prayojitaḥ | dattāvāpo yathādoṣam apakvaṃ hanti vidradhim
verses.tib: bza' dang btung dang bsku ba la / sbrang rtsi na le sham dkar sbyar / nad dmigs ji bzhin blud na ni / khong 'bras ma smin 'joms par byed

verses.skt: trāyantītriphalānimbakaṭukāmadhukaṃ samam | trivṛtpaṭolamūlābhyāṃ catvāro ’ṃśāḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.tib: kyi lce nim pa 'bras bu gsum / shing mngar pu tse shel cha mnyam / dur byid pa to la'i rtsa ba / re re cha ni bzhi par bya

verses.skt: masūrān nistuṣād aṣṭau tatkvāthaḥ saghṛto jayet | vidradhigulmavīsarpadāhamohamadajvarān
verses.tib: sran chung spun pa med srang brgyad / de bskol mar dang bcas pa blud / khong 'bras skran dang me dpal dang / lus tsha rmongs bag myos rims 'debs

verses.skt: tṛṇmūrchāchardihṛdrogapittāsṛkkuṣṭhakāmalāḥ | kuḍavaṃ trāyamāṇāyāḥ sādhyam aṣṭaguṇe ’mbhasi
verses.tib: skom dang brgyal slon snying nad dang / khrag mkhris mig ser mdze nad 'joms / kyi lce ba ni phul gang dag / brgyad 'gyur chu ru bskol nas ni

verses.skt: kuḍavaṃ tadrasād dhātrīsvarasāt kṣīrato ghṛtāt | karṣāṃśaṃ kalkitaṃ tiktātrāyantīdhanvayāsakam
verses.tib: de yi khu ba phul gang dang / skyu ru ra yi khu ba dang / 'o ma mar ni phul re dang / tig ta byi tsher kra yin ti / gla sgang ram nye ta ma la

verses.skt: mustātāmalakīvīrājīvantīcandanotpalam | paced ekatra saṃyojya tad ghṛtaṃ pūrvavad guṇaiḥ
verses.tib: tsan+dan ut+pal dzi ban ti / gcig tu bsdus te bskol ba yi / mar de yon tan snga mar mtshungs

verses.skt: drākṣā madhūkaṃ kharjūraṃ vidārī saśatāvarī | parūṣakāṇi triphalā tatkvāthe pācayed ghṛtam
verses.tib: rgun 'bru 'bra go ma du ka / bi da ri dang nye shing bcas / pa ru sha ka 'bras bu gsum / de btsos khu ba mar bskol la

verses.skt: kṣīrekṣudhātrīniryāsaprāṇadākalkasaṃyutam | tac chītaṃ śarkarākṣaudrapādikaṃ pūrvavad guṇaiḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma bu ram shing ku dang / skyu ru ra yi khu ba dang / a ru ra yi lde gur bcas / bskol te bsgrangs pa de nang du / kha ra sbrang rtsi bzhi char btab / yon tan snga ma 'drar shes bya

verses.skt: harec chṛṅgādibhir asṛk sirayā vā yathāntikam | vidradhiṃ pacyamānaṃ ca koṣṭhasthaṃ bahirunnatam
verses.tib: nad dmigs ji bzhin rngabs rwa sogs / yang na gtar gas khrag dbyung bya / khong 'bras smin par gyur pa la / khong par gnas pa phyir 'bur bar

verses.skt: jñātvopanāhayet śūle sthite tatraiva piṇḍite | tatpārśvapīḍanāt suptau dāhādiṣv alpakeṣu ca
verses.tib: shes nas de ni bcing bar bya / gzer ba der gnas gong bur 'dug / de ngos btsir bas tshor ba chung / tsha ba la sogs chung gyur na

verses.skt: pakvaḥ syād vidradhiṃ bhittvā vraṇavat tam upācaret | antarbhāgasya cāpy etac cihnaṃ pakvasya vidradeḥ
verses.tib: smin pa yin pas khong 'bras ni / brtol te rma ltar gso bar bya / nang gi char gnas khong 'bras ni / smin pa'i mtshan ma'ang 'di nyid yin / smin nas bu ga rnags gyur te / de ni steng ma 'og tu dbyung / rang nyid rdol ba'i nad de ni / zas phan byin zhing btang snyoms gzhag

verses.skt: pakvaḥ srotāṃsi saṃpūrya sa yāty ūrdhvam adho ’thavā | svayampravṛttaṃ taṃ doṣam upekṣeta hitāśinaḥ
verses.tib: smin pa yin pas khong 'bras ni / brtol te rma ltar gso bar bya / nang gi char gnas khong 'bras ni / smin pa'i mtshan ma'ang 'di nyid yin / smin nas bu ga rnags gyur te / de ni steng ma 'og tu dbyung / rang nyid rdol ba'i nad de ni / zas phan byin zhing btang snyoms gzhag

verses.skt: daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā rakṣan bhiṣag upadravāt | asamyag vahati klede varuṇādiṃ sukhāmbhasā
verses.tib: zhag bcu'am bcu / gnyis bar du ni / sman pas bla brnan las bsrung bya / rnag ni legs par mi 'dzag na / ba ra Na sogs chu dron nam

verses.skt: pāyayen madhuśigruṃ vā yavāgūṃ tena vā kṛtām | yavakolakulatthotthayūṣair annaṃ ca śasyate
verses.tib: shi kru sbrang rtsi blud pa'am / de dang sbyar ba'i nas thug blud / rgya shug rgya sran nas kyi ni / yu sha dang ni bza' ba bsngags

verses.skt: ūrdhvaṃ daśāhāt trāyantīsarpiṣā tailvakena vā | śodhayed balataḥ śuddhaḥ sakṣaudraṃ tiktakaṃ pibet
verses.tib: zhag bcu yan chad kyi lce ba / mar ram seng phrom dag gis ni / nyams stobs ji bzhin sbyang bar bya / sbyangs nas tag ta sbrang rtsi blud

verses.skt: sarvaśo gulmavac cainaṃ yathādoṣam upācaret | sarvāvasthāsu sarvāsu gugguluṃ vidradhīṣu ca
verses.tib: 'di la kun kyang skran lta bur / nad thabs ji bzhin gso bar bya / khong 'bras kun dang gnas skabs dang / thams cad du ni gu gul gtang

verses.skt: kaṣāyair yaugikair yuñjyāt svaiḥ svais tadvac chilājatu | pākaṃ ca vārayed yatnāt siddhiḥ pakve hi daivikī
verses.tib: de bzhin brag zhun rang rang gi / sbyor bar bcas te khu ba blud / 'bad de smin pa las bsrung bya / smin na shin tu gso dka' yin

verses.skt: api cāśu vidāhitvād vidradhiḥ so ’bhidhīyate | sati cālocayen mehe pramehāṇāṃ cikitsitam
verses.tib: gzhan yang myur du tsha byed pas / khong 'bras zhes ni de la bshad / gal te gcin snyi las gyur na

verses.skt: śaubhāñjanakaniryūho hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyutaḥ | acirād vidradhiṃ hanti prātaḥ prātar niṣevitaḥ
kaṭutrikaṃ tiktakarohiṇī ghanaṃ kirātatikto ’tha śatakrator yavāḥ | sasaptaparṇātiviṣā durālabhā paṭolamūlaṃ saha trāyamāṇayā
guḍūcīcavyaṃ saviḍaṅganimbaṃ priyaṅgunīlotpalalodhram añjanam | sadhātakīmocarasaṃ phalatrikaṃ sanāgaraṃ bilvakapitthaśārivāḥ

samāḥ syur ete dviguṇaṃ tu citrakaṃ dvir aṣṭabhāgaṃ kuṭajatvacaṃ syāt | susūkṣmapiṣṭaṃ śiśirāmbuyojitaṃ piben manuṣyo ’rdhapalaṃ guḍānvitam || 27+4 || bubhukṣite syān mṛdu bhojanaṃ hitaṃ śaśaiḥ salāvair athavā ’pi tittiraiḥ | nihanti gulmān kaphapittasaṃbhavān virājate śāradapūrṇacandravat

ajīrṇakāsaṃ kṣayapāṇḍute tathā jvarātisāragrahaṇīgadāpacīḥ | pramehamūtrakṣayavardhmavidradhīñ jayet prayuktaḥ saguḍaḥ kaṭutrikaḥ || 27+6 || bhūnimbārdhapalaṃ niśāpalayuktaṃ dārvīpale dve tathā | dārvyardhena punarnavāṃ kuru tathā dārvyā samaḥ pragrahaḥ | sārdhaṃ duḥsparśataḥ palaṃ tu kaṭukā yojyā tadardhena vā | aśvāhvaṃ niśayā samānam amṛtāpādādhikaṃ syāt palam
verses.tib: gcin snyi ba yi gso ba bya / nu mar byung la 'di ltar ni

verses.skt: etad vatsakasaptakarṣasahitaṃ suślakṣṇacūrṇīkṛtaṃ | vāsāyāḥ svarasena pañca caturas trīn vā pibed vāsarān | bhūyas tad guḍavāriṇā pratidinaṃ peyaṃ puraḥsthe ravau | etad vidradhirogiṇāṃ nirujakṛc cūrṇaṃ tu guhyottamam
nāputrāya na cābhrātre nāśiṣyāyāhitaiṣiṇe | ārogyaśāstrasarvasvaṃ deyam etat kathañcana
stanaje vraṇavat sarvaṃ na tv enam upanāhayet | pāṭayet pālayan stanyavāhinīḥ kṛṣṇacūcukau
verses.tib: mi bcing thams cad rma ltar gso / dbral tshe nu zho 'dzag pa dang / nu sor nag por mi gnod bsrung

verses.skt: sarvāsv āmādyavasthāsu nirduhīta ca tat stanam | śodhayet trivṛtā snigdhaṃ vṛddhau snehaiś calātmake
verses.tib: ma smin gnas skabs thams cad du / de yi nu zho btsir zhing bzho / rgyu rlugs rlung shas che ba la / dur byid snum can gyis sbyangs shing

verses.skt: kauśāmratilvakairaṇḍasukumārakamiśrakaiḥ | tato ’nilaghnaniryūhakalkasnehair nirūhayet
verses.tib: a mra'i 'bras bu seng phrom mar / e raN+Da dang skyid de ba'i / mar dang sman mar 'dren mar sbyin / de nas rlung 'joms sman khu snum / lde gu mas gtong drag po bya

verses.skt: rasena bhojitaṃ yaṣṭītailenānvāsayed anu | svedapralepā vātaghnāḥ pakve bhittvā vraṇakriyām
verses.tib: sha khu bcas pa'i zas sbyin zhing / shing mngar snum bskol 'jam rtsi gtang / rlung 'joms dugs dang bsku mnye bya / smin nas dral la rma ltar gso

verses.skt: pittaraktodbhave vṛddhāv āmapakve yathāyatham | śophavraṇakriyāṃ kuryāt pratataṃ ca hared asṛk
verses.tib: rgyu rlugs khrag mkhris las gyur pa / smin dang ma smin ji bzhin du / rma dang skrangs pa'i gso ba bya / rgyun tu khrag kyang dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: gomūtreṇa pibet kalkaṃ ślaiṣmike pītadārujam | vimlāpanād ṛte cāsya śleṣmagranthikramo hitaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur skyer pa yi / phye ma gcin sbyar ba blud / 'di la mnyed bya ma gtogs par / bad kan rmen bu'i gso ba bya

verses.skt: pakve ca pāṭite tailam iṣyate vraṇaśodhanam | sumano'ruṣkarāṅkollasaptaparṇeṣu sādhitam
verses.tib: smin nas dbral te dzA ti yi / me tog go bye ang ko la / lo ma bdun pa pa to la / nim pa yung ba byi dang ga / dug mo nyung dang til mar bskol / rma sbyang phyir ni blud pa bsngags

verses.skt: paṭolanimbarajanīviḍaṅgakuṭajeṣu ca | medojaṃ mūtrapiṣṭena susvinnaṃ surasādinā
verses.tib: tshil las gyur la bye'u rug sogs / ba gcin sbyar te btags pa'am

verses.skt: śirovirekadravyair vā varjayan phalasevanīm | dārayed vṛddhipattreṇa samyaṅ medasi sūddhṛte
verses.tib: mgo bo'i bkru sman dag gis bya / rlig pa'i srubs mtshams ma gtogs par / 'phel gtsags kyis ni dbral nas ni / tshil ni legs par dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: vraṇaṃ mākṣikakāsīsasaindhavapratisāritam | sīvyed abhyañjanaṃ cāsya yojyaṃ medoviśuddhaye
verses.tib: rma ni sbrang rtsi nag tshur dang / rgyam tsha nges par bskus nas btsems / de la tshil ni sbyang ba'i phyir / sdong ros sug smel su ma na

verses.skt: manaḥśilailāsumanogranthibhallātakaiḥ kṛtam | tailam āvraṇasaṃdhānāt snehasvedau ca śīlayet
verses.tib: go bye pi pi ling mU la / til mar ngag ni bsku bar bya / rma ni 'byor bar gyur gyi bar / snum dang dugs kyang bsten par bya

verses.skt: mūtrajaṃ sveditaṃ snigdhair vastrapaṭṭena veṣṭitam | vidhyed adhastāt sevanyāḥ srāvayec ca yathodaram
verses.tib: gcin byung snum gyis dugs bya zhing / ras ma phra mos dkri bar bya / srubs mtshams 'og tu dmu rdzing bzhin / legs par dbral te gzag par bya

verses.skt: vraṇaṃ ca sthagikābaddhaṃ ropayed antrahetuke | phalakośam asaṃprāpte cikitsā vātavṛddhivat
verses.tib: rma bkab bcing dang 'byor par bya / rgyu ma byung bar gyur pa dag / rlig par phyin par ma gyur la / rlung gi rgyu rlugs bzhin du gso

verses.skt: pacet punarnavatulāṃ tathā daśapalāḥ pṛthak | daśamūlapayasyāśvagandhairaṇḍaśatāvarīḥ
verses.tib: ba sbu ba ni srang brgya dang / rtsa ba bcu pa eraN+Da / a shwa gan+d+h+ya nye shing dang / pa ya s+ya dang dUr ba gnyis

verses.skt: dvidarbhaśarakāśekṣumūlapoṭagalānvitāḥ | vahe ’pām aṣṭabhāgasthe tatra triṃśatpalaṃ guḍāt
verses.tib: 'dam bu ku sha bu ram gnyis / a ha ga lar bcas pa ni / re re srang ni bcu bcur byas / chu bre brgya rtsa nyi shu brgyad / bskol ba brgyad cha lus pa ru

verses.skt: prastham eraṇḍatailasya dvau ghṛtāt payasas tathā | āvaped dvipalāṃśaṃ ca kṛṣṇātanmūlasaindhavam
verses.tib: der ni bu ram srang sum cu / e raN+Da yi mar bre do / 'o ma mar ni bre do do / pi pi ling dang de rtsa ba

verses.skt: yaṣṭīmadhukamṛdvīkāyavānīnāgarāṇi ca | tatsiddhaṃ sukumārākhyaṃ sukumāraṃ rasāyanam
verses.tib: shing mngar rgun 'bru lce myang tsha / la la phud dang dong gra gzhug / de btsos skyid de ba zhes bya / gzhon sha can gyi bcud len yin

verses.skt: vātātapādhvayānādiparihāryeṣv ayantraṇam | prayojyaṃ sukumārāṇām īśvarāṇām sukhātmanām
verses.tib: rlung dang than pa lam du 'gro / bzhon bsrung ba bsdams mi dgos / skyid de ba dang phyug po dang / bde ba bsten dang bud med dang

verses.skt: nṛṇāṃ strīvṛndabhartÃṇām alakṣmīkalināśanam | sarvakālopayogena kāntilāvaṇyapuṣṭidam
verses.tib: bud med rgan mo'i khyo dang ni / dpal skyed rtsod pa zlog byed cing / dus kun du ni brten gyur na / mdog mdangs sha ni rgyas byed cing

verses.skt: vardhmavidradhigulmārśoyonimeḍhrānilārtiṣu | śophodarakhuḍaplīhaviḍvibandheṣu cottamam
verses.tib: rgyu rlugs khong 'bras skran gzhang 'brum / pho mtshan mo mtshan rlung gis nyen / 'or nad dmu rdzing mchin pa dang / rtug skam nad ni sel byed mchog / snum gyi bkru sman 'jam rtsi yis

verses.skt: rāsnāyaṣṭyamṛtairaṇḍabalāgokṣurasādhitaḥ | kvātho ’ntravṛddhiṃ hanty āśu rubutailena miśritaḥ
verses.tib: rgyu rlugs khong 'bras skran gzhang 'brum / pho mtshan mo mtshan rlung gis nyen / 'or nad dmu rdzing mchin pa dang / rtug skam nad ni sel byed mchog / snum gyi bkru sman 'jam rtsi yis

verses.skt: yāyād vardhma na cec chāntiṃ sneharekānuvāsanaiḥ | vastikarma puraḥ kṛtvā vaṅkṣaṇasthaṃ tato dahet
verses.tib: gal te rgyu rlugs ma zhi na / dang po 'jam rtsi btang nas ni / de nas chu sor gnas pa ni

verses.skt: agninā mārgarodhārthaṃ maruto ’rdhenduvakrayā | aṅguṣṭhasyopari snāva pītaṃ tantusamaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: zla ba kham pa'i kha 'dra bas / rlung lam dgag phyir / bsreg par bya / mthe bong steng gi rgyus pa ni / ser zhing snal ma 'dra ba gang

verses.skt: utkṣipya sūcyā tat tiryag dahec chittvā yato gadaḥ | tato ’nyapārśve ’nye tv āhur dahed vānāmikāṅguleḥ
verses.tib: khab kyis bteg ste thad ka ru / gang na nad yod bcad de bsreg / gzhan dag de las logs gzhan nam / srin lag sor mo bsreg ces zer

verses.skt: gulme ’nyair vātakaphaje plīhni cāyaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | kaniṣṭhikānāmikayor viśvācyāṃ ca yato gadaḥ
verses.tib: kha cig 'di ni bad kan rlung / las gyur skran mcher la bya zer / bi sha tse nad gang na yod / mthe'u chung srin lag dag la bya

verses.skt: mūlaṃ bilvakapitthayoḥ aralukasyāgner bṛhatyor dvayoḥ | śyāmāpūtikarañjaśigrukataror viśvauṣadhāruṣkaram | kṛṣṇāgranthikavellapañcalavaṇakṣārājamodānvitaṃ | pītaṃ kāñjikatoya...mathitaiś cūrṇīkṛtaṃ vardhmajit
ajājīkuṣṭhagomedahapuṣābadarāṇi ca | āranālena lepaḥ syād vardhmajit param auṣadham
avikṣīreṇa godhūmacūrṇaṃ kandurukasya ca | pralepanaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ syād vardhmajit param auṣadham
mṛtamātre tu vai kāke viśastena pralepayet | muhūrtaṃ vardhma medhāvī tatkṣaṇād arujo bhavet
gulmaṃ baddhaśakṛdvātaṃ vātikaṃ tīvravedanam | rūkṣaśītodbhavaṃ tailaiḥ sādhayed vātarogikaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung gyur skran ni mi bzad na / phyis 'phyen ni 'gags gyur na / rtsub dang grang byung rlung nad la / phan pa'i til mar dag gis gso

verses.skt: pānānnānvāsanābhyaṅgaiḥ snigdhasya svedam ācaret | ānāhavedanāstambhavibandheṣu viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: zas skom 'jam rtsi sbyar ba dang / bsku byug snum 'tshos dugs dpyad bya / sbo dang zug dang rengs pa dang / 'gags pa la ni mchog tu bya

verses.skt: srotasāṃ mārdavaṃ kṛtvā jitvā mārutam ulbaṇam | bhittvā vibandhaṃ snigdhasya svedo gulmam apohati
verses.tib: snum 'chos dugs ni byas pa yis / bu ga'i rgyun srang mnyen byed la / rlung shas che ba gzhom bya zhing / phyis sri ba sel skran 'joms

verses.skt: snehapānaṃ hitaṃ gulme viśeṣeṇordhvanābhije | pakvāśayagate vastir ubhayaṃ jaṭharāśraye
verses.tib: lte ba yan chad skyes pa yi / skran la mchog tu snum blud phan / zhu ba'i gnas brtan 'jam rtsi bya / lto bar gnas la gnyi ga bya

verses.skt: dīpte ’gnau vātike gulme vibandhe ’nilavarcasoḥ | bṛṃhaṇāny annapānāni snigdhoṣṇāni pradāpayet
verses.tib: rlung can skran ni drod che la / phyis rlung ni 'gags gyur la / bza' btung nyams brtas byed pa dang / snum dang dro ba sbyin par bya

verses.skt: punaḥ punaḥ snehapānaṃ nirūhāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ | prayojyā vātaje gulme kaphapittānurakṣiṇaḥ
verses.tib: rlung gyur skran la bad kan dang / mkhris pa srung zhing ni ru ha / 'jam rtsi bcas pa'i sbyor ba ni / yang dang yang du bya ba yin

verses.skt: vastikarma paraṃ vidyād gulmaghnaṃ tad dhi mārutam | svasthāne prathamaṃ jitvā sadyo gulmam apohati
verses.tib: 'jam rtsi mchog tu skran 'joms par / shes bya de ni rlung gi nad / dang por rang gi gnas su bcom / 'phral du skran ni sel bar byed

verses.skt: tasmād abhīkṣṇaśo gulmā nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ | prayujyamānaiḥ śāmyanti vātapittakaphātmakāḥ
verses.tib: de bas skran la rgyun du ni / mas gtong drag po 'jam rtsi bcas / btang bar gyur pas rlung bad kan / mkhris pa'i bdag nyid can rnams sel

verses.skt: hiṅgusauvarcalavyoṣaviḍadāḍimadīpyakaiḥ | puṣkarājājīdhānyāmlavetasakṣāracitrakaiḥ
verses.tib: rtsabs ru tsha dang kha ru tsha / se 'bru ma nu go snyod dang / zi ra 'u su la la phud / star bu ya bak+Sha ra dang

verses.skt: śaṭhīvacājagandhailāsurasair dadhisaṃyutaiḥ | śūlānāhaharaṃ sarpiḥ sādhayed vātagulminām
verses.tib: zur pa shu dag tsi tra ka / a za gan+d+ha sug smel dang / bye rug pa ni zho dang bcas / mar bskol rlung gi skran sel zhing

verses.skt: hapuṣoṣaṇapṛthvīkāpañcakolakadīpyakaiḥ | sājājīsaindhavair dadhnā dugdhena ca rasena ca
verses.tib: gzer dang / lto sbos 'joms par byed / spa ma'i 'bras bu tsha ba gsum / zi ra go snyod tsha ba lnga / a za mo dang lce myang tsha / zho dang 'o ma mar dang ni

verses.skt: dāḍimān mūlakāt kolāt pacet sarpir nihanti tat | vātagulmodarānāhapārśvahṛtkoṣṭhavedanāḥ
verses.tib: se 'brul phug / rgya shug gi / khu ba bskol bas rlung gi ni / skran dang dmu rdzing lto sbos dang / rtsib logs snying dang lto ba gzer

verses.skt: yonyarśograhaṇīdoṣakāsaśvāsārucijvarān | daśamūlaṃ balāṃ kālāṃ suṣavīṃ dvau punarnavau
verses.tib: mngal nad gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba dang / rims nad yi ga 'chus pa 'joms / rtsa ba bcu pa su sha bi / pa la sha ka ma nu dang / ba sbu ba gnyis e raN+Da

verses.skt: pauṣkarairaṇḍarāsnāśvagandhābhārgyamṛtāśaṭhīḥ | paced gandhapalāśaṃ ca droṇe ’pāṃ dvipalonmitam
verses.tib: ra sna a shwa gan+d+ha dang / ga bra'i rtsa ba zur pa dkar / sle tres gan+d+ha pa lag srang ni gnyis gnyis tshad byas dang / nyi shu rtsa brgyad nang du bskol

verses.skt: yavaiḥ kolaiḥ kulatthaiś ca māṣaiś ca prāsthikaiḥ saha | kvāthe ’smin dadhipātre ca ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet
verses.tib: nas dang rgya shug rgya sran dang / ma sha bre re lhan cig tu / chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol / khu ba der zho bre bzhi dang / mar bre gang dang slar bskol la

verses.skt: svarasair dāḍimāmrātamātuluṅgodbhavair yutam | tathā tuṣāmbudhānyāmlaśuktaiḥ ślakṣṇaiś ca kalkitaiḥ
verses.tib: se 'bru amra ta ka dang / kha lung khu ba bre rer bcas / de bzhin rtsab mo skyur rtsabs tsha / g.yer ma shu dag ga bra'i rtsa

verses.skt: bhārgītumburuṣaḍgranthāgranthirāsnāgnidhānyakaiḥ | yavānakayavānyamlavetasāsitajīrakaiḥ
verses.tib: ra sna pi pi ling rtsa ba / tsi traka dang 'u su dang / ya ba na ga la la phud / star bu zi ra nag po dang / go snyod zi ra spa ma'i 'bras

verses.skt: ajājīhiṅguhapuṣākāravīvṛṣakoṣakaiḥ | nikumbhakumbhamūrvebhapippalīvelladāḍimaiḥ
verses.tib: ka ra pi ba zangs rtsi ba / u sha ka dang dur byid dang / dan da mur ba byi dang ga / se 'bru hasti pi pi ling

verses.skt: śvadaṃṣṭrātrapusairvārubījahiṃsrāśmabhedakaiḥ | miśidvikṣārasurasaśārivānīlinīphalaiḥ
verses.tib: gze ma spang spos sru sru'i rtsa / ga gon rgyal mo ga gon gyi / sa bon shu ti thal sman gnyis / bye'u rug pa thal tres dang / ni li na la'i 'bras bu dang

verses.skt: trikaṭutripaṭūpetair dādhikaṃ tad vyapohati | rogān āśutarān pūrvān kaṣṭān api ca śīlitam
verses.tib: lan tshwa gsum dang tsha ba gsum / bcas pa'i zho yi sman mar des / sngar bshad nang ni gso dka' dang

verses.skt: apasmāragadonmādamūtrāghātānilāmayān | tryūṣaṇatriphalādhānyacavikāvellacitrakaiḥ
verses.tib: brjed byed smyo byed gcin sri dang / rlung nad gzhang 'brum myur du 'joms / tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum / 'u su dbyi mong byi dang ga / tsi tra ka ni lde gur byas

verses.skt: kalkīkṛtair ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ sakṣīraṃ vātagulmanut | tulāṃ laśunakandānāṃ pṛthak pañcapalāṃśakam
verses.tib: 'o ma mar bskol rlung skran 'joms / sgog skya'i rtsa ba srang brgya dang

verses.skt: pañcamūlaṃ mahac cāmbubhārārdhe tad vipācayet | pādaśeṣaṃ tadardhena dāḍimasvarasaṃ surām
verses.tib: rtsa ba chen po srang lnga lnga / chu srang stong dang de bskol la / bzhi cha lus par phyed se 'bru'i

verses.skt: dhānyāmlaṃ dadhi cādāya piṣṭāṃś cārdhapalāṃśakān | tryūṣaṇatriphalāhiṅguyavānīcavyadīpyakān
verses.tib: khu ba chang dang 'bras khu skyur / zho rnams de yi phyed phyed dang / tshab gsum dang 'bras bu gsum / shing kun dbyi mo la la phud

verses.skt: sāmlavetasasindhūtthadevadārūn paced ghṛtāt | taiḥ prasthaṃ tat paraṃ sarvavātagulmavikārajit
verses.tib: dbyi mong star bu lce myang tsha / thang shing srang ni phyed phyed dang / mar ni bre gang bcas par bskol / rlung las gyur pa'i skran kun 'joms

verses.skt: ṣaṭpalaṃ vā pibet sarpir yad uktaṃ rājayakṣmaṇi | prasannayā vā kṣīrārthaḥ surayā dāḍimena vā
verses.tib: gcong chen skabs su bshad pa yi / srang drug pa yi mar yang blud / 'o ma'i skyin pa chang dngas sam

verses.skt: ghṛte mārutagulmaghnaḥ kāryo dadhnaḥ sareṇa vā | vātagulme kapho vṛddho hatvāgnim aruciṃ yadi
verses.tib: se 'bru zho spris sbyar ba'i mar / rlung las gyur pa'i skran sel to / rlung gi skran la bad kan 'phel / dro 'jam yi ga 'chus pa dang

verses.skt: hṛllāsaṃ gauravaṃ tandrāṃ janayed ullikhet tu tam | śūlānāhavibandheṣu jñātvā sasneham āśayam
verses.tib: snying rgal khong lci snyom gyur pa / de la skyug sman gtang bar bya / gzer dang lto sbos bshang sri la / gnas shes byas nas snum bcas pa'i

verses.skt: niryūhacūrṇavaṭakāḥ prayojyā ghṛtabheṣajaiḥ | koladāḍimagharmāmbutakramadyāmlakāñjikaih
verses.tib: sman mar sman gyi phye ma dang / khu ba ri lung byas pa yi / rgya shug se 'bru chu dron dang / dar ba chang dang skyur rtsabs dang

verses.skt: maṇḍena vā pibet prātaś cūrṇāny annasya vā puraḥ | cūrṇāni mātuluṅgasya bhāvitāny asakṛd rase
verses.tib: chang dngas bcas pa nang par blud / yang na phye ma la sogs pa / thug pa sla bor byas pa ni / nang par yang na zas sngon blud / phye ma kha lung khu ba dang / lan mang bgrungs par gyur pa yi

verses.skt: kurvīta kārmukatarān vaṭakān kaphavātayoḥ | hiṅguvacāvijayāpaśugandhādāḍimadīpyakadhānyakapāṭhāḥ | puṣkaramūlaśaṭhīhapuṣāgnikṣārayugatripaṭutrikaṭūni
verses.tib: las ni byed par nus gyur pa'i / ri lus rlung dang bad kan 'joms / shing kun shu dag a ru ra / a zag gan+d+ha se 'bru dang / 'u su pa ta ti mu sa / ma nu zur pa dkar po dang / spa ma'i 'bras bu ci ta ka / thal sman gnyis dang lan tshwa gnyis / tsha ba gsum dang zir dang

verses.skt: sājājicavyaṃ sahatintiḍīkaṃ savetasāmlaṃ vinihanti cūrṇaṃ | hṛtpārśvavastitrikayonipāyuśūlāni vāyvāmakaphodbhavāni
verses.tib: dbyi mo da trig star bu'i phyes / rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i / snying ga rtsib logs chu so dang / mjug to mngal dang chu sor gzer / bad kan rlung las gyur pa'i nad

verses.skt: kṛcchrān gulmān vātaviṇmūtrasaṅgaṃ kaṇṭhe bandhaṃ hṛdgrahaṃ pāṇḍurogam | annāśraddhāplīhadurnāmahidhmāvardhmādhmānaśvāsakāsāgnisādān
verses.tib: gso dka' skran dang 'phyen dang ni / gcin dang phyi sa 'gags pa dang / lkog ma 'gags shing snying nad dang / skya rbab yi ga 'chus pa dang / mcher pa gzhang 'brum skyigs bu dang / rgyu rlugs lto sbos me drod nyams / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel

verses.skt: lavaṇayavānīdīpyakakaṇanāgaram uttarottaraṃ vṛddham | sarvasamāṃśaharītakī cūrṇaṃ vaiśvānaraḥ sākṣāt
verses.tib: rgyam tsha dang ni la la phud / a za mo dang pi pi ling / dong gra rim bzhin cha res bskyed / thams cad dang ni cha mnyam pa'i / a ru ra bsres phye ma 'di / me ni mngon sum nyid yin no

verses.skt: trikaṭukam ajamodā saindhavaṃ jīrake dve | samadharaṇaghṛtānām aṣṭamo hiṅgubhāgaḥ | prathamakavaḍabhojyaḥ sarpiṣā saṃprayukto | janayati jaṭharāgniṃ vātagulmaṃ nihanti
verses.tib: tsha ba gsum dang ti mu sa / rgyam tsha dang ni zi ra gnyis / cha mnyam shing kun brgyad cha'i phyir / mar bsres kham gyi dang por zos / me drod drag po skyed / byed cing / rlung gi skran ni 'joms par byed

verses.skt: hiṅgūgrāviḍaśuṇṭhyajājivijayāvāṭyābhidhānāmayaiś | cūrṇaḥ kumbhanikumbhamūlasahitair bhāgottaraṃ vardhitaiḥ | pītaḥ koṣṇajalena koṣṭhajarujo gulmodarādīn ayaṃ | śārdūlaḥ prasabhaṃ pramathya harati vyādhīn mṛgaughān iva
verses.tib: shing kun shu dag kha ru tsha / dong gra dang ni la la phud / rnam rgyal ma nu ru rta dang / dur byid dan da'i rtsa bar bcas / cha res bskyed pa'i phye ma 'di / chu dron sbyar 'thungs lto ba'i nad / skran dang dmu rdzing la sogs pa / seng ges ri dwags tshogs rnams ni / mthu rtsal gyis ni zil non ltar / nad rnams 'joms par byed pa yin

verses.skt: sindhūtthapathyākaṇadīpyakānāṃ | cūrṇāni toyaiḥ pibatāṃ kavoṣṇaiḥ | prayāti nāśaṃ kaphavātajanmā | nārācanirbhinna ivāmayaughaḥ
verses.tib: a za mo dang a ru ra'i / phye ma chu dron sbyar blud na / skran can bad rlung las gyur tshogs / lcags mdas lus phug bzhin du 'joms

verses.skt: pūtīkapattragajacirbhaṭacavyavahni | vyoṣaṃ ca saṃstaracitaṃ lavaṇopadhānam | dagdhvā vicūrṇya dadhimastuyutaṃ prayojyaṃ | gulmodaraśvayathupāṇḍugudodbhaveṣu
verses.tib: ka rany+dza yi lo ma dang / in tra ba ru Na dbyi mo / kru trug tres dang bca' sga dang / bsregs la btags te zho dang ni / zho ga chu sbyar blud pa dag / skran dang dmu rdzing 'or nad dang

verses.skt: hiṅgutriguṇaṃ saindhavam asmāt triguṇaṃ ca tailam airaṇḍam
verses.tib: shing kun sum 'gyur rgyam tsha dang / de las e raN+Da yi mar / sum 'gyur de las sgog skya yi

verses.skt: tat triguṇalaśunarasaṃ gulmodaravardhmaśūlaghnam | mātuluṅgaraso hiṅgu dāḍimaṃ viḍasaindhavam
verses.tib: khu ba sum 'gyur sbyar ba dag / blud na skran dang dmu rdzing dang / rgyu rlugs gzer gyi nad rnams 'joms / kha lung khu ba shing kun dang / se 'bru rgyam tsha kha ru tsha

verses.skt: surāmaṇḍena pātavyaṃ vātagulmarujāpaham | śuṇṭhyāḥ karṣaṃ guḍasya dvau dhautāt kṛṣṇatilāt palam
verses.tib: chang gi dngas mar sbyar blud na / rlung las gyur pa'i skran nad sel / bca' sga zho gnyis bu ram zho / bzhi dang til nag bkrus srang gcig

verses.skt: khādann ekatra saṃcūrṇya koṣṇakṣīrānupo jayet | vātahṛdrogagulmārśoyoniśūlaśakṛdgrahān
verses.tib: gcig tu phye mar btags byin zhing / 'o ma dro 'jam rjes blud na / rlung gi snying nad skran gzhang 'brum / mngal gzer rtug pa 'gags pa sel

verses.skt: pibed eraṇḍatailaṃ tu vātagulmī prasannayā | śleṣmaṇy anubale vāyau pitte tu payasā saha
verses.tib: rlung gyur skran la e raN+Da'i / mar ni chang dang sbyar ba blud / bad rlung 'dres la'ang de nyid blud / mkhris pa 'dres la 'o ma bcas

verses.skt: vivṛddhaṃ yadi vā pittaṃ saṃtāpaṃ vātagulminaḥ | kuryād virecanīyo ’sau sasnehair ānulomikaiḥ
verses.tib: gal te mkhris pa 'phel 'gyur te / tsha gyur rlung gi skran can la / mthun pa rjes su 'byin byed pa / snum bcas bkru sman gtang bar bya

verses.skt: tāpānuvṛttāv evaṃ ca raktaṃ tasyāvasecayet | sādhayec chuddhaśuṣkasya laśunasya catuḥpalam
verses.tib: des kyang tsha ba ma bri na / de la gtar ga gdab par bya / sgog skya bshus pa skam po ni / srang bzhi chu dang 'o ma ni

verses.skt: kṣīrodake ’ṣṭaguṇite kṣīraśeṣaṃ ca pācayet | vātagulmam udāvartaṃ gṛdhrasīṃ viṣamajvaram
verses.tib: brgyad 'gyur gyi ni nang du bskol / 'o ma ma lus par blud na / rlung gyur skran dang rtug 'gags / dang / rlung nad gzugs 'khums mi bzad rims

verses.skt: hṛdrogaṃ vidradhiṃ śoṣaṃ sādhayaty āśu tat payaḥ | tailaṃ prasannā gomūtram āranālaṃ yavāgrajaḥ
verses.tib: snying nad khong 'bras zad byed rnams / 'o ma de yis myur du 'joms / til mar chang dang ba gcin dang / rang skyur ya bak+Sha rar bcas

verses.skt: gulmaṃ jaṭharam ānāhaṃ pītam ekatra sādhayet | citrakagranthikairaṇḍaśuṇṭhīkvāthaḥ paraṃ hitaḥ
verses.tib: blud na skran dang dmu rdzing dang / lto sbos cig car 'joms par byed / tsitra pi pi ling spru la / bca' sga shing kun eraN+Da

verses.skt: śūlānāhavibandheṣu sahiṅguviḍasaindhavaiḥ | puṣkarairaṇḍayor mūlaṃ yavadhanvayavāsakam
verses.tib: rgyam tsha kha ru tsha bcas pa / bskol ba blud na gzer ba dang / lto sbos rtug 'gags sel mchog yin / ma nu e raN+Da'i rtsa ba / nas dang byi tsher ba sha ka

verses.skt: jalena kvathitaṃ pītaṃ koṣṭhadāharujāpaham | vāṭyāhvairaṇḍadarbhāṇāṃ mūlaṃ dāru mahauṣadham
verses.tib: chu dang bskol te blud na ni / lto nad sbos dang gzer 'joms byed / ma nu e raN+Da 'jag ma'i / rtsa ba thang shing bca' sga rnams

verses.skt: pītaṃ niḥkvāthya toyena koṣṭhapṛṣṭhāṃsaśūlajit | śilājaṃ payasānalpapañcamūlaśṛtena vā
verses.tib: chu dang bskol ba'i khu ba blud / khong pa phrag pa rgyab gzer 'joms / brag zhun dang ni pa ya s+ya / rtsa ba chen po lnga bskol ba

verses.skt: vātagulmī pibed vāṭyam udāvarte tu bhojayet | snigdhaṃ paippalikair yūṣair mūlakānāṃ rasena vā
verses.tib: rlung gyur skran nad can la blud / rtug skam nad la nas kyi ni / chag tshe snum dang ldan pa sbyin / pi pi ling ngam la phug gi / khu ba dang ni sbyar ba sbyin

verses.skt: baddhaviṇmāruto ’śnīyāt kṣīreṇoṣṇena yāvakam | kulmāṣān vā bahusnehān bhakṣayel lavaṇottarān
verses.tib: nas kyi zan dron 'o mar bcas / rlung gi rtug 'gags nad la sbyin / yang na mon sran gre'u'i chan / snum mang lan tshwar ldan pa sbyin

verses.skt: nīlinītrivṛtādantīpathyākampillakaiḥ saha | samalāya ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ saviḍakṣāranāgaram
verses.tib: dur byid dan ti ni li ni / a ru ra dang kam pi l+ya / nas tshig 'khus thal kha ru tsha / dong gra mar dang bcas pa ni / dri mar bcas la bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: nīlinīṃ triphalāṃ rāsnāṃ balāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm | paced viḍaṅgaṃ vyāghrīṃ ca pālikāni jalāḍhake
verses.tib: ni li ni dang 'bras bu gsum / ra sna pa la pu tse shel / kaN+Da ka ri byi dang ga / srang re chu bre bzhi nang bskol

verses.skt: rase ’ṣṭabhāgaśeṣe tu ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet | dadhnaḥ prasthena saṃyojya sudhākṣīrapalena ca
verses.tib: khu ba brgyad cha lus pa ru / mar bre gang dang zho bre gang / su d+ha k+Shi ra srang gcig bskol

verses.skt: tato ghṛtapalaṃ dadyād yavāgūmaṇḍamiśritam | jīrṇe samyagviriktaṃ ca bhojayed rasabhojanam
verses.tib: de las mar bre re re na / nas thug thug sla sbyar te blud / zhu zhing legs par 'khrus nas ni / sha khu bza' ba sbyin par bya

verses.skt: gulmakuṣṭhodaravyaṅgaśophapāṇḍvāmayajvarān | śvitraṃ plīhānam unmādaṃ hanty etan nīlinīghṛtam
verses.tib: ni li ni yi sman mar 'dis / skran mdze dmu rdzing ngo khabs dang / 'or nad skya rbab rims nad dang / sha bkra mdzer ba smyo byed 'joms

verses.skt: kukkuṭāś ca mayūrāś ca tittirikrauñcavartakāḥ | śālayo madirā sarpir vātagulmacikitsitam
verses.tib: khyim bya rma bya gong ma sreg / khrung khrung bye'u'i sha khu dang / sA lu'i 'bras chan chang dang mar / rlung gi skran ni sel ba yin

verses.skt: mitam uṣṇaṃ dravaṃ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ vātagulminām | samaṇḍā vāruṇī pānaṃ taptaṃ vā dhānyakair jalam
verses.tib: nyung zhing snum la sla zhing dro / kha zas rlung skran can gyis / bza' / btung bar chang gi dngas ma'am / 'u su bskol ba'i chu tshan blud

verses.skt: snigdhoṣṇenodite gulme paittike sraṃsanaṃ hitam | drākṣābhayāguḍarasaṃ kampillaṃ vā madhudrutam
verses.tib: mkhris gyur skran ni snum dro las / byung ba de la rgun 'bru dang / a rur bskol bu ram bcas / kam pi l+ya dang sbrang rtsi dang

verses.skt: kalpoktaṃ raktapittoktaṃ gulme rūkṣoṣṇaje punaḥ | paraṃ saṃśamanaṃ sarpis tiktaṃ vāsāghṛtaṃ śṛtam
verses.tib: cho ga'am khrag mkhris gsor bshad pa'i / bkru sman blud de 'khrus pa phan / rtsub dro las byung skran la ni / tig ta'am ba sha ka bskol ba'i / mar ni blud par byas pa'am

verses.skt: tṛṇākhyapañcakakvāthe jīvanīyagaṇena vā | śṛtaṃ tenaiva vā kṣīraṃ nyagrodhādigaṇena vā
verses.tib: rtswa yi rtsa ba lnga pa 'am / 'tsho byed sde tshan bshad pa dang / mar bskol blud na mchog tu phan / n+ya gro d+ha sogs sde tshan rnams / 'tsho byed sde tshan 'o ma phan

verses.skt: tatrāpi sraṃsanaṃ yuñjyāc chīghram ātyayike bhiṣak | vairecanikasiddhena sarpiṣā payasāpi vā
verses.tib: de yang bshol du med gyur par / sman pas bkru sman dang bskol ba'i / mar ram 'o ma dag gi ni / bkru sman nye bar gtang bar bya

verses.skt: rasenāmalakekṣūṇāṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet | pathyāpādaṃ pibet sarpis tat siddhaṃ pittagulmanut
verses.tib: skyu ru ra dang bu ram shing / khu ba mar ni bre gang dang / a ru ra ni zhi cha bcug / bskol ba'i mar blud mkhris skran sel

verses.skt: pibed vā tailvakaṃ sarpir yac coktaṃ pittavidradhau | drākṣāṃ payasyāṃ madhukaṃ candanaṃ padmakaṃ madhu
verses.tib: yang na mkhris pa'i khong 'bras gsor / bshad pa'i seng phrom sman mar blud / rgun 'bru shing mngar pa ya s+ya / shug pa tsan+dan sbrang rtsi rnams

verses.skt: pibet taṇḍulatoyena pittagulmopaśāntaye | dvipalaṃ trāyamāṇāyā jaladviprasthasādhitam
verses.tib: 'bras bkrus chu dang blud na ni / mkhris pa'i skran ni sel bar 'gyur / kyi lce ba ni srang gnyis dang / chu bre do ni bskol nas su

verses.skt: aṣṭabhāgasthitaṃ pūtaṃ koṣṇaṃ kṣīrasamam pibet | pibed upari tasyoṣṇaṃ kṣīram eva yathābalam
verses.tib: brgyad cha lus pa btsags pa ni / dro 'jam 'o ma cha mnyam blud / yang na de steng 'o tshan ni / me drod ji bzhin blud par bya

verses.skt: tena nirhṛtadoṣasya gulmaḥ śāmyati paittikaḥ | dāhe ’bhyaṅgo ghṛtaiḥ śītaiḥ sājyair lepo himauṣadhaiḥ
verses.tib: de yis nad ni bsal bas na / mkhris pa can gyi skran zhir 'gyur / tsha la mar grang bsku ba'am / bsil ba'i sman mar bcas pa bsku

verses.skt: sparśaḥ saroruhāṃ pattraiḥ pātraiś ca pracalajjalaiḥ | vidāhapūrvarūpeṣu śūle vahneś ca mārdave
verses.tib: chu skyes lo mas reg bya zhing / snod chus gang la reg pa phan / gzer dang me drod bri 'gyur zhing / tsha ba'i dang po tshul can gyis

verses.skt: bahuśo ’pahared raktaṃ pittagulme viśeṣataḥ | chinnamūlā vidahyante na gulmā yānti ca kṣayam
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i skran la khyad par du / khrag ni lan mang dbyung ba phan / rtsa ba chad skran mi tsha zhing / nye bar zad par 'gyur ba dang

verses.skt: raktaṃ hi vyamlatāṃ yāti tac ca nāsti na cāsti ruk | hṛtadoṣaṃ parimlānaṃ jāṅgalais tarpitaṃ rasaiḥ
verses.tib: khrag ni skyur bar mi 'gyur la / khrag las gyur pa'i nad kyang mang / gnyid cing nad ni bsal bal / skam sar skyes pa'i sha khus brta

verses.skt: samāśvastaṃ saśeṣārtiṃ sarpir abhyāsayet punaḥ | raktapittātivṛddhatvāt kriyām anupalabhya vā
verses.tib: brtas na nyes pa lhag lus la / slar yang mar ni bsten par bya / khrag dang / mkhris pa 'phelagyur pas / skran ni smin par phyogs pa la / gso ba'i bya ba ma rnyed cing

verses.skt: gulme pākonmukhe sarvā pittavidradhivat kriyā | śālir gavyājapayasī paṭolī jāṅgalaṃ ghṛtam
