verses.tib: mkhris pa'i khong 'bras ltar gso bya / sA lu ba dang ra'i 'o ma / pa tol skam sa'i sha mar dang / pa ru sha ka skyu ru ra

verses.skt: dhātrī parūṣakaṃ drākṣā kharjūraṃ dāḍimaṃ sitā | bhojyaṃ pāne ’mbu balayā bṛhatyādyaiś ca sādhitam
verses.tib: rgun 'bru 'bra go se 'bru dang / kha rar bcas pa'i kha zas bza' / btung ba ba la bri ha ti / la sogs bskol ba blud par bya

verses.skt: śleṣmaje vāmayet pūrvam avamyam upavāsayet | tiktoṣṇakaṭusaṃsargyā vahniṃ saṃdhukṣayet tataḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur dang po ni / slon bya de mi bzod smyung bya / kha dro tsha ba'i thug kyi / rim par de 'og me drod skyed

verses.skt: hiṅgvādibhiś ca dviguṇakṣārahiṅgvamlavetasaiḥ | nigūḍhaṃ yadi vonnaddhaṃ stimitaṃ kaṭhinaṃ sthiram
verses.tib: shing kun la sogs thal sman dang / shing kun star bu nyis 'gyur gtang / gal te 'bur ram gting ring gyur / tshor ba chung zhing sra la brtan

verses.skt: ānāhādiyutaṃ gulmaṃ saṃsvedya vinayed anu | ghṛtaṃ sakṣārakaṭukaṃ pātavyaṃ kaphagulminām
verses.tib: lto sbos la sogs ldan pa'i skran / dugs byas nas ni snyi bar bya / bad kan las gyur skran can gyis / mar tsha thal sman bcas chu blud

verses.skt: savyoṣakṣāralavaṇaṃ sahiṅguviḍadāḍimam | kaphagulmaṃ jayaty āśu daśamūlaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: rgyam tsha shing kun kha ru tsha / se 'bru rtsa ba bcu bskol mar / bad kan las gyur skran myur 'joms

verses.skt: bhallātakānāṃ dvipalaṃ pañcamūlaṃ palonmitam | alpaṃ toyāḍhake sādhyaṃ pādaśeṣeṇa tena ca
verses.tib: bse shing 'bras bu srang gnyis dang / rtsa ba chung ngu lnga srang re / chu bre bzhi yi nang du bskol / bzhi cha lus pa de dang ni

verses.skt: tulyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tulyapayo vipaced akṣasaṃmitaiḥ | viḍaṅgahiṅgusindhūtthayāvaśūkaśaṭhīviḍaiḥ
verses.tib: mnyam pa'i 'o ma mnyam pa'i mar / byi dang ga dang shing kun dang / nas tshig 'khus thal lce myang tsha

verses.skt: sadvīpirāsnāyaṣṭyāhvaṣaḍgranthākaṇanāgaraiḥ | etad bhallātakaghṛtaṃ kaphagulmaharaṃ param
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri rtsabs ru tsha / zur pa ra sna shing mngar dang / pi pi ling dang dong gra rnams / zho ni gnyis gnyis bcas par bskol / go bye yi ni sman mar ni / bad kan skran ni sel ba'i mchog

verses.skt: plīhapāṇḍvāmayaśvāsagrahaṇīrogakāsajit | tato ’sya gulme dehe ca samaste svedam ācaret
verses.tib: mchin pa mcher pa'i nad dang ni / skya rbab dang ni pho ba'i nad / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba 'joms / de nas skran can de yi lus / ma lus par ni dugs byas la

verses.skt: sarvatra gulme prathamaṃ snehasvedopapādite | yā kriyā kriyate yāti sā siddhiṃ na virūkṣite
verses.tib: skran kun la ni thog ma nyid / snum chos dugs ni byas gyur na / gso ba gang zhig byas pa des / grub kyi rtsub chos kyis mi 'grub

verses.skt: snigdhasvinnaśarīrasya gulme śaithilyam āgate | yathoktāṃ ghaṭikāṃ nyasyed gṛhīte ’panayec ca tām
verses.tib: snum zhing dugs kyis brlan lus kyi / skran ni snyi bar gyur pa dang / ji ltar bshad pa'i bum pa ni / bzhag pas bkang nas de bsal bya

verses.skt: vastrāntaraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhindyād gulmaṃ pramāṇavit | vimārgājapadādarśair yathālābhaṃ prapīḍayet
verses.tib: de nas ras nang chud byas te / tshad shes pa yi / skran dbral bya / shing gcad ra rmig me long rnams / ji snyed pa yis legs par bcing

verses.skt: pramṛjyād gulmam evaikaṃ na tv antrahṛdayaṃ spṛśet | tilairaṇḍātasībījasarṣapaiḥ parilipya ca
verses.tib: des skran gcig pu dbyi bya zhing / snying dang rgyu mar reg mi bya / til dang zar ma'i sa bon dang / nyungs kar e raN+Da yis byug

verses.skt: śleṣmagulmam ayaḥpātraiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ svedayet tataḥ | evaṃ ca visṛtaṃ sthānāt kaphagulmaṃ virecanaiḥ
verses.tib: bad kan skran ni lcags kyi snod / dro 'jam tsam gyis dugs bya'o / de ltar gnas las bskyod nas ni / bad kan skran la snum bcas pa'i

verses.skt: sasnehair vastibhiś cainaṃ śodhayed dāśamūlikaiḥ | pippalyāmalakadrākṣāśyāmādyaiḥ pālikaiḥ pacet
verses.tib: bkru sman dang ni 'jam rtsi dag / rtsa ba bcu pa ldan par sbyang / pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra / rgun 'bru sha ma dur byid sogs

verses.skt: eraṇḍatailahaviṣoḥ prasthau payasi ṣaḍguṇe | siddho ’yaṃ miśrakaḥ sneho gulmināṃ sraṃsanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: srang re dang ni bskol ba la / e raN+Da yi zhun mar ni / bre re 'o ma drug 'gyur dang / lhan cig bskol bar gyur ba 'di / 'dres pa'i sman mar zhes bya ste / skran can 'khru bar byed pa'i mchog

verses.skt: vṛddhividradhiśūleṣu vātavyādhiṣu cāmṛtam | pibed vā nīlinīsarpir mātrayā dvipalīnayā
verses.tib: rgyu rlugs khong 'bras gzer ba ni / rlung gi nad la bdud rtsi yin / yang na ni li ni sman mar / srang gnyis tshad du blud pa'am

verses.skt: tathaiva sukumārākhyaṃ ghṛtāny audarikāṇi vā | droṇe ’mbhasaḥ paced dantyāḥ palānāṃ pañcaviṃśatim
verses.tib: de bzhin skyid de ba'i sman mar / dmu rdzing skabs bshad mar yang phan / dan da tsi tra a ru ra / srang ni nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga

verses.skt: citrakasya tathā pathyās tāvatīs tadrase srute | dviprasthe sādhayet pūte kṣiped dantīsamaṃ guḍam
verses.tib: chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol / brgyad cha lus btsags a ru ra / bcas pa bu ram dan dar mnyam

verses.skt: tailāt palāni catvāri trivṛtāyaś ca cūrṇataḥ | kaṇākarṣau tathā śuṇṭhyāḥ siddhe lehe tu śītale
verses.tib: bcug la til mar dur byid phye / srang bzhi bca' sga pi pi ling / zho gnyis bskol bsgrangs lde gu de

verses.skt: madhu tailasamaṃ dadyāc caturjātāc caturthikām | ato harītakīm ekāṃ sāvalehapalām adan
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi til mar cha mnyam pa / dri sna bzhi bzhi srang re gzhug / de las a ru gcig dang / lde gu srang gcig bcas zos na

verses.skt: sukhaṃ viricyate snigdho doṣaprastham anāmayaḥ | gulmahṛdrogadurnāmaśophānāhagarodarān
verses.tib: bde bar nad ni bre gang 'khru / skran dang snying nad gzhang 'brum dang / glo nad lto sbos sbyar ba'i dug

verses.skt: kuṣṭhotkleśāruciplīhagrahaṇīviṣamajvarān | ghnanti dantīharītakyaḥ pāṇḍutāṃ ca sakāmalām
verses.tib: mdze dang dmu rdzing nad slong dang / yi ga 'chus dang mcher pa'i nad / skya rbab mig ser 'joms par byed

verses.skt: sudhākṣīradravaṃ cūrṇaṃ trivṛtāyāḥ subhāvitam | kārṣikaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ līḍhvā sādhu viricyate
verses.tib: 'di ni dan da tsi tra ka / a ru ra yi lde gu yin / su d+ha k+Shi ra'i rlan dang ni / dur byid dang ni legs bsres te / mar dang sbrang rtsi zho gnyis bcas / lde gus legs par 'khru bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaśyāmātrivṛddantīvijayākṣāraguggulūn | gomūtreṇa pibed ekaṃ tena guggulum eva vā
verses.tib: ru rta dur byid a ru ra / dan da gu gul nas tshig 'khus / ba gcin bcas blud yang na ni / gu gul nyi tshe ba gcin blud

verses.skt: nirūhān kalpasiddhyuktān yojayed gulmanāśanān | kṛtamūlaṃ mahāvāstuṃ kaṭhinaṃ stimitaṃ gurum
verses.tib: cho ga grub pa las bshad pa'i / bkru sman drag po skran 'joms gtang / rtsa ba zug cing lhun che la / sra zhing lci la tshor ba med / gting ring ma smin pa yi skran

verses.skt: gūḍhamāṃsaṃ jayed gulmaṃ kṣārāriṣṭāgnikarmabhiḥ | ekāntaram dvyantaraṃ vā viśramayyāthavā tryaham
verses.tib: thal sman dang ni chang rnying dang / me yi las kyis bsal bar bya / bad kan shas che thal sman ni / gzhang 'brum rde'u pho ba'i nad / gso ba'i skabs bshad gtang bya zhing / zhag gcig zhag gnyis kyis chod pa / yang na zhag gsum ngal sos la

verses.skt: śarīradoṣabalayor vardhanakṣapaṇodyataḥ | arśo'śmarīgrahaṇyuktāḥ kṣārā yojyāḥ kapholbaṇe
verses.tib: lus kyi nyams stobs nad dag ni / 'phel 'bri'i las la brtson par bya / thang shing dur byid dan dang

verses.skt: devadārutrivṛddantīkaṭukāpañcakolakam | svarjikāyāvaśūkākhyau śreṣṭhāpāṭhopakuñcikāḥ
verses.tib: pu tse shel dang tsha ba lnga / swa rdzi ka thal nas tshig 'khus / pa ta dang ni 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaṃ sarpasugandhāṃ ca dvyakṣāṃśaṃ paṭupañcakam | pālikaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tailavasādadhighṛtāplutam
verses.tib: ru rta ba sar su gan+d+ha / zi ra nag po srang phyed phyed / lan tshwa lnga ni srang re dag / btags pa'i phye ma til mar dang

verses.skt: ghaṭasyāntaḥ pacet pakvam agnivarṇe ghaṭe ca tam | kṣāraṃ gṛhītvā kṣīrājyatakramadyādibhiḥ pibet
verses.tib: zhag dang zho dang mar dang sbrus / rdza mar dub ma shor bsregs / rdza ma me yi mdog 'gyur de'i / thal ba blangs pa 'o ma mar / dar ba chang sogs sbyar te blud

verses.skt: gulmodāvartavardhmārśojaṭharagrahaṇīkṛmīn | apasmāragaronmādayoniśukrāmayāśmarīḥ
verses.tib: skran dang rtug 'gags rgyu rlugs dang / gzhang 'brum dmu rdzing pho ba'i nad / srin nad brjed byed smyo byed gdon / mngal nad khu chu las gyur rde'u

verses.skt: kṣārāgado ’yaṃ śamayed viṣaṃ cākhubhujaṅgajam | śleṣmāṇaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ rasakṣīraghṛtāśinaḥ
verses.tib: byi la sbrul gyi dug rnams kyang / thal ba'i sman 'dis sel bar byed / bad kan las gyur skran la snum / sha khu 'o ma mar bsten la

verses.skt: chittvā bhittvāśayāt kṣāraḥ kṣāratvāt kṣārayaty adhaḥ | mande ’gnāv arucau sātmyair madyaiḥ sasneham aśnatām
verses.tib: thal sman btang na skran dag ni / gnas nas dum bu dum bu ru / bcad nas thur du 'byin par byed / me drod chung zhing yi ga 'chus / chang goms snum can za ba la

verses.skt: yojayed āsavāriṣṭān nigadān mārgaśuddhaye | śālayaḥ ṣaṣṭikā jīrṇāḥ kulatthā jāṅgalaṃ palam
verses.tib: rgyun srang dag phyir mnan chad dang / chang rnying skyon med blud par bya / sA lu drug cu pa rnying pa / rgya sran skam sa'i srog chags sha

verses.skt: ciribilvāgnitarkārīyavānīvaruṇāṅkurāḥ | śigrus taruṇabilvāni bālaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca mūlakam
verses.tib: tsi tra pu ri ka rany+dza / a ti man da la la phud / ba ri na yi myu gu dang / shi kru bil ba gzhon nu dang / la phug gzhon nu skam po dang

verses.skt: bījapūrakahiṅgvamlavetasakṣāradāḍimam | vyoṣaṃ takraṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ bhaktaṃ pānaṃ tu vāruṇī
verses.tib: kha lung shing kun star bu dang / se 'bru nas tshig 'khus thal ba / tsha ba gsum dang ngar ba dang / mar dang til mar kha zas sbyin

verses.skt: dhānyāmlaṃ mastu takraṃ ca yavānīviḍacūrṇitam | pañcamūlaśṛtaṃ vāri jīrṇaṃ mārdvīkam eva vā
verses.tib: btung bar chang gi dngas ma dang / skyur rtsabs dar bzhog chu / bid la la phud phye ma / rtsa ba la bskol khu ba'am / rgun chang rnying pa blud par bya

verses.skt: pippalīpippalīmūlacitrakājājīsaindhavaiḥ | surā gulmaṃ jayaty āśu jagalaś ca vimiśritaḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang de'i rtsa ba / go snyod rgyam tsha kru trug tres / chang gi snyigs mar bsres pa yis / skran ni myur du sel bar byed

verses.skt: vamanair laṅghanaiḥ svedaiḥ sarpiḥpānair virecanaiḥ | vastikṣārāsavāriṣṭaguṭikāpathyabhojanaiḥ
verses.tib: slon dang smyung ba dugs dang ni / sman mar blud dang bkru sman dang / 'jam rtsi thal sman mnan chang dang / chang rnying ri lu phan zas kyis

verses.skt: ślaiṣmiko baddhamūlatvād yadi gulmo na śāmyati | tasya dāhaṃ hṛte rakte kuryād ante śarādibhiḥ
verses.tib: bad kan skran can gting zug pas / gal te zhi bar ma gyur na / de la khrag dbyung tha mar ni / mde'u lcags sogs kyis bsreg par bya

verses.skt: atha gulmaṃ saparyantaṃ vāsasāntaritaṃ bhiṣak | nābhivastyantrahṛdayaṃ romarājīṃ ca varjayan
verses.tib: de nas skran ni mthar thug par / sman pas gos kyis dkris nas ni / lte ba chu so rgyu ma snying / spu yi phreng ni ma gtogs par

verses.skt: nātigāḍhaṃ parimṛśec chareṇa jvalatāthavā | lohenāraṇikotthena dāruṇā taindukena vā
verses.tib: shin tu gting thug ma yin par / mde'u bsregs pa'am yang na ni / gzong bu'i lcags ni bsregs pa'am / tin du ka yi shing gis bsreg

verses.skt: tato ’gnivege śamite śītair vraṇa iva kriyā | āmānvaye tu peyādyaiḥ saṃdhukṣyāgniṃ vilaṅghite
verses.tib: de nas bsil bas me dbal ni / zhi nas rma ltar gso bar bya / ma zhu rjes 'brel smyung byas nas / thug pa sogs kyis me drod bskyed

verses.skt: svaṃ svaṃ kuryāt kramaṃ miśraṃ miśradoṣe ca kālavit | gataprasavakālāyai nāryai gulme ’srasaṃbhave
verses.tib: rang rang rim dang 'brel pa las / 'dren ma'i gso bas gso bar bya / btsas pa'i dus ni 'das gyur pa'i / bud med la skran khrag skyes 'byung

verses.skt: snigdhasvinnaśarīrāyai dadyāt snehavirecanam | tilakvāthe ghṛtaguḍavyoṣabhārgīrajo'nvitaḥ
verses.tib: de la lus snum dugs byas par / snum gyi bkru sman gtang bar bya / til bskol mar dang bu ram dang / tsha gsum ga bra'i rtsa ba'i phye

verses.skt: pānaṃ raktabhave gulme naṣṭe puṣpe ca yoṣitaḥ | bhārgīkṛṣṇākarañjatvaggranthikāmaradārujam
verses.tib: khrag las gyur pa'i skran dang ni / bud med zla mtshan med la blud / ga bra'i rtsa ba pi pi ling / thang shing ka rany+dza'i shun pa

verses.skt: cūrṇaṃ tilānāṃ kvāthena pītaṃ gulmarujāpaham | palāśakṣārapātre dve dve pātre tailasarpiṣoḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling gi rtsa ba yi / phye ma til bskol chur sbyar ba / blud na khrag skran nad sel byed / pa la sha yi thal ba ni / bre brgyad til mar mar bre brgyad

verses.skt: gulmaśaithilyajananīṃ paktvā mātrāṃ prayojayet | na prabhidyeta yady evaṃ dadyād yonivirecanam
verses.tib: bskol te tshad bzhin blud na ni / skran ni snyi bar byed pa yin / gal te snyi bar ma gyur na / mngal gyi bkru sman gtang bar bya

verses.skt: kṣāreṇa yuktaṃ palalaṃ sudhākṣīreṇa vā tataḥ | tābhyāṃ vā bhāvitān dadyād yonau kaṭukamatsyakān
verses.tib: til gyi lde gu thal sman bcas / yang na su d+ha k+shi rar sbyar / yang na de gnyis dang bsres pa'i / nya ni kha bo gtang bar bya

verses.skt: varāhamatsyapittābhyāṃ naktakān vā subhāvitān | kiṇvaṃ vā saguḍakṣāraṃ dadyād yonau viśuddhaye
verses.tib: phag rgod nya yi mkhris pa yis / bsgos pa'i ras ma gzhug par bya / yang na bu ram thal sman gnyis / phabs sbyar mngal ni sbyang phyir / gtang

verses.skt: raktapittaharaṃ kṣāraṃ lehayen madhusarpiṣā | laśunaṃ madirāṃ tīkṣṇāṃ matsyāṃś cāsyai prayojayet
verses.tib: khrag mkhris sel ba'i thal sman ni / sbrang rtsi mar bcas lde gu sbyin / sgog skya'i chang ni rnon po dang / nya yang de la sbyin par bya

verses.skt: vastiṃ sakṣīragomūtraṃ sakṣāraṃ dāśamūlikam | avartamāne rudhire hitaṃ gulmaprabhedanam
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu pa thal sman dang / 'o ma ba gcin mas gtad bya / des kyang khrag 'dzag ma gyur na / skran 'jig byed pa'i sbyor ba phan

verses.skt: yamakābhyaktadehāyāḥ pravṛtte samupekṣaṇam | rasaudanas tathāhāraḥ pānaṃ ca taruṇī surā
verses.tib: byung nas mar dang til mar bsku / bcad pa dag ni mi bya zhing / sha khu 'bras chan bza' ba dang / btung ba chang ni sar pa blud

verses.skt: rudhire ’tipravṛtte tu raktapittaharāḥ kriyāḥ | kāryā vātarugārtāyāḥ sarvā vātaharāḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: khrag ni shas cher byung gyur na / khrag mkhris sel ba'i gso ba bya / rlung gi nad kyis nyen gyur na / rlung gi gso ba kun kyang bya

verses.skt: ānāhādāv udāvartabalāsaghnyo yathāyatham
verses.tib: ltor spos sogs dang rtug skam la / rlung bsal gsol ba ji bzhin bya

verses.skt: doṣātimātropacayāt srotomārganirodhanāt | saṃbhavaty udaraṃ tasmān nityam enaṃ virecayet
verses.tib: nad ni shas cher pa dang / bu ga'i rgyun srang 'gags pa la / dmu rdzing 'byung bas de yi phyir / rtag tu bkru sman gtang bar bya

verses.skt: pāyayet tailam airaṇḍaṃ samūtraṃ sapayo ’pi vā | māsaṃ dvau vāthavā gavyaṃ mūtraṃ māhiṣam eva vā
verses.tib: yang na zla ba gcig gam gnyis / e raN+Da'i mar ba gcin bcas / 'o mar bcas pa'am ba gcin nam / ma he'i gcin ni blud bya zhing

verses.skt: pibed gokṣīrabhuk syād vā karabhīkṣīravartanaḥ | dāhānāhātitṛṇmūrchāparītas tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: ba yi 'o ma blud par bya / lto sbos tsha bas nyam thag cing / skom dang brgyal bas non pa la / rnga mo'i 'o ma blud par bya

verses.skt: rūkṣāṇāṃ bahuvātānāṃ doṣasaṃśuddhikāṅkṣiṇām | snehanīyāni sarpīṃṣi jaṭharaghnāni yojayet
verses.tib: rtsub cing rlung shas che ba yi / nad ni sbyong bar 'dod pa yis / snum chos dang ni sman mar dag / dmu rdzing 'joms pa sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: ṣaṭpalaṃ daśamūlāmbumastudvyāḍhakasādhitam | nāgaratripalaṃ prasthaṃ ghṛtatailāt tathāḍhakam
verses.tib: srang drug rtsa ba bcu pa'i chu / zho ga chu ni bre brgyad bskol / dong gra srang gsum mar dang ni / til mar bre ni re re dang / zho ga chu ni bre bzhi dag

verses.skt: mastunaḥ sādhayitvaitat pibet sarvodarāpaham | kaphamārutasaṃbhūte gulme ca paramaṃ hitam
verses.tib: bskol ba 'di ni blud gyur na / dmu rdzing thams cad 'joms par byed / rlung dang bad kan las byung ba'i / skran la'ang mchog tu phan pa yin

verses.skt: caturguṇe jale mūtre dviguṇe citrakāt pale | kalke siddhaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ sakṣāraṃ jaṭharī pibet
verses.tib: bzhi 'gyur chu dang nyis 'gyur gcin / kru trug tres srang gcig lde gu / bre gang mar bskol thal sman bcas / dmu rdzing can la blud par bya

verses.skt: yavakolakulatthānāṃ pañcamūlasya cāmbhasā | surāsauvīrakābhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ vā pāyayed ghṛtam
verses.tib: nas dang rgya shug rgya sran dang / rtsa ba lnga ni bskol ba'i chu / chang dang rang skyur bcas pa dang / mar bskol ba yang blud par bya

verses.skt: ebhiḥ snigdhāya saṃjāte bale śānte ca mārute | sraste doṣāśaye dadyāt kalpadṛṣṭaṃ virecanam
verses.tib: snum 'di snum / bcas nyams stobs ni / skye zhing rlung nad zhi gyur nas / nad ni gnas nas bskyod pa dang / cho ga grub bshad bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: paṭolamūlaṃ triphalāṃ niśāṃ vellaṃ ca kārṣikam | kampillanīlinīkumbhabhāgān dvitricaturguṇān
verses.tib: pa to la'i rtsa 'bras bu gsum / skyer pa byi dang ga zho re / kam pi la dang ni li ni / tsi tra ka zho gnyis gsum bzhi

verses.skt: pibet saṃcūrṇya mūtreṇa peyāpūrvaṃ tato rasaiḥ | virikto jāṅgalair adyāt tataḥ ṣaḍdivasaṃ payaḥ
verses.tib: phyer btags ba gcin sbyar ba blud / 'khrus nas thug pa sha khu ni / skam sar gnas pa'i sha khu sbyin / de nas zhag drug 'o ma dang / tsha ba gsum dang bskol ba ni

verses.skt: śṛtaṃ pibed vyoṣayutaṃ pītam evaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | hanti sarvodarāṇy etac cūrṇaṃ jātodakāny api
verses.tib: yang dang yang du blud byas na / 'di yis dmu rdzing thams cad ni / dmu chur gyur kyang 'joms par byed / bi sha la dang shang khi ni

verses.skt: gavākṣīṃ śaṅkhinīṃ dantīṃ tilvakasya tvacaṃ vacām | pibet karkandhumṛdvīkākolāmbhomūtrasīdhubhiḥ
verses.tib: dan da seng phrom shun shu dag / rgya shug phre'u rgun 'bru dang / rgya shug sbom chu bu ram chang / ba gcin dang ni sbyar te blud

verses.skt: yavānī hapuṣā dhānyaṃ śatapuṣpopakuñcikā | kāravī pippalīmūlam ajagandhā śaṭhī vacā
verses.tib: la la phud dang spa ma'i 'bras / 'u su shu ti zir nag / pi pi ling rtsa ka ra bI / a za mo dang zur ba dkar

verses.skt: citrako ’jājikaṃ vyoṣaṃ svarṇakṣīrī phalatrayam | dvau kṣārau pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇapañcakam
verses.tib: shu dag zi ra tsi tra ka / tsha ba gsum dang khron bu dang / 'bras bu gsum dang thal sman gnyis / ma nu ru rta lan tshwa lnga

verses.skt: viḍaṅgaṃ ca samāṃśāni dantyā bhāgatrayaṃ tathā | trivṛdviśāle dviguṇe sātalā ca caturguṇā
verses.tib: byi dang ga rnams cha mnyam dang / dan da cha gsum de bzhin du / dur byid bi shal nyis 'gyur / sa dal ni bzhi 'gyur te

verses.skt: eṣa nārāyaṇo nāma cūrṇo rogagaṇāpahaḥ | nainaṃ prāpyābhivardhante rogā viṣṇum ivāsurāḥ
verses.tib: phye ma 'di ni sred med du / zhes bya nad kyi tshogs 'joms byed / 'di bsten nad ni mi gnas te / khyab 'jug gis bcom lha min mtshungs

verses.skt: takreṇodaribhiḥ peyo gulmibhir badarāmbunā | ānāhavāte surayā vātaroge prasannayā
verses.tib: dmu rdzing nad la dar ba blud / skran can rgya shug chu sbyar blud / rlung gis lto sbos chang sbyar gtang

verses.skt: dadhimaṇḍena viṭsaṅge dāḍimāmbhobhir arśasaiḥ | parikarte savṛkṣāmlair uṣṇāmbubhir ajīrṇake
verses.tib: rlung nad nyid la chang dngas sbyar / phyis 'gags la zhog chu / gzhang 'brum can la'ang zhog chus / bcad snyam sems la da trig chus / ma zhu ba la chu dron las

verses.skt: bhagandare pāṇḍuroge kāse śvāse galagrahe | hṛdroge grahaṇīdoṣe kuṣṭhe mande ’nale jvare
verses.tib: mtshan bar rdol dang skya rbab dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde skad 'gags / snying dang pho ba'i nad dang ni / mdze dang me drod nyams dang rims

verses.skt: daṃṣṭrāviṣe mūlaviṣe sagare kṛtrime doṣe | yathārhaṃ snigdhakoṣṭhena peyam etad virecanam
verses.tib: mche ba'i dug dang rtsa ba'i dug / dbyig dug sbyar ba'i dug bcas la / ci rigs par ni phye ma 'di / khong pa snum dang ldan pa la / blud nas 'khru ru gzhug par bya

verses.skt: hapuṣāṃ kāñcanakṣīrīṃ triphalāṃ nīlinīphalam | trāyantīṃ rohiṇīṃ tiktāṃ sātalāṃ trivṛtāṃ vacām
verses.tib: spa ma'i 'bras bu bya snu dang / 'bras bu gsum dang ni li ni / pu tse shel dang kyi lce ba / dur byid shu dgas ta

verses.skt: saindhavaṃ kālalavaṇaṃ pippalīṃ ceti cūrṇayet | dāḍimatriphalāmāṃsarasamūtrasukhodakaiḥ
verses.tib: la / rgyam tsha dang ni kha ru tsha / pi pi ling ni phye mar btags / se 'bru'i khu ba'am 'bras bu ni / gsum gyi khu ba'am sha khu'am / ba gcin dro 'jam chu las blud

verses.skt: peyo ’yaṃ sarvagulmeṣu plīhni sarvodareṣu ca | śvitre kuṣṭheṣv ajarake sadane viṣame ’nale
verses.tib: 'dis ni skran nad thams cad dang / mcher pa dmu rdzing thams cad dang / sha bkra mdze nad ma zhu dang / drod nyams me drod ma snyoms dang

verses.skt: śophārśaḥpāṇḍurogeṣu kāmalāyāṃ halīmake | vātapittakaphāṃś cāśu virekeṇa prasādhayet
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum skya rbab mig ser dang / rkang lag zha ba'i nad dang ni / rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan rnams / bkru sman btang bas myur du sel

verses.skt: nīlinīṃ niculaṃ vyoṣaṃ kṣārau lavaṇapañcakam | citrakaṃ ca pibec cūrṇaṃ sarpiṣodaragulmanut
verses.tib: ni li ni dang tsha ba gsum / lcang ma ya bak+Sha ra dang / lan tshwa dang kru trug tres / phye ma zhun mar blud na ni

verses.skt: pūrvavac ca pibed dugdhaṃ kṣāmaḥ śuddho ’ntarāntarā | kārabhaṃ gavyam ājaṃ vā dadyād ātyayike gade
verses.tib: dmu rdzing skran gyi nad rnams sel / sbyang byas nyam chung bar bar du / rnga mo ba'am ra yi ni / 'o ma sngon bzhin blud par bya

verses.skt: snehān eva virekārthe durbalebhyo viśeṣataḥ | harītakīsūkṣmarajaḥprasthayuktaṃ ghṛtāḍhakam
verses.tib: bkru sman phyir ni snum bcas gtang / mchog tu nyam chung gyur la sbyin / a ru ra yi phye ma ni / bre gang mar ni bre bzhi dang

verses.skt: agnau vilāpya mathitaṃ khajena yavapallake | nidhāpayet tato māsād uddhṛtaṃ gālitaṃ pacet
verses.tib: me la bzhus nas gzar bu yis / dkrugs nas nas kyi sbun pa'i nang / zla gcig bzhag nas de rjes la / phyung ste legs par bzhus nas ni

verses.skt: harītakīnāṃ kvāthena dadhnā cāmlena saṃyutam | udaraṃ garaṃ aṣṭhīlām ānāhaṃ gulmavidradhī
verses.tib: a ru ra bskol khu ba dang / zho ni skyur po bcas pa bskol / de 'thungs dmu rdzing skran lto sbos

verses.skt: hanty etat kuṣṭham unmādam apasmāraṃ ca pānataḥ | snukkṣīrayuktād gokṣīrāc chṛtaśītāt khajāhatāt
verses.tib: gtun 'dra'i rlung nad khong 'bras dang / mdze dang smyo byed brjed byed rnams / nye bar 'joms par byed pa yin / shrI khaN+Da ba'i 'o ma / bskol te bsgrangs nas gzar bus dkrugs

verses.skt: yaj jātam ājyaṃ snukkṣīrasiddhaṃ tac ca tathāguṇam | kṣīradroṇaṃ sudhākṣīraprasthārdhasahitaṃ dadhi
verses.tib: las byung mar ni snu ha yi / 'o mar bcas bskol snga mar mtshungs / 'o ma bre ni bcu drug dang / su d+ha k+Shi ra bre phyed bcas

verses.skt: jātaṃ mathitvā tatsarpis trivṛtsiddhaṃ ca tadguṇam | tathā siddhaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ payasy aṣṭaguṇe pibet
verses.tib: zhor gyur bsrubs pa las gyur mar / dur byid bskol ba'ang yon tan de'o / mar ni bre gang dag dang ni / 'o ma brgyad 'gyur nang du ni

verses.skt: snukkṣīrapalakalkena trivṛtāṣaṭpalena ca | eṣāṃ cānu pibet peyāṃ rasaṃ svādu payo ’thavā
verses.tib: snu ha'i 'o ma srang gcig dang / dur byid srang drug bskol de bzhin / 'di blud 'og tu thug pa dang / sha khu mngar po'am 'o ma blud

verses.skt: ghṛte jīrṇe viriktaś ca koṣṇaṃ nāgarasādhitam | pibed ambu tataḥ peyāṃ tato yūṣaṃ kulatthajam
verses.tib: ma zhu 'khrus par gyur pa dang / bca' sga bskol ba'i chu dron blud / de nas thug pa de 'og ni / ku lang+tha yi yu sha blud

verses.skt: pibed rūkṣas tryahaṃ tv evaṃ bhūyo vā pratibhojitaḥ | punaḥ punaḥ pibet sarpir ānupūrvyānayaiva ca
verses.tib: de ltar khong rtsub zhag gsum blud / slar yang thug sogs rim par blud / rim pa 'di dag nyid kyis ni / zhun mar yang dang yang du blud

verses.skt: ghṛtāny etāni siddhāni vidadhyāt kuśalo bhiṣak | gulmānāṃ garadoṣāṇām udarāṇāṃ ca śāntaye
verses.tib: mar ni bskol bar gyur pa 'di / sman pa las la byang ba yis / skran rnams dang ni dbyig dug dang / dmu rdzing bsal phyir blud par bya

verses.skt: pīlukalkopasiddhaṃ vā ghṛtam ānāhabhedanam | tailvakaṃ nīlinīsarpiḥ snehaṃ vā miśrakaṃ pibet
verses.tib: yang na pi lu lde gur bskol / lto sbos sel bar blud par bya / seng phrom ni li ni mar ram / 'dres pa'i sman mar blud par bya

verses.skt: hṛtadoṣaḥ kramād aśnan laghuśālyodanaprati | upayuñjīta jaṭharī doṣaśoṣanivṛttaye
verses.tib: nad bsal nas ni rim gyis zas / sA lu'i 'bras chan yang zhing nyung / byin la dmu rdzing can gyi ni / nad kyi lhag ma dag bya'i phyir

verses.skt: harītakīsahasraṃ vā gomūtreṇa payo'nupaḥ | sahasraṃ pippalīnāṃ vā snukkṣīreṇa subhāvitam
verses.tib: a ru ra ni rdog ma stong / ba gcin dang sbyar 'o ma blud / yang na pi pi ling rdog stong / su d+ha k+Shi rar legs bsres pa'am

verses.skt: pippalīvardhamānaṃ vā kṣīrāśī vā śilājatu | tadvad vā gugguluṃ kṣīraṃ tulyārdrakarasaṃ tathā
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni bskyed sbyin pa'am / 'o mar 'thung zhing brag zhun bza' / de bzhin gu gul 'o ma dang / cha mnyam sge'u gsher khu ba sbyin

verses.skt: citrakāmaradārubhyāṃ kalkaṃ kṣīreṇa vā pibet | māsaṃ yuktas tathā hastipippalīviśvabheṣajam
verses.tib: yang na thang shing tsi tra ka'i / lde gu 'o mar sbyar ba blud / zla gcig ha ti pi pi ling / bca' sga 'o mar bcas pa blud

verses.skt: viḍaṅgaṃ citrako dantī cavyaṃ vyoṣaṃ ca taiḥ payaḥ | kalkaiḥ kolasamaiḥ pītvā pravṛddham udaraṃ jayet
verses.tib: dan da tsi tra byi dang ga / dbyi mo tsha ba gsum lde gu / zho gnyis 'o ma sbyar blud na / dmu rdzing 'phel ba sel bar byed

verses.skt: bhojyaṃ bhuñjīta vā māsaṃ snuhīkṣīraghṛtānvitam | utkārikāṃ vā snukkṣīrapītapathyākaṇākṛtām
verses.tib: yang na su d+ha k+Shir mar / bcas pa'i kha zas zla gcig sbyin / su d+hA k+Shi ra la sbangs ba'i / pi pi ling dang khur ba sbyin

verses.skt: pārśvaśūlam upastambhaṃ hṛdgrahaṃ ca samīraṇaḥ | yadi kuryāt tatas tailaṃ bilvakṣārānvitam pibet
verses.tib: gal te rtsib logs gzer zhing rengs / snying brgal rlung gi nad ldang na / de la til mar bil ba dang / thal sman dang ni ldan par sbyin

verses.skt: pakvaṃ vā ṭuṇṭukabalāpalāśatilanālajaiḥ | kṣāraiḥ kadalyapāmārgatarkārījaiḥ prṭhakkṛtaiḥ
verses.tib: tun tu ka dang ba la dang / ba la sha 'am til sdong dang / a pa marga ka ta li / ag+ni man+thI thal ba rnams

verses.skt: kaphe vātena pitte vā tābhyāṃ vāpy āvṛte ’nile | balinaḥ svauṣadhayutaṃ tailam eraṇḍajaṃ hitam
verses.tib: bad kan rlung ngam mkhris pa'am / de gnyis rlung dang 'dres gyur pa / stobs ldan rang gi sman bcas pa / e raN+Da yi til mar phan

verses.skt: devadārupalāśārkahastipippaliśigrukaiḥ | sāśvakarṇaiḥ sagomūtraiḥ pradihyād udaraṃ bahiḥ
verses.tib: thang shing arga pa la sha / ha ti pi pi ling shi kru / a shwa kar+Na ba gcin bcas / lde gu lto ba'i phyi rim byug

verses.skt: vṛścikālīvacāśuṇṭhīpañcamūlapunarnavāt | varṣābhūdhānyakuṣṭhāc ca kvāthair mūtraiś ca secayet
verses.tib: bri shi kali shu dag dang / bca' sga rtsa ba lnga pa dang / 'u su ru rta ba spru gnyis / bskol / ba ba gcin bcas pa blugs

verses.skt: viriktamlānam udaraṃ sveditaṃ śālvaṇādibhiḥ | vāsasā veṣṭayed evaṃ vāyur nādhmāpayet punaḥ
verses.tib: 'khrus shing lto ba zhum 'gyur ba'i / sa ra na la sogs dugs bya / gos kyis legs par dkri bar bya / de ltar rlung gis spos mi 'gyur

verses.skt: suviriktasya yasya syād ādhmānaṃ punar eva tam | susnigdhair amlalavaṇair nirūhaiḥ samupācaret
verses.tib: gang zhig legs par 'khrus gyur pa / slar yang sbos gyur de la ni / snum bcas skyur dang lan tshwa gnyis / bkru sman mas gtong drag por bya

verses.skt: sopastambho ’pi vā vāyur ādhmāpayati yaṃ naram | tīkṣṇāḥ sakṣāragomūtrāḥ śasyante tasya vastayaḥ
verses.tib: rlung gis rengs dang bcas gyur pas / gang zhig lto sbos gyur pa'i mi / de la thal sman rnon po ni / ba gcin bcas pa mas gtong bya

verses.skt: iti sāmānyataḥ proktāḥ siddhā jaṭhariṇāṃ kriyāḥ | vātodare ’tha balinaṃ vidāryādiśṛtaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: de ltar dmu rdzing spyi yi ni / gso ba grags par bshad pa yin / de nas rlung gyur dmu rdzing can / bi da ri sogs mar bskol blud

verses.skt: pāyayeta tataḥ snigdhaṃ sveditāṅgaṃ virecayet | bahuśas tailvakenainaṃ sarpiṣā miśrakeṇa vā
verses.tib: de nas snum gyis zhen byas shing / yan lag dugs bya bkru sman gtang / 'di la seng phrom mar ram ni / 'dres pa'i sman mar lan mang blud

verses.skt: kṛte saṃsarjane kṣīraṃ balārtham avacārayet | prāg utkleśān nivartyaṃ ca bale labdhe kramāt payaḥ
verses.tib: thug rim pa byas nas ni / stobs bskyed phyir ni 'o ma blud / nyams stobs rnyed nas rim gyis ni / 'o ma de ni spang bar bya

verses.skt: yūṣai rasair vā mandāmlalavaṇair edhitānalam | sodāvartaṃ punaḥ snigdhasvinnam āsthāpayet tataḥ
verses.tib: yu sha sha khu skyur dang ni / lan tshwar bcas pas me drod bskyed / rtug 'gags gyur nas slar snum dang / dugs bya de 'og mas gtong bya

verses.skt: tīkṣṇādhobhāgayuktena daśamūlikavastinā | tilorubūkatailena vātaghnāmlaśṛtena ca
verses.tib: rtsub cing mas gtong sman bcas pa'i / rtsa ba bcu pa'i mas gtong sbyar / g.yo zhing tshigs rus la 'jug pa

verses.skt: sphuraṇākṣepasaṃdhyasthipārśvapṛṣṭhatrikārtiṣu | rūkṣaṃ baddhaśakṛdvātaṃ dīptāgnim anuvāsayet
verses.tib: rtsub cing 'phyen dang phyis 'gags / me drod che la til mar dang / e raN+Da'i mar rlung 'joms pa'i

verses.skt: avirecyasya śamanā vastikṣīraghṛtādayaḥ | balinaṃ svādusiddhena paitte saṃsnehya sarpiṣā
verses.tib: sman dang bskol ba'i 'jam rtsi gtang / khrus mi bya la 'o ma mar / sha khu la sogs zhi byed gtang / mkhris pa las gyur stobs che la / mngar dang sbyar ba'i snum chos bya

verses.skt: śyāmātribhaṇḍītriphalāvipakvena virecayet | sitāmadhughṛtāḍhyena nirūho ’sya tato hitaḥ
verses.tib: sha ma dur byid 'bras bu gsum / bskol ba'i khu ba'i bkru sman gtang / de 'og n+ya gro d+ha sogs bskol / khu bar kha ra sbrang rtsi mar

verses.skt: nyagrodhādikaṣāyeṇa snehavastiś ca tacchṛtaḥ | durbalaṃ tv anuvāsyādau śodhayet kṣīravastibhiḥ
verses.tib: ldan pa ni ru yang phan / de bskol snum gyi 'jam rtsi gtang / nyam chung dang po 'jam rtsi gtang / 'o ma mas gtong ges sbyang bya

verses.skt: jāte cāgnibale snigdhaṃ bhūyo bhūyo virecayet | kṣīreṇa satrivṛtkalkenorubūkaśṛtena vā
verses.tib: me stobs bskyed cing snum chos bya / 'o ma dur byid lde gu'am

verses.skt: sātalātrāyamāṇābhyāṃ śṛtenāragvadhena vā | sakaphe vā samūtreṇa satiktājyena sānile
verses.tib: e raN+Da dang bskol ba'am / sad la dang kyi / lce ba'am / dong ga bskol ba dag gis bya / bad kan bcas la ba gcin bcas / rlung can tig ta mar bcas pa'i

verses.skt: payasānyatamenaiṣāṃ vidāryādiśṛtena vā | bhuñjīta jaṭharaṃ cāsya pāyasenopanāhayet
verses.tib: 'di dag 'o mar bcas bza' ba'am / bi da ri sogs sde bskol blud / dmu rdzing can la 'o thug ni / sbyin zhing nye bar bsku bar bya

verses.skt: punaḥ kṣīraṃ punar vastiṃ punar eva virecanam | krameṇa dhruvam ātiṣṭhan yattaḥ pittodaraṃ jayet
verses.tib: slar yang 'o ma 'jam rtsi dang / bkru sman yang dang yang du gtang / rim pas nges par gnas byas te / ma yengs mkhris gyur dmu rdzing bsal

verses.skt: vatsakādivipakvena kaphe saṃsnehya sarpiṣā | svinnaṃ snukkṣīrasiddhena balavantaṃ virecitam
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur snum chos bya / dug mo nyung sogs mar bskol gtang / nyams stobs ldan pas dugs byas te / su d+ha k+Shi ra'i bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: saṃsarjayet kaṭukṣārayuktair annaiḥ kaphāpahaiḥ | mūtratryūṣaṇatailāḍhyo nirūho ’sya tato hitaḥ
verses.tib: thug sogs rim dang thal sman tsha / ldan pas bad kan sel ba sbyin / ba gcin tsha gsum til mar bcas / mas gtong drag po bya ba'ang phan

verses.skt: muṣkakādikaṣāyeṇa snehavastiś ca tacchṛtaḥ | bhojanaṃ vyoṣadugdhena kaulatthena rasena vā
verses.tib: mung+ga ka sogs lde gu dang / snum gyi 'jam rtsi de nas gtang / kha zas 'o ma tsha ba gsum / yang na rgya sran khu ba sbyin

verses.skt: staimityārucihṛllāse mande ’gnau madyapāya ca | dadyād ariṣṭān kṣārāṃś ca kaphastyānasthirodare
verses.tib: bad kan 'thas shing lto ba skrang / rmongs bag snying 'phar yi ga 'chus / me drod chung ba chang goms na / chang snying nas tshig 'khus thal blud

verses.skt: hiṅgūpakulye triphalāṃ devadāru niśādvayam | bhallātakaṃ śigruphalaṃ kaṭukāṃ tiktakaṃ vacāṃ
verses.tib: shing kun dang ni pi pi ling / 'bras bu gsum dang thang shing dang / ser po rnam gnyis go bye dang / na le sham dkar pu tse shel / seng phrom shu dag bca' sga dang

verses.skt: śuṇṭhīṃ mādrīṃ ghanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ saralaṃ paṭupañcakam | dāhayej jarjarīkṛtya dadhisnehacatuṣkavat
verses.tib: bong nga gla sgang ru rta dang / sa ra na dang lan tshwa dang / btags pa zho dang snum bzhi sbyar

verses.skt: antardhūmaṃ tataḥ kṣārād biḍālapadakaṃ pibet | madirādadhimaṇḍoṣṇajalāriṣṭasurāsavaiḥ
verses.tib: du ba ma shor bar bsregs la / thal ba de las zho gnyis dang / chang dang chu dron zhog chu / chang rnying mnan chang sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: udaraṃ gulmam aṣṭhīlāṃ tūṇyau śophaṃ viṣūcikām | plīhahṛdrogagudajān udāvartaṃ ca nāśayet
verses.tib: skran dang dmu rdzing gtun 'dra'i nad / rtsig pa 'dra dang gsud dang skran / snying nad mcher pa gzhang 'brum dang / rtug 'gags nad rnams 'joms par byed

verses.skt: jayed ariṣṭagomūtracūrṇāyaskṛtipānataḥ | sakṣāratailapānaiś ca durbalasya kaphodaram
verses.tib: bad kan dmu rdzing nyam chung la / chang rnying dang ni bag cin dang / lcags phye dang sbyar btung ba dang / thal sman til mar bcas pa blud

verses.skt: upanāhyaṃ sasiddhārthakiṇvair bījaiś ca mūlakāt | kalkitair udaraṃ svedam abhīkṣṇaṃ cātra yojayet
verses.tib: nyungs kar phabs dang la phug gi / sa bon btab pa'i lde gu yis / bsku zhing dmu rdzing dugs bya ba / 'di la rgyun du sbyang bar bya

verses.skt: saṃnipātodare kuryān nātikṣīṇabalānale | doṣodrekānurodhena pratyākhyāya kriyām imām
verses.tib: 'dus pa las gyur dmu / rdzing ni / me drod nyams stobs ma zad la / nad shas che ltar re thag chad / gso ba'i sbyor ba 'di bya'o

verses.skt: dantīdravantīphalajaṃ tailaṃ pāne ca śasyate | kriyānivṛtte jaṭhare tridoṣe tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: dan da tra pan ti'i 'bras bu / btsir ba'i mar ni blud pa bsngags / dmu rdzing gsos kyang ma 'chos dang / mchog tu nyes gsum las gyur la

verses.skt: dadyād āpṛcchya tajjñātīn pātuṃ madyena kalkitam | mūlaṃ kākādanīguñjākaravīrakasaṃbhavam
verses.tib: de yi nye du dris nas ni / ka ka da ni 'ol ma se / ka ra bI ra'i rtsa ba dag / btags pa'i lde gu chang sbyar blud

verses.skt: pānabhojanasaṃyuktaṃ dadyād vā sthāvaraṃ viṣam | yasmin vā kupitaḥ sarpo vimuñcati phale viṣam
verses.tib: yang na bza' btung nang du ni / dug kyang rim pas sbyin par bya / gang du sbrul ni khros gyur nas / shing tog la ni dug bsgos pa

verses.skt: tenāsya doṣasaṃghātaḥ sthiro līno vimārgagaḥ | bahiḥ pravartate bhinno viṣeṇāśu pramāthinā
verses.tib: de yis 'di yi nad tshogs ni / brtan zhing zhen pa lam log zhugs / bshig ste phyir ni 'byin par byed / dug gis myur du 'jig par byed

verses.skt: tathā vrajaty agadatāṃ śarīrāntaram eva vā | hṛtadoṣaṃ tu śītāmbusnātaṃ taṃ pāyayet payaḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin nad med 'gyur ba'am / 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin / nad bsal nad de chu grang gis / khrus byas 'o ma'am thug pa blud

verses.skt: peyāṃ vā trivṛtaḥ śākaṃ māṇḍūkyā vāstukasya vā | kālaśākaṃ yavākhyaṃ vā khādet svarasasādhitam
verses.tib: dur byid kyi ni tshod ma'am / rgya sne'u mar ti ka par+Ni / ka la sha ka sne'u yi / khu ba dang ni bskol ba la

verses.skt: niramlalavaṇasnehaṃ svinnāsvinnam anannabhuk | māsam ekaṃ tataś caiva tṛṣitaḥ svarasaṃ pibet
verses.tib: skyur dang lan tshwa snum med cing / shin tu tshos pa'am ma tshos min / zas med zla ba gcig sbyin la / de nas skom na khu ba blud

verses.skt: evaṃ vinirhṛte śākair doṣe māsāt paraṃ tataḥ | durbalāya prayuñjīta prāṇabhṛt kārabhaṃ payaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar zla ba gcig gi bar / tshod mas nad ni bsal gyur nas / nyam chung ba la brtas byed pa / rnga mo'i 'o ma blud par bya

verses.skt: plīhodare yathādoṣaṃ snigdhasya sveditasya ca | sirāṃ bhuktavato dadhnā vāmabāhau vimokṣayet
verses.tib: mcher pa'i dmu rdzing nad gzhi ni / ji bzhin snum chos dugs bya ste / zho dang 'bras chan bcas byin la / lag pa g.yon nas gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: labdhe bale ca bhūyo ’pi snehapītaṃ viśodhitam | samudraśuktijaṃ kṣāraṃ payasā pāyayet tathā
verses.tib: nyam stobs rnyed nas slar yang ni / snum blud nas ni sbyang bar bya / rgya mtsho'i nya phyis thal sman dang / 'o ma sbyar ba blud par bya

verses.skt: amlasrutaṃ viḍakaṇācūrṇāḍhyaṃ naktamālajam | śaubhāñjanasya vā kvāthaṃ saindhavāgnikaṇānvitam
verses.tib: pu ti ka rany+dza'i thal ba / skyur khu kha ru tsha dang ni / pi pi ling gi phye btab ba blud / shi kru bskol ba pi pi ling

verses.skt: hiṅgvādicūrṇaṃ kṣārājyaṃ yuñjīta ca yathābalam | pippalīnāgaraṃ dantīsamāṃśaṃ dviguṇābhayam
verses.tib: rgyam tsha tsi tra ka btab blud / shing kun phye thal sman dang / mar sbyar me drod ji bzhin sbyin / dong gra ngan pa pi pi ling / cha mnyam a ru ra nyis 'gyur

verses.skt: viḍārdhāṃśayutaṃ cūrṇam idam uṣṇāmbunā pibet | viḍaṅgaṃ citrakaṃ saktūn saghṛtān saindhavaṃ vacām
verses.tib: kha ru tsha ni cha phyed bcas / phye ma chu dron sbyar ba blud / byi dang ga dang kru trug tres / phye dang rgyam tsha shu dag rnams

verses.skt: dagdhvā kapāle payasā gulmaplīhāpahaṃ pibet | tailonmiśrair badarakapattraiḥ saṃmarditaiḥ samupanaddhaḥ
verses.tib: kham skyogs / nang bsregs 'o mar bcas / blud na skran dang mcher nad 'joms / rgya shug lo ma til mar bsres pa dag / legs par mnyes shing bsregs te de 'og tu

verses.skt: musalena pīḍito ’nu ca yāti plīhā payobhujo nāśam | rohītakalatāḥ k ptāḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ sābhayā jale
verses.tib: gtun bus btsir la de 'og 'o ma blud / mcher pa dmu rdzing tshogs ni 'jig par 'gyur / ro hita yi lcug ma gtubs / dum bu a ru ra bcas chu'am

verses.skt: mūtre vāsunuyāt tac ca saptarātrasthitaṃ pibet | kāmalāplīhagulmārśaḥkṛmimehodarāpaham
verses.tib: ba gcin nang du zhag bdun ni / sbangs la de ni blud gyur na / mig ser mcher pa skran gzhang 'brum / srin nad gcin snyid mu rdzing 'joms

verses.skt: rohītakatvacaḥ kṛtvā palānāṃ pañcaviṃśatim | koladviprasthasaṃyuktaṃ kaṣāyam upakalpayet
verses.tib: ro hi ta ka'i shun lpags ni / srang ni nyi shu rtsa lnga'i tshad / rgya shug bre dor bcas pa ni / bskol ba'i khu ba byas nas ni

verses.skt: pālikaiḥ pañcakolais tu taiḥ samastaiś ca tulyayā | rohītakatvacā piṣṭair ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet
verses.tib: tsha ba lnga ni sring re dang / de dag kun dang mnyam pa yi / ro hi ta ka'i shun lpags phye / mar bre gang dang btsos nas ni

verses.skt: plīhābhivṛddhiṃ śamayaty etad āśu prayojitam | kadalyās tilanālānāṃ kṣāreṇa kṣurakasya ca
verses.tib: 'di blud pa yis myur du ni / mcher pa rab tu 'phel ba sel / chu shing til gyi sdong po dang / bu ram shing bsregs thal ba ni

verses.skt: tailaṃ pakvaṃ jayet pānāt plīhānaṃ kaphavātajam | aśāntau gulmavidhinā yojayed agnikarma ca
verses.tib: til mar bskol ba blud gyur na / bad rlung las gyur mcher nad 'joms / ma zhi skran gyi cho ga ltar / rlung dang bad kan shas che la

verses.skt: aprāptapicchāsalile plīhni vātakapholbaṇe | paittike jīvanīyāni sarpīṃṣi kṣīravastayaḥ
verses.tib: mcher nad spyi bag ma gyur la / me yi las ni spyad par bya / mkhris gyur 'tsho byed sna bcu dang / mar dang 'o ma 'jam rtsi gtang

verses.skt: raktāvasekaḥ saṃśuddhiḥ kṣīrapānaṃ ca śasyate | yakṛti plīhavat karma dakṣiṇe tu bhuje sirām
verses.tib: khrag dbyung sbyang ba bya ba dang / 'o ma blud par gyur pa'ang bsngags / mchin pa mcher pa la ltar gso / gtar ga lag pa g.yas nas bya

verses.skt: svinnāya baddhodariṇe mūtratīkṣṇauṣadhānvitam | satailalavaṇaṃ dadyān nirūhaṃ sānuvāsanam
verses.tib: rgyu ma 'gags gyur dugs byas la / ba gcin sman ni rno bcas pa'i / til mar lan tshwa bcas pa yi / ni ru ha ni 'jam rtsir bya

verses.skt: parisraṃsīni cānnāni tīkṣṇaṃ cāsmai virecanam | udāvartaharaṃ karma kāryaṃ yac cānilāpaham
verses.tib: phyis sla 'gyur kha zas dang / bkru sman rnon po 'di la gtang / rtug 'gags bsal ba'i gso ba ni / rlung 'joms byed pa gang yin bya

verses.skt: chidrodaram ṛte svedāc chleṣmodaravad ācaret | jātaṃ jātaṃ jalaṃ srāvyam evaṃ tad yāpayed bhiṣak
verses.tib: rgyu ma rdol ba'i dmu rdzing la / dugs ma gtogs pa'i gso ba kun / bad kan dmu rdzing lta bur bya / sogs pa bzhin du chu gzags shing / sman pas de ltar 'tsho tsam bya

verses.skt: apāṃ doṣaharāṇy ādau yojayed udakodare | mūtrayuktāni tīkṣṇāni vividhakṣāravanti ca
verses.tib: dmu chu la ni chu yi ni / nyes sel sman ni dang po ni / sman rno ba gcin ldan pa dang / sna tshogs thal sman ldan par sbyin

verses.skt: dīpanīyaiḥ kaphaghnaiś ca tam āhārair upācaret | kṣāraṃ chāgakarīṣāṇāṃ srutaṃ mūtre ’gninā pacet
verses.tib: drod / skyed bad kan 'joms pa yi / zas kyis de ni gso bar bya / ra yi ril ma'i thal ba'i chu / ba gcin bcas gzags me bskol ba

verses.skt: ghanībhavati tasmiṃś ca karṣāṃśaṃ cūrṇitaṃ kṣipet | pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ śuṇṭhī lavaṇapañcakam
verses.tib: ska bar gyur pa de nang du / pi pi ling dang de'i rtsa ba / bca' sga dur byid lan tshwa lnga

verses.skt: nikumbhakumbhatriphalāsvarṇakṣīrīviṣāṇikāḥ | svarjikākṣāraṣaḍgranthāsātalāyavaśūkajam
verses.tib: dan da khron bu 'bras bu gsum / shu dag karka ta sring gi / ya bak+Sha ra pa ta la / swa rdzi kaSha zhes bya ba

verses.skt: kolābhā guṭikāḥ kṛtvā tataḥ sauvīrakāplutāḥ | pibed ajarake śophe pravṛddhe codakodare
verses.tib: rgya shug tsam gyi ri lu bya / de nas skyur rtsabs dang sbyar la / blud na ma zhu 'or nad dang / dmu chu'i nad ni 'phel ba sel

verses.skt: ity auṣadhair apraśame triṣu baddhodarādiṣu | prayuñjīta bhiṣak śastram ārtabandhunṛpārthitaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar sman gyis ma thub na / rgyu 'gags la sogs dmu rdzing gsum / gnyen gyi rgyal po la zhus te / mtshon gyi las ni spyad par bya

verses.skt: snigdhasvinnatanor nābher adho baddhakṣatāntrayoḥ | pāṭayed udaraṃ muktvā vāmataś caturaṅgulāt
verses.tib: rgyu 'gags rdol ba'i dmu rdzing la / snum zhen dugs byas lte ba'i 'og / g.yon logs su ni sor bzhi yi / lto ba'i phyogs su bzhag nas ni

verses.skt: caturaṅgulamānaṃ tu niṣkāsyāntrāṇi tena ca | nirīkṣyāpanayed vālamalalepopalādikam
verses.tib: sor bzhi tsam gyi tshad dbral la / de nas rgyu ma phyung nas ni / btags te spu dang dri ma dang / 'byar bag rdo ba la sogs bsal

verses.skt: chidre tu śalyam uddhṛtya viśodhyāntraparisravam | markoṭair daṃśayec chidraṃ teṣu lagneṣu cāharet
verses.tib: brtol ba zug rngu phyung nas ni / rnam par bsal la gzags par bya / bu ga dbral la 'char gzhug cing

verses.skt: kāyaṃ mūrdhno ’nu cāntrāṇi yathāsthānaṃ niveśayet | aktāni madhusarpirbhyām atha sīvyed bahir vraṇam
verses.tib: zin nas de yi lus kyi ni / mgo bo rnam par gcad par bya / de rjes mar dang sbrang rtsi yis / bskus nas rgyu ma legs par gzhug / de 'og phyi'i ngos nas rma btsem

verses.skt: tataḥ kṛṣṇamṛdālipya badhnīyād yaṣṭimiśrayā | nivātasthaḥ payovṛttiḥ snehadroṇyāṃ vaset tataḥ
verses.tib: de nas sa nag shing mngar gyi / lde gus legs par bsku bar bya / de 'og rlung med gnas su ni / bzhag la 'o mas gsos pa dang / snum gyi snod nas bcing bar bya

verses.skt: sajale jaṭhare tailair abhyaktasyānilāpahaiḥ | svinnasyoṣṇāmbunākakṣam udare paṭṭaveṣṭite
verses.tib: chu bcas dmu rdzing til mar ni / rlung 'joms bskol bas bskus nas ni / chu dron blugs pas dugs bya zhing / lto ba ras kyis dkris nas ni

verses.skt: baddhacchidroditasthāne vidhyed aṅgulamātrakam | nidhāya tasmin nāḍīṃ ca srāvayed ardham ambhasaḥ
verses.tib: rgyu 'gags rdol par bshang nas su / sor gcig tsam ni dbug par bya / der ni gce'u bcug nas ni / de la chu phyed gzags par bya

verses.skt: athāsya nāḍīm ākṛṣya tailena lavaṇena ca | vraṇam abhyajya baddhvā ca veṣṭayed vāsasodaram
verses.tib: de nas gce'u phyung nas ni / til dang rgyam tsha'i lde gu yis / rma bskus nas ni bkag nas su / ras kyis lto ba dkri bar bya

verses.skt: tṛtīye ’hni caturthe vā yāvad āṣoḍaśaṃ dinam | tasya viśramya viśramya srāvayed alpaśo jalam
verses.tib: zhag gsum yang na / zhag bzhi zhing / zhag ni bcu drug bar gyis bya / de ni bar bar dub bsti zhing / chu ni nyung zad nyung zad dbyung

verses.skt: viveṣṭayed gāḍhataraṃ jaṭharaṃ vāsasā ślatham | niḥsrute laṅghitaḥ peyām asnehalavaṇāṃ pibet
verses.tib: lto ni lhod par gyur pa na / shin tu dam du dkri bar bya / chu ni gzags pa smyung byas la / thug pa lan tshwa snum med blud

verses.skt: syāt kṣīravṛttiḥ ṣaṇmāsāṃś trīn peyāṃ payasā pibet | trīṃś cānyān payasaivādyāt phalāmlena rasena vā
verses.tib: zla drug bar du 'o mas gso / zla gsum thug pa 'o thug blud / zla gsum bar du'o thug gam / 'bras bu skyur bcas sha khu ni

verses.skt: alpaśo ’snehalavaṇaṃ jīrṇaṃ śyāmākakodravam | prayato vatsareṇaivaṃ vijayeta jalodaram
verses.tib: lan tshwa snum ni nyung ba blud / khre dang ci tse rnying po sbyin / de ltar lo gcig 'bad pa yis / chu yi dmu rdzing legs par gso

verses.skt: varjyeṣu yantrito diṣṭe nātyadiṣṭe jitendriyaḥ | sarvam evodaraṃ prāyo doṣasaṃghātajaṃ yataḥ
verses.tib: spang ba rnams ni bsdams pa dang / brtan par bya zhing skom med bya / gang phyir dmu rdzing thams cad ni / nad sogs pa las byung bas na

verses.skt: ato vātādiśamanī kriyā sarvatra śasyate | vahnir mandatvam āyāti doṣaiḥ kukṣau prapūrite
verses.tib: de phyir rlung sogs bsal ba yi / gso ba kun la bsngags pa yin / nad kyis lto ba gang 'gyur pas / me drod 'bri bar gyur pa yin

verses.skt: tasmād bhojyāni bhojyāni dīpanāni laghūni ca | sapañcamūlāny alpāmlapaṭusnehakaṭūni ca
verses.tib: de bas nang na drod skyed pa'i / rtsa ba lnga bcas nyung ba dang / lan tshwa snum dang kha ba nyung / 'ju sla'i kha zas sbyin par bya

verses.skt: bhāvitānāṃ gavāṃ mūtre ṣaṣṭikānāṃ ca taṇḍulaiḥ | yavāgūṃ payasā siddhāṃ prakāmaṃ bhojayen naram
verses.tib: ba gcin dang ni sbangs pa yi / drug cu pa yi 'bras dag las / thug pa 'o thug btsos nas ni / ci 'dod par ni sbyin par bya

verses.skt: pibed ikṣurasaṃ cānu jaṭharāṇāṃ nivṛttaye | svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ vrajanty eṣāṃ vātapittakaphās tathā
verses.tib: dmu rdzing skyon ni sbyang ba'i phyir / de rjes bu ram shing khu blud / de ni rlung mkhris bad kan rnams / rang rang gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur

verses.skt: atyarthoṣṇāmlalavaṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ grāhi himaṃ guru | guḍaṃ tailakṛtaṃ śākaṃ vāri pānāvagāhayoḥ
verses.tib: shin tu tsha ba'i chu lan tshwa / rtsub cing bshang sri grang zhing lci / bu ram til g.yos tshod ma dang / chu 'thung lus ni 'khru ba dang

verses.skt: āyāsādhvadivāsvapnayānāni ca parityajet | nātyacchasāndramadhuraṃ takraṃ pāne praśasyate
verses.tib: rtsol drags lam dub nyin mo gnyid / bzhon pas 'gro ba spang bar bya / shin tu ska sla min zhing mngar / dar ba skom du blud pa bsngags

verses.skt: sakaṇālavaṇaṃ vāte pitte soṣaṇaśarkaram | yavānīsaindhavājājīmadhuvyoṣaiḥ kaphodare
verses.tib: rlung la rgyam tsha pi pi ling / mkhris par kar tsha ba gsum / bad kan las gyur la la phud / rgyam tsha zi ra sbrang rtsi dang / tsha ba gsum dang ldan pa sbyin / 'dus pa las gyur sbrang rtsi dang

verses.skt: tryūṣaṇakṣāralavaṇaiḥ saṃyutaṃ nicayodare | madhutailavacāśuṇṭhīśatāhvākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: shu dag til mar bca' sga dang / shu ti ru rta lce myang tsha / mcher pa rgyun 'gags dmu rdzing la / tsha ba gsum dang la la phud

verses.skt: plīhni baddhe tu hapuṣāyavānīpaṭvajājibhiḥ | sakṛṣṇāmākṣikaṃ chidre vyoṣavat salilodare
verses.tib: rgyam tsha go snyod spa 'bras bcas / rgyu rdol sbrang rtsi pi pi ling / tsha ba / gsum dang ldan pa blud / chu yi dmu rdzing can la ni

verses.skt: gauravārocakānāhamandavahnyatisāriṇām | takraṃ vātakaphārtānām amṛtatvāya kalpate
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan gyis gzir zhing / lus lci lto sbos yi ga 'chus / tshad 'khru me drod nyams pa la / dar ba bdud rtsi lta bu yin

verses.skt: prayogāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām anu kṣīraṃ prayojayet | sthairyakṛt sarvadhātūnāṃ balyaṃ doṣānubandhahṛt
verses.tib: sbyor ba kun gyi rjes la ni / 'o ma nye bar sbyar bya ste / lus zungs thams cad brtan byed cing / stobs bskyed nad ni lhag lus sel

verses.skt: bheṣajāpacitāṅgānāṃ kṣīram evāmṛtāyate
verses.tib: sman gyis nyams smad gyur lus la / 'o ma bdud rtsi lta bu yin

verses.skt: pāṇḍvāmayī pibet sarpir ādau kalyāṇakāhvayam | pañcagavyaṃ mahātiktaṃ śṛtaṃ vāragvadhādinā
verses.tib: skya rbab nad la dang por ni / dge ba chen po'i sman mar ram / ba yi lnga dang tig ta che'am / dong ga sogs bskol sman mar blud

verses.skt: dāḍimāt kuḍavo dhānyāt kuḍavārdhaṃ palaṃ palam | citrakāc chṛṅgaverāc ca pippalyardhapalaṃ ca taiḥ
verses.tib: se'u 'bru phul gang 'u su phyed / tsi tra ka dang bca' sga las / srang re pi pi ling srang phyed

verses.skt: kalkitair viṃśatipalaṃ ghṛtasya salilāḍhake | siddhaṃ hṛtpāṇḍugulmārśaḥplīhavātakaphārtinut
verses.tib: lde gur byas pa mar srang ni / nyi shu chu bre bzhi nang bskol / skya rbab snying nad gzhang 'brum skran / mcher rlung bad kan gyis nyen sel

verses.skt: dīpanaṃ śvāsakāsaghnaṃ mūḍhavātānulomanam | duḥkhaprasavinīnāṃ ca vandhyānāṃ ca praśasyate
verses.tib: drod skyed lud pa dbugs mi bde / sel zhing dbugs 'khyil bder 'byung byed / bu btsas dka' dang mo gsham la / 'di ni mchog tu bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: snehitaṃ vāmayet tīkṣṇaiḥ punaḥ snigdhaṃ ca śodhayet | payasā mūtrayuktena bahuśaḥ kevalena vā
verses.tib: snum byas skyug sman rnon po gtang / slar yang snum bcas bkru sman ni / 'o ma gcin sbyar btang ba'am / mkhur bkang lan mang byas pas sbyang

verses.skt: dantīphalarase koṣṇe kāśmaryāñjalim āsutam | drākṣāñjaliṃ vā mṛditaṃ tat pibet pāṇḍurogajit
verses.tib: dan da'i 'bras bu'i khu ba dro / tang pal yang na rgun 'bru ni / srang brgyad zhag gcig spangs mnyes pa / de 'thungs skya rbab nad sel to

verses.skt: mūtreṇa piṣṭāṃ pathyāṃ vā tatsiddhaṃ vā phalatrayam | svarṇakṣīrītrivṛcchyāmābhadradārumahauṣadham
verses.tib: a ru ra btags ba gcin sbyar / yang na de bskol 'bras bu gsum / khron bu ma sha dur byid dang / thang shing bca' sga'i lde gu ni

verses.skt: gomūtrāñjalinā piṣṭaṃ śṛtaṃ tenaiva vā pibet | sādhitaṃ kṣīram ebhir vā pibed doṣānulomanam
verses.tib: ba gcin srang brgyad sbyar ba'am / ba gcig lhan cig bskol ba blud / de dag nyid ni mar bskol ba / blud na'ang nad ni sel bar byed

verses.skt: mūtre sthitaṃ vā saptāhaṃ payasāyorajaḥ pibet | jīrṇe kṣīreṇa bhuñjīta rasena madhureṇa vā
verses.tib: yang na lcags phye ba gcin nam / 'o ma zhag bdun bzhag pa blud / zhu nas kha zas 'o ma'am / sha khu mngar po sbyin par bya

verses.skt: śuddhaś cobhayato lihyāt pathyāṃ madhughṛtadrutām | viśālākaṭukāmustākuṣṭhadārukaliṅgakāḥ
verses.tib: stod smad sbyangs nas a ru ra / sbrang rtsi mar sbyar lde gu sbyin / bi sha la dang pu tse shel / gla sgang ru rta thang shing dang / dug mo nyung ni zho gnyis gnyis

verses.skt: karṣāṃśā dvipicur mūrvā karṣārdhāṃśā ghuṇapriyā | pītvā tac cūrṇam ambhobhiḥ sukhair lihyāt tato madhu
verses.tib: mur ba srang phyed bong nga ni / zho gcig de yi phyer btags chu / dro 'jam sbyar blud sbrang rtsi sbyin

verses.skt: pāṇḍurogaṃ jvaraṃ dāhaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsam arocakam | gulmānāhāmavātāṃś ca raktapittaṃ ca taj jayet
verses.tib: skya rbab rims dang khong tsha dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde skran sbos / yi ga 'chus dang ma zhu rlung / khrag mkhris des ni sel bar byed

verses.skt: vāsāguḍūcītriphalākaṭvībhūnimbanimbajaḥ | kvāthaḥ kṣaudrayuto hanti pāṇḍupittāsrakāmalāḥ
verses.tib: sle tres dang ni ba sha ka / 'bras bu gsum dang pu tse shel / tig ta nim pa rtsa mkhris rnams / bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi ni / btab pa blud na skya rbab dang / mig ser khrag mkhris 'joms par byed

verses.skt: vyoṣāgnivellatriphalāmustais tulyam ayorajaḥ | cūrṇitaṃ takramadhvājyakoṣṇāmbhobhiḥ prayojitam
verses.tib: tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka / 'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga / ga dur dang mnyam lcags kyi phye / mar dang sbrang rtsi dar ba'am / chu dron 'o mar sbyar blud na

verses.skt: kāmalāpāṇḍuhṛdrogakuṣṭhārśomehanāśanam | guḍanāgaramaṇḍūratilāṃśān mānataḥ samān
verses.tib: mig ser skya rbab snying nad dang / mdze dang gzhang 'brum nad rnams sel / dong gra lcags phye til dang ni / bu ram cha mnyam pa yi tshad

verses.skt: pippalīdviguṇān dadyād guṭikāṃ pāṇḍurogiṇe | tāpyaṃ dārvyās tvacaṃ cavyaṃ granthikaṃ devadāru ca
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni nyis 'gyur gzhug / ri lu skya rbab can la sbyin / ta bya skyer pa'i shun pa dang / dbyi mong pi pi ling rtsa ba / thang shing rtsa ba gsum dgu

verses.skt: vyoṣādinavakaṃ caitac cūrṇayed dviguṇaṃ tataḥ | maṇḍūraṃ cāñjananibhaṃ sarvato ’ṣṭaguṇe ’tha tat
verses.tib: phye mar btags pa nyis 'gyur gyi / man du ra'i phye dngul rdo 'dra / de dag gi ni brgyad 'gyur gyi / ba gcin nang du so sor bskol

verses.skt: pṛthag vipakve gomūtre vaṭakīkaraṇakṣame | prakṣipya vaṭakān kuryāt tān khādet takrabhojanaḥ
verses.tib: ri lur bya bar bzod pa dang / gcig tu bsres te ri lur bya / 'di ni ma du ra'i ri lu / de zos dar ba 'thungs na ni

verses.skt: ete maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ prāṇadāḥ pāṇḍurogiṇām | kuṣṭhāny ajarakaṃ śopham ūrustambham arocakam
verses.tib: skya rbab can la srog ster ro / mdze dang ma zhu 'or nad dang / brla rengs yi ga 'chus pa dang

verses.skt: arśāṃsi kāmalāṃ mehān plīhānaṃ śamayanti ca | tāpyādrijaturaupyāyomalāḥ pañcapalāḥ pṛthak
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum mig ser gcin snyi dang / mtsher pa'i nad rnams zhi bar byed / ta bya brag zhun rdul lcags kyi / dri ma sna re srang lnga lnga

verses.skt: citrakatriphalāvyoṣaviḍaṅgaiḥ pālikaiḥ saha | śarkarāṣṭapalonmiśrāś cūrṇitā madhunā drutāḥ
verses.tib: tsi tra ka dang 'bras bu gsum / tsha ba gsum dang bye dang ba / srang re kha ra srang brgyad sbyar / phye ma sbrang rtsis sbrus pa yis

verses.skt: pāṇḍurogaṃ viṣaṃ kāsaṃ yakṣmāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ jvaram | kuṣṭhāny ajarakaṃ mehaṃ śophaṃ śvāsam arocakam
verses.tib: skya rbab dug dang lud pa lu / gcong chen mi bzad rims dang ni / mdze dang ma zhu gcin sri dang / skran dbugs mi bde yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: viśeṣād dhanty apasmāraṃ kāmalāṃ gudajāni ca | kauṭajatriphalānimbapaṭolaghananāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: khyad par du ni brjed byed dang / mig ser / gzhang 'brum nad rnams 'joms / dug mo nyung dang 'bras bu gsum / nim pa gla sgang pa to la / dong gra bskol ba'i khu bar ni

verses.skt: bhāvitāni daśāhāni rasair dvitriguṇāni vā | śilājatupalāny aṣṭau tāvatī sitaśarkarā
verses.tib: brag zhun srang brgyad zhag bcur ram / nyi shu'am sum cu'i bar du sbangs / ka ra dkar po de mnyam dang / smig rkang dang ni pi pi ling

verses.skt: tvakkṣīrīpippalīdhātrīkarkaṭākhyāḥ palonmitāḥ | nidigdhyāḥ phalamūlābhyāṃ palaṃ yuktyā trijātakam
verses.tib: kar ka ta sring skyu ru ra / srang re'i tshad du byas pa dang / kaN+Da ka ri'i rtsa 'bras bu / srang gcig tshad du byas pa dang / dri sna gsum ni zho gnyis gnyis

verses.skt: madhutripalasaṃyuktān kuryād akṣasamān guḍān | dāḍimāmbupayaḥpakṣirasatoyasurāsavān
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi srang gsum byas pa dang / ri lu zho gnyis tshad byas zos / se 'bru'i khu ba 'o ma dang / bya yi sha khu chu dron dang

verses.skt: tān bhakṣayitvānupiben niranno bhukta eva vā | pāṇḍukuṣṭhajvaraplīhatamakārśobhagandaram
verses.tib: de ni zos rjes blud pa'am / zas sngon zas kyi rjes blud na / skya rbab mdze dang rims mcher pa / mgo 'khor gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol

verses.skt: hṛnmūtrapūtiśukrāgnidoṣaśoṣagarodaram | kāsāsṛgdarapittāsṛkśophagulmagalāmayān
verses.tib: rnag dang snying nad khu ba'i nad / gcin nad drod nyams sel byed cing / skem dang sbyar dug dmu rdzing dang / lud pa khrag mkhris gsar pa dang / 'or nad skran dang lkog ma'i nad

verses.skt: mehavardhmabhramān hanyuḥ sarvadoṣaharāḥ śivāḥ | drākṣāprasthaṃ kaṇāprasthaṃ śarkarārdhatulāṃ tathā
verses.tib: rgyu rlugs mgo 'khor bcas pa yi / nad kun sel zhing dge ba yin / rgun 'bru pi pi ling bre re / khar srang ni lnga bcu dang

verses.skt: dvipalaṃ madhukaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ tvakkṣīrīṃ ca vicūrṇitam | dhātrīphalarasadroṇe tat kṣiptvā lehavat pacet
verses.tib: shing mngar bca' sga smig rkang dag / srang ni gnyis gnyis phye mar byas / skyu ru ra khu bre bcu drug / nang gzhug lde gu bzhin du bskal

verses.skt: śītān madhuprasthayutād lihyāt pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ | halīmakaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ kāmalāṃ ca niyacchati
verses.tib: bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi bre gang gzhug / de las zho gnyis tshad zos na / gzugs 'khums skya rbab nad dang ni / mig ser gyi ni nad 'joms so

verses.skt: kanīyaḥpañcamūlāmbu śasyate pānabhojane | pāṇḍūnāṃ kāmalārtānāṃ mṛdvīkāmalakād rasaḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu'i chu / rgun 'bru skyu ru ra'i khu ba / bza' dang btung bar sbyar ba ni / skya rbab mig ser nad sel to

verses.skt: iti sāmānyataḥ proktaṃ pāṇḍuroge bhiṣagjitam | vikalpya yojyaṃ viduṣā pṛthag doṣabalaṃ prati
verses.tib: de ltar skya rbab nad la ni / spyi yi sman ni bstan pa yin / mkhas pas nad dmigs so so yi / stobs dbang las kyang sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: snehaprāyaṃ pavanaje tiktaśītaṃ tu paittike | ślaiṣmike kaṭurūkṣoṣṇaṃ vimiśraṃ sāṃnipātike
verses.tib: rlung gyur phal cher snum chos bya / mkhris par kha dang bsil ba gtang / bad kan las gyur rtsub tsha dro / 'dus par 'dren mar sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: mṛdaṃ niryāpayet kāyāt tīkṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanaiḥ puraḥ | balādhānāni sarpīṃṣi śuddhe koṣṭhe tu yojayet
verses.tib: sa zos las gyur sbyang ba ni / rnon pos lus las bsal bar / bya / de 'og lto sbyang stobs bskyed phyir / de la zhun mar sbyin par bya

verses.skt: vyoṣabilvadvirajanītriphalādvipunarnavam | mustāny ayorajaḥ pāṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ devadāru ca
verses.tib: tsha ba gsum dang bil ba dang / ser po gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum / ba spru ba gnyis gla sgang dang / lcags phye ba ta byi dang ga / thang shing breSh+tsi ka li dang

verses.skt: vṛścikālī ca bhārgī ca sakṣīrais taiḥ śṛtaṃ ghṛtam | sarvān praśamayaty āśu vikārān mṛttikākṛtān
verses.tib: ga bra'i rtsa ba 'o ma mar / bskol ba 'thungs na sa zhag zos / las gyur nad ni thams cad sel

verses.skt: tadvat kesarayaṣṭyāhvapippalīkṣīraśādvalaiḥ | mṛddveṣaṇāya tallaulye vitared bhāvitāṃ mṛdam
verses.tib: de bzhin nA ga ge sar dang / shing mngar ku sha pi pi ling / 'o mar bskol ba blud na phan / de la sred par gyur na ni / byi dang ga dang pa ta dang

verses.skt: vellāgninimbaprasavaiḥ pāṭhayā mūrvayāthavā | mṛdbhedabhinnadoṣānugamād yojyaṃ ca bheṣajam
verses.tib: nim pa bskol ba'i khu ba'am / mur ba dang bsres sa zhag dag / sred pa dgag phyir sbyin par bya / sa zhag bye brag tha dad nad / rjes su mthun pa'i sman sbyin bya

verses.skt: kāmalāyāṃ tu pittaghnaṃ pāṇḍurogāvirodhi yat | pathyāśatarase pathyāvṛntārdhaśatakalkitaḥ
verses.tib: mig ser la ni mkhris 'joms sman / skya rbab gnod pa med pa sbyin / a ru ra ni brgya'i khu bar / a ru ra rdog lnga bcu'i phyed

verses.skt: prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtād gulmakāmalāpāṇḍuroganut | āragvadhaṃ rasenekṣor vidāryāmalakasya vā
verses.tib: mar ni bre gang nang du bskol / skran dang mig ser skya rbab 'joms / dong ga bur shing khu ba'am / bi da ri dang skyu ru ra'i

verses.skt: satryūṣaṇaṃ bilvamātraṃ pāyayet kāmalāpaham | piben nikumbhakalkaṃ vā dviguḍaṃ śītavāriṇā
verses.tib: khu ba tsha ba gsum bcas la / srang gcig blud na mig ser 'joms / dan+da bu ram nyis 'gyur gyi / lde gu chu srang sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: kumbhasya cūrṇaṃ sakṣaudraṃ traiphalena rasena vā | triphalāyā guḍūcyā vā dārvyā nimbasya vā rasam
verses.tib: dur byid phye ma sbrang rtsir bcas / 'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba blud / 'bras bu gsum mam sle tres sam / skyer pa'am nim pa'i khu ba dag

verses.skt: prātaḥ prātar madhuyutaṃ kāmalārtāya yojayet | niśāgairikadhātrībhiḥ kāmalāpaham añjanam
verses.tib: sbrang rtsir sbyar ba nang re ni / mig ser gyis ni nyen la blud / skyer pa yug snam skyu ru ra / mig ser sel ba'i mig sman yin

verses.skt: tilapiṣṭanibhaṃ yas tu kāmalāvān sṛjen malam | kapharuddhapathaṃ tasya pittaṃ kaphaharair jayet
verses.tib: mig ser can gang dri ma ni / til btags lta bur byung gyur na / bad kan lam bkag de la ni / bad kan mkhris pa sel bas gso

verses.skt: rūkṣaśītagurusvāduvyāyāmabalanigrahaiḥ | kaphasaṃmūrchito vāyur yadā pittaṃ bahiḥ kṣipet
verses.tib: rtsub grang lci dang mngar ba dang / drag shul rlung ni 'gags pa yis / rlung dang bad kan gcig gyur pa / mkhris pa phyir 'byin de yi tshe

verses.skt: hāridranetramūtratvak śvetavarcās tadā naraḥ | bhavet sāṭopaviṣṭambho guruṇā hṛdayena ca
verses.tib: mig dang pags pa ser ba dang / phyis skya bar gyur pa dang / bshang 'gags rgyu ma 'khrugs pa dang / snying ga lci ba nyid 'gyur la

verses.skt: daurbalyālpāgnipārśvārtihidhmāśvāsārucijvaraiḥ | krameṇālpe ’nuṣajyeta pitte śākhāsamāśrite
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i yan lag la brten pa / rid cing drod chung rtsib / logs gzer / skyigs bu lud pa yi ga 'chus / rims 'debs rim gyis 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: rasais taṃ rūkṣakaṭvamlaiḥ śikhitittiridakṣajaiḥ | śuṣkamūlakajair yūṣaiḥ kulatthotthaiś ca bhojayet
verses.tib: de la rma bya'am khyim bya dang / sreg pa'i sha khu'am la phug ni / skam sa'i khu ba'am rgya sran khu / rtsub kha skyur bar sbyar ba sbyin

verses.skt: bhṛśāmlatīkṣṇakaṭukalavaṇoṣṇaṃ ca śasyate | sabījapūrakarasaṃ lihyād vyoṣaṃ tathāśayam
verses.tib: rab tsha skyur dang rno ba dang / lan tshwa shin tu dro ba'ang bsngags / kha lung khu ba tsha ba gsum / sbyar ba'i lde gu'ang sbyin par bya

verses.skt: svaṃ pittam eti tenāsya śakṛd apy anurajyate | vāyuś ca yāti praśamaṃ sahāṭopādyupadravaiḥ
verses.tib: des ni mkhris pa rang gnas su / 'jug cing bshang mdog tha mal 'gyur / rgyu ma 'khrugs sogs bla brnan bcas / rlung yang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: nivṛttopadravasyāsya kāryaḥ kāmaliko vidhiḥ | gomūtreṇa pibet kumbhakāmalāyāṃ śilājatu
verses.tib: 'di yis bla brnan zhi nas ni / mig ser gso ba'i cho ga bya / mig ser khong du zhen pa na / brag zhun ba gcin dang sbyar ba

verses.skt: māsaṃ mākṣikadhātuṃ vā kiṭṭaṃ vātha hiraṇyajam | guḍūcīsvarasakṣīrasādhitena halīmakī
verses.tib: gser gyi dri ma'am ta bya ni / ba gcin sbyar ba zla gcig blud / ha lis ka sle tres khu / 'o ma ma he'i mar bskol ba'i

verses.skt: mahiṣīhaviṣā snigdhaḥ pibed dhātrīrasena tu | trivṛtāṃ tadvirikto ’dyāt svādu pittānilāpaham
verses.tib: skyu ru ra yi khu ba dang / dur byid sbyar ba'i bkru sman blud / 'khrus nas kha zas mngar bag ni / rlung 'joms mkhris pa 'joms pa sbyin

verses.skt: drākṣālehaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ sarpīṃṣi madhurāṇi ca | yāpanān kṣīravastīṃś ca śīlayet sānuvāsanān
verses.tib: sngar bshad rgun 'bru lde gu dang / mngar ba'i sman mar zhun mar sbyin / 'o ma mas gtong sman dang ni / 'jam rtsir bcas pa bsten par bya

verses.skt: mārdvīkāriṣṭayogāṃś ca pibed yuktyāgnivṛddhaye | kāsikaṃ cābhayālehaṃ pippalīṃ madhukaṃ balām
verses.tib: me drod bskyed par bya ba'i phyir / rgun chang chang rnying sbyin bya zhing / lud pa'i skabs bshad a ru ra'i / shing mngar ra dar ba pi pi ling

verses.skt: payasā ca prayuñjīta yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam | pāṇḍurogeṣu kuśalaḥ śophoktaṃ ca kriyākramam
verses.tib: 'o mar bcas pas nad dmigs dang / me drod ji bzhin sbyin par bya / mkhas pas 'or nad skabs bshad pa'i / gso ba skya rbab la yang sbyar

verses.skt: ayastilatryūṣaṇakolabhāgaiḥ sarvaiḥ samaṃ mākṣikadhātucūrṇam | tair modakaḥ kṣaudrayuto ’nutakraḥ pāṇḍvāmaye dūragate ’pi śastaḥ || 57+1 ||
sarvatra sarvāṅgasare doṣaje śvayathau purā | sāme viśoṣito bhuktvā laghu koṣṇāmbhasā pibet
verses.tib: 'or nad yan lag kun zhugs shing / nad skyes ma smin la dang por / smyung byas kha zas yang ba bza'

verses.skt: nāgarātiviṣādāruviḍaṅgendrayavoṣaṇam | athavā vijayāśuṇṭhīdevadārupunarnavam
verses.tib: bong nga thang shing byi dang ga / dug mo nyung dang na le sham / bskol ba'i chu dron blud par bya / yang na a ru ra bca' sga

verses.skt: navāyasaṃ vā doṣāḍhyaḥ śuddhyai mūtraharītakīḥ | varākvāthena kaṭukākumbhāyastryūṣaṇāni ca
verses.tib: lcags phye dgu par bcas pa blud / 'or nad shas cher a ru ra / ba / gcin bcas pa sbyang phyir blud / 'bras bu gsum bskol pu tse shel / dur byid lcags phye tsha gsum bcas

verses.skt: athavā gugguluṃ tadvaj jatu vā śailasaṃbhavam | mandāgniḥ śīlayed āmagurubhinnavibandhaviṭ
verses.tib: yang na de bzhin gu gul lam / brag zhun dang ni sbyar ba blud / me drod chung zhing ma smin la / lci zhing rtug 'gags yang na 'khru / tsha ba gsum dang rtsab ru tsha

verses.skt: takraṃ sauvarcalavyoṣakṣaudrayuktaṃ guḍābhayām | takrānupānām athavā tadvad vā guḍanāgaram
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi dar bar sbyar ba'am / a ru ra dang bu ram bcas / bu ram bca' sgar sbyar ba'am / zos rjes dar ba blud par bya

verses.skt: ārdrakaṃ vā samaguḍaṃ prakuñcārdhavivardhitam | paraṃ pañcapalaṃ māsaṃ yūṣakṣīrarasāśanaḥ
verses.tib: sge'u gsher bu ram cha mnyam pa / srang phyed tshad kyis bskyed nas ni / che tshad srang lnga'i bar du ni / zla gcig za zhing yu sha dang / 'o ma sha khu bcas zos na

verses.skt: gulmodarārśaḥśvayathupramehāñ chvāsapratiśyālasakāvipākān | sakāmalāśoṣamanovikārān kāsaṃ kaphaṃ caiva jayet prayogaḥ
verses.tib: 'or nad dmu rdzing skran gzhang 'brum / gcin dang dbugs mi bde cham pa / sgyid snyom ma zhu mig ser dang / lus skem gdon gyi nad rnams dang / lud pa bad kan sbyor 'dis sel

verses.skt: ghṛtam ārdrakanāgarasya kalkasvarasābhyāṃ payasā ca sādhayitvā | śvayathukṣavathūdarāgnisādair abhibhūto ’pi piban bhavaty arogaḥ
verses.tib: sge'u gsher dong gra lde gu'i khu ba dang / 'o ma dag dang mar ni bskol blud na / 'or nad sbrid pa dmu rdzing me drod nyams / nad kyis zil non na yang nad med 'gyur

verses.skt: rasas tathaivārdrakanāgarasya peyo ’tha jīrṇe payasānnam adyāt | śilāhvayaṃ vā triphalārasena hanyāt tridoṣaṃ śvayathuṃ prasahya
punarnavānimbapaṭolaśuṇṭhī tiktāmṛtādārvyabhayākaṣāyaḥ | sarvāṅgaśophodarakāsaśūlaśvāsānvitaṃ pāṇḍugadaṃ ca hanti
nirāmo baddhaśamalaḥ pibec chvayathupīḍitaḥ | trikaṭutrivṛtādantīcitrakaiḥ sādhitaṃ payaḥ
verses.tib: ma zhu med cing phyi sa 'gags / 'or nad kyis gzir tsha ba gsum / dur byid dan da kru trug tres / bskol ba'i 'o ma blud par bya

verses.skt: mūtraṃ gor vā mahiṣyā vā sakṣīraṃ kṣīrabhojanaḥ | saptāhaṃ māsaṃ athavā syād uṣṭrakṣīravartanaḥ
verses.tib: ma he'am yang na ba gcin nam / 'o ma btung zhing de dang bza' / zhag bdun yang na zla gcig par / rnga mo'i 'o ma blud pas gso

verses.skt: yavānakaṃ yavakṣāraṃ yavānīṃ pañcakolakam | maricaṃ dāḍimaṃ pāṭhāṃ dhānakām amlavetasam
verses.tib: ti mu sa dang nas tshig thal / la la phud dang tsha ba lnga / na le sham dang se 'bru dang / pa ta 'u su star bu dang

verses.skt: bālabilvaṃ ca karṣāṃśaṃ sādhayet salilāḍhake | tena pakvo ghṛtaprasthaḥ śophārśogulmamehahā
verses.tib: bil ba gzhon nu zho gnyis gnyis / chu bre bzhi bskol mar bre gang / bskol ba blud na 'or nad dang / gzhang 'brum skran dang za khu 'joms

verses.skt: dadhnaś citrakagarbhād vā ghṛtaṃ tattakrasaṃyutam | pakvaṃ sacitrakaṃ tadvad guṇair yuñjyāc ca kālavit
verses.tib: zho dang tsi tra ka bsres las / byung ba'i mar ni dar bar bcas / tsi tra ka btab bskol ba ni / yon tan gong ma mtshungs pa yin

verses.skt: dhānvantaraṃ mahātiktaṃ kalyāṇam abhayāghṛtam | daśamūlakaṣāyasya kaṃse pathyāśataṃ pacet
verses.tib: thang la 'bar dang tig ta che / dge ba'am a ru ra'i sman mar / dus shes pa yis sbyin par bya / rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu ba ni

verses.skt: dattvā guḍatulāṃ tasmin lehe dadyād vicūrṇitam | trijātakaṃ trikaṭukaṃ kiñcic ca yavaśūkajam
verses.tib: der ni bu ram srang brgya gzhug / tsha ba gsum dang dri sna / gsum / nas tshig 'khus thal cung zad btab

verses.skt: prasthārdhaṃ ca hime kṣaudrāt tan nihanty upayojitam | pravṛddhaśophajvaramehagulmakārśyāmavātāmlakaraktapittam | vaivarṇyamūtrānilaśukradoṣaśvāsāruciplīhagarodaraṃ ca
verses.tib: bsgrangs nas sbrang rtsi bre phyed gzhug / de byin nas ni 'or nad dang / rims skran gcin nad lus skem pa / ma zhu khrag mkhris rlung dang ni / sgregs skyur kha dog mi sdug dang / gcin nad rlung gi khu chu'i nad / dbugs mi bde dang yi ga 'chus / mcher pa'i nad dang sbyar ba'i dug

verses.skt: purāṇayavaśālyannaṃ daśamūlāmbusādhitam
verses.tib: nas dang sA lu 'bras rnying zas / rtsa ba bcu ba'i chu dang bskol

verses.skt: alpam alpapaṭusnehaṃ bhojanaṃ śvayathor hitam | kṣāravyoṣānvitair maudgaiḥ kaulatthaiḥ sakaṇai rasaiḥ
verses.tib: lan tshwa nyung zhing snum shas chung / byin na 'or nad sel bar byed / rgya sran mung+ga'i khu ba ni / thal sman rtsa ba gsum dang ldan

verses.skt: tathā jāṅgalajaiḥ kūrmagodhāśalyakajair api | anamlaṃ mathitaṃ pāne madyāny auṣadhavanti ca
verses.tib: de bzhin skam sa'i sha rus sbal / skyin gor byi dur sha khu sbyin / btung ba dar ba gsar pa dang / chang ni sman dang bcas pa blud

verses.skt: ajājīśaṭhījivantīkāravīpauṣkarāgnikaiḥ | bilvamadhyayavakṣāravṛkṣāmlair badaronmitaiḥ
verses.tib: zi ra zur pa dzi ban ti / ma nu tsi tra ka ra dang / ya bak+Sha ra bil ba'i rkang / da trig zho re'i tshad du byas

verses.skt: kṛtā peyājyatailābhyāṃ yuktibhṛṣṭā paraṃ hitā | śophātīsārahṛdrogagulmārśo'lpāgnimehinām
verses.tib: mar dang til mar nang du brngos / byin na 'or nad skran gzhang 'brum / tshang 'khru dang ni snying gi nad / me drod chung dang gcin nad sel

verses.skt: guṇais tadvac ca pāṭhāyāḥ pañcakolena sādhitā | śaileyakuṣṭhasthauṇeyareṇukāgurupadmakaiḥ
verses.tib: tsha ba lnga dang sbyar ba yi / thug pa'ang yon tan de dang 'dra / rdo dreg ru rta ston ne ya / ha re Nu ka a ru ra / shri be ta ka shug pa dang

verses.skt: śrīveṣṭakanakhaspṛkkādevadārupriyaṅgubhiḥ | māṃsīmāgadhikāvanyadhānyadhyāmakavālakaiḥ
verses.tib: chu srin sder mo pri yang ku / pri ka thang shing spang spos dang / pi pi ling dang dbyi mo dang / ku nan na ta bya ma ka

verses.skt: caturjātakatālīśamustāgandhapalāśakaiḥ | kuryād abhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ lepaṃ snānāya tūdakam
verses.tib: ma li ka dang dri sna bzhi / bal bu'i lo ma gla sgang dang / gan+d+ha pa la sha la ni / bsku ba'i til mar dag dang ni / khrus kyi chu dang lde gu bya

verses.skt: snānaṃ vā nimbavarṣābhūnaktamālārkavāriṇā | ekāṅgaśophe varṣābhūkaravīrakakiṃśukaiḥ
verses.tib: nim pa arga ba spru ba / nag tam la'i chus khrus bya / yan lag phyogs gcig skrangs pa la / ka ra bIr ba spu ba / ki shu ka dang pi la sha

verses.skt: viśālātriphalālodhranalikādevadārubhiḥ | hiṃsrākośātakīmādrītālaparṇījayantibhiḥ
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang seng phrom dang / na li ka dang thang shing dang / spang spos ko sha ta ki dang / bong nga ta la'i lo ma dang

verses.skt: sthūlakākādanīśālanākulīvṛṣaparṇibhiḥ | vṛddhyarddhihastikarṇaiś ca sukhoṣṇair lepanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: dza yan ti dang 'ol ma se / ka ka dang ni sa le shing / pri sha kar+Ni byi mo dang / ri ti bri ti glang po'i sna / lde gu dro 'jam bskus pas phan

verses.skt: athānilotthe śvayathau māsārdhaṃ trivṛtaṃ pibet | tailam eraṇḍajaṃ vātaviḍvibandhe tad eva tu
verses.tib: de nas rlung gyur 'or nad la / zla phyed bar du dur byid dam / yang na e raN+Da mar blud / rlung gi rtug 'gags la de nyid

verses.skt: prāgbhaktaṃ payasā yuktaṃ rasair vā kārayet tathā | svedābhyaṅgān samīraghnān lepam ekāṅgage punaḥ
verses.tib: zas kyi sngon du 'o ma 'am / sha khu blud cing rlung 'joms pa'i / sman gyi dugs dang bsku ba bya / phyogs gcig skrangs la kha lud dang

verses.skt: mātuluṅgāgnimanthena śuṇṭhīhiṃsrāmarāhvayaiḥ | paitte tiktaṃ pibet sarpir nyagrodhādyena vā śṛtam
verses.tib: ag+ni man+tha spang spos dang / bca' sga thang shing lde gu bsku / mkhris gyur tig ta'i sman mar dang / n+ya gro d+ha sogs bskol ba blud

verses.skt: kṣīraṃ tṛḍdāhamoheṣu lepābhyaṅgāś ca śītalāḥ | paṭolamūlatrāyantīyaṣṭyāhvakaṭukābhayāḥ
verses.tib: skom dad che dang rmongs bag tsha / 'o ma bsku byug bsil ba bya / pa to la rtsa kyi lce ba / shing mngar thang shing pu tse shel

verses.skt: dāru dārvī himaṃ dantī viśālā niculaṃ kaṇā | taiḥ kvāthaḥ saghṛtaḥ pīto hanty antastāpatṛḍbhramān
verses.tib: skyer pa tsan+dan a ru ra / da na lcang ma bi la sha / pi pi ling dang mar bskol blud / khong tsha mgo 'khor skom dad che

verses.skt: sasaṃnipātavīsarpaśophadāhaviṣajvarān | āragvadhādinā siddhaṃ tailaṃ śleṣmodbhave pibet
verses.tib: 'dus pa'i nad dang me dbal skrang / lus tsha rims dang bcas pa sel / bad kan las gyur dong gra sogs / til mar dang ni bskol ba blud

verses.skt: srotovibandhe mande ’gnāv arucau stimitāśayaḥ | kṣāracūrṇāsavāriṣṭamūtratakrāṇi śīlayet
verses.tib: rgyun srang 'gags shing me drod nyams / rmongs bag yi ga 'chus pa la / thal sman chang rnying mnan chang dang

verses.skt: kṛṣṇāpurāṇapiṇyākaśigrutvaksikatātasīḥ | praleponmardane yuñjyāt sukhoṣṇā mūtrakalkitāḥ
verses.tib: ba gcin dar bar bcas pa blud / pi pi ling dang 'ba' cha rnying / shi kru'i shun pa zur pa dang

verses.skt: snānaṃ mūtrāmbhasī siddhe kuṣṭhatarkāricitrakaiḥ | kulatthanāgarābhyāṃ vā caṇḍāguru vilepane
verses.tib: ba gcin lde gu dro 'jam sbyar / bsku dang dril ba'i las la sbyar / ru rta ag+ni man+tha dang

verses.skt: kālājaśṛṅgīsaralabastagandhāhayāhvayāḥ | ekaiṣīkā ca lepaḥ syāc chvayathāv ekagātrage
verses.tib: rgya sran dong ga tsi tra ka / ba gcin chu bskol bas khrus bya / tsa rong a ka ru yis byug / na ga ba ra sa ral / a za sring gi am pa ta / a za gan+d+ha zhes bya dang / a shwa gan+d+ha'i lde gu ni / yan lag phyogs gcig skrangs la phan

verses.skt: yaṣṭīdugdhatilair lepo navanītena saṃyutaḥ | śopham āruṣkaraṃ hanti vṛntaiḥ śāladalasya vā
verses.tib: rgya sran dong ga tsi tra ka / ba gcin chu bskol bas khrus bya / tsa rong a ka ru yis byug / na ga ba ra sa ral / a za sring gi am pa ta / a za gan+d+ha zhes bya dang / a shwa gan+d+ha'i lde gu ni / yan lag phyogs gcig skrangs la phan

verses.skt: yathādoṣaṃ yathāsannaṃ śuddhiṃ raktāvasecanam | kurvīta miśradoṣe tu doṣodrekabalāt kriyām
verses.tib: nad gzhi ji bzhin yan lag ni / nye ba'i phyogs nas gtar ga bya / 'dres pa'i nad la nad gzhi ni / shas che'i dbang du gso ba bya

verses.skt: ajājipāṭhāghanapañcakolavyāghrīrajanyaḥ sukhatoyapītāḥ | śophaṃ tridoṣaṃ cirajaṃ pravṛddhaṃ nighnanti bhūnimbamahauṣadhe ca
verses.tib: go snyod pa ta gla sgang dang / kaN+Da ka ri tsha ba lnga / skyer pa chu dron sbyar blud pa / rtsa mkhris bca' sga chu dron blud / nad gzhi gsum gyi 'or nad ni / yun lon zhing tshabs chen sel

verses.skt: amṛtādvitayaṃ śivātikā surakāṣṭhaṃ sapuraṃ sagojalam | śvayathūdarakuṣṭhapāṇḍutākṛmimehordhvakaphānilāpaham
verses.tib: sle tres dang ni a ru ra / thang shing gu gul ba spru ba / ba gcin sbyar blud dmu rdzing dang / mdze dang skya rbab srin bu'i nad / gcin nad bad kan za khu dang / rlung ni stod du 'byams pa sel

verses.skt: iti nijam adhikṛtya pathyam uktaṃ kṣatajanite kṣatajaṃ viśodhanīyam | srutihimaghṛtalepasekarekair viṣajanite viṣajic ca śopha iṣṭam
verses.tib: de ltar rang rang nad kyi dbang byas bshad / snad pa las byung ba la khrag dbyung zhing / bsil sman mar khu byugs shing blugs par bya / dug skyes skrang la dug sel sbyor ba bya

verses.skt: grāmyābjānūpaṃ piśitam abalaṃ śuṣkaśākaṃ tilānnaṃ | gauḍaṃ piṣṭānnaṃ dadhi salavaṇaṃ vijjalaṃ madyam amlam | dhānā vallūraṃ samaśanam atho gurv asātmyaṃ vidāhi | svapnaṃ cārātrau śvayathugadavān varjayen maithunaṃ ca
verses.tib: grong dang rlan can chur gnas sha rid rlon / tshod skam til gyi zas dang bu ram can / phyer btags zas dang zho dang lan tshwa dang / kha zas rul bag chang skyur yos sha skam / 'dres pa'i zas dang lci dang ma goms za / mtshan mo gnyid ma log dang nyal po rnams / 'or nad can gyis de dag thams cad spang

verses.skt: ādāv eva visarpeṣu hitaṃ laṅghanarūkṣaṇam | raktāvaseko vamanaṃ virekaḥ snehanaṃ na tu
verses.tib: med bal nad la thog ma nyid / smyung ba dang ni rtsub chos dang / khrag dbyung skyug sman bkru sman gtang / snum chos spyad par mi bya'o

verses.skt: pracchardanaṃ visarpaghnaṃ sayaṣṭīndrayavaṃ phalam | paṭolapippalīnimbapallavair vā samanvitam
verses.tib: po son cha dang dug mo nyung / shing mngar bcas pa'am pa to la / nim pa'i lo ma pi pi ling / skyug sman btang na me dbal 'joms

verses.skt: rasena yuktaṃ trāyantyā drākṣāyās traiphalena vā | virecanaṃ trivṛccūrṇaṃ payasā sarpiṣāthavā
verses.tib: kyi lce ba yi khu ba'am / rgun 'bru 'bras bu gsum yang rung / dur byid phye ma btab pa'am / 'o ma mar sbyar bkru sman ni

verses.skt: yojyaṃ koṣṭhagate doṣe viśeṣeṇa viśodhanam | aviśodhyasya doṣe ’lpe śamanaṃ candanotpalam
verses.tib: khong ni zhen pa'i nad la ni / khyad par du ni sbyang ba gtang / sbyang min nad tshabs chung ba la

verses.skt: mustanimbapaṭolaṃ vā paṭolādikam eva vā | śārivāmalakośīramustaṃ vā kvathitaṃ jale
verses.tib: zhi sman tsan+dan ut+pal gtang / gla sgang nim pa pa to la / pa to la sogs nyid dag gam

verses.skt: durālabhāṃ parpaṭakaṃ guḍūcīṃ viśvabheṣajam | pākyaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā tṛṣṇāvisarpavān pibet
verses.tib: thal tres gla sgang skyu ru ra / pu shel tse ni chu bskol blud / me dbal skom dad can la ni

verses.skt: dārvīpaṭolakaṭukāmasūratriphalās tathā | sanimbayaṣṭītrāyantīḥ kvathitā ghṛtamūrchitāḥ
verses.tib: byi tsher ba dang par ba ta / sle tres bca' sga bskol ba ni / khu ba bsgrangs par blud par bya

verses.skt: amṛtavṛṣapaṭolaṃ mustakaṃ saptaparṇaṃ | khadiram asitavetraṃ nimbapattraṃ haridre | vividhaviṣavisarpān kuṣṭhavisphoṭakaṇḍūr | apanayati masūrīṃ śītapittaṃ jvaraṃ ca
verses.tib: skyer pa sran chung pu tse shel / pa to la dang 'bras bu gsum / nim pa shing mngar gyi lce ba / yan lag nad zhugs nad khrag nyid

verses.skt: śākhāduṣṭe tu rudhire raktam evādito haret | tvaṅmāṃsasnāyusaṃkledo raktakledād dhi jāyate
verses.tib: thog ma nyid du khrag dbyung bya / pags pa sha dang rgyus pa 'drul / khrag rul ba las byung ba yin

verses.skt: nirāme śleṣmaṇi kṣīṇe vātapittottare hitam | ghṛtaṃ tiktaṃ mahātiktaṃ śṛtaṃ vā trāyamāṇayā
verses.tib: smin zhing bad kan zad pa dang / rlung dang mkhris pa shas che la / tig ta tig ta / chen po'i mar / kyi lce ba bskol mar phan no

verses.skt: nirhṛte ’sre viśuddhe ’ntardoṣe tvaṅmāṃsasaṃdhige | bahiḥkriyāḥ pradehādyāḥ sadyo visarpaśāntaye
verses.tib: khrag dbyung khong pa dag gyur nas / nad ni sha lpags la gnas na / phyi rol na[+]sa ni byug kyis / 'phral du me dbal zhi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: śatāhvāmustavārāhīvaṃśārtagaladhānyakam | surāhvā kṛṣṇagandhā ca kuṣṭhaṃ cālepanaṃ cale
verses.tib: rlung gyur shu ti gla sgang dang / 'o ma 'u su pa ra hi / a ta ka la pi pi ling / thang shing sha kru ru rta yi / lde gu byug pa byas na phan

verses.skt: nyagrodhādigaṇaḥ pitte tathā padmotpalādikam | nyagrodhapādās taruṇāḥ kadalīgarbhasaṃyutāḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa n+ya gro d+ha sogs sde / de bzhin pad+ma ut+pal sogs / n+ya gro d+ha'i rtsa gzhon nu dang / chu shing nang gi lo mar bcas

verses.skt: bisagranthiś ca lepaḥ syāc chatadhautaghṛtāplutaḥ | padminīkardamaḥ śītaḥ piṣṭaṃ mauktikam eva vā
verses.tib: pad+ma'i rtsa ba lde gu dang / lan brgya bkrus pa'i mar gyis byug / pad+ma can gyi 'dam bsil ba'am / mu tig btags par gyur pa la

verses.skt: śaṅkhaḥ pravālaṃ śuktir vā gairikaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam | triphalāpadmakośīrasamaṅgākaravīrakam
verses.tib: dung ngam byu ru nya phyis sam / yug snam mar dang bcas pa byug / bad kan las gyur 'bras bu gsum / shug pa btsod dang pu tse shel

verses.skt: nalamūlāny anantā ca lepaḥ śleṣmavisarpahā | dhavasaptāhvakhadiradevadārukuraṇṭakam
verses.tib: ka ra bI ra 'dam bu'i rtsa / a nan ta yi lde gu bsku / da ba lo ma bdun pa dang / seng ldeng thang shing bkru sman dang

verses.skt: samustāragvadhaṃ lepo vargo vā varuṇādikaḥ | āragvadhasya pattrāṇi tvacaḥ śleṣmātakodbhavāḥ
verses.tib: gla sgang dong grar bcas pa'am / ba ra Na lde gu bsku / dong ga yi ni lo ma dang / sle sman ta ka'i shun lpags dang

verses.skt: indrāṇiśākaṃ kākāhvā śirīṣakusumāni ca | sekavraṇābhyaṅgahavirlepacūrṇān yathāyatham
verses.tib: in+d+ra ba ru na'i lo ma / shri sha 'ol ma se me tog / chu blugs rma bsku sman mar dang / lde gu'i phye ma ji bzhin du

verses.skt: etair evauṣadhaiḥ kuryād vāyau lepā ghṛtādhikāḥ | kaphasthānagate sāme pittasthānagate ’thavā
verses.tib: sman ni 'di dag nyid kyis bya / rlung rgyas mar ni shas cher bya / bad kan gnas shes ma smin la / dro dang rtsub pa shas cher sbyar / de bzhin mkhris pa'i gnas zhugs la / khrag mkhris lan mar ldan bya / shin tu bsil zhing srab pa dang / gos srab nang du bzhag pa ni

verses.skt: aśītoṣṇā hitā rūkṣā raktapitte ghṛtānvitāḥ | atyarthaśītās tanavas tanuvastrāntarāsthitāḥ
verses.tib: sman ni 'di dag nyid kyis bya / rlung rgyas mar ni shas cher bya / bad kan gnas shes ma smin la / dro dang rtsub pa shas cher sbyar / de bzhin mkhris pa'i gnas zhugs la / khrag mkhris lan mar ldan bya / shin tu bsil zhing srab pa dang / gos srab nang du bzhag pa ni

verses.skt: yojyāḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ’nye ’nye mandavīryās ta eva ca | saṃsṛṣṭadoṣe saṃsṛṣṭam etat karma praśasyate
verses.tib: nus pa chung ba yang dang yang / gzhan dang gzhan ni sbyar bar bya / 'dres pa'i nad la las 'di ni / 'dren mar bya ba bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: śatadhautaghṛtenāgniṃ pradihyāt kevalena vā | secayed ghṛtamaṇḍena śītena madhukāmbunā
verses.tib: me ltar tsha lan brgyar ni / bkrus pa'i mar gsar 'ba' zhig phan / mar gyi nying khu blugs pa'am / shing mngar bskol ba'i chu grang ngam

verses.skt: sitāmbhasāmbhodajalaiḥ kṣīreṇekṣurasena vā | pānalepanasekeṣu mahātiktaṃ paraṃ hitam
verses.tib: ut+pal pad+ma kha ra'i chu / 'o ma bu ram shing khu blugs / btung ba bsku dang blugs pa dang / tig ta chen po'i sman mar phan

verses.skt: granthyākhye raktapittaghnaṃ kṛtvā samyag yathoditam | kaphānilaghnaṃ karmeṣṭaṃ piṇḍasvedopanāhanam
verses.tib: rmen / bu khrag mkhris sel ba yi / gso ba ci rigs legs byas la / rlung dang bad kan 'joms par byed / glan dang dkri ba la sogs phan

verses.skt: granthivisarpaśūle tu tailenoṣṇena secayet | daśamūlavipakvena tadvan mūtrair jalena vā
verses.tib: rmen bu me dbal gzer bcas la / til mar rtsa ba bcu dang bskol / ba gcin dron mo chu dron blugs

verses.skt: sukhoṣṇayā pradihyād vā piṣṭayā kṛṣṇagandhayā | naktamālatvacā śuṣkamūlakaiḥ kalināthavā
verses.tib: yang na shi kru'i lde gu 'am / nag ta ma la'i shun pa'am / la phug skam po ba ru ra'i / lde gu dro 'jam bsku pa phan

verses.skt: dantī citrakamūlatvak saudhārkapayasī guḍaḥ | bhallātakāsthi kāsīsaṃ lepo bhindyāc chilām api
verses.tib: dan da shing tsha tsi tra ka / arka snu ha'i 'o ma dang / bu ram go bye rus nag mtshur / lde gus rdo yang 'bigs byed na
