verses.skt: bahirmārgāśritaṃ granthiṃ kiṃ punaḥ kaphasaṃbhavam | dīrghakālasthitaṃ granthim ebhir bhindyāc ca bheṣajaiḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur rmen bu'i nad / phyi rol gnas pa smos ci dgos / yun ring gnas pa'i rmen bu la

verses.skt: mūlakānāṃ kulatthānāṃ yūṣaiḥ sakṣāradāḍimaiḥ | godhūmānnair yavānnair vā sasīdhumadhuśārkaraiḥ
verses.tib: la phug rgya sran ku lang+tha'i / khu ba thal sman se 'brur bcas / gro yi zan dang nas kyi zan / rgun chang sbrang rtsi bu ram chang

verses.skt: sakṣaudrair vāruṇīmaṇḍair mātuluṅgarasānvitaiḥ | triphalāyāḥ prayogaiś ca pippalyāḥ kṣaudrasaṃyutaiḥ
verses.tib: kha ra chang gi dngas mar bcas / kha lud khu bar bcas pa dang / 'bras bu gsum gyi sbyor lde gu / pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir bcas

verses.skt: devadāruguḍūcyoś ca prayogair girijasya ca | mustabhallātasaktūnāṃ prayogair mākṣikasya ca
verses.tib: thang shing dang ni sle tres dang / brag zhun gyi ni sbyor ba dang / gla sgang go bye'i sbyor ba'am / sbrang rtsi yi ni sbyor ba dang

verses.skt: dhūmair virekaiḥ śirasaḥ pūrvoktair gulmabhedanaiḥ | taptāyohemalavaṇapāṣāṇādiprapīḍanaiḥ
verses.tib: mgo bkru sman dud rngub pa dang / sngar bshad skran ni bshig pa dang / lcags gser lan tshwa bsregs pa dang / rdo bas btsir bar bya ba yin

verses.skt: ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ siddhābhir vividhābhir bale sthitaḥ | granthiḥ pāṣāṇakaṭhino yadi naivopaśāmyati
verses.tib: sbyor ba sna tshogs de dag ni / byas kyang zhi bar ma gyur cing / shin tu sra bar gnas gyur la / nad stobs che bar gyur pa ni

verses.skt: athāsya dāhaḥ kṣāreṇa śarair hemnāpi vā hitaḥ | pākibhiḥ pācayitvā vā pāṭayitvā tam uddharet
verses.tib: de 'og 'di la thal sman nam / lde gu 'am gser gyis bsregs na phan / smin par byed pa brnags byas la / dbral nas de nas dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: mokṣayed bahuśaś cāsya raktam utkleśam āgatam | punaś cāpahṛte rakte vātaśleṣmajid auṣadham
verses.tib: 'di la khrag ni brnag 'dod pa / yang dang yang du gdon par bya / khrag bsal 'og tu slar yang ni / rlung dang bad kan sel sman gtang

verses.skt: praklinne dāhapākābhyāṃ bāhyāntar vraṇavat kriyā | dārvīviḍaṅgakampillaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ vraṇe hitam
verses.tib: tsha zhing smin pas brnags gyur la / phyi nang rma ltar gso bar bya / skyer pa srin sman kam bi l+ya / bskol ba'i til mar rma la phan

verses.skt: dūrvāsvarasasiddhaṃ tu kaphapittottare ghṛtam | ekataḥ sarvakarmāṇi raktamokṣaṇam ekataḥ
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pa shas che la / dUr ba'i / khu ba mar bskol phan / gso ba'i nad kun phyogs dang steng / khrag byung ba ni phyogs gcig yin

verses.skt: visarpo na hy asaṃsṛṣṭaḥ sa ’srapittena jāyate | raktam evāśrayaś cāsya bahuśo ’sraṃ hared ataḥ
verses.tib: me dbal de ni khrag mkhris dang / ma 'dres pa las byung mi 'gyur / 'di yi rten ni khrag nyid yin / de bas khrag ni mang du dbri

verses.skt: na ghṛtaṃ bahudoṣāya deyaṃ yan na virecanam | tena doṣo hy upastabdhas tvagraktapiśitaṃ pacet
verses.tib: nad gzhi mang po me dbal la / bkru sman ma gyur mar mi sbyin / de yis nad ni sra gyur pas / pags pa khrag dang sha 'tshed byed

verses.skt: kuṣṭhinaṃ snehapānena pūrvaṃ sarvam upācaret | tatra vātottare tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ hitam
verses.tib: de nas mdze nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o / mdze nad kun la thog ma nyid / snum blud pas ni gso bar bya

verses.skt: daśamūlāmṛtairaṇḍaśārṅgaṣṭāmeṣaśṛṅgibhiḥ | paṭolanimbakaṭukādārvīpāṭhādurālabhāḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu pa sle tres dang / sha rang ka ta e raN+Da / mi sha sring gi mar ram ni / til mar bskol te blud pa phan / nim pa pa to pu tse shel / skyer pa pha ta byi tsher pa

verses.skt: parpaṭaṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca palāṃśaṃ pācayed apām | dvyāḍhake ’ṣṭāṃśaśeṣeṇa tena karṣonmitais tathā
verses.tib: par pa ta dang kyi lce ba / srang re chu bre brgyad kyi ni / nang bskol brgyad cha lus pa ru / gla sgang rtsa mkhris kyi lce ba

verses.skt: trāyantīmustabhūnimbakaliṅgakaṇacandanaiḥ | sarpiṣo dvādaśapalaṃ pacet tat tiktakaṃ jayet
verses.tib: dug mo nyung dang pi pi ling / tsan+dan zho ni gnyis gnyis dang / zhun mar srang ni bcu gnyis bskol / tig ta'i sman mar de 'thungs na

verses.skt: pittakuṣṭhaparīsarpapiṭikādāhatṛḍbhramān | kaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmayān gaṇḍān duṣṭanāḍīvraṇāpacīḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa mdze dang me dbal dang / 'brum phran lus tsha skom dad che / mgo 'khor g.yan pa skya rbab 'bras / rma 'grams 'bras kyi phreng ba dang

verses.skt: visphoṭavidradhīgulmaśophonmādamadān api | hṛdrogatimiravyaṅgagrahaṇīśvitrakāmalāḥ
verses.tib: thor bu khong 'bras skran dang ni / zad byed smyo byed myos pa dang / snying nad rab rib ngo khabs dang / sha bkra mig ser pho ba'i nad

verses.skt: bhagandaram apasmāram udaraṃ pradaraṃ garam | arśo'srapittam anyāṃś ca sukṛcchrān pittajān gadān
verses.tib: mtshan par rdol dang brjed byed dang / dmu rdzing zla mtshan mi chod dang / sbyar dug gzhang 'brum khrag mkhris sel / gzhan yang mkhris pa las gyur nad

verses.skt: sapracchadaḥ parpaṭakaḥ śamyākaḥ kaṭukā vacā | triphalā padmakaṃ pāṭhā rajanyau śārive kaṇe
verses.tib: lo ma bdun pa par pa ta / dong ga shu dag pu tse shel / shug pa pa ta 'bras bu gsum / ser po gnyis dang thal tres gnyis / nim pa tsan+dan pi pi ling

verses.skt: nimbacandanayaṣṭyāhvaviśālendrayavāmṛtāḥ | kirātatiktakaṃ sevyaṃ vṛṣo mūrvā śatāvarī
verses.tib: shing mngar sle tres bi sha la / dug mo nyung dang pu shel tse / rtsa mkhris mur ba ba sha ka / nye'u

verses.skt: paṭolātiviṣāmustātrāyantīdhanvayāsakam | tair jale ’ṣṭaguṇe sarpir dviguṇāmalakīrase
verses.tib: shing pu sha pa to la / gla sgang byi tsher kyi lce ba / skyu ru ra khu nyis 'gyur dang / de rnams mar gyi brgyad 'gyur chu

verses.skt: siddhaṃ tiktān mahātiktaṃ guṇair abhyadhikaṃ matam | kaphottare ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ nimbasaptāhvacitrakaiḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba tig ta chen po ste / yon tan yang ni sngar bas lhag / bad kan las gyur nim pa dang / lo ma bdun pa tsi tra ka

verses.skt: kuṣṭhoṣaṇavacāśālapriyālacaturaṅgulaiḥ | sarveṣu cāruṣkarajaṃ taubaraṃ sārṣapaṃ pibet
verses.tib: ru rta dong gra tsha ba gsum / sa la pi la ya'i mar blud / kun la go bye'i mar ram ni / yungs kar dUr ba ra'i mar blud

verses.skt: snehaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā kṛmijitpathyābhallātakaiḥ śṛtam | āragvadhasya mūlena śatakṛtvaḥ śṛtaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: byi dang ga dang a ru ra / go bye'i lde gu mar bskol blud / dong ga'i rtsa ba dag dang mar / lan brgya'i bar bskol mar yang blud

verses.skt: piban kuṣṭhaṃ jayaty āśu bhajan sakhadiraṃ jalam | ebhir eva yathāsvaṃ ca snehair abhyañjanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: seng ldeng bskol ba'i chu bsten na / mdze nad myur du sel bar byed / 'di dag nyid kyis ci rigs par / snum chos bsku ba byas pa'ang phan

verses.skt: snigdhasya śodhanaṃ yojyaṃ visarpe yad udāhṛtam | lalāṭahastapādeṣu sirāś cāsya vimokṣayet
verses.tib: snum gyis zhen la me dbal ni / skabs su bshad pa'i sman sbyar gtang / dpral ba lag pa rkang pa las / 'di la gtar ga'ang gdab par bya

verses.skt: pracchānam alpake kuṣṭhe śṛṅgādyāś ca yathāyatham | snehair āpyāyayec cainaṃ kuṣṭhaghnair antarāntarā
verses.tib: mdze nad tshabs chung zhal zhal gdab / rwa sogs kyis kyang khrag dbyung bya / mdze nad 'joms pa'i snum gyis ni / 'di la bar bar brta bar bya

verses.skt: muktaraktaviriktasya riktakoṣṭhasya kuṣṭhinaḥ | prabhañjanas tathā hy asya na syād dehaprabhañjanaḥ
verses.tib: khrag phyung bkru sman gyis sbyang bya / lto stong gyur pa mdze can la / ci nas rlung gis 'di yi ni / lus mi 'jig pa de ltar bya

verses.skt: vāsāmṛtānimbavarāpaṭolavyāghrīkarañjodakakalkapakvam | sarpir visarpajvarakāmalāsrakuṣṭhāpahaṃ vajrakam āmananti
verses.tib: nim pa sle tres ba sha ka / 'bras bu gsum dang pa to la / kaN+Da ka ri ka rany+dza / lde gu chu dang mar bskol ba / sman mar rdo rje can zhes bya / des ni me dbal mig ser rims / khrag nad lud pa mdze nad 'joms

verses.skt: triphalātrikaṭudvikaṇṭakārīkaṭukākumbhanikumbharājavṛkṣaiḥ | savacātiviṣāgnikaiḥ sapāṭhaiḥ picubhāgair navavajradugdhamuṣṭyā
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum / dur byid kaN+Da ka ri gnyis / dan da dong ga pu tse shel / shu dag bong nga tsi tra ka / pa tar bcas pa zho gnyis gnyis / snu ha'i 'o ma srang gcig dang

verses.skt: piṣṭaiḥ siddhaṃ sarpiṣaḥ prastham ebhiḥ krūre koṣṭhe snehanaṃ recanaṃ ca | kuṣṭhaśvitraplīhavardhmāśmagulmān hanyāt kṛcchrāṃs tan mahāvajrakākhyam || 20 || dantyāḍhakam apāṃ droṇe paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet | dhāmārgavapale pītaṃ tad ūrdhvādho viśuddhikṛt
verses.tib: bre gang mar bskol lto sra ba'i / snum chos bkru sman dag tu sbyar / mdze dang sha bkra mdzer pa dang / rgyu rlugs rde'u 'gags skran 'joms byed / 'di ni rdo rje chen por bshad / dan da bre bzhi chu bre ni / bcu drug bskol te de mar bskol / ko sha ta ki srang gcig

verses.skt: āvartakītulāṃ droṇe paced aṣṭāṃśaśeṣitam | tanmūlais tatra niryūhe ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet
verses.tib: gdab / de blud steng 'og sbyong byed yin / a bar da ka srang brgyad cu / bre bcu drug bskol brgyad cha lus / khu ba de ni de'i rtsa ba / mar ni bre gang bskol bar bya

verses.skt: pītvā tad ekadivasāntaritaṃ sujīrṇe bhuñjīta kodravam asaṃskṛtakāñjikena | kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsam apacīṃ ca vijetum icchan icchan prajāṃ ca vipulāṃ grahaṇaṃ smṛtiṃ ca
verses.tib: blud na de bzhin zhag gcig gis / bar du chod de legs zhu nas / khre rgod rang skyur bskol ba blud / mdze nad sha bkra 'bras kyi phreng / sel zhing bu mang dran 'dzin 'gyur

verses.skt: yater lelītakavasā kṣaudrajātīrasānvitā | kuṣṭhaghnī samasarpir vā sagāyatryasanodakā
verses.tib: nI li ti ka'i tshil sbrang rtsi / dzA ti'i khu ba mar bcas pa'am / seng ldeng a sa na'i chur bcas / dbang po bsdams brtan mdze nad 'joms

verses.skt: śālayo yavagodhūmāḥ koradūṣāḥ priyaṅgavaḥ | mudgā masūrās tubarī tiktaśākāni jāṅgalam
verses.tib: sA lu nas dang gro dang ni / ci tse khre dang mung+ga dang / sran chung dang ni tu ka ri'i / tshod ma kha bo skam sa'i sha

verses.skt: varāpaṭolakhadiranimbāruṣkarayojitam | madyāny auṣadhagarbhāṇi mathitaṃ cendurājimat
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang pa to la / seng ldeng nim pa go bye sbyar / chang ni sman dang sbyar ba'am / dar ba so ma ra dzar bcas

verses.skt: annapānaṃ hitaṃ kuṣṭhe na tv amlalavaṇoṣaṇam | dadhidugdhaguḍānūpatilamāṣāṃs tyajettarām
verses.tib: bza' dang btung ba mdze la phan / skyur tsha lan tshwa can rnams gnod / zho dang 'o ma rlan can sha / bu ram ma sha til mar spang

verses.skt: paṭolamūlatriphalāviśālāḥ pṛthaktribhāgāpacitatriśāṇāḥ | syus trāyamāṇā kaṭurohiṇī ca bhāgārdhike nāgarapādayukte
verses.tib: pa to la'i rtsa 'bras bu gsum / bi sha la ni re re ni / cha gsum gyis dbri zho phyed gsum / kyi lce ba dang pu tse shel / zho phyed dong gra bzhi char bcas

verses.skt: etat palaṃ jarjaritaṃ vipakvaṃ jale pibed doṣaviśodhanāya | jīrṇe rasair dhanvamṛgadvijānāṃ purāṇaśālyodanam ādadīta
verses.tib: de ltar srang gcig brdungs pa dag / bskol ba'i chu ni 'thungs gyur na / nad kyi tshogs ni sbyong bar byed / sman de zhu nas skam sa yi / ri dwags bya yi sha khu dang / 'bras rnying chan dang sbyar ba bza'

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsaṃ grahaṇīpradoṣam arśāṃsi kṛcchrāṇi halīmakaṃ ca | ṣaḍrātrayogena nihanti caitad hṛdvastiśūlaṃ viṣamajvaraṃ ca
verses.tib: sbyor 'di zhag drug bsten na ni / mdze nad kun dang skrangs pa'i nad / pho ba'i nad dang gcin sri dang / gzugs 'khums gso dka'i nad rnams dang / snying nad chu sor gzer rims sel

verses.skt: viḍaṅgasārāmalakābhayānāṃ palatrayaṃ trīṇi palāni kumbhāt | guḍasya ca dvādaśa māsam eṣa jitātmanāṃ hanty upayujymānaḥ
verses.tib: byi dang ga yi snying po dang / a ru ra dang skyu ru ra / srang re dan da srang gsum dang / bu ram srang ni bcu gnyis dag / ri lur byas 'di byin gyur na

verses.skt: kuṣṭhaśvitraśvāsakāsodarārśomehaplīhagranthirugjantugulmān | siddhaṃ yogaṃ prāha yakṣo mumukṣor bhikṣoḥ prāṇān māṇibhadraḥ kilemam || 32 || bhūnimbanimbatriphalāpadmakātiviṣākaṇāḥ | mūrvāpaṭolīdviniśāpāṭhātiktendravāruṇīḥ
verses.tib: mdze dang sha bkra dbugs mi bde / lud pa dmu rdzing gzhang 'brum dang / gcin nad mcher pa rmen bu'i nad / thor bu srin nad skran rnams 'joms / grub pa'i sbyor 'di gnod sbyin ni / nor bu bzang pos dge slong zhig / srog 'dor nyid la bshad ces grags / tig ta nim pa 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: sakaliṅgavacās tulyā dviguṇāś ca yathottaram | lihyād dantītrivṛdbrāhmīs cūrṇitā madhusarpiṣā
verses.tib: shug pa bong nga pi pi ling / mur ba dang ni pa to la / ser po rnam gnyis pu tse shel / shu dag in+d+ra ba ru ni / dug mo nyung bcas cha mnyam pa / dan da dur byid bram sha mi / phyi ma bzhin du nyis 'gyur bcas / phye ma sbrang rtsi mar sbyar zos

verses.skt: kuṣṭhamehaprasuptīnāṃ paramaṃ syāt tad auṣadham | varāviḍaṅgakṛṣṇā vā lihyāt tailājyamākṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: mdze dang za gu tshor ba chung / sel ba'i sman gyi mchog yin no / 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling / byi dang ga dang sbrang rtsi ni / til mar mar sbyar lde gu'am

verses.skt: kākodumbarikāvellanimbābdavyoṣakalkavān | hanti vṛkṣakaniryūhaḥ pānāt sarvāṃs tvagāmayān
verses.tib: ka ka u dum bA ra dang / nim pa gla sgang byi dang ga / tsha ba gsum gyi lde gu ni / dug mo nyung gi khu bar bcas / blud na lpags nad thams cad 'joms

verses.skt: kuṭajāgninimbanṛpatarukhadirāsanasaptaparṇaniryūhe | siddhā madhughṛtayuktāḥ kuṣṭhaghnīr bhakṣayed abhayāḥ
verses.tib: dug mo nyung dang tsi tra ka / nim pa thang shing seng ldeng dang / lo ma bdun pa a sa na / khu bskol mar dang a ru ra / sbrang rtsi ldan zos mdze nad 'joms

verses.skt: dārvīkhadiranimbānāṃ tvakkvāthaḥ kuṣṭhasūdanaḥ
verses.tib: seng ldeng nim pa sle tres dang / pa to la dang byi tsher bskol / seng ldeng la sogs lnga pa ste / khyab 'jug gis ni lha min bzhin / mdze nad 'phral du 'joms par byed / skyer pa nim pa seng ldeng gi / shun lpags bskol bas mdze nad sel

verses.skt: niśottamānimbapaṭolamūlatiktāvacālohitayaṣṭikābhiḥ | kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaphapittakuṣṭhaṃ susevito dharma ivocchinatti
verses.tib: skyer pa nim pa 'bras bu gsum / pa tol rtsa pu tse shel / shu dag btsod ni bskol ba yis / dam chos la brten 'khor ba ltar / khrag mkhris las gyur mdze nad gcod

verses.skt: ebhir eva ca śṛtaṃ ghṛtam ukhyaṃ bheṣajair jayati mārutakuṣṭham | kalpayet khadiranimbaguḍūcīdevadārurajanīḥ pṛthag evam
verses.tib: sman 'di nyid dang ba yi mar / bskol bas rlung gyur mdze nad rnams / mchog tu sel bar byed pa yin / seng ldeng nim pa skyer pa dang / sle tres thang shing sna rer bskol

verses.skt: pāṭhādārvīvahnighuṇeṣṭākaṭukābhir | mūtraṃ yuktaṃ śakrayavaiś coṣṇajalaṃ vā | kuṣṭhī pītvā māsam aruk syād gudakīlī | mehī śophī pāṇḍurajīrṇī kṛmimāṃś ca
verses.tib: pa tha skyer pa tsi tra ka / dan da dug nyung pu tse shel / ba gcin yang na chu dron bcas / zla ba gcig blud mdze nang dang / gzhang 'brum za khu skrang nad dang

verses.skt: lākṣādantīmadhurasavarādvīpipāṭhāviḍaṅga | pratyakpuṣpītrikaṭurajanīsaptaparṇāṭarūṣam | raktā nimbaṃ surataru kṛtaṃ pañcamūlyau ca cūrṇaṃ | pītvā māsaṃ jayati hitabhug gavyamūtreṇa kuṣṭham
verses.tib: rgya skyegs dan ti 'bras bu gsum / mur ba pa tra tsi tra ka / a pa marga byi dang ga / lo ma bdun pa tsha ba gsum / btsod dang skyer pa ma sha ka / nim pa thang shing rtsa ba lnga / gnyis po phye ma ba gcin sbyar / zla ba / gcig 'thungs phan zas bza' / mdze yi nad kun 'joms par byed

verses.skt: niśākaṇānāgaravellataubaraṃ savahnitāpyaṃ kramaśo vivardhitam | gavāmbupītaṃ vaṭakīkṛtaṃ tathā nihanti kuṣṭhāni sadāruṇāny api
verses.tib: skyer pa pi pi ling dong gra / byi dang ga dang ba to ri / tsi tra ka dang bya rnams / bzhin du cha res bskyed / ba gcin sbyar ba'am ri lu ni / byin na mi bzad mdze yang 'joms

verses.skt: trikaṭūttamātilāruṣkarājyamākṣikasitopalāvihitā | guṭikā rasāyanaṃ kuṣṭhajic ca vṛṣyā ca saptasamā
verses.tib: tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum / til dang go bye'i phye ma ni / mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar / ri lu byas pa cha bdun pas / mdze yi nad rnams 'joms byed cing

verses.skt: candraśakalāgnirajanīviḍaṅgatubarāsthyaruṣkaratriphalābhiḥ | vaṭakā guḍāṃśak ptāḥ samastakuṣṭhāni nāśayanty abhyastāḥ
verses.tib: bcud kyis len dang ro tsar 'gyur / so ma ra dza tsi tra ka / skyer pa du ba ra'i rus pa / go bye srin sman 'bras bu gsum / bsten na mdze nad ma lus 'joms

verses.skt: viḍaṅgabhallātakavākucīnāṃ sadvīpivārāhiharītakīnām | salāṅgalīkṛṣṇatilopakulyā guḍena piṇḍī vinihanti kuṣṭham
verses.tib: so ma ra dza byi dang ga / go bye tsi tra ba ra hi / a ru ra dang lang ga li / til nag po dang pi pi ling / bu ram dang ni ri lur bya / mdze yi nad rnams 'joms par byed

verses.skt: śaśāṅkalekhā saviḍaṅgasārā sapippalīkā sahutāśamūlā | sāyomalā sāmalakā satailā kuṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇi nihanti līḍhā
verses.tib: so ma ra dza pi pi ling / de yi rtsa ba byi dang ga'i / snying po lcags rkyag skyu ru ra / til mar lde gu mdze nad 'joms

verses.skt: pathyātilaguḍaiḥ piṇḍī kuṣṭhaṃ sāruṣkarair jayet | guḍāruṣkarajantughnasomarājīkṛtāthavā
verses.tib: a ru ra dang go bye til / bu ram ri lus mdze nad 'joms / so ma ra dza byi dang ga / bu ram ri lu byas pa'ang phan

verses.skt: viḍaṅgādrijatukṣaudrasarpiṣmat khādiraṃ rajaḥ | kiṭibhaśvitradadrūghnaṃ khāden mitahitāśanaḥ
verses.tib: seng ldeng brag zhun byi dang ga / sbrang rtsi mar dang ldan za zhing / phan dang ran par zos na ni / 'brum phran sha bkra shu ba 'joms

verses.skt: sitātailakṛmighnāni dhātryayomalapippalīḥ | lihānaḥ sarvakuṣṭhāni jayaty atigurūṇy api
verses.tib: kha ra lcags phye byi dang ga / tsi tra ka dang skyu ru ra / pi pi ling gi lde gu yis / mdze nad shin tu gso dka' 'joms

verses.skt: mustaṃ vyoṣaṃ triphalā mañjiṣṭhā dāru pañcamūle dve | saptacchadanimbatvak saviśālā citrako mūrvā
verses.tib: gla sgang tsha gsum 'bras bu gsum / rtsa ba lnga gnyis thang shing btsod / nim pa shing tsha lo ma bdun / shing tsha tsi tra ka dang ni

verses.skt: cūrṇaṃ tarpaṇabhāgair navabhiḥ saṃyojitaṃ samadhvaṃśam | nityaṃ kuṣṭhanibarhaṇam etat prāyogikaṃ khādan
verses.tib: mur ba bi sha li'i phye ma / nas phye dgu cha sbrang rtsi ni / cha gcig sbyar ba 'di rtag tu / 'thungs na mdze nad 'joms byed cing

verses.skt: śvayathuṃ sapāṇḍurogaṃ śvitraṃ grahaṇīpradoṣam arśāṃsi | vardhmabhagandarapiṭikākaṇḍūkoṭhāpacīr hanti
verses.tib: 'or nad skya rbab sha bkra can / pho nad gzhang 'brum rgyu rlugs dang / mtshan bar rdol dang 'brum phran dang / g.yan pa shu ba'i nad rnams 'joms

verses.skt: rasāyanaprayogeṇa tubarāsthīni śīlayet | bhallātakaṃ vākucikāṃ vahnimūlaṃ śilāhvayam
verses.tib: tu pa ra yi rus pa'am / ga bya so ma ra dza dang / tsi tra ka'i rtsa brag zhun rnams / bcud len cho ga ltar bstan phan

verses.skt: iti doṣe vijite ’ntastvaksthe śamanaṃ bahiḥ pralepādi hitam | tīkṣṇālepotkliṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hi vivṛddhim eti maline dehe
verses.tib: de ltar nad bsal nang gi ni / nad / sbyangs nad ni phyi rol gyi / pags par gnas na sman blugs phan / nad kyi dri ma ma dag pa / sman rnon byugs na mdze nad ni / bslangs pas slar ni 'phel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: sthirakaṭhinamaṇḍalānāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ poṭalair hitaḥ svedaḥ | svinnotsannaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śastrair likhitaṃ pralepanair limpet
verses.tib: gting zug sra zhing kor kor po'i / mdze la dugs bya snyi ba dang / 'bur bar gyur nas mtshon gyis ni / zhal zhal btab cing byug par bya

verses.skt: yeṣu na śastraṃ kramate sparśendriyanāśaneṣu kuṣṭheṣu | teṣu nipātyaḥ kṣāro raktaṃ doṣaṃ ca visrāvya
verses.tib: gang zhig pags pa kun nyams shing / mtshon gyis btab tu mi rung ba / de la khrag ni phyung nas su / thal sman rnon po bsku bar bya

verses.skt: lepo ’tikaṭhinaparuṣe supte kuṣṭhe sthire purāṇe ca | pītāgadasya kāryo viṣaiḥ samantro ’gadaiś cānu
verses.tib: mdze nad rab sra rtsub pa dang / tshor ba med brtan yun ring lon / sngags bcas dug khu blud par bya / dug gi sman ni rjes su sbyar

verses.skt: stabdhāni suptasuptāny asvedanakaṇḍulāni kuṣṭhāni | ghṛṣṭāni śuṣkagomayaphenakaśastraiḥ pradehyāni
verses.tib: mdze nad rengs zhing tshor ba med / rdul mi 'byung zhing g.ya' ba la / lci skam rgya mtsho'i lbu ba'am / mtshon gyis bzhar la lde gu byug

verses.skt: mustā triphalā madanaṃ karañja āragvadhaḥ kaliṅgayavāḥ | saptāhvakuṣṭhaphalinīdārvyaḥ siddhārthakaṃ snānam
verses.tib: gla sgang dong gra 'bras bu gsum / po son cha dang ka rany+dza / lo ma bdun pa dug mo nyung / ru rta skyer pa pri yang ku / nyungs kar sbyor bas lus bkru zhing

verses.skt: eṣa kaṣāyo vamanaṃ virecanaṃ varṇakas tathodgharṣaḥ | tvagdoṣakuṣṭhaśophaprabādhanaḥ pāṇḍurogaghnaḥ
verses.tib: lde gus slon sman bkru sman dang / bzhar zhing lus ni bskus gyur na / pags pa'i nad dang mdze nad dang / skrang dang skya rbab mdze nad 'joms

verses.skt: karavīranimbakuṭajāc chamyākāc citrakāc ca mūlānām | mūtre darvīlepī kvātho lepena kuṣṭhaghnaḥ
verses.tib: ka ra bI ra nim pa dang / dug mo nyung dang dong gra dang / tsi tra ka'i rtsa ba gcin bskol / bskus na mdze nad 'joms par byed

verses.skt: śvetakaravīramūlaṃ kuṭajakarañjāt phalaṃ tvaco dārvyāḥ | sumanaḥpravālayukto lepaḥ kuṣṭhāpahaḥ siddhaḥ
verses.tib: ka ra bI ra kar rtsa ba / dug mo nyung dang ka rany+dza'i / 'bras bu skyer pa'i shun lpags ni / so man yi myu gu bcas

verses.skt: śairīṣī tvak puṣpaṃ kārpāsyā rājavṛkṣapattrāṇi | piṣṭā ca kākamācī caturvidhaḥ kuṣṭhahā lepaḥ
verses.tib: bskus na mdze 'joms grub pa yin / shri sha'i shun lpags ras bal gyi / me tog dong ga'i lo ma dang / mon sne'u dme ru bzhi po ni

verses.skt: vyoṣasarṣapaniśāgṛhadhūmair yāvaśūkapaṭucitrakakuṣṭhaiḥ | kolamātraguṭikārdhaviṣāṃśā śvitrakuṣṭhaharaṇo varalepaḥ
verses.tib: btags pa'i lde gus mdze nad 'joms / nim pa ser po rnam gnyis dang / bye'u rug pa dang pa to la / ru rta a shwa gan+d+ha dang

verses.skt: nimbaṃ haridre surasaṃ paṭolaṃ kuṣṭhāśvagandhe suradāru śigruḥ | sasarṣapaṃ tumburudhānyavanyaṃ caṇḍā ca cūrṇāni samāni kuryāt
verses.tib: thang shing shi kru nyungs kar dang / g.yer ma 'u su gla ba dang / tsa rong cha mnyam phye mar byas

verses.skt: tais takrapiṣṭaiḥ prathamaṃ śarīraṃ tailāktam udvartayituṃ yateta | tathāsya kaṇḍūḥ piṭikāḥ sakoṭhāḥ kuṣṭhāni śophāś ca śamaṃ vrajanti
verses.tib: dar bar sbyar ba'i til mar gyis / bskus pa'am lus byugs dril gyur na / mdze nad g.yan pa zlum por bcas / 'brum phran skrangs / pa'i nad rnams sel

verses.skt: mustāmṛtāsaṅgakaṭaṅkaṭerīkāsīsakampillakakuṣṭhalodhrāḥ | gandhopalaḥ sarjaraso viḍaṅgaṃ manaḥśilāle karavīrakatvak
verses.tib: gla sgang dngul rdo dang ni skyer pa dang / nag tshur kam bi l+ya dang ru rta dang / seng phrom mu zi pog dkar byi dang ga / ldong ros ba bla ka ra bI ra'i shun

verses.skt: tailāktagātrasya kṛtāni cūrṇāny etāni dadyād avacūrṇanārtham | dadrūḥ sakaṇḍūḥ kiṭibhāni pāmā vicarcikā ceti tathā na santi
verses.tib: phye mar byas pa'i til mar gyis bskus pa'i / steng du phye ma'i don du 'di blugs na / shu ba g.yan pa 'brum bu phra mo dang / rkang shu la sogs 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: snuggaṇḍe sarṣapāt kalkaḥ kukūlānalapācitaḥ | lepād vicarcikāṃ hanti rāgavega iva trapām
verses.tib: yungs kar snu ha'i shing dum btags / lde gu me ma mur btsos te / 'dod chags shugs kyis ngo tsha bzhin / bskus na glang shu 'jig par byed

verses.skt: manaḥśilāle maricāni tailam ārkaṃ payaḥ kuṣṭhaharaḥ pradehaḥ | tathā karañjaprapunāṭabījaṃ kuṣṭhānvitaṃ gosalilena piṣṭam
verses.tib: ldong ros ba bla na le sham til mar / arga'i lo ma'i lde gus mdze 'joms byed / de bzhin tsi tra marda ka rany+dza / ru rta sbyar ba ba gcin btags pa'ang phan

verses.skt: guggulumaricaviḍaṅgaiḥ sarṣapakāsīsasarjarasamustaiḥ | śrīveṣṭakālagandhair manaḥśilākuṣṭhakampillaiḥ
verses.tib: gu gul yungs kar na le sham / nag tshur dang ni byi dang ga / shri be+e sha ga sra rtsi pog / ba bla ldong ros mu zi dang

verses.skt: ubhayaharidrāsahitaiś cākrikatailena miśritair ebhiḥ | dinakarakarābhitaptaiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ ghṛṣṭaṃ ca naṣṭaṃ ca
verses.tib: ru rta dang ni kam bi l+ya / ser po gnyis dang bcas pa ni / 'khor los btsir ba'i til mar bsres / 'di ni mtshon gyis bzhar te bskus / nyi mar bsregs na mdze nad sel

verses.skt: maricaṃ tamālapattraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ samanaḥśilaṃ sakāsīsam | tailena yuktam uṣitaṃ saptāhaṃ bhājane tāmre
verses.tib: ta la'i lo ma na le sham / ru rta ldong ros nag tshur bcas / zangs kyi snod dang til mar dang / zhag bdun legs par spangs pa des

verses.skt: tenāliptaṃ sidhmaṃ saptāhād gharmasevino ’paiti | māsān navaṃ kilāsaṃ snānena vinā viśuddhasya
verses.tib: zhag bdun bsku zhing nyi mar bsreg / sha bkra 'joms par byed pa yin / sha bkra sar pa zla ba gcig / bsten zhing sbyang ba byas na sel

verses.skt: mayūrakakṣārajale saptakṛtvaḥ parisrute | siddhaṃ jyotiṣmatītailam abhyaṅgāt sidhmanāśanam
verses.tib: a pa marga'i thal ba'i chu / lan bdun legs par gzags pa ru / pri yang ku yi mar bskol bas / bskus na sha bkra sel bar byed

verses.skt: vāyasajaṅghāmūlaṃ vamanīpattrāṇi mūlakād bījam | takreṇa bhaumavāre lepaḥ sidhmāpahaḥ siddhaḥ
verses.tib: ka ka dzang gi rtsa ba dang / ras bal sa bon 'dab ma dang / la phug sa bon dar bar sbyar / mig dmar gza' la bskus na ni / sha bkra sel ba grub pa yin

verses.skt: jīvantī mañjiṣṭhā dārvī kampillakaṃ payas tuttham | eṣa ghṛtatailapākaḥ siddhaḥ siddhe ca sarjarasaḥ
verses.tib: dzi ban ti dang skyer pa btsod / kam bi l+ya dang spangs ma ni / 'o ma mar dang til mar bskol / sra rtsi bog dang sbra tshil ni

verses.skt: deyaḥ samadhūcchiṣṭo vipādikā tena naśyati hy aktā | carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭibhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śāmyaty alasakaṃ ca
verses.tib: btab pa bskus na de yis ni / rkang lag zhig pa sel bar byed / pags pa gcig pa'i mdze dang ni / 'brum phran 'bras ni ber ba / yi / mdze nad 'jig par byed pa yin

verses.skt: mūlaṃ saptāhvāt tvak śirīṣāśvamārād arkān mālatyāś citrakāsphotanimbāt | bījaṃ kārañjaṃ sārṣapaṃ prāpunāṭam śreṣṭhā jantughnaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ dve haridre
verses.tib: lo ma bdun pa rtsa ba dang / shi ri sha yi shun lpags dang / ka ra bI ra arka dang / su ma na dang tsi tra ka / thal tres nim pa'i shun lpags dang / ka rany+dza dang yungs kar dang / tsi tra mar dang 'bras bu gsum / byi dang ga dang tsha ba gsum

verses.skt: tailaṃ tailaṃ sādhitaṃ taiḥ samūtrais tvagdoṣāṇāṃ duṣṭanāḍīvraṇānām | abhyaṅgena śleṣmavātodbhavānāṃ nāśāyālaṃ vajrakaṃ vajratulyam
verses.tib: ba gcin bcas par bskol bas ni / pags pa'i nad dang rma 'grams dang / rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i / mje yi nad ni sel byed de / 'di ni rdo rje dang 'dra bas / rdo rje can zhes bya ba yin / e raN+Da dang dngul rdo dang

verses.skt: eraṇḍatārkṣyaghananīpakadambabhārgī | kampillavellaphalinīsuravāruṇībhiḥ | nirguṇḍyaruṣkarasurāhvasuvarṇadugdhā | śrīveṣṭagugguluśilāpaṭutālaviśvaiḥ
verses.tib: gla sgang nim pa ka dang ni / ga bra'i rtsa ba kam bi l+ya / byi dang ga dang nir gun thi / go bye in+d+ra ba ru ni / thang shing khron bu gu gul dang / ldong ros shri sha pi ti dang / lan tshwa tang pal bca' sga rnams

verses.skt: tulyasnugarkadugdhaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ smṛtaṃ mahāvajram | atiśayitavajrakaguṇaṃ śvitrārśogranthimālāghnam
verses.tib: cha mnyam snu ha'i 'o ma dang / arga'i til mar lan cig bskol / lde gu rdo rje chen po ste / rdo rje can pas yon tan lhag / sha bkra dang ni gzhang 'brum dang / 'bras kyi phreng ba 'joms par byed

verses.skt: kuṣṭhāśvamārabhṛṅgārkamūtrasnukkṣīrasaindhavaiḥ | tailaṃ siddhaṃ viṣāpaham abhyaṅgāt kuṣṭhajit param
verses.tib: ru rta ka ra bI ra dang / bring gar dza arga dang / shu dag shing mngar rgyam tsha gcin / til mar bskol ba dug bcug pa / bskus pas mdze nad sel ba'i mchog

verses.skt: siddhaṃ sikthakasindūrapuratutthakatārkṣyajaiḥ | kacchūṃ vicarcikāṃ cāśu kaṭutailaṃ nibarhati
verses.tib: spra tshil li khri gu gul dang / spangs ma dngul rdo yungs mar bskol / g.yan pa glang shu myur du sel

verses.skt: lākṣā vyoṣaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ ca bījaṃ saśrīveṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhasiddhārthakāś ca | takronmiśraḥ syād dharidrā ca lepo dadrūṣūkto mūlakotthaṃ ca bījam
verses.tib: rgya skyegs tsi tra mar da dang / shri pi ta dang tsha ba gsum / ru rta yungs kar la phug gi / sa bon ser po rnam gnyis kyi / lde gu dar bar sbyar bskus na / shu ba thams cad sel bar byed

verses.skt: citrakaśobhāñjanakau guḍūcyapāmārgadevadārūṇi | khadiro dhavaś ca lepaḥ śyāmā dantī dravantī ca
verses.tib: tsi tra ka dang shi kru'am / sle tres thang shing a pa mar / seng ldeng d+ha ba'i lde gu'am / dur byid dan da pra ban ti

verses.skt: lākṣārasāñjanailāḥ punarnavā ceti kuṣṭhināṃ lepāḥ | dadhimaṇḍayutāḥ pādaiḥ ṣaṭ proktā mārutakaphaghnāḥ
verses.tib: rgya skyegs dngul rdo sug smel lam / pur+Na rna ba'i lde gu ste / tshig rkang drug bshad lde gu drug / zho ga chu dang sbyar ba yis / bskus na bad kan rlung las ni / gyur pa'i mdze nad sel bar byed

verses.skt: jalavāpyalohakesarapattraplavacandanamṛṇālāni | bhāgottarāṇi siddhaṃ pralepanaṃ pittakaphakuṣṭhe
verses.tib: ba li ka dang ma nu dang / a kar nA ga ge sar dang / gan+t+ra b+ha dra gla ba dang / tsan+dan dang ni pu shel tse / cha res bskyed pa'i lde gu yis / bad mkhris mdze nad sel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tiktaghṛtair dhautaghṛtair abhyaṅgo dahyamānakuṣṭheṣu | tailaiś candanamadhukaprapauṇḍarīkotpalayutaiś ca
verses.tib: tig ta'i sman mar brgya bkrus mar / bskus na mdze yi cha ba sel / til mar tsan+dan shing mngar dang / stag tsher ba dang ut+pal / bcas par bskus na'ang phan pa yin

verses.skt: klede prapatati cāṅge dāhe visphoṭake ca carmadale | śītāḥ pradehasekā vyadhanavirekau ghṛtaṃ tiktam
verses.tib: rnags shing yan lag 'drul ba dang / lus tsha 'brum bu phra mo 'byung / pags pa myags dang bcas pa la / bsil ba'i sman chus blugs shing byug

verses.skt: khadiravṛṣanimbakuṭajāḥ śreṣṭhākṛmijitpaṭolamadhuparṇyaḥ | antar bahiḥ prayuktāḥ kṛmikuṣṭhanudaḥ sagomutrāḥ
verses.tib: gtar ga bkru sman btang ba dang / tig ta'i sman mar byin na phan / seng ldeng nim pa ba sha ka / dug mo nyung dang 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: pralepodvartanasnānapānabhojanakarmaṇi | śīlitaṃ khādiraṃ vāri sarvatvagdoṣanāśanam
verses.tib: byi dang ga dang sle tres dang / pa to la dang ba gcin sbyar / phyi dang nang nas btang gyur na / srin pu las gyur mdze nad 'joms

verses.skt: vātottareṣu sarpir vamanaṃ śleṣmottareṣu kuṣṭheṣu | pittottareṣu mokṣo raktasya virecanaṃ cāgre
verses.tib: rlung shas che la thog mar ni / mar btang bad kan shas che la / skyug sman mkhris pa las gyur na / gtar ga btab cing bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: ye lepāḥ kuṣṭhānāṃ yujyante nirhṛtāsradoṣāṇām | saṃśodhitāśayānāṃ sadyaḥ siddhir bhavati teṣām
verses.tib: nang sbyangs khrag ni byung ba dang / gnas ni dag par gyur pa la / bsku ba gang zhig byas gyur pa / de ni mod la med par 'gyur

verses.skt: doṣe hṛte ’panīte rakte bāhyāntare kṛte śamane | snehe ca kālayukte na kuṣṭham ativartate sādhyam
verses.tib: nad gzhi bsal zhing khrag ni phyung ba dang / phyi dang nang nas zhi ba'i gso ba bya / sman mar dang ni dus su byin gyur na / mdze yi nad ni gso sla nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: bahudoṣaḥ saṃśodhyaḥ kuṣṭhī bahuśo ’nurakṣatā prāṇān | doṣe hy atimātrahṛte vāyur hanyād abalam āśu
verses.tib: mdze can nad ni lan mang sbyangs gyur pa / de yi srog srub lan mang 'bad byas te / nad ni lhag par phyung bas nyam chung bas / rlung ldang myur du gsod par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: pakṣāt pakṣāc chardanāny abhyupeyān māsān māsāc chodhanāny apy adhastāt | śuddhir mūrdhni syāt trirātrāt trirātrāt ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe māsy asṛṅmokṣaṇaṃ ca
verses.tib: zla ba phyed cing skyug sman gtang ba dang / zla ba re re nas ni bkru sman gtang / mgo bo sbyang ba zhag ni gsum gsum nas / zla ba drug drug nas ni gtar ga bya

verses.skt: yo durvānto durvirikto ’thavā syāt | kuṣṭhī doṣair uddhatair vyāpyate ’sau | niḥsaṃdehaṃ yāty asādhyatvam evaṃ | tasmāt kṛtsnān nirhared asya doṣān
verses.tib: gang zhig slon dang 'khru bar dka' 'gyur zhing / mdze can nad shas che bas khyab gyur pa / de ni nges par gso dka' nyid gyur pas / de bas nad ni ma lus dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: vratadamayamasevātyāgaśīlābhiyogo | dvijasuragurupūjā sarvasattveṣu maitrī | śivaśivasutatārābhāskarārādhanāni | prakaṭitamalapāpaṃ kuṣṭham unmūlayanti
kuṣṭhād api bībhatsaṃ yac chīghrataraṃ ca yāty asādhyatvam | śvitram atas tacchāntyai yateta dīpte yathā bhavane
verses.tib: gang zhig mdze nad pas kyang 'jigs 'gyur zhing / myur du gso dka' nyid du 'gyur bas na / khang pa 'bar bar gyur pa lta bur ni / sha bkra'i nad zhi ba la 'bad par bya

verses.skt: saṃśodhanaṃ viśeṣāt prayojayet pūrvam eva dehasya | śvitre sraṃsanam agryaṃ malayūrasa iṣyate saguḍaḥ
verses.tib: khyad par du ni dang por lus la ni / sbyang bar bya ba nye bar sbyar bar bya / sha bkra la ni so ma ra dza'i khu / bu ram chang ngam sha khu bkru sman ni / snu ha'i 'o mar sbyar ba blud par bya

verses.skt: taṃ pītvābhyaktatanur yathābalaṃ sūryapādasaṃtāpam | seveta viriktatanur tryahaṃ pipāsuḥ pibet peyām
verses.tib: de 'thungs nas ni lus bskus nyams stobs dag / ci yod pa las nyin mtshan bsten par bya / skom dad skyes na zhag gsum thug pa blud

verses.skt: śvitre ’ṅge ye sphoṭā jāyante kaṇṭakena tān bhindyāt | sphoṭeṣu niḥsruteṣu prātaḥ prātaḥ pibet tridinam
verses.tib: sha bkra'i lus la chu bur byung gyur na / de ni tsher ma dag gis brtol bar bya / chu bur gzags par byas nas nang re bzhin / so ma ra dza dang ni a sa na

verses.skt: malayūm asanaṃ priyaṅguṃ śatapuṣpāṃ cāmbhasā samutkvāthya | pālāśaṃ vā kṣāraṃ yathābalaṃ phāṇitopetam
verses.tib: pri yang ku dang shu ti chur bskol blud / rgya skyegs shing thal bu ram phran sbyar ba'i / chu ni nyams stobs ci yod pa la blud

verses.skt: phalgvakṣavṛkṣavalkalaniryūheṇendurājikākalkam | pītvoṣṇasthitasya jāte sphoṭe takreṇa bhojanaṃ nirlavaṇam
verses.tib: phal gu skyu ru ra shun dug nyung shing / khu ba so ma ra dzar bcas pa blud / dro bar 'dug nas chu bur byung ba la / lan tshwa med zas dar bar bcas pa sbyin

verses.skt: gavyaṃ mūtraṃ citrakavyoṣayuktaṃ sarpiḥkumbhe sthāpitaṃ kṣaudramiśram | pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ śvitriṇā peyam etat kāryaṃ cāsmai kuṣṭhadiṣṭaṃ vidhānam || 7 || mārkavam athavā svāded bhṛṣṭaṃ tailena lohapātrastham | bījakaśṛtaṃ ca dugdhaṃ tad anu pibec chvitranāśāya
verses.tib: ba gcin tsi tra ka dang tsha ba gsum / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba mar gyi snod du gzhag / zla phyed lon nas sha bkra can la blud / 'di la mdze nad gso ba'i cho ga bya / yang na bring ga ra dza lcags snod bcug / til mar nang du brngos pa sbyin bya zhing / a sa na yi sa bon 'o mar bskol / de rjes blud na sha bkra 'joms par byed

verses.skt: pūtīkārkavyādhighātasnuhīnāṃ mūtre piṣṭāḥ pallavā jātijāś ca | ghnanty ālepāc chvitradurnāmadadrūpāmākoṭhān duṣṭanāḍīvraṇāṃś ca
verses.tib: dong ga arga pu ti ka rany+dza / snu ha dzA ti'i lo ma ba gcin btags / lde gus bskus na sha bkra gzhang 'brum dang / shu ba g.yan pa rma 'grams sel bar byed

verses.skt: dvaipaṃ dagdhaṃ carma mātaṅgajaṃ vā śvitre lepas tailayukto variṣṭhaḥ | pūtiḥ kīṭo rājavṛkṣodbhavena kṣāreṇāktaḥ śvitram eko ’pi hanti
verses.tib: glang chen gzig gi lpags bsregs til mar dang / sbyar ba bskus na sha bkra sel mchog yin / sbur ba dri ngan dong ga'i 'o ma dang / sbyar te bskus pa gcig pus sha bkra sel

verses.skt: rātrau gomūtre vāsitān jarjarāṅgān ahni cchāyāyāṃ śoṣayet sphoṭahetūn | evaṃ vārāṃs trīṃs tais tataḥ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ snuhyāḥ kṣīreṇa śvitranāśāya lepaḥ
verses.tib: chu bur bskyed phyir go bye cham chom brdungs / nub mo ba gcin la sbangs nyin grib bskam du / de ltar lan gsum byas te zhib tu btags / snu ha'i 'o mar sbyar bskus sha bkra 'joms

verses.skt: akṣatailadrutā lepaḥ kṛṣṇasarpodbhavā maṣī | śikhipittaṃ tathā dagdhaṃ hrīveraṃ vā tadāplutam
verses.tib: sbrul nag bsregs pa las byung snag tsha ni / ba ru ra yi mar dang sbyar te bsku / de bzhin rma bya'i mkhris pa bsregs pa'am / ba li ka bsregs rma bya'i mkhris bsregs phan

verses.skt: kuḍavo ’valgujabījād dharitālacaturbhāgasaṃmiśraḥ | mūtreṇa gavāṃ piṣṭaḥ savarṇakaraṇaṃ paraṃ śvitre
verses.tib: so ma ra dza'i sa bon phul gang dang / ba bla cha bzhi dag ni bsres nas su / ba yi gcin dang sbyar te btags bskus na / sha bkra lpags mdog 'dra bar byed pa'i mchog

verses.skt: kṣāre sudagdhe gajaliṇḍaje ca gajasya mūtreṇa parisrute ca | droṇapramāṇe daśabhāgayuktaṃ dattvā paced bījam avalgujānām
verses.tib: glang chen rtug pa legs bsres thal ba ni / glang chen gcin dang bsres te gzags gyur pa / bre bcu drug tshad so ma ra dza yi / sa bon bcu chas btab bskol sbyin bag gyur

verses.skt: śvitraṃ jayec cikkaṇatāṃ gatena tena pralimpan bahuśaḥ praghṛṣṭaṃ | kuṣṭhaṃ maṣaṃ vā tilakālakaṃ vā yad vā vraṇe syād adhimāṃsajātam
verses.tib: mang du bdar ba de yis bskus na ni / sha bkra'i nad ni rnam par 'joms 'gyur zhing / mdze yi nad dang sme ba nag po'am / sha lhag skyes pa'i rma ni sbyong bar byed

verses.skt: bhallātakaṃ dvīpisudhārkamūlaṃ guñjāphalaṃ tryūṣaṇaśaṅkhacūrṇam | tutthaṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇāni pañca kṣāradvayaṃ lāṅgalikāṃ ca paktvā
verses.tib: go bye tsi tra ka dang snu ha dang / arka'i rtsa ba dang ni 'ol ma se / de bzhin tsha ba gsum dang dung dang ni / spangs ma ru rtar bcas dang lan tshwa lngar / thal ba gnyis dang lang ga li btags phye

verses.skt: snugarkadugdhe ghanam āyasasthaṃ śalākayā tad vidadhīta lepam | kuṣṭhe kilāse tilakālakeṣu maṣeṣu durnāmasu carmakīle
verses.tib: snu ha arka'i 'o mar bskol nas ni / ska bar gyur pa lcags snod nang du gzhag / de ni thur mas bskus na mdze nad dang / sha bkra sme ba nag por gyur pa dang

verses.skt: śuddhyā śoṇitamokṣair virūkṣaṇair bhakṣaṇaiś ca saktūnām | śvitraṃ kasyacid eva praśāmyati kṣīṇapāpasya
verses.tib: mdzer pa gzhang 'brum pags pa'i rmen bu sel / sbyang byas gtar ga btab pa dang / rtsub chos phye zan zos gyur pa'i / sdig pa zad par gyur pa yi / 'ga' zhig gis ni sha bkra 'byung

verses.skt: snigdhasvinne guḍakṣīramatsyādyaiḥ kṛmiṇodare | utkleśitakṛmikaphe śarvarīṃ tāṃ sukhoṣite
verses.tib: khong pa'i srin yod snum dugs byas / bu ram 'o ma nya sogs kyis / bad kan srin bu bslangs nas ni / nub mo de ni bde bar gnas

verses.skt: surasādigaṇaṃ mūtre kvāthayitvārdhavāriṇi | taṃ kaṣāyaṃ kaṇāgālakṛmijitkalkayojitam
verses.tib: bye'u rug sdeb gcin dang / chu phyed bcas pa bskol nas ni / khu ba de nang pi pi ling / po son cha dang byi dang ga

verses.skt: satailasvarjikākṣāraṃ yuñjyād vastiṃ tato ’hani | tasminn eva nirūḍhaṃ taṃ pāyayeta virecanam
verses.tib: til mar swardzi k+Sha rar bcas / mas gtong bas ni gtang bar bya / de nyid de la de nyid dam / dur byid lde gu po son cha

verses.skt: trivṛtkalkaṃ phalakaṇākaṣāyāloḍitaṃ tataḥ | ūrdhvādhaḥśodhite kuryāt pañcakolayutaṃ kramam
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni khu bar bsres / bkru sman de la brud par bya / de ltar steng 'og sbyang byas nas / tsha ba lnga ldan thugs blud

verses.skt: kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ kaṣāyaiḥ pariṣecanam | kāle viḍaṅgatailena tatas tam anuvāsayet
verses.tib: tsha dang kha dang bska ba yi / sman ni bskol chus blugs par bya / dus / su byi dang ga'i til mar / 'jam rtsi de la gtang bar bya

verses.skt: śiroroganiṣedhoktam ācaren mūrdhageṣv anu | udriktatiktakaṭukam alpasnehaṃ ca bhojanam
verses.tib: mgo bo'i sin bu mgo nad ni / gso bar bshad pa'i rim par bya / tsha dang kha ba shas che zhing / snum nyung kha zas sbyin par bya

verses.skt: viḍaṅgakṛṣṇāmaricapippalīmūlaśigrubhiḥ | pibet sasvarjikākṣārair yavāgūṃ takrasādhitām
verses.tib: byi dang ga dang pi pi ling / pi pi ling rtsa na le sham / na le sham ni dkar po dang / swardzi ka ni thal bar bcas / nas thug dar bar btsos pa blud

verses.skt: rasaṃ śirīṣakiṇihīpāribhadrakakembukāt | palāśabījapattūrapūtikād vā pṛthak pibet
verses.tib: gi ri gar ni shri sha ka / pa ri pa tra ke pu ka / pa la sha 'bras pa tu ra / su ti ka ni so sor bskol

verses.skt: sakṣaudraṃ surasādīn vā lihyāt kṣaudrayutān pṛthak | śatakṛtvo ’śvaviṭcūrṇaṃ viḍaṅgakvāthabhāvitam
verses.tib: khu ba sbrang rtsir bcas pa'am / bye rug pa sogs sbrang rtsir sbyar / rta sbangs phye ma byi dang ga / bskol ba'i nang sbangs mang du bza'

verses.skt: kṛmimān madhunā lihyād bhāvitaṃ vā varārasaiḥ | śirogateṣu kṛmiṣu cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ ca tat
verses.tib: sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu'am / 'bras bu gsum khur sbangs pa sbyin / mgo bo'i srin bu'i nad la ni / de yi phye ma bud par bya

verses.skt: ākhukarṇīkisalayaiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ piṣṭamiśritaiḥ | paktvā pūpalikāṃ khāded dhānyāmlaṃ ca pibed anu
verses.tib: mu sha kar+Na'i 'dab ma ni / zhib tu btags pa 'bras phyer bcas / btsos pa'i khu ba sbyin par bya / de yi rjes la rang skyur ram

verses.skt: sapañcakolalavaṇam asāndraṃ takram eva vā | nīpamārkavanirguṇḍīpallaveṣv apy ayaṃ vidhiḥ
verses.tib: dar ba sla ba tsha ba lnga / lan tshwar bcas pa blud par bya / nim pa a pa marga dang / nir gun thi lo 'ang de bzhin bya

verses.skt: viḍaṅgacūrṇamiśrair vā piṣṭair bhakṣyān prakalpayet | viḍaṅgataṇḍulair yuktam ardhāṃśair ātape sthitam
verses.tib: byi dang ga yi phye ma dang / bgres pa'i 'bras phye'i khur ba sbyin / go bye'i mar ni rnying pa la / byi dang ga ni shun pa bsal / cha phyed bcug ste nyi mar gzhag

verses.skt: dinam āruṣkaraṃ tailaṃ pāne vastau ca yojayet | surāhvasaralasnehaṃ pṛthag evaṃ ca kalpayet
verses.tib: btung ba 'jam rtsi sbyar bar bya / thang shing shri beSh+Ta yi snum / so sor de bzhin sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: purīṣajeṣu sutarāṃ dadyād vastivirecane | śirovirekaṃ vamanaṃ śamanaṃ kaphajanmasu
verses.tib: bshang bar skyes la lhag par yang / bkru sman dang ni 'jam rtsi gtang / bad kan las gyur mgo bo'i nad / bkru sman slon dang zhi sman gtang

verses.skt: raktajānāṃ pratīkāraṃ kuryāt kuṣṭhacikitsitāt | indraluptavidhiś cātra vidheyo romabhojiṣu
verses.tib: khrag las gyur pa'i srin bu la / gso ba mdze yi tshul du bya / spu 'byi byed la gso ba ni / 'khor ling skra 'byi cho ga bya

verses.skt: kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti | samāsato ’mlān madhurān rasāṃś ca kṛmīñ jihāsuḥ parivarjayeta
verses.tib: 'o ma sha dang mar dang bu ram dang / zho dang 'dab ma can gyi tshod ma dang / mdor na mngar dang skyur ba'i khu ba rnams / srin bu gzhom par 'dod pas yongs su spang

verses.skt: kevalaṃ nirupastambham ādau snehair upācaret | vāyuṃ sarpirvasāmajjatailapānair naraṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: par bya'o / ma 'dres rlung las dang por ni / mar dang rkang dang tshil dang ni / til mar blud cing snum gyi ni

verses.skt: snehaklāntaṃ samāśvāsya payobhiḥ snehayet punaḥ | yūṣair grāmyaudakānūparasair vā snehasaṃyutaiḥ
verses.tib: sbyor bas legs par gso bar bya / de nas snum zhen ngal bso ste / 'o mas slar yang snum chos bya / rlan can grong dang chu la gnas / sha khu snum dang ldan pa gtang

verses.skt: pāyasaiḥ kṛśaraiḥ sāmlalavaṇaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ | nāvanais tarpaṇaiś cānnaiḥ susnigdhaiḥ svedayet tataḥ
verses.tib: 'o thug kri sar skyur dang bcas / lan tshwar ldan blud 'jam rtsi gtang / sna sman skyo byas kha zas ni / snum byas sbyin cing dugs byas la

verses.skt: svabhyaktaṃ snehasaṃyuktaiḥ śaṅkarādyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | snehāktaṃ svinnam aṅgaṃ tu vakraṃ stabdhaṃ savedanam
verses.tib: legs bskus snum dang ldan pa la / gseg ma la sogs dugs bya'o / snum gyis zhen byas dugs byas pas / g.yo zhing rengs dang gzer bcas pa

verses.skt: yatheṣṭam ānāmayituṃ sukham eva hi śakyate | śuṣkāṇy api hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ
verses.tib: ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gugs pa ni / bde blag nyid du nus par 'gyur / ji ltar shing skam dag kyang ni / snum bskus bsros par gyur na ni

verses.skt: śakyaṃ karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ kim u gātrāṇi jīvatām | harṣatodarugāyāmaśophastambhagrahādayaḥ
verses.tib: las su bya bar rung gyur na / srog chags lus ni smos ci dgos / spu brtse gzer na snyoms pa dang / lus skem rengs pa'i nad la

verses.skt: svinnasyāśu praśāmyanti mārdavaṃ copajāyate | snehaś ca dhātūn saṃśuṣkān puṣṇāty āśūpayojitaḥ
verses.tib: dugs byas myur du zhi 'gyur zhing / mnyen pa nyid du'ang 'gyur ba yin / snum btang bas ni lus zungs rnams / bskam pa myur du rgyas par byed

verses.skt: balam agnibalaṃ puṣṭiṃ prāṇāṃś cāsyābhivardhayet | asakṛt taṃ punaḥ snehaiḥ svedaiś ca pratipādayet
verses.tib: nyams stobs me drod 'phel 'gyur zhing / de yi srog kyang ring nas byed / lan mang snum dang dugs kyi ni / cho ga legs par sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: tathā snehamṛdau koṣṭhe na tiṣṭhanty anilāmayāḥ | yady etena sadoṣatvāt karmaṇā na praśāmyati
verses.tib: de ltar snum gyis mnyen byas ltor / rlung gi nad ni gnas mi 'gyur / gal te nad gzhan bcos pa'i phyir / las 'di zhi bar ma gyur na

verses.skt: mṛdubhiḥ snehasaṃyuktair bheṣajais taṃ viśodhayet | ghṛtaṃ tilvakasiddhaṃ vā sātalāsiddham eva vā
verses.tib: 'jam zhing snum dang ldan pa yi / snum gyis de ni sbyang bar bya / zhun mar seng phrom btsos pa dang / sap+ta la dang bskol ba'am

verses.skt: payasairaṇḍatailaṃ vā pibed doṣaharaṃ śivam | snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇādyair āhārair hi malaś citaḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma e raN+Da yi mar / bskol ba nad sel dge ba blud / snum skyur dro dang lan tshwa sogs / zas kyi dri ma tshogs gyur nas

verses.skt: sroto baddhvānilaṃ rundhyāt tasmāt tam anulomayet | durbalo yo ’virecyaḥ syāt taṃ nirūhair upācaret
verses.tib: bu ga 'gags te rlung bkag pas / de phyir de ni bde rgyu bya / nyam chung bkru sman byar 'os pa / de la drod skyed smin byed pa'i

verses.skt: dīpanaiḥ pācanīyair vā bhojyair vā tadyutair naram | saṃśuddhasyotthite cāgnau snehasvedau punar hitau
verses.tib: kha zas sbyin pa'am de bcas pa'i / mas gtong bkru sman sbyar bar bya / sbyang zhing me drod bskyed gyur nas / slar / yang snum dang dugs byas phan

verses.skt: āmāśayagate vāyau vamitapratibhojite | sukhāmbunā ṣaḍdharaṇaṃ vacādiṃ vā prayojayet
verses.tib: ma zhu'i gnas su zhugs pa'i rlung / slon byas zas rim byin nas ni / ba ra Na sogs drug pa'am / shu dag chu dro sbyar blud

verses.skt: saṃdhukṣite ’gnau parato vidhiḥ kevalavātikaḥ | matsyān nābhipradeśasthe siddhān bilvaśalāṭubhiḥ
verses.tib: me drod bskyed nas de'i 'og tu / rlung can gcig pu'i gso ba bya / lto ba'i phyogs zhugs bil ba ni / gzhon dang nya shas g.yos byas sbyin

verses.skt: vastikarma tv adho nābheḥ śasyate cāvapīḍakaḥ | koṣṭhage kṣāracūrṇādyā hitāḥ pācanadīpanāḥ
verses.tib: lte ba'i 'og zhugs 'jam rtsi gtang / zas kyi sngon du snum btang phan / khong par zhugs la thal sman sogs / phye ma drod skyed smin byed phan

verses.skt: hṛtsthe payaḥ sthirāsiddhaṃ śirovastiḥ śirogate | snaihikaṃ nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ śrotrādīnāṃ ca tarpaṇam
verses.tib: snying gnas sa la par+Ni dag / 'o ma dang ni bskol ba phan / mgo bor gnas la mgo snum bsku / sna sman dud rngub snum can dang / rna ba sogs la brta byas phan

verses.skt: svedābhyaṅganivātāni hṛdyaṃ cānnaṃ tvagāśrite | śītāḥ pradehā raktasthe vireko raktamokṣaṇam
verses.tib: pags par gnas la bsku byug dugs / rlung med gnas su gnas pa dang / kha zas yi ga 'byed pa phan / khrag gnas bsil sman bsku ba dang / bkru sman khrag ni dbyung ba phan

verses.skt: vireko māṃsamedaḥsthe nirūhaḥ śamanāni ca | bāhyābhyantarataḥ snehair asthimajjagataṃ jayet
verses.tib: sha tshil brten pa bkru sman dang / mas gtong drag dang zhi bya'i sman / rus pa rkang la gnas pa la / phyi dang nang nas snum gyis gso

verses.skt: praharṣo ’nnaṃ ca śukrasthe balaśukrakaraṃ hitam | vibaddhamārgaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu śukraṃ dadyād virecanam
verses.tib: khu chur gnas la sems dga' dang / kha zas stobs skyed ro tsa phan / khu ba rgyu ba 'gags gyur na / bkru sman btang bas gso bar bya

verses.skt: viriktaṃ pratibhuktaṃ ca pūrvoktāṃ kārayet kriyām | garbhe śuṣke tu vātena bālānāṃ ca viśuṣyatām
verses.tib: 'khrus shing zas rim bsten gyur nas / sngar bshad pa yi gso ba bya / rlung las mngal chags bskams gyur dang / byis pa skems par gyur pa la

verses.skt: sitākāśmaryamadhukaiḥ siddham utthāpane payaḥ | snāvasaṃdhisirāprāpte snehadāhopanāhanam
verses.tib: kar tang pa la shing mngar rnams / 'o ma sbyar bskol blud pa phan / rgyus pa tshigs dang rtsar zhugs la / snum tsha dkri ba'i dugs byas phan

verses.skt: tailaṃ saṃkucite ’bhyaṅgo māṣasaindhavasādhitam | āgāradhūmalavaṇatailair lepaḥ srute ’sṛji
verses.tib: yan lag 'khums lam sha dang / rgyam tsha til mar bskol bas bsku / khrag gzags drags la yan lag ni / tshor ba med la khyim dud pa

verses.skt: supte ’ṅge veṣṭayukte tu kartavyam upanāhanam | athāpatānakenārtam asrastākṣam avepanam
verses.tib: rgyam tsha til mar sbyar bas bsku / dkri ba'i dugs ni sbyar bar bya / gzhan dbang can gyis gzir gyur cing / mig 'gyur mi shes 'dar ba med

verses.skt: astabdhameḍhram asvedaṃ bahirāyāmavarjitam | akhaṭvāghātinaṃ cainaṃ tvaritaṃ samupācaret
verses.tib: pho mtshan mi ldang rngul mi 'byung / phyi rol rtsol ba med 'gyur la / khri yi bcings pas ma non pa / de la myur du gso / dpyad bya

verses.skt: tatra prāg eva susnigdhasvinnāṅge tīkṣṇanāvanam | srotoviśuddhaye yuñjyād acchapānaṃ tato ghṛtam
verses.tib: der ni thog mar snum zhen bya / dugs byas sna sman rnon pos ni / bu ga sbyang phyir btang ba dang

verses.skt: vidāryādigaṇakvāthadadhikṣīrarasaiḥ śṛtam | nātimātraṃ tathā vāyur vyāpnoti sahasaiva vā
verses.tib: bi da ra yi sde bskol dang / zho dang 'o ma sha khu dang / mar bskol ba yi dngas ma blud / des ni rlung nad tshabs che ba'am / 'phral du khyab par mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: kulatthayavakolāni bhadradārvādikaṃ gaṇam | niḥkvāthyānūpamāṃsaṃ ca tenāmlaiḥ payasāpi ca
verses.tib: rgya sran nas dang rgya shug / thang shing la sogs sde tshan ni / rlan can sha ni bskol ba dang / skyur dang 'o ma dag dang ni

verses.skt: svāduskandhapratīvāpaṃ mahāsnehaṃ vipācayet | sekābhyaṅgāvagāhānnapānanasyānuvāsanaiḥ
verses.tib: mngar ba'i sde tshan btab pa yi / snum chen dag ni bskol ba yis / blugs dang bsku dang lus spyi dang / btung dang sna sman 'jam rtsir bya

verses.skt: sa hanti vātaṃ te te ca snehasvedāḥ suyojitāḥ | vegāntareṣu mūrdhānam asakṛc cāsya recayet
verses.tib: snum dang dugs ni legs sbyar ba / de dang des ni rlung nad 'joms / nad shugs bar ma dag la ni / bad kan sel zhing rno ba yi / spyi bo'i bkru sman lan mang gtang / bud cing gtang bar bya ba yis / dbugs rgyu'i gnas ni dag gyur nas / des ni dran pa rnyed par 'gyur

verses.skt: avapīḍaiḥ pradhamanais tīkṣṇaiḥ śleṣmanibarhaṇaiḥ | śvasanāsu vimuktāsu tathā saṃjñāṃ sa vindati
verses.tib: snum dang dugs ni legs sbyar ba / de dang des ni rlung nad 'joms / nad shugs bar ma dag la ni / bad kan sel zhing rno ba yi / spyi bo'i bkru sman lan mang gtang / bud cing gtang bar bya ba yis / dbugs rgyu'i gnas ni dag gyur nas / des ni dran pa rnyed par 'gyur

verses.skt: sauvarcalābhayāvyoṣasiddhaṃ sarpiś cale ’dhike
verses.tib: kha ru tsha dang a ru ra

verses.skt: palāṣṭakaṃ tilvakato varāyāḥ prasthaṃ palāṃśaṃ gurupañcamūlam | sairaṇḍasiṃhītrivṛtaṃ ghaṭe ’pāṃ paktvā pacet pādaśṛtena tena
verses.tib: seng phrom srang brgyad 'bras bu gsum / bre gang rtsa ba chen po lnga / e raN+Da dang bri ha ti / dur byid srang re chu bre ni / bcu drug nang du bskol nas su / bzhi cha lus pa de dang ni / mar bre gang dang chu bre bzhi

verses.skt: dadhnaḥ pātre yāvaśūkāt tribilvaiḥ sarpiḥprasthaṃ hanti tat sevyamānam | duṣṭān vātān ekasarvāṅgasaṃsthān yonivyāpadgulmavardhmodaraṃ ca
verses.tib: nas tshig 'khus thal srang gsum bskol / de bsten rlung nad ma rungs pa / yan lag phyogs gcig kun la zhugs / mngal gyi nad dang rgyu rlugs dang / skran dang dmu rdzing 'joms par byed

verses.skt: vidhis tilvakavaj jñeyo ramyakāśokayor api
verses.tib: ra mnye ba dang a shwa ka'ang / cho ga seng phrom lta bur bya

verses.skt: cikitsitam idaṃ kuryāc chuddhavātāpatānake | saṃsṛṣṭadoṣe saṃsṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇayitvā kaphānvite
verses.tib: gso ba 'di ni gzhan dbang can / rlung nad ma 'dres pa la bya / nad gzhi 'dren mar 'dren mas bya / bad kan bcas pa'i gzhan dbang can

verses.skt: tumburūṇy abhayā hiṅgu pauṣkaraṃ lavaṇatrayam | yavakvāthāmbunā peyaṃ hṛtpārśvārtyapatantrake
verses.tib: snying ga rtsib logs na ba la / g.yer ma shing kun a ru ra / ma nu dang ni lan tshwa gsum / nas bskol khu ba sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ śuṇṭhī dāḍimaṃ sāmlavetasam | pibed vā śleṣmapavanahṛdrogoktaṃ ca śasyate
verses.tib: shing kun bca' sga rtsal ru tsha / se 'bru star bu bcas pa blud / bad kan rlung ni 'dres pa la / snying nad gso ba'i skabs bshad phan

verses.skt: āyāmayor arditavad bāhyābhyantarayoḥ kriyā | tailadroṇyāṃ ca śayanam āntaro ’tra sudustaraḥ
verses.tib: da rgan phyir dgye nang gug gnyis / klad pa gzhogs phyed na ltar gso / til / mar gyis bkang snod du bsnyal / 'dir ni nang gug rab gso dka'

verses.skt: vivarṇadantavadanaḥ srastāṅgo naṣṭacetanaḥ | prasvidyaṃś ca dhanuḥṣkambhī daśarātraṃ na jīvati
verses.tib: so dang bzhin gyi mdog nyams shing / yan lag lhod cing dran pa nyams / rab tu rngul ba'i gzhung rengs yin / de ni zhag bcu las mi 'tsho

verses.skt: vegeṣv ato anyathā jīven mandeṣu vinato jaḍaḥ | khañjaḥ kuṇiḥ pakṣahataḥ paṅgulo vikalo ’thavā
verses.tib: de las gzhan shugs sman gyur 'tsho / lus sgu ba dang 'on glen dang / 'theng dang zha bo gzhogs phyed nyams / 'phye bo'am dbang po ma tshang 'gyur

verses.skt: hanusraṃse hanū snigdhasvinnau svasthānam ānayet | unnāmayec ca kuśalaś cibukaṃ vivṛtte mukhe
verses.tib: 'gram pa nyams pa 'gram pa snum / dugs byas nas ni rang gnas gzhug / kha gdangs pa la kos ko ni / bteg la mkhas pas gzhug par bya

verses.skt: nāmayet saṃvṛte śeṣam ekāyāmavad ācaret | jihvāstambhe yathāvasthaṃ kāryaṃ vātacikitsitam
verses.tib: 'tham par gyur pa lhag ma la / phyogs gcig gug pa lta bur gso / lce ldibs gnas skabs ji bzhin du / rlung nad kyi ni gso ba bya

verses.skt: vāggrahe koṣṇatoyena vetasāmlaṃ piben naraḥ | mātuluṅgarasaṃ tadvad dhiṅgusauvarcalānvitam
ardite nāvanaṃ mūrdhni tailaṃ śrotrākṣitarpaṇam | saśophe vamanaṃ dāharāgayukte sirāvyadhaḥ
verses.tib: sna sman spyi bo'i til mar dang / mig dang rna ba dgang bar bya / skrangs par skyug sman gtang bar bya / tsha zhing dmar bcas gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: navanītena saṃyuktāṃ khāden māṣeṇḍarīṃ naraḥ | durvāram arditaṃ hanti saptāhān nātra saṃśayaḥ
snehanaṃ snehasaṃyuktaṃ pakṣāghāte virecanam | avabāhau hitaṃ nasyaṃ snehaś cottarabhaktikaḥ
verses.tib: gzhogs phyed skams la snum chos dang / snum dang ldan pa'i bkru sman gtang / dpung pa 'jas la sna sman dang

verses.skt: māṣabalāśukaśimbīkaṭtṛṇarāsnāśvagandhorubūkāṇām | kvātho nasyanipīto rāmaṭhalavaṇānvitaḥ koṣṇaḥ
apanayati pakṣavātaṃ manyāstambhaṃ sakarṇanādarujam | durjayam arditavātaṃ saptāhāj jayati cāvaśyam
guḍamañjaryā khapuraṃ vṛṣabhīmūlaṃ ca śiśirajalapiṣṭam | nāvanavidhau prayojitam avabāhukagalarujārtiharam
daśamūlabalāmāṣakvāthaṃ tailājyamiśritam | sāyaṃ bhuktvā piben nasyaṃ viśvācyām avabāhuke
verses.tib: zas kyi rjes la snum sbyin bya / brla rengs pa la snum chos dang

verses.skt: ūrustambhe tu na sneho na ca saṃśodhanaṃ hitam | śleṣmāmamedobāhulyād yuktyā tatkṣapaṇāny ataḥ
verses.tib: sbyang byas phan pa ma yin te / bad kan ma zhu tshil mang bas / de phyir de la rtsub chos kyi / zad par bya bas gso bar bya

verses.skt: kuryād rūkṣopacāraś ca yavaśyāmākakodravāḥ | śākair alavaṇaiḥ śastāḥ kiñcittailair jalaiḥ śṛtaiḥ
verses.tib: nas dang khre dang khre rgod sbyin / tshod ma lan tshwa med pa ni / til mar cung zad chur bskol ba'am

verses.skt: jāṅgalair aghṛtair māṃsair madhvambho'riṣṭapāyinaḥ | vatsakādir haridrādir vacādir vā sasaindhavaḥ
verses.tib: skam sa'i sha ni mar med dang / sbrang rtsi chu dang chang rnying sbyin / phyug po'i rlung la dug mo nyung / yung ba'i sde tshan shu dag sogs / bskol ba rgyam tshar bcas pa'am

verses.skt: āḍhyavāte sukhāmbhobhiḥ peyaḥ ṣaḍdharaṇo ’thavā | lihyāt kṣaudreṇa vā śreṣṭhācavyatiktākaṇāghanāt
verses.tib: ba ra Na sogs phye sbyar blud / yang na dbyi mo 'bras bu gsum / pu tse shel dang pi pi ling / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin

verses.skt: citrakendrayavāḥ pāṭhā kaṭukātiviṣā niśā | vātavyādhipraśamano yogaḥ ṣaḍdharaṇāhvayaḥ
kalkaṃ samadhu vā cavyapathyāgnisuradārujam | mūtrair vā śīlayet pathyāṃ gugguluṃ girisaṃbhavam
verses.tib: yang na dbyi mo a ru ra / tsi tra ka dang thang shing dang / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin / gu gul brag zhun a ru ra / ba gcin dang ni sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: vyoṣāgnimustatriphalāviḍaṅgair gugguluṃ samam | khādan sarvāñ jayed vyādhīn medaḥśleṣmāmavātajān
verses.tib: gla sgang tsi tra tsha ba gsum / 'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga / gu gul cha mnyam phye ma sbyin / chil dang bad / kan ma zhu las / gyur pa'i nad ni thams cad sel

verses.skt: śāmyaty evaṃ kaphākrāntaḥ samedaskaḥ prabhañjanaḥ | kṣāramūtrānvitān svedān sekān udvartanāni ca
verses.tib: de ltar bad kan shas che zhing / tshil bcas rlung ni nad sel byed / thal sman ba gcin sbyar dugs dang / blugs dang lus la dril ba'ang bya

verses.skt: kuryād dihyāc ca mūtrāḍhyaiḥ karañjaphalasarṣapaiḥ | mūlair vāpy arkatarkārīnimbajaiḥ sasurāhvayaiḥ
verses.tib: nyungs kar ka rany+dza'i 'bras bu / ba gcin sbyar bas bsku bar bya / arka ag+ni man+tha dang / nim pa'i rtsa ba thang shing dang

verses.skt: sakṣaudrasarṣapāpakvaloṣṭavalmīkamṛttikaiḥ | kaphakṣayārthaṃ vyāyāme sahye cainaṃ pravartayet
verses.tib: bong pa dang ni grog mkhar sa / yungs kar sbrang rtsir bcas pa bsku / bad kan zad phyir drag shul ni / bzod na de la brten par bya

verses.skt: sthalāny ullaṅghayen nārīḥ śaktitaḥ pariśīlayet | sthiratoyaṃ saraḥ kṣemaṃ pratisroto nadīṃ taret
verses.tib: thang la mchong dang ci nus kyis / nyal po dag kyang yongs su bsten / chu mi g.yo dang lteng ka dang / chu rgyun bzlog pas chu bo rgal

verses.skt: śleṣmamedaḥkṣaye cātra snehādīn avacārayet | sthānadūṣyādi cālocya kāryā śeṣeṣv api kriyā
verses.tib: 'dir ni tshil dang bad kan dag / zad nas snum la sogs pa gtang / gnas dang lus zungs sogs brtags la / lhag ma rnams kyang gso bar bya

verses.skt: bṛhannimbataror mūlaṃ vāriṇā paripeṣitam | saṃpītaṃ nāśayet kṣipram asādhyām api gṛdhrasīm
tūṇīpratūṇyor lavanaṃ saghṛtaṃ kṣārahiṅgu vā | raktāvasecanaṃ kuryād abhīkṣṇaṃ vātakaṇṭake
pibed eraṇḍatailaṃ vā dahet sūcībhir eva vā | sājyaiḥ saktubhir abhyaktau na cākṣīrasamanvitaiḥ
śālmalītvagviliptau vā pādau saṃtāpam udgataḥ
verses.tib: sa ha ra dza thang shing dang

verses.skt: sahacaraṃ suradāru sanāgaraṃ kvathitam ambhasi tailavimiśritam | pavanapīḍitadehagatiḥ piban drutavilambitago bhavatīcchayā
verses.tib: dong gra bskol ba til mar sbyar / rlung gis lus gzir la blud na / ci 'dod thogs pa med 'gro nus / ra sna dong gra tsi tra ka

verses.skt: rāsnāmahauṣadhadvīpipippalīśaṭhipauṣkaram | piṣṭvā vipācayet sarpir vātarogaharaṃ param
verses.tib: zur pa ma nu pi pi ling / btags pa'i phye ma mar bskol ba / rlung nad sel bar byed pa'i mchog

verses.skt: nimbāmṛtāvṛṣapaṭolanidigdhikānāṃ bhāgān pṛthak daśa palān vipaced ghaṭe 'pām | aṣṭāṃśaśeṣitarasena punaś ca tena prasthaṃ ghṛtasya vipacet picubhāgakalkaiḥ
verses.tib: nim pa sle tres ba sha ka / kaN+Da ka ri pa to la / srang ni bcu bcu'i tshad byas la / chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol / khu ba brgyad cha lus pa der / mar ni bre gang blugs te bskol

verses.skt: pāṭhāviḍaṅgasuradārugajopakulyādvikṣāranāgaraniśāmiśicavyakuṣṭhaiḥ | tejovatīmaricavatsakadīpyakāgnirohiṇyaruṣkaravacākaṇamūlayuktaiḥ
verses.tib: pa ta thang shing byi dang ga / dong gra ha ti pi pi ling / skyer pa shu ti dbyi mo dang / te dzo ba ti na le sham / ru rta dang ni dug mo nyung / thal sman rnam pa gnyis po dang / ti mu sa dang kru trug tres / bse shing 'bras bu pu tse shel

verses.skt: mañjiṣṭhayātiviṣayā viṣayā yavānyā saṃśuddhaguggulupalair api pañcasaṃkhyaiḥ | tat sevitaṃ vidhamati prabalaṃ samīraṃ saṃdhyasthimajjagatam apy atha kuṣṭham īdṛk
verses.tib: shu dag pi pi ling rtsa ba / btsod dang bong nga la la phud / zho ni gnyis gnyis tshad byas pa / gu gul sbyar ba srang lnga dang / lde gu btab ste bskol ba'i mar / blud na rlung tshad tshabs che ba / rus tshigs rkang la zhen pa'ang 'joms / mdze nad de 'dra'ang sel bar byed

verses.skt: nāḍīvraṇārbudabhagandaragaṇḍamālājatrūrdhvasarvagadagulmagudotthamehān | yakṣmāruciśvasanapīnasakāsaśophahṛtpāṇḍurogamadavidradhivātaraktam
verses.tib: bu ga'i rma dang lba ba dang / mtshan par rdol dang 'bras kyi phreng / nam tshong yan chad nad kun dang / skran dang gzhang 'brum za khu dang / gcong chen dbugs mi bde ba dang / yi ga 'chus dang cham pa dang / lud pa 'or nad snying nad dang

verses.skt: rāsnāṭarūṣasuradārvamṛtāśatāvaryeraṇḍapuṣkaradhamāsakaśuṇṭhipathyāḥ | nighnanti vātajarujaṃ khalu saśvadaṃṣṭrāḥ śaileyaśaṭhyativiṣāḥ kvathitāḥ prayuktā
verses.tib: skya rbab myos dang khong 'bras dang / rlung dang khrag gi nad rnams 'joms / bil ba gzhon nu'i 'o ma dang

verses.skt: balābilvaśṛte kṣīre ghṛtamaṇḍaṃ vipācayet | tasya śuktiḥ prakuñco vā nasyaṃ vāte śirogate
verses.tib: mar gyi nying khu bskol nas ni / de la srang ni gcig gam phyed / sna sman byas mgo'i rlung nad sel

verses.skt: tadvat siddhā vasā nakramatsyakūrmaculūkajā | viśeṣeṇa prayoktavyā kevale mātariśvani
verses.tib: de bzhin chu srin nag khra dang / nya dang rus sbal 'ug pa'i chil / bskol ba ma 'dres rlung la ni / khyad par du ni gtang bar bya

verses.skt: jīrṇaṃ piṇyākaṃ pañcamūlaṃ pṛthak ca kvāthyaṃ kvāthābhyām ekatas tailam ābhyām | kṣīrād aṣṭāṃśaṃ pācayet tena pānād vātā naśyeyuḥ śleṣmayuktā viśeṣāt || 64 || prasāriṇītulākvāthe tailaprasthaṃ payaḥsamam | dvimedāmiśimañjiṣṭhākuṣṭharāsnākucandanaiḥ
verses.tib: til gyi tshigs ma rnying pa dang / rtsa ba lnga pa so sor bskol / gcig tu bsres pa til mar ni / 'o ma brgyad cha'i nang du bskol / blud na rlung dang bad kan dang / 'dres pa'i nad ni thams cad 'joms / pra sa ra ni srang brgyad bskol / til mar 'o ma bre re dang

verses.skt: jīvakarṣabhakākolīyugalāmaradārubhiḥ | kalkitair vipacet sarvamārutāmayanāśanam
verses.tib: med gnyis dang sha puSh+pa / btsod dang ru rta ra sna dang / tsan+dan dmar po dzi ba ka / ra sna ra mnye ba gnyis dang / thang shing btags pa'i lde gu dang / bskol blud rlung nad thams cad sel

verses.skt: samūlaśākhasya sahācarasya tulāṃ sametāṃ daśamūlataś ca | palāni pañcāśad abhīrutaś ca pādāvaśeṣaṃ vipaced vahe ’pām
verses.tib: sa ha ra dza'i rtsa ba yal gar bcas / srang brgya rtsa ba bcu ni de dang mnyam / nye'u shing srang ni lnga bcu chu bre drug cu ni / rtsa bzhi'i nang bskol bzhi cha lus pa der

verses.skt: tatra sevyanakhakuṣṭhahimailāspṛkpriyaṅgunalikāmbuśilājaiḥ | lohitānaladalohasurāhvaiḥ kopanāmiśituruṣkanataiś ca
verses.tib: chu srin sder mo ru rta pu shel tse / tsan+dan sug smel pri ka pri yang ku / na li ka dang rdo dreg ba le ka / spang spos thang shing btsod dang a ru ra / tsa rong shu ti rgya spos du ru ka / srang re cha mnyam 'o mar bcas pa ni

verses.skt: tulyakṣīraṃ pālikais tailapātraṃ siddhaṃ kṛcchrāñ chīlitaṃ hanti vātān | kampākṣepastambhaśoṣādiyuktān gulmonmādau pīnasaṃ yonirogān
verses.tib: til mar bre bzhi lhan cig bskol ba blud / rlung nad gso dka' dag kyang 'joms par byed / lus 'dar lus la rlung 'jug lus rengs dang / lus bskams pa yis shin tu gzir la sogs / skran dang smyo byed cham pa mngal nad 'joms

verses.skt: sahacaratulāyās tu rase tailāḍhakaṃ pacet | mūlakalkād daśapalaṃ payo dattvā caturguṇam
verses.tib: sa ha ra dza srang brgya yi / khu bar til mar bre bzhi bskol / de rtsa lde gu srang bcu dang / 'o ma bzhi 'gyur bcug ste bskol

verses.skt: athavā nataṣaḍgranthāsthirākuṣṭhasurāhvayāt | sailānaladaśaileyaśatāhvāraktacandanāt
verses.tib: yang na rgya spos shu dag dang / stir ru rta shu dag dang / sug smel rdo dreg spang spos dang / shu ti tsan+dan dmar po gzhug

verses.skt: siddhe ’smiñ charkarācūrṇād aṣṭādaśapalaṃ kṣipet | bheḍasya saṃmataṃ tailaṃ tat kṛcchrān anilāmayān
verses.tib: bskol ba der ni kha ra'i phye / srang ni bco brgyad gzhug par bya / til mar sman / mar yin par bshad / des ni rlung nad ma lus dang

verses.skt: vātakuṇḍalikonmādagulmavardhmādikāñ jayet | balāśataṃ chinnaruhāpādaṃ rāsnāṣṭabhāgikam
verses.tib: rlung nad 'khyil dang smyo byed dang / skran dang rlig rlugs la sogs sel / ba la srang brgya sle tres ni / bzhi cha ra sna brgyad cha ni

verses.skt: jalāḍhakaśate paktvā śatabhāgasthite rase | dadhimastvikṣuniryāsaśuktais tailāḍhakaṃ samaiḥ
verses.tib: chu bre bzhi brgya'i nang du bskol / khu ba brgyad cha lus pa dang / zho dang zho ga chu bu ram / shing khu tsha dang til mar rnams

verses.skt: pacet sājapayo'rdhāṃśaṃ kalkair ebhiḥ palonmitaiḥ | śaṭhīsaraladārvelāmañjiṣṭhāgurucandanaiḥ
verses.tib: bre ni bzhi bzhi bskol nas ni / ra yi 'o ma cha phyed dang / zur pa skyer pa sa ra la / sug smel btsod dang a ka ru / tsan+dan a ti pa la dang

verses.skt: padmakātibalāmustāśūrpaparṇīhareṇubhiḥ | yaṣṭyāhvasurasavyāghranakharṣabhakajīvakaiḥ
verses.tib: shug pa gla sgang mung+ga'i lo / ha re Nu ka shing mngar dang / bya gri nA ga bye'u rug pa / zangs rtsi ba dang dzi ba ka

verses.skt: palāśarasakastūrīnalikājātikośakaiḥ | spṛkkākuṅkumaśaileyajātīkaṭuphalāmbubhiḥ
verses.tib: gla rtsi lce pog pa la sha / dzA ti sho ka na li ka / gur gum rdo dreg bi ka dang / dzA ti pa la kad pa la / ba li ka dang shing tsha dang

verses.skt: tvakkundurukakarpūraturuṣkaśrīnivāsakaiḥ | lavaṅganakhakaṅkolakuṣṭhamāṃsīpriyaṅgubhiḥ
verses.tib: kun du ru dang ga pur dang / shri pa sa da du ru ka / li shi chu srin sen mo dang / ru rta spang spos ka ko la / pri yang ku dang sto ne ya

verses.skt: sthauṇeyatagaradhyāmavacāmadanakaplavaiḥ | sanāgakesaraiḥ siddhe dadyāc cātrāvatārite
verses.tib: rgya spos shu dag bya ma ka / ma du nA ga gla ba dang / nA ga ge sar srang re dang / bskol te btsags par gyur pa ru / gan+d+ha b+ha dra'i lde gu ni / cho ga bzhin du bcug pa des / lud pa dbugs mi bde dang rims / brgyal dang slon skran zad byed dang

verses.skt: pattrakalkaṃ tataḥ pūtaṃ vidhinā tat prayojitam | kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ chardiṃ mūrchāṃ gulmakṣatakṣayān
verses.tib: rgya spos shu dag bya ma ka / ma du nA ga gla ba dang / nA ga ge sar srang re dang / bskol te btsags par gyur pa ru / gan+d+ha b+ha dra'i lde gu ni / cho ga bzhin du bcug pa des / lud pa dbugs mi bde dang rims / brgyal dang slon skran zad byed dang

verses.skt: plīhaśoṣāv apasmāram alakṣmīṃ ca praṇāśayet | balātailam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vātavyādhivināśanam
verses.tib: glo 'grams mcher nad skem pa dang / brjed byed bkra mi shis pa sel / ba li til mar bzang po 'di / rlung gi nad ni 'joms byed yin

verses.skt: pāne nasye ’nvāsane ’bhyañjane ca snehāḥ kāle samyag ete prayuktāḥ | duṣṭān vātān āśu śāntiṃ nayeyur vandhyā nārīḥ putrabhājaś ca kuryuḥ || 82 || snehasvedair drutaḥ śleṣmā yadā pakvāśaye sthitaḥ | pittaṃ vā darśayed rūpaṃ vastibhis taṃ vinirjayet
verses.tib: btung ba sna sman bsku dang 'jam rtsi ni / snum gyi sbyor ba dus su legs bsten na / des ni ma rungs rlung nad myur zhi ste / bud med mo gsham bu yi snod byed 'gyur / gang tshe bad kan mkhris pa ni / zhu ba'i gnas 'dug snum dugs kyis / zhu nas mkhris pa snang gyur pa / de la 'jam rtsis bsal bar bya

verses.skt: vātaśoṇitino raktaṃ snigdhasya bahuśo haret | alpālpaṃ pālayan vāyuṃ yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam
verses.tib: dreg nad can ni snum chos bya / rlung bsrungs nad gzhi nyams stobs las / dpag ste khrag ni cung zad tsam / lan mang du ni dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: rugrāgatodadāheṣu jalaukobhir vinirharet | śṛṅgatumbaiś cimicimākaṇḍūrugdūyanānvitam
verses.tib: ba la / srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung ngo / g.ya' zhing na la tsag tsag tsha / shas cher tsha la rngabs rus dbyung

verses.skt: pracchānena sirābhir vā deśād deśāntaraṃ vrajat | aṅgaglānau tu na srāvyaṃ rūkṣe vātottare ca yat
verses.tib: gnas nas gnas su 'pho ba la / gtar ga'am zhal zhal gyis khrag dbyung / lus zhum pa dang khong rtsub cing / rlung shas cha la khrag mid byung

verses.skt: gambhīraṃ śvayathuṃ stambhaṃ kampaṃ snāyusirāmayān | glānim anyāṃś ca vātotthān kuryād vāyur asṛkkṣayāt
verses.tib: khrag zad pa la rlung gis ni / skrangs pa gting zab rings pa dang / 'dar zhing rtsa rgyus na dang zhum / rlung nad gzhan yang skyed par byed

verses.skt: virecyaḥ snehayitvā tu snehayuktair virecanaiḥ | vātottare vātarakte purāṇaṃ pāyayed ghṛtam
verses.tib: snum chos byas rjes bkru sman ni / snum dang ldan pas 'khru ru gzhug / rlung shas che ba'i dreg nad la / mar ni rnying pa blud par bya

verses.skt: śrāvaṇīkṣīrakākolīkṣīriṇījīvakaiḥ samaiḥ | siddhaṃ sarṣabhakaiḥ sarpiḥ sakṣīraṃ vātaraktanut
verses.tib: ra mnye ba dang sra ba ni / pa ya s+ya dang dzi ba ka / zangs rtsi ba dang cha snyoms te / 'o ma mar bskol dreg nad 'joms

verses.skt: drākṣāmadhūkavāribhyāṃ siddhaṃ vā sasitopalam | ghṛtaṃ pibet tathā kṣīraṃ guḍūcīsvarase śṛtam
verses.tib: rgun 'bru ma du ka bskol ba'i / khu ba khar mar bcas pa'am / de bzhin sle tres khu bar ni / 'o ma bskol ba blud par bya

verses.skt: tailaṃ payaḥ śarkarāṃ ca pāyayed vā sumūrchitam | balāśatāvarīrāsnādaśamūlaiḥ sapīlubhiḥ
verses.tib: til mar 'o ma kha rar bcas / legs par bsres pa blud par bya / ba la nye shing ra snang dang / pi lu rtsa ba bcu par bcas

verses.skt: śyāmairaṇḍasthirābhiś ca vātārtighnaṃ śṛtaṃ payaḥ | dhāroṣṇaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ vā kṣīraṃ doṣānulomanam
verses.tib: dur byid sti ra e raN+Da / bskol ba'i 'o mas rlung dreg sel / ba gcin 'o ma bzhos ma thag / bcas pa'ang nad ni bde 'byung byed

verses.skt: paitte paktvā varītiktāpaṭolatriphalāmṛtāḥ | pibed ghṛtaṃ vā kṣīraṃ vā svādutiktakasādhitam
verses.tib: mkhris par nye shing pu tse shel / pa to la rtsa'i 'bras bu gsum / sle tres dang ni sman mngar kha / 'o ma'ang mar dang bskol ba blud

verses.skt: kṣīreṇairaṇḍatailaṃ ca prayogeṇa piben naraḥ | bahudoṣo virekārthaṃ jīrṇe kṣīraudanāśanaḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi shas che'i bkru sman phyir / e raN+Da'i mar 'o mar sbyar / sbyor ba ji bzhin blud par bya / zhu nas 'o ma 'bras chan sbyin

verses.skt: kaṣāyam abhayānāṃ vā pāyayed ghṛtabharjitam | kṣīrānupānaṃ trivṛtācūrṇaṃ drākṣārasena vā
verses.tib: a ru ra ni mar brngos pa / khu ba blud par bya ba'am / dur byid phye ma rgun chu'am / 'o ma sbyar ba blud par bya

verses.skt: nirhared vā malaṃ tasya saghṛtaiḥ kṣīravastibhiḥ | na hi vastisamaṃ kiñcid vātaraktacikitsitam
verses.tib: yang na de yi nad gzhi ni / 'jam rtsi 'o ma mar bcas sbyar / rlung dang khrag nad gso ba la / 'jam rtsi las lhag gang yang med

verses.skt: viśeṣāt pāyupārśvoruparvāsthijaṭharārtiṣu | mustādhātrīharidrāṇāṃ pibet kvāthaṃ kapholbaṇe
verses.tib: mchog tu gzhang dang rtsib logs brla / tshigs nad dmu rdzing nyam thag sel / bad kan shas che gla sgang dang

verses.skt: sakṣaudraṃ triphalāyā vā guḍūcīṃ vā yathā tathā | yathārhasnehapītaṃ ca vāmitaṃ mṛdu rūkṣayet
verses.tib: rgun 'bru skyer pa bskol ba'am / 'bras bu gsum bskol sbrang rtsir bcas / yang na sle tres ci rigs blud / ji ltar 'cham par snam / blud de

verses.skt: triphalāvyoṣapattrailātvakkṣīrīcitrakaṃ vacām | viḍaṅgaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ romaśāṃ vṛṣakaṃ tvacam
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum / gan+d+ha b+ha dra shing tsha dang / cu gang shu dag tsi tra ka / pi pi ling rtsa byi dang ga / spang spos ba sha ka'i shun phrags

verses.skt: ṛddhiṃ lāṅgalikīṃ cavyaṃ samabhāgāni peṣayet | kalye liptvāyasīṃ pātrīṃ madhyāhne bhakṣayed idam
verses.tib: ri sti dbyi mo lang ga ling / cha mnyam lde gur byas pa la / nang par lcags snod bskus te gzhag / nyi ma phyed dus de zos na

verses.skt: vātāsre sarvadoṣe ’pi paraṃ śūlānvite hitam | kokilākṣakaniryūhaḥ pītas tac chākabhojinā
verses.tib: nad gzhi kun gyur dreg nad ni / gzer dang ldan la mchog tu phan / ko ki lak+Sha bskol ba'i khu / blud cing de yi tshod ma zos

verses.skt: kṛpābhyāsa iva krodhaṃ vātaraktaṃ niyacchati | pañcamūlasya dhātryā vā rasair lelītakīṃ vasām
verses.tib: snying rje goms pa'i skyes bu ltar / dreg nad sel bar byed pa yin / rtsa ba lnga'am skyu ru ra'i / khu ba li li ta yi zhag

verses.skt: khuḍaṃ surūḍham apy aṅge brahmacārī piban jayet | ity ābhyantaram uddiṣṭaṃ karma bāhyam ataḥ param
verses.tib: 'khrig pa spong zhing 'thungs na ni / dreg 'theng shin tu gting zug sel / de ltar nang gi bstan nas ni / de 'og phyi rol gso ba bshad

verses.skt: triphalāṣṭapalaṃ kvāthya pādaśeṣaṃ jalāḍhake | ṣoḍaśaiva palāny atra prakṣipec chuddhagugguloḥ
verses.tib: rang skyur bre bzhir til mar dang

verses.skt: tatas tasmin ghanībhūte kalkīkṛtya dvikārṣikāḥ | pathyāviḍaṅgakaṭukā guḍūcī palasaṃmitā
verses.tib: sra rtsi pog ni bzhi char bskol / chu nang gzar bus mang du dkrugs

verses.skt: karṣāṃśe trivṛtā dantī khāded iṣṭānupānataḥ | vividham api vātaraktaṃ srutaśuṣkasphuṭitam api hanti
vraṇakāsakuṣṭhagulmaśvayathūdarapāṇḍumeham arśāṃsi | abhibhūya jarādoṣaṃ karoti kaiśorakaṃ kāyam
āranālāḍhake tailaṃ pādasarjarasaṃ śṛtam | prabhūte khajitaṃ toye jvaradāhārtinut param
verses.tib: rims tsha nad gzir sel mchog yin / til mar btsod dang spra tshil dang

verses.skt: samadhūcchiṣṭamañjiṣṭhaṃ sasarjarasaśārivam | piṇḍatailaṃ tad abhyaṅgād vātaraktarujāpaham
verses.tib: sra rtsi pog dang thal tres bcas / til mar skabs lus bskus na / dreg nad sel ba'i dam pa yin

verses.skt: daśamūlaśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ sadyaḥ śūlanivāraṇam | pariṣeko ’nilaprāye tadvat koṣṇena sarpiṣā
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu dang 'o ma bskol / yang na lde gu chu dron sbyar / blugs na rlung shas che ba yi / gzer nad 'phral du sel byed yin

verses.skt: snehair madhurasiddhair vā caturbhiḥ pariṣecayet | stambhākṣepakaśūlārtaṃ koṣṇair dāhe tu śītalaiḥ
verses.tib: lus 'jug rengs dang gzer gyis nyen / snum bzhi po ni mngar ba'i sman / dro 'jam sbyar ba blugs par bya / tsha bar gyur la grang mo blugs

verses.skt: tadvad gavyāvikacchāgaiḥ kṣīrais tailavimiśritaiḥ | niḥkvāthair jīvanīyānāṃ pañcamūlasya vā laghoḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin ra lug pa yi ni / 'o ma til mar sbyar ba'am / 'tsho byed sde tshan bskol ba'am / rtsa ba chung ngu lnga bskol blugs

verses.skt: drākṣekṣurasamadyāni dadhimastvamlakāñjikam | sekārthaṃ taṇḍulakṣaudraśarkarāmbhaś ca śasyate
verses.tib: rgun chu bu ram shing khu chang / rang skyur zho dang zho ga chu / 'bras bkrus chu dang sbrang rtsi'i chu / ka ra'i chu ni blud pa'ang phan

verses.skt: priyāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ nāryāś candanārdrakarastanāḥ | sparśaśītāḥ sukhasparśā ghnanti dāhaṃ rujaṃ klamam
verses.tib: bud med gzugs sdug snyan par smra / lag pa nu ma tsan+da bskus / reg na bsil zhing bde ba yis / tsha dang na dang rmya ba sel

verses.skt: sarāge saruje dāhe raktaṃ hṛtvā pralepayet | prapauṇḍarīkamañjiṣṭhādārvīmadhukacandanaiḥ
verses.tib: mdog dmar tsha dang na bcas la / khrag phyung nas ni lde gus bsku / stag tsher pa dang shing mngar btsong / skyer ba tsan+dan ka ra dkar / e raN+Da yi sa bon phye

verses.skt: sitopalairakāsaktumasūrośīrapadmakaiḥ | lepo rugdāhavīsarparāgaśophanibarhaṇaḥ
verses.tib: sran chung shug / pa pu shel tse / lde gus tsha na shu ba mched / na zhing mdog dmar skrangs pa sel

verses.skt: vātaghnaiḥ sādhitaḥ snigdhaḥ kṛśaro mudgapāyasaḥ | tilasarṣapapiṇḍaiś ca śūlaghnam upanāhanam
verses.tib: kri sa ra ni rlung 'joms sman / snum bcas bskol ba'am mung+ga dang / 'o thug nyungs kar til tshigs ma / glan zhing dkris pas gzer 'joms byed

verses.skt: audakaprasahānūpavesavārāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ | jīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ snehayuktāḥ syur upanāhane
verses.tib: chur gnas rlan can mthu rtsal gyis / zas tshol sha btags g.yos legs pa / 'tsho byed sman dang snum bcas pas / glan zhing dkri ba byas gyur na

verses.skt: stambhatodarugāyāmaśophāṅgagrahanāśanāḥ | jīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ siddhā sapayaskā vasāpi vā
verses.tib: sra zhing gzer la na ba dang / skrangs dang yan lag na ba 'joms / 'tsho byed sman dang bskol ba yi / 'o ma zhag gis bskus na'ang phan

verses.skt: ghṛtaṃ sahacarān mūlaṃ jīvantī chāgalaṃ payaḥ | lepaḥ piṣṭās tilās tadvad bhṛṣṭāḥ payasi nirvṛtāḥ
verses.tib: sa ha ra dza'i rtsa ba dang / dzi ban ti mar ra'i 'o ma / lde gu bskus pa'am de bzhin du / til btags brngos pa 'o mar sbyar

verses.skt: kṣīrapiṣṭakṣumāṃ lepam eraṇḍasya phalāni vā | kuryāc chūlanivṛttyarthaṃ śatāhvāṃ vānile ’dhike
verses.tib: zar ma 'o mar sbyar ba'am / e raN+Da yi 'bras bu ni / 'o ma dag dang sbyar ba'am / shu ti'i 'o mar sbyar ba yis / rlung shas che ba'i gzer 'joms byed

verses.skt: mūtrakṣārasurāpakvaṃ ghṛtam abhyañjane hitam | siddhaṃ samadhu śuktaṃ vā sekābhyaṅge kaphottare
verses.tib: ba gcin thal sman chang dang bskol / mar gyis bskus na'ang de la phan / bad kan shas che rgun tsha dang / bskol ba'i mar bsku blugs pa phan

verses.skt: gṛhadhūmo vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā rajanīdvayam | pralepaḥ śūlanud vātarakte vātakaphottare
verses.tib: shu dag ru rta khyim dud pa / shu ti ser po rnam gnyis kyi / lde gus bskus na dreg nad ni / rlung dang bad kan shas che sel

verses.skt: madhuśigror hitaṃ tadvad bījaṃ dhānyāmlasaṃyutam | muhūrtaliptam amlaiś ca siñced vātakaphottare
verses.tib: de bzhin shi kru'i sa bon ni / 'bras kyi khu ba'i rang skyur ni / yud tsam btags nas skyur gyur pa / blugs na bad rlung shas che sel

verses.skt: uttānaṃ lepanābhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhanaiḥ | virekāsthāpanasnehapānair gambhīram ācaret
verses.tib: rtogs par sla la byug dang bsku / blugs dang lus ni bcing bas gso / rtogs dka' mas gtong drag po dang / bkru sman snum ni blud pas gso

verses.skt: vātaśleṣmottare koṣṇā lepādyās tatra śītalaiḥ | vidāhaśopharukkaṇḍūvivṛddhiḥ stambhanād bhavet
verses.tib: bad rlung shas cher dro 'jam sbyar / de la byugs grang mo yis / lus tsha na zhing g.ya' zhing skangs / sra ba rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur

verses.skt: pittaraktottare vātarakte lepādayo himāḥ | uṣṇaiḥ ploṣoṣarugrāgasvedāvadaraṇodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: khrag mkhris shas che'i dreg nad la / byug pa la sogs bsil bas bya / dro bas tsha zhing na la dmar / rdul 'byung gas par 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: madhuyaṣṭyāḥ palaśataṃ kaṣāye pādaśeṣite | tailāḍhakaṃ samakṣīraṃ pacet kalkaiḥ palonmitaiḥ
verses.tib: shing mngar srang brgya bskol ba yi / khu ba bzhi cha lus pa ru / til mar bre bzhi 'o ma mnyam / ti ra mur ba / ta ma la

verses.skt: sthirātāmalakīdūrvāpayasyābhīrucandanaiḥ | lohahaṃsapadīmāṃsīdvimedāmadhuparṇibhiḥ
verses.tib: nye'u shing a gar pa ya s+ya / tsan+dan has ba ti dang / spang spos sle tres me da gnyis / ra mnye ba gnyis shu ti dang / shug pa rnam gnyis dzi ban ti

verses.skt: kākolīkṣīrakākolīśatapuṣparddhipadmakaiḥ | jīvakarṣabhajīvantītvakpattranakhavālakaiḥ
verses.tib: dzi ba ka dang bi sha ba / shing tsha gan+da b+ha dra dang / chu srin sin mo ba le ka / btsod dang pra puN+Da ri ka

verses.skt: prapauṇḍarīkamañjiṣṭhāśārivaindrīvitunnakaiḥ | catuṣprayogaṃ vātāsṛkpittadāhajvarārtinut
verses.tib: shi ri ba dang bi la sha / ku tan na ta srang re yi / lde gur bcas pa bskol bar bya / sbyor ba bzhi pos dreg nad kyi / mkhris pa'i rtsa ba rims nad sel

verses.skt: sopadravaṃ sāṅgaśūlaṃ sarvagātrānugaṃ tathā | vātāsṛkpittadāhārtijvaraghnaṃ balavarṇakṛt
balākaṣāyakalkābhyāṃ tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ pacet | sahasraśatapākaṃ tad vātāsṛgvātaroganut
verses.tib: ba la'i khu ba lde gu dang / til mar 'o ma cha mnyam bskol / lan brgya'i bar du bskol ba de / dreg nad rlung can sel bar byed

verses.skt: rasāyanaṃ mukhyatamam indriyāṇāṃ prasādanam | jīvanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ svaryaṃ śukrāsṛgdoṣanāśanam
verses.tib: bcud kyis len gyi dam pa ste / dbang po gsal bar byed pa yin / tshe ring lus 'phel skad snyan dang / khu chu khrag gi nad sel byed

verses.skt: kupite mārgasaṃrodhān medaso vā kaphasya vā | ativṛddhyānile śastaṃ nādau snehanabṛṃhaṇam
verses.tib: rgyu ba'i lam 'gags 'khrugs gyur pas / tshil lam bad kan shin tu ni / 'phel bar gyur pa'i rlung nad la / snum rtas dang por phan pa yin

verses.skt: kṛtvā tatrāḍhyavātoktaṃ vātaśoṇitikaṃ tataḥ | bheṣajaṃ snehanaṃ kuryād yac ca raktaprasādanam
verses.tib: der ni phyug po'i rlung nad kyi / gso bya dreg nad gso bar bya / khrag ni dngas par byed pa yi / snum dang sman gyi sbyor ba bya

verses.skt: prāṇādikope yugapad yathoddiṣṭaṃ yathāmayam | yathāsannaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ vikalpyaṃ syād yathābalam
verses.tib: srog rlung ni cig car 'khrugs / ji skad bstan dang nad gzhi bzhin / ji ltar nye bar sman rnams ni / nang tshul ji bzhin sbyin par bya

verses.skt: nīte nirāmatāṃ sāme svedalaṅghanapācanaiḥ | rūkṣaiś cālepasekādyaiḥ kuryāt kevalavātanut
verses.tib: ma zhu bcas la dugs dang smyung / smin bya rtsub sman byug pa dang / rlung kyis ni ma zhu bsal / byas la ma 'dres rlung gso bya

verses.skt: śoṣākṣepaṇasaṃkocastambhasvapanakampanam | hanusraṃso ’rditaṃ khāñjyaṃ pāṅgulyaṃ khuḍavātatā
verses.tib: skem dang bya rmyang yan lag 'khums / rengs dang 'dar bu tshor ba med / 'gram nyams kha yo 'theng po dang

verses.skt: saṃdhicyutiḥ pakṣavadho medomajjāsthigā gadāḥ | ete sthānasya gāmbhīryāt sidhyeyur yatnato navāḥ
verses.tib: zha bo dreg nad kyis 'theng dang / tshigs 'khrul gzhogs phyed na ba dang / tshigs dang rkang rus la zhugs nad / 'di dag gnas ni gting rings pas / de bas 'di dag gsar btab dang

verses.skt: tasmāj jayen navān etān balino nirupadravān | vāyau pittāvṛte śītām uṣṇāṃ ca bahuśaḥ kriyām
verses.tib: bla brnan med cing nyams stobs ldan / 'bad na 'tsho yi gzhan du min / mkhris 'dres rlung la grang dro yi / gso ba'i rim gyis mang du bya

verses.skt: vyatyāsād yojayet sarpir jīvanīyaṃ ca pāyayet | dhanvamāṃsaṃ yavāḥ śālir virekaḥ kṣīravān mṛduḥ
verses.tib: 'tsho byed sde dang bskol ba yi / sman mar dag kyang blud par bya / skam sa'i sha dang sA lu nas / bkru sman 'o mar bcas 'jam gtang

verses.skt: sakṣīrā vastayaḥ kṣīraṃ pañcamūlabalāśṛtam | kāle ’nuvāsanaṃ tailair madhurauṣadhasādhitaiḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba lnga dang ba lar bskol / 'o ma mas / gtong sbyor ba bya / sman mar bskol ba'i til mar gyi / 'jam rtsi dus su gtang bar bya

verses.skt: yaṣṭīmadhubalātailaghṛtakṣīraiś ca secanam | pañcamūlakaṣāyeṇa vāriṇā śītalena vā
verses.tib: shing mngar ba la til mar dang / mar dang 'o ma bskol ba blugs / rtsa ba lnga yi khu ba'am / chu ni grang mo nyid blugs bya

verses.skt: kaphāvṛte yavānnāni jāṅgalā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | svedās tīkṣṇā nirūhāś ca vamanaṃ savirecanam
verses.tib: bad kan bcas la nas kyi zan / skam sa'i ri dwags bya yi sha / dugs dang mas gtong bkru sman no / slon sman bkru sman bcas pa gtang

verses.skt: purāṇasarpis tailaṃ ca tilasarṣapajaṃ hitam | saṃsṛṣṭe kaphapittābhyāṃ pittam ādau vinirjayet
verses.tib: mar rnying til mar nyungs kar las / byung ba'i mar ni blud par bya / bad kan mkhris pa 'dres pa las / dang po mkhris pa gso bar bya

verses.skt: kārayed raktasaṃsṛṣṭe vātaśoṇitikīṃ kriyām | svedābhyaṅgarasāḥ kṣīraṃ sneho māṃsāvṛte hitam
