verses.tib: khrag dang 'des pa dreg nad kyi / gso ba ji skad bshad par bya / dugs bsku sha khu 'o ma dang / snum dang bcas pas sha bkra sel

verses.skt: pramehamedovātaghnam āḍhyavāte bhiṣagjitam | mahāsneho ’sthimajjasthe pūrvoktaṃ retasāvṛte
verses.tib: phyug po'i rlung la gcin snyi dang / tshil dang rlung 'joms sman gyis gso / rus pa rkang gnas snum chen gyis / khu chur gnas la sngar bshad pa'i

verses.skt: annāvṛte pācanīyaṃ vamanaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu | mūtrāvṛte mūtralāni svedāś cottaravastayaḥ
verses.tib: zas dang 'dres la 'ju byed dang / drod skyed skyug sman yang ba gtang / gcin 'dres gcin ni 'phel ba dang / dugs dang 'jam rtsi gong mas gso

verses.skt: eraṇḍatailaṃ varcaḥsthe vastisnehāś ca bhedinaḥ | kaphapittāviruddhaṃ yad yac ca vātānulomanam
verses.tib: bshang 'dres e raN+Da'i mar dang / 'jam rtsi snum ni 'khru byed phan / lus zungs kun zhugs rlung nad la / bad kan mkhris par mi gnod dang

verses.skt: sarvasthānāvṛte ’py āśu tat kāryaṃ mātariśvani | anabhiṣyandi ca snigdhaṃ srotasāṃ śuddhikāraṇam
verses.tib: gang yang rlung ni bder rgyu ba'i / sman de rlung nad de la gtang / 'khru bar mi byed snum pa dang / rtsa rgyun sbyong bar byed pa dang

verses.skt: yāpanā vastayaḥ prāyo madhurāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ | prasamīkṣya balādhikyaṃ mṛdu kāryaṃ virecanam
verses.tib: mas gtong bas ni mngar ba dang / snum gyi 'jam rtsis gso bar bya / nyams stobs ci yod brtags nas ni / bkru sman 'jam po gtang bar bya

verses.skt: rasāyanānāṃ sarveṣām upayogaḥ praśasyate | śilāhvasya viśeṣeṇa payasā śuddhagugguloḥ
verses.tib: bcud kyis len ni thams cad kyi / sbyor ba dag kyang bsngags pa yin / mchog tu brag zhun sbyor ba dang / de bzhin gu gul nyi tshe 'am

verses.skt: leho vā bhārgavas tadvad ekādaśasitāśitaḥ | apāne tv āvṛte sarvaṃ dīpanaṃ grāhi bheṣajam
verses.tib: kha ra srang stong chig brgyar bcas / pa wa sangs bshad lde gu'ang phan / thur sel 'dres la drod bskyed dang

verses.skt: vātānulomanaṃ kāryaṃ mūtrāśayaviśodhanam | iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktam āvṛtānāṃ cikitsitam
verses.tib: 'khru gcod rlung ni bder rgyu byed / gcin gyi gnas ni sbyong byed pa'i / sman rnams de la gtang bar bya / de ltar srog la sogs pa yi / 'dres pa'i gso ba mdor bshad / yin

verses.skt: prāṇādīnāṃ bhiṣak kuryād vitarkya svayam eva tat | udānaṃ yojayed ūrdhvam apānaṃ cānulomayet
verses.tib: sman pas de gso rgyas par ni / blo yis brtags te ci rigs bya / stod du rgyu ba'i spyi bor bsdu / thur sel de las bzlog par bya

verses.skt: samānaṃ śamayed vidvāṃs tridhā vyānaṃ tu yojayet | prāṇo rakṣyaś caturbhyo ’pi tatsthitau dehasaṃsthitiḥ
verses.tib: me dang mnyam gnas mnyam par bya / khyab byed gsum du sbyar bar bya / bzhi bo bas kyang srog bsrung ste / der gnas na ni lus gnas 'gyur

verses.skt: svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ nayed evaṃ vṛtān vātān vimārgagān | sarvaṃ cāvaraṇam pittaraktasaṃsargavarjitam
verses.tib: de ltar rlung ni lam gzhan zhugs / rang rang gi ni gnas su gzhag / khrag mkhris 'dres pa ma gtogs par / 'dres pa'i nad ni thams cad la

verses.skt: rasāyanavidhānena laśuno hanti śīlitaḥ | pittāvṛte pittaharaṃ marutaś cānulomanam
verses.tib: bcud kyis len gyi cho ga bzhin / sgog skya bsten na sel bar byed / mkhris par 'dres la mkhris sel bas / rlung ni bde bar rgyu bar bya

verses.skt: raktāvṛte ’pi tadvac ca khuḍoktaṃ yac ca bheṣajam | raktapittānilaharaṃ vividhaṃ ca rasāyanam
verses.tib: khrag dang 'dres la de nyid dang / 'theng pa'i nad bshad sman bya'o / khrag mkhris rlung ni sel ba yi / bcud kyis len ni sna tshogs sbyar

verses.skt: yathānidānaṃ nirdiṣṭam iti samyak cikitsitam | āyurvedaphalaṃ sthānam etat sadyo ’rtināśanāt
verses.tib: nad gzhi ji ltar bstan pa bzhin / gso ba de ltar yang dag bshad / nyam thag 'phral du sel ba 'di / tshe yi rig byed gnas 'bras bu

verses.skt: cikitsitaṃ hitaṃ pathyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ bhiṣagjitam | bheṣajaṃ śamanaṃ śastaṃ paryāyaiḥ smṛtam auṣadham
verses.tib: gso ba phan pa gnod sel dang / sbyor ba sman dang rtsi dang ni / zhi bar byed dang sngags bya ste / de dag sman ming rnam grangs yin

verses.skt: vamane madanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ trivṛnmūlaṃ virecane | nityam anyasya tu vyādhiviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭatā
verses.tib: skyug sman mchog ni po son cha / dur byid rtsa ba bkru sman mchog / gzhan dag nad kyi dbang las ni / khyad par du ni gyur pa yin

verses.skt: phalāni nātipāṇḍūni na cātiharitāny api | ādāyāhni praśatarkṣe madhye grīṣmavasantayoḥ
verses.tib: shin tu sngo ba'ang ma yin pa / nyin zhag tshes grangs shis pa la / sos ka dpyid kyi mtshams su btu

verses.skt: pramṛjya kuśamuttolyāṃ kṣiptvā baddhvā pralepayet | gomayenānu muttolīṃ dhānyamadhye nidhāpayet
verses.tib: phyis nas 'jag ma'i snod du ni / bcug ste bcings la ba lang gi / lci bas snod du byugs nas ni / 'bru yi nang du gzhag par bya

verses.skt: mṛdubhūtāni madhviṣṭagandhāni kuśaveṣṭanāt | niṣkṛṣṭāni gate ’ṣṭāhe śoṣayet tāny athātape
verses.tib: 'jag mas dkris pas 'jam pa dang / sbrang rtsi lta bu dri zhim la / zhag brgyad 'das par gyur pa dang / phyung ste de nyid nyi mar bskam

verses.skt: teṣāṃ tataḥ suśuṣkāṇām uddhṛtya phalapippalīḥ | dadhimadhvājyapalalair mṛditvā śoṣayet punaḥ
verses.tib: de 'og legs par bskams pa dang / nang gi 'bras bu phyung nas ni / zho dang zho ga chu mar gyi / lde gur mnyes la slar yang bskam

verses.skt: tataḥ suguptaṃ saṃsthāpya kāryakāle prayojayet | athādāya tato mātrāṃ jarjarīkṛtya vāsayet
verses.tib: de nas legs par sbas te gzhag / dgos pa'i dus su sbyar bar bya / de nas de la tshad tsam du / blangs nas cham chom brdungs nas ni

verses.skt: śarvarīṃ madhuyaṣṭyā vā kovidārasya vā jale | karbudārasya bimbyā vā nīpasya vidulasya vā
verses.tib: shing mngar go bye bi da ra'am / bim ba lcang ma sle sman ta / bum ti a pa marga dang / arga gang yang rung ba ni

verses.skt: śaṇapuṣpyāḥ sadāpuṣpyāḥ pratyakpuṣpyudake ’thavā | tataḥ pibet kaṣāyaṃ taṃ prātar mṛditagālitam
verses.tib: bskol ba'i chu yi nang du ni / nub gcig legs par spang bar bya'o / de nas sman gyi khu ba de / mnyes shing btsags la nang par ni

verses.skt: sūtroditena vidhinā sādhu tena tathā vamet | śleṣmajvarapratiśyāyagulmāntarvidradhīṣu ca
verses.tib: mdo nas bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin / legs par blud nas skyug tu gzhug / bad kan las byung rims tsham pa / skran dang khong 'bras rnams la ni

verses.skt: pracchardayed viśeṣeṇa yāvat pittasya darśanam | phalapippalīcūrṇaṃ vā kvāthena svena bhāvitam
verses.tib: ji srid mkhris pa snang gi bar / khyad par du yang skyug tu gzhug / po son cha yi 'bras bu ni / phye ma bskol ba'i khu bar ni

verses.skt: tribhāgatriphalācūrṇaṃ kovidārādivāriṇā | pibej jvarāruciṣṭhevagranthyapacyarbudodarī
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum phye cha gsum btab / ko bi dar khur bcas / blud na rims dang dmu rdzing dang / rmen bu 'bras dang 'brum chen dang / gtun 'dra'i rlung nad sel bar byed

verses.skt: pitte kaphasthānagate jīmūtādijalena tat | hṛddāhe ’dho'srapitte ca kṣīraṃ tatpippalīśṛtam
verses.tib: mkhris pa bad kan gnas zhugs la / dzi mu ta sogs khu ba blud / snying tsha khrag mkhris dag la na / de 'bras 'o mar bskol ba yi / 'o thug bcas pa blud par bya

verses.skt: kṣaireyīṃ vā kaphacchardiprasekatamakeṣu tu | dadhyuttaraṃ vā dadhi vā tacchṛtakṣīrasaṃbhavam
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur slon bro dang / cham pa mun 'thibs byed pa la / de bskol 'o ma las byung ba'i / zho yi spris ma'am zho blud bya

verses.skt: phalādikvāthakalkābhyāṃ siddhaṃ tatsiddhadugdhajam | sarpiḥ kaphābhibhūte ’gnau śuṣyaddehe ca vāmanam
verses.tib: po son cha sogs lde gu dang / bskol ba'i 'o ma las byung ba'i / mar sar bad kan gyis drod nyams / lus skam pa la skyug sman bya

verses.skt: svarasaṃ phalamajjño vā bhallātakavidhiśṛtam | ādarvīlepanāt siddhaṃ līḍhvā pracchardayet sukham
verses.tib: po son cha yi khu ba ni / bsre zhing cho gas btsags nas ni / gzar bur chags pa'i bar du bskol / byin la de bas skyug tu gzhug

verses.skt: taṃ lehaṃ bhakṣyabhojyeṣu tatkaṣāyāṃś ca yojayet | vatsakādipratīvāpaḥ kaṣāyaḥ phalamajjajaḥ
verses.tib: lde gu de'am de'i khu ba / bza' dang btung bar sbyar te gtang / po son cha yi 'bras bu'i khu / dug mo nyung sogs sde tshan btab

verses.skt: nimbārkānyatarakvāthasamāyukto niyacchati | baddhamūlān api vyādhīn sarvān saṃtarpaṇodbhavān
verses.tib: nim pa arka gang yang / rung / bskol ba'i khu bar bcas pa ni / blud na nyams brtas las byung nad / gting zug kun kyang sel bar byed

verses.skt: rāṭhapuṣpaphalaślakṣṇacūrṇair mālyaṃ surūkṣitam | vamen maṇḍarasādīnāṃ tṛpto jighran sukhaṃ sukhī
verses.tib: po son cha yi me tog ni / zhib btags phreng bsgos bsnams nas ni / thug pa sha khu sogs ngoms blud / skyid de ba ni bder slon gzhug

verses.skt: evam eva phalābhāve kalpyaṃ puṣpaṃ śalāṭu vā | jīmūtādyāś ca phalavaj jīmūtaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: po son cha med me tog dang / 'bras bu gzhon nu de bzhin sbyar / dzi mu ta sogs de dang 'dra / dzi mu ta ni khyad par du

verses.skt: prayoktavyaṃ jvaraśvāsakāsahidhmādirogiṇām | payaḥ puṣpe ’sya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā
verses.tib: rims dang lud pa dbugs mi bde / skyigs bu la sogs nad la gtang / 'di yi me tog 'o mar btsos / 'bras bu smin pa 'o thug bcas

verses.skt: romaśe kṣīrasaṃtānaṃ dadhyuttaram aromaśe | śṛte payasi dadhyamlaṃ jātaṃ haritapāṇḍuke
verses.tib: spu bcas 'o ma'i spris mar sbyar / sbu med zho yi spris mar sbyar / skya ba'am sngor gyur 'o mar bcug / zho ni skyur por gyur pa'am

verses.skt: āsutya vāruṇīmaṇḍaṃ piben mṛditagālitam | kaphād arocake kāse pāṇḍutve rājayakṣmaṇi
verses.tib: mnan pa'i chang gi dngas mar ni / mnyes te zhu bar gyur pa blud / bad kan lud pa yi ga 'chus / skya rbab gcong chen nad la gtang

verses.skt: iyaṃ ca kalpanā kāryā tumbīkośātakīṣv api | paryāgatānāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ phalānāṃ veṇijanmanām
verses.tib: ku ba ko sha ta ki yang / sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di nyid bya / smin zhing bskams par gyur pa yi / dzi mu ta yi 'bras bu dag

verses.skt: cūrṇasya payasā śuktiṃ vātapittārditaḥ pibet | dve vā trīṇy api vāpothya kvāthe tiktottamasya vā
verses.tib: phye ma srang phyed 'o mar bsres / rlung mkhris nad kyis nyen la blud / dzi mu ta 'bras gnyis sam gsum / brdungs pa de yi khu ba ni

verses.skt: āragvadhādinavakād āsutyānyatamasya vā | vimṛdya pūtaṃ taṃ kvāthaṃ pittaśleṣmajvarī pibet
verses.tib: dong ga la sogs dgu pa ni / gang yang rung ba la sbangs te / mnyes la bcags par gyur pa dag / bad kan mkhris rims can la blud

verses.skt: jīmūtakalkaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā pibec chītena vāriṇā | jvare paitte kavoṣṇena kaphavātāt kaphād api
verses.tib: dzi mu ta yi phye ma'am / lde gu chu grang sbyar ba dag / mkhris rims can blud bad kan dang / rlung 'dres rims la chu dron sbyar

verses.skt: kāsaśvāsaviṣacchardijvarārte kaphakarśite | ikṣvākur vamane śastaḥ pratāmyati ca mānave
verses.tib: lud pa dbugs mi bde dang dug / slon rims bad kan gyis nyen dang / mun 'thibs byed pa'i nad ldan la / ku ba kha bo'i skyug sman bsngags

verses.skt: phalapuṣpavihīnasya pravālais tasya sādhitam | pittaśleṣmajvare kṣīraṃ pittodrikte prayojayet
verses.tib: de ni me tog 'bras bu med / myu gu gzhon nu 'o mar btsos / bad kan mkhris pa las gyur rims / mkhris pa shas cher gyur la blud

verses.skt: hṛtamadhye phale jīrṇe sthitaṃ kṣīraṃ yadā dadhi | syāt tadā kaphaje kāse śvāse vamyaṃ ca pāyayet
verses.tib: 'bras bu smin pa'i nang gi ni / 'bras bu phyung ste 'o ma bcug / zhor gyur lud pa dbugs mi bde / blud de slon du gzhug par bya

verses.skt: mastunā vā phalān madhyaṃ pāṇḍukuṣṭhaviṣārditaḥ | tena takraṃ vipakvaṃ vā pibet samadhusaindhavam
verses.tib: 'bras bu'i nang na zho ga chu / mdze dug skya rbab nyid la blud / de dang dar ba / bskol ba ni / rgyam tsha sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud

verses.skt: bhāvayitvājadugdhena bījaṃ tenaiva vā pibet | viṣagulmodaragranthigaṇḍeṣu ślīpadeṣu ca
verses.tib: yang na de yi sa bon ni / ra yi 'o mar bcas pa dag / dug skran dmu rdzing rmen bu dang / 'bras dang rkang bam nad la blud

verses.skt: saktubhir vā piben manthaṃ tumbīsvarasabhāvitaiḥ | kaphodbhave jvare kāse galarogeṣv arocake
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur lud pa rims / lkog ma'i nad dang ma zhu la / ku ba kha bo'i khu ba ni / phye dang sbyar ba'i skyo ma blud

verses.skt: gulme jvare prasakte ca kalkaṃ māṃsarasaiḥ pibet | naraḥ sādhu vamaty evaṃ na ca daurbalyam aśnute
verses.tib: skran dang rims rnying bying ba la / lde gu sha khur sbyar blud na / legs pa kho nar slon gyur zhing / nyam chung bar yang 'gyur ma yin

verses.skt: tumbyāḥ phalarasaiḥ śuṣkaiḥ sapuṣpair avacūrṇitam | chardayen mālyam āghrāya gandhasaṃpatsukhocitaḥ
verses.tib: ku ba kha bo'i me tog dang / 'bras bu phye mas bsgos pa yis / me tog phreng ba mnam pa ni / skyid de ba yi skyug sman yin

verses.skt: kāsagulmodaragare vāte śleṣmāśayasthite | kaphe ca kaṇṭhavaktrasthe kaphasaṃcayajeṣu ca
verses.tib: skran lud dmu rdzing lkog ma'i nad / bad kan gnas la brten pa'i rlung / bad kan kha dang mgrin par gnas / bad kan 'phel bar gyur pa dag

verses.skt: dhāmārgavo gadeṣv iṣṭaḥ sthireṣu ca mahatsu ca | jīvakarṣabhakau vīrā kapikacchūḥ śatāvarī
verses.tib: brtan zhing dkyel ni skyes pa la / ko sha ta ka'i skyug sman bsngags / 'tsho byed nye'u shing zangs rtsi ba / kha sral phre'u ram nye gnyis

verses.skt: kākolī śrāvaṇī medā mahāmedā madhūlikā | tadrajobhiḥ pṛthag lehā dhāmārgavarajo'nvitāḥ
verses.tib: shra ba dang ni me da dang / ma hA me da ma du li / 'di dag re re'i phye ma dang / ko sha ta ka'i phye mar bcas

verses.skt: kāse hṛdayadāhe ca śastā madhusitādrutāḥ | te sukhāmbho'nupānāḥ syuḥ pittoṣmasahite kaphe
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar ba ni / lud pa snying ni tsha la bsngags / de rjes chu dron blud pa ni / bad kan mkhris tsha ldan la bsngags

verses.skt: dhānyatumburuyūṣeṇa kalkas tasya viṣāpahaḥ | bimbyāḥ punarnavāyā vā kāsamardasya vā rase
verses.tib: 'u su g.yer ma'i khu ba dang / de yi khu bas dug 'joms so / bim pa ka sa marda 'am / ba sbu ba yi khu bar ni / ra dza go sha ta ka yi

verses.skt: ekaṃ dhāmārgavaṃ dve vā mānase mṛditaṃ pibet | tacchṛtakṣīrajaṃ sarpiḥ sādhitaṃ vā phalādibhiḥ
verses.tib: rdog ma gcig gam gnyis mnyes pa'i / dngas ma snying gi nad la blud / de bskol 'o ma las byung mar / po son cha bskol ba blud

verses.skt: kṣveḍo ’tikaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇaḥ pragāḍheṣu praśasyate | kuṣṭhapāṇḍvāmayaplīhaśophagulmagarādiṣu
verses.tib: ko sha ta sogs kha dang tsha / mdze dang skya rbab mcher pa'i nad / 'or nad skran nad sbyar dug sogs / gting zug pa la bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: pṛthak phalādiṣaṭkasya kvāthe māṃsam anūpajam | kośātakyā samaṃ siddhaṃ tadrasaṃ lavaṇaṃ pibet
verses.tib: po son cha sogs drug so sor / bskol ba dang ni rlan can sha / ko sha ta ka cha mnyam bskol / khu ba rgyam tshar bcas pa blud

verses.skt: phalādipippalītulyaṃ siddhaṃ kṣveḍarase ’thavā | kṣveḍakvāthaṃ pibet siddhaṃ miśram ikṣurasena vā
verses.tib: po son cha sogs pi pi ling / cha mnyam ko sha ta kar sbyar / yang na ko sha ta ka yi / khu ba bu ram shing khu blud / dug mo nyung ni skyid de ba

verses.skt: kauṭajaṃ sukumāreṣu pittaraktakaphodaye | jvare visarpe hṛdroge khuḍe kuṣṭhe ca pūjitam
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pa khrag bcas dang / rims dang shu / ba snying nad dang / dreg nad kyis 'theng mdze la bsngags / dug mo nyung gi sa bon de

verses.skt: sarṣapāṇāṃ madhūkānāṃ toyena lavaṇasya vā | pāyayet kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ yuktaṃ kṛśarayāthavā
verses.tib: nyungs kar ram ni ma du ki / bskol ba'i khu ba'am rgyam tsha'i chu / yang na kri sa ra ldan blud / de yi sa bon arka yi

verses.skt: saptāhaṃ vārkadugdhāktaṃ taccūrṇaṃ pāyayet pṛthak | phalajīmūtakekṣvākujīvantījīvakodakaiḥ
verses.tib: 'o mar zhag bdun sbangs pa ni / po son cha dang dzi mu ta / ku ba kha bo dzi ban ti / dzi ba ka ni bskol ba yi / khu ba gang yang rung ba blud

verses.skt: vamanauṣadhamukhyānām iti kalpadig īritā | bījenānena matimān anyāny api ca kalpayet
verses.tib: skyug sman gyi ni gtso bo yi / cho ga phyogs tsam bshad pa yin / blo dang ldan pa tshul 'di yis / gzhan yang ci rigs sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: kaṣāyamadhurā rūkṣā vipāke kaṭukā trivṛt | kaphapittapraśamanī raukṣyāc cānilakopanī
verses.tib: dur byid bska zhing mngar la rtsub / zhu rjes tsha bar gyur pa yin / bad kan mkhris pa zhi byed de / rtsub pas rlung ni 'khrugs par byed

verses.skt: sedānīm auṣadhair yuktā vātapittakaphāpahaiḥ | kalpavaiśeṣyam āsādya jāyate sarvarogajit
verses.tib: de 'dir sman gyi sbyor ba yis / rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan sel / cho ga'i khyad par la brten nas / nad kun 'joms par byed pa yin

verses.skt: dvidhā khyātaṃ ca tanmūlaṃ śyāmaṃ śyāmāruṇaṃ trivṛt | trivṛdākhyaṃ varataraṃ nirapāyaṃ sukhaṃ tayoḥ
verses.tib: dur byid rnam pa gnyis su bshad / de rtsa dmar nag dkar ba yis / rnam pa gnyis su bshad pa yin / de las tri byi ta mchog tu bshad

verses.skt: sukumāre śiśau vṛddhe mṛdukoṣṭhe ca tad dhitam | mūrchāsaṃmohahṛtkaṇṭhakaṣaṇakṣaṇanapradam
verses.tib: nyes pa med cing bde bar 'khru / brgyal rmongs byed cing lkog ma ni

verses.skt: śyāmaṃ tīkṣṇāśukāritvād atas tad api śasyate | krūre koṣṭhe bahau doṣe kleśakṣamiṇi cāture
verses.tib: rtsub cing gnod par byed pa dang / rno zhing myur du 'khru byed pa / lto sra nad gzhi shas che dang / sdug bsngal gyis nyen nad pa la / sha ma dur bying bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: gambhīrānugataṃ ślakṣṇam atiryagvisṛtaṃ ca yat | gṛhītvā visṛjet kāṣṭhaṃ tvacaṃ śuṣkāṃ nidhāpayet
verses.tib: de ni zabs su zug cing 'jam / thad kar 'phros pa ma yin pa / btus la snying po bor nas ni / shun pa skams te sba bar bya

verses.skt: atha kāle tataś cūrṇaṃ kiñcin nāgarasaindhavam | vātāmaye pibed amlaiḥ paitte sājyasitāmadhu
verses.tib: de nas de'i 'og de'i phye ma / rgyam tsha dong ga cung zad btab / rlung nad la ni skyur las blud / mkhris par sbrang rtsi kha ra mar

verses.skt: kṣīradrākṣekṣukāśmaryasvāduskandhavarārasaiḥ | kaphāmaye pīlurasamūtramadyāmlakāñjikaiḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma rgun 'bru bu ram shing / khu ba tang pa la mngar ba yi / sman de'i 'bras bu gsum gyi ni / khu bar bcas pa blud par bya / bad kan nad la pi lu yi / khu ba ba gcin chang skyung rtsabs

verses.skt: pañcakolādicūrṇaiś ca yuktyā yuktaṃ kaphāpahaiḥ | trivṛtkalkakaṣāyābhyāṃ sādhitaḥ sasito himaḥ
verses.tib: tsha ba lnga sogs phye ma ni / bad kan 'joms dang ci rigs sbyar / dur byid lde gu khu ba / dang / bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs khar

verses.skt: madhutrijātasaṃyukto leho hṛdyaṃ virecanam | ajagandhā tavakṣīrī vidārī śarkarā trivṛt
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi dri bzang gsum dang bcas / lde gu yid 'ong bkru sman yin / a dza gan+d+ha smig rkang dang / ka ra dur byid bi da ri

verses.skt: cūrṇitaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ līḍhvā sādhu viricyate | saṃnipātajvarastambhapipāsādāhapīḍitaḥ
verses.tib: phyer btags sbrang rtsi mar dang ni / lde gu byin na 'dus pa dang / rims dang lus rengs tsha ba dang / skom dad kyis gzer legs par 'khru

verses.skt: limped antas trivṛtayā dvidhā kṛtvekṣugaṇḍikām | ekīkṛtya ca tat svinnaṃ puṭapākena bhakṣayet
verses.tib: bu ram shing ni tshal par bkas / nang ngos dur byid lde gus bsku / gcig tu sbyar te phur ma yis / btso ba'i tshul byas de bza' bya

verses.skt: bhṛṅgailābhyāṃ samā nīlī tais trivṛtaiś ca śarkarā | cūrṇaṃ phalarasakṣaudrasaktubhis tarpaṇaṃ pibet
verses.tib: shing tsha sug smel mnyam ni li / de mnyam dur byid sha ka ra / phye ma sbrang rtsi rgun chu dang / phye dang skyo mar sbyar te blud

verses.skt: vātapittakaphottheṣu rogeṣv alpānaleṣu ca | nareṣu sukumāreṣu nirapāyaṃ virecanam
verses.tib: rlung mkhris bad kan las gyur dang / me drod chung ba'i nad dang ni / skyid de ba yi mi rnams la / gnod pa med pa'i bkru sman yin

verses.skt: viḍaṅgataṇḍulavarāyāvaśūkakaṇās trivṛt | sarvato ’rdhena tal līḍhaṃ madhvājyena guḍena vā
verses.tib: byi dang ga yi snying po dang / 'bras bu gsum zhes bya ba dang / ya bak+Sha ra pi pi ling / dur byid kun gyi cha phyed byas / sbrang rtsi mar ram bu ram gyis / lde gur byas pa byin na ni

verses.skt: gulmaṃ plīhodaraṃ kāsaṃ halīmakam arocakam | kaphavātakṛtāṃś cānyān parimārṣṭi gadān bahūn
verses.tib: skran dang mcher pa dmu rdzing dang / gzugs 'khums lud pa yi ga 'chus / rlung dang bad kan las gyur nad / mang po gzhan dag sbyong bar byed

verses.skt: viḍaṅgapippalīmūlatriphalādhānyacitrakān | marīcendrayavājājīpippalīhastipippalīḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling rtsa byi dang ga / 'bras bu gsum dang 'u su dang / tsi tra ka dang na le sham / pi pi ling dang dug mo nyung / zi ra ha ste pi pi ling

verses.skt: dīpyakaṃ pañcalavaṇaṃ cūrṇitaṃ kārṣikaṃ pṛthak | tilatailatrivṛccūrṇabhāgau cāṣṭapalonmitau
verses.tib: ti mu sa dang lan tshwa lnga / zho ni gnyis gnyis phye mar byas / dur byid dang ni til mar gnyis / srang ni brgyad brgyad char bsres dang

verses.skt: dhātrīphalarasaprasthāṃs trīn guḍārdhatulānvitān | paktvā mṛdvagninā khādet tato mātrām ayantraṇaḥ
verses.tib: skyu ru ra'i khu bre gsum dang / bu ram srang ni lnga bcu me / chur bskol de las ran tsam ni

verses.skt: mandāgnitvaṃ jvaraṃ mūrchāṃ mūtrakṛcchram arocakam
verses.tib: zos na mdze dang gzhang 'brum dang

verses.skt: kuṣṭhārśaḥkāmalāgulmamehodarabhagandarān | grahaṇīpāṇḍurogāṃś ca hanti puṃsavanaś ca saḥ
verses.tib: mig ser za khu skran dang ni / dmu rdzing mtshan bar rdol ba dang / pho ba'i nad dang skya rbab rnams / 'joms shing cho ga bsrung mi dgos / bu skyed par yang de yis byed

verses.skt: guḍaḥ kalyāṇako nāma sarveṣv ṛtuṣu yaugikaḥ | vyoṣatrijātakāmbhodakṛmighnāmalakais trivṛt
verses.tib: bu ram dge ba can zhes bya / dus kun du ni 'phrod pa yin / tsha ba gsum dang dri sna gsum / gla sgang dang ni byi dang ga

verses.skt: sarvaiḥ samā samasitā kṣaudreṇa guṭikāḥ kṛtāḥ | mūtrakṛcchrajvaracchardikāsaśoṣabhramakṣaye
verses.tib: skyu ru ra ni de thams cad / mnyam pa'i dur byid / kha ra dang / sbrang rtsi'i ri lu byas zos na / gcin sri rims dang slon bro dang

verses.skt: bhakṣayet prātar utthāya śītaṃ cānu pibej jalam
tāpe pāṇḍvāmaye ’lpe ’gnau śastāḥ sarvaviṣeṣu ca | avipattir ayaṃ yogaḥ praśastaḥ pittarogiṇām
verses.tib: lud pa sha skem mgo 'khor dang / zad byed lus tsha skya rbab dang / me drod chung dang dug nad sbyong

verses.skt: trivṛtā kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ pippalī viśvabheṣajam | kṣaudradrākṣārasopetaṃ varṣākāle virecanam
verses.tib: dur byid dug mo nyung sa bon / bi pi ling dang bca' sga rnams / sbrang rtsi rgun 'bru chur sbyar ba / dbyar gyi dus kyi bkru sman yin

verses.skt: trivṛddurālabhāmustaśarkarodīcyacandanam | drākṣāmbunā sayaṣṭyāhvasātalaṃ jaladātyaye
verses.tib: dur byid gla sgang byi tsher ba / kha ra tsan+dan ba le ka / shing mngar pa ta la'i phye ma / rgun chu dang sbyar ston gyi yin

verses.skt: trivṛtāṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhām ajājīṃ saralaṃ vacām | svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā pibet
verses.tib: dur byid pa ta kru trug tres / zir shu dag sa ra la / khron bu'i phye ma chu dron sbyar / dgun gyi dus su blud par bya

verses.skt: trivṛtā śarkarātulyā grīṣmakāle virecanam | trivṛttrāyantihapuṣāsātalākaṭurohiṇīḥ
verses.tib: dur byid kha ra cha mnyam pa / so ga'i dus kyi bkru sman yin / dur byid spa 'bras kyi lce ba / pa ta la dang pu tse shel

verses.skt: svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca saṃcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayet tryaham | eṣa sarvartuko yogaḥ snigdhānāṃ maladoṣahṛt
verses.tib: khron bu legs par btags nas ni / ba gcin nang du zhag gsum sbangs / 'di ni dus kun sbyor ba ste / snum zhen dri ma nad rnams 'byin / sha ma dur byid byi tsher ba

verses.skt: śyāmātrivṛddurālabhāhastipippalīvatsakam | nīlinīkaṭukāmustāśreṣṭhāyuktaṃ sucūrṇitam
verses.tib: gla sgang hasti pi pi ling / dug mo nyung dang ni li ni / 'bras bu gsum dang pu tse shel / phye ma sha khu'am mar ram ni

verses.skt: rasājyoṣṇāmbubhiḥ śastaṃ rūkṣāṇām api sarvadā | jvarahṛdrogavātāsṛgudāvartādirogiṣu
verses.tib: chu dron dang sbyar thams cad du / khong rtsub la yang gtang bar bya / rims dang snying nad dreg nad dang / rtug skam la sogs nad rnams la

verses.skt: saindhavaṃ pippalīmūlam abhayā dviguṇottaram | cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā peyaṃ svasthe sukhavirecanam
verses.tib: dong ga'i bkru sman lhag par ni

verses.skt: rājavṛkṣo ’dhikaṃ pathyo mṛdur madhuraśītalaḥ | bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave
verses.tib: 'jam mngar bsil ba phan pa yin / byis pa rgan po glo rdol dang / skyid de ba yi mi rnams la

verses.skt: yojyo mṛdvanapāyitvād viśeṣāc caturaṅgulaḥ | phalakāle pariṇataṃ phalaṃ tasya samāharet
verses.tib: 'jam zhing skyon ni med pa'i phyir / mchog tu dong ga'i bkru sman gtang / 'bras bu'i dus su legs smin pa'i / de yi 'bras bu btus nas ni

verses.skt: teṣāṃ guṇavatāṃ bhāraṃ sikatāsu vinikṣipet | saptarātrāt samuddhṛtya śoṣayed ātape tataḥ
verses.tib: de ni yon tan ldan gyur pa / khur gcig bye ma'i nang du gzhug / zhag bdun lon nas phyung nas ni / nyi ma la ni bskam par bya

verses.skt: tato majjānam uddhṛtya śucau pātre nidhāpayet | drākṣārasena taṃ dadyād dāhodāvartapīḍite
verses.tib: de nas rkang ni phyung nas su / snod ni gtsang mar gzhag par bya / byis pa lo bzhi lon pa nas / lo ni bcu gnyis lon pa'i bar / lus tsha rtug 'gags kyis gzir la / rgun chur sbyar te blud par bya / dong ga'i rkang ni mnyes pa dang / bskol ba'i chu ni grang mo blud

verses.skt: caturvarṣe sukhaṃ bāle yāvad dvādaśavārṣike | caturaṅgulamajjño vā kaṣāyaṃ pāyayed dhimam
verses.tib: de nas rkang ni phyung nas su / snod ni gtsang mar gzhag par bya / byis pa lo bzhi lon pa nas / lo ni bcu gnyis lon pa'i bar / lus tsha rtug 'gags kyis gzir la / rgun chur sbyar te blud par bya / dong ga'i rkang ni mnyes pa dang / bskol ba'i chu ni grang mo blud

verses.skt: dadhimaṇḍasurāmaṇḍadhātrīphalarasaiḥ pṛthak | sauvīrakeṇa vā yuktaṃ kalkena traivṛtena vā
verses.tib: yang na chang dngas zho ga chu / skyu / ru ra yi khu ba'am / rang skyur dag dang bcas pa'am / dur byid lde gur sbyar ba sbyin

verses.skt: dantīkaṣāye tanmajjño guḍaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca nikṣipet | tam ariṣṭaṃ sthitaṃ māsaṃ pāyayet pakṣam eva vā
verses.tib: dan da'i khu bar de yi rkang / bu ram rnying pa bcug nas ni / zla ba gcig gam zla phyed bar / mnan pa'i chang ni blud par bya

verses.skt: tvacaṃ tilvakamūlasya tyaktvābhyantaravalkalam | viśoṣya cūrṇayitvā ca dvau bhāgau gālayet tataḥ
verses.tib: seng phrom rtsa ba'i shun pa ni / nang gi shun lpags bor nas ni / bskams te phye mar byas nas ni / de la cha gnyis bskol te gzags

verses.skt: lodhrasyaiva kaṣāyeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tena bhāvayet | kaṣāye daśamūlasya taṃ bhāgaṃ bhāvitaṃ punaḥ
verses.tib: seng phrom cha ni gsum pa sbangs / rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu ba dang / cha de slar yang sbang bar bya

verses.skt: śuṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet | mastumūtrasurāmaṇḍakoladhātrīphalāmbubhiḥ
verses.tib: slar yang bskams te phye mar bya / de las zho gnyis ba gcin nam / chang gi dngas ma'am zho ga chu / rgya shug skyu ru ra'i khu ba / gang yang rung dang sbyar te blud

verses.skt: tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca saśarkaraḥ | saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam
verses.tib: seng phrom bskol ba'i khu ba dang / lde gur byas dang khar dang / mar dang bskol ba'i lde gu de / bkru sman gyi ni dam pa yin

verses.skt: sudhā bhinatti doṣāṇāṃ mahāntam api saṃcayam | āśv eva kaṣṭavibhraṃśān naiva tāṃ kalpayed ataḥ
verses.tib: shrI khaN+Das nad kyi tshogs / shas cher sogs pa'ang 'jig par byed / myur du 'khru zhing drags pas na / lto snyi nyam chung byis pa dang / rgan po nad pa yun ring la / de ni gtang bar mi bya'o / skran dang dmu rdzing sbyang ba'i dug / pags nad gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra

verses.skt: mṛdau koṣṭhe ’bale bāle sthavire dīrgharogiṇi | kalpyā gulmodaragaratvagrogamadhumehiṣu
verses.tib: shrI khaN+Das nad kyi tshogs / shas cher sogs pa'ang 'jig par byed / myur du 'khru zhing drags pas na / lto snyi nyam chung byis pa dang / rgan po nad pa yun ring la / de ni gtang bar mi bya'o / skran dang dmu rdzing sbyang ba'i dug / pags nad gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra

verses.skt: pāṇḍau dūṣīviṣe śophe doṣavibhrāntacetasi | sā śreṣṭhā kaṇṭakais tīkṣṇair bahubhiś ca samācitā
verses.tib: skya rbab skran dang dug gis phog / nad kyis sems 'khrugs gyur la gtad / de ni tsher ma rnon po ni / mang pos khyab par gyur pa mchog

verses.skt: dvivarṣāṃ vā trivarṣāṃ vā śiśirānte viśeṣataḥ | tāṃ pāṭayitvā śastreṇa kṣīram uddhārayet tataḥ
verses.tib: lo gnyis pa'am lo gsum pa / khyad par du ni dgun gyi mthar / de ni mtshon gyis rnam bcad la / de las 'o ma blang bar bya

verses.skt: bilvādīnāṃ bṛhatyor vā kvāthena samam ekaśaḥ | miśrayitvā sudhākṣīraṃ tato ’ṅgāreṣu śoṣayet
verses.tib: bil ba la sogs rtsa ba lnga / bri ha ti ni rnam gnyis dang / bskol ba'i khu ba dang mnyam pa'i / su ti'i 'o ma dang bsres la / de 'og me yi mdag mar bskam

verses.skt: pibet kṛtvā tu guṭikāṃ mastumūtrasurādibhiḥ | trivṛtādīn nava varāṃ svarṇakṣīrīṃ sasātalām
verses.tib: ri lur byas pa zho ga chu'am / chang ngam ba gcin la sogs blud / dur byid sogs dgu 'bras bu gsum / khron bu sab tal dang bcas

verses.skt: saptāhaṃ snukpayaḥpītān rasenājyena vā pibet | tadvad vyoṣottamākumbhanikumbhāgnīn guḍāmbunā
verses.tib: su ta'i 'o mas zhag bdun sbangs / sha khu'am mar dang sbyar te blud / tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum / dur byid dan da tsi tra ka / de bzhin bu ram chus sbyar blud

verses.skt: nātiśuṣkaṃ phalaṃ grāhyaṃ śaṅkhinyā nistuṣīkṛtam | saptalāyās tathā mūlaṃ te tu tīkṣṇavikāṣiṇī
verses.tib: shang gi ni yi 'bras bu ni / phub ma med cing ma skams btu / de / bzhin sap+ta la'i rtsa ba / de dag rnon po 'khru byed yin

verses.skt: śleṣmāmayodaragaraśvayathvādiṣu kalpayet | akṣamātraṃ tayoḥ piṇḍaṃ madirālavaṇānvitam
verses.tib: bad kan dmu rdzing sbyar ba'i dug / skran sogs nad la gtang bar bya / de gnyis ri lu zho gnyis tsam / chang dang rgyam tshwa sbyar ba ni

verses.skt: hṛdroge vātakaphaje tadvad gulme ’pi yojayet | dantidantasthiraṃ sthūlaṃ mūlaṃ dantīdravantijam
verses.tib: bad rlung las gyur snying nad dang / de bzhin skran gyi nad la gtang / dan da dra ban ti'i rtsa ba / glang po'i so ltar brtan zhing sbom

verses.skt: ātāmraśyāvatīkṣṇoṣṇam āśukāri vikāśi ca | guru prakopi vātasya pittaśleṣmavilāyanam
verses.tib: dmar zhing gnag la rno zhing dro / myur du 'khru bar byed pa yin / lci zhing rlung nad 'khru byed cing / mkhris pa bad kan 'ju bar byed

verses.skt: tat kṣaudrapippalīliptaṃ svedyaṃ mṛddarbhaveṣṭitam | śoṣyaṃ mandātape ’gnyarkau hato hy asya vikāśitām
verses.tib: de ni sbrang rtsi pi pi ling / lde gus bskus la 'jag ma dang / 'jim pas bskus te mer bsreg cing / nyi ma cung zad dro bskams pas / de yi rno ba bsal bar bya

verses.skt: tat piben mastumadirātakrapīlurasāsavaiḥ | abhiṣyaṇṇatanur gulmī pramehī jaṭharī garī
verses.tib: de ni chang dngas zho ga chu / dar ba mnan chang pi lu yi / khu ba gang yang rung sbyar blud / nyam chung skran dang gcin snyi dang / dmu rdzing sbyar ba'i dug rnams sbyong

verses.skt: gomṛgājarasaiḥ pāṇḍuḥ kṛmikoṣṭhī bhagandarī | siddhaṃ tat kvāthakalkābhyāṃ daśamūlarasena ca
verses.tib: ba lang ri dwags ra sha yi / khu bar sbyar bas skya rbab dang / lto srin mtshan par rdol nad sel / de bskol khu ba lde gu dag / rtsa ba bcu yi khu bar bskol

verses.skt: visarpavidradhyalajīkakṣādāhān jayed ghṛtam | tailaṃ tu gulmamehārśovibandhakaphamārutān
verses.tib: mar gyis me dpal khong 'bras dang / 'brum phran mchan khung tsha ba sel / til mar bcas pas skran za khu / gzhang 'brum rtug 'gags bad rlung sel

verses.skt: mahāsnehaḥ śakṛcchukravātasaṅgānilavyathāḥ | virecane mukhyatamā navaite trivṛtādayaḥ
verses.tib: snum chen sbyar bas khu chu bshang / 'phyen 'gags rlung gi nad rnams sbyong / dur byid la sogs dgu po ni / bkru sman gyi ni rab mchog yin

verses.skt: harītakīm api trivṛdvidhānenopakalpayet | guḍasyāṣṭapale pathyā viṃśatiḥ syāt palaṃ palam
verses.tib: a ru ra yang dur byid kyi / cho ga bzhin du sbyar bar bya / de nas dus su de'i phye ma / rgyam tsha dong gra cung zad gdab / rlung nad la ni skyur bas blud / bu ram srang brgyad a ru ra

verses.skt: dantīcitrakayoḥ karṣau pippalītrivṛtor daśa | prakalpya modakān ekaṃ daśame daśame ’hani
verses.tib: srang re pi pi ling dur byid / zho ni gnyis gnyis lhan cig sbyar / ri lu bcu byas zhag bcu bar / ri lu re re zos rjes la

verses.skt: uṣṇāmbho ’nupibet khādet tān sarvān vidhināmunā | ete niṣparihārāḥ syuḥ sarvavyādhinibarhaṇāḥ
verses.tib: chu dron blud cing cho ga 'dis / de dag thams cad zos gyur na / kun zos bsrung ba mi dgos par / 'dis ni thams cad sel bar byed

verses.skt: viśeṣād grahaṇīpāṇḍukaṇḍūkoṭhārśasāṃ hitāḥ | alpasyāpi mahārthatvaṃ prabhūtasyālpakarmatām
verses.tib: mchog tu skya rbab pho ba'i nad / pags nad zlum po gzhang 'brum dang / g.yan pa'i nad rnams sel ba yin / chung ngu'am / don ni chen po dang / chen po las ni nyung zad dag

verses.skt: kuryāt saṃśleṣaviśleṣakālasaṃskārayuktibhiḥ
verses.tib: 'dre dang dbye ba byas pa dang / dus dang sbyor ba ldan par byed

verses.skt: tvakkesarāmrātakadāḍimailāsitopalāmākṣikamātuluṅgaiḥ | madyena tais taiś ca mano'nukūlair yuktāni deyāni virecanāni
verses.tib: shing tsha nA ga ge sar dang / a mra ta ka se 'bru dang / sug smel kha ra sbrang rtsi dang / kha lung chang sogs de dang de / yi rang rjes su 'thun pa yi / rigs pas bkru sman gtang bar bya

verses.skt: vamanaṃ mṛdukoṣṭhena kṣudvatālpakaphena vā | atitīkṣṇahimastokam ajīrṇe durbalena vā
verses.tib: skyug sman lto ni snyi ba'am / ltogs pa'am bad kan shas chung ba'am / shin tu rno ba'am grang ba'ang chung / ma zhu ba'ang nyam chung la

verses.skt: pītaṃ prayāty adhas tasminn iṣṭahānir malodayaḥ | vāmayet taṃ punaḥ snigdhaṃ smaran pūrvam atikramam
verses.tib: blud na nad 'byung re ba nyams / de tshe thur byung nad slong 'gyur / de la slar yang snum chos bya / sngar gyi skyon bral skyug sman gtang

verses.skt: ajīrṇinaḥ śleṣmavato vrajaty ūrdhvaṃ virecanam | atitīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇam ahṛdyam atibhūri vā
verses.tib: bkru sman ma zhu bad kan dang / ldan pa'am shin tu rno ches pa / dro ba'am lan tshwa shas ches pa / yi gar mi 'ong pa yis / gyen du brgal bar gyur pa dag

verses.skt: tatra pūrvoditā vyāpat siddhiś ca na tathāpi cet | āśaye tiṣṭhati tatas tṛtīyaṃ nāvacārayet
verses.tib: sngar bshad nyes pa de la ni / grub pa'i sbyor ba de bzhin bya / de yang snod du ma chags na / gsum po de la blud mi bya

verses.skt: anyatra sātmyād dhṛdyād vā bheṣajān nirapāyataḥ | asnigdhasvinnadehasya purāṇaṃ rūkṣam auṣadham
verses.tib: gzhan du goms pa'ang zhib pa yi / sman ni gnod pa med pa gtang / snum chos dugs ni ma byas la / sman ni rnying zhing rtsub pa yis

verses.skt: doṣān utkleśya nirhartum aśaktaṃ janayed gadān | vibhraṃśaṃ śvayathuṃ hidhmāṃ tamaso darśanaṃ tṛṣam
verses.tib: nad bslangs phyin par ma nus pas / mgo 'khor skrangs dang skyigs bu dang / mun par mthong dang skom dad che

verses.skt: piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ kaṇḍūm ūrvoḥ sādaṃ vivarṇatām | snigdhasvinnasya vātyalpaṃ dīptāgner jīrṇam auṣadham
verses.tib: byin snying na zhing lus g.ya' dang / bla dang kha dog mi sdug pa'i / nad ni skyed par byed pa yin / snum chos dugs byas sman nyung zhing / me drod che bas zhu gyur pa'am

verses.skt: śītair vā stabdham āme vā samutkleśyāharan malān | tān eva janayed rogān ayogaḥ sarva eva saḥ
verses.tib: grang bas rengs ba'am ma zhu bas / nad bslangs nas ni ma phyin pas / nad ni de dag nyid bskyad cing / de nyid sbyor nyes thams cad yin

verses.skt: taṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ prastarasaṃkaraiḥ | nirūḍhaḥ jāṅgalarasair bhojayitvānuvāsayet
verses.tib: de la til mar rgyam tshas bsku / gshag ma rdo yi dugs bya zhing / mas gtong drag byas skam sa'i sha / kha zas byin la 'jam rtsi ni

verses.skt: phalamāgadhikādārusiddhatailena mātrayā | snigdhaṃ vātaharaiḥ snehaiḥ punas tīkṣṇena śodhayet
verses.tib: po son cha dang pi / pi ling / thang shing til mar bskol ba gtang / rlung 'joms rlung gi snum chos bya / slar yang bkru sman rnon pos sbyang

verses.skt: bahudoṣasya rūkṣasya mandāgner alpam auṣadham | sodāvartasya cotkleśya doṣān mārgān nirudhya taiḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi che zhing khong rtsub la / me drod chung dang sman chung ba / rtug skam bcas pas bslangs pa dang / nad kyis lam ni 'gags par 'gyur

verses.skt: bhṛśam ādhmāpayen nābhiṃ pṛṣṭhapārśvaśirorujam | śvāsaṃ viṇmūtravātānāṃ saṅgaṃ kuryāc ca dāruṇam
verses.tib: mi bzad sbo dang lte ba dang / rgyab dang rtsib logs mgo bo na / phyi sa gcin 'gags dbugs mi bde / mi bzad pa ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: abhyaṅgasvedavartyādi sanirūhānuvāsanam | udāvartaharam sarvaṃ karmādhmātasya śasyate
verses.tib: bsku dang dugs dang ring bu sogs / mas gtong drag po 'jam rtsi bya / rtug skam sel ba'i gso dpyad las / thams cad sbo ba dag la phan

verses.skt: pañcamūlayavakṣāravacābhūtikasaindhavaiḥ | yavāgūḥ sukṛtā śūlavibandhānāhanāśanī
verses.tib: rtsa ba lnga pa nas tshig 'khus / shu dag pu ti ka rany+dza / rgyam tsha nas thug legs sbyar bas / gzer nad rtug skam lto sbos 'joms

verses.skt: pippalīdāḍimakṣārahiṅguśuṇṭhyamlavetasān | sasaindhavān piben madyaiḥ sarpiṣoṣṇodakena vā
verses.tib: thal sman se 'bru pi pi ling / shing kun bca' sga star bu dang / rgyam tshar bcas pa'i chang ngam ni / mar ram chu dron sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: pravāhikāparisrāvavedanāparikartane | pītauṣadhasya vegānāṃ nigrahān mārutādayaḥ
verses.tib: mkhregs shing yongs su 'dzag pa dang / na zhing bcad snyam sems pa sel / sman 'thungs gyur pa'i shugs bkag na / rlung la sogs pa'i nad rnams ni

verses.skt: kupitā hṛdayaṃ gatvā ghoraṃ kurvanti hṛdgraham | hidhmāpārśvarujākāsadainyalālākṣivibhramaiḥ
verses.tib: 'khrugs te snying gi phyogs song na / snying nad mi bzad skyed par byed / skyigs bu lud pa rtsib logs na / rmya zhing mig 'gul kha chu 'dzag

verses.skt: jihvāṃ khādati niḥsaṃjño dantān kaṭakaṭāyayan | na gacched vibhramaṃ tatra vāmayed āśu taṃ bhiṣak
verses.tib: dran pa nyams shing lce 'cha' la / so ni krig krig 'cha' bar byed / de la sman pa ma rmongs pas

verses.skt: madhuraiḥ pittamūrchārtaṃ kaṭubhiḥ kaphamūrchitam | pācanīyais tataś cāsya doṣaśeṣaṃ vipācayet
verses.tib: mkhris pas nyen la mngar ba dang / bad kan gyis nyen kha ba yi / skyug sman dag ni myur du gtang / de nas de la smin byed pa'i / nad kyi lhag ma smin par bya

verses.skt: kāyāgniṃ ca balaṃ cāsya krameṇābhipravardhayet | pavanenātivamato hṛdayaṃ yasya pīḍyate
verses.tib: de yi me drod lus kyi stobs / rim gyis mngon par 'phel bar byed / shas cher slon gyur rlung gis ni / gang gi snying ni gzer gyur pa

verses.skt: tasmai snigdhāmlalavaṇān dadyāt pittakaphe ’nyathā | pītauṣadhasya vegānāṃ nigraheṇa kaphena vā
verses.tib: de la snum gyur lan tshwa sbyin / mkhris pa bad kan de las gzhan / sman ni 'thungs par gyur nas shugs / bkag par gyur pa'am bad kan gyis

verses.skt: ruddho ’ti vā viśuddhasya gṛhṇāty aṅgāni mārutaḥ | stambhavepathunistodasādodveṣṭārtibhedanaiḥ
verses.tib: 'gags pa'am shin tu sbyangs gyur pa'i / lus la rlung ni 'jug 'gyur bas / rengs dang 'dar dang zug pa dang

verses.skt: tatra vātaharaṃ sarvaṃ snehasvedādi śasyate | bahutīkṣṇaṃ kṣudhārtasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya bheṣajam
verses.tib: de la rlung ni 'joms pa yi / snum chos dugs thams cad bsngags / sman thun che la rno ba ni / bkres nyen lto snyi la blud na

verses.skt: hṛtvāśu viṭpittakaphān dhātūn āsrāvayed dravān | tatrātiyoge madhuraiḥ śeṣam auṣadham ullikhet
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pa bshang ba ni / bsal nas lus zungs 'dzag par byed / de la sbyor drags mngar ba yi / sman gyis lhag ma slon du gzhug

verses.skt: yojyo ’tivamane reko vireke vamanaṃ mṛdu | pariṣekāvagāhādyaiḥ suśītaiḥ stambhayec ca tam
verses.tib: skyug sman drags la bkru sman gtang / 'khrus drags skyug sman 'jam po gtang / de la chu grang blud pa dang / ro smad bcings pas gcad par bya

verses.skt: añjanaṃ candanośīram ajāsṛkśarkarodakam | lājacūrṇaiḥ piben mantham atiyogaharaṃ param
verses.tib: stang zil tsan+dan pu shel tse / ra khrag kha ra'i chu dang ni / 'bras yos phye ma'i skyo ma ni / sbyor drags sel ba'i dam pa yin

verses.skt: vamanasyātiyoge tu śītāmbupariṣecitaḥ | pibet phalarasair manthaṃ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram
verses.tib: slon sman sbyor ba drags pa la / chu grang dag ni blugs par bya / rgun 'bru la sogs khu ba mar / sbrang rtsi kha ra'i skyo ma blud

verses.skt: sodgārāyāṃ bhṛśaṃ chardyāṃ mūrvāyā dhānyamustayoḥ | samadhūkāñjanaṃ cūrṇaṃ lehayen madhusaṃyutam
verses.tib: sgregs pa bcas par shin tu skyug / mur ba 'u su gla sgang dang / stang zil ma du ka'i phye ma / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu sbyin

verses.skt: vamato ’ntaḥ praviṣṭāyāṃ jihvāyāṃ kavaḍagrahāḥ | snigdhāmlalavaṇā hṛdyā yūṣamāṃsarasā hitāḥ
verses.tib: slon mthar lce ni 'khums pa la / snum dang skyur dang lan tshwa dang / ldan pas mkhur ba bkang ba dang / yid 'ong yu sha sha khu phan

verses.skt: phalāny amlāni khādeyus tasya cānye ’grato narāḥ | niḥsṛtāṃ tu tiladrākṣākalkaliptāṃ praveśayet
verses.tib: de yi mdun du mi gzhan ni / 'bras bu skyur ba za ru gzhug / lce phyir byung la til dang ni / rgun 'bru'i lde gu bskus nas gzhug

verses.skt: vāggrahānilarogeṣu ghṛtamāṃsopasādhitām | yavāgūṃ tanukāṃ dadyāt snehasvedau ca kālavit
verses.tib: tshig bkug rlung gi nad la ni / mar dang sha dang g.yos pa yi / nas thug sla ba sbyin bya zhing / snum dang dugs kyi sbyor ba bya

verses.skt: atiyogāc ca bhaiṣajyaṃ jīvaṃ harati śoṇitam | taj jīvādānam ity uktam ādatte jīvitaṃ yataḥ
verses.tib: sman gyi sbyor ba drags pa yis / srog ces bya ba'i khrag phyung na / gang phyir de ni srog 'phrog pas / srog len par ni yin par bshad

verses.skt: śune kākāya vā dadyāt tenānnam asṛjā saha | bhukte ’bhukte vadej jīvaṃ pittaṃ vā bheṣajeritam
verses.tib: khrag de dang ni zas bcas pa / khyi'am bya rog la byin la / zos na srog ces brjod par bya / ma zos mkhris pa yin par bshad

verses.skt: śuklaṃ vā bhāvitaṃ vastram āvānaṃ koṣṇavāriṇā | prakṣālitaṃ vivarṇaṃ syāt pitte śuddhaṃ tu śoṇite
verses.tib: yang na ras dkar la bsgos te / bskams la chu dron gyis bkrus la / bkrus kyang dag par ma gyur na / mkhris pa'o dag na khrag yin no

verses.skt: tṛṣṇāmūrchāmadārtasya kuryād āmaraṇāt kriyām | raktapittātisāraghnīṃ tasyāśu prāṇarakṣaṇīm
verses.tib: skom dang brgyal dang myos pas nyen / de la srog ni myur bsrung phyir / khrag dang mkhris pa sel ba yin / gso ba 'tsho / ba'i bar du bya

verses.skt: mṛgagomahiṣājānāṃ sadyaskaṃ jīvatām asṛk | pibej jīvābhisaṃdhānaṃ jīvaṃ tad dhy āśu gacchati
verses.tib: ba glang ma he ra / gson pa'i khrag ni phyung ma thag / srog ni 'byor par byed pa blud / des ni myur du srog tu 'gyur

verses.skt: tad eva darbhamṛditaṃ raktaṃ vastau niṣecayet | śyāmākāśmaryamadhukadūrvośīraiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ
verses.tib: de nyid 'jag ma dang mnyes pa'i / khrag ni 'jam rtsir gtang bar bya / dur byid tang pal shing mngar dang / dUr ba pu shel tse 'o ma

verses.skt: ghṛtamaṇḍāñjanayutaṃ vastiṃ vā yojayed dhimam | picchāvastiṃ suśītaṃ vā ghṛtamaṇḍānuvāsanam
verses.tib: bskol ba mar gyi snying po dang / stang zil dang ni bcas pa yi / 'jam rtsi grang mo gtang bar bya / spyi bag 'jam rtsi rab grang ba'am / mar gyi snying po 'jam rtsi gtang

verses.skt: gudaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ kaṣāyaiś ca stambhayitvā praveśayet | visaṃjñaṃ śrāvayet sāmaveṇugītādinisvanam
verses.tib: gzhang phyir byung la sman khu yis / 'khru ba gcad la gzhug par bya / dran pa stor la rig byed tshig / gling bu glu dbyangs nyan du gzhug

verses.skt: balāṃ guḍūcīṃ triphalāṃ sarāsnāṃ dvipañcamūlaṃ ca palonmitāni | aṣṭau phalāny ardhatulāṃ ca māṃsāc chāgāt paced apsu caturthaśeṣam
verses.tib: ba la sle tres ra sna 'bras bu gsum / rtsa ba lnga pa rnam gnyis srang re'i tshad / po son cha brgyad ra sha srang lnga bcu / chu nang bskol te bzhi cha lus gyur pa / btsags pa la la phud dang po son cha / bil ba ru rta sha ta puSh+pa dang

verses.skt: pūto yavānīphalabilvakuṣṭhavacāśatāhvāghanapippalīnām | kalkair guḍakṣaudraghṛtaiḥ satailair yuktaḥ sukhoṣṇo lavaṇānvitaś ca || 2 || vastiḥ paraṃ sarvagadapramāthī svasthe hito jīvanabṛṃhaṇaś ca | vastau ca yasmin paṭhito na kalkaḥ sarvatra dadyād amum eva tatra
verses.tib: shu dag gla sgang pi pi ling rnams kyi / lde gu bu ram sbrang rtsi mar dang ni / til mar rgyam tsha dag dang ldan gyur pa / dro 'jam cho ga bzhin du btang gyur pa / mas gtong mchog ste nad kun 'joms pa yin / nad med la phan tshe ring nyams brtas byed / 'jam rtsi gong du lde gu ma smos pa / der ni kun la 'di nyid gzhug par bya

verses.skt: dvipañcamūlasya raso ’mlayuktaḥ sacchāgamāṃsasya sapūrvapeṣyaḥ | trisnehayuktaḥ pravaro nirūhaḥ sarvānilavyādhiharaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ
verses.tib: ra sha bcas pa snga ma btags pa dang / snum chen gsum ldan mas gtong mchog yin te / rlung gi nad kun rab tu 'joms par bshad / pa la pa tol rtsa ba chung ngu lnga / kyi lce ba dang e raN+Da dang nas / bskol ba'i khu ba bre gang ra sha'i khu

verses.skt: balāpaṭolīlaghupañcamūlatrāyantikairaṇḍayavāt susiddhāt | prastho rasāc chāgarasārdhayuktaḥ sādhyaḥ punaḥ prasthasamaḥ sa yāvat || 5 || priyaṅgukṛṣṇāghanakalkayuktaḥ satailasarpirmadhusaindhavaś ca | syād dīpano māṃsabalapradaś ca cakṣurbalaṃ copadadhāti sadyaḥ
verses.tib: de'i phyed bcug la bskol te bre gang lus / pri yang ku dang gla sgang pi pi ling / lde gur byas shing til mar zhun mar dang / sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha dang ni ldan gyur pa'i / 'jam rtsi btang na me drod 'phel ba dang / nyams stobs skyed cing sha ni rgyas pa dang / mig gi gsal / stobs 'phral du skyed par byed

verses.skt: eraṇḍamūlāt tripalaṃ palāśāt tathā palāṃśaṃ laghupañcamūlam | rāsnābalāchinnaruhāśvagandhāpunarnavāragvadhadevadāru
verses.tib: e raN+Da'i rtsa srang gsum pa la sha / srang gsum rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu dang / ra sna ba la sle tres ba spru ba / a shwa gan+d+ha dong ga thang shing rnams

verses.skt: phalāni cāṣṭau salilāḍhakābhyāṃ vipācayed aṣṭamaśeṣite ’smin | vacāśatāhvāhapuṣāpriyaṅguyaṣṭīkaṇāvatsakabījamustam
verses.tib: po son cha brgyad chu bre brgyad du bskol / brgyad cha lus par gyur pa de nang du / shu dag shu ti ba sha'i 'bras bu dang / pri yang ku dang shing mngar pi pi ling / dug mo nyung gi sa bon gla sgang dang

verses.skt: dadyāt supiṣṭaṃ sahatārkṣyaśailam akṣapramāṇaṃ lavaṇāṃśayuktam | samākṣikas tailayutaḥ samūtro vastir jayel lekhanadīpano ’sau
verses.tib: skyer pa'i khaN+Dar bcas pa zhib btags pa / zho gnyis tshad kyi rgyam tshar bcas pa dang / sbrang rtsi til mar ba gcin dang sbyar ba'i / mas gtong skyug byed me drod skyed pa dang

verses.skt: jaṅghorupādatrikapṛṣṭhakoṣṭhahṛdguhyaśūlaṃ gurutāṃ vibandham | gulmāśmavardhmagrahaṇīgudotthāṃs tās tāṃś ca rogān kaphavātajātān
verses.tib: rkang pa byin pa brla dang mjug to dang / lto ba snying dang pho mtshan na ba dang / lus lci rlung dang bshang gci 'gags dang skran / rde'u chags rgyu rlugs gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad / bad kan rlung nad de dang de dag 'joms

verses.skt: yaṣṭyāhvalodhrābhayacandanaiś ca śṛtaṃ payo ’gryaṃ kamalotpalaiś ca | saśarkarākṣaudraghṛtaṃ suśītaṃ pittāmayān hanti sajīvanīyam
verses.tib: shing mngar seng phrom tsan+dan a ru ra / tsan+dan ut+pal ba yi 'o mar bskol / 'tsho byed kha ra mar dang bcas pa yi / 'jam rtsis mkhris pa'i nad rnams sel bar byed

verses.skt: rāsnāṃ vṛṣaṃ lohitikām anantāṃ balāṃ kanīyastṛṇapañcamūlyau | gopāṅganācandanapadmakarddhiyaṣṭyāhvalodhrāṇi palārdhakāni
verses.tib: ra sna ba sha ka btsos byi tsher ba / ba la rtsa ba chung lnga rtswa yi lnga / thal tres tsan+dan shug pa rnam gnyis dang / shing mngar seng phrom srang ni phyed phyed dang

verses.skt: niḥkvāthya toyena rasena tena śṛtaṃ payo ’rdhāḍhakam ambuhīnam | jīvantimedarddhivarīvidārīvīrādvikākolikaserukābhiḥ
verses.tib: chu dang bskol ba'i khu ba de nyid ni / 'o ma bre bzhi bskol te chu du'i bar / ji ban ti dang me da rnam gnyis dang / nye shing ram nye ba gnyis bi da ri / ka she ru dang kha ra dkar po dang

verses.skt: sitopalājīvakapadmareṇuprapauṇḍarīkotpalapuṇḍarīkaiḥ | lodhrātmaguptāmadhuyaṣṭikābhir nāgāhvamuñjātakacandanaiś ca
verses.tib: dzi ba ka dang pad+ma ge sar dang / stag tsher ut+pa la dang pad+ma dkar / seng phrom kha sral phre'u shing mngar dang / nA ga ge sar muny+dza ta ka dang / tsan+dan rnam gnyis btags pa mar dang ni

verses.skt: piṣṭair ghṛtakṣaudrayutair nirūhaṃ sasaindhavaṃ śītalam eva dadyāt | pratyāgate dhanvarasena śālīn kṣīreṇa vādyāt pariṣiktagātraḥ
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha dang ni ldan byas pa / bsgrangs pa'i ni ru ha ni gtang bar bya / slar phyung skam sa'i sha khu'am 'o ma dang / 'bras chan byin la lus la chu blugs bya

verses.skt: dāhātisārapradarāsrapittahṛtpāṇḍurogān viṣamajvaraṃ ca | sagulmamūtragrahakāmalādīn sarvāmayān pittakṛtān nihanti
verses.tib: lus tsha tshad 'khru mngal nad khrag mkhris dang / snying nad skya rbab mi bzad rims dang ni / skran bcas gcin 'gags mig ser la sogs pa / mkhris pa las gyur nad ni thams cad 'joms

verses.skt: kośātakāragvadhadevadārumūrvāśvadaṃṣṭrākuṭajārkapāṭhāḥ | paktvā kulatthān bṛhatīṃ ca toye rasasya tasya prasṛtā daśa syuḥ
verses.tib: ko sha ta ka dong ga thang shing dang / mur ba gze ma arga dug mo nyung / pa ta rgya sran bri ha ti chur bskol / khu ba srang ni nyi shu lus pa dang

verses.skt: tān sarṣapailāmadanaiḥ sakuṣṭhair akṣapramāṇaiḥ prasṛtaiś ca yuktān | kṣaudrasya tailasya phalāhvayasya kṣārasya tailasya ca sārṣapasya
verses.tib: der ni nyungs kar sug smel po son cha / ru rta zhon gnyis gnyis tshad dang ni / sbrang rtsi po son cha yi mar dang ni / thal sman nyungs mar srang ni gnyis gnyis bcas

verses.skt: dadyān nirūhaṃ kapharogitāya mandāgnaye cāśanavidviṣe ca | vakṣye mṛdūn snehakṛto nirūhān sukhocitānāṃ prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak tu
verses.tib: mas gtong me drod chung dang yi ga 'chus / bad kan las gyur nad ni kun la phan / de nas ni ru ha de ni / snum 'jam skyid de ba dang ni

verses.skt: athemān sukumārāṇāṃ nirūhān snehanān mṛdūn | karmaṇā viplutānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak
verses.tib: las kyis lus snyom gyur pa'i sman / srang ni gnyis gnyis so sor bshad / 'o ma las ni srang bzhir bya / sbrang rtsi til mar mar khyor re / gzar bus dkrugs pa mas gtong bas / rlung nad 'jam stobs kha dog skyed

verses.skt: kṣīrād dvau prasṛtau kāryau madhutailaghṛtāt trayaḥ | khajena mathito vastir vātaghno balavarṇakṛt
verses.tib: las kyis lus snyom gyur pa'i sman / srang ni gnyis gnyis so sor bshad / 'o ma las ni srang bzhir bya / sbrang rtsi til mar mar khyor re / gzar bus dkrugs pa mas gtong bas / rlung nad 'jam stobs kha dog skyed

verses.skt: ekaikaḥ prasṛtas tailaprasannākṣaudrasarpiṣām | bilvādimūlakvāthād dvau kaulatthād dvau sa vātajit
verses.tib: til mar chang dang sbrang rtsi mar / khyor ni re re'i tshad du byas / bil ba la sogs rtsa ba ni / khyor gnyis rgya sran khu ba ni / khyor do bcas pas rlung nad sel

verses.skt: paṭolanimbabhūtīkarāsnāsaptacchadāmbhasaḥ | prasṛtaḥ pṛthag ājyāc ca vastiḥ sarṣapakalkavān
verses.tib: pa to la dang nim pa dang / lo ma bdun pa pu ti ka / ra sna'i khu ba srang gnyis gnyis / mar srang gnyis dang nyungs kar kyi

verses.skt: sa pañcatikto ’bhiṣyandakṛmikuṣṭhapramehahā | catvāras tailagomūtradadhimaṇḍāmlakāñjikāt
verses.tib: lde gur bcas pa kha ba lnga / bad kan mang dang srin nad dang / mdze dang za khu'i nad rnams 'joms / til mar ba gcin zho ga chu

verses.skt: prasṛtāḥ sarṣapaiḥ piṣṭair viṭsaṅgānāhabhedanaḥ | payasyekṣusthirārāsnāvidārīkṣaudrasarpiṣām
verses.tib: skyur rtsabs khyor ni re re dag / yungs kar btags pa'i lde gur sbyar / rtug 'gags lto sbos sel byed yin / pa yas s+ye dang bu ram shing

verses.skt: ekaikaḥ prasṛto vastiḥ kṛṣṇākalko vṛṣatvakṛt | siddhavastīn ato vakṣye sarvadā yān prayojayet
verses.tib: sA la par+Ni bi da ri / ra sna khyor re pi pi ling / lde gu sbrang rtsi mar sbyar ba'i / mas gtong khu ba 'phel bar byed / de nas grub pa'i 'jam rtsi ni

verses.skt: nirvyāpado bahuphalān balapuṣṭikarān sukhān | madhutaile same karṣaḥ saindhavād dvipicur miśiḥ
verses.tib: nyes pa med cing 'bras bu che / stobs skyed lus 'phel bde bar byed / kun du sbyar bya bshad par bya / sbrang rtsi til mar cha mnyam pa / rgyam tsha zho gnyis shu ti bzhi

verses.skt: eraṇḍamūlakvāthena nirūho mādhutailikaḥ | rasāyanaṃ pramehārśaḥkṛmigulmāntravṛddhinut
verses.tib: e raN+Da yi rtsa ba bskol / mas gtong sbrang rtsi til mar can / bcud kyis len te gcin snyi dang / gzhang 'brum srin bu skran nad dang / rgyu ma rlugs pa'i nad rnams sel

verses.skt: sayaṣṭīmadhukaś caiṣa cakṣuṣyo raktapittajit | yāpano ghanakalkena madhutailarasājyavān
verses.tib: 'di ni shing mngar phye mar bcas / mig la phan zhing khrag mkhris sel / gla sgang lde gu sbrang rtsi dang / til mar sha khu mar bcas pa

verses.skt: pāyujānūruvṛṣaṇavastimehanaśūlajit | prasṛtāṃśair ghṛtakṣaudravasātailaiḥ prakalpayet
verses.tib: 'tsho bar byed pa zhes bya ste / gzhang gi nad dang brla nad dang / chu so dang ni rmig pa dang / pho mtshan zug pa'i nad rnams sel / sbrang rtsi mar dang zhag dang ni

verses.skt: yāpanaṃ saindhavārdhākṣahapuṣārdhapalānvitam | eraṇḍamūlaniḥkvātho madhutailaṃ sasaindhavam
verses.tib: til mar khyor ni re re'i tshad / rgyam tsha zho gcig spa ma yi / 'bras bu srang phyed bcas pa dag / de yang 'tsho ba yin par bshad / e raN+Da'i rtsa bskol ba yi

verses.skt: eṣa yuktaratho vastiḥ savacāpillalīphalaḥ | sa kvātho madhuṣaḍgranthāśatāhvāhiṅgusaindhavam
verses.tib: khu ba shu dag pi pi ling / po son cha yi phye mar bcas / sbrang rtsi til mar rgyam tshar bcas / 'di ni shing rta can zhes bya

verses.skt: suradāru ca rāsnā ca vastir doṣaharaḥ śivaḥ | pañcamūlasya niḥkvāthas tailaṃ māgadhikā madhu
verses.tib: de bskol shu dag shu ti dang / shing kun rgyam tsha thang shing dang / ra sna sbrang rtsi sbyar ba yi / 'jam rtsi nad sel zhes bya dge

verses.skt: sasaindhavaḥ samadhukaḥ siddhavastir iti smṛtaḥ | dvipañcamūlatriphalāphalabilvāni pācayet
verses.tib: rtsa ba lnga yi khu ba dang / pi pi ling dang rgyam tsha dang / shing mngar sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi / til mar grub pa'i 'jam rtsir bshad / rtsa ba bcu pa 'bras bu gsum / po son cha ni bil bar bskol

verses.skt: gomūtre tena piṣṭaiś ca pāṭhāvatsakatoyadaiḥ | saphalaiḥ kṣaudratailābhyāṃ kṣāreṇa lavaṇena ca
verses.tib: ba gcin dang ni de btags shing / pa ta gla sgang dug mo nyung / lan tshwa po son cha til mar / thal sman lan tshwar bcas pa ni

verses.skt: yukto vastiḥ kaphavyādhipāṇḍurogaviṣūciṣu | śukrānilavibandheṣu vastyāṭope ca pūjitaḥ
verses.tib: rigs pa'i 'jam rtsi bad kan nad / skya rbab gsud pa'i nad rnams dang / khu ba rlung ni 'gags pa dang / rlung 'khrugs pa la bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: mustāpāṭhāmṛtairaṇḍabalārāsnāpunarnavāḥ | mañjiṣṭhāragvadhośīratrāyamāṇākṣarohiṇīḥ
verses.tib: gla sgang pa ta e raN+Da / sle tres ba la ba spru ba / ra sna btsod dang dong ga dang / pu shel tse dang kyi lce ba / ba ru ra dang pu tse shel

verses.skt: kanīyaḥ pañcamūlaṃ ca pālikaṃ madanāṣṭakam | jalāḍhake pacet tac ca pādaśeṣaṃ parisrutam
verses.tib: rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu rnams / srang re po son cha rdog brgyad / de ni chu bre bzhi nang bskol / bzhi cha lus pa btsags nas ni

verses.skt: kṣīradviprasthasaṃyuktaṃ kṣīraśeṣaṃ punaḥ pacet | sapādajāṅgalarasaḥ sasarpirmadhusaindhavaḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma bre do dang bsres la / 'o ma lus pa slar yang bskol / skam sa'i sha khu bzhi cha dang / sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha shing mngar dang

verses.skt: piṣṭair yaṣṭīmiśiśyāmākaliṅgakarasāñjanaiḥ | vastiḥ sukhoṣṇo māṃsāgnibalaśukravivardhanaḥ
verses.tib: shu ti dur byid pi pi ling / dug mo nyung dang skyer khaN+Da / btags pa dang ni bsres pa yi / 'jam rtsi dro 'jam btang na ni / sha dang me drod lus kyi stobs / khu ba 'phel bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: vātāsṛṅmohamehārśogulmaviṇmūtrasaṃgrahān | viṣamajvaravīsarpavardhmādhmānapravāhikāḥ
verses.tib: dreg nad rmongs bag gcin snyi dang / gzhang 'brum skran dang bshang gci 'gags / mi bzad rims dang me dbal dang / rgyu rlugs lto sbos 'khrug cing 'khru

verses.skt: vaṅkṣaṇorukaṭīkukṣimanyāśrotraśirorujaḥ | hanyād asṛgdaronmādaśophakāsāśmakuṇḍalān
verses.tib: chu so rked / pa brla dku na / gnye'u rengs rna ba mgo bo'i nad / zla mtshan nad dang smyo byed dang / 'or nad lud pa rde'u chags dang / gcin 'khyil ba yi nad rnams 'joms

verses.skt: cakṣuṣyaḥ putrado rājā yāpanānāṃ rasāyanam | mṛgāṇāṃ laghuvadrāṇāṃ daśamūlasya cāmbhasā
verses.tib: mig la phan zhing bu skyed byed / 'tsho byed rgyal po bcud len yin / ri dwags phra mo mgo chung ba / rtsa ba bcu pa bskol ba'i chu

verses.skt: hapuṣāmiśigāṅgeyīkalkair vātaharaḥ param | nirūho ’tyarthavṛṣyaś ca mahāsnehasamanvitaḥ
verses.tib: spa ma'i 'bras bu shu ti dang / gla sgang lde gu snum chen bcas / mas gtong rlung ni sel ba'i mchog / shin tu ro tsar byed pa yin

verses.skt: mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrapādaviṭtuṇḍavarjitam | laghunā pañcamūlena pālikena samanvitam
verses.tib: rma bya'i gshog pa mkhris pa dang / rgyu ma rkang pa mchu rtug pa / por ba'i sha ni 'ba' zhig dang / rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu ni

verses.skt: paktvā kṣīrajale kṣīraśeṣaṃ saghṛtamākṣikam | tad vidārīkaṇāyaṣṭīśatāhvāphalakalkavat
verses.tib: srang re dang ni ldan gyur pa / chu dang 'o mar bskol nas ni / 'o ma lus par sbrang rtsi mar / bcas dang de bzhin bi da ri / shing mngar shu ti pi pi ling / po son cha yi lde gur bsres

verses.skt: vastir īṣatpaṭuyutaḥ paramaṃ balaśukrakṛt | kalpaneyaṃ pṛthak kāryā tittiriprabhṛtiṣv api
verses.tib: rgyam tsha cung zad btab pa yi / 'jam rtsi stobs 'phel ro tsa'i mchog / gong ma sreg la sogs pa yang / cho ga 'di ni so sor bya

verses.skt: viṣkireṣu samasteṣu pratudaprasaheṣu ca | jalacāriṣu tadvac ca matsyeṣu kṣīravarjitā
verses.tib: khron gyis gzas tshol thams cad dang / mthu rtsal mchu yis zas tshol ba / chu la gnas pa'ang de bzhin te / nya la 'o ma spang bar bya

verses.skt: godhānakulamārjāraśalyakondurajaṃ palam | pṛthag daśapalaṃ kṣīre pañcamūlaṃ ca sādhayet
verses.tib: sram dang ne+e'u le byi la dang / reg 'jam byi ba rnams kyi sha / re re srang bcu rtsa ba lnga / 'o ma'i nang du bskol nas ni

verses.skt: tat payaḥ phalavaidehīkalkadvilavaṇānvitam | sasitātailamadhvājyo vastir yojyo rasāyanam
verses.tib: 'o ma der ni po son cha / pi pi ling dang lan tshwa gnyis / kha ra til mar sbrang rtsi mar / 'jam rtsi btang na bcud len mchog

verses.skt: vyāyāmamathitoraskakṣīṇendriyabalaujasām | vibaddhaśukraviṇmūtrakhuḍavātavikāriṇām
verses.tib: rtsol bas dkrugs glo 'grams pa dang / dbang po nyams dang gzi mdangs stobs / khu chu bshang gci 'gags pa dang / dreg nad kyis 'theng nad rnams dang

verses.skt: gajavājirathakṣobhabhagnajarjaritātmanām | punarnavatvaṃ kurute vājīkaraṇam uttamam
verses.tib: rta dang glang po shing rtas g.yeng / rkang lag chag grugs gyur pa la / slar ni bde bar 'tsho byed cing / ro tsa byed pa'i mchog yin no

verses.skt: siddhena payasā bhojyam ātmaguptoccaṭekṣuraiḥ | snehāṃś cāyantraṇān siddhān siddhadravyaiḥ prakalpayet
verses.tib: kha sral bu ram shing phran las / g.yos su byas pa'i 'o thug blud / snum zhing bsdams pa mi dgos pa'i / grub pa'i sman ni sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: doṣaghnāḥ saparīhārā vakṣyante snehavastayaḥ | daśamūlaṃ balāṃ rāsnām aśvagandhāṃ punarnavām
verses.tib: nad 'joms srung dang bcas pa yi / snum gyi 'jam rtsi bshad bya ste / rtsa ba bcu pa ba la dang / ra sna a shwa / gan+d+ha dang

verses.skt: guḍūcyairaṇḍabhūtīkabhārgīvṛṣakarohiṣam | śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palāṃśakam
verses.tib: ba spru ba dang e raN dang / sle tres ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / ba sha ka dang bu ti ka / sa ha ra dza nye shing ba / ka ka na se srang re dang

verses.skt: yavamāṣātasīkolakulatthān prasṛtonmitān | vahe vipācya toyasya droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca
verses.tib: nas dang ma sha zar ma dang / rgya shug rgya sran khyor re'i tshad / chu bre drug cu rtsa bzhir bskol / de las bre ni bcu drug lus

verses.skt: pacet tailāḍhakaṃ peṣyair jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ | anuvāsanam ity etat sarvavātavikāranut
verses.tib: 'tsho byed sde ni srang re bcug / til mar bre ni bzhi dang bskol / 'di ni 'jam rtsir btang gyur na / rlung nad thams cad sel bar byed

verses.skt: ānūpānāṃ vasā tadvaj jīvanīyopasādhitā | śatāhvāciribilvāmlais tailaṃ siddhaṃ samīraṇe
verses.tib: de bzhin skam sa'i srog chags sha / 'tsho byed sde dang bcas par bskol / shu ti nas dang bil ba skyur / til mar bskol bas rlung nad sel

verses.skt: saindhavenāgnivarṇena taptaṃ cānilajid ghṛtam | jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām
verses.tib: rgyam tsha mdog dmar gyur gyi bar / mer bsregs mar gsur rlung nad 'joms / dzi ban ti dang po son cha / me da rnam gnyis sra ba ni / shing mngar ba la shu ti dang

verses.skt: śatāhvarṣabhakau kṛṣṇāṃ kākanāsāṃ śatāvarīm | svaguptāṃ kṣīrakākolīṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ śaṭhīṃ vacām
verses.tib: zangs rtsi ba dang pi pi ling / ka ka ni sa nye shing ba / kha sral k+Shi ra ka ka ri / zur pa karka ta sring gi

verses.skt: piṣṭvā tailaghṛtaṃ kṣīre sādhayet taccaturguṇe | bṛṃhaṇaṃ vātapittaghnaṃ balaśukrāgnivardhanam
verses.tib: shu dag btags pa'i lde gu dang / til mar mar dang 'o ma ni / bzhi 'gyur gyi ni nang du bskol / 'jam rtsi nyams brtas rlung nad 'joms / stobs dang khu ba me drod 'phel

verses.skt: rajaḥśukrāmayaharaṃ putrīyaṃ cānuvāsanam | saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā niculo vacā
verses.tib: khrag dang khu ba'i nad sel byed / bu skyed par yang byed pa yin / rgyam tsha ru rta po son cha / shu ti lcang ma shu dag dang

verses.skt: hrīveraṃ madhukaṃ bhārgī devadāru sakaṭphalam | nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medā cavikā citrakaḥ śaṭhī
verses.tib: ba le ka dang shing mngar dang / ga bra'i rtsa ba kad pha la / thang shing dong gra ma nu dang / me da dpyi mo tsi tra ka

verses.skt: viḍaṅgātiviṣe śyāmā hareṇur nīlinī sthirā | bilvājamodacapalā dantī rāsnā ca taiḥ samaiḥ
verses.tib: zur pa bong dbyi dang ga / sha ma dur byid ha re Nu / sti ra bil ba ni li ni / ti mu sa dang pi pi ling / dan da ra sna cha mnyam pa

verses.skt: sādhyam eraṇḍatailaṃ vā tailaṃ vā kapharoganut | vardhmodāvartagulmārśaḥplīhamehāḍhyamārutān
verses.tib: e raN+Da yi mar ram ni / til mar bskol ba'i 'jam rtsi yis / bad kan nad 'joms rgyu rlugs dang / rtug skam skran dang gzhang 'brum dang / mcher pa'i nad dang gcin snyi dang / rlung 'khyil ba dang lto sbos dang

verses.skt: ānāham aśmarīṃ cāśu hanyāt tad anuvāsanam | sādhitaṃ pañcamūlena tailaṃ bilvādināthavā
verses.tib: rde chags nad ni myur du sel / yang na bil ba la sogs pa'i / rtsa ba lnga pa til mar bskol

verses.skt: kaphaghnaṃ kalpayet tailaṃ dravyair vā kaphaghātibhiḥ | phalair aṣṭaguṇaiś cāmlaiḥ siddham anvāsanaṃ kaphe
verses.tib: yang na bad kan sel sman sbyar / til mar dang btang bad kan 'joms / yang na po son cha brgyad 'gyur / skyur bskol 'jam rtsis bad kan sel

verses.skt: mṛduvastijaḍībhūte tīkṣṇo ’nyo vastir iṣyate | tīkṣṇair vikarṣite snigdho madhuraḥ śiśiro mṛduḥ
verses.tib: 'jam rtsi 'jam pas / rmongs gyur la / rnon po nye bar sbyang bar bya / rno bas gnod la snum pa dang / mngar zhing bsil ba 'jam pa gtang

verses.skt: tīkṣṇatvaṃ mūtrapīlvagnilavaṇakṣārasarṣapaiḥ | prāptakālaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kṣīrājyādyais tu mārdavam
verses.tib: rnon po ba gcin pi lu dang / tsi tra ka dang lan tshwa dang / thal sman dang ni nyungs kar rnams / dus la bab par gtang bar bya / 'o ma mar 'jam po yis

verses.skt: balakālarogadoṣaprakṛtīḥ pravibhajya yojito vastiḥ | svaiḥ svair auṣadhavargaiḥ svān svān rogān nivartayati
verses.tib: nyams stobs dus dang nad gzhi rang bzhin dag / rnam par phye ste 'jam rtsi gtang bya ba / rang rang gi ni sman gyi sde tshan gyis / rang rang gi ni nang rnams bsal bar bya

verses.skt: uṣṇārtānāṃ śītāñ chītārtānāṃ tathā sukhoṣṇāṃś ca | tadyogyauṣadhayuktān vastīn saṃtarkya yuñjīta
verses.tib: tsha bas nyam thag la bsil ba / bsil bas nyen la dro 'jam sbyar / de dang 'tsham pa'i sman ldan par / 'jam rtsi brtags te gtang bar bya

verses.skt: vastīn na bṛṃhaṇīyān dadyād vyādhiṣu viśodhanīyeṣu | medasvino viśodhyā ye ca narāḥ kuṣṭhamehārtāḥ
verses.tib: sbyang bar bya ba'i nad rnams la / rtas byed 'jam rtsi mi gtang zhing / mi gang mdze gcin nad kyis nyen / tshil rgyas nad la gtang mi bya

verses.skt: na kṣīṇakṣatadurbalamūrchitakṛśaśuṣkaśuddhadehānām | dadyād viśodhanīyān doṣanibaddhāyuṣo ye ca
verses.tib: nyam chung glo 'grams pa dang brgyal ba dang / lus skem rid dang sbyangs pa'i lus can dang / gang yang dri mas tshe 'di gzung 'gyur la / sbyong bar byed pa'i mas gtong gtang mi bya

verses.skt: asnigdhasvinnadehasya gurukoṣṭhasya yojitaḥ | śīto ’lpasnehalavaṇadravyamātro ghano ’pi vā
verses.tib: snum chos dugs ni ma byas dang / lto lci ba la sman grang snum / tsha nyung sman tshad chung ba'am / sman ni ska ba btang gyur na

verses.skt: vastiḥ saṃkṣobhya taṃ doṣaṃ durbalatvād anirharan | karoty ayogaṃ tena syād vātamūtraśakṛdgrahaḥ
verses.tib: de yis nad ni bslangs gyur dang / stobs chung ba yi nad ma phyin / sbyor ba nyes pa skyed 'gyur zhing / 'phyen dang phyi sa gcin sri dang

verses.skt: nābhivastirujā dāho hṛllepaḥ śvayathur gude | kaṇḍūr gaṇḍāni vaivarṇyam aratir vahnimārdavam
verses.tib: lte ba chu so na zhing tsha / dang gar chags shing gzhang skrangs dang / g.yan pa'i thor bu mdog mi sdug / mi dga' me drod chung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kvāthadvayaṃ prāgvihitaṃ madhyadoṣe ’tisāriṇi | uṣṇasya tasmād ekasya tatra pānaṃ praśasyate
verses.tib: tshad 'khru'i nyes pa bar ma la / sngar bshad sman gyi khu ba gnyis / de las gcig ni dro ba yi / btung ba blugs pa bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: phalavartyas tathā svedāḥ kālaṃ jñātvā virecanam | bilvamūlatrivṛddāruyavakolakulatthavān
verses.tib: po son cha yi reng bu'i dugs / dus shes pa yis bkru sman gtang / bil ba'i rtsa ba dur byid dang / thang shing nas dang rgya shug dang

verses.skt: surādimūtravān vastiḥ saprākpeṣyas tam ānayet | yukto ’lpavīryo doṣāḍhye rūkṣe krūrāśaye ’thavā
verses.tib: rgya sran chang dang ba gcin bcas / mas gtong 'gags pa / sel bar byed / nad gzhi shas che lus rtsub dang / lto sra nus pa chung btang na

verses.skt: vastir doṣāvṛto ruddhamārgo rundhyāt samīraṇam | sa vimārgo ’nilaḥ kuryād ādhmānaṃ marmapīḍanam
verses.tib: mas gtong nad gzhi bslangs nas ni / rlung gi lam ni 'gag par byed / rlung ni lam log zhugs pa des / lto sbos nad rnams gzir bar byed

verses.skt: vidāhaṃ gudakoṣṭhasya muṣkavaṅkṣaṇavedanām | ruṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlair itaś cetaś ca dhāvati
verses.tib: gzhang dang lto ba tsha ba dang / rlig pa chu so na byed cing / snying gar 'gags pas gzer ba dang / phan tshun du ni 'gro bar byed

verses.skt: svabhyaktasvinnagātrasya tatra vartiṃ prayojayet | bilvādiś ca nirūhaḥ syāt pīlusarṣapamūtravān
verses.tib: de la lus bsku dugs byas pa'i / lus la reng bu gzhug par bya / bil ba sam bi lu dang / nyungs kar ba gcin bcas mas gtong

verses.skt: saralāmaradārubhyāṃ sādhitaṃ cānuvāsanam | kurvato vegasaṃrodhaṃ pīḍito vātimātrayā
verses.tib: tsi tra thang shing til mar ni / bskol ba'i 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya / shugs ni bkag par gyur pa'am / btsir drags par ni byas pa'am

verses.skt: asnigdhalavaṇoṣṇo vā vastir alpo ’lpabheṣajaḥ | mṛdur vā mārutenordhvaṃ vikṣipto mukhanāsikāt
verses.tib: lan tshwa snum shas chung la tsha / sman chung ba yis mas gtong ba / 'jam pas rlung gis gyen du 'phul / kha dang sna nas 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: nireti mūrchāhṛllāsatṛḍdāhādīn pravartayan | mūrchāvikāraṃ dṛṣṭvāsya siñcec chītāmbunā mukham
verses.tib: de yis brgyal dang snying nad dang / skom dang tsha ba la sogs 'byung / brgyal ba'i nad ni mthong gyur na / de yi gdod la chu grang gtor

verses.skt: vyajed āklamanāśāc ca prāṇāyāmaṃ ca kārayet | pṛṣṭhapārśvodaraṃ mṛjyāt karair uṣṇair adhomukham
verses.tib: ngal bsos bar du g.yab pa dang / dbugs rngub 'byung ba byed du gzhug / kha sbubs bzhag ste rgyab rtsib logs / lto ba lag pa dron pos mnye

verses.skt: keśeṣūtkṣipya dhunvīta bhīṣayed vyāladaṃṣṭribhiḥ | śastrolkārājapuruṣair vastir eti tathā hy adhaḥ
verses.tib: skra nas bteg ste sprugs pa dang / sbrul dang mche ba can 'jigs bstan / mtshon dang thog bab rgyal po'i mis / skrag bcas mas gtong thur du 'byung

verses.skt: pāṇivastrair galāpīḍaṃ kuryān na mriyate tathā | prāṇodānanirodhād dhi suprasiddhatarāyanaḥ
verses.tib: lag pa gos kyis mgul par bsdam / ci nas 'chi bar mi 'gyur bya / srog dang gyen rgyu rlung bkag pas / thur sel shin tu bder rgyu ba / grub pa yis ni mas gtong ba

verses.skt: apānaḥ pavano vastiṃ tam āśv evāpakarṣati | kuṣṭhakramukakalkaṃ ca pāyayetāmlasaṃyutam
verses.tib: myur du 'dren par byed pa yin / ru rta gla gor zho sha yi / lde gu skyur rtsabs sbyar te blud

verses.skt: auṣṇyāt taikṣṇyāt saratvāc ca vastiṃ so ’syānulomayet | gomūtreṇa trivṛtpathyākalkaṃ vādho'nulomanam
verses.tib: dro dang rno dang 'khru ba yis / mas gtong lugs bzhin 'byung bar byed / dur byid a ru ra ba gcin / sbyar blud lugs bzhin 'byung bar byed

verses.skt: pakvāśayasthite svinne nirūho dāśamūlikaḥ | yavakolakulatthaiś ca vidheyo mūtrasādhitaiḥ
verses.tib: zhu ba'i gnas 'dug dugs byas la / rtsa ba bcu pa rgya shug nas / rgya sran pa gcin bskol ba yi / mas gtong drag po sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: vastir gomūtrasiddhair vā sāmṛtāvaṃśapallavaiḥ | pūtikarañjatvakpattraśaṭhīdevāhvarohiṣaiḥ
verses.tib: sle tres / smyug ma'i lo ma dang / pu ti ka rany+dza'i shun pa / 'o ma zur pa thang shing dang / puti ka ni ba gcin bskol

verses.skt: satailaguḍasindhūttho virekauṣadhakalkavān | bilvādipañcamūlena siddho vastir uraḥsthite
verses.tib: til mar bu ram rgyam tshar bcas / bkru sman lde gur bcas pa gtang / mas gtong brang na gnas pa la / bil ba la sogs lnga bskol gtang

verses.skt: śiraḥsthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ | vastir atyuṣṇatīkṣṇāmlaghano ’tisveditasya vā
verses.tib: mgor gnas snar blugs dud pa rngub / nyungs kar lde gus mgo bo bsku / mas gtong drod ches rno skyur drags / ska ches dugs ni drags pa dang

verses.skt: alpe doṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe prayukto vā punaḥ punaḥ | atiyogatvam āpanno bhavet kukṣirujākaraḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi chung zhing lto snyi la / yang dang yang du gtong ba yi / sbyor ba drags pa nyes 'gyur bas / lto ba'i nad ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: virecanātiyogena sa tulyākṛtisādhanaḥ | vastiḥ kṣārāmlatīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇaḥ paittikasya vā
verses.tib: de la bkru sman drag sbyar bas / gso dang mtshungs pa nyid du bya / mas gtong thal sman skyur rno dro / lan tshwa can nam mkhris can la

verses.skt: gudaṃ dahan likhan kṣiṇvan karoty asya parisravam | sa vidagdhaṃ sravaty asraṃ varṇaiḥ pittaṃ ca bhūribhiḥ
verses.tib: gzhang tsha 'brud cing gnod pa dang / yongs su 'dzag par byed par 'gyur / khrag ni btsos pa lta bur 'byung / mkhris pa'ang mdog mang 'byung bar byed

verses.skt: bahuśaś cātivegena mohaṃ gacchati so ’sakṛt | raktapittātisāraghnī kriyā tatra praśasyate
verses.tib: lan mang shugs drag 'byung ba dang / yang dang yang du brgyal bar 'gyur / de la khrag mkhris 'khru ba sel / gso ba rab tu bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: dāhādiṣu trivṛtkalkaṃ mṛdvīkāvāriṇā pibet | tad dhi pittaśakṛdvātān hṛtvā dāhādikāñ jayet
verses.tib: tsha ba sogs la dur byid kyi / lde gu rgun chur sbyar ba blud / de yis bshang rlung mkhris pa ni / bsal nas tsha ba la sogs 'joms

verses.skt: viśuddhaś ca pibec chītāṃ yavāgūṃ śarkarāyutām | yuñjyād vātiviriktasya kṣīṇaviṭkasya bhojanam
verses.tib: dag gyur nas thug grang mo ni / khar dang ni bcas pa blud / 'khru ba drags par gyur pa yi / bshang ba zad la kha zas ni

verses.skt: māṣayūṣeṇa kulmāṣān pānaṃ dadhy athavā surām | siddhir vastyāpadām evaṃ snehavastes tu vakṣyate
verses.tib: ma sha'i khu ba zan dron sbyin / zho dang chang ni blud par bya / de ltar grub pa'i mas gtong nyes / bshad nas snum gyi mas gtong bshad

verses.skt: śīto ’lpo vādhike vāte pitte ’tyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ | atibhukte gurur varcaḥsaṃcaye ’lpabalas tathā
verses.tib: rlung can grang zhing chung ba dang / mkhris pa rab tsha bad kan 'jam / 'grangs ches pa la lci ba dang / bshang ba la stobs chung gtang / de ni snum rlung 'dres gyur zhing / zil gyis mnan pas 'byung mi 'gyur / rengs dang brla na sbos pa dang / rims dang gzer dang yan lag na

verses.skt: dattas tair āvṛtaḥ sneho nāyāty abhibhavād api | stambhorusadanādhmānajvaraśūlāṅgamardanaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung can grang zhing chung ba dang / mkhris pa rab tsha bad kan 'jam / 'grangs ches pa la lci ba dang / bshang ba la stobs chung gtang / de ni snum rlung 'dres gyur zhing / zil gyis mnan pas 'byung mi 'gyur / rengs dang brla na sbos pa dang / rims dang gzer dang yan lag na

verses.skt: pārśvarugveṣṭanair vidyād vāyunā sneham āvṛtam | snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇais taṃ rāsnāpītadrutailikaiḥ
verses.tib: rtsib logs na dang 'dar ba ni / snum rlung 'dres la 'byung zhes bya / de snum lan tshwa dro dang skyur / ra sna bi da dro yi mar

verses.skt: sauvīrakasurākolakulatthayavasādhitaiḥ | nirūhair nirharet samyak samūtraiḥ pāñcamūlikaiḥ
verses.tib: rang skyur chang dang rgya shug dang / rgya sran nas dang bskol / ba'am / rtsa ba lnga pa ba gcin bcas / mas gtong drag pos legs bsal bya

verses.skt: tābhyām eva ca tailābhyāṃ sāyaṃ bhukte ’nuvāsayet | tṛḍdāharāgasaṃmohavaivarṇyatamakajvaraiḥ
verses.tib: de dag nyid kyi til mar dang / dgongs kar zan zos 'jam rtsi gtang / skom dang lus tsha rmongs bag dmar

verses.skt: vidyāt pittāvṛtaṃ svādutiktais taṃ vastibhir haret | tandrāśītajvarālasyaprasekārucigauravaiḥ
verses.tib: mdog nyams rims 'debs mun par mthong / mkhris pa dang 'dres yin zhes bya / kha mngar mas gtong byas te sbyangs / lus snyom sgyid zhan rims drag 'debs

verses.skt: saṃmūrchāglānibhir vidyāc chleṣmaṇā sneham āvṛtam | kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaiḥ surāmūtropasādhitaiḥ
verses.tib: cham pa lus lci yi ga 'chus / brgyal bcas na bas bad kan dang / 'jam rtsi snum ni 'dres shes bya / de la bska dang kha dang tsha / chang dang ba gcin la bskol ba

verses.skt: phalatailayutaiḥ sāmlair vastibhis taṃ vinirharet | chardimūrchāruciglāniśūlanidrāṅgamardanaiḥ
verses.tib: po son cha dang til mar dang / skyur bcas mas gtong ba yis bsal / slon dang brgyal dang yi ga 'chus / snyom gzer gnyid che yan lag na

verses.skt: āmaliṅgaiḥ sadāhais taṃ vidyād atyaśanāvṛtam | kaṭūnāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca kvāthaiś cūrṇaiś ca pācanam
verses.tib: ma zhu'i mtshan mar lus tshar bcas / de ni 'grangs ches 'dres shes bya / de la tsha dang lan tshwa'i phye / bskol ba'i smin byed sman dang ni

verses.skt: mṛdur virekaḥ sarvaṃ ca tatrāmavihitaṃ hitam | viṇmūtrānilasaṅgārtigurutvādhmānahṛdgrahaiḥ
verses.tib: bkru sman 'jam po gtang ba dang / ma zhu la phan thams cad phan / gcin rtug 'phyen ni 'gags pas nyen / lus lci lto sbos snying ga na

verses.skt: snehaṃ viḍāvṛtaṃ jñātvā snehasvedaiḥ savartibhiḥ | śyāmābilvādisiddhaiś ca nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ
verses.tib: snum dang bshang 'dres yin zhes bya / de la snum dugs ring bur bcas / dur byid bil ba sogs bskol la / mas gtong drag dang 'jam rtsi gtang

verses.skt: nirhared vidhinā samyag udāvartahareṇa ca | abhukte śūnapāyau vā peyāmātrāśitasya vā
verses.tib: rtug pa 'gags pa sel bas kyang / cho ga bzhin du legs par bsal / rtog pa'am gzhang ni skrang pa'am / thug pa legs par 'thungs pa yis

verses.skt: gude praṇihitaḥ sneho vegād dhāvaty anāvṛtaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhād ūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya ety api
verses.tib: rkub tu snum ni btang gyur pa / sdod pa med par shugs kyis rgyu / de nas ro stod mgrin pa dang / stod kyi bu ga dag tu'ang 'byung

verses.skt: mūtraśyāmātrivṛtsiddho yavakolakulatthavān | tatsiddhatailo deyaḥ syān nirūhaḥ sānuvāsanaḥ
verses.tib: de la dur byid rgya shug nas / rgya sran ba gcin bskol ba dang / de dang bskol ba'i til mar ni / mas gtong 'jam rtsir bcas pa gtang

verses.skt: kaṇṭhād āgacchataḥ stambhakaṇṭhagrahavirecanaiḥ | chardighnībhiḥ kriyābhiś ca tasya kuryān nibarhaṇam
verses.tib: lkog mar byang ba dgag par bya / lkog ma bsdams shing skyug sman dang / slon bro sel ba'i gso bas kyang

verses.skt: nāpakvaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ gudaṃ sa hy upalimpati | tataḥ kuryāt saruṅmohakaṇḍūśophān kriyātra ca
verses.tib: bzlog pa dag ni de la bya / snum tshos ma gyur mi gtang ste / des ni gzhang khar chags 'gyur zhing / de las nad bcas rmongs bag dang / g.ya' dang skrang / pa skyed par byed

verses.skt: tīkṣṇo vastis tathā tailam arkapattrarase śṛtam | anucchvāsya tu baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā
verses.tib: de la mas gtong rnon po dang / arka'i lor bskol til mar gtang / dbugs ma phyung bar bcing pa'am / ma lus par ni btang ba yis

verses.skt: praviśya kṣubhito vāyuḥ śūlatodakaro bhavet | tatrābhyaṅgo gude svedo vātaghnāny aśanāni ca
verses.tib: rlung zhugs nas ni 'khrug byed cing / gzer dang na ba skyed par byed / de la gzhang kha bsku dugs bya / rlung 'joms pa yi kha zas gtang

verses.skt: drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā | syāt kaṭīgudajaṅghoruvastistambhārtibhedanam
verses.tib: myur du bcug cing phyung ba'am / glo bur du ni bteg pa yis / rked pa gzhang dang brla byin pa / chu so rengs shing na bar 'gyur

verses.skt: bhojanaṃ tatra vātaghnaṃ svedābhyaṅgāḥ savastayaḥ | pīḍyamāne ’ntarā mukte gude pratihato ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: de la rlung 'joms kha zas dang / dugs bsku 'jam rtsir bcas pa phan / btsir ba'i tshe na bar du grol / rlung gis gzhang la gnod gyur nas

verses.skt: uraḥśirorujaṃ sādam ūrvoś ca janayed balī | vastiḥ syāt tatra bilvādiphalaśyāmādimūtravān
verses.tib: brang dang mgo bo gzer zhing na / brla yi nad ni skyed par byed / de la bil ba la sogs dang / po son cha dang dur byid sogs / ba gcin dang ni sbyar ba gtang

verses.skt: atiprapīḍitaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhaty āyāti vā galam | tatra vastir virekaś ca galapīḍādi karma ca
verses.tib: btsir drags pa yis khong par ni / mi 'dug lkog ma 'byung bar 'gyur / de la mas gtong bkru sman dang / mgul pa bsdam sogs las rnams bya

verses.skt: vamanādyair viśuddhaṃ ca kṣāmadehabalānalam | yathāṇḍaṃ taruṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ tailapātraṃ yathā tathā
verses.tib: bkru sman sogs pas dag byas nas / lus dang nyams stobs me drod chung / sgo nga gzhon nu'am til mar ni / snod ni gang ba ji bzhin du

verses.skt: bhiṣak prayatnato rakṣet sarvasmād apacārataḥ | dadyān madhurahṛdyāni tato ’mlalavaṇau rasau
verses.tib: gnod par gyur pa thams cad las / sman pas 'bad de bsrung bar bya / kha zas mngar dang yid 'ong sbyin

verses.skt: svādutiktau tato bhūyaḥ kaṣāyakaṭukau tataḥ | anyo'nyapratyanīkānāṃ rasānāṃ snigdharūkṣayoḥ
verses.tib: de 'og skyur dang lan tshwar bcas / de nas mngar dang kha ba sbyin / de 'og bska dang tsha ba sbyin / ro ni snum dang rtsub pa dang / phan tshun gnyen por gyur pa bzhin

verses.skt: vyatyāsād upayogena kramāt taṃ prakṛtiṃ nayet | sarvaṃsahaḥ sthirabalo vijñeyaḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
verses.tib: rim pa nye bar sbyar ba yi / rim pa de ni rnal du dbab / kun bzod nyams stobs brtan pa ni / rnal mar gyur pa yin zhes bya

verses.skt: dhanve sādhāraṇe deśe same sanmṛttike śucau | śmaśānacaityāyatanaśvabhravalmīkavarjite
verses.tib: sa phyogs skam zhing cha mnyam pa'i / gzhi mnyam gtsang zhing sa gzhi bzang / dur khrod shing chen lha gnas dang / g.yang sa grog ma can ma gtogs

verses.skt: mṛdau pradakṣiṇajale kuśarohiṣasaṃstṛte | aphālakṛṣṭe ’nākrānte pādapair balavattaraiḥ
verses.tib: 'jam zhing chu ni g.yas na 'bab / 'jag ma dUr ba dang ldan pa / thong lcags kyis ni ma snad pa / ljon shing grib mas ma / phog pa

verses.skt: śasyate bheṣajaṃ jātaṃ yuktaṃ varṇarasādibhiḥ | jantvajagdhaṃ davādagdham avidagdhaṃ ca vaikṛtaiḥ
verses.tib: kha dog bcud la sogs dang ldan / sman skyes pa ni bsngags pa yin / 'bus ma zos shing mes ma tshig / 'byung ba sogs kyis gnod ma gyur

verses.skt: bhūtaiś chāyātapāmbvādyair yathākālaṃ ca sevitam | avagāḍhamahāmūlam udīcīṃ diśam āśritam
verses.tib: nyi grib chu la sogs ma nyen / ji bzhin dus su bsten gyur pa / rtsa ba che zhing gting du zug / byang gi phyogs su bsten pa bzang

verses.skt: mahendrarāmakṛṣṇānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ gavām api | tapasā tejasā vāpi praśāmyadhvaṃ śivāya vai
mantreṇānena matimān sarvam apy auṣadhaṃ nayet
atha kalyāṇacaritaḥ śrāddhaḥ śucir upoṣitaḥ | gṛhṇīyād auṣadhaṃ susthaṃ sthitaṃ kāle ca kalpayet
verses.tib: de nas dge ba la spyod cing / dad ldan gtsang sbra smyung ba byas / sman ni legs par gnas pa btu / 'o mar bcas pa dus su sbyar

verses.skt: sakṣīraṃ tad asaṃpattāv anatikrāntavatsaram | ṛte guḍaghṛtakṣaudradhānyakṛṣṇāviḍaṅgataḥ
verses.tib: bu ram mar dang sbrang rtsi dang / pi pi ling dang byi dang ga / 'bru rnams ma gtogs 'o ma med / lo gcig 'das par ma gyur sbyar

verses.skt: payo bāṣkayaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ tac ca nīrujām | vayobalavatāṃ dhātupicchaśṛṅgakhurādikam
verses.tib: 'o ma ba ni yar ma yi / gcin dang lci ba skon med yin / na tshod stobs ldan lus zungs dang / rwa 'dzugs rmig pa la sogs bzang

verses.skt: kaṣāyayonayaḥ pañca rasā lavaṇavarjitāḥ | rasaḥ kalkaḥ śṛtaḥ śītaḥ phāṇṭaś ceti prakalpanā
verses.tib: lan tshwa ma gtogs ro lnga'o / sman khu yi ni skye gnas yin / sman khu lde gu bskol dang grangs / phan dang zhes ni bya ba ste

verses.skt: pañcadhaiva kaṣāyāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ balādhikā | sadyaḥsamuddhṛtāt kṣuṇṇād yaḥ sravet paṭapīḍitāt
verses.tib: sman ni rnam pa lnga ru brtags / snga ma bzhin du mthu stobs che / 'phral du btus te brdungs nas ni / tshags la btsir te btsags pa gang

verses.skt: svarasaḥ sa samuddiṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ piṣṭo dravāplutaḥ | cūrṇo ’plutaḥ śṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ śīto rātriṃ drave sthitaḥ
verses.tib: de ni khu ba zhes bshad do / lde gu gsher gyis sbrus btags pa'o / de bskol ba ni bskol ba yin / bsgrangs pa mtshan mo gzhag pa yin

verses.skt: sadyo'bhiṣutapūtas tu phāṇṭas tanmānakalpane | yuñjyād vyādhyādibalatas tathā ca vacanaṃ muneḥ
verses.tib: khaN+Da 'phral du sbyar btsags pa / de dag gi ni tshad brtag pa / nad stobs las sbyar bar bya / de yang drang srong gis bshad pa

verses.skt: mātrāyā na vyavasthāsti vyādhiṃ koṣṭhaṃ balaṃ vayaḥ | ālocya deśakālau ca yojyā tadvac ca kalpanā
verses.tib: tshad kyi nges pa yod min gyi / nad dang lto tshad nyams dang ni / dus dang yul ni rnam brtags te / de ltar sman ni gtang bar bya

verses.skt: madhyaṃ tu mānaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ svarasasya catuḥpalam | peṣyasya karṣam āloḍyaṃ tad dravasya palatraye
verses.tib: sman gyi khu ba srang bzhi ni / 'bring tshad tsam du bshad pa yin / lde gu zho gnyis dag dang bsres / de ni chu srang gsum gyi tshad

verses.skt: kvāthaṃ dravyapale kuryāt prasthārdhaṃ pādaśeṣitam | śītaṃ pale palaiḥ ṣaḍbhiś caturbhis tu tato ’param
