verses.tib: bskol ba'i sman ni srang gcig bya / bre phyed chu bskol bzhi cha lus / bsgrangs pa srang gcig srang drug ni / de las gzhan pas srang bzhi yin

verses.skt: snehapāke tv amānoktau caturguṇavivardhitam | kalkasnehadravaṃ yojyam adhīte śaunakaḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: sman mar bskol tshad ma smos par / lde gu snum dang gsher rdzas ni / bzhi 'gyur du ni skyed de sbyar / shau na ka yis bshad pa ni

verses.skt: snehe sidhyati śuddhāmbuniḥkvāthasvarasaiḥ kramāt | kalkasya yojayed aṃśaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭham aṣṭamam
verses.tib: snum bskol chu ni 'ba' zhig dang / khu ba bskol pa rim bzhin du / lde gu'i cha ni bzhi dang drug / brgyad ni rim bzhin sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: pṛthak snehasamaṃ dadyāt pañcaprabhṛti tu dravam | nāṅgulīgrāhitā kalke na snehe ’gnau saśabdatā
verses.tib: lde gu sor mor ma 'byar dang / snum ni mer bcug sgra med dang

verses.skt: śuṣkadravyaṃ yadā na syāt tadā sadyaḥsamuddhṛtam | dviguṇaṃ tat prayoktavyaṃ kuḍavādi dravaṃ tathā
varṇādisaṃpac ca yadā tadainaṃ śīghram āharet | ghṛtasya phenopaśamas tailasya tu tadudbhavaḥ
verses.tib: gang tshe kha dog sogs phun tshogs / de tshe der ni myur du dbab / mar ni lbu ba dngas ma dang / til mar lbu ba byung ba dang / lde gu nal nal por 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: lehasya tantumattāpsu majjanaṃ saraṇaṃ na ca | pākas tu trividho mandaś cikkaṇaḥ kharacikkaṇaḥ
verses.tib: chu nang 'bying zhing gyes mi 'gyur / tshos pa'i tshad ni rnam gsum ste / 'jam tshos 'byar bag 'byar la rtsub

verses.skt: mandaḥ kalkasame kiṭṭe cikkaṇo madanopame | kiñcit sīdati kṛṣṇe ca vartyamāne ca paścimaḥ
verses.tib: 'jam tshos tshig ma lde gu 'dra / 'byar bag sbrang rtsi lta bu yin / cung zad tshig cing mdog gnag par / snang 'gyur de ni tha ma yin

verses.skt: dagdho ’ta ūrdhvaṃ niṣkāryaḥ syād āmas tv agnisādakṛt | mṛdur nasye kharo ’bhyaṅge pāne vastau ca cikkaṇaḥ
verses.tib: de las 'das par don mi byed / mtshos me drod nyams par byed / 'jam tshos snar btang rtsub pas bsku / btung dang 'jam rtsi 'byar bag bya

verses.skt: śāṇaṃ pāṇitalaṃ muṣṭiṃ kuḍavaṃ prastham āḍhakam | droṇaṃ vahaṃ ca kramaśo vijānīyāc caturguṇam
verses.tib: sha na kar sha lag mthil dang / spar gang phul bre a da ka / dro na ba ha rim bzhin du / bzhi 'gyur yin par shes par bya

verses.skt: dviguṇaṃ yojayed ārdraṃ kuḍavādi tathā dravam | peṣaṇāloḍane vāri snehapāke ca nirdrave
verses.tib: rlon pa nyis 'gyur sbyar bya zhing / gsher pa phul gang de bzhin / btags te sbrus nas gsher med pa'i / snum bskol ba la chu gzhug bya / gang du tshad ni ma bshad pa / der ni cha mnyam sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: kalpayet sadṛśān bhāgān pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam | kalkīkuryāc ca bhaiṣajyam anirūpitakalpanam
verses.tib: rlon pa nyis 'gyur sbyar bya zhing / gsher pa phul gang de bzhin / btags te sbrus nas gsher med pa'i / snum bskol ba la chu gzhug bya / gang du tshad ni ma bshad pa / der ni cha mnyam sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: aṅgānuktau tu mūlaṃ syād aprasiddhau tad eva tu | dvau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolaṃ badaraṃ draṅkṣaṇaś ca tau
ṣaḍ vaṃśyas tu marīciḥ syāt ṣaṇ marīcyas tu sarṣapaḥ | taṇḍulaḥ sarṣapās tv aṣṭau dhānyamāṣas tu tau yavaḥ
tāv aṇḍikā caturbhis tair māṣakaḥ śāṇakas tathā
verses.tib: sha na gnyis la ba da ka / de gnyis kar sha go la dang

verses.skt: akṣaṃ picuḥ pāṇitalaṃ suvarṇaṃ kavaḍagrahaḥ | karṣo biḍālapadakaṃ tindukaḥ pāṇimānikā
verses.tib: ba ru ra dang drang 'khru med / a k+Sha bi tsu su par+Na / lag mthil kham tshad byi la'i sder / tin du ka dang lag pa'i tshad

verses.skt: śabdānyatvam abhinne ’rthe śuktir aṣṭamikā picū | palaṃ prakuñco bilvaṃ ca muṣṭir āmraṃ caturthikā
verses.tib: sgra gzhan don ni gcig pa yin / shu ti brgyad pa pi tsu yin / srang gcig bil ba pra kun dza / sbar gang a mra bzhi po yin

verses.skt: dve pale prasṛtas tau dvāv añjalis tau tu mānikā | āḍhakaṃ bhājanaṃ kaṃso droṇaḥ kumbho ghaṭo ’rmaṇam
verses.tib: srang gnyis khyor gang de gnyis la / snyim gang de gnyis ma ni ka / a da ka dang snod ka nas / dro na kum pa bum chen yin

verses.skt: tulā palaśataṃ tāni viṃśatir bhāra ucyate | himavadvindhyaśailābhyāṃ prāyo vyāptā vasundharā
verses.tib: tu la srang ni brgya yin te / de nyi shu la khur du bshad / gangs can 'bigs byed ri yis ni / sa gzhi phal cher khyab pa yin

verses.skt: saumyaṃ pathyaṃ ca tatrādyam āgneyaṃ vaindhyam auṣadham
verses.tib: de las dang por bsil zhing phan / 'bigs byed sman ni me'i rang bzhin

verses.skt: jātamātraṃ viśodhyolbād bālaṃ saindhavasarpiṣā | prasūtikleśitaṃ cānu balātailena secayet
verses.tib: byis pa btsas ma thag phru ma / bsal te rgyam tsha mar bskus sbyang / de 'og btsas pas sdug bsngal la / ba la'i til mar blugs par bya

verses.skt: aśmanor vādanaṃ cāsya karṇamūle samācaret | athāsya dakṣiṇe karṇe mantram uccārayed imam
verses.tib: de yi rna ba'i drung du ni / rdo gnyis brdungs par spyad par bya / de nas de yi rna ba ni / g.yas par sngags 'di brjod par bya

verses.skt: aṅgād aṅgāt saṃbhavasi hṛdayād abhijāyase | ātmā vai putranāmāsi saṃjīva śaradāṃ śatam
verses.tib: yan lag yan lag las byung khyod / snying las mngon par bskyed pa yin / bdag nyid bu zhes bya ba khyod / lo brgyar yang dag 'tsho 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: śatāyuḥ śatavarṣo ’si dīrgham āyur avāpnuhi | nakṣatrāṇi diśo rātrir ahaś ca tvābhirakṣatu
verses.tib: lo brgya thub cing ston brgya 'tsho / tshe ring por ni thob gyur cig / rgyu skar phyogs dang mtshan mo dang / nyin mos khyod ni bsrung bar shog

verses.skt: svasthībhūtasya nābhiṃ ca sūtreṇa caturaṅgulāt | baddhvordhvaṃ vardhayitvā ca grīvāyām avasañjayet
verses.tib: bde bar gyur na lte ba ni / sor bzhi'i 'og tu srad bus bcing / de yi 'og tu bcad nas ni / lte ba la ni brtod de bzhag

verses.skt: nābhiṃ ca kuṣṭhatailena secayet snāpayed anu | kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa sarvagandhodakena vā
verses.tib: de 'og lte bar ru rta yi / til mar gyis ni bsku bar bya / 'o ma can shing bskol chu'am / dri zhim bcud ldan chu dag ni

verses.skt: koṣṇena taptarajatatapanīyanimajjanaiḥ | tato dakṣiṇatarjanyā tālūnnamyāvaguṇṭhayet
verses.tib: gser ram dngul ni bsregs pa yis / bsros pa'i dro 'jam chu yis bkru / de nas mdzub mo g.yas pa ni / dkris pas rkan ni bteg nas kyang

verses.skt: śirasi snehapicunā prāśyaṃ cāsya prayojayet | hareṇumātraṃ medhāyurbalārtham abhimantritam
verses.tib: mgo bor ras bal snum can g.yogs / blo dang tshe dang stobs bskyed phyir / shu dag pra ma bi sha li

verses.skt: aindrībrāhmīvacāśaṅkhapuṣpīkalkaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu | cāmīkaravacābrāhmītāpyapathyā rajīkṛtāḥ
verses.tib: shang kha puSh+pa'i lde gu ni / mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa dag / sngags btab ha re Nu tsam sbyin / gser dang shu dag mu men dang / ma nu a ru ra'i phye ma

verses.skt: lihyān madhughṛtopetā hemadhātrīrajo ’thavā | garbhāmbhaḥ saindhavavatā sarpiṣā vāmayet tataḥ
verses.tib: gser dang skyu ru ra'i phye ma / sbrang rtsi mar bcas lde gu sbyin / de nas mngal chu rgyam tsha ni / mar dang bcas pa skyug tu gzhug

verses.skt: prājāpatyena vidhinā jātakarmāṇi kārayet | sirāṇāṃ hṛdayasthānāṃ vivṛtatvāt prasūtitaḥ
verses.tib: skye dgu'i bdag po cho ga yis / btsas pa'i cho ga byed du gzhug / snying la gnas pa'i rtsa rnams ni / btsas nas kha ni dbye ba'i phyir

verses.skt: tṛtīye ’hni caturthe vā strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate | prathame divase tasmāt trikālaṃ madhusarpiṣī
verses.tib: nyi ma gsum mam bzhi pa la / bud med kyi ni nu zho 'byung / de bas nyin zhag dang po la / dus gsum du ni sbrang rtsi mar

verses.skt: anantāmiśrite mantrapāvite prāśayec chiśum | dvitīye lakṣmaṇāsiddhaṃ tṛtīye ca ghṛtaṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: byi tsher ba dang sbyar ba la / sngags kyis btab ste byis par byin / gnyis pa dang ni gsum pa la / lak+Sh+mi dang bskol mar blud bya

verses.skt: prāṅniṣiddhastanasyāsya tatpāṇitalasaṃmitam | stanyānupānaṃ dvau kālau navanītaṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: de nas dang po'i nu zho ni / bkag pa de la mar sar ni / zho gnyis tsam gyi tshad sbyin zhing / nu zho dus gnyis blud par bya

verses.skt: mātur eva pibet stanyaṃ tad dhy alaṃ dehavṛddhaye | stanyadhātryāv ubhe kārye tadasaṃpadi vatsale
verses.tib: ma nyid kyi ni nu zho blud / de yis lus ni 'phel byed yin / de med ma ma shin tu byams

verses.skt: avyaṅge brahmacāriṇyau varṇaprakṛtitaḥ same | nīruje madhyavayasau jīvadvatse na lolupe
verses.tib: skyon med 'khrig pa spangs pa dang / rigs dang rang bzhin de dang mnyam / nad med na tshod dar la bab / bu ma shi shing brkam chags med

verses.skt: hitāhāravihāreṇa yatnād upacarec ca te | śukkrodhalaṅghanāyāsāḥ stanyanāśasya hetavaḥ
verses.tib: de gnyis zas dang spyod lam ni / phan pas 'bad de gso bar bya / mya ngan khro dang smyung ba dang / lus dub nu zho nyams pa'i rgyu

verses.skt: stanyasya sīdhuvarjyāni madyāny ānūpajā rasāḥ | kṣīraṃ kṣīriṇya oṣadhyaḥ śokādeś ca viparyayaḥ
verses.tib: bu ram chang ma gtogs chang dang / rlan can sha khu 'o ma dang / 'o ma can sman mya ngan / go bzlog nu zho'i rgyun yin no

verses.skt: viruddhāhārabhuktāyāḥ kṣudhitāyā vicetasaḥ | praduṣṭadhātor garbhiṇyāḥ stanyaṃ rogakaraṃ śiśoḥ
verses.tib: mi mthun zas ni zos pa dang / ltogs dang sems ni nyams pa dang / lus zungs gnod bcas sbrum ma yi / 'o ma byis pa'i nad skyed byed

verses.skt: stanyābhāve payaś chāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā tadguṇaṃ pibet | hrasvena pañcamūlena sthirābhyāṃ vā sitāyutam
verses.tib: nu zho med na ra'am ba'i / 'o ma bri ha ti sogs rtsa'am / stir gnyis bskol kha rar bcas / yon tan de ldan blud par bya

verses.skt: ṣaṣṭhīṃ niśāṃ viśeṣeṇa kṛtarakṣābalikriyāḥ | jāgṛyur bāndhavās tasya dadhataḥ paramāṃ mudam
verses.tib: drug pa'i mtshan mo khyad par du / bsrung dang gtor ma'i bya ba bya / de yi gnyen gyis mel tshe bya / shin tu dga' ba nyid kyang bya

verses.skt: daśame divase pūrṇe vidhibhiḥ svakulocitaiḥ | kārayet sūtikotthānaṃ nāma bālasya cārcitam
verses.tib: zhag bcu rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / rang rig 'tsham pa'i cho ga ni / byed du gzhug cing btsas ma bslang

verses.skt: bibhrato ’ṅgair manohvālarocanāgurucandanam | nakṣatradevatāyuktaṃ bāndhavaṃ vā samākṣaram
verses.tib: lus la ldong ros ba bla dang / gi waM tsan+dan a kar btags / rgyu skar lha 'am nye du las / dras pa'i yi ge mnyam pa yi

verses.skt: tataḥ prakṛtibhedoktarūpair āyuḥparīkṣaṇam | prāgudakśirasaḥ kuryād bālasya jñānavān bhiṣak
verses.tib: de nas rang bzhin dbye las bshad / gzugs kyi tshe ni yongs su brtag / mkhas pas byis pa'i mal stan ni / byang ngam shar du mgo bstan la

verses.skt: śucidhautopadhānāni nirvalīni mṛdūni ca | śayyāstaraṇavāsāṃsi rakṣoghnair dhūpitāni ca
verses.tib: sngas dang gos ni gtsang zhing bkrus / 'jam zhing gnyer ma med pa yi / gos la gdon ni 'joms byed pa'i / sman gyi dud pas bdug par bya

verses.skt: kāko viśastaḥ śastaś ca dhūpane trivṛtānvitaḥ | jīvatkhaḍgādiśṛṅgotthān sadā bālaḥ śubhān maṇīn
verses.tib: bya rog bsad pa snum gsum dang / bcas pa'i dud pas bdug par bsngags / bse ru la sogs gson po yi / rwar btags / nor bu bzang po spu

verses.skt: dhārayed auṣadhīḥ śreṣṭhāḥ brāhmyaindrījīvakādikāḥ | hastābhyāṃ grīvayā mūrdhnā viśeṣāt satataṃ vacām
verses.tib: bram+hi 'tsho byed in+p+ri sogs / sman ni bzang po gdags par bya / mchog tu rtag par shu ngag ni / lag gnyis mgul dang spyi bor gdags

verses.skt: āyurmedhāsmṛtisvāsthyakarīṃ rakṣo'bhirakṣiṇīm | ṣaṭsaptāṣṭamamāseṣu nīrujasya śubhe ’hani
verses.tib: des ni tshe dang yid gzhungs dran / bde ba skyed byed gdon las bsrung / zla ba bdun nam brgyad pa na / nad med nyin zhag shis pa la

verses.skt: karṇau himāgame vidhyed dhātryaṅkasthasya sāntvayan | prāg dakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣag vāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ
verses.tib: ma ma'i pang du spro bsrings la / dgun gyi dus su rna ba dbug / khye'u'i dang po g.yas pa dbug / bu mo'i g.yon pa dbug par bya / sman pas khab ni g.yas pas gzung

verses.skt: dakṣiṇena dadhat sūcīṃ pālīm anyena pāṇinā | madhyataḥ karṇapīṭhasya kiñcid gaṇḍāśrayaṃ prati
verses.tib: g.yon pas rna shal bzung nas ni / rna ba'i khyon gyi dbus las ni / mkhur tshos kyi ni phyogs dag tu / pags pa dag ni phug nas su

verses.skt: jarāyumātrapracchanne raviraśmyavabhāsite | ghṛtasya niścalaṃ samyag alaktakarasāṅkite
verses.tib: nyi ma'i 'od zer snang ba ru / mi 'gyur brtan por bzung nas ni / rgya skyegs kyi ni khu bas bsku

verses.skt: vidhyed daivakṛte cchidre sakṛd evarju lāghavāt | nordhvaṃ na pārśvato nādhaḥ sirās tatra hi saṃśritāḥ
verses.tib: dbus su rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i / bu ga drang por cig car dbug / de nas rtsa ni g.yas pa'i phyir / steng 'og ngos gnyis gtang mi bya

verses.skt: kālikāmarmarīraktās tadvyadhād rāgarugjvarāḥ | saśophadāhasaṃrambhamanyāstambhāpatānakāḥ
verses.tib: nag po gnad 'dra dmar po ste / rtsa de phug na dmar zhing na / skrang zhing tsha la sra ba dang / gnye'u rengs gzhan dbang can nad skyed

verses.skt: teṣāṃ yathāmayaṃ kuryād vibhajyāśu cikitsitam | sthāne vyadhān na rudhiraṃ na rugrāgādisaṃbhavaḥ
verses.tib: de rnams nad gzhi ji bzhin du / gso ba dag ni myur du bya / gnad du phug na khrag med cing / nad dang dmar sogs 'byung mi 'gyur

verses.skt: snehāktaṃ sūcyanusyūtaṃ sūtraṃ cānu nidhāpayet | āmatailena siñcec ca bahalāṃ tadvad ārayā
verses.tib: khab rjes skud pa snum can ni / rjes su gzhug pa nyid du byas / til mar rlon pas bsku ba dang / rgya cher de ni bskyed par bya

verses.skt: vidhyet pālīṃ hitabhujaḥ saṃcāryātha sthavīyasī | vartis tryahāt tato rūḍhaṃ vardhayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.tib: de 'og sdong bu sbom po gzhug / zhag gsum bzhag nas rma 'tshobs nas / rim gyis de ni bskyed par bya

verses.skt: athainaṃ jātadaśanaṃ krameṇāpanayet stanāt | pūrvoktaṃ yojayet kṣīram annaṃ ca laghu bṛṃhaṇam
verses.tib: de nas de yi so skyes nas / nu zho 'thung las rim gyis bzlog / sngar bshad 'o ma sbyin bya zhing / kha zas yang dang rtas byed byin

verses.skt: priyālamajjamadhukamadhulājasitopalaiḥ | apastanasya saṃyojyaḥ prīṇano modakaḥ śiśoḥ
verses.tib: nu zho spangs nas bi ya la'i / rkang dang shing mngar 'bras yos dang / ka ra dkar po la du sbyin / bil ba gzhon nu sug smel dang

verses.skt: dīpano bālabilvailāśarkarālājasaktubhiḥ | saṃgrāhī dhātakīpuṣpaśarkarālājatarpaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: kha ra 'bras yos drod skyed sbyin / 'khru gcod da ta ka'i me tog / kha ra 'bras yos skyo ma sbyin

verses.skt: rogāṃś cāsya jayet saumyair bheṣajair aviṣādakaiḥ | anyatrātyayikād vyādher virekaṃ sutarāṃ tyajet
verses.tib: gnod pa skyed par mi byed pa'i / sman gyis de yi nad bsal bya / shin tu drags / nad ma gtogs gzhan / rno sman bkru sman kun tu spangs

verses.skt: trāsayen nāvidheyaṃ taṃ trastaṃ gṛhṇanti hi grahāḥ | vastravātāt parasparśāt pālayel laṅghanāc ca tam
verses.tib: tshul min skrag par mi bya ste / skrag na gdon ni 'jug par 'gyur / gos kyi rlung dang gzhan reg dang / 'gom pa la ni de bsrung bya

verses.skt: brāhmīsiddhārthakavacāśārivākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ | sakaṇaiḥ sādhitaṃ pītaṃ vāṅmedhāsmṛtikṛd ghṛtam
verses.tib: bram+hi nyungs kar shu dag dang / rgyam tsha ru rta sha ri ba / pi pi ling bcas bskol ba yi / sman mar dran dang yid gzhungs skyed

verses.skt: āyuṣyaṃ pāpmarakṣoghnaṃ bhūtonmādanibarhaṇam | vacendulekhāmaṇḍūkīśaṅkhapuṣpīśatāvarīḥ
verses.tib: tshe 'phel gdon ni mi bzad 'joms / 'byung po smyo byed zlog par byed / so ma ra dza shu dag dang / sbal pa nye shing sle tres dang

verses.skt: brahmasomāmṛtābrāhmīḥ kalkīkṛtya palāṃśikāḥ | aṣṭāṅgaṃ vipacet sarpiḥ prasthaṃ kṣīracaturguṇam
verses.tib: shang ka puSh+pa bram+hi dang / pra ma so ma srang re ni / lde gu brgyad cha mar bre gang / 'o ma bzhi 'gyur nang du ni / bskol ba de blud dpal yon dang

verses.skt: tat pītaṃ dhanyam āyuṣyaṃ vāṅmedhāsmṛtibuddhikṛt | ajākṣīrābhayāvyoṣapāṭhogrāśigrusaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: tshe blo yid gzhungs dran pa skyed / ra yi 'o ma a ru ra / tsha ba gsum dang pa ta dang / shi kru shu dag lce myang tsha

verses.skt: siddhaṃ sārasvataṃ sarpir vāṅmedhāsmṛtivahnikṛt | vacāmṛtāśaṭhīpathyāśaṅkhinīvellanāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba'i sman mar dbyangs can de / tshig dang blo gros dran pa dang / ngag gsal me drod skyed par byed / shu dag sle tres a ru ra

verses.skt: apāmārgeṇa ca ghṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ pūrvavad guṇaiḥ | hema śvetavacā kuṣṭham arkapuṣpī sakāñcanā
verses.tib: nye shing ba dang shang gi ni / a pa marga bskol ba yi / sman mar yon tan snga mar mtshungs / shu dag dkar po ru rta gser / arga'i puSh+pa gser dang bcas

verses.skt: hema matsyākṣakaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kaiḍaryaḥ kanakaṃ vacā | catvāra ete pādoktāḥ prāśā madhughṛtaplutāḥ
verses.tib: lcags rkyags dang ni dung dang gser / ka rany+dza dang shu dag gser / rkang pa re res bshad pa bzhi / sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas lde gu

verses.skt: varṣaṃ līḍhā vapurmedhābalavarṇakarāḥ śubhāḥ | vacāyaṣṭyāhvasindhūtthapathyānāgaradīpyakaiḥ
verses.tib: lo gcig byin na lus dang blo / kha dog nyams stobs skyed par byed / shu dag shing mngar lce myang tsha / dong gra shu ti a ru ra

verses.skt: śudhyate vāg ghavirlīḍhaiḥ sakuṣṭhakaṇajīrakaiḥ
verses.tib: ru rta zur pa pi pi ling / mar bcas lde gu dag dag byed

verses.skt: trividhaḥ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhayavartanaḥ | svāsthyaṃ tābhyām aduṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ rogasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.tib: de nas byis pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o / 'o ma zas dang gnyi gas 'tsho / byis pa rnam pa gsum du bshad / de dag gnod med las bder 'gyur / gnod pa las ni nad rnams 'byung

verses.skt: yad adbhir ekatāṃ yāti na ca doṣair adhiṣṭhitam | tad viśuddhaṃ payo vātād duṣṭaṃ tu plavate ’mbhasi
verses.tib: gang zhig chu dang gcig tu 'dres / nyes pa yod pa ma yin te / 'o ma de ni skyon med yin / rlung gis gnod gyur chu steng 'phyo

verses.skt: kaṣāyaṃ phenilaṃ rūkṣaṃ varcomūtravibandhakṛt | pittād uṣṇāmlakaṭukaṃ pītarājy apsu dāhakṛt
verses.tib: bska zhing rtsub la lbu ba can / de yis bshang gci sri bar byed / mkhris las gnod gyur dro skyur tsha / ri mo ser snang des tsha skyed

verses.skt: kaphāt salavaṇaṃ sāndraṃ jale majjati picchilam | saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ saṃsargāt triliṅgaṃ sāṃnipātikam
verses.tib: bad kan gyis ska lan tshwar bcas / sbyin bag can la chu nang 'bying / ldan pa'i mtshan ma 'dren ma ste / 'das pa'i mtshan ma gsum dang ldan

verses.skt: yathāsvaliṅgāṃs tad vyādhīn janayaty upayojitam | śiśos tīkṣṇam abhīkṣṇaṃ ca rodanāl lakṣayed rujam
verses.tib: rang gi mtshan ma ci 'dra las / de 'thungs pas ni nad skyed 'gyur / byis pa rtag tu mi bzad par / ngu ba la ni nad shes bya

verses.skt: sa yaṃ spṛśed bhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanākṣamaḥ | tatra vidyād rujaṃ mūrdhni rujaṃ cākṣinimīlanāt
verses.tib: de ni phyogs gang shas cher 'dzin / gang du reg par mi bzod pa / de na nad yod shes par bya / mgo nad mig 'byed las shes bya

verses.skt: hṛdi jihvauṣṭhadaśanaśvāsamuṣṭinipīḍanaiḥ | koṣṭhe vibandhavamathustanadaṃśāntrakūjanaiḥ
verses.tib: snying nad lce mchu sos gnon dang / dbugs dang khu tshur bsdams shes bya / khong nad bshang gci sri dang slon / nu ma sos 'debs rgyu ma 'khrug

verses.skt: ādhmānapṛṣṭhanamanajaṭharonnamanair api | vastau guhye ca viṇmūtrasaṅgottrāsadigīkṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: lto sbo rgyab ni 'gugs dgye dang / lto 'gugs pas kyang shes par bya / chu so mtshan nad bshang gci sri / skrag cing phyogs lta las shes bya

verses.skt: atha dhātryāḥ kriyāṃ kuryād yathādoṣaṃ yathāmayam | tatra vātātmake stanye daśamūlaṃ tryahaṃ pibet
verses.tib: de nas ma ma nad gzhi dang / skyon ni ji bzhin gso bar bya / de la nu zho rlung can la / rtsa ba bcu bskol zhag gsum blud

verses.skt: athavāgnivacāpāṭhākaṭukākuṣṭhadīpyakam | sabhārgīdārusaralavṛścikālīkaṇoṣaṇam
verses.tib: yang na ru rta tsi tra ka / pa ta shu dag pu tse shel / ga bra'i rtsa ba la la phud / thang shing dang ni sa ra la / bri sh+tsi ka ni pi pi ling / na le sham ni bskol ba blud

verses.skt: tataḥ pibed anyatamaṃ vātavyādhiharaṃ ghṛtam | anu cācchasurām evaṃ snigdhāṃ mṛdu virecayet
verses.tib: de nas rlung nad 'joms pa yi / sman mar gang yang rung ba blud / de rjes chang gi dwangs ma blud / snum 'gyur bkru sman 'jam po gtang

verses.skt: vastikarma tataḥ kuryāt svedādīṃś cānilāpahān | rāsnājamodāsaraladevadārurajo'nvitam
verses.tib: de 'og 'jam rtsi'i las bya zhing / dugs sogs rlung nad 'joms pa bya / bil ba ra sna ti mu sa / thang shing sa ra la bcas phye

verses.skt: bālo lihyād ghṛtaṃ tair vā vipakvaṃ sasitopalam | pittaduṣṭe ’mṛtābhīrupaṭolīnimbacandanam
verses.tib: mar dang sbyar ba'i lde gu'am / de bskol kha ra dkar btab sbyin / mkhris pas gnod la sle tras dang / nye shing nim pa pa to la

verses.skt: dhātrī kumāraś ca pibet kvāthayitvā saśārivam | athavā triphalāmustabhūnimbakaṭurohiṇīḥ
verses.tib: tsan+dan sha ri ba bskol ba / ma ma dang ni byis par blud / yang na gla sgang 'bras bu gsum / rtsa mkhris pu tse shel blud bya

verses.skt: śārivādiṃ paṭolādiṃ padmakādiṃ tathā gaṇam | ghṛtāny ebhiś ca siddhāni pittaghnaṃ ca virecanam
verses.tib: thal tres la sogs shug pa sogs / pa to la sogs sde bskol blud / sman ni 'di bskol mar dang ni / mkhris pa sel ba'i bkru sman dang

verses.skt: śītāṃś cābhyaṅgalepādīn yuñjyāc chleṣmātmake punaḥ | yaṣṭyāhvasaindhavayutaṃ kumāraṃ pāyayed ghṛtam
verses.tib: bsil sman gyis bsku byug sogs bya / bad kan can gyi bdag nyid la / shing mngar / rgyam tsha bcas pa'am / rgyam tsha shing mngar pi pi ling / mar sbyar byis pa la blud bya

verses.skt: sindhūtthapippalīmad vā piṣṭaiḥ kṣaudrayutair atha | rāṭhapuṣpaiḥ stanau limpec chiśoś ca daśanacchadau
verses.tib: de nas po son cha'i me tog / btags pa sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi / lde gus nu ma byis pa'i mchu / bskus pa byin pa der slon gzhug

verses.skt: sukham evaṃ vamed bālaḥ tīkṣṇair dhātrīṃ tu vāmayet | athācaritasaṃsargī mustādiṃ kvathitaṃ pibet
verses.tib: ma ma rnon pos slon du gzhug / de nas shag sogs rim pas spyad / gla skang la sogs bskol ba blud

verses.skt: tadvat tagarapṛthvīkāsuradārukaliṅgakān | athavātiviṣāmustaṣaḍgranthāpañcakolakam
verses.tib: de bzhin go snyod rgya spos dang / thang shing dug mo nyung bskol blud / yang na gla sgang bong nga dkar / shu dag tsha ba lnga bskol blud

verses.skt: stanye tridoṣamaline durgandhy āmaṃ jalopamam | vibaddham acchaṃ vicchinnaṃ phenilaṃ copaveśyate
verses.tib: nu zho nyes gsum dri ma can / dri mnam 'khru zhing du dang 'dra / ma bre gang shing sla la rgyun bar chad / lbu ba can du 'khru bar 'gyur

verses.skt: śakṛn nānāvyathāvarṇaṃ mūtraṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ ghanam | jvarārocakatṛṭchardiśuṣkodgāravijṛmbhikāḥ
verses.tib: bshang ba kha dog sna tshogs 'byung / na zhing gcin ser dkar zhing ska / rims nad skom dad yi ga 'chus / sgregs pa skam po 'byung zhing glal

verses.skt: aṅgabhaṅgo ’ṅgavikṣepaḥ kūjanaṃ vepathur bhramaḥ | ghrāṇākṣimukhapākādyā jāyante ’nye ’pi taṃ gadam
verses.tib: lus na yan lag rkyong ba dang / mkhun zhing 'dar la mgo 'khor dang / sna mig kha ni shu ba sogs / nad ni gzhan dag de las 'byung

verses.skt: kṣīrālasakam ity āhur atyayaṃ cātidāruṇam | tatrāśu dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca vamanenopapādayet
verses.tib: 'o ma'i be+e snabs zhes bshad de / gnod pa'i nad ni mi bzad yin / de la ma ma byis pa la / slon sman btang bas myur du gso

verses.skt: vihitāyāṃ ca saṃsargyāṃ vacādiṃ yojayed gaṇam | niśādiṃ vāthavā mādrīpāṭhātiktāghanāmayān
verses.tib: thug sogs rim par bshad pa ni / shu dag la sogs sde tshan rnams / skyer pa pa'ang bong nga dkar / ba ta dang ni pi pi ling / gla sgang pu tse shel bskol blud

verses.skt: pāṭhāśuṇṭhyamṛtātiktatiktādevāhvaśārivāḥ | samustamūrvendrayavāḥ stanyadoṣaharāḥ param
verses.tib: pa tha bca' sga pu tse shel / sle tres rtsa mkhris sha ri ba / thang shing gla sgang mur ba dang / dug mo nyung bcas bskol ba blud / nu zho'i nyes pa sel ba'i mchog

verses.skt: anubandhe yathāvyādhi pratikurvīta kālavit | dantodbhedaś ca rogāṇāṃ sarveṣām api kāraṇam
verses.tib: rjes 'brel nad la ji bzhin du / dus shes pa yis gso bar bya / so 'byung ba dag nad rnams ni / thams cad kyi yang rgyu yin no

verses.skt: viśeṣāj jvaraviḍbhedakāsacchardiśirorujām | abhiṣyandasya pothakyā visarpasya ca jāyate
verses.tib: mchog tu rims dang 'khru ba dang / lud pa slon dang mgo nad dang / bang mig 'dzag pa'i nad dang ni / shu ba rnams ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: pṛṣṭhabhaṅge biḍālānāṃ barhiṇāṃ ca śikhodbhave | dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiñcin na dūyate
verses.tib: byi la'i sgal tshigs bye ba dang / rma bya'i gtsug ni 'byung ba dang / byis pa'i so ni skye ba na / mi na ba ni cung zad med

verses.skt: yathādoṣaṃ yathārogaṃ yathodrekaṃ yathābhayam | vibhajya deśakālādīṃs tatra yojyaṃ bhiṣagjitam
verses.tib: de la nad ni ji bzhin dang / nad stobs ji bzhin 'jigs ji bzhin / yul dang dus rnam phye ste / sman gyi / sbyor bas gso bar bya

verses.skt: ta eva doṣā dūṣyāś ca jvarādyā vyādhayaś ca yat | atas tad eva bhaiṣajyaṃ mātrā tv asya kanīyasī
verses.tib: gnod dang gnod bya de nyid dang / rims sogs nad kyang de nyid 'byung / de bas sman ni de nyid de

verses.skt: saukumāryālpakāyatvāt sarvānnānupasevanāt | snigdhā eva sadā bālā ghṛtakṣīraniṣevaṇāt
verses.tib: gzhon sha can dang lus chung phyir / zas kun sten par mi byed pas / 'di yi tshad ni chung ngu sbyin / mar dang 'o ma la brten pas / byis pa rtag par khong snum yin

verses.skt: sadyas tān vamanaṃ tasmāt pāyayen matimān mṛdu | stanyasya tṛptaṃ vamayet kṣīrakṣīrānnasevinam
verses.tib: de bas 'phral du skyug sman ni / 'jam po blo dang ldan pas blud / 'o ma 'o ma zas bsten la / nu zho ngoms par byas pas slon

verses.skt: pītavantaṃ tanuṃ peyām annādaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutām | vastiṃ sādhye virekeṇa marśena pratimarśanam
verses.tib: zas za ba la mar bcas pa'i / thug pa sla bar blud par bya / bkru sman gyis gso mas gtong dang / tshad chung tshad phran dag gis bya

verses.skt: yuñjyād virecanādīṃs tu dhātryā eva yathoditān | mūrvāvyoṣavarākolajambūtvagdārusarṣapāḥ
verses.tib: bkru sman la sogs ji skad bshad / ma ma nyid la gtang bar bya / mur ba rgya shug tsha ba gsum / 'bras bu gsum dang 'dzam bu'i shun

verses.skt: sapāṭhā madhunā līḍhāḥ stanyadoṣaharāḥ param | dantapālīṃ samadhunā cūrṇena pratisārayet
verses.tib: thang shing pa ta nyungs kar bcas / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu sbyin / nu zho'i nyes pa sel mchog yin

verses.skt: pippalyā dhātakīpuṣpadhātrīphalakṛtena vā | lāvatittirivallūrarajaḥ puṣparasadrutam
verses.tib: pi pi ling ngam skyu ru ra / da ta ka yi me tog gi / phye ma sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi / lde gus rnyil ni byug par bya

verses.skt: drutaṃ karoti bālānāṃ dantakesaravan mukham | vacādvibṛhatīpāṭhākaṭukātiviṣāghanaiḥ
verses.tib: 'ur bya sreg pa'i sha skam gyi / phye ma sbrang rtsis sbrus pa yis / byis pa'i so yi myu gu ni / myur du skyed par byed pa yin

verses.skt: madhuraiś ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ siddhaṃ daśanajanmani | rajanīdārusaralaśreyasībṛhatīdvayam
verses.tib: shu dag bri ha ti gnyis dang / pa ta gla sgang pu tse shel / bong nga mngar ba'i sman sde dag / bskol ba'i mar gyis so skyed grub

verses.skt: pṛśniparṇī śatāhvā ca līḍhaṃ mākṣikasarpiṣā | grahaṇīdīpanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mārutasyānulomanam
verses.tib: skyer pa thang shing sa ral / bri ha ti gnyis nye shing ba / kr-iSh+Na par+Ni shri ya se / sbrang rtsi mar sbyar lde gu ni / pho ba'i me drod skyed pa'i mchog / rlung ni bde bar rgyu bar byed

verses.skt: atīsārajvaraśvāsakāmalāpāṇḍukāsanut | bālasya sarvarogeṣu pūjitaṃ balavarṇadam
verses.tib: 'khru ba'i rims dang dbugs mi bde / mig ser skya rbab lung pa 'joms / byis pa'i nad ni thams cad la / phan zhing mdog dang nyams stobs skyed

verses.skt: samaṅgādhātakīlodhrakuṭannaṭabalādvayaiḥ | mahāsahākṣudrasahāmudgabilvaśalāṭubhiḥ
verses.tib: btsod dang seng phrom da ta ki / ku ta nan ta ba la gnyis / sa ha che chung gnyis dang ni / mung+ga bil ba gzhon nu gnyis

verses.skt: sakārpāsīphalais toye sādhitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam | kṣīramastuyutaṃ hanti śīghraṃ dantodbhavodbhavān
verses.tib: ras bal sa bon bcas pa dag / chu bskol ba dang mar dang ni / thal sman zho ga chur bskol bas / so skyes las byung sna tshogs nad / 'di yis myur du 'joms byed de

verses.skt: vividhān āmayān etad vṛddhakāśyapanirmitam | dantodbhaveṣu rogeṣu na bālam atiyantrayet
verses.tib: 'od srungs rgad pos bshad pa yin / byis pa'i so skyes nad la ni / sngags kyis / mngon par gdab mi bya / so skyes pa yi nad gang yin

verses.skt: svayam apy upaśāmyanti jātadantasya yadgadāḥ | atyahaḥsvapnaśītāmbuślaiṣmikastanyasevinaḥ
verses.tib: gso bas rang nyid nyer zhir 'gyur / nyin par gnyid drags chu grang dang / nu zho bad kan can bsten pas

verses.skt: śiśoḥ kaphena ruddheṣu srotaḥsu rasavāhiṣu | arocakaḥ pratiśyāyo jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate
verses.tib: byis pa'i dngas ma rgyu ba yi / rtsa rgyun bad kan gyis bkag pa'i / yi ga 'chus dang cham pa dang

verses.skt: kumāraḥ śuṣyati tataḥ snigdhaśuklamukhekṣaṇaḥ | saindhavavyoṣaśārṅgaṣṭāpāṭhāgirikadambakān
verses.tib: de nas byis pa lus skams shing / mdog snum mig ni dkar bar 'gyur / rgyam tsha tsha gsum sha rang ga / ba ta ko ri ka tam pa

verses.skt: śuṣyato madhusarpirbhyām arucyādiṣu yojayet | aśokarohiṇīyuktaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca cūrṇitam
verses.tib: mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar skams dang / yi ga 'chus pa sogs la gtang / pu tse shel dang a sho ka / tsha ba lnga bcas phye ma pan

verses.skt: badarīdhātakīdhātrīcūrṇaṃ vā sarpiṣā drutam | sthirāvacādvibṛhatīkākolīpippalīnataiḥ
verses.tib: da ta ki dang skyu ru ra / rgya shug phye ma mar bcas phan / sA la par+Ni shu dag dang / bri ha ti gnyis ram nye ba / pi pi ling dang rgya spos dang

verses.skt: niculotpalavarṣābhūbhārgīmustaiś ca kārṣikaiḥ | siddhaṃ prasthārdham ājyasya srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ param
verses.tib: lcang ma ut+pal ba spru ba / ga bra'i rtsa ba gla sgang rnams / srang re yi ni tshad byas nas / mar ni bre gang bcas bskol ba / rtsa rgyun sbyong ba'i dam pa yin

verses.skt: siṃhyaśvagandhāsurasākaṇāgarbhaṃ ca tadguṇam | yaṣṭyāhvapippalīlodhrapadmakotpalacandanaiḥ
verses.tib: a shwa gan+d+ha bye'u rug pa / bri ha ti dang pi pi ling / bskol ba'ang yon tan de dang 'dra / shing mngar seng phrom pi pi ling / shug pa tsan+dan ut+pa la

verses.skt: tālīśaśārivābhyāṃ ca sādhitaṃ śoṣajid ghṛtam | śṛṅgīmadhūlikābhārgīpippalīdevadārubhiḥ
verses.tib: bal bu'i lo ma sha ri ba / bskol ba'i mar gyis skems pa yi / nad ni 'joms par byed pa yin / shring gi ma du lung ga dang / ga bra'i rtsa ba pi pi ling

verses.skt: aśvagandhādvikākolīrāsnarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ | śūrpaparṇīviḍaṅgaiś ca kalkitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: thang shing a shwa gan+d+ha dang / ra mnye ba gnyis ra sna dang / zangs rtsi ba dang dzi ba ka / ma sha mung+ga par+Ni dang / byi dang ga ni lde gur bcas / ri bong mgo bskol khu ba dang / bskol ba'i mar ni blud gyur na

verses.skt: śaśottamāṅganiryūhe śuṣyataḥ puṣṭikṛt param | vacāvayaḥsthātagarakāyasthācorakaiḥ śṛtam
verses.tib: lus skems rgyas par byed pa'i mchog / shu dag sle tres ka yas+tha / spang spos tsa rong ra thug gcin / chang bskol til mar bskus pa phan / rgya skyegs khu ba cha mnyam dang / til mar bre gang zho ga chu / bzhi 'gyur a shwa gan+d+ha dang

verses.skt: bastamūtrasurābhyāṃ ca tailam abhyañjane hitam | lākṣārasasamaṃ tailaprasthaṃ mastu caturguṇam
verses.tib: lus skems rgyas par byed pa'i mchog / shu dag sle tres ka yas+tha / spang spos tsa rong ra thug gcin / chang bskol til mar bskus pa phan / rgya skyegs khu ba cha mnyam dang / til mar bre gang zho ga chu / bzhi 'gyur a shwa gan+d+ha dang

verses.skt: aśvagandhāniśādārukauntīkuṣṭhābdacandanaiḥ | samūrvārohiṇīrāsnāśatāhvāmadhukaiḥ samaiḥ
verses.tib: skyer pa thang shing ru rta dang / ha re Nu ka ba li ka / tsan+dan mur ba pu tse shel / ra sna nye shing shing mngar mnyam

verses.skt: siddhaṃ lākṣādikaṃ nāma tailam abhyañjanād idam | balyaṃ jvarakṣayonmādaśvāsāpasmāravātanut
verses.tib: bskol ba'i til mar rgya skyegs sogs / zhes bya bskus na phan par 'gyur / stobs skyed rims dang zad byed dang / smyo byed brjed byed dbugs mi bde / rlung gi nad rnams sel bar / byed

verses.skt: yakṣarākṣasabhūtaghnaṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca śasyate | madhunātiviṣāśṛṅgīpippalīr lehayec chiśum
verses.tib: gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po 'joms / sbrum ma la yang bsngags pa yin / bong nga kar ka ta sring gi / pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir sbyar / lde gu byis pa la sbyin pa

verses.skt: ekāṃ vātiviṣāṃ kāsajvaracchardirupadrutam | pītaṃ pītaṃ vamati yaḥ stanyaṃ taṃ madhusarpiṣā
verses.tib: bong nga dkar po gcig po yis / lde gus lud pa rims slon bro / bla brnan gyi ni nad sel byed / nu zho 'thung zhing slon pa la / de la zhun mar sbrang rtsi dang

verses.skt: dvivārtākīphalarasaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca lehayet | pippalīpañcalavaṇaṃ kṛmijitpāribhadrakam
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri bri ha ti / 'bras bu'i khu ba tsha ba lnga / sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin par bya / pi pi ling dang lan tshwa lnga

verses.skt: tadval lihyāt tathā vyoṣaṃ maṣīṃ vā romacarmaṇām | lābhataḥ śalyakaśvāvidgodharkṣaśikhijanmanām
verses.tib: ba ri bar byi dang ga / de bzhin lde gur sbyar ba sbyin / de bzhin tsha ba gsum reg 'jam / sha ri da ta rma bya sram / ji snyed pags pa spu bsregs la

verses.skt: khadirārjunatālīśakuṣṭhacandanaje rase | sakṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ sarpir vamathuṃ viniyacchati
verses.tib: snag tsha sbrang rtsi mar sbyar phan / seng ldeng bal bu ardzun / ru rta pan ta na yi khu / 'o ma mar dang bcas bskol bas / slon bro nye bar sel bar byed

verses.skt: hanumūlagato vāyur dantadeśāsthigocaraḥ | yadā śiśoḥ prakupito nottiṣṭhanti tadā dvijāḥ
rūkṣāśino vātikasya cālayaty anilaḥ sirāḥ | hanvāśrayāḥ prasuptasya dantaiḥ śabdaṃ karoty ataḥ
sadanto jāyate yas tu dantāḥ prāg yasya cottarāḥ | kurvīta tasminn utpāte śāntiṃ taṃ ca dvijātaye
verses.tib: gang gi so dang bcas skyes dang / gang gi dang por ya so skyes / bkra mi shis pa de la ni / zhi ba bya zhing bram ze la

verses.skt: dadyāt sadakṣiṇaṃ bālaṃ naigameṣaṃ ca pūjayet | tālumāṃse kaphaḥ kruddhaḥ kurute tālukaṇṭakam
verses.tib: yon dang bcas par sbyin par bya / de bzhin skem byed mchod par bya / bad kan 'khrugs pas rkan gyi shar / rkan gyi 'dzer pa zhes bya ste

verses.skt: tena tālupradeśasya nimnatā mūrdhni jāyate | tālupātaḥ stanadveṣaḥ kṛcchrāt pānaṃ śakṛddravam
verses.tib: des na rkan gyi phyogs kyi ni / spyi bo dma' ba 'byung bar 'gyur / rkan lhung nu zho 'gras pa dang / ska ba 'thung zhing bshang ba sla

verses.skt: tṛḍāsyakaṇḍvakṣirujā grīvādurdharatā vamiḥ | tatrotkṣipya yavakṣārakṣaudrābhyāṃ pratisārayet
verses.tib: skom dang kha g.ya' mig na zhing / gnya' ba 'degs dka' slon par 'gyur / de la rkan 'degs nas tshig 'khus / thal ba sbrang rtsir sbyar ba bsku

verses.skt: tālu tadvat kaṇāśuṇṭhīgośakṛdrasasaindhavaiḥ | śṛṅgaveraniśābhṛṅgaṃ kalkitaṃ vaṭapallavaiḥ
verses.tib: yang na bca' sga pi pi ling / ba lang gcin khu rgyam tsha bsku / dong gra skyer pa shing tsha yi / lde gu n+ya go d+ha'i lo mar

verses.skt: baddhvā gośakṛtā liptam kukūle svedayet tataḥ | rasena limpet tālvāsyaṃ netre ca pariṣecayet
verses.tib: gtums la ba lang lci bas byug / de rjes me mar myur du bsreg / khu bas rkan dang kha bsku zhing / mig tu yang ni blugs par bya

verses.skt: harītakīvacākuṣṭhakalkaṃ mākṣikasaṃyutam | pītvā kumāraḥ stanyena mucyate tālukaṇṭakāt
verses.tib: ru rta shu dag a ru ra / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu ni / nu zhor bcas pa byis pa blud / rkan gyi 'dzer pa las thar 'gyur

verses.skt: malopalepāt svedād vā gude raktakaphodbhavaḥ | tāmro vraṇo ’ntaḥ kaṇḍūmān jāyate bhūryupadravaḥ
verses.tib: dri mas gos sam rdul ba las / gzhang khar bad kan khrag las 'byung / rma ni nang dmar g.ya' ba dang / bla brnan mang po 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kecit taṃ mātṛkādoṣaṃ vadanty anye ’hipūtanam | pṛṣṭhārur gudakuṭṭaṃ ca kecic ca tam anāmikam
verses.tib: la las ma mo'i nyes par bshad / gzhan / dag lus srul pos byas zer / rgyab kyi thor bu gzhang sdebs zer / la las de ming med ces bshad

verses.skt: tatra dhātryāḥ payaḥ śodhyaṃ pittaśleṣmaharauṣadhaiḥ | śṛtaśītaṃ ca śītāmbuyuktam antarapānakam
verses.tib: de la ma ma bad mkhris dag / sel ba'i sman gyis nu zho sbyar / tsan+dan dkar chu bsil ba dang / ldan pa'i skom ni nang nas blud

verses.skt: sakṣaudratārkṣyaśailena vraṇaṃ tena ca lepayet | triphalābadarīplakṣatvakkvāthapariṣecitam
verses.tib: de dang skyer pa'i khaN+Da ni / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i rma bsku bya / rgya shug 'bras bu gsum blag sha'i / shun pa bskol ba'i chu blugs bya

verses.skt: kāsīsarocanātutthamanohvālarasāñjanaiḥ | lepayed amlapiṣṭair vā cūrṇitair vāvacūrṇayet
verses.tib: nag chur gi wang spangs ma dang / dngul rdo ba bla ldong ros ni / skyur dang btags pas bsku bya zhing

verses.skt: suślakṣṇair athavā yaṣṭīśaṅkhasauvīrakāñjanaiḥ | śārivāśaṅkhanābhibhyām asanasya tvacāthavā
verses.tib: yang na shing mngar skyer khaN dang / dung ni zhib tu btags pa'am / dung gi lte ba sha ri ba'am / a sa na yi shun pa ni / phye ma btags pa gdab par bya

verses.skt: rāgakaṇḍūtkaṭe kuryād raktasrāvaṃ jalaukasā | sarvaṃ ca pittavraṇajic chasyate gudakuṭṭake
verses.tib: dmar zhing g.ya' ba'i shas che la / srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung bya / gzhang sdebs nad la mkhris pa yi / rma la phan pa thams cad bsngags

verses.skt: pāṭhāvelladvirajanīmustabhārgīpunarnavaiḥ | sabilvatryūṣaṇaiḥ sarpiḥ vṛścikālīyutaiḥ śṛtam
verses.tib: pa ta gla sgang ser po gnyis / ga bra'i rtsa ba byi dong ga / pur+Na rna ba bil bar bcas / brish+tsi ka li tsha ba gsum / mar bcas bskol ba tshad tsam bldags

verses.skt: lihāno mātrayā rogair mucyate mṛttikodbhavaiḥ | vyādher yady asya bhaiṣajyaṃ stanas tena pralepitaḥ | sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto ’nu pītas taṃ taṃ jayed gadam
verses.tib: sa zos nad las thar bar 'gyur / nad ni gang gi sman gang yin / de yis nu ma bskus nas ni / yud tsam 'dug la de rjes bkru / blud na nad ni de des sel

verses.skt: purā guhasya rakṣārthaṃ nirmitāḥ śūlapāṇinā | manuṣyavigrahāḥ pañca sapta strīvigrahā grahāḥ
verses.tib: sngon gyi skem byed bsrung ba'i phyir / gdon ni skyes pa'i gzugs can lnga / bud med kyi ni gzugs can bdun / lha chen po yi sprul pa yin

verses.skt: skando viśākho meṣākhyaḥ śvagrahaḥ pitṛsaṃjñitaḥ | śakuniḥ pūtanā śītapūtanādṛṣṭipūtanā
verses.tib: skem byed sa ga lug thug gdong / khyi gdong yi dwags zhes bya dang / bya gdon srul mo grang ba yi / srul mo long ma lus srul po

verses.skt: mukhamaṇḍitikā tadvad revatī śuṣkarevatī | teṣāṃ grahīṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin bzhin gyi rgyan can ma / nam gru nam gru skem ma'o / de rnams kyis ni bzung ba'i tshul / rtag tu ngu dang rims kyis 'debs

verses.skt: sāmānyaṃ rūpam uttrāsajṛmbhābhrūkṣepadīnatāḥ | phenasrāvordhvadṛṣṭyoṣṭhadantadaṃśaprajāgarāḥ
verses.tib: spyi'i tshul skrag dang glal ba dang / smin ma 'degs shing rmya ba dang / lbu ba slon zhing gyen du blta / ma mchu sos 'debs gnyid yar dang

verses.skt: rodanaṃ kūjanaṃ stanyavidveṣaḥ svaravaikṛtam | nakhair akasmāt paritaḥ svadhātryaṅgavilekhanam
verses.tib: ngu / zhing mkhun la nu zho la / mi dga' skad ni 'gyur ba dang / glo bur du ni sen mo yis / rang gi ma ma'i yan lag 'brad

verses.skt: tatraikanayanasrāvī śiro vikṣipate muhuḥ | hataikapakṣaḥ stabdhāṅgaḥ sasvedo natakandharaḥ
verses.tib: de la skem byed kyis zin rtags / mig gcig mchi ma 'dzag pa dang / yang dang yang du mgo bo rdegs / phyogs gcig nyams shing lus rengs la

verses.skt: dantakhādī stanadveṣī trasyan roditi visvaram | vakravaktro vaman lālāṃ bhṛśam ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate
verses.tib: rdul bcas skye ba rengs pa dang / so 'cha' nu zho la mi dga' / sngangs shing ngu la skad gsang nyams / kha yo kha chu skyugs pa dang / mi bzad par ni gyen du blta

verses.skt: vasāsṛggandhir udvigno baddhamuṣṭiśakṛc chiśuḥ | calitaikākṣigaṇḍabhrūḥ saṃraktobhayalocanaḥ
verses.tib: tshil khrag dri bro yid mi dga' / bshang ba khu tshur la bcang zhing / mkhur tshos mig dang smin ma gcig / g.yo zhing mig ni gnyi ga dmar

verses.skt: skandārtas tena vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā bhaved dhruvam | saṃjñānāśo muhuḥ keśaluñcanaṃ kandharānatiḥ
verses.tib: des ni yan lag nyes nyams pa'am / 'chi ba kho nar byed par 'gyur / skem byed brjed byed mtshan ma ni / dran pa nyams shing yang dang yang / skra 'bal rke ba 'gugs pa dang

verses.skt: vinamya jṛmbhamāṇasya śakṛnmūtrapravartanam | phenodvamanam ūrdhvekṣā hastabhrūpādanartanam
verses.tib: rnam par 'dud cing glal bzhin du / bshang dang gci ba 'byin par byed / lbu bar skyug cing gyen du lta / rkang lag smin mas gar yang byed

verses.skt: stanasvajihvāsaṃdaṃśasaṃrambhajvarajāgarāḥ | pūyaśoṇitagandhaś ca skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam
verses.tib: nu ma rang lce so yis 'debs / kun tu g.yo zhing gnyid yang rims / khrag ni rnag gi dri bro ba'o / lug thug gdon gyi rtags kyi nang

verses.skt: ādhmānaṃ pāṇipādasya spandanaṃ phenanirvamaḥ | tṛṇmuṣṭibandhātīsārasvaradainyavivarṇatāḥ
verses.tib: sbo zhing rkang pa lag pa dag / 'dar zhing lbu ba skyugs pa dang / skom dad che 'khru chang pa sdom / skad gsang dma' zhing mdog mi sdug

verses.skt: kūjanaṃ stananaṃ chardiḥ kāsahidhmāprajāgarāḥ | oṣṭhadaṃśāṅgasaṃkocastambhabastābhagandhatāḥ
verses.tib: mkhun cing slon par byed pa dang / lud pa skyigs bus 'debs gnyid yar / so yis mchu gnon yan lag sdud / rengs shing lug thug dri bro la

verses.skt: ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ madhye vinamanaṃ jvaraḥ | mūrchaikanetraśophaś ca naigameṣagrahākṛtiḥ
verses.tib: gyen du lta zhing dgod pa dang / bar du 'gugs shing rims kyis 'debs / brgyal zhing mig gcig skrangs pa yan / khyi yi gdong gi rtags gyur pa

verses.skt: kampo hṛṣitaromatvaṃ svedaś cakṣurnimīlanam | bahirāyāmanaṃ jihvādaṃśo ’ntaḥkaṇṭhakūjanam
verses.tib: 'dar zhing ba spu ldang ba dang / rngul zhing mig ni 'dzums pa dang / rgyab tu gug cing lce dang so / mchu dang rkan sgra 'byin zhing skyugs

verses.skt: dhāvanaṃ viṭsagandhatvaṃ krośanaṃ ca śvavac chuni | romaharṣo muhus trāsaḥ sahasā rodanaṃ jvaraḥ
verses.tib: bshang ba'i dri 'byung khyi skad 'byin / yi dwags kyi ni gdon gyi rtags / ba spu ldang / zhing yang yang sdang / glo bur du zhing rims kyis 'debs

verses.skt: kāsātīsāravamathujṛmbhātṛṭśavagandhatāḥ | aṅgeṣv ākṣepavikṣepaśoṣastambhavivarṇatāḥ
verses.tib: 'khru zhing slon byed lud pa lu / glal skom mi ro'i dri dang ldan / lus ni bskyod cing g.yo ba dang / skem zhing rengs la mdog mi sdug

verses.skt: muṣṭibandhaḥ srutiś cākṣṇor bālasya syuḥ pitṛgrahe | srastāṅgatvam atīsāro jihvātālugale vraṇāḥ
verses.tib: khu tshur sdom shing mchi ma 'dzag / bya gdon lus lhod 'khru bar byed / lce rkan lkog mar rma 'byung zhing

verses.skt: sphoṭāḥ sadāharukpākāḥ saṃdhiṣu syuḥ punaḥ punaḥ | niśy ahni pravilīyante pāko vaktre gude ’pi vā
verses.tib: thor bur na zhing tsha la gnag / tshigs dag tu ni yang yang 'byung / mtshan mo skye la nyin mo 'bri / kha'am bshang sgo 'gags pa dang

verses.skt: bhayaṃ śakunigandhatvaṃ jvaraś ca śakunigrahe | pūtanāyāṃ vamiḥ kampas tandrā rātrau prajāgaraḥ
verses.tib: 'jigs shing bya yi dri dang ldan / rims kyis 'debs par byed pa yin / srul mo'i slon zhing 'dar ba dang / lus snyom mtshan mo gnyid yar dang

verses.skt: hidhmādhmānaṃ śakṛdbhedaḥ pipāsā mūtranigrahaḥ | srastahṛṣṭāṅgaromatvaṃ kākavat pūtigandhitā
verses.tib: skyigs bu lto sbos 'khru ba dang / skom zhing gcin ni sri ba dang / lus lhod ba spu gshor ba dang / kha ltar dri ni mnam pa yin

verses.skt: śītapūtanayā kampo rodanaṃ tiryagīkṣaṇam | tṛṣṇāntrakūjo ’tīsāro vasāvad visragandhatā
verses.tib: grang ba'i srul mo 'dar ba dang / ngu zhing zur gyis blta ba dang / skom zhing 'khru la rgyu ma 'khrog / zhag ltar dri ni mnam pa dang

verses.skt: pārśvasyaikasya śītatvam uṣṇatvam aparasya ca | andhapūtanayā chardir jvaraḥ kāso ’lpanidratā
verses.tib: yan lag logs gcig grang ba dang / cig shos dro ba nyid yin no / srul mo long ma'i slon pa dang / rims dang lud pa gnyid chung dang

verses.skt: varcaso bhedavaivarṇyadaurgandhyāny aṅgaśoṣaṇam | dṛṣṭeḥ sādātirukkaṇḍūpothakījanmaśūnatāḥ
verses.tib: bshang ba sla zhing mdog mi sdug / dri nga bskus pas myur du skam / mthong ba nyams shing mig na g.ya' / mig skrangs glo bar gyur pa dang

verses.skt: hidhmodvegastanadveṣavaivarṇyasvaratīkṣṇatāḥ | vepathur matsyagandhatvam athavā sāmlagandhatā
verses.tib: skyigs bu mi dgod nu zho 'gras / mdog mi sdug cing nga ro rtsub / mdog nyams nya yi dri dang ldan / yang na dri ni skyur bcas yin

verses.skt: mukhamaṇḍitayā pāṇipādāsyaramaṇīyatā | sirābhir asitābhābhir ācitodaratā jvaraḥ
verses.tib: bzhin rgyan can gyis rkang pa dang / lag pa gdong ni mdzes pa dang / rtsa ni nag por snang ba yis / lto ba khyab cing rims kyis 'debs

verses.skt: arocako ’ṅgaglapanaṃ gomūtrasamagandhatā | revatyāṃ śyāvanīlatvaṃ karṇanāsākṣimardanam
verses.tib: yi ga 'chus shing yan lag na / ba gcin lta bu'i dri 'byung 'gyur / nam gru gnag cing sngo ba dang / mig dang rna ba sna med cing

verses.skt: kāsahidhmākṣivikṣepavakravaktratvaraktatāḥ | bastagandho jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ purīṣaṃ haritaṃ dravam
verses.tib: mig 'gul skyigs bu lud pa lu / kha ni yo zhing dmar ba dang / lug thug drir ldan rims 'debs skem / bshang ba sngo zhing sla ba yin

verses.skt: jāyate śuṣkarevatyāṃ kramāt sarvāṅgasaṃkṣayaḥ | keśaśāto ’nnavidveṣaḥ svaradainyaṃ vivarṇatā
verses.tib: nam gru skem mos lus kun ni / rims kyis 'debs par 'gyur ba dang / skra 'byi zas la mi dga' dang / skad gsang zhum zhing mdog mi sdug

verses.skt: nānāvarṇapurīṣatvam udare granthayaḥ sirāḥ
verses.tib: bshang ba kha dog sna tshogs dang / lto bar rtsa yi mdud pa chags

verses.skt: rodanaṃ gṛdhragandhatvaṃ dīrghakālānuvartanam | udare granthayo vṛttā yasya nānāvidhaṃ śakṛt
verses.tib: ngu zhing bya rgod dri ldan la / yun ring na bar byed pa yin / lto ba rmen bu zlum po 'byung / bshang ba kha dog sna tshogs 'byung

verses.skt: jihvāyā nimnatā madhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet | bhuñjāno ’nnaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yo bālaḥ parihīyate
verses.tib: lce yi dbus ni dma' ba dang / rkan ni gnag 'gyur de spang bya / kha zas mang du zos kyang ni / byis ba gang zhig lus skem byed

verses.skt: tṛṣṇāgṛhītaḥ kṣāmākṣo hanti taṃ śuṣkarevatī | hiṃsāratyarcanākāṅkṣā grahagrahaṇakāraṇam
verses.tib: skom pas nyen cing mig nyams pa / de ni nam gru skem mos gsod / 'tshe ba la dga' mchod par 'dod / gdon rnams 'dzin pa'i rgyu yin no

verses.skt: tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān vā srutanāsikaḥ | kṣatajihvaḥ kvaṇed bāḍham asukhī sāśrulocanaḥ
verses.tib: de la 'tshe ba'i bdag nyid can / byin tshe sna nas 'dzag pa dang / lce nyams mig ni gting du 'bros / 'degs byed mig ni mchi mar bcas

verses.skt: durvarṇo hīnavacanaḥ pūtigandhiś ca jāyate | kṣāmo mūtrapurīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdnāti na jugupsate
verses.tib: nyam chung tshig ni dman pa dang / dri nga ba ni 'byung bar 'gyur / skem zhing rang gi bshang dang gci / lag pas nyed cing smod mi byed

verses.skt: hastau codyamya saṃrabdho hanty ātmānaṃ tathā param | tadvac ca śastrakāṣṭhādyair agniṃ vā dīptam āviśet
verses.tib: lag pas bteg ste 'bad pa yis / bdag dang de bzhin gzhan la rdeg / mtshon dang shing kyis rdeg cing / 'bar ba'i me la 'jug par byed

verses.skt: apsu majjet patet kūpe kuryād anyac ca tadvidham | tṛḍdāhamohān pūyasya cchardanaṃ ca pravartayet
verses.tib: chu nang 'bying zhing khron par ltung / gzhan yang de 'drar byed bar 'gyur / skom dad che zhing tsha bas rnag / slon par byed par 'gyur ba dang

verses.skt: raktaṃ ca sarvamārgebhyo riṣṭotpattiṃ ca taṃ tyajet | rahaḥstrīratisaṃlāpagandhasragbhūṣaṇapriyaḥ
verses.tib: bu ga kun nas khrag 'dzag cing / 'chi ltas byung ba de spang bya / dga' ba 'dod pas gzir gyur pa / dben par bud med 'dod smra dga' / dri dang me tog phreng rgyan dga'

verses.skt: hṛṣṭaḥ śāntaś ca duḥsādhyo ratikāmena pīḍitaḥ | dīnaḥ parimṛśan vaktraṃ śuṣkauṣṭhagalatālukaḥ
verses.tib: mgu zhing zhi ba gso ba dka' / lces ni kha la nyug pa dang / mchu rkan gre ba skams pa dang

verses.skt: śaṅkitaṃ vīkṣate rauti dhyāyaty āyāti dīnatām | annam annābhilāṣe ’pi dattaṃ nāti bubhukṣate
verses.tib: dogs pas lta zhing ngu ba dang / sems khong chud cing zhum pa dang / zas 'dod ltogs par gyur kyang ni / byin na za bar mi 'dod la

verses.skt: gṛhītaṃ balikāmena taṃ vidyāt sukhasādhanam | hantukāmaṃ jayed dhomaiḥ siddhamantrapravartitaiḥ
verses.tib: gtor ma / 'dod pas zin pa ste / de ni gso sla yin par bshad / gsod 'dod pa la grub pa yi / sngags bzlas sbyin sreg byas pas gzhom

verses.skt: itarau tu yathākāmaṃ ratibalyādidānataḥ | atha sādhyagrahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte śaraṇe sthitam
verses.tib: cig shos la ni ci 'dod par / dga' dang gtor ma sogs sbyin pas / de nas gso rung gdon la ni / byis pa khang pa dben par bzhag

verses.skt: trir ahnaḥ siktasaṃmṛṣṭe sadā saṃnihitānale | vikīrṇabhūtikusumapattrabījānnasarṣape
verses.tib: zhag gsum chag chag phyag dar byas / rtag tu me ni gzhag pa yi / bu ti'i me tog bsil ma dang / 'dab ma sa bon nyungs kar gtor

verses.skt: rakṣoghnatailajvalitapradīpahatapāpmani | vyavāyamadyapiśitanivṛttaparicārake
verses.tib: gdon 'joms til mar sbar ba yi / mar mes gdon ni 'joms par byed / nad g.yog nyal po chang dang sha / yongs su spangs par gyur pa yi

verses.skt: purāṇasarpiṣābhyaktaṃ pariṣiktaṃ sukhāmbunā | sādhitena balānimbavaijayantīnṛpadrumaiḥ
verses.tib: mar ni rnying pas bskus nas ni / ba la nim pa star ka ri / dong gra thang shing ka tang ga / 'dzam bu dang ni ta ma la

verses.skt: pāribhadrakakaṭvaṅgajambūvaruṇakaṭtṛṇaiḥ | kapotavaṅkāpāmārgapāṭalāmadhuśigrubhiḥ
verses.tib: ka tri na dang lcam pa dang / a ba marga ma ta li / ma du shi kru zhes bya dang / ka ka dza ka shwe ta che / bil rkang 'o ma can gyi shing

verses.skt: kākajaṅghāmahāśvetākapitthakṣīripādapaiḥ | sakadambakarañjaiś ca dhūpaṃ snātasya cācaret
verses.tib: ka dam ba bcas ka rany+dza / chu ni dro 'jam dag gis bkru / stag dang gzig dang seng ge sbrul / dom gyi pags pa mar dang bcas / bdugs pas khrus byas 'og tu bdug

verses.skt: dvīpivyāghrāhisiṃharkṣacarmabhir ghṛtamiśritaiḥ | pūtidaśāṅgasiddhārthavacābhallātadīpyakaiḥ
verses.tib: pu ti nyungs kar sha raM ga / shu dag go bye la la phud / ru rta mar sbyar bdug pas ni / gdon kun las ni thar byed yin / yungs kar nim pa'i lo ma dang

verses.skt: sakuṣṭhaiḥ saghṛtair dhūpaḥ sarvagrahavimokṣaṇaḥ | sarṣapā nimbapattrāṇi mūlam aśvakhurā vacā
verses.tib: shu dag ka ra bI ra'i rtsa / dro ba mar sbyar bdug pas ni / gdon ni thams cad sel bar byed / ba lang rwa dang rus pa spu / pags pa byi la'i rtug pa dang / nim pa'i lo ma pu tse shel / mar dang bri ha ti gnyis dang / ras bal sa bon po son cha

verses.skt: bhūrjapattraṃ ghṛtaṃ dhūpaḥ sarvagrahanivāraṇaḥ | anantāmrāsthitagaraṃ maricaṃ madhuro gaṇaḥ
verses.tib: nas dang ra spu thang shing dang / nyungs kar rma bya'i sgro dang pog / skra dang phub ma pha bang dang / rdza mar ra thug gcin dang sbangs / zhib btags pa yi bdugs pas ni / 'byung po'i gdon ni thams cad dang / mi bzad rims nad 'joms par byed / byi tsher a mra'i tshi gu dang

verses.skt: śṛgālavinnā mustā ca kalkitais tair ghṛtaṃ pacet | daśamūlarasakṣīrayuktaṃ tad grahajit param
verses.tib: rgya spos mngar sde na le sham / kr-iSh+Na par+N-i gla sgang rnams / lde / gur byas pa mar dang ni / 'o ma rtsa ba bcu bskol khur / bcas bskol de ni gdon 'joms mchog

verses.skt: rāsnādvyaṃśumatīvṛddhapañcamūlabalāghanāt | kvāthe sarpiḥ pacet piṣṭaiḥ śārivāvyoṣacitrakaiḥ
verses.tib: ra sna aM shu ma ti gnyis / ba la rtsa ba chen po lnga / gla sgang btags te mar dang bskol / tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka / thal tres pa tra byi dang ga

verses.skt: pāṭhāviḍaṅgamadhukapayasyāhiṅgudārubhiḥ | sagranthikaiḥ sendrayavaiḥ śiśos tat satataṃ hitam
verses.tib: shing mngar shing kun pa ya s+ya / thang shing pi pi ling rtsa ba / dug mo nyung dang bcas pa yi / lde gu mar dang bskol bas ni / rtag tu byis pa la phan zhing

verses.skt: sarvarogagrahaharaṃ dīpanaṃ balavarṇadam | śārivāsurabhibrāhmīśaṅkhinīkuṣṭhasarṣapaiḥ
verses.tib: nad dang gnod pa thams cad 'joms / me drod stobs dang kha dog skyed / sha ri ba dang mu ra dang / bram+hi shu dag shang khi ni

verses.skt: vacāśvagandhāsurasayuktaiḥ sarpir vipācayet | tan nāśayed grahān sarvān pānenābhyañjanena ca
gośṛṅgacarmavālāhinirmokaṃ vṛṣadaṃśaviṭ | nimbapattrājyakaṭukāmadanaṃ bṛhatīdvayam
kārpāsāsthiyavacchāgaromadevāhvasarṣapam | mayūrapattraśrīvāsaṃ tuṣakeśaṃ sarāmaṭham
verses.tib: nyungs kar a shwa gan+d+ha dang

verses.skt: mṛdbhāṇḍe bastamūtreṇa bhāvitaṃ ślakṣṇacūrṇitam | dhūpanaṃ ca hitaṃ sarvabhūteṣu viṣamajvare
verses.tib: bye'u rug pa bcas mar bskol / de ni btung dang bsku ba yis / gdon rnams thams cad 'joms par byed / mar gad 'byung po'i rigs pa ru

verses.skt: ghṛtāni bhūtavidyāyāṃ vakṣyante yāni tāni ca | yuñjyāt tathā baliṃ homaṃ snapanaṃ mantratantravit
verses.tib: 'og nas bshad pa dag dang ni / de bzhin gtor ma sbyin sreg dang / khrus ni sngags rgyud shes pas sbyar

verses.skt: pūtikarañjatvakpattraṃ kṣīribhyo barbarād api | tumbīviśālāralukaśamībilvakapitthataḥ
verses.tib: pu ti ka rany+dza'i shun pa / bar pa ra yi rtsa ba dang / ku ba kha bo bi sha la / ka tra ka dang bil ba dang

verses.skt: utkvāthya toyaṃ tad rātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivam | anubandhān yathākṛcchraṃ grahāpāye ’py upadravān
verses.tib: ka pi ta bskol des mtshan mo / byis pa bkrus na shis pa yin / gdon dang bral yang bla brnan nad / rjes su 'brel pa thams cad la

verses.skt: bālāmayaniṣedhoktabheṣajaiḥ samupācaret
verses.tib: byis pa'i nad gsor bshad pa yi / sman gyis ji bzhin gso bar bya

verses.skt: lakṣayej jñānavijñānavākceṣṭābalapauruṣam | puruṣe ’pauruṣaṃ yatra tatra bhūtagrahaṃ vadet
verses.tib: shes dang rnam shes tshig dang ni / spyod dang snying stobs rang bzhin dag / gang gi rang bzhin 'gyur bar snang / de la 'byung po'i gdon yod bshad

verses.skt: bhūtasya rūpaprakṛtibhāṣāgatyādiceṣṭitaiḥ | yasyānukāraṃ kurute tenāviṣṭaṃ tam ādiśet
verses.tib: 'byung po'i gzugs dang rang bzhin dang / smra dang 'gro sogs spyod pa dang / gang zhig / 'dre bar byed pa rnams / de la de ni zhugs par bshad

verses.skt: so ’ṣṭādaśavidho devadānavādivibhedataḥ | hetus tadanuṣaktau tu sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto ’thavā
verses.tib: de ni lha dang lha min / dbye ba rnam pa bco brgyad bshad / de 'dzin rgyu ni 'phral gtam ni / sngon chad shes rab 'chal ba yi

verses.skt: prajñāparādhaḥ sutarāṃ tena kāmādijanmanā | luptadharmavratācāraḥ pūjyān apy ativartate
verses.tib: blo yis nyes pa byas gyur nas / de yi chags pa bskyed nas / brtul zhugs spyod dang chos lugs nyams / mchod 'os rnams ni brnyas pa dang

verses.skt: taṃ tathā bhinnamaryādaṃ pāpam ātmopaghātinam | devādayo ’py anughnanti grahāś chidraprahāriṇaḥ
verses.tib: gzhung lugs nyams pa de dag ni / sdig dang bdag ni gsod byed ni / gdon ni glags skabs tshol byed pas / lha la sogs pa'ang rjes gnod byed

verses.skt: chidraṃ pāpakriyārambhaḥ pāko ’niṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ | ekasya śūnye ’vasthānaṃ śmaśānādiṣu vā niśi
verses.tib: glags ni sdig la sogs pa dang / mi dge'i las ni smin pa dang / gcig pur khang stong gnas pa'am / dur khrod sogs par mtshan mo gnas

verses.skt: digvāsastvaṃ guror nindā rater avidhisevanam | aśucer devatārcādi parasūtakasaṃkaraḥ
verses.tib: gcer bur rgyu ba'am bla ma smod / 'khrig pa tshul min spyod pa dang / gtsang sbra med par lha mchod dang / mi gtsang gzhan dang 'dres pa dang

verses.skt: homamantrabalījyānāṃ viguṇaṃ parikarma ca | samāsād dinacaryādiproktācāravyatikramaḥ
verses.tib: sbyin sreg sngags gtor mchod sbyin rnams / phyin ci log tu byed pa dang / mdor na nyin re sogs spyod par / spyod pa brten pa las 'das pa'o

verses.skt: gṛhṇanti śuklapratipattrayodaśyoḥ surā naram | śuklatrayodaśīkṛṣṇadvādaśyor dānavā grahāḥ
verses.tib: lha yi gdon gyis yar ngo yi / tshes gcig bcu gsum dag la 'dzin / lha min gdon ni yar ngo yi / bcu gsum mar ngo bcu gnyis la

verses.skt: gandharvās tu caturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ coragāḥ punaḥ | pañcamyāṃ śuklasaptamyekādaśyos tu dhaneśvarāḥ
verses.tib: dri za'i gdon ni bcu bzhi dang / bcu gnyis dag la'ang 'dzin par byed / klu gdon tshes lnga la 'dzin byed / gnod sbyin gdon ni yar ngo yi / tshes bdun bcu gcig dag la 'dzin

verses.skt: śuklāṣṭapañcamīpaurṇamāsīṣu brahmarākṣasāḥ | kṛṣṇe rakṣaḥpiśācādyā navadvādaśaparvasu
verses.tib: tshangs pa srin pos yar ngo yi / tshes brgyad bco lnga dag la 'dzin / srin po sha za sogs mar ngo'i / tshes gcig tshes dgu bcu gcig la

verses.skt: daśāmāvāsyayor aṣṭanavamyoḥ pitaro ’pare | guruvṛddhādayaḥ prāyaḥ kālaṃ saṃdhyāsu lakṣayet
verses.tib: mtshun lha gnam stong tshes bcu dang / brgyad dang dgu pa dag la 'dzin / rgan pa la sogs gzhan dag ni / phal cher dus de'i thun mtshams la'o

verses.skt: phullapadmopamamukhaṃ saumyadṛṣṭim akopanam | alpavāksvedaviṇmūtraṃ bhojanānabhilāṣiṇam
verses.tib: gdong ni pad+ma kha bye 'dra / lta stangs zhi zhing khro ba med / tshig nyung dul dang bshang gci nyung / kha zas la ni 'dod pa med

verses.skt: devadvijātiparamaṃ śuciṃ saṃskṛtavādinam | mīlayantaṃ cirān netre surabhiṃ varadāyinam
verses.tib: lha dang bram ze 'byung ba dka' / gtsang zhing saMskr-i ta'i skad smra / yun ring nas ni mig 'dzums shing / lus dri zhim zhing mchog ster byed

verses.skt: śuklamālyāmbarasaricchailoccabhavanapriyam | anidram apradhṛṣyaṃ ca vidyād devavaśīkṛtam
verses.tib: gos phreng dkar po chu bo dang / ri mtho khang pa mtho la dga' / gnyid med tshugs pa med pa yin / lha min gdon gyis zin pa ni

verses.skt: jihmadṛṣṭiṃ durātmānaṃ gurudevadvijadviṣam | nirbhayaṃ māninaṃ śūraṃ krodhanaṃ vyavasāyinam
verses.tib: yon por blta zhing rang bzhin ngan / lha dang bla ma bram ze dang / 'jigs med khengs shing dpa' ba dang / khro zhing rtsol ba che ba dang

verses.skt: rudraḥ skando viśākho ’ham indro ’ham iti vādinam | surāmāṃsaruciṃ vidyād daityagrahagṛhītakam
verses.tib: nga ni drag po khyab 'jug dang / skem byed brgya byin yin zhes bshad / sha dang chang la dga' zhes bya / dri za'i gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags

verses.skt: svācāraṃ surabhiṃ hṛṣṭaṃ gītanartanakāriṇam | snānodyānaruciṃ raktavastramālyānulepanam
verses.tib: rang spyod la dga' lus dri zhim / snying dga' glu dang gar yang byed / khrus dang skyed mos tshal la dga' / gos phreng byug pa dmar la sred

verses.skt: śṛṅgāralīlābhirataṃ gandharvādhyuṣitaṃ vadet | raktākṣaṃ krodhanaṃ stabdhadṛṣṭiṃ vakragatiṃ calam
verses.tib: sgeg dang rtsed mo la dga'o / klu yi gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags / mig dmar khro zhing mi 'gyur lta / yon por 'gro zhing blta ba dang

verses.skt: śvasantam aniśaṃ jihvālolinaṃ sṛkkiṇīliham | priyadugdhaguḍasnānam adhovadanaśāyinam
verses.tib: nyin mtshan dbugs rgod lce las ni / kha chu 'dzag cing kha 'gram lhag / bu ram 'o ma khrus la dga' / kha sbub tu ni nyal bar byed

verses.skt: uragādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyāt trasyantaṃ cātapatrataḥ | viplutatrastaraktākṣaṃ śubhagandhaṃ sutejasam
verses.tib: gdugs mthong na ni 'jigs pa yin / gnod sbyin gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags / mig dmar bgrad cing skrag la 'gul / lus ni dri zhim gzi mdangs ldan

verses.skt: priyanṛtyakathāgītasnānamālyānulepanam | matsyamāṃsaruciṃ hṛṣṭaṃ tuṣṭaṃ balinam avyatham
verses.tib: gtam dang glu dang khrus dang ni / phreng ba byug pa la dga' zhing / nya yi sha sred dga' ba dang / dga' mgu stobs chen nad med la

verses.skt: calitāgrakaraṃ kasmai kiṃ dadāmīti vādinam | rahasyabhāṣiṇaṃ vaidyadvijātiparibhāvinam
verses.tib: lag rtse bskyod cing su zhig la / ci zhig sbyin zhes smra bar byed / gsang tshig smra zhing sman pa dang / bram ze la ni brnyas par byed

verses.skt: alparoṣaṃ drutagatiṃ vidyād yakṣagṛhītakam | hāsyanṛtyapriyaṃ raudraceṣṭaṃ chidraprahāriṇam
verses.tib: khro ba chung zhing mgyogs 'gro ba'o / tshangs pa srin pos zin pa'i rtags / dgod cing gar la dga' ba dang / spyod pa gtum zhing glags skabs tshol

verses.skt: ākrośinaṃ śīghragatiṃ devadvijabhiṣagdviṣam | ātmānaṃ kāṣṭhaśastrādyair ghnantaṃ bhoḥśabdavādinam
verses.tib: gshe zhing myur du 'gro ba dang / sman pa bram ze lha la sdang / rang la shing dang mtshon sogs brdeg / kye zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs shing

verses.skt: śāstravedapaṭhaṃ vidyād gṛhītaṃ brahmarākṣasaiḥ | sakrodhadṛṣṭiṃ bhrūkuṭīm udvahantaṃ sasaṃbhramaṃ
verses.tib: bstan bcos rig byed 'dod pa yin / srin po'i gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags / khro gnyer bcas shing khro bar / lta

verses.skt: praharantaṃ pradhāvantaṃ śabdantaṃ bhairavānanam | annād vināpi balinaṃ naṣṭanidraṃ niśācaram
verses.tib: rta bas bag tu ni byed pa dang / rdeg cing rab tu rgyug pa dang / ngu zhing gdong ni 'jigs rung ston / zas ma zos kyang stobs dang ldan / gnyid med mtshan mo rgyu ba dang

verses.skt: nirlajjam aśuciṃ śūraṃ krūraṃ paruṣabhāṣiṇam | roṣaṇaṃ raktamālyastrīraktamadyāmiṣapriyam
verses.tib: ngo tsha gtsang sbra med cing dpa' / gdug cing tshig rtsub smra ba dang / khro zhing phreng ba dmar po dang / bud med sha chang khrag la dga'

verses.skt: dṛṣṭvā ca raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vālihānaṃ daśanacchadau | hasantam annakāle ca rākṣasādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet
verses.tib: sha'am khrag ni mthong ba na / mchu ni ldag par byed pa dang / zas za'i tshe na dgod pa yin / sha za'i gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags

verses.skt: asvasthacittaṃ naikatra tiṣṭhantaṃ paridhāvinam | ucchiṣṭanṛtyagandharvahāsamadyāmiṣapriyam
verses.tib: sems ni bde bar mi gnas shing / yongs su rgyug par byed pa dang / mi gtsang la dga' glu gar dang / dgod dang chang dang sha rlon dga'

verses.skt: nirbhartsanād dīnamukhaṃ rudantam animittataḥ | nakhair likhantam ātmānaṃ rūkṣadhvastavapuḥsvaram
verses.tib: spyos na gdong ni zhum pa dang / rgyu med par ni ngu ba dang / bdag nyid sen mos 'brud pa dang / khong rtsub lus nyams skad gsang dma'

verses.skt: āvedayantam duḥkhādi saṃbaddhābaddhabhāṣiṇam | naṣṭasmṛtiṃ śūnyaratiṃ lolaṃ nagnaṃ malīmasam
verses.tib: sdug bsngal ba ni brda sprod cing / 'brel dang mi 'brel tshig mang smra / dran pa nyams shing gnas stong dga' / mi brtan gcer bu dri ma can

verses.skt: rathyācailaparīdhānaṃ tṛṇamālāvibhūṣaṇam | ārohantaṃ ca kāṣṭhāśvaṃ tathā saṃkarakūṭakam
verses.tib: srang bar 'khyams shing gos gyon zhing / rtswa yi phreng ba rgyun tu thogs / shing 'dzeg rta la zhon par byed / de bzhin phyag dar phung por 'dzeg

verses.skt: bahvāśinaṃ piśācena vijānīyād adhiṣṭhitam | pretākṛtikriyāgandhaṃ bhītam āhāravidviṣam
verses.tib: mang du za bar byed pa yin / gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags / spyod tshul dri ni 'dra / sngar zhing zas la mi dga' dang

verses.skt: tṛṇacchidaṃ ca pretena gṛhītaṃ naram ādiśet | bahupralāpaṃ kṛṣṇāsyaṃ pravilambitayāyinam
verses.tib: rtsa gcod byed pa zhes kyang bya / grul bum gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags / tshig mang smra zhing kha gdong gnag / dal gyis 'gro bar byed pa dang

verses.skt: śūnapralambavṛṣaṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet | gṛhītvā kāṣṭhaloṣṭādi bhramantaṃ cīravāsasam
verses.tib: rlig pa skrang zhing 'phyang ba yin / mi ni byang stems zin pa'i rtags / shing rdo bong ba thogs shing / tshal pa gyon te 'gro ba dang

verses.skt: nagnaṃ dhāvantam uttrastadṛṣṭiṃ tṛṇavibhūṣaṇam | śmaśānaśūnyāyatanarathyaikadrumasevinam
verses.tib: gcer bur rgyug cing 'jigs bag tu / lta la rtswa yis rgyan du byed / dur khrod gnas ni stong pa dang / srang bar shing gcig brten pa dang

verses.skt: tilānnamadyamāṃseṣu satataṃ saktalocanaṃ | niṣādādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyād vadantaṃ paruṣāṇi ca
verses.tib: til zas chang dang sha la ni / rtag tu mig ni tshags pa / dang / tshig rtsub de ni smra ba yin / g.yengs byed kyis ni zin pa'i rtags

verses.skt: yācantam udakaṃ cānnaṃ trastalohitalocanam | ugravākyaṃ ca jānīyān naram aukiraṇārditam
verses.tib: chu 'dod zas ni mi slong dang / sngangs shing mig ni dmar ba dang / tshig rtsub smra bar shes par bya / ro langs gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags

verses.skt: gandhamālyaratiṃ satyavādinaṃ parivepinam | bahunidraṃ ca jānīyād vetālena vaśīkṛtam
verses.tib: dri dang phreng ba la dga' zhing / tshig bden smra la yongs su 'dar / gnyid che bar ni shes par bya / mtshun lha'i gdon gyi rtags

verses.skt: aprasannadṛśaṃ dīnavadanaṃ śuṣkatālukam | calannayanapakṣmāṇaṃ nidrāluṃ mandapāvakam
verses.tib: mig mi gsal zhing bzhin ras zhum / rkan ni skam par byed pa dang / mig dang rdzi ma bskyod pa dang / gnyid che me drod chung ba dang

verses.skt: apasavyaparīdhānaṃ tilamāṃsaguḍapriyam | skhaladvācaṃ ca jānīyāt pitṛgrahavaśīkṛtam
verses.tib: g.yon phyogs nas ni gos gyon zhing / sha dang bu ram til la dga' / tshig 'khrul pa ni yin zhes bya

verses.skt: guruvṛddharṣisiddhābhiśāpacintānurūpataḥ | vyāhārāhāraceṣṭābhir yathāsvaṃ tadgrahaṃ vadet
verses.tib: bla ma drang srong rgan dang grub / dmod pa sems kyi rjes mthun pa / spyod lam kha zas rang bzhin las / ci 'dra gdon ni de yin bshad

verses.skt: kumāravṛndānugataṃ nagnam uddhatamūrdhajam | asvasthamanasaṃ dairghyakālikaṃ sagrahaṃ tyajet
verses.tib: gzhon nu'i tshogs kyi rjes 'brang zhing / gcer bu skra ni gyen du brdzes / yid mi bde zhing dus tshigs ni / yun ring gyur pa'i gdon de spang

verses.skt: bhūtaṃ jayed ahiṃsecchaṃ japahomabalivrataiḥ | tapaḥśīlasamādhānadānajñānadayādibhiḥ
verses.tib: 'byung po'i 'tshe ba mi 'dod dang / bzlas dang sbyin sreg gtor ma dang / brtul zhugs tshul khrims mnyam 'jog dang / sbyin shes brtse la sogs pas bsal

verses.skt: hiṅguvyoṣālanepālīlaśunārkajaṭājaṭāḥ | ajalomī sagolomī bhūtakeśī vacā latā
verses.tib: gla rtsi sgog skya arka'i rtsa / spang spos a za lo mi dang / la ba 'bam po ku ku ti / shu dag gan+d+ha pri yang ku

verses.skt: kukkuṭī sarpagandhākhyā tilāḥ kāṇavikāṇike | vajraproktā vayaḥsthā ca śṛṅgī mohanavally api
verses.tib: sar pa gan+d+ha til mar ni / ka ka an da ra mnye ba / snu ha ka ka ta shring gi / sle tres ma hA na ba li / yungs kar dang ni lig bu mig

verses.skt: srotojāñjanarakṣoghnaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ cānyad auṣadham | kharāśvaśvāviduṣṭrarkṣagodhānakulaśalyakāt
verses.tib: gdon 'joms sman ni gzhan dag dang / bong bu rta dang khyi lug dang / rnga mo go da dred dang ni / sre mo reg 'jam byi la gung

verses.skt: dvīpimārjāragosiṃhavyāghrasāmudrasattvataḥ | carmapittadvijanakhā varge ’smin sādhayed ghṛtam
verses.tib: ba / lang seng ge stag dang ni / rgya mtsho yi ni srog chags kyi / pags pa mkhris pa sen mo so / sde tshan 'di dang mar rnying ngam / til mar dang ni bskol ba dag

verses.skt: purāṇam athavā tailaṃ navaṃ tat pānanasyayoḥ | abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyam eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane
verses.tib: btung dang snar ni blugs pa dang / bsku ba'i don du sbyar bya zhing / 'di dag phye mas bdug par bya

verses.skt: ebhiś ca guṭikāṃ yuñjyād añjane sāvapīḍane | pralepe kalkam eteṣāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pariṣecane
verses.tib: 'di yi ri lu byas nas ni / mig sman sna sman bya ba dang / 'di yi lde gus byugs pa dang / bskol ba'i khu ba blugs par bya

verses.skt: prayogo ’yaṃ grahonmādān sāpasmārāñ chamaṃ nayet | gajāhvāpippalīmūlavyoṣāmalakasarṣapān
verses.tib: sbyor ba 'di yis smyo byed dang / brjed byed bcas pa'i gdon zhi byed / nyungs kar ha ti pi pi ling / pi pi ling rtsa che ba gsum / skyu ru ra dang go da dang

verses.skt: godhānakulamārjārajhaṣapittaprapeṣitān | nāvanābhyaṅgasekeṣu vidadhīta grahāpahān
verses.tib: sre mo byi la rtsa sha yi / mkhris pa dang btags sna sman dang / bsku byug byugs sogs byas gdon 'joms

verses.skt: siddhārthakavacāhiṅgupriyaṅgurajanīdvayam | mañjiṣṭhā śvetakaṭabhī varā śvetādrikarṇikā
verses.tib: nyungs kar shu dag shing kun dang / pri yang ku dang ser po gnyis / gi ri kar+Ni dkar nag gnyis / 'bras bu gsum dang shwe ta dang

verses.skt: nimbasya pattraṃ bījaṃ tu naktamālaśirīṣayoḥ | surāhvaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ sarpir gomūtre taiś caturguṇe
verses.tib: nim pa'i lo ma ka rany+dza / shri sha gnyis dang sa bon dang / thang shing dang ni tsha ba gsum / mar dang ba gcin de bzhi 'gyur

verses.skt: siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma pāne nasye ca yojitam | grahān sarvān nihanty āśu viśeṣād āsurān grahān
verses.tib: bskol ba don grub ces bya ste / btung dang snar blugs las sbyar na / gdon ni thams cad myur 'joms byed / mchog tu lha min gdon sel byed

verses.skt: kṛtyālakṣmīviṣonmādajvarāpasmārapāpma ca | ebhir evauṣadhair bastavāriṇā kalpito ’gadaḥ
verses.tib: brjed byed dug dang bkra mi shis / smyo byed gshed byed rims rnams 'joms / sman de nyid ni ra thug gi / gcin dang sbyar te blud pa dang

verses.skt: pānanasyāñjanālepasnānodgharṣaṇayojitaḥ | guṇaiḥ pūrvavad uddiṣṭo rājadvāre ca siddhikṛt
verses.tib: snar blugs mig sman byugs pa dang / khrus dang dril ba la sbyar ba / sngar bshad yon tan de 'dra zhing / rgyal po'i sgor yang don grub byed

verses.skt: siddhārthakavyoṣavacāśvagandhā niśādvayaṃ hiṅgupalāṇḍukandaḥ | bījaṃ karañjāt kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapitthavṛkṣāt
verses.tib: nyungs kar shu dag tsha ba gsum / a shwa gan+d+ha ser po gnyis / shing kun kun dong rtsa ba dang / karany+dza yi sa bon dang / shri sha yi me tog dang / ka bid tha yi 'bras bu dang

verses.skt: samāṇimanthaṃ sanataṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ śyoṇākamūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca | bastasya mūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ tat pittena gavyena guḍān vidadhyāt
verses.tib: rgyam tsha ru rta rgya spos dang / gi ri kar+Ni dkar po dang / so na ka yi rtsa bar gnas / ra / gcin dag dang legs bsgos shing / ba lang mkhris pa bu ram dang / ri lu byas pa'i sbyor ba de

verses.skt: duṣṭavraṇonmādatamoniśāndhān udbandhakān vārinimagnadehān | digdhāhatān darpitasarpadaṣṭāṃs te sādhayanty añjananasyalepaiḥ
verses.tib: smyo byed rma ni red pa dang / mtshan mo mi mthong mun 'thibs byed / bgegs dang lus chur nub pas brgyal / dug bskus mda' yis phog pa dang / gdug pa sbrul gyis zin pa sel

verses.skt: kārpāsāsthimayūrapattrabṛhatīnirmālyapiṇḍītaka | tvaṅmāṃsīvṛṣadaṃśaviṭtuṣavacākeśāhinirmokakaiḥ | nāgendradvijaśṛṅgahiṅgumaricais tulyaiḥ kṛtaṃ dhūpanaṃ | skandonmādapiśācarākṣasasurāveśajvaraghnaṃ param
verses.tib: ras bal sa bon rma bya'i sgro / me tog sman ma bri ha ti / shing tsha spang spos po son cha / byi la'i rtug pa phub ma dang / shu dag mi skra sbrul lpags dang / glang po'i so dang glang gi rwa / shing kun dang ni na le sham / tsha mnyam bdugs par byas pa yis / skem byed smyo byed sha za'i rigs / srin po lha yi gdon 'joms mchog

verses.skt: trikaṭukadalakuṅkumagranthikakṣārasiṃhīniśādārusiddhārthayugmāmbuśakrāhvayaiḥ | sitalaśunaphalatrayośīratiktāvacātutthayaṣṭībalālohitailāśilāpadmakaiḥ || 19b || dadhitagaramadhūkasārapriyāhvāviṣākhyāviṣātārkṣyaśailaiḥ sacavyāmayaiḥ kalkitaiḥ
verses.tib: gan+d+ha b+ha dra tsha ba gsum / gur kum pi pi ling rtsa ba / kaN+Da ka ri skyer pa dang / thang shing dang ni yungs kar gnyis / ba li ka dang dug mo nyung / tsan+dan dkar po rgyam tsha dang / 'bras bu gsum dang pu shel tse / shu dag spangs ma pu tse shel / tsan+dan dkar po ba la dang / shing mngar sug smel ldong ros dang / shug pa rgya spos shri pa sa / ma du ka yi snying po dang / bong nga gnyis po pri yang ku / dbyi mo ru rta skyer khaN dang / cha mnyam zhib btags lde gu dang

verses.skt: natamadhukakarañjalākṣāpaṭolīsamaṅgāvacāpāṭalīhiṅgusiddhārthasiṃhīniśāyuglatārohiṇī | badarakaṭuphalatrikākāṇḍadārukṛmighnājagandhāmarāṅkollakośātakīśigrunimbāmbu dendrāhvayaiḥ
verses.tib: rgya spos shing mngar ka rany+dza / rgya skyegs da ta pa to la / shu dag shing kun pa ta la / nyungs kar kaN+Da ka ri dang / ser po gnyis dang pu tse shel / rgya shug gan+d+ha pri yang ku / thang shing sle tres byi dang ga / ko sha ta ki ka kan ta / shi kru nim pa dug mo nyung / shri shi'i me tog sa bon dang / gla sgang ru rta dan da dang / gi ri kar+Ni tsi tra ka / bil ba cha mnyam / lde gur byas

verses.skt: madanakaṭuphalatrikākāṇḍadārukṛmighnājagandhāmarāṅkollakośātakīśigrunimbāmbudendrāhvayaiḥ grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ | dineṣu balihomādīn prayuñjīta cikitsakaḥ
verses.tib: khus 'debs chen po zhes bshad do / rim pa kun gyis sbyar na ni / gdon rnams kun dang smyo byed dang / mdze dang rims ni myur du 'joms / gdon ni nyi ma gang gang la / 'dzin pa'i nyi ma de dang der / mchog tu sbyin sreg gtor ma sogs / sman pas rab tu 'bad de bya

verses.skt: snānavastravasāmāṃsamadyakṣīraguḍādi ca | rocate yad yadā yebhyas tat teṣām āharet tadā
verses.tib: khrus dang gos dang sha dang tshil / chang dang mar dang bu ram / gang zhig gang la sred gyur pa / de tshe de ni de la sbyin

verses.skt: ratnāni gandhamālyāni bījāni madhusarpiṣī | bhakṣyāś ca sarve sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo vidhir ity ayam
verses.tib: rin chen dri dang phreng ba dang / sa bon mar dang sbrang rtsi dang / zas kun kun la sbyin bya ste / 'di ni spyi yi cho ga'o

verses.skt: surarṣiguruvṛddhebhyaḥ siddhebhyaś ca surālaye | diśy uttarasyāṃ tatrāpi devāyopahared balim
verses.tib: lha dang bla ma drang srong rgan / grub pa lha yi gnas su sbyin / de yang lha yi gdon la ni / byang gi phyogs su gtor ma sbyin

verses.skt: paścimāyāṃ yathākālaṃ daityabhūtāya catvare | gandharvāya gavāṃ mārge savastrābharaṇaṃ balim
verses.tib: lha min gdon la ci 'dod par / mtshams kyi gnas su nub tu sbyin / dri za'i gdon la ba lang ngam / gos dang rgyan bcas gtor ma sbyin

verses.skt: pitṛnāgagrahe nadyāṃ nāgebhyaḥ pūrvadakṣiṇe | yakṣāya yakṣāyatane saritor vā samāgame
verses.tib: mtshun lha klu gdon 'bab chu'i 'gram / klu la shar lho mtshams su sbyin / gnod sbyin rang gi gnas sam ni / chu gnyis 'dus pa'i gnas su sbyin

verses.skt: catuṣpathe rākṣasāya bhīmeṣu gahaneṣu ca | rakṣasāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ brahmarakṣasām
verses.tib: srin por lam gyi bzhi mdo'am / tshang tshing 'jigs su rung bar sbyin / srin po lho yi phyogs su sbyin / tshangs pa'i srin por shar du sbyin

verses.skt: śūnyālaye piśācāya paścimāṃ diśam āsthite | śuciśuklāni mālyāni gandhāḥ kṣaireyam odanam
verses.tib: sha za la ni khang stong du / nub phyogs su ni gnas te sbyin / phreng ba gtsang zhing dkar po dang / dri dang 'o thug 'bras chan dang

verses.skt: dadhi cchattraṃ ca dhavalaṃ devānāṃ balir iṣyate | hiṅgusarṣapaṣaḍgranthāvyoṣair ardhapalonmitaiḥ
verses.tib: zho dang gdugs ni dkar po dag / lha rnams kyi ni gtor mar 'dod / shing kun nyungs kar shu dag dang / tsha ba gsum ni srang phyed phyed / mar bre gang dang ba yi gcin

verses.skt: caturguṇe gavāṃ mūtre ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet | tatpānanāvanābhyaṅgair devagrahavimokṣaṇam
verses.tib: bzhi 'gyur dang ni lhan cig bskol / de btung snar blugs bskus pa yis / lha yi gdon las thar bar byed

verses.skt: nasyāñjanaṃ vacāhiṅgulaśunaṃ bastavāriṇā | daitye balir bahuphalaḥ sośīrakamalotpalaḥ
verses.tib: shu dag shing kun sgog skya rnams / ra gcin sbyar ba snar blugs dang / mig / bskus lha yi gdon las thar / lha min gtor ma 'bras bu ni / mang po dag dang pu shel tse

verses.skt: nāgānāṃ sumanolājaguḍāpūpaguḍaudanaiḥ | paramānnamadhukṣīrakṛṣṇamṛnnāgakesaraiḥ
verses.tib: klu yi gdon la dzA ti dang / 'bras yos bu ram snum khur dang / 'bras chan bu ram bcas pa dang / zas mchog 'o ma sbrang rtsi dang / sa nag nA ga ge sar dang

verses.skt: vacāpadmapurośīraraktotpaladalair baliḥ | śvetapattraṃ ca lodhraṃ ca tagaraṃ nāgasarṣapāḥ
verses.tib: shu dag pad+ma pu shel tse / ut+pal pad+ma dmar po yi / 'dab mar bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin / seng phrom lo ma dkar po dang / rgya sbos nA ga ge sar dang

verses.skt: śītena vāriṇā piṣṭaṃ nāvanāñjanayor hitam | yakṣāṇāṃ kṣīradadhyājyamiśrakaudanaguggulu
verses.tib: nyungs kar chu grang la btags pas / snar blugs mig tu bskus pa'ang phan / gnod sbyin gdon la 'o ma zho / mar dang 'bras chan bsres pa dang

verses.skt: devadārūtpalaṃ padmaṃ uśīraṃ vastrakāñcanam | hiraṇyaṃ ca balir yojyo mūtrājyakṣīram ekataḥ
verses.tib: gu gul pad+ma thang shing dang / pu shel tse dang gos dang gser / dbyig ni gtor mar sbyin par bya / mar dang 'o ma ba gcin ni

verses.skt: siddhaṃ samonmitaṃ pānanāvanābhyañjane hitam | harītakī haridre dve laśuno maricaṃ vacā
verses.tib: cha mnyam bskol ba btung ba dang / snar blugs lus la bskus na phan / a ru ra dang ser po gnyis / sgog skya shu dag na le sham

verses.skt: nimbapattraṃ ca bastāmbukalkitaṃ nāvanāñjanam | brahmarakṣobaliḥ siddhaṃ yavānāṃ pūrṇam āḍhakam
verses.tib: nim pa'i lo mar gcin btags / lde gus sna sman mig sman bya / tshangs pa srin po'i gtor ma ni / nas bre bzhi ni btsos pa yis

verses.skt: toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chattraṃ vastram vilepanam | gāyatrīviṃśatipalakvāthe ’rdhapalikaiḥ pacet
verses.tib: chu bre bcu drug til btags bsres / gdugs dang gos dang byug pa sbyin / seng ldeng srang ni nyi shu dang

verses.skt: tryūṣaṇatriphalāhiṅguṣaḍgranthāmiśisarṣapaiḥ | sanimbapattralaśunaiḥ kuḍavān sapta sarpiṣaḥ
verses.tib: tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum / shing kun shu dag shu ti dang / nyungs kar nim pa'i lo mar bcas / sgog skya srang ni phyed phyed dang / zhun mar phul ni bdun dag dang

verses.skt: gomūtre triguṇe pānanasyābhyaṅgeṣu tad dhitam | rakṣasāṃ palalaṃ śuklaṃ kusumaṃ miśrakaudanam
verses.tib: ba gcin sum 'gyur bskol ba de / btung dang snar blugs bskus na phan / srin po'i gdon la til phye dang / me tog dkar po 'bras chan bsres

verses.skt: baliḥ pakvāmamāṃsāni niṣpāvā rudhirokṣitāḥ | naktamālaśirīṣatvaṅmūlapuṣpaphalāni ca
verses.tib: sha btsos rjen pa nim pa la / khrag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin / nag ta ma la shri sha yi / shun lpags me tog 'bras bu dang

verses.skt: tadvac ca kṛṣṇapāṭalyā bilvamūlaṃ kaṭutrikam | hiṅgvindrayavasiddhārthalaśunāmalakīphalam
verses.tib: de bzhin pa ta la nag po / bil ba'i rtsa ba tsha ba gsum / shing kun nyungs kar dug mo nyung / sgog skya skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu

verses.skt: nāvanāñjanayor yojyo bastamūtrayuto ’gadaḥ | ebhir eva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe
verses.tib: ra gcin dang ni sbyar ba'i sman / snar blugs mig tu byugs na'ang phan / 'di dag nyid dang mar gyis ni / bzhi 'gyur ba gcin bskol ba ni

verses.skt: rakṣograhān vārayate pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ | piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi
verses.tib: btung dang snar blugs bskus pa yis / srin po'i gdon ni zlog par byed / sha za la ni bu ram chang / til tshig til gyi phye ma zho

verses.skt: mūlakaṃ lavaṇaṃ sarpiḥ sabhūtaudanayāvakam | haridrādvayamañjiṣṭhāmiśisaindhavanāgaram
verses.tib: la phug lan tshwa phye zan mar / 'byung po 'bras chan gtor ma sbyin / ser po rnam gnyis rgyam tsha btsod / shu ti dong gra pri yang ku

verses.skt: hiṅgupriyaṅgutrikaṭulaśunatriphalā vacā | pāṭalīśvetakaṭabhīśirīṣakusumair ghṛtam
verses.tib: shing kun sgog skya tsha ba gsum / 'bras bu gsum dang pa ta li / shu dag gi ri kar+Ni dkar / shi ri sha yi me tog dmar

verses.skt: gomūtrapādikaṃ siddhaṃ pānābhyañjanayor hitam | bastāmbupiṣṭais tair eva yojyam añjananāvanam
verses.tib: ba gcin bzhi cha bcas par bskol / btung dang bsku ba byas na phan / yang na de nyid ra gcin btags / mig bskus snar ni blugs pa phan

verses.skt: devarṣipitṛgandharve tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi varjayet | sarpiḥpānādi mṛdv asmin bhaiṣajyam avacārayet
verses.tib: lha dang drang srong mtshun lha dang / dri za'i gdon la sna sman / rnon po btang bar mi bya zhing / 'di la zhun mar btung la sogs / sman ni 'jam po spyad par bya

verses.skt: ṛte piśācāt sarveṣu pratikūlaṃ ca nācaret | savaidyam āturaṃ ghnanti kruddhās te hi mahaujasaḥ
verses.tib: sha za ma gtogs thams cad la / mi mthun sbyin par mi bya ste / mthu stobs che ba de khros nas / nad pa sman pa bcas gsod byed

verses.skt: īśvaraṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ nātham āryāvalokitam | sarvavyādhicikitsāṃ ca japan sarvagrahān jayet
verses.tib: 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug / mgon po phyag ni bcu gnyis pa / nad kun gso bar mdzad pa yi / sngags bzlas na ni nad kun sel

verses.skt: tathonmādān apasmārān anyaṃ vā cittaviplavam | mahāvidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ śuciṃ taṃ śrāvayet sadā
verses.tib: de bzhin smyo byed brjed byed dang / gzhan yang sems 'khrul byed pa 'joms / rig sngags rgyal mo rma bya che / gtsang byas de la rtag tu bsgrags

verses.skt: bhūteśaṃ pūjayet sthāṇuṃ pramathākhyāṃś ca tadgaṇān | japan siddhāṃś ca tanmantrān grahān sarvān apohati
verses.tib: 'byung po'i bdag po lha chen dang / de yi 'khor gyi tshogs mchod cing / de yi sngags grub bzlas na yang / gdon ni thams cad sel bar byed

verses.skt: yac cānantarayoḥ kiñcid vakṣyate ’dhyāyayor hitam | yac coktam iha tat sarvaṃ prayuñjīta parasparam
verses.tib: gang yang 'og nas bshad pa yi / le'u gnyis las smos pa dang / gang 'dir bshad pa de dag kun / phan tshun sbyor ba byas na phan

verses.skt: unmādāḥ ṣaṭ pṛthagdoṣanicayādhiviṣodbhavāḥ | unmādo nāma manaso doṣair unmārgagair madaḥ
verses.tib: smyo byed nad gzhi re re dang / 'dus dug las gyur pa drug / smyo byed ces bya lus dang ni / sems kyi nad lam log pa ru / zhugs pas smyos par gyur pa yin

verses.skt: śārīramānasair duṣṭair ahitād annapānataḥ | vikṛtāsātmyasamalād viṣamād upayogataḥ
verses.tib: bza' btung gnod pa dag dang ni / snying dang ma goms dri mar bcas / mang nyung ma snyoms bsten pa dang

verses.skt: viṣaṇṇasyālpasattvasya vyādhivegasamudgamāt | kṣīṇasya ceṣṭāvaiṣamyāt pūjyapūjāvyatikramāt
verses.tib: yid zhum snying stobs chung ba dang / nad kyi shugs kyis dkrugs pa dang / rid cing spyod pa ma snyoms dang / mchod 'os mchod par mi byed dang

verses.skt: ādhibhir cittavibhraṃśād viṣeṇopaviṣeṇa ca | ebhir hi hīnasattvasya hṛdi doṣāḥ pradūṣitāḥ
verses.tib: sems las kyis ni sems nyams dang / dug dang nye ba'i dug las gyur / 'di yis snying stobs zhan pa yi / snying gi nad la gnod byas te

verses.skt: dhiyo vidhāya kāluṣyaṃ hṛtvā mārgān manovahān | unmādaṃ kurvate tena dhīvijñānasmṛtibhramāt
verses.tib: blo ni dri ma can byas te / yid rgyu ba yi lam bkag nas / smyo byed dag ni skyed par byed / de yis blo dang rnam shes dang / dran pa 'khrul zhing lus kyi ni

verses.skt: deho duḥkhasukhabhraṣṭo bhraṣṭasārathivad rathaḥ | bhramaty acintitārambhas tatra vātāt kṛśāṅgatā
verses.tib: bde dang sdug bsngal las nyams te / shing rta kha lo sgyur ba ni / med pa lta bur rtsom pa ni / kun kyang bsam pa med par spyod / de la rlung gyur lus sbeg cing

verses.skt: asthāne rodanākrośahasitasmitanartanam | gītavāditravāgaṅgavikṣepāsphoṭanāni ca
verses.tib: rgyu med ngu zhing tshig rtsub smra / dgod dang 'dzum dang gar byed dang / glu len rol mo byed pa dang / lus bskyod pheg ni rdob pa dang

verses.skt: asāmnā veṇuvīṇādiśabdānukaraṇaṃ muhuḥ | āsyāt phenāgamo ’jasram aṭanaṃ bahubhāṣitā
verses.tib: gling bu pi wang la sogs kyi / sgra yi lad mo yang yang zlos / rgyun du kha nas lbu ba 'dzag / phan tshun rgyug cing mang du smra

verses.skt: alaṅkāro ’nalaṅkārair ayānair gamanodyamaḥ | gṛddhir abhyavahāryeṣu tallābhe cāvamānatā
verses.tib: rgyan min pas ni rgyan du byed / bzhon pa min pas 'gro ba rtsom / kha zas la ni gdu bar byed / de rnyed na ni mi 'dod byed

verses.skt: utpiṇḍitāruṇākṣitvaṃ jīrṇe cānne gadodbhavaḥ | pittāt saṃtarjanaṃ krodho muṣṭiloṣṭādyabhidravaḥ
