verses.tib: mig zlum mig ni dmar ba dang / kha zas zhu nas nad ldang 'gyur / mkhris las spyo zhing khro ba dang / khu tshur bong ba rdeg cing rgyug

verses.skt: śītacchāyodakākāṅkṣā nagnatvaṃ pītavarṇatā | asatyajvalanajvālātārakādīpadarśanam
verses.tib: grib ma chu ni grang mo 'dod / gcer bur 'dug cing lus mdog ser / med par me ni 'bar ba dang / skar ma mar me mthong ba'o

verses.skt: kaphād arocakaś chardir alpehāhāravākyatā | strīkāmatā rahaḥprītir lālāsiṅghāṇakasrutiḥ
verses.tib: bad kan slon zhing yi ga 'chus / kha zas rtsol dang smra ba nyung / bud med 'dod cing dben la dga' / kha chu snabs ni 'dzag pa dang

verses.skt: baibhatsyaṃ śaucavidveṣo nidrā śvayathur ānane | unmādo balavān rātrau bhuktamātre ca jāyate
verses.tib: 'jigs rung gtsang sbra la mi dga' / gnyid che gdong ni skrangs pa dang / nub mo shes cher smyo ba dang / zos ma thag tu ldang ba yin

verses.skt: sarvāyatanasaṃsthānasaṃnipāte tadātmakam | unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet
verses.tib: 'dus pa'i rgyu dang mtshan ma ni / kun ldan de yi bdag nyid can / smyo byed mi bzad par shes bya / de ni sman pas yongs su spang

verses.skt: dhanakāntādināśena duḥsahenābhiṣaṅgavān | pāṇḍur dīno muhur muhyan hāheti paridevate
verses.tib: nor dang chung ma la sogs bral / brnag dka' ba las sems gdung bas / smyo zhing zhum la yang yang brgyal / kyi hud kyi hud smre sngags 'don

verses.skt: rodity akasmān mriyate tadguṇān bahu manyate | śokakliṣṭamanā dhyāyañ jāgarūko viceṣṭate
verses.tib: glo bur du ni ngu zhing brgyal / de yi yon tan mang du sems / mya ngan gyis gdungs sems khong chud / gnyid yar rnam par 'khyams pa yin

verses.skt: viṣeṇa śyāvavadano naṣṭacchāyābalendriyaḥ | vegāntare ’pi saṃbhrānto raktākṣas taṃ vivarjayet
verses.tib: dug gis gdong ni sngo ba dang / gzi nyams dbang po stobs chung ba / shugs kyi bar du'ang 'khrul bar byed / mig dmar de ni spang bar bya

verses.skt: athānilaja unmāde snehapānaṃ prayojayet | pūrvam āvṛtamārge tu sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanam
verses.tib: de nas rlung gyur smyo byed la / dang po snum gyi btung ba blud / lam 'gags gyur la dang por ni / snum bcas sbyang ba 'jam po bya

verses.skt: kaphapittabhave ’py ādau vamanaṃ savirecanam | snigdhasvinnasya vastiṃ ca śirasaḥ savirecanam
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris gyur dang po ni / snum dang dugs bya skyug sman dang / bkru sman mas gtong byas pa dang / mgo bo'i bkru sman dag kyang bya

verses.skt: tathāsya śuddhadehasya prasādaṃ labhate manaḥ | ittham apy anuvṛttau tu tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanam añjanam
verses.tib: de ltar lus ni dag byas na / yid ni dran pa rnyed par 'gyur / de lta na yang rjes 'brangs na / sna sman mig sman rnon po gtang

verses.skt: harṣaṇāśvāsanottrāsabhayatāḍanatarjanam | abhyaṅgodvartanālepadhūpān pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ
verses.tib: sems dga' dbugs 'byung skrag pa dang / 'jigs dang rdeg dang sdigs mo byed / lus dris byugs dang bsku ba dang / dud rngub sman mar blud pa dag

verses.skt: yuñjyāt tāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ | hiṅgusauvarcalavyoṣair dvipalāṃśair ghṛtāḍhakam
verses.tib: sbyar te de ni dga' 'gyur na / yid ni tha mal pa la sbyar / shing kun dang ni rtsab ru tsha / tsha ba gsum ni srang gnyis gnyis / mar bre bzhi ni ba gcin bcas

verses.skt: siddhaṃ samūtram unmādabhūtāpasmāranut param | dvau prasthau svarasād brāhmyā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam
verses.tib: bskol bas smyo byed 'byung po dang / brjed byed gdon ni sel mchog yin / bram+hi'i bskol khu bre do dang / mar bre gang dang tsha ba gsum

verses.skt: vyoṣaśyāmātrivṛddantīśaṅkhapuṣpīnṛpadrumaiḥ | sasaptalākṛmiharaiḥ kalkitair akṣasaṃmitaiḥ
verses.tib: sh+ya ma dur byid bim pa dang / shang ka puSh+pa dong ga dang / sap+ta la dang byi dang ga / zho ni gnyis gnyis lde gu bskol / pram+ti'i sman mar zhes bshad de / mar ni srang res bskyed de btang

verses.skt: palavṛddhyā prayuñjīta paraṃ mātrā catuḥpalam | unmādakuṣṭhāpasmāraharaṃ vandhyāsutapradam
verses.tib: che tshad srang bzhi'i mar pos na / smyo byed brjed byed mdze yi nad / sel zhing mo gsham bu skyed byed

verses.skt: vāksvarasmṛtimedhākṛd dhanyaṃ brāhmīghṛtaṃ smṛtam | varāviśālābhadrailādevadārvelavālukaiḥ
verses.tib: skad snyan tshig gsal dran pa dang / yid gzhungs dpal ni skyed par byed / 'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga / pa tra e la thang shing dang / e la ba lu ka dang ni

verses.skt: dviśārivādvirajanīdvisthirāphalinīnataiḥ | bṛhatīkuṣṭhamañjiṣṭhānāgakesaradāḍimaiḥ
verses.tib: thal tres rnam gnyis ser po gnyis / s+thi ra rnam gnyis pri yang ku / rgya spos ru rta bri ha ti / nA ga ge sar dong ga btsod

verses.skt: vellatālīśapattrailāmālatīmukulotpalaiḥ | sadantīpadmakahimaiḥ karṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet
verses.tib: se'u 'bru bal bu'i lo ma dang / dzA ti kha 'bus byi dang ga / dan da shu dag ut+pa la / tsan+dan dkar po zho gnyis ni / zhun mar bre gang bcas bskol ba

verses.skt: prasthaṃ bhūtagrahonmādakāsāpasmārapāpmasu | pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mohe mehe gare jvare
verses.tib: 'byung po'i gdon dang smyo byed dang / brjed byed lud pa sdig can 'joms / skya rbab g.yan pa skem dang dug / rmongs bag gcin snyi dbyig dug rims

verses.skt: aretasy aprajasi vā daivopahatacetasi | amedhasi skhaladvāci smṛtikāme ’lpapāvake
verses.tib: khu ba med pa'am bu med pa'am / dran pa gdon gyis brlabs pa dang / yid gzhungs med cing tshig 'khrul dang / dran nyams me drod chung la phan

verses.skt: balyaṃ maṅgalyam āyuṣyaṃ kāntisaubhāgyapuṣṭidam | kalyāṇakam idaṃ sarpiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṃsavaneṣu ca
verses.tib: stobs skyed bkra shis tshe ring zhing / mdangs skye skal ldan lus rgyas che / bu skyed byed pa'i mchog yin no

verses.skt: ebhyo dviśārivādīni jale paktvaikaviṃśatim | rase tasmin pacet sarpir gṛṣṭikṣīracaturguṇam
verses.tib: 'di la thal tres rnam gnyis sogs / nyi shu rtsa gcig chu dang bskol / de yi khu ba mar dang ba / lan cig skyes 'o bzhi 'gyur dang

verses.skt: vīrādvimedākākolīkapikacchūviṣāṇibhiḥ | śūrpaparṇīyutair etan mahākalyāṇakaṃ param
verses.tib: med rnam gnyis ra mnye ba / bung tshang rdo dang kha sral phre'u / bu ram shing dang par+Ni gnyis / bskol ba yi ni sman mar 'di / dge ba chen po zhes bya ste

verses.skt: bṛṃhaṇaṃ saṃnipātaghnaṃ pūrvasmād adhikaṃ guṇaiḥ | jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā
verses.tib: brtas byed 'dus pa'i nad 'joms shing / snga ma bas kyang yon tan lhag / spang spos bu ta ke shi dang / chu rtsa shu dag kha sral pre'u

verses.skt: trāyamāṇā jayā vīrā corakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī | vayaḥsthā śūkarī chattrā sāticchattrā palaṅkaṣā
verses.tib: kyi lce ba dang ram nye ba / tsa rong dza ya pu tse shel / sle tres tsa tra pa ra ha / a ti tsa ta sa ta la

verses.skt: mahāpuruṣadantā ca kāyasthā nākulīdvayam | kaṭambharā vṛścikālī śāliparṇī ca tair ghṛtam
verses.tib: ma hA pu ru sha dan dang / na gu li gnyis skyu ru ra / bri ka la ka dam pa / sA la par+Ni bcas bskol mar

verses.skt: siddhaṃ cāturthikonmādagrahāpasmāranāśanam | mahāpaiśācakaṃ nāma ghṛtam etad yathāmṛtam
verses.tib: sha za chen po'i mar zhes bya / des ni nyin bzhi pa'i rims dang / smyo byed brjed byed gdon 'joms shing

verses.skt: buddhimedhāsmṛtikaraṃ bālānāṃ cāṅgavardhanam | brāhmīm aindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu jaṭāṃ murām
verses.tib: blo dang yid gzhungs dran pa skyed / byis pa rnams kyi lus 'phel byed / bdud rtsi dang ni 'dra ba yin / bram+hi in+d+ra byi dang ka / shing kun / spang sbos mur ba dang / ra sna sgog skya bong nga dkar

verses.skt: rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām | jyotiṣmatīṃ nāgavinnām anantāṃ saharītakīm
verses.tib: shu dag bye'u rug bi sha la / nA ga dan ti byi tsher ba / dzo ti sma ti tsha ba gsum / a ru ra dang sa nag rnams

verses.skt: kāṅkṣīṃ ca hastimūtreṇa piṣṭvā chāyāviśoṣītā | vartir nasyāñjanālepadhūpair unmādasūdanī
verses.tib: glang po'i gcin btags ri lur byas / grib bskams snar blugs mig bsku zhing / lus bskus spos bdugs smyo byed sel

verses.skt: avapīḍāś ca vividhāḥ sarṣapāḥ snehasaṃyutāḥ | kaṭutailena cābhyaṅgo dhmāpayec cāsya tad rajaḥ
verses.tib: nyungs kar dang ni sbyar ba yi / sna sman rnam pa sna tshogs phan / nyungs mar gyis ni lus bsku dang / nyungs kar phye ma snar bud bya

verses.skt: sahiṅgus tīkṣṇadhūmaś ca sūtrasthānodito hitaḥ | śṛgālaśalyakolūkajalaukāvṛṣabastajaiḥ
verses.tib: mdo gnas bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin / dung rnon shing kun bcas pa phan / wa dang reg 'jam 'ug pa dang / byi ba ra thug dza ti ka'i

verses.skt: mūtrapittaśakṛdromanakhacarmabhir ācaret | dhūpadhūmāñjanābhyaṅgapradehapariṣecanam
verses.tib: gcin dang rtug pa spu dang ni / pags pa mkhris pa sen mo dang / spos bdugs mig sman lus bsku dang

verses.skt: dhūpayet satataṃ cainaṃ śvagomatsyaiḥ supūtibhiḥ | vātaśleṣmātmake prāyaḥ paittike tu praśasyate
verses.tib: byugs dang blugs pa bshad par bya / bad kan rlung gyur la phal cher / khyi dang ba lang nya sha ni / rul ba'i bdug pas bdug par bya

verses.skt: tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaś ca miśrakaḥ | śītāni cānnapānāni madhurāṇi laghūni ca
verses.tib: mkhris gyur la ni tig ta'i mar / 'tsho byed snum ni gnyis kyi mar / bza' dang btung ba bsil ba dang / mngar ba dang ni yang ba bsngags

verses.skt: vidhyet sirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā | nivāte śāyayed evaṃ mucyate mativibhramāt
verses.tib: ji skad bshad pa'i gtar ga gdab / yang na sha tshon gyis 'grangs bya / de 'og rlung med gnas bsnyal nas / sems myos pa las thar bar 'gyur

verses.skt: prakṣipyāsalile kūpe śoṣayed vā bubhukṣayā | āśvāsayet suhṛt taṃ vā vākyair dharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ
verses.tib: khron pa'i chu ni nyung bar gzhug / ltogs pa nyid du byas te bskams / de la chos dang nor ldan pa'i / gtam snyan mdza' bos sems dga' bya

verses.skt: brūyād iṣṭavināśaṃ vā darśayed adbhutāni vā | baddhaṃ sarṣapatailāktaṃ nyased vottānam ātape
verses.tib: yang na sdug dang bral ba'am / rmad du byung ba bstan pa'am / bcings la yungs mar gyis bskus te / nyi tshan la ni gan rkyal gzhag

verses.skt: kapikacchvāthavā taptair lohatailajalaiḥ spṛśet | kaśābhis tāḍayitvā vā baddhaṃ śvabhre viniḥkṣipet
verses.tib: kha sral phre'u'am lcags tsha'am / til mar chu tshan gyis reg bya / yang na lcag gis gzhus nas ni / bcings te g.yang sar skyur bar bya

verses.skt: athavā vītaśastrāśmajane saṃtamase gṛhe | sarpeṇoddhṛtadaṃṣṭreṇa dāntaiḥ siṃhair gajaiś ca tam
verses.tib: yang na rdo dang mtshon med pa'i / mun khang mi ni med par gzhug / mche ba ston pa'i sbrul dang ni / glang dang seng ge glang po ches

verses.skt: trāsayec chastrahastair vā kirātārātitaskaraiḥ
verses.tib: de ni skrag tu gzhug pa'am

verses.skt: athavā rājapuruṣā bahir nītvā susaṃyatam | bhāpayeyur vadhenainaṃ tarjayanto nṛpājñayā
verses.tib: yang na rgyal po'i skyes bu / yis / dam du bcings te phyir phyung nas / rgyal po'i bka' yis bsdigs pa dang / 'di bsad bya zhes skrag tu gzhug

verses.skt: dehaduḥkhabhayebhyo hi paraṃ prāṇabhayaṃ matam | tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ
verses.tib: lus kyi sdug bsngal 'jigs pa bas / srog gi 'jigs par rab 'jigs pas / de phyir kun tu 'khrul pa'i yid / nye bar zhi ba nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: siddhā kriyā prayojyeyaṃ deśakālādyapekṣayā | iṣṭadravyavināśāt tu mano yasyopahanyate
verses.tib: grub pa'i sbyor ba 'di dag ni / nad dmigs dus sogs ltos te bya / sdug dang nor dang bral ba las / gang gi yid la gnod gyur pa

verses.skt: tasya tatsadṛśaprāptisāntvāśvāsaiḥ śamaṃ nayet | kāmaśokabhayakrodhaharṣerṣyālobhasaṃbhavān
verses.tib: de la de 'dra rnyed gyur pa'i / spro bsring dbugs dbyung ba yis gso / 'dod dang mya ngan 'jigs pa dang / khro dang 'jigs pa chang las gyur

verses.skt: parasparapratidvandvair ebhir eva śamaṃ nayet | bhūtānubandham īkṣeta proktaliṅgādhikākṛtim
verses.tib: gnyis dag gis ni gcig la gcig / de dag nyid kyis zhi bar bya / bshad pa'i mtshan ma las lhag pa / gdon dang rjes 'brel yin zhes bya

verses.skt: yady unmāde tataḥ kuryād bhūtanirdiṣṭam auṣadham | baliṃ ca dadyāt palalaṃ yāvakaṃ saktupiṇḍikām
verses.tib: gal te smyo byed gdon las gyur / gdon gsor bshad pa'i sman sbyar bya / til btags phye ma nas dang zan

verses.skt: snigdhaṃ madhuram āhāraṃ taṇḍulān rudhirokṣitān | pakvāmakāni māṃsāni surāṃ maireyam āsavam
verses.tib: snum zhing mngar ba'i kha zas dang / 'bras ni khrag tu sbrus pa dang / sha ni btses pa rjen pa dang / 'bru chang sbyar chang mnan pa'i chang

verses.skt: atimuktasya puṣpāṇi jātyāḥ sahacarasya ca | catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṃgameṣu ca
verses.tib: a ti mug+ti'i me tog dang / dzA ti sa ha ra dza yi / me tog bcas pa'i gtor ma ni / lam gyi bzhi mdo ba lang lhas / chu bo 'dus pa dag tu sbyin

verses.skt: nivṛttāmiṣamadyo yo hitāśī prayataḥ śuciḥ | nijāgantubhir unmādaiḥ sattvavān na sa yujyate
verses.tib: gang zhig sha dang chang spangs shing / phan la brtson zhing gtsang sbra che / snying stobs can la lhan cig skyes / glo bur smyo byed 'byung mi 'gyur

verses.skt: prasāda indriyārthānāṃ buddhyātmamanasāṃ tathā | dhātūnāṃ prakṛtisthatvaṃ vigatonmādalakṣaṇam
verses.tib: dbang po'i don ni gsal ba dang / de bzhin blo dang yid gsal ba / lus zungs tha mal par gnas pa / smyo byed dang bral mtshan ma yin

verses.skt: smṛtyapāyo hy apasmāraḥ sa dhīsattvābhisaṃplavāt | jāyate ’bhihate citte cintāśokabhayādibhiḥ
verses.tib: brjed byed dran pa nyams pa ste / de ni snying stobs blo 'khrul dang / sems las mya ngan 'jigs sogs kyis

verses.skt: unmādavat prakupitaiś cittadehagatair malaiḥ | hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca
verses.tib: gnod gyur sems las byung ba yin / lus sems gtogs pa'i nad kyis ni / smyo byed bzhin du 'khrug 'gyur bas / snying stobs nyams zhing snying dang ni / 'du shes rgyu ba'i rtsa sbubs khyab

verses.skt: tamo viśan mūḍhamatir bībhatsāḥ kurute kriyāḥ | dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan
verses.tib: mun par zhugs snyam sems shing rmongs / 'jigs su rung ba'i bya ba byed / so 'cha' lbu ba skyug pa dang / lag pa rkang pa g.yob pa dang

verses.skt: paśyann asanti rūpāṇi praskhalan patati kṣitau | vijihmākṣibhruvo doṣavege ’tīte vibudhyate
verses.tib: gzugs med par yang mthong ba dang / 'khrul zhing sa la 'gyel ba dang / smin ma mi g.yo nad shugs dang / bral nas sad par gyur pa dang

verses.skt: kālāntareṇa sa punaś caivam eva viceṣṭate | apasmāraś caturbhedo vātādyair nicayena ca
verses.tib: de ni dus gzhan dag tu yang / de bzhin du ni spyod pa yin / rlung la sogs dang 'dus pa yi / dbye bas brjed byed rnam pa bzhi

verses.skt: rūpam utpatsyamāne ’smin hṛtkampaḥ śūnyatā bhramaḥ | tamaso darśanaṃ dhyānaṃ bhrūvyudāso ’kṣivaikṛtam
verses.tib: de ni skye bar gyur pa'i tshul / snying 'dar khong stong mgo 'khor la / mun par mthong zhing sems khong chud / smin ma mi sdug mig 'gyur dang

verses.skt: aśabdaśravaṇaṃ svedo lālāsiṅghāṇakasrutiḥ | avipāko ’rucir mūrchā kukṣyāṭopo balakṣayaḥ
verses.tib: sgra mi thos shing rngul 'byung la / kha chu snabs ni 'dzag pa dang / mi 'ju yi ga 'chus shing brgyal / lto sbos nyams stobs zad pa dang

verses.skt: nidrānāśo ’ṅgamardas tṛṭ svapne gānaṃ sanartanam | pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayor eva ca mehanam
verses.tib: gnyid med skom zhing yan lag na / rmi lam glu len gar byed dang / til mar chang ni 'thung ba dang / de nyid gcin du 'byung ba rmi

verses.skt: tatra vātāt sphuratsakthiḥ prapataṃś ca muhur muhuḥ | apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan
verses.tib: de la rlung gyur brla 'gul zhing / yang dang yang du 'gyel ba dang / yang dang yang du dran pa stor / 'du shes rnyed nas mi gsal du

verses.skt: utpiṇḍitākṣaḥ śvasiti phenaṃ vamati kampate | āvidhyati śiro dantān daśaty ādhmātakandharaḥ
verses.tib: mig 'bur yang yang dbugs 'byin zhing / lbu bar skyug cing 'dar ba dang / so 'cha' mgo ni rdebs pa dang / rlung gis gre ba rgyas par byed

verses.skt: parito vikṣipaty aṅgaṃ viṣamaṃ vinatāṅguliḥ | rūkṣaśyāvāruṇākṣitvaṅnakhāsyaḥ kṛṣṇam īkṣate
verses.tib: yan lag kun du rdebs pa dang / sor mo mi snyoms 'gugs pa dang / mig dang pags pa sen mo ni / gnag cing rtsub mor snang ba dang

verses.skt: capalaṃ paruṣaṃ rūpaṃ virūpaṃ vikṛtānanam | apasmarati pittena muhuḥ saṃjñāṃ ca vindati
verses.tib: gzugs ni mi brtan rtsub pa dang / mi sdug bzhin ras ngan pa yin / mkhris pa las gyur brjed byed ni / dran pa yang yang nyams pa dang

verses.skt: pītaphenākṣivaktratvag āsphālayati medinīm | bhairavādīptaruṣitarūpadarśī tṛṣānvitaḥ
verses.tib: mig mdog pags pa lbu ba ser / sa la rdeg par byed pa dang / 'jigs rung 'bar zhing khro ba yi / gzugs mthong skom dad che ba yin

verses.skt: kaphāc cireṇa grahaṇaṃ cireṇaiva vibodhanam | ceṣṭālpā bhūyasī lālā śuklanetranakhāsyatā
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur ring nas 'dzin / yung ring nyid nas sad par byed / g.yo 'gul nyung zhing kha chu mang / kha mig pags pa sen mo dkar

verses.skt: śuklābharūpadarśitvaṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ tu varjayet | athāvṛtānāṃ dhīcittahṛtkhānāṃ prākprabodhanam
verses.tib: gzugs / rnams dkar por mthong ba yin / mtshan nyid kun dang ldan pa spang / de nas blo sems dran pa dang / snying ga'i sbubs ni sad byed pa'i

verses.skt: tīkṣṇaiḥ kuryād apasmāre karmabhir vamanādibhiḥ | vātikaṃ vastibhūyiṣṭhaiḥ paittaṃ prāyo virecanaiḥ
verses.tib: slon sman la sogs las rnams ni / rnon po yis ni sbyang bar bya / rlung gyur 'jam rtsi mang du bya / mkhris gyur phal cher bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanaprāyair apasmāram upācaret | sarvataḥ suviśuddhasya samyag āśvāsitasya ca
verses.tib: bad kan phal cher skyug sman ni / btang bas brjed byed gso bar bya / rnam pa kun tu legs dag cing / legs par spro ni bsring ba la

verses.skt: apasmāravimokṣārthaṃ yogān saṃśamanāñ chṛṇu | gomayasvarasakṣīradadhimūtraiḥ śṛtaṃ haviḥ
verses.tib: brjed byed las ni thar bya'i phyir / zhi bar bya ba'i sbyor bar nyon / ba lci khu ba 'o ma dang / zho dang gcin dang mar bskol ba

verses.skt: apasmārajvaronmādakāmalāntakaraṃ pibet | dvipañcamūlatriphalādviniśākuṭajatvacaḥ
verses.tib: brjed byed rims dang smyo byed dang / mig ser sel bar byed pa blud / rtsa ba bcu pa 'bras bu gsum / dug mo nyung shun ser po gnyis

verses.skt: saptaparṇam apāmārgaṃ nīlinīṃ kaṭurohiṇīm | śamyākapuṣkarajaṭāphalgumūladurālabhāḥ
verses.tib: a pa marga lo ma bdun / ni li ni dang pu tse shel / dong ga puSh+kar mU la dang / phal gu'i rtsa ba byi tsher srang

verses.skt: dvipalāḥ saliladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite | bhārgīpāṭhāḍhakīkumbhanikumbhavyoṣarohiṣaiḥ
verses.tib: gnyis gnyis chu bre bcu drug nang / bskol ba la ni bzhi cha lus / ga bra'i rtsa ba du ba ri / pa ta dan da dur byid dang / tsha ba gsum dang ro hi She

verses.skt: mūrvābhūtikabhūnimbaśreyasīśārivādvayaiḥ | madayantyagniniculair akṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet
verses.tib: mur ba rtsa mkhris bu di kha / ha ti pi pi ling dang ni / ma du yan te thal tres gnyis / lcang ma dang ni tsi tra ka / zho ni gnyis gnyis mar bre gang

verses.skt: prasthaṃ tadvad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañcagavyam idaṃ mahat | jvarāpasmārajaṭharabhagandaraharaṃ param
verses.tib: de bzhin snga ma'i gsher rdzas bskol / 'di ni ba yi rnam lnga che / brjed byed rims dang dmu rdzing dang / mtshan par rdol ba sel mchog yin

verses.skt: śophārśaḥkāmalāpāṇḍugulmakāsagrahāpaham | brāhmīrasavacākuṣṭhaśaṅkhapuṣpīśṛtaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: 'or nad gzhang 'brum mig ser dang / skya rbab skran dang lud pa dang / gdon rnams 'joms par byed pa yin / bram+hi shu dag ru rta dang / shang ka puSh+pa mar rnying bcas / bskol ba'i mar ni yid gzhungs byed

verses.skt: purāṇaṃ medhyam unmādālakṣmyapasmārapāpmajit | tailaprasthaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ
verses.tib: smyo byed bkra mi shis pa dang / brjed byed sdig pa 'joms par byed / 'tsho byed sde tshan srang re dang / til mar zhun mar bre re bsres / 'o ma bre ni bcu drug bskol

verses.skt: kṣīradroṇe pacet siddham apasmāravimokṣaṇam | kaṃse kṣīrekṣurasayoḥ kāśmarye ’ṣṭaguṇe rase
verses.tib: 'thungs na brjed byed las thar byed / 'o ma bu ram shing khu ba / bre bzhi dang ni tang pal gyi / khu ba brgyad 'gyur dag dang ni / 'tsho byed sde tshan zho gnyis gnyis

verses.skt: kārṣikair jīvanīyaiś ca sarpiḥprasthaṃ vipācayet | vātapittodbhavaṃ kṣipram apasmāraṃ nihanti tat
verses.tib: zhun mar bre gang bcas bskol blud / des / ni rlung mkhris las gyur pa'i / brjed byed myur du sel bar byed

verses.skt: tadvat kāśavidārīkṣukuśakvāthaśṛtaṃ payaḥ | kūṣmāṇḍasvarase sarpir aṣṭādaśaguṇe śṛtam
verses.tib: de bzhin 'jag ma'i bid ri / ku sha bu ram shing 'o ma / bskol ba 'thungs pa'ang de dang 'dra / ku sman ta yi khu ba mar / bco brgyad 'gyur dang shing mngar gyi / lde gur bcas pa bskol bas ni

verses.skt: yaṣṭīkalkam apasmāraharaṃ dhīvāksvarapradam | kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nāvane paramaṃ hitam
verses.tib: brjed byed sel bar byed pa dang / blo dang tshig gsal skad snyan byed / ba ni ser skya'i mkhris pa yi / sna sman btang yang mchog tu phan

verses.skt: śvaśṛgālabiḍālānāṃ siṃhādīnāṃ ca pūjitam | godhānakulanāgānāṃ pṛṣatarkṣagavām api
verses.tib: khyi dang wa dang byi la dang / seng ge sogs kyi mkhris pa bsngags / go da sre mo glang po che / ba lang dred dang pri sha ta'i

verses.skt: pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye ’bhyaṅge ca śasyate | triphalāvyoṣapītadruyavakṣāraphaṇijjakaiḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa til mar bskol ba dag / lus bsku snar ni blugs na'ang phan / 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum / nas tshig 'khus thal ko nyon tshe / pha ni dza ka sra rtsi pog

verses.skt: śryāhvāpāmārgakārañjabījais tailaṃ vipācitam | bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā dhmāpayed bhiṣak
verses.tib: a pa marga ka rany+dza'i / sa bon til mar ra gcin dang / bcas pa bskol ba snar blugs pa'am / phye ma sna nas bus pa'ang phan

verses.skt: nakulolūkamārjāragṛdhrakīṭāhikākajaiḥ | tuṇḍaiḥ pakṣaiḥ purīṣaiś ca dhūpam asya prayojayet
verses.tib: sre mo 'ug pa spre'u dang / bya rgod khyi rta bya rog sbrul / chu dang sgro dang rtug pa yi / dud pas 'di la bdug par bya

verses.skt: śīlayet tailalaśunaṃ payasā vā śatāvarīm | brāhmīrasaṃ kuṣṭharasaṃ vacāṃ vā madhusaṃyutām
verses.tib: til mar sgog skya bcas pa'am / 'o ma nye'u shing bsten yang phan / bram+hi 'am ru rta'i khu ba'am / shu dag sbrang rtsir ldan pa'ang phan

verses.skt: samaṃ kruddhair apasmāro doṣaiḥ śārīramānasaiḥ | yaj jāyate yataś caiṣa mahāmarmasamāśrayaḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi mnyam du 'khrugs pa las / lus dang sems la brten 'gyur nad / skyes par gyur pa gang yin de / brjed byed gnad ni chen por gnas

verses.skt: tasmād rasāyanair enaṃ duścikitsyam upācaret | tadārtaṃ cāgnitoyāder viṣamāt pālayet sadā
verses.tib: de bas gso dka' 'di la ni / bcud kyis len gyis gso bar bya / des nyen me dang chu la sogs / ya nga ba las rtag tu bsrung

verses.skt: muktaṃ manovikāreṇa tvam itthaṃ kṛtavān iti | na brūyād viṣayair iṣṭaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ ceto ’sya bṛṃhayet
verses.tib: thar pa na ni yid 'khrul bas / khyed kyis 'di ltar byas so zhes / mi brjod yul ni yid 'ong bas / nyams pa'i sems ni brta bar bya

verses.skt: sarvaroganidānoktair ahitaiḥ kupitā malāḥ | acakṣuṣyair viśeṣeṇa prāyaḥ pittānusāriṇaḥ
verses.tib: nad kun nad gzhi las bshad pa'i / gnod pas nad ni 'khrugs pa dang / mchog tu mig la gnod pa dang / phal cher mkhris pa skyed pa yis

verses.skt: sirābhir ūrdhvaṃ prasṛtā netrāvayavam āśritāḥ | vartma saṃdhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvam akṣi vā
verses.tib: rtsa las gyen du rgyus nas ni / mig gi yan lag mig mchu grwa / dkar nag mthong byed rgyal mo'am / mig kun la gnas nad skyed byed / de la rlung ni mig mchu yi / rtsa la zhugs par gyur pa dag / nyal nas ldang tshe mig mchu ni / har bag na dang bcas par byed

verses.skt: rogān kuryuś calas tatra prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ sirāḥ | suptotthitasya kurute vartmastambhaṃ savedanam
verses.tib: rtsa las gyen du rgyus nas ni / mig gi yan lag mig mchu grwa / dkar nag mthong byed rgyal mo'am / mig kun la gnas nad skyed byed / de la rlung ni mig mchu yi / rtsa la zhugs par gyur pa dag / nyal nas ldang tshe mig mchu ni / har bag na dang bcas par byed

verses.skt: pāṃsupūrṇābhanetratvaṃ kṛcchronmīlanam aśru ca | vimardanāt syāc ca śamaḥ kṛcchronmūlaṃ vadanti tat
verses.tib: mig ni rdul gyis gang snyam sems / 'dzums par dka' zhing mchi ma 'dzag / mnyes na bde ba snyam du byed / de ni 'dzums dka' yin zhes bshad

verses.skt: cālayan vartmanī vāyur nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ | karoty aruṅ nimeṣo ’sau vartma yat tu nimīlyate
verses.tib: rlung gis mig mchu bskyod nas ni / yang dang yang du 'byed cing 'dzums / 'di ni 'dzums pa zhes bshad do / gra mtshams lhod cing tshor ba med

verses.skt: vimuktasaṃdhi niśceṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ vātahataṃ hi tat | kṛṣṇāḥ pittena bahvyo ’ntarvartma kumbhīkabījavat
verses.tib: gang yin de ni rlung gnod yin / mkhris pas mig mchu'i mtha' mar ni / 'brum bu ku mu ta yi ni / sa bon 'dra slar gang gyur pa

verses.skt: ādhmāyante punar bhinnāḥ piṭikāḥ kumbhisaṃjñitāḥ | sadāhakledanistodaṃ raktābhaṃ sparśanākṣamam
verses.tib: 'brum phran ku mu ta zhes bya / tsha zhing 'drul la nad dang bcas / dmar zhing reg na mi bzod pa

verses.skt: pittena jāyate vartma pittotkliṣṭam uśanti tat | karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣṃāntam āsthitam
verses.tib: mkhris pas mig mchur skyes pa de / mkhris pas skyes pa yin zhes bshad / mkhris pa rdzi ma'i nang gnas shing / g.ya' zhing tsha bar byed pa dang

verses.skt: pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam | pothakyaḥ piṭikāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapābhā ghanāḥ kaphāt
verses.tib: de rjes rdzi ma 'byi ba ste / rdzi ma 'byi ba zhes bshad do / bad kan las gyur mig mchu'i nad / 'brum phran dkar po yungs kar 'dra

verses.skt: śophopadeharukkaṇḍūpicchilāśrusamanvitāḥ | kaphotkliṣṭaṃ bhaved vartma stambhakledopadehavat
verses.tib: mthug skrangs g.ya' na mig rdul khebs / spyi bag can 'dzag po dag kyang / har bag 'drul ba rdu mas khebs

verses.skt: granthiḥ pāṇḍurarukpākaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaḥ kaphāt | kolamātraḥ sa lagaṇaḥ kiñcid alpas tato ’thavā
verses.tib: bad kan gyis bslangs mig mchu'i nad / bad kan las gyur rmen bu dkar / na zhing smin ma med g.ya' sra / rgya shug tsam mam de las ni / cung zad chung ba chags pa yin

verses.skt: raktā raktena piṭikā tattulyapiṭikācitā | utsaṅgākhyā tathotkliṣṭaṃ rājīmat sparśanākṣamam
verses.tib: khrag las 'brum phran dmar ba dang / de mtshungs 'brum phran gyis khyab pa / brtsegs pa zhes bya des skyed dmar / reg mi bzod pa mig mchu slongs

verses.skt: arśo ’dhimāṃsaṃ vartmāntaḥ stabdhaṃ snigdhaṃ sadāharuk | raktaṃ raktena tatsrāvi cchinnaṃ chinnaṃ ca vardhate
verses.tib: mig mchu'i nang du sha lhag / ni / sra zhing snum la tsha zhing na / mdog dmar de ni khrag 'dzag cing / bcad bzhin 'phel byed mig 'brum yin

verses.skt: madhye vā vartmano ’nte vā kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā | mudgamātrāsṛjā tāmrā piṭikāñjananāmikā
verses.tib: mig mchu'i mtha' 'am dbus su ni / g.ya' zhing tshal na bcas brtan / mung+ga tsam gyi khrag 'brum dmar / 'brum phran mig nad ces bya'o

verses.skt: doṣair vartma bahiḥ śūnaṃ yad antaḥ sūkṣmakhācitam | sasrāvam antarudakaṃ bisābhaṃ bisavartma tat
verses.tib: nad kyis mig mchu'i phyi rol skrangs / nang du bu ga phra mos khyab / 'dzag bcas nang na chu yod de / pad+ma'i rtsa 'dra pad rtsa yin

verses.skt: yad vartmotkliṣṭam utkliṣṭam akasmān mlānatām iyāt | raktadoṣatrayotkleśād bhavaty utkliṣṭavartma tat
verses.tib: nad gzhi gsum dang khrag 'khrugs pas / mig mchu'i nad ni ldang ba dang / rgyu med par ni gnyid 'gyur gang / de ni mig mchu 'khrugs zhes bya / nad kyis mig mchu dri ma khrag

verses.skt: śyāvavartma malaiḥ sāsraiḥ śyāvaṃ rukkledaśophavat | śliṣṭākhyaṃ vartmanī śliṣṭe kaṇḍūśvayathurāgiṇī
verses.tib: skrangs rnags na bcas mig mchu sngo / g.ya' zhing skrangs la dmar ba dang / mig mchu 'byar ba 'byar zhes bya / mig mchu'i nad ni sra zhing rtsub

verses.skt: vartmano ’ntaḥ kharā rūkṣāḥ piṭikāḥ sikatopamāḥ | sikatāvartma kṛṣṇaṃ tu kardamaṃ kardamopamam
verses.tib: 'brum phran bye ma 'dra zhes bya / gnag cing 'dam 'dra 'dam bu'o

verses.skt: bahalaṃ bahalair māṃsaiḥ savarṇaiś cīyate samaiḥ | kukūṇakaḥ śiśor eva dantotpattinimittajaḥ
verses.tib: mdog 'dra sha ni mang pos rgyas / na shas che ba zhes bya'o / byis pa so skyes tshe na 'byung

verses.skt: syāt tena śiśur ucchūnatāmrākṣo vīkṣaṇākṣamaḥ | savartmaśūlapaicchilyaḥ karṇanāsākṣimardanaḥ
verses.tib: des ni byis pa'i mig skrang zhing / mig dmar lta bar mi nus la / mig mchu gzer zhing spyi bag 'dzag / rna ba sna dang mig nyed byed / gang yin de ni sgra ngan yin

verses.skt: pakṣmoparodhe saṃkoco vartmanāṃ jāyate tathā | kharatāntarmukhatvaṃ ca romṇām anyāni vā punaḥ
verses.tib: rdzi 'gags rdzi ma 'dus shing zhum / mig mchu'ang de 'drar gyur pa dang / rtsub cing nang du kha bltas la / spu gzhan yang ni tsher ma ltar

verses.skt: kaṇṭakair iva tīkṣṇāgrair ghṛṣṭaṃ tair akṣi śūyate | uṣyate cānilādidviḍ alpāhaḥ śāntir uddhṛtaiḥ
verses.tib: rtse mo rnon po skyes gyur cing / des bdar mig ni skrangs pa dang / tsha zhing rlung la sogs mi bzod / bton na cung zad bde bar byed

verses.skt: kanīnake bahirvartma kaṭhino granthir unnataḥ | tāmraḥ pakvo ’srapūyasrud alajy ādhmāyate muhuḥ
verses.tib: mig phugs grwa mtshams phyi rol du / thor bu sra zhing mtho ba dang / dmar zhing mchi ma rnag khrag 'dzag / yang yang rgyas pa slon pa yin

verses.skt: vartmāntar māṃsapiṇḍābhaḥ śvayathur grathito ’rujaḥ | sāsraiḥ syād arbudo doṣair viṣamo bāhyataś calaḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi gsum dang khrag las ni / mig mchu'i nang na sha'i dum bu / rmen bu sra la nad med la / phyi rol mi mnyam g.yo mdzer pa

verses.skt: caturviṃśatir ity ete vyādhayo vartmasaṃśrayāḥ | ādyo ’tra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tato ’rśaś ca varyajet
verses.tib: de ltar nyi shu rtsa bzhi po / mig mchu la gnas nad yin no / de la dang por sman gyis gso / de 'og gnyis dang 'brum bu spang

verses.skt: pakṣmoparodho yāpyaḥ syāc cheṣāñ chastreṇa sādhayet | kuṭṭayet pakṣmasadanaṃ chindyāt teṣv api cārbudam
verses.tib: rdzi ma 'gags pa gsor rung tsam / lhag ma mtshon gyis gso bar bya / de dag las kyang rdzi / ma 'phyi / gtsags par bya la mig mdzer gcad

verses.skt: bhindyāl lagaṇakumbhīkābisotsaṅgāñjanālajīḥ | pothakīśyāvasikatāśliṣṭotkliṣṭacatuṣṭayam
verses.tib: chags dang pad rtsa ku mu ta / brtsegs dang 'brum phran slon pa 'dral / mig mchu'i sha sngo bye ma 'dra / 'byar dang bskyed bya zhes pa bzhi

verses.skt: sakardamaṃ sabahalaṃ vilikhet sakukūṇakam
verses.tib: 'dam chas shas cher byas pa dang / sgra ngan bcas pa mtshon gyis bzhar

verses.skt: kṛcchronmīle purāṇājyaṃ drākṣākalkāmbusādhitam | sasitaṃ yojayet snigdhaṃ nasyadhūmāñjanādi ca
verses.tib: 'dzums pa dka' la mar rnying ni / rgun 'bru'i lde gu chur bskol bar / kha ra btab dang sna sman dang / dud pa mig sman snum can gtang

verses.skt: kumbhīkāvartmalikhitaṃ saindhavapratisāritam | yaṣṭīdhātrīpaṭolīnāṃ kvāthena pariṣecayet
verses.tib: ku mu ta la zhal zhal btab / de steng rgyam tsha gdab par bya / shing mngar dang ni skyu ru ra / pa to la bskol chu blugs bya

verses.skt: nivāte ’dhiṣṭhitasyāptaiḥ śuddhasyottānaśāyinaḥ | bahiḥ koṣṇāmbutaptena sveditaṃ vartma vāsasā
verses.tib: rlung med gnas la g.yog mkhas kyis / sbyang byas gan rkyal nyal ba la / mig mchu bzlog ste dro 'jam chur / bsros pa'i gos kyis dugs byas la

verses.skt: nirbhujya vastrāntaritaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulīghṛtam | na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatas tataḥ
verses.tib: gos kyis legs par dkris nas ni / g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis bzung zhing / 'gul zhing 'gyur ba med par ni / de nas mig mchu kun tu ni

verses.skt: maṇḍalāgreṇa tat tiryak kṛtvā śastrapadāṅkitam | likhet tenaiva pattrair vā śākaśephālikādijaiḥ
verses.tib: dkyil 'khor lta bu'i mtshon gyis ni / 'phred du gdab cing mtshan ma byas / de nyid kyis sam lo rtsub bam / she pa li yi lo ma'am

verses.skt: phenena toyarāśer vā picunā pramṛjann asṛk | sthite rakte sulikhitaṃ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet
verses.tib: yang na rgya mtsho'i lbu bas brud / khrag ni ras bal ye'us phyi / khrag bcas legs par brud shes nas

verses.skt: yathāsvam uktair anu ca prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā | ghṛtena siktam abhyaktaṃ badhnīyān madhusarpiṣā
verses.tib: rang rang sman ni sbrang rtsi dang / bcas pa de la bsku bar bya / de 'og chu dron gyis bkrus la / mar gyis blugs par bya ba dang

verses.skt: ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayor dattvā piṇḍīṃ ca yavasaktubhiḥ | dvitīye ’hani muktasya pariṣekaṃ yathāyatham
verses.tib: rna ba'i steng dang 'og gi bar / nas kyi zan dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang bcas pas dkri bar bya / zhag ni gnyis pa la dgrol te / ji lta bar ni sman blugs shing

verses.skt: kuryāc caturthe nasyādīn muñced evāhni pañcame | samaṃ nakhanibhaṃ śophakaṇḍūgharṣādyapīḍitam
verses.tib: bzhi par sna sman la sogs bya / zhag ni lnga pa dag la dgrol / mnyam zhing sen mo ltar dmar la / skrangs g.ya' drud sogs nad med pa / mig mchu sbyar legs yin zhes bya / de las bzlog pa slar bzhar bya / bzhar drags pas ni na ba dang / rdzi ma 'byi zhing mig

verses.skt: vidyāt sulikhitaṃ vartma likhed bhūyo viparyaye | rukpakṣmavartmasadanasraṃsanāny atilekhanāt
verses.tib: bzhi par sna sman la sogs bya / zhag ni lnga pa dag la dgrol / mnyam zhing sen mo ltar dmar la / skrangs g.ya' drud sogs nad med pa / mig mchu sbyar legs yin zhes bya / de las bzlog pa slar bzhar bya / bzhar drags pas ni na ba dang / rdzi ma 'byi zhing mig

verses.skt: snehasvedādikas tasminn iṣṭo vātaharaḥ kramaḥ | abhyajya navanītena śvetalodhraṃ pralepayet
verses.tib: de la snum dang dugs la sogs / rlung la phan pa'i sbyor ba bsngags / mar sar gyis ni bsku bya zhing / seng phrom dkar po mar sar gyis / legs par bsku ba byas nas ni

verses.skt: eraṇḍamūlakalkena puṭapāke pacet tataḥ | svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtam
verses.tib: e raN+Da yi rtsa ba yi / lde gus byugs te phur mas btso / tshos pa bkrus te bskams nas ni / btags pa thum po byas nas ni

verses.skt: striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam | śālitaṇḍulakalkena liptaṃ tadvat pariṣkṛtam
verses.tib: ra 'am bud med 'o mar ni / mnyes pa mig tu blugs par bya / de nyid sA lu thug po che'i / lde gu bskus te de ltar byas / zho dang zho ga chus spangs pa

verses.skt: kuryān netre ’tilikhite mṛditaṃ dadhimastunā | kevalenāpi vā sekaṃ mastunā jāṅgalāśinaḥ
verses.tib: mig ni bzhar drags gyur la blugs / yang na zho ga chu nyi tshe / blugs shing skam sa'i sha khu sbyin

verses.skt: piṭikā vrīhivaktreṇa bhittvā tu kaṭhinonnatāḥ | niṣpīḍayed anu vidhiḥ pariśeṣas tu pūrvavat
verses.tib: 'brum phran sra zhing mtho ba ni / 'bras kyi rtse mos brtol bar bya / de rjes btsir te cho ga ni / lhag ma snga ma bzhin du bya

verses.skt: lekhane bhedane cāyaṃ kramaḥ sarvatra vartmani | pittāsrotkliṣṭayoḥ svāduskandhasiddhena sarpiṣā
verses.tib: zhal zhal gdab dang 'dral ba la / rim 'dis mig mchu'i nad kun sbyar / khrag mkhris las gyur mngar ba yi / sde tshan dang bskol mar gyis gso

verses.skt: sirāvimokṣaḥ snigdhasya trivṛc chreṣṭhaṃ virecanam | likhite srutarakte ca vartmani kṣālanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: snum gyur nas ni gtar ga gdab / dur byid bkru sman btang ba mchog / bzhar zhing khrag ni phyung nas kyang

verses.skt: yaṣṭīkaṣāyaḥ sekas tu kṣīraṃ candanasādhitam | pakṣmaṇāṃ sadane sūcyā romakūpān vikuṭṭayet
verses.tib: shing mngar bskol ba'i chus bkru zhing / tsan+dan dkar po 'o mar bskol / mig mchu la ni blugs pa phan / rdzi ma 'byi la khab kyis ni / ba spu'i bu ga gtsags pa'am

verses.skt: grāhayed vā jalaukobhiḥ payasekṣurasena vā | vamanaṃ nāvanaṃ sarpiḥ śṛtaṃ madhuraśītalaiḥ
verses.tib: srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung ngo / yang na 'o ma'am bu ram shing / khu bas slon bya mngar bsil sman / bskol ba'i mar ni gtang bar bya

verses.skt: saṃcūrṇya puṣpakāsīsaṃ bhāvayet surasārasaiḥ | tāmre daśāhaṃ paramaṃ pakṣmaśāte tad añjanam
verses.tib: nag tshur dkar po'i phye ma ni / bye'u rug pa'i khu bar bsres / zangs kyi snod du bcug pa ste / rdzi ma 'byi ba'i mig sman mchog

verses.skt: pothakīr likhitāḥ śuṇṭhīsaindhavapratisāritāḥ | uṣṇāmbukṣālitāḥ siñcet khadirāḍhakiśigrubhiḥ
verses.tib: mig mchu'i sha brud bca' sga dang / rgyam tsha'i phye ma gdab par bya / chu dron gyis bkrus seng ldeng dang

verses.skt: apsiddhair dviniṣāśreṣṭhāmadhukair vā samākṣikaiḥ | kaphotkliṣṭe vilikhite sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam
verses.tib: na le sham dkar tu pa ri / chu bskol ba'am ser po gnyis / shing mngar dang ni 'bras bu gsum / khu ba sbrang rtsir bcas pa blugs / bad kan las gyur zhal zhal byas

verses.skt: sūkṣmaiḥ saindhavakāsīsamanohvākaṇatārkṣyajaiḥ | vamanāñjananasyādi sarvaṃ ca kaphajid dhitam
verses.tib: nag tshur rgyam tsha pi pi ling / ldong ros stang zil zhib btags la / sbrang rtsir bcas pa bsku bar bya / skyug sman mig sman sna sman ni / bad / kan sel ba thams cad phan

verses.skt: kartavyaṃ lagaṇe ’py etad aśāntāv agninā dahet | kukūṇe khadiraśreṣṭhānimbapattraśṛtaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: chags pa la yang 'di dag bya / ma zhi me btsa' gdab par bya / sgra ngan la ni seng ldeng dang / nim pa'i lo ma 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: svinnāṃ bhittvā viniṣpīḍya bhiṣag añjananāmikām | śilailāsaindhavanataiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet
verses.tib: mar dang sbyar ba'am pi pi ling / shing mngar rgyam tsha bskol ba ni

verses.skt: pītvā dhātrī vamet kṛṣṇāyaṣṭīsarṣapasaindhavaiḥ | abhayāpippalīdrākṣākvāthenaināṃ virecayet
verses.tib: ma mas blud de slon du gzhug / rgun 'brum dang ni a ru ra / pi pi ling bskol ba kru sman sbyin

verses.skt: mustādvirajanīkṛṣṇākalkenālepayet stanau | dhūpayet sarṣapaiḥ sājyaiḥ śuddhāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pāyayet
verses.tib: ser po rnam gnyis pi pi ling / gla sgang lde gus nu ma bsku / nyungs kar mar bcas dud pas bdug / sbyang ba byas nas pa to la

verses.skt: paṭolamustamṛdvīkāguḍūcītriphalodbhavam | śiśos tu likhitaṃ vartma srutāsṛg vāmbujanmabhiḥ
verses.tib: gla sgang dang ni rgun 'brum dang / sle tres 'bras bu gsum bskol blud / byis pa'i mig mchu brud pa'am / srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung bya

verses.skt: dhātryaśmantakajambūtthapattrakvāthena secayet | prāyaḥ kṣīraghṛtāśitvād bālānāṃ śleṣmajā gadāḥ
verses.tib: a sman ta ka skyu ru ra / 'dzam bu'i lo ma bskol ba blugs / byis pa 'o ma mar bsten pas / phal cher bad kan nad 'byung bas

verses.skt: tasmād vamanam evāgre sarvavyādhiṣu pūjitam | sindhūtthakṛṣṇāpāmārgabījājyastanyamākṣikam
verses.tib: de bas dang por skyug sman nyid / nad kun la ni bsngags pa yin / lce myang tsha dang pi pi ling / a pa marga'i 'bras bu mar

verses.skt: cūrṇo vacāyāḥ sakṣaudro madanaṃ madhukānvitam | kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnam annaṃ ca bhajataḥ kramataḥ śiśoḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma shu dag sbrang rtsir bcas / po son cha ni shing mngar bcas / 'o ma kha zas 'o ma dang / zas la brten pa'i byis pa la

verses.skt: vamanaṃ sarvarogeṣu viśeṣeṇa kukūṇake | saptalārasasiddhājyaṃ yojyaṃ cobhayaśodhanam
verses.tib: rim bzhin blud pas nad kun ni / sbyang par bya phyir slon sman gtang / mchog tu sgra ngan nad la phan / sap+ta la yi khu ba mar / bskol ba gnyis ka sbyong byed sbyin

verses.skt: dviniśālodhrayaṣṭyāhvarohiṇīnimbapallavaiḥ | kukūṇake hitā vartiḥ piṣṭais tāmrarajo'nvitaiḥ
verses.tib: seng phrom shing mngar ser po gnyis / nim pa'i lo ma pu tse shel / zangs kyi phye mar bcas reng bu / sgra ngan gyi ni nad la phan

verses.skt: kṣīrakṣaudraghṛtopetaṃ dagdhaṃ vā lohajaṃ rajaḥ | elālaśunakatakaśaṅkhoṣaṇaphaṇijjakaiḥ
verses.tib: yang na lcags kyi phye ma bsregs / 'o ma sbrang rtsi mar bcas phan / sug smel sgog skya ka ta ka / pha ni dza ka na le sham

verses.skt: vartiḥ kukūṇapothakyoḥ surāpiṣṭaiḥ sakaṭphalaiḥ | pakṣmarodhe pravṛddheṣu śuddhadehasya romasu
verses.tib: dung bcas chu dang bdar ba dang / kad pha la bcas ri lu'ang phan / rdzi ma'i 'gags nad 'phel ba la / sbyang ba byas par gyur pa ni

verses.skt: utsṛjya dvau bhruvo ’dhastād bhāgau bhāgaṃ ca pakṣmataḥ | yavamātraṃ yavākāraṃ tiryak chittvārdravāsasā
verses.tib: smin ma'i 'og gi cha gnyis dang / rdzi ma'i cha gcig bar bar ni / nas kyi tshad tsam nas kyi dbyibs / 'phred du dbral la ras rlon pas

verses.skt: apaneyam asṛk tasminn alpībhavati śoṇite | sīvyet kuṭilayā sūcyā mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ
verses.tib: de yi khrag ni bsal nas ni / khrag ni chung bar gyur pa dang / bar mtshams mung+ga tsam bzhag la / khab ni yon pos btsem par bya

verses.skt: baddhvā lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ ca tatra sīvanasūtrakam | nātigāḍhaślathaṃ sūcyā nikṣiped atha yojayet
verses.tib: dpral ba ras kyis bcings nas / ni / de bzhin skud pas btsem par bya / shin tu dam dang lhod min par / der ni legs par btsem par bya

verses.skt: madhusarpiḥkavalikāṃ na cāsmin bandham ācaret | nyagrodhādikaṣāyaiś ca sakṣīraiḥ secayed ruji
verses.tib: de nas sbrang rtsi'i mar gyis byug / 'di la bcing bar mi bya'o / na na n+ya gro d+ha sogs pa'i / khu ba 'o mar bcas pa blugs

verses.skt: pañcame divase sūtram apanīyāvacūrṇayet | gairikeṇa vraṇaṃ yuñjyāt tīkṣṇaṃ nasyāñjanādi ca
verses.tib: zhag lnga pa la skud pa ni / bsal te yug snam phye ma ni / rma la legs par gdab par bya / sna sman mig sman rnon po gtang

verses.skt: dahed aśāntau nirbhujya vartmadoṣāśrayāṃ valīm | saṃdaṃśenādhikaṃ pakṣma hṛtvā tasyāśrayaṃ dahet
verses.tib: mig mchur brten gnyer bzlog ste bsreg / rdzi ma'i lhag ma tsher zungs kyis / phyung la de yi gnas dag ni

verses.skt: sūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena dāho bāhyālajeḥ punaḥ | bhinnasya kṣāravahnibhyāṃ succhinnasyārbudasya ca
verses.tib: me yi mdog 'dra'i khab rtses bsreg / phyi rol rlon pa bsregs pa dang / thor bu bcad par gyur pa la / me 'am thal sman rnon pos bsreg

verses.skt: vāyuḥ kruddhaḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalābhaṃ jalavāhinīḥ | aśru srāvayate vartmaśuklasaṃdheḥ kanīnakāt
verses.tib: rlung 'khrugs pas ni chu rgyu ba'i / rtsar song nas ni chu 'dra ba'i / mchi ma mig mchu mig phugs kyi / mtshams nas mchi ma 'dzag par 'gyur

verses.skt: tena netraṃ sarugrāgaśophaṃ syāt sa jalāsravaḥ | kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet
verses.tib: des ni nad med rtsa dmar la / skrangs 'gyur de ni chu 'dzag yin / bad kan las gyur spyi bag mang / dkar ba bad kan 'dzag pa yin

verses.skt: kaphena śophas tīkṣṇāgraḥ kṣārabudbudakopamaḥ | pṛthumūlabalaḥ snigdhaḥ savarṇo mṛdupicchilaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan gyis skrangs rtse mo rno / lan tshwa'i chu bur 'dra ba 'byung / rtsa ba che zhing g.yo la snum / mdog 'dra 'jam zhing spyi bag can

verses.skt: mahān apākaḥ kaṇḍūmān upanāhaḥ sa nīrujaḥ | raktād raktāsrāve tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet
verses.tib: che zhing smin dka' g.ya' dang bcas / gzer med bcings pa lta bu yin / khrag las mchi ma khrag 'dzag dmar / shas cher dro ba khrag 'dzag yin

verses.skt: vartmasaṃdhyāśrayā śukle piṭikā dāhaśūlinī | tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī
verses.tib: mig mchu gra mtshams dkar po ru / 'brum phran tsha zhing gzer dang bcas / dmar zhing mung+ga 'dra lags / khrag 'dzag de ni tshigs can yin

verses.skt: pūyāsrave malāḥ sāsrā vartmasaṃdheḥ kanīnakāt | srāvayanti muhuḥ pūyaṃ sāsraṃ tvaṅmāṃsapākataḥ
verses.tib: rnag 'dzag dri ma khrag dang bcas / mig phugs kyi ni gra mtshams nas / yang dang yang du rnag 'dzag cing / sha lpags 'drul bas mchi mar bcas

verses.skt: pūyālaso vraṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śophasaṃrambhapūrvakaḥ | kanīnasaṃdhāv ādhmāyī pūyāsrāvī savedanaḥ
verses.tib: rnag sla 'dzag pa rma phra zhing / skrangs shing g.yo ba che ba dang / mig phugs mtshams skrangs rnag 'dzag cing / nad bcas rnag gi chu ser 'dzag

verses.skt: kanīnasyāntar alajī śopho ruktodadāhavān | apāṅge vā kanīne vā kaṇḍūṣāpakṣmapoṭavān
verses.tib: mig phugs kyi / ni mtshams nang na / skrangs zug tsha bcas chu ser nad / mig zur ram ni mig phugs su / g.ya' zhing rdzi ma'i bu ga nas

verses.skt: pūyāsrāvī kṛmigranthir granthiḥ kṛmiyuto ’rtimān | upanāhakṛmigranthipūyālasakaparvaṇīḥ
verses.tib: rnag 'dzag srin dang rmen bu 'byung / na bcas srin gyi rmen bu can / bcings pa lta bu'i srin rmen bu / rnag gi chu ser tshigs can dag

verses.skt: śastreṇa sādhayet pañca sālajīn āsravāṃs tyajet | pittaṃ kuryāt site bindūn asitaśyāvapītakān
verses.tib: mtshon gyis gso bya lhag ma lnga / 'dzag pa chu ser bcas pa spangs / mkhris pas dkar po'i thig le ni / nag pa'am sngo ba'am ser po skyed

verses.skt: malāktādarśatulyaṃ vā sarvaṃ śuklaṃ sadāharuk | rogo ’yaṃ śuktikāsaṃjñaḥ saśakṛdbhedatṛḍjvaraḥ
verses.tib: gur gum me long dri mas gos / ltar snang na dang tsha ba med / 'khru zhing skom dad rims dang bcas / nad gzhi nya phyis can zhes bya

verses.skt: kaphāc chukle samaṃ śvetaṃ ciravṛddhyadhimāṃsakam | śuklārma śophas tv arujaḥ savarṇo bahalo ’mṛduḥ
verses.tib: bad kan las dkar sha lhag dkar / ring nas 'phel ba mig mdzer dkar / nad med pa la skrangs pa dang / mdog dkar lhun chen 'jam pa dang

verses.skt: guruḥ snigdho ’mbubindvābho balāsagrathitaṃ smṛtaṃ | bindubhiḥ piṣṭadhavalair utsannaiḥ piṣṭakaṃ vadet
verses.tib: lci snum chu yi thigs pa 'dra / bad kan mdud pa zhes byar bshad / thig le 'bras phye ltar dkar ba / mtho ba 'bras phye 'dra zhes bshad

verses.skt: raktarājītataṃ śuklam uṣyate yat savedanam | aśophāśrūpadehaṃ ca sirotpātaḥ sa śoṇitāt
verses.tib: dkar po'i ri mo dmar pos khyab / tsha zhing na dang bcas pa dang / skrangs shing mchi mas gos pa med / khrag gyur rtsa yi nges par bshad

verses.skt: upekṣitah sirotpāto rājīs tā eva vardhayan | kuryāt sāsraṃ sirāharṣaṃ tenākṣyudvīkṣaṇākṣamam
verses.tib: rtsa'i nyes yal bar bor na ni / dmar ris de nyid 'phel bar 'gyur / khrag bcas rtsa ni brtse bar byed / de yis mig gis blta mi nus

verses.skt: sirājāle sirājālaṃ bṛhad raktaṃ ghanonnatam | śoṇitārma samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ padmābham adhimāṃsakam
verses.tib: rtsa yi dra bas g.yogs shing stug / mtho ba rtsa yi dra ba yin / khrag gis mig mdzer 'jam zhing mnyam / pad+ma 'dra ba sha lhag yin

verses.skt: nīruk ślakṣṇo ’rjunaṃ binduḥ śaśalohitalohitaḥ | mṛdvāśuvṛddhyaruṅmāṃsaṃ prastāri śyāvalohitam
verses.tib: nad med ri bong khrag ltar dmar / thig le ling thog dmar po yin / 'jam shing nad med myur du 'phel / dkar por khyab byed dmar nag ni / khyab pa'i mdzer pa zhes bya'o

verses.skt: prastāryarma malaiḥ sāsraiḥ snāvārma snāvasaṃnibham | śuṣkāsṛkpiṇḍavac chyāvaṃ yan māṃsaṃ bahalaṃ pṛthu
verses.tib: dri ma khrag bcas rtsa'i mdzer pa / rtsa rgyus dang 'dra rtsa mdzer yin / khrag skam gong bu ltar gnag cing / sha ni che zhing rgyas pa gang / de ni sha lhag mdzer pa yin / tsha zhing reg na rtsub pa dang / rtsas g.yogs mig 'bras nag dang nye / 'brum phran nyungs kar lta bus rtsa

verses.skt: adhimāṃsārma tad dāhagharṣavatyaḥ sirāvṛtāḥ | kṛṣṇāsannāḥ sirāsaṃjñāḥ piṭikāḥ sarṣapopamāḥ
verses.tib: dri ma khrag bcas rtsa'i mdzer pa / rtsa rgyus dang 'dra rtsa mdzer yin / khrag skam gong bu ltar gnag cing / sha ni che zhing rgyas pa gang / de ni sha lhag mdzer pa yin / tsha zhing reg na rtsub pa dang / rtsas g.yogs mig 'bras nag dang nye / 'brum phran nyungs kar lta bus rtsa

verses.skt: śuktiharṣasirotpātapiṣṭakagrathitārjunam | sādhayed auṣadhaiḥ ṣaṭkaṃ śeṣaṃ śastreṇa saptakam
verses.tib: 'bras phye 'dus pa'i ling tog dmar / drug po sman gyis gso bar bya / lhag ma bdun po mtshon / gyis gso

verses.skt: navotthaṃ tad api dravyair armoktaṃ yac ca pañcadhā | tac chedyam asitaprāptaṃ māṃsasnāvasirāvṛtam
verses.tib: de yang sar pa sman gyis gso / mdzer pa bshad pa lnga po gang / rgyus pa dang ni rtsas g.yogs pa

verses.skt: carmoddālavad ucchrāyi dṛṣṭiprāptaṃ ca varjayet | pittaṃ kṛṣṇe ’thavā dṛṣṭau śukraṃ todāśrurāgavat
verses.tib: nag por phyin zhing pags gas 'dra / mthon po gcad par bya ba yin / mthong byed steng du phyin pa spang / nag po'am mthong byed la mkhris pas

verses.skt: chittvā tvacaṃ janayati tena syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam | pakvajambūnibhaṃ kiñcin nimnaṃ ca kṣataśukrakam
verses.tib: pags pa brtol te ling tog ni / zug dmar mchi mar bcas pa skyed / de yis mig 'bras dkyil 'khor rnag / 'dzam bu smin pa 'drar snang zhing / dma' ba rma yi ling tog ste

verses.skt: tat kṛcchrasādhyaṃ yāpyaṃ tu dvitīyapaṭalavyadhāt | tatra todādibāhulyaṃ sūcīviddhābhakṛṣṇatā
verses.tib: de ni gso dka' rim gnyis dag / brtol ba gso ba tsam yin no / der ni zug pa la sogs mang / nag po khab kyis phug snyam byed

verses.skt: tṛtīyapaṭalacchedād asādhyaṃ nicitaṃ vraṇaiḥ | śaṅkhaśuklaṃ kaphāt sādhyaṃ nātiruk śuddhaśukrakam
verses.tib: rim pa gsum ni brtol ba dang / rma yis khyab pa gsor mi rung / bad kan las gyur dung ltar dkar / shas cher mi na gso sla dkar

verses.skt: ātāmrapicchilāsrasrud ātāmrapiṭikātiruk | ajāviṭsadṛśocchrāyakārṣṇyā varjyāsṛjājakā
verses.tib: dmar zhing mchi ma spyi bag 'dzag / 'brum phran dmar zhing shin tu na / ra yi ril ma 'dra zhing 'bur / khrag skyes ra ril 'dra ba spang

verses.skt: sirāśukraṃ malaiḥ sāsrais tajjuṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam | satodadāhatāmrābhiḥ sirābhir avatanyate
verses.tib: nad khrag bcas pas rtsa'i ling tog / de yis mig 'bras nag po khebs / na zhing tsha la dmar ba yi / rtsa yis kun tu rgyas gyur la

verses.skt: animittoṣṇaśītācchaghanāsrasruc ca tat tyajet | doṣaiḥ sāsraiḥ sakṛt kṛṣṇaṃ nīyate śuklarūpatām
verses.tib: rgyu med mchi ma grang dro dang / ska sla 'dzag pa de spang bya / nad gzhi khrag las mthong bcas rnag / 'bras bu dkar por sgyur byed de

verses.skt: dhavalābhropaliptābhaṃ niṣpāvārdhadalākṛti | atitīvrarujārāgadāhaśvayathupīḍitam
verses.tib: nim pa ba ni bkas pa 'dra / shin tu mi bzad na zhing dmar / tsha zhing skrangs pas gzir ba dag

verses.skt: pākātyayena tac chukraṃ varjayet tīvravedanam | yasya vā liṅganāśo ’ntaḥ śyāvaṃ yad vā salohitam
verses.tib: smin pas nyen pa'i ling tog ste / mi bzad na ba spang bar bya / gang gis mtshan ma nyams pa'am / nang sngo ba'am dmar bcas pas

verses.skt: atyutsedhāvagāḍhaṃ vā sāśru nāḍīvraṇāvṛtam | purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yac ca śukrakam
verses.tib: shin tu 'bur ba'am gting ring pa 'am / mchi mar bcas shing rtsa'i rmas khyab / rnying pa'am mtho dma' can dag gam / dbus chang ling tog spang bar bya

verses.skt: pañcety uktā gadāḥ kṛṣṇe sādhyāsādhyavibhāgataḥ
verses.tib: nag po'i nad ni gsor rung dang / mi rung dbye ba rnam lnga yin

verses.skt: upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vrīhimukhena ca | lekhayen maṇḍalāgreṇa tataś ca pratisārayet
verses.tib: mig nad bcings pa sman pa yis / dugs byas / rtse mo 'bras 'dras dbug / rtse mo dkyil 'khor 'dra bas bzhar

verses.skt: pippalīkṣaudrasindhūtthair badhnīyāt pūrvavat tataḥ | paṭolapattrāmalakakvāthenāścyotayec ca tam
verses.tib: de 'og rgyam tsha pi pi ling / sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku bar bya / de nas snga ma bzhin du bcings / pa to la'i lo skyu ru ra / bskol ba'i sman khu thigs pas blugs

verses.skt: parvaṇī baḍiśenāttā bāhyasaṃdhitribhāgataḥ | vṛddhipattreṇa vardhyārdhe syād aśrugatir anyathā
verses.tib: tshigs can lcags kyu'i cha spyad kyis / phyi yi mtshams kyi tsha gsum gzung / 'phel gtsags kyis ni phyed gcad bya / gzhan du mchi ma rgyu la gnod

verses.skt: cikitsā cārmavat kṣaudrasaindhavapratisāritā | pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyet tatas tam upanāhayet
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi rgyam tshas bskus nas ni / mig mdzer lta bur gso bar bya / chu ser rnag 'dzag gtar ga gdab / de nas de ni bcing bar bya

verses.skt: kurvīta cākṣipākoktaṃ sarvaṃ karma yathāvidhi | saindhavārdrakakāsīsalohatāmraiḥ sucūrṇitaiḥ
verses.tib: mig rnags cho gar bshad pa yi / las kun cho ga ji bzhin bya / rgyam tsha sge'u gsher nag tshur dang / lcags dang zangs ni zhib btags pa'i

verses.skt: cūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta sakṣaudrair vā rasakriyām | kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhittvā vilikhya ca
verses.tib: phye ma'i mig sman btang ba'am / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i khu ba blugs / srin gyi rmen bu lci ba yis / dugs byas brtol te phyi bar bya

verses.skt: triphalākṣaudrakāsīsasaindhavaiḥ pratisārayet | pittābhiṣyandavac chuktiṃ balāsāhvayapiṣṭake
verses.tib: nag tshur rgyam tsha 'bras bu gsum / sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bsku bar bya / nya phyis mkhris mchi 'dzag ltar gso

verses.skt: kaphābhiṣyandavan muktvā sirāvyadham upācaret | bījapūrarasāktaṃ ca vyoṣakaṭphalam añjanam
verses.tib: bad kan 'dud pa 'bras phye gnyis / gtar ga ma gtogs bad kan gyi / mchi ma 'dzag pa bzhin du gso / tsha ba gsum dang kad pha la / ba lung khu ba'i mig sman gtang

verses.skt: jātīmukulasindhūtthadevadārumahauṣadhaiḥ | piṣṭaiḥ prasannayā vartiḥ śophakaṇḍūghnam añjanam
verses.tib: rgyam tsha dzA ti kha 'bus pa / thang shing bca' sga btags pa'i phye / chang gi dngas mas ri lur byas / mig sman skrangs dang g.ya' ba sel

verses.skt: raktasyandavad utpātaharṣajālārjunakriyā | sirotpāte viśeṣeṇa ghṛtamākṣikam añjanam
verses.tib: rtsa nyes rtsa brtse ling tog dmar / rtsa dra khrag 'dzag lta bur gso / rtsa yi nyes la khyad par du / mar dang sbrang rtsi'i mig sman bsku

verses.skt: sirāharṣe tu madhunā ślakṣṇaghṛṣṭaṃ rasāñjanam | arjune śarkarāmastukṣaudrair āścyotanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: rtsa brtse ba la sbrang rtsi dang / skyer pa'i khaN+Da zhib btags bsku / ling tog dmar po zho ga chu / sbrang rtsi kha ra'i thigs pa blugs

verses.skt: sphaṭikaḥ kuṅkumaṃ śaṅkho madhukaṃ madhunāñjanam | madhunā cāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaḥ pheno vā sitayā saha
verses.tib: shel dang gur gum shing mngar dung / sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i mig sman gtang / yang na sbrang rtsi dung sbyar ba'am / kha ra rgya mtsho'i lbu ba phan

verses.skt: armoktaṃ pañcadhā tatra tanu dhūmāvilaṃ ca yat | raktaṃ dadhinibhaṃ yac ca śukravat tasya bheṣajam
verses.tib: mdzer par bshad pa rnam lnga las / dud pa lta bu'i rnyog can dang / gang yang dmar zhing zho 'dra ba / de sman ling tog bzhin du bya

verses.skt: uttānasyetarat svinnaṃ sasindhūtthena cāñjitam | rasena bījapūrasya nimīlyākṣi vimardayet
verses.tib: cig shos gan rkyal bzhag dugs byas / kha lung dang ni rgyam tsha dag / sbyar / ba'i mig sman bskus nas ni / mig btsums nas ni mnye bar bya

verses.skt: itthaṃ saṃroṣitākṣasya pracale ’rmādhimāṃsake | ghṛtasya niścalaṃ mūrdhni vartmanoś ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: de ltar mig ni 'khrugs bcas pa / sha lhag skyes pa bskyod nas ni / mgo bo mi 'gyur dam du gzung / mig mchu mchog tu mi 'gul bya

verses.skt: apāṅgam īkṣamāṇasya vṛddhe ’rmaṇi kanīnakāt | valī syād yatra tatrārma baḍiśenāvalambitam
verses.tib: mig zur du ni blta bzhin du / mig phug mtshams nas mdzer pa mtho / gang du gnyer ma 'dus gyur pa / der ni lcags kyus dam bzung ba'am

verses.skt: nātyāyataṃ mucuṇḍyā vā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā tataḥ | samantān maṇḍalāgreṇa mocayed atha mokṣitam
verses.tib: ha cang mi che mu tsi tra'am / khab bam skud pas blangs nas ni / kun nas dkyil 'khor 'dra bas 'dral / de nas bton te dral nas kyang

verses.skt: kanīnakam upānīya caturbhāgāvaśeṣitam | chindyāt kanīnakaṃ rakṣed vāhinīś cāśruvāhinīḥ
verses.tib: mig phug mtshams su bsnyen nas ni / cha bzhi lus par gcad bya ste / mig phug rtsa dang mchi ma ni / 'dzag pa'i rtsa la mi gnod bsrung

verses.skt: kanīnakavyadhād aśru nāḍī cākṣṇi pravartate | vṛddhe ’rmaṇi tathāpāṅgāt paśyato ’sya kanīnakam
verses.tib: mig phug zur bcad mchi ma 'dzag / mig gi rtsa sbubs rma can 'gyur / mig 'gram mdzer pa cher skyes la / mig phug zur du bltas te bya

verses.skt: samyakchinnaṃ madhuvyoṣasaindhavapratisāritam | uṣṇena sarpiṣā siktam abhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā
verses.tib: legs par bcad de tsha ba gsum / rgyam tsha sbrang rtsir bcas pa bsku / zhun mar dron mo blugs pa dang / sbrang rtsi mar sbyar bskus te bcings

verses.skt: badhnīyāt secayen muktvā tṛtīyādidineṣu ca | karañjabījasiddhena kṣīreṇa kvathitais tathā
verses.tib: de nas zhag gsum la sogs nas / bkrol nas ka rany+dza'i sa bon / 'o ma bskol ba de bzhin blugs

verses.skt: sakṣaudrair dviniśālodhrapaṭolīyaṣṭikiṃśukaiḥ | kuraṇṭamukulopetair muñced evāhni saptame
verses.tib: ser po rnam gnyis pa to la / shing mngar dang ni rgya skyegs shing / ka rany+dza yi me tog ni / kha 'bus sbrang rtsir bcas bskol blugs / zhag bdun nas ni de dgrol bya

verses.skt: samyakchinne bhavet svāsthyaṃ hīnāticchedajān gadān | sekāñjanaprabhṛtibhir jayel lekhanabṛṃhaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: legs par bcad na nad med 'gyur / bcad drags mchod las nad 'gyur / sman khu blugs dang mig sman sogs / phyi ba dang ni brta bas gso

verses.skt: sitāmanaḥśilaileyalavaṇottamanāgaram | ardhakarṣonmitaṃ tārkṣyaṃ palārdhaṃ ca madhudrutam
verses.tib: kha ra ldong ros e li ya / rgyam tsha bca' sga zho re dang / skyer pa'i khaN+Da srang phyed dang

verses.skt: añjanaṃ śleṣmatimirapillaśukrārmaśoṣajit | triphalaikatamadravyatvacaṃ pānīyakalkitām
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i mig sman gyis / bad kan las gyur rab rib dang / chu ser gyis gang ling tog dang / mig mdzer bcas pa'i sha lhag sel / 'bras bu gsum ni gang rung ba'i / shun pa chur btags lde gur byas

verses.skt: śarāvapihitāṃ dagdhvā kapāle cūrṇayet tataḥ | pṛthakśeṣauṣadharasaiḥ pṛthag eva ca bhāvitā
verses.tib: kham phor sbyar ba'i nang du bsregs / de nas tshig nas phye mar btags / sman ni lhag ma'i khu ba yis / so sor legs par bsgos nas ni

verses.skt: sā maṣī śoṣitā peṣyā bhūyo dvilavaṇānvitā | trīṇy etāny añjanāny āha lekhanāni paraṃ nimiḥ
verses.tib: snag tsha de bskams slar yang btags / rgyam tsha nyis 'gyur bcas / pa yi / mig sman gsum po de dag ni / phyi ba'i mchog tu mu khyud 'chad

verses.skt: sirājāle sirā yās tu kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhaiḥ | na sidhyanty armavat tāsāṃ piṭikānāṃ ca sādhanam
verses.tib: rtsa yi dras g.yogs rtsa gang zhig / sra bas phyi ba'i sman dag gis / ma zhi 'brum phran de la ni / mig mdzer cho ga bzhin du gso

verses.skt: doṣānurodhāc chukreṣu snigdharūkṣā varā ghṛtam | tiktam ūrdhvam asṛksrāvo rekasekādi ceṣyate
verses.tib: ling tog nad gzhi'i dbang las ni / snum rtsub 'bras bu gsum sbyin zhing / tig ta chen po'i sman mar sbyin / gtar ga bkru sman khu ba yi / thigs pa blugs pa la sogs bya

verses.skt: tris trivṛdvāriṇā pakvaṃ kṣataśukre ghṛtaṃ pibet | sirayānu hared raktaṃ jalaukobhiś ca locanāt
verses.tib: snad pa'i ling tog dur byid chu / lan gsum bskol ba'i mar blud bya / de 'og gtar ga'am pad pa yis / mig las khrag ni dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: siddhenotpalakākolīdrākṣāyaṣṭīvidāribhiḥ | sasitenājapayasā secanaṃ salilena vā
verses.tib: ut+pal rgun 'brum ra mnye ba / shing mngar bi da ri bskol ba / kha ra ra yi 'o ma 'am / chu bskol thigs pa blugs par bya

verses.skt: rāgāśruvedanāśāntau paraṃ lekhanam añjanam | vartayo jātimukulalākṣāgairikacandanaiḥ
verses.tib: mig dmar mchi ma nad zhi nas / de rjes phyi ba'i mig sman phan / dzA ti kha 'bus rgya skyegs dang / yug snam tsan+dan ri lur byas

verses.skt: prasādayanti pittāsraṃ ghnanti ca kṣataśukrakam | dantair dantivarāhoṣṭragavāśvājakharodbhavaiḥ
verses.tib: khrag dang mkhris pa dngas byed cing / snad pa las gyur ling tog sel / phag dang rnga mo glang po che / ba lang ra rta bong bu'i so

verses.skt: saśaṅkhamauktikāmbhodhiphenair maricapādikaiḥ | kṣataśukram api vyāpi dantavartir nivartayet
verses.tib: rgya mtsho'i lbu ba mu tig dang / na le sham ni bzhi par sbyar / so yi ri lus snad pa yi / ling tog gis khyab sel bar byed

verses.skt: tamālapattraṃ godantaśaṅkhapheno ’sthi gārdabham | tāmraṃ ca vartir mūtreṇa sarvaśukrakanāśinī
verses.tib: ta ma'i lo ma ba lang so / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba bong bu'i rus / zangs ma dung gcin ri lur byas / ling tog thams cad sel bar byed

verses.skt: ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi dhātavas tryūṣaṇaṃ truṭī | karañjabījaṃ laśuno vraṇasādi ca bheṣajam
verses.tib: rin chen so dang rwa dang ni / khams dang sug smel tsha ba gsum / sgog skya ka rany+dza'i sa bon / rma la phan pa'i sman rnams ni

verses.skt: savraṇāvraṇagambhīratvaksthaśukraghnam añjanam | nimnam unnamayet snehapānanasyarasāñjanaiḥ
verses.tib: rma bcas rma med gting zug dang / pags gnas ling tog 'joms sman yin / sna sman snum blud sha khu ni / blud pas dma' ba bstod par bya

verses.skt: sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tṛptipuṭapākena śukrakam | śuddhaśukre niśāyaṣṭīśārivāśābarāmbhasā
verses.tib: nad med ling tog dma' ba ni / phur ma btsos dang brta bas bstod / ling tog dkar po skyes pa dang / shing mngar thal tres seng phrom chu

verses.skt: secanaṃ lodhrapoṭalyā koṣṇāmbhomagnayāthavā | bṛhatīmūlayaṣṭyāhvatāmrasaindhavanāgaraiḥ
verses.tib: blugs pas seng phrom gtums pa ni / chu dron la spangs thigs pa blugs / shing mngar bri ha ti'i rtsa ba / rgyam tsha dong gra zangs ma ni

verses.skt: dhātrīphalāmbunā piṣṭair lepitaṃ tāmrabhājanam | yavājyāmalakīpattrair bahuśo dhūpayet tataḥ
verses.tib: skyu ru ra'i 'bras chu dang btags / lde gu zangs ma'i snod la bsku / nas mar skyu ru ra'i lo ma / dud pas de 'og mang du bdugs

verses.skt: tatra kurvīta guṭikās tā jalakṣaudrapeṣitāḥ | mahānīlā iti khyātāḥ śuddhaśukraharāḥ param
verses.tib: de nas ri / lur bya ba ni / de ni chu dang sbrang rtsir btags / mthon ka chen po zhes bya ste / ling tog dkar po sel mchog yin

verses.skt: sthire śukre ghane cāsya bahuśo ’pahared asṛk | śiraḥkāyavirekāṃś ca puṭapākāṃś ca bhūriśaḥ
verses.tib: ling tog brtan zhing mthug pa la / khrag ni lan mang dbyung bar bya / mgo dang lus kyi bkru sman gtang / phur ma btsos pa'ang lan mang gtang

verses.skt: kuryān maricavaidehīśirīṣaphalasaindhavaiḥ | harṣaṇaṃ triphalākvāthapītena lavaṇena vā
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang na le sham / rgyam tsha shri sha'i 'bras bu'am / 'bras bu gsum bskol rgyam tshar bcas

verses.skt: kuryād añjanayogau vā ślokārdhagaditāv imau | śaṅkhakolāsthikatakadrākṣāmadhukamākṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: blud pas gnas las bstod par bya / dung dang rgya shug ka ta ka / rgun 'brum shing mngar sbrang rtsi dang / mur so yi dri ma yi

verses.skt: surādantārṇavamalaiḥ śirīṣakusumānvitaiḥ | dhātrīphaṇijjakarase kṣāro lāṅgalikodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: shri sha yi ni me tog bcas / tshigs bcad phyed kyis bshad pa 'di / mig sman sbyor ba gtang bar bya / skyu ru pa ni dza'i khu bar / lang ka li yi thal ba ni

verses.skt: uṣitaḥ śoṣitaś cūrṇaḥ śukraharṣaṇam añjanam | mudgā vā nistuṣāḥ piṣṭāḥ śaṅkhakṣaudrasamāyutāḥ
verses.tib: nub gcig spangs te bskams pa'i phye / ling tog bskyod pa'i mig sman yin / mung+ga spun pa med btags pa / dung dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa'ang phan

verses.skt: sāro madhūkān madhumān majjā vākṣāt samākṣikā | gokharāśvoṣṭradaśanāḥ śaṅkhaḥ phenaḥ samudrajaḥ
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi ma du ka'i snying po'am / ba ru ra rkang sbrang rtsir bcas / ba lang rta bong rnga mo'i so / dung dang rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dang

verses.skt: vartir arjunatoyena hṛṣṭaśukrakanāśinī | utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śūkraṃ vālādibhir likhet
verses.tib: ardzu ne'i chus ri lur byas / bskyod pa'i ling tog 'jig par byed / bstod pa'am zug rngur bcas pa yi / ling tog spu la sogs pas phyi

verses.skt: sirāśukre tv adṛṣṭighne cikitsā vraṇaśukravat | puṇḍrayaṣṭyāhvakākolīsiṃhīlohaniśāñjanam
verses.tib: rtsa yi ling tog mthong gnod med / snad pa'i ling tog lta bur gso / shing mngar stag tsher ra mnye ba / bri ha ti dang a ka ru / skyer pa'i mig sman ra'i 'o ma

verses.skt: kalkitaṃ chāgadugdhena saghṛtair dhūpitaṃ yavaiḥ | dhātrīpattraiś ca paryāyād vartir atrāñjanaṃ param
verses.tib: btags pa'i lde gu nas dang mar / bcas pa'i dud pas bdug par bya / skyu ru ra yi lo ma dang / ri lur byas pa mig sman mchog

verses.skt: aśāntāv armavac chastram ajakākhye ca yojayet | ajakāyām asādhyāyāṃ śukre ’nyatra ca tadvidhe
verses.tib: ma sos ra yi ril ma 'dra / mdzer pa lta bur mtshon gyis gso / ra'i ril gsor ni mi rung dang / ling tog de 'dra de bzhin gzhan

verses.skt: vedanopaśamaṃ snehapānāsṛksrāvaṇādibhiḥ | kuryād bībhatsatāṃ jetuṃ śukrasyotsedhasādhanam
verses.tib: nad ma zhi na snum blud cing / gtar ga gdab pa la sogs bya / smad byas de ni bsal byas shing / dkar zhing mtho ba gso bar bya

verses.skt: nārikelāsthibhallātatālavaṃśakarīrajam | bhasmādbhiḥ srāvayet tābhir bhāvayet karabhāsthijam
verses.tib: rgya star go bye lung thang dang / ta la smyig ma ka ri ra / bsres pa'i thal chu btsags pa dang / rnga mo'i rus pa'i phye ma bsre

verses.skt: cūrṇaṃ śukreṣv asādhyeṣu tad vaivarṇyaghnam añjanam | sādhyeṣu sādhanāyālam idam eva ca śīlitam
verses.tib: mig sman ling tog gso dka' dang / mdog mi sdug pa 'joms par byed / gso sla la yang 'di nyid ni / bsten

verses.skt: ajakāṃ pārśvato viddhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam | samaṃ prapīḍyāṅguṣṭhena vasārdreṇānu pūrayet
verses.tib: pas sel bar nus pa yin / ra yi ril ma ngos gnyis nas / khab kyis phug ste chu gzags nas / mthe bos mnyam du btsir nas ni

verses.skt: vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca | saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇabhāge same sthire
verses.tib: rma yi nang ni sha phye dang / tshil ni rlon pas bkang nas ni / dkri zhing dkri zhing dgang bar bya / zhag bdun nas ni rma 'byor nas / mig 'bras nag po mnyam brtan la

verses.skt: snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā | tathāpi punarādhmāne bhedacchedādikāṃ kriyām
verses.tib: mig sman snum can gtang bya zhing / mar dang 'o ma'i sna sman blugs / de lta na yang rgyas gyur na / dbug dang bcad sogs bya ba byas

verses.skt: yuktyā kuryād yathā nāticchedena syāt nimajjanam
verses.tib: bcad drags pa yis mig nang du / zhugs par mi 'gyur ci rigs bya

verses.skt: nityaṃ ca śukreṣu śṛtaṃ yathāsvaṃ pāne ca marśe ca ghṛtaṃ vidadhyāt | na hīyate labdhabalā tathāntas tīkṣṇāñjanair dṛk satataṃ prayuktaiḥ || 58 ||
verses.tib: ling tog la ni rtag par rang gi sman / bskol ba'i mar blud sna sman bsten pa dang / ci nas mthong ba nyams par mi 'gyur bar / mig sman rnon po rtag tu bsten par bya

verses.skt: sirānusāriṇi male prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ śrite | avyaktam īkṣate rūpaṃ vyaktam apy animittataḥ
verses.tib: nad ni rtsa yi nang zhugs pa / rim pa dang por gnas nas ni / gzugs ni mi gsal mthong 'gyur zhing / rgyu med par yang gsal bar mthong

verses.skt: prāpte dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ abhūtam api paśyati | bhūtaṃ tu yatnād āsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmaṃ ca nekṣate
verses.tib: rim pa gnyis par phyin pa na / med pa dag kyang mthong 'gyur zhing / yod cing nye bar bsgribs na mthong / ring nas phra ba mthong bar 'gyur

verses.skt: dūrāntikasthaṃ rūpaṃ ca viparyāsena manyate | doṣe maṇḍalasaṃsthāne maṇḍalānīva paśyati
verses.tib: nye dang ring bar gnas pa'i gzugs / phyin ci log tu shes par 'gyur / nad kyis zlum po'i dbyibs 'dra par / zlum po nyid du mthong bar 'gyur

verses.skt: dvidhaikaṃ dṛṣṭimadhyasthe bahudhā bahudhāsthite | dṛṣṭer abhyantaragate hrasvavṛddhaviparyayam
verses.tib: mthong byed dbus gnas gcig gnyis mthong / mang du gnas na du ma mthong / mthong byed nang du zhugs pa ni / che chung go ni bzlog par mthong

verses.skt: nāntikastham adhaḥsaṃsthe dūragaṃ nopari sthite | pārśve paśyen na pārśvasthe timirākhyo ’yam āmayaḥ
verses.tib: 'og tu gnas pas nye mi mthong / steng du gnas pas ring mi mthong / ngos la gnas pas g.yas g.yon min / nad 'di rab rib ces byar bshad

verses.skt: prāpnoti kācatāṃ doṣe tṛtīyapaṭalāśrite | tenordhvam īkṣate nādhas tanucailāvṛtopamam
verses.tib: nad ni rim pa gsum par brten / sngon po nyid du 'gyur ba yin / de yis steng mthong 'og mi mthong / gos srab kyis g.yogs ltar mthong zhing

verses.skt: yathāvarṇaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭir hīyeta ca kramāt | tathāpy upekṣamāṇasya caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ gataḥ
verses.tib: kha dog ji bzhin 'gyur ba dang / rim gyis mthong ba nyams par 'gyur / de lta na yang yal bar dor / rim pa bzhi par / phyin nas ni

verses.skt: liṅganāśaṃ malaḥ kurvaṃś chādayed dṛṣṭimaṇḍalam | tatra vātena timire vyāviddham iva paśyati
verses.tib: mthong byed mtshan mo nyams byed cing / mig gi rgyal mo khebs par byed / de la rlung gyur rab rib ni / long long por ni mthong ba dang

verses.skt: calāvilāruṇābhāsaṃ prasannaṃ cekṣate muhuḥ | jālāni keśān maśakān raśmīṃś copekṣite ’tra ca
verses.tib: g.yo zhing rnyog can rtsa dmar snang / chad 'ga' gsal bar mthong ba dang / dra ba skra shad sbrang bu dang / 'od mthong de ni yal bar bor

verses.skt: kācībhūte dṛg aruṇā paśyaty āsyam anāsikam | candradīpādyanekatvaṃ vakram ṛjv api manyate
verses.tib: sngon por gyur la mig dmar la / bzhin la sna ni med par mthong / zla ba med sogs du mar mthong / yon po'ang drang por mthong bar 'gyur

verses.skt: vṛddhaḥ kāco dṛśaṃ kuryād rajodhūmāvṛtām iva | spaṣṭāruṇābhāṃ vistīrṇāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vā hatadarśanām
verses.tib: sngon po 'phel na mthong byed ni / rdul gyis khebs pa lta bur mthong / gsal zhing dmar ba'am rgya che ba'am / phra ba'am mthong ba nyams par 'gyur

verses.skt: sa liṅganāśo vāte tu saṃkocayati dṛksirāḥ | dṛṅmaṇḍalaṃ viśaty antar gambhīrā dṛg asau smṛtā
verses.tib: de ni mthong ba nyams pa yin / rlung gis mig gi rtsa 'khums 'gyur / mthong byed gting du zhugs pa dag / 'di ni gting ring zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: pittaje timire vidyutkhadyotadyotadīpitam | śikhitittiripattrābhaṃ prāyo nīlaṃ ca paśyati
verses.tib: mkhris gyur rab rib glog dang ni / srin bu me khyer me sgron 'od / rma bya sreg pa'i sgro dang 'dra / phal cher sngon por mthong bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kāce dṛg kācanīlābhā tādṛg eva ca paśyati | arkendupariveṣāgnimarīcīndradhanūṃṣi ca
verses.tib: mthong byed mig ni 'khar g.ya' 'dra / de lta bu ni mthong ba dang / nyi zla 'khyims dang me dang ni / smig rgyu 'ja' tshon mthong bar 'gyur

verses.skt: bhṛṅganīlā nirālokā dṛk snigdhā liṅganāśataḥ | dṛṣṭiḥ pittena hrasvākhyā sā hrasvā hrasvadarśinī
verses.tib: bung ba ltar sngo mthong ba med / 'bras bu snum pa mthong nyams yin / mkhris pa mig ni chung zhes bshad / chung mthong de ni thung ngu yin

verses.skt: bhavet pittavidagdhākhyā pītā pītābhadarśanā | kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ ca paśyati
verses.tib: ser zhing dngos po ser por mthong / mkhris pas tshig par gyur zhes bya / bad kan rab rib phal cher ni / snum zhing dkar bar mthong ba dang

verses.skt: śaṅkhendukundakusumaiḥ kumudair iva cācitam | kāce tu niṣprabhendvarkapradīpādyair ivācitam
verses.tib: dung dang zla ba kun+da dang / kun+da'i me tog lta bus khyab / sngon po 'od med nyi zla dang / sgron mes khyab pa lta bur mthong

verses.skt: sitābhā sā ca dṛṣṭiḥ syāl liṅganāśe tu lakṣyate | mūrtaḥ kapho dṛṣṭigataḥ snigdho darśananāśanaḥ
verses.tib: mig 'bras dkar por snang bar 'gyur / bad kan mthong nyams des mngon khyab / snum zhing mthong ba nyams 'gyur la

verses.skt: bindur jalasyeva calaḥ padminīpuṭasaṃsthitaḥ | uṣṇe saṃkocam āyāti cchāyāyāṃ parisarpati
verses.tib: chu yi thigs pa pad+ma yi / 'dab ma'i steng na gnas ltar g.yo / dro na zhum par 'gyur ba dang / grang bas yongs su khyab par byed

verses.skt: śaṅkhakundendukumudasphaṭikopamaśuklimā | raktena timire raktaṃ tamobhūtaṃ ca paśyati
verses.tib: zla ba me tog kun+da dung / shel ltar snang zhing dkar ba yin / khrag gi rab rib dmar ba dang / mun par gyur pa mthong ba yin

verses.skt: kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭis tādṛk ca paśyati | liṅganāśe ’pi tādṛg dṛṅ niṣprabhā hatadarśanā
verses.tib: sngon po dmar ba gnag par ni / mig gis de ltar mthong ba yin / mtshan ma nyams pa de 'drar mthong / 'od med mthong ba nyams pa yin

verses.skt: saṃsargasaṃnipāteṣu vidyāt saṃkīrṇalakṣaṇān | timirādīn akasmāc ca taiḥ syād vyaktākulekṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: ldan pa 'am ni 'dus pa yi / rab rib la sogs mtshan ma ni / 'dren ma yin par shes par bya / glo bur du ni rab rib dag / gsal dang mi gsal 'khrugs par byed

verses.skt: timire śeṣayor dṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ prajāyate | dyotyate nakulasyeva yasya dṛṅ nicitā malaiḥ
verses.tib: lhag ma dag gis mthong byed ni / dmar zhing sna tshogs dag tu snang / gang gis mthong byed nad kyis khyab / sre mo'i mig 'drar snang bar 'gyur

verses.skt: nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi | arke ’stamastakanyastagabhastau stambham āgatāḥ
verses.tib: de ni nyin mthong mtshan mo min / ne+e'u le long ba zhes de bshad / nyi ma nub par gyur pa na / 'od mi snang tshe rengs 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gado ’paraḥ | divākarakaraspṛṣṭā bhraṣṭā dṛṣṭipathān malāḥ
verses.tib: mthong byed nyams par byed pa ni / nad kyi long ba gnyis pa yin / nyi ma'i zer gyis phog pa na / mthong ba'i lam nas dri ma ni

verses.skt: vilīnalīnā yacchanti vyaktam atrāhni darśanam | uṣṇataptasya sahasā śītavārinimajjanāt
verses.tib: zhu zhing med par gyur nas ni / nyin mo gsal bar mthong bar byed / tsha bas gdungs te mod la ni / chu grang nang du zhugs gyur na

verses.skt: tridoṣaraktasaṃpṛkto yāty ūṣmordhvaṃ tato ’kṣiṇi | dāhoṣe malinaṃ śuklam ahany āviladarśanam
verses.tib: nad gzhi gsum dang khrag 'khrugs te / drod ni gyen 'gro de nas mig / tsha zhing na dkar dri ma can / nyin mo long long por mthong zhing

verses.skt: rātrāv āndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā | bhṛśam amlāśanād doṣaiḥ sāsrair yā dṛṣṭir ācitā
verses.tib: mtshan mo long bar gyur pa dag / de ni dro bas tshig ces bya / shas cher skyur zos nad dang ni / khrag dang bcas pas mig khyab 'gyur

verses.skt: sakledakaṇḍūkaluṣā vidagdhāmlena sā smṛtā | śokajvaraśirorogasaṃtaptasyānilādayaḥ
verses.tib: 'drul zhing g.yo la dri ma can / de ni skyur gyis tshig ces bya / mya ngan rims dang mgo nad kyis / rlung sogs gdungs par gyur pa las

verses.skt: dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ | sahasaivālpasattvasya paśyato rūpam adbhutam
verses.tib: rlung sogs 'khrugs shing dud 'thul mthong / de ni dud pa can zhes bya / snying stobs chung bas glo bur du / ngo mtshar can gyi gzugs mthong ba'am

verses.skt: bhāsvaraṃ bhāskarādiṃ vā vātādyā nayanāśritāḥ | kurvanti tejaḥ saṃśoṣya dṛṣṭiṃ muṣitadarśanām
verses.tib: nyi ma 'od can sogs mthong nas / mig la brten pa'i rlung la sogs / gzi brjid nyams pas mig gi ni / mthong ba nyams par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: vaiḍūryavarṇāṃ stimitāṃ prakṛtisthām ivāvyathām | aupasargika ity eṣa liṅganāśo ’tra varjayet
verses.tib: bai DUr+ya'i mdog mkhrang bag dang / rang bzhin gnas ltar nad med 'gyur / 'di ni phrad pa las byung ba'i / mtshan ma nyams pa zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: vinā kaphāl liṅganāśān gambhīrāṃ hrasvajām api | ṣaṭ kācā nakulāndhaś ca yāpyāḥ śeṣāṃs tu sādhayet
verses.tib: 'di las bad kan ma gtogs mtshan / nyams dang thung ngu gting zhen spang / mig sngon drug dang ne+e'u le'i / long ba 'tsho tsam lhag ma ni

verses.skt: dvādaśeti gadā dṛṣṭau nirdiṣṭāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ
verses.tib: bcu gnyis po ni gso bar bya / de ltar mig nad nyi shu ni / rtsa bdun dag tu bstan pa yin

verses.skt: timiraṃ kācatāṃ yāti kāco ’py āndhyam upekṣayā | netrarogeṣv ato ghoraṃ timiraṃ sādhayed drutam
verses.tib: rab rib sngon po nyid 'gyur zhing / sngon po ma bcos long bar 'gyur / de bas mig nad la rab rib / mi bzad myur du gso bar bya

verses.skt: tulāṃ paceta jīvantyā droṇe ’pāṃ pādaśeṣite | tatkvāthe dviguṇakṣīraṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet
verses.tib: 'tsho byed srang brgya chu pre ni / bcu drug nang bskol bzhi cha lus / khu ba 'o ma bre do dang / mar ni bre gang lhan cig btso

verses.skt: prapauṇḍarīkakākolīpippalīlodhrasaindhavaiḥ | śatāhvāmadhukadrākṣāsitādāruphalatrayaiḥ
verses.tib: stag tsher ba dang ra mnye ba / seng phrom rgyam tsha pi pi ling / shu ti shing mngar rgun 'brum dang / thang shing kha ra 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: kārṣikair niśi tat pītaṃ timirāpaharaṃ param | drākṣācandanamañjiṣṭhākākolīdvayajīvakaiḥ
verses.tib: zho ni gnyis gnyis btab bskol te / mtshan 'thungs rab rib sel mchog yin / rgun 'brum btsod dang tsan+dan dkar / ra mnye ba gnyis dzi ba ka

verses.skt: sitāśatāvarīmedāpuṇḍrāhvamadhukotpalaiḥ | pacej jīrṇaghṛtaprasthaṃ samakṣīraṃ picūnmitaiḥ
verses.tib: kha ra nye'u shing me da dang / shing mngar ut+pal puN+Da rI / zho ni gnyis gnyis mar rnying ni / bre gang 'o ma de mnyam bskol

verses.skt: hanti tat kācatimiraraktarājīśirorujaḥ | paṭolanimbakaṭukādārvīsevyavarāvṛṣam
verses.tib: de yis mig sngon rab rib dang / mar gyis mgo nad rab rib 'joms / nim pa skyer pa pa to la

verses.skt: sadhanvayāsatrāyantīparpaṭaṃ pālikaṃ pṛthak | prastham āmalakānāṃ ca kvāthayen nalvaṇe ’mbhasi
verses.tib: pu tse shel dang pu shel tsi / 'bras bu gsum dang ba sha ka / byi tshe rab dang kyi lce ba / par pa ta ni srang re yin / skyu ru ra ni bre gang dang / chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol

verses.skt: tadāḍhake ’rdhapalikaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet | mustabhūnimbayaṣṭyāhvakuṭajodīcyacandanaiḥ
verses.tib: bre bzhi lus par gla sgang dang / rtsa mkhris shing mngar dug mo nyung / ba lu ka dang tsan+dan dang / pi pi ling srang phyed phyed dang / mar bre gang dang bcas bskol ba

verses.skt: sapippalīkais tat sarpir ghrāṇakarṇāsyarogajit | vidradhijvaraduṣṭārurvisarpāpacikuṣṭhanut
verses.tib: des ni rna mig sna nad dang / khong 'bras rims dang mdzer pa dang / 'brum phran shu ba mdze nad sel

verses.skt: viśeṣāc chukratimiranaktāndhyoṣṇāmladāhahṛt | triphalāṣṭapalaṃ kvāthyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ jalāḍhake
verses.tib: mchog tu ling tog rab rib dang / mtshan long dro bas tshig pa 'joms / 'bras bu gsum ni srang brgyad dag / chu bre bzhi bskol bzhi cha lus

verses.skt: tena tulyapayaskena triphalāpalakalkavān | ardhaprastho ghṛtāt siddhaḥ sitayā mākṣikeṇa vā
verses.tib: 'o ma de dang cha mnyam dang / 'bras bu gsum gyi lde gu ni / srang gcig zhun mar bre phyed bskol / kha ra'am sbrang rtsir bcas pa'am / 'bras bu gsum gyi khu bar bcas

verses.skt: yuktaṃ pibet tat timirī tadyuktaṃ vā varārasam | yaṣṭīmadhudvikākolīvyāghrīkṛṣṇāmṛtotpalaiḥ
verses.tib: 'thungs na rab rib thams cad 'joms / shing mngar ra mnye ba gnyis dang / kaN+Da kA ri pi pi ling / a ru ra dang ut+pa la

verses.skt: pālikaiḥ sasitādrākṣair ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet samaiḥ | ajākṣīravarāvasāmārkavasvarasaiḥ pṛthak
verses.tib: kha ra rgun 'brum srang rer bcas / ra yi 'o ma mar bre re / 'bras bu gsum dang ba sha ka / bring ga ra dza'i khu bar bskol

verses.skt: mahātraiphalam ity etat paraṃ dṛṣṭivikārajit | traiphalenātha haviṣā lihānas triphalāṃ niśi
verses.tib: 'di ni 'bras bu gsum chen mo'i / mar de mig nad kun sel mchog / 'bras bu gsum dang mar ram ni / 'bras bu gsum dang shing mngar bcas

verses.skt: yaṣṭīmadhukasaṃyuktāṃ madhunā ca pariplutām | māsam ekaṃ hitāhāraḥ pibann āmalakodakam
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi yis ni sbrus gyur pa / mtshan mo zos par gyur na ni / zla gcig phan pa'i zas bsten zhing / skyu ru ra yi chu 'thungs na

verses.skt: sauparṇaṃ labhate cakṣur ity āha bhagavān nimiḥ | tāpyāyohemayaṣṭyāhvasitājīrṇājyamākṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: mkha' lding lta bu'i mig thob ces / drang srong mu khyud kyis bshad do / ta bya shing mngar lcags dang gser

verses.skt: saṃyojitā yathākāmaṃ timiraghnī varā varā | saghṛtaṃ vā varākvāthaṃ śīlayet timirāmayī
verses.tib: kha ra sbrang rtsi mar rnying dang / 'bras bu gsum dang ci 'dod sbyar / bsten pas rab rib 'joms mchog yin / yang na 'bras bu gsum bskol mar / rab rib can gyis bsten bya'am

verses.skt: apūpasūpasaktūn vā triphalācūrṇasaṃyutān | pāyasaṃ vā varāyuktaṃ śītaṃ samadhuśarkaram
verses.tib: snum khur phye'am sran tshod ni / 'bras bu gsum gyi phye bcas pa'am / 'o thug 'bras bu gsum bcas pa / bsgrangs te kha ra sbrang rtsi btab

verses.skt: prātar bhaktasya vā pūrvam adyāt pathyāṃ pṛthak pṛthak | mṛdvīkāśarkarākṣaudraiḥ satataṃ timirāturaḥ
verses.tib: zas ma zos pa'am nang par ni / rgun 'brum kha ra sbrang rtsi dang / a ru ra ni so sor bza' / rtag tu rab rib can gyis bsten

verses.skt: srotojāṃśāṃś catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ tāmrāyorūpyakāñcanaiḥ | yuktān pratyekam ekāṃśair andhamūṣodarasthitān
verses.tib: lig bu mig cha drug cu bzhi / zangs dang dngul dang gser gyi cha / re re gcig tu sbyar ba ni / kong bu kha sbyar nang du gzhug

verses.skt: dhmāpayitvā samāvṛttaṃ tatas tac ca niṣecayet | rasaskandhakaṣāyeṣu saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.tib: 'dres par gyur gyi bar du bud / de nas de yi ro drug gi / tshogs kyi khu ba lan bdun dang / so sor de la blugs par bya

verses.skt: vaiḍūryamuktāśaṅkhānāṃ tribhir bhāgair yutaṃ tataḥ | cūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta tat sarvatimirāpaham
verses.tib: mu tig dung dang be+e DUr+ya / tsha ba gsum dang de nas bsre / phye ma'i mig sman de gtang bya / rab rib thams cad sel byed yin

verses.skt: māṃsītrijātakāyaḥkuṅkumanīlotpalābhayātutthaiḥ | sitakācaśaṅkhaphenakamaricāñjanapippalīmadhukaiḥ
verses.tib: rgun 'brum pad+ma'i rtsa ba yi / khu ba 'o ma chang dang zhag / char pa de bzhin lig bu mig / bskol zhing bsku ba byas nas ni / phye ma de ni dung dang gzhug

verses.skt: candre ’śvinīsanāthe sucūrṇitair añjayed yugalaṃ akṣṇoḥ | timirārmaraktarājīkaṇḍūkācādiśamam icchan
verses.tib: mthong ba gsal byed mig sman yin / mig nad thams cad la bsngags zhes / lus 'phags rgyal pos bshad pa yin / spangs ma srang gnyis rgya shug gi

verses.skt: maricavaralavaṇabhāgau bhāgau dvau kaṇasamudraphenābhyām | sauvīrabhāganavakaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ kaphāmayajit
verses.tib: sol bar bsregs la ra yi ni / 'o ma mar dang sbrang rtsi yi / nang du lan ni bdun bdun bcug / ta bya dang ni na le sham

verses.skt: manohvātutthakastūrīmāṃsīmalayarocanāḥ | daśakarpūrasaṃyuktam aśītiguṇam añjanam
verses.tib: lig bu mig dang pu tse shel / spang spos rgyam tsha a ru ra

verses.skt: piṣṭaṃ citrāśvinīpuṣye ṣaḍvidhe timire hitam | prasādanaṃ ca dṛṣṭeḥ syāc cakṣuṣeṇāvabhāṣitam
drākṣāmṛṇālīsvarase kṣīramadyavasāsu ca | pṛthak divyāpsu srotojaṃ saptakṛtvo niṣecayet
verses.tib: seng phrom ldong ros pi pi ling / sug smel rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dang / stang zil zho ni gnyis gnyis dang

verses.skt: tac cūrṇitaṃ sthitaṃ śaṅkhe dṛkprasādanam añjanam | śastaṃ sarvākṣirogeṣu videhapatinirmitam
nirdagdhaṃ bādarāṅgārais tutthaṃ cetthaṃ niṣecitam | kramād ajāpayaḥsarpiḥkṣaudre tasmāt paladvayam
verses.tib: shing mngar srang gcig bcas pa ni / kong bu kha sbyar nang bsregs btags / mig sngon mtshan mo long / bar bcas / dmar ris de bsten pa yis 'joms

verses.skt: kārṣikais tāpyamaricasrotojakaṭukānataiḥ | paṭulodhraśilāpathyākaṇailāñjanaphenakaiḥ
verses.tib: phye mas mchog tu rab rib nad / nyi mas mun pa lta bur sel / spang spos dri bzang gsum dang lcags / gur gum ut+pal sngon po dang / kha ra spangs ma a ru ra

verses.skt: yuktaṃ palena yaṣṭyāś ca mūṣāntardhmātacūrṇitam | hanti kācārmanaktāndhyaraktarājīḥ suśīlitaḥ
verses.tib: rgya mtsho'i lbu ba 'ching bu dkar / na le sham dang pi pi ling / stang zil shing mngar dung dang bcas / tha skar zla ba'i tshe na ni / phye ma mig gnyis la bskus na

verses.skt: cūrṇo viśeṣāt timiraṃ bhāskaro bhāskaro yathā | triṃśadbhāgā bhujaṅgasya gandhapāṣāṇapañcakam
verses.tib: mig mdzer rab rib dmar ris dang / g.ya' dang mig sngon sogs zhi byed / na le sham dang rgyam tsha ni / cha re pi pi ling dang ni

verses.skt: śulbatālakayor dvau dvau vaṅgasyaiko ’ñjanāt trayam | andhamūṣīkṛtaṃ dhmātaṃ pakvaṃ vimalam añjanam
