verses.tib: rgya mtsho'i lbu ba cha gnyis dang / skyer pa'i kha N+Da cha dgu ni / nag pa la bab tshe na btags / mig bskus bad kan rab rib 'joms / spangs ma bsregs te lan mang du

verses.skt: timirāntakaraṃ loke dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ | gomūtre chagaṇarase ’mlakāñjike ca strīstanye | haviṣi viṣe ca mākṣike ca | yat tutthaṃ jvalitam anekaśo niṣiktaṃ | tat kuryād garuḍasamaṃ narasya cakṣuḥ
verses.tib: ba gcin ra thug khu ba dang / skyur rtsabs bud med nu zho dang / dug gi khu ba sbrang rtsi mar / bcug par gyur pa gang yin pa / phye mar byas des mi yi mig / mkha' lding mig ltar gsal bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tutthaṃ sakāśaṃ kanakaṃ saphalaṃ śaṅkhaśilāgairikam añjanaṃ ca | naraḥ kapālasahikūṅkuḍāṇḍaṃ saptadvisaptatrisamayo gataḥ
bhṛṅgodbhavasvarasabhāvitam ājadugdhe mūtre gavām payasi ca triphalākaṣāye | drākṣārase ca pariśuddham iti krameṇa sauvīram añjanam idaṃ timiraṃ nihanti
śreṣṭhājalaṃ bhṛṅgarasaṃ saviṣājyam ajāpayaḥ | yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yat sīsaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.tib: bring ga ra dza 'bras bu gsum / dug dang shing mngar khu ba dang / mar dang ra yi 'o mar ni / zha nye lan ni bdun bdun du

verses.skt: taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanānañjanā vā | taimiryārmasrāvapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti || 35 || rasendrabhujagau tulyau tayos tulyam athāñjanam | īṣatkarpūrasaṃyuktam añjanaṃ timirāpaham
verses.tib: bsregs shing bsregs shing btsos pa yi / mig sman thur mar byas pa de / mig sman bskol ba 'am ma bskol ba'am / byugs na rab rib mig mdzer nad / chu ser 'dzag dang 'byar bag can / g.ya' dang tshor ba med pa dang / ri mo dmar por snang ba 'joms / dngul chu ro nye cha mnyam bya

verses.skt: yo gṛdhras taruṇaraviprakāśagallas tasyāsyaṃ samayamṛtasya gośakṛdbhiḥ | nirdagdhaṃ samaghṛtam añjanaṃ ca peṣyaṃ yogo ’yaṃ nayanabalaṃ karoti gārdhram
verses.tib: de gnyis stang zil mnyam byas la / ga pur cung zad btab pa yi / mig sman rab rib sel mchog yin / bya rgod dus su shi ba'i mgo bo ni / nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog 'dra gang yin de

verses.skt: kṛṣṇasarpavadane sahaviṣkaṃ dagdham añjananiḥsṛtadhūmam | cūrṇitaṃ naladapattravimiśraṃ bhinnatāram api rakṣati cakṣuḥ
verses.tib: ba lang lci bas bsregs thal lig bu mig / cha mnyam btags par gyur pa'i phye ma yi / sbyor 'dis mig gi gsal stobs bya rgod lta bur byed / sbrul nag mgor ni lig pu mig / mar bcas dud pa ma shor bsregs / spang spos gan+d+ha b+ha dra dang / lhan cig btags pas mig 'bras ni / rdol yang mig ni srung bar byed

verses.skt: nāgāñjanāśmālaśilārkavaṅgais triṃśaddvipañcadvayam advikaikaiḥ | andhamūṣīkṛtaiś chāgapayoniṣiktair dṛṣṭer idaṃ bhāskaram añjanaṃ syāt || 38+1 || sroto'śmavīraṃ ... veṣṭyājamodāvaṭacchadaiḥ | ṣaṭkaṃ timirajit kliṣṭaṃ mṛlliptaṃ gomayāgninā
verses.tib: ba lang lci bas bsregs thal lig bu mig / cha mnyam btags par gyur pa'i phye ma yi / sbyor 'dis mig gi gsal stobs bya rgod lta bur byed / sbrul nag mgor ni lig pu mig / mar bcas dud pa ma shor bsregs / spang spos gan+d+ha b+ha dra dang / lhan cig btags pas mig 'bras ni / rdol yang mig ni srung bar byed

verses.skt: tāmrāyaskāntagandhāhvātārkṣā yat succhalaṃ rajaḥ | lohe bhṛṅgarajo bhṛṣṭaṃ saptāhaṃ dṛṣṭirogajit
kṛṣṇasarpaṃ mṛtaṃ nyasya caturaś cāpi vṛścikān | kṣīrakumbhe trisaptāhaṃ kledayitvā pramanthayet
verses.tib: sbrul nag shi ba'i ro dang ni / sdig pa shi ba'i ro bzhi ni / 'o ma'i bum par zhag nyi shu / rtsa gcig bcug

verses.skt: tatra yan navanītaṃ syāt puṣṇīyāt tena kukkuṭam | andhas tasya puṛīṣeṇa prekṣate dhruvam añjanāt
verses.tib: ste bsrul la bsrub / de las mar sar gang byung bas / khyim bya gsos te de yi ni / rtug pas mig ni bskus gyur na / long bas kyang ni legs par mthong

verses.skt: kṛṣṇasarpavasā śaṅkhaḥ katakāt phalam añjanam | rasakriyeyam acirād andhānāṃ darśanapradā
verses.tib: sbrul nag po yi zhag dang dug / stang zil ka ta ka'i 'bras bu / khu bar byas pa'i sbyor ba yis / long ba'ang myur du mthong bar byed

verses.skt: maricāni daśārdhapicus tāpyāt tutthāt palaṃ picur yaṣṭyāḥ | kṣīrārdradagdham añjanam apratisārākhyam uttamaṃ timire
verses.tib: na le sham ni rdog ma bcu / drub mar cang ni srang phyed dang / spangs ma srang gcig shing mngar ni / zho gnyis 'o ma'i nang du sbangs / du ba ma shor bsregs mig sman / khu ba mnyam med ces bya ste / rab rib 'joms pa'i mchog yin no

verses.skt: akṣabījamaricāmalakatvaktutthayaṣṭimadhukair jalapiṣṭaiḥ | chāyayaiva guṭikāḥ pariśuṣkā nāśayanti timirāṇy acireṇa
verses.tib: ba ru ra yi tshi gu na le sham / skyu ru ra dang spangs ma shing mngar ni / chu thag byas pa'i ri lu grib mar bskams / rab rib myur du 'joms par byed pa yin

verses.skt: maricāmalakajalodbhavatutthāñjanatāpyadhātubhiḥ kramavṛddhaiḥ | ṣaṇmākṣika iti yogas timirārmakledakācakaṇḍūhantā
verses.tib: na le sham dang skyu ru ra / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba spangs ma dang / dngul rdo dang ni drub mar bcas / go rims bzhin du cha res bskyed / drub mar cha ni drug pa ste / sbyor 'dis rab rib ling tog mdzer

verses.skt: ratnāni rūpyaṃ sphaṭikaṃ suvarṇaṃ sroto'ñjanaṃ tāmram ayaḥ saśaṅkhaṃ | kucandanaṃ lohitagairikaṃ ca cūrṇāñjanaṃ sarvadṛgāmayaghnam
verses.tib: rin chen dngul dang shel dang gser / lig bu mig dang zangs dang lcags / tsan+dan dmar po yug snam dmar / phye ma'i mig sman nad kun sel

verses.skt: tilatailam akṣatailaṃ bhṛṅgasvaraso ’sanāc ca niryūhaḥ | āyasapātravipakvaṃ karoti dṛṣṭer balaṃ nasyam
verses.tib: til mar ba ru ra yi mar / bring ga ra dza a sa na'i / khu ba lcags kyi snod du bskol / snar blugs mig ni gsal stobs skyed

verses.skt: doṣānurodhena ca naikaśas taṃ snehāsravisrāvaṇarekanasyaiḥ | upācared añjanamūrdhavastivastikriyātarpaṇalepasekaiḥ
verses.tib: nad kyi tshul las de la lan mang du / snum blud gtar ga bkru sman sna sman dang / mig sman mgo bo'i bkru sman mas gtong dang / nyams brtas byugs dang blugs pas ci rigs gso

verses.skt: sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idaṃ pratidoṣam ataḥ śṛṇu
verses.tib: 'di ni spyi yi gso ba yin / da ni re re'i mnyan par gyis

verses.skt: vātaje timire tatra daśamūlāmbhasā ghṛtam | kṣīre caturguṇe śreṣṭhākalkapakvaṃ pibet tataḥ
verses.tib: de la rlung gyur rab rib la / rtsa ba bcu bskol khu ba mar / 'o ma bzhi 'gyur 'bras bu gsum / lde gu bskol ba blud par bya

verses.skt: triphalāpañcamūlānāṃ kaṣāyaṃ kṣīrasaṃyutam | eraṇḍatailasaṃyuktaṃ yojayec ca virecanam
verses.tib: de 'og 'bras bu gsum dang ni / rtsa ba lnga'i khu 'o ma dang / e raN+Da yi til mar bcas / bkru sman nye bar gtang bar bya

verses.skt: samūlajālajīvantītulāṃ droṇe ’mbhasaḥ pacet | aṣṭabhāgasthite tasmiṃs tailaprasthaṃ payaḥsame
verses.tib: dzi ban ti yi yal gar bcas / srang brgya chu bre bcu drug bskol / brgyad cha lus pa de nang du / til mar 'o ma bre re dang

verses.skt: balātritayajīvantīvarīmūlaiḥ palonmitaiḥ | yaṣṭīpalaiś caturbhiś ca lohapātre vipācayet
verses.tib: ba la gsum dang dzi ban ti / nye'u shing rtsa ba srang / re dang / shing mngar srang ni bzhi dang bcas / lcags kyi snod du bskol bar bya

verses.skt: loha eva sthitaṃ māsaṃ nāvanād ūrdhvajatrujān | vātapittāmayān hanti tad viśeṣād dṛgāśrayān
verses.tib: lcags snod nyid du zla gcig gzhag / sna sman nam tshod yan chad kyi / rlung nad mkhris pa'i nad 'joms shing / mchog tu mig la gnas pa sel

verses.skt: keśāsyakandharāskandhapuṣṭilāvaṇyakāntidam | sitairaṇḍajaṭāsiṃhīphaladāruvacānataiḥ
verses.tib: skra gdong gnya' ba phrag nad sel / rgyas shing gzi mdangs mdzes par byed / e raN+Da dkar rtsa ba dang / thang shing bri ha ti'i 'bras bu / shu dag rgya spos tsi tra dang

verses.skt: ghoṣayā bilvamūlaiś ca tailaṃ pakvaṃ payo'nvitam | nasyaṃ sarvordhvajatrūtthavātaśleṣmāmayārtijit
verses.tib: bil ba'i rtsa ba til mar dang / 'o mar bcas bskol snar blugs na / nam tshong yan chad rlung dang ni / bad kan gyi ni nad kun sel

verses.skt: vasāñjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate | gṛdhrāhikukkuṭotthā vā madhukenānvitā pṛthak
verses.tib: stag dang phag dang bya rgod dang / sbrul dang khyim bya'i tshil dang ni / shing mngar so sor sbyar te bskol / mig sman bskus par bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: pratyañjane ca srotojaṃ rasakṣīraghṛte kramāt | niṣiktaṃ pūrvavad yojyaṃ timiraghnam anuttamam
verses.tib: de rjes mig sman lig bu mig / sha khu 'o ma mar rim bzhin / snga ma bzhin du blugs na ni / rab rib 'joms byed mchog yin no

verses.skt: na ced evaṃ śamaṃ yāti tatas tarpaṇam ācaret | śatāhvākuṣṭhanaladakākolīdvayayaṣṭibhiḥ
verses.tib: de ltar byas kyang ma zhi na / de 'og brta ba'i cho ga spyad / shu ti ru rta spang spos dang / shing mngar ram nye ba gnyis dang

verses.skt: prapauṇḍarīkasaralapippalīdevadārubhiḥ | sarpir aṣṭaguṇakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ tarpaṇam uttamam
verses.tib: stag tsher ba dang sa ra la / pi pi ling dang thang shing ni / mar gyi brgyad 'gyur 'o mar bskol / mig brta ba yi mchog yin no

verses.skt: medasas tadvad aiṇeyād dugdhasiddhāt khajāhatāt | uddhṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ tejo madhukośīracandanaiḥ
verses.tib: ri dag e ne ya'i tshil ni / 'o mar bskol te gzar bus dkrugs / de yi dngas ma shing mngar dang / tsan+dan pu shel tse de bzhin

verses.skt: śvāvicchalyakagodhānāṃ dakṣatittiribarhiṇām | pṛthak pṛthag anenaiva vidhinā kalpayed vasām
verses.tib: shwa bid reg 'jam go da dang / khyim bya sreg pa rma bya'i tshil / re re zhing ni cho ga dag / 'di dag gis ni brta bar bya

verses.skt: prasādanaṃ snehanaṃ ca puṭapākaṃ prayojayet | vātapīnasavac cātra nirūhaṃ sānuvāsanam
verses.tib: gsal bar bya dang snum dang ni / sman phur btsos pa'i thigs pa'ang blugs / 'dir ni rlung 'gyur cham pa bzhin / ni ru ha dang 'jam rtsi bya

verses.skt: pittaje timire sarpir jīvanīyaphalatrayaiḥ | vipācitaṃ pāyayitvā snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām
verses.tib: mkhris pa las gyur rab rib la / 'tsho byed 'bras bu gsum dang ni / bskol ba'i mar ni blud bya zhing / snum gyis zhen par gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: śarkarailātrivṛccūrṇair madhuyuktair virecayet | suśītān sekalepādīn yuñjyān netrāsyamūrdhasu
verses.tib: kha ra dur byid sug smel phye / sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i bkru sman gtang / rab bsil sman chu blugs byug sogs / gdong dang mig dang spyi bor bya

verses.skt: śārivāpadmakośīramuktāśābaracandanaiḥ | vartiḥ śastāñjane cūrṇas tathā pattrotpalāñjanaiḥ
verses.tib: thal tres shug pa pu shel tsi / mu tig seng phrom tsan+dan dkar / ri lu'i mig sman bskus na phan / de bzhin gan+d+ha b+ha dra

verses.skt: sanāgapuṣpakarpūrayaṣṭyāhvasvarṇagairikaiḥ | sauvīrāñjanatutthakaśṛṅgīdhātrīphalasphaṭikakarpūram
verses.tib: dang / nA ga puSh+pa ut+pa la / ga pur shing mngar yug snam phan / skyer khaN+Da dang sbangs ma dang / karka ta yi sring gi dang / skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu shel

verses.skt: pañcāṃśaṃ pañcāṃśaṃ tryaṃśam athaikāṃśam añjanaṃ timiraghnam | nasyaṃ cājyaṃ śṛtaṃ kṣīrajīvanīyasitotpalaiḥ
verses.tib: ga pur cha ni lnga lnga dang / cha gsum cha re sbyar ba yin / mig sman rab rib 'joms par byed / 'tsho byed kha ra ut+pa la / 'o ma mar bskol sna sman gtang

verses.skt: śleṣmodbhave ’mṛtākvāthavarākaṇaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam | vidhyet sirāṃ pītavato dadyāc cānu virecanam
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur sle tres dang / 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling / mar bskol snum blud gtar ga gdab / de rjes dan+da dur byid bskol

verses.skt: kvāthaṃ pūgābhayāśuṇṭhīkṛṣṇākumbhanikumbhajam | hrīveradārudviniśākṛṣṇākalkaiḥ payo'nvitaiḥ
verses.tib: gla gor zho sha a ru ra / bca' sga pi pi ling phye gdab / bkru sman dag ni gtang bar bya / rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu bar ni / ba le ka dang ser po gnyis / thang shing pi pi ling 'o ma

verses.skt: dvipañcamūlaniryūhe tailaṃ pakvaṃ ca nāvanam | śaṅkhapriyaṅgunepālīkaṭutrikaphalatrikaiḥ
verses.tib: til mar bskol ba'i sna sman gtang / dung dang gla rtsi pri yang ku / rtsa ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: dṛgvaimalyāya vimalā vartiḥ syāt kokilā punaḥ | kṛṣṇaloharajovyoṣasaindhavatriphalāñjanaiḥ
verses.tib: dri med ri lus mig gsal byed / lcags nag phye ma tsha ba gsum / rgyam tsha 'bras bu gsum mig sman / ri lu nag pos mig gsal byed

verses.skt: śaśagokharasiṃhoṣṭradvijā lālāṭam asthi ca | śvetagovālamaricaśaṅkhacandanaphenakam
verses.tib: ri bong bong bu seng ge glang / rnga mo'i so dang dpral ba'i rus / ba lang dkar spun le sham / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba tsan+dan dung

verses.skt: piṣṭaṃ stanyājyadugdhābhyāṃ vartis timiraśukrajit | raktaje pittavat siddhiḥ śītaiś cāsraṃ prasādayet
verses.tib: nu zho ra yi 'o mar btags / ri lus rab rib ling tog sel / khrag gyur mkhris pa lta bur gso / bsil chos bya zhing gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: madhūkasārāñjanatāmratrikaṭukaviḍaṅgapauṇḍarīkāṇi | salavaṇatutthatriphalālodhrāṇi nabho'mbupiṣṭāni
verses.tib: rgun 'brum spang spos seng phrom dang / shing mngar tsan+dan spangs ma dung

verses.skt: vartiś caturdaśāṅgī nayanāmayanāśanī śilāstambhe | likhitā hitāya jagatas timirāpaharī viśeṣeṇa
ekaguṇā māgadhikā dviguṇā ca harītakī salilapiṣṭā | vartir iyaṃ timirapaṭalakācakaṇḍvasraharī
drākṣayā naladalodhrayaṣṭibhiḥ śaṅkhatāmrahimapadmapadmakaiḥ | sotpalaiś chagaladugdhavartitair asrajaṃ timiram āśu naśyati
verses.tib: pad+ma shug pa ut+pal / ra yi 'o mas ri lur byas / khrag gyur rab rib myur du sel

verses.skt: saṃsargasaṃnipātotthe yathādoṣodayaṃ kriyā | siddhaṃ madhūkakṛmijinmaricāmaradārubhiḥ
verses.tib: ldan pa 'dus pa las gyur pa / nad gzhi cha ni ji bzhin gso / ma du ka dang byi dang ga

verses.skt: sakṣīraṃ nāvanaṃ tailaṃ piṣṭair lepo mukhasya ca | natanīlotpalānantāyaṣṭyāhvasuniṣaṇṇakaiḥ
verses.tib: na le sham dang sgron shing dang / 'o ma til mar bskol ba'am / btags pa'i sna sman gdong bsku bya / rgya spos ut+pal a nan+ta

verses.skt: sādhitaṃ nāvane tailaṃ śirovastau ca śasyate | dadyād uśīraniryūhe cūrṇitaṃ kaṇasaindhavam
verses.tib: shing mngar su ni shan kai / til mar bskol ba'i sna sman dang / mgo bsku 'jam rtsi bya ba bsngags / pu shel tsi bskol khu ba'i nang

verses.skt: tat srutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacet kṣaudraṃ ghane kṣipet | śīte cāsmin hitam idaṃ sarvaje timire ’ñjanam
verses.tib: de btsags slar yang mar bcas par / bskol la ska gyur bsgrangs nas ni / sbrang rtsi bcug pa'i mig sman ni / 'dus pa las gyur rab rib sel

verses.skt: asthīni majjapūrṇāni sattvānāṃ rātricāriṇām | srotojāñjanayuktāni vahaty ambhasi vāsayet
verses.tib: nub mo rgyu ba'i sems can gyi / rus pa rkang gis gang ba dang / lig bu mig dang bcas pa ni / 'bab chu'i nang du zla gcig gam

verses.skt: māsaṃ viṃśatirātraṃ vā tataś coddhṛtya śoṣayet | sameṣaśṛṅgīpuṣpāṇi sayaṣṭyāhvāni tāny anu
verses.tib: zhag ni nyi shu'i bar du gzhag / de nas phyung ste skams nas ni / lug ru yi ni me tog dang / shing mngar bcas pa'i phye mar byas

verses.skt: cūrṇitāny añjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timire sāṃnipātike | kāce ’py eṣā kriyā muktvā sirāṃ yantranipīḍitāḥ
verses.tib: mig bskus 'dus pa las gyur pa'i / rab rib sel bar byed mchog yin / mig sngo gso ba'ang 'di nyid las / gtar ga gdab par mi bya ste

verses.skt: āndhyāya syur malā dadyāt srāvye tv asre jalaukasaḥ | guḍaḥ pheno ’ñjanaṃ kṛṣṇā maricaṃ kuṅkumād rajaḥ
verses.tib: nad des long bar gyur pa yin / srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung bya / bu ram rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dang / pi pi ling dang na le sham

verses.skt: rasakriyeyaṃ sakṣaudrā kācayāpanam añjanam | nakulāndhe tridoṣotthe taimiryavihito vidhiḥ
verses.tib: gur gum sbrang rtsi lig bu mig / spris g.yogs 'tsho ba tsam mig sman / 'dus gyur ne+e'u le lta bur long / rab rib skabs bshad cho gar sbyar

verses.skt: rasakriyā ghṛtakṣaudragomayasvarasadrutaiḥ | tārkṣyagairikatālīśair niśāndhe hitam añjanam
verses.tib: mar dang sbrang rtsi ba lang gi / lci ba'i khu ba skyer khaN+Da / yug snam bal bu'i phye mar sbyar / mig sman mtshan me long la phan

verses.skt: dadhnā vighṛṣṭaṃ maricaṃ rātryandhe ’ñjanam uttamam | karañjikotpalasvarṇagairikāmbhojakesaraiḥ
verses.tib: na le sham ni zho dang sbyar / mtshan mo mi mthong mig sman mchog / ut+pal yug snam ka rany+dza / pad+ma ge sar ba lang gi

verses.skt: piṣṭair gomayatoyena vartir doṣāndhanāsinī | ajāmūtreṇa vā kauntīkṛṣṇāsrotojasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: lci ba'i khu ba dang sbyar ba'i / ri lus mtshan mo long ba sel / ha re Nu ka pi pi ling / rgyam tsha dang ni lig bu mig / ra gcin ri lur byas pa phan

verses.skt: kālānusārītrikaṭutriphalālamanaḥśilāḥ | saphenāś chāgadugdhena rātryandhe vartayo hitāḥ
verses.tib: pri yang ku dang tsha ba gsum / ldong ros ba bla 'bras bu gsum / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba ra'i 'o ma / ri lu byas pa'i mig sman gyis / mtshan mo long ba'i mig nad sel

verses.skt: saṃniveśya yakṛnmadhye pippalīr adahan pacet | tāḥ śuṣkā madhunā ghṛṣṭā niśāndhe śreṣṭham añjanam
verses.tib: mcher pa'i nang du pi pi ling / bcug ste ma tshos bar btsos la / de bskams sbrang rtsir btags pa ni / mtshan mo mi mthong mig sman mchog

verses.skt: khādec ca plīhayakṛtī māhiṣe tailasarpiṣā | ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet
verses.tib: ma he'i mchin pa mcher pa dang / til mar mar ni lhan cig bza' / 'tsho byed sna bcu lo ma ni / mar dang lhan cig bskol ba bza' / a ti mug ta e raN+Da

verses.skt: tathātimuktakairaṇḍaśephālyabhīrujāni ca | bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ pattraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam
verses.tib: nye'u shing lang ga li'i lo ma / mar dang brngos pa bza' bar bya / dro na puSh+pa mar dang brngos / bza' dang btung bar sbyar ba'ang phan

verses.skt: dhūmarākhyāmlapittoṣṇavidāhe jīrṇasarpiṣā | snigdhaṃ virecayec chītaiḥ śītair dihyāc ca sarvataḥ
verses.tib: dud 'thul mkhris pa skyur bro bas / tshig la mar ni rnying pa dag / snum gyur bsil ba'i bkru sman gtang / bsil sman gyis ni kun tu byug

verses.skt: gośakṛdrasadugdhājyair vipakvaṃ śasyate ’ñjanam | svarṇagairikatālīśacūrṇāvāpā rasakriyā
verses.tib: ba / lang lci khu 'o ma mar / bskol ba yi ni mig sman nam / bal bu'i lo ma yug snam bskal / phye ma btab pa'i mig sman phan

verses.skt: medāśābarakānantāmañjiṣṭhādārviyaṣṭibhiḥ | kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: med seng phrom a nan+ta / skyer pa btsod dang shing mngar ni / mar gyi brgyad 'gyur 'o ma bskol / til mar bskol ba'i sna sman phan

verses.skt: tarpaṇaṃ kṣīrasarpiḥ syād aśāmyati sirāvyadhaḥ | cintābhighātabhīśokaraukṣyāt sotkaṭakāsanāt
verses.tib: 'o ma mar sar gyis brta bya / des ma zhin gtar ga gdab / sems las nad dang mya ngan 'jigs / zas rtsub tsog tsog por 'dug dang / skyug sman bkru sman sna sman dang / sman thigs blugs sogs nyes pa dang / kha zas phyed zhu slon pa dang / bkres skom la sogs brnags pa dang

verses.skt: virekanasyavamanapuṭapākādivibhramāt | vidagdhāhāravamanāt kṣuttṛṣṇādividhāraṇāt
verses.tib: 'o ma mar sar gyis brta bya / des ma zhin gtar ga gdab / sems las nad dang mya ngan 'jigs / zas rtsub tsog tsog por 'dug dang / skyug sman bkru sman sna sman dang / sman thigs blugs sogs nyes pa dang / kha zas phyed zhu slon pa dang / bkres skom la sogs brnags pa dang

verses.skt: akṣirogāvasānāc ca paśyet timirarogivat | yathāsvaṃ tatra yuñjīta doṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam
verses.tib: mig nad ma bcos yun ring las / rab rib nad ldan brta bar bya / de la nad gzhi sogs brtags te / rang gi sman ni ji bzhin sbyar

verses.skt: sūryoparāgānalavidyudādivilokanenopahatekṣaṇasya | saṃtarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi kāryaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam
verses.tib: nyi ma gzas zin me 'od glog la sogs / bltas pas mig ni nyams par gyur pa dag / de la bsil sman sogs kyis brta bya zhing / de bzhin gser bdar mar gyi mig sman gtang

verses.skt: cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyair yatnaḥ kartavyo jīvite yāvad icchā | vyartho loko ’yaṃ tulyarātrindivānāṃ puṃsām andhānāṃ vidyamāne ’pi vitte
verses.tib: mi yis ji srid 'tsho yi bar du ni / rtag tu mig bsrung ba la 'bad par bya / nyin dang mtshan mo 'dra bar gyur pa yi / mi la nor yod gyur kyang don med yin

verses.skt: triphalā rudhirasrutir viśuddhir manaso nirvṛtir añjanaṃ sanasyam | śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum bsten gtar ga spyang bya dang / sems dga' mig sman sna sman bcas bsten na / bya sha za zhing rkang pa'i rim gro dang / zhun mar btung bas rtag tu mig bsrung bya

verses.skt: ahitād aśanāt sadā nivṛttir bhṛśabhāsvaccalasūkṣmavīkṣaṇāc ca | muninā niminopadiṣṭam etat paramaṃ rakṣaṇam īkṣaṇasya puṃsām
verses.tib: kha zas mi 'phrod za ba rtag tu spang / rab phra 'tsher dang g.yo ba mi lta zhes / skyes bu'i mig ni mchog tu bsrung ba'i thabs / drang srong chen po mu khyud 'dzin gyis bshad

verses.skt: vidhyet sujātaṃ niṣprekṣyaṃ liṅganāśaṃ kaphodbhavam | āvartakyādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhir vivarjitam upadravaiḥ
verses.tib: de nas mthong ba nyams pa gso ba bshad par bya'o / bad kan las gyur spris g.yogs pa / rba klong la sogs bla brnan ni / drug po med par gyur pa dang / legs smin mthong ba med pa dbye

verses.skt: so ’saṃjāto hi viṣamo dadhimastunibhas tanuḥ | śalākayāvakṛṣṭo ’pi punar ūrdhvaṃ prapadyate
verses.tib: de smin ma gyur mi snyoms la / zho ga chu 'dra srab pa ni / thur ma yis ni drangs gyur kyang / slar yang gyen du 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayet punaḥ | śleṣmalaiḥ pūryate cāśu so ’nyaiḥ sopadravaś cirāt
verses.tib: nad ni mi bzad skyed byed cing / mthong / byed slar yang 'gebs par byed / de ni zas bcas bla brnan bcas / bad kan can gyis myur du skyed

verses.skt: ślaiṣmiko liṅganāśo hi sitatvāc chleṣmaṇaḥ sitaḥ | tasyānyadoṣābhibhavād bhavaty ānīlatā gadaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan gyis ni mthong nyams pa / bad kan dkar bas dkar ba yin / de ni nad gzhan gyis zil gnon / kun tu sngo ba'i nad du 'gyur

verses.skt: tatrāvartacalā dṛṣṭir āvartaky aruṇāsitā | śarkarārkapayoleśaniciteva ghanāti ca
verses.tib: de la rlung gyur mig g.yo zhing / rba klong g.yo zhing dmar skyar 'dug / gseg ma arga'i 'o ma ni / thig phran khyab 'dra mthug pa yin

verses.skt: rājīmatī dṛṅ nicitā śāliśūkābharājibhiḥ | viṣamacchinnadagdhābhā saruk chinnāṃśukā smṛtā
verses.tib: gra ma lta bu'i mig 'bras ni / 'bras kyi gra ma 'bras khyab yin / gra ma bcad pa gra ma tshig / bcad pa ltar snang na ba yin

verses.skt: dṛṣṭiḥ kāṃsyasamacchāyā candrakī candrakākṛtiḥ | chattrābhā naikavarṇā ca chattrakī nāma nīlikā
verses.tib: rma sgro rma bya'i mjug sgro 'dra / khar ba'i mdog tu snang ba yin / gdugs 'dra kha dog sna tshogs pa / spris g.yogs gdugs can zhes bya'o

verses.skt: na vidhyed asirārhāṇāṃ na tṛṭpīnasakāsinām | nājīrṇibhīruvamitaśiraḥkarṇākṣiśūlinām
verses.tib: gtar ga mi bya cham pa dang / lud pa can ni dbye mi bya / ma zhu sngar ma skyugs pa dang / rna mig mgo gzer can mi dbye

verses.skt: atha sādhāraṇe kāle śuddhasaṃbhojitātmanaḥ | deśe prakāśe pūrvāhṇe bhiṣag jānūccapīṭhagaḥ
verses.tib: de nas thun mong dus su ni / sbyang byas zas zos pa la ni / sa phyogs gsal bar snga dro ni / sman pa pus mnyam khri la 'dug

verses.skt: yantritasyopaviṣṭasya svinnākṣasya mukhānilaiḥ | aṅguṣṭhamṛdite netre dṛṣṭau dṛṣṭvotplutaṃ malam
verses.tib: nad pa 'dug cing bsdam byas la / kha yi dbugs kyis dugs bya zhing / mthe bos mig ni mnyes byas nas / nad ni g.yos par mthong ba dang

verses.skt: svāṃ nāsāṃ prekṣamāṇasya niṣkampaṃ mūrdhni dhārite | kṛṣṇād ardhāṅgulaṃ muktvā tathārdhārdham apāṅgataḥ
verses.tib: mi 'gul bar ni mgo nas bzung / rang gi sna la blta bzhin du / nag po sor phyed ma gtogs shing / mig 'gram bzhi cha dor ba ru

verses.skt: tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhaiḥ śalākāṃ niścalaṃ dhṛtām | daivacchidraṃ nayet pārśvād ūrdhvam āmanthayan iva
verses.tib: mdzub mo gung mo mtheb mo yis / mig thur dam du bzung nas ni / rang grub bu gnas 'phred du / gzugs shing gyen mnye drang por byas

verses.skt: savyaṃ dakṣiṇahastena netraṃ savyena cetarat | vidhyet suviddhe śabdaḥ syād aruk cāmbulavasrutiḥ
verses.tib: mig g.yon lag pa g.yas pas dbug / mig g.yas lag pa g.yon pas dbug / legs par phug na sgra 'byung 'gyur / nad med chu ni nyung zhing 'byung

verses.skt: sāntvayann āturaṃ cānu netraṃ stanyena secayet | śalākāyās tato ’greṇa nirlikhen netramaṇḍalam
verses.tib: de rjes nad pa spro bsrings la / mig tu nu zho blugs par bya / de nas thur ma'i rtse mo yis

verses.skt: abādhamānaḥ śanakair nāsāṃ prati nudaṃs tataḥ | ucchiṅghanāc cāpahared dṛṣṭimaṇḍalagaṃ kapham
verses.tib: gnod pa med par dal gyis ni / mig gi 'bras bu dbyi byas la / sna nas dal gyis phul bar bya / mig na gnas pa'i bad kan ni / sna nas brngubs pas bsal bar bya

verses.skt: sthire doṣe cale vāti svedayed akṣi bāhyataḥ | atha dṛṣṭeṣu rūpeṣu śalākām āharec chanaiḥ
verses.tib: nad mi 'gul ba'am 'gyur na ni / mig gi phyi rol nas dugs bya / de nas gzugs ni mthong gyur nas / thur / ma rim gyis dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā baddhākṣaṃ śāyayet tataḥ | viddhād anyena pārśvena tam uttānaṃ dvayor vyadhe
verses.tib: mar la sbangs pa'i ras bal gzhug / mig dkris nas ni de 'og tu / de las logs ni cig shos dbab / gnyis ka phye na gan rkyal bzhag

verses.skt: nivāte śayane ’bhyaktaśiraḥpādaṃ hite ratam | kṣavathuṃ kāsam udgāraṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ pānam ambhasaḥ
verses.tib: rlung med mal du mgo bo dang / rkang bsku phan pa'i zas bsten bya / sbrid pa lud pa sgregs pa dang / mchil ma 'dor dang chu 'thung dang

verses.skt: adhomukhasthitiṃ snānaṃ dantadhāvanabhakṣaṇam | saptāhaṃ nācaret snehapītavac cātra yantraṇā
verses.tib: thur du gtong ba khrus byed dang / so shing 'cha' bar byed pa dag / zhag bdun bar du spang bya zhing / snum 'thung cho ga bzhin du bsdam

verses.skt: śaktito laṅghayet seko ruji koṣṇena sarpiṣā | savyoṣāmalakaṃ vāṭyam aśnīyāt saghṛtaṃ dravam
verses.tib: chu dron gyis ni nyer spyod / ci nus smyung bya na gyur na / mar khu dro 'jam blugs par bya / nas chan sla ba'am thug pa ska / tsha gsum skyu ru ra mar sbyin

verses.skt: vilepīṃ vā tryahāc cāsya kvāthair muktvākṣi secayet | vātaghnaiḥ saptame tv ahni sarvathaivākṣi mocayet
verses.tib: zhag gsum nas ni de bkrol la / rlung 'joms pa yi sman gyi ni / khu ba mig tu blugs par bya / zhag bdun nas ni mig de nyid / rnam pa kun tu dgrol bar bya

verses.skt: yantraṇām anurudhyeta dṛṣṭer āsthairyalābhataḥ | rūpāṇi sūkṣmadīptāni sahasā nāvalokayet
verses.tib: ji srid mi gsal brtan gyur pa / bsdams la 'bad de gnas par bya / gzugs ni phra dang 'tshor ba dag / mod la blta bar mi bya'o

verses.skt: śopharāgarujādīnām adhimanthasya codbhavaḥ | ahitair vedhadoṣāc ca yathāsvaṃ tān upācaret
verses.tib: dbug nyes mi mthun zos pa las / skrang dang na dang dmar la sogs / mig nad gdung ba 'byung bar 'gyur / nad tshul de bzhin de gso bya

verses.skt: kalkitāḥ saghṛtā dūrvāyavagairikaśārivāḥ | mukhālepe prayoktavyā rujārāgopaśāntaye
verses.tib: nad dang dmar bzhi bya'i phyir / dUr ba nas dang yug snam dang / thal tres mar dang ldan pa yi / lde gus gdong ni bsku bar bya

verses.skt: sasarṣapās tilās tadvan mātuluṅgarasāplutāḥ | payasyāśārivāpattramañjiṣṭhāmadhuyaṣṭibhiḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin til dang yungs kar bcas / kha lung khu bas sbrus pa'ang phan / thal tres lo ma pa ya s+ya / btsod dang shing mngar ra yi ni

verses.skt: ajākṣīrayutair lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ śarmakṛt param | lodhrasaindhavamṛdvīkāmadhukaiś chāgalaṃ payaḥ
verses.tib: 'o mar sbyar ba'i lde gu ni / dro 'jam bde bar byed mchog yin / seng phrom rgyam tsha rgun 'bru dang / shing mngar ra yi 'o mar bskol

verses.skt: śṛtam āścyotanaṃ yojyaṃ rujārāgavināśanam | madhukotpalakuṣṭhair vā drākṣālākṣāsitānvitaiḥ
verses.tib: thigs pa mig tu blugs pa ni / na dang dmar ba 'joms par byed / shing mngar ru rta ut+pal / rgun 'bru rgya skyegs kha rar bcas

verses.skt: vātaghnasiddhe payasi śṛtaṃ sarpiś caturguṇe | padmakādipratīvāpaṃ sarvakarmasu śasyate
verses.tib: rlung 'joms sman bskol 'o ma ni / mar gyi bzhi 'gyur bskol ba dang / shug pa la sogs lde gus btab / las kun la ni bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: sirāṃ tathānupaśame snigdhasvinnasya mokṣayet | manthoktāṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryād vedhe rūḍhe ’ñjanaṃ mṛdu
verses.tib: des ma zhi na snum chos dang / dugs byas gtar ga gdab par bya / gdung ba'i gso ba dag kyang bya / dbug 'drub mig sman 'jam / po bsku

verses.skt: āḍhakīmūlamaricaharitālarasāñjanaiḥ | viddhe ’kṣṇi saguḍā vartir yojyā divyāmbupeṣitā
verses.tib: tu pa ri'i rtsa na le sham / ba bla skyer pa'i khaN+Da bsku / mig phyed bu ram ri lu ni / char pa'i chu dang bdar ba gtang

verses.skt: jātīśirīṣadhavameṣaviṣāṇipuṣpavaiḍūryamauktikaphalaṃ payasā supiṣṭam | ājena tāmram amunā pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punar idaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam
verses.tib: dzA ti da ba shi ri sha / karka ta sring gi me tog / mu tig 'bras bu bai DUr+ya / ra yi 'o mar btags pa ni / zangs ma'i snod la sla bar bsku / zhag bdun nas bskol slar yang ni / 'o ma dang btags lde gur byas

verses.skt: piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitam anātapaśuṣkam akṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛc ca dṛṣṭeḥ | srotojavidrumaśilāmbudhiphenatīkṣṇair asyaiva tulyam uditaṃ guṇakalpanābhiḥ
verses.tib: ri lu grib ma la bskams pa / mig bskus phye ba mthong ba ni / gsal zhing stobs ni skyed par byed / byi ru ldong ros lig bu mig / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba na le sham / sna nas btang ba'i sman sbyar na / bshad pa'i yon tan mtshungs par bstan

verses.skt: vātena netre ’bhiṣyaṇṇe nāsānāho ’lpaśophatā | śaṅkhākṣibhrūlalāṭasya todasphuraṇabhedanam
verses.tib: rlung gis mig nad mchi ma 'dzag / sna rgyas cung zad skrangs pa dang / mur 'gram dpral mig smin ma kha / na zhing zug la 'phar ba dang

verses.skt: śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītam acchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ | nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ kṛcchrāj jantūnām iva sarpaṇam
verses.tib: rngu ma skam zhing mchi ma grang / sla nyung na ba ldang dub can / 'byed dang 'dzums par dka' ba dang / srin bu 'gro ba snyam du sems

verses.skt: akṣy ādhmātam ivābhāti sūkṣmaiḥ śalyair ivācitam | snigdhoṣṇaiś copaśamanaṃ so ’bhiṣyanda upekṣitaḥ
verses.tib: mig ni bus pa lta bur snang / zug rngu phra mos khyab snyam byed / snum dang dro bas nyer zhir 'gyur / mchi ma 'dzag pa zhes bya'o / de ma bcos na gdung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: adhimantho bhavet tatra karṇayor nadanaṃ bhramaḥ | araṇyeva ca mathyante lalāṭākṣibhruvādayaḥ
verses.tib: rna ba sgra 'byung mgo 'khor dang / dpral ba mig dang smin ma sogs / gtsub shing gis ni gtsubs snyam byed

verses.skt: hatādhimanthaḥ so ’pi syāt pramādāt tena vedanāḥ | anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā
verses.tib: de yang bag med yal bar bor / gdung bas bcom gyur nad de yis / sna tshogs tshul ni 'byung 'gyur zhing / mig mthong nyams byed rma 'byung 'gyur

verses.skt: manyākṣiśaṅkhato vāyur anyato vā pravartayan | vyathāṃ tīvrām apaicchilyarāgaśophaṃ vilocanam
verses.tib: mur 'gram kha dang mjing pa las / rlung ni gzhan du 'jug 'gyur zhing / mi bzad na la gnag pa dang / dmar zhing skrangs la mig mi sdug

verses.skt: saṃkocayati paryaśru so ’nyatovātasaṃjñitaḥ | tadvaj jihmaṃ bhaven netram ūnaṃ vā vātaparyaye
verses.tib: zhum zhing kun nas mchi ma 'dzag / de ni rlung gis gzhan gyur yin / de bzhin mig ni yon po dang / chung ba rlung gis phyin ci log

verses.skt: dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmano bahiḥ | antaḥkledo ’śru pītoṣṇaṃ rāgaḥ pītābhadarśanam
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i mchi 'dzag mtshan ma ni / tsha grang du ba 'byung snyam sems / mig chu'i phyi rol gnag pa dang / nang na rnag 'drul mchi ma tsha

verses.skt: kṣārokṣitakṣatākṣitvaṃ pittābhiṣyandalakṣaṇam | jvaladaṅgārakīrṇābhaṃ yakṛtpiṇḍasamaprabham
verses.tib: ser zhing mig dmar / ser por mthong / rma la lan tshwas btab snyam sems / me mdag gtor ba 'dra ba dang / mcher pa'i gong bu lta bur snang

verses.skt: adhimanthe bhaven netraṃ syande tu kaphasaṃbhave | jāḍyaṃ śopho mahān kaṇḍūr nidrānnānabhinandanam
verses.tib: mig nad gdung bar gyur pa yin / bad kan las gyur mchi 'dzag ni / tshor ba med skrangs rab tu g.ya' / gsher zhing snum la shas cher dkar / mig gdung spyi bag 'dzag pa yin / gdung ba des ni nag po dma' / 'bras bu dkar po mtho ba dang

verses.skt: sāndrasnigdhabahuśvetapicchāvaddūṣikāśrutā | adhimanthe nataṃ kṛṣṇam unnataṃ śuklamaṇḍalam
verses.tib: mig nad gdung bar gyur pa yin / bad kan las gyur mchi 'dzag ni / tshor ba med skrangs rab tu g.ya' / gsher zhing snum la shas cher dkar / mig gdung spyi bag 'dzag pa yin / gdung ba des ni nag po dma' / 'bras bu dkar po mtho ba dang

verses.skt: praseko nāsikādhmānaṃ pāṃsupūrṇam ivekṣaṇam | raktāśrurājīdūṣīkāraktamaṇḍaladarśanam
verses.tib: cham pas thebs shing sna rgyas la / mig ni rdul gyis gang snyam byed / khrag gyur dmar ris mig tu dmar

verses.skt: raktasyandena nayanaṃ sapittasyandalakṣaṇam | manthe ’kṣi tāmraparyantam utpāṭanasamānaruk
verses.tib: mig 'bras dkar po dmar ba dang / khrag 'dzag dmar po mthong ba dang / mkhris pa'i mchi 'dzag mtshan nyid yin / gdung ba mig ni mtha' dmar zhing

verses.skt: rāgeṇa bandhūkanibhaṃ tāmyati sparśanākṣamam | asṛṅnimagnāriṣṭābhaṃ kṛṣṇam agnyābhadarśanam
verses.tib: phyung ba dang ni mtshungs par na / me tog ban du ka ltar dmar / shin tu na zhing reg mi bzod / lung tang khrag tu nub pa 'dra / gnag cing me ltar snang ba yin

verses.skt: adhimanthā yathāsvaṃ ca sarve syandādhikavyathāḥ | śaṅkhadantakapoleṣu kapāle cātirukkarāḥ
verses.tib: gdung ba rang gi ji bzhin du / thams cad 'dzag pa las lhag na / mur 'gram so dang mkhur tshos dang / mgo bo lhag par na bar byed

verses.skt: vātapittāturaṃ gharṣatodabhedopadehavat | rūkṣadāruṇavartmākṣi kṛcchronmīlanimīlanam
verses.tib: rlung mkhris shas cher drud snyam sems / zug cing na la phul snyam sems / shin tu rtsub cing mig mchu mig / 'dzums dang 'byed par dka' ba dang / na zhing skams par gyur pa dang

verses.skt: vikūṇanaviśuṣkatvaśītecchāśūlapākavat | uktaḥ śuṣkādipāko yaṃ saśophaḥ syāt tribhir malaiḥ
verses.tib: grang 'dod smin zhing skam dang bcas / mig skam smin pa zhes bya'o / nad gzhi gsum ni khrag bcas la

verses.skt: saraktais tatra śopho ’tirugdāhaṣṭhīvanādimān | pakvodumbarasaṃkāśaṃ jāyate śuklamaṇḍalam
verses.tib: skrang 'gyur de ni rab skrangs shing / na dang tsha dang 'dzag dang bcas / u dum bA ra'i 'bras smin 'dra / mig 'bras dkar por 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: aśrūṣṇaśītaviśadapicchilācchaghanaṃ muhuḥ | alpaśophe ’lpaśophas tu pāko ’nyair lakṣaṇais tathā
verses.tib: mchi ma grang zhing dro ba dang / spyi bag ska sla res kyis 'byung / skrangs chung cung zad skrang zhes bya / de bzhin mtshan nyid gzhan gyis smin

verses.skt: akṣipākātyaye śophaḥ saṃrambhaḥ kaluṣāśrutā | kaphopadigdham asitaṃ sitaṃ prakledarāgavat
verses.tib: mig smin pas nyen skrang ba yi / rtsom che mchi ma rnyog can 'dzag / bad kan gyis bsgos mig 'bras ni / dkar po dmar zhing 'drul ba dang

verses.skt: dāho darśanasaṃrodho vedanāś cānavasthitāḥ | annasāro ’mlatāṃ nītaḥ pittaraktolbaṇair malaiḥ
verses.tib: tsha zhing mthong ba nyams pa dang / nad ni mal na mi gnas yin / khrag mkhris shas che'i nad kyis ni / zas kyi dngas ma skyur por 'gyur

verses.skt: sirābhir netram ārūḍhaḥ karoti śyāvalohitam | saśophadāhapākāśru bhṛśaṃ cāviladarśanam
verses.tib: mig gi rtsar ni song nas ni / mig ni dmar por byed par 'gyur / skrang tsha / smin zhing mchi ma 'dzag / shin tu lang long por mthong na / skyur gyis bskyed pa'i nad ces bya

verses.skt: amloṣito ’yam ity uktā gadāḥ ṣoḍaśa sarvagāḥ | hatādhimantham eteṣu sākṣipākātyayaṃ tyajet
verses.tib: de ltar kun gtogs nad bcu drug / de la gdung bas bcom pa ni / mig smin bcas pa spang bar bya

verses.skt: vātodbhūtaḥ pañcarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saptāhena śleṣmajāto ’dhimanthaḥ | raktotpanno hanti tadvat trirātrān mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva
verses.tib: rlung gyur zhag lngas mig la gnod par byed / bad kan las gyur gdung bas zhag bdun gyis / de bzhin khrag gyur zhag gsum gyis 'joms byed / mkhris gyur 'phral du log spyod kyis gnod byed

verses.skt: prāgrūpa eva syandeṣu tīkṣṇaṃ gaṇḍūṣanāvanam | kārayed upavāsaṃ ca kopād anyatra vātajāt
verses.tib: mchi 'dzag sngar byung tshul nyid la / mkhur bkang sna sman rnon po gtang / rlung 'khrugs ma gtogs nad gzhan la / smyung ba dag kyang bya ba yin

verses.skt: dāhopadeharāgāśruśophaśāntyai biḍālakam | kuryāt sarvatra pattrailāmaricasvarṇagairikaiḥ
verses.tib: tsha dang dmar dang gos pa dang / skrang sogs zhi phyir kun la ni / sug smel gan+d+ha b+ha dra dang / na le sham dang btsag yug snam / lde gur byas pas bsku bar bya

verses.skt: sarasāñjanayaṣṭyāhvanatacandanasaindhavaiḥ | saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tārkṣyaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍena sarpiṣaḥ
verses.tib: rlung gyur rgyam tsha skyer khaN+Da / shing mngar rgya spos tsan+dan nam / rgyam tsha dong gra skyer khaN+Da / mar gyi nying khu bdar ba'am / yang na seng phrom sbyar ba gtang

verses.skt: badarīpattrayaṣṭyāhvapathyāmalakatutthakam | antardhūmaṃ dahet sadyaḥ kope taccūrṇaṃ vātaje
vātaje ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā yojyaṃ śabaradeśajam | māṃsīpadmakakālīyayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ pittaraktayoḥ
verses.tib: khrag mkhris gyur la spang spos dang / shug pa shing mngar ra mnye ba / bad kan las gyur pri yang+ku

verses.skt: manohvāphalinīkṣaudraiḥ kaphe sarvais tu sarvaje | sitamaricabhāgam ekaṃ caturmanohvaṃ dvir aṣṭaśābarakam | saṃcūrṇya vastrabaddhaṃ prakupitamātre ’vaguṇṭhanaṃ netre
verses.tib: ldong ros sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku / 'dus pa las gyur kun gyis bsku / na le sham ni dkar po cha gcig dang / ldong ros cha bzhi seng phrom cha bcu drug / zhib tu btags te ras gtsang phur mas gtums / nad ldang mod la mig tu gdab par bya

verses.skt: dhātuśuṇṭhyabhayātārkṣyaṃ bahirlepo ’kṣirogahā || 5.1(1)+1ab || harītakīsaindhavatārkṣyaśīlaiḥ sagairikaiḥ svasvakarapramṛṣṭaiḥ | bahiḥpralepaṃ nayanasya kuryāt sarvākṣirogapraśamārtham etat || 5.1(2)+1 || āraṇyāś chagaṇarase paṭāvabaddhāḥ susvinnā nakhavituṣīkṛtāḥ kulatthāḥ | taccūrṇaṃ sakṛd avacūrṇanān niśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam || 6 || ghoṣābhayātutthakayaṣṭilodhrair mūtī susūkṣmaiḥ ślathavastrabaddhaiḥ | tāmrasthadhānyāmlanimagnamūrtir artiṃ jayaty akṣiṇi naikarūpām
verses.tib: rgya sran nag po ba lci ra'i ril khu / legs btsos sen mos shun pa bshus gyur pa / de yis mtshan mo lan cig bskus pa yis / mig nad 'khrugs pa myur du zhi bar byed / shu ti shing mngar spangs ma a ru ra / zhib btags ras kyi thum po lhod par bcing / zangs kyi snod du skyur rtsabs nang du bcug / mig tu bzhag na mig nad sna tshogs sel

verses.skt: ṣoḍaśabhiḥ salilapalaiḥ palaṃ tathaikaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭeryāḥ siddham | seko ’ṣṭabhāgaśiṣṭaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ sarvadoṣakupite netre
verses.tib: skyer pa srang gcig chu bre phyed du yang / khu ba brgyad cha lus par sbrang rtsi btab / de bzhin mig tu bskus par gyur na ni / nad gzhi thams cad 'khrugs pa'i mig nad sel

verses.skt: vātapittakaphasaṃnipātajāṃ netrayor bahuvidhām api vyathām | śīghram eva jayati prayojitaḥ śigrupallavarasaḥ samākṣikaḥ
verses.tib: shi kru'i lo ma'i khu ba sbrang rtsir bcas / mig tu blugs na rlung dang mkhris pa dang / bad kan 'dus pa las gyur mig nad rnams / mig nad mang po dag kyang myur du sel

verses.skt: taruṇam urubūkapattraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya siddham āje kṣīre | vātābhiṣyandarujaṃ sadyo vinihanti saktupiṇḍikā coṣṇā
verses.tib: e raN+Da ni gzhon nu'i lo ma dang / rtsa ba brdungs te ra yi 'o mar bskol / blugs sam zan dron mig tu glan pa yis / rlung gyur mchi 'dzag nad ni mod la 'joms

verses.skt: āścyotanaṃ mārutaje kvātho bilvādibhir hitaḥ | koṣṇaḥ sahairaṇḍajaṭābṛhatīmadhuśigrubhiḥ
verses.tib: rlung gyur ba la bil ba / bskol ba'i sman thigs blugs pa'am / e raN+Da'i rtsa bri ha ti

verses.skt: hrīveravakraśārṅgaṣṭodumbaratvakṣu sādhitam | sāmbhasā payasājena śūlāścyotanam uttamam
verses.tib: ma du shi kru dro 'jam blugs / sha rang gaSh+Ta ba la ka

verses.skt: lodhrāmalakarasāñja[na]bimbitikāpattratubarikātutthaiḥ | āścyotanam idam akṣṇoḥ prasahya sadyaḥ prakopaharam
verses.tib: rgya spos u dum wA ra'i shun / chu dang 'o ma bcas bskol ba'i / thigs blugs gzer ni sel mchog yin / btsong dang skyer pa rgya skyegs dang / rgun 'brum ut+pal shing mngar gnyis / bskol te bsgrangs par khar gdab / mig blugs khrag mkhris mig nad sel

verses.skt: mañjiṣṭhārajanīlākṣādrākṣarddhimadhukotpalaiḥ | kvāthaḥ saśarkaraḥ śītaḥ secanaṃ raktapittajit
verses.tib: rgya spos u dum wA ra'i shun / chu dang 'o ma bcas bskol ba'i / thigs blugs gzer ni sel mchog yin / btsong dang skyer pa rgya skyegs dang / rgun 'brum ut+pal shing mngar gnyis / bskol te bsgrangs par khar gdab / mig blugs khrag mkhris mig nad sel

verses.skt: kaseruyaṣṭyāhvarajas tāntave śithilaṃ sthitam | apsu divyāsu nihitaṃ hitaṃ syande ’srapittaje
verses.tib: shing mngar ka she ru'i phye ma / ras ma 'jam pos lhod par bcing / char chu'i nang du sbangs pa ni / khrag mkhris las gyur mchi 'dzag sel

verses.skt: puṇḍrayaṣṭīniśāmūtī plutā stanye saśarkare | chāgadugdhe ’thavā dāharugrāgāśrunivartanī
verses.tib: shing mngar skyer pa stag tsher ba / thum po nu zho kha rar bcas / ra yi 'o mar sbangs pa blugs / tsha na mdog dmar mchi 'dzag sel

verses.skt: śvetalodhraṃ samadhukaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sucūrṇitam | vastrasthaṃ stanyamṛditaṃ pittaraktābhighātajit
verses.tib: seng phrom dkar po shing mngar bcas / mar brngos legs par btags pa ni / ras la gtums te nu zhor mnye / khrag mkhris snad pa'i mig nad sel

verses.skt: nāgaratriphalānimbavāsālodhrarasaḥ kaphe | koṣṇam āścyotanaṃ miśrair bheṣajaiḥ sāṃnipātike
verses.tib: dong gra nim pa 'bras bu gsum / seng phrom ba sha ka'i khu ba / dro 'jam blugs pas bad kan sel / 'dus par 'di dag bsres pas phan

verses.skt: sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pavane pitte śarkarayānvitam | vyoṣasiddhaṃ kaphe pītvā yavakṣārāvacūrṇitam
verses.tib: rlung la mar ni rnying pa dang / mkhris par kha rar bcas pa dang / bad kan la ni tsha ba gsum / bskol dang thal sman bcas pa blud

verses.skt: srāvayed rudhiraṃ bhūyas tataḥ snigdhaṃ virecayet | ānūpavesavāreṇa śirovadanalepanam
verses.tib: de 'og khrag kyang dbyung ba dang / de nas snum gyur bkru sman gtang / dro bas tsha ste gzer ba la / skam sa'i srog chags sha btags pas / mgo dang gdong bsku tsha ba la

verses.skt: uṣṇena śūle dāhe tu payaḥsarpiryutair himaiḥ | timirapratiṣedhaṃ ca vīkṣya yuñjyād yathāyatham
verses.tib: 'o ma mar bcas grang mos bsku / rab rib gso ba'i cho ga yang / brtags te ji bzhin gso bar bya

verses.skt: ayam eva vidhiḥ sarvo manthādiṣv api śasyate | aśāntau sarvathā manthe bhruvor upari dāhayet
verses.tib: cho ga 'di dag thams cad ni / gdung ba la sogs rnams la phan / gdung ba yong ye ma zhi na / smin ma'i steng du me btsa' gdab

verses.skt: rūpyaṃ rūkṣeṇa godadhnā limpen nīlatvam āgate | śuṣke tu mastunā vartir vātākṣyāmayanāśinī
verses.tib: ba zho snum med kyis dngul snod / byugs te sngon por gyur pa dang / skams nas zho ga chu ri lur / byas pas rlung gyur mig nad 'joms

verses.skt: sumanaḥkorakāḥ śaṅkhas triphalā madhukaṃ balā | pittaraktāpahā vartiḥ piṣṭā divyena vāriṇā
verses.tib: dzA ti'i me tog kha 'bus dung / shing mngar ba la 'bras bu gsum / char chu dang btags ri lur byas / khrag mkhris las gyur mig nad sel

verses.skt: saindhavaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ śaṅkhanābhiḥ samudrajaḥ | phena aileyakaṃ sarjo vartiḥ śleṣmākṣiroganut
verses.tib: rgyam tsha 'bras bu tsha ba gsum / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dung snying po / e la ba lu sra rtsi pog / ri lus bad kan mig nad sel

verses.skt: prapauṇḍarīkaṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ dārvī cāṣṭapalaṃ pacet | jaladroṇe rase pūte punaḥ pakve ghane kṣipet
verses.tib: shing mngar pra puN+Da rI ka / skyer pa srang ni brgyad brgyad dag / chu bre bcu drug nang bskol btsags / slar bskol ska bar gyur pa ni

verses.skt: puṣpāñjanād daśapalaṃ karṣaṃ ca maricāt tataḥ | kṛtaś cūrṇo ’thavā vartiḥ sarvābhiṣyandasaṃbhavān
verses.tib: ra gan dud pa srang bcu dang / na le sham phye zho gnyis gzhug / de la ri lu'am phye mar byas / bskus na mchi 'dzag thams cad dang

verses.skt: hanti rāgarujāgharṣān sadyo dṛṣṭiṃ prasādayet | ayaṃ pāśupato yogo rahasyaṃ bhiṣajāṃ param
verses.tib: dmar na drud pa byed snyam 'joms / 'phral du mig ni gsal bar byed / sbyor 'di phyug bdag ces bya ste / sman pa rnams kyi gsang ba mchog

verses.skt: śuṣkākṣipāke haviṣaḥ pānam akṣṇoś ca tarpaṇam | ghṛtena jīvanīyena nasyaṃ tailena vāṇunā
verses.tib: mig smin skam pa mar blud cing / 'tsho byed kyi ni sman mar ni / blud cing mig ni brta bya dang / til mar chung ngu'i sna sman gtang

verses.skt: pariṣeko hitaś cātra payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam | sarpiryuktaṃ stanyapiṣṭam añjanaṃ ca mahauṣadham
verses.tib: 'di la 'o ma rgyam tshar bcas / dro 'jam thigs pa blugs pa'ang phan / bca' sga bud med nu zhor btags / mar sbyar mig tu bskus na'ang phan / yang na rlan can sha yi zhag / dong gra rgyam tsha cung zad btab / skra ni mar bskus me long gis / mnyes te kham phor kha sbyar bcug

verses.skt: vasā vānūpasattvotthā kiñcitsaindhavanāgarā | ghṛtāktān darpaṇe ghṛṣṭān keśān mallakasaṃpuṭe
verses.tib: 'di la 'o ma rgyam tshar bcas / dro 'jam thigs pa blugs pa'ang phan / bca' sga bud med nu zhor btags / mar sbyar mig tu bskus na'ang phan / yang na rlan can sha yi zhag / dong gra rgyam tsha cung zad btab / skra ni mar bskus me long gis / mnyes te kham phor kha sbyar bcug

verses.skt: dagdhvājyapiṣṭā lohasthā sā maṣī śreṣṭham añjanam | saśophe vālpaśophe ca snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām
verses.tib: bsregs te lcags snod mar dang bcas / snag tsha de ni mig sman mchog / skrang bcas cung zad skrangs pa la / snum chos byas te gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: rekaḥ snigdhe punar drākṣāpathyākvāthatrivṛdghṛtaiḥ | śvetalodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tāntavasthitam
verses.tib: snum byas rgun 'brum a ru ra / dur byid mar bcas bkru sman gtang / seng phrom dkar po mar la brngos / phye mar byas te ras la gtums

verses.skt: uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekaḥ śūlaharaḥ param | dārvīprapauṇḍarīkasya kvātho vāścyotane hitaḥ
verses.tib: chu dron la mnyes thigs pa blugs / gzer 'joms pa yi mchog yin no / skyer pa pra puN+Da rI ka

verses.skt: yaṣṭīhimotpalakṣīraiḥ kuryān mūrdhasya lepanam
verses.tib: bskol ba'i thigs pa blugs pas phan

verses.skt: saṃdhāvāṃś ca prayuñjīta gharṣarāgāśruruggharān
verses.tib: mchi 'dzag na zhing drud snyam byed / sbyar sman 'di dag gtang bar bya

verses.skt: tāmraṃ lohe mūtraghṛṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ netre sarpirdhūpitaṃ vedanāghnam | tāmre ghṛṣṭo gavyadadhnaḥ saro vā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavābhyāṃ variṣṭhaḥ || 34 || śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamyāḥ pattrair dhūpitaṃ tad yavaiś ca | netre yuktaṃ hanti saṃdhāvasaṃjñaṃ kṣipraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāṃ cātitīvrām || 35 || udumbaraphalaṃ lohe ghṛṣṭaṃ stanyena dhūpitam
verses.tib: lcags kyi snod du zangs ma ba gcin sbyar / mar bdug mig bskus gzer ni 'joms par byed / zangs ma'i snod du ba zho'i spris ma bdar / rgyam tsha pi pi ling dang bcas pa mchog / zangs ma'i snod du nu zho dung bdar la / dong ga'i lo ma mar bcas dud pas bdug / sbyar sman zhes bya mig tu bskus na ni / drud snyam byed sogs mi bzad nad myur sel

verses.skt: sājyaiḥ śamīcchadair dāhaśūlarāgāśruharṣajit | śigrupallavaniryāsaḥ sughṛṣṭas tāmrasaṃpuṭe
verses.tib: lcags kyi snod du zangs ma ba gcin sbyar / mar bdug mig bskus gzer ni 'joms par byed / zangs ma'i snod du ba zho'i spris ma bdar / rgyam tsha pi pi ling dang bcas pa mchog / zangs ma'i snod du nu zho dung bdar la / dong ga'i lo ma mar bcas dud pas bdug / sbyar sman zhes bya mig tu bskus na ni / drud snyam byed sogs mi bzad nad myur sel

verses.skt: dviniśātriphalāmustaiḥ pramadādugdhapeṣitaiḥ | sekaḥ saśarkarākṣaudrair abhighātarujāpahaḥ
verses.tib: u dum wA ra'i 'bras bu ni / lcags snod nang du nu zho bdar / sha ma'i lo ma mar dud bdug / mchi 'dzag gzer dmar drud pa 'joms

verses.skt: niṣiktaṃ tutthakaṃ vārān gojale pañcaviṃśatim | stanye vā chāgadugdhe vā sadyaḥkope tad añjanam
verses.tib: shi kru'i lo ma'i khu ba ni / zangs ma gnyis kyi bar du bdar / mar dud bdugs pas skrangs pa dang

verses.skt: ghṛtena dhūpito hanti śophagharṣāśruvedanāḥ | tilāmbhasā mṛtkapālaṃ kāṃsye ghṛṣṭaṃ sudhūpitam
verses.tib: g.ya' dang mchi 'dzag nad rnams 'joms / til gyi chu dang khar ba ni / kham phor bdar te nim pa yi / 'o ma mar bskol dud pas bdug

verses.skt: nimbapattrair ghṛtābhyaktair gharṣaśūlāśrurāgajit | saṃdhāvenāñjite netre vigatauṣadhavedane
verses.tib: gzer ram mchi 'dzag drud snyam sel / sbyar sman gyis ni mig bskus te / sman shugs zug gzer dang bral nas

verses.skt: stanyenāścyotanaṃ kāryaṃ triḥ paraṃ nāñjayec ca taiḥ | tālīśapattracapalānataloharajo'ñjanaiḥ
verses.tib: bud med nu zho'i thigs pa blugs / lan gsum phan chad de mi bsku / bal bu'i lo ma pi pi ling / rgya spos lcags phye stang zil dang

verses.skt: jātīmukulakāsīsasaindhavair mūtrapeṣitaiḥ | tāmram ālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayet peṣayet tataḥ
verses.tib: dzA ti kha 'bus nag tshur dang / rgyam tsha ba gcin btags pa yi / lde gus zangs kyi snod bskus la / zhag bdun bzhag ste ba gcin dang

verses.skt: mūtreṇaivānu guṭikāḥ kāryāś chāyāviśoṣitāḥ | tāḥ stanyaghṛṣṭā gharṣāśruśophakaṇḍūvināśanāḥ
verses.tib: btags te ri lur byas nas ni / de 'og grib ma la bskams te / bud med nu zho dang bdar bsku / drud snyam byed dang mchi ma 'dzag / skrang dang g.ya' ba sel bar byed

verses.skt: vyāghrītvaṅmadhukaṃ tāmrarajo ’jākṣīrakalkitam | śamyāmalakapattrājyadhūpitaṃ śopharukpraṇut
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri'i shun pa dang / shing mngar zangs ma'i phye ma ni / ra yi 'o mas lde gur byas / sha mi skyu ru ra'i lo ma / mar gyis bskus pa'i dud pas bdug / bskus na skrangs dang gzer nad sel

verses.skt: amloṣite prayuñjīta pittābhiṣyandasādhanam | utkliṣṭāḥ kaphapittāsranicayotthāḥ kukūṇakaḥ
verses.tib: skyur gyis bskyed la mkhris pa yi / mchi ma 'dzag pa'i cho gas gso / bad kan khrag mkhris kyis bskyed dang

verses.skt: pakṣmoparodhaṃ śuṣkākṣipākaḥ pūyālaso bisaḥ | pothakyamloṣito ’lpākhyaḥ syandamanthā vinānilāt
verses.tib: 'dus pas bskyed dang sgra ngan dang / rdzi ma 'gags dang mig smin skam / rnag gi chu ser pad+ma'i rtsa / mig mchu'i sha dang skyur skyed cung / mchi 'dzag gdung ba rlung ma gtogs

verses.skt: ete ’ṣṭādaśa pillākhyā dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ | cikitsā pṛthag eteṣāṃ svaṃ svam uktātha vakṣyate
verses.tib: brgyad po dag chag par bshad / yun ring du ni na ba yin / 'di dag gso ba so so yi / le'u'i nang du bshad pa yin

verses.skt: pillībhūteṣu sāmānyād atha pillākhyarogiṇaḥ | snigdhasya charditavataḥ sirāvyadhahṛtāsṛjaḥ
verses.tib: de'i 'og mig tshag / spyi yi bshad / de nas mig tshag nad pa ni / snum chos slon ni byas nas kyang / gtar ga gdab ste khrag dbyung bya

verses.skt: viriktasya ca vartmānu nirlikhed āviśuddhitaḥ | tutthakasya palaṃ śvetamaricāni ca viṃśatiḥ
verses.tib: dag par gyur gyi bar du bzhar / spangs ma srang gcig na le sham / dkar po srang ni nyi shu dang

verses.skt: triṃśatā kāñjikapalaiḥ piṣṭvā tāmre nidhāpayet | pillān apillān kurute bahuvarṣotthitān api
verses.tib: skyur rtsabs srang ni sum cu dag / btags te zangs ma'i snod du gzhug / lo mang lon pa'i mig tshag pa'am

verses.skt: tat sekenopadehāśrukaṇḍūśophāṃś ca nāśayet | karañjabījaṃ surasaṃ sumanaḥkorakāṇi ca
verses.tib: chu ser 'dzag sogs zhi bar byed / gos dang tsha dang mchi ma 'dzag / g.ya' skrangs de blugs pa yis sel / bye'u rug ka rany+dza'i sa bon / dzA ti'i me tog kha 'bus pa

verses.skt: saṃkṣudya sādhayet kvāthe pūte tatra rasakriyā | añjanaṃ pillabhaiṣajyaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam
verses.tib: brdungs te bskol la btsags nas ni / khu bar byas pa de dang ni / stang zil dang sbyar mig sman ni / mig tshag g.ya' dang chu ser 'dzag / g.ya' zhing 'drul ba sel mchog yin

verses.skt: rasāñjanaṃ sarjaraso rītipuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā | samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca
verses.tib: skyer pa'i khaN+Da sra rtsi pog / ra gan dud pa ldong ros dang / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba rgyam tsha dang / na le sham dang btsag yug snam

verses.skt: añjanaṃ madhunā piṣṭaṃ kledakaṇḍūghnam uttamam | abhayārasapiṣṭaṃ vā tagaraṃ pillanāśanam
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi btags pa'i mig sman ni / mig tshag 'drul g.ya' sel bar byed / rgya spos a ru ra'i khu bar / dngul rdo btags pas mig tshag sel

verses.skt: bhāvitaṃ bastamūtreṇa sasnehaṃ devadāru ca | saindhavatriphalākṛṣṇākaṭukāśaṅkhanābhayaḥ
verses.tib: thang shing snum dang bcas pa ni / ra gcin nang du sbangs pa'ang phan / rgyam tsha 'bras gsum pi pi ling / dung gi snying po pu tse shel

verses.skt: satāmrarajaso vartiḥ pillaśukrakanāśinī | puṣpakāsīsacūrṇo vā surasārasabhāvitaḥ
verses.tib: zangs ma'i phye ma bcas ri lu / mig tshag ling tog sel bar byed / yang na nag tshur phye ma ni / bye'u rug pa'i khu bar sbangs

verses.skt: tāmre daśāhaṃ tat paillyapakṣmaśātajid añjanam
verses.tib: zangs ma'i snod du zhag bcu bzhag / de yis mig tshag chu ser 'dzag / rdzi ma 'byi ba sel bar byed

verses.skt: alaṃ ca sauvīrakam añjanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ samaṃ tāmrarajaḥ susūkṣmam | pilleṣu romāṇi niṣevito ’sau cūrṇaḥ karoty ekaśalākayāpi
verses.tib: ldong ros dang ni skyer pa'i khaN+Da dang / de mnyam zangs ma'i phye ma zhib tu btags / phye ma mig sman thur ma gcig gis kyang

verses.skt: lākṣānirguṇḍībhṛṅgadārvīrasena śreṣṭhaṃ kārpāsaṃ bhāvitaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ | dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ sarpiṣā tatsamutthā śreṣṭhā pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe maṣī sā
verses.tib: rdzi ma bskyed cing mig tshag 'dis sel byed / rgya skyegs bring ga skyer pa ni rgun+thi / khu bar ras kyi dum bu lan bdun sbangs / sdong bu mar me de bus las byung ba'i / snag tsha mig tshag sel bar byed mchog yin

verses.skt: vartmāvalekhaṃ bahuśas tadvac choṇitamokṣaṇam
verses.tib: mig mchu mang du zhal zhal bya / de bzhin gtar ga bya ba dang

verses.skt: punaḥ punar virekaṃ ca nityam āścyotanāñjanam | nāvanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca pillarogāturo bhajet
verses.tib: bkru sman yang yang bya ba ni / mig tshag can gyi nad pas bsten / rnag gi chu 'dzag ma zhi'i mthar / thur

verses.skt: pūyālase tv aśānte ’nte dāhaḥ sūkṣmaśalākayā | caturṇavatir ity akṣṇo hetulakṣaṇasādhanaiḥ
verses.tib: ma phra mos bsreg par bya / de ltar mig nad dgu bcu bzhi / nad gzhi mtshan nyid gso ba dag

verses.skt: parasparam asaṃkīrṇāḥ kārtsnyena gaditā gadāḥ | sarvadā ca niṣeveta svastho ’pi nayanapriyaḥ
verses.tib: phan tshun 'dres pa med par ni / ma lus par ni bshad pa yin / skyes bu nad med pa yis kyang

verses.skt: purāṇayavagodhūmaśāliṣaṣṭikakodravān | mudgādīn kaphapittaghnān bhūrisarpiḥpariplutān
verses.tib: nas dang gro rnying drug cu pa / sA lu khre rgod rnyid pa dang / mung+ga la sogs bad mkhris 'joms / zhun mar mang du btab pa dang

verses.skt: śākaṃ caivaṃvidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām | saindhavaṃ triphalāṃ drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam
verses.tib: tshod ma de 'dra skam sa yi / sha dang se 'bru kha ra dkar / bsten zhing char chu btung ba dang

verses.skt: ātapatraṃ padatrāṇaṃ vidhivad doṣaśodhanam | varjayed vegasaṃrodham ajīrṇādhyaśanāni ca
verses.tib: gdugs bcang lham ni bgo ba dang / cho ga bzhin du nad sbyang ba / rnam pa kun tu bsten par bya / shugs bkag pa dang ma zhur za

verses.skt: krodhaśokadivāsvapnarātrijāgaraṇātapān | vidāhi viṣṭambhakaraṃ yac cehāhārabheṣajam
verses.tib: phyed zhu za dang rtug 'gags za / tsha dang phyi sa 'gags byed pa'i / zas dang spyod lam sman kun spang

verses.skt: dve pādamadhye pṛthusaṃniveśe sire gate te bahudhā ca netre | tāmrakṣaṇodvartanalepanādīn pādaprayuktān nayane nayanti
verses.tib: rkang pa gnyis kyi dbus na rtsa sbom po / gnyis gnas de yis mig ni nang du khyab / de bskus byug dang dril ba la sogs pa / rkang par byas na mig tu 'gro bar 'gyur

verses.skt: malauṣṇyasaṃghaṭṭanapīḍanādyais tā dūṣayante nayanāni duṣṭāḥ | bhajet sadā dṛṣṭihitāni tasmād upānadabhyañjanadhāvanāni
verses.tib: dri ma tsha dang snad pa la sogs pas / de gnod gyur na mig la gnod par 'gyur / de bas mig la phan 'dod lham dang ni / bsku dang dril dang byug pa sogs bsten bya

verses.skt: pratiśyāyajalakrīḍākarṇakaṇḍūyanair marut | mithyāyogena śabdasya kupito ’nyaiś ca kopanaiḥ
verses.tib: cham pas btab dang chu la rtse / rna ba brud pas rlung 'khrugs shing / sgra yi log pa'i sbyor ba dang / ldang ba'i rgyu gzhan gyis 'khrugs nas

verses.skt: prāpya śrotrasirāḥ kuryāc chūlaṃ srotasi vegavat | ardhāvabhedakaṃ stambhaṃ śiśirānabhinandanam
verses.tib: rna ba'i rtsar ni rlung zhugs te / rna ba'i bu gar shugs drag gzer / gzhogs phyed na zhing rengs pa dang / grang ba dag ni mi 'phrod cing

verses.skt: cirāc ca pākaṃ pakvaṃ tu lasīkām alpaśaḥ sravet | śrotraṃ śūnyam akasmāc ca syāt saṃcāravicāravat
verses.tib: ring nas rnags shing smin nas kyang / chu ser cung zad 'dzag par byed / rgyu med rna ba stong snyam sems / zhum dang rgyas pa snyam du byed

verses.skt: śūlaṃ pittāt sadāhoṣāśītecchāśvayathujvaram | āśupākaṃ prapakvaṃ ca sapītalasikāsruti
verses.tib: mkhris gyur tsha bcas na zhing gzer / grang 'dod skrang zhing rims kyis 'debs / myur du smin zhing smin nas kyang / chu ser ser por 'dzag par byed

verses.skt: sā lasīkā spṛśed yad yat tat tat pākam upaiti ca | kaphāc chirohanugrīvāgauravaṃ mandatā rujaḥ
verses.tib: chu ser des ni gang gang du / reg pa de dang der rnags 'gyur / bad kan las gyur mgo 'gram pa / mgrin pa lci zhing nad shugs dal

verses.skt: kaṇḍūḥ śvayathur uṣṇecchā pākāc chvetaghanasrutiḥ | karoti śravaṇe śūlam abhighātādidūṣitam
verses.tib: g.ya' zhing / grang la dro ba 'dod / smin nas rnag dkar ska ba 'dzag / snad la sogs pas gnod gyur pa / rna ba gzer bar byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: raktaṃ pittasamānārti kiñcid vādhikalakṣaṇam | śūlaṃ samuditair doṣaiḥ saśophajvaratīvraruk
verses.tib: khrag dang mkhris pa ltar na dang / mtshan nyid cung zad lhag pa yin / nad gzhi 'dus pas gzer ba dang / skrangs bcas rims 'debs mi bzad na

verses.skt: paryāyād uṣṇaśītecchāṃ jāyate śrutijāḍyavat | pakvaṃ sitāsitāraktaghanapūyapravāhi ca
verses.tib: res kyis grang dang dro ba 'dod / 'on pa lta bu nyid du 'gyur / smin nas rnag ni dkar dang nag / dmar dang ska ba 'dzag par 'gyur

verses.skt: śabdavāhisirāsaṃsthe śṛṇoti pavane muhuḥ | nādān akasmād vividhān karṇanādaṃ vadanti tam
verses.tib: sgra thos rtsar ni rlung zhugs pa / rgyu med par ni sna tshogs pa'i / sgra ni yang dang yang du thos / de ni rna ba'i sgra zhes bya

verses.skt: śleṣmaṇānugato vāyur nādo vā samupekṣitaḥ | uccaiḥ kṛcchrāc chrutiṃ kuryād badhiratvaṃ krameṇa ca
verses.tib: rlung ni bad kan dang 'dres pa'i / rna sgra yal bar bor na ni / skad gsang mthon por smras pa thos / rim gyis 'on pa nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: vātena śoṣitaḥ śleṣmā śroto limpet tato bhavet | ruggauravaṃ pidhānaṃ ca sa pratīnāhasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.tib: rlung gis bad kan bskams gyur pas / de la rna bar gos gyur na / na zhing lci la 'gags gyur pa / de ni rna ba 'gags zhes bshad

verses.skt: kaṇḍūśophau kaphāc chrotre sthirau tatsaṃjñayā smṛtau | kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tv api
verses.tib: bad kan las ni rna ba g.ya' / skrang sra de yi ming gis bshad / mkhris pas bad kan tshig gyur pa / nad bcas pa'am nad med kyang

verses.skt: ghanapūtibahukledaṃ kurute pūtikarṇakam | vātādidūṣitaṃ śrotraṃ māṃsāsṛkkledajā rujam
verses.tib: rnag ska 'dzag cing mang du 'drul / rna ba rnag can byed par 'gyur / rlung sogs pa yis rna ba'i sha

verses.skt: khādanto jantavaḥ kuryus tīvrāṃ sa kṛmikarṇakaḥ | śrotrakaṇḍūyanāj jāte kṣate syāt pūrvalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: khrag la gnod gyur 'drul bar za / srin bus bskyod cing mi bzad na / rna nad srin bu can zhes bya / rna ba phug pa'i rma las byung

verses.skt: vidradhiḥ pūrvavac cānyaḥ śopho ’rśo ’rbudam īritam | teṣu ruk pūtikarṇatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca bādhate
verses.tib: rma ni snga ma'i mtshan nyid can / khong 'bras 'gyur ba'am gzhan du'ang 'gyur / thor bu 'brum bu skrangs las 'byung / de las rna ba rnags pa dang / 'on par byed pas gnod par 'gyur

verses.skt: garbhe ’nilāt saṃkucitā śaṣkulī kucikarṇakaḥ | eko nīrug aneko vā garbhe māṃsāṅkuraḥ sthiraḥ
verses.tib: mngal du rlung gis rna ba'i sha / zhum 'gyur 'khums pa zhes bya'o / mngal du sha mdzer sra na med / pi pi ling 'dra mang po'ang gcig

verses.skt: pippalī pippalīmānaḥ saṃnipātād vidārikā | savarṇaḥ sarujaḥ stabdhaḥ śvayathuḥ sa upekṣitaḥ
verses.tib: nad med pi pi ling zhes bya / 'dus pa las gyur gas pa ni / mdog 'dra na zhing sra ba dang / skrang 'gyur de ni ma gsos na

verses.skt: kaṭutailanibhaṃ pakvaḥ sravet kṛcchreṇa rohati | saṃkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīm
verses.tib: smin nas nyungs mar lta bur ni / 'dzag cing 'tsho ba dka' bar 'gyur / rma 'tsho bas kyang nges par ni / rna ba'i sha ni zhum par 'gyur

verses.skt: sirāsthaḥ kurute vāyuḥ pālīśoṣaṃ tadāhvayam | kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīvat pālī vātena tantrikā
verses.tib: rtsa la gnas pa'i rlung gis ni / rna shal skam pa de ming can / rna shal pi wang rgyud ltar pra / sra ba rgyud can zhes bya'o

verses.skt: sukumāre cirotsargāt sahasaiva pravardhite | karṇe śophaḥ saruk pālyām aruṇaḥ paripoṭavān
verses.tib: gzhon sha can ni yun ring du / btang snyoms bor nas 'phral du bskyed / rna shal skrangs shing nad bcas la / dmar zhing 'byar bar gyur pa ni

verses.skt: paripoṭaḥ sa pavanād utpātaḥ pittaśoṇitāt | gurvābharaṇabhārādyaiḥ śyāvo rugdāhapākavān
verses.tib: de ni rlung gis 'byar zhes bya / gnod 'gyur rgyan lci khur sogs kyis / khrag dang mkhris pa 'khrugs gyur pas / dmar zhing tshan smin pa dang

verses.skt: śvayathuḥ sphoṭapiṭikārāgoṣākledasaṃyutaḥ | pālyāṃ śopho ’nilakaphāt sarvato nirvyathaḥ sthiraḥ
verses.tib: skrang dang 'brum bu 'brum phran dang / dmar zhing tshal rnags pa yin / rlung dang bad kan gyis rna shal / skrang zhing nad med sra ba dang

verses.skt: stabdhaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān unmantho galliraś ca saḥ | durviddhe vardhite karṇe sakaṇḍūdāhapākaruk
verses.tib: brtan zhing mdog 'dra g.ya' ba dang / de ni mnye ba zhes byar bshad / phug nyes rna ba brgyangs pa las / g.ya' bcas tsha grang smin zhing na

verses.skt: śvayathuḥ saṃnipātotthaḥ sa nāmnā duḥkhavardhanaḥ | kaphāsṛkkṛmijāḥ sūkṣmāḥ sakaṇḍūkledavedanāḥ
verses.tib: 'dus pa las gyur skrangs ba de / sdug bsngal 'phel byed ces bya'o / bad kan khrag gyur srin bu phra / g.ya' zhing gnag la rnag bcas pa / srin bu phra mos bldags zhes bya

verses.skt: lihyuḥ pālīm upekṣitāḥ lehyākhyāḥ piṭikās tā hi | pippalī sarvajaṃ śūlaṃ vidārī kucikarṇakaḥ
verses.tib: de ma gsos na rna shal za / de las 'dus gyur pi pi ling / gzer can gas 'khums gsor mi rung / rgyud can gcig pu 'tsho ba tsam / lhag ma rnams ni gso bar bya / de ltar rna ba'i nad kyi ni / dbye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar bshad

verses.skt: eṣām asādhyā yāpyaikā tantrikānyāṃs tu sādhayet | pañcaviṃśatir ity uktāḥ karṇarogā vibhāgataḥ
verses.tib: de ma gsos na rna shal za / de las 'dus gyur pi pi ling / gzer can gas 'khums gsor mi rung / rgyud can gcig pu 'tsho ba tsam / lhag ma rnams ni gso bar bya / de ltar rna ba'i nad kyi ni / dbye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar bshad

verses.skt: karṇaśūle pavanaje pibed rātrau rasāśitaḥ | vātaghnasādhitaṃ sarpiḥ karṇaṃ svinnaṃ ca pūrayet
verses.tib: rlung las gyur pa'i rna nad la / sha khu blud cing rlung 'joms pa'i / sman bskol mar ni mtshan mo blud / rna ba dugs byas de rjes la

verses.skt: pattrāṇāṃ pṛthag aśvatthabilvārkairaṇḍajanmanām | tailasindhūtthadigdhānāṃ svinnānāṃ puṭapākataḥ
verses.tib: a shwat+tha dang e raN+Da / bil ba arka'i lo ma dang / til mar rgyam tshar bcas pa dang / phur ma btso ba byas pa yi

verses.skt: rasaiḥ kavoṣṇais tadvac ca mūlakasyāralor api | gaṇe vātahare ’mleṣu mūtreṣu ca vipācitaḥ
verses.tib: khu ba dro 'jam tsam mam ni / la phug gu gul rna ba dgang / rlung 'joms sde tshan skyur rnams dang / gcin gyi nang du snum chen ni

verses.skt: mahāsneho drutaṃ hanti sutīvrām api vedanām | mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṣṭhāt kṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt
verses.tib: mi bzad pa yang myur du sel / rtsa ba chen po lnga yi shing / gang yang rung ba gse mas dkri

verses.skt: tailasiktāt pradīptāgrāt snehaḥ sadyo rujāpahaḥ | yojyaś caivaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhāt kuṣṭhāt kāṣṭhāc ca sāralāt
verses.tib: til mar gyis bskus 'bar ba'i rtse / snum 'dzag 'phral du nad sel byed / de bzhin thang shing ru rta dang / sgron shing las kyang de bzhin bya

verses.skt: vātavyādhipratiśyāyavihitaṃ hitam atra ca | varjayec chirasā snānaṃ śītāmbhaḥpānam ahny api
verses.tib: rlung nad cham pa la bshad pa'i / gso bas 'dir yang phan pa yin / mgo bo bkru dang chu grang btung / nyin mo'ang yongs su spang bar bya

verses.skt: pittaśūle sitāyuktaghṛtasnigdhaṃ virecayet | drākṣāyaṣṭīśṛtaṃ stanyaṃ śasyate karṇapūraṇam
verses.tib: mkhris gyur kha ra dkar por bcas / mar gyis snum byas bkru sman gtang / rgun 'brum shing mngar nu zho bskol / rna ba bkang ba'ang bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: yaṣṭyanantāhimośīrakākolīlodhrajīvakaiḥ | mṛṇālabisamañjiṣṭhāśārivābhiś ca sādhayet
verses.tib: shing mngar tsan+dan dUr ba dkar / pu shel tse dang ra mnye ba / seng phrom pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / pad+ma'i sdong bu dzi ba ka

verses.skt: yaṣṭīmadhurasaprasthakṣīradviprasthasaṃyutam | tailasya kuḍavaṃ nasyapūraṇābhyañjanair idam
verses.tib: btsod dang thal tres bskol ba dang / shing mngar khu ba bre gang dang / 'o ma bre do bcas pa dag / til mar phul gang bskol ba dang / 'di yis rnar blugs rna dgang bsku

verses.skt: nihanti śūladāhoṣāḥ kevalaṃ kṣaudram eva vā | yaṣṭyādibhiś ca saghṛtaiḥ karṇau dihyāt samantataḥ
verses.tib: yang na sbrang rtsi nyi tshes dgang / gzer dang tsha dang na ba sel / shing mdang la sogs mar dang bcas / rna ba kun tu byugs na'ang phan

verses.skt: vāmayet pippalīsiddhasarpiḥsnigdhaṃ kaphodbhave | dhūmanāvanagaṇḍūṣasvedān kuryāt kaphāpahān
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur pi pi ling / mar bskol snum gyur skyug tu gzhug / bad kan sel ba'i sna sman dang / mkhur bkang dugs dang dud pa brngub

verses.skt: laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ muraṅgyā mūlakasya ca | kadalyāḥ svarasaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaduṣṇaḥ karṇapūraṇe
verses.tib: sgog skya sge'u gsher shi kru dang / la phug chu shing mu rang ga / bskol ba'i khu ba dam pa ni / dro 'jam rna bar blugs na'ang phan

verses.skt: arkāṅkurān amlapiṣṭāṃs tailāktā¿ lavaṇānvitān | saṃnidhāya snuhīkāṇḍe korite tacchadāvṛtān
verses.tib: arka'i myu gu skyur khur btags / til mar rgyam tshar bcas pa gang / snu ha'i shing bu brus par ni / bcug la arka'i lo mas g.yogs

verses.skt: svedayet puṭapākena sa rasaḥ śūlajit param | rasena bījapūrasya kapitthasya ca pūrayet
verses.tib: phur ma btsos pa'i tshul du bsreg / de yi khu ba gzer 'joms mchog / ma du lung ga'am ka pid ta'i / khu bas bkang ba byas na'ang phan

verses.skt: śuktena pūrayitvā vā phenenānv avacūrṇayet | ajāvimūtravaṃśatvaksiddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pūraṇam
verses.tib: yang na tshas bkang de rjes la / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba'i phye mas gdab / ra lug gcin dang 'od ma'i shun / til mar bskol bas bkang na phan

verses.skt: siddhaṃ vā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ hiṅgutumburunāgaraiḥ | raktaje pittavat kāryaṃ sirāṃ cāśu vimokṣayet
verses.tib: yang na nyungs mar shing kun dang / e raN dong gra bskol ba blugs / khrag gyur mkhris pa lta bur gso / gtar ga myur du gdab par bya

verses.skt: pakve pūyavahe karṇe dhūmagaṇḍūṣanāvanam | yuñjyān nāḍīvidhānaṃ ca duṣṭavraṇaharaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: smin zhing rna ba khrag 'dzag la / dud pa mkhur bkang sna sman sbyar / sbu gu'i cho ga dag dang ni / rma red cho ga gang yin bya

verses.skt: srotaḥ pramṛjya digdhaṃ tu dvau kālau picuvartibhiḥ | pureṇa dhūpayitvā tu mākṣikeṇa prapūrayet
verses.tib: gos par ye'us dus gnyis su / rna ba phyi zhing dag par bya / gu gul dud pas bdugs nas kyang / sbrang rtsi yis kyang dgang bar bya

verses.skt: surasādigaṇakvāthaphāṇitāktāṃ ca yojayet | picuvartiṃ susūkṣmaiś ca taccūrṇair avacūrṇayet
verses.tib: bye'u rug khu ba bskol ba dang / bu ram khu bas bskol ba yi / ras bal ye'u rab phras byug / de yi phye ma gdab

verses.skt: śūlakledagurutvānāṃ vidhir eṣa nivartakaḥ | priyaṅgumadhukāmbaṣṭhādhātakyutpalaparṇibhiḥ
verses.tib: par bya / gzer dang rnags dang lci ba la / cho ga 'dis ni bzlog par bya / pri yang+ku dang am pash+tha / shing mngar dang ni da ta ki / ut+pa la yi lo ma dang

verses.skt: mañjiṣṭhālodhralākṣābhiḥ kapitthasya rasena ca | pacet tailaṃ tad āsrāvaṃ nigṛhṇāty āśu pūraṇāt
verses.tib: btsod dang seng phrom rgya skyegs dang / ka pid ta yi khu ba dang / til mar bskol te de blugs na / rnag 'dzag pa ni myur 'chad byed

verses.skt: nādabādhiryayoḥ kuryād vātaśūloktam auṣadham | śleṣmānubandhe śleṣmāṇam prāg jayed vamanādibhiḥ
verses.tib: sgra bcas 'on pa dag la ni / rlung gi gzer 'joms sman gtang bya / bad kan las gyur bad kan ni / slon sman sogs kyis dang bor bsal

verses.skt: eraṇḍaśigruvaruṇamūlakāt pattraje rase | caturguṇe pacet tailaṃ kṣīre cāṣṭaguṇonmite
verses.tib: e raN+Da dang shi kru dang / la phug gzhon nu'i lo ma dang / khu ba til mar bzhi 'gyur dang / lo ma brgyad 'gyur bcas pa dang

verses.skt: yaṣṭyāhvākṣīrakākolīkalkayuktaṃ nihanti tat | nādabādhiryaśūlāni nāvanābhyaṅgapūraṇaiḥ
verses.tib: shing mngar ram nye ba'i lde gu / bcas par bskol ba rnar blugs dang / bsku dang rna ba bkang ba yis / sgra bcas 'on dang gzer ba 'joms

verses.skt: pakvaṃ prativiṣāhiṅgumiśitvaksvarjikoṣaṇaiḥ | saśuktaiḥ pūraṇāt tailaṃ ruksrāvāśrutinādanut
verses.tib: shu ti skyer shun sa rdzi ka / til mar tsha dang bcas bskol bas / bkang na gzer dang chu ser 'dzag / sgra bcas 'on pa sel bar byed

verses.skt: karṇanāde hitaṃ tailaṃ sarṣapotthaṃ ca pūraṇe | śuṣkamūlakakhaṇḍānāṃ kṣāro hiṅgu mahauṣadham
verses.tib: rna ba sgra dang bcas pa la / nyungs mar gyis ni bkang na phan / la phug skam pa'i dum bu yi / thal ba shing kun bca' sga dang

verses.skt: śatapuṣpāvacākuṣṭhadāruśigrurasāñjanam | sauvarcalayavakṣārasvarjikaudbhidasaindhavam
verses.tib: shu ti ru rta shu dag dang / thang shing shi kru skyer khaN+Da / ya bak+Sha ra rtsabs ru tsha / rgyam tsha rngul tsha sardzi ka

verses.skt: bhūrjagranthiviḍaṃ mustā madhuśuktaṃ caturguṇam | mātuluṅgarasas tadvat kadalīsvarasaś ca taiḥ
verses.tib: stag pa'i tsher ma kha ru tsha / gla sgang rgun tsha bzhi 'gyur dang / kha lung khu ba de dang 'dra / chu shing khu ba mnyam bskol ba'i

verses.skt: pakvaṃ tailaṃ jayaty āśu sukṛcchrān api pūraṇāt | kaṇḍūṃ kledaṃ ca bādhiryapūtikarṇatvarukkṛmīn
verses.tib: til mar bkang bas rna ba'i nad / g.ya' dang sgra bcas 'on pa dang / rnag 'dzag gzer zhing srin bu can / shin tu gso dka' thal sman gyi / til mar gyis ni myur du 'joms

verses.skt: kṣāratailam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mukhadantāmayeṣu ca | atha suptāv iva syātāṃ karṇau raktaṃ haret tataḥ
verses.tib: kha dang so yi nad la'ang phan / de nas tshor ba med pa la / nye ba la ni gtar ga gdab / skrang zhing rnags la thos pa ni

verses.skt: saśophakledayor mandaśruter vamanam ācaret | bādhiryaṃ varjayed bālavṛddhayoś cirajaṃ ca yat
verses.tib: mi gsal gyur la skyug sman btang / byis pa rgan dang yun ring du / lon pa'i 'on pa spang bar bya / sgra bcas rnags par gyur pa la

verses.skt: pratīnāhe parikledya snehasvedair viśodhayet | karṇaśodhanakenānu karṇaṃ tailasya pūrayet
verses.tib: snum dang dugs byas dag par bya / rna ba sbyangs nas de rjes la / rna ba sbyangs pa'i til mar dag

verses.skt: saśuktasaindhavamadhor mātuluṅgarasasya vā | śodhanād rūkṣatotpattau ghṛtamaṇḍasya pūraṇam
verses.tib: kha lung khu ba rgyam tsha dang / tsha dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa'ang blugs / dag byas / rtsub par gyur na ni / mar gyi nying khus dgang bar bya

verses.skt: kramo ’yaṃ malapūrṇe ’pi karṇe kaṇḍvāṃ kaphāpaham | nasyādi tadvac chophe ’pi kaṭūṣṇaiś cātra lepanam
verses.tib: rim 'di rna spabs gang la'ang bya / g.ya' dang skrang la rna sman sogs / bad kan sel bar byed pa phan / skrang la tshwa dang dro bas byug

verses.skt: karṇasrāvoditaṃ kuryāt pūtikṛmiṇakarṇayoḥ | pūraṇaṃ kaṭutailena viśeṣāt kṛmikarṇake
verses.tib: rna ba rnag 'dzag 'bu can la / rna ba chu 'dzag gso bar bya / mchog tu rna nad srin can la / nyungs mar dron po blugs par bya

verses.skt: vamipūrvā hitā karṇavidradhau vidradhikriyā | pittotthakarṇaśūloktaṃ kartavyaṃ kṣatavidradhau
verses.tib: rna ba'i 'bras la khong 'bras kyi / gso ba dang ni skyug sman gtang / snad pa'i khong 'bras gso ba ni / mkhris gyur rna gzer gso bar bya

verses.skt: arśo'rbudeṣu nāsāvad āmā karṇavidārikā | karṇavidradhivat sādhyā yathādoṣodayena ca
verses.tib: 'brum pa thor bu sna ltar bya / rna ba gas pa ma smin la / rna ba'i khong 'bras ltar gso zhing / nad gzhi ji bzhin las kyang bya

verses.skt: pālīśoṣe ’nilaśrotraśūlavan nasyalepanam | svedaṃ ca kuryāt svinnāṃ ca pālīm udvartayet tilaiḥ
verses.tib: rna shal skam la rlung gzer ltar / rna sman bsku ba la sogs bya / dugs bya snyi bar gyur pa na / rna shal til mar bskus shing mnye

verses.skt: priyālabījayaṣṭyāhvahayagandhāyavānvitaiḥ | tataḥ puṣṭikaraiḥ snehair abhyaṅgaṃ nityam ācaret
verses.tib: shing mngar pi la ya'i sa bon / a shwa gan+d+ha nas bcas bsku / de nas rgyas byed snum gyis ni / bsku ba rtag tu bsten par bya

verses.skt: śatāvarīvājigandhāpayasyairaṇḍajīvakaiḥ | tailaṃ vipakvaṃ sakṣīraṃ pālīnāṃ puṣṭikṛt param
verses.tib: nye shing a shwa gan+d+ha dang / e raN+Da dang pa ya s+ya / dzi ba ka dang 'o mar bcas / til mar bskol bas bsku ba ni / rna shal rgyas byed mchog yin no

verses.skt: kalkena jīvanīyena tailaṃ payasi pācitam | ānūpamāṃsakvāthe ca pālīpoṣaṇavardhanam
verses.tib: 'tsho byed sde tshan lde gu dang / rlan can sha ni bskol ba dag / rna shal 'phel zhing rgyas byed yin

verses.skt: pālīṃ chittvātisaṃkṣīṇāṃ śeṣāṃ saṃdhāya poṣayet | yāpyaivaṃ tantrikākhyāpi paripoṭe ’py ayaṃ vidhiḥ
verses.tib: rna shal rab zad bcad pas ni / lhag ma sbyar la gso zhing bskyed / de bzhin rgyud 'dra 'tsho tsam bya / 'byor ba la yang cho ga 'di

verses.skt: utpāte śītalair lepo jalaukohṛtaśoṇite | jambvāmrapallavabalāyaṣṭīlodhratilotpalaiḥ
verses.tib: gnod gyur bsil sman bsku ba dang / srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung bya / 'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma dang

verses.skt: sadhānyāmlaiḥ samañjiṣṭhaiḥ sakadambaiḥ saśārivaiḥ | siddham abhyañjane tailaṃ visarpoktaghṛtāni ca
verses.tib: ba la shing mngar seng phrom til / btsod dang ut+pal ka dam pa / thal tres til mar bcas pa dang / skyur rtsa bas bcas par bskol ba 'di / til mar bsku bar bya ba dang / me dbal skabs bshad mar gyis bsku / mnye ba go ta karka ta / zhag dang bcas pa'i til mar dang

verses.skt: unmanthe ’bhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ godhākarkavasānvitam | tālapattryaśvagandhārkavākucīphalasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: ta la'i lo ma arka dang / a shwa gan+d+ha bye'u rug pa / so ma ra dza 'bras bu dang / rgyam tsha lang ka lir bcas bskol / til mar bsku bar bya ba dang

verses.skt: surasālāṅgalībhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca nāvanam | durviddhe ’śmantajambvāmrapattrakvāthena secitām
verses.tib: rna sman rnon po gtang bar bya / dbug nyes pa la a sman ta / 'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma ni / bskol ba'i / khu ba blugs par bya

verses.skt: tailena pālīṃ svabhyaktāṃ suślakṣṇair avacūrṇayet | cūrṇair madhukamañjiṣṭhāprapuṇḍrāhvaniśodbhavaiḥ
verses.tib: rna shal til mar gyis bsku zhing / shing mngar btsod dang stag tsher ba / yung ba'i phye ma zhib po gdab

verses.skt: lākṣāviḍaṅgasiddhaṃ ca tailam abhyañjane hitam | svinnāṃ gomayajaiḥ piṇḍair bahuśaḥ parilehikām
verses.tib: rgya skyegs byi dang ga bskol ba'i / til mar gyis ni bskus na phan / srin bus zos la ba'i lci bas / lan mang du ni dugs byas la

verses.skt: viḍaṅgasārair ālimped urabhrīmūtrakalkitaiḥ | kauṭajeṅgudakārañjabījaśamyākavalkalaiḥ
verses.tib: byi dang ga yi snying po ni / lug gi gcin sbyar lde gus bsku / dug mo nyung dang ing gu dang / e raN+Da yi sa bon dang

verses.skt: athavābhyañjanaṃ tair vā kaṭutailaṃ vipācayet | sanimbapattramaricamadanair lehikāvraṇe
verses.tib: dong ga'i shun pa lde gus bsku / yang na de dag nim pa yi / lo ma na le sham dang bcas / sbrang rtsi'i lde gus rma la bsku

verses.skt: chinnaṃ tu karṇaṃ śuddhasya bandham ālocya yaugikam | śuddhāsraṃ lāgayel lagne sadyaśchinne viśodhanam
verses.tib: rna ba chad la sbyang byas te / skyon med khrag dang de 'tsham pa'i / bcing ba dag gis sbyar bar bya / sbyar nas 'phral bcad sbyang bar bya

verses.skt: atha grathitvā keśāntaṃ kṛtvā chedanalekhanam | niveśya saṃdhiṃ suṣamaṃ na nimnaṃ na samunnatam
verses.tib: de nas skra mthar mdud byas te / rna shal bcad dang zhal zhal bya / bcad pa dang ni bsrung bar bya / mtshams ni mnyam par sbyar bya zhing / mthon dman med pa nyid du bya

verses.skt: abhyajya madhusarpirbhyāṃ picuplotāvaguṇṭhitam | sūtreṇāgāḍhaśithilaṃ baddhvā cūrṇair avākiret
verses.tib: zhun mar dang ni sbrang rtsis byug / ras bal gyis ni glan pa dang / skud pas dam lhod ran par bcing

verses.skt: śoṇitasthāpanair vraṇyam ācāraṃ cādiśet tataḥ | saptāhād āmatailāktaṃ śanair apanayet picum
verses.tib: rma yi khrag ni bcad pa yi / sman gyi phye mas gdab bya zhing / spyod pa de la bsten par bya / zhag bdun nas ni ma btses pa'i / til mar bskus la ras bal dgrol

verses.skt: surūḍhaṃ jātaromāṇaṃ śliṣṭasaṃdhiṃ samaṃ sthiram | suvarṣmāṇam arogaṃ ca śanaiḥ karṇaṃ vivardhayet
verses.tib: legs 'byor spu skyes pa dang / mtshams 'byor mnyam zhing brtan pa dang / tshad ldan nad ni med pa dang / rim gyis rna ba skyed par byed

verses.skt: jalaśūkaḥ svayaṅguptā rajanyau bṛhatīphalam | aśvagandhābalāhastipippalīgaurasarṣapāḥ
verses.tib: nya lcibs kha sral phre'u dang / pri ha ti 'bras ser po gnyis / ba la ha ti pi pi ling / a shwa gan+d+ha nyungs kar ser

verses.skt: mūlaṃ kośātakāśvaghnarūpikāsaptaparṇajam | chucchundarī kālamṛtā gṛhaṃ madhukarīkṛtam
verses.tib: ko sha ta ka'i rtsa ba dang / ka ra bI ra ru shig / lo ma bdun pa bil ba la / sa nag sbrang ma'i gnas dang ni / bye'u chu skyes srin bu'i sha / de bzhin seng phrom sdong bu rnams / 'di dag lde gu til mar bcas

verses.skt: jatūkā jalajanmā ca tathā śabarakandakam | ebhiḥ kalkaiḥ kharaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: ko sha ta ka'i rtsa ba dang / ka ra bI ra ru shig / lo ma bdun pa bil ba la / sa nag sbrang ma'i gnas dang ni / bye'u chu skyes srin bu'i sha / de bzhin seng phrom sdong bu rnams / 'di dag lde gu til mar bcas

verses.skt: hastyaśvamūtreṇa param abhyaṅgāt karṇavardhanam | atha kuryād vayaḥsthasya cchinnāṃ śuddhasya nāsikām
verses.tib: ma he'i mar dang glang po rta'i / gcin dang bcas par bskol ba ni / bskus na rna ba 'phel byed mchog / de nas na tshod ldan pa yi / sbyang ba byas nas rna chad gso

verses.skt: chindyān nāsāsamaṃ pattraṃ tattulyaṃ ca kapolataḥ | tvaṅmāṃsaṃ nāsikāsanne rakṣaṃs tat tanutāṃ nayet
verses.tib: sna dang mnyam pa'i sha lpags ni / mkhur tshos las ni bcad nas kyang / rna dang nye ba'i sha lpags ni / srab mo / nyid du bzhar bar bya

verses.skt: sīvyed gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sevinyā picuyuktayā | nāsācchede ’tha likhite parivartyopari tvacam
verses.tib: de nas ras bal bcas pa yi / khab kyis mkhur ba btsem par bya / sna bcad mtshon gyis bzhar nas ni

verses.skt: kapolavadhraṃ saṃdadhyāt sīvyen nāsāṃ ca yatnataḥ | nāḍībhyām utkṣiped antaḥ sukhocchvāsapravṛttaye
verses.tib: mkhur tshos las bcad pags pa yis / sna ni lags mor btsem par bya / kha yi dbugs ni dbyung ba'i phyir / snar ni sbu gu can gzhug bya

verses.skt: āmatailena siktvānu pattaṅgamadhukāñjanaiḥ | śoṇitasthāpanaiś cānyaiḥ suślakṣṇair avacūrṇayet
verses.tib: de rjes til mar slon par bsku / rma ni sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bsku / khrag bcad pa yi sman gzhan yang / zhib tu btags pa'i phye mas gdab

verses.skt: tato madhughṛtābhyaktaṃ baddhvācārikam ādiśet | jñātvāvasthāntaraṃ kuryāt sadyovraṇavidhiṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: de nas mar dang sbrang rtsis bsku / bcings la spyod pa bstan par bya / de nas gnas skabs shes byas nas / rma gsar gso ba'i cho ga bya

verses.skt: chindyād rūḍhe ’dhikaṃ māṃsaṃ nāsopāntāc ca carma tat | sīvyet tataś ca suślakṣṇaṃ hīnaṃ saṃvardhayet punaḥ
verses.tib: rma 'byor sna yi nye 'khor gyi / sha lhag legs par gcad par bya / de nas shin tu zhib tu btsem / dma' ba dag kyang bskyed par bya

verses.skt: niveśite yathānyāsaṃ sadyaśchinne ’py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | nāḍīyogād vinauṣṭhasya nāsāsaṃdhānavad vidhiḥ
verses.tib: bcad ma thag la ci rigs par / bzhag ste cho ga 'di nyid bya / mchu bcad pa la sbu gu dag / ma gtogs sna sbyar bzhin du bya

verses.skt: avaśyāyānilarajobhāṣyātisvapnajāgaraiḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānena pītenānyena vāriṇā
verses.tib: ba mo rlung dang rdul dang ni / smra drags gnyid log gnyid yar drags / sngas ni mtho dang dma' drags dang / chu gzhan 'thungs par gyur pa dang

verses.skt: atyambupānaramaṇacchardibāṣpagrahādibhiḥ | kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ gatāḥ
verses.tib: chu mang 'thungs dang nyal po dang / skyugs dang mchi ma bkag pa yis / rlung shas che ba'i nad 'khrugs nas / sna ni sra ba nyid 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: janayanti pratiśyāyaṃ vardhamānaṃ kṣayapradam | tatra vātāt pratiśyāye mukhaśoṣo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ
verses.tib: cham pa skyed par byed pa yin / 'phel na zad pa skyed par byed / de la rlung gyur cham pa ni / kha skam sbrid pa drag tu 'byung

verses.skt: ghrāṇoparodhanistodadantaśaṅkhaśirovyathāḥ | kīṭikā iva sarpantīr manyate parito bhruvau
verses.tib: sna 'gags zug cing na ba dang / mur 'gram so dang klad pa dang / smin ma nas ni sna rtse'i bar / srin bu rgyu ba snyam du sems

verses.skt: svarasādaś cirāt pākaḥ śiśirācchakaphasrutiḥ | pittāt tṛṣṇājvaraghrāṇapiṭikāsaṃbhavabhramāḥ
verses.tib: skad 'gags ring nas smin pa dang / mchil snabs grang bar 'dzag pa yin / mkhris gyur skom dad rims kyis 'debs / mgo 'khor sna nang 'brum pa 'byung

verses.skt: nāsāgrapāko rūkṣoṣṇatāmrapītakaphasrutiḥ | kaphāt kāso ’ruciḥ śvāso vamathur gātragauravam
verses.tib: sna rtse gnag cing dro la rtsub / mchil snabs dmar ser 'dzag pa yin / bad kan lud pa dbugs mi bde / slon zhing lus lci yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: mādhuryaṃ vadane kaṇḍūḥ snigdhaśuklakaphasrutiḥ | sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvair akasmād vṛddhiśāntimān
verses.tib: kha mngar bro zhing g.ya' ba dang / mchil snabs snum / dkar ska ba 'dzag / 'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun dang ldan / rgyu med 'phel dang 'grib par byed

verses.skt: duṣṭaṃ nāsāsirāḥ prāpya pratiśyāyaṃ karoty asṛk | urasaḥ suptatā tāmranetratvaṃ śvāsapūtitā
verses.tib: nad khrag sna yi rtsar zhugs nas / cham pas 'debs par byed 'gyur ba / brang na tshor ba med pa dang / mig dmar dbugs kyi dri mi zhim

verses.skt: kaṇḍūḥ śrotrākṣināsāsu pittoktaṃ cātra lakṣaṇam | sarva eva pratiśyāyā duṣṭatāṃ yānty upekṣitāḥ
verses.tib: mig dang rna ba sna g.ya' zhing / 'di ni mkhris gyur mtshan nyid ldan / cham pa thams cad ma gsos na / gnod pa mi bzad skyed byed 'gyur

verses.skt: yathoktopadravādhikyāt sa sarvendriyatāpanaḥ | sāgnisādajvaraśvāsakāsoraḥpārśvavedanaḥ
verses.tib: ji skad bshad pa'i bla brnan ni / 'phel bas dbang po kun gnod byed / me drod nyams nyes dbugs mi bde / lud pa brang dang rtsib logs zug
