verses.skt: kupyaty akasmād bahuśo mukhadaurgandhyaśophakṛt | nāsikākledasaṃśoṣaśuddhirodhakaro muhuḥ
verses.tib: glo bur du ni shas cher 'khrugs / kha dri nga zhing skam par byed / sna nang 'drul zhing skam pa dang / yang yang sna 'gags dag par byed

verses.skt: pūyopamāsitāraktagrathitaśleṣmasaṃsrutiḥ | mūrchanti cātra kṛmayo dīrghasnigdhasitāṇavaḥ
verses.tib: snabs ni rnag 'dra dkar zhing dmar / dud pa can ni 'dzag par 'gyur / 'di la srin bu snum zhing ring

verses.skt: pakvaliṅgāni teṣv aṅgalāghavaṃ kṣavathoḥ śamaḥ | śleṣmā sacikkaṇaḥ pīto ’jñānaṃ ca rasagandhayoḥ
verses.tib: dkar zhing phra ba 'byung bar bshad / de smin mtshan ma lus yang zhing / sbrid pa zhi bar gyur pa dang / snabs ni sbyin zhing ser ba dang / dri dang ro ni tshor ba yin

verses.skt: tīkṣṇāghrāṇopayogārkaraśmisūtratṛṇādibhiḥ | vātakopibhir anyair vā nāsikātaruṇāsthani
verses.tib: snar ni rnon po brngubs pa dang / nyi 'od skud pa rtsa sogs dang / rlung 'khrugs byed pa gzhan gyis kyang / sna yi mtshul par zhugs gyur pas

verses.skt: vighaṭṭite ’nilaḥ kruddho ruddhaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ vrajet | nivṛttaḥ kurute ’tyarthaṃ kṣavathuṃ sa bhṛśakṣavaḥ
verses.tib: bskyod de rlung ni 'khrugs gyur pa / sum mdor zhugs 'gyur 'gags nas ni / ldog nas mi bzad sbrid pa ni / snabs 'dzag bcas par skyed par byed

verses.skt: śoṣayan nāsikāsrotaḥ kaphaṃ ca kurute ’nilaḥ | śūkapūrṇābhanāsātvaṃ kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: sna yi bu ga skam byed cing / rlung gis bad kan skyed par byed / sna nang gra mas gang snyam sems / dbugs 'byung dka' bar gyur pa de

verses.skt: smṛto ’sau nāsikāśoṣo nāsānāhe tu jāyate | naddhatvam iva nāsāyāḥ śleṣmaruddhena vāyunā
verses.tib: sna skams pa zhes bya bar bshad / sna rgyas pa ni 'byung 'gyur ba / sna ni bkag pa 'drar sems shing / rlung gis 'gag par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃrodhāt srotasī saṃvṛte iva | pacen nāsāpuṭe pittaṃ tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dāhaśūlavat
verses.tib: dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub 'gags pa las / bu ga gdangs pa lta bu yin / mkhris pas sna khung rnags gyur pa / sha lpags tsha zhing gzer dang bcas

verses.skt: sa ghrāṇapākaḥ srāvas tu tatsaṃjñaḥ śleṣmasaṃbhavaḥ | accho jalopamo ’jasraṃ viśeṣān niśi jāyate
verses.tib: de ni sna yi shu bar bshad / bad kan las gyur chu ser ni / chu 'dra rgyun du 'dzag pa dang / mchog tu mtshan 'dzag de ming can

verses.skt: kaphaḥ pravṛddho nāsāyāṃ ruddhvā srotāṃsy apīnasam | kuryāt saghurghuraśvāsaṃ pīnasādhikavedanam
verses.tib: bad kan 'phel bas sna khung du / bu ga 'gags shing cham pa skyed / dbugs / ni ngar ngar por 'byin zhing / cham pa las kyang nad tshabs che

verses.skt: aver iva sravaty asya praklinnā tena nāsikā | ajasraṃ picchilaṃ pītaṃ pakvaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam
verses.tib: sna las lug ltar rnag 'dzag cing / rgyun du sbyin bag ser po dang / smin ma'i rnag ni 'dzag 'gyur zhing / de yi sna ni snabs bcas yin

verses.skt: raktena nāsā dagdheva bāhyāntaḥsparśanāsahā | bhaved dhūmopamocchvāsā sā dīptir dahatīva ca
verses.tib: khrag gi sna ni tshig snyam sems / phyi dang nang du reg mi bzod / du ba lta bu'i dbugs 'byin pa / bsregs 'dra de ni 'bar ba yin

verses.skt: tālumūle malair duṣṭair māruto mukhanāsikāt | śleṣmā ca pūtir nirgacchet pūtināsaṃ vadanti tam
verses.tib: rkan gyi phugs su nad 'khrugs pas / rlung ni kha dang sna nas 'byung / mchil snabs dri nga 'byung 'gyur ba / de ni sna nad rul pa yin

verses.skt: nicayād abhighātād vā pūyāsṛṅ nāsikā sravet | tat pūyaraktam ākhyātaṃ śirodāharujākaram
verses.tib: 'dus pa'am snad pa las gyur pa'i / rnag dang khrag ni sna nas 'dzag / mgo bo tsha zhing na byed pa / de ni rnag khrag can zhes bshad

verses.skt: pittaśleṣmāvaruddho ’ntar nāsāyāṃ śoṣayen marut | kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭatāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat
verses.tib: rlung gis mkhris pa bad kan dag / sna ni skams par gyur pa las / bad kan skams te gong por gyur / de ni bsgongs pa zhes bya'o

verses.skt: arśo'rbudāni vibhajed doṣaliṅgair yathāyatham | sarveṣu kṛcchrocchvasanaṃ pīnasaḥ pratataṃ kṣutiḥ
verses.tib: 'brum bu thor bu nad gzhi yi / mtshan nyid ci 'dra dag las dbye / kun las dbugs 'byung dka' ba dang / rgyun du chu 'dzag sbrid pa 'byung

verses.skt: sānunāsikavāditvaṃ pūtināsaḥ śirovyathā | aṣṭādaśānām ity eṣāṃ yāpayed duṣṭapīnasam
verses.tib: sna 'gags lta bur smra ba dang / sna nas rnag 'dzag klad pa na / de ltar rnam pa bco brgyad las / cham pa ma rungs 'tsho ba tsam

verses.skt: sarveṣu pīnaseṣv ādau nivātāgārago bhajet | snehanasvedavamanadhūmagaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam
verses.tib: sna nad kun las dang por ni / rlung med khang par 'dug nas ni / snum chos dugs dang skyug sman dang / dud pa brngub dang mkhur bkang bsten

verses.skt: vāso gurūṣṇaṃ śirasaḥ sughanaṃ pariveṣṭanam | laghvamlalavaṇaṃ snigdham uṣṇaṃ bhojanam adravam
verses.tib: gos ni lci zhing dro ba bgo / mgo bo shin tu mthug pas dkri / kha zas yang skyur lan tshwa snum / dro ba dang ni bska ba bza'

verses.skt: dhanvamāṃsaguḍakṣīracaṇakatrikaṭūtkaṭam | yavagodhūmabhūyiṣṭhaṃ dadhidāḍimasārikam
verses.tib: bu ram 'o ma skam sa'i sha / lan tshwa tsha ba gsum shas che / nas dang gro ni mang po dang / zho dang se 'bru'i khu ba bsten

verses.skt: bālamūlakajo yūṣaḥ kulatthotthaś ca pūjitaḥ | kavoṣṇaṃ daśamūlāmbu jīrṇāṃ vā vāruṇīṃ pibet
verses.tib: la phug gzhon nu'i khu ba dang / ku lang+tha yi khu ba'ang bsngags / rtsa bcu'i khu ba dro 'jam mam / chang snying dngas ma blud par bya

verses.skt: jighrec corakatarkārīvacājājyupakuñcikāḥ | vyoṣatālīśacavikātintiḍīkāmlavetasam
verses.tib: tsa rong ag+ni man+tha dang / shu dag zi ra go snyod snom / bal bu'i lo ma tsha ba gsum

verses.skt: manaḥśilāviḍaṅgālavacātrikaṭuhiṅgubhiḥ | cūrṇīkṛtya samāghrātaḥ pratiśyāyo vinaśyati
tadvad dorakavallyelālavātārkṣyadvijīrakaiḥ
verses.tib: dbyi mo da trig star bu dang

verses.skt: sāgnyajāji dvipalikaṃ tvagelāpattrapādikam | jīrṇād guḍāt tulārdhena pakvena vaṭakīkṛtam
verses.tib: zir tsi tra srang gnyis gnyis / shing tsha gan+d+ha b+ha da dang / sug smel zho ni gnyis gnyis dang / bu ram rnying pa srang / lnga bcu / bskol te ri lur byas pa ni

verses.skt: pīnasaśvāsakāsaghnaṃ rucisvarakaraṃ param | śatāhvātvagbalā mūlaṃ śyoṇākairaṇḍabilvajam
verses.tib: zos na cham pa dbugs mi bde / lud pa lu ba 'joms byed cing / skad snyan yi ga 'byed mchog yin / shu ti'i shun pa ba la dang / so na ka dang e raN+Da

verses.skt: sāragvadhaṃ pibed dhūmaṃ vasājyamadanānvitam | athavā saghṛtān saktūn kṛtvā mallakasaṃpuṭe
verses.tib: bil ba'i rtsa ba dong grar bcas / zhag mar spra tshil dud pa brngub / yang na phye dang mar dang bcas / kham phor sbyar ba'i nang du bcug / bsregs pa'i dud pa brngub par bya

verses.skt: tyajet snānaṃ śucaṃ krodhaṃ bhṛśaṃ śayyāṃ himaṃ jalam | pibed vātapratiśyāye sarpir vātaghnasādhitam
verses.tib: khrus dang mya ngan khro ba dang / shas cher gnyid log chu grang spang / rlung gyur cham pa rlung 'joms pa'i / sman ni bskol ba'i khu ba'am

verses.skt: paṭupañcakasiddhaṃ vā vidāryādigaṇena vā | svedanasyādikāṃ kuryāt cikitsām arditoditām
verses.tib: lan tshwa lnga ni bskol ba'am / bi da ri sogs sde bskol blud / dugs dang sna sman la sogs bya / gzhogs byed nar bshad gso ba'ang bya

verses.skt: pittaraktotthayoḥ peyaṃ sarpir madhurakaiḥ śṛtam | pariṣekān pradehāṃś ca śītaiḥ kurvīta śītalān
verses.tib: khrag mkhris las gyur thug pa ni / mar sar mngar ba'i sman bskol blud / sman chu blugs shing byug pa dang / nus bsil grang mo dag gis bya

verses.skt: dhavatvaktriphalāśyāmāśrīparṇīyaṣṭitilvakaiḥ | kṣīre daśaguṇe tailaṃ nāvanaṃ saniśaiḥ pacet
verses.tib: da ba'i shun pa 'bras bu gsum / shi ri par+Ni pri yad+ku / shing mngar seng phrom til mar gyi / bcu 'gyur 'o ma skyer bar bcas

verses.skt: kaphaje laṅghanaṃ lepaḥ śiraso gaurasarṣapaiḥ | sakṣāraṃ vā ghṛtam pītvā vamet piṣṭais tu nāvanam
verses.tib: bskol ba'i sna sman gtang bar bya / bad kan las gyur smyung ba dang / yungs kar lde gus mgo bsku'am / thal sman bcas pa'i mar blud de

verses.skt: bastāmbunā paṭuvyoṣavellavatsakajīrakaiḥ | kaṭutīkṣṇair ghṛtair nasyaiḥ kavaḍaiḥ sarvajaṃ jayet
verses.tib: byi dong ga dang dug mo nyung / zi ra ra gcin sbyar ba yi / sna sman dag ni gtong bar bya / 'dus gyur tsha dang rno sbyar ba'i / mar gyi sna sman blugs pas gso

verses.skt: yakṣmakṛmikramaṃ kurvan yāpayed duṣṭapīnasam | vyoṣorubūkakṛmijiddārumādrīgadeṅgudam
verses.tib: gcong chen srin gso'i rim gyis ni / cham pa ma rung 'tsho tsam bya / tsha ba gsum dang e raN+Da / thang shing ru rta byi dong ga / bong nga dkar po ing gu dang / dur byid par ta ka'i sa bon

verses.skt: vārtākabījaṃ trivṛtā siddhārthaḥ pūtimatsyakaḥ | agnimanthasya puṣpāṇi pīluśigruphalāni ca
verses.tib: nyungs kar nye'u 'phral rus pa dang / ag+hi man+d+ra'i me tog dang / pi lu shi kru'i sa bon dang

verses.skt: aśvaviḍrasamūtrābhyāṃ hastimūtreṇa caikataḥ | kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmaṃ ghrāṇāsyataḥ pibet
verses.tib: rta sbangs khu ba gcin dang ni / glang po'i gcin dang gcig tu sbyar / zar ma'i skud dkris reng bu yi / dud pa kha dang sna nas brngub

verses.skt: kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam | śuṇṭhīkuṣṭhakaṇāvelladrākṣākalkakaṣāyavat
verses.tib: smin dang sbrid pa 'byung zhes pa / sna sman rnon po bud pas phan / bca' sga ru rta pi pi ling / rgun 'brum byi dong ga'i lde gu

verses.skt: sādhitaṃ tailam ājyaṃ vā nasyaṃ kṣavapuṭapraṇut | nāsāśoṣe balātailaṃ pānādau bhojanaṃ rasaiḥ
verses.tib: mar ram til mar bcas bskol ba'i / sna sman sbrid pa rnags pa sel / sna skams pa la ba la'i mar / btung sogs sha khur sbyar ba bza'

verses.skt: snigdho dhūmas tathā svedo nāsānāhe ’py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | pāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi saṃsrutau
verses.tib: snum gyi dud pa dugs kyis gso / sna rgyas la yang cho ga 'di'o / sna rnags 'bar la mkhris 'joms sman / chu 'dzag sna sman sogs rnos bya

verses.skt: kaphapīnasavat pūtināsāpīnasayoḥ kriyā | lākṣākarañjamaricavellahiṅgukaṇāguḍaiḥ
verses.tib: rnags can la ni bad kan gyi / gso ba dang ni 'dra bar bya / rgya skyegs dang ni karany+dza / na le sham dang byi dang ga / shing kun bu ram pi pi ling

verses.skt: avimūtradrutair nasyaṃ kārayed vamane kṛte | śigrusiṃhīnikumbhānāṃ bījaiḥ savyoṣasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: lug thug gcin sbyar sna sman ni / slon byas 'og tu gtang bar bya / shi kru dan+da bri ha ti / tsha ba gsum dang lce myang tsha

verses.skt: savellasurasais tailaṃ nāvanaṃ paramaṃ hitam | pūyarakte nave kuryād raktapīnasavat kramam
verses.tib: bye'u rug pha dang byi dang ga / til mar bskol ba'i sna sman yang / btang na mchog tu phan pa yi / rnag dang khrag can sar pa ni / khrag gi cham pa lta bur gso

verses.skt: atipravṛddhe nāḍīvad dagdheṣv arśo'rbudeṣu ca | nikumbhakumbhasindhūtthamanohvālakaṇāgnikaiḥ
verses.tib: shin tu 'phel la rma 'khyims ltar / 'brum bu rmen bu tsha ba la / dan ti dur byid lce myang tsha / ldong ros dang ni bi pi ling

verses.skt: kalkitair ghṛtamadhvaktāṃ ghrāṇe vartiṃ praveśayet | śigrvādināvanaṃ cātra pūtināsoditaṃ bhajet
verses.tib: tsi tra ka yi lde gu ni / mar dang sbrang rtsir sbyar ba yi / reng bu snar ni gzhug par bya / shi kru la sogs sna sman yang

verses.skt: mātsyamāhiṣavārāhapiśitāmakamūlakam | māṣasūpadadhikṣīraśuktekṣurasaphāṇitam
verses.tib: nya dang ma he phag gi ni / sha dang la phug rjen pa dang / ma sha'i sran tshod 'o ma zho / cha dang bu ram shing kun dang / 'brum phran kha sbubs nyal bsten dang

verses.skt: avākśayyāṃ ca bhajato dviṣato dantadhāvanam | dhūmacchardanagaṇḍūṣān ucitaṃ ca sirāvyadham
verses.tib: so shing gis snad goms pa spong / dud ba mkhur bkang skyugs pa dang

verses.skt: kruddhāḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kurvanty antar mukhaṃ gadān | tatra khaṇḍauṣṭha ity ukto vātenauṣṭho dvidhā kṛtaḥ
verses.tib: gtar ga dbug ni nyes pa yi / bad kan shas che'i nad 'khrugs pas / kha yi nang gi nad skyed 'gyur / de la rlung gis mchu gas 'gyur / mchu ral ba yi nad ces bshad

verses.skt: oṣṭhakope tu pavanāt stabdhāv oṣṭhau mahārujau | dālyete paripāṭyete paruṣāsitakarkaśau
verses.tib: rlung gis mchu la gnod gyur pa / mchu sra nad tshabs che ba yin / mchu gas rdol bar 'gyur ba dang

verses.skt: pittāt tīkṣṇasahau pītau sarṣapākṛtibhiś citau | piṭikābhir bahukledāv āśupākau kaphāt punaḥ
verses.tib: gnag cing rtsub pa mchu 'khrugs yin / mkhris pa tsha ba mi bzod ser / 'brum phran nyungs kar 'dra bas khyab / myur smin mang du rnags pa yin

verses.skt: śītāsahau gurū śūnau savarṇapiṭikācitau | saṃnipātād anekābhau durgandhāsrāvapicchilau
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur grang ba yis / mi bzod lci zhing skrang ba dang / 'brum phran dkar pos khyab pa yin / 'dus gyur sna tshogs par snang zhing / dri nga'i spyi bag / 'dzag pa dang

verses.skt: akasmān mlānasaṃśūnarujau viṣamapākinau | raktopasṛṣṭau rudhiraṃ sravataḥ śoṇitaprabhau
verses.tib: glo bur shas cher skrang zhing zhum / na dang min rnag mi snyoms / khrag las gyur pa khrag 'dzag cing

verses.skt: kharjūrasadṛśaṃ cātra kṣīṇe rakte ’rbudaṃ bhavet | māṃsapiṇḍopamau māṃsāt syātāṃ mūrchatkṛmī kramāt
verses.tib: khrag gi mdog dang 'dra ba dang / 'di la 'bra go lta bu yi / khrag zad chu bur 'byung ba yin / sha gyur sha yi gong po 'dra / rim gyis srin bu skye zhing 'gul

verses.skt: tailābhaśvayathukledau sakaṇḍvau medasā mṛdū | kṣatajāv avadīryete pāṭyete cāsakṛt punaḥ
verses.tib: tshil gyur g.ya' zhing 'drul ba dang / skrang 'jam til mar lta bur 'dzag / snad pa las gyur gas pa dang / yang dang yang du 'bye 'gyur la

verses.skt: grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśanacchadau | jalabudbudavad vātakaphād oṣṭhe jalārbudam
verses.tib: slar yang 'drub par 'gyur ba dang / mchu ni g.ya' bar byed pa yin / rlung dang bad kan 'dres pa las / chu yi chu bur lta bur 'byung

verses.skt: gaṇḍālajī sthiraḥ śopho gaṇḍe dāhajvarānvitaḥ | vātād uṣṇasahā dantāḥ śītasparśe ’dhikavyathāḥ
verses.tib: mkhur ba'i 'bras 'byed skrang zhing brtan / mkhur ba tsha zhing rims dang bcas / rlung gyur so nad dro la sred / grang bas reg na lhag par na

verses.skt: dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaś ca saḥ | dantaharṣe pravātāmlaśītabhakṣākṣamā dvijāḥ
verses.tib: gzer zhing bcag pa snyam du sems / grang bas zhig pa de bshad do / rlung dang chu yis so brtse pa / grang dang skyur ba mi bzod par

verses.skt: bhavanty amlāśaneneva sarujāś calitā iva | dantabhede dvijās todabhedaruksphuṭanānvitāḥ
verses.tib: skyur ba zos pa nyid kyis 'gyur / nad bcas 'gul bar byed pa yin / so gas so ni zegs pa dang / na zhing zug la g.yo ba yin

verses.skt: cālaś caladbhir daśanair bhakṣaṇād adhikavyathaiḥ | karālas tu karālānāṃ daśanānāṃ samudgamaḥ
verses.tib: so 'gul so ni g.yo ba dang / za ba'i tshe na lhag par na / so sto so ni mi sdug par / so rnams skye bar 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: danto ’dhiko ’dhidantākhyaḥ sa coktaḥ khalu vardhanaḥ | jāyamāne ’tirug dante jāte tatra tu śāmyati
verses.tib: so lhag so ni skyes pa ste / de ni 'phel ba zhes kyang bshad / skye bar 'gyur ba'i tshe na ni / na zhing skyes nas de zhi byed

verses.skt: adhāvanān malo dante kapho vā vātaśoṣitaḥ | pūtigandhiḥ sthirībhūtaḥ śarkarā sāpy upekṣitā
verses.tib: ma bkrus so yi dri ma'am / bad kan rlung gis skams pa las / dri nga brtan gyur so dreg yin / de ni yal bar bor ba las

verses.skt: śātayaty aṇuśo dantāt kapālāni kapālikā | śyāvaḥ śyāvatvam āyāto raktapittānilair dvijaḥ
verses.tib: so ni dum bur zegs gyur pa / grugs shing so ni gogs pa yin / khrag dang mkhris pa rlung gis so / sngon por gyur pa so sngon yin

verses.skt: samūlaṃ dantam āśritya doṣair ulbaṇamārutaiḥ | śoṣite majjñi suṣire dante ’nnamalapūrite
verses.tib: nad kyi rlung ni shas cher 'gyur / rtsa bar bcas pa'i so la brtan / so dbus skams te stong par byas / so ni zas kyi dri mas gang

verses.skt: pūtitvāt kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante jāyate tataḥ | ahetutīvrārtiśamaḥ sasaṃrambho ’sitaś calaḥ
verses.tib: rul bas srin bu phra mo ni / skye bar 'gyur te de 'og tu / rgyu med brnag dka' ldang dub can / sbom che gnag la shas cher na

verses.skt: pralūnaḥ pūyaraktasrut sa coktaḥ kṛmidantakaḥ | śleṣmaraktena pūtīni vahanty asram ahetukam
verses.tib: bcad pa 'drar snang rnag khrag 'dzag / de ni so srin can zhes bya / bad kan dang ni khrag gis rnyil / rnags

verses.skt: śīryante dantamāṃsāni mṛduklinnāsitāni ca | śītādo ’sāv upakuśaḥ pākaḥ pittāsṛgudbhavaḥ
verses.tib: shing rul bar 'gyur ba dang / mnyen la zags shing gnag pa de / grang bas nyen pa yin par bshad / khrag mkhris rnags pa las byung ba

verses.skt: dantamāṃsāni dahyante raktāny utsedhavanty ataḥ | kaṇḍūmanti sravanty asram ādhmāyante ’sṛji sthite
verses.tib: rnyil ni tsha bar byed pa dang / khrag gis skrangs pa mtho ba dang / g.ya' zhing khrag ni 'dzag pa dang / khrag chad nas ni rgyas par 'gyur

verses.skt: calā mandarujo dantāḥ pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate | dantayos triṣu vā śopho badarāsthinibho ghanaḥ
verses.tib: so na 'gul zhing nad tshabs chung / kha dri mnam gyur nyer bdar yin / so ni gnyis sam gsum thad kar / bad kan las gyur rgya shug tsam

verses.skt: kaphāsrāt tīvraruk śīghraṃ pacyate dantapuppuṭaḥ | dantamāṃse malaiḥ sāsrair bāhyāntaḥ śvayathur guruḥ
verses.tib: skrangs pa sra zhing mi bzad na / myur du smin pa so 'bur yin / rnyil ni nad bcas khrag gis ni / phyi dang nang du skrang zhing lci

verses.skt: sarugdāhaḥ sraved bhinnaḥ pūyāsraṃ dantavidradhiḥ | śvayathur dantamūleṣu rujāvān pittaraktajaḥ
verses.tib: na zhing tsha la gas pa las / rnag khrag 'dzag so'i khong 'bras yin / so rtsar khrag mkhris las gyur nad / skrang zhing nad dang bcas pa dang

verses.skt: lālāsrāvī sa suṣiro dantamāṃsapraśātanaḥ | sa saṃnipātāj jvaravān sapūyarudhirasrutiḥ
verses.tib: kha chu 'dzag cing rnyil 'drul ba / khong stong gi ni nad ces bya / 'dus pa las gyur rims dang bcas / rnag dang bcas pa'i khrag 'dzag la

verses.skt: mahāsuṣira ity ukto viśīrṇadvijabandhanaḥ | dantānte kīlavac chopho hanukarṇarujākaraḥ
verses.tib: so yi sprel mtshams zhig pa ni / khong stong chen po zhes bshad do / bad kan gyis ni so yi mthar / sha mdzer ltar skrang 'gram pa dang / rna ba na byed spyod lam nyams

verses.skt: pratihanty abhyavahṛtim śleṣmaṇā so ’dhimāṃsakaḥ | ghṛṣṭeṣu dantamāṃseṣu saṃrambho jāyate mahān
verses.tib: de ni sha lhag ces byar bshad / rnyil ni bdar bar 'gyur pa las / nad tshabs chen por 'byung 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: yasmiṃś calanti dantāś ca sa vidarbho ’bhighātajaḥ | dantamāṃsāśritān rogān yaḥ sādhyān apy upekṣate
verses.tib: gang zhig so ni 'gul gyur pa / de ni snad pa las byung yin / rnyil la brten par byed pa'i nad / gsor rung yal bar bor ba gang

verses.skt: antas tasyāsravan doṣaḥ sūkṣmāṃ saṃjanayed gatim | pūyaṃ muhuḥ sā sravati tvaṅmāṃsāsthiprabhedinī
verses.tib: nang du de ni nad 'dzag pas / des ni rgyun lam phra ba skyed / de ni yang yang rnag 'dzag cing / pags pa sha dang rus pa 'bigs

verses.skt: tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā lakṣaṇaiḥ svair yathoditaiḥ | śākapattrakharā suptā sphuṭitā vātadūṣitā
verses.tib: de yang rang rang mtshan nyid ni / ji skad bshad pas lngar shes bya / lce ni sha kha'i lo ltar rtsub / tshor ba med gas rlung gnod yin / mkhris pas tsha zhing nad bcas 'gyur / mdzer pa dmar pos khyab pa yin / bad kan las gyur shal ma li'i / tsher mas khyab gyur lci zhing mthug

verses.skt: jihvā pittāt sadāhoṣā raktair māṃsāṅkuraiś citā | śālmalīkaṇṭakābhais tu kaphena bahalā guruḥ
verses.tib: de yang rang rang mtshan nyid ni / ji skad bshad pas lngar shes bya / lce ni sha kha'i lo ltar rtsub / tshor ba med gas rlung gnod yin / mkhris pas tsha zhing nad bcas 'gyur / mdzer pa dmar pos khyab pa yin / bad kan las gyur shal ma li'i / tsher mas khyab gyur lci zhing mthug

verses.skt: kaphapittād adhaḥ śopho jihvāstambhakṛd unnataḥ | matsyagandhir bhavet pakvaḥ so ’laso māṃsaśātanaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pas 'og tu skrang / mtho zhing gyong bar byed pa dang / smin na nya yi dri 'dra la / sha 'drul chu ser can zhes bya

verses.skt: prabandhane ’dho jihvāyāḥ śopho jihvāgrasaṃnibhaḥ | sāṅkuraḥ kaphapittāsrair lāloṣāstambhavān kharaḥ
verses.tib: lce rtsa'i 'og dang 'brel pa ni / skrang zhing lce yi rtse mo 'dra / mdzer pa byung zhing / kha chu 'dzag / lce ni rengs shing rtsub pa dang / g.ya' dang nad bcas tshig mi thon

verses.skt: adhijihvaḥ sarukkaṇḍur vākyāhāravighātakṛt | tādṛg evopajihvas tu jihvāyā upari sthitaḥ
verses.tib: za bar mi nus lce lhag yin / de dang 'dra bar lce steng na / gnas pa'i nye ba'i lce zhes bya

verses.skt: tālumāṃse ’nilād duṣṭe piṭikāḥ sarujaḥ kharāḥ | bahvyo ghanāḥ srāvayutās tās tālupiṭikāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.tib: rlung 'khrugs pa ni rkan gyi shar / 'brum phran sra zhing nad bcas 'gyur / mang zhing mthug la 'dzag par bcas / rkan gyi 'brum phran zhes de bshad

verses.skt: tālumūle kaphāt sāsrān matsyavastinibho mṛduḥ | pralambaḥ picchilaḥ śopho nāsayāhāram īrayan
verses.tib: bad kan khrag gis rkan phugs su / nya yi lgang pa 'dra zhing 'jam / 'phyang zhing skrangs la spyi bag can / kha zas sna nas 'byung bar byed

verses.skt: kaṇṭhoparodhatṛṭkāsavamikṛt galaśuṇḍikā | tālumadhye niruṅ māṃsaṃ saṃhataṃ tālusaṃhatiḥ
verses.tib: lkog 'gags skom dang lud pa dang / slon byed lkog ma'i sha lhag yin / rkan gyi dbus su nad med sha / 'dus pa rkan 'dus zhes bya'o

verses.skt: padmākṛtis tālumadhye raktāc chvayathur arbudam | kacchapaḥ kacchapākāraś ciravṛddhiḥ kaphād aruk
verses.tib: rkan gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dra / khrag las skyes pa chu bur yin / bad kan 'khrugs pas ring nas 'phel / nad med rus sbal 'dra zhes bya

verses.skt: kolābhaḥ śleṣmamedobhyāṃ puppuṭo nīrujaḥ sthiraḥ | pittena pākaḥ pākākhyaḥ pūyāsrāvī mahārujaḥ
verses.tib: bad kan tshil gyis rgya sran 'dra / nad med brtan pa 'bur ba yin / mkhris pas rnags pa smin zhes bya / rnag 'dzag nad dkyel che ba yin

verses.skt: vātapittajvarāyāsais tāluśoṣas tadāhvayaḥ | jihvāprabandhajāḥ kaṇṭhe dāruṇā mārgarodhinaḥ
verses.tib: rlung mkhris las gyur tsha nyon mongs / rkan skam de yi ming can yin / lce dang 'brel ba lkog ma'i nad

verses.skt: māṃsāṅkurāḥ śīghracayā rohiṇī śīghrakāriṇī | kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣakṛd vātāt sā hanuśrotrarukkarī
verses.tib: sha yi myu gu myur 'phel zhing / mi bzad lam ni 'gog byed pa / myur gsod byed pa gag pa yin / de ni rlung gyur lkog ma kha / skam byed 'gram pa rna nad skyed

verses.skt: pittāj jvaroṣātṛṇmohakaṇṭhadhūmāyanānvitā | kṣiprajā kṣiprapākātirāgiṇī sparśanāsahā
verses.tib: mkhris pas rims skom rmongs bag can / lkog 'gags dud pas bdugs snyam sems / myur smin myur du 'phel ba dang / dmar zhing reg na mi bzod byed

verses.skt: kaphena picchilā pāṇḍur asṛjā sphoṭakācitā | taptāṅgāranibhā karṇarukkarī pittajākṛtiḥ
verses.tib: bad kan gyis dkar 'byar bag can / khrag gyur 'brum bus khyab pa dang / me mdag 'dra zhing rna nad skyed / mkhris pa las gyur mtshan nyid mtshungs

verses.skt: gambhīrapākā nicayāt sarvaliṅgasamanvitā | doṣaiḥ kapholbaṇaiḥ śophaḥ kolavad grathitonnataḥ
verses.tib: 'dus gyur rnag phugs gting ring zhing / mtshan ma kun dang ldan pa yin / bad kan shas cher skrangs pa dang

verses.skt: śūkakaṇṭakavat kaṇṭhe śālūko mārgarodhanaḥ | vṛndo vṛttonnato dāhajvarakṛd galapārśvagaḥ
verses.tib: rmen bu rgya shug 'dra zhing mtho / gra ma tsher mas gar snyam byed / lam 'gag byed pa rtsa ba yin / zlum zhing mtho la tsha ba dang / lkog ma'i ngos gnas 'dus pa yin

verses.skt: hanusaṃdhyāśritaḥ kaṇṭhe kārpāsīphalasaṃnibhaḥ | picchilo mandaruk śophaḥ kaṭhinas tuṇḍikerikā
verses.tib: 'gram pa'i mtshams nas mgul pa'i nad / ras bal sa bon lta bur zlum / spyi bag nad tshabs / chung bar skrang / sra ba mchu rtse can zhes bya

verses.skt: bāhyāntaḥ śvayathur ghoro galamārgārgalopamaḥ | galaugho mūrdhagurutātandrālālājvarapradaḥ
verses.tib: phyi dang nang du mi bzad skrang / lkog ma'i lam gyi gtan pa 'dra / mgo lci snum dang kha chu 'dzag / rims skyed lkog mchu 'dzings pa yin

verses.skt: valayaṃ nātiruk śophas tadvad evāyatonnataḥ | māṃsakīlo gale doṣair eko ’neko ’thavā ’lparuk
verses.tib: skrangs pa shas cher mi na zhing / chu zheng de 'dra gdu bu yin / nad kyi lkog ma sha mdzer ni / gcig gam mang skyes nad tshabs chung

verses.skt: kṛcchrocchvāsābhyavahṛtiḥ pṛthumūlo gilāyukaḥ | bhūrimāṃsāṅkuravṛtā tīvratṛḍjvaramūrdharuk
verses.tib: dbugs 'byin dka' zhing zas mid dka' / rtsa ba che ba lkog ma'i mtshon / sha yi mdzer pa mang pos khyab / rab skam tsha la mgo bo na

verses.skt: śataghnī nicitā vartiḥ śataghnīvātirukkarī | vyāptasarvagalaḥ śīghrajanmapāko mahārujaḥ
verses.tib: mdung ltar shin tu nad skyed byed / mdzer pas khyab pas mdung 'dra yin / lkog ma kun ni myur khyab cing / myur skye myur smin shas cher na

verses.skt: pūtipūyanibhasrāvī śvayathur galavidradhiḥ | jihvāvasāne kaṇṭhādāv apākaṃ śvayathuṃ malāḥ
verses.tib: rul ba'i rnag 'dra 'dzag gyur pa / skrangs pa lkog ma'i khong 'bras pa yin / lce yi mtha' ma lkog ma sogs / skrang zhing smin pa med pa'i nad

verses.skt: janayanti sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ tad galārbudam | pavanaśleṣmamedobhir galagaṇḍo bhaved bahiḥ | vardhamānaḥ sa kālena muṣkaval lambate ’tiruk
verses.tib: brtan pa khrag gis skyed byed pa / nad med lkog ma'i rmen bu yin / rlung dang bad kan tshil gyis ni / lkog ma'i phyi rol lba ba skyes / de ni 'phel bar gyur pa'i tshe / rlig pa ltar 'phyang na ba med

verses.skt: kṛṣṇo ’ruṇo vā todāḍhyaḥ sa vātāt kṛṣṇarājimān | vṛddhas tālugale śoṣaṃ kuryāc ca virasāsyatām
verses.tib: de ni rlung gyur dmar ba'am gnag / na zug rtsa ris nag por bcas / 'phel bas lkog ma kha skam zhing / lce yis ro mi tshor bar byed

verses.skt: sthiraḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītasparśo guruḥ kaphāt | vṛddhas tālugale lepaṃ kuryāc ca madhurāsyatām
verses.tib: bad kan las lci reg na grang / brtan zhing skya la g.ya' dang bcas / 'phel na rkan dang lkog mar chags / kha ni mngar ba bro bar byed

verses.skt: medasaḥ śleṣmavad dhānivṛddhyoḥ so ’nuvidhīyate | dehaṃ vṛddhaś ca kurute gale śabdaṃ svare ’lpatām
verses.tib: tshil gyur bad kan lta bur na / de ni 'phel 'bri lus 'dar byed / 'phel bar byed pa'i tshe na ni / lkog mar sgra bcas skad gsang nyams

verses.skt: śleṣmaruddhānilagatiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭho hatasvaraḥ | tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svarahānilāt
verses.tib: bad kan gyis ni rlung rgyun bkag / lkog skam skad gsang nyams pa dang / dka' bas dbugs 'byin mon zhugs snyam / rlung las skad nyams gang yin 'gyur

verses.skt: karoti vadanasyāntar vraṇān sarvasaro ’nilaḥ | saṃcāriṇo ’ruṇān rūkṣān oṣṭhau tāmrau calatvacau
verses.tib: rlung ni kun tu 'gro byed pas / kha nang rma ni 'pho bar byed / dmar la rtsub pa skyed byed cing

verses.skt: jihvā śītāsahā gurvī sphuṭitā kaṇṭakācitā | vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ
verses.tib: lce yis grang ba me bzod lci / gas shing tsher mas khyab 'drar snang / kha mnam gdangs par dka' ba ni / kha yi shu ba zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: adhaḥ pratihato vāyur arśogulmakaphādibhiḥ | yāty ūrdhvaṃ vaktradaurgandhyaṃ kurvann ūrdhvagudas tu saḥ
verses.tib: bad kan gzhang 'brum skran sogs kyis / 'og tu gnod par byas pa'i rlung / gyen 'byung kha / ni dri mi zhim / de ni steng gi rkub ces bya

verses.skt: mukhasya pittaje pāke dāhoṣe tiktavaktratā | kṣārokṣitakṣatasamā vraṇās tadvac ca raktaje
verses.tib: mkhris gyur kha shu kha rnag cing / tsha na kha ni tsha bro la / rma la lan tshwas byugs snyam sems / khrag las gyur pa'ang de dang 'dra

verses.skt: kaphaje madhurāsyatvaṃ kaṇḍūmatpicchilā vraṇāḥ | antaḥkapolam āśritya śyāvapāṇḍu kapho ’rbudam
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur kha mngar bro / g.ya' zhing rma ni 'byil bag can / mkhur tshos nang du brten nas ni / 'brum bu gnag cing skya ba 'byung

verses.skt: kuryāt tad ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate | mukhapāko bhavet sāsraiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtir malaiḥ
verses.tib: de ni mnye zhing bcad pa dang / bskyod na 'phel bar byed pa yin / nad ni khrag bcas gyur kha shu / kha shu nad ni khrag bcas 'gyur / 'dus pa mtshan nyid kun dang ldan

verses.skt: pūtyāsyatā ca tair eva dantakāṣṭhādividviṣaḥ | oṣṭhe gaṇḍe dvije mūle jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale
verses.tib: de nyid so shing la sogs la / mi dga' kha dri mi zhim 'gyur / mchu dang mkhur tshos so rtsa dang / lce dang rkan dang mgul pa dang

verses.skt: vaktre sarvatra cety uktāḥ pañcasaptatir āmayāḥ | ekādaśaiko daśa ca trayodaśa tathā ca ṣaṭ
verses.tib: kha dang thams cad dag gi ni / nad ni bdun cu rtsa dgu yin / bcu gcig gcig dang bcu dang ni / bcu gsum de bzhin drug dang brgyad

verses.skt: aṣṭāv aṣṭādaśāṣṭau ca kramāt teṣv anupakramāḥ | karālo māṃsaraktauṣṭhāv arbudāni jalād vinā
verses.tib: bcu gnyis bco brgyad dag dang ni / de dag bzhin du sbyar / so sto sha dang khrag gyur mchu / chu bur chu ni med pa dang

verses.skt: kacchapas tālupiṭikā galaughaḥ suṣiro mahān | svaraghnordhvagudaśyāvaśataghnīvalayālasāḥ
verses.tib: rkan gyi rus sbal 'brum phran dang / ming khong stong stong che chung 'dzings / skad nyams so sngon steng gi rkub / mdung 'dra gdu bu chu ser can / 'dus gyur mid pa mchu nad dang / khrag dang 'dus gyur gag pa dang / so gogs so ni chag pa dang / smin pa'i nye ba'i lce dang ni

verses.skt: nāḍyoṣṭhakopau nicayād raktāt sarvaiś ca rohiṇī | daśane sphuṭite dantabhedaḥ pakvopajihvikā
verses.tib: rkan gyi rus sbal 'brum phran dang / ming khong stong stong che chung 'dzings / skad nyams so sngon steng gi rkub / mdung 'dra gdu bu chu ser can / 'dus gyur mid pa mchu nad dang / khrag dang 'dus gyur gag pa dang / so gogs so ni chag pa dang / smin pa'i nye ba'i lce dang ni

verses.skt: galagaṇḍaḥ svarabhraṃśī kṛcchrocchvāso ’tivatsaraḥ | yāpyas tu harṣo bhedaś ca śeṣāñ chastrauṣadhair jayet
verses.tib: lkog ma'i lba ba skad nyams dang / dbugs mi thon pa lo gcig lon / so brtse gsang ba 'tsho ba tsam / lhag ma mtshon dang sman gyis gso

verses.skt: khaṇḍauṣṭhasya vilikhyāntau syūtvā vraṇavad ācaret | yaṣṭījyotiṣmatīlodhraśrāvaṇīśārivotpalaiḥ
verses.tib: mchu ral ba yi mtha' brud de / btsems la rma ltar gso bar bya / shing mngar seng phrom kra ku ni / thal tres ut+pal shra pa ni / mon sne'u dme ru pa to la

verses.skt: paṭolyā kākamācyā ca tailam abhyañjanaṃ pacet | nasyaṃ ca tailaṃ vātaghnamadhuraskandhasādhitam
verses.tib: til mar bskol bas bsku bar bya / rlung 'joms mngar ba'i sde tshan dang / bskol ba'i til mar sna sman gtang / rlung gyur mchu nad sra rtsi phog

verses.skt: mahāsnehena vātauṣṭhe siddhenāktaḥ picur hitaḥ | devadhūpamadhūcchiṣṭaguggulvamaradārubhiḥ
verses.tib: spra tshil gu gul thang shing na / snum chen bskol ba'i ras bal dag / sbangs pa'i ye'us glan par bya / shing

verses.skt: yaṣṭyāhvacūrṇayuktena tenaiva pratisāraṇam | nāḍyoṣṭhaṃ svedayed dugdhasiddhair eraṇḍapallavaiḥ
verses.tib: mngar phye mar bcas pa dang / de nyid kyis ni bsku bar bya / e raN+Da yi lo ma ni / 'o mar bskol bas sbubs dugs bya

verses.skt: khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ nasyaṃ tasya mūrdhni ca tarpaṇam | pittābhighātajāv oṣṭhau jalaukobhir upācaret
verses.tib: mchu ral skabs bshad sna sman dang / mgo bo brta ba dag kyang bya / mkhris pas snad pa'i mchu nad la / srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung bya

verses.skt: lodhrasarjarasakṣaudramadhukaiḥ pratisāraṇam | guḍūcīyaṣṭipattaṅgasiddham abhyañjane ghṛtam
verses.tib: seng phrom sbrang rtsi sra rtsi pog / shing mngar bcas pa'i phye ma gdab / sle tres shing mngar rma shing dang / bskol ba'i mar gyis bskus na'ang phan

verses.skt: pittavidradhivac cātra kriyā śoṇitaje ’pi ca | idam eva nave kāryaṃ karmauṣṭhe tu kaphāture
verses.tib: mkhris pa'i khong 'bras ltar yang gso / khrag las gyur pa sar pa la / de dag nyid kyis gso bar bya / bad kan las gyur mchu nad la

verses.skt: pāṭhākṣāramadhuvyoṣair hṛtāsre pratisāraṇam | dhūmanāvanagaṇḍūṣāḥ prayojyāś ca kaphacchidaḥ
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi dang ni sbyar bas bsku / gtar ga byas nas phye ma gdab / bad kan 'joms par byed pa yin / dud brngub sna sman mkhur bkang bya

verses.skt: svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vimedaskaṃ dahen medojam agninā | priyaṅgulodhratriphalāmākṣikaiḥ pratisārayet
verses.tib: tshil gyur dugs byas dbral nas ni / me yis nges par bsreg par bya / pri yang ku dang 'bras bu gsum / seng phrom sbrang rtsir sbyar bas sku

verses.skt: sakṣaudrā gharṣaṇaṃ tīkṣṇā bhinnaśuddhe jalārbude | avagāḍhe ’tivṛddhe vā kṣāro ’gnir vā pratikriyā
verses.tib: chu yi chu bur brtol nas sbyang / sman rnon sbrang rtsis bsku bar bya / gting ring ba'am rab 'phel la / thang sman dag gam me btsas gso

verses.skt: āmādyavasthāsv alajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavad ācaret | svinnasya śītadantasya pālīṃ vilikhitāṃ dahet
verses.tib: mkhur ba'i chu ser smin skabs su / skrangs pa'i nad ltar gso bar bya / so grang ba la dugs byas la

verses.skt: tailena pratisāryā ca sakṣaudraghanasaindhavaiḥ | dāḍimatvagvarātārkṣyakāntājambvasthināgaraiḥ
verses.tib: so rtsa brud de til mar bsregs / gla sgang rgyam tsha sbrang rtsi dang / se'u 'bru'i shun pa 'bras bu gsum / skyer pa'i khaN+Da 'dam bu'i rkang / bca' sga sbyar bas bsku bar bya

verses.skt: kavaḍaḥ kṣīriṇāṃ kvāthair aṇutailaṃ ca nāvanam | dantaharṣe tathā bhede sarvā vātaharā kriyā
verses.tib: 'o ma can bskol mkhur ba bkang / e raN+Da'i mar sna sman gtang / so brtse de bzhin bye ba la / rlung 'joms gso ba thams cad bya

verses.skt: tilayaṣṭīmadhuśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam | sasnehaṃ daśamūlāmbu gaṇḍūṣaḥ pracaladdvije
verses.tib: til dang shing mngar sbrang rtsi ni / 'o mar bskol ba'i mkhur bkang bcang / so 'gul ba la rtsa ba bcu'i / khu ba mar bskol mkhur ba bkang

verses.skt: tutthalodhrakaṇāśreṣṭhāpattaṅgapaṭugharṣaṇam | snigdhāḥ śīlyā yathāvasthaṃ nasyānnakavaḍādayaḥ
verses.tib: sbangs ma seng phrom pi pi ling / 'bras bu gsum dang rma shing dang / rgyam tsha yis ni bdar bar bya / snum bag gis ni sna sman dang / mkhur bkang gnas skabs ji bzhin bsten

verses.skt: adhidantakam āliptaṃ yadā kṣāreṇa jarjaram | kṛmidantam ivotpāṭya tadvac copacaret tadā
verses.tib: so lhag skyes la thal sman gyis / bskus te gogs par gyur pa dang / srin can so ltar phyung nas / ni / de tshe de dang 'dra bar gso

verses.skt: anavasthitarakte ca dagdhe vraṇa iva kriyā | ahiṃsan dantamūlāni dantebhyaḥ śarkarāṃ haret
verses.tib: khrag ni chod par ma gyur na / bsregs la rma ltar gso bar bya / so dreg chags la so rtsal / gnod pa med par bsal bar bya

verses.skt: kṣāracūrṇair madhuyutais tataś ca pratisārayet | kapālikāyām apy evaṃ harṣoktaṃ ca samācaret
verses.tib: thal sman sbrang rtsir bcas pas ni / de yi 'og tu bsku bar bya / so gogs pa la'ang 'di nyid dang / so brtser bshad pa'i gso ba bya

verses.skt: jayed visrāvaṇaiḥ svinnam acalaṃ kṛmidantakam | snigdhaiś cālepagaṇḍūṣanasyāhāraiś calāpahaiḥ
verses.tib: srin can so ni mi 'gul la / dugs byas nas ni khrag dbyung bya / snum gyis bsku zhing mkhur bkang dang / sna sman kha zas rlung 'joms sbyin

verses.skt: guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madhūcchiṣṭena vā dahet | saptacchadārkakṣīrābhyāṃ pūraṇaṃ kṛmiśūlajit
verses.tib: khong stong bu ram spra tshil gyis / gang ba'i thur mas bsreg par bya / lo ma bdun pa arka yi / lo mas bkang na srin gzer 'joms

verses.skt: hiṅgukaṭphalakāsīsasvarjikākuṣṭhavellajam | rajo rujaṃ jayaty āśu vastrasthaṃ daśane ghṛtam
verses.tib: shing kun nag chur kad pa la / sardzi ka dang byi dang ga / ru rta'i phye ma ras la gtums / sor glan zug gzer myur du 'joms

verses.skt: alaktakaṃ vā sindhūtthaṃ velladhūmaṃ sahiṅgu vā | dhānyāmlasiddhaṃ śevālaṃ koṣṇaṃ vā daśanasthitam
verses.tib: yang na 'di nyid bskol ba yi / til mar mkhur bar dgang bar bya / yang na bri ha ti rnam gnyis / bu ga dam pa e raN+Da

verses.skt: varāhakarṇīmūlaṃ vā śarapuṅkhājaṭāthavā | vartir vāvalgujaphalair bījapūrajaṭānvitaiḥ
gaṇḍūṣaṃ grāhayet tailam ebhir eva ca sādhitam | kvāthair vā yuktam eraṇḍadvivyāghrībhūkadambajaiḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba'i khu bas mkhur ba bkang / de ltar gso ba mang po yis / nad ni zhi bar ma gyur na / skam pa phra mo dag gis sam / so dbyung ba yi cha spyad kyis / dang po rtsa ba nas bslangs te

verses.skt: kriyāyogair bahuvidhair ity aśāntarujaṃ bhṛśam | dṛḍham apy uddhared dantaṃ pūrvaṃ mūlād vimokṣitam
verses.tib: bskol ba'i khu bas mkhur ba bkang / de ltar gso ba mang po yis / nad ni zhi bar ma gyur na / skam pa phra mo dag gis sam / so dbyung ba yi cha spyad kyis / dang po rtsa ba nas bslangs te

verses.skt: saṃdaṃśakena laghunā dantanirghātanena vā | tailaṃ sayaṣṭyāhvarajo gaṇḍūṣo madhu vā tataḥ
verses.tib: gtan nas de ni dbyung bar bya / til mar shing mngar phyer bcas pa'am / sbrang rtsis de 'og mkhur bkang bya

verses.skt: tato vidāriyaṣṭyāhvaśṛṅgāṭakakaserubhiḥ | tailaṃ daśaguṇakṣīraṃ siddhaṃ yuñjīta nāvanam
verses.tib: de 'og shing mngar bid ri / srid ka dang ka she ru / til mar bcu 'gyur 'o ma dang / bskol ba'i sna sman gtang bar bya

verses.skt: kṛśadurbalavṛddhānāṃ vātārtānāṃ ca noddharet | noddharec cottaraṃ dantaṃ bahūpadravakṛd dhi saḥ
verses.tib: rid cing nyam chung rgan po dang / rlung nad kyis nyen so mi dbyung / ya so dbyung bar mi bya ste / de ni bla brnan mang po skyed

verses.skt: eṣām apy uddhṛtau snigdhasvāduśītakramo hitaḥ | visrāvitāsre śītāde sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam
verses.tib: de yang 'byin na snum pa dang / mngar dang bsil ba'i rim pas gso / grang bas nyen la khrag dbyung zhing / sbrang rtsir bcas pas bsku bar bya

verses.skt: mustārjunatvaktriphalāphalinītārkṣyanāgaraiḥ | tatkvāthaḥ kavaḍo nasyaṃ tailaṃ madhurasādhitam
verses.tib: gla sgang ardzu na'i shun pa / pri yang ku dang skyer khaN+Da / bca' sga sgrang rtsir sbyar ba bsku / de bskol bas ni mkhur bkang dang / mngar sman til mar bskol snar blugs

verses.skt: dantamāṃsāny upakuśe svinnāny uṣṇāmbudhāraṇaiḥ | maṇḍalāgreṇa śākādipattrair vā bahuśo likhet
verses.tib: rnyil ni nye bar bdar ba la / chu tshan mkhur bkang bas dugs bya / dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'am sha kha yi / lo mas mang du brud par bya

verses.skt: tataś ca pratisāryāṇi ghṛtamaṇḍamadhudrutaiḥ | lākṣāpriyaṅgupattaṅgalavaṇottamagairikaiḥ
verses.tib: rgya skyegs rma shing pri yang ku / rgyam tsha ru rta btsag / yug snam / na le sham dang bca' sga dang / shing mngar skyer pa'i khaN+Da dang / mar gyi snying po sbrang rtsi dang / sbyar ba de 'og bsku bar bya

verses.skt: sakuṣṭhaśuṇṭhīmaricayaṣṭīmadhurasāñjanaiḥ | sukhoṣṇo ghṛtamaṇḍo ’nu tailaṃ vā kavaḍagrahaḥ
verses.tib: mar khu'am til mar mkhur spo ba / dro 'jam de yi rjes la bya / mngar ba'i sde dang bskol ba'i mar

verses.skt: ghṛtaṃ ca madhuraiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavaḍanasyayoḥ | dantapuppuṭake svinnacchinnabhinnavilekhite
verses.tib: mkhur bkang sna sman byas na phan / so 'bur ba la dugs byas la / bcad dang dbug dang brud par bya / shing mngar bca' sgas rdzi ka / rgyam tsha'i phye ma bsku bar bya / so yi khong 'bras tsha dro rno / rtsub pa'i mkhur bkang bsku bar bya

verses.skt: yaṣṭyāhvasvarjikāśuṇṭhīsaindhavaiḥ pratisāraṇam | vidradhau kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣaiḥ kavaḍalepanam
verses.tib: mkhur bkang sna sman byas na phan / so 'bur ba la dugs byas la / bcad dang dbug dang brud par bya / shing mngar bca' sgas rdzi ka / rgyam tsha'i phye ma bsku bar bya / so yi khong 'bras tsha dro rno / rtsub pa'i mkhur bkang bsku bar bya

verses.skt: gharṣaṇaṃ kaṭukākuṣṭhavṛścikālīyavodbhavaiḥ | rakṣet pākaṃ himaiḥ pakvaḥ pāṭyo dāhyo ’vagāḍhakaḥ
verses.tib: pu tse shel dang ba spru ba / ru rta nas tshig 'khus phyir bdar / bsil sman gyis ni smin mi gzhug / smin nas dral la gting ring bsreg

verses.skt: suṣire chinnalikhite sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam | lodhramustamiśiśreṣṭhātārkṣyapattaṅgakiṃśukaiḥ
verses.tib: khong stong bcad de brud nas ni / gla sgang seng phrom 'bras bu gsum / shu ti rma shing skyer khaN+Da / rgya skyegs shing mngar kad phal / sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bsku bar bya

verses.skt: sakaṭphalaiḥ kaṣāyaiś ca teṣāṃ gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate | yaṣṭīlodhrotpalānantāśārivāgurucandanaiḥ
verses.tib: de nyid khu bas mkhur ba bkang / shing mngar seng phro ma dUr ba dkar / thal tres tsan+dan na a ga ru

verses.skt: sagairikasitāpuṇḍraiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca nāvanam | chittvādhimāṃsakaṃ cūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet
verses.tib: ka ra dkar po btsag yug snam / pad+ma dkar po stag tsher ba / bskol ba'i til mar sna sman gtang / sha lhag skyes pa bcad nas ni

verses.skt: vacātejovatīpāṭhāsvarjikāyavaśūkajaiḥ | paṭolanimbatriphalākaṣāyaḥ kavaḍo hitaḥ
verses.tib: shu dag te dzo ba ti dang / pa ta nas tshig 'khus thal ba / sardzi ka dang sbrang rtsis bsku / 'bras bu gsum dang pa to la / nim pa bskol bas mkhur ba bkang

verses.skt: vidarbhe dantamūlāni maṇḍalāgreṇa śodhayet | kṣāraṃ yuñjyāt tato nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam
verses.tib: snad pa las byung nad la ni / dkyil 'khor rtse mo 'dra bas sbyangs / de nas thal sman sna sman gtang / mkhur bkang la sogs bsil sman gtang

verses.skt: saṃśodhyobhayataḥ kāyaṃ śiraś copacaret tataḥ | nāḍīṃ dantānugāṃ dantaṃ samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet
verses.tib: lus kyi gong 'og nas sbyang bya / de 'og mgo bo'i bkru sman bya / so yi rtsa ni sos nas kyang / phyung ste nad dang ldan pa yi / bu ram spra tshil bkang bas bsreg / dzA ti seng ldeng spra tshil dang / gze ma bskol ba'i khu bas bkru

verses.skt: kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā | dhāvanaṃ jātimadanakhadirasvādukaṇṭakaiḥ
verses.tib: lus kyi gong 'og nas sbyang bya / de 'og mgo bo'i bkru sman bya / so yi rtsa ni sos nas kyang / phyung ste nad dang ldan pa yi / bu ram spra tshil bkang bas bsreg / dzA ti seng ldeng spra tshil dang / gze ma bskol ba'i khu bas bkru

verses.skt: kṣīrivṛkṣāmbugaṇḍūṣo nasyaṃ tailaṃ ca tatkṛtam | kuryād vātauṣṭhakopoktaṃ kaṇṭakeṣv anilātmasu
verses.tib: 'o ma can shing chus mkhur bkang / de bskol til mar sna sman gtang / rlung gyur lce ni rtsub pa la / rlung gi mchu nad gso bar bya

verses.skt: jihvāyāṃ pittajāteṣu ghṛṣṭeṣu rudhire srute | pratisāraṇagaṇḍūṣanāvanaṃ madhurair hitam
verses.tib: mkhris pa las gyur lce nad la / bzhar te khrag ni dbyung bar bya / bsku dang mkhur ba bkang ba dang / sna sman mngar ba dag kyang bya

verses.skt: tīkṣṇaiḥ kaphottheṣv evaṃ ca sarṣapatryūṣaṇādibhiḥ | nave jihvālase ’py evaṃ taṃ tu śastreṇa na spṛśet
verses.tib: de bzhin bad kan las gyur la / nyungs kar tsha ba gsum la / sogs / sman ni rnon pos gso bar bya / lce las chu ser 'dzag pa gsar / mtshon mi reg par de bzhin gso

verses.skt: unnamya jihvām ākṛṣṭāṃ baḍiśenādhijihvikām | chedayen maṇḍalāgreṇa tīkṣṇoṣṇair gharṣaṇādi ca
verses.tib: lce lhag skyes pa lce bteg ste / lcags kyus lce lhag drangs nas ni / rtse mo dkyil 'khor 'dra bas bcad / rno dang dro bas bdar sogs bya

verses.skt: upajihvāṃ parisrāvya yavakṣāreṇa gharṣayet | kaphaghnaiḥ śuṇḍikā sādhyā nasyagaṇḍūṣagharṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: nye ba'i lce la khrag gzags te / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal bas bdar / sha lhag skyes la bad kan 'joms / sna sman mkhur bkang bdar bar bya

verses.skt: ervārubījapratimaṃ vṛddhāyām asirātatam | agraṃ niviṣṭaṃ jihvāyā baḍīśādyavalambitam
verses.tib: ga gon sa bon lta bur ni / 'phel zhing rtsa ni mi mngon dang / rtse mos lce yi rtsa ba slebs

verses.skt: chedayen maṇḍalāgreṇa nātyagre na ca mūlataḥ | chede ’ty asṛkkṣayān mṛtyur hīne vyādhir vivardhate
verses.tib: rtse mo dkyil 'khor 'dra ba yis / rtse mo rtsa ba ran par gcad / bcad drags khrag zags 'chi bar byed / bcad chung nad ni 'phel bar byed

verses.skt: maricātiviṣāpāṭhāvacākuṣṭhakuṭannaṭaiḥ | chinnāyāṃ sapaṭukṣaudrair gharṣaṇaṃ kavaḍaḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: bong nga ba ta na le sham / shu dag ru rta pa ri la / rgyam tsha sbrang rtsir bcas pa yis / bcad pa dag ni bdar bar bya

verses.skt: kaṭukātiviṣāpāṭhānimbarāsnāvacāmbubhiḥ | saṃghāte puppuṭe kūrme vilikhyaivaṃ samācaret
verses.tib: pa ri be la kun ta ta'o / pu tse shel dang bong da dkar / ba ta nim pa ra sna dang / shu dag chu yis mkhur bkang bya / 'dus dang so 'bur rus sbal 'dra / de bzhin bzhar te gso bar bya

verses.skt: apakve tālupāke tu kāsīsakṣaudratārkṣyajaiḥ | gharṣaṇaṃ kavaḍaḥ śītakaṣāyamadhurauṣadhaiḥ
verses.tib: rkan rnags ma smin pa la ni / nag tshur sbrang rtsi skyer khaN+Da / bsku bar bya'o bsil dang mngar / sman bskol khu bas mkhur bkang bya

verses.skt: pakve ’ṣṭāpadavad bhinne tīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pratisāraṇam | vṛṣanimbapaṭolādyais tiktaiḥ kavaḍadhāraṇam
verses.tib: smin nas na ya'i gzhi ltar dras / dro dang rno bas bsku bar bya / ba sha ka dang pa to la / nim pa la sogs rno ba yi

verses.skt: tāluśoṣe tv atṛṣṇasya sarpir uttarabhaktikam | kaṇāśuṇṭhīśṛtaṃ pānam amlair gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam
verses.tib: rkan skam skom dad gdung med pa / zas zos rjes la zhun mar ni / bca' sga bi pi ling bskol blud / skyur bas mkhur ba spo ba bcang

verses.skt: dhanvamāṃsarasāḥ snigdhāḥ kṣīrasarpiś ca nāvanam | kaṇṭharogeṣv asṛṅmokṣas tīkṣṇair nasyādi karma ca
verses.tib: skam sa'i sha khu snum pa dang / zhun mar 'o ma'i sna sman gtang / lkog ma'i nad la gtar ga gdab / sna sman la sogs rnon po bya

verses.skt: kvāthaḥ pānaṃ ca dārvītvaṅnimbatārkṣyakaliṅgajaḥ | harītakīkaṣāyo vā peyo mākṣikasaṃyutaḥ
verses.tib: skyer pa'i shun pa skyer khaN+Da / dug mo nyung bskol khu ba blud / a ru ra yi khu ba ni / sbrang rtsir ldan pa sbyin par bya

verses.skt: śreṣṭhāvyoṣayavakṣāradārvīdvīpirasāñjanaiḥ | sapāṭhātejinīnimbaiḥ śuktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ
verses.tib: nas tshig 'khus thal skyer pa dang / tsi tra ka dang skyer khaN+Da / pa ta te dzo ba ti dang / nim pa tsha dang ra gcin bskol

verses.skt: kavaḍo guṭikā vātra kalpitā pratisāraṇam | niculaṃ kaṭabhī mustaṃ devadāru mahauṣadham
verses.tib: mkhur ba spo dang ri lu dang / phye ma gdab pa dag kyang / bya / lcang ma gi ri kar+Ni dang / gla sgang thang shing bca' sga dang

verses.skt: vacā dantī ca mūrvā ca lepaḥ koṣṇo ’rtiśophahā | athāntarbāhyataḥ svinnāṃ vātarohiṇikāṃ likhet
verses.tib: shu dag dan da mur ba yi / lde gu dro bskus skrangs nad sel / de nas phyi nang dugs byas te / sor gdub cha spyad dag gis sam / rgyam tsha ldan pa'i sen mo yis / rlung gyur gag pa bzhar bar bya / rtsa ba lnga bskol mkhur bkang dang / til mar mkhur sbo sna sman gtang

verses.skt: aṅgulīśastrakeṇāśu paṭuyuktanakhena vā | pañcamūlāmbu kavaḍas tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣanāvanam
verses.tib: shu dag dan da mur ba yi / lde gu dro bskus skrangs nad sel / de nas phyi nang dugs byas te / sor gdub cha spyad dag gis sam / rgyam tsha ldan pa'i sen mo yis / rlung gyur gag pa bzhar bar bya / rtsa ba lnga bskol mkhur bkang dang / til mar mkhur sbo sna sman gtang

verses.skt: visrāvya pittasaṃbhūtāṃ sitākṣaudrapriyaṅgubhiḥ | gharṣet salodhrapattaṅgaiḥ kavaḍaḥ kvathitaiś ca taiḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa las gyur gtar ga gdab / kha ra sbrang rtsi pri yang ku / seng phrom rma shing bcas pa bdar / de bskol khu ba mkhur bar bcang

verses.skt: drākṣāparūṣakakvātho hitaś ca kavaḍagrahe | upācared evam eva pratyākhyāyāsrasaṃbhavām
verses.tib: rgun 'brum pa ru sha ka bskol / mkhur ba bkang ba'ang phan pa yin / khrag las gyur pa'ang de bzhin du / gtar ga gdab ste gso bar bya

verses.skt: sāgāradhūmaiḥ kaṭukaiḥ kaphajāṃ pratisārayet | nasyagaṇḍūṣayos tailaṃ sādhitaṃ ca praśasyate
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur khang pa yi / dud pa tsha ba'i sman bcas gdab / a pa marga'i 'bras bu dang / gi ri kar+Ni byi dang ga / rgyam tsha tsan+dan til mar bskol / sna sman mkhur bkang bya ba bsngags / de bzhin 'dus dang rtsa ba dang / mchu rtse lkog ma'i mtshon la'ang bya

verses.skt: apāmārgaphalaśvetādantījantughnasaindhavaiḥ | tadvac ca vṛndaśālūkatuṇḍikerīgilāyuṣu
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur khang pa yi / dud pa tsha ba'i sman bcas gdab / a pa marga'i 'bras bu dang / gi ri kar+Ni byi dang ga / rgyam tsha tsan+dan til mar bskol / sna sman mkhur bkang bya ba bsngags / de bzhin 'dus dang rtsa ba dang / mchu rtse lkog ma'i mtshon la'ang bya

verses.skt: vidradhau srāvite śreṣṭhārocanātārkṣyagairikaiḥ | salodhrapaṭupattaṅgakaṇair gaṇḍūṣagharṣaṇe
verses.tib: khong 'bras khrag gzags 'bras bu gsum / gi wang yug snam skyer khaN+Da / seng phrom rgyam tsha rma shing dang / pi pi ling bsku mkhur bkang bya

verses.skt: galagaṇḍaḥ pavanajaḥ svinno niḥsrutaśoṇitaḥ | tilair bījaiś ca laṭvomāpriyālaśaṇasaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung las gyur pa'i wa ba la / dugs byas nas ni khrag dbyung zhing / til dang zar ma leb rgan rtsi / pi la ya dang btsod 'bras kyis

verses.skt: upanāhyo vraṇe rūḍhe pralepyaś ca punaḥ punaḥ | śigrutilvakatarkārīgajakṛṣṇāpunarnavaiḥ
verses.tib: rma 'drub nas bskus dkri bar bya / shi kru seng phrom tar ka ri / tang pa la ha ti pi pi ling

verses.skt: kālāmṛtārkamūlaiś ca puṣpaiś ca karahāṭajaiḥ | ekaiṣīkānvitaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ surayā kāñjikena vā
verses.tib: ba spu pa dang a ru ra / arka'i rtsa ba po son cha / e kai Shi kar bcas pa ni / chang ngam rang sgyur btags pas bsku

verses.skt: guḍūcīnimbakuṭajahaṃsapadībalādvayaiḥ | sādhitaṃ pāyayet tailaṃ sakṛṣṇādevadārubhiḥ
verses.tib: sle tres nim pa dug mo nyung / han sa ba ti ba la gnyis / thang shing dang ni pi pi ling / bskol ba'i til mar blud par bya

verses.skt: kartavyaṃ kaphaje ’py etat svedavimlāpane tv ati | lepo ’jagandhātiviṣāviśalyāḥ saviṣāṇikāḥ
verses.tib: bad kan la yang 'di dag ni / bya zhing lhag par dugs bsku bya / a za gan+d+ha bong nga dkar / a za shing gi bi sha l+ya

verses.skt: guñjālābuśukāhvāś ca palāśakṣārakalkitāḥ | mūtrasrutaṃ haṭhakṣāraṃ paktvā kodravabhuk pibet
verses.tib: ku ba kha bo 'ol ma se / shi ri sha dang rgya skyegs shing / thal chu'i lde gus bsku bar bya / thal ba drag po gcin bskol btsags / khre rgod za zhing btung bar bya

verses.skt: sādhitaṃ vatsakādyair vā tailaṃ sapaṭupañcakaiḥ | kaphaghnān dhūmavamananāvanādīṃś ca śīlayet
verses.tib: dug mo nyung sogs lan tshwa lnga / til mar lhan cig bskol ba blud / bad kan 'joms / pa'i dud pa dang / slon sman sna sman la sogs bsten

verses.skt: medobhave sirāṃ vidhyet kaphaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ bhajet | asanādirajaś cainaṃ prātar mūtreṇa pāyayet
verses.tib: tshil gyur ba la gtar ga gdab / bad kan 'joms pa'i cho ga bsten / 'di la a sa la sogs pa'i / khu ba gcin ni snga dro blud

verses.skt: aśāntau pācayitvā ca sarvān vraṇavad ācaret | mukhapākeṣu sakṣaudrā prayojyā mukhadhāvanāḥ
verses.tib: des ma zhin thams cad ni / smin byas rma ltar gso bar bya / kha shu la ni 'bras bu gsum / ba ta rgun 'brum dzA ti yi / 'o mar bskol ba'i sbrang rtsir bcas / kha ni bsku zhing bcang bar bya / yang na zin thig la sogs spe / bza' zhing bsten pa nyid du bya

verses.skt: kvathitās triphalāpāṭhāmṛdvīkājātipallavāḥ | niṣṭhevyā bhakṣayitvā vā kuṭherādir gaṇo ’thavā
verses.tib: des ma zhin thams cad ni / smin byas rma ltar gso bar bya / kha shu la ni 'bras bu gsum / ba ta rgun 'brum dzA ti yi / 'o mar bskol ba'i sbrang rtsir bcas / kha ni bsku zhing bcang bar bya / yang na zin thig la sogs spe / bza' zhing bsten pa nyid du bya

verses.skt: mukhapāke ’nilāt kṛṣṇāpaṭvelāḥ pratisāraṇam | tailaṃ vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavaḍanasyayoḥ
verses.tib: rlung gi kha shur pi pi ling / rgyam tsha sug smel phye ma gdab / yang na rlung 'joms sman bskol ba'i / til mar sna sman mkhur bkang phan

verses.skt: pittāsre pittaraktaghnaḥ kaphaghnaś ca kaphe vidhiḥ | likhec chākādipattraiś ca piṭikāḥ kaṭhināḥ sthirāḥ
verses.tib: khrag mkhris gyur la khrag mkhris 'joms / bad kan las gyur de 'joms bsten / 'brum phran sra zhing brtan pa la / sha kha'i lo ma sogs kyis bzhar

verses.skt: yathādoṣodayaṃ kuryāt saṃnipāte cikitsitam | nave ’rbude tv asaṃvṛddhe chedite pratisāraṇam
verses.tib: 'dus pa las gyur gso ba ni / nad gzhi ji bzhin shas cher bya / chu bur gsar zhing ma 'phel ba / bcad las rdzi ka'i thal ba

verses.skt: svarjikānāgarakṣaudraiḥ kvātho gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate | guḍūcīnimbakalkottho madhutailasamanvitaḥ
verses.tib: bca' sga sbrang rtsi gdab par bya / de bskol mkhur ba bkang bar bya / sle tres nim pa'i lde gu ni / sbrang rtsi til mar bcas pa'ang rung

verses.skt: yavānnabhuk tīkṣṇatailanasyābhyaṅgāṃs tathācaret | vamite pūtivadane dhūmas tīkṣṇaḥ sanāvanaḥ
verses.tib: nas zan za zhing til mar rnos / sna sman dang ni bsku byug bya / kha dri nga la slon sman dang / dud pa sna sman rnon po gtang

verses.skt: samaṅgādhātakīlodhraphalinīpadmakair jalam | dhāvanaṃ vadanasyāntaś cūrṇitair avacūrṇitam
verses.tib: btsod dang seng phrom da ta ki / shug pa bri yang ku yi chus / kha yi nang ni bkru ba dang / phye mas kha ni dag par bya

verses.skt: śītādopakuśoktaṃ ca nāvanādi ca śīlayet | phalatrayadvīpikirātatiktayaṣṭyāhvasiddhārthakaṭutrikāṇi | mustāharidrādvayayāvaśūkavṛkṣāmlakāmlāgrimavetasāś ca
verses.tib: grang nyen nye bar bdar bshad pa'i / 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa mkhris tsi tra ka / shing mngar nyungs kar gla sgang tshab gsum / ya bak+Sha ra ser po rnam gnyis dang / da trig tsan+dan lcang ma star bu dang

verses.skt: aśvatthajambvāmradhanañjayatvak tvak cāhimārāt khadirasya sāraḥ | kvāthena teṣāṃ ghanatāṃ gatena taccūrṇayuktā guṭikā vidheyāḥ
verses.tib: a shwat+tha dang 'dzam bu'i myu gu dang / da nan dza ya ka ra bI ra'i shun / seng ldeng snying po bskol te ska bar gyur / de yi phye ma btab ste ri lu bya

verses.skt: tā dhāritā ghnanti mukhena nityaṃ kaṇṭhauṣṭhatālvādigadān sukṛcchrān | viśeṣato rohiṇikāsyaśoṣagandhān videhādhipatipraṇītāḥ
verses.tib: de ni kha nang rtag tu bzhag gyur na / mchu dang rkan sogs nad ni mi bzad 'joms / mchog tu kha skams pa dang gag pa dang / ro mi tshor sel lus 'phags bdag pos bshad

verses.skt: khadiratulām ambughaṭe paktvā toyena tena piṣṭaiś ca | candanajoṅgakakuṅkumaparipelavavālakośīraiḥ
verses.tib: seng ldeng srang brgya chu bre bcu drug bskol / khu ba de dang tsan+dan a ga ru / gur gum pa la ba ri pe la dang

verses.skt: suratarulodhradrākṣāmañjiṣṭhācocapadmakaviḍaṅgaiḥ | spṛkkānatanakhakaṭphalasūkṣmailādhyāmakaiḥ sapattaṅgaiḥ
verses.tib: thang shing seng phrom rgun 'brum pu shel tsi / btsod dang tso tsa shug pa byi dang ga / pri ka rgya spos kad pa la chu srin sder / sug smel d+he ma ka dang rma shing bcas

verses.skt: tailaprasthaṃ vipacet karṣāṃśaiḥ pānanasyagaṇḍūṣais tat | hatvāsye sarvagadān janayati gārdhrīṃ dṛśaṃ śrutiṃ ca vārāhīm
verses.tib: zho ni gnyis gnyis til mar bre gang bskol / de ni btung dang sna sman mkhur bkang bya / kha yi nad kun 'joms byed bya rgod ltar / mig gsal rna ba phag 'drar gsang bar byed

verses.skt: udvartitaṃ ca prapunāṭalodhradārvībhir abhyaktam anena vaktram | nirvyaṅganīlīmukhadūṣikādi saṃjāyate candrasamānakānti
verses.tib: tsa kra mar da skyer pa seng phrom gyi / lde gu gdong la byugs par gyur na ni / do khabs sme ba dri ma la sogs sel / zla ba lta bu'i mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur

verses.skt: palaśataṃ bāṇāt toyaghaṭe paktvā rase ’smiṃś ca palārdhikaiḥ | khadirajambūyaṣṭyānantāmrair ahimāranīlotpalānvitaiḥ
verses.tib: sa ha ra dza srang stong chu bre ni / bcu drug nang bskol brgyad cha lus pa ru / seng ldeng 'dzam bu shing mngar e raN+Da / a mra a ti ma ra ut+pal sngo

verses.skt: tailaprasthaṃ pācayec chlakṣṇapiṣṭair ebhir dravyair dhāritaṃ tan mukhena | rogān sarvān hanti vaktre viśeṣāt sthairyaṃ dhatte dantapaṅkteś calāyāḥ || 89 || khadirasārād dve tule paced valkāt tulāṃ cārimedasaḥ | ghaṭacatuṣke pādaśeṣe ’smin pūte punaḥ kvathanād ghane
verses.tib: zhib btags til mar bre gang nang du bskol / de ni kha yi nang du bcangs gyur na / kha yi nad kun 'joms shing khyad par du / so yi phreng ba 'gul ba brtan par byed / seng ldeng snying po srang ni nyis brgya dang / a ri me da sa ni srang brgya dag / chu bre drug cu bzhi bskol bzhi cha lus / btsags te slar yang ska ba'i bar du bskol

verses.skt: ākṣikaṃ kṣipet susūkṣmaṃ rajaḥ sevyāmbupattaṅgagairikam | candanadvayalodhrapuṇḍrāhvayaṣṭyāhvalākṣāñjanadvayam
verses.tib: de nang dbyi mo rma shing ba le ka / tsan+dan rnam gnyis seng phrom stag tsher ba / shing mngar rgya skyegs a dza ri rnam gnyis

verses.skt: dhātakīkaṭphaladviniśātriphalācaturjātajoṅgakam | mustamañjiṣṭhānyagrodhaprarohamāṃsīyavāsakam
verses.tib: da ta ki dang kat+pa la'i 'bras bu / ser po rnam gnyis 'bras bu gsum dang ni / dri sna bzhi dang gla sgang a ru ra / btsod dang spang spos n+ya gro d+ha'i myu gu / shug pa btsod dang e la ba lu ka / zho ni gnyis gnyis btab ste bsgrangs pa ru / dzA ti pa tra dzA ti phal dang / li shi a ko la dang ka ko la

verses.skt: padmakailāsamaṅgāś ca śīte tasmiṃs tathā pālikāṃ pṛthak | jātīpattrikāṃ sajātiphalāṃ sahalavaṅgakaṇkollakām
verses.tib: da ta ki dang kat+pa la'i 'bras bu / ser po rnam gnyis 'bras bu gsum dang ni / dri sna bzhi dang gla sgang a ru ra / btsod dang spang spos n+ya gro d+ha'i myu gu / shug pa btsod dang e la ba lu ka / zho ni gnyis gnyis btab ste bsgrangs pa ru / dzA ti pa tra dzA ti phal dang / li shi a ko la dang ka ko la

verses.skt: sphaṭikaśubhrasurabhikarpūrakuḍavaṃ ca tatrāvapet tataḥ | kārayed guṭikāḥ sadā caitā dhāryā mukhe tadgadāpahāḥ
verses.tib: srang reg pur srang bzhi gzhug par bya / de las ri lu byas la rtag tu ni / khar bzhag na ni kha nad thams cad sel

verses.skt: kvāthyauṣadhavyatyayayojanena tailaṃ pacet kalpanayānayaiva | sarvāsyarogoddhṛtaye tad āhur dantasthiratve tv idam eva mukhyam
verses.tib: bskol dang reng bu'i sman ni go bzlog pa / btags pa 'di yi til mar bskol bar bya / kha nad kun sel bar ni de bshad do / so brtan byed pa'i mchog kyang 'di nyid yin

verses.skt: khadireṇaitā guṭikās tailam idaṃ cārimedasā prathitam | anuśīlayan pratidinaṃ svastho ’pi dṛḍhadvijo bhavati
verses.tib: ri lu 'di ni seng ldeng sbyar til mar / a ri me da sa dang bskol ba dag / nyin re bsten par byed na nad med pa'ang / so ni nges par brtan par byed pa yin

verses.skt: kṣudrāguḍūcīsumanaḥpravāladārvīyavāsatriphalākaṣāyaḥ | kṣaudreṇa yuktaḥ kavaḍagraho ’yaṃ sarvāmayān vaktragatān nihanti
verses.tib: rgun 'brum sle tres dzA ti'i myu gu dang / skyer pa byi / tsher 'bras bu gsum bskol ba'i / sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'di ni mkhur bar bcangs / kha yi nad du gtogs pa thams cad sel

verses.skt: pāṭhādārvītvakkuṣṭhamustāsamaṅgātiktāpītāṅgīlodhratejovatīnām | cūrṇaḥ sakṣaudro dantamāṃsārtikaṇḍūpākasrāvāṇāṃ nāśano gharṣaṇena
verses.tib: skyer pa ba ta ru rta gla sgang btsod / yung ba seng phrom te dzo ba ti dang / pu tse shel gyi phye ma sbrang rtsir sbyar / bskus na rnyil nad nyam thag g.ya' ba dang / rnag dang 'dzag pa'i nad rnams 'joms par byed

verses.skt: gṛhadhūmatārkṣyapāṭhāvyoṣakṣārāgnyayovarātejohvaiḥ | mukhadantagalavikāre sakṣaudraḥ kālako vidhāryaś cūrṇaḥ
verses.tib: khyim gyi dud pa tha skyer khaN+Da / tsha ba gsum dang nas tshig 'khus thal ba / tsi tar ka dang lcags phye 'bras bu gsum / te dzo ba ti sbrang rtsir sbyar ba ni

verses.skt: dārvītvaksindhūdbhavamanaḥśilāyāvaśūkaharitālaiḥ | dhāryaḥ pītakacūrṇo dantāsyagalāmaye samadhvājyaḥ
verses.tib: nag po khar bcangs so dang mgul nad sel / skyer pa'i shun pa ldong ros lce myang tsha

verses.skt: dvikṣāradhūmakavarāpañcapaṭuvyoṣavellagiritārkṣyaiḥ | gomūtreṇa vipakvā galāmayaghnī rasakriyā eṣā
verses.tib: ba bla nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba'i phye / sbrang rtsi mar sbyar phye ma ser po can / khar bzhag so dang mgul ba'i nad rnams sel

verses.skt: gomūtrakvathanavilīnavigrahāṇāṃ pathyānāṃ jalamiśikuṣṭhabhāvitānām | attāraṃ naram aṇavo ’pi vaktrarogāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpam iva na spṛśanty anarthāḥ
verses.tib: ba gcin a ru ra bskol thim gyur pa / shu ti ru rta ba le ka'i phye zos / nang gi kha nad phra mo yan chad ni / rgyal por brten na gnod pas mi tshugs bzhin

verses.skt: saptacchadośīrapaṭolamustaharītakītiktakarohiṇībhiḥ | yaṣṭyāhvarājadrumacandanaiś ca kvāthaṃ pibet pākaharaṃ mukhasya
verses.tib: lo ma bdun pa gla sgang bu shel tse / a ru ra dang tig ta pa to la / shing mngar dong gra tsan+dan pu shel tse / bskol ba 'thungs na kha yi shu ba 'joms

verses.skt: paṭolaśuṇṭhītriphalāviśālātrāyantitiktādviniśāmṛtānām | pītaḥ kaṣāyo madhunā nihanti mukhe sthitaś cāsyagadān aśeṣān
verses.tib: pa to la dang bca' sga 'bras bu gsum / bi sha l+ya dang tig ta kyi lce ba / sle tres bskol ba sbrang rtsir bcas blud dam / khar bzhag kha yi nad kun ma lus 'joms

verses.skt: svarasaḥ kvathito dārvyā ghanībhūtaḥ sagairikaḥ | āsyasthaḥ samadhur vaktrapākanāḍīvraṇāpahaḥ
verses.tib: skyer pa bskol ba'i khu ba ni / ska gyur yug snam btsag dang bcas / sbrang rtsir bcas pa kha nang bzhag / shu ba rma 'khyims sel bar byed

verses.skt: paṭolanimbayaṣṭyāhvavāsājātyarimedasām | khadirasya varāyāś ca pṛthag evaṃ prakalpanā
verses.tib: nim pa shing mngar pa to la / ba sha ka dang dzA ti dang / seng ldeng a ri med sa / 'bras bu gsum po re re la'ang / de bzhin du ni gtang bar bya

verses.skt: khadirāyovarāpārthamadayantyahimārakaiḥ | gaṇḍūṣo ’mbuśṛtair dhāryo durbaladvijaśāntaye
verses.tib: seng ldeng lcags phye 'bras bu gsum / ma ta yan ti a rdzu na / a ti ma ra bskol ba ni / mkhur bcad kha nad so nad sel

verses.skt: mukhadantamūlagalajāḥ prāyo rogāḥ kaphāsrabhūyiṣṭhāḥ | tasmāt teṣām asakṛd rudhiraṃ visrāvayed duṣṭam
verses.tib: kha dang so rtsa mgul nad phal cher ni / bad kan khrag las mang du 'byung ba yin / de bas nad de bsal bar bya ba'i phyir / nad khrag lan mang du ni dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: kāyaśirasor vireko vamanaṃ kavaḍagrahāś ca kaṭutiktāḥ | prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapharaktaharaṃ tathā karma
verses.tib: mgo dang lus kyi skyug sman bkru sman dang / kha dang tsha dang mkhur bkang bcang bar bya / de bzhin / bad kan khrag ni sel ba yi / gso ba'i nad ni phal cher bsngags pa yin

verses.skt: yavatṛṇadhānyaṃ bhaktaṃ vidalaiḥ kṣāroṣitair apasnehāḥ | yūṣā bhakṣyāś ca hitā yac cānyac chleṣmanāśāya
verses.tib: nas dang rtsa 'bru phub ma med byas la / thal sman mang du spangs shing snum med bza' / khu ba bstan pa la sogs gang gzhan ni / bad kan sel bar byed pa phan pa yin

verses.skt: prāṇānilapathasaṃsthāḥ śvasitam api nirundhate pramādavataḥ | kaṇṭhāmayāś cikitsitam ato drutaṃ teṣu kurvīta
verses.tib: srog ni rlung gi lam la gnas pas na / bag med pa yis 'gag par 'gyur ba yin / de bas lkog ma'i nad kyi gso ba ni / shin tu myur bar bya ba kho na yin

verses.skt: dhūmātapatuṣārāmbukrīḍātisvapnajāgaraiḥ | utsvedādhipurovātabāṣpanigraharodanaiḥ
verses.tib: du ba nyi tshan kha ba dang / chu dang rtse dang gnyid drags dang / gnyid yar rdul dang mdun gyi rlang / mchi ma bkag dang dus drags dang

verses.skt: atyambumadyapānena kṛmibhir vegadhāraṇaiḥ | upadhānamṛjābhyaṅgadveṣādhaḥpratatekṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: chu 'thungs chang 'thungs drags pa dang / srin bus shugs ni bkag pa dang / sngas dang bsku byug dril phyis la / mi dga' rgyun du thur du blta

verses.skt: asātmyagandhaduṣṭāmabhāṣyādyaiś ca śirogatāḥ | janayanty āmayān doṣās tatra mārutakopataḥ
verses.tib: ma goms dri dang zas gnod zos / mang du smras pas mgo bo yi / nang du nad ni skyed par byed / de la rlung ni 'khrugs pa las

verses.skt: nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā saṃbhidyate tathā | bhruvor madhyaṃ lalāṭaṃ ca patatīvātivedanam
verses.tib: mur 'gram gnyis su shin tu zug / 'gram so phug pa snyam du sems / smin ma'i mtshams dang dpral ba ni / ltung ba snyam sems rab tu na

verses.skt: bādhyete svanataḥ śrotre niṣkṛṣyete ivākṣiṇī | ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ saṃdhibhya iva mucyate
verses.tib: rna bar sgra yis gnod par byed / mig ni phyung ba snyam du sems / mgo bo 'khor ba lta bur sems / tshigs rnams bye ba snyam du byed

verses.skt: sphuraty ati sirājālaṃ kandharāhanusaṃgrahaḥ | prakāśāsahatā ghrāṇasrāvo ’kasmād vyathāśamau
verses.tib: rtsa yi dra ba shin tu 'phar / mjing pa 'gram pa 'byar snyam byed / gsal ba mthong bar mi bzod cing / sna chu 'dzag cing glo bur du

verses.skt: mārdavaṃ mardanasnehasvedabandhaiś ca jāyate | śirastāpo ’yam ardhe tu mūrdhnaḥ so ’rdhāvabhedakaḥ
verses.tib: mnye zhing snum bskus dugs byas dang / bcings pas bde bar 'gyur ba yin / mgo bo tsha ba'i nad ces bya / klad pa'i gzhogs phyed na ba ni / gzhogs phyed nad ces bya bar bshad

verses.skt: pakṣāt kupyati māsād vā svayam eva ca śāmyati | ativṛddhas tu nayanaṃ śravaṇaṃ vā vināśayet
verses.tib: zla gcig zla phyed nas ldang de / rang nyid zhi bar 'gyur pa yin / shas cher 'phel na mig dang ni / rna ba dag kyang ma rung byed

verses.skt: śiro'bhitāpe pittotthe śirodhūmāyanaṃ jvaraḥ | svedo ’kṣidahanaṃ mūrchā niśi śītaiś ca mārdavam
verses.tib: mkhris gyur mgo bo tsha ba dang / dud pas bdugs snyam sems rims 'debs / rdul zhing mig tsha brgyal ba dang / mtshan mo grang bas rtse 'jil 'gyur

verses.skt: aruciḥ kaphaje mūrdhno gurustimitaśītatā | sirāniṣpandatālasyaṃ ruṅ mandāhny adhikā niśi
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur yi ga 'chus / mgo lci tshor ba med cing grang / rtsa mi 'phar zhing sgyid snyom la / nyin mo nad chung mtshan mo ldang

verses.skt: tandrā śūnākṣikūṭatvaṃ karṇakaṇḍūyanaṃ vamiḥ | raktāt pittādhikarujaḥ sarvaiḥ syāt sarvalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: rmya zhing mig ni skrangs pa dang / rna ba g.ya' zhing slon pa yin / khrag gyur mkhris pa las cher na / 'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun dang ldan

verses.skt: saṃkīrṇair bhojanair mūrdhni kledite rudhirāmiṣe | kopite saṃnipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ
verses.tib: 'dren ma'i zas kyis spyi bo yi / khrag dang sha ni 'drul byas pas / 'dus pa'i nad ni 'khrugs 'gyur zhing / mgo bo'i srin bu skye bar 'gyur

verses.skt: śirasas te pibanto ’sraṃ ghorāḥ kurvanti vedanāḥ | cittavibhraṃśajananīr jvaraḥ kāso balakṣayaḥ
verses.tib: des ni mgo bo'i khrag 'thung zhing / sems ni 'khrul par byed pa yi / mi bzad nad ni skyed par byed / lud pa rims dang nyams stobs zad

verses.skt: raukṣyaśophavyadhacchedadāhasphuraṇapūtitāḥ | kapāle tāluśirasoḥ kaṇḍūḥ śoṣaḥ pramīlakaḥ
verses.tib: mgo bo rtsub skrangs dbug snyam na / tsha zhing mgo 'gul rnags pa dang / thod pa rkan dang mgo bor ni / g.ya' zhing skem la tshor ba med

verses.skt: tāmrācchasiṅghāṇakatā karṇanādaś ca jantuje | vātolbaṇāḥ śiraḥkampaṃ tatsaṃjñaṃ kurvate malāḥ
verses.tib: snabs kyi mdog ni dmar ba la / rna ba sgra bcas srin skyes nad / rlung shas che bas mgo 'dar zhing / de yi ming can nad skyed byed

verses.skt: pittapradhānair vātādyaiḥ śaṅkhe śophaḥ saśoṇitaiḥ | tīvradāharujārāgapralāpajvaratṛḍbhramāḥ
verses.tib: mkhris shas che ba'i rlung sogs kyis / mur 'gram skrang zhing khrag bcas la / mi bzad tsha zhing nal dmar / glal zhing rims 'debs skom mgo 'khor

verses.skt: tiktāsyaḥ pītavadanaḥ kṣiprakārī sa śaṅkhakaḥ | trirātrāj jīvitaṃ hanti sidhyaty apy āśu sādhitaḥ
verses.tib: kha nang kha bro gdong ser zhing / myur du gsod byed mur 'gram can / zhag gsum nas ni srog 'joms shing / myur du gso na 'tsho ba yin

verses.skt: pittānubaddhaḥ śaṅkhākṣibhrūlalāṭeṣu mārutaḥ | rujaṃ saspandanāṃ kuryād anusūryodayodayām
verses.tib: rlung mkhris rjes 'brel mur 'gram mig / smin ma dpral ba na ba dang / 'phar bar byed pa skyed par byed / nyi ma 'char bar gyur pa nas

verses.skt: āmadhyāhnaṃ vivardhiṣṇuḥ kṣudvataḥ sā viśeṣataḥ | avyavasthitaśītoṣṇasukhā śāmyaty ataḥ param
verses.tib: nyi ma phyed kyi bar du 'phel / de phan chad ni bde bar 'gyur / ltogs na de ni lhag par na / grang dang dro la nges pa med

verses.skt: sūryāvartaḥ sa ity uktā daśa rogāḥ śirogatāḥ | śirasy eva ca vakṣyante kapāle vyādhayo nava
verses.tib: de ni nyi ma 'khor zhes bya / de ltar mgo bor gtogs pa'i nad / rnam pa bcur ni bshad pa yin / gzhan yang thod pa la brten nad / dgu po mgo bo bzhin bshad bya

verses.skt: kapāle pavane duṣṭe garbhasthasyāpi jāyate | savarṇo nīrujaḥ śophas taṃ vidyād upaśīrṣakam
verses.tib: klad pa rlung ni 'khrugs gyur pa / nang na gnas pa'ang nad skyed byed / mdog gnag nad chung skrangs pa yin / de ni nye ba'i mgo zhes bya

verses.skt: yathādoṣodayaṃ brūyāt piṭikārbudavidradhīn | kapāle kledabahulāḥ pittāsṛkśleṣmajantubhiḥ
verses.tib: 'brum phran thor bu khong 'bras ni / nad gzhi ji bzhin brjod par bya / thod par ljan ljin mang po dang / khrag dang mkhris pa'i 'bu las ni

verses.skt: kaṅgusiddhārthakanibhāḥ piṭikāḥ syur arūṃṣikāḥ | kaṇḍūkeśacyutisvāparaukṣyakṛt sphuṭanaṃ tvacaḥ
verses.tib: khre dang nyungs kar lta bur 'byung / 'brum phran srin gyi nad skyed 'gyur / rlung dang mkhris pa / 'khrugs pa las / pags ba rtsub cing gas pa dang

verses.skt: susūkṣmaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ vidyād dāruṇakaṃ tu tat | romakūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrchitam
verses.tib: g.ya' zhing skra 'byi tshor ba med / gyur pa mi bzad yin zhes bya / mkhris ba rlung dang 'dres pa ni / ba spu'i nang du zhugs gyur pa

verses.skt: pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā saśoṇitaḥ | romakūpān ruṇaddhy asya tenānyeṣām asaṃbhavaḥ
verses.tib: skra ni 'byi bar byed pa yin / de nas bad kan khrag bcas pas / ba spu'i bu ga 'gag byed de / de yis gzhan dag mi 'byung ba

verses.skt: tad indraluptaṃ rujyāṃ ca prāhuś cāceti cāpare | khalater api janmaivaṃ śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt
verses.tib: 'khor ling skra 'byi zhes bya ste / gzhan dag skra 'byi zhes byar 'dod / spyi cer skye ba'ang de bzhin du / skra 'byi de la rim gyis 'byung

verses.skt: sā vātād agnidagdhābhā pittāt svinnasirāvṛtā | kaphād ghanatvag varṇāṃś ca yathāsvaṃ nirdiśet tvaci
verses.tib: de ni rlung gyur mes tshig 'dra / mkhris gyur rlan can rtsa yis khyab / bad kan pags pa'i mdog dkar mthug / pags pa rang gi ji bzhin snang

verses.skt: doṣaiḥ sarvākṛtiḥ sarvair asādhyā sā nakhaprabhā | dagdhāgnineva nīromā sadāhā yā ca jāyate
verses.tib: 'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun dang ldan / sen mo'i mdog 'dra gsor mi rung / mes bsregs lta bur spu med gang / tsha bcas de yang gsor mi rung

verses.skt: śokaśramakrodhakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ | keśān sadoṣaḥ pacati palitaṃ saṃbhavaty ataḥ
verses.tib: mya ngan khro dang ngal las byung / lus kyi drod ni mgor zhugs pas / nad des skra ni btsos nas ni / de la skra dkar skye bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tad vātāt sphuṭitaṃ śyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ jalaprabham | pittāt sadāhaṃ pītābhaṃ kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhimat
verses.tib: de ni rlung gyur yid tsam gnag / sra zhing rtsub la chu mdog can / mkhris pa tsha zhing mdog ser yin / bad kan las gyur snum zhing 'phel

verses.skt: sthūlaṃ suśuklaṃ sarvais tu vidyād vyāmiśralakṣaṇam | śirorujodbhavaṃ cānyad vivarṇaṃ sparśanāsaham
verses.tib: sbom zhing mdog ni dkar ba yin / 'dus gyur mtshan ma 'dren ma yin / mgo bo'i nad las byung ba gzhan / mdog ngan reg na mi bzod yin

verses.skt: asādhyā saṃnipātena khalatiḥ palitāni ca | śarīrapariṇāmotthāny apekṣante rasāyanam
verses.tib: 'dus pa las ni gyur pa yi / spyi cer skra dkar gsor mi rung / lus kyi 'gyur ba las byung ba / bcud kyis len gyis gso bar bya

verses.skt: śiro'bhitāpe ’nilaje vātavyādhividhiṃ caret | ghṛtam aktaśirā rātrau pibed uṣṇapayo'nupaḥ
verses.tib: de nas mgo bo'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o / rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad la / rlung nad gso ba'i cho ga bshad / 'di ni mtshan mo zhun mar blud

verses.skt: māṣān kulatthān mudgān vā tadvat khāded ghṛtānvitān | tailaṃ tilānāṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet
verses.tib: ma sha rgya sran mung+ga 'ang rung / mar dang ldan pa de bzhin sbyin / til mar til gyi lde gu ni / 'o ma dang ni lhan cig blud

verses.skt: piṇḍopanāhasvedāś ca māṃsadhānyakṛtā hitāḥ | vātaghnadaśamūlādisiddhakṣīreṇa secanam
verses.tib: glan dang bcing ba'i dugs dag ni / sha dang 'u su las byas phan / rlung 'joms rtsa ba bcu la sogs / bskol ba'i 'o ma snum can blud

verses.skt: snigdhaṃ nasyaṃ tathā dhūmaḥ śiraḥśravaṇatarpaṇam | varaṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīram ardhodakaṃ pacet
verses.tib: sna sman dud brngub snum can dang / mgo dang rna ba brta bar bya / ba ra Na sogs sde tshan brdungs / 'o ma chu phyed bskol / ba yi

verses.skt: kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tac chītaṃ mathitvā sāram āharet | tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ
verses.tib: 'o ma lus pa de bsgrangs la / bsrubs te snying po blangs nas ni / de nas mngar ba'i sde tshan bskol / mar gyi sna sman blugs pa bsngags

verses.skt: varge ’tra pakvaṃ kṣīre ca peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram | kārpāsamajjā tvaṅ mustā sumanaḥkorakāṇi ca
verses.tib: 'dir ni 'o ma'i sde tshan bskol / mar dang kha rar bcas pa blugs / ras bal sa bon shing tsha dang / gla sgang dzA ti kha 'bus pa

verses.skt: nasyam uṣṇāmbupiṣṭāni sarvamūrdharujāpaham | śarkarākuṅkumaśṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ pittāsṛganvaye
verses.tib: chu dron btags pa'i sna sman ni / mgo bo'i nad kun 'joms byed yin / khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur pa / kha ra gur gum mar bskol gtang

verses.skt: pralepaiḥ saghṛtaiḥ kuṣṭhakuṭilotpalacandanaiḥ | vātodrekabhayād raktaṃ na cāsminn avasecayet
verses.tib: ru rta rgya spos ut+pa la / tsan+dan mar sbyar mgo bskus phan / rlung shas che la 'jigs yod pas / gtar ga 'di la mi bya'o

verses.skt: ity aśāntau cale dāhaḥ kaphe ceṣṭo yathoditaḥ | ardhāvabhedake ’py eṣā tathā doṣānvayāt kriyā
verses.tib: des ma zhi na bad rlung la / me btsa' ji skad bshad pa bya / gzhogs phyed na la'ang de bzhin te / nad dang 'brel pa'i gso ba bya

verses.skt: śirīṣabījāpāmārgamūlaṃ nasyaṃ viḍānvitam | sthirāraso vā lepe tu prapunnāṭo ’mlakalkitaḥ
verses.tib: shi ri sha yi sa bon dang / a pa marga'i rtsa ba dang / kha ru tsha bcas sna sman gtang / yang na sa la par+Ni 'am / tsa kra marda gang yang rung / skyur ku dang sbyar lde gus bsku

verses.skt: sūryāvarte ’pi tasmiṃs tu sirayāpahared asṛk | śiro'bhitāpe pittotthe snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām
verses.tib: nyi ma ltar 'khor de yi tshe / gtar gas khrag ni dbyung bar bya / mkhris pa las gyur mgo nad la / snum chos byas nas gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: śītāḥ śiromukhālepasekaśodhanavastayaḥ | jīvanīyaśṛte kṣīrasarpiṣī pānanasyayoḥ
verses.tib: mgo dang gdong byugs sman chu blugs / slon khrus mas gtong bsil bar bya / 'tsho byed dang bskol 'o ma dang / mar ni sna sman btung ba blugs

verses.skt: kartavyaṃ raktaje ’py etat pratyākhyāya ca śaṅkhake | śleṣmābhitāpe jīrṇājyasnehitaiḥ kaṭukair vamet
verses.tib: khrag las gyur pa 'ang 'di nyid bya / mur 'gram can la gtar ga spang / bad kan mgo nad mar snying dang / snum chos byas la tsha bas slon

verses.skt: svedapralepanasyādyā rūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇabheṣajaiḥ | śasyante copavāso ’tra nicaye miśram ācaret
verses.tib: dugs dang byug pa sna sman sogs / rtsub dro rno ba'i sman gyis gso / 'dir ni smyung ba'ang bsngags pa yin / 'dus pa las ni 'dren mar gso

verses.skt: kṛmije śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ tena mūrchanti jantavaḥ | mattāḥ śoṇitagandhena niryānti ghrāṇavaktrayoḥ
verses.tib: srin gyur sna sman khrag blugs te / de yis 'bu ni brgyal bar 'gyur / khrag gi dri yis ra ro nas / kha dang sna nas 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: sutīkṣṇanasyadhūmābhyāṃ kuryān nirharaṇaṃ tataḥ | viḍaṅgasvarjikādantīhiṅgugomūtrasādhitam
verses.tib: de nas sna sman dud brngub rnos / de ni nye bar dbyung bar bya / nyungs kar nim pa ing gu dang / pi lu'i mar dang sbyar ba yi / byi dang ga dang sa rdzi ka

verses.skt: kaṭunimbeṅgudīpīlutailaṃ nasyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak | ajāmūtradrutaṃ nasyaṃ kṛmijit kṛmijit param
verses.tib: dan+da shing kun ba gcin bskol / sna sman so sor gtang bar bya / byi dang ga ni ra gcin dang / sbyar ba'i sna sman 'bu 'joms mchog

verses.skt: pūtimatsyayutaiḥ kuryād dhūmaṃ nāvanabheṣajaiḥ | kṛmibhiḥ pītaraktatvād raktam atra na nirhared
verses.tib: nya rul bcas pa'i sna / sman dang / dud pa dag kyang brngub par bya / srin bus khrag ni 'thungs pa'i phyir / 'di la khrag ni dbyung mi bya

verses.skt: pūtimatsyaḥ kṛmīn hatvā durgandhatvāt tu vātaje
verses.tib: mgo 'dar rlung gi mgo nad kyi

verses.skt: vātābhitāpavihitaḥ kampe dāhād vinā kramaḥ | nave janmottaraṃ jāte yojayed upaśīrṣake
verses.tib: gso ba me btsa' ma gtogs bya / nye ba'i mgo nad skyes pa yi / rjes dang skyes ma thag la ni

verses.skt: vātavyādhikriyāṃ pakve karma vidradhicoditam | āmapakve yathāyogyaṃ vidradhipiṭikārbude
verses.tib: rlung nad kyi ni gso ba bya / smin nas khong 'bras gso las bya / 'brum phran 'brum bu khong 'bras la / smin dang ma smin ji bzhin bya

verses.skt: arūṃṣikā jalaukobhir hṛtāsrā nimbavāriṇā | siktā prabhūtalavaṇair limped aśvaśakṛdrasaiḥ
verses.tib: srin las srin bu pad pa yis / gtar ga byas te nim pa'i chu / blugs shing rta spangs khu ba ni / lan tshwa shas cher btab pas bsku

verses.skt: paṭolanimbapattrair vā saharidraiḥ sukalkitaiḥ | gomūtrajīrṇapiṇyākakṛkavākumalair api
verses.tib: nim pa pa to la'i lo ma / yungs mar bcas pa zhib btags bsku / ba gcin 'ba' cha rnying par sbyar / khyim bya'i rtug pa dag gis bsku

verses.skt: kapālabhṛṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vā cūrṇitaṃ tailasaṃyutam | rūṃṣikālepanaṃ kaṇḍūkledadāhārtināśanam
verses.tib: gyo mor ru rta brngos pa dang / til gyi phye mar bcas pa yis / glog pa bskus na g.ya' ba'am / chu 'dzag tsha ba sel bar byed

verses.skt: mālatīcitrakāśvaghnanaktamālaprasādhitam | cācārūṃṣikayos tailam abhyaṅgaḥ kṣuraghṛṣṭayoḥ
verses.tib: ma la dzi dang tsi tra ka / ka ra bI ra ka rany+dza / til mar spu gris bregs pa yi / rjes bskus 'khor ling 'byi ba sel

verses.skt: aśāntau śirasaḥ śuddhyai yateta vamanādibhiḥ | vidhyet sirāṃ dāruṇake lālāṭyāṃ śīlayen mṛjām
verses.tib: des ma zhin mgo bo yi / sbyang bya slon sman sogs pa bya / mi bzad pa la dang por ni / dpral ba'i rtsa la gtar ga bya

verses.skt: nāvanaṃ mūrdhavastiṃ ca lepayec ca samākṣikaiḥ | priyālabījamadhukakuṣṭhamāṣaiḥ sasarṣapaiḥ
verses.tib: mgo bo'i bkru sman sna sman gtang / shing mngar pi la ya'i sa bon / ru rta ma sha nyungs kar bcas / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gus bsku

verses.skt: lākṣāśamyākapattraiḍagajadhātrīphalais tathā | koradūṣatṛṇakṣāravāriprakṣālanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: rgya skyegs dong ga'i lo ma dang / tsakra marda skyu ru ra / sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bskus kyang phan / khre rgod rtsa bsregs thal ba ni / chu dang sbyar bas bskus na phan

verses.skt: indralupte yathāsannaṃ sirāṃ viddhvā pralepayet | pracchāya gāḍhaṃ kāsīsamanohvātutthakoṣaṇaiḥ
verses.tib: 'khor ling skra 'byi'i nad la ni / nye bar gtar ga gdab pa dang / zhal zhal byas te na le sham / ldong ros spangs ma nag tshur bsku

verses.skt: vanyāmaratarubhyāṃ vā guñjāmūlaphalais tathā | tathā lāṅgalikāmūlaiḥ karavīrarasena vā
verses.tib: yang na 'ba' cha'i thang shing ngam / 'ol ma se yi 'bras bu'i rtsa / yang na lang ka li'i rtsa ba'am / ka ra bI ra'i khu ba 'am

verses.skt: sakṣaudrakṣudravārtākasvarasena rasena vā | dhattūrakasya pattrāṇāṃ bhallātakarasena vā
verses.tib: kaN+Da kA ri'i khu ba ni / sbrang rtsir bcas pas bsku ba 'am / d+ha du spyor yi lo ma 'am / bse shing 'bras bu'i khu bas bsku

verses.skt: athavā mākṣikahavistilapuṣpatrikaṇṭakaiḥ | tailāktā hastidantasya maṣī cācauṣadhaṃ param
verses.tib: til gyi me tog gze ma dang / mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa'am / glang po'i so bsregs til mar bsres / 'khor ling 'byi ba'i sman mchog yin

verses.skt: śuklaromodgame tadvan maṣī meṣaviṣāṇajā | varjayed vāriṇā sekaṃ yāvad romasamudbhavaḥ
verses.tib: skra dkar skye la lug gi rwa'i / snag tshas de / bzhin bsku bar bya / ji srid skra ni skyes kyi bar / chu blugs pa ni spang bar bya

verses.skt: khalatau palite valyāṃ haridromni ca śodhitam | nasyavaktraśiro'bhyaṅgapradehaiḥ samupācaret
verses.tib: spyi cer skra dkar gnyer ma mang / skra ser skyes la sbyang byas nas / sna sman gtong dang mgo bkrus la / byug pa rnams kyis gso bar bya

verses.skt: siddhaṃ tailaṃ bṛhatyādyair jīvanīyaiś ca nāvanam | māsaṃ vā nimbajaṃ tailaṃ kṣīrabhuṅ nāvayed yatiḥ
verses.tib: bri ha ti sogs til mar bskol / 'tsho byed bskol ba'i sna sman blugs / nim pa'i mar gyis zla ba gcig / sna sman btang ste 'o ma blud

verses.skt: nīlīśirīṣakoraṇṭabhṛṅgasvarasabhāvitam | śelvakṣatilarāmāṇāṃ bījaṃ kākāṇḍakīsamam
verses.tib: shri sha e raN+Da dang rams / bring ga rA dza'i khu bar sbangs / se'u lu til dang ba ru ra / pri yang ka ka ti'i sa bon

verses.skt: piṣṭvājapayasā lohāl liptād arkāṃśutāpitāt | tailaṃ srutaṃ kṣīrabhujo nāvanāt palitāntakṛt
verses.tib: cha mnyam lcags la bskol nas ni / nyi ma'i 'od la skams nas ni / mar 'dzag pa yi sna sman gtang / 'o ma 'thungs pas skra dkar sel

verses.skt: kṣīrāt sāhacarād bhṛṅgarajasaḥ saurasād rasāt | prasthais tailasya kuḍavaḥ siddho yaṣṭīpalānvitaḥ
verses.tib: sa ha ra dza bye'u rug pa / bring ga ra dza'i khu ba ni / bre gang til mar phul gang dang / shing mngar srang gcig btab ste bskol

verses.skt: nasyaṃ śailāsane bhāṇḍe śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ | kṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭau vā dugdhikākaravīrakau
verses.tib: a sa na'am rdo snod dam / lug gi rwa yi nang du gzhug / ka ra bI ra pa ya s+ya / 'o ma dang ni zhib btags pa / skra dkar phyung ba'i rjes bskus shing

verses.skt: utpāṭya palitaṃ deyāv āśaye palitāpahau | kṣīraṃ priyālaṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ jīvanīyo gaṇas tilāḥ
verses.tib: sbangs na skra dkar sel bar byed / bi la ya dang shing mngar dang / 'tsho byed sde tshan til nag dang / sa nag 'o ma'i lde gu yis

verses.skt: kṛṣṇāḥ pralepo vaktrasya haridromavalīhitaḥ | tilāḥ sāmalakāḥ padmakiñjalko madhukaṃ madhu
verses.tib: gdong bskus gnyer ma spu ser sel / til dang pad+ma ge sar dang / shing mngar sbrang rtsi skyu ru ra

verses.skt: bṛṃhayed rañjayec caitat keśān mūrdhapralepanāt | māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ śārivā nīlam utpalam
verses.tib: lde gu 'di yis mgo bskus na / skra 'phel gnag par 'gyur ba yin / spang spos ru rta til nag dang / thal tres ut+pal sngon po dang

verses.skt: kṣaudraṃ ca kṣīrapiṣṭāni keśasaṃvardhanam param | ayorajo bhṛṅgarajas triphalā kṛṣṇamṛttikā
verses.tib: 'o mar btags te sbrang rtsir sbyar / skra ni 'phel bar byed pa'i mchog / lcags phye bring ga ra dza dang / 'bras bu gsum dang sa nag po

verses.skt: sthitam ikṣurase māsaṃ samūlaṃ palitaṃ rajet | māṣakodravadhānyāmlair yavāgūṃs tridinoṣitā
verses.tib: bu ram shing khur zla gcig gzhug / skra dkar rtsad nas skyur bar byed / ma sha khre rgod skyur rtsabs dang / nas thug lcags phye tsha mang btab / zhag gsum bzhag ste btags pa yis

verses.skt: lohaśuklotkaṭā piṣṭā balākām api rañjayet | prapauṇḍarīkamadhukapippalīcandanotpalaiḥ
verses.tib: bya dkar yang ni nag por byed / shing mngar tsan+dan stag tsher ba / pi pi ling dang ut+pal dang

verses.skt: bhṛṅgarajastriphalotpalasārilohapurīṣasamanvitakāri | tailam idaṃ paca dāruṇahāri luñcitakeśaghanasthirakāri
siddhaṃ dhātrīrase tailaṃ nasyenābhyañjanena ca | sarvān mūrdhagadān hanti palitāni ca śīlitam
verses.tib: skyu ru ra khu til mar bskol / sna sman bsku ba byas gyur na / skra dkar dang ni klad pa yi

verses.skt: madhūkayaṣṭīkṛmijidviśvabhṛṅgaiḥ śṛtaṃ haviḥ | ṣaḍbindudānāt tan nasyaṃ sarvamūrdhagadāpaham
verses.tib: nad kun 'joms par byed pa yin / nye'u shing dzi ban+ti'i khu ba / 'o ma mar dang til mar dang

verses.skt: varījīvantiniryāsapayobhir yamakaṃ pacet | jīvanīyaiś ca tan nasyaṃ sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit
verses.tib: 'tsho byed bskol ba'i sna sman gyis / nam tshong yan chad nad kun sel
