verses.skt: mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrapādaviṭtuṇḍavarjitam | daśamūlabalārāsnāmadhukais tripalair yutam
verses.tib: rma bya'i sgro mkhris rgyu ma dang / rkang pa rtug pa chu bor ba'i / sha dang ba la rtsa ba bcu / ra sna shing mngar srang gsum gsum

verses.skt: jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet | kalkitair madhuradravyaiḥ sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit
verses.tib: chu bskol khu ba mar bre gang / 'o ma bre gang bcas bskol ba / mngar ba'i sman sde'i lde gu btab

verses.skt: tad abhyāsīkṛtaṃ pānavastyabhyañjananāvanaiḥ | etenaiva kaṣāyeṇa ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet
verses.tib: de btung mas gtong bsku ba dang / sna sman dag tu bsten pa yis / nam tshong yan chad nad kun sel

verses.skt: caturguṇena payasā kalkair ebhiś ca kārṣikaiḥ | jīvantītriphalāmedāmṛdvīkarddhiparūṣakaiḥ
verses.tib: sman 'di dag gi lde gu dang / dzi ban+ti dang 'bras bu gsum / med rgun 'brum dbyi mo dang

verses.skt: samaṅgācavikābhārgīkāśmarīkarkaṭāhvayaiḥ | ātmaguptāmahāmedātālakharjūramastakaiḥ
verses.tib: pa ru sha ka sa mang ga / ga pra'i rtsa ba tang pa la dang / karka ta sring kha sral phre'u

verses.skt: mṛṇālabisakharjūrayaṣṭīmadhukajīvakaiḥ | śatāvarīvidārīkṣubṛhatīśārivāyugaiḥ
verses.tib: 'bro go pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / pad+ma'i sdong po kha rdzun / shing mngar nye'u shing dzi ba ka / bi da ri dang bu ram shing

verses.skt: mūrvāśvadaṃṣṭrarṣabhakaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaiḥ | rāsnāsthirātāmalakīsūkṣmailāśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ
verses.tib: mur ba gze ma zangs rtsi ba / sring ga ta dang ka she ru / ra sna s+thi ra lca ba dang / sug smel zur ba ma nu dang

verses.skt: punarnavātavakṣīrīkākolīdhanvayāsakaiḥ | madhūkākṣoṭavātāmamuñjātābhiṣukair api
verses.tib: ba spru ba dang cu gang dang / ra mnye ba dang byi tsher ba / ma du ka dang star ga dang / a bi shu ka muny+dza ka

verses.skt: mahāmāyūram ity etan māyūrād adhikaṃ guṇaiḥ | dhātvindriyasvarabhraṃśaśvāsakāsārditāpaham
verses.tib: 'di ni rma bya chen mo ste / rma bya las ni yon tan lhag / lus zungs dbang po nyams skad 'gags / lud pa dbugs mi bde nyen 'joms

verses.skt: yonyasṛkśukradoṣeṣu śastaṃ vandhyāsutapradam | ākhubhiḥ kukkuṭair haṃsaiḥ śaśaiś ceti prakalpayet
verses.tib: zla mtshan khu ba'i skyon la'ang phan / mo gsham la yang bu skyed byed / byi ba khyim bya dang pa dang / ri bong dang yang de bzhin sbyar

verses.skt: jatrūrdhvajānāṃ vyādhīnām ekatriṃśacchatadvayam | parasparam asaṃkīrṇaṃ vistareṇa prakāśitam
verses.tib: nam tshod yan chad gtogs pa'i nad / nyis brgya sum cu rtsa gcig yin / de dag phan tshun ma 'dres par / rgya cher rab tu bshad pa yin

verses.skt: ūrdhvamūlam adhaḥśākham ṛṣayaḥ puruṣaṃ viduḥ | mūlaprahāriṇas tasmād rogāñ chīghrataraṃ jayet
verses.tib: drang srong rnams kyis skyes bu'i mgo / rtsa ba 'og ni yal gar bshad / de phyir rtsa ba la gnod pa'i / nad ni myur du gso bar bya

verses.skt: sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ | tena tasyottamāṅgasya rakṣāyām ādṛto bhavet
verses.tib: gang la dbang po kun rten zhing / gang la srog ni gnas byed pas / des na yan lag dam pa yi / srung ba la ni 'bad par bya

verses.skt: nīlotpalaṃ sotpalakuṣṭhayuktaṃ sapippalīkaṃ madhukaṃ śatāhvam | saśṛṅgaveraṃ śirasaḥ pralepaḥ sadyaḥ śirorogavināśanāya
vraṇo dvidhā nijāgantuduṣṭaśuddhavibhedataḥ | nijo doṣaiḥ śarīrotthair āgantur bāhyahetujaḥ
verses.tib: rma ni lhan cig skyes glo bur / red dang ma red dbye ba gnyis / lus kyi nad gzhis skyed lhan cig / phyi rol rgyus byung glo bur ba'o

verses.skt: doṣair adhiṣṭhito duṣṭaḥ śuddhas tair anadhiṣṭhitaḥ | saṃvṛtatvaṃ vivṛtatā kāṭhinyaṃ mṛdutāti vā
verses.tib: nad dang 'dres pa red pa yin / de med dag pa ma red yin / rma red kha rgyas zhum pa dang / shin tu sra ba'am shin tu snyi

verses.skt: atyutsannāvasannatvam atyauṣṇyam atiśītatā | raktatvaṃ pāṇḍutā kārṣṇyaṃ pūtipūyaparisrutiḥ
verses.tib: shin tu mtho 'am shin tu dma' / shin tu grang ngam shin tu tsha / dmar zhing skya'am gnag pa nyid / rnag ni dri mnam yongs su 'dzag

verses.skt: pūtimāṃsasirāsnāyucchannatotsaṅgitātiruk | saṃrambhadāhaśvayathukaṇḍvādibhir upadrutaḥ
verses.tib: sha dang rtsa rgyus 'drul ba dang / g.yos shing mched la rab tu na / g.yo zhing tsha la skrang ba dang / g.ya' ba la sogs bla brnan bcas

verses.skt: dīrghakālānubandhaś ca vidyād duṣṭavraṇākṛtim | sa pañcadaśadhā doṣaiḥ saraktais tatra mārutāt
verses.tib: yun ring du ni 'tsho ba dka' / rma red mtshan mar shes par bya / de ni khrag bcas nad bco lnga / de la rlung las gyur ba'i rma

verses.skt: śyāvaḥ kṛṣṇo ’ruṇo bhasmakapotāsthinibho ’pi vā | mastumāṃsapulākāmbutulyatanvalpasaṃsrutiḥ
verses.tib: gnag cing smug dmar thal mdog dang / thi ba'i rus pa lta bur snang / zho ga chu'am 'bras bkrus chu / 'dra ba'i chu sla nyung ngu 'dzag / sha zad shas cher na zhing zug / rtsub cing tsheg tsheg tsha ba yin / mkhris gyur myur rnags ser ba dang / sngo zhing ser skya'am kham par 'dug

verses.skt: nirmāṃsas todabhedāḍhyo rūkṣaś caṭacaṭāyate | pittena kṣiprajaḥ pīto nīlaḥ kapilapiṅgalaḥ
verses.tib: gnag cing smug dmar thal mdog dang / thi ba'i rus pa lta bur snang / zho ga chu'am 'bras bkrus chu / 'dra ba'i chu sla nyung ngu 'dzag / sha zad shas cher na zhing zug / rtsub cing tsheg tsheg tsha ba yin / mkhris gyur myur rnags ser ba dang / sngo zhing ser skya'am kham par 'dug

verses.skt: mūtrakiṃśukabhasmāmbutailābhoṣṇabahusrutiḥ | kṣārokṣitakṣatasamavyatho rāgoṣmapākavān
verses.tib: gcin dang thal chu rgya skyegs khu / til mar 'dra chu mang du 'dzag / rma la thal sman btab ltar na / dmar zhing tsha la rnags pa yin

verses.skt: kaphena pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūmān bahuśvetaghanasrutiḥ | sthūlauṣṭhaḥ kaṭhinaḥ snāyusirājālatato ’lparuk
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur mdog skya g.ya' / chu ni ska ba mang du 'dzag / rma kha sbom zhing na ba dang / rtsa rgyus kyis khyab nad tshabs chung

verses.skt: pravālarakto raktena saraktaṃ pūyam udgiret | vājisthānasamo gandhe yukto liṅgaiś ca paittikaiḥ
verses.tib: khrag gyur byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar / khrag dang bcas pa'i rnag 'dzag cing / rta bres kyi ni dri ltar bro / mkhris pa'i mtshan ma dag dang ldan

verses.skt: dvābhyāṃ tribhiś ca sarvaiś ca vidyāl lakṣaṇasaṃkarāt | jihvāprabho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ śyāvauṣṭhapiṭikaḥ samaḥ
verses.tib: gnyis sam gsum mam thams cad las / gyur pa'i mtshan ma 'dren ma yin / lce yi mdog 'dra 'jam zhing mnyen

verses.skt: kiñcidunnatamadhyo vā vraṇaḥ śuddho ’nupadravaḥ | tvagāmiṣasirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthīni vraṇāśayāḥ
verses.tib: rma kha smug cing 'brum phran can / mnyam pa dbus ma cung zad mtho / bla brnan med rma dag pa yin / pags pa sha dang rtsa rgyus dang / tshigs dang rus pa nang grol gnad

verses.skt: koṣṭho marma ca tāny aṣṭau duḥsādhyāny uttarottaram | susādhyaḥ sattvamāṃsāgnivayobalavati vraṇaḥ
verses.tib: brgyad po der ni rma gnas pa / phyi ma bzhin du gso bar dka' / gso sla snying stobs me drod sha / na tshod nyams stobs ldan pa'i rma

verses.skt: vṛtto dīrghas tripuṭakaś caturaśrākṛtiś ca yaḥ | tathā sphikpāyumeḍhrauṣṭhapṛṣṭhāntarvaktragaṇḍagaḥ
verses.tib: zlum zhing dkyus ring rim gsum pa / zur bzhi pa ni gang yin dang / de bzhin / dpyi rkub pho mtshan mchu / rgyab dang kha nang mkhur tshos byung

verses.skt: kṛcchrasādhyo ’kṣidaśananāsikāpāṅganābhiṣu | sevanījaṭharaśrotrapārśvakakṣāstaneṣu ca
verses.tib: gso dka' mig dang so dang ni / sna dang mig zur lte ba dang / srubs mtshams lto ba rna ba dang / rtsib logs mchan khung nu mar byung

verses.skt: phenapūyānilavahaḥ śalyavān ūrdhvanirvamī | bhagandaro ’ntarvadanas tathā kaṭyasthisaṃśritaḥ
verses.tib: lbu ba rnag 'dzag rlung 'byung zhing / zug rngur bcas shing stong nas 'dzag / mtshan bar rdol zhing kha nang bltas / de bzhin rked pa'i rus par gnas

verses.skt: kuṣṭhināṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhumehināṃ | vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ ca syur vraṇe vraṇāḥ
verses.tib: mdze can dug gis phog pa dang / lus skem gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra / rma steng rma ni byung ba gang / rma de gso bar dka' ba yin

verses.skt: naiva sidhyanti vīsarpajvarātīsārakāsinām | pipāsūnām anidrāṇāṃ śvāsinām avipākinām
verses.tib: me dbal rims dang tshad par 'khru / lud pa lu dang skom dad che / gnyid med pa dang dbugs mi bde / me drod chung bar gyur pa yi / rma ni 'tsho ba par mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: bhinne śiraḥkapāle vā mastuluṅgasya darśane | snāyukledāt sirāchedād gāmbhīryāt kṛmibhakṣaṇāt
verses.tib: mgo bo'i thod pa chag gyur cing / klad rgyas mtshan ma snang de bzhin / chu ba rul zhing rtsa chad dang / rma phugs ring dang srin bus zos

verses.skt: asthibhedāt saśalyatvāt saviṣatvād atarkitāt | mithyābandhād atisnehād raukṣyād romādighaṭṭanāt
verses.tib: rus pa chag dang zug rngur bcas / dug bcas pa dang ma rtogs dang / bcing ba nyes dang snum ches dang / rtsub pas spu sogs bdar ba dang

verses.skt: kṣobhād aśuddhakoṣṭhatvāt sauhityād atikarśanāt | madyapānād divāsvapnād vyavāyād rātrijāgarāt
verses.tib: bskyod dang khong pa ma dag dang / 'grangs drags nyams smad drags pa dang / chang 'thungs nyin par gnyid log dang / nyal po la brten mtshan gnyid yar

verses.skt: vraṇo mithyopacārāc ca naiva sādhyo ’pi sidhyati | kapotavarṇapratimā yasyāntaḥ kledavarjitāḥ
verses.tib: rma ni log par gsos pa dag / gsos kyang 'drub par mi 'gyur ro / gang zhig nang ni thi pa'i mdog / 'dra zhing rnags pa med pa dang

verses.skt: sthirāś cipiṭikāvanto rohatīti tam ādiśet | athātra śophāvasthāyāṃ yathāsannaṃ viśodhanam
verses.tib: brtan zhing 'brum bu rnyid bcas pa / 'tsho bar 'gyur bar de bshad do / de nas 'dir skrang gnas skabs su / gang la nye ba de las sbyang

verses.skt: yojyaṃ śopho hi śuddhānāṃ vraṇaś cāśu praśāmyati | kuryāc chītopacāraṃ ca śophāvasthasya saṃtatam
verses.tib: sbyangs pas skrangs par gyur pa dang / rma ni myur du 'tshob par 'gyur / skrangs pa'i skabs su rgyun du ni / nye bar spyod pa bsil bas gso

verses.skt: doṣāgnir agnivat tena prayāti sahasā śamam | śophe vraṇe ca kaṭhine vivarṇe vedanānvite
verses.tib: de yis nad med chu lta bur / mod la zhi bar 'gyur ba yin / rma skrang sra bar gyur pa dang / nad bcas mdog ni mi sdug dang

verses.skt: viṣayukte viśeṣeṇa jalajādyair hared asṛk | duṣṭāsre ’pagate sadyaḥ śopharāgarujāṃ śamaḥ
verses.tib: dug can la ni khyad par du / pad pa sogs shes khrag dbyung ngo / nad khrag bral nas mod la ni / skrang dang mdog dmar nad zhir 'gyur

verses.skt: hṛte hṛte ca rudhire suśītaiḥ sparśavīryayoḥ | suślakṣṇais tadahaḥpiṣṭaiḥ kṣīrekṣusvarasadravaiḥ
verses.tib: khrag dbyung nas ni cung zad lus / reg na nus pa rab bsil ba / shin tu zhib par de nyid btags / bu ram shing khu 'o mas sbrus

verses.skt: śatadhautaghṛtopetair muhur anyair aśoṣibhiḥ | pratilomaṃ hito lepaḥ sekābhyaṅgāś ca tatkṛtāḥ
verses.tib: lan brgyar / bskus pa'i mar dang bcas / gzhan ma skam par yang dang yang / rjes su mthun par bskus na phan / byugs dang blugs pa de bzhin bya

verses.skt: nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣavetasavalkalaiḥ | pradeho bhūrisarpirbhiḥ śophanirvāpaṇaḥ param
verses.tib: u dum bA ra n+ya gro dang / blag sha lcang ma a shwad+tha'i / shun pa mar dang bcas bskus na / skrangs pas sel ba'i mchog yin no

verses.skt: vātolbaṇānāṃ stabdhānāṃ kaṭhinānāṃ mahārujām | srutāsṛjāṃ ca śophānāṃ vraṇānām api cedṛśām
verses.tib: rlung shas che zhing mkhrang ba dang / sra zhing nad tshabs che ba dang / khrag 'dzag pa dang rma skrang ba / 'di lta bu yi rma la ni

verses.skt: ānūpavesavārādyaiḥ svedaḥ somās tilāḥ punaḥ | bhṛṣṭā nirvāpitāḥ kṣīre tatpiṣṭā dāharugharāḥ
verses.tib: rlan can sha btags la dugs bya / zar ma til ni brngos pa dang / 'o mas dbal ni bsad pa dag / de btags bskus na tsha na sel

verses.skt: sthirān mandarujaḥ śophān snehair vātakaphāpahaiḥ | abhyajya svedayitvā ca veṇunāḍyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.tib: rma skrangs brtan zhing nad tshabs chung / bad kan rlung 'joms snum bsku zhing / de yi rjes la 'od ma yi / sbu gus rim gyis dugs bya'o

verses.skt: vimlāpanārthaṃ mṛdnīyāt talenāṅguṣṭhakena vā | yavagodhūmamudgaiś ca siddhapiṣṭaiḥ pralepayet
verses.tib: zhu bar bya phyir lag mthil lam / mthe bo yis ni mnye bar bya / nas dang gro dang mon sran sde'u / btsos te btags pa'i lde gus bsku

verses.skt: vilīyate sa cen naivaṃ tatas tam upanāhayet | avidagdhas tathā śāntiṃ vidagdhaḥ pākam aśnute
verses.tib: gal te de yis ma zhum na / de nas de ni dkri bar bya / ma smin pa ni zhi 'gyur la / smin na rnags pa nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: sakolatilavallomā dadhyamlā saktupiṇḍikā | sakiṇvakuṣṭhalavaṇā koṣṇā śastopanāhane
verses.tib: rgya shug til dang zar ma dang / rgyam tsha phabs dang ru rta'i phye / zho skyur zan dron gyis glan zhing / dugs byas nas ni dkri bar bya

verses.skt: supakve piṇḍite śophe pīḍanair upapīḍite | dāraṇaṃ dāraṇārhasya sukumārasya ceṣyate
verses.tib: legs smin skrangs pa phyogs gcig 'dus / btsir bas nye bar btsir gyur pa / dral bar 'os la dral bya zhing / shin tu 'jam por gyur pa'ang dral

verses.skt: guggulvatasigodantasvarṇakṣīrīkapotaviṭ | kṣārauṣadhāni kṣārāś ca pakvaśophavidāraṇam
verses.tib: gu gul zar ma ba lang so / khron bu phug ron rtug pa dang / thal sman 'phrod dang thal sman de / smin pa'i sman gyis brtol bar bya

verses.skt: pūyagarbhān aṇudvārān sotsaṅgān marmagān api | niḥsnehaiḥ pīḍanadravyaiḥ samantāt pratipīḍayet
verses.tib: nang na rnag 'byung sgo phra zhing / mtho bar gyur dang gnad la gnas / snum med btsir ba'i sman gyis ni / kun nas rab tu btsir bar bya

verses.skt: śuṣyantaṃ samupekṣeta pralepaṃ pīḍanaṃ prati | na mukhe cainam ālimpet tathā doṣaḥ prasicyate
verses.tib: bsku ba bskams na btsir ba yi / las la btang snyoms nyid du bya / de yi rma sgor mi bsku ste / de 'dras nad ni 'byung mi 'gyur

verses.skt: kalāyayavagodhūmamāṣamudgahareṇavaḥ | dravyāṇāṃ picchilānāṃ ca tvaṅmūlāni prapīḍanam
verses.tib: sran ma nas dang gro dang ni / ma sha shu dag bra bo dang / sman ni spyi bag can dag gis / pags pa'i rtsa ba rab tu bsdams

verses.skt: saptasu kṣālanādyeṣu surasāragvadhādikau | bhṛśaṃ duṣṭe vraṇe yojyau mehakuṣṭhavraṇeṣu ca
verses.tib: gcin snyi mdze yi rma dang ni / shas cher red pa'i rma dag la / dong ga bye'u rug pa sogs kyis / lan ni bdun bdun bkru sogs bya

verses.skt: athavā kṣālanaṃ kvāthaḥ paṭolīnimbapattrajaḥ | aviśuddhe viśuddhe tu nyagrodhāditvagudbhavaḥ
verses.tib: ma dag nim pa pa to / la'i / lo ma bskol bas bkru bar bya / rma dag pa la n+ya gro d+ha / la sogs shun lpags bskol bas bkru

verses.skt: paṭolītilayaṣṭyāhvatrivṛddantīniśādvayam | nimbapattrāṇi cālepaḥ sapaṭur vraṇaśodhanaḥ
verses.tib: shing mngar til dang pa to la / dur byid dan da ser po gnyis / nim pa'i lo ma rgya mtshar bcas / lde gus bskus na rma sbyong byed

verses.skt: vraṇān viśodhayed vartyā sūkṣmāsyān saṃdhimarmagān | kṛtayā trivṛtādantīlāṅgalīmadhusaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: rma ni kha phrag nad mtshams gnas / da rgyam tsha lang ka li / dud byid sbrang rtsir sbyar ba yi / reng bur byas pas rma sbyang bya

verses.skt: vātābhibhūtān sāsrāvān dhūpayed ugravedanān | yavājyabhūrjamadanaśrīveṣṭakasurāhvayaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung gis gnod cing khrag bcas shing / mi bzad na la nas dang gro / spra tshil shri ba kra ka dang / thang shing mar bcas dud pas bdug

verses.skt: nirvāpayed bhṛśaṃ śītaiḥ pittaraktaviṣolbaṇān | śuṣkālpamāṃse gambhīre vraṇa utsādanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: khrag mkhris dag gi shas che la / shin tu bsil ba'i sman gyis bsku / skam zhing sha nyung gting ring rma / sha skyed pa yi sman bya ste

verses.skt: nyagrodhapadmakādibhyām aśvagandhābalātilaiḥ | adyān māṃsādamāṃsāni vidhinopahitāni ca
verses.tib: shug pa n+ya gro d+ha sogs dang / ba la a shwa gan+d+ha til / bskus te sha ni bskyed par bya / sha za'i sha ni cho ga bzhin / g.yos su byas te sbyin par bya

verses.skt: māṃsaṃ māṃsādamāṃsena vardhate śuddhacetasaḥ | utsannamṛdumāṃsānāṃ vraṇānām avasādanam
verses.tib: sems dga' ba dang sha za yi / sha zos na ni sha 'phel 'gyur / sha snyi 'bur bar gyur pa la

verses.skt: jātīmukulakāsīsamanohvālapurāgnikaiḥ | utsannamāṃsān kaṭhinān kaṇḍūyuktāṃś cirotthitān
verses.tib: dzA ti'i me tog nag tshur dang / ldong ros ba bla gu gul dang / tsi tra ka sogs lde gus bsku / sha 'bur bar ni sra ba dang / g.ya' zhing ring nas 'tsho ba dang

verses.skt: vraṇān suduḥkhaśodhyāṃś ca śodhayet kṣārakarmaṇā | sravanto ’śmarījā mūtraṃ ye cānye raktavāhinaḥ
verses.tib: rma ni na zhing sbyang dka' la / thal sman las kyis sbyang bar bya / rde'u dbyung rma ni gcin 'dzag dang / gang gzhan khrag ni 'byung ba dang

verses.skt: chinnāś ca saṃdhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktair ye ca śodhanaiḥ | śodhyamānā na śudhyanti śodhyāḥ syus te ’gnikarmaṇā
verses.tib: gang zhig bcad nas sbyar ba dang / ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga yis / gso bar byed bzhin mi 'grub na / de ni me yi las kyis gso / skyon med rma la rma 'byor ba'i

verses.skt: śuddhānāṃ ropaṇaṃ yojyam utsādāya yad īritam | aśvagandhā ruhā lodhraṃ kaṭphalaṃ madhuyaṣṭikā
verses.tib: sman dang sha skyed gang yin sbyar / a shwa gan+d+ha seng phrom dang / shing mngar btsod dang kad pha la

verses.skt: samaṅgā dhātakīpuṣpaṃ paramaṃ vraṇaropaṇam | apetapūtimāṃsānāṃ māṃsasthānām arohatām
verses.tib: da ta ki yi me tog gi / phye ma rma 'tshob byed pa'i mchog / rnag dang sha ni med pa dang / sha yi gnas su ma 'drubs par

verses.skt: kalkaṃ saṃrohaṇaṃ kuryāt tilānāṃ madhukānvitam | snigdhoṣṇatiktamadhurakaṣāyatvaiḥ sa sarvajit
verses.tib: til dang shing mngar bcas pa yi / lde gus rma ni 'tshob par bya / snum dro mngar dang kha ba dang / bska bas thams cad sel bar byed

verses.skt: sa kṣaudranimbapattrābhyāṃ yuktaḥ saṃśodhanaṃ param | pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syād āśu ropaṇaḥ
verses.tib: nim pa'i lo ma sbrang rtsir bcas / bskus pas rma sbyor mchog yin no / snga ma gnyis dang zhun mar sbyar / myur du rma 'tshob byed pa yin

verses.skt: tilavad yavakalkaṃ tu kecid icchanti tadvidaḥ | sāsrapittaviṣāgantugambhīrān soṣmaṇo vraṇān
verses.tib: til 'drar nas kyi lde gu ni / de dang 'dra bar la la 'dod / khrag mkhris dug dang glo bur dang / gting ring tsha dang bcas pa'i rma

verses.skt: kṣīraropaṇabhaiṣajyaśṛtenājyena ropayet | ropaṇauṣadhasiddhena tailena kaphavātajān
verses.tib: 'o ma rma 'byor sman dang ni / bskol ba'i mar gyis rma 'tshob bya / bad kan rlung gyur rma 'byor sman / til mar bcas pas rma 'tshob 'gyur

verses.skt: kācchīlodhrābhayāsarjasindūrāñjanatutthakam | cūrṇitaṃ tailamadanair yuktaṃ ropaṇam uttamam
verses.tib: nag tshur seng phrom a ru ra / li khri dngul rdo sra rtsi pog / spangs ma po son cha'i phye ma / til mar bcas pa rma 'tshob mchog

verses.skt: samānāṃ sthiramāṃsānāṃ tvaksthānāṃ cūrṇa iṣyate | kakubhodumbarāśvatthajambūkaṭphalalodhrajaiḥ
verses.tib: mnyam zhing sha ni brtan pa dang / pags par gnas la phye ma phan / u dum wA ra a shwat+tha / 'dzam bu seng phrom kad pha la

verses.skt: tvakcūrṇaiś cūrṇitā vraṇāḥ tvakcūrṇaiś cūrṇitā vraṇāḥ | lākṣāmanohvāmañjiṣṭhāharitālaniśādvayaiḥ
verses.tib: ka ku seng phrom phye mas gdab / pags pa myur du skyed par byed / rgya skyegs ldong ros btsod dang ni / ba la dang ni ser po gnyis

verses.skt: pralepaḥ saghṛtakṣaudras tvagviśuddhikaraḥ param | kālīyakalatāmrāsthihemakālārasottamaiḥ
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi mar sbyar lde gu yis / bskus na pags pa dag byed mchog / skyer pa a mra'i rus pa dang / nA ga ge sar bri yang ku / tsan+dan ser po dngul chu rnams

verses.skt: lepaḥ sagomayarasaḥ savarṇakaraṇaḥ param | dagdho vāraṇadanto ’ntardhūmaṃ tailaṃ rasāñjanam
verses.tib: lde gu ba lang lci khu dang / sbyar ba bskus par gyur na ni / pags pa mdog 'drar byed mchog yin / ba so dud pa ma shor bsregs / skyer khan+Da dang til mar sbyar

verses.skt: romasaṃjanano lepas tadvat tailapariplutā | catuṣpānnakharomāsthitvakśṛṅgakhurajā maṣī
verses.tib: bskus na spu ni skyed par byed / de bzhin rkang bzhi'i sen mo spu / rus pa pags pa rwa rmig bsregs / snag tsha til mar dang sbyar bas / bskus na spu ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: vraṇinaḥ śastrakarmoktaṃ pathyāpathyānnam ādiśet | dve pañcamūle vargaś ca vātaghno vātike hitaḥ
verses.tib: smin ma la ni cha spyad kyi / las bshad phan dang gnod pa bsten / rlung gyur rma la rtsa ba lnga / gnyis dang rlung 'joms sde tshan phan

verses.skt: nyagrodhapadmakādyau tu tadvat pittapradūṣite | āragvadhādiḥ śleṣmaghnaḥ kaphe miśrās tu miśraje
verses.tib: mkhris gyur shug pa n+ya gro dang / sde tshan gnyis dang mkhris 'joms gtong / bad kan las gyur dong ga'i sde / bad kan 'joms par byed pa gtang / 'dren ma las gyur 'dren mar byas

verses.skt: ebhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ lepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasakriyā | cūrṇo vartiś ca saṃyojya vraṇe sapta yathāyatham
verses.tib: 'di dag gis bkru byugs pa dang / sman mar til mar sman khu dang / phye ma ril bu bdun po ni / rma la ci rigs sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: jātīnimbapaṭolapattrakaṭukādārvīniśāśārivā | mañjiṣṭhābhayasikthatutthamadhukair naktāhvabījānvitaiḥ | sarpiḥ sādhyam anena sūkṣmavadanā marmāśritāḥ kledino | gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ sagatayaḥ śudhyanti rohanti ca
verses.tib: dzA ti nim pa pa to la'i lo ma / skyer pa yung ba thal tres pu tse shel / spra tshil spangs ma shing mngar a ru ra / ka rany+dza yi sa bon btsod dang btsos / mar bskol 'dis ni rma kha chung ba dang / nad la brten zhing rnag ni 'dzag pa dang / rma yi phugs ring nad bcas phugs ring ba'i / rma ni dag cing 'tshob par byed pa yin

verses.skt: sādhitaṃ svarase tailaṃ kākamācyāś caturguṇe | gatibhājām api hitaṃ vraṇānāṃ ropaṇaṃ param
sadyovraṇā ye sahasā saṃbhavanty abhighātataḥ | anantair api tair aṅgam ucyate juṣṭam aṣṭadhā
verses.tib: rma gang snad pas 'phral du ni / byung gyur glo bur rma zhes bya / de ni mtha' yas kyang yan lag / gnas pa rnam pa brgyad du bshad

verses.skt: ghṛṣṭāvakṛttavicchinnapravilambitapātitam | viddhaṃ bhinnaṃ vidalitaṃ tatra ghṛṣṭaṃ lasīkayā
verses.tib: bshus dang bcad dang rnam par bcad / rab tu 'phyang dang lhung ba dang / phug dang gshags dang grugs pa'o

verses.skt: raktaleśena vā yuktaṃ saploṣaṃ chedanāt sravet | avagāḍhaṃ tataḥ kṛttaṃ vicchinnaṃ syāt tato ’pi ca
verses.tib: de la bshus pa chu ser ram / khrag ni nyung zad 'byung 'gyur zhing / pags pa chos pas tsha 'gyur yin / de las tshos gyur bcad pa yin / de las chos pa rnam bcad yin

verses.skt: pravilambi saśeṣe ’sthni patitaṃ pātitaṃ tanoḥ | sūkṣmāsyaśalyaviddhaṃ tu viddhaṃ koṣṭhavivarjitam
verses.tib: rab 'phyang rus par lhag ma lus / lhung ba lus las phogs pa yin / zug rngu phra mo 'bigs pas phug / khong pa ma gtogs bsnun pa yin

verses.skt: bhinnam anyad vidalitaṃ majjaraktapariplutam | prahārapīḍanotpeṣāt sahāsthnā pṛthutāṃ gatam
verses.tib: snga ma las gzhan gshags pa yin / khrag dang rkang ni 'dres gyur pa / mtshon gyis drag tu bsnun pa yis / rus bcas rgya cher snad grugs pa

verses.skt: sadyaḥ sadyovraṇaṃ siñced atha yaṣṭyāhvasarpiṣā | tīvravyathaṃ kavoṣṇena balātailena vā punaḥ
verses.tib: de la 'phral du byung ba'i rma / zug gzer shin tu che ba la / shing mngar mar dang bskol ba'am / ba la'i til mar dro 'jam blugs

verses.skt: kṣatoṣmaṇo nigrahārthaṃ tatkālaṃ visṛtasya ca | kaṣāyaśītamadhurasnigdhā lepādayo hitāḥ
verses.tib: snad pa'i tsha ba zhi bya'i phyir / bsku ba la sogs snum pa dang / bsil dang mngar ba'i sman gyis ni / de yi mdo la blugs par bya

verses.skt: sadyovraṇeṣv āyateṣu saṃdhānārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ | madhusarpiś ca yuñjīta pittaghnīś ca himāḥ kriyāḥ
verses.tib: 'phral gyi rma ni rgya che la / sbyar ba'i phyir ni sbrang rtsi dang / mar gyis mchog tu bsku bya zhing / mkhris 'joms bsil ba'i gso ba bya

verses.skt: sasaṃrambheṣu kartavyam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhanam | upavāso hitaṃ bhuktaṃ pratataṃ raktamokṣaṇam
verses.tib: nad kyi rtsom pa che ba la / steng dang 'og nas sbyang bar bya / smyung ba bya zhing 'bras chan sbyin / rgyun du gtar ga gdab par bya

verses.skt: ghṛṣṭe vidalite caiṣa sutarām iṣyate vidhiḥ | tayor hy alpaṃ sravaty asraṃ pākas tenāśu jāyate
verses.tib: bshus dang grugs pa 'di nyid de / cho ga 'di nyid lhag par sbyar / de gnyis khrag ni nyung shas 'dzag / smin pa'ang myur ba nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: atyartham asraṃ sravati prāyaśo ’nyatra vikṣate | tato raktakṣayād vāyau kupite ’tirujākare
verses.tib: phal cher rma ni shas cher 'byung / gzhan las khrag ni 'byung gyur la / de yis khrag ni zad gyur pas / rlung 'khrugs nad ni skyed pa las

verses.skt: snehapānaparīṣekasvedalepopanāhanam | snehavastiṃ ca kurvīta vātaghnauṣadhasādhitam
verses.tib: rlung 'joms sman dang bskol ba yi / snum blugs pa dang sman chu blugs / dugs dang bsku dang dkri ba dang / snum gyi 'jam rtsi rnams kyang bya

verses.skt: iti sāptāhikaḥ proktaḥ sadyovraṇahito vidhiḥ | saptāhād gatavege tu pūrvoktaṃ vidhim ācaret
verses.tib: de ltar zhag bdun par bshad pa'i / 'phral gyi rma byung cho ga bshad / zhag bdun nas ni shugs zad nas / sngar bshad pa yi cho gas

verses.skt: prāyaḥ sāmānyakarmedaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthak | ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu vraṇe cūrṇāni yojayet
verses.tib: spyad / 'dir ni phal cher spyi'i cho ga / re re'i gso ba bshad bya ste / shus la na ba myur bsal phyir / rma la phan pa'i phye mas gdab

verses.skt: kalkādīny avakṛtte tu vicchinnapravilambinoḥ | sīvanaṃ vidhinoktena bandhanaṃ cānu pīḍanam
verses.tib: bcad pa rma sel lde gus bsku / rnam par bcad dang rab 'phyang la / cho ga bzhin du btsem pa dang / bcing ba dang ni btsir bar bya

verses.skt: asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netram adīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat | saṃniveśya yathāsthānam avyāviddhasiraṃ bhiṣak
verses.tib: mig bcang ba ni gsor mi rung / ma zhar phyir ni 'phyang ba la / rang gi gnas su legs gzhag cing / rtsam 'chol bar byas nas ni

verses.skt: pīḍayet pāṇinā padmapalāśāntaritena tat | tato ’sya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ
verses.tib: pad+ma'i 'dab mas g.yogs nas ni / lag pas dal gyis mnan par bya / de nas shing mngar dzi ba ka / zangs rtsi ba dang ut+pa la / mar dang 'o ma bcas bskol ba'i / sman thigs blugs dang sna sman dang

verses.skt: vipakvam ājaṃ yaṣṭyāhvajīvakarṣabhakotpalaiḥ | sapayaskaiḥ paraṃ tad dhi sarvanetrābhighātajit
verses.tib: brta ba'i cho ga dag kyang bya / mig nad thams cad sel mchog yin / mig phugs zhugs la mgul pa bsdam

verses.skt: galapīḍāvasanne ’kṣṇi vamanotkāsanakṣavāḥ | prāṇāyāmo ’thavā kāryaḥ kriyā ca kṣatanetravat
verses.tib: slon dang lud pa sbrid pa 'byung / yang na dbugs 'byung dbugs brngub bsdam / rma byung mig gi gso ba bya

verses.skt: karṇe sthānāc cyute syūte śrotas tailena pūrayet | kṛkāṭikāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ nirgacchaty api mārute
verses.tib: rna ba bogs pa btsems nas ni / bu ga til mar dag gis dgang / ltag pa'i sum mdo chod gyur te / rlung ni 'byung bar gyur pa la'ang

verses.skt: samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtvā śīghraṃ nirantaram | ājena sarpiṣā cātra pariṣekaḥ praśasyate
verses.tib: mnyam du bzhag ste bar mtshams ni / med par btsems te bcing bar bya / de la ra yi mar sar gyis / blugs pa dag ni rab tu bsngags

verses.skt: uttāno ’nnāni bhuñjīta śayīta ca suyantritaḥ | ghātaṃ śākhāsu tiryaksthaṃ gātre samyaṅniveśite
verses.tib: gan rkyal bzhag ste kha zas sbyin / legs par spyod lam bsdams te nyal / yan lag thad kar gnas pa yi / rma byung yan lag legs gzhag ste

verses.skt: syūtvā vellitabandhena badhnīyād ghanavāsasā | carmaṇā goṣphaṇābandhaḥ kāryaś cāsaṃgate vraṇe
verses.tib: btsems la dkri zhing bcing bya zhing / gos ni mthug pos bcing bar bya / pags pa'i 'ur mthil bcing bas ni / phrag pa'i rma la bcing bar bya

verses.skt: pādau vilambimuṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā | praveśya vṛṣaṇau sīvyet sevanyā tunnasaṃjñayā
verses.tib: rlig pa 'phyang la rkang par ni / sbu gus chu ni gtor nas kyang / rlig pa bcug ste ras bal dang / bcas pa'i khab kyis btsem par bya

verses.skt: kāryaś ca goṣphaṇābandhaḥ kaṭyām āveśya paṭṭakam | snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tatra klidyati hi vraṇaḥ
verses.tib: 'ur mthil bcing bar byas pa la / rked pa nas ni srad bus gdags / der ni rma ni 'dul gyur pas / snum dang dugs kyi las mi bya

verses.skt: kālānusāryagurvelājātīcandanaparpaṭaiḥ | śilādārvyamṛtātutthaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam
verses.tib: pri yang ku dang a ga ru / sug smel dzA ti par pa ta / tsan+dan ldong ros skyer pa dang / sle tres dang ni spangs ma dang / til mar bskol bas rma 'tshob byed

verses.skt: chinnāṃ niḥśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktitaḥ | badhnīyāt kośabandhena tato vraṇavad ācaret
verses.tib: yan lag ma las chad pa la / til mar bskol bas / bsregs nas ni / sgye'u bcing bas bcing bar bya / de nas rma ltar gso bar bya

verses.skt: kāryā śalyāhṛte viddhe bhaṅgād vidalite kriyā | śiraso ’pahṛte śalye vālavartiṃ praveśayet
verses.tib: phug pa zug rngu phyung bas gso / grugs dang chag grugs gso bar bya / mgo bo'i zug rngu dbyung ba la / skra yi ye'u gzhug par bya

verses.skt: mastuluṅgasruteḥ kruddho hanyād enaṃ calo ’nyathā | vraṇe rohati caikaikaṃ śanair apanayet kacam
verses.tib: gzhan du klad rgyas 'dzag pa yis / rlung 'khrugs de ni gsod par 'gyur / rma 'tshob nas ni rim gyis ni / skra ni dal gyis dbyung bar bya

verses.skt: mastuluṅgasrutau khāden mastiṣkān anyajīvajān | śalye hṛte ’ṅgād anyasmāt snehavartiṃ nidhāpayet
verses.tib: klad rgyas 'dzag la srog chags ni / gzhan gyi klad pa sbyin par bya / gzhan las zug rngu phyung nas ni / rma der ring bu snum can gzhug

verses.skt: dūrāvagāḍhāḥ sūkṣmāsyā ye vraṇāḥ srutaśoṇitāḥ | secayec cakratailena sūkṣmanetrārpitena tān
verses.tib: phugs ring kha ni chung ba dang / rma gang rnag dang khrag 'dzag la / 'khor los btsir ba'i til mar blugs / de ni sbu gu chung ngus gtang

verses.skt: bhinne koṣṭhe ’sṛjā pūrṇe mūrchāhṛtpārśvavedanāḥ | jvaro dāhas tṛḍ ādhmānaṃ bhaktasyānabhinandanam
verses.tib: khong pa brtol te khrag gis gang / brgyal zhing snying ga rtsib logs na / rims 'debs lus tsha lto spo skom / zas la mngon par mi dga' zhing

verses.skt: saṅgo viṇmūtramarutāṃ śvāsaḥ svedo ’kṣiraktatā | lohagandhitvam āsyasya syād gātre ca vigandhatā
verses.tib: bshang ba gcin dang 'phyen 'gags la / mig dmar rngul 'byung dbugs mi bde / kha nang khrag gi dri bro zhing / lus kyang dri mi zhim par 'gyur

verses.skt: āmāśayasthe rudhire rudhiraṃ chardayaty api | ādhmānenātimātreṇa śūlena ca viśasyate
verses.tib: ma zhu'i gnas na gnas pa'i khrag / khrag tu yang ni skyug par byed / shin tu shas cher lto spo zhing / gzer nad kyis kyang gnod par byed

verses.skt: pakvāśayasthe rudhire saśūlaṃ gauravaṃ bhavet | nābher adhastāc chītatvaṃ khebhyo raktasya cāgamaḥ
verses.tib: zhu ba'i gnas na gnas pa'i khrag / gzer bcas lus ni lci bar byed / lto ba man chad grang ba dang / bu ga las kyang khrag 'byung 'gyur

verses.skt: abhinno ’py āśayaḥ sūkṣmaiḥ srotobhir abhipūryate | asṛjā syandamānena pārśve mūtreṇa vastivat
verses.tib: gnas ni zhig par ma gyur kyang / khrag ni 'dzag par gyur pa yis / bu ga las ni 'gengs byed de / lgang pa'i ngos nas 'gengs dang 'dra

verses.skt: tatrāntarlohitaṃ śītapādocchvāsakarānanam | raktākṣaṃ pāṇduvadanam ānaddhaṃ ca vivarjayet
verses.tib: khrag nad yod pa de la ni / rkang lag kha dang dbugs grang zhing / mig dmar gdong ni skya pa dang / lto sbo ba ni spang bar bya

verses.skt: āmāśayasthe vamanaṃ hitaṃ pakvāśayāśrite | virecanaṃ nirūhaṃ ca niḥsnehoṣṇair viśodhanaiḥ
verses.tib: ma zhur gnas la skyug sman gtang / zhu ba'i gnas la gnas pa la / bkru sman dang ni ni ru ha / snum med dro bas sbyang bar bya

verses.skt: yavakolakulatthānāṃ rasaiḥ snehavivarjitaiḥ | bhuñjītānnaṃ yavāgūṃ vā pibet saindhavasaṃyutām
verses.tib: nas dang rgya shug rgya sran gyi / khu ba snum ni med pa dang / nas thug kha zas bza' ba dang / lce myang tsha dang ldan pa sbyin

verses.skt: atiniḥsrutaraktas tu bhinnakoṣṭhaḥ pibed asṛk | kliṣṭacchinnāntrabhedena koṣṭhabhedo dvidhā smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: khrag ni mang du 'dzag pa dang / khong pa snad la khrag blud bya / rgyu ma 'byar dang chad par nyen / khong pa snad pa gnyis su bshad

verses.skt: mūrchādayo ’lpāḥ prathame dvitīye tv atibādhakāḥ | kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśayī dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati
verses.tib: dang por brgyal sogs chung ba yin / gnyis pa shas / cher gnod par byed / rgyu ma 'byar ba the tshom bcas / rgyu ma chad pa 'tsho mi 'gyur

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ mārgam āpannā yasya viṇmūtramārutāḥ | vyupadravaḥ sa bhinne ’pi koṣṭhe jīvaty asaṃśayam
verses.tib: gang gi bshang dang gcin dang 'phyen / rang gi lam las byung gyur la / bla brnan med par rdol gyur kyang / 'tsho bar 'gyur bar the tshom med

verses.skt: abhinnam antraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśyaṃ na tv ato ’nyathā | utpaṅgilaśirograstaṃ tad apy eke vadanti tu
verses.tib: ma rdol rgyu ma byung ba ni / gzhug par bya zhing gzhan du min / grog ma'i mgo bo bcad nas ni / de yang gzhug ces pa la smra

verses.skt: prakṣālya payasā digdhaṃ tṛṇaśoṇitapāṃsubhiḥ | praveśayet k ptanakho ghṛtenāktaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.tib: rdul dang khrag dang rtsa yis gos / 'o mas legs par bkrus nas ni / sen mo bregs te mar gyis bskus / rim gyis legs par gzhug par bya

verses.skt: kṣīreṇārdrīkṛtaṃ śuṣkaṃ bhūrisarpiḥpariplutam | aṅgulyā pramṛśet kaṇṭhaṃ jalenodvejayed api
verses.tib: skam po 'o mas spangs nas ni / mar sar mang po bsku bar bya / sor mos mgul pa mnye ba dang / chu yis kyang ni gtor bar bya

verses.skt: tathāntrāṇi viśanty antas tatkālaṃ pīḍayanti ca | vraṇasaukṣmyād bahutvād vā koṣṭham antram anāviśat
verses.tib: de ltar rgyu ma nang zhugs nas / de yi tshe na btsir bar bya / rma kha chung dang sbom pa yis / rgyu ma khong par ma chud na

verses.skt: tatpramāṇena jaṭharaṃ pāṭayitvā praveśayet | yathāsthānaṃ sthite samyak antre sīvyed anu vraṇam
verses.tib: de yi tshad tsam lto ba ni / dbral te nang du gzhug par bya / gnas su legs par 'dug gyur nas / de rjes rgyu ma'i rma btsem bya

verses.skt: sthānād apetam ādatte jīvitaṃ kupitaṃ ca tat | veṣṭayitvānu paṭṭena ghṛtena pariṣecayet
verses.tib: gnas su legs par ma bzhag na / de ni 'khrugs pas 'chi bar 'gyur / de rjes ras kyis dkris nas ni

verses.skt: cūrṇair yathoktaiḥ saṃdhānaṃ kṛtvā kṣaudraghṛtaplutaiḥ | tataḥ kavalikāṃ dattvā veṣṭayed anupūrvaśaḥ
verses.tib: mar gyis bsku zhing blugs par bya / de nas ngan da til mar dang

verses.skt: pāyayeta tataḥ koṣṇaṃ citrātailayutaṃ payaḥ | mṛdukriyārthaṃ śakṛto vāyoś cādhaḥpravṛttaye
verses.tib: sbyar ba'i 'o ma dro 'jam blud / des ni bshang ba snyi ba dang / rlung ni bde bar 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: anuvarteta varṣaṃ ca yathoktaṃ vraṇayantraṇām | udarān medaso vartiṃ nirgatāṃ bhasmanā mṛdā
verses.tib: ji skad bshad pa'i spyod pa bsrung / lo gcig bar du 'bad par bya / lto las tshil ni byung gyur na / thal ba'am ni sa dag gam

verses.skt: avakīrya kaṣāyair vā ślakṣṇair mūlais tataḥ samam | dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā ca sūtreṇa vardhayet kuśalo bhiṣak
verses.tib: ro bska ba yi rtsa ba dag / zhib tu btags pas btab nas ni / de nas srad bus dam du bcing / sman pa mkhas pas gcad par bya

verses.skt: tīkṣṇenāgniprataptena śastreṇa sakṛd eva tu | syād anyathā rug āṭopo mṛtyur vā chidyamānayā
verses.tib: mtshon rnon me la bsregs pa yis / lan cig kho na gcad par bya / gzhan du byas nas gcod pa'i tshe / na zhing sbo 'am 'chi bar 'gyur

verses.skt: sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe sujīrṇe ’nne ghṛtaṃ pibet | kṣīraṃ vā śarkarācitrālākṣāgokṣurakaiḥ śṛtam
verses.tib: sbrang rtsir bcas pas rma bcings la / kha zas zhu nas 'o ma mar / dan te rgya skyegs gze ma dang / shing mngar kha ra bskol ba blud

verses.skt: rugdāhajit sayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ paraṃ pūrvodito vidhiḥ | medogranthyuditaṃ tatra tailam abhyañjane hitam
verses.tib: shing mngar bcas pa sngar gyi ni / cho gas na dang tsha ba sel / tshil gyi rmen bur bshad pa yi / til mar bskus na'ang phan pa yin

verses.skt: tālīśaṃ padmakaṃ māṃsī hareṇvagurucandanam | haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ
verses.tib: bal bu'i lo ma shug pa dang / spang spos ha re Nu ka / dang / a ga ru dang tsan+dan dang / pad+ma'i sa bon ser po gnyis / u shi ra dang shing mngar bcas

verses.skt: pakvaṃ sadyovraṇeṣūktaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇam uttamam | gūḍhaprahārābhihate patite viṣamoccakaiḥ
verses.tib: bskol ba 'phral gyi rma la ni / 'tsho bar byed pa'i dam par bshad / mtshon gyis bsnun pas mi mngon pa / g.yang sa mthon po nas lhung ba / rlung mkhris 'joms sman 'drangs pa dang / mnye dang bsku dang sbyang ba bya / lus tshigs bye dang mnyes pa dang / gnad du bsnun pas nyen pa la

verses.skt: kāryaṃ vātāsrajit tṛptimardanābhyañjanādikam | viśliṣṭadehaṃ mathitaṃ kṣīṇaṃ marmāhataṃ hatam
verses.tib: bskol ba 'phral gyi rma la ni / 'tsho bar byed pa'i dam par bshad / mtshon gyis bsnun pas mi mngon pa / g.yang sa mthon po nas lhung ba / rlung mkhris 'joms sman 'drangs pa dang / mnye dang bsku dang sbyang ba bya / lus tshigs bye dang mnyes pa dang / gnad du bsnun pas nyen pa la

verses.skt: vāsayet tailapūrṇāyāṃ droṇyāṃ māṃsarasāśinam
verses.tib: snod chen til mar gyis bkang bar / gzhug cing sha khu sbyin par bya

verses.skt: pātaghātādibhir dvedhā bhaṅgo ’sthnāṃ saṃdhyasaṃdhitaḥ | prasāraṇākuñcanayor aśaktiḥ saṃdhimuktatā
verses.tib: lhung dang snad sogs kyis rus tshigs / tshigs dang tshigs min chag gyur gnyis / tshigs byung gyur na brkyang dang bskum / nus pa med pa nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: itarasmin bhṛśaṃ śophaḥ sarvāvasthāsv ativyathā | aśaktiś ceṣṭite ’lpe ’pi pīḍyamāne saśabdatā
verses.tib: gzhan dag shin tu skrangs pa dang / gnas skabs kun tu rab tu na / bskyod pa chung ngu'ang mi nus shing / btsir na sgra dang bcas pa yin

verses.skt: samāsād iti bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ bahudhā tu tat | bhidyate bhaṅgabhedena tasya sarvasya sādhanam
verses.tib: de ltar chag grugs mdor bsdus pa'i / mtshan nyid yin te de dbye ba / chag pa'i dbye bas du mar 'gyur / de dag kun gyi gso ba ni

verses.skt: yathā syād upayogāya tathā tad upadekṣyate | prājyāṇudāri yat tv asthi sparśe śabdaṃ karoti yat
verses.tib: ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du ni / de bzhin de ni nye bar bstan / mang du phra mor chag pa dang / reg na sgra ni 'khrol ba dang

verses.skt: yatrāsthileśaḥ praviśen madhyam asthno vidāritaḥ | bhagnaṃ yac cābhighātena kiñcid evāvaśeṣitam
verses.tib: gang du rus pa chag pa yi / bar du rus pa phra mo zhugs / yang na snad pas chag pa las / cung zad lus par gyur pa dang

verses.skt: unnamyamānaṃ kṣatavad yac ca majjani majjati | tad duḥsādhyaṃ kṛśāśaktavātalālpāśinām api
verses.tib: gang yang bteg pa'i tshe na ni / rma ltar rkang du nub pa dang / nus zhan sbig par gyur pa dang / rlung can nyung zad spang bar bya

verses.skt: bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ yat kaṭyāṃ saṃdhimuktaṃ cyutaṃ ca yat | jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yat tad vivarjayet
verses.tib: dpyi yi rus mig chag pa dang / gang yang tshigs bye lhung pa dang / ro smad zhib tu grugs pa'am / chag par gyur pa gang yin dang

verses.skt: asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tathā | yac ca bhagnaṃ bhavec chaṅkhaśiraḥpṛṣṭhastanāntare
verses.tib: thod pa'i mtshams ni ma 'byor ba'am / de bzhin dpral ba phye mar gyur / gang yang mur 'gram chag pa dang / ltag pa nu ma'i par chad spang

verses.skt: samyagyamitam apy asthi durnyāsād durnibandhanāt | saṃkṣobhād api yad gacched vikriyāṃ tad vivarjayet
verses.tib: rus pa legs par chag gyur kyang / bzhag nyes bcings ni nyes pa dang / gang zhig bskyod pas gnod gyur pa / de yang spang bar bya ba yin

verses.skt: ādito yac ca durjātam asthi saṃdhir athāpi vā | taruṇāsthīni bhujyante bhajyante nalakāni tu
verses.tib: gdod nas rus pa'i tshigs dag ni / nyes par skyes gyur de yang spang / rus pa gzhon nu gug pa dang

verses.skt: kapālāni vibhidyante sphuṭanty anyāni bhūyasā | athāvanatam unnamyam unnataṃ cāvapīḍayet
verses.tib: sbu ba can chag par gyur pa dang / thod pa gyes par gyur pa dang / gzhan yang mang du gas pa rnams / de nas dma' ba bstod par bya / mthon po mnan par bya ba yin

verses.skt: āñched atikṣiptam adhogataṃ copari vartayet | āñchanotpīḍanonnāmacarmasaṃkṣepabandhanaiḥ
verses.tib: nung du nub pa drang bar bya / 'og tu song ba steng du drang / 'degs dang mnan dang smad pa dang / pags pa bsdus te bcing ba dang

verses.skt: saṃdhīñ charīragān sarvāṃś calān apy acalān api | ity etaiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ samyak saṃsthāpya niścalam
verses.tib: de ltar bzhag pa'i thabs kyis ni / lus su gtogs pa'i tshigs thams cad / g.yo ba'am mi g.yo gang yang rung / legs par bzhag ste mi 'gyur bya

verses.skt: paṭṭaiḥ prabhūtasarpirbhiḥ veṣṭayitvā sukhais tataḥ | kadambodumbarāśvatthasarjārjunapalāśajaiḥ
verses.tib: ras ma mar ni mang bas dkri / u dum bA ra ka dam pa / ardzu na dang a shwat+tha / sardza dang ni pa la sha

verses.skt: vaṃśodbhavair vā pṛthubhis tanubhiḥ suniveśitaiḥ | suślakṣṇaiḥ sapratistambhair valkalaiḥ śakalair api
verses.tib: 'od ma las byung shun zheng che / 'jam pas legs par 'jar ba dang / rten dang bcas shing mi 'gyur ba'i / shun pa'am dum bu dag dang ni

verses.skt: kuśāhvayaiḥ samaṃ bandhaṃ paṭṭasyopari yojayet | śithilena hi bandhena saṃdhisthairyaṃ na jāyate
verses.tib: 'jag mas legs par dkri bya zhing / ras kyis steng du glan par bya / bcing ba lhod par gyur pa yis / mtshams sbyor brtan por mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: gāḍhenāti rujādāhapākaśvayathusaṃbhavaḥ | tryahāt tryahād ṛtau gharme saptāhān mokṣayed dhime
verses.tib: dam pos shin tu na zhing tsha / rnag dang skrangs pa 'byung bar 'gyur / sos ka'i dus su zhag gsum / dgun gyi dus su bdun nas dgrol

verses.skt: sādhāraṇe tu pañcāhād bhaṅgadoṣavaśena vā | nyagrodhādikaṣāyeṇa tataḥ śītena secayet
verses.tib: thun mong dus su zhag lnga nas / yang na chag pa'i dbang las dgrol / de nas n+ya gro d+ha sogs pa'i / khu ba bsil ba'i chu blugs bya

verses.skt: taṃ pañcamūlapakvena payasā tu savedanam | sukhoṣṇaṃ vāvacāryaṃ syāc cakratailaṃ vijānatā
verses.tib: de ni nang bcas rtsa ba lnga / 'o ma bskol ba blugs par bya / mkhas pas til mar 'khor los btsir / rlung 'joms sran dang bcas pa ni / dro 'jam tsam ni bsku bar bya

verses.skt: vibhajya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca vātaghnauṣadhasaṃyutam | pratataṃ sekalepāṃś ca vidadhyād bhṛśaśītalān
verses.tib: dus dang yul gyi dbye bas bya / khu ba shin tu grang mo ni / rgyun du blugs shing lde gus bsku

verses.skt: gṛṣṭikṣīraṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ madhurauṣadhasādhitam | prātaḥ prātaḥ pibed bhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yutam
verses.tib: ba gsar 'o ma mar dang bcas / mngar ba'i sman dang bskol ba dag / rgya skyegs khu bar bcas pa ni / chag grugs can la nang re blud

verses.skt: savraṇasya tu bhagnasya vraṇo madhughṛtottaraiḥ | kaṣāyaiḥ pratisāryo ’tha śeṣo bhaṅgoditaḥ kramaḥ
verses.tib: chag grugs rma dang bcas pa ni / rma la shing mngar mar shas che / lde gu bskus pa'am yang na ni / lhag ma chag grugs lta bur gso

verses.skt: lambāni vraṇamāṃsāni pralipya madhusarpiṣā | saṃdadhīta vraṇān vaidyo bandhanaiś copapādayet
verses.tib: rma yi sha ni 'phyang ba la / sbrang rtsi mar gyis bskus nas ni / sman pas rma ni kha sbyar nas / bcing ba dag kyang legs par bya

verses.skt: tān samān susthitāñ jñātvā phalinīlodhrakaṭphalaiḥ | samaṅgādhātakīyuktaiś cūrṇitair avacūrṇayet
verses.tib: de ni mnyam zhing legs bzhag nas / pri yang ku dang kad / pa la / seng phrom btsod dang da ta ki / phye mas legs par bdar bya'am

verses.skt: dhātakīlodhracūrṇair vā rohanty āśu tathā vraṇāḥ | iti bhaṅga upakrāntaḥ sthiradhātor ṛtau hime
verses.tib: seng phrom da ta ki'i phye ma / btab na myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur / de ltar chag grugs gso ba yin / lus zungs brtan la dgun gyi tshe

verses.skt: māṃsalasyālpadoṣasya susādhyo dāruṇo ’nyathā | pūrvamadhyāntavayasām ekadvitriguṇaiḥ kramāt
verses.tib: sha chen nad gzhi chung ba'i rma / gso sla gzhan ni gso bar dka' / na tshod dang po bar ma mtha' / zla gcig gnyis dang gsum rim gyis

verses.skt: māsaiḥ sthairyaṃ bhavet saṃdher yathoktaṃ bhajatāṃ vidhim | kaṭījaṅghorubhagnānāṃ kapāṭaśayanaṃ hitam
verses.tib: cho ga ji skad bshad bsten na / rma 'byor brtan par 'gyur ba yin / rked pa rje ngar brla chag na / spang leb la ni nyal na phan

verses.skt: yantraṇārthaṃ tathā kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ | jaṅghorvoḥ pārśvayor dvau dvau tala ekaś ca kīlakaḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin bsdams phyir phur pa lnga / byas nas nye bar brtod bya ste / rje dar ngos gnyis la gnyis gnyis / rkang mthil drang po gcig bzhag brtod

verses.skt: śroṇyāṃ vā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vā vakṣasy akṣakayos tathā | vimokṣe bhagnasaṃdhīnāṃ vidhim evaṃ samācaret
verses.tib: sta zur ram ni sgal tshigs sam / gdong dang de bzhin phrag pa rus / tshigs byung chag grugs byung gyur na / cho ga 'di bzhin spyad par bya

verses.skt: saṃdhīṃś ciravimuktāṃs tu snigdhasvinnān mṛdūkṛtān | uktair vidhānair buddhyā ca yathāsvaṃ sthānam ānayet
verses.tib: tshigs ni byung nas yun ring la / snum bsku dugs kyis mnyen byas te / 'di bshad thabs dang rang gi blos / rang gi gnas su legs par gzhug

verses.skt: asaṃdhibhagne rūḍhe tu viṣamolbaṇasādhite | āpothya bhaṅgaṃ yamayet tato bhagnavad ācaret
verses.tib: tshigs min chag ste 'drubs pa dang / bcings nyes pa yis gsos pa la / brdungs te chag grugs bsrang bar bya / de nas chag grugs bzhin du gso

verses.skt: bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak | pakvamāṃsasirāsnāyuḥ saṃdhiḥ śleṣaṃ na gacchati
verses.tib: chag nas ci nas ma rnags pa / de ltar sman pas 'bad par bya / sha dang rtsa rgyus 'drul na ni / tshigs ni 'drubs par mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: vātavyādhivinirdiṣṭān snehān bhagnasya yojayet | catuṣprayogān balyāṃś ca vastikarma ca śīlayet
verses.tib: chag grugs can la rlung nad kyi / skabs bshad snum ni sbyar bar bya / stobs bskyed sbyor ba bzhi po dang / 'jam rtsi'i las kyang bsten par bya

verses.skt: śālyājyarasadugdhādyaiḥ pauṣṭikair avidāhibhiḥ | mātrayopacared bhagnaṃ saṃdhisaṃśleṣakāribhiḥ
verses.tib: sA lu'i chan ngang sha khu mar / 'o ma rgyas byed bsil ba bsten / chag grugs can la rus pa'i mtshams / 'byor byed tshad tsam sbyin par bya

verses.skt: glānir na śasyate tasya saṃdhiviśleṣakṛd dhi sā | lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāram amlaṃ maithunam ātapam | vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bhojanam
verses.tib: de ni mtshams sbyor byed pas na / rmya bar byed pa bsngags pa yin / lan tshwa tsha dang thal sman dang / snum dang nyal po nyi tshan dang / rtsol ba bsten par mi bya zhing / chag grugs zas rtsub bsten mi bya

verses.skt: kṛṣṇāṃs tilān virajaso dṛḍhavastrabaddhān sapta kṣapā vahati vāriṇi vāsayet | saṃśoṣayed anudinaṃ pravisārya caitān kṣīre tathaiva madhukakvathite ca toye
verses.tib: til nag phub ma med pa ras sra'i nang du gtums / chu yi nang du zhag bdun nye bar spangs gyur cing / 'di ni bteg ste nyin re legs par bskams nas ni / de bzhin 'o ma chu dang shing mngar / nang du bskol

verses.skt: punar api pītapayaskāṃs tān pūrvavad eva śoṣitān bāḍham | vigatatuṣān arajaskān saṃcūrṇya sucūrṇitair yuñjyāt
verses.tib: slar yang 'o mar snga ma bzhin du spangs te bskams / phub ma med cing rdul med zhib tu btags nas ni

verses.skt: naladavālakalohitayaṣṭikānakhamiśiplavakuṣṭhabalātrayaiḥ | agurukuṅkumacandanaśārivāsaralasarjarasāmaradārubhiḥ
verses.tib: spang spos ba la ka dang btsod dang chu srin sen / shu ti ku tan nad ru rta ba la gsum / tsan+dan gur gum dang ni thal tres a ga ru / sgron shing sra rtsi pog dang thang shing shug pa'i sde

verses.skt: padmakādigaṇopetais tilapiṣṭaṃ tataś ca tat | samastagandhabhaiṣajyasiddhadugdhena pīḍayet
verses.tib: de yi phye ma dri zhim 'o ma lhan cig btags / dri yi sman ni ma lus 'o mar bskol ba btsir

verses.skt: śaileyarāsnāṃśumatīkaserukālānusārīnatapattralodhraiḥ | sakṣīraśuklaiḥ sapayaḥ sadūrvais tailaṃ pacet tan naladādibhiś ca
verses.tib: rdo dreg ra sna aM shu ma ti dang / ka she ru dang gan+d+ha bri yang ku / rgya spos gan+d+ha b+ha dra seng phrom dang / pa ya s+ya dang mur ba 'o mar bcas / spang spos sogs dang til mar de bskol ba

verses.skt: gandhatailam idam uttamam asthisthairyakṛj jayati cāśu vikārān | vātapittajanitān ativīryān vyāpino ’pi vividhair upayogaiḥ
verses.tib: dri yi til mar mchog 'dis rus pa dag / brtan zhing myur du zhi bar byed mchog yin / rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur nad kyis khyab / sbyor ba sna tshogs bsten pas sel ba yin

verses.skt: hastyaśvapṛṣṭhagamanakaṭhinotkaṭakāsanaiḥ | arśonidānābhihitair aparaiś ca niṣevitaiḥ
verses.tib: glang po rta la zhon te 'gro / gnas dang mal sar tsog pur 'dug / gzhang 'brum nad kyi rgyur bshad dang / gzhan la'ang brten par gyur pa dang

verses.skt: aniṣṭādṛṣṭapākena sadyo vā sādhugarhaṇaiḥ | prāyeṇa piṭikāpūrvo yo ’ṅgule dvyaṅgule ’pi vā
verses.tib: mi dge smin par gyur pa dang / 'phral du dam pa la smad pas / phal cher 'brum phran dang por 'byung / rkub kyi phyi'am nang du ni / rma ni sor tshad gnyis sam gcig

verses.skt: pāyor vraṇo ’ntar bāhyo vā duṣṭāsṛṅmāṃsago bhavet | vastimūtrāśayābhyāsagatatvāt syandanātmakaḥ
verses.tib: sha khrag gnod par gyur las 'byung / chu sor gcin gyi gnas nye bar / byung bas 'dzag pa'i rang bzhin can / de ni mtshan par rdol zhes bya

verses.skt: bhagandaraḥ sa sarvāṃś ca dārayaty akriyāvataḥ | bhagavastigudāṃs teṣu dīryamāṇeṣu bhūribhiḥ
verses.tib: kun kyang ma gsos 'drul byed cing / mo mtshan chu so gzhang gi bar / shas cher 'jig par byed pa dang

verses.skt: vātamūtraśakṛcchukraṃ khaiḥ sūkṣmair vamati kramāt | doṣaiḥ pṛthag yutaiḥ sarvair āgantuḥ so ’ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: bshang gci 'phyen dang khu chu ni / bu ga'i nang nas rim gyis 'byung / nad gzhi re re ldan pa 'dus / glo bur ba dang brgyad du bshang

verses.skt: apakvaṃ piṭikāṃ āhuḥ pākaprāptaṃ bhagandaram | gūḍhamūlāṃ sasaṃrambhāṃ rugāḍhyāṃ rūḍhakopinīm
verses.tib: ma smin 'brum bu zhes byar bshad / smin pa mtshan bar rdol yin no / rtsa ba mi mngon nad tshabs che / shas cher g.yos shing rma 'khyims 'khrugs

verses.skt: bhagandarakarīṃ vidyāt piṭikāṃ na tv ato ’nyathā | tatra śyāvāruṇā todabhedasphuraṇarukkarī
verses.tib: mtshan bar rdol 'gyur shes par bya / de las gzhan du de mi byed / de las rlung gyur 'brum bu ni / dmar zhing gnag la na ba dang

verses.skt: piṭikā mārutāt pittād uṣṭragrīvāvad ucchritā | rāgiṇī tanur ūṣmāḍhyā jvaradhūmāyanānvitā
verses.tib: zug cing 'phar bar byed pa yin / mkhris gyur rnga mo'i mgrin ltar ring / dmar zhing srab la shas cher tsha / thal mdog dud pa 'thul bcas yin

verses.skt: sthirā snigdhā mahāmūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūmatī kaphāt | śyāvā tāmrā sadāhoṣā ghorarug vātapittajā
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur brtan zhing snum / rtsa ba che zhing mdog skya g.ya' / rlung mkhris las gyur mdog gnag cing / dmar zhing tsha la mi bzod na

verses.skt: pāṇḍurā kiñcidāśyāvā kṛcchrapākā kaphānilāt | pādāṅguṣṭhasamā sarvair doṣair nānāvidhavyathā
verses.tib: bad rlung las gyur cung zad gnag / smin par dka' ba'i mtshan nyid can / 'dus gyur rkang pa'i mthe bo 'dra / nad ni sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: śūlārocakatṛḍdāhajvaracchardirupadrutā | vraṇatāṃ yānti tāḥ pakvāḥ pramādāt tatra vātajā
verses.tib: gzer dang skam dad yi ga 'chus / rims dang slon sogs kyis gnod byed / yal bar bor la smin pa dang / rma nyid du ni 'gyur ba yin / de la rlung gyur 'brum bu ni

verses.skt: cīyate ’ṇumukhaiś chidraiḥ śataponakavat kramāt | acchaṃ sravadbhir āsrāvam ajasraṃ phenasaṃyutam
verses.tib: kha phra mang pos khyab byed de / ko tshags bzhin du kha mang zhing / rim 'phel chu ser sla ba dang / lbu ba can ni rgyun du 'dzag

verses.skt: śataponakasaṃjño ’yam uṣṭragrīvas tu pittajaḥ | bahupicchāparisrāvī parisrāvī kaphodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: ko tshags kha brgya pa zhes bya / mkhris pa las gyur rnga mo'i mgrin / bad kan las gyur spyi bag ni / mang 'dzag yongs su 'dzag ces bya

verses.skt: vātapittāj parikṣepī parikṣipya gudaṃ gatiḥ | jāyate paritas tatra prākāraṃ parikheva ca
verses.tib: rlung mkhris las gyur bshang sgor ni / yongs su mched pa kun khyab cing / der ni ra ba'i 'obs kyis ni / bskor ba lta bur 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: ṛjur vātakaphād ṛjvyā gudo gatyātra dīryate | kaphapitte tu pūrvotthaṃ durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ
verses.tib: rlung dang bad kan las gyur grang / gzhan du drang por song 'gas byed / bad mkhris las gyur sngar bshad pa'i / gzhang 'brum la brten de ldang zhing

verses.skt: arśomūle tataḥ śophaḥ kaṇḍūdāhādimān bhavet | sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno ’sya kledayan mūlam arśasaḥ
verses.tib: de las gzhang 'brum rtsa bar g.ya' / skrang dang tsha ba la sogs skyed / de ni myur smin rdol gyur na / gzhang 'brum rtsa ba rnag can yin

verses.skt: sravaty ajasraṃ gatibhir ayam arśobhagandaraḥ | sarvajaḥ śambukāvartaḥ śambūkāvartasaṃnibhaḥ
verses.tib: rgyun mi chad par 'dzag byed de / gzhang 'brum 'di ni mtshan bar rdol / 'dus pa las gyur dung 'dra ba / dung ni 'khyil pa'i dbyibs dang 'dra

verses.skt: gatayo dārayanty asmin rugvegair dāruṇair gudam | asthileśo ’bhyavahṛto māṃsagṛddhyā yadā gudam
verses.tib: 'di yis gzhang ni zhig byed cing / mi bzad lam ni zhig par byed / gang tshe sha la brkam pa yis / rus pa'i dum bu zos gyur pas

verses.skt: kṣiṇoti tiryaṅ nirgacchann unmārgaṃ kṣatato gatiḥ | syāt tataḥ pūyadīrṇāyāṃ māṃsakothena tatra ca
verses.tib: thad kar song bas lam log zhugs / rdol zhing snad par byed pa yin / de tshags pas rnags pa dang / sha ni 'drul bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: jāyante kṛmayas tasya khādantaḥ parito gudam | vidārayanti na cirād unmārgī kṣatajaś ca saḥ
verses.tib: der ni srin bu skye 'gyur zhing / gzhang ni kun tu za bar byed / ring por mi thogs des 'jig byed / de / ni lam log rma skyes yin

verses.skt: teṣu rugdāhakaṇḍvādīn vidyād vraṇaniṣedhataḥ | ṣaṭ kṛcchrasādhanās teṣāṃ nicayakṣatajau tyajet
verses.tib: de las na tsha g.ya' la sogs / rma gso ba las shes par bya / de las drug po gso dka' yin / 'dus gyur rma skyes spang bar bya

verses.skt: pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam | athāsya piṭikām eva tathā yatnād upācaret
verses.tib: sel ba'i gnyer mar phyin pa dang / srubs mtshams la ni brten pa'ang spang / de nas 'brum bu'i tshe nyid ni / 'di ni 'bad de gso bar bya

verses.skt: śuddhyasṛksrutisekādyair yathā pākaṃ na gacchati | pāke punar upasnigdhaṃ sveditaṃ cāvagāhataḥ
verses.tib: sbyang dang gtar ga chu blugs sogs / ci nas smin par mi 'gyur bar / 'di ni 'bad de gso bar bya / smin nas slar yang snum chos dang / dugs byas nas ni lus spying bya

verses.skt: yantrayitvārśasam iva paśyet samyag bhagandaram | arvācīnaṃ parācīnam antarmukhabahirmukham
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum lta bur bsdams nas ni / gting ring legs par brtag bya zhing / rtsa ba'am ni rtse mo'am / phyi bltas nang du bltas pa brtags

verses.skt: athāntarmukham eṣitvā samyak śastreṇa pāṭayet | bahirmukhaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet
verses.tib: de la nang bltas btsal nas ni / gtsags bus legs par gcad par bya / phyir bltas ma lus par bcad la / thal sman dag gis gso bar bya / de nas thal sman btab pa'am

verses.skt: agninā vā bhiṣak sādhu kṣāreṇaivoṣṭrakandharam | nāḍīr ekāntarāḥ kṛtvā pāṭayec chataponakam
verses.tib: yang na sman pas me btsa' gdab / rnga mo'i mgrin la thal sman bsku / ko tshags kha brgya sbubs gcig pa / bcug nas legs par gcad par bya

verses.skt: tāsu rūḍhāsu śeṣāś ca mṛtyur dīrṇe gude ’nyathā | parikṣepiṇi cāpy evaṃ nāḍyuktaiḥ kṣārasūtrakaiḥ
verses.tib: de 'drubs nas ni lhag ma'ang gcad / gzhan du gzhang ni zhig nas 'chi / 'obs ltar khyab pa'ang de bzhin du / thal sman pa gcin sbu gus gso

verses.skt: arśobhagandare pūrvam arśāṃsi pratisādhayet | tyaktvopacaryaḥ kṣatajaḥ śalyaṃ śalyavatas tataḥ
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol la sngar / gzhang 'brum la ni sman phye gdab / rma skyes pa la re thag bcad / zug rngu dbyung ba'i cho ga bzhin / zug rngu phyung ste srin 'joms pa'i / bza' dang byug pa sbyar bar bya / glan dugs sbu gu can la sogs / snum chos legs sbyar nad la phan

verses.skt: āharec ca tathā dadyāt kṛmighnaṃ lepabhojanam | piṇḍanāḍyādayaḥ svedāḥ susnigdhā ruji pūjitāḥ
verses.tib: gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol la sngar / gzhang 'brum la ni sman phye gdab / rma skyes pa la re thag bcad / zug rngu dbyung ba'i cho ga bzhin / zug rngu phyung ste srin 'joms pa'i / bza' dang byug pa sbyar bar bya / glan dugs sbu gu can la sogs / snum chos legs sbyar nad la phan

verses.skt: sarvatra ca bahucchidre chedān ālocya yojayet | gotīrthasarvatobhadradalalāṅgalalāṅgalān
verses.tib: ko tshags 'dra dang thams cad la / ba lang dogs dang kun tu bzang / gshol phyed pa dang gshol gyis bya / brtags te nye bar sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: pārśvaṃ gatena śastreṇa cchedo gotīrthako mataḥ | sarvataḥ sarvatobhadraḥ pārśvacchedo ’rdhalāṅgalaḥ
verses.tib: ngos su 'debs par byed pa'i mtshon / ba lang ngogs zhes bya bar bshad / kun tu gtong ba kun tu bzang / ngos la gcod pa gshol phyed pa

verses.skt: pārśvadvaye lāṅgalakaḥ samastāṃś cāgninā dahet | āsrāvamārgān niḥśeṣaṃ naivaṃ vikurute punaḥ
verses.tib: ngos gnyis su ni gshol gyis bcad / 'dzag pa'i lam ni ma lus pa / thams cad me yis bsreg par bya / slar yang 'di lta'i gnod mi bskyed

verses.skt: yateta koṣṭhaśuddhau ca bhiṣak tasyāntarāntarā | lepo vraṇe biḍālāsthi triphalārasakalkitam
verses.tib: sman pas de yi bar bar du / de yi lto sbyang la 'bad bya / byi la'i rus / pa 'bras bu gsum / khu ba lde gur byas pas bsku

verses.skt: jyotiṣmatīmalayulāṅgaliśelupāṭhākumbhāgnisarjakaravīravacāsudhārkaiḥ | abhyañjanāya vipaceta bhagandarāṇāṃ tailaṃ vadanti paramaṃ hitam etad eṣām
verses.tib: dzo ti sma ti ma la yu / sle sman ta ka bi sha l+ya / dur byid pa ti ba tra ka / ka ra bI ra sra rtsi pog / shu dag su d+ha k+Shir dang / arka'i lo ma til mar bskol / mtshan bar rdol la bskus na ni / 'di ni phan byed mchog tu bshad

verses.skt: madhukalodhrakaṇātruṭireṇukādvirajanīphalinīpaṭuśārivāḥ | kamalakesarapadmakadhātakīmadanasarjarasāmayarodikāḥ
verses.tib: shing mngar seng phrom pi pi ling / sug smel ha re Nu ka dang / ser po gnyis dang pri yang+ku / rgyam tsha thal tres shug pa dang / pad+ma'i snying po da ta ki

verses.skt: sabījapūracchadanair ebhis tailaṃ vipācitam | bhagandarāpacīkuṣṭhamadhumehavraṇāpaham
verses.tib: spra tshil ru rta sra rtsi pog / kha lung 'o mar bcas pa dang / til mar lhan cig bskol ba yis / bskus na 'brum bu mdze dang rma / gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra ba 'joms

verses.skt: madhutailayutā viḍaṅgasāratriphalāmāgadhikākaṇāś ca līḍhāḥ | kṛmikuṣṭhabhagandarapramehakṣatanāḍīvraṇaropaṇā bhavanti
verses.tib: byi dang ka snying 'bras bu gsum / pi pi ling rtsa pi pi ling / sbrang rtsi til mar sbyar ba yi / lde gu zos na srin bu'i nad / mtshan bar rdol dang mdze nad dang / gcin snyi ba dang smas pa dang / rma 'khyims 'tsho bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: amṛtātruṭivellavatsakaṃ kalipathyāmalakāni gugguluḥ | kramavṛddham idaṃ madhudrutaṃ piṭikāsthaulyabhagandarāñ jayet
verses.tib: sle tres sug smel byi dang ka / dug mo nyung dang ba ru ra / skyu ru ra dang a ru ra / gu gul rim gyis cha res bskyed / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba 'di zos na / 'brum bu sbom dang mtshan bar rdol / nad ni sel bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: māgadhikāgnikaliṅgaviḍaṅgair bilvaghṛtaiḥ savarāpalaṣaṭkaiḥ | guggulunā sadṛśena sametaiḥ kṣaudrayutaiḥ sakalāmayanāśaḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka / byi dang ga dang dug mo nyung / cha mnyam phyed kyi 'bras bu gsum / kun dang cha mnyam gu gul dang / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu yis / nad ni thams cad 'joms par byed

verses.skt: guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā triphalā ca pṛthak syāt | tvaktruṭikarṣayutaṃ madhulīḍhaṃ kuṣṭhabhagandaragulmagatighnam
verses.tib: gu gul srang lda pi pi ling / 'bras bu gsum ni srang re dang / shing tsha sug smel zho gnyis gnyis / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu ni / zos na mtshan bar rdol ba dang / mdze dang skran nad 'joms par byed

verses.skt: śṛṅgaverarajoyuktaṃ tad eva ca subhāvitam | kvāthena daśamūlasya viśeṣād vātarogajit
verses.tib: de nyid dang ni bca' sga'i phye / legs par bsres par gyur pa dang / rtsa ba bcu yi khu bar bsres / mchog tu rlung gi nad sel byed

verses.skt: uttamākhadirasārajaṃ rajaḥ śīlayann asanavāribhāvitam | hanti tulyamahiṣākṣamākṣikaṃ kuṣṭhamehapiṭikābhagandarān
verses.tib: seng ldeng snying po 'bras bu gsum gyi phye / a sa na bskol khu ba dang bsres dang / cha mnyam gu gul sbrang rtsi lde gur byas / mdze 'brum gcin snyi mtshan bar rdol nad sel

verses.skt: bhagandareṣv eṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni | vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanāc ca samyag viditvaupayikaṃ vidadhyāt
verses.tib: 'di ni mtshan bar rdol gso'i bye brag bshad / sman gyi mtshan nyid lhag ma gang yin pa / rma yi dbang byas yongs su bsten pa dang / gso thabs dgos pa legs par brtags te sbyar

verses.skt: aśvapṛṣṭhagamanaṃ calarodhaṃ madyamaithunam ajīrṇam asātmyam | sāhasāni vividhāni ca rūḍhe vatsaraṃ parihared adhikaṃ vā
verses.tib: rta zhon stobs 'gyed shugs ni / 'gegs pa dang / chang 'thungs nyal po ma zhum goms dang / drag shul las ni sna tshogs rma 'drubs na / lo gcig bar ram de las lhag pa spang

verses.skt: kaphapradhānāḥ kurvanti medomāṃsāsragā malāḥ | vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ sa granthir grathanāt smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: nad ni bad kan shas che ba / khrag dang sha dang tshil la brten / zlum zhing mtho bar skrangs pa de / mdud pa 'dra bas rmen bur bshad

verses.skt: doṣāsramāṃsamedo'sthisirāvraṇabhavā nava | te tatra vātād āyāmatodabhedānvito ’sitaḥ
verses.tib: de ni nad gzhi khrag sha tshil / rus rtsa rma las gyur pa dgu / de la rlung gyur rgya che zhing / zug cing bye ba snyam sems na

verses.skt: sthānāt sthānāntaragatir akasmād dhānivṛddhimān | mṛdur vastir ivānaddho vibhinno ’cchaṃ sravaty asṛk
verses.tib: gnas nas gnas gzhan dag tu 'pho / rgyu med par ni 'phel zhing 'bri / 'jam zhing lgang pa lta bur rgyas / brtol na khrag ni sla ba 'dzag

verses.skt: pittāt sadāhaḥ pītābho rakto vā pacyate drutam | bhinno ’sram uṣṇaṃ sravati śleṣmaṇā nīrujo ghanaḥ
verses.tib: mkhris gyur tsha zhing mdog ser la / dmar zhing myur du smin pa yin / brtol na khrag ni dron mo 'dzag / bad kan las gyur nad med sra

verses.skt: śītaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān pakvaḥ pūyaṃ sraved ghanam | doṣair duṣṭe ’sṛji granthir bhaven mūrchatsu jantuṣu
verses.tib: reg na grang zhing dkar la g.ya' / smin na rnag ni ska ba 'dzag / nad 'khrugs khrag las gyur rmen bu

verses.skt: sirāmāṃsaṃ ca saṃśritya sasvāpaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ | māṃsalair dūṣitaṃ māṃsam āhārair granthim āvahet
verses.tib: srin bu dang ni bcas par 'gyur / sha dang rtsa la gnas pa yi / rmen bu tshor ba chung ba dang / mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid 'dra ba yin / sha che'i gnod gyur sha las ni

verses.skt: snigdhaṃ mahāntaṃ kaṭhinaṃ sirānaddhaṃ kaphākṛtim | pravṛddhaṃ medurair medo nītaṃ māṃse ’thavā tvaci
verses.tib: snum zhing che la sra ba dang / rtsa yis khyab cing bad kan 'dra / tshil skyed pa yis tshil 'phel ba / sha 'am pags par phyin gyur pa

verses.skt: vāyunā kurute granthiṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam | śleṣmatulyākṛtiṃ dehakṣayavṛddhikṣayodayam
verses.tib: rlung gi rmen bu shin tu snum / 'jam dang brtan par byed pa yin / bad kan dang ni mtshan nyid mtshungs / lus 'phel 'bri ba mtshungs pa yin

verses.skt: sa vibhinno ghanaṃ medas tāmrāsitasitaṃ sravet | asthibhaṅgābhighātābhyām unnatāvanataṃ tu yat
verses.tib: de brtol tshil mthug dmar ba dang / dkar dang gnag pa 'dzag par 'gyur / rus pa chag dang snad pa las / mtho dang dma' bar gyur pa de

verses.skt: so ’sthigranthiḥ padātes tu sahasāmbho'vagāhanāt | vyāyāmād vā pratāntasya sirājālaṃ saśoṇitam
verses.tib: rus pa'i rmen bu zhes bya'o / rkang gis song ba'am drag shul gyis / dub par gyur nas chu brgal bas / rlung gis rtsa grang khrag bcas pa

verses.skt: vāyuḥ saṃpīḍya saṃkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca | niḥsphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ
verses.tib: rlung gis btsir te 'khums nas ni / yon por byas te bskams pa dang / mi 'phar nad byung rmen bu chags / de ni rtsa yi rmen bur bshad

verses.skt: arūḍhe rūḍhamātre vā vraṇe sarvarasāśinaḥ | sārdre vā bandharahite gātre ’śmābhihate ’thavā
verses.tib: rma ni ma 'drubs / 'drubs ma thag / ro ni thams cad zos gyur pa'am / rlon pa dkris pa med pa'am / yang na lus ni snad gyur pas

verses.skt: vāto ’sram asrutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇam | kuryāt sadāhaḥ kaṇḍūmān vraṇagranthir ayaṃ smṛtaḥ
verses.tib: rlung ni nad khrag ma phyung ba / ma sbyangs rma ni bsrubs pa las / tsha zhing g.ya' dang bcas gyur pa / rma yi rmen bur de bshad do

verses.skt: sādhyā doṣāsramedojā na tu sthūlakharāś calāḥ | marmakaṇṭhodarasthāś ca mahat tu granthito ’rbudam
verses.tib: gsor rung nad gzhi khrag tshil gyur / sra zhing 'gyur dang sbom pa dang / gnad dang mgul pa stor gnas yin / mdud pa cher chags thor bu ste

verses.skt: tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medo'ntaiḥ ṣoḍhā doṣādibhis tu tat | prāyo medaḥkaphāḍhyatvāt sthiratvāc ca na pacyate
verses.tib: rmen bu de yi mtshan nyid can / nad gzhi la sogs gyur drug yin / phal cher bad kan tshil rgyas yin / brtan pas smin par mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: sirāsthaṃ śoṇitaṃ doṣaḥ saṃkocyāntaḥ prapīḍya ca | pācayeta tad ānaddhaṃ sāsrāvaṃ māṃsapiṇḍitam
verses.tib: rtsa la gnas pa'i khrag nad kyis / 'khums pa'i rjes la gnod 'gyur zhing / smin pa de tshe rgyas par 'gyur / sha yi gong po bcas par 'gyur

verses.skt: māṃsāṅkuraiś citaṃ yāti vṛddhiṃ cāśu sravet tataḥ | ajasraṃ duṣṭarudhiraṃ bhūri tac choṇitārbudam
verses.tib: sha yi myu gus khyab gyur zhing / skyes pa de las nad khrag ni / rgyun mi 'chad par mang du 'dzag / de ni khrag gi thor bu yin

verses.skt: teṣv asṛṅmāṃsaje varjye catvāry anyāni sādhayet | prasthitā vaṅkṣaṇorvādim adhaḥkāyaṃ kapholbaṇāḥ
verses.tib: de las sha khrag las gyur spang / bzhi po gzhan dag gso bar bya / dang por chu sor gnas pa'am / ro smad la brten bad kan rgyas

verses.skt: doṣā māṃsāsragāḥ pādau kālenāśritya kurvate | śanaiḥ śanair ghanaṃ śophaṃ ślīpadaṃ tat pracakṣate
verses.tib: sha khrag nad kyi rkang par ni / dus su skrang bar byed 'gyur zhing / rim gyis stug po nyid du 'gyur / de ni rkang bam zhes bya'o

verses.skt: paripoṭayutaṃ kṛṣṇam animittarujaṃ kharam | rūkṣaṃ ca vātāt pittāt tu pītaṃ dāhajvarānvitam
verses.tib: rlung gyur gas shing gnag pa dang / rgyu med na zhing rtsub cing na / mkhris pa las gyur ser ba dang / tsha dang rims kyis 'debs pa yin

verses.skt: kaphād guru snigdham aruk citaṃ māṃsāṅkurair bṛhat | tat tyajed vatsarātītaṃ sumahat suparisruti
verses.tib: bad kan snum lci nad tshabs chung / sha yi mdzer pa chen pos khyab / de ni mang du 'dzag pa dang / lo gcig 'das pa spang bar bya

verses.skt: pāṇināsauṣṭhakarṇeṣu vadanty eke tu pādavat | ślīpadaṃ jāyate tac ca deśe ’nūpe bhṛśaṃ bhṛśam
verses.tib: kha cig lag pa sna dang mchu / rna ba rkang pa ltar 'byung gzer / rkang bam skyes par gyur pa de / rlan can gnas su mi bzad skye

verses.skt: medasthāḥ kaṇṭhamanyākṣakakṣāvaṅkṣaṇagā malāḥ | savarṇān kaṭhinān snigdhān vārtākāmalakākṛtīn
verses.tib: nad ni tshil mgrin mjing pa mig / mchan khung chu sor gnas pa dag / mdog 'dra sra zhing snum pa dang / bar ta skyu ru ra 'dra dang

verses.skt: avagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃś cirapākāṃś ca kurvate | pacyante ’lparujas te ’nye sravanty anye ’tikaṇḍurāḥ
verses.tib: gting zug 'bras ni cher 'byung ba / ring zhig lon na smin par byed / de las kha cig nad med smin / kha cig 'dzag dang g.ya' ba yin

verses.skt: naśyanty anye bhavanty anye dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ | gaṇḍamālāpacī ceyaṃ dūrveva kṣayavṛddhibhāk
verses.tib: kha cig skam zhing kha cig skye / yun ring du ni gnas par byed / drur ba bzhin du 'bri zhing 'phel / 'brum chen 'bras phreng zhes bya'o

verses.skt: tāṃ tyajet sajvaracchardipārśvarukkāsapīnasām | abhedāt pakvaśophasya vraṇe cāpathyasevinaḥ
verses.tib: de ni rims bcas / skyugs pa dang / chom lud rtsib logs zug pa yang / rma la mi 'phrod bsten pa yis / skrang dang smin pa khyad par med

verses.skt: anupraviśya māṃsādīn dūraṃ pūyo ’bhidhāvati | gatiḥ sā dūragamanān nāḍī nāḍīva saṃsruteḥ
verses.tib: sha sogs nang du rnag zhugs 'gyur / ring du 'gro bar byed pa yin / de ni ring du 'gro bas 'gro / sbubs ltar 'dzag pa sbu gu yin

verses.skt: nāḍy ekānṛjur anyeṣāṃ saivānekagatir gatiḥ | sā doṣaiḥ pṛthag ekasthaiḥ śalyahetuś ca pañcamī
verses.tib: drang po sbu gu gcig yin te / de nyid sna tshogs 'gro bas 'gro / de ni nad gzhi re re 'dus / zug rngu'i rgyus 'byung lngar 'gyur ro

verses.skt: vātāt saruk sūkṣmamukhī vivarṇā phenilodvamā | sravaty abhyadhikaṃ rātrau pittāt tṛḍjvaradāhakṛt
verses.tib: rlung gyur nad bcas rma sgo sra / mdog mi sdug cing lbu ba 'dzag / nub mo lhag par 'dzag pa yin / mkhris gyur skom tsha rims kyis 'debs

verses.skt: pītoṣṇapūtipūyasrud divā cāti niṣiñcati | ghanapicchilasaṃsrāvā kaṇḍūlā kaṭhinā kaphāt
verses.tib: ser bro rnag ni dri mnam 'dzag / nyin par lhag par 'dzag pa yin / bad kan ska zhing spyi bag 'dzag / g.ya' zhing sra bar gyur pa dang

verses.skt: niśi cābhyadhikakledā sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtiṃ tyajet | antaḥsthitaṃ śalyam anāhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sāsya
verses.tib: mtshan mo lhag par 'dzag pa yin / 'dus gyur mtshan ma kun ldan spang / nang na gnas pa'i zug rngu ma phyung zhing / sbu gu skyed par byed pa gang yin de

verses.skt: phenānuviddhaṃ tanum alpam uṣṇaṃ sāsraṃ ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca nityam || 31ef ||
verses.tib: lbu ba can la sla zhing dro ba dang / khrag bcas rnag ni nad bcas rtag tu 'byung

verses.skt: granthiṣv āmeṣu kartavyā yathāsvaṃ śophavat kriyā | bṛhatīcitrakavyāghrīkaṇāsiddhena sarpiṣā
verses.tib: de nas rmen bu la sogs pa'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o / rmen bu ma smin pa la ni / rang rang skrangs pa'i nad ltar gso / kaN+Da ka ri bri ha ti / tsi tra ka dang pi pi ling / bskol ba'i mar gyis lus sbyang bar

verses.skt: snehayec chuddhikāmaṃ ca tīkṣṇaiḥ śuddhasya lepanam | saṃsvedya bahuśo granthiṃ vimṛdnīyāt punaḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: 'dod pa dag gis snum chos bya / sbyang byas sman rnon lde gus bsku / rmen bu lan mang dugs byas te / yang dang yang du mnye bar bya

verses.skt: eṣa vāte viśeṣeṇa kramaḥ pittāsraje punaḥ | jalaukaso himaṃ sarvaṃ kaphaje vātiko vidhiḥ
verses.tib: 'di ni mchog tu rlung la bya / khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur pa'ang / gtar ga bsil ba'i sbyor kun bya / bad kan las gyur rlung ltar gso

verses.skt: tathāpy apakvaṃ chittvainaṃ sthite rakte ’gninā dahet | sādhv aśeṣaṃ saśeṣo hi punar āpyāyate dhruvam
verses.tib: 'on kyang smin na de bcad de / khrag yod pa ni mes bsreg bya / ma lus par bcad lus gyur na / slar yang 'phel bar byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: māṃsavraṇodbhavau granthī yāpayed evam eva ca | kāryaṃ medobhave ’py etat taptaiḥ phalādibhiś ca tam
verses.tib: sha yi rma las gyur rmen bu / de bzhin 'tsho ba tsam du bya / tshil las gyur pa'ang 'di nyid dang

verses.skt: pramṛdyāt tiladigdhena cchannaṃ dviguṇavāsasā | śastreṇa pāṭayitvā vā dahen medasi sūddhṛte
verses.tib: til dang 'o ma'i lde gus bsku / ras ni nyis rim dag gis dkri / tog lcags la sogs bsregs pas bsro / yang na mtshon gyis / dbral nas ni

verses.skt: sirāgranthau nave peyaṃ tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ tathā | upanāho ’nilaharair vastikarma sirāvyadhaḥ
verses.tib: tshil phyung nas ni legs par bsregs / rtsa yi thor bu sar pa la / sa ha tsa ra'i til mar blud / rlung 'joms sman gyis dkri dugs bya

verses.skt: arbude granthivat kuryāt yathāsvaṃ sutarāṃ hitam | ślīpade ’nilaje vidhyet snigdhasvinnopanāhite
verses.tib: 'jam rtsi dang ni gtar ga bya / thor bu rmen bu lta bur ni / rang gi ji bzhin byas rab phan

verses.skt: ajāśakṛcchigrumūlalākṣāsurasakāñjikaiḥ
verses.tib: rkang bam rlung gyur 'phel ba la

verses.skt: upodakāpattrapiṇḍyā chadair ācchāditaṃ ghanam | niveśya paṭṭaṃ badhnīyāc chāmyaty evaṃ navārbudam
jīrṇe cārkacchadasudhāsāmudraguḍakāñjikaiḥ | pracchāne piṇḍikā baddhā granthyarbudavilāyanī
verses.tib: snum zhing dugs bcas dkri ba dang

verses.skt: sirām upari gulphasya dvyaṅgule pāyayec ca tam | māsam eraṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ gomūtreṇa samanvitam
verses.tib: long mo'i sor gnyis gong du ni / gtar ga gdab par bya ba dang / e raN+Da'i mar 'o ma dang / ba gcin sbyar ba zla gcig blud

verses.skt: jīrṇe jīrṇānnam aśnīyāc chuṇṭhīśṛtapayo'nvitam | traivṛtaṃ vā pibed evam aśāntāv agninā dahet
verses.tib: zhu nas 'bru rnying bca' sga dang / 'o ma dang sbyar kha zas sbyin / de bzhin dur byid 'o ma blud / des ma zhin mes bsreg bya

verses.skt: gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ paitte sarvaṃ ca pittajit | sirām aṅguṣṭhake viddhvā kaphaje śīlayed yavān
verses.tib: mkhris gyur long mo'i 'og tu ni / khrag dbyung mkhris pa sel kun sbyar / bad kan las gyur mthe bo las / khrag gtar nas kyi kha zas ni

verses.skt: sakṣaudrāṇi kaṣāyāṇi vardhamānās tathābhayāḥ | limpet sarṣapavārtākīmūlābhyāṃ dhanvayāthavā
verses.tib: sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i sman khu blud / 'phel ba'i tshe na pi pi ling / a ru ra ni bsten par bya / yungs kar bri ha ti gnyis kyi / rtsa ba'i lde gus byug par bya

verses.skt: ūrdhvādhaḥśodhanaṃ peyam apacyāṃ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam | dantīdravantītrivṛtājālinīdevadālibhiḥ
verses.tib: yang na 'u su'i lde gus byug / 'bras kyi phreng ba steng 'og nas / sbyang zhing dan da tra ban ti / dur byid ko sha ta ki dang

verses.skt: śīlayet kaphamedoghnaṃ dhūmagaṇḍūṣanāvanam | sirayāpahared raktaṃ piben mūtreṇa tārkṣyajam
verses.tib: de ba ta la'i mar bskol blud / bad kan tshil ni 'joms pa yi / dud pas mkhur bkang sna sman btang / gtar gas khrag ni dbyung ba dang

verses.skt: palam ardhapalaṃ vāpi karṣaṃ vāpy uṣṇavāriṇā | kāñcanāratvacaṃ pītvā gaṇḍamālāṃ vyapohati
verses.tib: skyer pa'i khaN+Das gcin yang blud / rmen bu ma smin pa la ni / rgyam tsha bca' sga na gu li

verses.skt: granthīn apakvān ālimpen nākulīpaṭunāgaraiḥ | svinnān lavaṇapoṭalyā kaṭhinān anu mardayet
verses.tib: bsku zhing sra bar rgyam tsha yi / thum bus dugs byas mnye bar bya / sha mi la phug shi kru yi

verses.skt: śamīmūlakaśigrūṇāṃ bījaiḥ sayavasarṣapaiḥ | lepaḥ piṣṭo ṇmlatakreṇa granthigaṇḍavilāyanaḥ
verses.tib: sa bon nas dang yungs kar bcas / dar ba skyur po btags bskus na / rmen bu'i mdud pa zhi bar byed

verses.skt: kṣuṇṇāni nimbapattrāṇi k ptair bhallātakaiḥ saha | śarāvasaṃpuṭe dagdhvā sārdhaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ samaiḥ
etac chāgāmbunā piṣṭaṃ gaṇḍamālāpralepanam
verses.tib: smin par 'phrigs na khrag dbyung zhing

verses.skt: pākonmukhān srutāsrasya pittaśleṣmaharair jayet | apakvān evo voddhṛtya kṣārāgnibhyām upācaret
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pa sel bas gso / ma smin pa ni phyung nas kyang / thal sman me btsas gso bar bya

verses.skt: kākādanīlāṅgalikānahikottuṇḍikīphalaiḥ | jīmūtabījakarkoṭīviśālākṛtavedhanaiḥ
verses.tib: dzo tiSh+ma ti lang ga li / shu ka na sa'i 'bras bu dang / ka ka tig ta kar ko Ti / de bta la'i sa bon dang / bi sha l+ya dang ni rgun ti

verses.skt: pāṭhānvitaiḥ palārdhāṃśair viṣakarṣayutaiḥ pacet | prasthaṃ karañjatailasya nirguṇḍīsvarasāḍhake
verses.tib: ko sha ta ki pa ta rnams / srang ni phyed dang dug zho gnyis / ka rany+dza'i mar bre gang dang / ni rgun ti yi khu ba ni / bre bzhi bskol bar gyur pa 'di'i

verses.skt: anena mālā gaṇḍānāṃ cirajā pūyavāhinī | sidhyaty asādhyakalpāpi pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ
verses.tib: btung dang bsku byug snar btang na / 'bras kyi phreng ba gsor mi rung / yun ring / lon zhing rnag 'dzag sel

verses.skt: tailaṃ lāṅgalikīkandakalkapādaṃ caturguṇe | nirguṇḍīsvarase pakvaṃ nasyādyair apacīpraṇut
verses.tib: long ka li yi sdong bu yi / lde gu til mar de bzhi 'gyur / nir gun ti yi khu bar bskol / sna sman sogs btang 'bras phreng sel

verses.skt: bhadraśrīdārumaricadviharidrātrivṛdghanaiḥ | manaḥśilālanaladaviśālākaravīrakaiḥ
verses.tib: tsan+dan thang shing na le sham / dur byid gla sgang ser po gnyis

verses.skt: gomūtrapiṣṭaiḥ palikair viṣasyārdhapalena ca | brāhmīrasārkajakṣīragośakṛdrasasaṃyutam
verses.tib: srang re dug ni srang phyed dang / ba gcin sbyar te zhib tu btags / bram+b+hi'i khu ba arga yi / 'o ma ba lang lci khur bcas

verses.skt: prasthaṃ sarṣapatailasya siddham āśu vyapohati | pānādyaiḥ śīlitaṃ kuṣṭhaduṣṭanāḍīvraṇāpacīḥ
verses.tib: yungs mar bre gang bcas bskol ba / btung ba la sogs par bsten na / mdze dang rma ni 'khyims pa dang / 'bras kyi phreng ba myur du sel

verses.skt: vacāharītakīlākṣākaṭurohiṇicandanaiḥ | tailaṃ prasādhitaṃ pītaṃ samūlām apacīṃ jayet
verses.tib: shu dag rgya skyegs a ru ra / pu tse shel dang tsan+dan dang / til mar bskol ba blud na ni / 'bras phreng rtsa bar bcas pa sel

verses.skt: śarapuṅkhodbhavaṃ mūlaṃ piṣṭaṃ taṇḍulavāriṇā | nasyāl lepāc ca duṣṭārurapacīviṣajantujit
verses.tib: sha ra pung ka'i rtsa ba ni / 'bras kyi chu dang btags gyur pa / sna sman bsku bas 'brum bu dang / dug srin 'bras kyi phreng ba 'joms

verses.skt: mūlair uttamakāraṇyāḥ pīluparṇyāḥ sahācarāt | salodhrābhayayaṣṭyāhvaśatāhvādvīpidārubhiḥ
verses.tib: ut+tam ka ra'i rtsa ba dang / bi lu'i lo ma seng phrom dang / sa ha tsa ra a ru ra / shing mngar shu ti tsi tra ka

verses.skt: tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ siddhaṃ nasye ’bhyaṅge ca pūjitam | go'vyajāśvakhurā dagdhāḥ kaṭutailena lepanam
verses.tib: thang shing til mar 'o ma mnyam / sna sman bsku byug byas pa'ang phan / ba lang ra lug rta rmig bsregs / nyungs mar sbyar te bsku ba'am

verses.skt: aiṅgudena tu kṛṣṇāhir vāyaso vā svayaṃ mṛtaḥ | ity aśāntau gadasyānyapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritam
verses.tib: sbrul nag bya rog rang nyid shi / ing gu dang ni sbyar ba bsku / de ltar ma zhi nad kyi ni / logs gzhan byin pa la gnas pa'i

verses.skt: vaster ūrdhvam adhastād vā medo hṛtvāgninā dahet | sthitasyordhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena ca pārṣṇitaḥ
verses.tib: chu so'i steng ngam 'og nas ni / tshil phyung nas ni mes bsreg bya / gyen du 'greng ba'i rkang pa gzhal / de yi tshad kyi rting pa ru

verses.skt: tata ūrdhvaṃ hared granthīn ity āha bhagavān nimiḥ | pārṣṇiṃ prati dvādaśa cāṅgulāni muktvendravastiṃ ca gadānyapārśve || 31cd || vidārya matsyāṇḍanibhāni madhyāj jālāni karṣed iti suśrutoktiḥ
verses.tib: de las rmen bu dbyung bya zhes / drang srong mu khyud kyis bshad do / rting pa nas bzung sor ni bcu gnyis na / dbang po'i chu so yod spang nad kyi ni / g.yon du dbral te nya sgong 'dra dbus nas / dra ba drang zhes legs thos kyis bshad do

verses.skt: āgulphakarṇāt sumitasya jantos tasyāṣṭabhāgaṃ khuḍakād vibhajya | ghrāṇārjave ’dhaḥ surarājavaster bhittvākṣamātraṃ tv apare vadanti
verses.tib: mi yi long mo rna ba'i bar du gzhal / de yis brgyad pa rting pa'i cha bgos te / byin snying gnad kyi drang thad ma gtogs dpral / tshil ni dbyung bar bya zhes gzhan dag 'chad

verses.skt: upanāhyānilān nāḍīṃ pāṭitāṃ sādhu lepayet | pratyakpuṣpīphalayutais tailaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung gyur sbu gur dugs byas la / dbral te a pa marga yi / sbu gus til dang rgyam tshar bcas / btags pa'i lde gus legs par bsku

verses.skt: paittīṃ tu tilamañjiṣṭhānāgadantīniśādvayaiḥ | ślaiṣmikīṃ tilasaurāṣṭrīnikumbhāriṣṭasaindhavaiḥ
verses.tib: mkhris pa las gyur til dang btsod / nA ga dan ti ser po gnyis / bad kan las gyur rgyam / tsha til / dan da nim pa lan tshwas bsku

verses.skt: śalyajāṃ tilamadhvājyair lepayec chinnaśodhitām | aśastrakṛtyām eṣiṇyā bhittvānte samyageṣitām
verses.tib: zug rngu las byung dbral te dbyung / til dang mar dang sbrang rtsis bsku / mtshon dbral mi rung chu tshod kyis / legs par btsal te nang du dbug

verses.skt: kṣārapītena sūtreṇa bahuśo dārayed gatim | vraṇeṣu duṣṭasūkṣmāsyagambhīrādiṣu sādhanam
verses.tib: thal sman la spangs skud pa yis / rma tshol kha ni shas cher dral / rma red kha ni dog pa dang / phugs ring la yang sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: yā vartyo yāni tailāni tan nāḍīṣv api śasyate | piṣṭaṃ cañcuphalaṃ lepān nāḍīvraṇaharaṃ param
verses.tib: reng bu gang dang til mar gang / de ni rma 'khyims la yang bsngags / e raN+Da'i 'bras lde gus bsku / sbu gu'i rma sbyor byed mchog yin

verses.skt: ghoṇṭāphalatvak lavaṇaṃ salākṣaṃ būkasya pattraṃ vanitāpayaś ca | snugarkadugdhānvita eṣa kalko vartīkṛto hanty acireṇa nāḍīm
verses.tib: rgya shug 'bras bu shun pa dang / lan tshwa rgya skyegs bcas pa dang / gla gor zho sha'i lo ma dang / pri yang ku dang nu zho dang / arka snu hi'i 'o mar sbyar / reng bus rma 'khyims myur 'tsho bar byed

verses.skt: sāmudrasauvarcalasindhujanmasupakvaghoṇṭāphalaveśmadhūmāḥ | āmrātagāyatrijapallavāś ca kaṭaṅkaṭeryāv atha cetakī ca
verses.tib: rgyam tsha'i tsha dang rtsabs ru tsha / lce myang tsha ni legs par bsregs / gla gor zho sha khyim dud pa / a mra ta ka seng ldeng gi / lo ma dzi na skyer pa gnyis

verses.skt: kalke ’bhyaṅge cūrṇe vartyāṃ caiteṣu śīlyamāneṣu | agatir iva naśyati gatiś capalā capaleṣu bhūtir iva
verses.tib: lde gus bsku ba sogs bsten na / skyabs med mi brtan skyes bu yi / 'byor pa bzhin du 'grib par byed

verses.skt: snigdhā savarṇā grathitā nīrujā mudgasaṃnibhā | piṭikā kaphavātābhyāṃ bālānām ajagallikā
verses.tib: bad rlung las gyur 'brum phran ni / snum zhing mdog 'dra mdud pa can / nad med mung+ga 'dra ba ni / byis pa las skyes ra'i 'gram pa

verses.skt: yavaprakhyā yavaprakhyā tābhyāṃ māṃsāśritā ghanā | avaktrā cālajī vṛttā stokapūyā ghanonnatā
verses.tib: de gnyis las byung shar gnas mthug / nas 'dra nas zhes bya ba yin / 'bras byer zlum po rtse mo med / rnag nyung rtag mtho 'bras byer yin

verses.skt: granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍ vā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ | karṇasyordhvaṃ samantād vā piṭikā kaṭhinograruk
verses.tib: rmen bu lnga 'am drug 'byung zhing / rus sbal ltar mtho rus sbal yin / rna ba'i steng ngam kun tu ni / 'brum phran sra zhing mi bzad na

verses.skt: śālūkābhā panasikā śophas tv alparujaḥ sthiraḥ | hanusaṃdhisamudbhūtas tābhyāṃ pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ
verses.tib: ut+pal rtsa 'dra pa nas / skrang shing cung zad na la brtan / 'gam pa'i mtshams su de gnyis las / 'byung ba rdo yi bong bu yin

verses.skt: śālmalīkaṇṭakākārāḥ piṭikāḥ sarujo ghanāḥ | medogarbhā mukhe yūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikāḥ
verses.tib: shal ma li yi tsher ma 'dra / 'brum phran nad bcas mthug po ni / nang na tshil yod lang tsho la

verses.skt: te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmam iva kaṇṭakaiḥ | cīyate nīrujaiḥ śvetaiḥ śarīraṃ kaphavātajaiḥ
verses.tib: bad kan rlung gyur pad+ma yi / tsher ma 'dra bas khyab gyur cing / dkar zhing nad ni med pa dag / pad+ma'i tsher ma can zhes bya

verses.skt: pittena piṭikā vṛttā pakvodumbarasaṃnibhā | mahādāhajvarakarī vivṛtā vivṛtānanā
verses.tib: mkhris pa las gyur 'brum phran / zlum / u dum bA ra'i 'bras smin 'dra / shas cher tsha zhing rims 'debs byed / gas pa kha bye zhes bya'o

verses.skt: gātreṣv antaś ca vaktrasya dāhajvararujānvitāḥ | masūramātrās tadvarṇās tatsaṃjñāḥ piṭikā ghanāḥ
verses.tib: lus kyi nang dang gdong la ni / tsha zhing nad dang rims skyed cing / sran chung tsam la de'i mdog can / 'brum phran mthug po srin chung zhing
