verses.skt: tataḥ kaṣṭatarāḥ sphoṭā visphoṭākhyā mahārujāḥ | yā padmakarṇikākārā piṭikā piṭikācitā
verses.tib: de bas 'brum bu nad tshabs che / sdug bsngal byed pa 'brum bu yin / rlung mkhris las gyur 'brum bu'i nang / pad+ma'i snying po lta bu yi / 'brum phran gyis ni phug pa yin

verses.skt: sā viddhā vātapittābhyāṃ tābhyām eva ca gardabhī | maṇḍalā vipulotsannā sarāgapiṭikācitā
verses.tib: de dag nyid skyed bong bu yin / zlum zhing rgya che mtho ba dang / mdog dmar 'brum phran dag gis khyab / phal cher rlung las mchan khung du

verses.skt: kakṣeti kakṣāsanneṣu prāyo deśeṣu sānilāt | pittād bhavanti piṭikāḥ sūkṣmā lājopamā ghanāḥ
verses.tib: nye bar skyes pa mchan khung 'brum / mkhris pa las gyur 'brum phran ni / phra zhing mthug pa 'bras yos 'dra

verses.skt: tādṛśī mahatī tv ekā gandhanāmeti kīrtitā | gharmasvedaparīte ’ṅge piṭikāḥ sarujo ghanāḥ
verses.tib: de 'dra'i chen po cig byung ba / dri can zhes ni grags pa yin / tsha ba'i rdul gyis lus gdungs la / 'brum phran nad bcas stug po ni

verses.skt: rājīkāvarṇasaṃsthānapramāṇā rājikāhvayāḥ | doṣaiḥ pittolbaṇair mandair visarpati visarpavat
verses.tib: dbyibs dang chad mdog skye tshe 'dra / de ni ske tshe zhes bya'o / mkhris pa shas che'i nad kyis ni / me dbal lta bur dal gyis mched

verses.skt: śopho ’pākas tanus tāmro jvarakṛj jālagardabhaḥ | malaiḥ pittolbaṇaiḥ sphoṭā jvariṇo māṃsadāraṇāḥ
verses.tib: skrang zhing snum la srab cing dmar / rim skyed dra ba'i bong bu yin / mkhris pa shas che'i 'brum bu ni / rim skyed sha la gnod byed pa

verses.skt: kakṣābhāgeṣu jāyante ye ’gnyābhāḥ sāgnirohiṇī | pañcāhāt saptarātrād vā pakṣād vā hanti jīvitam
verses.tib: mchan khung phyogs byung me'i mdog can / 'dra ba de ni me skyed yin / zhag lnga'am ni zhag bdun na / zla ba phyed nas srog 'phrog byed

verses.skt: triliṅgā piṭikā vṛttā jatrūrdhvam irivellikā | vidārīkandakaṭhinā vidārī kakṣavaṅkṣaṇe
verses.tib: nad gzhi gsum skyes 'brum bu zlum / nam tshong yan chad skyes sa skor / mchan khung chu sor bi da ri'i / rtsa ba ltar sra bi da ri

verses.skt: medo'nilakaphair granthiḥ snāyumāṃsasirāśrayaiḥ | bhinno vasājyamadhvābhaṃ sravet tatrolbaṇo ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: tshil dang bad rlung las gyur pa'i / rmen bu rtsa rgyus sha la gnas / brtol na mar zhag sbrang rtsi 'dra / 'dzag gyur de la rlung shas che

verses.skt: māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ upapādayet | durgandhaṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tato malāḥ
verses.tib: sha skam rmen bur byas nas ni / gseg ma lta bur skyed par byed / khrag ni dri mnam rangs pa dang / kha dog sna tshogs 'byung ba yi

verses.skt: tāṃ srāvayanti nicitāṃ vidyāt tac charkarārbudam | pāṇipādatale saṃdhau jatrūrdhvaṃ vopacīyate
verses.tib: nad kyis de la khrag 'dzag pa / de ni 'brum bu gseg ma can / lag pa rkang mthil tshigs dang ni / nam tshong yan chad grog mo yi

verses.skt: valmīkavac chanair granthis tadvad bahvaṇubhir mukhaiḥ | rugdāhakaṇḍūkledāḍhyair valmīko ’sau samastajaḥ
verses.tib: mgo ltar rim gyis rmen bu ni / phra mo mang pos khyab byed la / na zhing tsha la g.ya' zhing 'drul / kun tu skyes te grog mo'i mgo

verses.skt: śarkaronmathite pāde kṣate vā kaṇṭakādibhiḥ | granthiḥ kīlavad utsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tu tat
verses.tib: rkang mthil gshags mas brud pa'am / tsher ma sogs kyis snad pa yi / 'brum bu bur pa ltar mtho ba / skyes te mdzer pa 'dra zhes bya

verses.skt: vegasaṃdhāraṇād vāyur apāno ’pānasaṃśrayam | aṇūkaroti bāhyāntarmārgam asya tataḥ śakṛt
verses.tib: shugs bkag pa yis rlung dag ni / gzhang dang rkang pa la gnas pa / phyi dang nang du rgyu byed pa / lam rgyu de las bshang ba ni

verses.skt: kṛcchrān nirgacchati vyādhir ayaṃ ruddhagudo mataḥ | kuryāt pittānilaṃ pākaṃ nakhamāṃse sarugjvaram
verses.tib: dka' bas 'byung bar byed pa'i nad / gzhang 'gags pa zhes bya bar 'dod / rlung mkhris kyis ni sen mo yi / nang gi sha smin nad skyed pa

verses.skt: cipyam akṣatarogaṃ ca vidyād upanakhaṃ ca tam | kṛṣṇo ’bhighātād rūkṣaś ca kharaś ca kunakho nakhaḥ
verses.tib: ma snad nad dang tshim pa dang / nye ba'i sen mo zhes bya'o / snad pas gnag cing rtsub pa dang

verses.skt: duṣṭakardamasaṃsparśāt kaṇḍūkledānvitāntarāḥ | aṅgulyo ’lasam ity āhus tilābhāṃs tilakālakān
verses.tib: sra ba sen mo ngan zhes bya / 'dam ni gnod byed la reg las / nang na g.ya' zhing rnag bcas pa / sor mo'i 'bras 'byer zhes bya'o

verses.skt: kṛṣṇān avedanāṃs tvaksthān māṣāṃs tān eva connatān | maṣebhyas tūnnatatarāṃś carmakīlān sitāsitān
verses.tib: pags pa til 'dra gnag pa la / nad med byung gyur rme ba ste / de nyid 'bur ba mdzer pa yin / mdzer pa las kyang chen por gyur / dkar nag pags pa'i mdzer pa yin

verses.skt: tathāvidho jatumaṇiḥ sahajo lohitas tu saḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam
verses.tib: de 'dra'i 'brum bu skyes pa ni / dmar po rgya skyegs nor bu yin / dkar ba'am gnag par lhan cig skyes / zlum pa'am mtshan ma zhes bya'o

verses.skt: śokakrodhādikupitād vātapittān mukhe tanu | śyāmalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyaṅgaṃ vaktrād anyatra nīlikā
verses.tib: mya ngan khro dang rlung mkhris sogs / 'khrugs te gdong ni srab 'gyur zhing / thig le nag po ngo shig can / gdong las gzhan 'byung khabs zhes bya

verses.skt: paruṣaṃ paruṣasparśaṃ vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt | pittāt tāmrāntam ānīlaṃ śvetāntaṃ kaṇḍumat kaphāt
verses.tib: rlung gyur ngo shig rtsub par snang / reg na rtsub cing gnag pa yin / mkhris gyur mtha' ma cung zad sngo / bad kan las gyur mtha' dkar g.ya'

verses.skt: raktād raktāntam ātāmraṃ sauṣaṃ cimicimāyate | vāyunodīritaḥ śleṣmā tvacaṃ prāpya viśuṣyati
verses.tib: khrag gyur mtha' ma zangs mdog can / skam zhing tsha ba tsag tsag byed / rlung gis bad kan bslangs gyur pa / pags par phyin te bskams gyur nas

verses.skt: tatas tvag jāyate pāṇduḥ krameṇa ca vicetanā | alpakaṇḍūr avikledā sā prasuptiḥ prasuptitaḥ
verses.tib: de las pags pa skya 'gyur zhing / rim gyis tshor ba med 'gyur la / g.ya' ba chung zhing 'drul ba med / bem po de ni tshor med yin

verses.skt: asamyagvamanodīrṇapittaśleṣmānnanigrahaiḥ | maṇḍalāny atikaṇḍūni rāgavanti bahūni ca
verses.tib: skyug sman nyes dang ma zhu dang / bad mkhris lus la gnas bslangs pas / rab g.ya' zlum po gor gor po / dmar po mang du 'byung 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: utkoṭhaḥ so ’nubaddhas tu koṭha ity abhidhīyate | proktāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśad ity ete kṣudrarogā vibhāgaśaḥ
verses.tib: rjes 'brel ldan pa zlum por bshad / de ltar nad ni phra mo yi / dbye ba sum cu drug tu bstan

verses.skt: yān avijñāya muhyeta cikitsāyāṃ cikitsakaḥ
visrāvayej jalaukobhir apakvām ajagallikām | svedayitvā yavaprakhyāṃ vilayāya pralepayet
verses.tib: ra yi 'gram pa ma smin pa / srin / bu pad pas khrag dbyung ngo / nas 'dra dugs ni byas nas su

verses.skt: dārukuṣṭhamanohvālair ity āpāṣāṇagardabhāt | vidhis tāṃś cācaret pakvān vraṇavat sājagallikān
verses.tib: thang shing ru rta ldong ros dang / ba bla'i lde gu bskus te bzhu / rdo yi bong bu'ang de ltar gso / smin pa ra 'gram rma ltar gso

verses.skt: lodhrakustumburuvacāḥ pralepo mukhadūṣike | vaṭapallavayuktā vā nārikelotthaśuktayaḥ
verses.tib: bzhin gnod seng phrom 'u su dang / shu dag btags pa'i lde gu'am / n+ya gro d+ha yi lo ma'am / rgya star lo ma tsha sbyar bsku

verses.skt: aśāntau vamanaṃ nasyaṃ lalāṭe ca sirāvyadhaḥ | nimbāmbuvānto nimbāmbusādhitaṃ padmakaṇṭake
verses.tib: des ma zhi na skyug sman dang / sna sman dpral bar gtar ga gdab / pad+ma'i tsher ma nim pa yi

verses.skt: pibet kṣaudrānvitaṃ sarpir nimbāragvadhalepanam | vivṛtādīṃs tu jālāntāṃś cikitset serivellikān | pittavisarpavat tadvat pratyākhyāyāgnirohiṇīm
verses.tib: khu ba'am nim pa mar bskol bar / sbrang rtsi dang ni bcas pa blud / nim pa dong gar sbyar bas byug / kha bye sogs nas dra bong bar / sa skor bcas pa mkhris pa yi / me dbal lta bur gso bar bya

verses.skt: vilaṅghanaṃ raktavimokṣaṇaṃ ca virūkṣaṇaṃ kāyaviśodhanaṃ ca | dhātrīprayogāñ chiśirapradehān kuryāt sadā jālakagardabhasya
verses.tib: me skyed pa ni spang bar bya / dra ba'i bong bu smyung ba dang / gtar ga gdab dang rtsub chos dang / lus kyi sbyang ba skyu ru ra'i / sbyor ba'i bsil sman byugs pas gso

verses.skt: vidārikāṃ hṛte rakte śleṣmagranthivad ācaret | medo'rbudakriyāṃ kuryāt sutarāṃ śarkarārbude
verses.tib: bid ril khrag gtar zhing / bad kan rman bu lta bur gso / gseg ma lta bu'i 'brum phran la / tshil gyi rmen bu lta bur gso

verses.skt: pravṛddhaṃ subahucchidraṃ saśophaṃ marmaṇi sthitam | valmīkaṃ hastapāde ca varjayed itarat punaḥ
verses.tib: grog ma'i mgo 'dra bu ga mang / cher skyed skrang zhing gnad la gnas / rkang pa lag par byung ba spang / cig shos la ni khrag byung la

verses.skt: śuddhasyāsre hṛte limpet sapaṭvārevatāmṛtaiḥ | śyāmākulatthikāmūladantīpalalasaktubhiḥ
verses.tib: rgyam tsha dong ga sle tres dang / ci tse rgya sran rtsa ba dang / da nad til btags nas phyes bsku

verses.skt: pakve tu duṣṭamāṃsāni gatīḥ sarvāś ca śodhayet | śastreṇa samyag anu ca kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā
verses.tib: smin pa la ni nad can sha / thams cad legs par sbyang bar bya / mtshon gyis bcad la de rjes la / thal sman yang na me yis bsreg

verses.skt: śastreṇotkṛtya niḥśeṣaṃ snehena kadaraṃ dahet | niruddhamaṇivat kāryaṃ ruddhapāyoś cikitsitam
verses.tib: mdzer pa 'dra la gtsags bu yis / ma lus bcad la snum gyis bsreg / gzhang 'gags pa la nor bu ni / 'gags pa lta bur gso bar bya

verses.skt: cipyaṃ śuddhyā jitoṣmāṇaṃ sādhayec chastrakarmaṇā | duṣṭaṃ kunakham apy evaṃ caraṇāv alase punaḥ
verses.tib: nye ba'i sen mo sbyangs pa yis / tsha ba bsal te mtshon gyis gso / sen mo ngan la'ang de bzhin bya / rkang pa'i chu ser dag la'ang

verses.skt: dhānyāmlasiktau kāsīsapaṭolīrocanātilaiḥ | sanimbapattrair ālimped dahet tu tilakālakān
verses.tib: 'bras bu skyur po nag tshur bcas / til dang gi wang nim pa yi / lo ma'i lde gus bsku bar bya / sme ba mdzer par bcas pa ni

verses.skt: maṣāṃś ca sūryakāntena kṣāreṇa yadi vāgninā | tadvad utkṛtya śastreṇa carmakīlajatūmaṇī
verses.tib: me shel thal sman dag gis bsreg / yang na me btsa' gdab par bya / de bzhin bags mdzer rgya skyegs nor / mtshon gyis bcad de de bzhin gso

verses.skt: lāñchanāditraye kuryād yathāsannaṃ sirāvyadham | lepayet kṣīrapiṣṭaiś ca kṣīrivṛkṣatvagaṅkuraiḥ
verses.tib: mtshan ma can sogs / gsum po la / nye ba'i phyogs la gtar ga gdab / 'o ma can shing myu gu shun / 'o mar btags pas bsku bar bya

verses.skt: vyaṅgeṣu cārjunatvag vā mañjiṣṭhā vā samākṣikā | lepaḥ sanavanītā vā śvetāśvakhurajā maṣī
verses.tib: ngo shig ardzu na'i shun pa'am / btsod dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba yi / lde gu'am rta dkar rmig pa ni / bsregs pa'i snag tsha mar sbyar bsku

verses.skt: raktacandanamañjiṣṭhākuṣṭhalodhrapriyaṅgavaḥ | vaṭāṅkurā masūrāś ca vyaṅgaghnā mukhakāntidāḥ
verses.tib: tsan+dan dmar po btsod dang ni / ru rta seng phrom pri yad+ku / sran chung n+ya gro d+ha'i myu gu / lde gus ngo shig sel byed cing / bzhin mdangs gsal bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: dve jīrake kṛṣṇatilāḥ sarṣapāḥ payasā saha | piṣṭāḥ kurvanti vaktrendum apāstavyaṅgalāñchanam
verses.tib: zir gnyis dang til nag dang / yungs kar 'o mar bcas pa ni / btags pa'i lde gus gdong bskus na / ngo shig sel zhing zla 'drar byed / sran chung phub ma med brngos pa / 'o ma sbrang rtsi mar btags bsku / tsher ma rno ba'i shal ma li'i / 'o mar btags pas bskus na phan

verses.skt: kṣīrapiṣṭā ghṛtakṣaudrayuktā vā bhṛṣṭanistuṣāḥ | masūrāḥ kṣīrapiṣṭā vā tīkṣṇāḥ śālmalikaṇṭakāḥ
verses.tib: zir gnyis dang til nag dang / yungs kar 'o mar bcas pa ni / btags pa'i lde gus gdong bskus na / ngo shig sel zhing zla 'drar byed / sran chung phub ma med brngos pa / 'o ma sbrang rtsi mar btags bsku / tsher ma rno ba'i shal ma li'i / 'o mar btags pas bskus na phan

verses.skt: saguḍaḥ kolamajjā vā śaśāsṛkkṣaudrakalkitaḥ | saptāhaṃ mātuluṅgasthaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vā madhunānvitam
verses.tib: rgya shug tshi gu bu ram bcas / sbrang rtsi ri bong khrag sbyar bsku / ru rta kha lung khu ba yi

verses.skt: piṣṭā vā chāgapayasā sakṣaudrā mausalī jaṭā | gor asthi musalīmūlayuktaṃ vā sājyamākṣikam
verses.tib: nang sbangs sbrang rtsir bcas pa'am / rkang mar rtsa ba ra'i 'o ma / sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu'ang phan / rkang mar rtsa ba lang rus

verses.skt: jambvāmrapallavā mastu haridre dve navo guḍaḥ | lepaḥ savarṇakṛt piṣṭaṃ svarasena ca tindukam
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas pas bsku / 'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma dang / ser po rnam gnyis zho ga chu / bu ram sar pa sbyar ba'am / tin du ka yi lo ma yi

verses.skt: utpalam utpalakuṣṭhaṃ priyaṅgukālīyakaṃ badaramajjā | idam udvartanam āsyaṃ karoti śatapattrasaṃkāśam
verses.tib: khu bar btags pa yang mdog gsal byed / ut+pal sngo dang ru rta dang / tsan+dan ser po pri yang ku / rgya shug tshi gu'i lde gu yis / gdong ni bskus zhing dril gyur na / pad+ma'i mdog dang 'dra bar byed

verses.skt: ebhir evauṣadhaiḥ piṣṭair mukhābhyaṅgāya sādhayet | yathādoṣartukān snehān madhukakvāthasaṃyutaiḥ
verses.tib: sman ni 'di dag btags pa dang / shing mngar dang bcas bskol snum ni / nad gzhi ji bzhin ma lus la / btung dang bsku ba la sogs bya

verses.skt: yavān sarjarasaṃ lodhram uśīraṃ madanaṃ madhu | ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca gomūtre paced ādarvilepanāt
verses.tib: nas dang seng phrom sra rtsi pog / spra tshil sbrang rtsi pu tse shel / mar dang bu ram ba gcin ni / gzar bur chags kyi bar du bskol

verses.skt: tad abhyaṅgān nihanty āśu nīlikāvyaṅgadūṣikān | mukhaṃ karoti padmābhaṃ pādau padmadalopamau
verses.tib: de bskus pa yis sme ba dang / ngo shig mdzer pa myur sel byed / gdong ni pad+ma 'drar byed cing / rkang pa pad+ma'i 'dab 'dar byed

verses.skt: kuṅkumośīrakālīyalākṣāyaṣṭyāhvacandanam | nyagrodhapādāṃs taruṇān padmakaṃ padmakesaram
verses.tib: gur gum shing mngar pu shel tse / tsan+dan ser dang rgya skyegs dang / tsan+dan dkar dang n+ya gro d+ha'i / rkang pa gzhon nu shug pa dang / de bzhin pad+ma ge sar dang

verses.skt: sanīlotpalamañjiṣṭhaṃ pālikaṃ salilāḍhake | paktvā pādāvaśeṣeṇa tena piṣṭaiś ca kārṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: ut+pal sngon po btsod dang bcas / srang re chu bre bzhi nang du / bskol / te bzhi cha lus ba ru / rgya skyegs btsod dang le brgan rtsi

verses.skt: lākṣāpattaṅgamañjiṣṭhāyaṣṭīmadhukakuṅkumaiḥ | ajākṣīraṃ dviguṇitaṃ tailasya kuḍavaṃ pacet
verses.tib: shing mngar gur gum zho gnyis gnyis / phye ma til mar srang brgyad dang / de yi nyis 'gyur 'o ma bskol

verses.skt: nīlikāpalitavyaṅgavalītilakadūṣikān | hanti tan nasyam abhyastaṃ mukhopacayavarṇakṛt
verses.tib: de ni sna sman tshul bsten na / sme ba ngo shig skra dkar dang / gnyer ma gdong gi dri ma sel / gdong gi sha rgyas mdog gsal byed

verses.skt: mañjiṣṭhā śabarodbhavas tubarikā lākṣā haridrādvayaṃ | nepālī haritālakuṅkumagadā gorocanā gairikam | pattraṃ pāṇḍu vaṭasya candanayugaṃ kālīyakaṃ pāradaṃ | pattaṅgaṃ kanakatvacaṃ kamalajaṃ bījaṃ tathā kesaram
verses.tib: btsod dang seng phrom sha ba ri / rgya skyegs ldong ros du pa ri / gur gum ru rta ser po gnyis / gi wang tsan+dan rnam gnyis dang / n+ya gro d+ha yi lo ma dang / dngul chu rma shing tsan+dan ser / d+ha du ra yi shun pa yi / sa bon pad+ma ge sar dang / spra tshil spangs ma shug pa sogs

verses.skt: sikthaṃ tutthaṃ padmakādyo vasājyaṃ majjā kṣīraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣāmbu cāgnau | siddhaṃ siddhaṃ vyaṅganīlyādināśe vaktre chāyām aindavīṃ cāśu dhatte || 32 || mārkavasvarasakṣīratoyānīṣṭāni nāvane | prasuptau vātakuṣṭhoktaṃ kuryād dāhaṃ ca vahninā
verses.tib: 'o ma can shing 'o ma ni / bskol ba'i mar ni bskus gyur na / ngo shig gnyer ma sogs 'joms shing / bzhin ni pad+ma'i mdangs 'drar 'gyur / bring ga ra dza'i khu bar ni / 'o ma chu bskol sna sman bsngags / pags pa tshor med la rlung gi / gso ba dang ni me btsa' bya

verses.skt: utkoṭhe kaphapittoktaṃ koṭhe sarvaṃ ca kauṣṭhikam
verses.tib: pags nad zlum por bad mkhris bshad / mdze nad sel ba thams cad phan

verses.skt: strīvyavāyanivṛttasya sahasā bhajato ’thavā | doṣādhyuṣitasaṃkīrṇamalināṇurajaḥpathām
verses.tib: bud med nyal po spangs pa las / mod la bsten par gyur pa'am / nad dang bcas shing dogs pa las / dri ma can nam zla mtshan nam

verses.skt: anyayonim anicchantīm agamyāṃ navasūtikām | dūṣitaṃ spṛśatas toyaṃ ratānteṣv api naiva vā
verses.tib: skye gnas gzhan dang mi 'dod dang / bgrod min gsar du btsas pa dang / dga' ba'i mthar ni dug can sogs / chus reg pa'am ma bkrus dang

verses.skt: vivardhayiṣayā tīkṣṇān pralepādīn prayacchataḥ | muṣṭidantanakhotpīḍāviṣavacchūkapātanaiḥ
verses.tib: bskyed pa'i bsam pas sman rnon po'i / lde gu la sogs bskus pa dang / khu tshur so dang sen mo dang / gra ma dug can gyis reg dang

verses.skt: veganigrahadīrghātikharasparśavighaṭṭanaiḥ | doṣā duṣṭā gatā guhyaṃ trayoviṃśatim āmayān
verses.tib: shugs dgag pa dang yun ring du / reg pa rtsub pas bdar ba 'am / nad gzhi 'khrugs pas gsang bar zhugs / sos 'dzin lta bu la sogs nad / nyi shu rtsa gsum 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: janayanty upadaṃśādīn upadaṃśo ’tra pañcadhā | pṛthag doṣaiḥ sarudhiraiḥ samastaiś cātra mārutāt
verses.tib: sos 'dzin lta bu 'dir lnga ste / nad gzhi re re khrag las gyur / 'dus pa'i nad las gyur pa'o / de la rlung gyur pho mtshan skrangs

verses.skt: meḍhre śopho rujaś citrāḥ stambhas tvakparipoṭanam | pakvodumbarasaṃkāśaḥ pittena śvayathur jvaraḥ
verses.tib: nad mang / rtag ldang pags 'gas pa'o / mkhris pa las gyur skrang rims 'debs / u dum+WA ra'i 'bras smin 'dra

verses.skt: śleṣmaṇā kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmāñ chītalo guruḥ | śoṇitenāsitasphoṭasaṃbhavo ’srasrutir jvaraḥ
verses.tib: bad kan gyis mkhrang snum pa dang / g.ya' zhing skrangs la lci ba yin / khrag gyur 'brum bu nag po 'byung / khrag 'dzag rims kyis 'debs par byed

verses.skt: sarvaje sarvaliṅgatvaṃ śvayathur muṣkayor api | tīvrā rug āśupacanaṃ daraṇaṃ kṛmisaṃbhavaḥ
verses.tib: 'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun dang ldan / rlig 'bras gnyis kyang skrang bar byed / mi bzad na zhing lhung pa dang / gas shing srin bu skye ba yin

verses.skt: yāpyo raktodbhavas teṣāṃ mṛtyave saṃnipātajaḥ | jāyante kupitair doṣair guhyāsṛkpiśitāśrayaiḥ
verses.tib: de las khrag gyur 'tsho ba tsam / 'dus pa las gyur 'chi bar byed / nad 'khrugs pa las pho mtshan gnas

verses.skt: antar bahir vā meḍhrasya kaṇḍūlā māṃsakīlakāḥ | picchilāsrasravā yonau tadvac ca cchattrasaṃnibhāḥ
verses.tib: sha khrag las ni pho mtshan gyi / phyi'am yang na nang du ni / mdzer pa g.ya' bar byed pa 'byung / khrag ni spyi bag 'dzag par byed / mo mtshan de 'dra gdugs ltar 'dug

verses.skt: te ’rśāṃsy upekṣayā ghnanti meḍhrapuṃstvaṃ bhagārtavaṃ | guhyasya bahir antar vā piṭikāḥ kapharaktajāḥ
verses.tib: de ni 'brum nad ma gsos na / pho mo'i khu khrag nyams byed gsod / pho mtshan gyi ni phyi'am nang / bad kan khrag gyur 'brum phran ni

verses.skt: sarṣapāmānasaṃsthānā ghanāḥ sarṣapikāḥ smṛtāḥ | piṭikā bahavo dīrghā dīryante madhyataś ca yāḥ
verses.tib: tshad dang dbyibs ni yungs kar 'dra / stug po'i yungs kar zhes byar bshad / bad kan khrag gyur 'brum bu ni / ring zhing mang por gyur pa la / dbus nas gas pa gang yin pa / de ni nges par 'joms shes bya / na zhing ba sbu brtse bar byed / khrag mkhris las ni 'dzam bu yi

verses.skt: so ’vamanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanāromaharṣavān | kumbhīkā raktapittotthā jāmbavāsthinibhāśujā
verses.tib: tshad dang dbyibs ni yungs kar 'dra / stug po'i yungs kar zhes byar bshad / bad kan khrag gyur 'brum bu ni / ring zhing mang por gyur pa la / dbus nas gas pa gang yin pa / de ni nges par 'joms shes bya / na zhing ba sbu brtse bar byed / khrag mkhris las ni 'dzam bu yi

verses.skt: alajīṃ mehavad vidyād uttamāṃ pittaraktajām | piṭikāṃ māṣamudgābhāṃ piṭikā piṭikācitā
verses.tib: rus pa ltar 'dug khong stong can / 'bras byer gcin snyi 'drar shes bya / khrag mkhris las gyur 'brum phran ni / ma sha mang+ga 'dra mchog yin

verses.skt: karṇikā puṣkarasyeva jñeyā puṣkariketi sā | pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasaṃvyūḍhe saṃvyūḍhapiṭikā bhavet
verses.tib: pad+ma'i steng du ge sar bzhin / 'brum bu 'brum phran gyis khyab pa / de ni pad+ma can zhes bya / lag pa gnyis kyis rab mnyes pa

verses.skt: mṛditaṃ mṛditaṃ vastrasaṃrabdhaṃ vātakopataḥ | viṣamā kaṭhinā bhugnā vāyunāṣṭhīlikā smṛtā
verses.tib: de ni mnyes pa'i 'brum bur gyur / mtshan ni mnyes par gyur pa las / rlung 'khrugs gyur pa mnyes pa yin / mi mnyam sra zhing yon por ni / rlung 'khrugs gyur pa gtun shing yin

verses.skt: vimardanādiduṣṭena vāyunā carma meḍhrajam | nivartate sarugdāhaṃ kvacit pākaṃ ca gacchati
verses.tib: rlung gis mnyes pa la sogs pa'i / nad 'khrugs mtshan gyi pags pa ni / ldog cing tsha la nad bcas shing / la lar shu ba dag tu 'gyur

verses.skt: piṇḍitaṃ granthitaṃ carma tat pralambam adho maṇeḥ | nivṛttasaṃjñaṃ sakaphaṃ kaṇḍūkāṭhinyavat tu tat
verses.tib: 'dus shing mdud pa chags pa ni / de yi nor bu thur du 'phyang / pags pa ldog pa'i nad ces bya / bad kan bcas las g.ya' zhing sra / rma 'tshob dka' zhing pags pa gas / gas pa'i nad / ces bya bar bshad / rlung gis pags pa gnod 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: durūḍhaṃ sphuṭitaṃ carma nirdiṣṭam avapāṭikā | vātena dūṣitaṃ carma maṇau saktaṃ ruṇaddhi cet
verses.tib: 'dus shing mdud pa chags pa ni / de yi nor bu thur du 'phyang / pags pa ldog pa'i nad ces bya / bad kan bcas las g.ya' zhing sra / rma 'tshob dka' zhing pags pa gas / gas pa'i nad / ces bya bar bshad / rlung gis pags pa gnod 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: sroto mūtraṃ tato ’bhyeti mandadhāram avedanam | maṇer vikāśarodhaś ca sa niruddhamaṇir gadaḥ
verses.tib: nor bu 'byar zhing gcin 'gag 'gyur / de las rgyun phra nad med 'byung / nor bu'i kha ni 'gags gyur pas / de ni nor bu'i nad ces bya

verses.skt: liṅgaṃ śūkair ivāpūrṇaṃ grathitākhyaṃ kaphodbhavam | śūkadūṣitaraktotthā sparśahānis tadāhvayā
verses.tib: bad kan las gyur mtshan gyi nad / gra mas gang snyam mdud pa'i nad / gra mas gnod pa'i khrag gi nad / tshor ba nyams pa de ming can

verses.skt: chidrair aṇumukhair yat tu mehanaṃ sarvataś citam | vātaśoṇitakopena taṃ vidyāc chataponakam
verses.tib: rlung dang khrag mkhris las gyur pa / bu ga'i rtse mo phra ba yis / mtshan gyi nang ni kun tu khyab / de ni kha brgya pa zhes bya

verses.skt: pittāsṛgbhyāṃ tvacaḥ pākas tvakpāko jvaradāhavān | māṃspākaḥ sarvajaḥ sarvavedano māṃsaśātanaḥ
verses.tib: khrag mkhris las gyur pags pa rnams / tsha zhing rims bcas pags pa smin / 'dus pa las gyur sha rnams ni / thams cad ngan pas smin pa yin / 'brum bu gnag cing dmar ba yi / 'brum bu dag gis gnod 'gyur shing / pho mtshan shin tu na ba gang / de ni khrag gi 'brum bu yin

verses.skt: sarāgair asitaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ piṭikābhiś ca pīḍitam | mehanaṃ vedanā cogrā taṃ vidyād asṛgarbudam
verses.tib: khrag mkhris las gyur pags pa rnams / tsha zhing rims bcas pags pa smin / 'dus pa las gyur sha rnams ni / thams cad ngan pas smin pa yin / 'brum bu gnag cing dmar ba yi / 'brum bu dag gis gnod 'gyur shing / pho mtshan shin tu na ba gang / de ni khrag gi 'brum bu yin

verses.skt: māṃsārbudaṃ prāg uditaṃ vidradhiś ca tridoṣajaḥ | kṛṣṇāni bhūtvā māṃsāni viśīryante samantataḥ
verses.tib: sha yi mdzer pa sngar bshad do / khong 'bras nad gzhi gsum las skyes / 'dus pas mtshan ni rnags gyur cing / sha ni nag por gyur pa dang

verses.skt: pakvāni saṃnipātena tān vidyāt tilakālakān | māṃsottham arbudaṃ pākaṃ vidradhiṃ tilakālakān
verses.tib: kun nas zhig par byed pa gang / de ni til nag ces brjod bshad / sha las gyur pa'i 'brum bu rnags / khong 'bras til nag ces bya ba

verses.skt: caturo varjayed eṣāṃ śeṣāñ chīghram upācaret | viṃśatir vyāpado yoner jāyante duṣṭabhojanāt
verses.tib: bzhi po 'di dag spang bar bya / lhag ma rnams ni myur du gso / kha zas gnod pa zos pa dang

verses.skt: viṣamasthāṅgaśayanabhṛśamaithunasevanaiḥ | duṣṭārtavād apadravair bījadoṣeṇa daivataḥ
verses.tib: mal stan mi bder nyal ba dang / nyal po bsten ni drags pa dang / nang na nad khrag sman gnod dang / sa bon nyes pa rnam smin las

verses.skt: yonau kruddho ’nilaḥ kuryād ruktodāyāmasuptatāḥ | pipīlikāsṛptim iva stambhaṃ karkaśatāṃ svanam
verses.tib: rlung gis mngal la gnod gyur pas / na zug yangs shing tshor ba med / grog mas khyab pa snyam du sems / sra zhing rtsub pa sgra dang bcas

verses.skt: phenilāruṇakṛṣṇālpatanurūkṣārtavasrutim | sraṃsaṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśvādau vyathāṃ gulmaṃ krameṇa ca
verses.tib: zla mtshan sla zhing wu ba can / nyung zhing gnag pa 'dzag par byed / chu so rtsib logs lhod pa dang / na zhing rim gyis skran bskyed la

verses.skt: tāṃs tāṃś ca svān gadān vyāpad vātikī nāma sā smṛtā | saivāticaraṇā śophasaṃyuktātivyavāyataḥ
verses.tib: rang rang nyes pa de dang de / de ni rlung can yin zhes bshad / de nyid shas cher spyad na skrang / bcas pa nyal po drags zhes bya

verses.skt: maithunād atibālāyāḥ pṛṣṭhajaṅghoruvaṅkṣaṇam | rujan saṃdūṣayed yoniṃ vāyuḥ prākcaraṇeti sā
verses.tib: shin tu gzhon la 'khrig pa spyad / rgyab dang chu so byin par ni / na zhing mngal la gnod byed pa / de ni spyad sngas pa zhes bya

verses.skt: vegodāvartanād yoniṃ prapīḍayati mārutaḥ | sā phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrād udāvṛttaṃ vimuñcati
verses.tib: shugs 'khyil ba yi mngal du ni / rlung gis gnod par gyur pa las / zla mtshan lbu ba can 'byung ba / 'khyil ba lta bur snang gyur pa

verses.skt: iyaṃ vyāpad udāvṛttā jātaghnī tu yadānilaḥ | jātaṃ jātaṃ sutaṃ hanti raukṣyād duṣṭārtavodbhavam
verses.tib: nad 'di 'khyil pa can zhes bya / gang tshe rlung ni rtsub pos bu / skye zhing skye zhing gsod byed pa / skyes nas gsod pa zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: atyāśitāyā viṣamaṃ sthitāyāḥ surate marut | annenotpīḍito yoneḥ sthitaḥ srotasi vakrayet
verses.tib: 'grangs drags mi mnyam gnas par ni / 'dod pa spyad pas rlung 'khrugs shing / gzhan gyis gnod par gyur pa las / mtshan gyi bu ga sha rus la

verses.skt: sāsthimāṃsaṃ mukhaṃ tīvrarujam antarmukhīti sā | vātalāhārasevinyāṃ jananyāṃ kupito ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: gnod gyur mngal ni yon bor 'gyur / na gyur nang du kha bltas yin / kha zas rlung can bsten pa yis / zla mtshan rlung gis gnod gyur zhing

verses.skt: striyo yonim aṇudvārāṃ kuryāt sūcīmukhīti sā | vegarodhād ṛtau vāyur duṣṭo viṇmūtrasaṃgraham
verses.tib: bud med mo mtshan zhum gyur par / byed pa de ni khabs mig yin / dus su shugs bkag rlung 'phel bas / bshang dang gci ba 'gag byed cing

verses.skt: karoti yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca śuṣkākhyā sātivedanā | ṣaḍahāt saptarātrād vā śukraṃ garbhāśayān marut
verses.tib: mo mtshan skam par byed pa dang / shas cher na ba mngal skams yin / zhag drug gam ni zhag bdun nas / rlung gis mngal gnas khu ba 'byin

verses.skt: vamet saruṅ nīrujo vā yasyāḥ sā vāminī matā | yonau vātopataptāyāṃ strīgarbhe bījadoṣataḥ
verses.tib: nad bcas pa'am nad med pa / de ni khu ba slon zhes bya / bud med mngal dang sa bon gyi / nyes pa rlung gis gnod gyur zhing

verses.skt: nṛdveṣiṇy astanī ca syāt ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñānupakramā | duṣṭo viṣṭabhya yonyāsyaṃ garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca mārutaḥ
verses.tib: 'khrig par mi dga' nu ma med / ma ning yin te gsor mi rung / mngal gyi nang du rlung gis ni / gnod gyur mo mtshan khong khar gnas

verses.skt: kurute vivṛtāṃ srastāṃ vātikīm iva duḥkhitām | utsannamāṃsāṃ tām āhur mahāyoniṃ mahārujām
verses.tib: bye ba'am lhod par gyur pa dang / rlung can bzhin du na gyur pa / sha ni mtho bar gyur pa ste / mo mtshan che nad tshabs che bya

verses.skt: yathāsvair dūṣaṇair duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yonim upāśritam | karoti dāhapākoṣāpūtigandhijvarānvitām
verses.tib: mkhris pa mngal na gnas pa yi / nang gi nad gzhis gnod gyur pa / tsha ba'am rnag par byed 'gyur zhing / dri mnam rims kyis 'debs pa dang

verses.skt: bhṛśoṣṇabhūrikuṇapanīlapītāsitārtavām | sā vyāpat paittikī raktayonyākhyāsṛgatisruteḥ
verses.tib: shin tu tsha zhing ro ltar mnam / zla mtshan sngo nag ser por 'dzag / nad de mkhris pa can zhes bya / zla mtshan cher 'dzag khrag can yin

verses.skt: kapho ’bhiṣyandibhiḥ kruddhaḥ kuryād yonim avedanām | śītalāṃ kaṇḍulāṃ pāṇḍupicchilāṃ tadvidhasrutim
verses.tib: bad kan skyed par byed pa yis / mo mtshan gnod gyur na ba med / grang zhing dkar la g.ya' ba dang / spyin bag tu ni 'dzag par byed

verses.skt: sā vyāpac chlaiṣmikī vātapittābhyāṃ kṣīyate rajaḥ | sadāhakārśyavaivarṇyaṃ yasyāḥ sā lohitakṣayā
verses.tib: nad de bad kan las gyur yin / rlung mkhris 'khrugs pas zla mtshan zad / tsha zhing lus skems mdog mi sdug / de ni khrag zad pa zhes bya

verses.skt: pittalāyā nṛsaṃvāse kṣavathūdgāradhāraṇāt | pittayuktena marutā yonir bhavati dūṣitā
verses.tib: mkhris pa shas che nyal po bsten / sgrid pa sbregs pa bkag pa / las / mkhris par bcas pa'i rlung gis ni / mngal du gnod pa skyed par 'gyur

verses.skt: śūnā sparśāsahā sārtir nīlapītāsravāhinī | vastikukṣigurutvātīsārārocakakāriṇī
verses.tib: skrang zhing nyam thag reg mi bzod / zla mtshan sngo dang ser por 'byung / pho ba'i lto ni lci ba dang / 'khru zhing yi ga 'chus par byed

verses.skt: śroṇivaṅkṣaṇaruktodajvarakṛt sā pariplutā | vātaśleṣmāmayavyāptā śvetapicchilavāhinī
verses.tib: chu so brla ni na zhing zug / rims skyed yongs rgyas nad ces bya / rlung dang bad kan nad kyis khyab / mngal nas skye zhing spyi bag 'dzag / nye bar 'dzag pa zhes bya'o / srin bu skyes shing g.ya' bas 'dod pa las / rab gdungs de ni rnam par g.yeng zhes bya

verses.skt: upaplutā smṛtā yonir viplutākhyā tv adhāvanāt | saṃjātajantuḥ kaṇḍūlā kaṇḍvā cātiratipriyā
verses.tib: chu so brla ni na zhing zug / rims skyed yongs rgyas nad ces bya / rlung dang bad kan nad kyis khyab / mngal nas skye zhing spyi bag 'dzag / nye bar 'dzag pa zhes bya'o / srin bu skyes shing g.ya' bas 'dod pa las / rab gdungs de ni rnam par g.yeng zhes bya

verses.skt: akālavāhanād vāyuḥ śleṣmaraktavimūrchitaḥ | karṇikāṃ janayed yonau rajomārganirodhinīm
verses.tib: dus min spyod par gyur pas rlung / bad kan khrag dang 'dres gyur te / zla mtshan lam ni 'gag byed de / mngal du lte ba skyed par byed

verses.skt: sā karṇinī tribhir doṣair yonigarbhāśayāśritaiḥ | yathāsvopadravakarair vyāpat sā sāṃnipātikī
verses.tib: nad gzhi gsum ni mo mtshan gyi / mngal nas rang rang gnod pa skyed / 'dus pa las gyur nyes pa yin

verses.skt: iti yonigadā nārī yaiḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati | tato garbhaṃ na gṛhṇāti rogāṃś cāpnoti dāruṇān
verses.tib: de ltar bud med mngal nad kyis / khu ba 'dzin par mi byed de / des na mngal du bu mi chags / mi bzad nad kyang skye 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: asṛgdarārśogulmādīn ābādhāṃś cānilādibhiḥ
verses.tib: khrag 'byung gzhang 'brum skran la sogs / rlung sogs nad ni kun skyed byed

verses.skt: meḍhramadhye sirāṃ vidhyed upadaṃśe navotthite | śītāṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ śuddhiṃ virekeṇa viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: sos 'dzin 'dra ba gsar byung la / pho mtshan dbus na gtar ga gdab / bsil ba'i gso bas sbyang bar bya / khyad par du ni bkru sman gtang

verses.skt: tilakalkaghṛtakṣaudrair lepaḥ pakve tu pāṭite | jambvāmrasumanonīpaśvetakāmbojikāṅkurān
verses.tib: smin na til gyi lde gu ni / sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas pa bsku / 'dzam bu a mra klu shing dang / nim pa kam po dza'i myu gu

verses.skt: śallakībadarībilvapalāśatiniśodbhavāḥ | tvacaḥ kṣīridrumāṇāṃ ca triphalāṃ ca pacej jale
verses.tib: rgya shug bil ba sa li ka / rgya skyegs til ni sha yi shun / 'o ma can gyi shing gi shun / 'bras bu gsum ni chur bskol ba'i

verses.skt: sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam | tutthagairikalodhrailāmanohvālarasāñjanaiḥ
verses.tib: khu ba des ni bkru ba dang / de bskol til mar gyis rma 'tshob / spangs ma seng phrom btsag yug snam / sug smel ldong ros ba bla dang

verses.skt: hareṇupuṣpakāsīsasaurāṣṭrīlavaṇottamaiḥ | lepaḥ kṣaudradrutaiḥ sūkṣmair upadaṃśavraṇāpahaḥ
verses.tib: nag tshur rgya skyegs skyer khaN+Da / rgyam tsha ha re Nu ka yi / phye ma sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku / sos 'dzin lta bu'i rma 'tshob byed

verses.skt: kapāle triphalā dagdhā saghṛtā ropaṇaṃ param | sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idaṃ pratidoṣaṃ tu śophavat
verses.tib: kham phor sbyar bar 'bras bu gsum / bsregs pa mar bcas rma 'tshob byed / 'di ni spyi / yi gso ba yin

verses.skt: na ca yāti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhṛśam | pakvaiḥ snāyusirāmāṃsaiḥ prāyo naśyati hi dhvajaḥ
verses.tib: sman pas ci nas rnags par ni / mi 'gyur de ltar 'bad par bya / rnags na rgyus pa rtsa dang sha / zhig pas pho mtshan ma rungs 'gyur

verses.skt: arśasāṃ chinnadagdhānāṃ kriyā kāryopadaṃśavat | sarṣapā likhitāḥ sūkṣmaiḥ kaṣāyair avacūrṇayet
verses.tib: 'brum pa bcad dang bsregs pa yi / gso ba so sa 'dzin lta bur bya / brud nas yungs kar phye zhib dang / bskol sman phye mas gdab par bya

verses.skt: tair evābhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ sādhayed vraṇaropaṇam | kriyeyam avamanthe ’pi raktaṃ srāvyaṃ tathobhayoḥ
verses.tib: til mar de nyid kyis bsku zhing / rma 'tsho ba pa yi gso ba bya / mnye gso ba ni 'di nyid bya / de dag gnyi gar gtar ga gdab / khong stong la ni gtar ga bya

verses.skt: kumbhīkāyāṃ hared raktaṃ pakvāyāṃ śodhite vraṇe | tindukatriphalālodhrair lepas tailaṃ ca ropaṇam
verses.tib: rnags la rma ni dag par bya / tin du ka dang 'bras bu gsum / seng phrom lde gu til mar bsku / 'bras byer la ni gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: alajyāṃ srutaraktāyām ayam eva kriyākramaḥ | uttamākhyāṃ tu piṭikāṃ saṃchidya baḍiśoddhṛtām
verses.tib: gso ba'i rim pa 'di nyid bya / mchog ces bya ba'i 'brum bu ni / brtol te lcags kyus blangs te bcad

verses.skt: kalkaiś cūrṇaiḥ kaṣāyāṇāṃ kṣaudrayuktair upācaret | kramaḥ pittavisarpoktaḥ puṣkaravyūḍhayor hitaḥ
verses.tib: lde gu phye ma sman khu ni / sbrang rtsir bcas pas gso bar bya / mnye dang pad+ma can la ni / mkhris pa'i me dbal gso bar bya

verses.skt: tvakpāke sparśahānyāṃ ca secayed mṛditaṃ punaḥ | balātailena koṣṇena madhuraiś copanāhayet
verses.tib: pags smin tshor ba med pa la'ang / pho mo'i gso ba 'di nyid bya / mnye la dugs ni bya ba dang / ba la'i sman mar dro 'jam blugs / mngar ba'i sman sbyar dkri dugs bya

verses.skt: aṣṭhīlikāṃ hṛte rakte śleṣmagranthivad ācaret | nivṛttaṃ sarpiṣābhyajya svedayitvopanāhayet
verses.tib: gtun shing 'dra la gtar ga gdab / bad kan rmen bu lta bur gso / pags pa ldog la mar gyis bsku

verses.skt: trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā susnigdhaiḥ śālvaṇādibhiḥ | svedayitvā tato bhūyaḥ snigdhaṃ carma samānayet
verses.tib: sa lba la sogs snum gyur pas / zhag gsum mam ni zhag lnga ru / dkri ba'i las ni spyad par bya / dugs bya de yi 'og tu ni / snum gyur pags pa drang bar bya

verses.skt: maṇiṃ prapīḍya śanakaiḥ praviṣṭe copanāhanam | maṇau punaḥ punaḥ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ cātra śasyate
verses.tib: nor bu rim gyis btsir nas ni / chud nas nye bar dkri bar bya / nor bu yang yang snum chos bya / kha zas snum can sbyin pa'ang phan

verses.skt: ayam eva prayojyaḥ syād avapāṭyām api kramaḥ | nāḍīm ubhayatodvārāṃ niruddhe jatunā sṛtām
verses.tib: gas pa la yang cho ga yi / rim pa ji bzhin byas pa'ang phan / 'gags pa sbu gu kha gnyis pa

verses.skt: snehāktāṃ srotasi nyasya siñcet snehaiś calāpahaiḥ | tryahāt tryahāt sthūlatarāṃ nyasya nāḍīṃ vivardhayet
verses.tib: rgya skyegs kyis ni dkris pa la / snum bskus bu gar bcug nas ni / rlung 'joms snum ni blugs par bya / sbu gu zhag ni gsum gsum nas / legs par bskyed de spang bar bya

verses.skt: srotodvāram asiddhau tu vidvān śastreṇa pāṭayet | sevanīṃ varjayan yuñjyāt sadyaḥkṣatavidhiṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: sbu gu'i sbyor bas ma grub na / mkhas pas mdoms kyi srubs can ni / bor te mtshon gyis dral nas kyang / de 'og rma gsar cho ga bya

verses.skt: granthitaṃ sveditaṃ nāḍyā snigdhoṣṇair upanāhayet | limpet kaṣāyaiḥ sakṣaudrair likhitvā śataponakam
verses.tib: rmen bur sbu gu'i dugs byas la / snum zhing dro bas dkri bar bya / kha brgya pa ni bzhar nas kyang / bska ba sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku

verses.skt: raktavidradhivat kāryā cikitsā śoṇitārbude | vraṇopacāraṃ sarveṣu yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: khrag gi 'brum bu khrag gi ni / khong 'bras bzhin du gso bar bya / kun la rma yi gso ba ni / gnas skabs ji bzhin sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: yonivyāpatsu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śasyate karma vātajit | snehanasvedavastyādi vātajāsu viśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: mngal gyi nad la mang du ni / snum chos dugs dang mas gtong sogs / rlung 'joms pa yi gso ba bsngags / rlung las gyur la mchog tu sbyar

verses.skt: na hi vātād ṛte yonir vanitānāṃ praduṣyati | ato jitvā tam anyasya kuryād doṣasya bheṣajam
verses.tib: bud med kyi ni mngal gyi nad / rlung ma gtogs par 'byung mi 'gyur / de bas rlung ni bsal byas la / nad gzhan gyis ni gso sman bya

verses.skt: pāyayeta balātailaṃ miśrakaṃ sukumārakam | snigdhasvinnāṃ tathā yoniṃ duḥsthitāṃ sthāpayet samām
verses.tib: ba la'i til mar blud bya zhing / 'dren ma skye de'i 'o ma blud / snum chos dugs ni byas te mngal / nyes par gnas pa mnyam du gzhag

verses.skt: pāṇinā namayej jihmāṃ saṃvṛtāṃ vyadhayet punaḥ | praveśayen niḥsṛtāṃ ca vivṛtāṃ parivartayet
verses.tib: yon po lag pas drang por bsrang / zhum pa slar ni bskyed par bya / byung ba slar ni gzhug bya zhing / gyes pa yongs su bzlog par bya

verses.skt: sthānāpavṛttā yonir hi śalyabhūtā striyo matā | karmabhir vamanādyaiś ca mṛdubhir yojayet striyam
verses.tib: mngal ni gnas nas g.yos gyur pa / bud med zug rngur gyur par 'dod / bud med la ni slon sman sogs / 'jam po yongs su sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: sarvataḥ suviśuddhāyāḥ śeṣaṃ karma vidhīyate | vastyabhyaṅgaparīṣekapralepapicudhāraṇam
verses.tib: rnam pa kun tu dag gyur nas / 'jam rtsi bsku byug sman khu blugs / byugs dang ye'u gzhug la sogs / gso ba'i las ni lhag ma spyad

verses.skt: kāśmaryatriphalādrākṣākāsamardaniśādvayaiḥ | guḍūcīsairyakābhīruśukanāsāpunarnavaiḥ
verses.tib: rgun 'brum tang pal 'bras bu gsum / ka sa mar da ser po gnyis / sle tres nye'u shing sher+ya ka

verses.skt: parūṣakaiś ca vipacet prastham akṣasamair ghṛtāt | yonivātavikāraghnaṃ tat pītaṃ garbhadaṃ param
verses.tib: shu ka na sa ba spru ba / pa ru sha ka zho gnyis gnyis / mar ni bre gang bcas par bskol / de blud mngal gyi rlung nad dang / bu skyed byed pa'i mchog yin no

verses.skt: vacopakuñcikājājīkṛṣṇāvṛṣakasaindhavam | ajamodāyavakṣāraśarkarācitrakānvitam
verses.tib: zi ra go snyod pi pi ling / shu dag rgyam tsha ba sha ka / nas tshig 'khus thal ti mus / tsi tra ka dang kha rar bcas

verses.skt: piṣṭvā prasannayāloḍya khādet tad ghṛtabharjitam | yonipārśvārtihṛdrogagulmārśovinivṛttaye
verses.tib: btags te chang gi dngas mar sbyar / mar brngos de ni byin gyur na / mngal nad rtsib logs snying nad dang / skrangs dang gzhang 'brum sel bar byed

verses.skt: vṛṣakaṃ mātuluṅgasya mūlāni madayantikām | piben madyaiḥ salavaṇais tathā kṛṣṇopakuñcike
verses.tib: kha lung khu ba ka sha'i rtsa ba / zi ra nag po go snyod dang / sen rtsi rgyam tsha'i phye ma ni / chang dang sbyar te blud par bya

verses.skt: rāsnāśvadaṃṣṭrāvṛṣakaiḥ śṛtaṃ śūlaharaṃ payaḥ | guḍūcītriphalādantīkvāthaiś ca pariṣecanam
verses.tib: ra sna gze ma ba sha ka / bskol ba gzer 'joms mchog yin no / sle tres dan dang 'bras bu gsum / bskol ba'i khu ba'ang / blugs par bya

verses.skt: natavārtākinīkuṣṭhasaindhavāmaradārubhiḥ | tailāt prasādhitād dhāryaḥ picur yonau rujāpahaḥ
verses.tib: rgya spos kaN+Da ka ri dang / ru rta rgyam tsha thang shing rnams / bskol ba'i khu ba til mar bskol / sbangs pa'i ye'us mngal nad sel

verses.skt: pittalānāṃ tu yonīnāṃ sekābhyaṅgapicukriyāḥ | śītāḥ pittajitaḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca
verses.tib: mngal nad mkhris pa las gyur pa / chu blugs bsku byug ye'u yis / gso ba bsil zhing mkhris 'joms pa / snum chos don du mar gyis bya

verses.skt: śatāvarīmūlatulācatuṣkāt kṣuṇṇapīḍitāt | rasena kṣīratulyena pācayeta ghṛtāḍhakam
verses.tib: nye'u shing rtsa ba srang bzhi brgya / brdungs te btsir ba'i khu ba dang / 'o ma de mnyam mar bre ni / bzhi yi nang du bskol bar bya

verses.skt: jīvanīyaiḥ śatāvaryā mṛdvīkābhiḥ parūṣakaiḥ | piṣṭaiḥ priyālaiś cākṣāṃśair dvibalāmadhukānvitaiḥ
verses.tib: 'tsho byed sde tshan nye'u shing dang / pa ru sha ka rgun 'brum dang / pi la ya dang ba la gnyis / shing mngar zho ni gnyis gnyis phye

verses.skt: siddhaśīte tu madhunaḥ pippalyāś ca palāṣṭakam | śarkarāyā daśapalaṃ kṣipel lihyāt picuṃ tataḥ
verses.tib: bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi dang / pi pi ling ni srang brgyad brgyad / ka ra dkar po srang bcu gzhug

verses.skt: yonyasṛkśukradoṣaghnaṃ vṛṣyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param | kṣataṃ kṣayam asṛkpittaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ halīmakam
verses.tib: mngal khrag khu ba'i nad sel zhing / ro tsa bu skyed byed mchog yin / glo rdol zang byed khrag mkhris dang / lud pa dbugs mi bde ba dang

verses.skt: kāmalāṃ vātarudhiraṃ visarpaṃ hṛcchirograham | apasmārārditāyāmamadonmādāṃś ca nāśayet
verses.tib: mig ser rlung dang khrag dang ni / me dbal dang ni snying nad dang / brjed byed kyis nyen da rgan dang / myos byed skem byed 'joms par byed

verses.skt: evam eva payaḥsarpir jīvanīyopasādhitam | garbhadaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam
verses.tib: de bzhin 'o ma zhun mar dang / 'tsho byed sde tshan bskol ba ni / bu skyed mkhris pa las gyur pa'i / mngal nad sel ba'i dam pa yin

verses.skt: balādroṇadvayakvāthe ghṛtatailāḍhakaṃ pacet | kṣīre caturguṇe kṛṣṇākākanāsāsitānvitaiḥ
verses.tib: ba la bre ni sum cu gnyis / bskol ba'i til mar mar bre bzhi / 'o ma bzhi 'gyur pi pi ling / ka ka ma si ka ra dkar

verses.skt: jīvantīkṣīrakākolīsthirāvīrarddhijīvakaiḥ | payasyāśrāvaṇīmudgapīlumāṣākhyaparṇibhiḥ
verses.tib: dzi ban ti dang ram nye ba / s+thi ra nye shing zi ra gnyis / mon sran gre'u pa ya s+ya / ma sha par+Ni sra ba ni / pi lu'i lo ma lhan cig bskol

verses.skt: vātapittāmayān hatvā pānād garbhaṃ dadhāti tat | raktayonyām asṛgvarṇair anubandham avekṣya ca
verses.tib: blud na rlung mkhris las gyur pa'i / mngal nad sel zhing bu skyed byed / khrag gi mngal nad khrag mdog las / rjes su 'brel ba brtags nas kyang / nad gzhi bsags pa'i tshul las ni / khrag bcad pa yi sman gtang bya

verses.skt: yathādoṣodayaṃ yuñjyād raktasthāpanam auṣadham | pāṭhāṃ jambvāmrayor asthi śilodbhedaṃ rasāñjanam
verses.tib: blud na rlung mkhris las gyur pa'i / mngal nad sel zhing bu skyed byed / khrag gi mngal nad khrag mdog las / rjes su 'brel ba brtags nas kyang / nad gzhi bsags pa'i tshul las ni / khrag bcad pa yi sman gtang bya

verses.skt: mañjiṣṭhāgurukaṭphalamustapriyaṅgumiśikuṣṭhaiḥ | kaṭvaṅgakuṭajaśābarakakubhatvaṅmadhukapadmakamadhūkaiḥ
verses.tib: shing mngar sbrang rtsi chu shing rtsa / ta la'i sa bon skyer pa'i rtsa / pri yang ku dang 'bras drus chu

verses.skt: kuṅkumabilvātiviṣāmākṣīkarasāñjanaiḥ sakiñjalkaiḥ | piṣṭair ghṛtaṃ vipakvaṃ dviguṇājakṣīrasaṃyuktam
verses.tib: sbyar ba blud na khrag 'dzag pa / mdog skya dmar po sel bar byed / pa tha 'dzam bu a mra yi / tshi gu dang ni brag zhun dang / skyer pa'i khaN+Da aM baSh+Ta

verses.skt: strīṇām apatyajananaṃ yonirujādoṣajit sadā yuñjyāt | uttaravastiṣu sarpir yojyaṃ kalyāṇakaṃ nāma
ambaṣṭhāṃ śālmalīpicchāṃ samaṅgāṃ vatsakatvacam | bāhlīkabilvātiviṣālodhratoyadagairikam
verses.tib: btsod dang shal ma li'i thang chu / dug mo nyung gi shun / lpags dang / gur gum bil ba bong nga dkar / seng phrom gla sgang btsag yug snam

verses.skt: śuṇṭhīmadhūkamācīkaraktacandanakaṭphalam | kaṭvaṅgavatsakānantādhātakīmadhukārjunam
verses.tib: shing mngar tsan+dan dmar po dang / kad pa la dang tsa ma ka / ka Tang ka dang dug mo nyung / byi tsher ba dang da ta ki / ma du ka dang stang zil ni

verses.skt: puṣye gṛhītvā saṃcūrṇya sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbhasā | pibed arśaḥsv atīsāre raktaṃ yaś copaveśyate
verses.tib: skar ma rgyal la bab pa na / btus shing btags te sbrang rtsi dang / 'bras kyi chur sbyar blud na ni / gzhang 'brum tshad par 'khru ba dang / gang yang khrag tu 'khru ba dang

verses.skt: doṣā jantukṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃś ca nāśayet | yonidoṣaṃ rajodoṣaṃ śyāvaśvetāruṇāsitam
verses.tib: gang yang srin bu'i nad rnams dang / byis pa'i nad gang yin pa 'joms / mngal gyi nad dang zla mtshan nad / gnag cing dkar dang dmar ba sel

verses.skt: cūrṇaṃ puṣyānugaṃ nāma hitam ātreyapūjitam | yonyāṃ balāsaduṣṭāyāṃ sarvaṃ rūkṣoṣṇam auṣadham
verses.tib: phye ma rgyal gyi rjes 'gro ba / phan zhes rgyun shes bu yis bshad / bad kan las gyur mngal nad la / rtsub dang dro ba'i sman kun sbyar

verses.skt: dhātakyāmalakīpattrasrotojamadhukotpalaiḥ | jambvāmrasārakāsīsalodhrakaṭphalatindukaiḥ
verses.tib: skyu ru'i lo ma da ta ki / shing mngar ut+pal lig bu mig / 'dzam bu a mra'i tshi gu dang / seng phrom sa nag kang pa la

verses.skt: saurāṣṭrikādāḍimatvagudumbaraśalāṭubhiḥ | akṣamātrair ajāmūtre kṣīre ca dviguṇe pacet
verses.tib: se'u 'bru shing tsha tin du ka / u dum bA ra bil ba gzhon / zho ni gnyis gnyis btags pa'i phye / ra gcin 'o ma nyis 'gyur dang

verses.skt: tailaprasthaṃ tad abhyaṅgapicuvastiṣu yojayet | tena śūnonnatā stabdhā picchilā srāviṇī tathā
verses.tib: til mar bre gang bskol bar bya / de bsku ba dang 'jam rtsi dang / ras bal ye'us gzhug par bya / skrang zhing phyir log mtho zhing sra / de bzhin spyi bag 'dzag pa dang

verses.skt: viplutopaplutā yoniḥ sidhyet sasphoṭaśūlinī | yavānnam abhayāriṣṭaṃ sīdhu tailaṃ ca śīlayet
verses.tib: phyir 'bur nang du zhum pa dang / 'brum bu gzer dang bcas la phan / nas zan a ru sbyar chang dang / bu ram chang dang til mar bsten

verses.skt: pippalyayorajaḥpathyāprayogāṃś ca samākṣikān | kāsīsaṃ triphalā kāṅkṣī sāmrajambvasthi dhātakī
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang lcags phye dang / a rur sbyor sbrang rtsi phan / nag tshur rgyam tsha 'bras bu gsum / a mra 'dzam bu'i tshi gu bcas

verses.skt: paicchilye kṣaudrasaṃyuktaś cūrṇo vaiśadyakārakaḥ | palāśadhātakījambūsamaṅgāmocasarjajaḥ
verses.tib: da ta ka'i phye sbrang rtsir sbyar / spyi bag 'dzag pa dag par byed / rgya skyegs 'dzam bu da ta ki / so ma ra dza la mang gi / sra rtsi pog gi phye ma yis

verses.skt: durgandhe picchile klede stambhanaś cūrṇa iṣyate | āragvadhādivargasya kaṣāyaḥ pariṣecanam
verses.tib: dri mi zhim dang spyi bag 'dzag / rnags shing sra ba sel bar byed / dong ga la sogs sde tshan ni / bskol ba'i khu ba blugs par bya

verses.skt: stabdhānāṃ karkaśānāṃ ca kāryaṃ mārdavakārakam | dhāraṇaṃ vesavārasya kṛśarāpāyasasya ca
verses.tib: sra zhing rtsub par gyur pa la / mnyen pa'i cho ga bya ba dang / sha brdungs pa yis glan pa dang / kri sa ra dang 'o thug gzhung

verses.skt: durgandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ syāt tailaṃ vā kalka eva vā | cūrṇo vā sarvagandhānāṃ pūtigandhāpakarṣaṇaḥ
verses.tib: dri ngar til mar dri zhim pa'am / lde gu dri zhim bsku ba'am / dri kun gyi phye ma'am / rul ba'i dri ni sel byed

verses.skt: śleṣmalānāṃ kaṭuprāyāḥ samūtrā vastayo hitāḥ | pitte samadhukakṣīrā vāte tailāmlasaṃyutāḥ
verses.tib: gzhug / bad kan can la phal cher sman / tsha ba ba gcin mas gtong phan / mkhris pa shing mngar 'o mar bcas / rlung gyur skyur bcas til mar phan

verses.skt: saṃnipātasamutthāyāḥ karma sādhāraṇaṃ hitam | evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ
verses.tib: 'dus pa las gyur nad la ni / thun mong gis ni gso ba phan / de ltar mngal ni dag gyur na

verses.skt: candano natayośīratiktāpadmebhakesaraiḥ | kuṭajatvakphalaṃ mustaṃ jambvāmrāsthi rasāñjanam
padmakotpalabilvābdakaṭphalaiḥ sādhitā niśā | dhātakyativiṣāmāṃsīpāṭhāmocarasodakam
madhūkaṃ madhukānantāśārivādāḍima[tva]cam | mṛllodhrārjunaśaileyasamaṅgā nāgarāḥ samāḥ
cūrṇaṃ śreṣṭhāmbunā pītaṃ hanti lohitamehinam | mūrchātṛṣṇājvarārtāya raktātīsāramehinām
strīṇām asṛgdaraṃ yāti garbhasaṃsthāpanaṃ param
verses.tib: sa bon skyon med tha mal bar / rnam par shes pa 'jug pas na / bud med la ni bu chags 'gyur / skyes pa yi ni dbang po yang / las rnam lnga yis dag bya zhing

verses.skt: aduṣṭe prākṛte bīje jīvopakramaṇe sati | pañcakarmaviśuddhasya puruṣasyāpi cendriyam
verses.tib: sa bon skyon med tha mal bar / rnam par shes pa 'jug pas na / bud med la ni bu chags 'gyur / skyes pa yi ni dbang po yang / las rnam lnga yis dag bya zhing

verses.skt: parīkṣya varṇair doṣāṇāṃ duṣṭaṃ tadghnair upācaret | mañjiṣṭhākuṣṭhatagaratriphalāśarkarāvacāḥ
verses.tib: mdog las nad gzhi brtags nas ni / nad bcas de 'joms sman gyis gso / ru rta rgya spos shu dag bcod / 'bras bu gsum dang kar dkar

verses.skt: rasaṃ śirīṣapattrāṇāṃ kalkaṃ ca ṣaḍahaḥ pibet | kṣīropanāśinā yoṣid ṛtusnātā sutārthinī
dve niśe madhukaṃ medāṃ dīpyakaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm | payasyāhiṅgukākolīvājigandhāśatāvarīḥ
verses.tib: shing mngar me da ser po gnyis / la la phud dang pu tse shel / shing mngar ram nye pa ya s+ya / a shwa gan+d+ha nye'u shing pa / zho ni gnyis gnyis btags pa'i phye

verses.skt: piṣṭvākṣāṃśā ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet kṣīracaturguṇam | yoniśukrapradoṣeṣu tat sarveṣu praśasyate
verses.tib: mar bre gang dang 'o ma ni / bzhi 'gyur bcas pa bskol bar bya / blud na mngal dang khu ba yi / nyes pa thams cad sel byed cing

verses.skt: āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ medhyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param | phalasarpir iti khyātaṃ puṣpe pītaṃ phalāya yat
verses.tib: tshe ring lus ni rgyas byed la / yid gzhungs pa dang bkra shis dang / bu skyed par ni byed mchog yin / 'bras bu'i sman mar zhes byar bshad / zla mtshan rgyu tshe 'thungs gyur na

verses.skt: mriyamāṇaprajānāṃ ca garbhiṇīnāṃ ca pūjitam | etat paraṃ ca bālānāṃ grahaghnaṃ dehavardhanam
verses.tib: bu ni 'chi bar byed pa yang / 'tsho zhing sbrum ma rnams la bsngags / 'di ni mchog tu byis pa yi / lus rgyas gdon 'joms byed pa yin

verses.skt: mathyamāne jalanidhāv amṛtārthaṃ surāsuraiḥ | jātaḥ prāg amṛtotpatteḥ puruṣo ghoradarśanaḥ
verses.tib: sngon ni lha dang lha ma yin / bdud rtsi 'dod pas bsrubs pa na / bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i sngon rol du / skyes bu shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs

verses.skt: dīptatejāś caturdaṃṣṭro harikeśo ’nalekṣaṇaḥ | jagad viṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.tib: mche ba bzhi pa gzi brjid 'bar / skra ser mig ni me 'bar ba / de mthong 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur / des na 'di ni dug ces bya

verses.skt: huṅkṛto brahmaṇā mūrtī tataḥ sthāvarajaṅgame | so ’dhyatiṣṭhan nijaṃ rūpam ujjhitvā vañcanātmakam
verses.tib: tshangs pas hUM zhes brjod pa dang / bslu ba'i bdag nyid can spangs te / gzugs de rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i / gzugs la de ni zhugs par gyur

verses.skt: sthiram ity ulbaṇaṃ vīrye yat kandeṣu pratiṣṭhitam | kālakūṭendravatsākhyaśṛṅgīhālāhalādikam
verses.tib: brtan dug nus pa mi bzad par / sdong bu la ni gnas pa gang / ka la ku ta dbang po'i bu / btsan dug ha la ha / la sogs

verses.skt: sarpalūtādidaṃṣṭrāsu dāruṇaṃ jaṅgamaṃ viṣam | sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti viṣaṃ proktam akṛtrimam
verses.tib: rgyu ba'i dug ni mi bzad gyur / sprul dang phag dang mche ba can / rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu ba'i / bcos ma ma yin dug tu bshad

verses.skt: kṛtrimaṃ garasaṃjñaṃ tu kriyate vividhauṣadhaiḥ | hanti yogavaśenāśu cirāc ciratarāc ca tat
verses.tib: bcos ma sna tshogs sman la ni / sbyar ba sbyar ba'i dug ces bya / de ni sbyor ba'i dbang las ni / shin tu ring nas gsod pa'am

verses.skt: śophapāṇḍūdaronmādadurnāmādīn karoti vā | tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣaviśadaṃ vyavāyy āśukaraṃ laghu
verses.tib: skrang dang skya rbab dmu rdzing dang / smyo byed gzhang 'brum la sogs bskyed / rno dro rtsub cing dang ba dang / khyab cing myur gsod yang ba dang

verses.skt: vikāṣi sūkṣmam avyaktarasaṃ viṣamapāki ca | ojaso viparītaṃ tat tīkṣṇādyair anvitaṃ guṇaiḥ
verses.tib: 'dar zhing bra la ro mi gsal / 'ju bar mi byed pa yin no / rno sogs yon tan dang ldan pas / de ni mdangs las go bzlog yin

verses.skt: vātapittottaraṃ nÃṇāṃ sadyo harati jīvitam | viṣaṃ hi dehaṃ saṃprāpya prāg dūṣayati śoṇitam
verses.tib: mi ni rlung mkhris shas che ba / srog ni 'phral du 'phrog par byed / dug gis lus su phyin pa dang / dang por khrag la gnod par byed

verses.skt: kaphapittānilāṃś cānu samaṃ doṣān sahāśayān | tato hṛdayam āsthāya dehocchedāya kalpate
verses.tib: bad kan mkhris pa rlung rjes la / nad gzhi grogs dang lhan cig 'byung / de nas snying la gnas nas ni / lus la gnod par byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: sthāvarasyopayuktasya vege pūrve prajāyate | jihvāyāḥ śyāvatā stambho mūrchā trāsaḥ klamo vamiḥ
verses.tib: lce gnag lus ni rengs pa dang / brgyal dang slon dang sdang dang ngal / gnas skabs dang por 'byung bar 'gyur

verses.skt: dvitīye vepathuḥ svedo dāhaḥ kaṇṭhe ca vedanā | viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ kurute hṛdi vedanām
verses.tib: gnyis par 'dar zhing rngul ba dang / tsha zhing lkog ma na ba dang / dug gis ma zhu'i gnas phyin na / snying ni na bar byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: tāluśoṣas tṛtīye tu śūlaṃ cāmāśaye bhṛśam | durbale harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane
verses.tib: gsum par rkan ni bskams pa dang / ma zhu'i gnas su shin tu gzer / de'i mig nyam chung ser ba dang / skrang ba nyid du 'gyur ba dang

verses.skt: pakvāśayagate todahidhmākāsāntrakūjanam | caturthe jāyate vege śirasaś cātigauravam
verses.tib: zhu ba'i gnas phyin zug pa dang / skyigs bu lud pa rgyu ma 'khrug / dug gi shugs ni bzhi pa la / mgo bo lhag par lci bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kaphapraseko vaivarṇyaṃ parvabhedaś ca pañcame | sarvadoṣaprakopaś ca pakvādhāne ca vedanā
verses.tib: lnga par mchil snabs 'dzag pa dang / lhu tshigs na ba 'byung 'gyur la / mdog mi sdug cing nad kun 'khrug / zhu ba'i gnas kyi 'og tu na

verses.skt: ṣaṣṭhe saṃjñāpraṇāśaś ca subhṛśaṃ cātisāryate | skandhapṛṣṭhakaṭībhaṅgo bhaven mṛtyuś ca saptame
verses.tib: drug par 'du shes nyams pa dang / shin tu 'khrul bar byed par 'gyur / bdun par phrag gong sgal tshigs dang / dpyi tshigs bye na 'chi 'gyur yin

verses.skt: prathame viṣavege tu vāntaṃ śītāmbusecinam | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ saṃyuktam agadaṃ pāyayed drutam
verses.tib: dug gi shugs ni dang po la / slon zhing chu grang dag gis gtor / mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi / dug gi sman ni myur du blud

verses.skt: dvitīye pūrvavad vāntaṃ viriktaṃ cānupāyayet | tṛtīye ’gadapānaṃ tu hitaṃ nasyaṃ tathāñjanam
verses.tib: gnyis par skyug sman bkru sman gtang / snga ma bzhin du dug sman blud / gsum par dug gi sman blud cing / de / bzhin mig sman sna sman gtang

verses.skt: caturthe snehasaṃyuktam agadaṃ pratiyojayet | pañcame madhukakvāthamākṣikābhyāṃ yutaṃ hitam
verses.tib: bzhi par snum dang bcas pa yi / dug gi sman ni btang na phan / lnga par shing mngar khu ba dang / sbrang rtsir sbyar ba blud na phan

verses.skt: ṣaṣṭhe ’tīsāravad siddhir avapīḍaś tu saptame | mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛg vā piśitaṃ kṣipet
verses.tib: drug par 'khru ba lta bur gso / bdun par sna sman dud pa dang / spyi bor rgya gram byas nas ni / sha'am khrag ni gzhug par bya

verses.skt: kośātaky agnikaḥ pāṭhā sūryavallyamṛtābhayāḥ | śeluḥ śirīṣaḥ kiṇihī haridre kṣaudrasāhvayā
verses.tib: ko sha ta ki lang ga li / pa tha lcam pa a ru ra / sA lu sle tres shi ri sha / gi ri kar ni yung ba dang / ha yang sbrang rtsi ba spru ba

verses.skt: punarnave trikaṭukaṃ bṛhatyau śārive balā | eṣāṃ yavāgūṃ niryūhe śītāṃ saghṛtamākṣikām
verses.tib: bri ha ti gnyis tsha ba gsum / sha ri ba dang ba la ste / 'di rnams bskol ba'i khu ba dang / bskol ba'i nas thug bsgrangs par ni / sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas pa gzhug

verses.skt: yuñjyād vegāntare sarvaviṣaghnīṃ kṛtakarmaṇaḥ | tadvan madhūkamadhukapadmakesaracandanaiḥ
verses.tib: gnas skabs gzhan la dug 'joms pa'i / sman dang gso ba thams cad bya / shing mngar tsan+dan ma du ka / pad+ma ge sar de bzhin bya

verses.skt: añjanaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā | phalinī trikaṭu spṛkkā nāgapuṣpaṃ sakesaram
verses.tib: dngul rdo rgya spos ru rta dang / ba bla ldong ros pri yang ku / tsha ba gsum dang 'bu su hang / nA ga puSh+pa ge sar bcas

verses.skt: hareṇur madhukaṃ māṃsī rocanā kākamālikā | śrīveṣṭakaṃ sarjarasaḥ śatāhvā kuṅkumaṃ balā
verses.tib: shing mngar spang spos ha re Nu / gi wang mon sne'u rme ru dang / shi ri beSh+Ta sra rtsi pog / shu ti gur gum ba la dang

verses.skt: tamālapattratālīśabhūrjośīraniśādvayam | kanyopavāsinī snātā śuklavāsā madhudrutaiḥ
verses.tib: bal bu ta ma la'i lo ma / stag pa dang ni pu shel tse / ser po gnyis ni sbrang rtsir sbyar / bu mo khrus dang smyung ba byas / gos dkar bgos pa byas nas ni

verses.skt: dvijān abhyarcya taiḥ puṣye kalpayed agadottamam | vaidyaś cātra tadā mantraṃ prayatātmā paṭhed imam
verses.tib: dge sbyong bram ze mchod byas te / dug sman mchog ni sbyar bar bya / de tshe sman pas sngags 'dis ni / bdag nyid bsngags te brjod par bya

verses.skt: namaḥ puruṣasiṃhāya namo nārāyaṇāya ca | yathāsau nābhijānāti raṇe kṛṣṇaparājayam
verses.tib: skyes bu seng ger phyag 'tshal lo / sred med bu la phyag 'tshal lo / ji ltar khyab 'jug g.yul ngor ni / gzhan gyis pham par ma mthong ste

verses.skt: etena satyavākyena agado me prasidhyatu | namo vaiḍūryamāte hulu hulu rakṣa māṃ sarvaviṣebhyaḥ
verses.tib: bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis kyang / bdag la dug med grub par shog / na mo be+e DUr+ya ma de / hu Tu hu Tu rak+Sha maM / sarba bi She b+h+yaHgau ri

verses.skt: gauri gāndhāri cāṇḍāli mātaṅgi svāhā piṣṭe ca dvitīyo mantraḥ | harimāyi svāhā
verses.tib: gan+d+ha ri / tsaN+Da li / matang gi swA hA / 'thag pa'i sngags gnyis pa ni / ha ri mA ye swa hA

verses.skt: aśeṣaviṣavetālagrahakārmaṇapāpmasu | marakavyādhidurbhikṣayuddhāśanibhayeṣu ca
verses.tib: ma lus dug dang ro langs dang / gdon gyi las dang sdig pa dang / gsod byed nad dang mu ge dang / 'thab par 'dod dang 'jigs pa la

verses.skt: pānanasyāñjanālepamaṇibandhādiyojitaḥ | eṣa candrodayo nāma śāntisvastyayanaṃ param
verses.tib: sman btung sna sman mig sman bsku / gdu bu la sogs la sbyar bya / 'di ni zla shar zhes bya ste / zhi dang bde legs byed mchog yin

verses.skt: vāsavo vṛtram avadhīt samāliptaḥ kilāmunā
jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhir hataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā | svabhāvato vā na guṇaiḥ suyuktaṃ dūṣīviṣākhyāṃ viṣam abhyupaiti
verses.tib: dug rnying dug sel sman gyis zil mnan pa / nags me rlung dang nyi tshan / gyis bskams pa'am / rang bzhin gyis ni yon tan mi ldan pas / nyams pa'i dug ces bya ba'i dug tu 'gyur

verses.skt: vīryālpabhāvād avibhāvyam etat kaphāvṛtaṃ varṣagaṇānubandhi | tenārdito bhinnapurīṣavarṇo duṣṭāsrarogī tṛḍarocakārtaḥ
verses.tib: 'di ni nus pa chung bas mi rtogs te / bad kan dang 'dres lo ni mang por gnas / des nyen gyur pa mdog ngan 'khru bar byed / nad khrag skom dad yi ga 'chus pas nyen

verses.skt: mūrchan vaman gadgadavāg vimuhyan bhavec ca dūṣyodaraliṅgajuṣṭaḥ | āmāśayasthe kaphavātarogī pakvāśayasthe ’nilapittarogī
verses.tib: brgyal zhing slon la rnam rmongs skad 'dzer dang / dug gis dmu rdzing mtshan mas gnod par 'gyur / ma zhu'i gnas brten bad kan rlung nad skyed / zhu ba'i gnas brten mkhris dang rlung nad skyed

verses.skt: bhaven naro dhvastaśiroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ sa yathā vihaṅgaḥ | sthitaṃ rasādiṣv athavā vicitrān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān
verses.tib: mi yi yan lag zhig cing skra 'byibs / ji ltar bya ni spu btogs lta bur byed / dngas ma'am khrag la gnas par byed na ni / lus zungs las byung nad ni sna tshogs skyed

verses.skt: prāgvātājīrṇaśītābhradivāsvapnāhitāśanaiḥ | duṣṭaṃ dūṣayate dhātūn ato dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam
verses.tib: mdun gyi rlung dang ma zhu grang / yul dmus gnod zas nyin par nyal / lus zungs gnod par byas pa na / de bas gnod pa'i dug ces bshad

verses.skt: dūṣīviṣārtaṃ susvinnam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhitam | dūṣīviṣārim agadaṃ lehayen madhunāplutam
verses.tib: gnod pa'i dug nyen dugs byas la / steng dang 'og nas sbyang bar bya / gnod pa'i dug ni sel ba'i sman / sbrang rtsi sbyar te lde gu sbyin

verses.skt: pippalyo dhyāmakaṃ māṃsī lodhram elā suvarcikā | kuṭannaṭaṃ nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ yaṣṭī candanagairikam
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang bya ma ka / spang spos seng phrom sug smel dang / ku tan na ta sardzi ka / ru rta shing mngar tsan+dan dang / yug snam btsag dang sbyar ba'i sman

verses.skt: dūṣīviṣārir nāmnāyaṃ na cānyatrāpi vāryate | viṣadigdhena viddhas tu pratāmyati muhur muhuḥ
verses.tib: gnod pa'i dug sel zhes bya ste / gzhan yang zlog par byed pa yin / dug mdas phog par gyur pa dag / yang dang yang du mun 'thibs byed

verses.skt: vivarṇabhāvaṃ bhajate viṣādaṃ cāśu gacchati | kīṭair ivāvṛtaṃ cāsya gātraṃ cimicimāyate
verses.tib: mdog ni mi sdug gyur pa dang / myur du yid 'byung sdug bsngal 'thob / 'dis ni srin bus khyab pa ltar / lus tsha tsag tsag por 'gyur ro

verses.skt: śroṇipṛṣṭhaśiraḥskandhasaṃdhayaḥ syuḥ savedanāḥ | kṛṣṇaduṣṭāsravisrāvī tṛṇmūrchājvaradāhavān
verses.tib: gdong mo rgyab dang phrag pa mgo / lhu tshigs rnams su na bar byed / khrag ni nad can gnag pa 'dzag / skom dang brgyal tsha rims kyis 'debs

verses.skt: dṛṣṭikāluṣyavamathuśvāsakāsakaraḥ kṣaṇāt | āraktapītaparyantaḥ śyāvamadhyo ’tirug vraṇaḥ
verses.tib: mig ni gnag cing slon pa dang / btud mar lud pa dbugs mi bde / rma dmar mtha' mar ser ba dang / dbus ni gnag cing shin tu na

verses.skt: śūyate pacyate sadyo gatvā māṃsaṃ ca kṛṣṇatām | praklinnaṃ śīryate ’bhīkṣṇaṃ sapicchilaparisravam
verses.tib: 'phral du skrangs shing rnags pa dang / sha yang nag por gyur nas ni / gnag cing shin tu 'drul bar byed / spyi bag can du 'dzag par byed

verses.skt: kuryād amarmaviddhasya hṛdayāvaraṇaṃ drutam | śalyam ākṛṣya taptena lohenānu dahed vraṇam
verses.tib: gnad du phog par ma gyur pa / myur du snying la phan byed bya / zug rngu phyung la lcags bsregs pas / rma ni legs par bsreg par / bya

verses.skt: athavā muṣkakaśvetāsomatvaktāmravallitaḥ | śirīṣād gṛdhranakhyāś ca kṣāreṇa pratisārayet
verses.tib: yang na mu ka ka dang ni / gi ri kar+Ni dkar po dang / kad pa la yi shun pa dang / btsod dang shir sha bya rgod sen / bsregs pa'i thal bas bsku bar bya

verses.skt: śukanāsāprativiṣāvyāghrīmūlaiś ca lepayet | kīṭadaṣṭacikitsāṃ ca kuryāt tasya yathārhataḥ
verses.tib: shu ka na sa bong nga dkar / kaN+Da ka ri'i rtsa bas bsku / dug 'thung sos btab gso ba dag / ci rigs par ni de la bya

verses.skt: vraṇe tu pūtipiśite kriyā pittavisarpavat | saubhāgyārthaṃ striyo bhartre rājñe vāraticoditāḥ
verses.tib: rma yi sha ni rnags pa la / mkhris pa'i me dbal lta bur gso / bde phyir khyo la bud med dang / rgyal po la ni dgras bslab ste

verses.skt: garam āhārasaṃpṛktaṃ yacchanty āsannavartinaḥ | nānāprāṇyaṅgaśamalaviruddhauṣadhibhasmanām
verses.tib: zas dang sbyar ba'i dug bsres pa / nye 'khor skye bor ster bar 'gyur / sna tshogs lus kyi dri mar bcas / mi mthun sman dang thal ba dang

verses.skt: viṣāṇāṃ cālpavīryāṇāṃ yogo gara iti smṛtaḥ | tena pāṇduḥ kṛśo ’lpāgniḥ kāsaśvāsajvarārditaḥ
verses.tib: nus pa chung bar gyur pa'i dug / sbyar ba'i dug ni sbyar ma yin / des nyen mdog skya rid pa dang / me drod nyams shing lud pa dang / dbugs mi bde dang rims kyis nyen

verses.skt: vāyunā pratilomena svapnacintāparāyaṇaḥ | mahodarayakṛtplīhī dīnavāg durbalo ’lasaḥ
verses.tib: rlung ni mi mthun rgyu ba dang / gnyid che yid ni zhum par byed / gcin snyi lto ba mchin pa dang / mcher pa na zhing skad gsang dma' / nyam chung sgyid ni zhan pa dang

verses.skt: śophavān satatādhmātaḥ śuṣkapādakaraḥ kṣayī | svapne gomāyumārjāranakulavyālavānarān
verses.tib: skrangs shing rtag tu sbo ba dang / rkang pa lag pa skam zhing zad / rmi lam du ni ce spyang dang / byi la sbrul dang ne+e'u le dang

verses.skt: prāyaḥ paśyati śuṣkāṃś ca vanaspatijalāśayān | manyate kṛṣṇam ātmānaṃ gauro gauraṃ ca kālakaḥ
verses.tib: spre'u mthong zhing phal cher ni / nags tshal mtsho ni skams par mthong / bdag nyid nag por mthong 'gyur zhing / ser po nag por mthong bar byed

verses.skt: vikarṇanāsānayanaṃ paśyet tadvihatendriyaḥ | etair anyaiś ca bahubhiḥ kliṣṭo ghorair upadravaiḥ
verses.tib: mig sna rna ba med pa dang / de yi dbang po nyams par mthong / 'di dang gzhan yang gnod pa yi / bla brnan mi bzad mang pos gtses

verses.skt: garārto nāśam āpnoti kaścit sadyo ’cikitsitaḥ | garārto vāntavān bhuktvā tat pathyaṃ pānabhojanam
verses.tib: 'ga' zhig 'phral du ma gsos na / sbyar dug gis nyen 'chi bar 'gyur / dbyig dug slon byas kha zas ni / de la phan pa'i bza' btung sbyin

verses.skt: śuddhahṛc chīlayed dhema sūtrasthānavidheḥ smaran | śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ cūrṇaṃ tāpyasuvarṇayoḥ
verses.tib: sbyangs nas gser ni bsten bya zhing / mdo nas bstan pa bzhin du bya / gser dang zangs kyi phye ma ni / sbrang rtsi kha ra dkar po sbyar

verses.skt: lehaḥ praśamayanty ugraṃ sarvayogakṛtaṃ viṣam | mūrvāmṛtānatakaṇāpaṭolīcavyacitrakān
verses.tib: lde gus dug ni mi bzad dang / dbyig dug thams cad sel bar byed / mur ba sle tres pi pi ling / rgya spos dbyi mo pa to la / gla sgang shu dag tsi tra ka

verses.skt: vacāmustaviḍaṅgāni takrakoṣṇāmbumastubhiḥ | pibed rasena vāmlena garopahatapāvakaḥ
verses.tib: byi dang ka ni dar ba dang / chu dron zho ga chur sbyar ba / skyur khu dang sbyar blud na ni / dbyig dug gi bcom me drod sbyong

verses.skt: pārāvatāmiṣaśaṭhīpuṣkarāhvaśṛtaṃ himam | garatṛṣṇārujākāsaśvāsahidhmājvarāpaham
verses.tib: zur ba ma nu phug ron gyi / sha bskol khu ba bsgrangs pa ni / dbyig dug skom dang lud pa na / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde rims sel

verses.skt: tryūṣaṇaṃ pañcalavaṇaṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ rajanīdvayam | sūkṣmailāṃ trivṛtāṃ pattraṃ viḍaṅgānīndravāruṇīm
madhukaṃ ceti sakṣaudraṃ goviṣāṇe nidhāpayet | tasmād uṣṇāmbunā mātrāṃ prāgbhaktaṃ yojayet tathā
viṣaṃ bhuktaṃ jarāṃ yāti nirviṣe ’pi na doṣakṛt | lākṣāpriyaṅgumañjiṣṭhāḥ samṛṇālahareṇukāḥ
sayaṣṭyāhvā madhuyutā bastapittena kalpitāḥ | nikhaned goviṣāṇasthāḥ saptarātraṃ mahītale
tatra kṛtvā maṇiṃ hemnā baddhaṃ hastena dhārayet | saṃspṛṣṭaṃ saviṣaṃ tena sadyo bhavati nirviṣam
viṣaprakṛtikālānnadoṣadūṣyādisaṃgame | viṣasaṃkaṭam uddiṣṭaṃ śatasyaiko ’tra jīvati
verses.tib: dug gi rang bzhin dus dang zas / nad gzhi lus zungs tshogs 'dus pa / dug gi nyam nga zhes bshad de

verses.skt: kṣuttṛṣṇāgharmadaurbalyakrodhaśokabhayaśramaiḥ | ajīrṇavarcodravatāpittamārutavṛddhibhiḥ
verses.tib: bkres skom nyam ni chung ba dang / khro dang mya ngan 'jigs dang ngal / ma zhu ba dang 'khru ba dang / mkhris pa rlung ni 'phel ba dang

verses.skt: tilapuṣpaphalāghrāṇabhūbāṣpaghanagarjitaiḥ | hastimūṣikavāditraniḥsvanair viṣasaṃkaṭaiḥ
verses.tib: til gyi me tog 'bras bu snum / sa yi rlangs pa 'brug sgra dang / gling bu pi wang rol mo yi / sgra dang mdun gyi ser bu dang

verses.skt: purovātotpalāmodamadanair vardhate viṣam | varṣāsu cāmbuyonitvāt saṃkledaṃ guḍavad gatam
verses.tib: ut+pal dri dang myos pa yis / dug gi nyam nga 'phel bar byed / dbyar ni char gi dus yin pas / bu ram lta bur rlan can 'gyur

verses.skt: visarpati ghanāpāye tad agastyo hinasti ca | prayāti mandavīryatvaṃ viṣaṃ tasmād ghanātyaye
verses.tib: lus la khyab byed dbyar 'das nas / ri byi 'char bas de med byed / de bas sprin bral dus su ni / nus pa chung ba nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: iti prakṛtisātmyartusthānavegabalābalam | ālocya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā karmānantaram ācaret
verses.tib: de ltar rang bzhin goms pa dang / gnas dus shugs stobs che chung ba / brtags te mkhas pas shes byas la / de rjes gso ba'i las spyad bya

verses.skt: ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanair uṣṇarūkṣatīkṣṇaiḥ pralepanaiḥ | kaṣāyakaṭutiktaiś ca bhojanaiḥ śamayed viṣam
verses.tib: bad kan can ni slon dang dro / rtsub dang rno ba'i sman bsku zhing / bska dang kha dang tsha ba yis / zas kyi dug ni bsal bar bya

verses.skt: paittikaṃ sraṃsanaiḥ sekapradehair bhṛśaśītalaiḥ | kaṣāyatiktamadhurair ghṛtayuktaiś ca bhojanaiḥ
verses.tib: mkhris can bkru sman sman chu blugs / shin tu bsil ba'i sman bsku zhing / bska dang kha dang mngar ba dang / mar bcas kha zas sbyin pas gso

verses.skt: vātātmakaṃ jayet svādusnigdhāmlalavaṇānvitaiḥ | saghṛtair bhojanair lepais tathaiva piśitāśanaiḥ
verses.tib: rlung gi bdag nyid can mngar dang / skyur dang lan tshwa mar bcas pa'i / bza' ba mar bcas bsku byug dang / de bzhin sha ni bza' bas gso

verses.skt: nāghṛtaṃ sraṃsanaṃ śastaṃ pralepo bhojyam auṣadham | sarveṣu sarvāvasthāsu viṣeṣu na ghṛtopamam
verses.tib: bkru sman bsku byug kha zas sman / mar med bsngags pa ma yin no / dug kun gnas skabs thams cad du / dug 'joms mar dang 'dra ba yi

verses.skt: vidyate bheṣajaṃ kiñcid viśeṣāt prabale ’nile | ayatnāc chleṣmagaṃ sādhyaṃ yatnāt pittāśayāśrayam
verses.tib: sman ni gzhan dag yod min te / mchog tu rlung shas che la phan / bad kan gnas zhugs gso bar sla / mkhris pa'i gnas brten 'bad pas gso

verses.skt: suduḥsādhyam asādhyaṃ vā vātāśayagataṃ viṣam
verses.tib: rlung gi gnas su zhugs pa'i dug / shin tu gso dka' gsor mi rung

verses.skt: jatusarjarasośīrasarṣapāpattravālakaiḥ | savaillāruṣkarapuraiḥ kusumair arjunasya ca
dhūpo vāsagṛhe hanti viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | na tatra kīṭāḥ saviṣā nondurā na sarīsṛpāḥ
na kṛtyāḥ kārmaṇādyāś ca dhūpo ’yaṃ yatra dahyate
darvīkarā maṇḍalino rājīmantaś ca pannagāḥ | tridhā samāsato bhaumā bhidyante te tv anekadhā
verses.tib: mdor nas yi steng na sbrul / gsum ste gdengs ka can lus 'khyil / khra bo yin te de yi ni / dbye ba mtha' yas gyur

verses.skt: vyāsato yonibhedena nocyante ’nupayoginaḥ | viśeṣād rūkṣakaṭukam amloṣṇaṃ svāduśītalam
verses.tib: pa dag / skye gnas dbye bas rgyas par ni / dgos pa med phyir ma bshad do / mchog tu rtsub dang tsha ba dang / skyur dro mngar bsil dag las ni

verses.skt: viṣaṃ darvīkarādīnāṃ kramād vātādikopanam | tāruṇyamadhyavṛddhatve vṛṣṭiśītātapeṣu ca
verses.tib: gdengs ka can la sogs pa'i dug / rim gyis rlung sogs 'khrug par byed / gzhon dang rgan po bar ma dang / dbyar dang dgun dang sos kar ni

verses.skt: viṣolbaṇā bhavanty ete vyantarā ṛtusaṃdhiṣu | rathāṅgalāṅgalacchattrasvastikāṅkuśadhāriṇaḥ
verses.tib: 'di dag dug ni 'phel 'gyur zhing / gzhan dag dus tshigs rnams su 'gyur / 'khor lo gshol dang g.yung drung gdugs / lcags kyu'i mtshan mar ldan pa yin

verses.skt: phaṇinaḥ śīghragatayaḥ sarpā darvīkarāḥ smṛtāḥ | jñeyā maṇḍalino ’bhogā maṇḍalair vividhaiś citāḥ
verses.tib: gdengs ka can ni myur 'gro ba / thams cad gdengs ka can zhes bya / lus 'khyil sna tshogs pa yi ni / zlum por 'dug pa lus 'khyil zhing

verses.skt: prāṃśavo mandagamanā rājīmantas tu rājibhiḥ | snigdhā vicitravarṇābhis tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca citritāḥ
verses.tib: ring zhing 'gros ni bul ba yin / ri mo sna tshogs ldan pa dang / snum zhing kha dog sna tshogs pas / chu zheng bris 'gyur khra bo yin

verses.skt: godhāsutas tu gaudhero viṣe darvīkaraiḥ samaḥ | catuṣpād vyantarān vidyād eteṣām eva saṃkarāt
verses.tib: go d+ha'i bu ni go d+ha can / dug ni gdengs ka can mnyam la / rkang bzhi po yi sbrul gzhan ni / 'di dag nyid ni 'dres pa las

verses.skt: vyāmiśralakṣaṇās te hi saṃnipātaprakopaṇāḥ | āhārārthaṃ bhayāt pādasparśād ativiṣāt krudhaḥ
verses.tib: 'dren ma'i mtshan nyid can te des / 'dus pa'i nad ni ldang bar byed / zas kyi don dang 'jigs pa dang / rkang pas reg las dug rab 'khrugs

verses.skt: pāpavṛttitayā vairād devarṣiyamacodanāt | daśanti sarpās teṣūktaṃ viṣādhikyaṃ yathottaram
verses.tib: rkang gi rgyu dang 'dres pa dang / lha dang drang srong gshin rjes bskul / sbrul gyis zin par gang bshad pa / phyi ma bzhin du dug shas che

verses.skt: ādiṣṭāt kāraṇaṃ jñātvā pratikuryād yathāyatham | vyantaraḥ pāpaśīlatvān mārgam āśritya tiṣṭhati
verses.tib: 'jug pa'i rgyu ni shes byas nas / gso ba ji bzhin bya ba yin / phal pa sdig can ngang tshul bas / lam bkag nas ni gnas pa yin

verses.skt: yatra lālāparikledamātraṃ gātre pradṛśyate | na tu daṃṣṭrākṛtaṃ daṃśaṃ tat tuṇḍāhatam ādiśet
verses.tib: gang du kha chu gsher ba tsam / lus la snang bar byed 'gyur zhing / mche ba'i rma ni mi mngon gang / de ni mchus gnod byed ces bya

verses.skt: ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ dve vā vyālīḍhākhyam aśoṇitam | daṃṣṭrāpade sarakte dve vyāluptaṃ trīṇi tāni tu
verses.tib: mche ba gcig las rjes gnyis mngon / khrag med gyur pa bldags zhes bya / mche ba'i rjes ni khrag bcas gnyis / rnam par bcad pa'o de gsum ni

verses.skt: māṃsacchedād avicchinnaraktavāhīni daṣṭakam | daṃṣṭrāpadāni catvāri tadvad daṣṭanipīḍitam
verses.tib: sha bcad shin tu phug pa dang / khrag dbyung so yis zin zhes bya / mche ba'i rjes ni bzhi snang ba / de bzhin sos 'dzin btsir bar bshad

verses.skt: nirviṣaṃ dvayam atrādyam asādhyaṃ paścimaṃ vadet | viṣaṃ nāheyam aprāpya raktaṃ dūṣayate vapuḥ
verses.tib: de las dang po dug med gnyis / phyi ma gnyis po gsor mi rung / sbrul gyi dug ni khrag dag la / ma brten lus la gnod mi byed

verses.skt: raktam aṇv api tu prāptaṃ vardhate tailam ambuvat | bhīros tu sarpasaṃsparśād bhayena kupito ’nilaḥ
verses.tib: khrag ni cung zad la brten yang / til mar thigs pa bzhin du mched / sngar ma / sbrul gyis reg pa las / 'jig pas rlung ni 'khrug par byed

verses.skt: kadācit kurute śophaṃ sarpāṅgābhihataṃ tu tat | durgāndhakāre viddhasya kenacid daṣṭaśaṅkayā
verses.tib: lan 'ga' skrang bar byed pa de / sbrul gyis lus ni bcom zhes bya / bgrod dka' mun par zug gyur pa / la la rtog pas zin pa dang

verses.skt: viṣodvego jvaraś chardir mūrchā dāho ’pi vā bhavet | glānir moho ’tisāro vā tac chaṅkāviṣam ucyate
verses.tib: dug gi shugs dang slon dang rims / brgyal ba'am tsha ba skye ba'am / na zhing rmongs bag 'khru bar 'gyur / de ni rtog pa'i dug ces bya

verses.skt: tudyate saviṣo daṃśaḥ kaṇḍūśopharujānvitaḥ | dahyate grathitaḥ kiñcid viparītas tu nirviṣaḥ
verses.tib: dug bcas nad kyis zug pa dang / skrang dang g.ya' dang rims bcas pa / la la tsha zhing rmen bur 'gyur / de las bzlog pa dug med yin

verses.skt: pūrve darvīkṛtāṃ vege duṣṭaṃ śyāvībhavaty asṛk | śyāvatā tena vaktrādau sarpantīva ca kīṭakāḥ
verses.tib: gdengs ka can shugs dang po la / nad khrag nag por 'dzag par 'gyur / mig dang gdong sogs gnag pa dang / srin bu rgyu ba snyam du sems

verses.skt: dvitīye granthayo vege tṛtīye mūrdhni gauravam | dṛgrodho daṃśavikledaś caturthe ṣṭhīvanaṃ vamiḥ
verses.tib: shugs gnyis par ni rmen bu skye / gsum par mgo ni lci bar 'gyur / bzhi par mig 'byed dka' ba dang / so sa btab rnags shing mchil ma slon

verses.skt: saṃdhiviśleṣaṇaṃ tandrā pañcame parvabhedanam | dāho hidhmā ca ṣaṣṭhe tu hṛtpīḍā gātragauravam
verses.tib: lnga par tshigs 'bye snyam sems dang / rgyud gzhan tshigs ni 'jig pa dang / lus tsha skyigs bu 'byung ba yin / drug par snying na lus lci zhing

verses.skt: mūrchāvipāko ’tīsāraḥ prāpya śukraṃ tu saptame | skandhapṛṣṭhakaṭībhaṅgaḥ sarvaceṣṭānivartanam
verses.tib: brgyal zhing 'khru la zas mi 'ju / bdun par khu ba'i gnas phyin nas / phrag gong rgyab dang sgal tshegs dang / rked pa zhig pa snyam sems zhing / spyod lam thams cad las nyams 'gyur

verses.skt: atha maṇḍalidaṣṭasya duṣṭaṃ pītībhavaty asṛk | tena pītāṅgatā dāho dvitīye śvayathūdbhavaḥ
verses.tib: de nas lus bskyil bas zin na / nad khrag ser por 'gyur ba dang / de yi lus ser tsha ba skyed / gnyis par skrang bar 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: tṛtīye daṃśavikledaḥ svedas tṛṣṇā ca jāyate | caturthe jvaryate dāhaḥ pañcame sarvagātragaḥ
verses.tib: gsum par sos btab rnags pa dang / rngul dang skom dang skye bar 'gyur / bzhi par khong tsha rims kyis 'debs / lnga par lus kun khyab par tsha

verses.skt: daṣṭasya rājilair duṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ yāti śoṇitam | pāṇḍutā tena gātrāṇāṃ dvitīye gurutāti ca
verses.tib: sprul ni khra bos zin gyur na / khrag ni skya bor 'gyur ba dang / des ni lus mdog skya bor 'gyur / gnyis par lus ni lci bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tṛtīye daṃśavikledo nāsikākṣimukhasravāḥ | caturthe garimā mūrdhno manyāstambhaś ca pañcame
verses.tib: gsum par sos btab rnags pa dang / mig dang kha sna las 'dzag 'gyur / bzhi par mgo lci gnye'u rengs 'gyur

verses.skt: gātrabhaṅgo jvaraḥ śītaḥ śeṣayoḥ pūrvavad vadet | kuryāt pañcasu vegeṣu cikitsāṃ na tataḥ param
verses.tib: lnga par lus tshigs na ba dang / grang ba'i rims kyis 'debs par byed / lhag ma gnyis po snga mar mtshungs / shugs ni lnga par gso ba dag / bya yi de las phan chad min

verses.skt: jalāplutā ratikṣīṇā bhītā nakulanirjitāḥ | śītavātātapavyādhikṣuttṛṣṇāśramapīḍitāḥ
verses.tib: chu yis g.yeng dang chags pas zad / skrag / dang ne+e'u les 'phen pa dang / grang lhags nyi tshan rlung dang nad / bkres skom dal bas gzir ba dang

verses.skt: tūrṇaṃ deśāntarāyātā vimuktaviṣakañcukāḥ | kuśauṣadhikaṇṭakavad ye caranti ca kānanam
verses.tib: phyogs gzhan nas ni rings par 'ongs / dug spangs pags pa brjes pa dang / 'jag ma sman dang tsher ma can / nags na rgyu ba gang yin dang

verses.skt: deśaṃ ca divyādhyuṣitaṃ sarpās te ’lpaviṣā matāḥ | śmaśānaciticaityādau pañcamīpakṣasaṃdhiṣu
verses.tib: rig pa la sogs brten phyogs gnas / sbrul de dug ni chung bar 'dod / dur khrod bsti gnas shing gcig sogs / tshes lnga dang ni dus tshigs dang

verses.skt: aṣṭamīnavamīsaṃdhyāmadhyarātridineṣu ca | yāmyāgneyamaghāśleṣāviśākhāpūrvanairṛte
verses.tib: tshes brgyad tshes dgu thun mtshams dang / nam phyed dang ni nyi ma'i gung / bra nye smin drug mchu dang skag / sa ga chu stod khrums stod dang

verses.skt: nairṛtākhye muhūrte ca daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca tyajet | daṣṭamātraḥ sitāsyākṣaḥ śīryamāṇaśiroruhaḥ
verses.tib: snubs dang bra nye yud tsam la / gnad du bzung ba spang bar bya / zin pa'i mod la bzhin skya zhing / skra ni 'byi bar byed pa dang

verses.skt: stabdhajihvo muhur mūrchan śītocchvāso na jīvati | hidhmā śvāso vamiḥ kāso daṣṭamātrasya dehinaḥ
verses.tib: lce 'khums yang dang yang du brgyal / dbugs grang gang yin de mi 'tsho / skyigs bu dbugs mi bde zhing slon / lus can zin pa'i mod la ni

verses.skt: jāyante yugapad yasya sa hṛcchūlī na jīvati | phenaṃ vamati niḥsaṃjñaḥ śyāvapādakarānanaḥ
verses.tib: snying nas gzer bar 'gyur ba dang / cig car 'byung ba de mi 'tsho / 'du shes stor zhing lbu bar skyugs / rkang pa lag pa bzhin gnag cing

verses.skt: nāsāvasādo bhaṅgo ’ṅge viḍbhedaḥ ślathasaṃdhitā | viṣapītasya daṣṭasya digdhenābhihatasya ca
verses.tib: sna zhom yan lag zhig pa dang / tshigs lhod bshang ba 'khru ba yi / dug 'thungs pa dang sprul gyis zin / dug can mda' yis phog gyur pa

verses.skt: bhavanty etāni rūpāṇi saṃprāpte jīvitakṣaye | na nasyaiś cetanā tīkṣṇair na kṣatāt kṣatajāgamaḥ
verses.tib: tshul ni 'di dag snang gyur na / srog zad par ni 'gyur ba yin / sna sman rnon po mi tshor zhing / rma nas khrag ni mi 'byung la

verses.skt: daṇḍāhatasya no rājī prayātasya yamāntikam | ato ’nyathā tu tvarayā pradīptāgāravad bhiṣak
verses.tib: dbyig pas bsnun na rjes mi mngon / gshin rje'i thad du 'gro ba yin / de las gzhan du sman pa yis / 'bar ba'i khyim nas 'byung ba bzhin

verses.skt: rakṣan kaṇṭhagatān prāṇān viṣam āśu śamaṃ nayet | mātrāśataṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā daṃśe daṣṭasya dehinaḥ
verses.tib: lkog mar phyin pa'i srog bsrung zhing / dug ni myur du bsal bar bya / lus can dug gis zin gyur pa / grangs brgya'i bar du gnas nas ni

verses.skt: dehaṃ prakramate dhātūn rudhirādīn pradūṣayan | etasminn antare karma daṃśasyotkartanādikam
verses.tib: lus zungs khrag sogs la gnod cing / lus la khyab par byed pa yin / dus 'di'i bar du gdug pa yi / mche bas zin pa bcad sogs las

verses.skt: kuryac chīghraṃ yathā dehe viṣavallī na rohati | daṣṭamātro daśed āśu tam eva pavanāśinam
verses.tib: bya zhing ci nas lus la ni / dug gi yal ga ma 'phros bya / zin pa'i mod la myur du ni

verses.skt: loṣṭaṃ mahīṃ vā daśanaiś chittvā cānu sasaṃbhramam | niṣṭhīvena samālimped daṃśaṃ karṇamalena vā
verses.tib: sbrul ni de nyid za ba'am / sa 'am bod bar gcod byed na / rings pa kho nar sman pa yi / mchil mas byug par bya ba'am / rna spabs kyis ni so rjes bsku

verses.skt: daṃśasyopari badhnīyād ariṣṭāṃ caturaṅgule | kṣaumādibhir veṇikayā siddhair mantraiś ca mantravit
verses.tib: mche bas btab / pa'i gong du ni / sor bzhir ras ma las byas pa / gso ma'am 'od ma la sogs bcing / sngags shes pa yis grub sngags bzla

verses.skt: ambuvat setubandhena bandhena stabhyate viṣam | na vahanti sirāś cāsya viṣaṃ bandhābhipīḍitāḥ
verses.tib: chu lon gyis ni chu lta bur / bcings pas dug ni 'phros mi 'gyur / dug gi bcings sogs nyen pa yi / rtsa las rgyu bar mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: niṣpīḍyānūddhared daṃśaṃ marmasaṃdhyagataṃ tathā | na jāyate viṣād vego bījanāśād ivāṅkuraḥ
verses.tib: btsir nas sos btab dbyung bya zhing / tshigs dang gnad du ma chud de / sa bon nyams pa'i myu gu bzhin / dug shugs de ni 'byung mi 'gyur

verses.skt: daṃśaṃ maṇḍalināṃ muktvā pittalatvād athāparam | prataptair hemalohādyair dahed āśūlmukena vā
verses.tib: lus 'khyil so rjes mkhris bskyed pas / de ma gtogs pa gzhan dag ni / lcags dang gser la sogs pas sam / mgal me yis ni myur du bsreg

verses.skt: karoti bhasmasāt sadyo vahniḥ kiṃ nāma tu kṣatam | ācūṣet pūrṇavaktro vā mṛdbhasmāgadagomayaiḥ
verses.tib: me yis thal bar byed 'gyur na / ci phyir de ni 'byung bar 'gyur / sa dang lci ba sman sogs kyis / kha bkang nas ni gzhib par bya

verses.skt: pracchāyāntar ariṣṭāyāṃ māṃsalaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ | aṅgaṃ sahaiva daṃśena lepayed agadair muhuḥ
verses.tib: chings ma'i nang nas sha che'i phyogs / mchog tu zhal zhal bya ba dang / yan lag mche bas zin bcas pa / dug sman gyis ni yang yang bsku

verses.skt: candanośīrayuktena salilena ca secayet | viṣe pravisṛte vidhyet sirāṃ sā paramā kriyā
verses.tib: tsan+dan pu shel tse ldan pa'i / chu yis kyang ni blugs par bya / dug gis khyab par gyur pa la / gtar ga gdab pa gso mchog ste

verses.skt: rakte nirhriyamāṇe hi kṛtsnaṃ nirhriyate viṣam | durgandhaṃ saviṣaṃ raktam agnau caṭacaṭāyate
verses.tib: khrag ni phyung bar gyur pa na / ma lus dug ni 'byung bar 'gyur / dug bcas khrag ni dri mi zhim / mer bsregs sgra ni tseg tseg zer

verses.skt: yathādoṣaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca pūrvaval lakṣayed asṛk | sirāsv adṛśyamānāsu yojyāḥ śṛṅgajalaukasaḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi ji bzhin dag gyur pa / khrag ni snga ma bzhin zhes bya / rtsa ni snang bar ma gyur na / rngabs rwa srin bu pad pas gtar

verses.skt: śoṇitaṃ srutaśeṣaṃ ca pravilīnaṃ viṣoṣmaṇā | lepasekaiḥ subahuśaḥ stambhayed bhṛśaśītalaiḥ
verses.tib: khrag phyung ba yi lhag ma ni / dug gi drod kyis zhugs gyur pa / shin tu bsil ba'i sman bsku dang / blugs pa yis ni bsal bar bya

verses.skt: askanne viṣavegād dhi mūrchāyamadahṛddravāḥ | bhavanti tān jayec chītair vījec cāromaharṣataḥ
verses.tib: dug gi shugs kyis ma zhu bas / brgyal dang myos dang snying 'dzag 'byung / de ni bsil sman blugs pa dang / rlung yab spu ldang byed pas bsal

verses.skt: skanne tu rudhire sadyo viṣavegaḥ praśāmyati | viṣaṃ karṣati tīkṣṇatvād dhṛdayaṃ tasya guptaye
verses.tib: khrag na sla bar gyur na dug / 'phral du shugs ni zhi bar 'gyur / dug gi rno bas snying 'dar byed / de bsrung phyir ni zhun mar dang

verses.skt: pibed ghṛtaṃ ghṛtakṣaudram agadaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam | hṛdayāvaraṇe cāsya śleṣmā hṛdy upacīyate
