verses.tib: mar dang bcas pa'i sbrang rtsi 'am / dug sman mar dang sbrus pa blud / de yi snying ni 'gag byed pas / snying gar bad kan sogs par byed

verses.skt: pravṛttagauravotkleśahṛllāsaṃ vāmayet tataḥ | dravaiḥ kāñjikakaulatthatailamadyādivarjitaiḥ
verses.tib: lus lci nad ni bslangs pa dang / snying 'phar de ni slon du gzhug / gsher rdzas skyur rtsabs rgya sran dang / til dang chang sogs ma gtogs pa

verses.skt: vamanair viṣahṛdbhiś ca naivaṃ vyāpnoti tad vapuḥ | bhujaṅgadoṣaprakṛtisthānavegaviśeṣataḥ
verses.tib: dug sel ba yi slon sman gtang / des ni lus la khyab mi 'gyur / sbrul dang nyes pa rang bzhin dang / gnas dang shugs kyi khyad par ni

verses.skt: susūkṣmaṃ samyag ālocya viśiṣṭāṃ cācaret kriyām | sindhuvāritamūlāni śvetā ca girikarṇikā
verses.tib: phra mo yan chad legs brtags la / gso ba khyad par can bya'o / srin bu ba ri'i rtsa ba dang / gi ri kar+Ni dkar po'i chu

verses.skt: pānaṃ darvīkarair daṣṭe nasyaṃ madhu sapākalam | kṛṣṇasarpeṇa daṣṭasya limped daṃśaṃ hṛte ’sṛji
verses.tib: btung ba gdengs ka can bzhin sbyar / sna sman ru rta sbrang rtsi gtang / sbrul nag gis ni zin pa la / khrag gtar nas ni bca' ba dang

verses.skt: cāraṭīnākulībhyāṃ vā tīkṣṇamūlaviṣeṇa vā | pānaṃ ca kṣaudramañjiṣṭhāgṛhadhūmayutaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: na go la ni sbyar ba bsku / yang na rtsa rnon dug gis bsku / btung bar btsod dang sbrang rtsi dang / khang pa'i dud pa mar sbyar blud

verses.skt: taṇḍulīyakakāśmaryakiṇihīgirikarṇikāḥ | mātuluṅgī sitā śeluḥ pānanasyāñjanair hitaḥ
verses.tib: gdengs ka can dang ri mo can / mi bzad dug gis zin pa la / tan du li ya tad pal dang / gi ri kar+Ni rnam gnyis dang / kha lung khaN+Da se'u 'bru ni / btung dang sna sman mig sman bya

verses.skt: agadaḥ phaṇināṃ ghore viṣe rājīmatām api | samāḥ sugandhāmṛdvīkāśvetākhyāgajadantikāḥ
verses.tib: a shwa gan+d+ha rgun 'brum dang / gi ri kar+Ni sa nag dang / ha ti pi pi ling dang ni / bye'u rug pa'i lo ma dang

verses.skt: ardhāṃśaṃ saurasaṃ pattraṃ kapitthaṃ bilvadāḍimam | sakṣaudro maṇḍaliviṣe viśeṣād agado hitaḥ
verses.tib: bil ba se 'bru ka pid tha / cha ni phyed phyed sbrang rtsir sbyar / dug sman yin te khyad par du / lus 'khyil sbrul gyi dug la phan

verses.skt: pañcavalkavarāyaṣṭīnāgapuṣpailavālukam | jīvakarṣabhakau śītaṃ sitā padmakam utpalam
verses.tib: lo ma lnga dang 'bras bu gsum / shing mngar nA ga puSh+pa dang / e la ba lu dzi ba ka / zangs rtsi ba dang pu shel tse / kha ra shug pa ut+pa la

verses.skt: sakṣaudro himavān nāma hanti maṇḍalināṃ viṣam | lepāc chvayathuvīsarpavisphoṭajvaradāhahā
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi dang sbyar kha ba can / zhes bya lus 'khyil dug 'joms so / bskus na skrang dang shu ba mched / 'brum bu rims dang lus lci sel

verses.skt: kāśmaryaṃ vaṭaśuṅgāni jīvakarṣabhakau sitā | mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ ceti daṣṭo maṇḍalinā pibet
verses.tib: tang pal n+ya gro d+ha'i myu gu / dzi ba ka dang zangs rtsi ba / ka ra dkar po shing mngar btsod / khu ba lus 'khyil dug la blud

verses.skt: vaṃśatvagbījakaṭukāpāṭalībījanāgaram | śirīṣabījātiviṣe mūlaṃ gāvedhukaṃ vacā
verses.tib: 'od ma'i shun pa sa bon dang / bca' sga pa to la'i sa bon / shir sha'i sa bon pu tse shel / 'bras kyi rtsa ba bong nga dkar

verses.skt: piṣṭo govāriṇāṣṭāṅgo hanti gonasajaṃ viṣam | kaṭukātiviṣākuṣṭhagṛhadhūmahareṇukāḥ
verses.tib: shu dag ba gcin bcas par btags / yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ste / go nas yi dug 'joms so / ru rta bong nga pu tse shel / ha re Nu ka khyim dud pa

verses.skt: sakṣaudravyoṣatagarā ghnanti rājīmatāṃ viṣam | nikhanet kāṇḍacitrāyā daṃśaṃ yāmadvayaṃ bhuvi
verses.tib: rgya spos sbrang rtsi tsha ba gsum / sbyar bas ri mo can dug sel / 'dam bu khra bo 'dras zin na / sa brkos 'og tu thun gnyis gzhug

verses.skt: uddhṛtya pracchitaṃ sarpirdhānyamṛdbhyāṃ pralepayet | pibet purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ varācūrṇāvacūrṇitam
verses.tib: phyung ste bzhar la mar sar dang / 'bras dang sa yi lde gus byug / 'bras bu gsum gyi phye btab pa'i / mar ni rnying pa blud par bya

verses.skt: jīrṇe virikto bhuñjīta yavānnaṃ sūpasaṃskṛtam | karavīrārkakusumamūlalāṅgalikākaṇāḥ
verses.tib: zhu zhing bkrus nas nas zan ni / sran tshod dang ni / bcas pa sbyin / ka ra bI ra arka yi / me tog lang ka li'i rtsa ba

verses.skt: kalkayed āranālena pāṭhāmaricasaṃyutāḥ | eṣa vyantaradaṣṭānām agadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling dang na le sham / pa ta skyur rtsabs lde gur byas / 'di ni sbrul gzhan gyis zin pa'i / sbrul gyi dug kun sel ba yin

verses.skt: śirīṣapuṣpasvarase saptāhvaṃ maricaṃ sitam | bhāvitaṃ sarpadaṣṭānāṃ pānanasyāñjane hitam
verses.tib: shir sha'i me tog khu ba dang / na le sham dkar zhag bdun sbangs / btung dang sna sman byas gyur na / sbrul gyi mche bas zin pa sel

verses.skt: dvipalaṃ natakuṣṭhābhyāṃ ghṛtakṣaudraṃ catuḥpalam | api takṣakadaṣṭānāṃ pānam etat sukhapradam
verses.tib: rgya spos ru rta srang gnyis gnyis / mar dang sbrang rtsi srang bzhi bzhi / 'di blud 'jog pos zin pa yang / bde ba skyed par byed pa yin

verses.skt: atha darvīkṛtāṃ vege pūrve visrāvya śoṇitam | agadaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ saṃyuktaṃ tvaritaṃ pibet
verses.tib: de nas gdengs ka can gyi shugs / dang por khrag ni dbyung bar bya / dug sman sbrang rtsi zhun mar dang / bcas pa myur du blud par bya

verses.skt: dvitīye vamanaṃ kṛtvā tadvad evāgadaṃ pibet | viṣāpahe prayuñjīta tṛtīye ’ñjananāvane
verses.tib: gnyis par slon sman btang nas ni / de bzhin dug sman blud par bya / gsum par dug sman sbyar bya zhing / mig sman dang ni sna sman gtang

verses.skt: pibec caturthe pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūṃ vamane kṛte | ṣaṣṭhapañcamayoḥ śītair digdhaṃ siktam abhīkṣṇaśaḥ
verses.tib: bzhi bar skyug sman btang nas ni / sngar bshad pa yi nas thug blud / lnga pa drug par bsil sman gyis / bsku zhing sman chu yang yang blugs

verses.skt: pāyayed vamanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ yavāgūṃ ca viṣāpahaiḥ | agadaṃ saptame tīkṣṇaṃ yuñjyād añjananasyayoḥ
verses.tib: slon sman rnon po gtang bya zhing / dug sel nas thug blud par bya / bdun par dug sman rnon po yi / mig sman dang ni sna sman gtang

verses.skt: kṛtvāvagāḍhaṃ śastreṇa mūrdhni kākapadaṃ tataḥ | māṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ tasya carma vā tatra nikṣipet
verses.tib: de nas spyi bor rgya gram du / zab mo'i mtshon gyis batra la nas ni / der ni sha'am khrag gam ni / pags pa dag ni gzhug par bya

verses.skt: tṛtīye vamitaḥ peyāṃ vege maṇḍalināṃ pibet | atīkṣṇam agadaṃ ṣaṣṭhe gaṇaṃ vā padmakādikam
verses.tib: lus 'khyil shugs ni gsum pa la / slon sman btang la nas thug blud / drug par sman ni rtul po'am / shug pa la sogs sde tshan blud

verses.skt: ādye ’vagāḍhaṃ pracchāya vege daṣṭasya rājilaiḥ | alābunā hared raktaṃ pūrvavac cāgadaṃ pibet
verses.tib: khra bo'i shugs ni dang po la / zhal zhal zab tu gdang bya zhing / ku bas khrag ni bton nas ni / snga ma bzhin du dug sman blud

verses.skt: ṣaṣṭhe ’ñjanaṃ tīkṣṇatamam avapīḍaṃ ca yojayet | anukteṣu ca vegeṣu kriyāṃ darvīkaroditām
verses.tib: drug par mig sman rnon po dang / sna sman phye ma bud pa gtang / ma smas pa yi shugs las ni / gdengs ka can skabs bshad ltar gso

verses.skt: garbhiṇībālavṛddheṣu mṛduṃ vidhyet sirāṃ na ca | tvaṅ manohvā niśe vakraṃ rasaḥ śārdūlajo nakhaḥ
verses.tib: sbrum ma byis pa rgan po la / gtar ga mi gdab 'jam pos gso / shing tsha ldong ros rgya spos nyung / ku sha'i khu ba chu srin sen

verses.skt: tamālaḥ kesaraṃ śītaṃ pītaṃ taṇḍulavāriṇā | hanti sarvaviṣāṇy etad vajraṃ vajram ivāsurān
verses.tib: ta ma la yi ge sar dang / 'bras bu chu grang sbyar ba blud / 'di yis dbang po'i rdo rjes ni / lha min lta bur dug 'joms byed

verses.skt: bilvasya mūlaṃ surasasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ karañjasya nataṃ surāhvam | phalatrikaṃ vyoṣaniśādvayaṃ ca bastasya mūtreṇa susūkṣmapiṣṭam
verses.tib: bil ba'i rtsa ba bye'u rug pa'i me tog / rgya spos thang shing ka rany+dza'i 'bras bu / ser po rnam gnyis 'bras bu gsum dang ni / tsha ba gsum po ra gcin zhib btags la

verses.skt: bhujaṅgalūtonduravṛścikādyair viṣūcikājīrṇagarajvaraiś ca | ārtān narān bhūtavidharṣitāṃś ca svasthīkaroty añjanapānanasyaiḥ
verses.tib: btung dang sna sman mig sman sbyar ba yis / sbrul dang lu dbyi ba sdig pa sogs / dug dang dbyig dug ma zhu gsud dang rims / mi ni gdon gyis zin pa bde bar byed

verses.skt: pralepādyaiś ca niḥśeṣaṃ daṃśād apy uddhared viṣam | bhūyo vegāya jāyeta śeṣaṃ dūṣīviṣāya vā
verses.tib: sos btab bsku ba la sogs kyis / ma lus ston par gyur kyang ni / nyams pa'i dug ni ji bzhin dang / slar yang shugs ni skye bar byed

verses.skt: viṣāpāye ’nilaṃ kruddhaṃ snehādibhir upācaret | tailamadyakulatthāmlavarjyaiḥ pavananāśanaiḥ
verses.tib: dug dang bral nas rlung 'khrugs na / snum la sogs pas gso bya zhing / til mar chang dang rgya sran chu / ma gtogs rlung ni sel ba sbyin

verses.skt: pittaṃ pittajvaraharaiḥ kaṣāyasnehavastibhiḥ | samākṣikeṇa vargeṇa kapham āragvadhādinā
verses.tib: mkhris par mkhris pa'i rims sel ba'i / sman khu sman mar 'jam rtsis gso / bad kan sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi / dong ka la sogs sde yis gso

verses.skt: sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu | pānaṃ samantrapūtāmbu prokṣaṇaṃ sāntvaharṣaṇam
verses.tib: sprul gyi rus pas gnod 'gyur dang / de bzhin rtog pa'i dug gis nyen / ka ra rgun 'brum pa ya s+ya / shing mngar kha ra sbrang rtsir sbyar / sngags kyis btab pa'i chu dang bcas / gtor zhing spro bsring dga' bar bya / ke ke ru dang mu tig margad dang

verses.skt: sarpāṅgābhihate yuñjyāt tathā śaṅkāviṣārdite | karketanaṃ marakataṃ vajraṃ vāraṇamauktikam
verses.tib: sprul gyi rus pas gnod 'gyur dang / de bzhin rtog pa'i dug gis nyen / ka ra rgun 'brum pa ya s+ya / shing mngar kha ra sbrang rtsir sbyar / sngags kyis btab pa'i chu dang bcas / gtor zhing spro bsring dga' bar bya / ke ke ru dang mu tig margad dang

verses.skt: vaiḍūryaṃ gardabhamaṇiṃ picukaṃ viṣamūṣikām | himavadgirisaṃbhūtāṃ somarājīṃ punarnavām
verses.tib: bai DUr+ya dang rdo rje mthon ka che / ras bal sa bon dug gis gnod pa'am / kha ba can gyi ri las skyes pa yi / so ma ra dza dang ni ba spru ba

verses.skt: tathā droṇāṃ mahādroṇāṃ mānasīṃ sarpajaṃ maṇim | viṣāṇi viṣaśāntyarthaṃ vīryavanti ca dhārayet
verses.tib: de bzhin dro na ma hA dro na dang / sbrul la yod pa'i nor bu ma na si / nus pa dang ni ldan par gyur pa yi / dug ni dug gzhom bya phyir bcad par bya

verses.skt: chattrī jharjharapāṇiś ca cared rātrau viśeṣataḥ | tacchāyāśabdavitrastāḥ praṇaśyanti bhujaṅgamāḥ
verses.tib: nub mo'i dus su rgyu che khyad par du / gdugs dang khar gsil sgra dang bcas pa bcang / de yi grib ma sgra yi skad phyung na / sbrul gyi tshogs ni 'byer bar byed par 'gyur

verses.skt: vāriguñjāphalośīraṃ netrayor viṣaduṣṭayoḥ | añjanaṃ vāriṇā piṣṭaṃ gāruḍaṃ garuḍopamam
sarpāṇām eva viṇmūtraśukrāṇḍaśavakothajāḥ | doṣair vyastaiḥ samastaiś ca yuktāḥ kīṭāś caturvidhāḥ
verses.tib: sbrul nyid kyi ni bshang gci dang / kha chu sgo nga lus rul skyes / nad ni re re 'dus pa dang / ldan pa'i srin bu'i dug rnam bzhi

verses.skt: daṣṭasya kīṭair vāyavyair daṃśas todarujolbaṇaḥ | āgneyair alpasaṃsrāvo dāharāgavisarpavān
verses.tib: rlung gi srin bus zin gyur na / shas cher na zhing zug par byed / me yi srin bus 'dzag pa chung / tsha zhing dmar la shu ba mched

verses.skt: pakvapīluphalaprakhyaḥ kharjūrasadṛśo ’thavā | kaphādhikair mandarujaḥ pakvodumbarasaṃnibhaḥ
verses.tib: ba lu'i 'bras bu smin pa'am / 'bra go'i 'bras bu smin pa 'dra / bad kan shas ches nad tshabs chung / u dum / wA ra smin pa 'dra

verses.skt: srāvāḍhyaḥ sarvaliṅgas tu vivarjyaḥ sāṃnipātikaiḥ | vegāś ca sarpavac chopho vardhiṣṇur visraraktatā
verses.tib: shas cher 'dzag pa'o 'dus pa yi / mtshan nyid thams cad ldan pa dang / shugs ni sbrul dang 'dra ba dang / skrang ba 'phel zhing khrag dri ma mnam

verses.skt: śiro'kṣigauravaṃ mūrchā bhramaḥ śvāso ’tivedanā | sarveṣāṃ karṇikā śopho jvaraḥ kaṇḍūr arocakaḥ
verses.tib: mgo dang mig lci brgyal mgo 'khor / dbugs mi bde na spang bar bya / kun tu skrang ba lte ba can / tsha ba g.yo zhing yi ga 'chus

verses.skt: vṛścikasya viṣaṃ tīkṣṇam ādau dahati vahnivat | ūrdhvam ārohati kṣipraṃ daṃśe paścāt tu tiṣṭhati
verses.tib: sdig pa'i dug ni rno ba ste / dang por me ltar sreg par byed / steng du myur du mched byed cing / mche ba 'og tu 'dug pa yin

verses.skt: daṃśaḥ sadyo ’tiruk śyāvas tudyate sphuṭatīva ca | te gavādiśakṛtkothād digdhadaṣṭādikothataḥ
verses.tib: zin ma thag ni rab na gnag / gas pa snyam du sems shing zug / de ni lci ba sogs rul dang / dug gis phog sogs rul ba dang

verses.skt: sarpakothāc ca saṃbhūtā mandamadhyamahāviṣāḥ | mandāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śyāvā rūkṣāḥ karburamecakāḥ
verses.tib: sbrul rul pa las skyes pa yi / dug tshabs chung dang 'bring dang che / tshabs chung ser zhing dkar dang gnag / rtsub dang phra zhing gzig mdog can

verses.skt: romaśā bahuparvāṇo lohitāḥ pāṇḍurodarāḥ | dhūmrodarās triparvāṇo madhyās tu kapilāruṇāḥ
verses.tib: spu drang tshigs ni dmar ba dang / dmar zhing lto ba dkar ba yin / bar ma lto ru tshigs gsum pa / rked pa ser skya dmar ba yin

verses.skt: piśaṅgāḥ śabarāś citrāḥ śoṇitābhā mahāviṣāḥ | agnyābhā dvyekaparvāṇo raktāsitasitodarāḥ
verses.tib: dug che ser skya phra ba dang / ri mo can la khrag 'dra zhing / me 'dra tshigs ni gnyis sam gcig / lto ba dkar zhing dmar ram gnag

verses.skt: tair daṣṭaḥ śūnarasanaḥ stabdhagātro jvarārditaḥ | khair vamañ choṇitaṃ kṛṣṇam indriyārthān asaṃvidan
verses.tib: des zin lce ni skrangs pa dang / lus rengs rims kyis nyen pa dang / bu ga las ni khrag nag slon / dbang po'i don ni mi shes shing

verses.skt: svidyan mūrchan viśuṣkāsyo vihvalo vedanāturaḥ | viśīryamāṇamāṃsaś ca prāyaśo vijahāty asūn
verses.tib: rdul zhing brgyal la kha skom dad / rmongs shing nad kyis nyen pa dang / sha ni zhig par byed pa ste / phal cher srog ni 'dor bar byed

verses.skt: ucciṭiṅgas tu vaktreṇa daśaty abhyadhikavyathaḥ | sādhyato vṛścikāt stambhaṃ śephaso hṛṣṭaromatām
verses.tib: mchu sbom pa yi kha yis ni / 'debs shing gsor rung sdig pa las / lhag par na byed lus rengs shing / mtshan gyi sbubs ni ldang ba dang

verses.skt: karoti sekam aṅgānāṃ daṃśaḥ śītāmbuneva ca | uṣṭradhūmaḥ sa evokto rātricārāc ca rātrikaḥ
verses.tib: lus ni rngul bar byed 'gyur zhing / sos 'debs chu grang snyam du sems / de nyid rnga mo dud ka dang / mtshan mo rgyu bas mtshan mo can

verses.skt: vātapittottarāḥ kīṭāḥ ślaiṣmikāḥ kaṇabhondurāḥ | prāyo vātolbaṇaviṣā vṛścikāḥ soṣṭradhūmakāḥ
verses.tib: srin bu rlung mkhris shas che zhing / rnga mo byi ba bad kan can / rnga mo dud pa zhes bya ba / phal cher rlung shas che ba yin

verses.skt: yasya yasyaiva doṣasya liṅgādhikyaṃ pratarkayet | tasya tasyauṣadhaiḥ kuryād viparītaguṇaiḥ kriyām
verses.tib: nad ni gang dang gang gi ni / mtshan ma shas che ba las brtags / de dang de las gso ba'i sman / yon tan mi mthun pa yis gso

verses.skt: hṛtpīḍordhvānilastambhaḥ sirāyāmo ’sthiparvaruk | ghūrṇanodveṣṭanaṃ gātraśyāvatā vātike viṣe
verses.tib: snying gzer stong rlung gis rengs shing / rtsa mi snang zhing rus tshigs na / mgo 'khor lus bcings snyam du sems / mdog gnag rlung las gyur pa'i dug

verses.skt: saṃjñānāśoṣṇaniśvāsau hṛddāhaḥ kaṭukāsyatā | māṃsāvadaraṇaṃ śopho raktapītaś ca paittike
verses.tib: dran nyams / dbugs ni tsha bar byed / snying tsha kha ni kha bro la / sha 'gas skrang par byed pa dang / khrag ser ba ni mkhris pa can

verses.skt: chardyarocakahṛllāsaprasekotkleśapīnasaiḥ | saśaityamukhamādhuryair vidyāc chleṣmādhikaṃ viṣam
verses.tib: slon zhing snying na yi ga 'chus / kha chu 'dzag cing chom pas 'debs / grang bcas kha ni mngar bar bro / bad kan shas che'i dug nad yin

verses.skt: piṇyākena vraṇālepas tailābhyaṅgaś ca vātike | svedo nāḍīpulākādyair bṛṃhaṇaś ca vidhir hitaḥ
verses.tib: 'ba' chas rma ni bsku ba dang / rlung sel til mar gyis bsku dang / sbu gu ma smin 'bru dugs dang / brtas par bya ba'i cho gas phan

verses.skt: paittikaṃ stambhayet sekaiḥ pradehaiś cātiśītalaiḥ | lekhanacchedanasvedavamanaiḥ ślaiṣmikaṃ jayet
verses.tib: mkhris pa can la sman chu blugs / shin tu grang ba'i lde gus bsku / bad kan can la bzhar zhing bcad / dugs dang skyug sman btang bas gso

verses.skt: kīṭānāṃ triprakārāṇāṃ traividhyena kriyā hitā | svedālepanasekāṃs tu koṣṇān prāyo ’vacārayet
verses.tib: srin bu rnam pa gsum po la / gso ba rnam pa gsum pos phan / dugs dang bsku dang sman chu blugs / phal cher dro 'jam gtang bar bya

verses.skt: anyatra mūrchitād daṃśapākataḥ kothato ’thavā | nṛkeśāḥ sarṣapāḥ pītā guḍo jīrṇaś ca dhūpanam
verses.tib: gzhan du brgyal dang mche ba yis / rnag dang 'drul bar byed ma gtogs / mi skra yungs kar ser po dang / bu ram rnying pa'i dud pas bdug

verses.skt: viṣadaṃśasya sarvasya kāśyapaḥ param abravīt | viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca
verses.tib: dug dang mche ba'i dug kun la / mchog tu phan par 'drob skyong 'chang / dug sel sman ni thams cad dang / sbyang ba'i las kyang bya ba yin

verses.skt: sādhayet sarpavad daṣṭān viṣograiḥ kīṭavṛścikaiḥ | taṇḍulīyakatulyāṃśāṃ trivṛtāṃ sarpiṣā pibet
verses.tib: srin bu sdig pa mi bzad dug / 'bus zin sbrul gyis zin ltar gso / tan du li ya cha mnyam pa'i / dur byid dang ni zhun mar blud

verses.skt: yāti kīṭaviṣaiḥ kampaṃ na kailāsa ivānilaiḥ | kṣīrivṛkṣatvagālepaḥ śuddhe kīṭaviṣāpahaḥ
verses.tib: 'bu yi dug gis gangs can ltar / bskyod par nus pa ma yin no / 'o ma can shing lde gus bsku / sbyangs byas srin bu'i dug sel byed

verses.skt: muktālepo varaḥ śophatodadāhajvarapraṇut | vacāhiṅguviḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ gajapippalī
verses.tib: skrang dang dug dang tsha ba sel / shu dag shing kun byi dang ga / rgyam tsha ha ti pi pi ling / ba tha bong nga tsha ba gsum

verses.skt: pāṭhā prativiṣā vyoṣaṃ kāśyapena vinirmitam | daśāṅgam agadaṃ pītvā sarvakīṭaviṣaṃ jayet
verses.tib: 'drob skyong gis ni bshad pa yin / yan lag bcu pa'i dug sman ni / 'drob skyong gis ni bshad pa dag / blud na srin bu'i dug kyang sel

verses.skt: sadyo vṛścikajaṃ daṃśaṃ cakratailena secayet | vidārigandhāsiddhena kavoṣṇenetareṇa vā
verses.tib: sdig pa'i dug gis 'phral zin la / 'khor los btsir ba'i til mar bsku / sa la par+Ni bskol ba yi / dro 'jam yang na gzhan dag blugs

verses.skt: lavaṇottamayuktena sarpiṣā vā punaḥ punaḥ | siñcet koṣṇāranālena sakṣīralavaṇena vā
verses.tib: rgyam tsha dang ni bcas pa yi / zhun mar yang dang yang du blugs / yang na skyur rtsabs dro 'jam mam / rgyam tsha 'o mar bcas pa blugs

verses.skt: upanāho ghṛte bhṛṣṭaḥ kalko ’jājyāḥ sasaindhavaḥ | ādaṃśaṃ sveditaṃ cūrṇaiḥ pracchāya pratisārayet
verses.tib: mar dang brngos pa'i go snyod dang / rgyam tshar bcas pas dkri bar bya / mche bas zin pa dugs / byas la / zhal zhal btab ste 'bras bu gsum

verses.skt: rajanīsaindhavavyoṣaśirīṣaphalapuṣpajaiḥ | mātuluṅgāmlagomūtrapiṣṭaṃ ca surasāgrajam
verses.tib: shir sha'i me tog bsku bar bya / rgyam tsha kha lung ba gcin skyur / bye'u rug pa'i rtse mo btags

verses.skt: lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaś ca hitaḥ piṇyāko gomayo ’pi vā | pāne sarpir madhuyutaṃ kṣīraṃ vā bhūriśarkaram
verses.tib: 'ba' cha'am lci ba dro 'jam tsam / bskus na'ang phan par 'gyur ba yin / btung ba zhun mar sbrang rtsir bcas / yang na 'o mar kha ra btab

verses.skt: pārāvataśakṛt pathyā tagaraṃ viśvabheṣajam | bījapūrarasonmiśraḥ paramo vṛścikāgadaḥ
verses.tib: phug ron rtug pa a ru ra / rgya spos bca' sga kha lung gi / khu ba dang sbyar blud pa ni / sdig pas zin pa'i sman mchog yin

verses.skt: saśaivaloṣṭradaṃṣṭrā ca hanti vṛścikajaṃ viṣam | hiṅgunā haritālena mātuluṅgarasena ca
verses.tib: rnga mo'i so ni chu bal bcas / sdig pa'i dug ni 'joms par byed / shing kun ba la kha lung gi / khu ba dang sbyar lde gu dang

verses.skt: lepāñjanābhyāṃ guṭikā paramaṃ vṛścikāpahā | karañjārjunaśelūnāṃ kaṭabhyāṃ kuṭajasya ca
verses.tib: mig sman ri lur byas na ni / sdig pa'i dug ni sel mchog yin / ka rany+dza dang ardzu na / gi ri kar+Ni se lu dang

verses.skt: śirīṣasya ca puṣpāṇi mastunā daṃśalepanam | yo muhyati praśvasiti pralapaty ugravedanaḥ
verses.tib: shir sha'i me tog dug mo nyung / zhog chu dang btags bskus na / sdig pa'i dug ni sel bar byed / gang zhig rmugs shing rngam pa 'thon

verses.skt: tasya pathyāniśākṛṣṇāmañjiṣṭhātiviṣoṣaṇam | sālābuvṛntaṃ vārtākarasapiṣṭaṃ pralepanam
verses.tib: bla zhing mi bzad na gyur pa / de la yung dang a ru ra / btsod dang bong nga pi pi ling / bil ba gzhon nu na le sham / bA ta ka yi khu bar btags / lde gus byugs na phan pa yin

verses.skt: sarvatra cogrāliviṣe pāyayed dadhisarpiṣī | vidhyet sirāṃ vidadhyāc ca vamanāñjananāvanam | uṣṇasnigdhāmlamadhuraṃ bhojanaṃ cānilāpaham
verses.tib: sbrang ma gdug pa'i dug kun la / zho dang mar ni blud bya zhing / gtar ga gdab cing sna sman dang / mig sman gyi ni cho ga bya / dro zhing snum dang skyur ba dang / rlung 'doms kha zas sbyin par bya

verses.skt: nāgaraṃ gṛhakapotapurīṣaṃ bījapūrakaraso haritālam | saindhavaṃ ca vinihanty agado ’yaṃ lepato ’likulajaṃ viṣam āśu
verses.tib: dong gra byi ba'i rtug pa dang / kha lung khu ba sla ba dang / rgyam tsha pu shel tse sbyar ba'i / lde gus dang ma'i dug myur 'joms

verses.skt: ante vṛścikadaṣṭānāṃ samudīrṇe bhṛśaṃ viṣe | viṣeṇālepayed daṃśam ucciṭiṅge ’py ayaṃ vidhiḥ
verses.tib: sdig pas zin pa'i tha mar ni / dug ni shas cher langs gyur par / zin pa'i rma la dug gis bsku / uts+tshe TiM ka'i gso ba'ang 'di

verses.skt: nāgapurīṣacchattraṃ rohiṣamūlaṃ ca śelutoyena | kuryād guṭikāṃ lepād iyam aliviṣanāśanī śreṣṭhā
verses.tib: glang po che yi rtug pa'i steng / ro hi sha'i rtsa se'u'i chu / sde gur byas btags bskus na ni / 'di ni sbrang ma'i dug 'joms mchog

verses.skt: arkasya dugdhena śirīṣabījaṃ trir bhāvitaṃ pippalicūrṇamiśram | eṣo ’gado hanti viṣāṇi kīṭabhujaṅgalūtonduravṛścikānām
verses.tib: shir sha'i sa bon arga yi / 'o mas lan gsum bsgos pa ni / pi pi ling gi phye mar bsres / dug sman 'dis ni srin bu'i dug / sbrul dang lu dbyi ba yi / dug ni sel bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: śirīṣapuṣpaṃ sakarañjabījaṃ kāśmīrajaṃ kuṣṭhamanaḥśile ca | eṣo ’gado rātrikavṛścikānāṃ saṃkrāntikārī kathito jinena
verses.tib: shir sha ka rany+dza yi sa bon dang / gur gum ru rta ldong / ros bcas pa yi / dug sman 'dis ni mtshan rgyu'i sdig pas zin / sel bar byed pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs

verses.skt: kīṭebhyo dāruṇatarā lūṭāḥ ṣoḍaśa tā jaguḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatir ity eke tato ’py anye tu bhūyasīḥ
verses.tib: srin bu las ni rab gdug pa / ba ni bcu drug yin par bshad / gzhan dag nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'dod / kha cig de bas mang bar 'dod

verses.skt: sahasraraśmyanucarā vadanty anye sahasraśaḥ | bahūpadravarūpā tu lūtaikaiva viṣātmikā
verses.tib: nyi ma'i 'od kyi rjes 'brang ba / stong phrag yod ces gzhan dag 'chad / bla brnan gzugs ni mang gyur pa / dug can pa ni gcig pur 'dod

verses.skt: rūpāṇi nāmatas tasyā durjñeyāny atisaṃkarāt | nāsti sthānavyavasthā ca doṣato ’taḥ pracakṣate
verses.tib: de yi gzugs dang ming dag ni / shin tu 'dres pas shes par dka' / gnas kyi nges pa yod min pas / de phyir nad las bshad par bya

verses.skt: kṛcchrasādhyā pṛthagdoṣair asādhyā nicayena sā | taddaṃśaḥ paittiko dāhatṛṭsphoṭajvaramohavān
verses.tib: nad gzhi so so'i gso ba dka' / 'dus pa las gyur gsor mi rung / des zin mkhris gyur tsha ba dang / skom dad chu bur rims kyis 'debs

verses.skt: bhṛśoṣṃā raktapītābhaḥ kledī drākṣāphalopamaḥ | ślaiṣmikaḥ kaṭhinaḥ pāṇḍuḥ parūṣakaphalākṛtiḥ
verses.tib: rmongs bag rab tsha dmar ser mdog / rnags shing rgun 'bru'i 'bras bu 'dra / bad kan las gyur sra zhing skya / ba ru sha ka'i 'bras bu 'dra

verses.skt: nidrāṃ śītajvaraṃ kāsaṃ kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute bhṛśam | vātikaḥ paruṣaḥ śyāvaḥ parvabhedajvarapradaḥ
verses.tib: gnyid che grang rims lud pa lu / shin tu g.ya' bar byed pa yin / rlung gyur rtsub cing gnag pa dang / tshigs na rims kyis 'debs par byed

verses.skt: tadvibhāgaṃ yathāsvaṃ ca doṣaliṅgair vibhāvayet | asādhyāyāṃ tu hṛnmohaśvāsahidhmāśirograhāḥ
verses.tib: de yi dbye ba nad kyi ni / rang gi mtshan nyid las shes bya / gsor mi rung ba snying tsha zhing / lud pa skyigs bu mgo nad dang

verses.skt: śvetapītāsitāraktāḥ piṭikāḥ śvayathūdbhavaḥ | vepathur vamathur dāhas tṛḍ āndhyaṃ vakranāsatā
verses.tib: 'brum phran dkar dang ser dang gnag / dmar dang skya ba las 'byung 'gyur / 'dar zhing skrangs la tsha ba dang / skom dad lang zhing sna 'chus la

verses.skt: śyāvauṣṭhavaktradantatvaṃ pṛṣṭhagrīvāvabhañjanam | pakvajambūsavarṇaṃ ca daṃśāt sravati śoṇitam
verses.tib: mchu gnag so ni g.yo ba dang / rgyab dang mid pa bcom snyam sems / 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu smin 'dra ba'i / khrag ni mchus bldags rma las 'dzag

verses.skt: sarvāpi sarvajā prāyo vyapadeśas tu bhūyasā | tīkṣṇamadhyāvaratvena sā tridhā hanty upekṣitā
verses.tib: 'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun ldan zhing / ming ni mang por gyur pa yi / de dug rnon po bar ma dang / dman pa'i dbye ba gsum du 'gyur

verses.skt: saptāhena daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca paraṃ kramāt | lūtādaṃśaś ca sarvo ’pi dadrūmaṇḍalasaṃnibhaḥ
verses.tib: ma bcos zhag bdun zhag bcu dang / zla ba phyed kyi rims kyis gsod / ba dang mchu thams cad kyang / glang shu kor kor por byed cing

verses.skt: sito ’sito ’ruṇaḥ pītaḥ śyāvo vā mṛdur unnataḥ | madhye kṛṣṇo ’thavā śyāvaḥ paryante jālakāvṛtaḥ
verses.tib: dkar dang gnag dang dmar dang ser / gnag pa'am 'jam zhing mtho ba dang / dbus su gnag pa'am sngo ba la / mtha' ma dra ba lta bus khebs

verses.skt: visarpavāṃś chophayutas tapyate bahuvedanaḥ | jvarāśupākavikledakothāvadaraṇānvitaḥ
verses.tib: mched cing skrang bar byed pa dang / tsha zhing mang du na ba dang / rims 'debs myur du rnags shing 'drul / rul zhing gas par byed pa dang

verses.skt: kledena yat spṛśaty aṅgaṃ tatrāpi kurute vraṇam | śvāsadaṃṣṭrāśakṛnmūtraśukralālānakhārtavaiḥ
verses.tib: rnag gis gang du reg gyur / pa'i / phyogs der yang ni rma skyed byed / dbugs dang mche ba bshang gci dang / khu chu kha chu sen mo khrag

verses.skt: aṣṭābhir udvamaty eṣā viṣaṃ vaktrād viśeṣataḥ | lūtā nābher daśaty ūrdhvam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca kīṭakāḥ
verses.tib: brgyad po gnod byed khyad par du / dug ni kha la gnas pa yin / ba ni lte ba yan chad 'dzin / srin bu stod smad kun tu gnod

verses.skt: taddūṣitaṃ ca vastrādi dehe pṛktaṃ vikārakṛt | dinārdhaṃ lakṣyate naiva daṃśo lūtāviṣodbhavaḥ
verses.tib: de gnod byas pa'i gos la sogs / lus la reg na nad skyed byed / ba dang srin bu las gyur dug / nyin phyed bar du tshor mi 'gyur

verses.skt: sūcīvyadhavad ābhāti tato ’sau prathame ’hani | avyaktavarṇaḥ pracalaḥ kiñcitkaṇḍūrujānvitaḥ
verses.tib: de nas dang po'i nyin zhag la / khab kyis gtsags pa snyam du sems / mdog mi gsal zhing g.yo ba dang / cung zad g.ya' zhing nad dang ldan

verses.skt: dvitīye ’bhyunnato ’nteṣu piṭikair iva vācitaḥ | vyaktavarṇo nato madhye kaṇḍūmān granthisaṃnibhaḥ
verses.tib: gnyis par mtha' ma shin tu mtho / 'brum bu phra mos khyab pa 'dra / mdog gsal gyur na dbus dma' zhing / g.ya' zhing rmen bu lta bur snang

verses.skt: tṛtīye sajvaro romaharṣakṛd raktamaṇḍalaḥ | śarāvarūpas todāḍhyo romakūpeṣu sāsravaḥ
verses.tib: gsum par rims bcas spu ldang zhing / 'khor ling dmar por snang ba dang / kham phor gzugs 'dra phal cher ni / ba spu'i bu ga 'dzag par 'gyur

verses.skt: mahāṃś caturthe śvayathus tāpaśvāsabhramapradaḥ | vikārān kurute tāṃs tān pañcame viṣakopajān
verses.tib: nyin zhag bzhi par cher skrangs shing / mgo 'khor lus tsha dbugs mi bde / lnga par dug ldang las gyur pa'i / nad ni de dang de dag bskyed

verses.skt: ṣaṣṭhe vyāpnoti marmāṇi saptame hanti jīvitam | iti tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ madhyaṃ hīnaṃ ca vibhajed ataḥ
verses.tib: drug par gnad du khyab par byed / bdun par srog ni 'joms par byed / de ltar dug ni rnon po dang / bar ma dman pa dbye bar bya

verses.skt: ekaviṃśatirātreṇa viṣaṃ śāmyati sarvathā | athāśu lūtādaṣṭasya śastreṇādaṃśam uddharet
verses.tib: de nas nyin zhag nyi shu ni / gcig na yong ye zhi bar 'gyur / de 'og ba yis zin pa ni / mtshon gyis rma ni gnod par bya

verses.skt: dahec ca jāmbavauṣṭhādyair na tu pittottaraṃ dahet | karkaśaṃ bhinnaromāṇaṃ marmasaṃdhyādisaṃśritam
verses.tib: 'dzam bu'i mchu la sogs pas bsreg / mkhris pa las gyur bsreg mi bya / rtsub cing spu ni gyes pa dang / gnad dang tshigs la sogs la gnas

verses.skt: prasṛtaṃ sarvato daṃśaṃ na cchindīta dahen na ca | lepayed dagdham agadair madhusaindhavasaṃyutaiḥ
verses.tib: zin nas kun tu khyab gyur pa / gcad par mi bya bsreg mi bya / bsreg pa dug sman rgyam tsha dang / sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bsku bar bya

verses.skt: suśītaiḥ secayec cānu kaṣāyaiḥ kṣīrivṛkṣajaiḥ | sarvato ’pahared raktaṃ śṛṅgādyaiḥ sirayāpi vā
verses.tib: de rjes 'o ma can shing bskol / sman khu shin tu bsil mo blugs / rngabs rwa sogs sam gtar ga yis / thams cad la ni khrag dbyung bya

verses.skt: sekalepās tataḥ śītā bodhiśleṣmātakākṣakaiḥ | phalinīdviniśākṣaudrasarpirbhiḥ padmakāhvayaḥ
verses.tib: de nas bsil sman bsku blugs bya / sle sman ta ka a shwad+tha / ba ru ra dang pri yang ku / shug pa ser gnyis sbrang rtsir sbyar

verses.skt: aśeṣalūtākīṭānām agadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ | haridrādvayapattaṅgamañjiṣṭhānatakesaraiḥ
verses.tib: ba dang srin bu la sogs pa'i / dug 'joms las ni thams cad byed / ser po rnam gnyis rma shing btsod / pad+ma ge sar rgya spos ni

verses.skt: sakṣaudrasarpiḥ pūrvasmād adhikaś campakāhvayaḥ | tadvad gomayaniṣpīḍaśarkarāghṛtamākṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi mar sbyar tsam pa ka / snga ma bas kyang yon tan lhag / lci khu btsir / dang kar dkar

verses.skt: apāmārgamano'hvāladārvīdhyāmakagairikaiḥ | natailākuṣṭhamaricayaṣṭyāhvaghṛtamākṣikaiḥ
verses.tib: a pa marga ldong ros dang / ba bla skyer pa bya ma ka / yug snam sbrang rtse mar de bzhin

verses.skt: agado mandaro nāma tathānyo gandhamādanaḥ | natalodhravacākaṭvīpāṭhailāpattrakuṅkumaiḥ
verses.tib: rgya spos na le sham sug smel / ru rta shing mngar sbrang rtsi mar

verses.skt: mañjiṣṭhāśleṣmātakarajanīsuvahāśirīṣapālindyaḥ | sasindhuvārā viṣaṃ ghnanti sailācandanakanakāḥ
verses.tib: sbyar ba'i sman ni man+da ra / rgya spos seng phrom pu tse shel / shu dag pa tha sug smel dang / gur gum spos dang ldang de bzhin

verses.skt: viṣaghnaṃ bahudoṣeṣu prayuñjīta viśodhanam | yaṣṭyāhvamadanāṅkollajālinīsindhuvārikāḥ
verses.tib: nad gzhi mang la dug 'joms pa'i / sbyang ba byas pas gso bar bya / shing mngar dang ni po son cha / ko sha ta ki ang ko la

verses.skt: kaphe jyeṣṭhāmbunā pītvā viṣam āśu samudvamet | śirīṣapattratvaṅmūlaphalaṃ vāṅkollamūlavat
verses.tib: sin du bar 'bras chur sbyar / 'thungs na bad kan las gyur dug / myur du slon par byed pa yin / shir sha'i lo ma med dang / rtsa ba 'bras bu ang ko la'i / rtsa bar bcas pa'ang de bzhin no

verses.skt: virecayec ca triphalānīlinītrivṛtādibhiḥ | nivṛtte dāhaśophādau karṇikāṃ pātayed vraṇāt
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang ni li ni / dur byid la sogs bkru sman gtang / skrang dang tsha sogs zhi gyur na / rma yi lte ba dbog par bya

verses.skt: kusumbhapuṣpaṃ godantaḥ svarṇakṣīrī kapotaviṭ | trivṛtā saindhavaṃ dantī karṇikāpātanaṃ tathā
verses.tib: ba bla le brgan rtsi'i me tog / khron bu byi ba'i rtug pa dang / dur byid rgyam tsha dan dang sbyang

verses.skt: mūlam uttaravāruṇyā vaṃśanirlekhasaṃyutam | tadvac ca saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dantī kaṭukadaugdhikam
verses.tib: lte ba 'byin par byed pa yin / de bzhin u ta ma ka ra'i / rtsa ba smin pa'i shun bcas pa'i / rgyam tsha ru rta pu tse shel

verses.skt: rājakośātakīmūlaṃ kiṇvo vā mathitodbhavaḥ | karṇikāpātasamaye bṛṃhayec ca viṣāpahaiḥ
verses.tib: dan da pa ya s+ya sbyar ba'am / ra dza ko ta ka'i rtsar / dar ba'i tshigs ma'ang sbyar bar bya / lte ba bcad pa'i dus su ni / dug sel ba yis brta bar bya

verses.skt: snehakāryam aśeṣaṃ ca sarpiṣaiva samācaret | viṣasya vṛddhaye tailam agner iva tṛṇolupam
verses.tib: snum chos ma lus bya ba ni / zhun mar nyid kyis bya ba yin / til mar gyis ni rtswa sogs la / me mched lta bur dug 'phel byed

verses.skt: hrīveravaikaṅkatagopakanyāmustāśamīcandanaṭuṇṭukāni | śaivālanīlotpalavakrayaṣṭītvaṅnākulīpadmakarāṭhamadhyam
verses.tib: be kang ka ta ba li ka / thal tres gla sgang spri ka dang / tsan+dan nya lcibs son ka / ut+pal rgya spos shing mngar dang / shing tsha shug pa na gu li

verses.skt: rajanīghanasarpalocanākaṇaśuṇṭhīkaṇamūlacitrakāḥ | varuṇāgurubilvapāṭalīpicumandāmayaśelukesaram
verses.tib: skyer pa gla sgang sar pak+Shi / bca' sga pi pi ling rtsa ba / pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka / ba ru na dang a ka ru / bil ba nim pa pa ta li / ru rta nA ga ge sar dang / se'u lu lhan cig sbyar ba dang

verses.skt: bilvacandananatotpalaśuṇṭhīpippalīniculavetasakuṣṭham | śuktiśākavarapāṭalibhārgīsindhuvārakaraghāṭavarāṅgam
verses.tib: bil ba tsan+dan ut+pal / rgya spos bca' sga pi pi ling / lcam pa nim pa ru rta dang / chu srin sder mo dzi ban ti / ga bra'i rtsa ba pa ta li / dzi ban ti dang po son cha / shing tsha sbyar ba de dag ni

verses.skt: pittakaphānilalūtāḥ pānāñjananasyalepasekena | agadavarā vṛttasthāḥ kugatīr iva vārayanty ete
verses.tib: mig sman snar blugs byug pa dang / sman chu blugs pa'i sbyor ba yis / mkhris pa bad kan rlung gyur pa'i / lu ta'i dug ni ji snyed pa / tshul / khrims la gnas ngan 'gro bzhin / 'di yis dug nad kun 'joms byed

verses.skt: lodhraṃ sevyaṃ padmakaṃ padmareṇuḥ kālīyākhyaṃ candanaṃ yac ca raktam | kāntāpuṣpaṃ dugdhinīkā mṛṇālaṃ lūtāḥ sarvā ghnanti sarvakriyābhiḥ
verses.tib: seng phrom shug pa pad+ma ge sar dang / tsan+dan dmar ser pri yang ku'i me tog / pad+ma pu shel tse dang pa ya s+ya'i / sbyor ba kun gyis ba yi dug kun 'joms

verses.skt: lālanaś capalaḥ putro hasiraś cikkiro ’jiraḥ | kaṣāyadantaḥ kulakaḥ kokilaḥ kapilo ’sitaḥ
verses.tib: khu chu can dang mi brtan bu / rgod dang sgra can pags pa dang / rnying pa'i so dang khu byug dang / ser skya dang ni nag po dang

verses.skt: aruṇaḥ śabaraḥ śvetaḥ kapotaḥ palitonduraḥ | chucchundaro rasālākhyo daśāṣṭau ceti mūṣikāḥ
verses.tib: dmar ser khra bo dkar po dang / thib skra dkar phyi ba dang / phus pa dang ni bra byi ste / byi ba'i dbye ba bco brgyad yin

verses.skt: śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukradigdhaiḥ spṛśanti vā | yad aṅgam aṅgais tatrāsre dūṣite pāṇḍutāṃ gate
verses.tib: gang du 'di yi khu chus phog / khu bas phog dang reg pa ni / lus kyi lus la reg pa der / khrag la gnod cing mdog skya la

verses.skt: granthayaḥ śvayathuḥ koṭho maṇḍalāni bhramo ’ruciḥ | śītajvaro ’tiruk sādo vepathuḥ parvabhedanam
verses.tib: thor bu rmen bu dri mnam dang / shu ba kor ling yi ga 'chus / mgo 'khor skrangs rims rab tu na / nyam chung 'dar zhing lhu tshigs na

verses.skt: romaharṣaḥ srutir mūrchā dīrghakālānubandhanam | śleṣmānubaddhabahvākhupotakacchardanaṃ satṛṭ
verses.tib: spu ldang dran nyams khrag 'dzag dang / yun ring du ni gnas par byed / bad kan can gyi byi ba yi / phru gu mang reg skom slon 'gyur

verses.skt: vyavāyy ākhuviṣaṃ kṛcchraṃ bhūyo bhūyaś ca kupyati | mūrchāṅgaśophavaivarṇyakledaśabdāśrutijvarāḥ
verses.tib: byi ba 'khrig spyod dug gso dka' / yang dang yang du ldang bar byed / yan lag kun skrangs mdog mi sdug / rnags shing 'on la rims kyis 'debs

verses.skt: śirogurutvaṃ lālāsṛkchardiś cāsādhyalakṣaṇam | śūnavastiṃ vivarṇauṣṭham ākhvābhair granthibhiś citam
verses.tib: mgo lci kha chu khrag 'byung zhing / slon pa gso dka'i mtshan nyid yin / phus pas zin pa de dri bro / lgang pa skrangs shing chu mdog nyams

verses.skt: chucchundarasagandhaṃ ca varjayed ākhudūṣitam | śunaḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ saṃjñāṃ saṃjñāvahāśritāḥ
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i rmen bus khyab / khye'i dug bad kan shas cher 'khrugs / 'du shes rgyu ba'i rtsa mang gnas

verses.skt: muṣṇantaḥ kurvate kṣobhaṃ dhātūnām atidāruṇam | lālāvān andhabadhiraḥ sarvataḥ so ’bhidhāvati
verses.tib: gnod cing 'khrug par byed pa dang / lus zungs la ni mi bzad gnod / kha chu 'dzag dang long dang 'on / kun tu rgyug par byed pa dang

verses.skt: srastapucchahanuskandhaḥ śiroduḥkhī natānanaḥ | daṃśas tena vidaṣṭasya suptaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣaraty asṛk
verses.tib: mjug ma 'gram pa phrag gong lhod / mgon gdong ni dud pa yin / de yi so yis zin na rma / tshor ba chung zhing khrag rnag 'dzag

verses.skt: hṛcchirorugjvarastambhatṛṣṇāmūrchodbhavo ’nu ca | anenānye ’pi boddhavyā vyālā daṃṣṭrāprahāriṇaḥ
verses.tib: mgo snying na zhing rims 'debs rengs / de rjes skom dang brgyal bar 'gyur / 'di yis gdug cing mche ba can / ce spyang dom dang dred dang gung

verses.skt: śṛgālāśvatarāśvarkṣadvīpivyāghravṛkādayaḥ | kaṇḍūnistodavaivarṇyasuptikledajvarabhramāḥ
verses.tib: stag dang spyang ki la sogs pa / gzhan dag kyang ni shes par bya / g.ya' zhing zug la mdog mi sdug / tshor ba med gnas rims mgo 'khor

verses.skt: vidāharāgarukpākaśophagranthivikuñcanam | daṃśāvadaraṇaṃ sphoṭāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca
verses.tib: tsha zhing dmar lan zhing gnag / skrang zhing rmen bu skye zug 'khums / rma ni 'gags shing 'brum bu 'byung / lte ba can du zlum por 'gyur

verses.skt: sarvatra saviṣe liṅgaṃ viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe | daṣṭo yena tu tacceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan vinaśyati
verses.tib: kun tu dug bcas mtshan ma 'di / dug med de las bzlog pa yin / gang gis bzung ba de'i spyod tshul

verses.skt: paśyaṃs tam eva cākasmād ādarśasalilādiṣu | yo ’dbhyas trasyed adaṣṭo ’pi śabdasaṃsparśadarśanaiḥ
verses.tib: sgra sgrogs rgyu med par de'i gzugs / chu dang me long sogs mthong 'chi / ma bzung bar yang sgra dang ni / mthong bas sdang bar byed pa ni

verses.skt: jalasaṃtrāsanāmānaṃ daṣṭaṃ tam api varjayet | ākhunā daṣṭamātrasya daṃśaṃ kāṇḍena dāhayet
verses.tib: chu yis skrag ces bya ba ste / zin pas de yang spang bar bya / byi ba'i dug gis zin ma thag / rma ni mde'u bsregs pas bsreg

verses.skt: darpaṇenāthavā tīvrarujā syāt karṇikānyathā | dagdhaṃ visrāvayed daṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet
verses.tib: yang na me long dag gis bya / gzhan du lte bar mi bzod na / bsregs nas rma las khrag dbyung zhing / zhal zhal byas la shir sha dang

verses.skt: śirīṣarajanīvakrakuṅkumāmṛtavallibhiḥ | agāradhūmamañjiṣṭhārajanīlavaṇottamaiḥ
verses.tib: yung ba rgya spos gur gum dang / sle tres kyi ni lde gus bsku / khyim gyi dud pa skyer pa dang / rgyam tsha dang ni btsod dag gi

verses.skt: lepo jayaty ākhuviṣaṃ karṇikāyāś ca pātanaḥ | tato ’mlaiḥ kṣālayitvānu toyair anu ca lepayet
verses.tib: lde gus byi ba'i dug sel zhing / lte ba 'bur ba'ang 'joms par byed / de nas skyur bas bkrus nas ni

verses.skt: pālindīśvetakaṭabhībilvamūlaguḍūcibhiḥ | anyaiś ca viṣaśophaghnaiḥ sirāṃ vā mokṣayed drutam
verses.tib: gi ri kar Ni pa lin di / bil ba'i rtsa ba sle tres dang / chu dang btags pa'i lde gus bsku / dug dang skrang sel sman gzhan dang / yang na gtar ga myur du gdab

verses.skt: chardanaṃ nīlinīkvāthaiḥ śukākhyāṅkollayor api | kośātakyāḥ śukākhyāyāḥ phalaṃ jīmūtakasya ca
verses.tib: ni li ni bskol shi ri sha / ang ko la yi khu bas slon / ko sha ta ki shir sha dang / dzi mu ta ka'i 'bras bu dang

verses.skt: madanasya ca saṃcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet | vacāmadanajīmūtakuṣṭhaṃ vā mūtrapeṣitam
verses.tib: po son cha ni phye mar btags / zho sbyar blud la dug slon gzhug / shu dag ru rta po son cha'am / dzi ban ti ni ba gcin btags

verses.skt: pūrvakalpena pātavyaṃ sarvonduraviṣāpaham | virecanaṃ trivṛnnīlītriphalākalka iṣyate
verses.tib: cho ga snga ma bzhin blud na / dug gi nad ni thams cad sel / dur byid ni li ni dang ni / 'bras bu gsum gyi bkru sman bsngags

verses.skt: śirovirecane sāraḥ śirīṣasya phalāni ca | añjanaṃ gomayaraso vyoṣasūkṣmarajo'nvitaḥ
verses.tib: shir sha'i snying po'i 'bras bu yis / mgo bo'i bkru sman dag kyang phan / ba lci'i khu ba tsha ba gsum / phye ma zhib btags lde gus phan

verses.skt: kapitthagomayaraso madhumān avalehanam | taṇḍulīyakamūlena siddhaṃ pāne hitaṃ ghṛtam
verses.tib: ba lang lci ba ka pid ta'i / phye ma sbrang rtsi'i lde gu bza' / taN+Du li yi rtsa ba dang / bskol ba'i mar ni blud na'ang phan

verses.skt: dviniśākaṭabhīraktāyaṣṭyāhvair vāmṛtānvitaiḥ | āsphotamūlasiddhaṃ vā pañcakāpittham eva vā
verses.tib: gi ri kar Ni ser po gnyis / shing mngar btsod dang sle tras phan / thal tres rtsa pa mar bskol ba / ka ping ta yi rnam lnga'ang phan

verses.skt: sindhuvāraṃ nataṃ śigrubilvamūlaṃ punarnavā | vacāśvadaṃṣṭrājīmūtam eṣāṃ kvāthaṃ samākṣikam
verses.tib: sin du ba ra rgya spos dang / shi kru bil ba'i rtsa ba dang / shu dag gze ma / ba spru ba / dzi mu ta dang bcas pa ste / de rnams khu ba sbrang rtsir bcas

verses.skt: pibec chālyodanaṃ dadhnā bhuñjāno mūṣikārditaḥ | takreṇa śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ saṃcūrṇya vā pibet
verses.tib: blud nas 'bras chan sA lu zho / byin na byi ba'i dug nad sel / shar pung ga'i phye ma ni / dar bar sbyar ba blud pa'ang phan

verses.skt: aṅkollamūlakalko vā bastamūtreṇa kalkitaḥ | pānālepanayor yuktaḥ sarvākhuviṣanāśanaḥ
verses.tib: aM ko la yi rtsa ba ni / ra thug gcin sbyar lde gus ni / btung dang bsku ba la sbyar na / byi ba'i dug kun sel bar byed

verses.skt: kapitthamadhyatilakatilāṅkollajaṭāḥ pibet | gavāṃ mūtreṇa payasā mañjarīṃ tilakasya vā
verses.tib: ka pid ta yi snying po dang / til ka dang til dang ni / aM ko la yi rtsa ba ni / ba yi 'o ma'am gcin sbyar blud / til ka'i gdong yal ga yi / ba yi 'o ma sbyar ba blud

verses.skt: athavā sairyakān mūlaṃ sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunā | kaṭukālābuvinyastaṃ pītaṃ vāmbu niśoṣitam
verses.tib: yang na sher+ya ka'i rtsa ba / sbrang rtsi 'bras bu sbyar ba blud / ku ba kha bo zhag gcig ni / chu la sbangs pa'ang blud par bya

verses.skt: sindhuvārasya mūlāni biḍālāsthi viṣaṃ natam | jalapiṣṭo ’gado hanti nasyādyair ākhujaṃ viṣam
verses.tib: sin du ba ra'i rtsa ba dang / byi ba'i rus pa bong nga dkar / rgya spos chur btags sna sman sogs / sbyar bas byi ba'i dug sel byed

verses.skt: saśeṣaṃ mūṣikaviṣaṃ prakupyaty abhradarśane | yathāyathaṃ vā kāleṣu doṣāṇāṃ vṛddhihetuṣu
verses.tib: byi ba'i dug ni lhag lus pa / sprin mthong bas ni ldang byed pa'am / nad ni 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu / ji lta bar ni 'phel bar byed

verses.skt: tatra sarve yathāvasthaṃ prayojyāḥ syur upakramāḥ | yathāsvaṃ ye ca nirdiṣṭās tathā dūṣīviṣāpahāḥ
verses.tib: de la gnas skabs thams cad du / gso ba thams cad sbyar bya zhing / rang gi gso bar gang bshad dang / de bzhin nyams pa'i dug sel sbyor

verses.skt: daṃśaṃ tv alarkadaṣṭasya dagdham uṣṇena sarpiṣā | pradihyād agadais tais taiḥ purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ pibet
verses.tib: a lang ga yi so yis zin / mar bskol ba yis bsreg par bya / dug sman de dang de bsku zhing / mar gyi snying po blud par bya

verses.skt: arkakṣīrayutaṃ cāsya yojyam āśu virecanam | aṅkollottaramūlāmbu tripalaṃ sahaviḥpalam
verses.tib: 'di la arka'i 'o mar bcas / bkru sman dag kyang myur du gtang / aM ko la'i rtsa byang phyogs chu / srang gsum mar ni srang gcig blud

verses.skt: pibet sadhattūraphalāṃ śvetāṃ vāpi punarnavām | aikadhyaṃ palalaṃ tailaṃ rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ
verses.tib: d+ha du ra yi 'bras bu dang / gi ri kar Ni ba spru ba / bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya / til btags lde gu arka lcags / 'o ma bu ram bsres byin na

verses.skt: bhinatti viṣam ālarkaṃ ghanavṛndam ivānilaḥ | samantraṃ sauṣadhīratnaṃ snapanaṃ ca prayojayet
verses.tib: sprin sogs rlung gis gtor ba bzhin / a laM ka yi dug 'joms byed / sngags bcas sman dang rin chen bcas / zhi bar byed pa dag kyang sbyar

verses.skt: catuṣpādbhir dvipādbhir vā nakhadantaparikṣatam | śūyate pacyate rāgajvarasrāvarujānvitam
verses.tib: rkang bzhi pa dang rkang gnyis pa'i / so 'am sen mos snad gyur pa / skrang zhing rnags la mdog dmar zhing / tshan chu ser 'dzag pa la

verses.skt: somavalko ’śvakarṇaś ca gojihvā haṃsapādikā | rajanyau gairikaṃ lepo nakhadantaviṣāpahaḥ
verses.tib: a shwa kar+Na kad pha la / han sa pa ti go ji ha / yug snam ser po gnyis kyis bsku / so dang sen mo'i dug 'joms byed

verses.skt: dīrgham āyuḥ smṛtiṃ medhām ārogyaṃ taruṇaṃ vayaḥ | prabhāvarṇasvaraudāryaṃ dehendriyabalodayam
verses.tib: tshe ring dran dang yid gzhungs dang / nad med gzhon dang lang tsho dang / gzugs bzang mdog dang skad gsal dang / lus dang dbang po'i stobs skyed cing

verses.skt: vāksiddhiṃ vṛṣatāṃ kāntim avāpnoti rasāyanāt | lābhopāyo hi śastānāṃ rasādīnāṃ rasāyanam
verses.tib: tshig grub ro tsa mdangs ldan pa / bcud kyis len gyis 'thob par 'gyur / dngas ma la sogs yon tan can / thob gnas yin phyir bcud kyis len

verses.skt: pūrve vayasi madhye vā tat prayojyaṃ jitātmanaḥ | snigdhasya srutaraktasya viśuddhasya ca sarvathā
verses.tib: na tshod dang po'am bar ma'i tshe / dbang po thul bas de sbyar te / snum chos bya zhing gtar ga gdab / rnam pa kun tu sbyangs byas gtang

verses.skt: aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ | vājīkaro vā maline vastre raṅga ivāphalaḥ
verses.tib: ma sbyangs pa yi lus la ni / bcud kyis len dang ro tsa ba'i / sbyor ba dri ma can gyi ni / gos kyi tshon ltar don med 'gyur

verses.skt: rasāyanānāṃ dvividhaṃ prayogam ṛṣayo viduḥ | kuṭīprāveśikaṃ mukhyaṃ vātātapikam anyathā
verses.tib: bcud kyis len gyi sbyor ba ni / rnam pa gnyis su drang srong 'dod / spyil bor 'dug pa gtso bo ste / rlung dang than pas nyen cig shos

verses.skt: pure prāpyopakaraṇe harmyanirvātanirbhaye | diśy udīcyāṃ śubhe deśe trigarbhāṃ sūkṣmalocanām
verses.tib: khang pa rlung med 'jigs pa med / chos ldan yo byad 'byor pa'i grong / sa phyogs shis pa'i byang phyogs su / khang pa sum rim skar khung chung

verses.skt: dhūmātaparajovyālastrīmūrkhādyavilaṅghitām | sajjavaidyopakaraṇāṃ sumṛṣṭāṃ kārayet kuṭīm
verses.tib: dud pa nyi tshan sbrul dang rdul / bud med glen mas ma bgrod par / yo byad sman pa sta gon byas / khang pa legs par byi dor bya'o

verses.skt: atha puṇye ’hni saṃpūjya pūjyāṃs tāṃ praviśec chuciḥ | tatra saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ sukhī jātabalaḥ punaḥ
verses.tib: de nas tshes grangs bzang khrus byas / mchod 'os mchod la 'jug par bya / der ni sbyang byas dag gyur nas / bde zhing stobs ni skyed pa dang

verses.skt: brahmacārī dhṛtiyutaḥ śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ | dānaśīladayāsatyavratadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.tib: tshangs par spyod dang brtan par ldan / dad par ldan zhing dbang po thul / sbyin dang tshul khrims bde ba dang / brtul zhugs chos la mchog tu gzhol

verses.skt: devatānusmṛtau yukto yuktasvapnaprajāgaraḥ | priyauṣadhaḥ peśalavāg ārabheta rasāyanam
verses.tib: lha ni rjes su dran par ldan / rigs pas gnyid log gnyid mi log / sman la dga' zhing tshig 'jam pas / bcud kyis len ni brtsam par bya

verses.skt: harītakīm āmalakaṃ saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ vacām | haridrāṃ pippalīṃ vellaṃ guḍaṃ coṣṇāmbunā pibet
verses.tib: de nyid snum chos dugs byas nas / a ru ra dang skyu ru ra / rgyam tsha bca' sga pi pi ling / shu dag yung ba byi dang ga / bu ram chu dron sbyar ba ni

verses.skt: snigdhasvinno naraḥ pūrvaṃ tena sādhu viricyate | tataḥ śuddhaśarīrāya kṛtasaṃsarjanāya ca
verses.tib: blud na legs par 'khru bar 'gyur / de nas lus ni dag 'gyur zhing / thug sogs rim par spyad nas kyang

verses.skt: trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam | dadyād yāvakam āśuddheḥ purāṇaśakṛto ’thavā
verses.tib: zhag gsum mam ni zhag lnga'am / zhag bdun bar du zhun mar bcas / nas thug dag par gyur gyi bar / sbyin zhing bshang rnying dag par bya

verses.skt: itthaṃ saṃskṛtakoṣṭhasya rasāyanam upāharet | yasya yad yaugikaṃ paśyet sarvam ālocya sātmyavit
verses.tib: de ltar lto ni sbyangs byas nas / goms par shes pas gang zhig la / gang zhig 'tsham pa de kun brtags / bcud kyis len ni sbyin par bya

verses.skt: pathyāsahasraṃ triguṇadhātrīphalasamanvitam | pañcānāṃ pañcamūlānāṃ sārdhaṃ palaśatadvayam
verses.tib: a ru ra stong de'i sum 'gyur / skyu ru ra dang bcas pa dang / rtsa ba lnga bo lnga rnams ni / srang ni nyis brgya lnga bcu dag

verses.skt: jale daśaguṇe paktvā daśabhāgasthite rase | āpothya kṛtvā vyasthīni vijayāmalakāny atha
verses.tib: chu ni bcu 'gyur nang du bskol / khu ba bcu cha lus pa ru / a ru rnam rgyal skyu ru ra

verses.skt: vinīya tasmin niryūhe yojayet kuḍavāṃśakam | tvagelāmustarajanīpippalyagurucandanam
verses.tib: brdungs la rus pa phyung nas ni / khu ba de yi nang du ni / shing tsha sug smel pi pi ling / ga dur skyer pa a ru ra

verses.skt: maṇḍūkaparṇīkanakaśaṅkhapuṣpīvacāplavam | yaṣṭyāhvayaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ tulayādhikam
verses.tib: tsan+dan ma du ka par Ni / shaM ka puSh+pa ka na ya / shu dag gla ba shing mngar dang / byi dang ga ni phul re'i tshad

verses.skt: sitopalārdhabhāraṃ ca pātrāṇi trīṇi sarpiṣaḥ | dve ca tailāt pacet sarvaṃ tad agnau lehatāṃ gatam
verses.tib: khar dkar srang stong chig brgya / zhun mar bre ni bcu gnyis dang / til mar bre ni brgyad bcas pa / lde gur gyur gyi bar du bskol

verses.skt: avatīrṇaṃ himaṃ yuñjyād viṃśaiḥ kṣaudraśatais tribhiḥ | tataḥ khajena mathitaṃ nidadhyād ghṛtabhājane
verses.tib: phab la bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi ni / srang ni sum brgya nyi shu gzhug / de nas gzar bus dkrugs nas ni / mar gyi snod du gzhug par bya

verses.skt: yā noparundhyād āhāram ekaṃ mātrāsya sā smṛtā | ṣaṣṭikaḥ payasā cātra jīrṇe bhojanam iṣyate
verses.tib: gang zhig zas gcig la mi gnod / de ni 'di yi tshad du bshad / zhu ba'i tshe na drug cu pa / 'o mar bcas pa'i kha zas sbyin

verses.skt: vaikhānasā bālakhilyās tathā cānye tapodhanāḥ | brahmaṇā vihitaṃ dhanyam idaṃ prāśya rasāyanam
verses.tib: bcud kyis len 'di tshangs pas bshad / dge zhing dpal yon can yin zhing / mkha' la gnas dang byis pa rtse / de bzhin dka' thub pas bsten byas

verses.skt: tandrāśramaklamavalīpalitāmayavarjitāḥ | medhāsmṛtibalopetā babhūvur amitāyuṣaḥ
verses.tib: lus snyom ngal dang skra dkar dang / gnyer ma'i skyon ni spang 'gyur zhing / yid gzhungs dran dang stobs ldan zhing / tshe ring bar yang 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: abhayāmalakasahasraṃ nirāmayaṃ pippalīsahasrayutam | taruṇapalāśakṣāradravīkṛtaṃ sthāpayed bhāṇḍe
verses.tib: skyon med a ru ra dang skyu ru ra / stong dang pi pi ling ni stong dang bcas / rgya skyegs shing gzhon thal ba'i chu sbyar ba / snod du bzhag ste legs par sbangs nas ni

verses.skt: upayukte ca kṣāre chāyāsaṃśuṣkacūrṇitaṃ yojyam | pādāṃśena sitāyāś caturguṇābhyāṃ madhughṛtābhyām
verses.tib: slar phyung grib mar bskams te phye mar byas / kha ra dkar po bzhi cha mar dang ni / sbrang rtsi bzhi 'gyur bcas pa mar gyi ni

verses.skt: tad ghṛtakumbhe bhūmau nidhāya ṣaṇmāsasaṃstham uddhṛtya | prāhṇe prāśya yathānalam ucitāhāro bhavet satatam
verses.tib: bum par bcug ste sa brkos par bzhag la / zla ba drug lon nas ni slar phyung ste / snga dro'i dus su me drod ji bzhin bza' / rtag tu mthun pa'i zas ni bza' bar bya

verses.skt: ity upayuñjyāśeṣaṃ varṣaśatam anāmayo jarārahitaḥ | jīvati balapuṣṭivapuḥsmṛtimedhādyanvito viśeṣeṇa
verses.tib: de ltar ma lus zos na lo brgya 'tsho / nad med pa dang skra dkar gnyer ma med / lus kyi stobs 'phel rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / mchog tu dran gsal yid ni gzhungs par 'gyur

verses.skt: nīrujārdrapalāśasya cchinne śirasi tat kṣatam | antar dvihastaṃ gambhīraṃ pūryam āmalakair navaiḥ
verses.tib: skyon med rgya skyegs shing rlon pa / thor to bcad la gzhog pa yi / sdong bu khru gnyis brkos pa'i nang / skyu ru ra ni sar pas dgang

verses.skt: āmūlaṃ veṣṭitaṃ darbhaiḥ padminīpaṅkalepitam | ādīpya gomayair vanyair nirvāte svedayet tataḥ
verses.tib: rtsa ba'i bar du 'jag mas dkri / pad+ma skyes pa'i 'dam gyis bsku / de nas rlung med gnas su ni / lci ba sar pa gtsang mas btso

verses.skt: svinnāni tāny āmalakāni tṛptyā khāden naraḥ kṣaudraghṛtānvitāni | kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ cānu pibet prakāmaṃ tenaiva varteta ca māsam ekam
verses.tib: tshos shing skyu ru ra spangs nas / sbrang rtsi mar bcas mi yis bza' / de rjes 'o ma mar bcas pa / ci 'dod par ni btung bar bya / de nyid kyis ni zla gcig bar

verses.skt: varjyāni varjyāni ca tatra yatnāt spṛśyaṃ ca śītāmbu na pāṇināpi | ekādaśāhe ’sya tato vyatīte patanti keśā daśanā nakhāś ca
verses.tib: bsten zhing spang bar bya ba rnams / de ni 'bad de spang bar bya / chu ni grang mo lag pa yis / reg pa tsam yang mi bya'o / de ltar zhag ni bcu gcig 'das / skra so sen mo lhags par 'gyur

verses.skt: athālpakair eva dinaiḥ surūpaḥ strīṣv akṣayaḥ kuñjaratulyavīryaḥ | viśiṣṭamedhābalabuddhisattvo bhavaty asau varṣasahasrajīvī
verses.tib: de nas nyin zhag cung zad nas / gzugs bzang bud med la phod cing / stobs ni glang po dang 'drar 'gyur / mchog tu yid gzhungs snying stobs dang / blo ldan lo stong 'tsho bar 'gyur

verses.skt: daśamūlabalāmustajīvakarṣabhakotpalam | parṇinyau pippalī śṛṅgī medā tāmalakī truṭī
verses.tib: rtsa ba bcu pa ba bla dang / gla sgang thal tres dzi ba ka / ut+pal dang par+Ni gnyis / karka ta sring pi pi ling / med sug smel ta ma la

verses.skt: jīvantī joṅgakaṃ drākṣā pauṣkaraṃ candanaṃ śaṭhī | punarnavarddhikākolīkākanāsāmṛtādvayam
verses.tib: 'tsho byed rgun 'brum a ka ru / ma nu zur ba ba spru ba / ram nye ba gnyis sle tres dang / ka ka na sa a ru ra

verses.skt: vidārī vṛṣamūlaṃ ca tad aikadhyaṃ palonmitam | jaladroṇe pacet pañca dhātrīphalaśatāni ca
verses.tib: ba sha ka'i rtsa bid ri / srang re gcig tu bsres nas ni / skyu ru ra'i 'bru lnga brgya ni / chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol

verses.skt: pādaśeṣaṃ rasaṃ tasmād vyasthīny āmalakāni ca | gṛhītvā bharjayet tailaghṛtād dvādaśabhiḥ palaiḥ
verses.tib: de yi khu ba bzhi cha lus / skyu ru ra yi rus pa bsal / mar dang til mar srang bcu gnyis / nang du legs par brngos nas ni

verses.skt: matsyaṇḍikātulārdhena yuktaṃ tal lehavat pacet | snehārdhaṃ madhu siddhe tu tavakṣīryāś catuḥpalam
verses.tib: btags te lde gu'i tshul du bskol / snum phyed kyis ni sbrang rtsi gzhug / smig rkang srang ni bzhi dag dang

verses.skt: pippalyā dvipalaṃ dadyāc caturjātaṃ kaṇārdhitam | ato ’valehayen mātrāṃ kuṭīsthaḥ pathyabhojanaḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni srang gnyis dang / dri bzang bzhi ni srang gcig gzhug / de la tshad tsam bza' bya zhing / khang par gnas shing 'phrod zas bsten

verses.skt: ity eṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ prāśya cyavano muniḥ | jarājarjarito ’py āsīn nārīnayananandanaḥ
verses.tib: drang srong 'pho bas gang zos pa / rgas pas nyen par gyur pa yang / bud med kyis ni mig tu sdug / cho ga bzhin du bsten gyur na

verses.skt: kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ śoṣaṃ hṛdrogaṃ vātaśoṇitam | mūtraśukrāśrayān doṣān vaisvaryaṃ ca vyapohati
verses.tib: lud pa dbugs mi bde rims dang / skems dang snying nad dreg nad dang / gcin dang khu chu la gnas dang / skad 'gags pa yang sel bar byed

verses.skt: bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇakṛśānām aṅgavardhanaḥ | medhāṃ smṛtiṃ kāntim anāmayatvam āyuḥprakarṣaṃ pavanānulomyam
verses.tib: byis pa rgan dang glo 'gram gcong / red pa'i nyams stobs 'phel bar byed / yid gzhungs dran dang mdangs ldan dang / nad med nyid dang tshe 'phel dang / rlung ni bde bar rgyu byed cing

verses.skt: strīṣu praharṣaṃ balam indriyāṇām agneś ca kuryād vidhinopayuktaḥ || 41ef || madhukena tavakṣīryā pippalyā sindhujanmanā | pṛthag lohaiḥ suvarṇena vacayā madhusarpiṣā
verses.tib: bud med la phod stobs dang ni / dbang po gsal zhing me drod skyed / shing mngar smig rkang pi pi ling / lce myang tsha dang bcas pa dang / lcags ni sna re gser dang ni / shu dag sbrang rtsi zhun mar ram

verses.skt: sitayā vā samā yuktā samāyuktā rasāyanam | triphalā sarvarogaghnī medhāyuḥsmṛtibuddhidā
verses.tib: kha ra dkar po 'bras bu gsum / lo gcig bsten na bcud len 'gyur / nad kun 'joms shing dran pa dang / yid gzhungs blo ni skyed par byed

verses.skt: maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ svarasaṃ yathāgni kṣīreṇa yaṣṭīmadhukasya cūrṇam | rasaṃ guḍūcyās sahamūlapuṣpyāḥ kalkaṃ prayuñjīta ca śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ
verses.tib: ma du ka par+Ni yi khu ba 'am / shing mngar phye ma 'o mar bcas pa ni / lhan cig sbyar ba me drod ji bzhin sbyin / sle tres shang ka puSh+pa'i me tog bcas / lde gur sbyar ba me drod ji bzhin du

verses.skt: āyuḥpradāny āmayanāśanāni balāgnivarṇasvaravardhanāni | medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa tu śaṅkhapuṣpī
verses.tib: bsten na tshe ni sbyin par byed pa dang / nad 'jig stobs skyed mdog ni gsal byed cing / me drod skang gsal yid gzhungs skyed par byed / bcud kyis len gyi sbyor ba 'di dag las / shang+ka puSh+pa'i sbyor 'di yid gzhungs mchog

verses.skt: naladaṃ kaṭurohiṇī payasyā madhukaṃ candanaśārivogragandhāḥ | triphalā kaṭukatrayaṃ haridre sapaṭolaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca taiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ
verses.tib: spangs ma pu tse shel dang pa ya s+ya / shing mngar thal tres tsan+dan 'bras bu gsum / shu dag tsha ba gsum dang ser po gnyis / pa to la'i rtsa rgyam tsha zhib tu btags

verses.skt: triguṇena rasena śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ sapayaskaṃ ghṛtanalvaṇaṃ vipakvam | upayujya bhavej jaḍo ’pi vāṅmī śrutadhārī pratibhānavān arogaḥ
verses.tib: shang+ka puSh+pa'i khu ba sum 'gyur bskol / blud na glen pa'ang tshig la dbang 'gyur zhing / thos 'dzin spobs pa che zhing nad med 'gyur

verses.skt: peṣyair mṛṇālabisakesarapattrabījaiḥ siddhaṃ sahemaśakalaṃ payasā ca sarpiḥ | pañcāravindam iti tat prathitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ prabhraṣṭapauruṣabalapratibhair niṣevyam
verses.tib: pad+ma'i rtsa ba sdong bu dang / ge sar nang gi sa bon rnams / gser bcas mar dang 'o ma ni / bre ni bcu drug nang du bskol / pad+ma lnga yi thig le zhes / sa steng dag tu grags pa yin / tshul bzhin bsten na skyes bu ni / nyams stobs zad pa 'phel bar byed

verses.skt: yan nālakandadalakesaravad vipakvaṃ nīlotpalasya tad api prathitaṃ dvitīyam | sarpiś catuṣkuvalayaṃ sahiraṇyapattraṃ medhyaṃ gavām api bhavet kim u mānuṣāṇām
verses.tib: gang zhig ut+pal sdong bu lo / rtsa ba ge sar ldan bskol ba / ut+pal bzhi par grags pa yin / gser dang bcas pa'i bcud len gyi / sbyor ba bsten na ba lang yang / yid gzhungs 'gyur na mir ci smos

verses.skt: brāhmīvacāsaindhavaśaṅkhapuṣpīmatsyākṣakabrahmasuvarcalaindryaḥ | vaidehikā ca triyavāḥ pṛthak syur yavau suvarṇasya tilo viṣasya
verses.tib: bram+hi shu dag shang ka puSh+pa dang / rgyam tsha mang tsha k+Sha ra bi sha la / bram+hi so bar tsal pi pi ling / re re nas ni gsum gsum tsam tshad dang / gser ni nas gnyis dug ni til 'bru tsam

verses.skt: sarpiṣaś ca palam ekata etad yojayet pariṇate ca ghṛtāḍhyam | bhojanaṃ samadhu vatsaram evaṃ śīlayann adhikadhīsmṛtimedhaḥ
verses.tib: zhun mar srang gcig 'di dag zhib tu sbyar / legs par btang ste zhu bar gyur nas ni / mar bcas kha zas lo gcig bar du bsten / dran dang yid gzhungs blo ni 'phel 'gyur zhing

verses.skt: atikrāntajarāvyādhitandrālasyaśramaklamaḥ | jīvaty abdaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ śrītejaḥkāntidīptimān
verses.tib: nad dang rgas pa dag las 'das pa dang / snyom dang ngal dub sel byed lo brgyar 'tsho / dpal dang gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur

verses.skt: viśeṣataḥ kuṣṭhakilāsagulmaviṣajvaronmādagarodarāṇi | atharvamantrādikṛtāś ca kṛtyāḥ śāmyanty anenātibalāś ca vātāḥ
verses.tib: khyad par du ni mdze nad sha bkra skran / dug dang dbyig dug rims dang smyo byed dang / srid srung rig byed sngags byas gshed byed dang / rlung nad stobs chen 'dis ni zhi bar byed

verses.skt: śaranmukhe nāgabalāṃ puṣyayoge samuddharet | akṣamātraṃ tato mūlāc cūrṇitāt payasā pibet
verses.tib: na ga ba la ston gyi tshe / skar ma rgyal la bab par btu / de yi rtsa ba zho gnyis tsam / phyer btags 'o ma sbyar te btung

verses.skt: lihyān madhughṛtābhyāṃ vā kṣīravṛttir anannabhuk | evaṃ varṣaprayogena jīved varṣaśataṃ balī
verses.tib: yang na mar dang sbrang rtsir sbyar / bldag cing zas med 'o mas 'tsho / de ltar lo gcig zos gyur na / lo brgyar 'tsho zhing stobs ldan 'gyur

verses.skt: phalonmukho gokṣurakaḥ samūlaś chāyāviśuṣkaḥ suvicūrṇitāṅgaḥ | subhāvitaḥ svena rasena tasmān mātrāṃ parāṃ prāsṛtikīṃ pibed yaḥ
verses.tib: gze ma 'bras bu skyes pa rtsa bar bcas / grib mar bskams te zhib tu btags nas ni / rang gi khu bar sbangs pa de las ni / che tshad khyor gang tsam du byas gyur gang

verses.skt: kṣīreṇa tenaiva ca śālim aśnan jīrṇe bhavet sa dvitulopayogāt | śaktaḥ surūpaḥ subhagaḥ śatāyuḥ kāmī kakudmān iva gokulasthaḥ
verses.tib: de dang 'o mar sbyar nas bza' bya zhing / zhu nas 'o ma srang ni nyis brgya zos / gzugs bzang skal ldan lo brgya thub pa dang / 'dod spyod khyu mchog pa lang tshogs gnas 'dra

verses.skt: vārāhīkandam ārdrārdraṃ kṣīreṇa kṣīrapaḥ pibet | māsaṃ niranno māsaṃ ca kṣīrānnādo jarāṃ jayet
verses.tib: bar hi yi sdong bu rlon pa ni / 'o mar sbyar bzos shing 'o ma btung / zla gcig bar du kha zas 'o mas 'tsho / rgas pa'i tshogs las nges par rgyal bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tatkandaślakṣṇacūrṇaṃ vā svarasena subhāvitam | ghṛtakṣaudraplutaṃ lihyāt tatpakvaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pibet
verses.tib: yang na de yi sdong bu'i phye zhib mo / rang gi khu ba dang ni legs sbyar ba / mar dang sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu bza' / yang na de bskol mar ni btung bar bya

verses.skt: tadvad vidāryatibalābalāmadhukavāyasīḥ | śreyasīśreyasīyuktāpathyādhātrīsthirāmṛtāḥ
verses.tib: de bzhin a ti ba la bid ri / shing mngar dang ni mon sne'u dme ru dang / dzi ban ti dang ra sna a ru ra / sa la par+Ni sle tres skyu ru ra

verses.skt: maṇḍūkīśaṅkhakusumāvājigandhāśatāvarīḥ | upayuñjīta medhādhīvayaḥsthairyabalapradāḥ
verses.tib: shang ka puSh+pa man du ka par+Ni / a shra gan+d+ha dang ni nye'u shing rnams / sbyar ba btang na yid gzhungs blo dang ni / rgas sra na tshod brtan zhing stobs skyed byed

verses.skt: yathāsvaṃ citrakaḥ puṣpair jñeyaḥ pītasitāsitaiḥ | yathottaraṃ sa guṇavān vidhinā ca rasāyanam
verses.tib: tsi tra ka yi me tog ni / ser po dkar nag las shes bya / cho ga bzhin du bcud len sbyar / bzhin du yon tan che

verses.skt: chāyāśuṣkaṃ tato mūlaṃ māsaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ lihan | sarpiṣā madhusarpirbhyāṃ piban vā payasā yatiḥ
verses.tib: de yi rtsa ba grib mar skam / phye mar btags pa sbrang rtsi mar / 'o ma / chu dang zla gcig bar / brtul zhugs can gyis bsten byas la

verses.skt: ambhasā vā hitānnāśī śataṃ jīvati nīrujaḥ | medhāvī balavān kānto vapuṣmān dīptapāvakaḥ
verses.tib: phan pa'i zas ni za byed na / lo brgyar 'tsho zhing nad med la / yid gzhungs stobs dang mdangs ldan zhing / lus rgyas me drod 'bar bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tailena līḍho māsena vātān hanti sudustarān | mūtreṇa śvitrakuṣṭhāni pītas takreṇa pāyujān
verses.tib: til mar lde gu zla gcig bar / bsten na rlung nad gso dka' 'joms / gcin sbyar sha bkra mdze nad 'joms / dar bar sbyar bas gzhang 'brum sel

verses.skt: bhallātakāni puṣṭāni dhānyarāśau nidhāpayet | grīṣme saṃgṛhya hemante svādusnigdhahimair vapuḥ
verses.tib: go bye legs par smin pa ni / 'bras kyi phung po'i nang du gzhug / sos ka'i tshe btus dgun tshe phyung / mngar zhing snum dang bsil ba yi

verses.skt: saṃskṛtya tāny aṣṭaguṇe salile ’ṣṭau vipācayet | aṣṭāṃśaśiṣṭaṃ tatkvāthaṃ sakṣīraṃ śītalaṃ pibet
verses.tib: sman sbyar de yi rdog ma brgyad / brgyad 'gyur chur ni bskol nas ni / khu ba de yi brgyad cha lus / 'o ma dang sbyar grang mo btung

verses.skt: vardhayet pratyahaṃ cānu tatraikaikam aruṣkaram | saptarātratrayaṃ yāvat trīṇi trīṇi tataḥ param
verses.tib: de rjes nyi ma re re zhing / go bye rdog ma re res bskyed / nyi shu rtsa gcig bar du ni / gsum gsum gyis bskyed de phan chad

verses.skt: ācatvāriṃśatas tāni hrāsayed vṛddhivat tataḥ | sahasram upayuñjīta saptāhair iti saptabhiḥ
verses.tib: bzhi bcu'i bar bskyed de 'og tu / bskyed pa bzhin du dbri bar bya / bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du ni / stong gi bar du gtang bar bya

verses.skt: yantritātmā ghṛtakṣīraśāliṣaṣṭikabhojanaḥ | tadvat triguṇitaṃ kālaṃ prayogānte ’pi cācaret
verses.tib: bdag nyid bsdams shing 'o ma mar / sA lu drug cu'i 'bras chan bza' / de bzhin dus ni sum 'gyur bya / sbyor ba'i mtha' yang spyad par bya

verses.skt: āśiṣo labhate ’pūrvā vahner dīptiṃ viśeṣataḥ | pramehakṛmikuṣṭhārśomedodoṣavivarjitaḥ
verses.tib: sngon gyi legs smon 'thob 'gyur zhing / khyad par du ni me drod skyed / gcin snyi srin bu gzhang 'brum mdze

verses.skt: piṣṭasvedanam arujaiḥ pūrṇaṃ bhallātakair vijarjaritaiḥ | bhūminikhāte kumbhe pratiṣṭhitaṃ kṛṣṇamṛlliptam
verses.tib: tshil las gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum 'joms / go bye'i 'bras bu skyon med pa / brdungs shing zhib tu btags pa ni / bum par bcug steng sa nag bskus / sa brkos pa yi nang du gzhug

verses.skt: parivāritaṃ samantāt pacet tato gomayāgninā mṛdunā | tatsvaraso yaś cyavate gṛhṇīyāt taṃ dine ’nyasmin
verses.tib: kun nas ba yi lci bas bskor / de sbyar me la btsos nas ni / de las 'dzag pa'i khu ba gang / blangs pa nyin zhag gzhan la ni

verses.skt: amum upayujya svarasaṃ madhvaṣṭamabhāgikaṃ dviguṇasarpiḥ | pūrvavidhiyantritātmā prāpnoti guṇān sa tān eva
verses.tib: de yi brgyad 'gyur sbrang rtsi dang / nyis 'gyur mar dang sbyar ba ni / cho ga snga ma bzhin bsdams te / bsten na yon tan de nyid thob

verses.skt: puṣṭāni pākena paricyutāni bhallātakāny āḍhakasaṃmitāni | ghṛṣṭveṣṭikācūrṇakaṇair jalena prakṣālya saṃśoṣya ca mārutena
verses.tib: go bye'i 'bras bu smin te lhung gyur pa / bre bzhi'i tshad tsam dang ni so phag dang / bdar ba'i phye ma dag dang chu dang mnye / bkrus te rlung la legs par bskams nas ni

verses.skt: jarjarāṇi vipacej jalakumbhe pādaśeṣaghṛtagālitaśītam | tadrasaṃ punar api śrapayeta kṣīrakumbhasahitaṃ caraṇasthe
verses.tib: brdungs te chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol / bzhi cha lus pa btsags te bsgrangs pa yi / khu ba / de dang 'o ma bre bcu drug / bskol te bzhi cha lus par gyur pa dang

verses.skt: sarpiḥ pakvaṃ tatra tulyapramāṇaṃ yuñjyāt svecchaṃ śarkarayā rajobhiḥ | ekībhūtaṃ tat khajakṣobhaṇena sthāpyaṃ dhānye saptarātraṃ suguptam
verses.tib: de dang mnyam pa'i zhun mar bcas par bskol / de'i nang kha ra'i phye ma ci ran gzhug / de ni gzar bus dkrugs pas gcig tu gyur / 'bras kyi phung por zhag bdun legs par sba

verses.skt: tam amṛtarasapākaṃ yaḥ prage prāśam aśnann anupibati yatheṣṭaṃ vāri dugdhaṃ rasaṃ vā | smṛtimatibalamedhāsattvasārair upetaḥ kanakanicayagauraḥ so ’śnute dīrgham āyuḥ
verses.tib: bdud rtsi 'dra ba de bsten skyes bu gang / chu 'am 'o ma sha khu 'thungs gyur na / dran dang yid gzhungs blo gros stobs dang ldan / snying stobs dang ldan gser gyi mdog dang 'dra / tshe ring ba yang des ni thob par 'gyur

verses.skt: droṇe ’mbhaso vraṇakṛtāṃ triśatād vipakvāt kvāthāḍhake palasamais tilatailapātram | tiktāviṣādvayavarāgirijanmatārkṣyaiḥ siddhaṃ paraṃ nikhilakuṣṭhanibarhaṇāya
verses.tib: chu bre bcu drug nang du go bye ni / sum brgya bskol te bzhi cha lus pa ru / til mar bre bzhi der ni bcug nas kyang / tig ta bong nga gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum / brag zhun skyer shun da lis phye ma gdab / bskol na mdze nad ma lus 'joms par byed

verses.skt: sahāmalakaśuktibhir dadhisareṇa tailena vā | guḍena payasā ghṛtena yavasaktubhir vā saha | tilena saha mākṣikeṇa palalena sūpena vā | vapuṣkaram aruṣkaraṃ paramamedhyam āyuṣkaram
verses.tib: go bye skyu ru ra 'am tsha 'am ni / zho yi spris ma til mar 'o ma 'am / bu ram 'o thug mar ram sbrang rtsi'am / nas zan ngag gam til btags lde gur byas / sran tshod dag dang lhan cig sbyar ba ni / lus rgyas yid gzhungs tshe ring byed mchog yin

verses.skt: bhallātakāni tīkṣṇāni pākīny agnisamāni ca | bhavanty amṛtakalpāni prayuktāni yathāvidhi
verses.tib: go bye'i 'bras bu rnon po ni / smin pa me dang 'drar gyur pa / cho ga bzhin du sbyar ba ni / bdud rtsi dang ni 'dra bar 'gyur

verses.skt: kaphajo na sa rogo ’sti na vibandho ’sti kaścana | yaṃ na bhallātakaṃ hanyāc chīghram agnibalapradam
verses.tib: bse shing 'bras bu ma bcos pa'i / bad kan nad dang nad rnying ni / 'brel pa gang yin de med cing / me yi drod kyang myur du skyed

verses.skt: vātātapavidhāne ’pi viśeṣeṇa vivarjayet | kulatthadadhiśuktāni tailābhyaṅgāgnisevanam
verses.tib: rlung dang tsha bar 'dug pa ni / khyad par du ni spang bya zhing / rgya sran zho dang tsha dang ni / til mar bsku dang me bsten spangs

verses.skt: vṛkṣās tubarakā nāma paścimārṇavatīrajāḥ | vīcītaraṅgavikṣobhamārutoddhūtapallavāḥ
verses.tib: du ba ri yi shing zhes bya / nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i ngos nas skye / chu rlabs g.yo bas bskyod pa dang / rlung gis lo ma g.yengs pa yin

verses.skt: tebhyaḥ phalāny ādadīta supakvāny ambudāgame | majjñaḥ phalebhyaś cādāya śoṣayitvāvacūrṇya ca
verses.tib: de yi 'bras bu dbyar gyi tshe / legs par smin pa btu bar bya / 'bras bu de las rkang phyung nas / bskams te phye mar btags nas ni

verses.skt: tilavat pīḍayed droṇyāṃ kvāthayed vā kusumbhavat | tattailaṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ paced āsalilakṣayāt
verses.tib: til bzhin btsir bar bya ba'am / le brgan me tog bzhin du bskol / de yi mar bsags gyur pa ni / pa yi bar du bskol

verses.skt: avatārya karīṣe ca pakṣamātraṃ nidhāpayet | snigdhasvinno hṛtamalaḥ pakṣād uddhṛtya tat tataḥ
verses.tib: phab ste ba yi lci ba yi / nang du zla phyed tsam du gzhug / de 'og de las phyung nas ni / snum zhing dugs byas dri ma bsal

verses.skt: caturthabhaktāntaritaḥ prātaḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet | mantreṇānena pūtasya tailasya divase śubhe
verses.tib: zas / kyi dus ni bzhis chod par / nang par zho gnyis tsam zhig btung / mar de nyi ma shis pa la / sngags 'di yis ni dag par bya

verses.skt: majjasāra mahāvīrya sarvān dhātūn viśodhaya | śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇis tvām ājñāpayate ’cyutaḥ
verses.tib: rkang pa gnyis po brtson pa che / lus zungs thams cad skyong byed par / 'khor lo dbyig pa dung thogs la / mi 'pho bas ni khyod la bsgo

verses.skt: tenāsyordhvam adhastāc ca doṣā yānty asakṛt tataḥ | sāyam asnehalavaṇāṃ yavāgūṃ śītalāṃ pibet
verses.tib: de gang 'di yi nad steng dang / 'og gi nad ni du ma sel / dgongs ka snum dang lan tshwar bcas / nas thug grang mo btung bar bya

verses.skt: pañcāhāni pibet tailam itthaṃ varjyān vivarjayan | pakṣaṃ mudgarasānnāśī sarvakuṣṭhair vimucyate
verses.tib: mar de zhag lnga'i bar du btung / spang bar bya ba thams cad spang / zla phyed mud ga'i khu ba btung / mdze nad kun las thar bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tad eva khadirakvāthe triguṇe sādhu sādhitam | nihitaṃ pūrvavat pakṣaṃ piben māsaṃ suyantritaḥ
verses.tib: de nyid seng ldeng khu ba ni / sum 'gyur dang ni legs par bskol / snga ma bzhin du zla phyed gzhag / legs par bsdams te zla gcig btung

verses.skt: tenābhyaktaśarīraś ca kurvann āhāram īritam | anenāśu prayogeṇa sādhayet kuṣṭhinaṃ naram
verses.tib: de yis lus ni bsku ba dang / ji skad bshad pa'i zas zos pa'i / sbyor ba 'di yis myur du ni / mdze can mi ni gso bar bya

verses.skt: bhinnasvaraṃ raktanetraṃ śīrṇāṅgaṃ kṛmibhakṣitam
sarpirmadhuyutaṃ pītaṃ tad eva khadirād vinā | pakṣaṃ māṃsarasāhāraṃ karoti dviśatāyuṣam
verses.tib: de nyid seng ldeng med par ni / zhun mar sbrang rtsi ldan par btung / zla phyed bar du sha khu btung / lo ni nyis brgyar 'tsho bar 'gyur

verses.skt: tad eva nasye pañcāśad divasān upayojitam | vapuṣmataṃ śrutadharaṃ karoti triśatāyuṣam
verses.tib: de nyid zhag ni lnga bcu'i bar / sna sman du ni btang gyur na / lus rgyas thos pa 'dzin pa dang / lo ni sum brgyar 'tsho bar 'gyur

verses.skt: valīpalitanirmuktaṃ sthirasmṛtikacadvijam
verses.tib: de nyid zhag ni lnga bcu'i bar / sna sman du ni btang gyur na / lus rgyas thos pa 'dzin pa dang / lo ni sum brgyar 'tsho bar 'gyur

verses.skt: pañcāṣṭau sapta daśa vā pippalīr madhusarpiṣā | rasāyanaguṇānveṣī samām ekāṃ prayojayet
tisras tisras tu pūrvāhṇe bhuktvāgre bhojanasya ca | pippalyaḥ kiṃśukakṣārabhāvitā ghṛtabharjitāḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni pa la sha'i / thal chur sbangs shing mar dang brngos / rdog ma gsum gsum snga dro dang / zas kyi sngon du bza' bar bya

verses.skt: prayojyā madhusaṃmiśrā rasāyanaguṇaiṣiṇā | kramavṛddhyā daśāhāni daśapaippalikaṃ dinam
verses.tib: bcud len yon tan 'dod pa yis / sbrang rtsi dang ni sbyar te bza' / pi pi ling bcu nyin re zhing / rim gyis bskyed par gyur pa dag

verses.skt: vardhayet payasā sārdhaṃ tathaivāpanayet punaḥ | jīrṇauṣadhaś ca bhuñjīta ṣaṣṭikaṃ kṣīrasarpiṣā
verses.tib: de bzhin 'o mar sbyar te bza' / de bzhin du ni dbri bar bya / sman zhu nas ni drug cu pa'i / 'bras chan 'o ma mar bcas bza'

verses.skt: pippalīnāṃ sahasrasya prayogo ’yaṃ rasāyanam | piṣṭās tā balibhiḥ peyāḥ śṛtā madhyabalair naraiḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni stong gi bar / btang na 'di ni bcud len 'gyur / stobs dang ldan la de btags sbyin / stobs dbri ba la bskol te blud

verses.skt: śītīkṛtā hīnabalair vīkṣya doṣāmayān prati
tadvac ca cchāgadugdhena dve sahasre prayojayet | ebhiḥ prayogaiḥ pippalyaḥ kāsaśvāsagalagrahān
verses.tib: de bzhin ra yi 'o ma dang / nyis stong gi ni bar du gtang / pi pi ling gi sbyor ba 'dis / lud pa dbugs mi bde mgul nad

verses.skt: yakṣmamehagrahaṇyarśaḥpāṇḍutvaviṣamajvarān | ghnanti śophaṃ vamiṃ hidhmāṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam
verses.tib: gcong chen gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad / gcin snyi skya rbab mi bzad rims / 'or nad slon dang skyigs bu dang / mdzer pa dreg nad 'joms par byed

verses.skt: bilvārdhamātreṇa ca pippalīnāṃ pātraṃ pralimped ayaso niśāyām | prātaḥ pibet tat salilāñjalibhyāṃ varṣaṃ yatheṣṭāśanapānaceṣṭaḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni srang phyed lde gur byas / lcags kyi snod bskus nas ni nub gcig bzhag / de dang chu ni snyim gang nang par btung / lo gcig bza' btung spyod pa ci 'dod bsten

verses.skt: śuṇṭhīviḍaṅgatriphalāguḍūcī yaṣṭīharidrātibalābalāś ca | mustāsurāhvāgurucitrakāś ca saugandhikaṃ paṅkajam utpalāni
verses.tib: bca' sga sle tres shing mngar byi dang ka / ba la a ti ba la 'bras bu gsum / gla sgang thang shing yung ba a ka ru / mu zi pad+ma ut+pal kru trug tres

verses.skt: dhavāśvakarṇāsanabālapattrasārās tathā pippalivat prayojyāḥ | lohopaliptāḥ pṛthag eva jīvet samāḥ śataṃ vyādhijarāvimuktaḥ
verses.tib: da ta a shwa kar Na a sa na / ba la'i lo ma'am snying po de bzhin du / pi pi ling bzhin lcags snod bsku sogs bya / lo brgya 'tsho zhing rgas dang na las thar

verses.skt: kṣīrāñjalibhyāṃ ca rasāyanāni yuktāny amūny āyasalepanāni | kurvanti pūrvoktaguṇaprakarṣam āyuḥprakarṣaṃ dviguṇaṃ tataś ca
verses.tib: 'o ma snyim gang gi ni bcud len sman / sbyar ba 'di yis lcags snod bskus pas ni / sngar bshad yon tan bas kyang lhag bskyed cing / tshe yang de las nyis 'gyur skyed par byed

verses.skt: asanakhadirayūṣair bhāvitāṃ somarājīṃ madhughṛtaśikhipathyālohacūrṇair upetām | śaradam avalihānaḥ pāriṇāmān vikārāṃs tyajati mitahitāśī tadvad āhārajātān
verses.tib: a sa na dang seng ldeng gi / khu bar so ma ra dza sbangs / sbrang rtsi ru rta mar dang ni / a ru ra dang lcags phyer bcas / lde gu lo gcig bar zos na / rgas dang mi 'phrod zos pa las / nad ni yongs su 'dor bar byed

verses.skt: tīvreṇa kuṣṭhena parītamūrtir yaḥ somarājīṃ niyamena khādet | saṃvatsaraṃ kṛṣṇatiladvitīyāṃ sa somarājīṃ vapuṣātiśete
verses.tib: mdze nad mi bzad pa yis ni / lus ni nyen gyur gang yin pas / so ma ra dza til nag gnyis / lo gcig bar du bsten na ni / de ni zla rgyas lta bur 'gyur

verses.skt: ye somarājyā vituṣīkṛtāyāś cūrṇair upetāt payasaḥ sujātāt | uddhṛtya sāraṃ madhunā lihanti takraṃ tad evānupibanti cānte
verses.tib: gang gi so ma ra dza sbun pa med / btags pa 'o ma lhan cig zhor mnan pa'i / snying po phyung la sbrang rtsi'i lde gu bldag / de rjes de nyid kyi ni dar ba btung

verses.skt: kuṣṭhinaḥ śīryamāṇāṅgās te jātāṅgulināsikāḥ | bhānti vṛkṣā iva punaḥ prarūḍhanavapallavāḥ
verses.tib: mdze yi nad kyis yan lag nyams pa dang / sna chad sor mo brul ba la sogs pa / shing bcad rjes la ljon shing skye ba ltar

verses.skt: śītavātahimadagdhatanūnāṃ stabdhabhagnakuṭilavyathitāsthnām | bheṣajasya pavanopahatānāṃ vakṣyate vidhir ato laśunasya
rāhor amṛtacauryeṇa lūnād ye patitā galāt | amṛtasya kaṇā bhūmau te laśunatvam āgatāḥ
verses.tib: sgra gcan bdud rtsi brkus pa na / rke bcad pa las 'dzag gyur pa'i / bdud rtsi'i thigs pa sar lhung ba / sgog skya nyid du gyur pa yin

verses.skt: dvijā nāśnanti tam ato daityadehasamudbhavam | sākṣād amṛtasaṃbhūter grāmaṇīḥ sa rasāyanam
verses.tib: lha min lus las byung bas na / de phyir bram zes de mi bza' / mngon du bdud rtsi las byung bas / de ni bcud kyis len mchog yin

verses.skt: śīlayel laśunaṃ śīte vasante ’pi kapholbaṇaḥ | ghanodaye ’pi vātārtaḥ sadā vā grīṣmalīlayā
verses.tib: grang ba'i dus na'ang sgog skya bsten / dpyid dus bad kan shas cher bza' / sos ka'i dus su'ang spyad bya zhing / dbyar ni rlung gis gzir tshe bza'

verses.skt: snigdhaśuddhatanuḥ śītamadhuropaskṛtāśayaḥ | taduttaṃsāvataṃsābhyāṃ carcitānucarājiraḥ
verses.tib: dgun ni snum zhing bsil ba dang / mngar bas nye bar bsres pa dang / de ni phreng ba rgyan dag dang / 'khor dang lhan cig bsten par bya

verses.skt: tasya kandān vasantānte himavacchakadeśajān | apanītatvaco rātrau timayen madirādibhiḥ
verses.tib: de yi lde gu dpyid kyi tshe / kha ba can gyi yul skyes pa / shun pa bshus nas mtshan mo ni / chang sogs la ni spang bar bya

verses.skt: tatkalkasvarasaṃ prātaḥ śucitāntavapīḍitam | madirāyāḥ surūḍhāyās tribhāgena samanvitam
verses.tib: de yi khu ba nang par ni / ras ni gtsang mas btsags nas kyang / chang ni legs par langs gyur pa / cha gsum dang ni sbyar ba'am

verses.skt: madyasyānyasya takrasya mastunaḥ kāñjikasya vā | tatkāla eva vā yuktaṃ yuktam ālocya mātrayā
verses.tib: chang gzhan dag gam til mar ram / rang skyur ram ni zho ga chu / de tshe nyid sbyar nad par ni / tshad dang ldan par sbyin bya zhing

verses.skt: tailasarpirvasāmajjakṣīramāṃsarasaiḥ pṛthak | kvāthena vā yathāvyādhi rasaṃ kevalam eva vā
verses.tib: 'o ma zhun mar zhag dang rkang / skam sa'i sha khu so sor ni / bskol ba nad gzhi ji bzhin blud / yang na sman khu 'ba' zhig blud

verses.skt: pibed gaṇḍūṣamātraṃ prāk kaṇṭhanālīviśuddhaye | pratataṃ svedanaṃ cānu vedanāyāṃ praśasyate
verses.tib: dang por mkhur gang tsam 'thungs na / mid pa'i sbubs ni dag par byed / rgyun tu blugs pa'i dugs byas na / na zhing zug pa dag la phan

verses.skt: śītāmbusekaḥ sahasā vamimūrchāyayor mukhe | śeṣaṃ pibet klamāpāye sthiratāṃ gata ojasi
verses.tib: skyug cing brgyal ba'i nad la ni / 'phral du chu grang dag kyang blud / ngal ba med cing lus kyi ni / gzi mdangs brtan pas lhag ma sbyin

verses.skt: vidāhaparihārāya paraṃ śītānulepanaḥ | dhārayet sāmbukaṇikā muktākarpūramālikāḥ
verses.tib: tsha ba bsal bar bya ba'i phyir / shin tu bsil bas bsku bya zhing / mu tig ga bur phreng ba can / chu thigs phre'u bsten par bya

verses.skt: kuḍavo ’sya parā mātrā tadardhaṃ kevalasya tu | palaṃ piṣṭasya tanmajjñaḥ sabhaktaṃ prāk ca śīlayet
verses.tib: 'di yi tshad chen phul gang ste / nyi tshe la ni de yi phyed / sgog skya srang gcig btags pa ni / zas dang bcas pa'ang bsten par bya

verses.skt: jīrṇaśālyodanaṃ jīrṇe śaṅkhakundendupāṇḍuram | bhuñjīta yūṣair payasā rasair vā dhanvacāriṇām
verses.tib: zhu nas sA lu rnying pa'i chan / dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba / yu sha 'o ma skam sa yi / sha khu dang ni lhan cig bza'

verses.skt: madyam ekaṃ pibet tatra tṛṭprabandhe jalānvitam | amadyapas tv āranālaṃ phalāmbu parisikthakām
verses.tib: skams par gyur na chang dang ni / chur sbyar ba ni blud par bya / chang mi btung na rang skyur ram / rgun 'brum chu ni blud par bya

verses.skt: tatkalkaṃ vā samaghṛtaṃ ghṛtapātre khajāhatam | sthitaṃ daśāhād aśnīyāt tadvad vā vasayā samam
verses.tib: de yi lde gu mar dang bcas / mar ni snod du gzar bus dkrugs / zhag bcu gzhag gam de bzhin du / zhag dang mnyam sbyar spyad par bya

verses.skt: vikañcukaprājyarasonagarbhān saśūlyamāṃsān vividhopadaṃśān | nimardakān vā ghṛtaśuktayuktān prakāmam adyāl laghu tuccham aśnan
verses.tib: sgog skya shun pa bshus pa'i snying po ni / bsregs sha dag gam bza' ba sna tshogs sam / sha btubs pa'am mar dang tshar bcas bza' / kha zas nyung ba ci 'dod spyad par bya / khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad ni ma gtogs pa / nad gzhi ma lus ldan par 'gyur ba'am / rlung nad nyi tshe dang ni ldan gyur la / sgog pa las lhag

verses.skt: priyāmbuguḍadugdhasya māṃsamadyāmlavidviṣaḥ | atitikṣor ajīrṇaṃ ca laśuno vyāpade dhruvam
