verses.skt: pittakopabhayād ante yuñjyān mṛdu virecanam | rasāyanaguṇān evaṃ paripūrṇān samaśnute
verses.tib: mkhris pa ldang ba'i 'jigs pa yi / tha mar bkru sman 'jam po gtang / de ltar bcud len yon tan ni / yongs su rdzogs pa 'thob par 'gyur

verses.skt: grīṣme ’rkataptā girayo jatutulyaṃ vamanti yat | hemādiṣaḍdhāturasaṃ procyate tac chilājatu
verses.tib: sos ka'i tsha bas gdungs drags las / rgya skyegs khu ba ltar 'dzag gang / gser sogs 'byung khungs drug gi bcud / de ni brag zhun zhes byar bshad

verses.skt: sarvaṃ ca tiktakaṭukaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ kaṭu pākataḥ | chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lauhaṃ tatra praśasyate
verses.tib: de ni kun kyang kha zhing tsha / shas cher me drod zhu rjes tsha / gcod par byed de de las ni / lcags las byung ba rab tu bsngags

verses.skt: gomūtragandhi kṛṣṇaṃ guggulvābhaṃ viśarkaraṃ mṛtsnam | snigdham anamlakaṣāyaṃ mṛdu guru ca śilājatu śreṣṭham
verses.tib: ba gcin dri bro gnag pa dang / gu gul 'dra zhing gseg ma med / spyi bag snum zhing skyur ba dang / bska zhing 'jam la lci ba yi / brag zhun de ni mchog yin no

verses.skt: vyādhivyādhitasātmyaṃ samanusmaran bhāvayed ayaḥpātre | prāk kevalajaladhautaṃ śuṣkaṃ kvāthais tato bhāvyam
verses.tib: nad dang nad pa rjes mthun par / sman dang brag zhun cha mnyam byas / lcags kyi snod du sbyar bar bya / dang por chu ni nyi tshes bkru / de 'og bskams la bskol dang bsre

verses.skt: samagirijam aṣṭaguṇite niḥkvāthyaṃ bhāvanauṣadhaṃ toye | tanniryūhe ’ṣṭāṃśe pūtoṣṇe prakṣiped girijam
verses.tib: brag zhun sman dang mnyam byas la / brgyad cha'i nang du bskol bar bya / khu ba brgyad cha lus btsags pa / dro 'jam nang du brag zhun gzhug

verses.skt: tat samarasatāṃ yātaṃ saṃśuṣkaṃ prakṣiped rase bhūyaḥ | svaiḥ svair evaṃ kvāthair bhāvyaṃ vārān bhavet sapta
verses.tib: de dang 'dres gyur bskams nas ni / sman chu'i nang du slar yang gzhug / de ltar rang rang sman 'phrod ni / bskol ba'i khu bar lan bdun sbangs

verses.skt: atha snigdhasya śuddhasya ghṛtaṃ tiktakasādhitam | tryahaṃ yuñjīta girijam ekaikena tathā tryaham
verses.tib: de nas tig ta'i sman mar gyis / snum chos byas nas sbyar byas te / 'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba dang / shing mngar pa to la'i khu ba / brag zhun dag ni re re yang / zhag gsum bar du blud par bya / de nas de la sbyor ba ni / dus dang sbyar te blud par bya

verses.skt: phalatrayasya yūṣeṇa paṭolyā madhukasya ca | yogaṃ yogyaṃ tatas tasya kālāpekṣaṃ prayojayet
verses.tib: de nas tig ta'i sman mar gyis / snum chos byas nas sbyar byas te / 'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba dang / shing mngar pa to la'i khu ba / brag zhun dag ni re re yang / zhag gsum bar du blud par bya / de nas de la sbyor ba ni / dus dang sbyar te blud par bya

verses.skt: śilājam evaṃ dehasya bhavaty atyupakārakam | guṇān samagrān kurute sahasā vyāpadaṃ na ca

verses.tib: zhag bdun phrag gcig phrag gsum dang / phrag bdun zho gnyis srang phyed gcig / dman dang bar ma chen po yi / brag zhun bzhin du sbyar / lus ni shin tu sbyangs byas la / brag zhun sbyang ba gtang bar bya / zangs dang lcags dang dngul dang gser / kun dang yang na re rer sbyar

verses.skt: saṃskṛtaṃ saṃskṛte dehe prayuktaṃ girijāhvayam | yuktaṃ vyastaiḥ samastair vā tāmrāyorūpyahemabhiḥ
verses.tib: zhag bdun phrag gcig phrag gsum dang / phrag bdun zho gnyis srang phyed gcig / dman dang bar ma chen po yi / brag zhun bzhin du sbyar / lus ni shin tu sbyangs byas la / brag zhun sbyang ba gtang bar bya / zangs dang lcags dang dngul dang gser / kun dang yang na re rer sbyar

verses.skt: kṣīreṇāloḍitaṃ kuryāc chīghraṃ rāsāyanaṃ phalam | kulatthān kākamācīṃ ca kapotāṃś ca sadā tyajet
verses.tib: 'o ma dang ni / ni lhan cig gtang / bcud len 'bras bu myur du 'grub / rgya sran mon sne'u dme ru dang / phug ron sha ni rtag tu spang

verses.skt: na so ’sti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpo jatv aśmajaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya | tatkālayogair vidhivat prayuktaṃ svasthasya corjāṃ vipulāṃ dadhāti || 142 || kuṭīpraveśaḥ kṣaṇināṃ paricchadavatāṃ hitaḥ | ato ’nyathā tu ye teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhiḥ
verses.tib: gang zhig brag zhun gyis ni mngon sum du / ma bsal nad ni sa steng yod ma yin / dus su cho ga bzhin du bsten gyur na / nad med nyams stobs rgya chen skyed par byed / khang par gnas pa'i khom ldan can / phun sum tshogs dang ldan la phan / de las gzhan du de rnams la / nyi ma rlung gi tshe na bsten

verses.skt: vātātapasahā yogā vakṣyante ’to viśeṣataḥ | sukhopacārā bhraṃśe ’pi ye na dehasya bādhakāḥ
verses.tib: rlung dang nyi tshan bcas sbyor ba / bde ba'i longs spyod med na yang / gang zhig lus la mi gnod pa / mchog tu de ni bshad par bya

verses.skt: śītodakaṃ payaḥ kṣaudraṃ ghṛtam ekaikaśo dviśaḥ | triśaḥ samastam athavā prāk pītaṃ sthāpayed vayaḥ
verses.tib: chu grang 'o ma sbrang rtsi dang / mar ni re re gnyis gnyis dang / gsum mam yang na thams cad ni / zas sngar 'thungs na rgas sra byed

verses.skt: guḍena madhunā śuṇṭhyā kṛṣṇayā lavaṇena vā | dve dve khādan sadā pathye jīved varṣaśataṃ sukhī
verses.tib: bu ram sbrang rtsi bca' sga dang / pi pi ling ngam rgyam tsha dang / a ru ra ni gnyis gnyis dag / rtag zos bde zhing lo brgyar 'tsho

verses.skt: harītakīṃ sarpiṣi saṃpratāpya samaśnatas tat pibato ghṛtaṃ ca | bhavec cirasthāyi balaṃ śarīre sakṛt kṛtaṃ sādhu yathā kṛtajñe
verses.tib: a ru ra ni mar nang bsres / bza' zhing mar de 'thungs na ni / rgas sra lus ni yun ring gnas / stobs ni 'phel bar byed 'gyur te / ji ltar dam pa byas gzo ba / lan cig phan 'dogs ji lta bzhin

verses.skt: dhātrīrasakṣaudrasitāghṛtāni hitāśanānāṃ lihatāṃ narāṇām | praṇāśam āyānti jarāvikārā granthā viśālā iva durgṛhītāḥ
verses.tib: skyu ru ra khu sbrang rtsi dang / kha ra mar dang lde gu byas / bsten zhing 'phrod pa za ba'i mi / rgas pa'i gnod pa 'jig 'gyur te

verses.skt: dhātrīkṛmighnāsanasāracūrṇaṃ satailasarpirmadhulohareṇu | niṣevamāṇasya bhaven narasya tāruṇyalāvaṇyam avipraṇaṣṭam
verses.tib: skyu ru ra dang byi dang ka / a sa na yi snying po'i phye / lcags phye til mar sbrang rtsi yi / mar bcas lde gu bsten na ni / na tshod mdzes pa ma nyams 'gyur

verses.skt: lauhaṃ rajo vellabhavaṃ ca sarpiḥkṣaudradrutaṃ sthāpitam abdamātram | samudgake bījakasārak pte lihan balī jīvati kṛṣṇakeśaḥ
verses.tib: lcags phye byi dang ka yi phye ma dang / mar dang sbrang rtsi bsres la lo gcig tsam / a sa na yi za ma tog nang gzhug / bsten na stobs ldan tshe ring skra gnag 'gyur

verses.skt: viḍaṅgabhallātakanāgarāṇi ye ’śnanti sarpirmadhusaṃyutāni | jarānadīṃ rogataraṅgiṇīṃ te lāvaṇyayuktāḥ puruṣās taranti
verses.tib: byi dang ga dang go bye bca' sga rnams / mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa gang gis zos / rgas pa'i chu bo nad kyi rba rlabs can / na tshod ldan pa'i skyes bu de brgal 'gyur

verses.skt: khadirāsanayūṣabhāvitāyās triphalāyā ghṛtamākṣikaplutāyāḥ | niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvanty arujaḥ kim atra citram
verses.tib: seng ldeng a sa na yi khu ba dang / 'bras bu gsum dang sbrang rtsi mar sbyar ba / cho ga bzhin du bsten pa'i mi rnams ni / tshe ring 'gyur ba 'di las ngo mtshar med

verses.skt: bījakasya rasam aṅgulihāryaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ triphalāṃ ca | śīlayatsu puruṣeṣu jarattā svāgatāpi vinivartata eva
verses.tib: dzi ba ka yi khu ba sor mor chags / kha ra sbrang / rtsi mar dang 'bras bu gsum / skyes bu dam pas bsten par gyur na ni / rgas dang nad ni nges par bzlog par 'gyur

verses.skt: punarnavasyārdhapalaṃ navasya piṣṭaṃ pibed yaḥ payasārdhamāsam | māsadvayaṃ tattriguṇaṃ samāṃ vā jīrṇo ’pi bhūyaḥ sa punarnavaḥ syāt || 154 || mūrvābṛhatyaṃśumatībalānām uśīrapāṭhāsanaśārivāṇām | kālānusāryāgurucandanānāṃ vadanti paunarnavam eva kalpam
verses.tib: ba spru ba ni sar ba srang phyed dang / 'o mar btags pa zla phyed zla ba gnyis / zla drug lo gcig bar du 'thungs na ni / rgas shing rnying pa'ang slar ni gzhon par 'gyur / mur ba ang shu ma ti bri ha ti / ba la pu shel tse dang pa ta dang / a sa na dang thal tres a ka ru

verses.skt: śatāvarīkalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ ye sarpir aśnanti sitādvitīyam | tāñ jīvitādhvānam abhiprapannān na vipralumpanti vikāracaurāḥ
verses.tib: pri yang ku dang tsan+dan re re yis / cho ga'ang ba spru ba dang mtshungs pa yin / nye'u shing lde gu khu bar bskol ba dang / zhun mar kha rar bcas pa za byed pa / de ni 'tsho ba'i lam du zhugs gyur tshe / nad kyi rkun pos choms par mi 'gyur ro

verses.skt: dine dine kṛṣṇatilaprakuñcaṃ samaśnatāṃ śītajalānupānam | poṣaḥ śarīrasya bhavaty analpo dṛḍhībhavanty āmaraṇāc ca dantāḥ
verses.tib: nyin re til nag srang ni re re dag / zos pa'i rjes la chu grang 'thungs gyur na / lus ni shas cher rgyas pa nyid 'gyur zhing / 'chi ba'i bar du so ni brtan par 'gyur

verses.skt: cūrṇaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāmalakāmṛtānāṃ lihan sasarpir madhubhāgamiśram | vṛṣaḥ sthiraḥ śāntavikāraduḥkhaḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvati kṛṣṇakeśaḥ
verses.tib: gze ma sle tres skyu ru ra'i phye ma / mar dang sbrang rtsi cha mnyam lde gu zos / ro tsa lus brtan nad kyi sdug bsngal zhi / lo brgya 'tsho zhing skra ni nag por 'gyur

verses.skt: sārdhaṃ tilair āmalakāni kṛṣṇair akṣāṇi saṃkṣudya harītakīr vā | ye ’dyur mayūrā iva te manuṣyā ramyaṃ parīṇāmam avāpnuvanti
verses.tib: til nag a ru ra dang skyu ru ra / ba ru ra dang bcas pa brdungs nas bsten / mi de rma bya bzhin du mdangs ldan zhing / yid du 'ong ba'i bde ba thob par 'gyur

verses.skt: śilājatukṣaudraviḍaṅgasarpirlohābhayāpāradatāpyabhakṣaḥ | āpūryate durbaladehadhātus tripañcarātreṇa yathā śaśāṅkaḥ
verses.tib: brag zhun mar dang sbrang rtsi byi dang ga / a ru ra dang lcags phye dngul chu dang / ta bya bsten na lus zungs rdzogs 'gyur te / yar ngo zla phyed rdzogs pa'i zla ba 'dra

verses.skt: ye māsam ekaṃ svarasaṃ pibanti dine dine bhṛṅgarajaḥsamuttham | kṣīrāśinas te balavīryayuktāḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvitam āpnuvanti
verses.tib: gang zhig bring ga ra dza'i khu ba zla ba gcig / nyin re rgyun du bsten par byed pa dang / 'o ma 'thungs te stobs dang brtson 'grus ldan / lo brgyar 'tsho ba dag kyang thob par 'gyur

verses.skt: māsaṃ vacām apy upasevamānāḥ kṣīreṇa tailena ghṛtena vāpi | bhavanti rakṣobhir adhṛṣyarūpā medhāvino nirmalamṛṣṭavākyāḥ
verses.tib: shu dag kyang ni zla ba gcig bsten zhing / 'o ma'am mar ram til mar bcas pa bsten / gdon gyis mi tshugs pa yi lus 'gyur zhing / yid gzhungs tshig ni shin tu gsal bar 'gyur

verses.skt: maṇḍūkaparṇīm api bhakṣayanto bhṛṣṭāṃ ghṛte māsam anannabhakṣāḥ | jīvanti kālaṃ vipulaṃ pragalbhās tāruṇyalāvaṇyaguṇodayasthāḥ
verses.tib: ma du ka pa r+Ni yi mar dang brngos / zla gcig bar du zas ma zos par bsten / gzugs ni rgya cher 'tsho zhing spobs pa che / gzhon zhing mdangs ldan yon / tan ldan par 'gyur

verses.skt: lāṅgalītriphalālohapalapañcāśatā kṛtam | mārkavasvarase ṣaṣṭyā guṭikānāṃ śatatrayam
verses.tib: 'bras bu gsum dang tsang gi ri dang ni / lcags phye srang ni lnga bcu las byas shing / ko sha da ka'i khu ba'i nang du btags / ri lu sum brgya byas nas ri lu de

verses.skt: chāyāviśuṣkaṃ guṭikārdham adyāt pūrvaṃ samastām api tāṃ krameṇa | bhajed viriktaḥ kramaśaś ca maṇḍaṃ peyāṃ vilepīṃ rasakaudanaṃ ca

verses.skt: sarpiḥsnigdhaṃ māsam ekaṃ yatātmā māsād ūrdhvaṃ sarvathā svairavṛttiḥ | varjyaṃ yatnāt sarvakālaṃ tv ajīrṇaṃ varṣeṇaivaṃ yogam evopayuñjyāt || 167 || bhavati vigatarogo yo ’py asādhyāmayārtaḥ prabalapuruṣakāraḥ śobhate yo 'pi vṛddhaḥ | upacitapṛthugātraśrotranetrādiyuktas taruṇa iva samānāṃ pañca jīvec chatāni
verses.tib: zla gcig 'das nas rang dga' nyid du spyad / 'bad pas dus kun tu ni ma zhu spang / lo gcig bar du sbyor ba 'di bsten na / gang zhig gso dka'i nad kyis nyen pa'ang / shin tu stobs che skyes bu'i bya ba rdzogs / lus rgyas 'jam zhing mig dang rna ba gsal / gzhon pa nyid dang lo ni lnga brgyar 'tsho

verses.skt: gāyatrīśikhiśiṃśipāsanaśivāvellākṣakāruṣkarān | piṣṭvāṣṭādaśasaṃguṇe ’mbhasi dhṛtān khaṇḍaiḥ sahāyomayaiḥ | pātre lohamaye tryahaṃ ravikarair āloḍayan pācayed | agnau cānu mṛdau salohaśakalaṃ pādasthitaṃ tat pacet
verses.tib: seng ldeng shir sha ba dang a sa na / rma bya a ru ra dang skyu ru ra / go bye byi dang ga btags chu 'gyur ni / bco brgyad nang bskol lcags kyi dum bu gzhug / lcags kyi snod du zhag gsum nyi ma yi / 'od kyis bsros la de rjes me la ni / lcags kyi phye ma zhing par byas te bskol

verses.skt: pūtasyāṃśaḥ kṣīrato ’ṃśas tathāṃśau bhārgān niryāsād dvau varāyās trayo 'ṃśāḥ | aṃśāś catvāraś ceha haiyaṅgavīnād ekīkṛtyaitat sādhayet kṛṣṇalauhe || 170 || vimalakhaṇḍasitāmadhubhiḥ pṛthag yutam ayuktam idaṃ yadi vā ghṛtam | svarucibhojanapānaviceṣṭito bhavati nā palaśaḥ pariśīlayan
verses.tib: de btsags khu ba cha gcig 'o ma ni / cha gcig de bzhin gso ma'i khu ba gcig / nye'u shing bskol ba'i khu ba cha gsum dang / 'dir ni mar sar cha ni bzhi dang sbyar / 'di dag gcig tu lcags nag snod du bskol / khar rdul med de bzhin sbrang rtsi dang / de bzhin mar dang bsres par gyur pa dang / 'phrod pa'i zas dang skom dang spyod lam bcas

verses.skt: śrīmān nirdhūtapāpmā vanamahiṣabalo vājivegaḥ sthirāṅgaḥ | keśair bhṛṅgāṅganīlair madhusurabhimukho naikayoṣinniṣevī | vāṅmedhādhīsamṛddhaḥ supaṭuhutavaho māsamātropayogād | dhatte ’sau nārasiṃhaṃ vapur analaśikhātaptacāmīkarābham
verses.tib: dpal dang ldan zhing nyes pa bsal ba dang / nags kyi ma he lta bu'i stobs ldan zhing / rta ltar na mgyogs la lus ni brtan pa dang / skra ni bung ba'i mdog ltar gnag pa dang / kha ni dri zhim bud med mang bsten nus / tshig gsal yid gzhungs phun sum tshogs pa dang / zla gcig bsten na me drod che ba yin / de ni mi yi seng ge'am me'am ni / btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra'i lus 'dzin 'gyur

verses.skt: attāraṃ nārasiṃhasya vyādhayo na spṛśanty api | cakrojjvalabhujaṃ bhītā nārasiṃham ivāsurāḥ
verses.tib: mi yi seng ge'i sbyor ba 'di / zos na nad kyis mi nyen te / 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lag pa yis / lha min tshogs ni 'jigs dang 'dra

verses.skt: bhṛṅgapravālān amunaiva bhṛṣṭān ghṛtena yaḥ khādati yantritātmā | viśuddhakoṣṭho ’sanasārasiddhadugdhānupas tatkṛtabhojanārthaḥ
verses.tib: bring ga ra dza'i myu gu'i cho ga 'dis / brdos shing mar / bcas zos la bsdams dang bcas / lto sbyangs pa la a sa na'i khu ba / 'o ma 'thungs shing zas kyi bya ba byed

verses.skt: māsopayogāt sa sukhī jīvaty abdaśatatrayam | gṛhṇāti sakṛd apy uktam aviluptasmṛtīndriyaḥ
verses.tib: zla gcig bar du bsten par gyur na ni / bde zhing lo ni nyis brgya'i bar du 'tsho / lan cig smras pa'i tshig kyang zin gyur zhing / dran dang dbang po nyams pa med par 'gyur

verses.skt: anenaiva ca kalpena yas tailam upayojayet | tān evāpnoti sa guṇān kṛṣṇakeśaś ca jāyate
verses.tib: gang zhig sbyor ba 'di yis ni / til mar bsten par byed pa dag / de yis yon tan de thob cing / lus ni nag po nyid du 'gyur

verses.skt: uktāni śakyāni phalānvitāni yugānurūpāṇi rasāyanāni | mahānuśaṃsāny api cāparāṇi prāptyādikaṣṭāni na kīrtitāni
verses.tib: bcud kyis len ni dus dang rjes mthun zhing / bsten nus 'bras bur bcas pa bshad pa yin / gzhan dag phan yon bcas pa yod mod kyis / rnyed par dka' bas bdag gis ma bshad do

verses.skt: rasāyanavidhibhraṃśāj jāyeran vyādhayo yadi | yathāsvam auṣadhaṃ teṣāṃ kāryaṃ muktvā rasāyanam
verses.tib: bcud kyis len gyi cho ga las / nyams pas gal te nad skye na / bcud kyis len de spangs nas ni / de yi sman ni ji bzhin bya

verses.skt: satyavādinam akrodham adhyātmapravaṇendriyam | śāntaṃ sadvṛttanirataṃ vidyān nityarasāyanam
verses.tib: bden par smra zhing khro ba med / dbang po bsdams shing bdag nyid thul / zhi zhing dam pa'i spyod la dga' / rtag tu bcud len yin zhes bya

verses.skt: guṇair ebhiḥ samuditaḥ sevate yo rasāyanam | sa nivṛttātmā dīrghāyuḥ paratreha ca modate
verses.tib: yon tan 'di dag ldan gyur pas / gang zhig bcud len bsten gyur pa / de ni dga' zhing tshe ring la / 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du bde

verses.skt: śāstrānusāriṇī caryā cittajñāḥ pārśvavartinaḥ | buddhir askhalitārtheṣu paripūrṇaṃ rasāyanam
verses.tib: spyod pa bstan bcos rjes 'jug cing / gam na gnas pa'i sems dang mthun / don la blo ni ma 'khrugs pa / bcud kyis len ni rdzogs pa yin

verses.skt: vājīkaraṇam anvicchet satataṃ viṣayī pumān | tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭir apatyaṃ ca guṇavat tatra saṃśritam
verses.tib: skyes bus rtag tu yul bsten pas / ro tsa bar ni 'dod bya ste / dga' dang brta dang bu rgyud ni / yon tan ldan pas de la gnas

verses.skt: apatyasaṃtānakaraṃ yat sadyaḥ saṃpraharṣaṇam | vājīvātibalo yena yāty apratihato ’ṅganāḥ
verses.tib: bu tsha'i rgyud ni skyed byed cing / 'phral du yang dag dka' byed gang / gang gis rta ltar rab stobs ldan / bud med la ni thogs med 'gro

verses.skt: bhavaty atipriyaḥ strīṇāṃ yena yenopacīyate | tad vājīkaraṇaṃ tad dhi dehasyorjaskaraṃ param
verses.tib: bud med la rab chags 'gyur ba / gang dang gang gis 'phel 'gyur ba / de ni ro tsa byed pa ste / lus kyi stobs kyang skyed pa'i mchog

verses.skt: dharmyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ lokadvayarasāyanam | anumodāmahe brahmacaryam ekāntanirmalam
verses.tib: chos dang grags dang tshe ring dang / 'jig rten gnyis ka'i / bcud len 'gyur / gcig tu skyon ni med pa yi / tshangs par spyo la bdag yi rang

verses.skt: alpasattvasya tu kleśair bādhyamānasya rāgiṇaḥ | śarīrakṣayarakṣārthaṃ vājīkaraṇam ucyate
verses.tib: snying stobs chung ba nyon mongs pas / gnod par gyur pa'i nad bu can / lus mi zad pa bsrung ba'i phyir / ro tsa'i cho ga brjod pa yin

verses.skt: kalyasyodagravayaso vājīkaraṇasevinaḥ | sarveṣv ṛtuṣv ahar ahar vyavāyo na nivāryate
verses.tib: nad med lang tsho ldan pa dag / ro tsa ba ni sten byed pa / dus tshigs kun la nyin re zhing / nyal po bya ba dgag pa med

verses.skt: atha snigdhaviśuddhānāṃ nirūhān sānuvāsanān | ghṛtatailarasakṣīraśarkarākṣaudrasaṃyutān
verses.tib: de nas snum gyur sbyang byas pa / ni ru ha dang 'jam rtsir bcas / mar dang til mar sbrang rtsi dang / sha khu 'o ma kha rar bcas

verses.skt: yogavid yojayet pūrvaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasāśinām | tato vājīkarān yogān śukrāpatyabalapradān
verses.tib: 'o ma sha dang sha khu bza' / sbyor ba shes pas dang por gtad / de nas ro tsa byed sbyor ba / khu ba bu tsha 'phel byed bya

verses.skt: acchāyaḥ pūtikusumaḥ phalena rahito drumaḥ | yathaikaś caikaśākhaś ca nirapatyas tathā naraḥ
verses.tib: me tog dri mnam grib ma med / 'bras bu med par gyur pa'i shing / yal ga gcig pa'i shing gcig bzhin / bud med med mi de dang 'dra

verses.skt: skhaladgamanam avyaktavacanaṃ dhūlidhūsaram | api lālāvilamukhaṃ hṛdayāhlādakārakam
verses.tib: gom 'gros 'khyor zhing tshig mi gsal / rdul gyis g.yogs pa ltar snang zhing / bzhin ras snabs kyis gos pa yang / snying ni dga' bar byed pa yin

verses.skt: apatyaṃ tulyatāṃ kena darśanasparśanādiṣu | kiṃ punar yad yaśodharmamānaśrīkulavardhanam
verses.tib: reg pa dang ni mthong la / bu mnyam bde ba yod min na / gang zhig chos dang grags par ldan / nga rgyal rigs 'phel smos ci dgos

verses.skt: śuddhakāye yathāśakti vṛṣyayogān prayojayet | śarekṣukuśakāśānāṃ vidāryā vīraṇasya ca
verses.tib: lus sbyang byas te ci nus par / ro tsa'i sbyor ba brtsam par bya / 'dam bu gung shing 'jag ma sogs / pu shel tse dang bi da ri

verses.skt: mūlāni kaṇṭakāryāś ca jīvakarṣabhakau balām | mede dve dve ca kākolyau śūrpaparṇyau śatāvarīm
verses.tib: kaN+Da ka ri'i rtsa ba dang / ba la 'tsho byed zangs rtsib / ram nye ba gnyis med gnyis / nye'u shing par+Na rnam gnyis dang

verses.skt: aśvagandhām atibalāṃ ātmaguptāṃ punarnavām | vīrāṃ payasyāṃ jīvantīm ṛddhiṃ rāsnāṃ trikaṇṭakam
verses.tib: a shwa gan+d+ha kha sral phre'u / a ti ba la ba spru ba / bi da ri ti ba ya s+ye / ra sna gze ma dzi ban ti

verses.skt: madhukaṃ śāliparṇīṃ ca bhāgāṃs tripalikān pṛthak | māṣāṇām āḍhakaṃ caitad dvidroṇe sādhayed apām
verses.tib: shing mngar sa la par+Ni rnams / re re'ang srang ni gsum gsum cha / mon sran gre'u bre bzhi dang / chu bre sum cu gnyis nang bskol

verses.skt: rasenāḍhakaśeṣeṇa pacet tena ghṛtāḍhakam | dattvā vidārīdhātrīkṣurasānām āḍhakāḍhakam
verses.tib: khu ba bre bzhi lus pa ru / mar bre bzhi dang bid ri / skyu ru ra dang bu ram shing

verses.skt: ghṛtāc caturguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ peṣyāṇīmāni cāvapet | vīrāṃ svaguptāṃ kākolyau yaṣṭīṃ phalgūni pippalīm
verses.tib: bre ni bzhi bzhi gzhug par bya / 'o ma mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang / bir kha sral ram nye gnyis / shing mngar phal gu pi pi ling

verses.skt: drākṣāṃ vidārīṃ kharjūraṃ madhukāni śatāvarīm | tat siddhapūtaṃ cūrṇasya pṛthak prasthena yojayet
verses.tib: rgun 'brum 'bra go bi da ri / ma du ka dang nye'u shing pa / 'di dag btags te bcug nas ni / de bskol btsags pa'i nang du ni / ka ra dkar po smig rkang ni / sman ni bre re gzhug pa / dang

verses.skt: śarkarāyās tugāyāś ca pippalyāḥ kuḍavena ca | maricasya prakuñcena pṛthag ardhapalonmitaiḥ
verses.tib: pi pi ling ni srang bzhi dang / na le sham ni srang gcig dang / shing tsha sug smel ge sar rnams / re re srad ni phyed phyed phye

verses.skt: tvagelākesaraiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ kṣaudradvikuḍavena ca | palamātraṃ tataḥ khādet pratyahaṃ rasadugdhabhuk
verses.tib: sbrang rtsi srad ni bcu drug sbyar / de las nyin re srang re bza' / 'o ma dang ni sha khu btung

verses.skt: tenārohati vājīva kuliṅga iva hṛṣyati | vidārīpippalīśālipriyālekṣurakād rajaḥ
verses.tib: des ni rta ltar spyod gyur cing / mchil pa lta bur 'dod pa spyod / bid ri dang pi pi ling / sha li 'bras rtsa pi ya li

verses.skt: pṛthak svaguptāmūlāc ca kuḍavāṃśaṃ tathā madhu | tulārdhaṃ śarkarācūrṇāt prasthārdhaṃ navasarpiṣaḥ
verses.tib: kha sral phye ma phul re dang / de bzhin sbrang rtsi srang brgyad dang / kha ra'i phye ma srang lnga bcu / mar sar srang ni bcu drug sbyar

verses.skt: so ’kṣamātram ataḥ khādet yasya rāmāśataṃ gṛhe | sātmaguptāphalān kṣīre godhūmān sādhitān himān
verses.tib: de las zho ni gnyis gnyis bza' / bud med brgya la spyod par nus / khra sral phre'u zho 'am ni / ma sha 'o mar bskol te bsgrangs

verses.skt: māṣān vā saghṛtakṣaudrān khādan gṛṣṭipayo'nupaḥ | jāgarti rātriṃ sakalām akhinnaḥ khedayan striyaḥ
verses.tib: mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa dag / zos la ba sar 'o ma btung / mtshan mo thog thag gnyid ma log / dub pa med par nyal po spyod

verses.skt: bastāṇḍasiddhe payasi bhāvitān asakṛt tilān | yaḥ khādet sasitān gacchet sa strīśatam apūrvavat
verses.tib: ra thug rlig pa 'o mar btsos / til dang lan mang bsres pa dang / kha rar bcas zos gang yin de / bud med brgya la'ang gsar snyam sems

verses.skt: cūrṇaṃ vidāryā bahuśaḥ svarasenaiva bhāvitam | kṣaudrasarpiryutaṃ līḍhvā pramadāśatam ṛcchati
verses.tib: bid ri yi phye ma ni / rang gi khu bar lan mang sbangs / zhun mar sbrang rtsi bcas bldags na / bud med bcu la spyod par nus

verses.skt: kṛṣṇādhātrīphalarajaḥ svarasena subhāvitam | śarkarāmadhusarpirbhir līḍhvā yo ’nu payaḥ pibet
verses.tib: pi ling skyu ru ra yi phye / rang gi khu bar legs par sbangs / sha kha mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas / zos rjes 'o ma 'thungs pa gang

verses.skt: sa naro ’śītivarṣo ’pi yuveva parihṛṣyati | karṣaṃ madhukacūrṇasya ghṛtakṣaudrasamanvitam
verses.tib: mi de brgyad cu lon na yang / lang tshor gnas shing 'dod spyod nus / shing mdar phye ma zho gnyis dang / mar dang sbrang rtsi de mnyam pa

verses.skt: payo'nupānaṃ yo lihyān nityavegaḥ sa nā bhavet | kulīraśṛṅgyā yaḥ kalkam āloḍya payasā pibet
verses.tib: zos rjes 'o ma 'thungs gyur na / mi de rtag tu 'dod spyod nus / kar ka ta yi sring gi phye / 'o mar sbyar te 'thungs pa dang

verses.skt: sitāghṛtapayo'nnāśī sa nārīṣu vṛṣāyate | yaḥ payasyāṃ payaḥsiddhāṃ khāden madhughṛtānvitām
verses.tib: kha ra 'o ma mar bcas pa'i / zas zos bud med la phod 'gyur / pa ya s+ya dang 'o ma bskol / mar dang sbrang rtsi bcas za zhing

verses.skt: pibed bāṣkayaṇaṃ cānu kṣīraṃ na kṣayam eti saḥ | svayaṅguptekṣurakayor bījacūrṇaṃ saśarkaram
verses.tib: ba ni yar ma'i 'o ma 'thung / de yi sa bon zad mi shes / kha sral phre'u bu ram gyi / sa bon phye ma kha rar bcas

verses.skt: dhāroṣṇena naraḥ pītvā payasā rāsabhāyate | uccaṭācūrṇam apy evaṃ śatāvaryāś ca yojayet
verses.tib: 'o ma bzhos ma thag btung na / lug bong lta bur spyod par 'gyur / u tsa da yi phye ma dang / nye'u shing sbyar ba'ang de bzhin no

verses.skt: candraśubhraṃ dadhisaraṃ sasitāṣaṣṭikaudanam | paṭe sumārjitaṃ bhuktvā vṛddho ’pi taruṇāyate
verses.tib: zho spris zla ba ltar dkar ba'i / tshags kyis btsags pa zos nas ni / kha ra drug cu'i 'bras chan zos / rgan po'ang gzhon nu bzhin du spyod

verses.skt: śvadaṃṣṭrekṣuramāṣātmaguptābījaśatāvarīḥ | piban kṣīreṇa jīrṇo ’pi gacchati pramadāśatam
verses.tib: gze ma ma sha a ru ra / kha sral sa bon nye'u shing pa / 'o ma bcas 'thung rgas pa yang / bud med / brgya la spyod par nus

verses.skt: yat kiñcin madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavardhanam | manaso harṣaṇaṃ yac ca tat sarvaṃ vṛṣyam ucyate
verses.tib: gang yang snum zhing mngar ba dang / stobs 'phel nyams ni brtas byed dang / yid ni dga' bar byed pa gang / de dag thams cad ro tsar bshad

verses.skt: dravyair evaṃvidhais tasmād darpitaḥ pramadāṃ vrajet | ātmavegena codīrṇaḥ strīguṇaiś ca praharṣitaḥ
verses.tib: de bas rdzas ni 'di lta bus / brtas byas bud med la 'jug bya / rang gi shugs kyis spyod pa dang / bud med yon tan gyis dga' spyad

verses.skt: sevyāḥ sarvendriyasukhā dharmakalpadrumāṅkurāḥ | viṣayātiśayāḥ pañca śarāḥ kusumadhanvanaḥ
verses.tib: chos kyi dpag bsam shing myu gu / dbang po'i bde ba kun bsten bya / yul ni yid du 'ong ba lnga / 'dod pa'i lha yi mda' yin no

verses.skt: iṣṭā hy ekaikaśo ’py arthā harṣaprītikarāḥ param | kiṃ punaḥ strīśarīre ye saṃghātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.tib: yid 'ong yul ni re res kyang / tshim zhing dga' byed mchog yin no / bud med lus la 'dus nas gang / gnas pa de ni smos ci dgos

verses.skt: nāmāpi yasyā hṛdayotsavāya yāṃ paśyatāṃ tṛptir anāptapūrvā | sarvendriyākarṣaṇapāśabhūtā kāntānuvṛttivratadīkṣitā yā
verses.tib: gang gi ming thos na yang snying dga' zhing / mthong na ngoms par 'gyur ba med pa dang / dbang po kun 'dren lcags kyur 'gyur ba yin / bud med khyo yi rjes 'jug 'phyon ma min

verses.skt: kalāvilāsāṅgavayovibhūṣā śuciḥ salajjā rahasi pragalbhā | priyaṃvadā tulyamanaḥśayā yā sā strī vṛṣyatvāya paraṃ narasya
verses.tib: sgyu rtsal 'jo sgeg na tshod lus kyis brgyan / dga' ba'i phyir ni ngo tsha dben par spyod / tshig snyan smra zhing mtshungs par mngon dga' bcas / bud med de ni ro tsa'i don mchog byed

verses.skt: ācarec ca sakalāṃ raticaryāṃ kāmasūtravihitām anavadyām | deśakālabalaśaktyanurodhād vaidyatantrasamayoktyaviruddhām
verses.tib: 'dod pa'i bstan bcos las bshad skyon med pa'i / yul dang dus dang nyams stobs rjes mthun zhing / sman dpyad bstan bcos sbyor dang mi 'gal ba / 'dod pa'i spyod pa ma lus spyad par bya

verses.skt: abhyañjanodvartanasekagandhasrakcitravastrābharaṇaprakārāḥ | gāndharvakāvyādikathāpravīṇāḥ samasvabhāvā vaśagā vayasyāḥ
verses.tib: bsku byug lus dril sman chu blugs dang dril / me tog phreng ba sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan / glu dang snyan dngags la sogs gtam la mkhas / rang bzhin na tshod mtshungs shing dbang gyur grogs

verses.skt: dīrghikā svabhavanāntaniviṣṭā padmareṇumadhumattavihaṅgā | nīlasānugirikūṭanitambe kānanāni purakaṇṭhagatāni
verses.tib: rang gi khang pa'i nye 'khor khrus rdzing bu / pad+ma'i ge sar sbrang rtsis myos pa yis / sbrang ma bya dang bcas pas gyur pa ni / sngo zhing gzhi mnyam ri yi 'dab na ni / nags tshal khyim dang nye bar 'gyur ba dang

verses.skt: dṛṣṭisukhā vividhā tarujātiḥ śrotrasukhaḥ kalakokilanādaḥ | aṅgasukhartuvaśena vibhūṣā cittasukhaḥ sakalaḥ parivāraḥ
verses.tib: mthong na dga' ba'i shing ni sna tshogs skye / mnyan na bde ba'i khu byug sgra snyan sgrogs / lus bde bud med rgyan ldan dus dbang 'gyur / sems bde ma lus 'khor gyis bskor ba dang

verses.skt: tāmbūlam acchamadirā kāntā kāntā niśā śaśāṅkāṅkā | yad yac ca kiñcid iṣṭaṃ manaso vājīkaraṃ tat tat
verses.tib: so rtsi dang ni chang dang chung ma ni / yid 'ong mtshan mo zla zer bcas par 'dug / yid ni dga' bar byed pa gang dang gang / de dang de ni ro tsar byed pa yin

verses.skt: madhu mukham iva sotpalaṃ priyāyāḥ kalaraṇanā parivādinī priyeva | kusumacayamanoramā ca śayyā kisalayinī latikeva puṣpitāgrā
verses.tib: chung ma'i kha ni ut+pal ltar dri zhim / pi wang snyan pa'i sgra ni nyan byed dang / mal stan yid 'ong me tog gcal bkram pa / lcug ma me tog myu gus brgyan pa 'dra

verses.skt: deśe śarīre ca na kācid artir artheṣu nālpo ’pi manovidhānaḥ | vājīkarāḥ saṃnihitāś ca yogāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ paripūrayanti
verses.tib: yul dang dus la gnod pa gang yang med / yul gyi yid la gnod pa chung ngu'ang med / ro tsa'i sbyor ba nye bar ldan gyur pa / 'dod pa'i 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed

verses.skt: mustā parpaṭakaṃ jvare tṛṣi jalaṃ mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭodbhavaṃ | lājāś chardiṣu vastijeṣu girijaṃ meheṣu dhātrīniśe | pāṇḍau śreṣṭham ayo ’bhayānilakaphe plīhāmaye pippalī | saṃdhāne kṛmijā viṣe śukatarur medo'nile gugguluḥ
verses.tib: gla sgang par pa ta ni rims la phan / skom dad che la bong pa bsregs pa ni / chu yi nang du gsur pa'i dngas ma phan / slon la 'bras yos chu so'i nang brag zhun / gcin snyi skyu ru ra dang ser po gnyis / skya rbab nad la lcags kyi phye ma mchog / rlung dang bad kan la ni a ru ra / mcher pa'i nad la pi pi ling mchog yin / glo rdol ba la rgya skyegs khu ba bsngags / dug gi nad la shir sha rab tu bsngags / tshil dang rlung nad la ni gu gul phan

verses.skt: vṛṣo ’srapitte kuṭajo ’tisāre bhallātako ’rśaḥsu gareṣu hema | sthūleṣu tārkṣyaṃ kṛmiṣu kṛmighnaṃ śoṣe surā chāgapayo ’tha māṃsam
verses.tib: khrag mkhris la ni ba sha ka rab bsngags / 'khru ba'i nad la dug mo nyung phan zhing / gzhang 'brum go bye dbyig dug la gser phan / tsho ches pa la skyer khaN+Da bsngags shing / srin bu'i nad ni byi dang ga yis 'joms / gcong chen la chang ra sha'am 'o ma phan

verses.skt: akṣyāmayeṣu triphalā guḍūcī vātāsraroge mathitaṃ grahaṇyām | kuṣṭheṣu sevyaḥ khadirasya sāraḥ sarveṣu rogeṣu śilāhvayaṃ ca
verses.tib: mig gi nad la 'bras bu gsum rab phan / dreg nad la ni sle tres rab bsngags shing / pho ba'i nad la dar ba gsar pa mchog / mdze la seng ldeng snying po bsten pas mchog / nad kun la ni brag zhun rab tu bsngags

verses.skt: unmādaṃ ghṛtam anavaṃ śokaṃ madyaṃ vyapasmṛtiṃ brāhmī | nidrānāśaṃ kṣīraṃ jayati rasālā pratiśyāyam
verses.tib: smyo byed nad la mar ni rnying pa phan / brjed byed nad la bram+hi'i rtsa ba phan / mya ngan la ni chang ni blud pas phan / gnyid med pa yi nad ni 'o mas sel

verses.skt: māṃsaṃ kārśyaṃ laśunaḥ prabhañjanaṃ stabdhagātratāṃ svedaḥ | guḍamañjaryāḥ khapuro nasyāt skandhāṃsabāhurujam
verses.tib: cham pa zho ni sbyar ma dag gis sel / rid pa'i nad la sha ni sbyin par bya / rlung gi nad la sgog skya rab tu bsngags / yan lag rengs pa'i nad ni dugs kyis sel / phrag pa phrag gong lag ngar na ba la

verses.skt: navanītakhaṇḍamarditam auṣṭraṃ mūtraṃ payaś ca hanty udaram | nasyaṃ mūrdhavikārān vidradhim acirotthitam asravisrāvaḥ
verses.tib: 'i nad la mar sar hwags kyis sel / dmu rdzing rnga mo'i gcin dang 'o mas sel / mgo ba'i nad kun la ni sna sman bsngags / khong 'bras gsar du byung la gtar ga gdab

verses.skt: nasyaṃ kavaḍo mukhajān nasyāñjanatarpaṇāni netrarujaḥ | vṛddhasya kṣīraghṛte mūrchāṃ śītāmbumārutacchāyāḥ
verses.tib: kha yi nad kun la ni mkhur bkang phan / mig nad sna sman mig sman brtabs sel / rgas pa la ni 'o ma zhun mar phan / brgyal la chu gang blugs dang grib ma phan

verses.skt: samaśuktārdrakamātrā mande vahnau śrame surā snānam | duḥkhasahatve sthairye vyāyāmo gokṣurur hitaḥ kṛcchre
verses.tib: drod chung ngal dang sge'u gsher tsha ran phan / dub la chang 'thungs lus ni khrus byas phan / sdug bsngal bzod dang brtan la rtsol / pa phan / gcin sri ba la gze ma phan pa yin

verses.skt: kāse nidigdhikā pārśvaśūle puṣkarajā jaṭā | vayasaḥ sthāpane dhātrī triphalā guggulur vraṇe
verses.tib: lud pa lu la kaN+Da ka ri phan / rtsib logs gzer la puSh+kar mU la phan / rgas sra ba la skyu ru ra phan zhing / rma la 'bras bu gsum dang gu gul phan

verses.skt: vastir vātavikārān paittān rekaḥ kaphodbhavān vamanam | kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ sarpiḥ pittaṃ samīraṇaṃ tailam
ity agryaṃ yat proktaṃ rogāṇām auṣadhaṃ śamāyālam | tad deśakālabalato vikalpanīyaṃ yathāyogam
verses.tib: de ltar nad rnams kyi ni sman gyi mchog / bshad pas nad rnams zhi bar nus pa yin / de ni yul dang dus kyi stobs las ni / ci rigs par ni brtags te sbyar bar bya

verses.skt: ity ātreyād āgamayyārthasūtraṃ tatsūktānāṃ peśalānām atṛptaḥ | bheḍādīnāṃ saṃmato bhaktinamraḥ papracchedaṃ saṃśayāno ’gniveśaḥ
verses.tib: de ltar rgyun shes bu las gzhung gi mdo / legs par bshad pa des ni ma ngoms pas / me bzhin 'jug sogs blo mthun dad pas 'dud / the tshom 'di ni me bzhin 'jug gis dris

verses.skt: dṛśyante bhagavan kecid ātmavanto ’pi rogiṇaḥ | dravyopasthātṛsaṃpannā vṛddhavaidyamatānugāḥ
verses.tib: skal ldan kha cig bdag nyid mkhas / sman dang nad g.yog phun sum tshogs / sman pa rgan po'i lung gis ni / rjes su 'jug kyang nad bcas shing

verses.skt: kṣīyamāṇāmayaprāṇā viparītās tathā ’pare | hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmād aniścitam
verses.tib: nad kyis srog ni zad par snang / gzhan dag de las go bzlog snang / de phyir phan dang gnod pa yi / 'bras bu nges pa ma mchis na

verses.skt: kiṃ śāsti śāstram asmin iti kalpayato ’gniveśamukhyasya | śiṣyagaṇasya punarvasur ācakhyau kārtsnyatas tattvam
verses.tib: 'dir ni bstan bcos kyis ci bstan / de ltar me bzhin 'jug sogs slob ma'i tshogs / rtog pa skyes la rgyun shes bu yis ni / de nyid ma lus rnam par bshad gyur pa

verses.skt: na cikitsācikitsā ca tulyā bhavitum arhati | vināpi kriyayā svāsthyaṃ gacchatāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśayā
verses.tib: gso byas ma byas mnyam por bya mi rigs / yan lag drug cu ldan pa yi / gso byed bde 'gyur yod mod kyi

verses.skt: ātaṅkapaṅkamagnānāṃ hastālambo bhiṣagjitam | jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣām eva nauṣadhāt
verses.tib: nad kyi 'dam du bying ba la / lag nas 'dren thabs sman yin no / 'tsho dang 'chi bar 'gyur ba la

verses.skt: na hy upāyam apekṣante sarve rogā na cānyathā | upāyasādhyāḥ sidhyanti nāhetur hetumān yataḥ
verses.tib: kun la sman yod ma yin zhing / thabs la ltos pa ma yin la / gzhan du thabs la ltos pa'i nad / thabs kyis bsgrubs na 'grub 'gyur bas / rgyu med par ni gtan tshigs min

verses.skt: yad uktaṃ sarvasaṃpattiyuktayāpi cikitsayā | mṛtyur bhavati tan naivaṃ nopāye ’sty anupāyatā
verses.tib: gang yang khyed kyi phun tshogs ni / kun dang ldan pas gsos na yang / 'chi 'gyur zhes smra de ma yin / thabs ni thabs min 'gyur yod min

verses.skt: api copāyayuktasya dhīmato jātu cit kriyā | na sidhyed daivavaiguṇyān na tv iyaṃ ṣoḍaśātmikā
verses.tib: gal te de lta'i thabs ldan zhing / blo ldan gso ba byas gyur kyang / sngon las nyes pa ma grub pas / yan lag bcu drug ldan med yin

verses.skt: kasyāsiddho ’gnitoyādiḥ svedastambhādikarmaṇi | na prīṇanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vā kasya kṣīraṃ gavedhukam
verses.tib: me dang chu sogs dugs dang ni / rengs sogs mi 'grub su zhig zer / brta dang nyams smad 'o ma dang / 'bras ngan mi byed su zhig 'dod

verses.skt: kasya māṣātmaguptādau vṛṣyatve nāsti niścayaḥ | viṇmūtrakaraṇākṣepau kasya saṃśayitau yave
verses.tib: ma sha kha sral la sogs la / ro tsa mi nus su zhig zer / bshang gci bskyed dang mang bar ni / nad la the tshom su zhig / zer

verses.skt: viṣaṃ kasya jarāṃ yāti mantratantravivarjitam | kaḥ prāptaḥ kalyatāṃ pathyād ṛte rohiṇikādiṣu
verses.tib: sngags dang rgyud ni med pa ru / gang gis dug ni 'jug par 'gyur / gag pa la sogs gso ba ni / med par gang zhig bde bar 'gyur

verses.skt: api cākālamaraṇaṃ sarvasiddhāntaniścitam | mahatāpi prayatnena vāryatāṃ katham anyathā
verses.tib: 'on kyang dus min 'chi la sogs / grub mtha' kun tu nges par grags / 'bad pa chen po dag gis ni / ji ltar gzhan gyis bzlog par nus

verses.skt: candanādy api dāhādau rūḍham āgamapūrvakam | śāstrād eva gataṃ siddhiṃ jvare laṅghanabṛṃhaṇam
verses.tib: tsan+dan la sogs tsha sogs pa / lung las grags pa bzhin du sel / rims la smyung dang brta ba dag / bstan bcos nyid las grags pa yin

verses.skt: catuṣpādguṇasaṃpanne samyag ālocya yojite | mā kṛthā vyādhinirghātaṃ vicikitsāṃ cikitsite
verses.tib: yan lag bzhi pa'i yon tan 'byor / legs par brtags nas sbyar bya zhing / gzhan du nad kyi tshogs 'joms pa / gso ba the tshom bcas mi bya

verses.skt: etad dhi mṛtyupāśānām akāṇḍe chedanaṃ dṛḍham | rogottrāsitabhītānāṃ rakṣāsūtram asūtrakam
verses.tib: 'di ni dus min 'chi zhags pa / brtan po bcom par byed pa yin / nad kyis skrag cing 'jigs pa la / sngags med pa yi srung skud yin

verses.skt: etat tad amṛtaṃ sākṣāj jagadāyāsavarjitam | yāti hālāhalatvaṃ tu sadyo durbhājanasthitam
verses.tib: 'di ni 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rnams / sel byed bdud rtsi mngon sum yin / snad ngan gnas na 'phral du ni / ha la ha lar 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: ajñātaśāstrasadbhāvāñ chāstramātraparāyaṇān | tyajed dūrād bhiṣakpāśān pāśān vaivasvatān iva
verses.tib: bstan bcos nges pa mi shes shing / tshig tsam la ni rjes gzhol ba'i / gshin rje'i zhags pa thogs pa bzhin / sman pa ngan pa ring du spang

verses.skt: bhiṣajāṃ sādhuvṛttānāṃ bhadram āgamaśālinām | abhyastakarmaṇāṃ bhadraṃ bhadraṃ bhadrābhilāṣiṇām
verses.tib: sman pa gzhung la legs mkhas shing / lung la mkhas pa'i bzang po dang / las la goms shing dge ba ni / bzang por 'dod pa dam pa yin / de ltar rgyud kyi yon tan ldan / rgyud kyi skyon ni spangs gyur pa / gso ba'i bstan bcos ma lus pa / khyab ste yongs su gnas pa yin

verses.skt: iti tantraguṇair yuktaṃ tantradoṣair vivarjitam | cikitsāśāstram akhilaṃ vyāpya yat paritaḥ sthitam
verses.tib: sman pa gzhung la legs mkhas shing / lung la mkhas pa'i bzang po dang / las la goms shing dge ba ni / bzang por 'dod pa dam pa yin / de ltar rgyud kyi yon tan ldan / rgyud kyi skyon ni spangs gyur pa / gso ba'i bstan bcos ma lus pa / khyab ste yongs su gnas pa yin

verses.skt: vipulāmalavijñānamahāmunimatānugam | mahāsāgaragambhīrasaṃgrahārthopalakṣaṇam
verses.tib: drang srong chen po'i gzhung rjes 'jug / rgya che'i dri ma med pa'i gnas / rgya mtsho chen po ltar zab cing / bsdus don nye bar mtshon byed yin

verses.skt: aṣṭāṅgavaidyakamahodadhimanthanena yo ’ṣṭāṅgasaṃgrahamahāmṛtarāśir āptaḥ | tasmād analpaphalam alpasamudyamānāṃ prītyartham etad uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram
verses.tib: sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las / yan lag brgyad bsdus bdud rtsi'i tshogs thob gang / de las don chen rtsol ba zhan pa rnams / dga' bar bya phyir rgyud 'di logs shig byas

verses.skt: idam āgamasiddhatvāt pratyakṣaphaladarśanāt | mantravat saṃprayoktavyaṃ na mīmāṃsyaṃ kathañcana
verses.tib: 'di ni lud chen las grags shing / 'bras bu mngon du ston byed pas / sngags dang 'dra bar legs sbyar gyi / log dpyod nam yang mi bya'o

verses.skt: dīrghajīvitam ārogyaṃ dharmam arthaṃ sukhaṃ yaśaḥ | pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānair adhigacchaty ato dhruvam
verses.tib: 'di bklags rtogs dang nyams blangs pas / tshe ring ba dang nad med dang / chos dang nor dang bde dang grags / nges par 'thob par 'gyur ba yin

verses.skt: etat paṭhan saṃgrahabodhaśaktaḥ svabhyastakarmā bhiṣag aprakampyaḥ | ākampayaty anyaviśālatantrakṛtābhiyogān yadi tan na citram
verses.tib: 'di / ni bltas na bsdus don rtogs nus pas / rang gi goms las sman pas bskyod mi nus / rgya chen rgyud gzhan dag las goms gyur pas / mi bskyod gyur gang de ni ngo mtshar med

verses.skt: yadi carakam adhīte tad dhruvaṃ suśrutādipraṇigaditagadānāṃ nāmamātre ’pi bāhyaḥ | atha carakavihīnaḥ prakriyāyām aklinnaḥ kim iva khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ
verses.tib: gal te tsa ra ka ni bslabs gyur des ni legs thos sogs / las bshad nad kyi ming tsam yang ni shes par 'gyur ma yin / tsa ra ka la ma bslabs gso ba dag ni ma goms pa'i / nyon mongs des ni nad pa rnams kyi gso ba ji ltar bya

verses.skt: abhiniveśavaśād abhiyujyate subhaṇite ’pi na yo dṛḍhamūḍhakaḥ | paṭhatu yatnaparaḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu vaidyakam ādyam anirvidaḥ
verses.tib: mngon par zhen pa'i dbang gis legs par bshad par gyur pa'ang / shin tu rmongs pas mngon par spyad par mi byed gang yin de / de ni dang por sman dpyad bstan bcos skyon med bklags gyur zhing / skyes bu tshe yis ji srid thub kyi bar du bslab par byed

verses.skt: vāte pitte śleṣmaśāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpir mākṣikaṃ ca krameṇa | etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahmajo vā kā nirmantre vaktṛbhedoktiśaktiḥ
verses.tib: rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan zhi bya'i phyir / til mar mar sar sbrang rtsi rim bzhin bsten / de ltar tshangs pa'am tshangs pa'i bu yis bshad / tshig gi dbye bas bshad kyang khyad 'phags med

verses.skt: abhidhātṛvaśāt kiṃ vā dravyaśaktir viśiṣyate | ato matsaram utsṛjya mādhyasthyam avalambyatām
verses.tib: ston pa po yi dbang gis ni / sman gyi nus pa khyad 'phags yin / de bas phrag dog spangs nas ni / bar ma nyid la bsten par bya

verses.skt: ṛṣipraṇīte prītiś cen muktvā carakasuśrutau | bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmād grāhyaṃ subhāṣitam
verses.tib: drang srong gis bshad phyir dga' na / legs thos tsa ra kar ma zad / lug kyis byas ci mi slob / de bas legs bshad gzung bar bya

verses.skt: hṛdayam iva hṛdayam etat sarvāyurvedavāṅmayapayodheḥ | kṛtvā yac chubham āptaṃ śubham astu paraṃ tato jagataḥ
verses.tib: 'di ni tshe yi rig byed rgya mtsho yi / snying po las ni snying po blangs nas su / rnam par sbyar las dge ba gang thob pa / de yis 'gro bas de nyid mthong bar shog

skt: sādhyo ’sādhya iti vyādhir dvidhā tau tu punar dvidhā | susādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaś ca yāpyo yaś cānupakramaḥ
bhuktavāṃś ca śiraḥsnātaḥ śrāntaḥ chardananāvanaiḥ | rātrau jāgaritaś cāpi nāñjyāj jvarita eva ca
asaṃmārjitam ādarśam anupaskṛtakāminīm | rajasvalāṃ ca nekṣeta sadā prātar amaṅgalam
evaṃ kṛtsnadinaṃ nītvā rātrau yāme gṛhe gate | devān ṛṣīn gurūn smṛtvā tataḥ śayanam ācaret
snehasvedavidhis tatra vartayo bhojanāni ca | pānāni vastayaś caiva śastaṃ vātānulomanam
atharvavihitā śāntiḥ pratikūlagrahārcanam | bhūtādyasparśanopāyo nirdiṣṭaś ca pṛthak pṛthak
āvilaṃ samalaṃ nīlaṃ ghanaṃ pītam athāpi ca | sakṣāraṃ picchilaṃ caiva sāmudraṃ tan nigadyate
drākṣekṣavaḥ sakharjūrāḥ śālipiṣṭam yavasya ca | pañca madyākārāḥ śreṣṭhā drākṣā teṣāṃ viśiṣyate
asmād alpāntaraguṇaṃ khārjūraṃ vātalaṃ guru | śārkaraḥ surabhiḥ svāduhṛdyo nātimado laghuḥ
kṛmihṛdrogagulmārśaḥpāṇḍuroganibarhaṇe | te kramād vituṣair vidyāt satuṣaiś ca yavaiḥ kṛte
puṇḍraḥ pāṇḍuḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ pramodo gauraśārivau | kāñcano mahiṣaḥ śūkaḥ dūṣakaḥ kusumāṇḍakaḥ
akṛtaṃ kṛtayūṣaṃ ca tanu saṃskāritaṃ rasam | sūpam amlam anamlaṃ ca guru vidyād yathottaram
mṛgyaṃ vaiṣkirikaṃ kiṃ ca prātudaṃ ca bileśayam | prāsahaṃ ca mahāmṛgyam apcaraṃ mātsyam aṣṭadhā
matsyādipakṣiṇāṃ caiva gurūṇy aṇḍāni cādiśet | tāni snigdhāni vṛṣyāṇi svādupākarasāni ca
svādv amlaṃ laghu kolaṃ tu śuṣkaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca dīpanam
vātaghnaṃ durjaraṃ proktaṃ nāraṅgaṃ kaphakṛd guru | tṛṣṇāśūlakaphotkledacchardiśvāsanivāraṇam
nārikelaṃ guru snigdhaṃ pittaghnaṃ svādu śītalam | balamāṃsakaraṃ hṛdyaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vastiśodhanam
sugandhi sarvapeyānāṃ vyañjanānāṃ ca vāsanam | lehānāṃ khādyapākānāṃ cūrṇānāṃ ca prayojayet
unmīlitavinirbhugne parivartitatārake | bhavatas tatra nayane srute lulitapakṣmaṇī
āmāśaye ’lasībhūtas tena so ’lasakaḥ smṛtaḥ | vividhair vedanodbhedair vāyvādibhṛśakopataḥ
madanaṃ pippalī kuṣṭhaṃ vacā gaurāś ca sarṣapāḥ | guḍakṣārasamāyuktā phalavartiḥ praśasyate
lavaṇād amlamadhurau kāryau syātāṃ yathākramam | vāyor niranubandhasya pākaśāntipravṛttaye
prāk tikto madhuraḥ paścāt kaṣāyo ’nte vidhīyate | taiḥ pittaṃ śamam abhyeti pakvācchīkṛtapiṇḍitam
kaṭuḥ prāk tiktakaḥ paścāt kaṣāyo ’nte vidhīyate | taiḥ śleṣmā śamam abhyeti pakvācchīkṛtapiṇḍitaḥ
sādhāraṇaṃ vā kurvīta kriyām ubhayayoginīm
viṇmūtranakhadantatvakcakṣuṣāṃ pītatā bhavet | raktatvam atha kṛṣṇatvaṃ pṛṣṭhāsthikaṭisaṃdhiruk
śiroruk jāyate tīvrā nidrā virasatā mukhe | kvacic ca śvayathur gātre jvarātīsāraharṣaṇam
vāyuḥ sāmo vibandhāgnisādastambhāntrakūjanaiḥ | vedanāśophanistodaiḥ kramaśo ’ṅgāni pīḍayan
vicared yugapac cāpi gṛhṇāti kupito bhṛśam | snehādyair vṛddhim āyāti sūryameghodaye niśi
nirāmo viśado rūkṣo nirvibandho ’lpavedanaḥ | viparītaguṇaiḥ śāntiṃ snigdhair yāti viśeṣataḥ
durgandhi haritaṃ śyāvaṃ pittam amlaṃ ghanaṃ guru | amlīkākaṇṭhahṛddāhakaraṃ sāmaṃ vinirdiśet
ātāmrapītam atyuṣṇaṃ rase kaṭukam asthiram | pakvaṃ vigandhi vijñeyaṃ rucipaktibalapradam
āvilas tantulaḥ styānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe ’vatiṣṭhate | sāmo balāso durgandhiḥ kṣududgāravighātakṛt
phenavān piṇḍitaḥ pāṇdur niḥsāro ’gandha eva ca | pakvaḥ sa eva vijñeyaś chedavān vaktraśuddhidaḥ
trayaḥ sādhāraṇās teṣām antare prāvṛṣādayaḥ | prāvṛṭ śucinabhau teṣu śarad ūrjasahau smṛtau
tapasyo madhumāsaś ca vasantaḥ śodhanaṃ prati | etān ṛtūn vikalpyaivaṃ dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ bhiṣak
mūrchā dāho ’ratis tṛṣṇā jṛmbhā mohabhramaklamāḥ | bhavanti jīryati snehe jīrṇaḥ syāt taiḥ śamaṃ gataiḥ
svedayanti daśaitāni naram agniguṇād ṛte
manaḥprasādaḥ svāsthyaṃ cāvasthānaṃ ca svayaṃ bhavet | vaiparītyam ayogānāṃ na cātimahatī vyathā
ādhmānasaṃkocapurīṣabandhakṣīṇendriyatvārucibhaṅgaśūlāḥ | pāṅgulyaśākhāśritavātabhagnabandhāś ca sādhyā hy anuvāsanena
virecanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca śamanaṃ ca tridhāpi tat | virecanaṃ śiraḥśūlajāḍyasyandagalāmaye
marśadhmānāvapīḍākhyais tat punaḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ smṛtam
uccairbhāṣaṇam āyāsam ajīrṇāsātmyabhojanam | dattanasyo naraḥ krodhaṃ yānādīṃś ca vivarjayet
vyādher apacayaḥ puṣṭir vaiśadyaṃ vaktralāghavam | indriyāṇāṃ prasādaś ca kavaḍe śuddhilakṣaṇam
hīnāj jāḍyakaphotkleśāv arasajñānam eva ca | atiyogān mukhe pākaḥ śoṣatṛṣṇāruciklamaḥ
piṇḍasya tīkṣṇadravyasya mṛdudravyakṛtasya ca | hareṇumātraṃ dviguṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ kathayanty api
rasakriyāyām apy evaṃ viḍaṅgaphalamātrakam | śalākāṃ dviguṇāṃ tīkṣṇe cūrṇe ca triguṇāṃ mṛdau
hareṇumātrā piṇḍasya vellamātrā rasakriyā | tīkṣṇasya dviguṇaṃ tasya mṛdunaś cūrṇitasya ca
maṇḍalāgraṃ vṛddhipattram utpalādhyardhadhārake | sarpaiṣaṇyau vetasākhyaṃ śarāryāsyatrikūrcake
kuśāsyaṃ sāṭavadanam antarvaktrārdhacandrake | vrīhimukhaṃ kuṭhārī ca śalākāṅguliśastrake
baḍiśaṃ karapattrākhyaṃ kartarī nakhaśastrakam | dantalekhanakaṃ sūcyaḥ kūrco nāma khajāhvayam
gulmārśovidradhīn kuṣṭhavātaraktagalāmayān | netrarugviṣavīsarpān śamayanti jalaukasaḥ
vātikaṃ śoṇitaṃ śīghraṃ bhūmiḥ pibati cāvṛtam | makṣikāṇām akāntaṃ ca raktaṃ bhavati paittikam
ślaiṣmikaṃ makṣikākrāntaṃ śuṣyaty api na ceṇayat
nirvyādhinīlotpalapattranetraṃ suvyaktamūlāsitabaddhakeśam | candropamaṃ padmasugandhi vaktraṃ bhavel lalāṭe tu sirāvyadhena
vraṇe śvayathur āyāsāt sa ca rāgaś ca jāgarāt | tau ca ruk ca divāsvāpāt tāś ca mṛtyuś ca maithunāt
vidadhyāt teṣu teṣv eva kośam aṅguliparvasu | svastikaṃ karṇakakṣādistaneṣūktaṃ ca saṃdhiṣu
khaṭvāṃ gaṇḍe hanau śaṅkhe vibandhaṃ pṛṣṭhakodare | aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimeḍhrāgre sthagikām antravṛddhiṣu
vitānaṃ pṛthulāṅgādau tathā śirasi cerayet | vilambini tathotsaṅgaṃ nāsauṣṭhacibukādiṣu
goṣphaṇaṃ saṃdhiṣu tathā yamakaṃ yamike vraṇe | vṛtte ’ṅge maṇḍalākhyaṃ ca pañcāṅgīṃ cordhvajatruṣu
viṣāgniśastrāśanimṛtyutulyaḥ kṣāro bhaved alpam atiprayuktaḥ | rogān nihanyād acireṇa ghorān sa dhīmatā samyaganuprayukto
śastrakṣārāgnayo yasmān mṛtyoḥ paramam āyudham | apramatto bhiṣak tasmāt tān samyag avacārayet
vāmapārśvāśritaṃ nābheḥ kiñcit sūryasya maṇḍalam | tanmadhye maṇḍalaṃ saumyaṃ tanmadhye ’gnir vyavasthitaḥ
jarāyumātrapracchannaḥ kācakośasthadīpavat
āyuṣmati kriyāḥ sarvāḥ saphalāḥ saṃprayojitāḥ | bhavanti bhiṣajāṃ bhūtyai kṛtajña iva bhūbhuji
kṣīṇāyuṣi kṛtaṃ karma vyarthaṃ kṛtam ivādhame | ayaśo dehasaṃdehaṃ svārthahāniṃ ca yacchati
tarhīdānīṃ gatāsūnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpracakṣate | vikṛtiḥ prakṛteḥ prājñaiḥ pradiṣṭā riṣṭasaṃjñayā
so ’mlābhilāṣī puruṣaḥ pittān maraṇam aśnute | yasya gomayacūrṇābhaṃ cūrṇaṃ mūrdhni mukhe ’pi vā
pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvarādiṣv atimātrayā | yaṃ viśanti viśaty enaṃ mṛtyur jvarapuraḥsaraḥ
candanośīramadirākuṇapadhvāṅkṣagandhayaḥ | śaivālakukkuṭaśikhākuṅkumālamaṣīprabhāḥ
vāyunā kapharuddhena pittam antaḥ prapīḍitam | vyavāyitvāc ca sūkṣmatvād bahirmārgaṃ pravartate
manaso viṣayāṇāṃ ca kālaṃ taṃ taṃ prapadyate | dhātūn prakṣobhayan doṣo mokṣakāle vilīyate
kṣīṇamāṃsabalaṃ jahyāt pūrvaliṅgair upadrutam | pratyākhyāya naraṃ cāśu dravyavantam upācaret
iti vṛddhinidānam atha gulmanidānam
vyādhīnāṃ saṃśayaṃ chettum anyato yo ’pramattavān | nidānaṃ satataṃ tena cintanīyaṃ vipaścitā
śamayet pittam evādau jvareṣu samavāyiṣu | durnivārataraṃ tad dhi jvarārtānāṃ viśeṣataḥ
chardimūrchāpipāsādīn avirodhāñ jvarasya tu
galagrahaṃ pūtinasyaṃ mūrchāyam aruciṃ jvaram | gulmaṃ plīhānam ānāhaṃ kilāsaṃ mūtrakṛcchratām
kuṣṭhāny arśāṃsi vīsarpaṃ varṇanāśaṃ bhagandaram | buddhīndriyoparodhaṃ ca kuryāt stambhitam āditaḥ
susūkṣmā māṣapiṣṭī ca ghṛtabhṛṣṭā śivasya ca | ruṇaddhi mūrdhalepena nāsāraktaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
śaṭhītāmalakībhārgīcaṇḍāvālakapauṣkaram | śarkarāṣṭaguṇaṃ cūrṇaṃ hidhmāśvāsaharaṃ param
laghum acyutavīryaṃ ca sujaraṃ balakṛc ca yat
iti chardicikitsitam atha hṛdrogacikitsitam
bhidyate saptarātreṇa pavanena yathā ghanaḥ || 33+(1™)ab || pañcakolaśaṭhīpathyāguḍabījāhvapauṣkaram | vāruṇīkalkitaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ yamake lavaṇānvitam
yuktamadyasya madyottho na vyādhir upajāyate | ato ’sya vakṣyate yogo yaḥ sukhāyaiva kevalam
āśvinaṃ yā mahat tejo balaṃ sārasvataṃ ca yā | dadhāty aindraṃ ca yā vīryaṃ prabhāvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yā
astraṃ makaraketor yā puruṣārtho balasya yā | sautrāmaṇyāṃ dvijamukhe yā hutāśe ca hvayate
yā sarvauṣadhisaṃpūrṇān mathyamānāt surāsuraiḥ | mahodadheḥ samudbhūtā śrīśaśāṅkāmṛtaiḥ saha
madhumādhavamaireyasīdhugauḍāsavādibhiḥ | madaśaktim anujjhantī yā rūpair bahubhiḥ sthitā
yām āsvādya vilāsinyo yathārthaṃ nāma bibhrati | kulāṅganāpi yāṃ pītvā nayaty uddhatamānasā
anaṅgāliṅgitair aṅgaiḥ kvāpi ceto muner api | taraṅgabhaṅgabhrūkuṭītarjanair māninīmanaḥ
ekaṃ prasādya kurute yā dvayor api nirvṛtim | yathākāmaṃ bhaṭāvāptiparihṛṣṭāpsarogaṇe
tṛṇavat puruṣā yuddhe yām āsvādya tyajanty asūn | yāṃ śīlayitvāpi ciraṃ bahudhā bahuvigrahām
nityaṃ harṣātivegena tatpūrvam iva sevate | śokodvegāratibhayair yāṃ dṛṣṭvā nābhibhūyate
goṣṭhīmahotsavodyānaṃ na yasyāḥ śobhate vinā | smṛtvā smṛtvā ca bahuśo viyuktaḥ śocate yayā
aprasannāpi yā prītyai prasannā svarga eva yā | apīndraṃ manyate duḥsthaṃ hṛdayasthitayā yayā
anirdeśyasukhāsvādā svayaṃvedyaiva yā param | iti citrāsv avasthāsu priyām anukaroti yā
priyātipriyatāṃ yāti yat priyasya viśeṣataḥ | yā prītir yā ratir vā vāg yā puṣṭir iti ca stutā
devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasamānuṣaiḥ | pānapravṛttau satyāṃ tu tāṃ surāṃ vidhinā pibet
saṃbhavanti na te rogā medo'nilakaphodbhavāḥ | vidhiyuktād ṛte madyād ye na sidhyanti dāruṇāḥ
asti dehasya sāvasthā yasyāṃ pānaṃ nivāryate | anyatra madyān nigadād vividhauṣadhasaṃskṛtāt
ānūpaṃ jāṅgalaṃ ṃāṃsaṃ vidhināpy upakalpitam | madyaṃ sahāyam aprāpya samyak pariṇamet katham
sutīvramārutavyādhighātino laśunasya ca | madyamāṃsaviyuktasya prayoge syāt kiyān guṇaḥ
nigūḍhaśalyāharaṇe śastrakṣārāgnikarmaṇi | pītamadyaś viṣahate sukhaṃ vaidyavikatthanām
analottejanaṃ rucyaṃ śokaśramavinodakam | na cātaḥ param asty anyad ārogyabalapuṣṭikṛt
rakṣatā jīvitaṃ tasmāt peyam ātmavatā sadā | āśritopāśritahitaṃ paramaṃ dharmasādhanam

snātaḥ praṇamya suravipragurūn yathāsvaṃ vṛttiṃ vidhāya ca samastaparigrahasya | āpānabhūmim atha gandhajalābhiṣiktām āhāramaṇḍapasamīpagatāṃ śrayet || 75 || svāstṛte ’tha śayane kamanīye mitrabhṛtyaramaṇīsamavetaḥ | svaṃ yaśaḥ kathakacāraṇasaṃghair uddhataṃ niśamayann atilokam
vilāsinīnāṃ ca vilāsaśobhi gītaṃ sanṛtyaṃ kalatūryaghoṣaiḥ | kāñcīkalāpaiś calakiṅkiṇīkaiḥ krīḍāvihaṅgaiś ca kṛtānunādam
maṇikanakasamutthair āvaneyair vicitraiḥ | sajalavividhalekhakṣaumavastrāvṛtāṅgaiḥ | api munijanacittakṣobhasaṃpādinībhiś | cakitahariṇalolaprekṣaṇībhiḥ priyābhiḥ
stananitambakṛtād atigauravād alasam ākulam īśvarasaṃbhramāt | iti gataṃ dadhatībhir asaṃsthitaṃ taruṇacittavilobhanakārmaṇam
yauvanāsavamattābhir vilāsādhiṣṭhitātmabhiḥ | saṃcāryamāṇaṃ yugapat tanvaṅgībhir itastataḥ
tālavṛntanalinīdalānilaiḥ śītalīkṛtam atīva śītalaiḥ | darśane ’pi vidadhad vaśānugam svāditaṃ kim uta cittajanmanaḥ
cūtarasendumṛgaiḥ kṛtavāsaṃ mallikayojjvalayā ca sanātham | sphāṭikaśuktigataṃ sataraṅgaṃ kāntam anaṅgam ivodvahad aṅgam
tālīśādyaṃ cūrṇam elādikaṃ vā hṛdyaṃ prāśya prāg vayaḥsthāpanaṃ vā | tatprārthibhyo bhūmibhāge sumṛṣṭe toyonmiśraṃ dāpayitvā tataś ca
dhṛtimān smṛtimān nityam anūnādhikam ācaran | ucitenopacāreṇa sarvam evopapādayan
jitavikasitāsitasarojanayanasaṃkrāntivardhitaśrīkam | kāntāmukham iva saurabhahṛtamadhupagaṇaṃ piben madyam

pītvaivaṃ caṣakadvayaṃ parijanaṃ sanmānya sarvaṃ tato | gatvāhārabhuvaṃ puraḥ subhiṣajo bhuñjīta bhūyo ’tra ca | māṃsāpūpaghṛtārdrakādiharitair yuktaṃ sasauvarcalair | dvis trir vā niśi cālpam eva vanitāsaṃvalganārthaṃ pibet
rahasi dayitām aṅke kṛtvā bhujāntarapīḍanāt | pulakitatanuṃ jātasvedāṃ sakampapayodharām | yadi sarabhasaṃ sīdhor vāraṃ na pāyayate kṛtī | kim anubhavati kleśaprāyaṃ tato gṛhatantratām
itthaṃ yuktyā piban madyaṃ na trivargād vihīyate | asārasaṃsārasukhaṃ paramaṃ cādhigacchati
aiśvaryasyopabhogo ’yaṃ spṛhaṇīyaḥ surair api | anyathā hi vipatsu syāt paścāt tāpendhanaṃ dhanam
upabhogena rahito bhogavān iti nindyate | nirmito ’tikadaryo ’yaṃ vidhinā nidhipālakaḥ
tasmād vyavasthayā pānaṃ pānasya satataṃ hitam | jitvā viṣayalubdhānām indriyāṇāṃ svatantratām
vidhir vasumatām eṣa bhaviṣyadvasavas tu ye | yathopapatti tair madyaṃ pātavyaṃ mātrayā hitam
yāvad dṛṣṭer na saṃbhrāntir yāvan na kṣobhate manaḥ | tāvad eva virantavyaṃ madyād ātmavatā sadā
abhyaṅgodvartanasnānavāsadhūpānulepanaiḥ | snigdhoṣṇair bhāvitaś cānnaiḥ pānaṃ vātottaraḥ pibet
śītopacārair vividhair madhurasnigdhaśītalaiḥ | paittiko bhāvitaś cānnaiḥ piban madyaṃ na sīdati
upacārair aśiśirair yavagodhūmabhuk pibet | ślaiṣmiko dhanvajair māṃsair madyaṃ māricikaiḥ saha
kāsīsaṃ saindhavaṃ rāsnā śuṇṭhī kuṣṭhaṃ ca lāṅgalī | śilābhrakāśvamāraṃ ca jantuhṛd danticitrakau
haritālaṃ tathā svarṇakṣīrī taiś ca pacet samaiḥ | tailaṃ sudhārkapayasī gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe
etad abhyaṅgato ’rśāṃsi kṣāravat pātayed drutam | kṣārakarmakaraṃ hy etan na ca dūṣayate valīm
eraṇḍabilvayavagokṣurakāmlasiddhāṃ pathyāṃ lihan madhuyutām atha vā guḍena | kṛcchrapravṛttam atiśūlam asṛgvimiśraṃ hanyād avaśyam atisāram udīrṇavegam
nāgarātiviṣāmustābhūnimbāmṛtavatsakaiḥ | sarvajvaraharaḥ kvāthaḥ sarvātīsāranāśanaḥ
kaṣāyaḥ śitalaḥ peyo jvarātīsāraśāntaye | hṛllāsārocakacchardipipāsādāhanāśanaḥ
kaṭvaṅgabilvajaṃ tv asthi kapitthaṃ surasāñjanam | lākṣāharidre hrīveraṃ kaṭphalaṃ śukanāsikā
pibet tenaiva toyena jvarātīsāranāśanaḥ | raktaprasādano hy eṣa śophātīsāranāśanaḥ
kaṭphalaṃ madhukaṃ lodhraṃ tvagdāḍimaphalasya ca | vātapittātisāraghnaṃ pibet taṇḍulavāriṇā
pītadāru vacā lodhraṃ kaliṅgaphalanāgaram | dāḍimāmbuyutaṃ dadyāt pittaśleṣmātisāriṇe
candanam utpalaṃ drākṣā uśīraṃ ca punarnavā | yaṣṭīmadhukaśrīkhaṇḍaṃ triphalotpalaśārivā
śamī vaṃśaphalaṃ lodhraṃ trijātaṃ nāgakesaram | padmakaṃ ca kaṇācūrṇaṃ tattulyā śarkarā śubhā
etac cūrṇaṃ pibet prātas taṇḍulodakavāriṇā | pramehe raktapitte ca kṛcchradoṣe ca dāruṇe
saṃcūrṇya madhunā lihyāt tadvac cūrṇaṃ navāyasam | madhumehitvam āpanno bhiṣagbhiḥ parivarjitaḥ
śaubhāñjanakaniryūho hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyutaḥ | acirād vidradhiṃ hanti prātaḥ prātar niṣevitaḥ
kaṭutrikaṃ tiktakarohiṇī ghanaṃ kirātatikto ’tha śatakrator yavāḥ | sasaptaparṇātiviṣā durālabhā paṭolamūlaṃ saha trāyamāṇayā
guḍūcīcavyaṃ saviḍaṅganimbaṃ priyaṅgunīlotpalalodhram añjanam | sadhātakīmocarasaṃ phalatrikaṃ sanāgaraṃ bilvakapitthaśārivāḥ

samāḥ syur ete dviguṇaṃ tu citrakaṃ dvir aṣṭabhāgaṃ kuṭajatvacaṃ syāt | susūkṣmapiṣṭaṃ śiśirāmbuyojitaṃ piben manuṣyo ’rdhapalaṃ guḍānvitam || 27+4 || bubhukṣite syān mṛdu bhojanaṃ hitaṃ śaśaiḥ salāvair athavā ’pi tittiraiḥ | nihanti gulmān kaphapittasaṃbhavān virājate śāradapūrṇacandravat

etad vatsakasaptakarṣasahitaṃ suślakṣṇacūrṇīkṛtaṃ | vāsāyāḥ svarasena pañca caturas trīn vā pibed vāsarān | bhūyas tad guḍavāriṇā pratidinaṃ peyaṃ puraḥsthe ravau | etad vidradhirogiṇāṃ nirujakṛc cūrṇaṃ tu guhyottamam
nāputrāya na cābhrātre nāśiṣyāyāhitaiṣiṇe | ārogyaśāstrasarvasvaṃ deyam etat kathañcana

mūlaṃ bilvakapitthayoḥ aralukasyāgner bṛhatyor dvayoḥ | śyāmāpūtikarañjaśigrukataror viśvauṣadhāruṣkaram | kṛṣṇāgranthikavellapañcalavaṇakṣārājamodānvitaṃ | pītaṃ kāñjikatoya...mathitaiś cūrṇīkṛtaṃ vardhmajit
ajājīkuṣṭhagomedahapuṣābadarāṇi ca | āranālena lepaḥ syād vardhmajit param auṣadham
avikṣīreṇa godhūmacūrṇaṃ kandurukasya ca | pralepanaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ syād vardhmajit param auṣadham
mṛtamātre tu vai kāke viśastena pralepayet | muhūrtaṃ vardhma medhāvī tatkṣaṇād arujo bhavet
ayastilatryūṣaṇakolabhāgaiḥ sarvaiḥ samaṃ mākṣikadhātucūrṇam | tair modakaḥ kṣaudrayuto ’nutakraḥ pāṇḍvāmaye dūragate ’pi śastaḥ || 57+1 ||
rasas tathaivārdrakanāgarasya peyo ’tha jīrṇe payasānnam adyāt | śilāhvayaṃ vā triphalārasena hanyāt tridoṣaṃ śvayathuṃ prasahya
punarnavānimbapaṭolaśuṇṭhī tiktāmṛtādārvyabhayākaṣāyaḥ | sarvāṅgaśophodarakāsaśūlaśvāsānvitaṃ pāṇḍugadaṃ ca hanti
vratadamayamasevātyāgaśīlābhiyogo | dvijasuragurupūjā sarvasattveṣu maitrī | śivaśivasutatārābhāskarārādhanāni | prakaṭitamalapāpaṃ kuṣṭham unmūlayanti
vāggrahe koṣṇatoyena vetasāmlaṃ piben naraḥ | mātuluṅgarasaṃ tadvad dhiṅgusauvarcalānvitam
navanītena saṃyuktāṃ khāden māṣeṇḍarīṃ naraḥ | durvāram arditaṃ hanti saptāhān nātra saṃśayaḥ
māṣabalāśukaśimbīkaṭtṛṇarāsnāśvagandhorubūkāṇām | kvātho nasyanipīto rāmaṭhalavaṇānvitaḥ koṣṇaḥ
apanayati pakṣavātaṃ manyāstambhaṃ sakarṇanādarujam | durjayam arditavātaṃ saptāhāj jayati cāvaśyam
guḍamañjaryā khapuraṃ vṛṣabhīmūlaṃ ca śiśirajalapiṣṭam | nāvanavidhau prayojitam avabāhukagalarujārtiharam
citrakendrayavāḥ pāṭhā kaṭukātiviṣā niśā | vātavyādhipraśamano yogaḥ ṣaḍdharaṇāhvayaḥ
bṛhannimbataror mūlaṃ vāriṇā paripeṣitam | saṃpītaṃ nāśayet kṣipram asādhyām api gṛdhrasīm
tūṇīpratūṇyor lavanaṃ saghṛtaṃ kṣārahiṅgu vā | raktāvasecanaṃ kuryād abhīkṣṇaṃ vātakaṇṭake
pibed eraṇḍatailaṃ vā dahet sūcībhir eva vā | sājyaiḥ saktubhir abhyaktau na cākṣīrasamanvitaiḥ
karṣāṃśe trivṛtā dantī khāded iṣṭānupānataḥ | vividham api vātaraktaṃ srutaśuṣkasphuṭitam api hanti
vraṇakāsakuṣṭhagulmaśvayathūdarapāṇḍumeham arśāṃsi | abhibhūya jarādoṣaṃ karoti kaiśorakaṃ kāyam
sopadravaṃ sāṅgaśūlaṃ sarvagātrānugaṃ tathā | vātāsṛkpittadāhārtijvaraghnaṃ balavarṇakṛt
bhakṣayet prātar utthāya śītaṃ cānu pibej jalam
mahendrarāmakṛṣṇānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ gavām api | tapasā tejasā vāpi praśāmyadhvaṃ śivāya vai
mantreṇānena matimān sarvam apy auṣadhaṃ nayet
śuṣkadravyaṃ yadā na syāt tadā sadyaḥsamuddhṛtam | dviguṇaṃ tat prayoktavyaṃ kuḍavādi dravaṃ tathā
aṅgānuktau tu mūlaṃ syād aprasiddhau tad eva tu | dvau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolaṃ badaraṃ draṅkṣaṇaś ca tau
ṣaḍ vaṃśyas tu marīciḥ syāt ṣaṇ marīcyas tu sarṣapaḥ | taṇḍulaḥ sarṣapās tv aṣṭau dhānyamāṣas tu tau yavaḥ
hanumūlagato vāyur dantadeśāsthigocaraḥ | yadā śiśoḥ prakupito nottiṣṭhanti tadā dvijāḥ
rūkṣāśino vātikasya cālayaty anilaḥ sirāḥ | hanvāśrayāḥ prasuptasya dantaiḥ śabdaṃ karoty ataḥ
vacāśvagandhāsurasayuktaiḥ sarpir vipācayet | tan nāśayed grahān sarvān pānenābhyañjanena ca
gośṛṅgacarmavālāhinirmokaṃ vṛṣadaṃśaviṭ | nimbapattrājyakaṭukāmadanaṃ bṛhatīdvayam
piṣṭaṃ citrāśvinīpuṣye ṣaḍvidhe timire hitam | prasādanaṃ ca dṛṣṭeḥ syāc cakṣuṣeṇāvabhāṣitam
tac cūrṇitaṃ sthitaṃ śaṅkhe dṛkprasādanam añjanam | śastaṃ sarvākṣirogeṣu videhapatinirmitam
tutthaṃ sakāśaṃ kanakaṃ saphalaṃ śaṅkhaśilāgairikam añjanaṃ ca | naraḥ kapālasahikūṅkuḍāṇḍaṃ saptadvisaptatrisamayo gataḥ
bhṛṅgodbhavasvarasabhāvitam ājadugdhe mūtre gavām payasi ca triphalākaṣāye | drākṣārase ca pariśuddham iti krameṇa sauvīram añjanam idaṃ timiraṃ nihanti
tāmrāyaskāntagandhāhvātārkṣā yat succhalaṃ rajaḥ | lohe bhṛṅgarajo bhṛṣṭaṃ saptāhaṃ dṛṣṭirogajit
vartiś caturdaśāṅgī nayanāmayanāśanī śilāstambhe | likhitā hitāya jagatas timirāpaharī viśeṣeṇa
ekaguṇā māgadhikā dviguṇā ca harītakī salilapiṣṭā | vartir iyaṃ timirapaṭalakācakaṇḍvasraharī
badarīpattrayaṣṭyāhvapathyāmalakatutthakam | antardhūmaṃ dahet sadyaḥ kope taccūrṇaṃ vātaje
manaḥśilāviḍaṅgālavacātrikaṭuhiṅgubhiḥ | cūrṇīkṛtya samāghrātaḥ pratiśyāyo vinaśyati
varāhakarṇīmūlaṃ vā śarapuṅkhājaṭāthavā | vartir vāvalgujaphalair bījapūrajaṭānvitaiḥ
bhṛṅgarajastriphalotpalasārilohapurīṣasamanvitakāri | tailam idaṃ paca dāruṇahāri luñcitakeśaghanasthirakāri
nīlotpalaṃ sotpalakuṣṭhayuktaṃ sapippalīkaṃ madhukaṃ śatāhvam | saśṛṅgaveraṃ śirasaḥ pralepaḥ sadyaḥ śirorogavināśanāya
sādhitaṃ svarase tailaṃ kākamācyāś caturguṇe | gatibhājām api hitaṃ vraṇānāṃ ropaṇaṃ param
upodakāpattrapiṇḍyā chadair ācchāditaṃ ghanam | niveśya paṭṭaṃ badhnīyāc chāmyaty evaṃ navārbudam
kṣuṇṇāni nimbapattrāṇi k ptair bhallātakaiḥ saha | śarāvasaṃpuṭe dagdhvā sārdhaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ samaiḥ
yān avijñāya muhyeta cikitsāyāṃ cikitsakaḥ
strīṇām apatyajananaṃ yonirujādoṣajit sadā yuñjyāt | uttaravastiṣu sarpir yojyaṃ kalyāṇakaṃ nāma
candano natayośīratiktāpadmebhakesaraiḥ | kuṭajatvakphalaṃ mustaṃ jambvāmrāsthi rasāñjanam
padmakotpalabilvābdakaṭphalaiḥ sādhitā niśā | dhātakyativiṣāmāṃsīpāṭhāmocarasodakam
madhūkaṃ madhukānantāśārivādāḍima[tva]cam | mṛllodhrārjunaśaileyasamaṅgā nāgarāḥ samāḥ
cūrṇaṃ śreṣṭhāmbunā pītaṃ hanti lohitamehinam | mūrchātṛṣṇājvarārtāya raktātīsāramehinām
rasaṃ śirīṣapattrāṇāṃ kalkaṃ ca ṣaḍahaḥ pibet | kṣīropanāśinā yoṣid ṛtusnātā sutārthinī
vāsavo vṛtram avadhīt samāliptaḥ kilāmunā
tryūṣaṇaṃ pañcalavaṇaṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ rajanīdvayam | sūkṣmailāṃ trivṛtāṃ pattraṃ viḍaṅgānīndravāruṇīm
madhukaṃ ceti sakṣaudraṃ goviṣāṇe nidhāpayet | tasmād uṣṇāmbunā mātrāṃ prāgbhaktaṃ yojayet tathā
viṣaṃ bhuktaṃ jarāṃ yāti nirviṣe ’pi na doṣakṛt | lākṣāpriyaṅgumañjiṣṭhāḥ samṛṇālahareṇukāḥ
sayaṣṭyāhvā madhuyutā bastapittena kalpitāḥ | nikhaned goviṣāṇasthāḥ saptarātraṃ mahītale
tatra kṛtvā maṇiṃ hemnā baddhaṃ hastena dhārayet | saṃspṛṣṭaṃ saviṣaṃ tena sadyo bhavati nirviṣam
jatusarjarasośīrasarṣapāpattravālakaiḥ | savaillāruṣkarapuraiḥ kusumair arjunasya ca
dhūpo vāsagṛhe hanti viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | na tatra kīṭāḥ saviṣā nondurā na sarīsṛpāḥ
na kṛtyāḥ kārmaṇādyāś ca dhūpo ’yaṃ yatra dahyate
vāriguñjāphalośīraṃ netrayor viṣaduṣṭayoḥ | añjanaṃ vāriṇā piṣṭaṃ gāruḍaṃ garuḍopamam
bhinnasvaraṃ raktanetraṃ śīrṇāṅgaṃ kṛmibhakṣitam
pañcāṣṭau sapta daśa vā pippalīr madhusarpiṣā | rasāyanaguṇānveṣī samām ekāṃ prayojayet
śītīkṛtā hīnabalair vīkṣya doṣāmayān prati
śītavātahimadagdhatanūnāṃ stabdhabhagnakuṭilavyathitāsthnām | bheṣajasya pavanopahatānāṃ vakṣyate vidhir ato laśunasya
vastir vātavikārān paittān rekaḥ kaphodbhavān vamanam | kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ sarpiḥ pittaṃ samīraṇaṃ tailam
